title: GRC Analyst
description:
**About Origin Medical Research Lab**

Origin Medical Research Lab is the research arm of Origin Medical. Here, we strive to bring together the best and brightest minds at the intersection of AI and healthcare to fulfill Origin Medical’s mission.

By combining the knowledge of healthcare and AI, it is on a journey to build state-of-the-art solutions aimed at supporting a broad spectrum of healthcare providers in rural and urban communities, allowing them to practice at the top of their licenses. With AI in the imaging workflow, clinicians can more confidently deliver timely interventions, enhance pregnancy outcomes, identify high-risk pregnancies to reduce maternal mortality, and significantly lower infant mortality rates.

Origin Medical, headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, USA, is driven by a mission to advance maternal health equity by improving access to quality prenatal care with artificial intelligence.

**About Governance, Risk, and Compliance Team and the Role**

Our Governance, Risk & Compliance team ensures Origin Medical's quality assurance standards and regulatory obligations are upheld across all processes, taking a proactive approach to translating evolving regulations into actionable compliance practices.

As an Information Security Analyst, you will own the assessment and strengthening of Origin Medical's cloud, product, and infrastructure security posture through a GRC lens. This role sits at the intersection of compliance rigor and hands-on technical assessment. You will work cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, and Legal teams to ensure all controls are documented, auditable, and aligned to applicable regulatory frameworks.

**What will you do?**

**Cloud, Product & Infrastructure Security Assessment**

* Conduct GRC-led security assessments of cloud environments (AWS / GCP / Azure), internal product infrastructure, and data pipelines against ISO 27001, NIST 800-53, SOC 2, and HIPAA controls
* Document technical, administrative, and physical controls for cloud and product environments, driving remediation of identified gaps to closure

**Risk Management & Compliance**

* Build and maintain a data security risk register and reporting framework aligned to ISO 27001, ISO 27701, and NIST SP 800-53 for governance committees and leadership
* Manage exception review processes and escalate critical risk findings to leadership with prioritized remediation plans

**Audit & Regulatory Compliance**

* Prepare evidence packages and coordinate responses for security assessments and audits under HIPAA, HITRUST, and SOC 2
* Own the lifecycle management of information security policies, standards, and supporting compliance documentation

**Cross-Functional & Operational Security**

* Collaborate with Engineering, Product, and Operations teams to embed security policies and drive a culture of compliance across the organization
* Analyze security incidents, coordinate remediation actions, and lead post-incident awareness and documentation efforts

**Who are we looking for?**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science & Engineering, Information Security, Cybersecurity, Networking, or Computer Applications
* At least 1–3 years of hands-on GRC or information security compliance experience
* Prior exposure to cloud security assessments (AWS, GCP, or Azure) from a risk or compliance perspective is strongly preferred
* Working knowledge of ISO 27001, HIPAA, SOC 2, and familiarity with NIST CSF / 800-53, HITRUST, GDPR, and DPDPA, cloud security concepts such as IAM, encryption, logging, and network segmentation.
* Strong Python/scripting skills for compliance automation and experience with GRC platforms such as Vanta, Drata, or OneTrust is a plus
* ISO 27001 Lead Implementer / Lead Auditor, CISA, CISM, CRISC, CEH, or CCSP
* Specific training in NIST CSF, HIPAA Security Rule, or HITRUST CSF is a plus
* Ability to independently own assessment projects end-to-end with strong attention to detail and a data-driven approach to risk decision-making
* Strong written and verbal communication in English, able to present complex security findings clearly to both technical teams and senior leadership

**Working at Origin Medical Research Lab**

You will receive competitive monthly compensation aligned with industry standards. Additionally, we provide a comprehensive benefits package, including:

* Provident fund
* Paid annual leaves
* Sick leaves
* Wellness allowance
* Insurance allowance

You will work with an exceptional team of highly qualified individuals who strive towards a common goal of delivering a product that improves the standard of care for expecting mothers everywhere.

You will also collaborate with renowned clinicians, AI scientists, and business leaders from around the world.

At Origin Medical Research Lab, we take pride in fostering an inclusive and optimistic company culture that places great value on collaboration, teamwork, and work-life balance. As a valued member of our team, you will have the opportunity to join a supportive environment where individuals genuinely care about each other's success and well-being. title: Senior CAS Analyst
description:
**Job Summary**
The Senior CAS Analyst is an individual contributor responsible for strengthening client authentication and identity verification controls across Retail, Private and Business Banking. The role develops, implements and governs Client Authentication Standards; provides clear, risk-based guidance to business, operations, technology, compliance and fraud teams; and supports consistent adoption across markets. The role helps protect clients and the Bank by ensuring authentication requirements remain aligned with emerging fraud risks, regulatory expectations and secure banking practices.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Authentication standards and policy governance:**
Develop, maintain and implement authentication-related standards, policies and governance frameworks in line with regulatory requirements, internal policies and the Fraud Risk Management Framework.
  
  
**Subject matter expertise and stakeholder guidance:**
Act as a subject matter expert for client authentication and identity verification controls, including MFA/2FA, biometrics, soft tokens, OTPs, device binding and knowledge-based authentication. Interpret requirements and provide clear, practical guidance to country, business, operations, technology, risk and compliance teams.
  
  
**Consistent implementation across markets**
: Drive consistent adoption of Client Authentication Standards across countries, customer segments and channels. Lead gap assessments, coordinate remediation, maintain implementation evidence and support cross-functional programmes that strengthen customer security while enabling business objectives.
  
  
**Risk, dispensation and control oversight:**
Identify and assess authentication-related risks; review dispensations, risk acceptances and compensating controls; and ensure appropriate safeguards for higher-risk transactions. Maintain accurate documentation, approvals, governance records and audit trails, and support internal audits and regulatory reviews.
  
  
**Governance, reporting and continuous improvement:**
Monitor compliance and control effectiveness, escalate material gaps, and provide transparent reporting to senior stakeholders and governance forums. Update standards in response to emerging fraud threats, regulatory change, industry practice and lessons from control reviews, while influencing outcomes without direct authority.
  
  
**Motivations**
This role suits someone motivated by solving complex fraud-risk and authentication challenges, translating policy into practical controls, and creating consistent outcomes across diverse markets and channels. The role will appeal to a collaborative, curious and action-oriented professional who values strong governance, clear evidence, continuous improvement and the opportunity to influence senior stakeholders while protecting clients and enabling secure banking experiences.
  
  
**Skills And Experience**
**Priority Skills**

* Fraud Risk Management
* Client Authentication and Identity Verification
* Policy and Standards Governance
* Risk and Control Assessment
* Stakeholder Management and Influencing
* Business Analysis and Data Analytics
* Microsoft Word and Document Management

**Other Skills**

* Regulatory and Compliance Awareness
* Written and Verbal Communication
* Programme and Change Delivery
* Banking Operations and Processes
* Technology and Information Security Awareness

**Qualifications**

* Experience: Substantial experience, typically 8-10 years, in customer authentication, identity verification, fraud prevention, risk management or related controls across digital and assisted banking channels.
* Strong understanding of banking operations and customer journeys across Retail, Private and/or Business Banking, with experience in policy interpretation, control design, gap assessment, dispensation governance, stakeholder management and executive reporting.
* Qualification: Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience in banking, risk, fraud, technology, cybersecurity, compliance or a related discipline.
* Knowledge and capabilities: Working knowledge of authentication mechanisms such as OTP, MFA/2FA, biometrics, soft tokens and device-based authentication, together with strong analytical, documentation, planning and problem-solving skills.
* Stakeholder capability: Demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority, simplify complex requirements, manage competing priorities and collaborate effectively with business, operations, technology, risk, compliance, auditors and regulators.
* Languages: Strong written and spoken English. Additional market-relevant language capability is advantageous but not mandatory.

**About Standard Chartered**
We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.
  
  
Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
* In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
* Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
* A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

* Monitor administrative

* Role management
* Access reviews

* Application integration processes

* Develop, maintain, and regularly test the BC/DR plan for the SailPoint environment.

* Initiate and conduct access reviews in accordance with the agreed calendar, ensuring timely launch and completion of each cycle.
* Provide business and technical stakeholders with clear review instructions, timelines, and escalation protocols.

* Excessive privileges

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**About the job**

Experience: 3-5 years

Position: Individual contributor; senior backend engineer

Reporting to: CTO

Superlaw is hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to build and improve the backend systems that power our AI products for legal and governance workflows.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role combining Python development, backend service and API design, and ownership of reliable software delivery. You'll work directly with the CTO and the product and engineering teams to take features from requirements to release, and grow toward independently owning core parts of our backend.

**About Superlaw**

Superlaw builds AI solutions for legal and governance workflows, with an initial focus on the insurance sector. Our products include an AI assistant, drafting engine, and an intelligence layer that integrates into customers' existing systems.

Our platform spans multiple services, data stores, and external integrations. Success requires clean design, careful engineering, and consistent follow-through.

**What you'll do**

**Build and maintain backend services**

* Develop and maintain backend applications and services, primarily in Python.
* Design and build APIs that connect our frontend, internal services, and external systems.
* Work with databases, data models, and queries to support product functionality and efficient data access.
* Coordinate integrations with external systems alongside the CTO and technical team.

**Improve reliability and code quality**

* Write clean, maintainable code, backed by automated tests and clear technical documentation.
* Debug issues, investigate performance bottlenecks, and improve the reliability of existing systems.
* Participate in code reviews and apply good practices for authentication, access controls, and secure data handling.

**Take ownership and collaborate**

* Own backend features from requirements through implementation, testing, release, and ongoing improvement.
* Work with the CTO, frontend engineers, and product team to define technical approaches, agree on interfaces, and resolve dependencies.
* Communicate progress, technical decisions, and delivery risks clearly.

The CTO will initially lead architecture direction and final technical decisions. You'll own the implementation, quality, and delivery of the features assigned to you.

**What we're looking for**

* 3-5 years of professional software engineering experience, including hands-on backend development.
* Strong proficiency in Python as your primary language, with experience building and maintaining backend applications or services.
* Hands-on experience with Docker and Git, including containerised development and collaborative version control.
* Demonstrated ability to build and integrate APIs, with a solid understanding of request handling, validation, and error handling.
* Working knowledge of databases, data modelling, and writing efficient queries.
* Evidence of writing readable, maintainable code and working with automated testing, debugging, and code reviews.
* Strong grasp of backend fundamentals, including performance, reliability, and application security.
* Strong written and spoken communication, with the ability to explain technical decisions to technical and non-technical teammates.
* Strong ownership, disciplined follow-through, and comfort working independently in an early-stage startup.

**Experience that would be particularly valuable**

* Exposure to Go (Golang).
* Familiarity with cloud environments and automated build, testing, and deployment workflows.
* Experience with background tasks, asynchronous processing, or integrations with external services.
* Experience integrating AI capabilities into software products.

You don't need to meet every preferred qualification. We value relevant results, curiosity, sound judgment, and ownership.

**Why join Superlaw?**

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
**Why this role exists**

JustCall is hiring an SDE 4 (Senior Software Engineer, Backend) in Noida or Bangalore to build and scale the backend systems powering customer conversations for 6,000+ businesses across 70+ countries.

This is a senior individual contributor role for an engineer with strong backend fundamentals who can work across application, service and data layers. You'll own complex engineering problems, drive architectural decisions and build systems that can handle growing product and data demands.

We're looking for someone who combines strong Node.js engineering with deep SQL and database fundamentals, and knows how to build, optimise and operate backend systems in production
**.**

**What you'll actually do**

* Build backend services: Design and develop scalable, maintainable and high-performance backend services using Node.js and JavaScript.
* Own system architecture: Design service boundaries, make architectural trade-offs and drive technical decisions for complex backend systems.
* Work across data layers: Design efficient data models, write optimised SQL queries and improve database performance.
* Build analytical workloads: Work with ClickHouse to model large-scale datasets, optimise queries and use execution plans to identify performance bottlenecks.
* Design distributed systems: Build asynchronous and event-driven workflows, handling concurrency, retries, consistency and failure scenarios.
* Solve scaling challenges: Improve throughput, reduce latency and identify bottlenecks across application and database layers.
* Build reliable APIs: Design and maintain REST APIs and backend components that support evolving product requirements.
* Own production systems: Debug complex issues, improve observability and ensure reliability through monitoring and performance optimisation.
* Raise engineering standards: Drive design reviews, write technical documentation, mentor engineers and influence engineering practices across teams.
* Your work will shape the backend systems powering JustCall's product and data ecosystem. You'll take on complex engineering challenges, improve how we process and serve data, and build systems that can support our growth without compromising performance or reliability.

**What we're looking for**

* 8+ years of backend engineering experience, with a track record of owning and scaling production systems.
* Strong backend fundamentals: Comfortable working across backend services, application architecture and data layers.
* Strong experience in Node.js and JavaScript, with the ability to write clean, efficient and maintainable backend services.
* Strong SQL fundamentals: Experience with data modelling, query optimisation, indexing and understanding query execution plans.
* Hands-on experience with ClickHouse: Ability to model analytical workloads, write efficient queries and troubleshoot performance issues.
* Distributed systems knowledge: Understanding of asynchronous processing, concurrency, consistency, retries and fault tolerance.
* Strong system design skills: Ability to design scalable systems and make sound technical trade-offs.
* API development: Experience building and maintaining REST APIs and backend services.
* Production engineering: Experience debugging, monitoring and optimising systems running at scale.
* Cloud and infrastructure: Familiarity with AWS/GCP, Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD.
* Senior IC ownership: Ability to independently drive technical decisions, mentor engineers and take projects from design to production.

**Edges that help**

* Experience building high-throughput, data-intensive B2B SaaS products.
* Exposure to Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS or other event-streaming systems.
* Experience with Redis, caching strategies and database performance optimisation.
* Familiarity with OLAP systems and large-scale analytical data processing.
* Experience with observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana and OpenTelemetry.
* Exposure to AI-powered products, real-time systems or communication platforms.

**How we work**

* Small teams, real ownership: Own systems end-to-end, from design to production.
* Engineering over process: Focus on clean code, sound technical decisions and solving meaningful problems.
* Think beyond the feature: Understand the bigger system and build solutions that scale.
* Write it down: Design documents and technical discussions drive how we build.
* Work where the work is: Based in Noida or Bangalore, working closely with product and engineering teams.
* Pay for impact: Market-benchmarked fixed pay with variable and equity as JustCall scales toward $100M ARR.

**The bigger picture**

JustCall is SaaS Labs' flagship product, used by 6,000+ businesses across 70+ countries to run their customer conversations. Backed by Peak XV and Base10 Partners, we've crossed $40M ARR and are building toward $100M.

If building the next generation of AI-powered conversations excites you, let's talk.

SaaS Labs is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better products and make employment decisions without discrimination based on race, colour, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other protected characteristic.

description:

Labor Planning & Forecasting
  
  
Hybrid, Bangalore or Pune, India
  
  
The Legion application is a high-performance data-driven Java enterprise application that implements sophisticated scheduling and optimization algorithms. It also provides the necessary endpoints for our Web and mobile frontend applications. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be a member of the team responsible for the implementation and evolution of this application. You will need to be able to write secure, efficient, enterprise-quality Java code, and have a deep understanding of the techniques and technologies that are necessary for scalability and performance. You will also need knowledge and experience with data modeling and relational databases. Our application runs on AWS, so experience with containerization and cloud deployments is desirable. We're using Springboot, Hibernate, MySQL, and JSON, so familiarity with these technologies will be helpful. Frontend experience in JavaScript and Angular and/or React is a big plus.
  
  
**RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES**

* Develop features with high quality and on time
* Thorough understanding of the product area
* Assist with feature design along with CTO/Architect
* Develop features keeping in mind best coding practices including performance and user experience
* Own product quality

* Fix incoming bugs daily: Adhere to bug resolution goals and SLA
* Be able to demo the Legion product end-to-end

* Design, build, and support applications from End to End.
* Make data-driven technical decisions
* Use your deep technical knowledge to debug and solve complex technical problems
* Identify and resolve ambiguities in requirements in consultation with the various stakeholders
* Contribute to the long-term team charter and quarterly planning
* Mentor others on the team, and hold a high bar for code quality and standards by conducting design reviews, code reviews, and providing feedback
* Work with QA team to make the feature as Production ready.

**REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related discipline
* 7-8 years with backend technologies (Java, Spring Boot, MySQL)
* 7-8 years working on building multi-tenant SaaS applications
* 7-8 years experience with designing and building APIs
* 5+ years delivering software in a cloud-based environment (AWS, GCP, Azure)
* Professional software development experience
* Proficiency in Java or C++, and object-oriented design skills
* Application architecture and design patterns
* Experience serving as technical lead throughout the full software development lifecycle, from conception, architecture definition, detailed design, scoping, planning, implementation, and testing to documentation, delivery, and maintenance is preferred
* Knowledge of professional software engineering and best practices for the full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
* Experience in the development of distributed/scalable systems and high-volume transaction applications
* Proven ability to lead projects from inception to production
* Strong mastery in communication skills, software architecture design, writing technical documents
* Strong personal work ethic focused on prioritization, being action-oriented, and being driven to achieve positive results

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS AND ATTRIBUTES**

* Proactive and able to command respect through intelligence, hard work, and persistence
* Personal passion and fervor for industry-leading next-generation technology
* Ability to operate in an environment with limited resources
* A great communicator who can distill powerful messages that resonate with customers
* Track record of building positive relationships with peers
* Continuous and thoughtful listener, able to learn from others and leverage input
* Strong personal work ethic focused on high-priority issues; action and results-oriented
* Unquestionable integrity, credibility, and character; demonstrated high moral and ethical behavior
* Proficiency with AWS products and services
* Experience in managing frameworks/systems for ensuring code quality such as Coverity, SonarQub, etc.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**
At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data.
  
  
We strive to make competitive offers allowing employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position.
  
  
Benefits include, but are not limited to:
  
  

* Health Benefits
* Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
* Parental Leave
* Equity
* Monthly Wellness Reimbursement
* Monthly Lunch on Legion

**ABOUT LEGION**
Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission.
  
  
Legion Technologies delivers the industry’s most innovative workforce management platform. It enables businesses to maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. The award-winning, AI-driven Legion WFM platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric. It’s proven to deliver 13x ROI through schedule optimization, reduced attrition, increased productivity, and increased operational efficiency. Legion delivers cutting-edge technology in an easy-to-use platform and mobile app that employees love.
  
  
If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling.
  
  
**BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY**
There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion’s mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion’s Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously. Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today’s hourly employees. Our team is comprised of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones.
  
  
For more information, visit https://legion.co
  
  
**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY**
Legion Technologies is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, marital status, familial status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, veteran status, and any other legally protected status under federal, state, or local anti-discrimination laws.
  
  
**DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION**
For individuals with disabilities who need additional assistance at any point in the application and interview process, please email recruiting@legion.co
  
  
We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Legion recruiting email communications will always come from the @legion.co domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Legion via other sources should be ignored. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official Legion employee, reach out to recruiting@legion.co
  
  
*Legion is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, religion, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, veteran, disability status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.*
**How We Determine What We Pay**
*As a global employer, Legion determines pay for positions using local, national, and industry-specific survey data. We evaluate external equity and the cost of labor/prevailing wage index in the relative marketplace for jobs directly comparable to jobs within our company. Our posted salary range is based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living. For new hires, we strive to make competitive offers allowing the new employee room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position. An employee/candidate with a stronger skill set will receive higher pay.*

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**AppLogic Networks**
powers the networks behind AI and the critical applications people rely on every day. We help network owners service providers and Enterprises understand how applications perform, how users experience them, and where action is needed to improve quality, efficiency, security, and profitability. Our software combines application intelligence, experience visibility, contextual insights, and real-time control to help customers elevate observability and do more with the networks they already run. As AI reshapes how the world works, connects, and communicates, AppLogic Networks helps ensure modern applications run smoothly across any network, from the consumer edge to the data center. Join our team and help build the software that makes networks smarter, more adaptive, and ready for what comes next.

**Overview of the Role**

 

AppLogic Networks delivers analytics platform capabilities focused on application identification, subscriber awareness, secure data handling, and large-scale network data processing. The Software Engineer II is responsible for developing new features for high performance network traffic simulation tools used to simulate customer environments for product system-level, functional and regression testing.

This role is responsible for the design and development of software features in a highly collaborative and fast-paced environment, working closely with Architects, Technical Leads, and Tests Engineers to deliver innovative features. You will be involved in the full software development lifecycle, from planning and design to implementation and documentation. You may assist in testing, debugging and modification of software. The role may include analysis of test results to ensure existing functionality and may make recommendations on corrective action
 

The role will contribute to backend services that support analytics workflows, data enrichment, secure API integrations, reporting, and platform scalability. The position requires strong backend engineering expertise, practical AI fluency, and working knowledge of React for frontend-backend collaboration. The engineer is expected to bring an innovation-driven mindset and contribute to building reliable, scalable, and secure platform components.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain backend services for the Analytics Platform.
* Build scalable and secure applications using Python.
* Design and implement REST APIs with clear contracts, strong error handling, and reliable performance.
* Support platform scalability, high availability, failover, and active-active deployment patterns.
* Work with large-scale data flows, analytics workflows, reporting, and operational data processing.
* Collaborate with React frontend teams on API integration and backend support.
* Use AI tools to improve coding, debugging, testing, documentation, automation, and engineering productivity.
* Provide technical guidance on backend design, web development trends, scalable methodologies, and engineering best practices.
* Troubleshoot production issues across APIs, services, databases, infrastructure, and integrations.
* Work with DevOps teams on CI/CD, deployment automation, and production readiness.
* Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, API reviews, and technical design discussions.
* Promote innovation, ownership, maintainability, and continuous improvement within the engineering team.

**Qualifications**
**Knowledge and Skills**

*Required*

* Strong hands-on experience in Python backend development.
* Excellent programming skills in one or more of (C/C++, Python, Java, Go or similar languages)
* Scripting Skills (Shell, Ruby, or, Bash, etc.)
* Good grasp on networking concepts and protocols
* Self-starter attitude and ability to make decisions independently
* Excellent problem-solving skills with a history of superb delivery against assigned tasks
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Knowledge and experience in one or more of the following domains:

  + Debugging and troubleshooting problems in test and in production
  + Experience with GDB, Wireshark and similar industry standards aids
  + Knowledge on leveraging GenAI tools into day to day working

*Desired*

* Experience with multiple AI/ML Algorithms , GenAI usage
* Working experience with Socket Programming, Python programming
* Experience of working in a collaborative mode across multiple time zones and across cultures would be an added advantage

**Work Experience, Education and Certifications**

 

* Bachelor's Degree (STEM) or equivalent experience
* 3+ years of experience in large-scale integrations environments

**Work Conditions**

 

* Team Environment
* Flexible hours
* Casual Office environment
* Fast Paced environment

**What We offer**

* Competitive base salary and performance-based compensation
* Flexible working environment designed for high-performance teams
* Clear path for career growth as the company scales
* Comprehensive benefits package supporting your health and well-being

title: Virtual Reality Software Engineer
description:
About InfiVR

InfiVR is a Bangalore-based VR/AR company building immersive training and visualization solutions for enterprise clients across energy, manufacturing, and industrial sectors. Our work spans operator training simulators, equipment visualization, safety drills, and mixed-reality data exploration tools — deployed on standalone headsets, tethered PC VR, and AR devices.

The Role

We're hiring a VR/Unity Developer to lead the technical delivery of immersive applications on standalone and tethered XR platforms. You'll own features end-to-end — from architecture and prototyping through optimization and deployment — and mentor junior developers on the team. You'll work directly with project leads and clients on requirements, technical feasibility, and demos.

What You'll Do

* Architect and develop production-grade VR, AR, and MR applications in Unity for standalone headsets (Meta Quest 2/3/Pro, Pico) and tethered PC VR setups
* Build interaction systems, custom locomotion, hand-tracking and controller flows using OpenXR / XR Interaction Toolkit
* Optimize performance for mobile-class GPUs — draw calls, batching, LODs, shader complexity, memory budgets — to hit comfort framerates on standalone hardware
* Integrate 3D assets, scenarios, and authored content into modular, reusable application frameworks
* Implement backend integrations (REST APIs, LMS/SCORM/xAPI, analytics) for enterprise deployments
* Collaborate with 3D artists, designers, and project managers to translate client requirements into shippable builds
* Write clean, maintainable, well-documented code; review PRs; mentor junior developers
* Participate in technical scoping, feasibility assessments, and client-facing demos

Must-Have Skills

* Strong proficiency in
  **Unity (2021 LTS or later)**
  and
  **C#**
* 3+ years of hands-on VR/AR development with shipped projects on standalone headsets (Meta Quest preferred)
* Solid grasp of
  **OpenXR**
  and
  **XR Interaction Toolkit**
  (or equivalent: Oculus Integration, MRTK)
* Experience optimizing for standalone XR — profiling tools (Unity Profiler, RenderDoc, OVR Metrics Tool), URP rendering pipeline, shader optimization
* Comfort with 3D math (vectors, matrices, quaternions), physics, and spatial computing concepts
* Version control with
  **Git**
  , branching strategies, and collaborative workflows
* Ability to read documentation, debug independently, and ship under deadlines

Nice to Have

* Experience with
  **AR / MR**
  development (ARKit, ARCore, HoloLens 2, Quest Passthrough)
* Multiplayer/networked XR (Photon Fusion/PUN, Netcode for GameObjects, Mirror)
* Shader programming (HLSL, Shader Graph)
* LMS integration experience — SCORM, xAPI, Tin Can
* Spatial anchoring, QR/marker-based tracking, image targets
* Exposure to enterprise domains: oil & gas, manufacturing, healthcare, training simulators
* Native plugin development (Android/iOS) and build pipeline automation
* Experience with WebXR or cross-platform XR frameworks

At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers — and customer obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to solve technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started in
**Bengaluru , India**
! As a software engineer with a backend focus, you will work with your team to build infrastructure for the Databricks platform at scale.
  
  
**The Role**
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Staff Software Engineer with a deep understanding of low-level systems to join our team. In this role, you will be instrumental in designing, developing, and optimizing application frameworks that form the building blocks for all software development at Databricks. This is not a full-stack role; your expertise will be focused on the intricate details of system internals, performance, and efficiency.
  
  
**What We Look For**

* Design, implement, and maintain core system infrastructure and low-level software components.
* Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability through meticulous analysis and innovative solutions.
* Work with JVM internals, memory management, concurrency, and distributed systems.
* Collaborate with other senior engineers and architects to define technical strategies and roadmaps.
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to a culture of technical excellence.
* Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and architectural decision-making.
* Troubleshoot complex system issues and provide effective resolutions.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* 12+ years of professional experience in software development.
* Deep understanding of Java Virtual Machine (JVM) internals, including garbage collection, JIT compilation, class loading, and memory model.
* Proficiency in at least one JVM language and extensive experience with its runtime environment.
* Strong programming skills in Scala/Java/Rust or other systems-level languages.
* Extensive experience with operating system concepts; including processes, threads, concurrency, scheduling, and I/O.
* Proven track record of building and optimizing high-performance, scalable, and reliable systems.
* Experience with distributed systems concepts and technologies.
* Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and debugging skills.
* Strong communication and collaboration abilities
* Experience with performance profiling and tuning tools.
* Contributions to open-source projects related to JVM or systems software.
* Experience with RPC frameworks.

If you are a systems-level expert with a passion for optimizing the core of technology and possess a deep understanding of JVM internals, we encourage you to apply and help us build the future.
  
  
**About Databricks**
Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

title: AI Agent Developer & Integration Specialist
description:
**Job Title: AI Agent Developer & Integration Specialist**
**Location: Bangalore, India**
**Reports to: CIO**
**Benefits: Comprehensive health and wellness benefits, professional development opportunities, and a collaborative, mission-driven work environment.**
**About Ceres India**
At Ceres India Private Limited, we support initiatives that help communities recover, rebuild, and strengthen resilience. As part of the Ceres Global network of companies, we contribute to disaster recovery, infrastructure restoration, environmental services, and critical response operations through engineering, technology, innovation, and operational excellence. From India, we help enable faster decisions, stronger delivery, and meaningful outcomes where they matter most. The purpose is at the core of what we do. We are building an environment where talent can do meaningful work, take ownership, grow with the business, and be part of something larger than themselves.
  
  
**Driven by Purpose, Powered by People**
At Ceres India, we believe you’re more than just an employee; you’re part of a team with a purpose and a meaningful mission. Every team member plays a vital role in restoring hope, helping communities recover and rebuild.
  
  
We value initiative, respect diversity, and give our people the freedom to lead. We offer competitive pay, growth opportunities, travel, and a culture built on resilience and teamwork. If you show up with compassion, share the commitment, react with urgency, and deliver solutions, you’ll fit right in. We don’t just respond to challenges; we rise to them.
  
  
**What We Are Looking For**
We are seeking an AI Agent Developer & Integration Specialist to lead the design, development, deployment, and continuous improvement of enterprise AI agents and intelligent automation solutions across Ceres. This role sits within the Information Technology organization and serves as the bridge between business stakeholders and technology teams, partnering directly with subject matter experts to identify opportunities, gather requirements, build solutions, and drive user adoption.
  
  
The successful candidate will own AI initiatives from concept through production, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, reliable, and aligned with business objectives. This role has no direct people management responsibilities but requires strong cross-functional leadership and collaboration. Success during the first 12 months will be demonstrated through the deployment of multiple business AI solutions, measurable efficiency gains, strong stakeholder adoption, and the establishment of scalable AI governance and best practices across the organization.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Lead the design, development, testing, deployment, and support of enterprise AI agents and intelligent automation solutions.
* Partner with business leaders and subject matter experts to identify process improvement and automation opportunities.
* Facilitate requirement-gathering sessions and document business, technical, and operational needs.
* Build AI agents using approved enterprise AI platforms, frameworks, and development tools.
* Integrate AI solutions with enterprise applications, databases, APIs, and data sources.
* Develop prompts, workflows, orchestration logic, retrieval systems, and business process automations.
* Conduct functional, integration, performance, and user acceptance testing to ensure solution quality and reliability.
* Ensure compliance with organizational security, privacy, governance, and Responsible AI standards.
* Monitor deployed AI agents, analyze performance metrics, and implement continuous improvements.
* Manage the AI agent portfolio, including demand intake, prioritization, lifecycle management, adoption tracking, and ROI measurement.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field; equivalent experience may be considered.
* Three (3) or more years of experience developing AI-enabled applications, enterprise automation solutions, or workflow systems.
* Experience building and deploying AI agents, large language model (LLM) applications, or intelligent automation solutions.
* Proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript/Node.js, including API integration and automation development.
* Experience with AI development platforms and frameworks such as Microsoft Copilot Studio, Semantic Kernel, LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, or similar technologies.
* Proven ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions while communicating effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with enterprise cloud platforms including Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Familiarity with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, prompt engineering, and AI evaluation methodologies.
* Experience with MLOps or LLMOps tools used for monitoring, testing, and optimizing AI applications.
* Knowledge of enterprise business systems including ERP, CRM, finance, operations, or project management platforms.

**What To Expect**
This is a highly visible role that combines software development, AI innovation, business process improvement, and stakeholder engagement. You will spend time meeting with business leaders and subject matter experts to understand challenges, evaluate opportunities, and prioritize automation initiatives. You will also spend significant time designing, building, testing, and deploying AI agents that improve efficiency and support operational decision-making across the organization.
  
  
Success in this role requires balancing technical development with business partnership. You will manage multiple projects simultaneously, work across departments, and adapt to changing priorities as organizational needs evolve. Some projects will involve rapid prototyping and experimentation, while others will require structured development, governance reviews, and enterprise deployment planning.
  
  
The pace is fast and collaborative, with a strong focus on practical problem solving, measurable business outcomes, and responsible AI adoption. Individuals who are curious, self-directed, and excited about applying emerging technology to real-world business challenges will thrive in this environment.
  
  
Occasional travel may be required to collaborate with business teams, support implementations, facilitate workshops, or provide training at company locations.
  
  
**Why Join Ceres India?**
At Ceres India, you won’t just have a job, you’ll have a mission. Your work will directly impact the speed and strength of community recovery after disasters.
  
  
**We Offer**

* A collaborative, mission-driven culture.
* Opportunities for professional growth and advancement.
* The chance to make a lasting difference for communities.
* The opportunity to help shape and scale AI capabilities across a growing global organization.

title: Sales Lead
description:
About Kaalcāri

Kaalcāri is a science-led foot-well-being company. We want to improve the health, comfort and long-term mobility of Indian feet. Footwear has mostly been designed to be made at scale. Sizes and shapes are standardised, and people end up adjusting their feet to fit the shoe. We think it should work the other way round. So we start with the foot. We study the structure and biomechanics of Indian feet and design footwear around what they need. Our configurable platform combines engineered fit, structural support and adaptability. It draws on thousands of movement analyses, our work with doctors and physiotherapists, and feedback from over 1,000 users. The innovation is patent-pending. Footwear is where we have started. Over time we want to build a wider foot-wellbeing ecosystem of products, tools, devices and daily routines, so that caring for your feet becomes a habit and people can stay active for longer. We have spent the last few years on research and product development, and ran an early business on a service-led model. The product is now proven with clinicians and users. The next step is turning Kaalcāri into a scalable product company, and we need someone to lead the sales side of that.

The opportunity:

Sales Lead (Bengaluru) As Sales Lead, you will build our sales function from scratch and own it end to end, from the first conversation to the thousandth customer. Most sales roles come with a product, a playbook and a pipeline. This one comes with a good product and nothing else, so you will be setting up the rest yourself.

You will:

• Set the sales strategy: decide which channels we build and sell through, and set the revenue targets and plans for each.

• Create demand for a category most people haven’t thought about. This means building partnerships with doctors, physiotherapists, clinics, hospitals, wellness centres and corporates, and giving customers ways to try Kaalcāri through events, activations and retail.

• Own the funnel from lead generation to repeat purchase, set up the CRM and follow-up systems, and pay attention to the objections and buying signals you hear along the way.

• Be accountable for the numbers: revenue, conversion, average order value, customer acquisition cost and sales cycle, with dashboards to track them.

• Hire, train and lead the first sales team, and decide how incentives, accountability and team culture will work. This is a hands-on role. You will be out planning, selling as well as building.

Why this role, why now

• You can stand behind the product. The science, clinical input and patentpending design are real, so you can answer a doctor’s or a customer’s hard questions.

• You will own outcomes, and you will work directly with the founder and leadership team.

• You decide how Kaalcāri is sold, and the systems you set up will need to work for thousands of customers, not just the first few.

• You will be helping change how people in India think about their feet, which goes beyond selling shoes.

Who we are looking for

You have 5–8 years of experience in sales, business development or commercial growth, ideally in consumer, lifestyle, footwear, wellness, retail or D2C businesses. You have built channels, opened new markets and grown teams. You are as comfortable looking at a CRM dashboard or discussing margins as you are making a cold call. You tend to see opportunities where others see obstacles, and you believe in what we are building. If that sounds like you, we would like to meet you.

We believe that when we take care of what carries us, we are free to live fully. If you want to help build the sales engine that takes this idea across India, we would love to hear from you.

To apply or refer someone, send a resume and a short note on your relevant experience and achievements.

Send your resume and details to:

shreyabojamma@kaalcari.com

title: Co-Founder : Content, Growth Sales
description:
**About Entrext**

Entrext is a venture-building company focused on identifying real-world problems and building businesses through technology, experimentation, and business development.

**About Stage**

Stage is an early-stage SaaS venture being developed within Entrext, with the vision of growing into an independent company.

We’re building Stage as a
**communication layer between clients and the developers, designers, and product teams bringing their ideas to life.**

During a project, feedback often gets scattered across WhatsApp, emails, screenshots, and calls. As conversations grow, the original context gets lost. A simple change can lead to repeated follow-ups, misunderstandings, and unnecessary revision rounds.

Stage brings feedback closer to the actual work. Clients can point to the specific part of a webpage, design, app, or digital product they want changed and leave feedback in context. The person working on it can respond and keep the discussion connected to that specific change.

The goal is simple:
**less time clarifying feedback, less effort chasing conversations, and fewer unnecessary revisions caused by misunderstandings.**

Stage isn't another messaging tool. It's a way to keep communication connected to the work, from the first feedback to its resolution.

**About the Role**

We’re looking for a
**Co-Founder to own Content, Growth & Sales from zero.**

You’ll help take Stage to market, find the right customers, build relationships, and turn an early-stage product into a business with real customers and repeatable growth.

There is no established playbook. You’ll help create it.

**What You’ll Own**

* **ICP & Go-to-Market:**
  Identify our ideal customers and figure out how to reach them.
* **Customer Acquisition:**
  Build our initial customer base among web development agencies, freelancers, designers, and product teams.
* **Content & Distribution:**
  Create content that connects with real customer problems and attracts the right audience.
* **Outbound & Partnerships:**
  Reach out to potential customers, build relationships, and explore relevant partnerships.
* **Sales & Conversion:**
  Talk to customers, demonstrate Stage, understand objections, and turn conversations into active users and paying customers.
* **Market Validation:**
  Test assumptions, gather feedback, and identify what customers actually need.
* **Growth Experiments:**
  Experiment with acquisition channels, messaging, and positioning until we find what works consistently.
* **Business Building:**
  Help shape Stage's direction and eventually build its growth and sales function.

**Who We’re Looking For**

Someone who enjoys building from zero and is comfortable figuring things out without waiting for instructions.

You should be willing to:

* Talk to customers and understand their problems
* .Build relationships and explore opportunities
* .Create content and handle outbound outreach
* .Sell, negotiate, and handle rejection
* .Test ideas, learn from failures, and adapt quickly
* .Take ownership of outcomes rather than just completing assigned tasks

.

Experience in SaaS, B2B sales, startup growth, or agency business development is valuable. A perfect founder résumé isn't necessary. We care more about your ability to execute, learn, and build.

**What You Get**

**25% Equity | Co-Founder Rol**

* e
* Real ownership and responsibility in building Stag
* e.The opportunity to shape its growth, sales, and business strategy from the beginnin
* g.Direct collaboration with Entrext's product, technology, and venture-building ecosyste
* m.The opportunity to help develop Stage into an independent compan

y.

Stage is currently being developed within Entrext, with the intention of establishing it as a separate venture as it grows. The proposed equity will relate to the future independent Stage company, subject to the agreed legal structure and formal documentation.

This is
**an equity-only opportun**
ity, with no guaranteed salary. Equity terms, vesting, founder responsibilities, and the future company structure will be discussed transparently with the selected candidate.

This isn't a conventional growth job. It's an opportunity to help build a company
**.**

d?

If you enjoy solving real problems, talking to customers, finding opportunities, and building something from the ground up, we'd like to hear from you...

Location: Bangalore

We are seeking a seasoned Solution Engineer with deep expertise in building and scaling ecommerce platforms and marketplaces. You will play a pivotal role in architecting and delivering solutions that drive seamless customer experiences, streamline operations, and scale marketplace ecosystems. **The role:**

**Title:**
Senior AI Engineer

**Function:**
Technology

**Location:**
Bengaluru

**About the Technology Function:**

By joining the Technology team in the GCC you will play a direct role in Officeworks’ global digital transformation, contributing to world-class capabilities that sit at the heart of how the business operates and grows. The GCC will support Officeworks’ purpose of helping to bring big ideas to life at low prices, ensuring technology remains a true enabler of customer value and operational excellence.

This opportunity to join as a founding member of the new global hub is a chance to be part of the original build-out of our GCC. Early joiners will influence how the hub operates and help shape the future state of some of Officeworks’ core technology ecosystem.

These roles are best suited for people who enjoy:

* exposure to eCommerce and digital platforms, customer facing services enabled online and in retail stores, and an expanding presence into generative and agentic commerce - covering operations, security, development, automation, and solution architecture
* supporting global initiatives and modernising business critical systems
* being the forefront of global innovation and transformation, helping digitize the Officeworks business
* joining a place where your skills matter, your growth is intentional, and your work has visible impact on business outcomes.

**Why this role exists:**

The Senior AI Engineer sits inside a Customer Platforms pod and orchestrates the technical agents that produce code, tests, documentation and design artefacts. The role is a full stack engineering role that takes complete ownership of the quality engineering and testing, holding accountability for everything committed to production.

The role exists to translate product specifications into functional agent tasks, maintain the human-in-the-loop review gate, and ensure system design integrity, non-functional performance and security standards are met. It plays a critical role in enabling continuous delivery across Customer Platforms while mentoring junior engineers and continuously improving agent workflows across pods.

**Where you will make a difference:**

**In this role you will:**

**Agent Orchestration and Execution:**

* Decompose Product Orchestrator specifications into functional tasks for technical agents.
* Run multiple agents in parallel across coding, test generation, documentation and design workflows.
* Sequence workstreams and manage technical dependencies to maintain high pod delivery velocity.
* Apply base context, security policies and platform standards to every agent execution cycle.

**Quality Control and Commit Gate:**

* Hold the human-in-the-loop review and commit gate independently on complex and high-risk change.
* Perform fast, accurate code and test reviews to ensure correctness, specification alignment and standards conformance.
* Owns end-to-end quality assurance accountability by designing agent test coverage and evaluation logic.
* Own defect management for the pod, from identification through root cause and resolution tracking, escalating systemic quality risks.
* Identify when agent workflows are insufficient and apply direct engineering intervention to resolve technical issues.

**System Design and Non-Functional Excellence:**

* Own architectural fit and system design judgement across the features delivered by the pod.
* Ensure non-functional outcomes, including performance, scalability, resilience and security, are met across all releases.
* Lead production incident resolution within the pod across touched platform domains.
* Contribute to domain design decisions as a consulted partner to the Solution Architects.

**Knowledge Governance and Workflow Improvement:**

* Maintain accurate, up-to-date documentation and knowledge artefacts to serve as context layers for future agent runs.
* Feed refined domain context back to central repositories in collaboration with Context Engineers.
* Continuously refine and optimize agent workflows and share best practices across engineering pods.
* Mentor engineers on test design, defect triage and quality engineering practice across the pod.

**Who you will be working with:**

* Pod Leadership and Delivery Teams: Partner with Product Orchestrators and fellow pod engineers to refine requirements, assess technical feasibility and execute workstreams.
* Architecture Teams: Consult with Domain Architects and Solution Architects on domain design, system architecture and escalation pathways.
* Capability and Platform Specialists: Collaborate with Context Engineers, Associate AI Agent Evaluation Engineers and Associate Platform Engineers to align on shared context, security standards and tooling.
* Vendor and Platform Partners: Liaise with external AI tooling providers and vendor technical support to resolve complex platform constraints and adopt new capabilities.

**What success looks like:**

* Commit Gate Integrity: Low commit gate escape rate on complex and high-risk production changes.
* Innovation and Scaling: Agent workflow improvements developed within the pod are successfully adopted across broader engineering teams.
* Operational Resilience: Rapid resolution of production incidents within the pod with minimal downtime or customer impact.
* Delivery Velocity: High throughput of automated coding and testing tasks achieved without compromising technical quality or architectural standards.
* Demonstrates behaviours aligned to Officeworks’ values, contributing to a respectful, inclusive and high-performing culture.

**How you will lead:**

**Individual Contributor:**

* Lives our Officeworks values and behaviours
* Proactively contributes to a safe working environment, escalates appropriately if there are unsafe conditions or inappropriate behaviour
* Operates in line with applicable Officeworks company policies and Code of Conduct
* Demonstrates a strong sense of personal accountability and curiosity to learn and develop
* Contributes to an inclusive and respectful environment where diverse perspectives are valued and everyone feels safe to speak up and belong

**Our Values:**

Our values shape the way we work, our behaviours and how we interact with each other, our customers, suppliers and communities.

**We begin with customer:**

* We start with our customer’ needs in every decision.
* We offer simple, helpful and affordable solutions.
* We listen, learn and continuously improve.

**We do the right thing:**

* We lead with integrity and care for our team communities and planet.
* We work together safely and treat everyone with respect, inclusion, and trust.
* We collaborate across teams and think Officeworks-wide.

**We execute with accountability:**

* We are accountable for our decisions, actions, results, and mistakes.
* We stay across the details and focus on delivering what matters.
* We move with pace and agility to deliver outcomes.

**We lead with ambition:**

* We set bold ambitions that help us to win and transform.
* We are courageous with new ideas.
* We focus on transformation, not incremental steps.

**Qualifications and work experience:**

**Essential:**

* Education: Tertiary degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience: 8-10 years of software engineering experience, primarily full stack with microservices architecture exposure, including senior-level ownership of quality engineering and test strategy.
* AI-Assisted Delivery: Proven experience or strong proficiency in delivering production software using AI coding, test generation and orchestration tooling.
* Quality Ownership: Demonstrated track record of owning end-to-end code quality, test strategy design, defect management and release gates directly, built through hands-on quality engineering experience.
* Stack Breadth: Broad technical exposure across front-end, back-end and integration layers.
* System Design: Strong system design judgement with the capability to evaluate, challenge and refine agent-generated architectural outputs.
* Technical Support: Experience supporting production cloud environments, including logging, alerting, incident response and observability.

**Preferred:**

* Retail and Commerce Exposure: Experience in retail, e-commerce, or complex omnichannel platform ecosystems.
* Advanced AI Tooling: Familiarity with modern AI agent frameworks, model gateways, and evaluation platforms.

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and the environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins works with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. Eurofins is a global leader in food, environmental, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in agroscience CRO services. title: Senior Product Manager, Bengaluru
description:
Role: Senior Product Manager, Bengaluru

Experience: 10+ years

Salary: upto 15-20 LPA

Note: Experience in the service or social sector, ideally in livelihoods, financial inclusion, MSME, or rural development.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**About the role**

Our livelihoods program works with nano-entrepreneurs—small shop owners, street vendors, home-based producers, and a growing number of rural nano-entrepreneurs, many of them women. They run on thin margins, with patchy networks and limited digital literacy, and rarely operate in English.

Field operatives, Monitoring & Evaluation (M&E), and program and operations teams all need technology, and today those needs reach the tech team as separate requests. We are looking for a
**Senior Product Manager**
to set the product vision and turn these needs into one unified roadmap, grounded in time spent in the field. This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Head of Technology.

**What You'll Own**

**Vision and Strategy**

* Set a 2–3 year product vision for how technology and AI can help our livelihoods program reach more nano-entrepreneurs and make field operatives more effective.
* Own the product roadmap, combining field, M&E, and operational requirements.
* Prioritize with evidence (impact on nano-entrepreneurs, effort, cost, risk) and be clear about what we won't build.
* Identify where AI meaningfully helps, and where it doesn't.

**Field Discovery**

* Spend about 20% of your time with field operatives and nano-entrepreneurs in rural and urban locations.
* Run user research and quick prototypes with low-literacy, multilingual users.

**Delivery and Outcomes**

* Write requirements engineers can build from; make scope, sequencing, and build-or-buy calls with them.
* Plan pilots and rollouts with field teams, designing for multiple languages, voice, and low-end Android devices.
* Define success metrics, track adoption and outcomes, and work with M&E on impact measurement.
* Ensure products respect privacy and consent, including India's Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act.

**Stakeholders**

* Bridge program, field, M&E, operations, fundraising, and technology teams, and communicate the roadmap to leadership, funders, and partners.

**Skills and Experience**

**Essential**

* 8–10 years of overall experience, with at least 2–3 years in product management owning a product from discovery to launch.
* Bachelor's degree; an MBA or Master's is a plus.
* Experience in the service or social sector, ideally in livelihoods, financial inclusion, MSME, or rural development.
* Strategic thinking: able to set a product vision and connect it to organizational goals.
* Enough technical depth to build a technology roadmap and hold your own with engineers on APIs, data, mobile, web, and cloud.
* Working knowledge of AI and LLM-based products, including evaluation and cost.
* Data-driven: comfortable with metrics, dashboards, and basic SQL or analytics tools.
* Speaks and works in at least one of Kannada, Hindi, Tamil, or Marathi, along with English, with empathy for multilingual and voice-first users.
* Able to travel about 20% of the time.
* Clear communicator who partners well with field teams, engineers, leadership, and funders.

**Nice to Have**

* Built for low-bandwidth, offline-first, or low-end Android contexts in India.
* Experience with WhatsApp, chatbot, or voice interfaces, or field data tools like KoboToolbox or ODK.
* Worked with M&E teams, or on DPDP and privacy-by-design.

**Mindsets We're Looking For**

* A real pull towards livelihoods and social impact.
* Field-first, comfortable with ambiguity, and honest about where technology doesn't help.
* Low ego, high ownership.

More details: https://groundzero.community/
