title: Senior Product Manager - Payments
description:
Constantinople delivers a new era of AI-native banking. Constantinople provides banks with a fully-managed software and AI operational platform, which brings together customer experience, product, data, operations, compliance and infrastructure in a single platform.
  
  
Constantinople’s AI-native platform eliminates the need for expensive infrastructure, and replaces manual operational and compliance processes with AI at scale. By removing the operational complexity of banking, Constantinople enables our client banks to focus on their customers and the business of banking.
  
  
**The Role**
You will own the Payments product itself: the platform capability every client bank runs on, rather than the launch of any single client. Your job is to make Payments serviceable, manageable and competitive at scale across all of our client banks, current and future, as part of normal business-as-usual operation.
  
  
You will work closely with Software Engineering, Solution Engineering, Product Design, Operations, Risk and Compliance, and the Client Delivery team.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own the Payments product roadmap and prioritisation.
* Own new Payments platform capability, including its timeline and delivery commitments. You will build it as reusable capability for all of our clients on the platform, including new payment rail integrations, for example NPP , PayTo and BECS bulk payments in Australia, and their equivalents in other jurisdictions.
* Own payment orchestration and routing logic, and bulk and batch payment processing.
* Build out the requirements for scheme and payment rail connectivity, and work with the Technology team in owning the technical architecture: adapter design per rail and country, gateway integrations, and how payment state is managed across the platform.
* Own the configuration model, which gathers the specifications needed to streamline implementation for each new client that joins the platform.
* Work with second line to continue to develop the fraud and risk control framework for Payments across jurisdictions, and own its implementation.
* Own the serviceability and management of Payments functionality at scale, with every process automated end to end so no manual processing is needed, supported by self-service tooling for Operations and, where appropriate, clients, and designed to work for both day-to-day operations and risk and compliance oversight.
* Own client-facing reporting that gives client banks everything they need to understand and run their own payments business, including reconciliation, settlement and transaction reporting available to all clients.
* Evolve the Payments offering to stay competitive with modern fintech payments providers, both for our current market position and as the market moves, while helping build a best-in-class Product team that values collaboration, meaningful work and impact.

**Who You Are**

* You have 5+ years of experience as a Product Manager, with significant time on payments products.
* You have built payment rail integrations or payment platform capability, and know how scheme and rail connectivity works in practice.
* You have a background in payment processing systems, messaging standards such as ISO 20022, and API-based integrations.
* You have worked with second line to develop and implement fraud and financial crime controls for payment products.
* You have designed payment processes and tooling together with Operations and Risk and Compliance, and you understand the regulatory requirements for payments in the markets we serve.
* You have built reusable platform capability for multiple clients, supported by a configuration model that streamlines implementation for each new client.
* You have a bias toward action, a problem-solving mindset, and a willingness to do whatever it takes to solve complex challenges.
* You explain technical detail clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
* You have a track record of driving alignment across technical teams, business partners and external vendors.
* You cut through ambiguity to produce strategic insight and spot opportunities.
* Startup experience is valued highly.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with more than one country's payment schemes.
* Experience at a modern fintech payments provider or a payments platform serving financial institutions.
* Experience building internal operations tooling.

**Application Process**
If this sounds like the kind of opportunity you've been looking for, select the 'Apply Now' button below to submit your cover letter and resume. Use your cover letter to introduce us to you; we want to know who you are, what you've worked on and why you think you'd be a great addition to the Constantinople team.
  
  
**Inclusion**
*To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.*
*We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants in need of special assistance or accommodation during the interview process or in accessing our website may contact us. We will treat your request as confidentially as possible. In your email, please include your name and preferred method of contact, and we will respond as soon as possible.*

title: Product Manager
description:
**About The Team**
FinTech is an ever-changing, complex, competitive, and extremely exciting industry. More than ever before, in order to accomplish Booking.com's mission ("making it easier for everyone to experience the world"), we need to offer world-class payment experiences and financial products on both sides of our marketplace. Do you want to play a part in that journey?
  
  
Join us in Bangalore as a Product Manager on the Partner Master Data track within FinTech Foundations, and help us build the single source of truth for Financial Partner Master Data (FPMD) that powers onboarding, payouts, invoicing, and compliance across every Booking Holdings brand.
  
  
**About The Role**
Join the Partner Master Data team within FinTech Foundations and help build a trusted source of partner and property data used across Booking Holdings. This foundation supports critical experiences and operations—including partner onboarding, payouts, invoicing and compliance. You’ll own one or more product areas, working within the track’s broader strategy and with guidance from senior product leaders.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  

* Own the roadmap and delivery for your product area, turning business and compliance needs into clear requirements and a prioritized backlog.
* Work with stakeholders to map how partner data is captured, governed and used across upstream and downstream systems.
* Improve the quality of critical data by defining and tracking measures such as completeness, validity, consistency and timeliness, and partnering on remediation.
* Identify risks and dependencies early—including data ownership across teams and brands—and work with Engineering and partners to address them.
* Keep stakeholders informed on progress, decisions, risks and asks; represent your area in planning and governance forums.
* Support clear data ownership practices, including stewardship and lineage, and contribute to hiring and onboarding when needed.

What you’ll bring
  
  

* 4+ years of product management experience, ideally in payments, financial products or master/reference data.
* Experience taking product features from discovery through delivery, particularly in complex or fragmented environments.
* The ability to translate business, tax or compliance needs into clear, sequenced product requirements.
* Strong data fluency: you can define success measures, work with analytics or SQL, interpret data-quality signals and make evidence-based decisions.
* A practical understanding of technical systems and data flows, such as pipelines and large-scale platforms.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to build relationships across teams and business units.

Familiarity with master data management—such as golden records, data lineage, validation and governance—is useful. Experience with partner or customer data, tax or regulatory products, or B2B FinTech is a plus. You’ll also bring a thoughtful perspective on how AI may shape data, compliance and financial operations.
  
  
**Pre-Employment Screening**
*If your application is successful, your personal data may be used for a pre-employment screening check by a third party as permitted by applicable law. Depending on the vacancy and applicable law, a pre-employment screening may include employment history, education and other information (such as media information) that may be necessary for determining your qualifications and suitability for the position.*

title: Product Manager III
description:
**Our Mission:**
6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.
  
  
**Our People:**
People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.
  
  
**The Role**
:
  
  
As the Product Manager III, Sales Intelligence, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and execution for the Sales Intelligence product line. Using 6sense Sales Intelligence, sellers know which accounts to focus on, why now, and where their time makes the most impact. 6sense intelligence guides sellers on who to contact, what lands with them, and what to know before reaching out, so they can reach the right buyer at the right moment: one-on-one, at scale, or with an agent.
  
  
This role helps 6sense customers empower their sellers where they work, whether in the 6sense platform, their own tools, or their own agents. You will own sales experiences in the 6sense platform, the Chrome Extension, CRM and SEP integrations and iframes, and RevvyAI for Sales, in the platform and via MCP. You will work in close partnership with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Customer Success, and go-to-market teams. This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Sr. Director - Product Management.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Define the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and success metrics for the Sales Intelligence product line across the 6sense platform, Chrome Extension, CRM and partner integrations/embedded experiences, RevvyAI and/or customers’ own agents and tools – bring 6sense intelligence to sellers where they already work
* Build experiences that enable sellers to reach the right buyer at the right moment, one-on-one, at scale, or with an agent.
* Own RevvyAI for Sales, in the platform and via MCP, including the roadmap for new companion agent capabilities and the maintenance of existing agents; Own agent quality, including writing and refining prompts, defining evals and quality benchmarks, reviewing agent responses, and driving improvements based on results and user feedback.
* Translate customer and seller needs into clear requirements, user journeys, acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes.
* Partner cross-functionally to launch high-quality features, make tradeoffs using data and customer feedback, and improve usability, reliability, and scale.
* Define and track success metrics for seller adoption, engagement, agent usage and quality, and business impact.
* Establish feedback loops with customers, sellers, and internal teams to continuously improve the relevance and effectiveness of Sales Intelligence.
* Partner with internal teams to monitor product health, identify friction points, and improve performance, reliability, and scalability over time.

**Performance Metrics**
:
  
  

* Adoption and active usage of Sales Intelligence experiences across the platform, Chrome Extension, and CRM and SEP integrations and headless activation channels.
* Seller engagement with critical, high-value adoption workflows.
* RevvyAI for Sales agent usage, response quality, and eval performance over time.
* Reliability and performance of Sales Intelligence experiences and integrations at scale.
* Customer impact, including satisfaction, retention, pipeline influence, and product differentiation.

**Qualifications**
:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
* 4–6 years in product management, with experience in B2B SaaS, AI products, or sales technology.
* Hands-on experience building AI-enabled and agentic products
* Strong technical fluency across data products, APIs, integrations (such as CRM, SEP, browser extensions, and MCP), and analytics.
* Experience partnering with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Customer Success, Sales, and Product Marketing to deliver customer-facing products.
* Strong customer orientation, analytical judgment, and communication skills for technical and non-technical audiences.

**Key Competencies**

* Strategic, customer-centered product thinker with strong ownership and judgment.
* Deep empathy for sellers and how they work, with the ability to turn it into simple, high-value experiences.
* Data-driven decision maker who can connect product usage, customer value, and business outcomes.
* Systems thinker who can operate in ambiguity and simplify complex customer workflows.
* Strong collaborator who can align cross-functional teams and drive execution from discovery to launch.

**Why You’ll Love This Role**

* Impact. You will own the experiences where sellers decide who to focus on, prepare, and reach out, wherever they work.
* Innovation. You’ll shape how sellers work with agents, defining the capabilities and quality bar for RevvyAI for Sales.
* Growth. Join a rocket ship, learn every day, and accelerate your career in a collaborative, high-energy environment.
* Fun. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. Expect GIFs, puns, and the occasional Agentic GTM meme.

**Our Benefits:**
Full-time employees can take advantage of health coverage, paid parental leave, generous paid time-off and holidays, quarterly self-care days off, and stock options. We’ll make sure you have the equipment and support you need to work and connect with your teams, at home or in one of our oﬃces.
  
  
We have a growth mindset culture that is represented in all that we do, from onboarding through to numerous learning and development initiatives including access to our LinkedIn Learning platform. Employee well-being is also top of mind for us. We host quarterly wellness education sessions to encourage self care and personal growth. From wellness days to ERG-hosted events, we celebrate and energize all 6sense employees and their backgrounds.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer:**
6sense is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employers. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to jobs@6sense.com.
  
  
*We are aware of recruiting impersonation attempts that are not affiliated with 6sense in any way. All email communications from 6sense will originate from the @6sense.com domain. We will not initially contact you via text message and will never request payments. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official 6sense employee, reach out to jobs@6sense.com*

title: Senior Product Manager - Banking (Security)
description:
FairMoney is building the leading mobile banking platform for emerging markets. Founded in 2017, we are a Nigerian fintech company backed by investors including Tiger Global, Flourish Ventures, and others, having raised nearly €50 million.

Our products include current accounts, savings, debit cards, transfers, bill payments, POS solutions, and more. With a team representing over 27 nationalities, we are committed to making financial services accessible, reliable, and secure.

**Role Overview**

As a Senior Product Manager focused on Banking Security, you will own the strategy and roadmap for security-related product experiences across FairMoney's banking division, with a focus on protecting Nigerian customers and strengthening trust in our financial products.

You will work at the intersection of customer experience, fraud prevention, risk, compliance, and technology to build secure yet seamless banking experiences. Your goal will be to reduce security risks and fraudulent activity while ensuring that legitimate customers can access and use their accounts with minimal friction.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Product Strategy & Vision**

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
**Company: Spacewire Tech**

**Location: HSR Layout, Bengaluru (Work From Office)**

**Experience: 6 months to 2 years. (NO REMOTE/WFH)**

About us

We build subscription apps for Bharat: the hundreds of millions of people in tier 2, 3 and 4 India who pay by UPI and live on their phones. Our apps include BhaktiLok (daily devotion, aartis, AI palm and face reading), MeraTune (ringtones with your own name in them), CashAlert (voice alerts for UPI payments) and HeyBuddy (voice lock and assistant).

We are a small team that ships fast. An idea on Monday is usually a live test by Friday, and the numbers decide who was right.

The role

You will own the path from install to paid subscriber on one or more of our apps: onboarding, paywall, trial, autopay and retention. You work directly with the founders, engineers, designers and the ads team, and you get real ownership from week one — this is a backfill role, so you'll be stepping into live funnels and running experiments from day one, not easing in slowly.

This is a junior role (6 months to 2 years of experience). We care more about how you think and how fast you learn than about your title so far.

What you'll do

• Run experiments on onboarding, paywalls, pricing and trials, from hypothesis to result, and call the winner with data.

• Live in Mixpanel: build funnels, spot where users drop, and turn that into the next test.

• Track the subscription numbers that matter: login to trial, trial to paid, autopay success, renewals and churn.

• Write short, clear PRDs and work with engineers and designers to ship them quickly.

• Tear down competitor apps and bring back what is worth testing.

• Work with the ads team so the promise in the ad matches the first screen of the app.

• Shape features around how our users actually behave: regional languages, low-end Android phones, UPI autopay habits.

• Use AI tools every day to move faster on research, specs, copy and analysis.

Who we're looking for

**You should have**

• A feel for consumer apps in India, especially subscription, UPI autopay or content apps for the next billion users.

• Comfort with numbers. You can read a funnel, question it, and explain what it means in two lines.

• Clear writing in English and good spoken Hindi. You should be able to think like a user in Patna as easily as one in Pune.

• A bias to ship. You would rather run a rough test this week than a perfect one next month.

• Curiosity. You install apps just to see how their paywall works.

**Good to have**

• Hands-on time with Mixpanel, Firebase or a similar analytics tool.

• Hands-on experience with UPI AutoPay, mandate flows, recurring billing, or payment retry/dunning logic — big plus given our autopay and D2C payments work.

• Exposure to paywalls, pricing tests, payment gateways (Razorpay, Juspay, etc.) or Meta ads.

• Experience in devotional, astrology, utility or entertainment apps.

• A side project, app, page or channel you grew yourself.

Why you'll like it here

**Real ownership.**
Your tests go live to real users, and you see the result in days.

**Grow with us.**
This is an immediate backfill with real scope from day one — if you own it well, there's a clear path from Associate PM to PM as the product and team grow.

**Learn the full stack of a subscription business.**
Product, pricing, payments, ads and analytics, all in one seat.

**The gear you need.**
Laptop, tools, AI subscriptions: ask and it is sorted.

**We celebrate.**
Team parties every month, and nobody needs a reason.

**No heavy process.**
Few meetings, short docs, quick decisions.

**A fun bunch.**
We take the numbers seriously and ourselves a lot less.

How to apply

Send your resume to [email to add] with two things:

• One app you think has a great paywall or onboarding, and why.

• One thing you would test first on any of our apps.

Interested applicants can send their resumes to hr@spacewiretech.com / 6363598861

title: Principal Product Manager (FactoryOS)
description:
**ABOUT QUINCE**

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

**OUR CULTURE**

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

* We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
* Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
* Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

**THE ROLE**

We are seeking a
**Principal Product Manager**
to lead our Factory Tech within our Sourcing team. Quince is building the operating system for the factories, mills, and vendors that make our products. Factory OS is the software our supply partners run their operations on — planning, scheduling, capacity, quality, and compliance — replacing spreadsheets and disconnected tools with one system of record for how goods actually get made.

As Principal PM, you own this platform end to end: the vision, the roadmap, and the hard calls about what we build, for whom, and in what order. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with vendors and mills on the factory floor, and with our engineering, ops, and sourcing teams, to turn messy real-world production workflows into reliable software. This is a builder's role with outsized scope — you're defining a category, not iterating on a mature one.

**Responsibilities**

* Own the Factory OS product strategy — from vendor/mill discovery through roadmap, specs, and launch — and be accountable for adoption and measurable operational impact (adoption, on-time production, capacity utilization, quality yield, planning accuracy).
* Design the core operational workflows — production planning, scheduling, capacity management, order and material tracking — so they hold up under the reality of a working factory, not just a demo.
* Build for compliance and auditability from day one. Factory data touches sourcing, labor, quality, and trade requirements. You'll make compliance, traceability, and auditability first-class product surfaces, not bolt-ons — and ensure the system produces the records our partners and Quince are held to.
* Drive real adoption on the floor. A system that vendors and mills won't use is worthless. You'll obsess over onboarding, change management, and the gap between "shipped" and "used daily"
* Set the AI and automation thesis. Architect Factory OS for a future where every automatable workflow is executed by an agent, not a person clicking through screens. Decide which steps to automate first, design the human-in-the-loop and exception paths, and treat agents, APIs, and humans as composable actors in auditable, business-grade workflows.
* Partner deeply cross-functionally with engineering, ML, design, sourcing, and factory operations — translating ambiguous problem statements into shipped products.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 10+ years in product management, including senior/principal-level ownership of a complex B2B SaaS or operational software product from zero-to-one or through significant scale
* Direct experience building workflow-automation software - you've taken manual, multi-step operational processes and turned them into software that runs them, and you understand the difference between digitizing a workflow and actually automating it.
* Domain proximity to manufacturing, supply chain, or factory/operations software (MES/MOM, ERP, planning/scheduling, quality, or sourcing systems). You don't need to have run a factory, but you need to have built for people who do.
* A credible point of view on AI and agents in production software - not slideware. You've shipped, or can clearly articulate how you'd ship, agentic and human-in-the-loop automation into a real operational system.
* A track record with compliance-sensitive products — you've built software where auditability, traceability, and regulatory or contractual requirements were core to the design.
* Hands-on AI fluency — you use AI tools daily for discovery, spec-writing, and prototyping, and you build to think.
* Comfort in the field — you'll spend time with vendors and mills, and you're energized (not deterred) by messy, physical, real-world operations

**Preferred**

* Experience building software used by external partners/suppliers (not just internal or single-tenant customers).
* Background in apparel, textiles, consumer goods, or hard-goods manufacturing supply chains

**WHY QUINCE?**

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY**

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

*Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds*

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

description:
We are a technology-led healthcare solutions provider. We are driven by our purpose to enable healthcare organizations to be future-ready. We offer accelerated, global growth opportunities for talent that’s bold, industrious, and nimble. With Indegene, you gain a unique career experience that celebrates entrepreneurship and is guided by passion, innovation, collaboration, and empathy. To explore exciting opportunities at the convergence of healthcare and technology, check out www.careers.indegene.com Looking to jump-start your career? We understand how important the first few years of your career are, which create the foundation of your entire professional journey. At Indegene, we promise you a differentiated career experience. You will not only work at the exciting intersection of healthcare and technology but also will be mentored by some of the most brilliant minds in the industry. We are offering a global fast-track career where you can grow along with Indegene’s high-speed growth. We are purpose-driven. We enable healthcare organizations to be future ready and our customer obsession is our driving force. We ensure that our customers achieve what they truly want. We are bold in our actions, nimble in our decision-making, and industrious in the way we work.

**Experience:**
2+ years of relevant experience

**About the role**

Indegene is looking for a Product Analyst to join its platform team, which builds technology and AI-powered products used by life sciences companies around the world. You’ll work across the full product lifecycle: spotting customer needs, shaping features, delivering and deploying them, and supporting them in the field. You’ll work with clients, engineering, data science and business teams, and help decide where we can make our products smarter, faster and more useful for the people who rely on them.

**What you’ll do**

**Discovery and requirements**

* Turn business requirements into clear user stories with acceptance criteria, and help keep the product backlog prioritized and well groomed.
* Run stakeholder and user conversations, competitive research and workflow analysis to find real problems worth solving.

**Design and prototyping**

* Build wireframes, user flows and clickable prototypes for new features, using AI-assisted design and prototyping tools where they speed things up.
* Test concepts with users and stakeholders early, and refine them before development starts.

**Delivery and governance**

* Manage product development and deployment for multiple clients and internal stakeholders, working closely with engineering and QA through agile sprints.
* Coordinate user acceptance testing, release readiness and client-specific configuration, and keep scope, timelines and quality on track.

**Data and insights**

* Define and track product KPIs, including feature adoption, usage and AI output quality, and turn the data into recommendations for the roadmap.

**Go-to-market and support**

* Help create sales and marketing collateral, user guides, release notes and training materials.
* Run product demos for clients and internal teams.
* Triage support issues, find root causes and feed what you learn back into the roadmap.

**Working AI-first**

* Use AI tools such as LLM assistants and copilots every day to speed up research, analysis, documentation and story writing, while applying your own judgment to validate what they produce.

**What you bring**

**Must have**

* 2+ years of relevant experience as a Product Analyst, Business Analyst or Product Associate, ideally in B2B SaaS.
* A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or Engineering. An MBA with a technical background is preferred.
* Hands-on experience writing user stories and working in agile teams, using tools such as Jira and Confluence.
* Practical experience with generative AI tools, plus a solid grasp of how LLMs work, including prompting, context, strengths and limitations.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with close attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including the confidence to present to clients.

**Good to have**

* Exposure to pharma, life sciences or healthcare, especially commercial, medical or regulatory functions.
* Comfort with SQL and analytics tools such as Excel, Power BI, Tableau

**What’s in it for you**

* **End-to-end ownership:**
  Hands-on experience across the full product management and deployment lifecycle.
* **AI at the core :**
  From AI-Assisted to AI-lead product lifecycle management
* **Global exposure:**
  Work with clients and business teams around the world.
* **Strategic impact:**
  A role in one of the organization’s strategic initiatives.
* **Great team:**
  Learn from an experienced product and account management team who built the product from scratch.

title: Product Strategy
description:
***AI that manages your credit***

Our vision is simple: your credit should manage itself. Our AI agents continuously monitor your credit, identify problems, negotiate with lenders, help resolve overdues, manage payments and rewards and unlock better credit as your profile improves. What started in 2023 as personalised credit guidance is evolving into an intelligent credit partner that works for you 24/7. With 8M+ users, a $13M Series A led by Peak XV Partners, and a rapidly expanding credit marketplace, we’re in the next phase of our growth.

The Product Strategy role is a rare opportunity to help define what agentic AI looks like in consumer finance at India scale from deciding what we should build next, to turning entirely new ideas into products used by millions. We’re scaling from 1 to 100x. And we’re looking for people who want to build that future with us. Working closely with the Founder and Product leadership to identify opportunities, understand users, shape product bets and drive them from idea to launch to creating impact. You’ll help answer some of GoodScore’s biggest questions:

* What should we build next?
* Which consumer financial problems are worth solving?
* Where can AI create a 10x better experience?
* How do we turn an idea into a product used by millions?

**The Challenge:**

* Find the next big opportunities: Identify customer problems, market opportunities and new product bets; size them and build the business case.
* Shape what we build: Use user insights, data and competitive intelligence to influence product strategy, roadmap and prioritisation.
* Drive 0→1 initiatives: Take high-priority ideas from hypothesis to product definition, launch and iteration.
* Solve ambiguous problems: Work across product, tech, design, growth and business to tackle problems with no obvious playbook.
* Explore what's next: Track fintech, AI, consumer technology and emerging business models; identify ideas GoodScore should pursue.
* Own outcomes: Define success metrics, measure impact and continuously improve what you build.

**What do you need to succeed?**

* Exceptional academic and professional track record; IIT/NIT or equivalent undergraduate degree and/or top-tier MBA.
* 1–3 years of experience in management consulting at MBB or other top-tier firms (Kearney, Strategy&, L.E.K., etc.)
* Exposure to growth, digital, product or fintech projects is preferred.
* Strong structured problem solving and analytical skills . Should be comfort able with data, Excel and modelling (SQL is a plus)
* Genuine interest in technology, AI and digital products and a strong desire to move from strategy into execution
* Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to work across multiple stakeholders

*GoodScore is an equal opportunity employer. We hire for ability, potential and impact, and welcome talented people from all backgrounds. We do not discriminate based on gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, caste, religion, race, ethnicity, age, disability, marital or parental status, nationality, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Different perspectives make better products. We’re building a team that reflects the users we serve.*

title: Sr Manager, Business Process
description:
**The Company**
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
  
  
We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
  
  
We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.
  
  
Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

This role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to enhance operational effectiveness and developing methods for new assignments to align with organizational goals. PayPal

* Comfortable balancing creativity with structured thinking.

  *(Good to have)*

* Comfortable working cross-functionally with product, content, design, and engineering teams.

title: Technical Lead
description:
This is a hands-on senior developer role that is expected to operate like a Chief Technology Officer for our products.

You will write and review code, and you will also own what gets built, why, and in what order. You will work directly with the founders, the compliance and legal teams, and the sales team, and be the technology voice in front of clients.

You are

* The owner of the product and its technology
* Hands-on in architecture, code and releases
* A partner to sales in demos, pilots and pricing
* Building the roadmap with the founders

Key responsibilities

**Product ownership**

Own product end to end: features, quality, uptime and user experience. Convert client and internal feedback into clear product requirements.

**Technology roadmap**

Build and maintain a 12–18 month product and technology roadmap with the founders. Prioritise by revenue impact, client need and effort.

**Architecture and engineering**

Design and build a scalable, secure, multi-tenant SaaS platform. Modernise the existing product in stages without disrupting live clients. Write production code, review code, own releases.

**AI and automation**

Design AI into the product from the start: regulatory update ingestion, compliance mapping, evidence review and reporting, with human approval where needed.

**Go-to-market**

Join client demos, technical discussions, RFPs and pilots. Shape packaging and pricing inputs. Handle integrations and client security questionnaires.

**Security and reliability**

Set up access control, audit trails, monitoring, alerting and backups. Lead readiness for ISO 27001 / SOC 2 expected by regulated clients.

**Team and vendors**

Hire and mentor developers and interns. Manage external technology vendors and consultants, including scope, cost and delivery.

**Reporting**

Report progress, risks and technology costs to the founders in simple, measurable terms.

Must have

**Experience**

7–8 years in software development, with most of it in a SaaS or product-based technology company (not only services or project delivery).

Has taken at least one product or major module from 0 to 1 and run it in production with paying B2B customers.

Has led a small engineering team (3–5 people) or owned a product area end to end.

Has worked directly with founders, product, sales or customers, not only within engineering.

**Technical skills**

**Backend**

Strong in at least one modern stack: Python (Django / FastAPI) or Node.js

**Frontend**

Working knowledge of React or Angular; able to review and guide UI work

**Data**

PostgreSQL / MySQL, data modelling, migrations with zero downtime; Redis or similar

**SaaS architecture**

Multi-tenancy, role-based access control, audit logging, REST APIs, third-party integrations

**Cloud and DevOps**

AWS, GCP or Azure; Docker; CI/CD; monitoring and alerting (e.g. Grafana, Prometheus, Sentry)

**AI**

Practical experience shipping LLM-based features: RAG, document parsing, classification or agents

**Legacy modernization**

Has migrated or re-platformed a live product in stages

**Leadership and business skills**

•        Can build a roadmap and defend the priorities with numbers.

•        Can explain technology to non-technical founders, lawyers and clients in plain language.

•        Comfortable in client meetings, demos and commercial discussions.

•        Ownership mindset: treats product uptime, cost and delivery dates as personal commitments.

Good to have

•        Experience in compliance, legal-tech, regtech, fintech or other regulated-industry products.

•        Founding-engineer or early-engineer experience at a startup.

•        Exposure to ISO 27001 or SOC 2 Type II programmes.

•        Workflow, document-management or reporting/analytics products.

•        ERP or enterprise integrations (e.g. SAP, NetSuite) and SSO.

•        B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science or a related field.

title: Senior Manager - Business Growth (D2C)
description:
**About GoKwik**

GoKwik is a growth operating system for D2C and eCommerce brands, powering 15,000+ merchants globally. With a mission to democratise the shopping experience, GoKwik leverages technology, data, and AI to help brands maximise conversions, improve customer experience, and drive profitable growth. Its suite of solutions spans checkout, payments, customer engagement, performance marketing, shipping, and returns, enabling brands to optimise every stage of the customer journey.

**Why This Role Matters**

At GoKwik, we don't just power the growth of D2C brands; we also manage the end-to-end business operations of select brands, driving their growth, profitability, and long-term success.

As a Senior Manager - Business Growth, you will take complete ownership of the business performance and P&L of the brands you manage. You will work closely with brand founders, GoKwik's leadership, and cross-functional teams to define growth strategies, drive execution, and build scalable operating models.

Beyond managing individual brands, you will play a pivotal role in developing a repeatable business playbook that will enable GoKwik to onboard and scale multiple D2C brands.

**What You’ll Own**

**1. Business Strategy & P&L Ownership**

* Own the overall D2C business P&L, including revenue, gross margins, CAC, contribution margins, and cash flows.
* Develop annual operating plans, quarterly business targets, and growth strategies in collaboration with brand founders and GoKwik leadership.
* Identify growth opportunities across categories, pricing, hero SKUs, new product launches, and channel mix.
* Drive monthly business reviews, identifying opportunities to scale, optimise, or discontinue initiatives.

**2. Growth Strategy & Performance Marketing**

* Define customer acquisition strategies and marketing budgets across Meta, Google, influencers, and affiliate channels.
* Drive performance against key metrics such as ROAS, CAC, and new customer acquisition.
* Plan and execute seasonal campaigns and large-scale sale events, including forecasting, execution, and performance analysis.
* Drive customer retention and lifetime value through CRM, WhatsApp marketing, loyalty programmes, and subscriptions.

**3. Website Performance & Conversion Optimisation**

* Own the end-to-end D2C website funnel, tracking traffic, conversion rates, AOV, checkout success, and RTO.
* Identify and prioritise opportunities to improve product pages, bundles, offers, and checkout experiences in collaboration with GoKwik's product teams.
* Optimise COD and prepaid payment mix to drive order growth while maintaining healthy RTO levels.

**4. Business Operations & Supply Chain**

* Work closely with brand teams on demand forecasting, inventory planning, and new product launch timelines.
* Monitor fulfilment efficiency, delivery timelines, returns, and customer support metrics.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and drive improvements through root-cause analysis and cross-functional execution.

**5. Business Analytics & Performance Management**

* Build and maintain business dashboards and metric frameworks covering the entire funnel, from traffic and acquisition to contribution margins.
* Conduct detailed analysis across customer cohorts, SKUs, channels, and campaigns to identify growth opportunities.
* Establish and drive a structured weekly business review cadence across marketing, operations, customer experience, and agency partners.
* Translate business data into actionable insights and measurable business outcomes.

**6. Multi-Brand Strategy & Business Expansion**

* Build and document scalable operating playbooks covering business diagnostics, 90-day growth plans, dashboards, and team structures.
* Evaluate prospective D2C brands through business diagnostics, opportunity assessments, and business case development.
* Lead the onboarding and growth of new brands as GoKwik expands its managed brand portfolio.
* Over time, build and manage a team of brand managers to drive business performance across multiple brands.

**7. Stakeholder & Leadership Management**

* Act as the primary business partner for brand founders, ensuring alignment on business priorities, strategies, and performance.
* Collaborate with internal product, data, marketing, and operations teams to drive business outcomes.
* Present business performance, strategic recommendations, and key trade-offs to GoKwik leadership.

**Who You Are**

* MBA from a premier institute such as IIMs, ISB, XLRI, FMS, SPJIMR, or an equivalent global business school.
* 2–4 years of post-MBA experience in management consulting, preferably with MBB firms, Big 4 strategy practices, or reputed boutique strategy consulting firms. Pre-MBA experience will be an added advantage.
* Strong structured problem-solving abilities, with the ability to break down complex business challenges, identify root causes, and develop actionable recommendations.
* Strong understanding of P&L, business metrics, and unit economics, with hands-on experience building financial models using Excel or Google Sheets.
* Strong bias for action, with the ability to translate strategies into execution, experiment, measure outcomes, and drive continuous improvement.
* Comfortable taking end-to-end accountability for business performance and driving outcomes rather than limiting responsibilities to strategy and recommendations.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and align founders, agencies, leadership, and cross-functional teams.
* Thrives in fast-paced, entrepreneurial environments and is comfortable building processes and operating models from the ground up.

**Why GoKwik**

At GoKwik, you'll have the opportunity to work at the intersection of technology, commerce, and business strategy. You will get the ownership to build and scale businesses, work directly with founders and leadership teams, and create operating models that shape how GoKwik manages and grows its D2C brand portfolio. If you enjoy solving complex business challenges, driving execution, and building something from the ground up, GoKwik offers an opportunity to make a meaningful business impact.

title: Founding Product & Industry Specialist | Fashion AI
description:
**About Spurby**

**We're building the next generation of AI-native software for the industries that make and move physical products.**

AI is transforming how people work. We believe the next frontier is transforming how entire industries operate - making businesses faster, smarter and radically more efficient.

We're starting with fashion, an industry where bringing products from concept to market involves complex processes, multiple stakeholders and countless operational challenges.

Our ambition is to build category-defining AI products with global impact.

**The Opportunity**

**You've seen how the fashion industry works. Now help us reimagine it.**

We're looking for someone with hands-on fashion industry experience who is excited to move beyond traditional roles and help build the future of enterprise AI.

You'll work directly with Spurby's founding team, bringing deep industry knowledge into product discovery, innovation and development.

**You don't need to know how to build AI. You need to deeply understand the problems worth solving.**

**What You'll Do**

* **Understand the industry deeply:**
  Explore how fashion brands operate across design, buying, merchandising, product development, sourcing and production.
* **Discover high-impact problems:**
  Identify inefficiencies, repetitive work, bottlenecks and opportunities where technology could create significant value.
* **Shape new AI products:**
  Work closely with our founders and engineering team to translate industry insights into product ideas and solutions.
* **Engage with industry professionals:**
  Connect with brands, manufacturers and fashion teams to conduct research, validate ideas and gather feedback.
* **Build from day one:**
  Help test early products, learn from real users and influence our product roadmap.

**Who We're Looking For**

* **2+ years of hands-on experience**
  in fashion product development, merchandising, buying, design, sourcing or production.
* Experience at a fashion brand, buying house, apparel exporter or manufacturer.
* Strong understanding of real-world workflows, including the challenges of coordinating across teams and suppliers.
* Someone who questions existing processes, notices inefficiencies and enjoys solving complex problems.
* Curiosity about AI, technology and how software can transform traditional industries.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to explain operational problems in depth.

**Experience with PLM systems**
(Centric, WFX, BlueKaktus, Bamboo Rose, FlexPLM or similar) is strongly preferred.

However,
**we're not just looking for someone who understands the software. We're looking for someone who understands the work behind it.**

**Why Join Spurby?**

**Most people work within existing systems. Here's your opportunity to help build what comes next.**

* Work directly with the founding team at an early-stage AI startup.
* Play a meaningful role in defining new products from the ground up.
* Gain exposure to AI, product development and entrepreneurship.
* Help build technology with the potential to transform industries globally.

This isn't a traditional fashion operations or PLM role. It's an opportunity to bring your industry expertise into the world of frontier technology and help shape what comes next.

**How to Apply**

Along with your CV, briefly share:

1. Which fashion workflows and PLM systems have you personally worked with?
2. What's one major inefficiency you've experienced in your day-to-day work that you wish technology could solve?

title: Sana Commerce Cloud Lead
description:
**Sana Commerce Cloud Lead**

**Location:**
Bengaluru, India (Remote)

**Engagement Type:**
Contract

We are seeking an experienced
**Sana Commerce Cloud (SCC) Lead**
on a contract basis to own, design, and deliver end-to-end B2B e-commerce capabilities. You will drive solution architecture, functional leadership, and vendor coordination while integrating SCC with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O), product configurators, distributor portals, and PunchOut flows. Acting as the primary liaison across E-Commerce, Sales Ops, Pricing, Product, Finance, and engineering teams, you will ensure commerce solutions align seamlessly with enterprise business priorities across B2B, distributor, and internal sales channels.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Strategy & Functional Leadership:**
  Lead SCC commerce strategy, roadmap, and execution across B2B, distributor, and internal sales portals. Conduct fit/gap analyses, define requirements, and translate business needs into functional designs, user flows, and backlog items.
* **Architecture & System Integrations:**
  Oversee end-to-end integration architecture across SCC, D365 F&O, Experlogix configurator, Flintfox, and external middleware. Drive API, OData, and data mapping definitions.
* **Pricing & Order Orchestration:**
  Manage complex pricing controls for specific distributor and end-customer combinations, ensuring consistent order entry rules across all channels.
* **Testing & Vendor Coordination:**
  Own test planning (access, data setup, scenario coverage) across CRP/UAT cycles and coordinate with vendor teams to ensure timely delivery readiness.
* **Support & Governance:**
  Serve as the L3 escalation point for production issues across order capture, pricing, catalog, checkout, and integrations. Present updates, capability gaps, and solution risks in PMO calls, governance forums, and SteerCo discussions.

**Must-Have Skill Sets**

* **ERP & B2B E-Commerce Expertise:**
  8+ years of experience in ERP-enabled e-commerce solutions, including at least 4+ years of hands-on leadership in Sana Commerce Cloud (or equivalent B2B e-commerce platforms).
* **D365 F&O & Third-Party Integrations:**
  Proven experience integrating e-commerce platforms with Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&O, Experlogix (CPQ/configurator), Flintfox (pricing engine), and middleware via APIs and OData.
* **B2B Commerce Workflows:**
  Deep domain expertise in distributor portals, PunchOut flows, customer-specific pricing/catalog segmentation, "on-behalf-of" ordering, role-based access, and order orchestration.
* **End-to-End Delivery & Support:**
  Demonstrated track record leading functional designs, CRP/UAT cycles, and L3 production troubleshooting.

**Preferred Qualifications & Certifications**

* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related field (Master’s degree is a plus).
* **Certifications:**
  Sana Commerce Cloud certifications/training; Microsoft Dynamics 365 certifications (MB-300, MB-500, or MB-700) or Azure cloud integration certifications.
* **Additional Technical Exposure:**
  Familiarity with D365 security models, Microsoft Power Platform (workflow extensions and user provisioning), and complex CPQ systems.

**Key Deliverables & Expected Outcomes**

* **Deliverables:**
* End-to-end commerce solution architecture covering B2B portals, distributor ordering flows, pricing, catalog segmentation, PunchOut, and Available-to-Promise (ATP).
* Technical integration architecture documentation for D365 F&O, Flintfox, Experlogix, and middleware.
* Solution blueprints for "on-behalf-of" ordering and customer-specific catalog/pricing enablement.
* **Outcomes:**
* A scalable, future-ready enterprise commerce platform that eliminates fragmented ordering experiences across channels and establishes clear alignment between IT, Sales Ops, Pricing, Finance, and global digital teams.

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
**About SmartQ:**

SmartQ is redefining how the world experiences food. As a next-generation food-tech innovator, we solve real operational challenges through empathy-led insights and powerful technology. Our mission is clear: to elevate everyday dining into a seamless and meaningful experience.

In the last decade, we’ve transformed cafeteria and food operations across industries with scalable, cutting-edge solutions. Operating in 14 countries and backed by Compass Group- a $60B global foodservice leader SmartQ continues to push the boundaries of what modern food-tech can achieve.

Since our inception in 2015, we’ve become a trusted partner for corporates, hospitals, universities, and food courts worldwide. With a bold vision to become the world’s largest B2B food-tech company, we connect people through exceptional food experiences powered by advanced technology. Today, we proudly serve 400+ global clients, including leaders like Google, HSBC, Amazon, and Wells Fargo.

At the heart of SmartQ is a culture shaped by four core pillars:

**Great People | Great Food | Great Experience | Greater Good**

These values inspire collaboration, innovation, humility, and a relentless pursuit of excellence.

To dive deeper into what drives us, explore our cultural pillars on the SmartQ LinkedIn ‘Life’ page. It offers an authentic glimpse into the journey you could be part of: https://www.linkedin.com/company/smartq-bottlelabs/life/cdc290f8-ff81-4e7f-9c96-37d842f936c4/?viewA…

**Are you excited to join our team as Associate Product Manager?**

We are looking for a motivated, result-oriented and who is passionate about solving real-world business and user problems through technology and design.

In this role, you will take ownership of key product areas, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and translate customer insights and business requirements into scalable product solutions. You will work closely with engineering, design, and business teams to drive product development, ensure seamless execution, and deliver impactful solutions.

If you are enthusiastic about building innovative products and making a difference in the food-tech industry, we would love to have you on our team!

**Roles and responsibilities:**

* Solutioning: Translate business challenges and requirements into well-defined product solutions, outlining scope, possible approaches, dependencies, and edge cases.
* Product Discovery: Drive product discovery through user research, market analysis, competitor benchmarking, and customer insights to identify opportunities and shape product strategy.
* Product Documentation: Create and maintain product documentation, including Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), user stories, acceptance criteria, release notes
* Technical Collaboration: Work closely with engineering teams to assess technical feasibility, understand dependencies, evaluate effort estimates
* Design Collaboration: Partner with UI/UX teams to develop wireframes and mock-ups using tools such as Figma, ensuring designs align with business and product requirements.
* Cross-functional Coordination: Collaborate with engineering, design, business, and customer success teams to ensure smooth product execution and delivery.
* Product Performance: Monitor product performance through customer feedback, and data analysis to identify improvement opportunities and drive continuous enhancement.
* Agile Product Management: Participate in sprint planning, backlog grooming, sprint reviews, and release management while promoting Agile best practices.
* Delivery Management: Track product features throughout development, testing, and deployment, proactively follow up on dependencies and blockers, and provide regular progress updates to stakeholders

**Qualifications:**

* 1+ year of experience in Product Management, preferably within a B2B technology environment.
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.
* Experience in contributing to product launches, feature development, and product enhancements.
* Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Analytical mindset with hands-on experience in working with data, KPIs, metrics, and OKRs.
* Familiarity with product discovery methodologies, user research, and market analysis.
* Understanding of wireframing and prototyping, with exposure to tools such as Figma.
* Experience in creating PRDs, user stories, Jira tickets, and acceptance criteria.
* Good understanding of Agile methodologies, sprint planning, and product lifecycle management.
* Ability to understand technical concepts and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
* Excellent communication, problem-solving, and presentation skills, with the ability to engage technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Self-driven, adaptable, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

**Message from CEO:**

Food is an everyday necessity, but the experience around it can influence how we feel, connect, and go about our day. At SmartQ, we see an opportunity to make these everyday moments better, one meal at a time. Our aggregation model, powered by technology and operational excellence, brings together food partners, processes, and people to transform dining experience. By combining these capabilities, we continuously seek better ways to solve problems, improve efficiency, and create experiences that are simpler, smarter, and more human. As we continue to redefine this space, we believe the next breakthrough can come from anyone who questions convention, sees possibilities where others see routine, and brings a fresh perspective to a familiar challenge.

We look forward to welcoming minds who will challenge our thinking and help shape what SmartQ becomes next. We invite you to be that person. Together, let’s make everyday experiences extraordinary.

title: Senior Finance Manager- Financial and IR
description:
**Client - Fast growing venture in the SpaceTech domain.**

**What they build:**

* Launch vehicle systems — thrust vector control, flex nozzle and flow control systems, flight avionics
* Satellite subsystems — onboard computers, electronic control units, reaction wheels, star trackers, sun sensors

Our hardware supports India's national space programmes and a growing base of international customers across North America, Europe, the Middle East and Asia-Pacific.

**Role Summary**

We are looking for a Senior Finance Manager (Financial modelling & Investor Relation) to build and operate the entire global accounting and finance function across India, North America and European entities. The successful candidate will own the day-to-day finance operations, accounting, drive monthly close, publish MIS, working capital management, support budgeting and forecasting, coordinate global consolidation and work closely with the CFO and management on business and financial decision-making.

The role offers significant exposure to global operations, project-based / engineering finance and business decision-making, with the opportunity to grow into a broader finance leadership role.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own day-to-day accounting and finance function for the group, ensuring books and financial records are accurate, complete and up to date.
* Manage the monthly financial close, including reconciliations, review of key accounts and timely closure of books.
* Prepare consolidated financials consolidating the various global subsidiaries
* Prepare and publish monthly MIS, including P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, key financial schedules and relevant business KPIs.
* Manage the complete billing and invoicing process, ensuring timely and accurate billing in line with contracts, purchase orders, milestones and deliverables.
* Own accounts receivable and collections, monitor ageing, follow up on outstanding receivables and escalate collection risks.
* Manage accounts payable and vendor payments, ensuring accurate, timely and appropriately approved payments while maintaining visibility of outstanding payables.
* Manage banking and cash operations, including bank reconciliations, cash balances, banking transactions and short-term liquidity requirements.
* Coordinate monthly payroll processing, ensuring accurate inputs, timely processing and salary payments in coordination with HR and relevant external partners.
* Drive working capital management, with regular monitoring of receivables, payables, cash and inventory, and identify opportunities to improve cash conversion.
* Prepare and maintain cash-flow forecasts, providing management with visibility of expected cash inflows, outflows and funding requirements.
* Support the annual budgeting and forecasting process, including collection of inputs, consolidation, analysis and tracking of actual performance against budget.
* Analyse financial performance and provide variance analysis and actionable insights to the CFO and founders to support business decision-making.
* Review project financial tracking, including project revenues, costs, budgets, inventory/WIP and profitability, and provide visibility into project margins, cost overruns and key financial risks.
* Support project and contract economics, including costing of materials, labour, subcontracting and other direct/indirect costs, and develop relevant project KPIs and analysis.
* Ensure timely and accurate statutory and regulatory compliance, including GST, TDS, payroll-related and other compliance, in coordination with external advisors where required.
* Coordinate with auditors, tax advisors, bankers and other external stakeholders, and ensure timely provision of information and resolution of finance-related matters.
* Establish, maintain and improve finance processes, internal controls and documentation
* Support ERP implementation, process automation and financial-system enhancements to build a scalable finance function.
* Identify gaps in existing processes and implement improvements to enhance accuracy, efficiency and accountability.

**Qualifications**

* CA / CMA or equivalent qualification.
* 3–6 years of relevant experience in accounting and finance, preferably in a high-growth startup, technology, manufacturing, aerospace, engineering, EPC or other project-based environment.
* Strong understanding of financial accounting and financial reporting.
* Experience working with multiple entities and/or international operations.
* Hands-on experience with MIS, budgeting, forecasting and cash-flow management.
* Ability to independently manage monthly close and management reporting.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and ownership of deliverables.
* Strong communication and coordination skills.

**What We Offer**

* High-ownership role with direct exposure to the CFO and leadership team.
* Opportunity to help build and scale the finance function of a growing aerospace and engineering business.
* Exposure to project finance, manufacturing/engineering economics and global operations.
* Opportunity to work across accounting, FP&A, working capital and strategic finance.
* Strong learning and career-growth opportunity with the potential to take on broader finance leadership responsibilities as the organisation scales.

title: Business Finance Manager
description:
**About Us**

At Vahan, we are building India's first AI-powered recruitment marketplace for the country's 300 million-strong blue-collar workforce, opening doors to economic opportunities and brighter futures. Already India's largest recruitment platform, Vahan is backed by marquee investors like Khosla Ventures, Y Combinator, LemmaTree (a Temasek-founded investing firm), Persol Group, Bharti Airtel, Vijay Shekhar Sharma (CEO, Paytm), and senior executives from Google and Facebook. Our customers include leading names such as Swiggy, Zomato, Rapido, Zepto, and many more. We leverage cutting-edge technology and AI to help these companies recruit at scale and with precision.

Our vision is ambitious: to become the go-to platform for blue-collar professionals worldwide, empowering them with not just earning opportunities but also the tools, benefits, and support they need to thrive. Our mission is to impact over a billion lives globally, creating a future where everyone has access to economic prosperity.

If our vision excites you, Vahan might just be your next adventure. We're on the hunt for driven individuals who love tackling big challenges. If this sounds like your kind of journey, dive into the details and see where you can make your mark.

**About the Role**

As a Business Finance professional, you will partner with business and operating teams to turn performance data into clear financial decisions. You will own planning, forecasting, reporting, and business analysis across key cost and revenue drivers in a fast-moving marketplace environment.

**What You Will Be Doing**

***Business Planning & Forecasting***

• Build annual operating plans, periodic forecasts, and scenario models for revenue, headcount, operating costs, and unit economics.

• Partner with business owners to translate operating plans into measurable financial targets and budget requirements.

• Identify risks and opportunities in forecasts early, quantify their impact, and recommend actions.

***Performance Reporting & Analysis***

• Own monthly business performance reporting, including actual-versus-budget analysis, trend analysis, and management dashboards.

• Analyse revenue, contribution margin, customer acquisition cost, fulfilment costs, productivity, and other key business drivers.

• Investigate material variances, separate one-off effects from structural issues, and communicate the underlying story clearly.

***Business Partnering & Decision Support***

• Work closely with operations, growth, product, and leadership teams on pricing, investments, hiring plans, and new initiatives.

• Build decision models for business cases and evaluate expected returns, payback periods, and sensitivity to key assumptions.

• Challenge assumptions constructively and ensure decisions are supported by reliable data and financial logic.

***Financial Controls & Process Improvement***

• Maintain disciplined planning and reporting processes, including version control, reconciliations, and documentation of key assumptions.

• Work with Accounting to reconcile management reporting with financial actuals and improve reporting accuracy.

• Automate recurring analyses and improve the speed, reliability, and usability of finance reports.

**You Will Thrive in This Role If You**

***Core Requirements***

• Have 3–5 years of experience in FP&A, business finance, commercial finance, investment banking, consulting, or a similarly analytical finance role.

• Have built budgets, forecasts, financial models, and actual-versus-budget analyses for a business or business unit.

• Are highly proficient in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including complex formulas, pivot tables, scenario modelling, and data reconciliation.

• Can interpret P&L drivers, unit economics, contribution margins, and cash-flow implications.

• Can turn incomplete business data into a structured analysis and a clear recommendation.

***Strong Plus***

• Have worked in a high-growth startup, marketplace, consumer internet, logistics, or operations-heavy business.

• Have used SQL to independently extract, validate, and analyse business data.

• Have experience with BI tools such as Metabase, Power BI, Tableau, or Looker.

• Hold a CA, CMA, CFA, MBA in Finance, or equivalent finance qualification.

***Finance Mindset***

• Are detail-oriented enough to reconcile numbers, while staying focused on the decision those numbers need to support.

• Communicate financial findings in plain language and adapt the level of detail for operators and leadership.

• Are comfortable challenging assumptions, asking for source data, and owning the accuracy of your work.

• Move quickly on recurring business questions without compromising on rigour or controls.

***Leadership Without Authority***

• Build trust with cross-functional stakeholders and get timely inputs without relying on formal reporting lines.

• Influence decisions through evidence, structured trade-offs, and clear follow-through.

• Take ownership of ambiguous problems and bring stakeholders to a practical, measurable plan.

**What We Offer**

• Unlimited PTO: Trust and flexibility to manage your time in the way that works best for you.

• Comprehensive Medical Insurance: Plans designed to support you and your loved ones.

• Monthly Wellness Leaves: Regular time off to recharge and focus on what matters most.

• Competitive Pay: Your contributions are recognised and rewarded with a compensation package that reflects your impact.

Join us, and be part of something bigger, where your work drives real, positive change in the world.
