title: MIS/ERP - Marketing
description:
**B**

The role is responsible for managing
**Marketing MIS, ERP/CRM**
operations, marketing-related financial documentation, vendor coordination, invoice processing, payment tracking, work orders, purchase orders, and marketing expenditure records. The position will act as a key coordination point between the Marketing, Accounts & Finance, Procurement, and external vendors/agencies to ensure timely processing and closure of marketing-related commercial activities.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. MIS & ERP Management**

* Prepare and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports related to marketing activities and expenditures.
* Maintain accurate project-wise, campaign-wise, vendor-wise, and cost-wise data in ERP/CRM systems.
* Update ERP systems with relevant purchase orders, work orders, invoices, vendor details, and payment status.
* Generate periodic reports and dashboards for management review.
* Track approved budgets versus actual marketing expenditure.
* Ensure timely and accurate data entry and updation in ERP/MIS systems.
* Identify data discrepancies and coordinate with concerned teams for resolution.
* Maintain trackers for pending approvals, invoices, payments, work orders, and purchase orders.

**2. Invoice Processing & Verification**

* Collect marketing-related invoices from vendors, agencies, suppliers, and service providers.
* Verify invoices against approved work orders, purchase orders, quotations, agreements, and deliverables.
* Check invoice details, tax information, billing amounts, and supporting documents before submission for processing.
* Coordinate with Marketing and Finance/Accounts teams for invoice verification and approval.
* Submit approved invoices to Accounts/Finance for further processing.
* Maintain an updated invoice tracker with invoice number, vendor name, amount, submission date, approval status, and payment status.
* Follow up on pending or rejected invoices and coordinate for necessary corrections.
* Ensure timely closure of invoice-related queries and discrepancies.

**3. Payment Follow-up & Status Updates**

* Regularly follow up with Accounts/Finance teams regarding pending vendor payments.
* Maintain and update payment status trackers for all marketing vendors and agencies.
* Share periodic payment status updates with Marketing leadership and relevant stakeholders.
* Coordinate with vendors regarding payment-related queries and communicate expected payment timelines.
* Track overdue and pending payments and escalate delays where required.
* Maintain records of payment confirmations and update the ERP/MIS accordingly.
* Coordinate with Accounts for payment reconciliation and closure of outstanding items.

**4. Vendor Onboarding & Management**

* Coordinate the onboarding of new marketing vendors, agencies, suppliers, and service providers.
* Collect and verify vendor onboarding documents such as company details, PAN, GST, bank details, cancelled cheque, agreements, and other required documents.
* Coordinate with Procurement, Finance, Legal, and other internal teams for vendor registration and approval.
* Maintain an updated vendor master database.
* Ensure vendor information is accurately updated in the ERP system.
* Coordinate with vendors for renewal and updation of expired or incomplete documentation.
* Maintain vendor-wise records of work orders, invoices, payments, agreements, and supporting documents.

**5. Work Orders & Purchase Orders**

* Coordinate with Marketing teams to prepare and process work orders based on approved requirements.
* Collect quotations and commercial proposals from vendors wherever required.
* Coordinate with Procurement and Finance teams for work order and purchase order processing.
* Ensure work orders/POs are raised with appropriate approvals before commencement of vendor activities.
* Track the status of work orders and purchase orders from initiation to closure.
* Maintain a work order and PO tracker with details of vendor, scope of work, value, validity, approval status, and closure status.
* Ensure invoices are processed against the appropriate work orders/POs.
* Coordinate for amendments or extensions to work orders wherever required.

**6. Marketing Budget & Expense Tracking**

* Maintain project-wise and campaign-wise marketing budget trackers.
* Monitor approved budgets, committed costs, actual expenditure, and available balances.
* Track marketing expenses against approved work orders and purchase orders.
* Prepare budget versus actual expenditure reports.
* Highlight budget variances and pending commitments to the Marketing team.
* Coordinate with Finance for monthly expenditure closing and reconciliation.
* Support the Marketing team in preparing annual and quarterly marketing budgets.

**7. Documentation & Record Management**

* Maintain proper documentation of all marketing-related commercial and financial transactions.
* Maintain records of quotations, comparative statements, approvals, work orders, purchase orders, invoices, payment confirmations, agreements, and vendor documents.
* Ensure documents are systematically filed and easily retrievable for audits and management reviews.
* Maintain project-wise and vendor-wise documentation.
* Ensure all required approvals and supporting documents are available before processing invoices and payments.
* Support internal and external audit requirements by providing relevant records and reports.

**8. Marketing Agency & Vendor Coordination**

* Coordinate with advertising agencies, digital marketing agencies, media partners, event agencies, printers, outdoor advertising vendors, and other marketing service providers.
* Track vendor deliverables against agreed scope of work and commercial terms.
* Coordinate with vendors for submission of invoices and supporting documents.
* Follow up on pending documentation, invoices, and payment-related queries.
* Maintain vendor performance and commercial records wherever required.

**9. Marketing Campaign & Spend Tracking**

* Maintain records of all ongoing and completed marketing campaigns and activities.
* Track campaign-wise planned and actual expenditure.
* Coordinate with Marketing and Digital teams to capture campaign performance data.
* Maintain records of media spends, event expenses, branding expenses, digital marketing spends, and other marketing costs.
* Prepare campaign-wise and project-wise expenditure reports for management review.

**10. Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Act as a coordination point between Marketing, Accounts & Finance, Procurement, Legal, and vendors.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure timely approvals and processing of commercial transactions.
* Follow up with relevant teams to close pending invoices, payments, work orders, and documentation.
* Provide regular status updates to the Marketing Head and management.
* Support the Marketing team in maintaining operational and financial discipline.

title: Senior Marketing Operations Specialist
description:
Sprinto is an
**Autonomous Trust Platform**
that centralizes trust requirements across
**security frameworks, vendors, and customers.**
Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.
  
  
Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve
**raised**
**$31.8M**
in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over
**4,000 organizations across 75 countries**
, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With
**300+ native integrations**
and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports
**200+ global security standards natively**
, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.
  
  
**Founded in 2020**
by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.
  
  
**Life as a Sprinter -**
Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.
  
  
We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.
  
  
Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.
  
  
We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.
  
  
And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.
  
  
**The mission -**
We’re looking for a Senior Marketing Operations Specialist to own marketing reporting, manage HubSpot processes, and build automation and AI-powered workflows.
  
  
You’ll work closely with the Marketing Operations Manager and support demand gen, content, events, sales and RevOps with reporting, campaign operations and lead management.
  
  
**Where you'll leave your mark?**

* Own reporting across leads, demos, pipeline and revenue by channel and campaign.
* Build dashboards in HubSpot and BI tools, investigate performance changes and recommend next steps.
* Improve ROI and attribution reporting, with consistent metric definitions across marketing and RevOps.
* Manage HubSpot properties, lists, lifecycle stages and data quality.
* Maintain lead scoring, routing and handoff workflows in partnership with sales and RevOps.
* Maintain tracking across forms, UTMs, GA4 and HubSpot, and support campaign setup and launches.
* Automate manual processes using HubSpot workflows and tools like Zapier, n8n or Make.
* Build AI-powered workflows for lead research, enrichment, data cleanup and reporting.
* Test and monitor workflows, measure their impact and document how they work.

**The kind of builder we're looking for -**

* 3+ years in marketing or revenue operations, ideally in B2B SaaS.
* Strong hands-on HubSpot experience and experience independently managing operational projects.
* Confidence analysing data in Excel or Google Sheets and building dashboards in a BI tool.
* A solid understanding of the B2B funnel, conversion rates and marketing-to-sales handoffs.
* Experience building automations and at least one practical AI-powered workflow, at work or in a side project.
* Attention to detail, strong problem-solving skills and clear communication.

Good to Have
  
  
  

* Basic SQL and familiarity with APIs, webhooks and JSON.
* Experience with GA4, enrichment or intent tools.
* Experience evaluating, rolling out and managing a MarTech or GTM tool.

**How we care for our Sprinters?**

* Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach
* Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance
* We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills
* We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to
* Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary
* Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you

**Inclusion & Diversity -**
At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.
  
  
We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Marketing Manager
description:

title: Senior Manager - Business Growth (D2C)
description:
**About GoKwik**

GoKwik is a growth operating system for D2C and eCommerce brands, powering 15,000+ merchants globally. With a mission to democratise the shopping experience, GoKwik leverages technology, data, and AI to help brands maximise conversions, improve customer experience, and drive profitable growth. Its suite of solutions spans checkout, payments, customer engagement, performance marketing, shipping, and returns, enabling brands to optimise every stage of the customer journey.

**Why This Role Matters**

At GoKwik, we don't just power the growth of D2C brands; we also manage the end-to-end business operations of select brands, driving their growth, profitability, and long-term success.

As a Senior Manager - Business Growth, you will take complete ownership of the business performance and P&L of the brands you manage. You will work closely with brand founders, GoKwik's leadership, and cross-functional teams to define growth strategies, drive execution, and build scalable operating models.

Beyond managing individual brands, you will play a pivotal role in developing a repeatable business playbook that will enable GoKwik to onboard and scale multiple D2C brands.

**What You’ll Own**

**1. Business Strategy & P&L Ownership**

* Own the overall D2C business P&L, including revenue, gross margins, CAC, contribution margins, and cash flows.
* Develop annual operating plans, quarterly business targets, and growth strategies in collaboration with brand founders and GoKwik leadership.
* Identify growth opportunities across categories, pricing, hero SKUs, new product launches, and channel mix.
* Drive monthly business reviews, identifying opportunities to scale, optimise, or discontinue initiatives.

**2. Growth Strategy & Performance Marketing**

* Define customer acquisition strategies and marketing budgets across Meta, Google, influencers, and affiliate channels.
* Drive performance against key metrics such as ROAS, CAC, and new customer acquisition.
* Plan and execute seasonal campaigns and large-scale sale events, including forecasting, execution, and performance analysis.
* Drive customer retention and lifetime value through CRM, WhatsApp marketing, loyalty programmes, and subscriptions.

**3. Website Performance & Conversion Optimisation**

* Own the end-to-end D2C website funnel, tracking traffic, conversion rates, AOV, checkout success, and RTO.
* Identify and prioritise opportunities to improve product pages, bundles, offers, and checkout experiences in collaboration with GoKwik's product teams.
* Optimise COD and prepaid payment mix to drive order growth while maintaining healthy RTO levels.

**4. Business Operations & Supply Chain**

* Work closely with brand teams on demand forecasting, inventory planning, and new product launch timelines.
* Monitor fulfilment efficiency, delivery timelines, returns, and customer support metrics.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and drive improvements through root-cause analysis and cross-functional execution.

**5. Business Analytics & Performance Management**

* Build and maintain business dashboards and metric frameworks covering the entire funnel, from traffic and acquisition to contribution margins.
* Conduct detailed analysis across customer cohorts, SKUs, channels, and campaigns to identify growth opportunities.
* Establish and drive a structured weekly business review cadence across marketing, operations, customer experience, and agency partners.
* Translate business data into actionable insights and measurable business outcomes.

**6. Multi-Brand Strategy & Business Expansion**

* Build and document scalable operating playbooks covering business diagnostics, 90-day growth plans, dashboards, and team structures.
* Evaluate prospective D2C brands through business diagnostics, opportunity assessments, and business case development.
* Lead the onboarding and growth of new brands as GoKwik expands its managed brand portfolio.
* Over time, build and manage a team of brand managers to drive business performance across multiple brands.

**7. Stakeholder & Leadership Management**

* Act as the primary business partner for brand founders, ensuring alignment on business priorities, strategies, and performance.
* Collaborate with internal product, data, marketing, and operations teams to drive business outcomes.
* Present business performance, strategic recommendations, and key trade-offs to GoKwik leadership.

**Who You Are**

* MBA from a premier institute such as IIMs, ISB, XLRI, FMS, SPJIMR, or an equivalent global business school.
* 2–4 years of post-MBA experience in management consulting, preferably with MBB firms, Big 4 strategy practices, or reputed boutique strategy consulting firms. Pre-MBA experience will be an added advantage.
* Strong structured problem-solving abilities, with the ability to break down complex business challenges, identify root causes, and develop actionable recommendations.
* Strong understanding of P&L, business metrics, and unit economics, with hands-on experience building financial models using Excel or Google Sheets.
* Strong bias for action, with the ability to translate strategies into execution, experiment, measure outcomes, and drive continuous improvement.
* Comfortable taking end-to-end accountability for business performance and driving outcomes rather than limiting responsibilities to strategy and recommendations.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and align founders, agencies, leadership, and cross-functional teams.
* Thrives in fast-paced, entrepreneurial environments and is comfortable building processes and operating models from the ground up.

**Why GoKwik**

At GoKwik, you'll have the opportunity to work at the intersection of technology, commerce, and business strategy. You will get the ownership to build and scale businesses, work directly with founders and leadership teams, and create operating models that shape how GoKwik manages and grows its D2C brand portfolio. If you enjoy solving complex business challenges, driving execution, and building something from the ground up, GoKwik offers an opportunity to make a meaningful business impact.

title: Sr. Director, Market Lead
description:
Thomson Reuters is looking for a Senior Director, Market Lead, India to join our Regional Asia & Emerging Markets Leadership Team. This is a hands-on and strategic role, responsible for building a high-performance sales organisation while setting the foundations for long-term success aligned to our India market strategy.
  
  
You will provide strategic and operational leadership across the full sales team; BDMs, Pre-Sales, and SDRs; driving a high-performance culture through clear expectations, ambitious goals, accountability, and ongoing coaching and development. You'll shape team dynamics, motivate individuals, and ensure alignment with strategic goals.
  
  
This is a high-impact, end-to-end commercial leadership role covering the full customer lifecycle; from lead generation and sales closure through to retention and growth across our complete company portfolio. You will shape and execute strategies that accelerate market share, drive short- and long-term revenue growth, and strengthen our brand's presence in India.
  
  
You're a results-driven leader who thrives in a matrixed, fast-paced, regional and global environment; someone with strong ability to influence and collaborate across cross-functional teams, build C-level relationships, and inspire high-performing teams to deliver.
  
  
**Key Deliverables**

* Achieve or exceed market revenue, net new sales, cross-sell, upsell and retention targets.
* Deliver strong Net Promoter Scores and customer experience metrics.
* Grow Book of Business through new business development and retention strategies.
* Maximize client value through renewals and upselling initiatives.
* Ensure team adherence to KPIs: activity metrics, forecast accuracy, pipeline coverage, and account planning.
* Provide actionable market feedback to inform company strategy and product development.
* Lead performance management for a strong-performing regional team; using data-driven insights to assess contributions, identify growth opportunities, and implement targeted development plans that keep the team engaged, empowered, and delivering results

**About The Role**
As a Senior Director, Market Lead, India, you will be responsible for the following:
  
  

* Tactical and Strategic Leadership: Develop and execute go-to-market strategies to drive sales, market share, and retention goals. Champion the company's vision and thought leadership within the market.
* Team Management & Coaching: Lead, coach, and inspire high-performing Sales & Pre Sales teams. Foster a customer-focused, results-driven culture through targeted development and performance management.
* End-to-End Sales & Retention Ownership: Oversee all market commercial activity from lead generation through to sales closure, onboarding, and ongoing client retention and upsell.
* Client Relationship Management: Build and nurture strong C-level and executive relationships with key clients, acting as a trusted advisor and brand ambassador.
* Market Intelligence: Stay ahead of industry trends, competitor activity, and client needs to inform commercial strategy and market relevance.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with Product, Marketing, Professional Services, Partnerships & Alliances, and other internal teams in a matrixed environment to deliver seamless client experiences.
* Performance Management: Monitor and report on sales metrics, pipeline health, and team/individual performance. Prepare regular business reports and recommendations for senior leadership.
* Brand Advocacy: Represent the company at industry events, speaking engagements, and client forums.
* Continuous Improvement: Identify and implement process improvements & best practices to drive efficiency across the sales cycle.

**About You**
As a Senior Director, Market Lead, India, you should possess the following:
  
  

* Go-To-Market/Sales Leadership experience: 15+ years experience in a high performing technology / SaaS environment with at least 5 years experience in leading and managing teams.
* Strategic Acumen: Proven ability to design, execute, and adjust commercial strategies to achieve ambitious sales and retention objectives.
* Executive Communication: Exceptional communication, negotiation, and influencing skills at C-level and senior executive level, both internally and externally
* Collaboration: Demonstrated success operating in a matrixed, cross-functional environment, building strong partnerships across peers and stakeholders.
* Client Centricity: Strong customer orientation with the ability to understand, articulate, and solve complex client needs specific to the India market.
* Analytical & Problem Solving: Advanced analytical skills to identify risks and opportunities, and drive data-informed decision-making.
* Market Understanding & Intelligence: Deep understanding of the India market, including established client relationships and knowledge of local market considerations
* Presentation Skills: Strong public speaking and presentation skills, with experience representing organizations at industry events.
* Change Management: Track record of leading change management, mitigating risk, and driving adoption across teams
* M&A experience would be highly desirable

**What’s in it For You?**

* Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
* Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
* Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
* Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
* Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
* Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
* Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

**About Us**
Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.
  
  
We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.
  
  
As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace.
  
  
We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here.

description:

title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
About betterhood

betterhood is a preventive pain care and musculoskeletal wellness D2C brand focused on helping Indians live healthier, more active and pain-free lives. We are building a science-backed, physiotherapist-co-created ecosystem across posture support, pain relief, recovery and musculoskeletal health products.

As we scale our product portfolio and build new categories, we are looking for a highly driven Performance Marketing Manager who understands the intersection of performance marketing, creative strategy, consumer psychology and D2C business growth.

The Role

You will own performance marketing strategy and execution across Meta and Google Ads, with a strong emphasis on Meta-led customer acquisition and creative-led growth. This is not just an ad-account management role. We are looking for someone who can identify growth opportunities, build categories from scratch, develop winning creative strategies and scale individual SKUs towards ₹1 Cr+ in monthly revenue.

1. Performance Marketing & Business Scaling

·  Own the end-to-end performance marketing strategy across Meta Ads and Google Ads.

·  Drive customer acquisition, revenue growth, ROAS, CAC and contribution-margin efficiency.

·  Build and scale D2C categories and individual SKUs through structured performance marketing strategies.

·  Demonstrate the ability to take products from launch (0 to 1) to ₹1 Cr+ monthly revenue.

·  Manage and optimise monthly advertising budgets of ₹1 Cr+ while maintaining acquisition efficiency.

·  Identify growth opportunities across products, categories, audiences and customer segments.

·  Develop scaling strategies across prospecting, retargeting, remarketing and customer acquisition funnels.

2. Creative Research, Strategy & Planning - Core Competency

·  Own the complete creative research and planning process for performance marketing.

·  Develop a deep understanding of consumer pain points, motivations, buying behaviour, objections and purchase triggers.

·  Research competitors, winning ads, category trends, customer reviews, social conversations and emerging consumer insights.

·  Translate consumer insights into high-converting creative concepts, hooks, angles and communication strategies.

·  Build structured creative testing frameworks across audiences, target groups, product USPs, use cases and messaging angles.

·  Develop creative briefs for static ads, videos, UGC, founder-led content, testimonials and product demonstrations.

·  Analyse creative performance to identify winning hooks, formats, messaging and visual patterns.

·  Improve creative hit rate through systematic research, testing, analysis and iteration.

·  Build a repeatable creative pipeline that consistently delivers winning creatives and reduces creative fatigue.

3. Category Building & SKU Scaling

·  Build new D2C categories through consumer research, demand identification and performance-led experimentation.

·  Develop go-to-market and customer acquisition strategies for new product launches.

·  Understand how to establish a new category, create consumer demand and scale product adoption.

·  Demonstrate the journey from initial product testing to category-level growth.

·  Identify hero SKUs, winning product propositions and scalable consumer segments.

·  Build repeatable frameworks to scale individual SKUs to ₹1 Cr+ monthly sales.

4. Meta & Google Ads Expertise

·  Demonstrate deep hands-on expertise in Meta Ads, including campaign structures, audience strategies, creative testing and scaling.

·  Manage large-scale Meta advertising campaigns with strong command over budget allocation and optimisation.

·  Have practical experience with Google Ads, including Search, Shopping, Performance Max and other relevant acquisition formats.

·  Understand full-funnel acquisition, retargeting, attribution and campaign measurement.

·  Collaborate with creative, content and growth teams to improve campaign performance.

5. Data Analytics & Performance Optimisation

·  Analyse campaign performance at account, campaign, ad set, creative, audience and SKU levels.

·  Bring strong analytical skills and advanced working knowledge of Excel / Google Sheets.

·  Track and interpret CAC, ROAS, CPA, CTR, CPM, CVR, AOV, MER and contribution margins.

·  Build performance dashboards, creative performance trackers and growth reports.

·  Identify performance gaps and translate data into actionable optimisation strategies.

·  Make data-backed decisions on budget allocation, creative testing and scaling.

Must-Have Requirements

·       Minimum 2+ years of hands-on experience in D2C performance marketing.

·       Proven experience managing and scaling D2C brands, categories and individual SKUs.

·       Strong track record of scaling products to significant monthly revenue, ideally ₹1 Cr+ per SKU.

·       Experience managing monthly advertising budgets of ₹1 Cr or above.

·       Deep expertise in Meta Ads and hands-on experience with Google Ads.

·       Exceptional understanding of creative research, creative strategy, creative planning and performance analysis.

·       Ability to independently develop performance marketing strategies and execute them hands-on.

·       Strong analytical skills and proficiency in Excel / Google Sheets.

·       Demonstrated ability to connect advertising performance with actual business growth and profitability.

Good to Have

·       Experience scaling D2C brands in Health & Wellness, Fitness, Nutrition, Personal Care, Beauty or other consumer categories.

·       Experience launching and scaling new product categories from scratch.

·       Understanding of D2C funnels, landing page optimisation, CRO, attribution and retention marketing.

·       Experience working with high-volume creative production teams, content creators and UGC ecosystems.

Who Should Apply?

We are looking for an owner, not just an executor. Someone who:

·       Thinks like a growth entrepreneur and approaches marketing with a business-first mindset.

·       Has the creative intelligence to identify consumer insights and turn them into winning ads.

title: Head of International Exports
description:
**About Shashi Distilleries**

Established in 1993 and headquartered in Bengaluru, Shashi Distilleries Private Limited is an established Indian alcoholic beverages manufacturer with a diverse portfolio spanning Whisky, Brandy, Vodka, Rum and Gin.

With over three decades of manufacturing experience, we are focused on expanding our international presence by building strong distribution partnerships, developing new markets, and taking our brands to consumers across the globe.

As we accelerate our international growth, we are looking for an experienced and commercially driven Head of International Exports to lead this journey.

**The Role**

The Head of International Exports will be responsible for developing, growing, and managing Shashi Distilleries' international business.

This is a leadership role requiring a combination of strategic market development, distributor acquisition, commercial management and export business execution. The successful candidate will identify attractive international markets, establish distribution partnerships, develop sustainable revenue streams, and build a scalable export business.

The position will report directly to the Managing Director.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. International Market Development**

* Develop and execute the company's international export strategy and growth roadmap.
* Identify, evaluate, and prioritise new markets across Africa, the Middle East, Southeast Asia, and other relevant regions.
* Assess market opportunities, competitive positioning, consumer segments, pricing structures and regulatory requirements.
* Develop country-specific business plans and market-entry strategies.

**2. Distributor Acquisition and Business Development**

* Identify, engage, negotiate, and onboard importers, distributors, and strategic business partners.
* Build a strong international distributor network and develop long-term commercial relationships.
* Lead business negotiations, commercial agreements, pricing discussions and market-entry arrangements.
* Convert market opportunities into sustainable business relationships and repeat orders.

**3. International Sales and Key Account Management**

* Drive export revenue, volume growth, and profitability across assigned markets.
* Manage and grow existing international accounts and distribution partnerships.
* Develop country-wise sales targets, forecasts, and business plans.
* Work closely with distributors to improve brand visibility, market penetration and portfolio performance.

**4. Portfolio and Brand Development**

* Identify suitable products and brand portfolios for different international markets and consumer segments.
* Develop market-specific product, pricing and positioning strategies.
* Work with internal teams on packaging, labelling, product specifications and market requirements.
* Identify opportunities for expanding the company's international brand presence.

**5. Commercial and Financial Management**

* Develop export pricing strategies and ensure healthy contribution margins.
* Manage commercial negotiations, payment terms, credit exposure, and collections.
* Monitor market-wise profitability, business performance, and working capital.
* Ensure appropriate commercial controls and risk management across export transactions.

**6. Export Operations and Cross-functional Coordination**

* Oversee the end-to-end export process, including order planning, production coordination, documentation, shipment and delivery.
* Coordinate with internal teams covering Finance, Production, Supply Chain, Excise, Regulatory, and Quality.
* Ensure compliance with applicable export regulations, destination-market requirements, and customer specifications.
* Resolve operational challenges that may affect timely execution and customer satisfaction.

**7. Team Building and Leadership**

* Build and lead a capable international exports team as the business expands.
* Establish clear performance targets, reporting structures, and operating processes.
* Develop a performance-driven culture focused on market development, customer relationships and profitable growth.

**Candidate Profile**

* 10–15 years of overall professional experience, with substantial experience in international business development, exports, or overseas sales.
* Demonstrated experience in developing international markets and acquiring distributors or importers.
* Experience in the alcoholic beverages, spirits, liquor, or beverage industry is strongly preferred.
* Candidates with relevant international business experience in FMCG or beverages may also be considered.
* Exposure to African, Middle Eastern or Southeast Asian markets will be a significant advantage.
* Strong understanding of international trade, export pricing, distributor economics, commercial negotiations, and cross-border business practices.
* Proven ability to develop and manage international customer relationships and deliver measurable business growth.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, analytical, and leadership skills.
* Willingness to travel internationally as required.

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for a business builder who can take ownership of our international growth agenda.

The ideal candidate should have the ability to identify opportunities, open new markets, acquire the right distribution partners, negotiate commercially sound agreements, and convert opportunities into sustainable business.

This is an opportunity to play a key leadership role in building the international business of an established Indian alcoholic beverages company.

**Reporting and Location**

* Designation: Head of International Exports
* Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
* Reporting to: Managing Director
* Employment Type: Full-time
* Travel: International travel as required

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates with relevant international exports and business development experience may apply through LinkedIn with their updated profile.

Candidates are encouraged to highlight their international market experience, countries handled, distributor relationships developed, and business growth achieved.

title: Area Manager
description:
**About Supertails**
--------------------

Supertails is a pet care company built around everything a pet parent needs in one place. We run an online pharmacy and food business, teleconsultation with qualified vets, and a growing network of veterinary clinics and grooming centres.

The clinic network is the part of the business this role sits in. Our clinics bring the care online channels cannot give: consultations, diagnostics, procedures, vaccinations and grooming, delivered by vets, paravets, groomers and front of house teams who see the same pets and their families again and again.

We are scaling that network, and the quality of a visit cannot be allowed to depend on which clinic a pet parent walks into. That is the problem this role exists to solve.

**Purpose of the role**
-----------------------

You run a cluster of Supertails clinics as one business. You carry the revenue and the cost of every clinic in it. You hold the same standard of care, hygiene and service in each one whether or not you are standing in it. And you build Centre Managers who can run their clinic well on the days you are somewhere else.

This is a hands on operating role, not an oversight role. The cluster performs the way you run it.

**What you will own**
---------------------

### **Cluster performance**

* Revenue, cost and contribution for every clinic in the cluster, read clinic by clinic and not as a cluster average.
* Capacity and utilisation: appointment load, vet and paravet deployment, grooming slots, walk in conversion, repeat visits.
* The cost lines you control: manpower cost against revenue, consumables, local spend.
* A growth plan for each clinic, with the actions and the timeline that sit under it.

### **Standards in every clinic**

* Hygiene, safety, premises, equipment uptime and stock availability, checked on a published audit cadence rather than on visits.
* Service standards for pet parents: wait time, handover quality, complaint closure.
* Clinical process compliance alongside the Lead Vet and the CVO office. Clinical judgement sits with the clinical line. You own that the process is followed.

* Lead the Centre Managers: set their goals, review them weekly, coach them, and hold them to the standard.
* Train and motivate frontline staff with the function leads, with the Centre Manager as the day to day manager.

### **Governance**

* Keka as the single record for attendance, leave and employee data across your cluster.
* Statutory and licence compliance for the premises you run.
* Escalate what you cannot close locally, with the facts attached.

**Essential experience**

* 4 to 8 years running multi site operations.
* Concurrent responsibility for 5 to 8 sites. Sites run one after another do not count.
* Direct P&L ownership at cluster level. Not single site P&L, and not support to someone else who held it.
* Experience leading a team spread across a city, where managers are seen weekly rather than daily, with a method you can demonstrate for holding standards in locations you do not personally supervise.
* An operating rhythm that you designed and implemented yourself: a daily call, a weekly scoreboard, an audit cadence or an equivalent of your own. You should be ready to describe it in detail.
* Proven ability to train, motivate and lead both Centre Managers and frontline staff.

Format matters more than sector. Multi site retail, clinics, salons, diagnostics, QSR, fitness and similar formats all count.

**Preferred, not essential**
----------------------------

* Experience in a veterinary, healthcare, diagnostics or other regulated service format.
* Comfort using an HRMS and an operations dashboard as everyday tools. We run on Keka.
* Experience opening new sites and stabilising them.
* Kannada alongside English and Hindi.

title: Director
description:
**Director, Renewals & Quoting Strategy & Operations**
======================================================

Rubrik is on a mission to secure and accelerate the world's AI transformation. Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, leads at the intersection of data protection, cyber resilience, and enterprise AI acceleration. With Zero Trust Data Security™, Rubrik helps organizations achieve business resilience against cyberattacks, malicious insiders, and operational disruptions.

**About the Team**
------------------

Rubrik's Renewals & Quoting Strategy & Operations team sits at the intersection of commercial strategy, systems, and execution, translating go-to-market priorities into the operational infrastructure that drives predictable, scalable business outcomes.

The team spans renewal operations and quoting, and works closely with Customer Success, Sales, Finance, and Product so that every renewal and new business deal is handled with speed, accuracy, and strategic intent. We're a high-impact team in a period of active build, which means the work is visible, the problems are real, and there's a genuine opportunity to shape how this function grows.

As the Director of Renewals & Quoting Strategy, you will be the senior-most leader of our India team and a strategic right hand to the Senior Director of Global Renewals & Quoting Operations. You will take our India-based Renewal Operations, Data Assurance and Quote Desk teams to the next level of scale, rigor, and impact.. This role is ideal for someone with a consulting, strategy, or operations background who wants to own solutions in a fast-paced SaaS environment.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

**Build the Foundations of the Renewals Business**

* Design and implement the systems, policies, and processes that enable renewals to scale, with clear rules of engagement, strong governance, and a great experience for sales and customers.
* Develop quoting frameworks and standards for multi-year, co-term, and mid-term expansion scenarios that maximize ARR retention.
* Partner with IT, RevOps, and Finance to define requirements for system enhancements, integrations, and automation.
* Create playbooks, guidelines, and standard operating procedures that make excellence repeatable across regions.

**Evolve and Lead Our Data Quality Function**

* Define the next chapter for the team responsible for the accuracy and integrity of the data powering global renewals operations, supporting a large global base of account executives and renewal sales professionals.
* Raise the standard of the function through clear data definitions, quality metrics, audit rhythms, and governance controls across CRM and renewal systems.
* Shift the team from reactive clean-up to proactive, preventive, and increasingly automated data quality.
* Turn data insights into action for sales leadership, and partner with Business Intelligence so reporting meets business needs.

**Lead the Quote Desk Center of Excellence**

* Own the strategy, service standards, and quality bar of our India-based Quote Desk, which serves sales teams worldwide, and scale it into a recognized center of excellence.
* Drive adoption of the Quote Desk and build trusted relationships with the sales leaders who rely on it.
* Streamline end-to-end workflows from opportunity identification to quote to close, reducing cycle times and improving accuracy.

**Influence and Partner Across the Business**

* Partner with India renewals sales leadership and senior stakeholders across Sales and Finance globally, bringing structure, data, and a clear point of view.
* Navigate high-stakes conversations and competing priorities with poise, and align leaders around trade-offs and decisions.
* Present renewal performance, forecasts, and operational insights to senior leadership in partnership with the Senior Director.

**Build and Inspire the Team**

* Attract and hire exceptional talent, and set a higher bar for what great looks like across roles.
* Coach and develop high-potential people into future leaders, building clear career paths and strong succession.
* Raise the overall caliber, capability, and culture of the India team over time.

**Desired Skills & Experience**
-------------------------------

**Required**

* 12+ years of experience in Management Consulting, Strategy & Operations, Sales/Renewal Operations, or Business Operations, ideally within a high-growth technology or SaaS business.
* 5+ years of people leadership, including hiring, developing, and retaining high-performing teams.
* Demonstrated experience building, scaling, or transforming an operations, data quality, or shared-services team that supports a large sales organization, including raising talent quality and operating standards.
* Experience setting up or scaling a center of excellence in India, including driving adoption and stakeholder buy-in.
* Proven ability to influence senior sales and finance leaders across geographies, including through difficult conversations and pushback.
* Thrives in ambiguity, with exceptional prioritization and problem-solving skills and a high degree of ownership and autonomy.
* Excellent communication skills (written, oral, and presentation), with the ability to simplify complexity for any audience.
* Strong analytical skills, with experience driving insight through tools such as Excel, Google Sheets, Tableau, Salesforce, or Clari.
* Strong project management skills, including defining and executing against timelines, dependencies, and risks.
* B.A./B.S. degree; MBA or equivalent advanced degree highly preferred.

**Preferred**

* Experience with CPQ tools (e.g., Salesforce CPQ) and/or forecasting platforms such as Clari.
* Familiarity with renewal quoting workflows, including multi-year and co-term deal structures.
* Understanding of SaaS renewal metrics: ARR, NRR, GRR, churn rate, renewal rate, and pipeline coverage.
* Exposure to subscription lifecycle management, contract data, and revenue recognition concepts.
* Knowledge of SQL or Python for data extraction and ad hoc analysis.

**Why this role:** If you're ready to take real ownership of execution, with a seat at the table, a team to build, and a business to shape, this is that opportunity.

**Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation**
----------------------------------------------------------------------

Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK) is the Security and AI Operations Company, delivering one platform built at the intersection of data, identity, and AI. The platform enables agentic cyber resilience and trusted AI operations for enterprises worldwide, built to recover before disruption strikes and stay a step ahead, so security is never the reason ambition stalls.

title: Client Acquisition & Relationship Executive
description:
**Roles & Responsibilities**

**1. New Business Development & Lead Generation**

* Follow up on assigned leads and arrange meetings with prospective B2B clients across the assigned territory / zone in a timely and structured manner.
* Generate leads independently through field experience, market research, referrals, networking, and observation of industry events and regulatory developments.
* Research prospective client institutions – their business profile, organizational structure, regulatory context, and technology maturity – to build relevant engagement and project strategies.
* Attend industry events, conferences, and seminars to identify new prospects and build APT's presence and credibility in target markets.
* Maintain an organized, current pipeline of all prospects in the CRM system at all times.

**2. Product Demonstrations & Pre-Sales Engagement**

* Develop thorough, in-depth functional knowledge of all assigned APT products – for both sales conversations and post-sale client advisory.
* Conduct structured, confident product demonstrations and presentations for prospective clients – positioning APT's solutions as the most relevant fit for the client's specific needs.
* Prepare supporting documentation – quotations, product notes, and proposal decks – to move deals forward efficiently and professionally.
* Handle commercial negotiations within approved parameters and close business deals – ensuring full documentation is handed over accurately to the CS and Billing teams.
* Consistently work towards and surpass assigned quarterly and annual new business targets.

**3. Client Relationship Management & Account Retention**

* Develop long-term, trusted relationships with key stakeholders across assigned existing client accounts – positioning yourself as a reliable, knowledgeable, and responsive point of contact.
* Schedule and conduct regular client meetings and structured check-ins – monitoring satisfaction levels, addressing concerns proactively, and reinforcing the value of APT's products and services.
* Create and execute quarterly client engagement plans – structured around key accounts, upcoming renewals, and product awareness or training needs.
* Act as the first point of contact for client complaints and escalations – owning the resolution process and coordinating internally to ensure prompt, professional closure.
* Proactively seek and document client feedback and share structured insights with the concerned teams.

**4. AMC & Subscription Renewal Management**

* Take full ownership of AMC and subscription renewals for all assigned client accounts – tracking renewal timelines, initiating engagement well in advance, and ensuring zero unplanned churn.
* Prepare, present, and negotiate renewal proposals and commercial quotes with clients – handling negotiations confidently and finalizing agreements.
* Identify and actively pursue **upsell and cross-sell opportunities** within the existing client base – introducing clients to additional APT products or service tiers that genuinely address their evolving needs.
* Maintain accurate, current records of all renewals, client interactions, and commercial discussions in the CRM system.

**5. Client Training & Product Awareness**

* Conduct product training sessions and awareness programs for assigned clients – helping them maximize adoption, utilization, and value from APT's products and services.
* Proactively advise clients on product updates, new features, and best practices that could benefit their organization.
* Prepare client-facing training documentation, user guides, and awareness materials where required.

**6. Market Intelligence & Internal Collaboration**

* Track competitor activity, market trends, and regulatory developments – and share structured insights with the teams at defined intervals.
* Provide field intelligence to the concerned team(s) to support product positioning, campaigns, and collateral development.
* Collaborate proactively with the Product Delivery, Product Development, and Marketing teams to address client needs and ensure a seamless client experience across the entire lifecycle.
* Maintain accurate and current records of all client interactions, deal stages, renewal timelines, and pipeline activity in the CRM system.
* Provide regular, structured updates to the Reporting Head on new business pipeline, renewal status, client health, and market observations.

**Qualification / Skill-sets**

* Graduates / Professional Degree-holders / Post-Graduates desirous of a career spanning both Business Development / Sales and Client Relationship Management in the IT Software Solutions / Services space.
* 2-3 years of overall experience. Freshers with the right attitude, communication skills, and client orientation are actively encouraged to apply.
* Pleasing personality with excellent oral and written communication skills – a non-negotiable prerequisite for this client-facing role.
* Sound presentation creation and delivery skills – including the ability to engage confidently with senior institutional stakeholders.
* Strong problem-solving aptitude – with the clarity and composure to understand client issues and find structured, practical resolutions.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities – new business conversations, active renewals, client relationships, and internal coordination – without losing detail or urgency.
* Character traits of patience, resilience, and adaptability – essential for navigating long sales cycles while simultaneously sustaining trusted client relationships.
* Willingness and enthusiasm to extensively travel across assigned territory *(within the city and PAN India, by any means of transport)* – and a genuine passion for daily client interaction.
* Proficiency in MS Office – particularly PowerPoint and Excel.
* Keen desire for collaboration and interaction with internal cross-functional teams.

**Added Advantage Qualification / Skill-sets**

* Prior experience of 2 years in Business Development, Key Account Management, or Client Relationship Management – ideally in IT Software Solutions / Services, with a demonstrable track record.
* Prior exposure to the BFSI sector – including banks, NBFCs, cooperative institutions, mutual fund houses, insurance companies, or financial training institutions – in a sales or relationship management capacity.
* Basic understanding of Banking / Financial Services – including regulatory frameworks, compliance dynamics, AMC / subscription commercial models, or technology adoption trends.
* Experience of engaging with mid-profile or senior institutional clients and stakeholders across multiple levels of an organization.
* Working knowledge of CRM software for pipeline management, renewal tracking, and client interaction records and exposure to AMC, subscription-based, or SaaS commercial models and the associated renewal and upsell processes.

title: DLP Analyst
description:
Data Loss Prevention (DLP) Engineer

Experience: 2-4 Years

Location: Bengaluru

Department: Information Security / Cyber Security

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly motivated Data Loss Prevention (DLP) Engineer to join

our Information Security team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for

implementing, monitoring, and enhancing DLP controls to protect sensitive

organizational data across endpoints, email, cloud applications, and collaboration

platforms.

The role requires strong technical expertise in DLP technologies, incident

investigation, policy management, and collaboration with business and technology

teams to ensure compliance with security and regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities

 Implement, manage, and optimize Data Loss Prevention (DLP) solutions

across enterprise environments.

 Configure and maintain DLP policies for data classification, monitoring, and

protection.

 Monitor DLP alerts and incidents, investigate potential data leakage events,

and drive timely remediation.

 Work closely with Security Operations, IT, Cloud, and Business teams to

strengthen data protection controls.

 Identify sensitive data repositories and recommend security measures to

reduce data exposure.

 Manage DLP controls across endpoints, email systems, cloud applications,

and collaboration platforms.

 Perform root cause analysis for security incidents and provide corrective and

preventive actions.

 Develop and maintain DLP dashboards, reports, and metrics for management

review.

 Assist in regulatory compliance initiatives related to data protection and

privacy requirements.

 Conduct periodic reviews and fine-tuning of DLP policies to minimize false

positives.

 Participate in security audits, risk assessments, and compliance reviews.

 Create and maintain operational documentation, runbooks, and incident

response procedures.

Required Skills & Qualifications

 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber

Security, or a related field.

 3-5 years of experience in Information Security, with hands-on experience in

DLP technologies.

 Experience with DLP solutions such as:

o Microsoft Purview DLP

o Symantec DLP

o Forcepoint DLP

o Trellix (McAfee) DLP

o Broadcom DLP

 Strong understanding of data classification, data protection, and information

security principles.

 Experience in endpoint, email, network, and cloud DLP implementations.

 Knowledge of Microsoft 365 Security, Exchange Online, SharePoint Online,

Teams, and OneDrive security controls.

 Familiarity with SIEM tools such as Splunk, Sentinel, QRadar, or LogRhythm.

 Understanding of security frameworks and standards such as ISO 27001,

NIST, PCI-DSS, and GDPR.

**Strong hands-on experience with Forcepoint DLP** is mandatory.

Hands-on experience in **DLP implementation, deployment, configuration, and administration** in enterprise environments.

Strong experience in **DLP alert investigation, incident analysis, and data leakage incident handling**.

 Strong incident investigation, troubleshooting, and analytical skills.

 Knowledge of Windows and Linux operating systems.

 Good understanding of networking and security fundamentals.

Good to Have

 Experience with Microsoft Purview Information Protection and Compliance

solutions.

 Exposure to CASB technologies such as Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps.

 Experience with Cloud Security (Azure, AWS, or GCP).

 Knowledge of Insider Risk Management and Data Governance solutions.

 Familiarity with scripting languages such as PowerShell or Python.

 Security certifications such as:

o SC-400 (Microsoft Information Protection Administrator)

o AZ-500

o Security+

o CEH

o CISSP (preferred)

Behavioral Competencies

 Strong ownership and accountability.

 Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

 Effective stakeholder management and communication skills.

 Attention to detail and commitment to data security.

 Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

 Proactive approach toward identifying and mitigating security risks.

 Strong documentation and reporting capabilities.

Keywords: DLP, Microsoft Purview, Information Protection, Data Security, Insider

Risk Management, Compliance, Microsoft 365 Security, SIEM, Data Governance,

Endpoint Security, Cloud Security, Cyber Security.

Pay: Up to ₹700,000.00 per year

title: Investment Manager – AIF & Wealth Management
description:
We are looking for a dynamic and experienced Fundraising & Investment Manager with strong expertise in Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs), Wealth Management, Investment Advisory, and Portfolio Management.

The candidate will be responsible for identifying and acquiring HNI/UHNI investors, driving fundraising activities, evaluating investment opportunities, developing investment strategies, and managing investor relationships.

The role requires a combination of strong fundraising capabilities, financial market knowledge, investment analysis, and relationship management skills. The ideal candidate should have an established network of HNI/UHNI investors, practical experience in capital mobilisation, and the ability to identify and recommend suitable investment opportunities.

Roles & Responsibilities1. Fundraising & Investor Acquisition

* Identify, acquire, and develop relationships with HNI/UHNI individuals, family offices, institutional investors, and corporate investors.
* Drive fundraising initiatives for Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs) and other investment opportunities.
* Build and maintain a strong investor database and generate new investment leads.
* Develop fundraising strategies to achieve assigned capital mobilisation targets.
* Conduct investor meetings, presentations, and investment discussions to secure commitments.
* Build relationships with wealth managers, financial advisors, brokers, distributors, and investment partners.
* Manage the complete fundraising cycle, from lead generation and investor engagement to commitment and onboarding.

2. Investment Research & Evaluation

* Identify and evaluate investment opportunities across AIFs, PMS, Private Equity, Mutual Funds, Debt Instruments, and structured investment products.
* Conduct financial analysis, market research, industry assessments, and investment due diligence.
* Evaluate investment proposals based on financial performance, risk factors, expected returns, liquidity, and market potential.
* Analyse fund structures, investment strategies, financial statements, and underlying assets.
* Prepare investment research reports, financial models, proposals, and recommendations.
* Monitor financial markets, economic developments, and emerging investment opportunities.

3. Investment & Portfolio Management

* Develop investment strategies and asset allocation recommendations based on investor objectives and risk profiles.
* Monitor investment portfolios, fund performance, asset allocation, and investment returns.
* Evaluate portfolio risks, diversification, liquidity, and overall performance.
* Recommend suitable investment products and portfolio adjustments based on market conditions.
* Maintain regular communication with investors regarding investment performance and opportunities.
* Coordinate with fund managers and investment partners to monitor existing investments.

4. Client & Relationship Management

* Develop and maintain long-term relationships with HNI/UHNI clients and prospective investors.
* Understand client financial objectives, investment preferences, and risk appetite.
* Present investment opportunities, fund structures, research findings, and portfolio recommendations.
* Prepare business presentations, investment proposals, and periodic portfolio reports.
* Participate in client meetings, investor discussions, and business development activities.
* Identify cross-selling and additional investment opportunities within the existing client network.

5. Compliance & Documentation

* Ensure fundraising and investment activities comply with applicable SEBI regulations and internal compliance requirements.
* Coordinate with legal, compliance, finance, and operations teams for investor onboarding and documentation.
* Maintain accurate records of investor commitments, fundraising pipelines, and investment activities.
* Ensure appropriate disclosures and investor communication throughout the investment lifecycle.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Bachelor's or master's degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, or Business Administration.
* MBA Finance, CFA, CA, or relevant professional qualifications will be preferred.
* 5–10 years of relevant experience in AIF, Wealth Management, Investment Banking, Portfolio Management, PMS, or Investment Advisory.
* Strong understanding of AIF Category I, II, and III, PMS, Mutual Funds, Private Equity, Debt Instruments, and alternative investment products.
* Proven experience in fundraising, capital mobilisation, and HNI/UHNI client acquisition.
* Established network of HNI/UHNI investors, family offices, or institutional investors.
* Strong knowledge of investment research, financial analysis, valuation, and portfolio evaluation.
* Ability to independently generate investment leads and convert prospects into investors.
* Excellent negotiation, communication, presentation, and relationship management skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, financial modelling, and investment research tools.
* NISM certifications or other relevant financial market certifications will be an advantage.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Capital mobilisation and fundraising targets achieved.
* Number of new HNI/UHNI investors acquired.
* Investor conversion and onboarding ratio.
* Growth of investor database and business network.
* Quality of investment research and recommendations.
* Investment opportunity identification and evaluation.
* Portfolio monitoring and reporting efficiency.
* Client retention and relationship development.

Preferred Candidate Profile

We are particularly interested in candidates who have worked with AIFs, PMS providers, Wealth Management firms, Private Banks, Investment Advisory firms, or Alternative Investment platforms.

Candidates with a combination of an established HNI/UHNI investor network, proven fundraising achievements, and hands-on investment analysis experience will be strongly preferred.

title: SAP GRC Access Control Consultant (Functional & Technical)
description:
**About The Role**
We are looking for an SAP GRC professional with a blend of functional and technical expertise to manage and strengthen our SAP Governance, Risk and Compliance framework. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience in SAP GRC Access Control, risk mitigation and Segregation of Duties (SoD) conflict management. They should also have a solid understanding of SAP functional modules and role design. You will help ensure our SAP environment is secure, compliant and aligned with internal control and regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Configure and maintain SAP GRC Access Control (ARA, ARM, EAM/Firefighter, BRM), including access risk rulesets, mitigating controls and remediation workflows.
* Analyse and resolve SoD conflicts at user and role level. Create, assign and monitor mitigating controls with business control owners.
* Design, review and maintain SAP roles and role assignments across key modules (MM, FI, SD, PP, QM, PM), ensuring least-privilege access.
* Manage emergency (Firefighter) access, including ID setup, owner/controller assignment and periodic log reviews.
* Perform periodic user access reviews, privileged access reviews and role certifications across procure-to-pay, order-to-cash and user access management cycles.
* Assess IT general controls (ITGC) and application controls within SAP and related environments, benchmarking against frameworks such as NIST.
* Partner with IT and business stakeholders to investigate audit findings, track remediation and improve control effectiveness.
* Support internal and external audits for SAP-based systems, including evidence preparation, walkthroughs and issue follow-up.
* Review third-party assurance reports (ISAE 3402 / SOC) for outsourced IT functions.
* Train key users, auditors and auditees on GRC processes, tools and controls, and maintain audit issue tracking workflows.

**Mandatory Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Accounting or a related field.
* CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor) certification – required.
* 4–6 years of experience in IT audit / SAP security, with a strong focus on access controls and GRC.
* Proven hands-on experience in SAP GRC Access Control: access risk analysis, ruleset configuration, mitigating control assignment and SoD conflict management.
* Strong understanding of SAP functional modules (MM, FI, SD, PP, QM, PM), role design, role assignment and conflict mitigation.
* Working knowledge of ITGC, application controls and access governance processes.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to turn technical findings into actionable business recommendations.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Visio, PowerPoint).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* SAP GRC certification (Access Control).
* Experience with MSMP workflow configuration and SAP GRC 10.x / 12.0.
* Exposure to IAM / PAM tools (e.g., CyberArk) and audit analytics tools (e.g., ACL, TeamMate).
* ITIL Foundation; experience with vulnerability assessment tools (e.g., Nmap, Nessus).
* Big 4 or large-scale internal audit exposure.
* Experience delivering GRC or access-control training.
* Fluency in English.

title: QA Lead - Trading Platform (India, Chennai)
description:
**About GoCharting**

GoCharting is a web-native charting and trading platform. Traders use professional orderflow tools — footprint charts, volume and market profile, cumulative delta, DOM trading — to read the market and place orders through their broker, all in the browser. Our users are active traders in India, the US and around the world.

**The Role**

You will own the quality gate that every release of GoCharting's terminal and apps passes before it reaches traders, and you will test and write automation yourself while you lead a small QA team. The role is full-time and in person in our Chennai office, and it reports to the Engineering Manager for Client Engineering. Every release needs one accountable owner of what "ready to ship" means, and that is you. At 12 months, no release should reach production without your sign-off, and the team should trust the checks behind it.

**What you'll do**

* **Own the release gate**
  — define what must pass before a release ships, run the sign-off, and stop a release that fails it
* **Test and automate yourself**
  — write and maintain end-to-end and regression automation for the web terminal and for APIs
* **Lead and coach the QA team**
  — assign work, review test plans and automation, and raise each engineer's standard
* **Run quality checks in CI**
  — keep automated tests as required checks on merges and releases, fast and reliable
* **Triage defects**
  — set severity with product and engineering, and track each one to a verified fix
* **Report quality plainly**
  — publish a weekly view of defects found, escaped and fixed

**What we're looking for**

**Must-haves:**

* 6+ years in QA or test automation on production web applications
* Hands-on automation code with Playwright, Cypress or Selenium, written by you
* Has owned a release gate or release sign-off for a production web application
* Has led or mentored other QA engineers
* Has run automated tests as required checks in a CI pipeline, for example GitHub Actions
* In person in our Chennai office, 5 days a week

**Nice-to-haves:**

* Testing real-time or data-dense applications, such as WebSocket feeds or live charts (adds the ability to test our core risk)
* API and contract testing for REST and WebSocket services (adds coverage below the UI)
* Performance and load testing with k6, JMeter or similar (adds confidence under market-open load)
* Trading, fintech or market-data testing (adds speed in learning our domain)

The Data Center Engineer is responsible for the management, maintenance, and deployment of the physical infrastructure within the data center. This role involves both building and operational support activities to ensure optimal data center performance and reliability.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

Operational activities (not limited to):
  
  

* Work on tickets assigned to fix incidents in the data center on-site visit is required

Build activities (Not limited to):
  
  

* Installation and commissioning of compute and network racks.

* Flexible and adaptable, capable of working both independently and as part of a collaborative team.
* Skilled in reviewing, enhancing, and maintaining Methods of Procedure (MOPs) and operational guidelines.

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively across teams and with customers.
* A proactive team player with strong interpersonal skills, able to work seamlessly with cross-functional teams.
* Capable of handling multiple priorities and engaging with both customers and internal stakeholders under high-pressure situations.
* Proficient in spoken and written English to support effective communication in global environments.
