title: Agentic AI Orchestrator
description:
**Job Summary**

The Agentic AI Orchestrator designs, builds, and operates the Investment Division's agentic AI workflows—the automated, multi-step processes through which AI agents read documents, reconcile data, draft analysis, and assemble reporting across the division's clusters. The role converts analyst workflows into orchestrated agent pipelines with human review gates, owns the division's prompt, skill, and agent library, and is accountable for the accuracy, auditability, and cost of every automated output.

The position anchors the division's AI-led operating model from the Chennai office, working alongside the Data Engineer (data pipelines and infrastructure) and the ML Engineer (models and evaluation), and serves as the bridge between the investment analysts and the division's AI tooling

**ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

1. Design, build, and operate agentic AI workflows for the division's recurring processes: document extraction and reconciliation, portfolio and company performance monitoring, report and IC pack assembly, and data-room processing.

2. Translate analyst and reporting workflows into orchestrated multi-agent pipelines with defined human review gates, so that no figure or recommendation is published without analyst sign-off.

3. Own the division's prompt, skill, agent, and plugin library: design, versioning, testing, and documentation, ensuring workflows are reusable across clusters rather than one-off chats.

4. Integrate agents with the division's systems and data sources — document repositories, custodian and administrator reporting, and the division's knowledge base — working with the Data Engineer on pipelines and access.

5. Build and run evaluation harnesses with the ML Engineer: accuracy benchmarks against verified ground truth, regression testing on workflow changes, and periodic audits of automated outputs.

6. Implement AI governance and guardrails: access controls and confidentiality boundaries for family and portfolio data, audit trails for every automated output, and compliance with the Group's AI usage policies.

7. Monitor agent performance, cost, latency, and failure modes; triage incidents, maintain runbooks, and drive continuous improvement of workflow reliability.

8. Train and support the division's analysts in AI-assisted working practices; capture their feedback and convert it into a prioritised automation backlog.

9. Maintain complete documentation of all orchestrated workflows, their data sources, model versions, and review controls, ensuring every automated output is reproducible and auditable.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Minimum Education Required**

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related quantitative field.

• Strong Python engineering skills: API integration, data handling, and production-quality code with testing and version control (Git).

• Hands-on experience building LLM-based and agentic systems in production: workflow orchestration, tool and function calling, and multi-agent patterns — using frameworks such as LangGraph or LangChain, or SDK-native orchestration (e.g. Claude Agent SDK). Framework experience matters less than sound orchestration design.

• Practical RAG experience: document chunking, embeddings, vector databases (e.g. pgvector, Pinecone, Qdrant, or similar), hybrid search, and retrieval evaluation.

• Experience building or integrating MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and tools, or equivalent connector architectures linking AI agents to enterprise systems and data sources.

• Familiarity with LLM evaluation and observability tooling (accuracy benchmarks, regression tests, tracing); disciplined prompt and skill engineering with versioning and documentation.

• Understanding of data privacy, access control, and audit requirements for confidential financial data; exposure to investment or financial reporting workflows preferred.

**Years of experience are required.**

• Minimum of 4 to 7 years of experience in software or AI engineering, of which at least 2 years hands-on with LLM-based or agentic systems in production, at a technology firm, financial institution, or data-driven enterprise.

title: Technical Team Lead
description:
About Audit Sense

Audit Sense is an AI-powered SaaS company developing technology solutions for the Finance and Audit industry. We are looking for a hands-on Technical Team Lead to lead technical architecture, full-stack development and deployment delivery across our Subscription Management system, AuditSense application and AskAthena AI analysis product.

About the Role

The selected candidate will lead the technical team, contribute to production development, review architecture and code, and translate business requirements into scalable and maintainable software solutions.

The role involves managing existing cloud deployments and developing deployment capabilities for customer-managed on-premises and private-cloud environments. It also includes designing subscription and licensing controls across different deployment models.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Full-Stack Development & Architecture**

* Lead the development of React frontends and TypeScript APIs using Hono and Express.
* Define application architecture, module boundaries and service integration patterns.
* Design and manage PostgreSQL databases, Prisma schemas, migrations and database performance.
* Implement database connection pooling using PgBouncer or equivalent solutions.
* Manage multi-tenant database architecture and troubleshoot database connection issues.

**2. Identity & Application Security**

* Design enterprise Single Sign-On (SSO) using OpenID Connect, OAuth 2.0 and SAML.
* Manage JWT, session authentication, MFA, RBAC/ABAC and tenant isolation.
* Apply OWASP Top 10 security practices.
* Implement secure API authentication and HMAC-signed webhooks.

**3. Deployment Architecture & DevOps**

* Manage cloud, customer on-premises and private-cloud deployment architectures.
* Provision and maintain Azure infrastructure, including VMs, networking, storage, Key Vault and monitoring.
* Develop secure customer installation packages using Docker, Docker Compose and Kubernetes/Helm where appropriate.
* Build CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Azure Pipelines.
* Implement infrastructure as code using Terraform, Bicep or Pulumi.
* Manage deployment strategies, application upgrades, rollback procedures, monitoring and production reliability.

**4. Subscription & Licensing Management**

* Architect subscription and licence management across cloud, on-premises and private-cloud deployments.
* Design installation registration, activation, renewal, expiry and suspension mechanisms.
* Implement module entitlements, user limits and usage tracking.
* Develop secure communication and synchronization between customer installations and central subscription services.
* Support licensing requirements for restricted-connectivity and offline environments.

**5. Technical Leadership & Code Review**

* Lead technical planning, task allocation, estimation and delivery coordination.
* Review application architecture and production code.
* Establish development standards, testing practices and API documentation.
* Mentor technical team members and provide guidance during implementation and production support.

Required Technical Expertise

* Strong hands-on expertise in TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Node.js, Hono and Express.
* Strong PostgreSQL and Prisma ORM expertise, including database modelling, migrations, transactions, indexing and performance tuning.
* Practical experience with PgBouncer or equivalent database connection pooling solutions.
* DevOps experience with Docker, Docker Compose, Linux, nginx, GitHub Actions and Azure Pipelines.
* Hands-on Azure infrastructure experience, including virtual machines, networking, storage, identity, secrets and monitoring.
* Experience with customer-managed on-premises or private-cloud software deployments.
* Knowledge of SaaS subscription licensing and entitlement management.
* Experience with enterprise SSO, JWT, MFA, RBAC/ABAC and application security.
* Proven technical leadership, architecture decision-making and code review experience.
* Experience in automated testing, monitoring and production troubleshooting.

Preferred Experience

* Kubernetes, Helm and air-gapped customer installations.
* Infrastructure as code using Terraform, Azure Bicep or Pulumi.
* AI application integration, LLM providers, document processing and vector search.
* Redis, DBOS, ChromaDB, Microsoft Graph and enterprise audit workflows.
* Offline licensing and synchronization between central services and customer installations.

Expected Outcomes

Establish a clear technical architecture and delivery roadmap across our products, develop reliable cloud and customer-managed deployment models, implement a consistent subscription-control framework and lead the team towards maintainable software delivery and reliable releases.

* **Company:**
  Audit Sense Pvt. Ltd.

title: Business Development & Research Intern
description:
**Company:**
Brandy Crush Studio (BCS)

**Reports to:**
Mithran. E (Venture Head - Gamification)

**Location:**
Chennai / Bangalore / Hybrid

**Duration:**
4-week trial, with a conversion review at day 30

**Stipend:**
₹15,000

**Bonus:**
₹10,000 if 4 weeks deliverables are achieved.

**About the role**

BCS builds gamified micro products for brands (Spin the Wheel, Scratch & Win, Digital Stamp Cards, quizzes and more) and custom gamification solutions for larger clients. You will join at the start, working directly with the founding team to find our first customers. You will research the market, build prospect lists, run outreach, and keep the sales pipeline organized.

**What you will do**

* Research brands, agencies and marketing teams that run campaigns, loyalty programs or customer engagement activities.
* Build and maintain a target list of 50 accounts with decision-maker names, roles and contact details.
* Send personalised outreach on LinkedIn, email and WhatsApp.
* Book discovery meetings and demos for the team.
* Track every lead, conversation and follow-up in the CRM.
* Research competitors and similar gamification products, covering what they offer and at what price.
* Prepare short notes before each meeting: who the prospect is, what they run, and what we could pitch.
* Help draft one-page offers and proposal inputs.

**4-week plan**

**Week 1: Learn and research**

* Learn our products, pitch and target segments.
* Set up the CRM (Google Sheet or HubSpot free tier).
* Build the first 25 accounts, with decision-makers identified.
* *Deliverable:*
  a 25-account list, a CRM live, and a short competitor summary.

**Week 2: Build the list and start outreach**

* Complete the list of 50 accounts.
* Send 10-15 personalised messages a day.
* Log every response in the CRM.
* *Deliverable:*
  50 accounts, 100+ outreach messages sent, and a response tracker.

**Week 3: Convert conversations into meetings**

* Follow up on every reply and book meetings.
* Prepare a prospect note before each meeting.
* Join discovery calls and demos as the note-taker.
* *Deliverable:*
  8-10 meetings booked, and notes for each.

**Week 4: Pipeline and review**

* Follow up with pilot prospects.
* Clean up the CRM and report the pipeline status.
* Report what worked and what didn't in outreach.
* *Deliverable:*
  a final pipeline report and an outreach learnings summary.

**How your work will be measured**

* Accounts researched and CRM accuracy
* Outreach messages sent and response rate
* Meetings and demos booked
* Quality of prospect notes
* Reliability: updates on time and follow-ups done

**Who we're looking for**

* Final-year student, recent graduate, or early-career (0-1 years). Any degree is fine.
* Strong written English, and Tamil or other local languages are a plus.
* Comfortable messaging strangers and following up without being told.
* Organized, with good habits in Excel/Google Sheets.
* Curious about marketing, branding, games or tech.
* Prior LinkedIn outreach, sales or marketing internship experience is a plus but not required.

**Tools you'll use**

LinkedIn, Google Sheets or a free CRM, email, WhatsApp, and Canva or Google Slides for basic one-pagers.

**What you'll gain**

* Hands-on experience building a sales pipeline from zero.
* Direct mentorship from the person building the business unit.
* A real chance at a full-time role after the trial, based on your performance at day 30.

**How to apply**

Send your resume and a 3-4 line note on why this role interests you to mithran@brandycrush.studio

title: Sales Officer
description:
**Company Description**
DALMAF Private Limited is a technology-driven platform that offers end-to-end professional services, including legal, auditing, human resources, bank auction support, buying and selling, and marketing assistance. Founded in June 2022, DALMAF aims to simplify access to professional services across India by providing individuals and businesses with one-click solutions for their legal and professional needs. The company partners with a network of over 100 qualified professionals, such as Chartered Accountants, Company Secretaries, Lawyers, Cost Accountants, Chartered Engineers, and Bankers. DALMAF is committed to helping businesses overcome challenges, strengthen internal operations, and achieve their goals while maintaining a strong focus on accurate and efficient document handling. The workforce prioritizes client needs and strives to deliver reliable, high-quality service.
  
**Role Description**
The Sales Officer role at DALMAF Private Limited is a full-time, on-site position based in Chennai. The Sales Officer will be responsible for identifying prospective clients, generating leads, and promoting DALMAF’s portfolio of professional services to businesses and individuals. Daily tasks include managing the sales pipeline, conducting client meetings and presentations, coordinating with internal teams to understand service offerings, and maintaining accurate records of sales activities. The role involves building and nurturing long-term client relationships, addressing client queries, and providing excellent customer service to ensure high levels of satisfaction and retention. The Sales Officer will also support channel sales initiatives and contribute to achieving team and organizational sales targets.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong customer service skills with a focus on client satisfaction and relationship management.
* Proficiency in lead generation and prospecting techniques to build a robust sales pipeline.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, for client interactions and presentations.
* Experience in sales operations, including managing deals, tracking activities, and reporting results.
* Background in channel sales or partner management is an advantage.
* Prior experience in professional services, financial services, or related sectors is beneficial.
* Ability to work independently, meet targets, and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Commerce, or a related field preferred.
* Comfort with basic digital tools and CRM systems to manage client information and sales activities.

title: Sales Consultant
description:
**Company Description**
Capital Honda is an authorized dealer of Honda Cars India and part of the KUN Capital Auto Group, a well-established automotive dealership network founded in 1997. The group has built a strong reputation across Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, and Pondicherry for its customer-focused approach and professional service standards. This is a full-time, on-site Sales Consultant role based at the Capital Honda dealership in Chennai. **Job Title:**
Relationship Manager (B2B Partnerships)
  
  
**Department:**
B2B Sales
  
  
**Product:**
Education Loan & B2B Admissions
  
  
**About GyanDhan:**
GyanDhan is India's leading platform for education financing, helping students secure loans for studying abroad. We partner with study abroad consultants to provide the best financial and admission solutions for students.
  
  
**Role Overview:**
As a Relationship Manager at GyanDhan, you will play a critical role in driving B2B sales and building partnerships with study abroad consultants, channel partners, DSAs, and coaching institutes. Your goal is to generate student referrals across both education loans and B2B admissions, position GyanDhan as the preferred financing and admission partner, and drive partner adoption of Setulin, GyanDhan's study-abroad CRM.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* B2B Sales & Field Partnerships: Identify and secure new business opportunities through consultants, channel partners, DSAs, and coaching institutes. Focus on field sales to drive referrals and build strong partnerships across both loan and admission business lines.
* B2B Admissions: Expand partner engagement beyond loans to include admission referrals, driving cross-sell of GyanDhan's admission services alongside education loan products.
* Setulin CRM Adoption: Onboard and train partners on Setulin so they manage the full student journey from enquiry to admission on the CRM, replacing manual tracking via Google Sheets or diaries. Drive consistent partner usage to improve lead visibility, cross-sell, and conversion tracking.
* Relationship Management: Establish and maintain long-term relationships with partners, ensuring consistent support and communication through regular meetings and networking.
* Achieve Referral & Sales Targets: Drive the referral pipeline across loans and admissions, ensuring 100% student referrals from your partner network, contributing to increased disbursements, admission conversions, and overall growth.
* Strategic Planning & Market Insights: Identify key business opportunities, monitor market trends, and ensure GyanDhan's loan and admission offerings remain competitive.
* Partner Education & Support: Organize webinars, seminars, and training sessions to educate partners on GyanDhan's loan and admission products and on using Setulin effectively.
* Resolve Issues & Ensure Smooth Operations: Act as the primary point of contact for partners, providing timely solutions to any concerns and ensuring seamless operations.
* Track Performance & Report Results: Monitor and report key metrics, including referral rates, loan disbursements, admission conversions, Setulin adoption/usage rates, partner satisfaction, and sales performance to senior management.

**Preferred Experience**

* 2+ years in B2B sales, relationship management, business development, or field sales (experience with study abroad consultants, DSAs, or coaching institutes is a plus).
* Proven skills in negotiation, persuasion, and driving business growth.
* Comfort with CRM tools; experience driving partner/customer adoption of a CRM or digital platform is a plus.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to build rapport and trust with a wide range of stakeholders.
* Willingness to travel extensively for field sales.
* Target-driven and results-oriented, with a track record of exceeding sales goals.

**Interested candidates can connect me at priyanka.yadav@gyandhan.com or 9266766233**

description:

**1. JOB PURPOSE**

Ecube Solutions is looking for an experienced and result-oriented Business Development Manager to drive business growth in its Event Management division.

The candidate will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, acquiring corporate clients, developing strategic business relationships and generating revenue through corporate events, dealer conferences, product launches, exhibitions, annual days, award ceremonies, brand activations and other corporate events.

The ideal candidate should have strong corporate networking capabilities, excellent sales and negotiation skills, and the ability to independently manage the complete business development cycle, from lead generation to order closure.

**2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**A. Business Development & Client Acquisition**

* Identify, develop and acquire new corporate clients and business opportunities.
* Build strong relationships with corporate decision-makers, including HR Heads, Marketing Heads, Admin Heads, Procurement Heads and senior management.
* Generate business leads through networking, references, cold calling, LinkedIn and industry connections.
* Identify new market opportunities and expand the company's corporate client base.
* Develop strategic partnerships with corporates, brands, agencies and business organisations.

**B. Sales & Revenue Generation**

* Drive monthly, quarterly and annual business revenue targets.
* Convert prospective enquiries and business opportunities into confirmed event projects.
* Prepare and present business proposals, event concepts, presentations, quotations and commercial offers.
* Conduct client meetings, presentations and commercial negotiations.
* Follow up on prospective clients and ensure timely business closures.
* Maintain a healthy sales pipeline and provide regular business development reports to management.
* Ensure profitability while negotiating and closing business deals.

**C. Corporate Client Relationship Management**

* Establish and maintain long-term relationships with existing and prospective corporate clients.
* Understand client requirements, event objectives, budgets and expectations.
* Identify opportunities for repeat business and account expansion.
* Maintain regular communication with clients and ensure a high level of client satisfaction.
* Develop new business through referrals and existing client relationships.

**D. Event Industry Knowledge & Business Development**

Identify and generate business opportunities across the following event categories:

* Corporate Events and Conferences.
* Dealer Meets and Channel Partner Meets.
* Product Launches and Brand Launches.
* Annual Days and Employee Family Days.
* Award Nights and Recognition Events.
* Exhibitions and Trade Shows.
* Brand Activations and Promotional Events.
* Corporate Celebrations and Gala Dinners.
* Employee Engagement Events and Corporate Gatherings.

The candidate should have a good understanding of event concepts, stage design, LED production, fabrication, branding, audiovisual requirements and overall event execution.

**E. Internal Coordination & Project Handover**

* Coordinate with creative, design, estimation, production and operations teams during proposal development.
* Understand project requirements and ensure accurate communication of client expectations.
* Work closely with internal teams to develop competitive event solutions and commercial proposals.
* Ensure a proper handover of confirmed projects to the operations team.
* Support the project team wherever required to maintain client relationships and business continuity.

**3. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Management or a related field.
* 4–8 years of experience in Event Management Business Development, Corporate Event Sales or related B2B sales.
* Proven experience in acquiring corporate clients and closing business deals.
* Strong corporate networking and relationship-building capabilities.
* Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Good commercial understanding and business development capabilities.
* Ability to independently handle client meetings and sales closures.
* Proficiency in MS Office, PowerPoint, Excel and CRM tools.
* Strong planning, follow-up and time management skills.

**4. PREFERRED INDUSTRY EXPERIENCE**

Preference will be given to candidates with experience in:

* Corporate Event Management Companies.
* Event Production and Experiential Marketing Agencies.
* Exhibition and Trade Show Companies.
* Brand Activation Agencies.

title: Channel Relationship Manager, AMZL - Tamilnadu
description:
**Description**
Amazon.com, Inc. is a US-based multinational electronic commerce company headquartered in Seattle, Washington. Jeff Bezos founded Amazon.com, Inc. in 1994 and launched it online in 1995. Amazon.com started as an online bookstore, but soon diversified, selling DVDs, CDs, MP3 downloads, computer software, video games, electronics, apparel, furniture, food, and toys. Amazon has established separate websites in Canada, the United Kingdom, Germany, France, Italy, Japan, and China. Today, as a market leader in online retail, Amazon product lines include Amazon.com, A9.com, IMDb, Kindle, Amazon Web Services, Alexa.com, Audible.com, A2Z Development, Alexa Internet and Endless.com.
  
  
At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. Amazon is one of the most recognizable brand names in the world and we distribute millions of products each year to our loyal customers. Amazon has great opportunities to pursue a career as a leader in Operations Management. We know that learning through experience is what transforms talented people into great leaders. Our roles are designed to accelerate the growth of leaders through challenging field experiences that stretch individual capability. Our Operations environment presents the candidates with great challenges in dealing with front line management, and driving scalable and continuous improvements across our Fulfillment Centers, Supply Chain & Transportation execution teams.
  
  
Amazon is seeking a Channel Relationship Manager to work with our Last Mile Team managing end to end station operations and channel partner management.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Act as the custodian of the processes & SOPs for the allotted program and consistently challenge and innovate to improvise the existing ones. Provide out of the box solutions for to enhance quality standards, reduce waste, and eliminate unnecessary work.
* Primarily responsible for coordinating with cross-functional teams and vendors to deliver customer orders through the last mile network.
* Responsible for in-bound, outbound, delivery, returns and forward leg pick-ups, capacity utilization , network optimization & contingency planning.
* Ensure high all around performance in quality and customer experience through our last-mile delivery and pick-up operations.
* Liaise with training teams to develop and update training materials on an ongoing basis to incorporate the latest relevant content for transition to a problem-solving culture.
* Ensure new processes are communicated to relevant stakeholders and implemented in a timely manner and are standardized across locations. Perform continuous process evaluation to ensure sustainment
* Ensure a data driven approach to solve problems and to develop solutions to reduce losses and optimize operational cost.

**Additional Responsibilities May Include**

* Developing standard operating procedures.
* Direct accountability for setting and meeting operational goals, strategic planning and forecasting
* Leading process improvements

**Demonstrated Abilities**
We are looking for smart and analytical people, who are passionate about operations, to join the Operations team at Amazon India. This role is for those candidates who thrive on driving change, building an organization and leading through others, by giving them a direct management assignment in our Operations Services and Technology Centers. Ideal candidates for this program are expected to leverage their strong analytical skills, communication, and think big.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Process & SOP Ownership
  
  
Serve as the custodian of all processes and SOPs for the assigned program. Continuously challenge, refine, and innovate existing workflows to enhance quality, reduce waste, and eliminate non-value-added activities through creative, out-of-the-box solutions.
  
  
Cross-Functional Coordination
  
  
Collaborate with internal teams and external stakeholders to ensure seamless execution of last-mile operations and timely delivery of customer orders.
  
  
End-to-End Operations Management
  
  
Oversee in-bound, outbound, delivery, returns, forward-leg pick-ups, capacity utilization, network optimization, and contingency planning to drive operational efficiency.
  
  
Partner Management
  
  
Manage relationships with delivery partners and vendors to ensure alignment with performance standards, compliance requirements, and capacity needs. Drive accountability, monitor performance metrics, and enable partners with support and guidance to meet operational goals.
  
  
Quality & Customer Experience Excellence
  
  
Drive high performance in quality metrics and customer experience across last-mile delivery and pick-up operations.
  
  
Training & Capability Building
  
  
Work with training teams to develop, improve, and update training materials, embedding a culture of problem-solving and continuous learning across the network.
  
  
Data-Driven Problem Solving
  
  
Use data insights and analytics to identify root causes, reduce losses, improve productivity, and optimize operational costs through structured problem-solving.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
Reviews previous day’s metrics across inbound, outbound, delivery, returns, and customer experience.
  
  
Leads the Daily Business Review (DBR) to discuss performance gaps, root causes, capacity, and action plans.
  
  
Coordinates with cross-functional teams and delivery partners to ensure smooth last-mile operations.
  
  
Monitors real-time execution, resolves escalations, and activates contingency plans when required.
  
  
Ensures SOP adherence, drives process standardization, and evaluates improvement opportunities.
  
  
Works with training teams to update materials and reinforce a problem-solving culture.
  
  
Ends the day by updating dashboards, tracking actions, and preparing insights for the next DBR.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 2+ years of employee and performance management experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Assistant Manager Marketing
description:
**Assistant Manager - Marketing**

**FUNCTION - Marketing, Integra**

**ROLE TYPE -**
Individual contributor — creative, strategic and execution-oriented

**EXPERIENCE - 5–7 years**

**LOCATION - Remote(India)**

**REPORTS TO - Vice President – Growth & Strategy**

**SCOPE -**
All Integra brands, serving Academic Publishing (books and journals) and Education Publishing (K-12 and Higher Education) audiences across the US, UK, Europe and UAE

**01 PURPOSE OF THE ROLE**

The Assistant Manager, Marketing's primary focus is to grow Integra's social media audience, website visitors and leads. The role plans, coordinates and delivers Integra's brand and content communications across its websites, social media channels, newsletter and podcast. It is a creative role that combines strong editorial judgement with excellent organisation, planning and structured thinking.

The role owns the consistency and quality of brand messaging across channels, develops content that is relevant to the audiences and markets Integra serves, and turns marketing performance data into clear insights, recommendations and actions.

**PRIMARY FOCUS**

**Growth of social media, website visitors and leads**

Most time and effort goes here, and performance is judged mainly on it.

**SECONDARY FOCUS**

**Content operations and website support**

Newsletter, podcast, creative quality, plus technical website support (see section 07).

**Why it matters:**
*Marketing at Integra is a core business function, not a support function. This role is central to how publishers and educators perceive Integra — and to the visibility and demand that fuel growth.*

**02KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Social media and digital channels (primary focus)**

* Own day-to-day social media planning and publishing across Integra brands and platforms, particularly LinkedIn.
* Create and manage channel-specific content calendars, ensuring a consistent publishing rhythm and coherent brand messaging.
* Repurpose blogs, articles, white papers, webinars, podcasts, events, case studies and product updates into engaging, channel-appropriate content.
* Work with the design team on social creatives and campaign assets, providing clear briefs and consolidated feedback.
* Monitor comments, mentions and engagement, and coordinate timely responses with relevant internal teams.
* Review channel performance and continuously improve content themes, formats and publishing approaches.

**Website traffic, leads, SEO and AI search visibility (primary focus)**

* Grow website visitors and leads through content, SEO, conversion-focused landing pages and clear calls to action, and track progress against agreed targets.
* Own content planning and updates across all Integra websites, coordinating with content owners and subject-matter experts.
* Manage content SEO, including keyword research, on-page optimisation, metadata, internal linking, content-gap analysis and refreshing underperforming pages.
* Plan and develop website resources such as case studies, white papers, brochures, blogs and other marketing collateral.
* Coordinate video content from briefing and production handoff through to publishing and distribution.
* Improve Integra's visibility in AI- and LLM-driven search — including ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity and Copilot — through AEO- and GEO-informed content planning and structure.
* Monitor how Integra and its brands appear in AI search, and recommend improvements to strengthen accurate discovery, representation and citation.

**Brand messaging, content strategy and planning**

* Own the consistency, clarity and quality of Integra's brand messaging across all websites, social media channels and marketing communications.
* Develop and maintain integrated content and channel calendars aligned with business priorities, brand positioning, campaigns and audience needs.
* Translate business, product and segment priorities into compelling content themes, narratives and communication plans.
* Bring creativity and fresh thinking to content formats, storytelling, campaigns and audience engagement.
* Work with marketing leadership, segment champions and subject-matter experts to ensure messaging is accurate, relevant and differentiated across Integra brands.
* Maintain brand voice, messaging guidelines, editorial standards and content review processes.

**Newsletter, email marketing and customer database**

* Plan and deliver the Integra newsletter and email campaigns, including content, segmentation, quality checks and performance tracking.
* Keep customer and contact databases accurate, appropriately segmented and compliant with consent and privacy requirements.
* Use campaign performance data to improve relevance, engagement and conversion.

**Integra podcast and content repurposing**

* Own the operational planning of the Integra podcast: episode calendars, guest coordination, recording logistics, production handoffs, show notes and publishing.
* Coordinate with hosts, subject-matter experts, segment champions, the design team and leadership on topics, schedules, approvals and promotion.
* Track podcast performance, including listens, downloads, audience growth, engagement and platform performance.
* Repurpose episodes into clips, social posts, blogs and newsletter content to extend the reach and value of each episode.

**Creative quality**

* Bring creative judgement and attention to detail to website and landing pages, social creatives, newsletters, podcast assets and other marketing materials.
* Review all content and creative assets for accuracy, clarity, audience relevance and brand alignment before release.
* Work closely with the design team and external agencies, providing clear briefs, timely feedback and approvals.
* Maintain practical content guidelines, review checklists and quality standards across channels.

**Marketing analytics, insights and reporting**

* Own performance analytics across Integra's websites, social media channels, email campaigns and podcast.
* Build, maintain and use dashboards and reporting tools such as GA4, Google Search Console, LinkedIn Analytics and Looker Studio.
* Track traffic, engagement, SEO performance, conversions, form submissions, campaign performance and audience growth.
* Go beyond reporting numbers: explain what is working, what is not, emerging trends and opportunities for improvement.
* Share weekly and monthly performance updates with marketing leadership and stakeholders, covering what the data shows, why it matters and the recommended actions.
* Follow through on recommendations by coordinating actions, monitoring their impact and refining plans based on results.
* Define tracking requirements and UTM conventions, and coordinate implementation with the Website & Digital Platforms role.

**Planning, coordination and stakeholder management**

* Plan and organise multiple workstreams, managing priorities, dependencies, timelines and approvals proactively.
* Work closely with the Website & Digital Platforms role: provide approved, ready-to-publish content and assets, agree timelines and review pages before go-live.
* Partner with segment champions across Academic and Education Publishing to understand priorities, source content and share performance insights.
* Collaborate with business development, product, editorial teams and subject-matter experts on accurate, audience-focused communications.
* Communicate plans, progress and required actions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders — flagging delays, risks and blockers early rather than waiting for them to become issues.

**Industry and customer understanding**

* Build and continuously deepen knowledge of scholarly, academic and educational publishing, Integra's services and products, and its customer segments.
* Apply this understanding to create credible, informed content that reflects customer needs, industry developments and Integra's positioning.

**03EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS**

**Essential**

* 5–7 years in content marketing, digital marketing, brand communications, content operations or a related B2B marketing role.
* Strong creative thinking, storytelling and writing skills, with excellent written English and editorial judgement.
* Proven ability to plan and manage multiple projects, channels and deadlines in a structured, methodical way.
* Experience managing brand messaging and keeping it consistent across websites, social media and other channels.
* Hands-on experience with website content management, content SEO and business social media, particularly LinkedIn.
* Working understanding of answer engine optimisation (AEO), generative engine optimisation (GEO), and how large language models discover, interpret and cite online content.
* AI literacy: confident, responsible use of AI tools to improve the quality and speed of content, research and analysis — with careful verification of outputs.
* Strong analytical skills: able to interpret marketing data and turn it into practical recommendations and actions.
* Experience with GA4, Google Search Console, social media analytics, dashboarding tools and Excel/Sheets.
* Experience with email marketing platforms and customer databases or CRM systems.
* Good visual and design sensibility, with the ability to brief and work effectively with designers.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to work independently.

**Preferred**

* Experience in academic, scholarly or educational publishing, or B2B technology/SaaS.
* Experience planning and running podcasts, webinars or video content.
* Familiarity with SEO tools such as Semrush or Ahrefs, and social media scheduling tools.
* Basic familiarity with design tools such as Canva or Figma.

**04HOW WE WORK**

Our Marketing Team Charter sets out the behaviours we expect of everyone, aligned with the Integra Way competencies. In this role, they look like this:

**Ownership**

Owns outcomes end to end, with sincerity and good faith. Plans ahead, follows through and does not create unnecessary load for others.

**High agency**

Spots what needs doing and acts, without waiting for instructions — while knowing when to bring others in. Manages their own work and priorities to high standards.

**Proactive communication**

Doesn't overpromise. Flags delays, risks and blockers early, even before having a solution, and keeps stakeholders informed.

**Execution**

Delivers accurate, complete, on-brand work on time, backed by rigorous self-review.

**Growth & technology mindset**

Owns their learning; stays current with AI tools, search and the publishing industry, and shares what they learn with the team.

**Customer focus**

Understands what Academic and Education publishers need, and turns that insight into relevant, credible content.

**05WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

**AREA**
**WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE**

* Visitors & leads - Website visitors and marketing leads grow measurably against agreed baselines and targets, quarter on quarter.
* Brand & content - Brand messaging is clear and consistent across all channels; content plans are well organised, aligned with business priorities and delivered on schedule.
* Websites & search - Website content is current, accurate and on-brand; organic and AI-search visibility improve against agreed baselines.
* Social media - Consistent, engaging publishing with measurable growth in followers, reach, engagement and traffic to the website.
* Newsletter & podcast - Delivered reliably, with improving reach and content repurposing.
* Insights - Reports explain what the data means and what to do next — and lead to tracked actions.
* Insights - Reports explain what the data means and what to do next — and lead to tracked actions.
* Ownership & communication - Stakeholders are never surprised: plans, progress, risks and decisions are shared early, and delivery is owned end to end.
* Growth - A visibly deepening understanding of the industry, Integra's customers and their needs, reflected in the relevance and quality of communications.

**06KEY INTERFACES**

Vice President – Growth & Strategy · the Marketing team · Website & Digital Platforms role · design team · segment champions · business development, product and editorial teams · subject-matter experts · podcast hosts · external agencies.

**07SECONDARY RESPONSIBILITIES**

Alongside the primary focus, the role supports the Website & Digital Platforms role on the technical side of Integra's websites, working with the relevant technical owners and vendors:

* Website maintenance and testing, including checking pages, forms and functionality before and after changes.
* Coordination with website vendors and hosting providers.
* Coordination with IT and cybersecurity teams on website-related matters.
* Technical SEO implementation, such as site speed, indexing, structured data and fixing crawl issues.

title: PPC Marketing Specialist (Remote)
description:
**Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.**
That is the whole job.
  
  
Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.
  
  
So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.
  
  
At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.
  
  
You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.
  
  
Here is what "end to end" actually means.
  
  
**You are the account manager. We do not have any.**
You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.
  
  
**You own the whole funnel, not the campaign.**
Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.
  
  
**You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it.**
We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.
  
  
**You can live anywhere.**
We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.
  
  
If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.
  
  
If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.
  
  
**Requirements**
**What the job looks like**

* Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month
* Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working
* Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people
* Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing
* Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target
* Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule
* Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery
* Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why
* Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team
* Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt

**You are a fit if**

* You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search
* You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have
* You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it
* You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list
* You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard
* You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you
* Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too

**You are not a fit if**

* "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed
* You want to be told what to do this week
* You need a ticketing system to know what matters
* You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question

**Benefits**
**Why this role is exciting**
This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.
  
  
You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.
  
  
You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.
  
  
You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

title: Senior Manager, Product Management
description:
The Product Management function defines the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for platforms and capabilities that deliver customer value and enable business outcomes. By partnering closely with engineering, design, data, operations, and business teams, the function drives outcome focused product discovery and delivery, balances innovation with platform stability, and ensures disciplined prioritization and governance. The team applies modern product management practices, customer centric thinking, and data informed decision making to deliver scalable, high impact products across the enterprise.

The Senior Manager, Product Management builds and executes the product management strategy for assigned digital platforms and products, or business domains, aligning product vision, roadmaps, prioritization, and governance frameworks with business priorities and customer needs. The role enables predictable, high quality digital product outcomes by overseeing end to end product lifecycle execution, and by building strong product management capability aligned to organizational product standards and outcome driven practices.

**Strategic Responsibilities**

· Build and execute the product management strategy for assigned platforms, products, or domains by aligning product vision, roadmaps, OKRs, and prioritization with business goals, customer outcomes, and governance frameworks.

· Implement product governance and outcome controls by operationalizing product management processes, portfolio reviews, prioritization frameworks, success metrics, and documentation standards.

· Promote product practice uplifting by identifying gaps in product discovery, delivery, and lifecycle practices and adopting modern product management methods and tools.

· Optimize product planning and delivery by aligning road mapping, prioritization cycles, dependency management, and resource allocation across PM teams to improve predictability and value delivery.

· Monitor product, delivery, and portfolio risks, establish escalation paths, and support informed trade off decisions across scope, customer impact, stability, timelines, and priorities.

**Functional Responsibilities**

· Oversee end to end product lifecycle execution across assigned platforms, products, or business areas, ensuring alignment with business objectives, customer needs, and product strategy.

· Ensure consistent application of product governance practices across teams, including prioritization frameworks, roadmap hygiene, outcome metrics, documentation standards, and decision making rigor.

· Align product priorities, roadmap decisions, and dependency management with engineering, design, data, operations, and business partners to deliver integrated, scalable product outcomes.

· Strengthen product delivery workflows through standardization of discovery practices, roadmapping approaches, prioritization templates, OKR adoption, and product tooling to improve consistency and predictability.

· Assure predictable portfolio level outcomes by monitoring product performance, delivery health, dependency risks, platform stability, and execution bottlenecks across initiatives.

**People Responsibilities**

· Lead and guide multiple Product Managers and Product Management leads across assigned platforms, products, or domains, strengthening product discipline, customer focus, and outcome oriented execution.

· Build strong relationships with senior business, engineering, design, data, and platform leaders to ensure transparency, aligned priorities, and effective portfolio level decision making.

· Identify capability gaps within product teams and drive targeted capability building initiatives across product strategy, discovery, prioritization, stakeholder management, and outcome ownership.

· Support hiring and onboarding of Product Managers by contributing to role definitions, skill requirements, candidate assessment, and effective team integration.

· Provide ongoing performance feedback, coaching, and career guidance to Product Managers to develop high potential talent and build a strong product leadership pipeline.

Requirements
  
  

· 10–14 years of experience leading product management initiatives across multiple platforms, products, or domains within large organizations, including product governance, portfolio level delivery, and people leadership of Product Managers.

· Strong ability to align domain-level product strategies, roadmaps, and prioritization with business objectives, customer outcomes, and enterprise platform considerations to deliver measurable impact.

· Deep understanding of operationalizing product governance, outcome measurement, and decision controls, including OKRs, prioritization frameworks, roadmap discipline, and documentation standards.

· Experience building and scaling product management capability through standardized practices, shared frameworks, tooling, and coaching to improve consistency and execution maturity.

· Ability to interpret portfolio-level product and delivery signals, including roadmap health, dependency risks, outcome performance, customer feedback, and platform stability, and take corrective action.

Skilled at identifying product, delivery, and portfolio risks, assessing trade-offs, and shaping recommendations that balance customer impact, strategic priorities, platform health, and delivery timelines.
  
  
  

**Minimum:**
Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

**Preferred:**
Master’s degree in Business, Management, Engineering, or a related discipline and/or relevant certifications in Product Management, Agile, Scrum, SAFe, Lean, Design Thinking, OKRs

title: Product Innovation Manager – Airline Solutions
description:
**Company Description**

Infiniti Software Solutions is a Chennai-based airline technology company serving over 30 airlines globally. Our products span airline group revenue management, distribution, modern airline retailing, AI-powered intelligence and operational automation.

With over 350 professionals and a growing international airline customer base, we are focused on building technology that solves real business problems and creates measurable value for our customers.

**Role Description**

We are looking for a Product Innovation Manager who combines strong airline-domain knowledge with commercial thinking, customer engagement and a passion for solving business problems.

This is not a conventional product management or project coordination role.

You will engage directly with airline stakeholders, understand their commercial and operational challenges, identify opportunities for innovation, and work with our teams to develop solutions that customers are willing to adopt and pay for.

The role requires someone who can move confidently from customer discovery and solution conceptualization to demonstrations, business cases and commercial progression.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Engage airline commercial, revenue management, distribution and technology stakeholders to understand business challenges.
* Lead customer discovery workshops and identify opportunities for innovation and commercial improvement.
* Translate customer problems into compelling product concepts, solutions and value propositions.
* Present solutions to airline executives, handle objections and build customer confidence.
* Work with engineering and product teams to develop prototypes, validate concepts and bring solutions to market.
* Develop business cases, pricing inputs and go-to-market propositions.
* Collaborate with Sales to progress qualified opportunities through pilots, commercial proposals and customer commitments.
* Identify opportunities to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve airline revenue, efficiency and customer experience.
* Take ownership of initiatives from idea and customer validation through product readiness and commercialization.



**Qualifications**

* 7–12 years of professional experience, preferably including significant exposure to airline technology or airline commercial operations.
* Experience in airline technology pre-sales, solution consulting, product management, business development or commercial transformation.
* Strong understanding of one or more airline domains such as revenue management, group sales, airline distribution, NDC, Offer/Order or ancillary retailing.
* Proven ability to engage customers, identify business problems and communicate technology solutions effectively.
* Experience presenting to senior customer stakeholders and contributing to commercial opportunity progression.
* Strong analytical thinking, communication, influencing and stakeholder-management skills.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with a genuine passion for solving customer problems.
* Familiarity with AI-enabled products and modern software development practices is an advantage.



**What We Value**

We are looking for someone who is curious, commercially minded and comfortable taking ownership.

We value people who listen to customers, challenge assumptions, communicate clearly and focus on outcomes rather than activities.

You do not need to be a hands-on programmer. You must be able to understand technology well enough to work effectively with engineering and confidently present its business value.

**Location:**
Chennai, Tamil Nadu — On-site

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

If you understand airline business challenges and enjoy turning ideas into solutions that customers value, we would like to hear from you.

title: Accountant
description:
**Company Description**
Hipa Masala is a growing organization in the food and hospitality sector, focused on delivering high-quality products and memorable experiences to customers. The company values reliability, strong operational controls, and sustainable financial practices to support its expansion. Team members are encouraged to contribute ideas, take ownership of their responsibilities, and collaborate across functions. Joining Hipa Masala offers the opportunity to work in a dynamic environment where professional development and integrity are highly valued.
  
**Role Description**
The Accountant at Hipa Masala will manage day-to-day finance and accounting operations in an on-site, full-time role based in Chennai. Responsibilities include maintaining accurate ledgers, recording daily transactions, handling accounts payable and receivable, and reconciling bank statements. The role will involve preparing financial reports, supporting budgeting and forecasting activities, and ensuring compliance with applicable accounting standards, tax regulations, and internal controls. The Accountant will coordinate with internal teams, vendors, and auditors, assist with month-end and year-end closing, and help improve financial processes and documentation. * Strong accounting knowledge, including general ledger management, accounts payable/receivable, and bank reconciliations.
* Proficiency with accounting software and MS Excel, including use of formulas, pivot tables, and basic financial analysis.
* Understanding of local tax regulations, statutory compliance, and financial reporting standards relevant to operations in Chennai.
* Excellent numerical accuracy, attention to detail, and ability to maintain organized financial records and documentation.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and external partners.
* Ability to work on-site full time, manage multiple deadlines, and maintain confidentiality of financial information.

title: Principal Engineer
description:
**Why this role exists**

Our engineering team is young. We have about 30 engineers, six new team leads and one senior

architect. The leads are good builders who have not led before. They need someone to learn from

every day.

AI agents now write a large share of our code. Design, review and judgement have become the

scarce skills. This role brings them.

**About Company**

We build customised holidays for Indian travellers. We have done this for over 12 years

from Chennai.

A traveller plans a trip with us, a seller helps them decide, and our team delivers it on the ground.

Technology runs through all of it: the website and app, the sales funnel, pricing and supply,

booking, and everything after booking.

**How tech is organised**

You report to Chief Architect. The six team leads look to you for every technical

call.

**The roles you will play**

1. Guide to the six leads. You review their designs and code, and you pair with them on the hard

problems. Every lead gets your time every week.

2. Keeper of standards. You set how we design APIs, test, release and code with AI agents.

Then you make sure it is followed.

3. Builder. You stay hands-on. Expect a good part of your week in code.

4. Chief Architect's partner on architecture. You work with him on data unification and on the API layer

that our website, partners and agents all use.

5. Owner of one critical system. In your first months you own one system end to end, most

likely payments.

6. Hiring bar. You interview engineers and decide who is good enough.

**What you will not do:**

• Manage people. Appraisals and staffing stay with the founder.

• Set AI direction. That sits with the AI head. You make sure agents call our systems safely.

Your first 90 days

• By day 30: you know the codebase, the six leads and where each team is stuck. You have

shipped one fix or feature yourself.

• By day 60: design reviews run every week with every lead. Our standards for APIs, tests and

releases are written down and in use.

• By day 90: one critical system is fully yours. Each lead can name one thing they do better

because of you.

**What we look for**

• 8 to 12 years of building software, full stack with most of it in backend.

• Our stack: Java and Spring Boot, MongoDB, React.

• Time spent on systems where a mistake costs money: booking, payments, fintech or

commerce.

• You code with AI agents every day, and you can show us how.

• The role is in Chennai.

The three skills that matter most:

1. Backend system design.

2. API and data modelling.

3. Code review and debugging across the stack.

The one quality: you enjoy making other engineers better. A teacher's patience matters more here

than being the best coder in the room.

The opportunity

• Six leads grow because of you. That is how we will measure this role.

• You shape how a team builds with AI agents. We are early, and the habits you set will stay.

• The problems are real. Live pricing and supply, bookings that cannot fail, voice AI in sales,

and post-booking work that runs without people.

**What is coming up:**

• One unified data layer across our systems.

• A Holidays API that banks and partners sell from.

• A new product for travellers outside India.

• A CTO decision. We have not hired one. We will decide once this structure settles, and

whoever does this role well is part of that conversation

title: Application Security Architect
description:
We are looking for an experienced Application Security Architect with 9–12 years of experience to drive application security architecture, engineering security standards and secure software development practices across Novac's fintech product ecosystem.

The candidate will be responsible for designing and implementing security architecture for enterprise-grade financial software products, ensuring security is embedded throughout the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). The role requires strong expertise in application security, secure coding, API security, cloud security, DevSecOps, threat modelling, vulnerability management, and security architecture reviews.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience securing fintech applications, digital lending platforms, loan management systems, insurance technology platforms, financial APIs, payment integrations, and enterprise software products. The candidate will work closely with Product Engineering, Software Architecture, Cloud, DevOps, and Information Security teams to ensure that Novac's products are scalable, resilient, and secure.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities:**

**Application Security Architecture**

* Establish secure architecture standards for digital banking, lending, insurance, and payment platforms.
* Define enterprise security reference architectures and reusable security patterns.
* Define security controls for AI-enabled applications and APIs.
* Assess risks relating to LLM integration, prompt injection, sensitive data exposure, and model governance.
* Review application architecture, technical designs, and business requirements to identify security risks and recommend appropriate controls.
* Drive security-by-design principles across product development and software engineering.
* Review architecture designs and provide security requirements before development begins.
* Conduct security architecture reviews for web applications, mobile applications, APIs, microservices, and cloud-based platforms.
* Define secure architecture patterns for authentication, authorization, encryption, data protection, and identity management.
* Review NFRs (Non-Functional Requirements) related to security, privacy, resilience, and compliance.

**Secure SDLC & DevSecOps**

* Integrate security practices across all stages of the Software Development Life Cycle.
* Implement and strengthen DevSecOps practices by embedding automated security testing into CI/CD pipelines.
* Drive implementation of SAST, DAST, SCA, container security, and Infrastructure-as-Code security scanning.
* Establish secure coding guidelines and conduct application code security reviews.
* Work closely with development teams to identify, prioritise, and remediate security vulnerabilities.
* Automate security validation and vulnerability detection within software development and deployment processes.

**API & Fintech Product Security**

* Design and implement security controls for REST APIs, microservices, third-party integrations, and distributed applications.
* Ensure secure API authentication and authorisation using OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, and API gateways.
* Secure financial applications involving digital lending, loan origination, loan management, insurance workflows, and transaction processing.
* Define security controls for sensitive customer information, financial records, and transactional data.
* Ensure secure integration with banking systems, payment gateways, financial institutions, and external service providers.
* Identify and mitigate risks associated with data exposure, unauthorised access, fraud, and application-level attacks.

**Vulnerability Assessment & Threat Modelling**

* Conduct application security assessments, architecture reviews, and threat modelling exercises.
* Establish vulnerability management processes, risk classification, and remediation SLAs.
* Perform security risk assessments for new product features, application enhancements, and third-party integrations.

**Cloud & Infrastructure Application Security**

* Define and implement application security controls across AWS, Azure, or GCP environments.
* Review IAM architectures and enforce least-privilege access controls.
* Establish Zero-Trust application security principles.
* Ensure security across cloud-native applications, Docker, Kubernetes, and microservices environments.
* Implement encryption, secrets management, key management, and secure communication protocols.
* Work with cloud and DevOps teams to strengthen application deployment and runtime security.
* Ensure secure configurations and access controls across application environments.

**Security Governance & Compliance**

* Define application security policies, standards, technical guidelines, and governance frameworks.
* Ensure alignment with relevant security standards such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, and applicable RBI requirements, based on product and regulatory scope.
* Support internal and external security audits, compliance assessments, and risk reviews.
* Drive security awareness and secure coding practices across engineering teams.
* Work closely with technology leadership and product stakeholders to ensure security requirements are met.
* Define application security KPIs and maturity roadmap.
* Track:
* Vulnerability remediation SLA adherence
* Security debt
* Critical vulnerability trends
* Application security coverage
* Secure coding adoption metrics
* Present security posture and risks to senior management and technology leadership.

**Experience & Educational Qualifications**

* 9–12 years of overall experience in Application Security, Product Security, Security Engineering, or Information Security.
* Minimum 5+ years of relevant hands-on experience in application security and secure software development.
* 3+ years of experience in application security architecture, security design reviews, or security engineering leadership preferred.
* Experience securing UPI, payment gateway, and financial transaction workflows.
* Understanding of RBI Cyber Security Framework expectations.
* Knowledge of PCI DSS v4.0 requirements.
* Familiarity with data protection requirements involving customer PII, financial information, and consent management.
* Experience in a FinTech, BFSI technology, Banking Software, or Enterprise software Product Company is strongly preferred.
* Preferred Certifications (CISSP/CSSLP/CCSP).
* Proven experience in securing enterprise-grade applications, APIs, microservices, and cloud-based platforms.
* Strong understanding of modern software architecture, distributed systems, and cloud-native applications.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate should come from a FinTech, Banking Technology, Financial Software Product, or Enterprise SaaS Product Engineering Organisation.

**Candidates should have demonstrated experience in:**

* Designing and implementing application security architecture for complex software products.
* Securing digital lending, banking, payment, insurance, and transaction-based platforms.
* Implementing DevSecOps and integrating security into CI/CD pipelines.
* Conducting threat modelling, security architecture reviews, and secure code assessments.
* Securing APIs, microservices, cloud platforms, and third-party integrations.

title: Agentic AI Orchestrator
description:
**Job Summary**

The Agentic AI Orchestrator designs, builds, and operates the Investment Division's agentic AI workflows—the automated, multi-step processes through which AI agents read documents, reconcile data, draft analysis, and assemble reporting across the division's clusters. The role converts analyst workflows into orchestrated agent pipelines with human review gates, owns the division's prompt, skill, and agent library, and is accountable for the accuracy, auditability, and cost of every automated output.

The position anchors the division's AI-led operating model from the Chennai office, working alongside the Data Engineer (data pipelines and infrastructure) and the ML Engineer (models and evaluation), and serves as the bridge between the investment analysts and the division's AI tooling

**ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

1. Design, build, and operate agentic AI workflows for the division's recurring processes: document extraction and reconciliation, portfolio and company performance monitoring, report and IC pack assembly, and data-room processing.

2. Translate analyst and reporting workflows into orchestrated multi-agent pipelines with defined human review gates, so that no figure or recommendation is published without analyst sign-off.

3. Own the division's prompt, skill, agent, and plugin library: design, versioning, testing, and documentation, ensuring workflows are reusable across clusters rather than one-off chats.

4. Integrate agents with the division's systems and data sources — document repositories, custodian and administrator reporting, and the division's knowledge base — working with the Data Engineer on pipelines and access.

5. Build and run evaluation harnesses with the ML Engineer: accuracy benchmarks against verified ground truth, regression testing on workflow changes, and periodic audits of automated outputs.

6. Implement AI governance and guardrails: access controls and confidentiality boundaries for family and portfolio data, audit trails for every automated output, and compliance with the Group's AI usage policies.

7. Monitor agent performance, cost, latency, and failure modes; triage incidents, maintain runbooks, and drive continuous improvement of workflow reliability.

8. Train and support the division's analysts in AI-assisted working practices; capture their feedback and convert it into a prioritised automation backlog.

9. Maintain complete documentation of all orchestrated workflows, their data sources, model versions, and review controls, ensuring every automated output is reproducible and auditable.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Minimum Education Required**

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related quantitative field.

• Strong Python engineering skills: API integration, data handling, and production-quality code with testing and version control (Git).

• Hands-on experience building LLM-based and agentic systems in production: workflow orchestration, tool and function calling, and multi-agent patterns — using frameworks such as LangGraph or LangChain, or SDK-native orchestration (e.g. Claude Agent SDK). Framework experience matters less than sound orchestration design.

• Practical RAG experience: document chunking, embeddings, vector databases (e.g. pgvector, Pinecone, Qdrant, or similar), hybrid search, and retrieval evaluation.

• Experience building or integrating MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and tools, or equivalent connector architectures linking AI agents to enterprise systems and data sources.

• Familiarity with LLM evaluation and observability tooling (accuracy benchmarks, regression tests, tracing); disciplined prompt and skill engineering with versioning and documentation.

• Understanding of data privacy, access control, and audit requirements for confidential financial data; exposure to investment or financial reporting workflows preferred.

**Years of experience are required.**

• Minimum of 4 to 7 years of experience in software or AI engineering, of which at least 2 years hands-on with LLM-based or agentic systems in production, at a technology firm, financial institution, or data-driven enterprise.
