title: Principal Engineer
description:
**Why this role exists**

Our engineering team is young. We have about 30 engineers, six new team leads and one senior

architect. The leads are good builders who have not led before. They need someone to learn from

every day.

AI agents now write a large share of our code. Design, review and judgement have become the

scarce skills. This role brings them.

**About Company**

We build customised holidays for Indian travellers. We have done this for over 12 years

from Chennai.

A traveller plans a trip with us, a seller helps them decide, and our team delivers it on the ground.

Technology runs through all of it: the website and app, the sales funnel, pricing and supply,

booking, and everything after booking.

**How tech is organised**

You report to Chief Architect. The six team leads look to you for every technical

call.

**The roles you will play**

1. Guide to the six leads. You review their designs and code, and you pair with them on the hard

problems. Every lead gets your time every week.

2. Keeper of standards. You set how we design APIs, test, release and code with AI agents.

Then you make sure it is followed.

3. Builder. You stay hands-on. Expect a good part of your week in code.

4. Chief Architect's partner on architecture. You work with him on data unification and on the API layer

that our website, partners and agents all use.

5. Owner of one critical system. In your first months you own one system end to end, most

likely payments.

6. Hiring bar. You interview engineers and decide who is good enough.

**What you will not do:**

• Manage people. Appraisals and staffing stay with the founder.

• Set AI direction. That sits with the AI head. You make sure agents call our systems safely.

Your first 90 days

• By day 30: you know the codebase, the six leads and where each team is stuck. You have

shipped one fix or feature yourself.

• By day 60: design reviews run every week with every lead. Our standards for APIs, tests and

releases are written down and in use.

• By day 90: one critical system is fully yours. Each lead can name one thing they do better

because of you.

**What we look for**

• 8 to 12 years of building software, full stack with most of it in backend.

• Our stack: Java and Spring Boot, MongoDB, React.

• Time spent on systems where a mistake costs money: booking, payments, fintech or

commerce.

• You code with AI agents every day, and you can show us how.

• The role is in Chennai.

The three skills that matter most:

1. Backend system design.

2. API and data modelling.

3. Code review and debugging across the stack.

The one quality: you enjoy making other engineers better. A teacher's patience matters more here

than being the best coder in the room.

The opportunity

• Six leads grow because of you. That is how we will measure this role.

• You shape how a team builds with AI agents. We are early, and the habits you set will stay.

• The problems are real. Live pricing and supply, bookings that cannot fail, voice AI in sales,

and post-booking work that runs without people.

**What is coming up:**

• One unified data layer across our systems.

• A Holidays API that banks and partners sell from.

• A new product for travellers outside India.

• A CTO decision. We have not hired one. We will decide once this structure settles, and

whoever does this role well is part of that conversation

title: Agentic AI Orchestrator
description:
**Job Summary**

The Agentic AI Orchestrator designs, builds, and operates the Investment Division's agentic AI workflows—the automated, multi-step processes through which AI agents read documents, reconcile data, draft analysis, and assemble reporting across the division's clusters. The role converts analyst workflows into orchestrated agent pipelines with human review gates, owns the division's prompt, skill, and agent library, and is accountable for the accuracy, auditability, and cost of every automated output.

The position anchors the division's AI-led operating model from the Chennai office, working alongside the Data Engineer (data pipelines and infrastructure) and the ML Engineer (models and evaluation), and serves as the bridge between the investment analysts and the division's AI tooling

**ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

1. Design, build, and operate agentic AI workflows for the division's recurring processes: document extraction and reconciliation, portfolio and company performance monitoring, report and IC pack assembly, and data-room processing.

2. Translate analyst and reporting workflows into orchestrated multi-agent pipelines with defined human review gates, so that no figure or recommendation is published without analyst sign-off.

3. Own the division's prompt, skill, agent, and plugin library: design, versioning, testing, and documentation, ensuring workflows are reusable across clusters rather than one-off chats.

4. Integrate agents with the division's systems and data sources — document repositories, custodian and administrator reporting, and the division's knowledge base — working with the Data Engineer on pipelines and access.

5. Build and run evaluation harnesses with the ML Engineer: accuracy benchmarks against verified ground truth, regression testing on workflow changes, and periodic audits of automated outputs.

6. Implement AI governance and guardrails: access controls and confidentiality boundaries for family and portfolio data, audit trails for every automated output, and compliance with the Group's AI usage policies.

7. Monitor agent performance, cost, latency, and failure modes; triage incidents, maintain runbooks, and drive continuous improvement of workflow reliability.

8. Train and support the division's analysts in AI-assisted working practices; capture their feedback and convert it into a prioritised automation backlog.

9. Maintain complete documentation of all orchestrated workflows, their data sources, model versions, and review controls, ensuring every automated output is reproducible and auditable.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Minimum Education Required**

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related quantitative field.

• Strong Python engineering skills: API integration, data handling, and production-quality code with testing and version control (Git).

• Hands-on experience building LLM-based and agentic systems in production: workflow orchestration, tool and function calling, and multi-agent patterns — using frameworks such as LangGraph or LangChain, or SDK-native orchestration (e.g. Claude Agent SDK). Framework experience matters less than sound orchestration design.

• Practical RAG experience: document chunking, embeddings, vector databases (e.g. pgvector, Pinecone, Qdrant, or similar), hybrid search, and retrieval evaluation.

• Experience building or integrating MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and tools, or equivalent connector architectures linking AI agents to enterprise systems and data sources.

• Familiarity with LLM evaluation and observability tooling (accuracy benchmarks, regression tests, tracing); disciplined prompt and skill engineering with versioning and documentation.

• Understanding of data privacy, access control, and audit requirements for confidential financial data; exposure to investment or financial reporting workflows preferred.

**Years of experience are required.**

• Minimum of 4 to 7 years of experience in software or AI engineering, of which at least 2 years hands-on with LLM-based or agentic systems in production, at a technology firm, financial institution, or data-driven enterprise.

title: Manager Software Development
description:
Here at Appian, our values of
**Intensity**
and
**Excellence**
define who we are. We set high standards and live up to them, ensuring that everything we do is done with care and quality. We approach every challenge with ambition and commitment, holding ourselves and each other accountable to achieve the best results. When you join Appian, you’ll be part of a passionate team dedicated to accomplishing hard things, together.

*Job Description:*

ABOUT THE TEAM

Our Engineering team is revolutionizing how Appian resolves customer issues by building AI-powered diagnostic tools and internal platforms that dramatically reduce resolution time. We combine deep technical expertise with AI innovation to empower support engineers to identify root causes faster, ensuring our customers experience uninterrupted business-critical operations. This team operates with high autonomy and directly impacts customer satisfaction and retention across Appian's enterprise client base.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Appian is at an inflection point where intelligent automation meets customer success, and we need a technical leader who can architect and ship the next generation of diagnostic platforms. This role exists because our growing enterprise customer base demands faster, smarter issue resolution, and AI agents are the key to unlocking that scale. You will shape both the technical direction and the team culture while delivering tools that become essential to how Appian supports thousands of mission-critical deployments worldwide.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

* Lead the design and delivery of a scalable AI-powered triage platform that reduces mean time to resolution by leveraging AI agents, LangChain frameworks, and intelligent diagnostics
* Lead the engineering team building AI-powered diagnostic tools that cut customer issue resolution time in half while scaling a platform that empowers support engineers across the globe.
* Architect quarterly releases of diagnostic tools on AWS infrastructure, balancing innovation velocity with production stability and security requirements
* Build and grow a high-performing engineering team through effective people management, technical mentorship, and career development focused on AI and cloud-native technologies
* Partner with Customer Success and Product leadership to translate support pain points into engineering roadmaps that drive measurable improvements in customer satisfaction
* Drive technical excellence through hands-on code reviews in Python and AI frameworks while establishing engineering best practices for the team
* Execute stakeholder management across engineering, product, and customer-facing teams to align priorities and communicate progress on platform capabilities

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

* Education: Hold a Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related STEM field
* Experience: 9+ years of experience in software engineering with at least 3+ years in engineering management or technical leadership roles
* AI Fluency: Proven fluency in AI and LLMs, encompassing both the strategic development of AI-powered platform capabilities and the hands-on application of AI tools to accelerate daily workflows
* Python Expertise: Strong proficiency in Python with demonstrated experience building production-grade applications and diagnostic tools
* Cloud Infrastructure: Hands-on experience designing and deploying scalable systems on AWS with knowledge of cloud-native architectures
* AI Agent Development: Experience building AI agents and working with frameworks such as LangChain or similar orchestration tools
* People Leadership: Proven track record managing engineering teams, including hiring, performance management, and technical mentorship
* Technical Collaboration: Active participation in code reviews and ability to balance hands-on technical contributions with leadership responsibilities
* Stakeholder Management: Strong communication skills with experience managing cross-functional stakeholders and translating business needs into technical solutions

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

* Customer Support Domain: Experience building tools or platforms for customer support, site reliability, or operations teams
* Diagnostic Systems: Background in observability, monitoring, troubleshooting tools, or root cause analysis platforms
* Enterprise SaaS: Experience working in enterprise software companies with complex multi-tenant architectures
* Ecosystem Experience: We value experience with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce or ServiceNow, as these skills translate well into our Enterprise-Grade Orchestration environment

**Tools and Resources**

* Training and Development: During onboarding, we focus on equipping new hires with the skills and knowledge for success through department-specific training. Continuous learning is a central focus at Appian, with dedicated mentorship and the First-Friend program being widely utilized resources for new hires.
* Growth Opportunities: Appian provides a diverse array of growth and development opportunities, including our leadership program tailored for new and aspiring managers, a comprehensive library of specialized department training through Appian University, skills based training, and tuition reimbursement for those aiming to advance their education. This commitment ensures that employees have access to a holistic range of development opportunities.
* Community: We’ll immerse you into our community rooted in respect starting on day one. Appian fosters inclusivity through our 8 employee-led affinity groups. These groups help employees build stronger internal and external networks by planning social, educational, and outreach activities to connect with Appianites and larger initiatives throughout the company.

**Benefits**

Appian offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and financial future. Benefits may include health coverage, Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with free mental health support, life and disability insurance, an Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), a retirement/pension plan, wellness dollars, tuition reimbursement, family-forming benefits and more. Benefits vary by country—please ask your Talent Acquisition contact for details specific to the location you are applying to.

**About Appian**

Appian provides AI automation for the most important business processes at the world’s largest organizations. Our platform is known for its unique power, reliability, and scale. We’ve been automating processes for more than 25 years and have proven expertise in enterprise operations. For more information, visit appian.com.

Follow Appian: LinkedIn, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, and X.

*Appian provides reasonable accommodations to applicants in accordance with all applicable laws. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please contact us by email at ReasonableAccommodations@appian.com. Please note that only inquiries concerning a request for reasonable accommodation will be responded to from this email address.*

team.

leads

● Have hands-on experience on continuous integration and continuous delivery

technologies

persistence, infrastructure automation, etc

different approaches to delivery

● Working with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCloud, Azure etc.

● Infrastructure management technologies such as Cloud Formation or Terraform

title: 3DX – Manager, Technical Transformation
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**3DX – Manager, Technical Transformation**
Join Deloitte’s Enterprise Performance practice as a Manager, 3DX, where you will support digital transformation initiatives across product lifecycle management environments. In this role, you will contribute to the design, customization, deployment, and support of 3DEXPERIENCE solutions for complex client needs. You will work with cross-functional teams to translate functional requirements into technical solutions, deliver quality work products within project timelines, and support implementation activities across the solution lifecycle.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Manager, 3DX on the Enterprise Performance team, you will be responsible for supporting product lifecycle management transformation initiatives across engineering, manufacturing, and enterprise application environments.
  
  

* Lead configuration and customization activities within Dassault 3DEXPERIENCE ENOVIA and DELMIA environments based on documented business and technical requirements.
* Support bill of materials management, computer-aided design data management, document management, project management, change management, and product information management activities within product lifecycle management environments.
* Lead integration activities between 3DEXPERIENCE and enterprise platforms such as enterprise resource planning, manufacturing execution systems, customer relationship management systems, reporting tools, and MCAD or ECAD applications.
* Support requirements documentation, legacy data migration, test planning, functional testing, user acceptance testing, and issue resolution across deployment phases.
* Collaborate with business, technology, onsite, and offshore teams and provide guidance to junior team members to support end-to-end PLM solution delivery.

**The team**
Enterprise Performance
  
  
Our Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise technology, working across finance, supply chain, and IT operations to support the delivery of holistic performance improvement and digital transformation. We support Deloitte client service teams of strategic advisors and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to help collaborate with leading insights providers and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable the heart of business solutions.
  
  
The Enterprise Performance team leverages deep industry knowledge, strong analytical skills, and practical approaches to address clients’ toughest business challenges. Our professionals as part of the Supply Chain Network Operations (SCNO) service line within Enterprise Performance focus on helping organizations achieve sustainable competitive advantage throughout their operations, spanning product development, planning, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, and distribution. We excel at translating strategic objectives into tangible, measurable outcomes at the operational level. By aligning high-level goals with frontline execution, we ensure our clients realize real value and improved performance across every stage of their supply chain and operations.
  
  
**Location:**
Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai
  
  
**Shift Timings:**
11 AM to 8 PM or 2 PM to 11 PM IST, as per business requirements
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 10+ years of experience configuring and customizing Dassault 3DEXPERIENCE ENOVIA
* Experience developing customization or extension solutions using two or more of the following: CAA, Matrix Query Language (MQL), Java/Java Program Objects (JPO), JavaScript, Enterprise Knowledge Language (EKL), Spinner, 3DX Widget, or EXALEAD
* Experience developing integrations between 3DEXPERIENCE and enterprise systems using web services, Simple Object Access Protocol (SOAP), Representational State Transfer (REST) APIs, or third-party connectors
* Experience supporting bill of materials structures, including electronic bill of materials (EBOM) and manufacturing bill of materials (MBOM), along with CAD data, document management, change management, and product information management processes
* Experience documenting technical requirements, supporting legacy data migration, and contributing to test planning, functional testing, and user acceptance testing
* Experience contributing to at least 2 full-cycle PLM implementations in a project delivery role
* Bachelor of Technology, Master of Computer Applications, Master of Technology, Master of Business Administration, or equivalent from an accredited university

Preferred:
  
  

* Experience with Dassault 3DEXPERIENCE ENOVIA in cloud or on-premises environments
* Experience with 3DX client-side development, including CATIA macros
* Experience with 3DX platform installation, setup, and maintenance
* Experience using code change management tools such as TortoiseSVN or GitLab
* Experience supporting build management and deployments, including continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD)
* Experience with infrastructure components such as Windows, Linux, Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, Apache TomEE, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), or Microsoft Azure

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: QuickBase Developer
description:
**Overview**
## Role Summary
  
  
Responsible for designing, building, enhancing, and supporting \*\*Quickbase native solutions\*\* (and \*\*custom Quickbase extensions\*\* using \*\*Code Pages\*\* and the \*\*Quickbase RESTful API\*\*). This role requires a strong \*\*product-ownership mindset\*\* and the ability to partner closely with business stakeholders to clarify requirements, translate business needs into scalable technical solutions, and support ongoing platform adoption and improvement.
  
  
The ideal candidate is comfortable working directly with non-technical users, proactively re-engaging stakeholders when requirements are unclear or incomplete, and applying strong judgment around \*\*change control\*\*, \*\*solution scalability\*\*, and \*\*Quickbase best practices\*\*. This includes familiarity with \*\*Application Lifecycle Management (ALM)\*\*, platform performance considerations, architectural limitations, efficient table and field design, and strategies to minimize unnecessary complexity and API usage.
  
  
## Required Technical Skills
  
  

* Strong hands-on experience building and supporting \*\*Quickbase native applications\*\*
* Deep understanding of:
* app and table design
* relationships and reference fields
* forms, reports, and dashboards
* permissions, roles, and governance
* formula fields, summary fields, and automations/pipelines
* Ability to design solutions that are maintainable, scalable, and business-friendly
* Understanding of platform design and performance considerations, including:
* efficient report design
* impact of embedded reports on usability and performance
* efficient use of scalar fields vs. formula fields
* thoughtful table and field design that promotes reuse across solution sets
* minimizing unnecessary API calls and other avoidable performance overhead
* Understanding of \*\*ALM\*\*, release discipline, and change management practices within Quickbase
* Understanding of how role design and permissions impact the end-user experience
* Preferred: familiarity with \*\*SCIM\*\* and identity/access provisioning concepts

* Experience integrating with the \*\*Quickbase RESTful API\*\*
* Ability to:
* query, insert, update, and delete records
* work with tables, fields, relationships, and reports via API
* build secure custom integrations and custom front-end functionality using API calls
* Solid understanding of authentication, token-based access, and secure development practices
* Nice to have: familiarity with legacy Quickbase API patterns for supporting older implementations, including the XML API

Job description:
  
  
Job Description

Role Purpose

The purpose of this role is to resolve priority incident tickets and service requests while contributing to incident analysis, change request preparation, and continuous service improvement.

͏

Areas of responsibility

Triaging and resolution of tickets-"Perform initial triage for high priority incident tickets (P2 tickets) which may have an impact across one or more processes and resolve priority incident (P3) tickets within defined SLAs.

Create log of incidents and Document observations and related root causes, to support in evaluation of mitigation measures. "

Resolution of service Requests-Fulfil software/hardware/network service requests within agreed timeline, ensuring timely completion and adherence to SLAs while maintaining quality and accuracy in request handling.

SLA Monitoring-Monitor SLA timelines for entire lifecycle of high priority incident tickets (P2 tickets). Escalate as needed and participate in weekly or monthly service review meetings with clients and internal teams.

Change request execution-"Create change requests as per the priority of the incident tickets in adherence with the defined guidelines.

Present changes for approval with rollback plans in change approval meetings. Execute approved changes and document post-implementation outcomes."

Incident Analysis-"Analyse nature of incidents to support root cause analysis and related service improvement plans.

Contribute towards development of mitigation action to reduce repeat incidents, by identifying patterns of issues noted."

͏ ͏ ͏

.

title: Senior Cloud Architect
description:
**About Us:**
Barry-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper-converting industries. By blending people-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose-driven growth, Barry-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Position Description:**
The Senior Cloud Architect is the technical authority for enterprise cloud, data, AI and industrial IoT (IIoT) infrastructure strategy across global manufacturing and industrial operations. The role owns the architecture vision for an Azure-primary multi-cloud estate spanning Azure, AWS and Google Cloud, while accelerating the reduction of on-premises datacentres and enabling secure, optimized, scalable platforms for enterprise applications, OT/IT integration, digital transformation and artificial intelligence.
  
  
The Senior Cloud Architect defines how generative AI, machine learning, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation and GPU-accelerated workloads are hosted, connected, governed, observed and operated. The role leads a small team of cloud and infrastructure engineers, translates strategy into executable standards and works across Infrastructure, Security, Data, Applications and OT to ensure AI adoption is secure, resilient, cost-effective and aligned to business value.
  
  
The Senior Cloud Architect enables platform-team autonomy, agility and delivery speed through self-service subscription and workspace provisioning, approved infrastructure-as-code templates and policy-as-code guardrails that minimize manual approvals and processes. This position is ideally suited to an energetic and intellectually curious individual who will be part of a collaborative, purposeful, and passionate team in the manufacturing industry operating with agility and leveraging modern architecture, tools & processes.
  
  
**Principal Duties and Responsibilities:**
**Architecture & Strategy:**

* Own the enterprise cloud, data, and AI infrastructure architecture roadmap, standards and governance framework, balancing innovation, security, cost-optimization, maintainability, reliability, operational stability and self-serviceability.
* Design cloud landing zones, network patterns and hybrid connectivity using services such as ExpressRoute, Direct Connect and SD-WAN across corporate and manufacturing sites.
* Lead workload placement, migration assessment and application rationalization to support datacentre consolidation and exit programmes.
* Evaluate cloud-native, data and AI platform services and make build-versus-buy recommendations based on business value, performance, supportability, risk and total cost of ownership.
* Enable platform-team autonomy, agility and delivery speed through self-service subscription and workspace provisioning, approved infrastructure-as-code templates and policy-as-code guardrails that minimize manual approvals. This includes Data, AI and IIoT platforms.
* Partner with OT/IT convergence and digital innovation teams to ensure cloud infrastructure standards and architecture extend approved cloud, data and AI capabilities to plant-floor, industrial data and IIoT use cases.
* Cloud architecture strategy must consider data residency implications due to regulatory, privacy and/or nation state security requirements.

**AI, Data and Industrial IoT (IIoT) Infrastructure Architecture:**

* Define approved enterprise patterns for Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI and other authorised AI and machine-learning platforms, including subscription and project structure, compute, networking, identity, storage, search, secrets and private endpoints. Includes network integrations for AI platform services, endpoints, gateways, and MCP servers/connectors, using private networks and managed identities.
* Working collaboratively with the AI Engineering and Architecture team, architect secure platforms for generative AI, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation, model training, fine-tuning and inference, selecting managed services, platform-as-a-service, Kubernetes or dedicated infrastructure according to workload needs.
* Working collaboratively with Data Engineering and Architecture team, architect secure, scalable, maintainable, reliable and cost-effective cloud infrastructure for enterprise data platforms, primarily on Microsoft Azure. Help ensure storage infrastructure meets requirements for encryption, network isolation, data residency and access control.
* Define cloud architecture patterns for Azure Databricks and Fabric, including networking, identity, security, compute, storage, governance, environment separation (dev/test/prod), availability, and integration with Azure services.
* Help provide the network and connectivity foundations (private endpoints, hybrid connectivity, DNS, firewall rules) needed to reach Dynamics 365, SAP, on-premises and other source systems securely.Working collaboratively with Digital Innovation (DI) software engineering team, help ensure existing industrial IoT platform infrastructure remains secure, scalable, maintainable, reliable, optimized, cost-effective, agile and supports ability to securely integrate equipment telemetry data with business systems data. Help ensure secure customer data isolation and site-to-cloud connectivity patterns in partnership with DI, security, network and operational technology (OT) teams.
* Design GPU and accelerated-compute architectures, including capacity planning, workload scheduling, high-throughput storage, low-latency networking, availability and cost controls.
* Establish reference patterns for Azure Kubernetes Service and containerised AI workloads, including node-pool separation, autoscaling, image governance, workload identity, monitoring and lifecycle management.
* Define enterprise RAG patterns covering ingestion, grounding data, vector and search services, access control, data lineage, content freshness and segregation between business domains.
* Design secure integration patterns for AI agents and copilots connecting to APIs, enterprise applications, Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365, SAP, data platforms and approved OT systems.
* Establish Data & AI platform resilience, capacity, performance, backup, recovery and service-continuity requirements, including defined service objectives for production data & AI capabilities.

Provide architecture governance for AI proofs of concept and production deployments, ensuring experiments have a controlled path to operational support.
  
  
**Security, Responsible AI & Governance:**

* Define and enforce cloud, data and AI security posture standards, identity and access-management frameworks, Zero Trust principles and policy-as-code controls aligned with NIST and ISO 27001.
* Establish AI-specific guardrails for private connectivity, managed identities, role-based access control, secrets, encryption, data residency, environment separation, logging and approved model or service use.
* Partner with Security, Legal, Privacy, Data and Risk stakeholders to translate responsible-AI policy into enforceable infrastructure and platform controls.
* Design controls to reduce risks including unauthorised data exposure, prompt injection, insecure tool or agent connections, excessive permissions, unapproved model use and insufficient auditability.
* Conduct architecture reviews and gate new cloud, data and AI solutions against approved patterns, security baselines and operational readiness criteria.
* Establish disaster-recovery and business-continuity standards for cloud, data and AI workloads, including geo-redundancy for lakehouse storage, data catalog/metadate recovery, telemetry ingestion continuity, RTO/RPO targets and tested recovery procedures.

**FinOps, Capacity & Sustainability:**

* Implement FinOps disciplines across cloud, data and AI services, including tagging, allocation, storage tiering, streaming/telemetry volumes, budgeting, rightsizing, reserved capacity and optimisation reviews.
* Establish AI cost management for GPU utilisation, model endpoints, token and inference consumption, storage, search and network traffic.
* Create demand and capacity models for data & AI workloads; identify when shared managed services, dedicated endpoints or reserved GPU capacity provide the best value.
* Include energy efficiency and sustainability considerations in workload placement, architecture and lifecycle decisions.

**Engineering Excellence & Operations:**

* Champion infrastructure as code using Terraform, Bicep and approved automation frameworks, supported by CI/CD and DevSecOps practices.
* Define standards for AI platform operations, MLOps/LLMOps integration, release management, configuration, patching and model-endpoint lifecycle management.
* Define observability and service-health standards covering availability, latency, throughput, quality signals, GPU utilisation, capacity, safety controls and cost.
* Help ensure best-practice observability and monitoring tools are being leveraged that allow proactive and preemptive diagnosis and remediation.
* Develop test and validation plans for cloud and AI infrastructure changes and ensure findings drive measurable improvements.
* Create and maintain architecture diagrams, decision records, approved patterns, service catalogues, operational runbooks and recovery procedures.
* Serve as a technical escalation point for complex cloud, AI-platform and hybrid-infrastructure issues.

**People Leadership:**

* Manage, coach and develop a small team of cloud and infrastructure engineers, setting clear goals and technical direction.
* Build capability in cloud engineering, data & AI infrastructure, automation, security, reliability and cost management.
* Allocate team capacity across project, operational and continuous-improvement work while protecting engineering focus and sustainable delivery.
* Promote a culture of ownership, disciplined experimentation, documentation, learning and continuous improvement.

**Stakeholder & Supplier Engagement:**

* Collaborate with IT leadership, business-unit leaders, plant teams, Data, Security, AI, Digital Innovation, Applications and OT to align cloud and AI investments with operational priorities.
* Translate complex infrastructure, AI risk and technology decisions into clear recommendations for executive and non-technical audiences.
* Manage strategic technical relationships with Microsoft, AWS, Databricks, Google and other key technology partners.
* Guide product and application teams through architecture choices, non-functional requirements and production-readiness expectations.

**Job Specifications:**

* Deep knowledge of enterprise cloud architecture, including compute, containers, web and application tiers, load balancing, caching, storage, databases, integration and content-delivery patterns.
* Hands-on expertise across major cloud platform, with deep Microsoft Azure experience strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of Databricks, Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI Search and enterprise AI deployment patterns, or demonstrably equivalent platforms.
* Understanding of generative AI, large language models, AI agents, RAG, embeddings, vector search, model endpoints and the infrastructure implications of training, fine-tuning and inference.
* Knowledge of GPU and accelerated computing, high-performance storage and networking, capacity planning, scheduling and AI workload economics.
* Experience with Kubernetes and Azure Kubernetes Service, container registries, workload identity, autoscaling and secure container-platform operations.
* Expertise with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, Bicep or CloudFormation and with CI/CD pipelines.
* Strong command of cloud networking, private connectivity, DNS, identity using Entra ID or cloud IAM, secrets management, encryption and policy controls.
* Deep understanding of cloud, data and AI security, Zero Trust, cloud-security posture management and responsible-AI control implementation.
* Familiarity with MLOps/LLMOps, model and endpoint lifecycle, monitoring, evaluation integration and production-support models. Familiarity with high volume IoT streaming telemetry data infrastructure.
* Experience with hybrid and multi-cloud connectivity and datacentre consolidation or exit programmes.
* Familiarity with hosting and integration infrastructure for enterprise business applications including SAP ERP, Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations architecture, integration patterns and lifecycle services(LCS and PPAC, to govern infrastructure supporting ERP workloads).
* Strong critical thinking, commercial judgement and the ability to assess emerging technology for business value, risk and operability.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to work effectively from engineering teams through executive leadership.

**Required Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 15+ years in IT infrastructure, platform engineering or systems engineering, including 10+ years in a cloud architecture role.
* Demonstrated experience leading cloud strategy and governance in a complex, multi-site enterprise environment.
* Practical experience architecting secure production cloud platforms for enterprise applications, data, AI and/or IIoT; experience enabling enterprise data, AI or machine-learning workloads is strongly preferred.
* Prior experience managing, leading or mentoring a technical team.
* Active professional-level cloud certification strongly preferred, such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional or equivalent. AI, security, Kubernetes or FinOps credentials are advantageous.

**Supervisory Responsibility:**
This role has direct supervisory responsibility for a small team of cloud and infrastructure engineers. Responsibilities include hiring, goal-setting, coaching, development, day-to-day leadership and performance management. The role reports to the Senior Director, Global Infrastructure Services.
  
  
**Work Environment:**
This role may be performed in a hybrid capacity. Periodic visits to manufacturing facilities and corporate sites are expected to engage operational teams and assess on-premises and edge infrastructure. Appropriate personal protective equipment is required when working in active manufacturing areas.
  
  
**Position Type and Working Hours**
: Regular, full-time. Extended hours may occasionally be required to meet project milestones, support global teams or respond to operational incidents.
  
  
**Physical Demands :**
The physical demands described here are representative of those performed in the job duties. The employee sits at a desk and uses a computer for prolonged periods. The role frequently requires close vision, speech, hearing and dexterity to operate office equipment. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 15 pounds.
  
  
**Disclaimer:**
The above information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed within this classification. It is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties or skills required. This job description may be amended to meet changing business needs.
  
  
*At Barry-Wehmiller we recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of a job. If your experience is close to what you see listed here, please still consider applying. We know that our differences often can bring about innovation, excellence and meaningful work—therefore, people from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply to our positions. Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodations during the interview process.*

BW Corporate GCC

title: Technical Team Lead
description:
About Audit Sense

Audit Sense is an AI-powered SaaS company developing technology solutions for the Finance and Audit industry. We are looking for a hands-on Technical Team Lead to lead technical architecture, full-stack development and deployment delivery across our Subscription Management system, AuditSense application and AskAthena AI analysis product.

About the Role

The selected candidate will lead the technical team, contribute to production development, review architecture and code, and translate business requirements into scalable and maintainable software solutions.

The role involves managing existing cloud deployments and developing deployment capabilities for customer-managed on-premises and private-cloud environments. It also includes designing subscription and licensing controls across different deployment models.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Full-Stack Development & Architecture**

* Lead the development of React frontends and TypeScript APIs using Hono and Express.
* Define application architecture, module boundaries and service integration patterns.
* Design and manage PostgreSQL databases, Prisma schemas, migrations and database performance.
* Implement database connection pooling using PgBouncer or equivalent solutions.
* Manage multi-tenant database architecture and troubleshoot database connection issues.

**2. Identity & Application Security**

* Design enterprise Single Sign-On (SSO) using OpenID Connect, OAuth 2.0 and SAML.
* Manage JWT, session authentication, MFA, RBAC/ABAC and tenant isolation.
* Apply OWASP Top 10 security practices.
* Implement secure API authentication and HMAC-signed webhooks.

**3. Deployment Architecture & DevOps**

* Manage cloud, customer on-premises and private-cloud deployment architectures.
* Provision and maintain Azure infrastructure, including VMs, networking, storage, Key Vault and monitoring.
* Develop secure customer installation packages using Docker, Docker Compose and Kubernetes/Helm where appropriate.
* Build CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Azure Pipelines.
* Implement infrastructure as code using Terraform, Bicep or Pulumi.
* Manage deployment strategies, application upgrades, rollback procedures, monitoring and production reliability.

**4. Subscription & Licensing Management**

* Architect subscription and licence management across cloud, on-premises and private-cloud deployments.
* Design installation registration, activation, renewal, expiry and suspension mechanisms.
* Implement module entitlements, user limits and usage tracking.
* Develop secure communication and synchronization between customer installations and central subscription services.
* Support licensing requirements for restricted-connectivity and offline environments.

**5. Technical Leadership & Code Review**

* Lead technical planning, task allocation, estimation and delivery coordination.
* Review application architecture and production code.
* Establish development standards, testing practices and API documentation.
* Mentor technical team members and provide guidance during implementation and production support.

Required Technical Expertise

* Strong hands-on expertise in TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Node.js, Hono and Express.
* Strong PostgreSQL and Prisma ORM expertise, including database modelling, migrations, transactions, indexing and performance tuning.
* Practical experience with PgBouncer or equivalent database connection pooling solutions.
* DevOps experience with Docker, Docker Compose, Linux, nginx, GitHub Actions and Azure Pipelines.
* Hands-on Azure infrastructure experience, including virtual machines, networking, storage, identity, secrets and monitoring.
* Experience with customer-managed on-premises or private-cloud software deployments.
* Knowledge of SaaS subscription licensing and entitlement management.
* Experience with enterprise SSO, JWT, MFA, RBAC/ABAC and application security.
* Proven technical leadership, architecture decision-making and code review experience.
* Experience in automated testing, monitoring and production troubleshooting.

Preferred Experience

* Kubernetes, Helm and air-gapped customer installations.
* Infrastructure as code using Terraform, Azure Bicep or Pulumi.
* AI application integration, LLM providers, document processing and vector search.
* Redis, DBOS, ChromaDB, Microsoft Graph and enterprise audit workflows.
* Offline licensing and synchronization between central services and customer installations.

Expected Outcomes

Establish a clear technical architecture and delivery roadmap across our products, develop reliable cloud and customer-managed deployment models, implement a consistent subscription-control framework and lead the team towards maintainable software delivery and reliable releases.

* **Company:**
  Audit Sense Pvt. Ltd.

title: Network & Cyber Security Architect
description:

**Your Role**

As a Network & Cyber Security Architect, you will be responsible for defining and leading the architecture, security, and transformation of enterprise, telecom, cloud, and hybrid network environments. You will work closely with clients, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to design secure, scalable, and resilient network infrastructures while driving cybersecurity initiatives that protect critical business assets and enable digital transformation.

* Design secure enterprise, telecom, cloud, and hybrid network architectures supporting business growth and operational resilience.
* Lead network modernization, security transformation, and Zero Trust adoption initiatives.
* Develop security frameworks, architecture standards, governance models, and technology roadmaps.

title: Manager Software Development
description:
Here at Appian, our values of
**Intensity**
and
**Excellence**
define who we are. We set high standards and live up to them, ensuring that everything we do is done with care and quality. We approach every challenge with ambition and commitment, holding ourselves and each other accountable to achieve the best results. When you join Appian, you’ll be part of a passionate team dedicated to accomplishing hard things, together.

*Job Description:*

ABOUT THE TEAM

Our Engineering team is revolutionizing how Appian resolves customer issues by building AI-powered diagnostic tools and internal platforms that dramatically reduce resolution time. We combine deep technical expertise with AI innovation to empower support engineers to identify root causes faster, ensuring our customers experience uninterrupted business-critical operations. This team operates with high autonomy and directly impacts customer satisfaction and retention across Appian's enterprise client base.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Appian is at an inflection point where intelligent automation meets customer success, and we need a technical leader who can architect and ship the next generation of diagnostic platforms. This role exists because our growing enterprise customer base demands faster, smarter issue resolution, and AI agents are the key to unlocking that scale. You will shape both the technical direction and the team culture while delivering tools that become essential to how Appian supports thousands of mission-critical deployments worldwide.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

* Lead the design and delivery of a scalable AI-powered triage platform that reduces mean time to resolution by leveraging AI agents, LangChain frameworks, and intelligent diagnostics
* Lead the engineering team building AI-powered diagnostic tools that cut customer issue resolution time in half while scaling a platform that empowers support engineers across the globe.
* Architect quarterly releases of diagnostic tools on AWS infrastructure, balancing innovation velocity with production stability and security requirements
* Build and grow a high-performing engineering team through effective people management, technical mentorship, and career development focused on AI and cloud-native technologies
* Partner with Customer Success and Product leadership to translate support pain points into engineering roadmaps that drive measurable improvements in customer satisfaction
* Drive technical excellence through hands-on code reviews in Python and AI frameworks while establishing engineering best practices for the team
* Execute stakeholder management across engineering, product, and customer-facing teams to align priorities and communicate progress on platform capabilities

Continuous learning is a central focus at Appian, with dedicated mentorship and the First-Friend program being widely utilized resources for new hires.

This commitment ensures that employees have access to a holistic range of development opportunities.

title: Application Security Architect
description:
We are looking for an experienced Application Security Architect with 9–12 years of experience to drive application security architecture, engineering security standards and secure software development practices across Novac's fintech product ecosystem.

The candidate will be responsible for designing and implementing security architecture for enterprise-grade financial software products, ensuring security is embedded throughout the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). The role requires strong expertise in application security, secure coding, API security, cloud security, DevSecOps, threat modelling, vulnerability management, and security architecture reviews.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience securing fintech applications, digital lending platforms, loan management systems, insurance technology platforms, financial APIs, payment integrations, and enterprise software products. The candidate will work closely with Product Engineering, Software Architecture, Cloud, DevOps, and Information Security teams to ensure that Novac's products are scalable, resilient, and secure.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities:**

**Application Security Architecture**

* Establish secure architecture standards for digital banking, lending, insurance, and payment platforms.
* Define enterprise security reference architectures and reusable security patterns.
* Define security controls for AI-enabled applications and APIs.
* Assess risks relating to LLM integration, prompt injection, sensitive data exposure, and model governance.
* Review application architecture, technical designs, and business requirements to identify security risks and recommend appropriate controls.
* Drive security-by-design principles across product development and software engineering.
* Review architecture designs and provide security requirements before development begins.
* Conduct security architecture reviews for web applications, mobile applications, APIs, microservices, and cloud-based platforms.
* Define secure architecture patterns for authentication, authorization, encryption, data protection, and identity management.
* Review NFRs (Non-Functional Requirements) related to security, privacy, resilience, and compliance.
* Ensure security controls are incorporated into product architecture from the design stage.

**Secure SDLC & DevSecOps**

* Integrate security practices across all stages of the Software Development Life Cycle.
* Implement and strengthen DevSecOps practices by embedding automated security testing into CI/CD pipelines.
* Drive implementation of SAST, DAST, SCA, container security, and Infrastructure-as-Code security scanning.
* Establish secure coding guidelines and conduct application code security reviews.
* Work closely with development teams to identify, prioritise, and remediate security vulnerabilities.
* Automate security validation and vulnerability detection within software development and deployment processes.

**API & Fintech Product Security**

* Design and implement security controls for REST APIs, microservices, third-party integrations, and distributed applications.
* Ensure secure API authentication and authorisation using OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, and API gateways.
* Secure financial applications involving digital lending, loan origination, loan management, insurance workflows, and transaction processing.
* Define security controls for sensitive customer information, financial records, and transactional data.
* Ensure secure integration with banking systems, payment gateways, financial institutions, and external service providers.
* Identify and mitigate risks associated with data exposure, unauthorised access, fraud, and application-level attacks.

**Vulnerability Assessment & Threat Modelling**

* Conduct application security assessments, architecture reviews, and threat modelling exercises.
* Establish vulnerability management processes, risk classification, and remediation SLAs.
* Perform security risk assessments for new product features, application enhancements, and third-party integrations.

**Cloud & Infrastructure Application Security**

* Define and implement application security controls across AWS, Azure, or GCP environments.
* Review IAM architectures and enforce least-privilege access controls.
* Establish Zero-Trust application security principles.
* Ensure security across cloud-native applications, Docker, Kubernetes, and microservices environments.
* Implement encryption, secrets management, key management, and secure communication protocols.
* Work with cloud and DevOps teams to strengthen application deployment and runtime security.
* Ensure secure configurations and access controls across application environments.

**Security Governance & Compliance**

* Define application security policies, standards, technical guidelines, and governance frameworks.
* Ensure alignment with relevant security standards such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, and applicable RBI requirements, based on product and regulatory scope.
* Support internal and external security audits, compliance assessments, and risk reviews.
* Drive security awareness and secure coding practices across engineering teams.
* Work closely with technology leadership and product stakeholders to ensure security requirements are met.
* Define application security KPIs and maturity roadmap.
* Track:
* Vulnerability remediation SLA adherence
* Security debt
* Critical vulnerability trends
* Application security coverage
* Secure coding adoption metrics

title: Principal Engineer
description:
**Why this role exists**

Our engineering team is young. We have about 30 engineers, six new team leads and one senior

architect. The leads are good builders who have not led before. They need someone to learn from

every day.

AI agents now write a large share of our code. Design, review and judgement have become the

scarce skills. This role brings them.

**About Company**

We build customised holidays for Indian travellers. We have done this for over 12 years

from Chennai.

A traveller plans a trip with us, a seller helps them decide, and our team delivers it on the ground.

Technology runs through all of it: the website and app, the sales funnel, pricing and supply,

booking, and everything after booking.

**How tech is organised**

You report to Chief Architect. The six team leads look to you for every technical

call.

**The roles you will play**

1. Guide to the six leads. You review their designs and code, and you pair with them on the hard

problems. Every lead gets your time every week.

2. Keeper of standards. You set how we design APIs, test, release and code with AI agents.

Then you make sure it is followed.

3. Builder. You stay hands-on. Expect a good part of your week in code.

4. Chief Architect's partner on architecture. You work with him on data unification and on the API layer

that our website, partners and agents all use.

5. Owner of one critical system. In your first months you own one system end to end, most

likely payments.

6. Hiring bar. You interview engineers and decide who is good enough.

**What you will not do:**

• Manage people. Appraisals and staffing stay with the founder.

• Set AI direction. That sits with the AI head. You make sure agents call our systems safely.

Your first 90 days

• By day 30: you know the codebase, the six leads and where each team is stuck. You have

shipped one fix or feature yourself.

• By day 60: design reviews run every week with every lead. Our standards for APIs, tests and

releases are written down and in use.

• By day 90: one critical system is fully yours. Each lead can name one thing they do better

because of you.

**What we look for**

• 8 to 12 years of building software, full stack with most of it in backend.

• Our stack: Java and Spring Boot, MongoDB, React.

• Time spent on systems where a mistake costs money: booking, payments, fintech or

commerce.

• You code with AI agents every day, and you can show us how.

• The role is in Chennai.

The three skills that matter most:

1. Backend system design.

2. API and data modelling.

3. Code review and debugging across the stack.

The one quality: you enjoy making other engineers better. A teacher's patience matters more here

than being the best coder in the room.

The opportunity

• Six leads grow because of you. That is how we will measure this role.

• You shape how a team builds with AI agents. We are early, and the habits you set will stay.

• The problems are real. Live pricing and supply, bookings that cannot fail, voice AI in sales,

and post-booking work that runs without people.

**What is coming up:**

• One unified data layer across our systems.

• A Holidays API that banks and partners sell from.

• A new product for travellers outside India.

• A CTO decision. We have not hired one. We will decide once this structure settles, and

whoever does this role well is part of that conversation

title: QA Engineer (Manual to Automation)
description:
**About the Role:**

Techtinium Technologies is a product engineering company that designs, builds and deploys software and AI products for manufacturing, enterprise, healthcare, e-commerce and digital content clients.

We are hiring a QA Engineer who will start by owning manual testing across web and mobile products, then progressively build and own test automation. You will be the person who makes sure what we ship works — first by hand, then at scale through code. This role suits a strong manual tester who wants a clear, supported path into automation engineering.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Manual testing (from day one)**

* Review requirements, user stories and designs; raise gaps and ambiguities before development starts
* Write and maintain test plans, test scenarios and test cases with clear expected results
* Run functional, regression, smoke, exploratory, UI/UX and cross-browser/cross-device testing on web and mobile apps
* Test REST APIs using Postman or similar tools
* Log clear, reproducible defects in Jira (or similar), track them to closure and verify fixes
* Take part in sprint ceremonies and give release sign-off with a clear view of quality risks

**Test automation (growing over time)**

* Identify which manual regression cases give the best return when automated
* Build and maintain UI automation using Playwright, Selenium or Cypress, and API automation using Postman/Newman or REST Assured
* Help design a maintainable framework: page objects, reusable utilities, test data management and reporting
* Integrate automated suites into the CI/CD pipeline (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or Jenkins) so they run on every build
* Monitor flaky tests, keep suites fast and reliable, and report coverage and quality metrics
* Share automation practices with developers and help shift testing earlier in the cycle

**Must-have skills and qualifications:**

* 2–4 years of hands-on manual testing of web and/or mobile applications
* Solid grasp of SDLC, STLC, Agile/Scrum and the defect life cycle
* Strong test design skills: boundary value analysis, equivalence partitioning, decision tables, exploratory testing
* Experience testing REST APIs with Postman or a similar tool
* Working knowledge of SQL to validate data
* Hands-on use of Jira (or similar) for defect and test tracking
* Basic programming in at least one language — JavaScript/TypeScript, Python or Java — and a clear willingness to grow into automation
* Attention to detail, and clear written and spoken communication
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

**Nice to have:**

* Exposure to an automation tool such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress or Appium, even through personal projects
* Familiarity with Git and CI/CD pipelines
* Mobile testing on real devices and emulators (Android and iOS), including Flutter apps
* Basic performance testing (JMeter, k6) or security testing awareness (OWASP Top 10)
* Experience testing AI/ML-driven features or data-heavy applications
* ISTQB Foundation or a similar certification

**What we offer**

* A defined path from manual QA to automation engineer, with time set aside to learn and build
* Mentorship from senior engineers and exposure to modern tools and CI/CD practices
* Varied products across industries, including AI-driven solutions
* Competitive compensation and health insurance cover
* A collaborative team where quality is owned by everyone

title: Quality Assurance Rater - English speakers in India
description:
Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.

This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.

**A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater**

In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.

You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.
* Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.
* Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.
* Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.
* Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.
* Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.
* Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.

**TELUS Digital AI Community**

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands.

Qualification path

Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring.

**Basic Requirements**

* **Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in English.**
* **Resident in India for the last 5 consecutive years.**
* Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.
* Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.
* Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools.
* Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer.
* Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification
* Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently.
* High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification.
* Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems.
* Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering.
* Additional language skills may be beneficial depending on project requirements.

title: QA Lead - Trading Platform (India, Chennai)
description:
**About GoCharting**

GoCharting is a web-native charting and trading platform. Traders use professional orderflow tools — footprint charts, volume and market profile, cumulative delta, DOM trading — to read the market and place orders through their broker, all in the browser. Our users are active traders in India, the US and around the world.

**The Role**

You will own the quality gate that every release of GoCharting's terminal and apps passes before it reaches traders, and you will test and write automation yourself while you lead a small QA team. The role is full-time and in person in our Chennai office, and it reports to the Engineering Manager for Client Engineering. Every release needs one accountable owner of what "ready to ship" means, and that is you. At 12 months, no release should reach production without your sign-off, and the team should trust the checks behind it.

**What you'll do**

* **Own the release gate**
  — define what must pass before a release ships, run the sign-off, and stop a release that fails it
* **Test and automate yourself**
  — write and maintain end-to-end and regression automation for the web terminal and for APIs
* **Lead and coach the QA team**
  — assign work, review test plans and automation, and raise each engineer's standard
* **Run quality checks in CI**
  — keep automated tests as required checks on merges and releases, fast and reliable
* **Triage defects**
  — set severity with product and engineering, and track each one to a verified fix
* **Report quality plainly**
  — publish a weekly view of defects found, escaped and fixed

**What we're looking for**

**Must-haves:**

* 6+ years in QA or test automation on production web applications
* Hands-on automation code with Playwright, Cypress or Selenium, written by you
* Has owned a release gate or release sign-off for a production web application
* Has led or mentored other QA engineers
* Has run automated tests as required checks in a CI pipeline, for example GitHub Actions
* In person in our Chennai office, 5 days a week

**Nice-to-haves:**

* Testing real-time or data-dense applications, such as WebSocket feeds or live charts (adds the ability to test our core risk)
* API and contract testing for REST and WebSocket services (adds coverage below the UI)
* Performance and load testing with k6, JMeter or similar (adds confidence under market-open load)
* Trading, fintech or market-data testing (adds speed in learning our domain)
* Mobile app testing for iOS and Android (adds coverage of the app release)

**Logistics**

**Location**
Chennai, India - in person, office-based

**Employment type**
Full-time

**Entity**
ProCharting Private Limited

**Reports to**
Engineering Manager, Client Engineering

**Start date**
ASAP

**Travel**
None

title: Performance Reporting Analyst
description:
**Job Summary**

The Performance Reporting Analyst is responsible for consolidated performance measurement and reporting across the global portfolio and the Investment Division's other asset clusters, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and timeliness. The role owns the monthly and quarterly reporting cycle: collecting and validating data from custodians, fund administrators, and external managers; computing returns against benchmarks and targets; and producing the performance packs used by the Executive Director, the Investment Committee (IC), and family shareholders.

The position applies AI-enabled workflows to automate recurring extraction, reconciliation, and report production, and serves as the single source of truth for portfolio performance data across the India-based investment team and the Jeddah-based family governance structure.

**ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

1. Produce the monthly and quarterly consolidated performance reports covering the global portfolio and designated clusters, from custody statements, administrator reports, and manager reporting.

2. Maintain the division's performance database: positions, transactions, cash flows, and valuations, reconciled monthly to custodian and administrator records.

3. Calculate time-weighted and money-weighted returns (TWR/IRR) at portfolio, cluster, asset-class, and manager level, with realised and unrealised components separately identified.

4. Maintain the benchmark framework and produce attribution analysis by asset class, manager, and currency, explaining performance versus benchmarks and the IC's targets.

5. Prepare the quarterly IC performance pack and shareholder reporting with the Executive Director, including commentary, exceptions, and data-quality notes.

6. Track management fees, performance fees, and costs against provider agreements, and report fee drag as part of net performance analysis.

7. Build and maintain AI-enabled reporting pipelines for recurring document extraction, data validation, and report assembly, keeping human review over all published figures.

8. Liaise with the finance department to align investment performance records with the SAP accounting entries.

9. Maintain organised digital archives of all performance records, methodologies, and published reports, ensuring auditability of every reported figure.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Minimum Education Required**

• Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, or business administration.

• Strong understanding of performance measurement: TWR and IRR methodologies, benchmarking, attribution, and composite reporting (GIPS awareness preferred).

• Experience with custodian and fund administrator reporting and multi-asset data (public markets, funds, private assets).

• Proficient in Excel and financial systems; experience with Addepar or similar portfolio platforms preferred; working knowledge of Power BI or Python an advantage.

• Demonstrated ability to use AI tools for document processing and reporting automation, with disciplined verification.

• Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills and ability to manage recurring deadlines.

**Professional Certifications Required**

• N\A. (CIPM or CFA progress preferred)

**Years of experience are required.**

• Minimum of 5 to 8 years of experience in performance measurement, investment reporting, or fund operations at a bank, asset manager, fund administrator, or family office.

title: Agentic AI Orchestrator
description:
**Job Summary**

The Agentic AI Orchestrator designs, builds, and operates the Investment Division's agentic AI workflows—the automated, multi-step processes through which AI agents read documents, reconcile data, draft analysis, and assemble reporting across the division's clusters. The role converts analyst workflows into orchestrated agent pipelines with human review gates, owns the division's prompt, skill, and agent library, and is accountable for the accuracy, auditability, and cost of every automated output.

The position anchors the division's AI-led operating model from the Chennai office, working alongside the Data Engineer (data pipelines and infrastructure) and the ML Engineer (models and evaluation), and serves as the bridge between the investment analysts and the division's AI tooling

**ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

1. Design, build, and operate agentic AI workflows for the division's recurring processes: document extraction and reconciliation, portfolio and company performance monitoring, report and IC pack assembly, and data-room processing.

2. Translate analyst and reporting workflows into orchestrated multi-agent pipelines with defined human review gates, so that no figure or recommendation is published without analyst sign-off.

3. Own the division's prompt, skill, agent, and plugin library: design, versioning, testing, and documentation, ensuring workflows are reusable across clusters rather than one-off chats.

4. Integrate agents with the division's systems and data sources — document repositories, custodian and administrator reporting, and the division's knowledge base — working with the Data Engineer on pipelines and access.

5. Build and run evaluation harnesses with the ML Engineer: accuracy benchmarks against verified ground truth, regression testing on workflow changes, and periodic audits of automated outputs.

6. Implement AI governance and guardrails: access controls and confidentiality boundaries for family and portfolio data, audit trails for every automated output, and compliance with the Group's AI usage policies.

7. Monitor agent performance, cost, latency, and failure modes; triage incidents, maintain runbooks, and drive continuous improvement of workflow reliability.

8. Train and support the division's analysts in AI-assisted working practices; capture their feedback and convert it into a prioritised automation backlog.

9. Maintain complete documentation of all orchestrated workflows, their data sources, model versions, and review controls, ensuring every automated output is reproducible and auditable.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Minimum Education Required**

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related quantitative field.

• Strong Python engineering skills: API integration, data handling, and production-quality code with testing and version control (Git).

• Hands-on experience building LLM-based and agentic systems in production: workflow orchestration, tool and function calling, and multi-agent patterns — using frameworks such as LangGraph or LangChain, or SDK-native orchestration (e.g. Claude Agent SDK). Framework experience matters less than sound orchestration design.

• Practical RAG experience: document chunking, embeddings, vector databases (e.g. pgvector, Pinecone, Qdrant, or similar), hybrid search, and retrieval evaluation.

• Experience building or integrating MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and tools, or equivalent connector architectures linking AI agents to enterprise systems and data sources.

• Familiarity with LLM evaluation and observability tooling (accuracy benchmarks, regression tests, tracing); disciplined prompt and skill engineering with versioning and documentation.

• Understanding of data privacy, access control, and audit requirements for confidential financial data; exposure to investment or financial reporting workflows preferred.

**Years of experience are required.**

• Minimum of 4 to 7 years of experience in software or AI engineering, of which at least 2 years hands-on with LLM-based or agentic systems in production, at a technology firm, financial institution, or data-driven enterprise.

Amazon.com, Inc. is a US-based multinational electronic commerce company headquartered in Seattle, Washington. Jeff Bezos founded Amazon.com, Inc. in 1994 and launched it online in 1995. Amazon.com started as an online bookstore, but soon diversified, selling DVDs, CDs, MP3 downloads, computer software, video games, electronics, apparel, furniture, food, and toys. Amazon has established separate websites in Canada, the United Kingdom, Germany, France, Italy, Japan, and China. At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. Amazon has great opportunities to pursue a career as a leader in Operations Management. We know that learning through experience is what transforms talented people into great leaders. Our roles are designed to accelerate the growth of leaders through challenging field experiences that stretch individual capability. Our Operations environment presents the candidates with great challenges in dealing with front line management, and driving scalable and continuous improvements across our Fulfillment Centers, Supply Chain & Transportation execution teams.

This role is for those candidates who thrive on driving change, building an organization and leading through others, by giving them a direct management assignment in our Operations Services and Technology Centers. Ideal candidates for this program are expected to leverage their strong analytical skills, communication, and think big.
