Data-Driven Problem Solving
  
  
Use data insights and analytics to identify root causes, reduce losses, improve productivity, and optimize operational costs through structured problem-solving.
  
  
A day in the life

title: Mobile Engineer - Trading Platform (India, Chennai)
description:
**About GoCharting**

GoCharting is a web-native charting and trading platform. Traders use professional orderflow tools — footprint charts, volume and market profile, cumulative delta, DOM trading — to read the market and place orders through their broker, all in the browser. Our users are active traders in India, the US and around the world.

**The Role**

You will build and release features in GoCharting's iOS and Android app, working in Flutter and writing the code yourself. The role is full-time and in person in our Chennai office, and it reports to the Engineering Manager for Client Engineering. You will work alongside the existing mobile engineer and share the build, test and release work. At 12 months, you should own a part of the app, including charts, watchlists, alerts or broker connections, and ship releases to both stores without help.

**What you'll do**

* **Build app features in Flutter**
  — charts, watchlists, alerts and broker connections, from spec to store release
* **Release to both stores**
  — prepare builds, pass App Store and Google Play review, and fix what review or users find
* **Keep the app stable**
  — use crash reports and user feedback to find and fix the causes of crashes and slow screens
* **Match the web terminal**
  — bring behavior and data from the web product to mobile, and raise gaps between the two
* **Work with product and design**
  — turn a written spec and a design into working screens, and raise gaps in the spec early
* **Write clear pull requests and test notes**
  — say what changed, how to test it, and what could break

**What we're looking for**

**Must-haves:**

* 5+ years building mobile apps, with the code written by you
* Has released at least one app to both the App Store and Google Play
* Strong Flutter and Dart in a production app
* Has built or maintained a mobile screen that updates with live data, for example from WebSockets or push
* In person in our Chennai office, 5 days a week

**Nice-to-haves:**

* Native iOS (Swift) or Android (Kotlin) code, for example for platform plugins (adds the ability to go below Flutter when needed)
* Deep links with Universal Links and App Links, and push notifications (adds the ability to own app-to-web flows)
* Mobile crash reporting and performance profiling (adds faster diagnosis)
* Charting, trading, market-data or broker-integration work (adds speed in learning our domain)

title: Apprentice Research Analyst- Campus
description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.
  
  
At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate, serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations.
  
  
**Your Team’s Impact**
FactSet Fundamentals Team collects financial statements of Public and Private (US only) companies across the continent. The team sources the company filings from
  
  
various sources like stock exchanges, company websites, and regulatory body & thirdparty vendors. We extract & analyze the data from financial statement like Balance
  
  
Sheet, Income Statement & Cash flow statement of the company. The team also collects the textual data like Business Activities, Officers, Shareholder, industry classification,
  
  
etc. You will report to the Team Lead and assist in meeting the team’s business goals by meeting your individual targets. You are expected to work onsite three times a week.
  
  
**What You ’II Do**

* Collect, analyze, and process financial market data from various data sources and into the database utilized by the team.
* Focus and ensure that the integrity of the company's financial market information is intact.
* Provide timely, accurate and reliable demographic and statistical financial market data on internal database and to internal/external clientele.
* Fix the audit resolutions and recommendations coming from QC\Policy team based on specific guidelines.
* Fulfil the research/analytical/ market study needs as and when required/ requested by the external clients in order to procure and retain future/current business.
* The job also involves reporting and maintaining records of work done on a timely basis.
* Share Ideas and Best Practices from a Process Improvement perspective.

**Required Skills**
**What We’re Looking For**

* Graduate in Commerce / Finance / Accounting with tenure of 3 years [ UG] / MBA tenure of 2 years [ PG] / PGDM
* Computer Literacy to effectively use the database and software for collection and processing of content/data
* Good communications skills - written & verbal

**Desired Skills**

* Numerical skills to ensure understanding of the financial data to be collected and/or processed
* Analytical skills and detail orientation to ensure accuracy of data
* Good Knowledge of financial markets and accountancy (as needed) To ensure effective understanding of assigned content/market

**What's In It For You**
At FactSet, our people are our greatest asset, and our culture is our biggest competitive advantage. Being a FactSetter means:
  
  

* The opportunity to join an S&P 500 company with over 45 years of sustainable growth powered by the entrepreneurial spirit of a start-up.
* Support for your total well-being. This includes health, life, and disability insurance, as well as retirement savings plans and a discounted employee stock purchase program, plus paid time off for holidays, family leave, and company-wide wellness days.
* Flexible work accommodations. We value work/life harmony and offer our employees a range of accommodations to help them achieve success both at work and in their personal lives.
* A global community dedicated to volunteerism and sustainability, where collaboration is always encouraged, and individuality drives solutions.
* Career progression planning with dedicated time each month for learning and development.
* Business Resource Groups open to all employees that serve as a catalyst for connection, growth, and belonging.

**Company Overview**
FactSet (NYSE:FDS | NASDAQ:FDS) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8,200 global clients, including over 200,000 individual users. Clients across the buy-side and sell-side, as well as wealth managers, private equity firms, and corporations, achieve more every day with our comprehensive and connected content, flexible next-generation workflow solutions, and client-centric specialized support. As a member of the S&P 500, we are committed to sustainable growth and have been recognized among the Best Places to Work in 2023 by Glassdoor as a Glassdoor Employees’ Choice Award winner. Learn more at www.factset.com and follow us on X and LinkedIn.
  
  
At FactSet, we celebrate difference of thought, experience, and perspective. Qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

title: Field Associate - Hyderabad
description:
At Medflix, our mission is to help doctors stay updated and provide better care every day. We’re looking for
**Field Associates in Hyderabad**
who enjoy being on the ground, building relationships with doctors, and creating meaningful connections with the medical community.

**Role Overview**

If you enjoy meeting people, engaging with doctors, and building relationships through on-field interactions, this role is for you.

As a Field Associate, you’ll be the face of Medflix in your city - connecting with doctors, introducing them to our learning platform and programs, engaging with our existing users, and helping us understand what doctors need and love about Medflix.

**What You’ll Do**

* Doctor Engagement: Visit hospitals, clinics, and medical colleges to engage with physicians and introduce them to Medflix and its learning programs
* Faculty Outreach: Identify and connect with senior doctors who could contribute as faculty on Medflix
* User Engagement: Meet existing Medflix users, understand their experience, gather feedback, and help strengthen their engagement with the platform
* On-ground Outreach: Build relationships with doctors across institutions and grow Medflix’s presence in your city
* Field Insights: Bring back insights, feedback, and opportunities from the field to help our product and programs improve
* Relationship Building: Develop long-term relationships with doctors and medical institutions through consistent, meaningful interactions

**Who You Are**

* Experience engaging with doctors - as a Medical Representative (MR) or in any other role involving doctor interactions
* Enjoy meeting people, building relationships, and working on the field
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Self-driven, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership of your city
* Willing to travel locally and spend time visiting hospitals, clinics, and medical colleges.

**Why Join Us?**

At Medflix, we’re building a platform that reaches 300,000+ doctors across India through Medflix, RobinMD, and programs like PRISM and AICP.

This is an opportunity to work closely with the medical community, build a strong network of doctors, and play a direct role in growing one of India’s leading doctor-learning platforms.

If you love the challenge of on-field sales, enjoy engaging with doctors, and want to be part of a team making medical learning more accessible, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Associate/Sr. Associate - Admissions
description:
**Associate/Senior Associate – Admissions (Advanced Management Programmes)**

Department: Admissions & Financial Aid - Advanced Management Programmes (AMPs)

**Role Overview**

The Senior Associate – Admissions will be responsible for managing and supporting the admissions process for ISB’s Advanced Management Programmes (AMPs). The role involves engaging with prospective candidates, particularly working professionals and senior executives, providing programme guidance, driving quality enrolments, and ensuring a seamless candidate experience from initial enquiry to admission.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities:**

**1. Admissions & Enrolment Management**

* Manage the end-to-end admissions process for assigned Advanced Management Programmes.
* Engage with prospective candidates through calls, emails, webinars, and other communication channels.
* Understand candidate profiles, career aspirations, and programme requirements to provide relevant guidance.
* Counsel prospective applicants on programme structure, eligibility, curriculum, and admission process.
* Follow up with prospective candidates to support timely application submission and enrolment.
* Work towards achieving programme-wise application and enrolment targets.

**2. Calling & Candidate Engagement**

* Conduct high-quality outbound and inbound calls with working professionals, senior executives, and prospective students.
* Effectively communicate the value proposition, learning outcomes, and career relevance of ISB’s programmes.
* Build meaningful relationships with prospective candidates through professional and mature communication.
* Handle candidate queries with confidence, empathy, and clarity.
* Maintain regular follow-ups with prospective candidates and ensure timely movement through the admissions funnel.
* Identify serious and high-potential prospects and nurture them towards application and enrolment.

**3. Lead Management & Conversion**

* Manage and nurture leads received through digital marketing, webinars, referrals, events, and other sources.
* Ensure timely follow-up and accurate updating of lead status in Salesforce or the designated CRM.
* Track lead progression from enquiry to application, interview, offer, and enrolment.
* Identify reasons for lead drop-offs and recommend improvements to enhance conversion.
* Focus on generating quality applications and enrolments aligned with programme eligibility and profile requirements.
* Coordinate with the Digital Marketing and Sales teams to improve lead quality and conversion outcomes.

**4. Candidate Counselling & Application Support**

* Guide candidates through the application process, including eligibility, SOP, video essay, supporting documents, and deadlines.
* Clarify programme-related queries and provide accurate information to applicants.
* Support candidates in understanding the application requirements and submission timelines.
* Coordinate with the relevant internal teams for application-related concerns.
* Ensure a positive and professional candidate experience throughout the admissions journey.

**5. Stakeholder Coordination**

* Coordinate with Programme Leads, Faculty, Marketing, Digital Marketing, Finance, and other internal stakeholders.
* Support the execution of information sessions, webinars, application guidance workshops, and alumni engagement activities.
* Assist in coordinating candidate interviews, shortlisting, and other admissions-related activities.
* Maintain effective communication with applicants, alumni, corporate representatives, and other relevant stakeholders.

**6. Reporting & Data Management**

* Maintain accurate and updated admissions records in Salesforce or the designated CRM.
* Prepare regular reports on leads, applications, offers, enrolments, conversion rates, and pending follow-ups.
* Analyse admissions funnel performance and identify areas for improvement.
* Track programme-wise targets and provide timely updates to the reporting manager.
* Ensure data accuracy, confidentiality, and compliance with institutional processes.

**7. Programme Promotion & Outreach**

* Support admissions campaigns and outreach initiatives for assigned AMPs.
* Participate in webinars, candidate engagement activities, alumni interactions, and programme promotion events.
* Leverage alumni referrals, professional networks, and other outreach opportunities to generate prospective leads.
* Communicate programme differentiators, faculty expertise, peer learning, and institutional value effectively.
* Contribute ideas to improve programme visibility, candidate engagement, and enrolment outcomes.

**8. Process Improvement & Team Contribution**

* Identify opportunities to improve admissions processes, candidate communication, and conversion strategies.
* Share insights from candidate interactions to strengthen programme positioning and marketing communication.
* Support team members in resolving candidate queries and operational challenges.
* Contribute to a collaborative, professional, and target-oriented team environment.
* Take ownership of assigned programmes and deliver responsibilities within agreed timelines.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

**Area - Performance Measures**

Enrolments- Achievement of programme-wise enrolment targets

Applications - Quality applications generated and submitted

Lead Conversion - Lead-to-application and application-to-enrolment conversion

Calling - Quality and effectiveness of candidate interactions

Candidate Experience - Timely, professional, and accurate communication

CRM Management - Accuracy and timely updating of Salesforce records

Follow-ups - Timely and effective lead nurturing

Programme Support - Contribution to webinars, outreach, and admissions initiatives

Teamwork - Collaboration and support to internal stakeholders

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate should possess excellent communication and calling skills, particularly in engaging with working professionals and senior executives. A master’s degree from a recognised institution is preferred. The candidate should demonstrate maturity, professionalism, confidence, and the ability to understand and convey programme information effectively.

Overall objective: To drive quality admissions and enrolments for ISB’s Advanced Management Programmes while delivering a professional, personalised, and high-quality experience to prospective candidates.

title: Principal Engineer
description:
Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.
  
  
At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day - building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with entrepreneurial speed, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset.
  
  
The Principal Engineer, Software – Finance & Supply Chain Platform is responsible for architecting resilient, distributed transaction flows across microservices, cloud ERPs (Oracle Fusion, NetSuite, D365), OMS, WMS, financial systems, and data platforms that underpin Fanatics Commerce's global operations. This role sets engineering standards for event contracts, data consistency, reconciliation frameworks, and financial ledger integrity while leading modernization initiatives including monolith decomposition, async processing, and domain-driven design. The Principal Engineer, Software – Finance & Supply Chain Platform delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights.
  
  
**How Will You Drive Impact**
Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes.
  
  
Team & Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams)
  
  
**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Partner with Finance, Supply Chain, Data, and Security leadership to translate regulatory and operational requirements into actionable architecture decisions and platform roadmaps.
* Influence cloud infrastructure strategy and drive platform alignment across engineering domains, ensuring cohesive standards for event contracts, API design, and data consistency.
* Engage executive and cross-functional stakeholders to shape long-term platform strategy and build organizational confidence in distributed system design choices.

**People Leadership**

* Mentor senior engineers across domains, elevating technical craft and establishing engineering standards that scale with the organization.
* Champion a culture of observability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement — coaching teams on SRE principles, SLOs, and self-service resilience patterns.

Fan & Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans)
  
  

* Architect systems designed for high availability and horizontal scalability, ensuring seamless fan and commerce experiences during peak traffic events such as seasonal spikes and product launches.
* Design and enforce disaster recovery, fault tolerance, and latency standards that protect the integrity of financial and order management systems fans depend on.
* Enable accurate, real-time inventory and order data flows across OMS and WMS, ensuring fans receive reliable fulfillment experiences at every touchpoint.
* Drive the adoption of Agentic AI to reimagine finance workflows — including invoice processing, reconciliation, and supplier communication — freeing teams to focus on higher-value fan and business outcomes.

Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)
  
  

* Lead modernization initiatives including monolith decomposition, asynchronous processing, event streaming, and domain-driven design across Finance and SCM platforms.
* Define and evolve cloud-native architecture using API-first and event-driven patterns, establishing the technical foundation for a scalable, future-ready platform.
* Establish a robust error framework with self-service retry mechanisms, reducing manual intervention and improving system resilience across distributed transaction flows.
* Influence the adoption of streaming platforms (Kafka, Pub/Sub, Event Hubs) and async messaging patterns to unlock real-time processing capabilities across financial and inventory domains.

Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset)
  
  

* Own system-level non-functional requirements — latency, fault tolerance, disaster recovery, and security — holding the bar on platform reliability for critical financial and supply chain systems.
* Drive observability strategy across logging, tracing, metrics, and SLOs for financial and inventory systems, ensuring engineering teams can detect, diagnose, and resolve issues with speed and confidence.
* Establish standards for financial ledger integrity, revenue recognition, and reconciliation frameworks within distributed, eventually consistent system architectures.
* Design for peak readiness — including month-end close cycles and high-transaction retail events — ensuring platform stability and performance under the most demanding operational conditions.

AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY
  
  
We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to:
  
  

* Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes
* Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance
* Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working
* Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

**Required Qualifications**
CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING
  
  

* 12+ years of engineering experience building distributed, cloud-native systems, with demonstrable expertise in microservices architecture, event-driven systems, and API design.
* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and container orchestration (Kubernetes), including serverless and managed service patterns.
* Experience with streaming platforms (Kafka, Pub/Sub, Event Hubs) and asynchronous messaging patterns in high-transaction retail or eCommerce environments.
* Strong understanding of financial domain concepts — ledgering, revenue recognition, inventory costing, and reconciliation — and direct experience with cloud ERPs such as Oracle Fusion, NetSuite, or D365.
* Deep knowledge of data architecture, eventual consistency, and idempotent processing, paired with strong SQL and data modeling skills and proficiency in modern backend stacks (Java, .NET, Go, or similar).
* Experience implementing observability and SRE principles using tools such as OpenTelemetry, with demonstrated ability to define and enforce SLOs for mission-critical systems.
* Proven ability to influence cross-functional and executive stakeholders on platform strategy, with a track record of mentoring senior engineers and elevating engineering standards at scale.

WORK LOCATION
  
  
Hybrid: The primary place of performance of this role is the Company's office located in
**Hyderabad,Telangana,**
subject to the Company's current hybrid work policy. This role currently requires in-office presence 3 days a week i.e, Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday
  
  
*At Fanatics, we operate with a BOLD mindset - We Build Championship Teams, we’re Obsessed with Fans, we embrace a Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit, and we approach every challenge with a Determined and Relentless Mindset. If you’re ready to contribute to a dynamic, fast-paced environment that thrives on collaboration and growth, we want you to be part of our team.*
**About Us**
*Fanatics is a leading global sports platform redefining how fans connect with the teams, players and moments they love. Our businesses — Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, Fanatics Betting & Gaming, Fanatics Events, Fanatics Advertising, Fanatics Markets and Fanatics Studios — maximize the presence and reach for hundreds of partners globally and create a one-stop experience that allows fans to buy, bet, collect, and earn, while engaging with sports in deeper, more immersive ways. Together, they form a powerful, integrated ecosystem — connected by the Fanatics ONE loyalty program and FanCash, the currency of sport — delivering personalized experiences to over 100 million fans worldwide. **Location: Khairatabad, Hyderabad**

**Salary:₹30,000 – ₹45,000 per month**

**Employment Type: Full-time**

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Video Editor & Graphic Designer who can create high-quality, engaging visual content for our brands and social media platforms.

The role involves working closely with our team to create Reels, social media videos, graphics, campaign creatives, and other visual content. The ideal candidate should have a strong eye for design, a good understanding of video editing and social media content, and the ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with the team.

We are looking for someone who is creative, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking a concept from an idea to a finished piece of content.

Knowledge of Videography, Photography and AI-powered content creation will be an added advantage.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Video Editing**

* Edit engaging short-form videos, Reels and social media content.
* Work on different types of video content including promotional, educational, lifestyle, brand and trend-based content.
* Add appropriate transitions, text, motion graphics, music, sound effects and other elements to enhance videos.
* Ensure videos are optimised for different social media platforms and formats.
* Work closely with the team to understand the objective and creative direction of each video.
* Keep up with current editing styles, trends and social media formats.

**Graphic Design**

* Design creative content for Instagram, Facebook and other digital platforms.
* Create social media posts, carousels, stories, banners, advertisements and campaign creatives.
* Develop visual concepts based on content briefs and brand requirements.
* Maintain consistency in brand identity, typography, layouts and visual language.
* Adapt designs into multiple sizes and formats as required.
* Bring fresh design ideas and creative approaches to the team.

**Creative Collaboration**

* Work closely with the Social Media & Content Manager and the wider team.
* Understand creative briefs and translate ideas into compelling visual content.
* Participate in brainstorming and contribute creative ideas for Reels, campaigns and social media content.
* Take feedback positively and make revisions efficiently.
* Manage multiple projects and meet deadlines without compromising quality.

**Videography & Photography — Added Advantage**

* Candidates with hands-on videography and photography skills will be preferred.
* Assist with or independently handle basic photoshoots and videoshoots when required.
* Understand framing, composition, lighting, and camera basics.
* Capture suitable footage and photographs for social media content.
* Understand how to shoot specifically for Reels and short-form content.
* Help the team create better visual assets during shoots.

**AI Content Creation — Added Advantage**

* Candidates who have experience using AI-powered creative tools will have an added advantage.
* Use AI tools for image and video generation.
* Create visual concepts, references, moodboards and storyboards using AI.
* Explore AI tools for creative enhancement, video production, voiceovers and other content requirements.
* Experiment with emerging AI tools to improve the quality and efficiency of content production.
* Identify opportunities where AI can complement traditional design and video-production workflows.

Software Skills

Strong proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly:

* Adobe Photoshop
* Adobe Illustrator
* Adobe Premiere Pro
* Adobe After Effects



Added Advantage

* Adobe Lightroom
* Adobe Audition
* DaVinci Resolve
* Figma or other design tools
* AI image and video generation tools
* Other emerging creative and editing tools

**The Right Candidate**

We are looking for someone who is more than just an editor or designer.

Someone who can understand a creative idea, contribute to it, and turn it into \*\*strong visual content\*\*.

You should be comfortable moving between:

Brief → Idea → Design/Shoot → Edit → Feedback → Final Content

You should have a strong sense of what looks good, what communicates clearly and what works on social media.

Most importantly, you should be a good communicator, team player and proactive creative thinker who is willing to experiment and continuously improve.

title: Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
description:
**About us:**
upGrad is India's leading lifelong upskilling partner. We work with learners at every stage of their career, from college students and early-career graduates to working professionals, senior leaders and enterprises, helping them stay relevant through online degrees, certifications, bootcamps, executive programmes, study-abroad pathways and workforce upskilling. We partner with leading universities and institutions in India and abroad, including IIIT Bangalore, the IIMs, IIT Delhi and universities across the US, UK, Europe and Australia.

Our engineering teams build and run the platforms behind this scale: learner-facing web and mobile apps, enterprise learning products, assessment and career services, and the data and AI systems that power personalised learning.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

● Own test automation for web, API and mobile applications across one or more product lines, working closely with engineering and product to understand changes and prioritise testing.

● Design, build and maintain automation frameworks from scratch or restructure existing ones, using AI-assisted development tools to deliver in aggressive timelines without compromising maintainability.

● Write, enhance and execute automated functional, regression and acceptance suites, integrated into CI/CD pipelines with reliable reporting.

● Validate end-to-end flows across the front end, backend services and databases, including data setup, teardown and verification through SQL.

● Shift testing left: review requirements and designs for testability, and contribute to API contracts and test strategies before code lands.

● Triage, log and track defects by severity and priority, and drive them to closure with engineering, product and operations.

● Continuously evaluate new tools, including AI agents and MCP-based testing integrations, and bring practical improvements to the team's workflow.

● Mentor junior QA engineers and contribute to automation standards and best practices across the team.

**Skills Required**

***Must have***

● Minimum 2 years of hands-on test automation experience, with 3-5 years overall in software engineering or QA.

● Hands-on experience automating Web, API and Mobile applications using Playwright, Selenium, Appium, Cypress, REST Assured or similar frameworks. Strong in at least two of the three layers.

● Demonstrated use of AI-assisted tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, ChatGPT or similar) to build or restructure automation frameworks, generate and refactor tests, and accelerate delivery. Be ready to walk us through a real example.

● Hands-on object-oriented programming in Java, or equivalent in TypeScript, Python or C#, with a solid grasp of design patterns used in test frameworks (Page Object, Builder, Factory).

● Good working knowledge of how modern front-end and backend applications are built: HTTP, REST, authentication, browser DevTools, microservices, and reading application logs.

● Comfortable with SQL and relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) for test data management and validation. Exposure to NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis) is a plus.

● Experience integrating automation into CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) and using Git for version control.

● Strong grounding in QA methodologies, test design techniques and defect lifecycle management.

***Good to have***

● Experience with contract testing, performance testing (k6, JMeter) or accessibility testing.

● Exposure to Docker, cloud environments (AWS) and observability tools.

● Experience with AI-native testing approaches: using LLMs to generate test data, self-healing locators, or agentic test execution via MCP.

● Prior experience in a product company at scale, ideally consumer-facing.

title: Sr. Fullstack Developer
description:
As a Fullstack Engineer you will design and build production-grade, user-facing AI experiences that customers love using. If you are a hands-on, results-driven engineer with deep web development chops and a passion for shipping polished AI-powered interfaces, we want to hear from you.

In this role, you will own the architecture and implementation of immersive conversational AI experiences end-to-end—from pixel-perfect, responsive frontends to the backend services and LLM integrations that power them. You will partner with product, design, and AI engineers across the globe to translate ambiguous requirements into production code, extending existing systems where it makes sense rather than rebuilding from scratch, and helping to raise the bar for engineering quality across the team.

**Job Responsibilities:**

1. Architect, design, and build full-screen conversational AI experiences from the ground up, including streaming chat interfaces, real-time UI state, and rich response rendering.
2. Make smart, defensible technology choices when selecting and applying frontend frameworks (React, Angular, or comparable), balancing speed of delivery against long-term maintainability.
3. Design and extend backend services in Node.js and Express, including REST APIs, authentication, streaming endpoints (Server-Sent Events / WebSockets), and integrations with LLM providers.
4. Integrate large language model APIs into customer-facing products, handling token streaming, error recovery, retries, tool use, and conversation state.
5. Ensure new features integrate cleanly with existing backend systems and frontend codebases.
6. Own the end-to-end quality of the user experience, including performance, accessibility, responsiveness, error states, and overall polish.
7. Write clean, testable, well-documented TypeScript across the stack, and advocate for engineering best practices in code review, system design, and architecture discussions.
8. Collaborate closely with product, design, AI engineers, and other development partners to refine requirements and deliver on aggressive timelines.
9. Proactively identify and resolve technical risks, performance bottlenecks, and UX issues, escalating tradeoffs clearly to stakeholders.
10. Mentor other engineers and contribute to the team’s technical direction, documentation, and engineering standards.

**Required Experience:**

* Minimum 7+ years of professional fullstack web development experience shipping production software.
* Minimum 3+ years of hands-on experience integrating LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, or similar) or building AI/ML-powered features into customer-facing applications.
* Comfort and experience architecting and building rich, full-screen web experiences from scratch, with a strong eye for UX, accessibility, and visual polish.
* Deep experience with at least one major modern frontend framework (React strongly preferred; Angular, Vue, or Svelte also valuable), including state management and component architecture.
* Strong backend experience with Node.js and Express (or comparable), including REST API design, authentication, streaming responses, and integration with third-party services.
* Demonstrated experience building real-time or streaming user interfaces (chat, dashboards, collaborative tools, or similar) and a solid grasp of conversational UX patterns.
* Proven ability to architect non-trivial features end-to-end with minimal supervision and make pragmatic technology choices under ambiguity.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain technical tradeoffs to engineers, designers, product managers, and non-technical stakeholders.

Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and own delivery from concept to production

title: AI Product Engineer (Full Stack + Forward Deployed AI)
description:

Orcaworks and Assistly are US-based technology startups building AI-powered products to solve real-world business challenges.

We are looking for a highly motivated, resourceful, and hands-on AI Product Engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, experimenting with new technologies, and building innovative solutions.

The ideal candidate is a self-starter who can independently understand a business problem, think beyond conventional approaches, and take ownership of a solution from concept to deployment.

This role offers the opportunity to work closely with founders, engineering teams, and customers across the US and India, contributing to product development, AI innovation, and customer implementations.

**AI & Product Development**

* Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered applications, intelligent agents, and automation solutions.
* Work with LLMs, RAG, AI/ML frameworks, and emerging technologies to build practical product capabilities.
* Explore new technologies, prototype ideas, and contribute to product innovation.

**Full Stack Engineering**

* Develop and maintain applications across frontend, backend, APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure.
* Design scalable architectures, integrate third-party systems, and optimize application performance.
* Troubleshoot complex technical challenges and independently implement solutions.

**Forward Deployed Engineering**

* Work directly with customers and internal stakeholders to understand business processes, challenges, and technical requirements.
* Translate customer needs into practical solutions, including custom integrations, workflows, and product enhancements.
* Take ownership of customer-facing technical challenges from problem identification through implementation and resolution.

**Problem-Solving & Product Ownership**

* Independently investigate problems, evaluate different approaches, and deliver effective solutions.
* Identify opportunities for automation, process improvement, and new product capabilities.
* Collaborate with founders and cross-functional teams to shape product direction and deliver solutions in a fast-paced environment.

**Required Qualifications**

* 3–7 years of hands-on software engineering experience with strong full-stack development capabilities.
* Proficiency in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, React/Next.js, Node.js, or comparable technologies.
* Practical experience with AI/ML, LLMs, generative AI applications, RAG, or agentic AI.
* Experience with APIs, databases, cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP), and deployment.
* Strong analytical thinking, debugging, system design, and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to understand business requirements and independently translate them into technical solutions.
* Good communication skills and confidence interacting with customers and global teams.
* Curiosity, adaptability, and the ability to learn and work across different technologies.

title: Tech Lead – Payment Platform
description:
**Role summary**

You will be the senior technical owner for one or more platform domains. Working closely with Architects and Product Management, you will turn the target architecture and product requirements into clear technical specifications, then lead the team that delivers them predictably, with high quality and on schedule. You will spend roughly half your time on technical design, code and reviews, and half on people, planning and cross-team alignment.

**Key responsibilities**

**Delivery**

* Break product goals into well-scoped epics, estimates and milestones with Product and Engineering Management.
* Run sprint planning and reviews, track progress and risks, and keep delivery predictable.
* Identify and unblock dependencies across teams and external partners early.
* Own release readiness: test strategy, rollout and rollback plans, and post-release monitoring.
* Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly to raise team throughput and code quality.

**Process and engineering practices**

* Define and improve the team’s delivery process: branching, code review, CI/CD, testing and definition of done.
* Set coding, API and data-modelling standards; review critical pull requests across backend and frontend.
* Write and review design documents and architecture decision records; represent the team at the Architecture Review Board.
* Define SLOs, observability and alerting; lead incident response and blameless post-incident reviews.
* Manage technical debt and keep the technical roadmap aligned with the architecture roadmap.

**Technical leadership**

* Translate architecture blueprints into low-level designs, API contracts, data models, sequence diagrams and non-functional requirements.
* Keep implementation aligned with the approved architecture; raise deviations and trade-offs early.
* Champion secure design: encryption, key management, secrets handling, least-privilege access and audit trails, in line with PCI DSS and internal InfoSec policy.

**People leadership**

* Mentor and grow engineers through pairing, design reviews and regular feedback.
* Take part in hiring: define the bar, interview and onboard new team members.
* Build a culture of ownership, documentation and calm, data-driven decisions.

**Technical environment**

**Backend**
: Java / Spring Boot (primary); Node.js (TypeScript) or Python for APIs, integrations and tooling

**Frontend**
: React (TypeScript)

**Architecture**
: Microservices, event-driven design, REST APIs, saga and outbox patterns

**Data**
: PostgreSQL (primary), Redis; NoSQL where the workload warrants it

**Cloud and DevOps**
: AWS (or Azure/GCP), Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, feature flags

**Observability**
: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, centralised logging

**Security**
: Cloud KMS/HSM, secrets management, WAF, SAST/DAST

**Critical skills**

* These are must-haves; candidates should show real depth in each area during interviews.
* Delivery leadership: turning high-level requirements into scoped work and shipping it predictably with a team of 5 or more engineers.
* Engineering process: code review, test automation, CI/CD, release management and incident management run as a discipline.
* Distributed systems: consistency, idempotency, concurrency, failure handling and high-throughput APIs.
* Java with Spring Boot, plus working proficiency in TypeScript/Node.js or Python and the ability to review React code.
* SQL: schema design, indexing, query tuning, transactions and isolation levels; zero-downtime migrations.
* Cloud and infrastructure: Kubernetes in a public cloud, infrastructure as code and observability.
* Security fundamentals: encryption, key and secrets management, least privilege and audit trails.

**Required qualifications**

* 8+ years building production systems, including 2+ years as a tech lead leading a team of 5 or more engineers.
* Proven track record of turning architecture and product requirements into detailed specifications that teams deliver against.
* Deep experience with distributed systems and high-availability services.
* Strong command of Java and Spring Boot; working knowledge of Node.js (TypeScript) or Python, and React.
* Experience running services on Kubernetes in a public cloud, with CI/CD and infrastructure as code.
* Working knowledge of security and compliance practices such as PCI DSS; exposure to payments or fintech systems is helpful.
* Clear written and verbal communication; able to explain trade-offs to architects, engineers, product leaders and auditors.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred qualifications**

* Experience in payments, fintech or banking technology, such as payment gateways, processor integrations, settlement and reconciliation.
* Built or scaled a ledger, payment switch or settlement engine handling 1M+ transactions a day.
* Led certification with a card network or an acquiring bank.
* Shipped an AI/ML or LLM-powered feature to production.
* Has used AI coding assistants and agentic tools within a governed SDLC.

T-Mobile US, Inc. (NASDAQ: TMUS) is America’s supercharged Un-carrier, powered by an award-winning 5G network that connects more people in more places than ever before. With its unique value proposition of best network, best value, and best experiences, T-Mobile is redefining connectivity, fueling competition, and driving the next wave of innovation in wireless and beyond. **TMUS Global Solutions:**

TMUS Global Solutions is a world-class technology organization accelerating T-Mobile’s global digital transformation. Our teams combine engineering talent, technology expertise, and collaborative ways of working to build secure, scalable solutions that improve customer and employee experiences. We foster innovation, agility, transparency, and strong enterprise partnerships to deliver measurable business outcomes.

**About the Role:**

This role is responsible for designing, building, and scaling the foundational software platform that powers T-Mobile’s agentic AI capabilities across conversational experiences, including text and voice interactions. The engineer develops the core execution, orchestration, and integration frameworks that enable AI systems to reason, plan, act, and interact safely with enterprise services at scale, while providing technical leadership for the architecture, evolution, and scalability of the AI execution platform.

Working closely with AI/ML engineers, platform engineers, product teams, and enterprise application teams, this role focuses on building reusable platform capabilities rather than individual AI applications. Responsibilities include designing agent orchestration frameworks, workflow execution engines, SDKs, tool integration layers, memory and state management systems, and conversational runtime services that support next-generation customer and employee experiences.

Success in this role requires strong software engineering expertise, distributed systems knowledge, and practical understanding of LLM-powered systems, with an emphasis on reliability, extensibility, scalability, and platform adoption. We pride ourselves on encouraging a culture of innovation, agile ways of working, and transparency in all we do. Join us in embodying the spirit of the Un-carrier and making a tangible impact.

**What You'll Do:**

* Design and develop agent orchestration frameworks and execution engines supporting complex AI-driven workflows.
* Design and optimize low-latency services supporting real-time conversational and voice interactions.
* Build reusable platform services, SDKs, APIs, and libraries that accelerate development of conversational AI applications.
* Design and implement Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations and frameworks that enable secure, scalable access to enterprise tools, APIs, data sources, and agent capabilities.
* Develop reusable tool-calling, context-sharing, and interoperability services that support MCP-enabled agent ecosystems.
* Develop runtime services for text- and voice-based agent interactions, including context management, tool execution, memory, and state orchestration.
* Architect microservices and event-driven systems that integrate AI reasoning with enterprise systems such as customer, billing, network, and support platforms.
* Design mechanisms that safely translate model outputs into deterministic business actions and workflows.
* Collaborate with AI/ML engineers to integrate foundation models, retrieval systems, evaluation frameworks, and agent capabilities into production platforms.
* Drive platform reliability, scalability, observability, and performance across high-volume AI workloads.
* Establish software architecture standards, engineering best practices, and reusable design patterns for agentic systems.
* Contribute to technical strategy and platform evolution by evaluating emerging AI, orchestration, and distributed systems technologies.
* Mentor engineers and promote engineering excellence through design reviews, documentation, and knowledge sharing.

**What You'll Bring**
:

* 7+ years of software engineering experience building distributed systems and cloud-native applications.
* Strong proficiency in Python or Java, with working knowledge of both preferred.
* Experience designing APIs, microservices, workflow engines, or platform services.
* Experience building systems that integrate with LLMs, AI services, or conversational platforms.
* Experience designing highly available distributed systems and service-oriented architectures.
* Strong understanding of software architecture, system design, scalability, resiliency, and performance optimization.
* Demonstrated experience leading technical design discussions, driving architectural decisions, and influencing engineering direction across teams.
* Experience with cloud-native technologies, including containers, Kubernetes, and service-based architectures.
* Excellent problem-solving, debugging, and technical communication skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience integrating AI systems with enterprise applications, APIs, tools, or data platforms through standardized integration patterns.

**Must Have Skills:**

* Python or Rust Or GO software engineering
* Distributed systems, APIs, and microservices
* LLM, AI service, and conversational platform integration
* Cloud-native architecture, containers, and Kubernetes
* Software architecture and technical leadership

**Nice-to-Have:**

* Experience building agent orchestration frameworks, workflow platforms, or AI execution systems.
* Experience with conversational AI, voice platforms, speech technologies, or real-time interaction systems.
* Familiarity with retrieval systems, vector databases, memory architectures, and evaluation frameworks.
* Experience designing internal developer platforms, SDKs, or reusable engineering frameworks.
* Knowledge of event-driven architectures, distributed workflows, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent tool-calling frameworks, or similar standards for connecting AI systems with external tools and services.
* Experience designing reusable tool integration frameworks, context management systems, or agent interoperability platforms.

title: Principal Engineer
description:
Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.
  
  
At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day - building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with entrepreneurial speed, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset.
  
  
The Principal Engineer, Software – Finance & Supply Chain Platform is responsible for architecting resilient, distributed transaction flows across microservices, cloud ERPs (Oracle Fusion, NetSuite, D365), OMS, WMS, financial systems, and data platforms that underpin Fanatics Commerce's global operations. This role sets engineering standards for event contracts, data consistency, reconciliation frameworks, and financial ledger integrity while leading modernization initiatives including monolith decomposition, async processing, and domain-driven design. The Principal Engineer, Software – Finance & Supply Chain Platform delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights.
  
  
**How Will You Drive Impact**
Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes.
  
  
Team & Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams)
  
  
**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Partner with Finance, Supply Chain, Data, and Security leadership to translate regulatory and operational requirements into actionable architecture decisions and platform roadmaps.
* Influence cloud infrastructure strategy and drive platform alignment across engineering domains, ensuring cohesive standards for event contracts, API design, and data consistency.
* Engage executive and cross-functional stakeholders to shape long-term platform strategy and build organizational confidence in distributed system design choices.

**People Leadership**

* Mentor senior engineers across domains, elevating technical craft and establishing engineering standards that scale with the organization.
* Champion a culture of observability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement — coaching teams on SRE principles, SLOs, and self-service resilience patterns.

Fan & Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans)
  
  

* Architect systems designed for high availability and horizontal scalability, ensuring seamless fan and commerce experiences during peak traffic events such as seasonal spikes and product launches.
* Design and enforce disaster recovery, fault tolerance, and latency standards that protect the integrity of financial and order management systems fans depend on.
* Enable accurate, real-time inventory and order data flows across OMS and WMS, ensuring fans receive reliable fulfillment experiences at every touchpoint.
* Drive the adoption of Agentic AI to reimagine finance workflows — including invoice processing, reconciliation, and supplier communication — freeing teams to focus on higher-value fan and business outcomes.

Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)
  
  

* Lead modernization initiatives including monolith decomposition, asynchronous processing, event streaming, and domain-driven design across Finance and SCM platforms.
* Define and evolve cloud-native architecture using API-first and event-driven patterns, establishing the technical foundation for a scalable, future-ready platform.
* Establish a robust error framework with self-service retry mechanisms, reducing manual intervention and improving system resilience across distributed transaction flows.
* Influence the adoption of streaming platforms (Kafka, Pub/Sub, Event Hubs) and async messaging patterns to unlock real-time processing capabilities across financial and inventory domains.

Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset)
  
  

* Own system-level non-functional requirements — latency, fault tolerance, disaster recovery, and security — holding the bar on platform reliability for critical financial and supply chain systems.
* Drive observability strategy across logging, tracing, metrics, and SLOs for financial and inventory systems, ensuring engineering teams can detect, diagnose, and resolve issues with speed and confidence.
* Establish standards for financial ledger integrity, revenue recognition, and reconciliation frameworks within distributed, eventually consistent system architectures.
* Design for peak readiness — including month-end close cycles and high-transaction retail events — ensuring platform stability and performance under the most demanding operational conditions.

AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY
  
  
We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to:
  
  

* Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes
* Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance
* Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working
* Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

**Required Qualifications**
CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING
  
  

* 12+ years of engineering experience building distributed, cloud-native systems, with demonstrable expertise in microservices architecture, event-driven systems, and API design.
* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and container orchestration (Kubernetes), including serverless and managed service patterns.
* Experience with streaming platforms (Kafka, Pub/Sub, Event Hubs) and asynchronous messaging patterns in high-transaction retail or eCommerce environments.
* Strong understanding of financial domain concepts — ledgering, revenue recognition, inventory costing, and reconciliation — and direct experience with cloud ERPs such as Oracle Fusion, NetSuite, or D365.
* Deep knowledge of data architecture, eventual consistency, and idempotent processing, paired with strong SQL and data modeling skills and proficiency in modern backend stacks (Java, .NET, Go, or similar).
* Experience implementing observability and SRE principles using tools such as OpenTelemetry, with demonstrated ability to define and enforce SLOs for mission-critical systems.
* Proven ability to influence cross-functional and executive stakeholders on platform strategy, with a track record of mentoring senior engineers and elevating engineering standards at scale.

WORK LOCATION
  
  
Hybrid: The primary place of performance of this role is the Company's office located in
**Hyderabad,Telangana,**
subject to the Company's current hybrid work policy. This role currently requires in-office presence 3 days a week i.e, Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday
  
  
*At Fanatics, we operate with a BOLD mindset - We Build Championship Teams, we’re Obsessed with Fans, we embrace a Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit, and we approach every challenge with a Determined and Relentless Mindset. If you’re ready to contribute to a dynamic, fast-paced environment that thrives on collaboration and growth, we want you to be part of our team.*
**About Us**
*Fanatics is a leading global sports platform redefining how fans connect with the teams, players and moments they love. Our businesses — Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, Fanatics Betting & Gaming, Fanatics Events, Fanatics Advertising, Fanatics Markets and Fanatics Studios — maximize the presence and reach for hundreds of partners globally and create a one-stop experience that allows fans to buy, bet, collect, and earn, while engaging with sports in deeper, more immersive ways. This includes licensed fan gear and lifestyle products, sportsbook and iGaming, physical and digital trading cards, live events, premium sports entertainment content, credit card offerings and more. Together, they form a powerful, integrated ecosystem — connected by the Fanatics ONE loyalty program and FanCash, the currency of sport — delivering personalized experiences to over 100 million fans worldwide. Fanatics holds partnerships with over 900 sports properties, from professional leagues and players’ associations to teams, colleges and retail partners; over 7,000 athletes and celebrities; and over 2,000 retail locations, including all Lids stores. Backed by a team of more than 22,000 employees, Fanatics is committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience.*
**About The Team**
*Fanatics Commerce is a leading designer, manufacturer, and seller of licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods. It operates a vertically-integrated platform of digital and physical capabilities for leading sports leagues, teams, colleges, and associations globally – as well as its flagship site, www.fanatics.com.*
*Fanatics Commerce has a broad range of online, sports venue, and vertical apparel partnerships worldwide, including comprehensive partnerships with leading leagues, teams, colleges, and sports organizations across the world—including the NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, Formula 1, and Australian Football League (AFL); the Dallas Cowboys, Golden State Warriors, Paris Saint-Germain, Chelsea FC, and Tokyo Giants; the University of Notre Dame, University of Alabama, and University of Texas; the International Olympic Committee (IOC), England Rugby, and the Union of European Football Associations (UEFA).*
*At Fanatics Commerce, we infuse our BOLD Leadership Principles in everything we do:*

* Build Championship Teams
* Obsessed with Fans
* Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit
* Determined and Relentless Mindset

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to manage, operate, and maintain the ingestion layer of a large-scale observability platform. The role involves ensuring continuous collection and delivery of metrics, logs, and traces from monitored application and infrastructure systems into centralized data stores.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in Linux administration, OpenTelemetry, Vector, Prometheus exporters, Kafka, Grafana, and scripting. The candidate will be responsible for day-to-day operations, application onboarding, telemetry validation, incident management, troubleshooting, and automation.

Since the platform supports critical business operations, ensuring uninterrupted telemetry collection and maintaining service continuity will be the primary responsibility.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Ingestion Monitoring & Operations**

* Monitor and maintain the end-to-end observability ingestion layer, including Node Exporter, JMX Exporter, OpenTelemetry agents and collectors, Vector agents, SNMP, Blackbox, and syslog collection.
* Monitor ingestion health, scrape success, ingestion rates, consumer-group lag, buffer utilization, queue depth, and data freshness.
* Identify and resolve silent source loss, pipeline failures, and telemetry collection gaps.
* Perform routine health checks, capacity checks, certificate renewals, patching, and component upgrades.

**2. Agent & Collector Deployment**

* Deploy, configure, upgrade, and maintain telemetry agents across application and infrastructure hosts.
* Onboard applications and infrastructure components, including Kafka, Cassandra, KeyDB, PostgreSQL, network, and security systems.
* Maintain Vector agent and aggregator pipelines, including file sources, multiline parsing, VRL transformations, disk buffering, and sink configurations.
* Ensure proper telemetry labels and resource attributes across metrics, logs, and traces.

**3. Incident Management & Troubleshooting**

* Act as the first responder for ingestion-related alerts and incidents.
* Troubleshoot exporter failures, pipeline stalls, connectivity issues, parsing errors, and consumer lag.
* Acknowledge P1 alerts within 5 minutes and P2 alerts within 15 minutes.
* Perform root cause analysis, implement preventive actions, and follow defined escalation procedures.
* Ensure proper incident documentation and timely shift handovers.

**4. Application Onboarding & Telemetry Validation**

* Validate network connectivity, routing, firewall rules, port reachability, DNS resolution, and certificate validity.
* Ensure telemetry completeness and accuracy after every onboarding or configuration change.
* Investigate data gaps, count mismatches, cardinality issues, and coverage discrepancies.
* Follow approved onboarding runbooks and verification procedures.

**5. Automation & Scripting**

* Automate repetitive operational tasks using Bash/Shell scripting and Python.
* Develop scripts for agent deployment, configuration templating, verification checks, log analysis, and shift reporting.
* Follow Git-based version control and configuration-as-code practices.

**6. Dashboards, Alerting & Documentation**

* Build and maintain Grafana dashboards and alert rules for monitoring ingestion health.
* Validate alert rules and ensure referenced metrics are available.
* Maintain operational documentation, including runbooks, SOPs, onboarding guides, shift handover notes, and incident reports.

**7. Security & Compliance**

* Ensure secure configuration of collection endpoints, OTLP receivers, and log mounts.
* Prevent exposure of unauthenticated ingestion endpoints on routable interfaces.
* Follow approved security controls, patching procedures, and operational compliance standards.

Required Technical Skills

* **Linux Administration:**
  Strong experience with RHEL/Ubuntu, command-line operations, systemd, networking, and performance troubleshooting.
* **OpenTelemetry:**
  Java agent instrumentation, Collector pipelines, OTLP, receivers, processors, and exporters.
* **Vector.dev:**
  File sources, multiline parsing, VRL transformations, disk buffering, and sinks.
* **Prometheus Exporters:**
  Node Exporter, JMX Exporter, SNMP Exporter, Blackbox Exporter, and PromQL.
* **Prometheus / VictoriaMetrics:**
  Scrape configuration, relabelling, and remote write.
* **Log & Trace Management:**
  VictoriaLogs (LogsQL) or OpenSearch; exposure to trace stores.
* **Apache Kafka:**
  Topics, partitions, consumer groups, offsets, lag, and retention.
* **Containerization:**
  Docker and container operations; working knowledge of Kubernetes.
* **Grafana:**
  Dashboard creation, panel queries, and alert rule configuration.
* **Scripting:**
  Bash/Shell scripting and Python for operational automation.
* **Networking:**
  TCP/IP, routing, DNS, TLS, firewall rules, and port analysis.
* **Version Control:**
  Git and configuration-as-code practices.
* **Incident Management:**
  Incident triage, escalation, root cause analysis, and documentation.

24x7 Shift & Support Requirements

* Must be willing to work in a 24x7 rotational shift environment.
* Shifts will rotate across morning, evening, and night schedules, including weekends and public holidays.
* Take primary on-call responsibility for ingestion alerts during assigned shifts.
* Complete documented shift handovers covering open incidents, ingestion health, suppressed alerts, and ongoing activities.
* Follow defined incident acknowledgement and escalation timelines.
* Ensure operational continuity and timely incident resolution.

Key Expectations

* Ensure uninterrupted telemetry collection and ingestion across monitored systems.
* Maintain high availability and reliability of the observability ingestion layer.
* Proactively identify and resolve ingestion failures and data collection gaps.
* Ensure accurate, complete, and consistent telemetry data.
* Reduce manual effort through automation and operational improvements.
* Maintain proper documentation and follow established operational procedures.

title: Sr Engineer, AI [T500-30757]
description:
**About T-Mobile:**

T-Mobile US, Inc. (NASDAQ: TMUS) is America’s supercharged Un-carrier, powered by an award-winning 5G network that connects more people in more places than ever before. With its unique value proposition of best network, best value, and best experiences, T-Mobile is redefining connectivity, fueling competition, and driving the next wave of innovation in wireless and beyond. Headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, T-Mobile provides services through its subsidiaries and operates its flagship brands, T-Mobile, Metro by T-Mobile, and Mint Mobile.

**TMUS Global Solutions:**

TMUS Global Solutions is a world-class technology organization accelerating T-Mobile’s global digital transformation. Our teams combine engineering talent, technology expertise, and collaborative ways of working to build secure, scalable solutions that improve customer and employee experiences. We foster innovation, agility, transparency, and strong enterprise partnerships to deliver measurable business outcomes.

**About the Role:**

This role is responsible for designing, building, and scaling the foundational software platform that powers T-Mobile’s agentic AI capabilities across conversational experiences, including text and voice interactions. The engineer develops the core execution, orchestration, and integration frameworks that enable AI systems to reason, plan, act, and interact safely with enterprise services at scale, while providing technical leadership for the architecture, evolution, and scalability of the AI execution platform.

Working closely with AI/ML engineers, platform engineers, product teams, and enterprise application teams, this role focuses on building reusable platform capabilities rather than individual AI applications. Responsibilities include designing agent orchestration frameworks, workflow execution engines, SDKs, tool integration layers, memory and state management systems, and conversational runtime services that support next-generation customer and employee experiences.

Success in this role requires strong software engineering expertise, distributed systems knowledge, and practical understanding of LLM-powered systems, with an emphasis on reliability, extensibility, scalability, and platform adoption. We pride ourselves on encouraging a culture of innovation, agile ways of working, and transparency in all we do. Join us in embodying the spirit of the Un-carrier and making a tangible impact.

**What You'll Do:**

* Design and develop agent orchestration frameworks and execution engines supporting complex AI-driven workflows.
* Design and optimize low-latency services supporting real-time conversational and voice interactions.
* Build reusable platform services, SDKs, APIs, and libraries that accelerate development of conversational AI applications.
* Design and implement Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations and frameworks that enable secure, scalable access to enterprise tools, APIs, data sources, and agent capabilities.
* Develop reusable tool-calling, context-sharing, and interoperability services that support MCP-enabled agent ecosystems.
* Develop runtime services for text- and voice-based agent interactions, including context management, tool execution, memory, and state orchestration.
* Architect microservices and event-driven systems that integrate AI reasoning with enterprise systems such as customer, billing, network, and support platforms.
* Design mechanisms that safely translate model outputs into deterministic business actions and workflows.
* Collaborate with AI/ML engineers to integrate foundation models, retrieval systems, evaluation frameworks, and agent capabilities into production platforms.
* Drive platform reliability, scalability, observability, and performance across high-volume AI workloads.
* Establish software architecture standards, engineering best practices, and reusable design patterns for agentic systems.
* Contribute to technical strategy and platform evolution by evaluating emerging AI, orchestration, and distributed systems technologies.
* Mentor engineers and promote engineering excellence through design reviews, documentation, and knowledge sharing.

**What You'll Bring**
:

* 7+ years of software engineering experience building distributed systems and cloud-native applications.
* Strong proficiency in Python or Java, with working knowledge of both preferred.
* Experience designing APIs, microservices, workflow engines, or platform services.
* Experience building systems that integrate with LLMs, AI services, or conversational platforms.
* Experience designing highly available distributed systems and service-oriented architectures.
* Strong understanding of software architecture, system design, scalability, resiliency, and performance optimization.
* Demonstrated experience leading technical design discussions, driving architectural decisions, and influencing engineering direction across teams.
* Experience with cloud-native technologies, including containers, Kubernetes, and service-based architectures.
* Excellent problem-solving, debugging, and technical communication skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience integrating AI systems with enterprise applications, APIs, tools, or data platforms through standardized integration patterns.

**Must Have Skills:**

* Python or Rust Or GO software engineering
* Distributed systems, APIs, and microservices
* LLM, AI service, and conversational platform integration
* Cloud-native architecture, containers, and Kubernetes
* Software architecture and technical leadership

**Nice-to-Have:**

* Experience building agent orchestration frameworks, workflow platforms, or AI execution systems.
* Experience with conversational AI, voice platforms, speech technologies, or real-time interaction systems.
* Familiarity with retrieval systems, vector databases, memory architectures, and evaluation frameworks.
* Experience designing internal developer platforms, SDKs, or reusable engineering frameworks.
* Knowledge of event-driven architectures, distributed workflows, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent tool-calling frameworks, or similar standards for connecting AI systems with external tools and services.
* Experience designing reusable tool integration frameworks, context management systems, or agent interoperability platforms.

Platform Services | Vantage Core – Platform Software
  
  
**Our Company**
Teradata empowers companies to achieve high-impact business outcomes through analytics. With a powerful combination of industry expertise and leading hybrid cloud technologies for data warehousing and big data analytics, Teradata unleashes the potential of great companies. Partnering with top companies around the world, Teradata helps improve customer experience, mitigate risk, drive product innovation, achieve operational excellence, transform finance, and optimize assets. Teradata is recognized by media and industry analysts as a future-focused company for its technological excellence, sustainability, ethics, and business value.
  
  
The Teradata culture isn’t just about one kind of person. So many individuals make up who we are, making us that much more unique. It’s what sets apart the dynamic, diverse and collaborative environment that is Teradata. But even as individuals, there’s one thing that we all share — our united goal of making Teradata and our people, the best we can be.
  
  
**OUR TEAM**
This position is for a Manager, Software Engineering in the Platform Services team within the Vantage Core – Platform Software organization. The team builds core cloud platform services that power provisioning, lifecycle management, and runtime operations of Teradata compute infrastructure across public cloud environments (AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud). These highly reliable, scalable, and automated infrastructure services are used by multiple engineering teams and enterprise customers.
  
  
Key areas of focus include:
  
  

* Cloud-native provisioning and lifecycle automation for distributed compute environments.
* Platform services for orchestration, scaling, and configuration management across public cloud platforms.
* Serverless and event-driven automation frameworks for infrastructure workflows.
* Secure and reliable connectivity enablement for cloud-deployed compute systems.

We are looking for a candidate to join our fast-paced and cutting-edge development organization that is on the forefront of our “Teradata Everywhere” strategy.
  
  
Teradata Labs, the technology research and development (R&D) organization within Teradata Corporation, has been turning innovative decision support technology into business results for over 30 years. Our R&D team of analytic architects, database developers and engineers work to understand and advance emerging technologies to invent the next wave of cutting-edge analytic data solutions.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
The position involves leading one or more software engineering teams responsible for the development, integration, functional and performance testing, and fault analysis of our cloud platform services across public cloud environments. The manager will be responsible for:
  
  

* Providing and communicating the engineering vision for your team, aligned with the long-term cloud platform strategy.
