title: Principal Engineer
description:
Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.
  
  
At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day - building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with entrepreneurial speed, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset.
  
  
The Principal Engineer, Software – Finance & Supply Chain Platform is responsible for architecting resilient, distributed transaction flows across microservices, cloud ERPs (Oracle Fusion, NetSuite, D365), OMS, WMS, financial systems, and data platforms that underpin Fanatics Commerce's global operations. This role sets engineering standards for event contracts, data consistency, reconciliation frameworks, and financial ledger integrity while leading modernization initiatives including monolith decomposition, async processing, and domain-driven design. The Principal Engineer, Software – Finance & Supply Chain Platform delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights.
  
  
**How Will You Drive Impact**
Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes.
  
  
Team & Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams)
  
  
**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Partner with Finance, Supply Chain, Data, and Security leadership to translate regulatory and operational requirements into actionable architecture decisions and platform roadmaps.
* Influence cloud infrastructure strategy and drive platform alignment across engineering domains, ensuring cohesive standards for event contracts, API design, and data consistency.
* Engage executive and cross-functional stakeholders to shape long-term platform strategy and build organizational confidence in distributed system design choices.

**People Leadership**

* Mentor senior engineers across domains, elevating technical craft and establishing engineering standards that scale with the organization.
* Champion a culture of observability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement — coaching teams on SRE principles, SLOs, and self-service resilience patterns.

Fan & Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans)
  
  

* Architect systems designed for high availability and horizontal scalability, ensuring seamless fan and commerce experiences during peak traffic events such as seasonal spikes and product launches.
* Design and enforce disaster recovery, fault tolerance, and latency standards that protect the integrity of financial and order management systems fans depend on.
* Enable accurate, real-time inventory and order data flows across OMS and WMS, ensuring fans receive reliable fulfillment experiences at every touchpoint.
* Drive the adoption of Agentic AI to reimagine finance workflows — including invoice processing, reconciliation, and supplier communication — freeing teams to focus on higher-value fan and business outcomes.

Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)
  
  

* Lead modernization initiatives including monolith decomposition, asynchronous processing, event streaming, and domain-driven design across Finance and SCM platforms.
* Define and evolve cloud-native architecture using API-first and event-driven patterns, establishing the technical foundation for a scalable, future-ready platform.
* Establish a robust error framework with self-service retry mechanisms, reducing manual intervention and improving system resilience across distributed transaction flows.
* Influence the adoption of streaming platforms (Kafka, Pub/Sub, Event Hubs) and async messaging patterns to unlock real-time processing capabilities across financial and inventory domains.

Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset)
  
  

* Own system-level non-functional requirements — latency, fault tolerance, disaster recovery, and security — holding the bar on platform reliability for critical financial and supply chain systems.
* Drive observability strategy across logging, tracing, metrics, and SLOs for financial and inventory systems, ensuring engineering teams can detect, diagnose, and resolve issues with speed and confidence.
* Establish standards for financial ledger integrity, revenue recognition, and reconciliation frameworks within distributed, eventually consistent system architectures.
* Design for peak readiness — including month-end close cycles and high-transaction retail events — ensuring platform stability and performance under the most demanding operational conditions.

AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY
  
  
We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to:
  
  

* Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes
* Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance
* Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working
* Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

**Required Qualifications**
CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING
  
  

* 12+ years of engineering experience building distributed, cloud-native systems, with demonstrable expertise in microservices architecture, event-driven systems, and API design.
* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and container orchestration (Kubernetes), including serverless and managed service patterns.
* Experience with streaming platforms (Kafka, Pub/Sub, Event Hubs) and asynchronous messaging patterns in high-transaction retail or eCommerce environments.
* Strong understanding of financial domain concepts — ledgering, revenue recognition, inventory costing, and reconciliation — and direct experience with cloud ERPs such as Oracle Fusion, NetSuite, or D365.
* Deep knowledge of data architecture, eventual consistency, and idempotent processing, paired with strong SQL and data modeling skills and proficiency in modern backend stacks (Java, .NET, Go, or similar).
* Experience implementing observability and SRE principles using tools such as OpenTelemetry, with demonstrated ability to define and enforce SLOs for mission-critical systems.
* Proven ability to influence cross-functional and executive stakeholders on platform strategy, with a track record of mentoring senior engineers and elevating engineering standards at scale.

WORK LOCATION
  
  
Hybrid: The primary place of performance of this role is the Company's office located in
**Hyderabad,Telangana,**
subject to the Company's current hybrid work policy. This role currently requires in-office presence 3 days a week i.e, Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday
  
  
*At Fanatics, we operate with a BOLD mindset - We Build Championship Teams, we’re Obsessed with Fans, we embrace a Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit, and we approach every challenge with a Determined and Relentless Mindset. If you’re ready to contribute to a dynamic, fast-paced environment that thrives on collaboration and growth, we want you to be part of our team.*

Our businesses — Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, Fanatics Betting & Gaming, Fanatics Events, Fanatics Advertising, Fanatics Markets and Fanatics Studios — maximize the presence and reach for hundreds of partners globally and create a one-stop experience that allows fans to buy, bet, collect, and earn, while engaging with sports in deeper, more immersive ways. **Role Summary**

We are seeking a Workday Integrations Consultant with strong technical delivery experience and a solid understanding of Workday Finance modules. The primary focus is monitoring, triaging, and resolving production integration incidents across finance-domain interfaces — AP invoice feeds, supplier payment files, GL journals, banking interfaces, and project data exchanges. The role also handles integration change requests and regression testing for Workday semi-annual releases. A strong understanding of Workday Finance processes is essential to diagnose failures and validate fixes accurately without breaking downstream financial processing.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and deploy Workday integrations using Workday Studio, EIBs, Core Connectors, and Document Transformation (XSLT).
* Build inbound and outbound integrations supporting AP invoice feeds, supplier payment files, GL journals, banking interfaces, and project financial data exchanges.
* Monitor production Workday integrations daily; identify, triage, and resolve failures in EIBs, Core Connectors, Studio integrations, and document transformation jobs.
* Analyse integration error logs; perform data-mapping corrections, reprocessing of failed records, and downstream interface validation for finance-critical transactions.
* Manage the integration AMS change-request queue: assess impact, design solutions, build and test within the agreed change-management process.
* Apply a strong understanding of Workday AP, GL, Supplier Accounts, and project finance data models to accurately diagnose integration failures and confirm that corrected outputs meet financial accuracy standards.
* Coordinate with the Workday Finance Functional Consultant when integration failures surface as functional configuration issues; provide clear technical context to enable fast resolution.
* Conduct regression testing of all live integrations following Workday semi-annual releases; document results and deploy necessary fixes.
* Manage integration-related configuration changes (XSLT transformations, field-mapping updates, connector reconfiguration) through the client change management process.
* Produce and maintain integration runbooks, error-handling guides, and known-error records for the AMS knowledge base.
* Liaise with downstream system owners (ERP, banking, procurement platforms) to coordinate interface fixes and validate corrected data end-to-end.
* Participate in problem management reviews; contribute to root-cause analysis and permanent fix identification for recurring integration failures.

**Workday Technical Skills**

Workday Studio/ EIB (Inbound & Outbound), Core Connectors, Document Transformation (XSLT). REST / SOAP Web Services, PECI / PICOF, Workday Report-as-a-Service (RaaS), XML / JSON, SFTP / PGP encryption, Accounts Payable (domain), General Ledger (domain), Business Process Customization

**General & Professional Skills**

* **Communication:**
  Ability to bridge technical and functional teams; clearly present integration designs to non-technical stakeholders.
* **Analytical:**
  Strong data-mapping analysis and root-cause diagnosis for integration failures.
* **Documentation:**
  Detail-oriented; produces thorough specs, mapping logs, and test evidence packages.
* **Team Player:**
  Works collaboratively with functional consultants, architects, and client IT teams.
* **Time Management:**
  Manages multiple integration workstreams simultaneously and delivers to sprint schedules.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
* 4–7 years of Workday integration development experience across at least two full implementations or support operations.
* Workday Integration certification.
* Hands-on experience with at least one finance-domain integration (payment files, GL feeds, invoice processing).

A field sales professional who can independently manage an assigned territory, build relationships with solar industry stakeholders, acquire new B2B partners and contribute to the growth of Rengy's solar marketplace ecosystem.

**About Guidant Global:**

Guidant Global delivers dynamic, tailored workforce solutions that empower businesses to thrive in ever-evolving markets. Through our MSP, RPO, Direct Sourcing, Services Procurement and Consulting services, we help organizations find, engage, and manage the best permanent and contingent talent across the globe.

With over 1.5 million STEM and professional experts in our network across 80+ countries, we don't just solve today's challenges. We're helping to shape the workforce of tomorrow.

**About Guidant Global India:**

At Guidant Global India, we play our part in shaping the future of work by powering recruitment and support services for Guidant teams across APAC and wider global markets. As a strategic delivery hub and global capability center, we partner with stakeholders worldwide to raise quality, strengthen compliance, and deliver consistently at scale.

We're not standing still. We're building deeper capability in-house, taking ownership of the work that matters most, and designing an agile, future-ready delivery model built for where the business is heading next.

Join us, and you'll be part of a people-first team that's expert, ambitious, and collaborative, delivering A Better Way, every day.

The Senior Sales Executive is a senior individual contributor responsible for accelerating profitable growth across the India market by originating, shaping, and closing complex opportunities for HeadFirst Global's GCC and workforce solutions. The role engages confidently with senior client stakeholders, translating business and workforce challenges into differentiated, outcome-led propositions that demonstrate measurable value, return on investment, and long-term partnership potential. Working closely with the VP - Sales and cross-functional leaders, the role develops territory and account strategies, applies disciplined sales processes, maintains a high-quality pipeline and forecast, and navigates multi-stakeholder buying cycles from initial engagement through commercial negotiation and handover. The Senior Sales Executive brings strong market judgement, consultative and value-selling capability, commercial acumen, and customer advocacy to strengthen client trust, expand strategic relationships, and consistently deliver revenue and margin objectives.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop and execute territory, segment, and target-account strategies aligned to India growth priorities, ideal customer profiles, and revenue objectives.
* Originate and qualify high-value opportunities through executive networks, referrals, strategic partnerships, market intelligence, events, and focused outreach.
* Build trusted relationships with C-suite, procurement, HR, talent, finance, and operational stakeholders, mapping influence, decision criteria, and buying dynamics.
* Own the full sales cycle for complex opportunities, from discovery and opportunity strategy through proposal, negotiation, contracting, and transition to delivery.
* Consistently achieve or exceed revenue, gross-margin, new-logo, pipeline coverage, and conversion objectives while protecting commercial quality.
* Represent HeadFirst Global as a credible market voice at senior client forums, industry events, and strategic networking platforms.

**Client Engagement & Solutions:**

* Lead executive-level discovery to uncover strategic priorities, operational pain points, risk considerations, decision criteria, and measurable success outcomes.
* Apply consultative and value-based selling methods to connect HeadFirst Global's capabilities with client outcomes, including productivity, compliance, scalability, experience, cost optimization, and speed to value.
* Orchestrate cross-functional solution design with Sales, Customer Success, Talent Management, Finance, Legal, and Operations, ensuring propositions are differentiated, deliverable, and commercially sound.
* Develop and present compelling business cases, proposals, and executive presentations that articulate value, return on investment, commercial logic, and implementation confidence.
* Lead complex negotiations across scope, commercials, service levels, risk, and contract terms, maintaining client trust while protecting margin and governance standards.
* Act as a customer advocate by bringing client insight into solution development, mobilizing internal support, and setting clear expectations that enable long-term value realisation

**Pipeline Management & Reporting:**

* Maintain rigorous CRM discipline, complete opportunity data, and clear next-step ownership across all active accounts and deals.
* Build and manage a balanced, stage-appropriate pipeline with sufficient coverage, prioritizing opportunities by strategic fit, value, probability, timing, and margin potential.
* Apply the agreed sales methodology and qualification framework consistently, using evidence-based deal reviews to identify risks, remove blockers, and improve conversion.
* Provide accurate weekly, monthly, and quarterly forecasts, clearly articulating assumptions, dependencies, decision paths, and recovery actions.
* Use data, market intelligence, and AI-enabled sales tools to improve account prioritization, research, outreach personalisation, pipeline insight, and forecast quality while applying appropriate judgement and data safeguards.
* Provide actionable insight on market trends, competitors, buying behaviour, customer needs, and proposition gaps to inform commercial strategy and portfolio development.

**Governance & Collaboration:**

* Operate within the delegation of authority, pricing, margin, contractual, compliance, and ethical frameworks; escalate exceptions early and with clear recommendations.
* Lead internal deal governance for priority opportunities, aligning stakeholders on win strategy, solution, commercials, risks, approvals, and responsibilities.
* Coordinate a disciplined handover to Customer Success and delivery teams, ensuring commitments, assumptions, risks, success measures, and stakeholder expectations are documented and understood.
* Partner effectively across functions and geographies to mobilize expertise, remove barriers, and present one integrated HeadFirst Global experience to the client.
* Share winning practices, market insight, and constructive coaching with colleagues, contributing to continuous improvement in sales capability, process, and performance.

**Qualifications & Experience:**

* Substantial B2B solution-sales or business-development experience, preferably in staffing, MSP, RPO, GCC, workforce solutions, technology-enabled services, or professional services.
* Demonstrated record of winning new logos, meeting or exceeding revenue and margin targets, and closing complex, multi-stakeholder opportunities.
* Strong proficiency in sales strategy, territory and account planning, consultative and value selling, opportunity qualification, commercial negotiation, and disciplined sales-process execution.
* Advanced pipeline management and forecasting capability, with strong CRM discipline and the ability to convert data into practical deal and portfolio decisions.
* Credibility and confidence engaging C-suite and senior functional leaders, with excellent executive communication, presentation, facilitation, and negotiation skills.
* Commercial acumen with the ability to develop business cases, articulate return on investment, understand pricing and margin implications, and balance customer value with organizational outcomes.
* AI fluency, including effective and responsible use of AI-enabled tools for research, account intelligence, prospecting, personalization, proposal development, productivity, and sales analysis; able to validate outputs and protect confidential data.
* Strong customer-advocacy orientation, with evidence of representing the customer voice internally, resolving barriers, and building relationships that support retention, expansion, and referrals.
* Sound understanding of the India commercial and workforce landscape, including relevant client buying dynamics, market trends, and regulatory considerations.
* High levels of ownership, resilience, judgement, collaboration, and adaptability in a fast-growing, matrixed environment.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Management, or a related field; relevant advanced study or professional sales certification is advantageous.

**What We Offer:**

* The opportunity to shape commercial growth across India's major metropolitan markets and represent a differentiated GCC and workforce solutions portfolio.
* A high-impact senior individual-contributor role with access to executive stakeholders, strategic opportunities, and international expertise.
* A collaborative, ambitious, and customer-led culture that values performance, ownership, innovation, and responsible use of technology.
* Competitive compensation, performance-based incentives, and clear opportunities for continued professional and leadership development.

title: Agentic AI Engineer
description:
The Agentic AI Engineer will design, build and deploy AI agents that automate multi-step business processes across enterprise systems such as ERP, CRM, email and collaboration tools.

The role requires hands-on engineering with LLMs and agent tooling, a practical understanding of what makes software enterprise-ready, and the ability to work with business users, functional consultants and junior engineers.

Candidates from software engineering, integration or automation backgrounds (RPA, low-code workflows) who have built LLM-based agents, at work or on their own, are also encouraged to apply.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build and deploy AI agents, tools and skills that take actions in business systems, not only answer questions.
* Translate business processes into agent workflows with clear steps, decision points, approvals and exception paths.
* Build long-running workflows that pause for human input, resume reliably and avoid duplicate transactions.
* Design human-in-the-loop steps over email and chat where users confirm or correct agent-proposed values instead of answering open questions.
* Integrate agents with enterprise applications through APIs, MCP servers and existing integration layers.
* Apply access control, least-privilege service identities and segregation of duties, in line with customer security and data privacy standards.
* Build audit logging, monitoring and evaluation so every agent action is traceable and measurable.
* Handle errors, retries and edge cases, and route failures to the right person with enough context to act.
* Work with functional consultants and business users to capture requirements and test with realistic scenarios.
* Write documentation and runbooks, demo working solutions to stakeholders, and mentor junior engineers.

**Job Requirements**

Must-have

* 2 to 3 years of hands-on experience in software, integration or automation engineering.
* Built at least one LLM-based agent or automation, at work or on your own, that uses tool or function calling to take real actions in a business system.
* Hands-on experience with at least one LLM platform such as OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock or Google Vertex AI.
* Experience with at least one agent framework such as LangChain / LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Microsoft Agent Framework / Semantic Kernel, CrewAI or OpenAI Agents SDK.
* Strong Python or TypeScript / JavaScript, with REST APIs, JSON and authentication (OAuth 2.0, service accounts).
* Hands-on experience with at least one workflow or orchestration tool such as Microsoft Power Automate, Azure Logic Apps, n8n, UiPath or Camunda.
* Working knowledge of Git, CI/CD, Docker and testing practices.
* Understanding of enterprise requirements: access control, audit trails, error handling and data privacy.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical ideas to business users.

Nice-to-have

* Exposure to SAP or other ERP processes such as procurement, finance or supply chain.
* Experience building or using Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers or the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol.
* Integration with enterprise applications such as Salesforce, Dynamics 365 or ServiceNow.
* Microsoft 365 integration: Teams bots, adaptive cards, Outlook automation or the Microsoft Graph API.
* Experience on AWS, Azure or Google Cloud (serverless functions, storage, identity and access management); a cloud certification is a plus.
* Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with vector stores such as pgvector, OpenSearch or Pinecone.
* Event-driven architecture using Kafka, queues or webhooks.
* LLM observability and evaluation tools such as LangSmith, Langfuse or OpenTelemetry.
* Experience mentoring junior engineers.

What We Offer

* **Customer Exposure:**
  Direct interaction with business and technology stakeholders across North American enterprise customers.
* **End-to-End Ownership:**

title: Predictive Science -  AI Engineering & Prompt Architecture Lead - Vice President
description:
**Job Description**
Take a lead role in acquiring, managing and retaining meaningful relationships that deliver outstanding experience to our customers. In this role, you will balance your focus on business results by offering options and finding solutions to help our customers with issues.
  
  
As a Vice President – AI Engineering & Prompt Architecture Lead in Predictive Science, you will own the technical vision and delivery for a team of prompt engineers and AI/ML model developers building intelligent document processing and data extraction solutions in the KYC/AML domain.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Architect agentic, multi-step AI workflows chaining classification → extraction → cross-validation → exception routing with human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
* Debug and remediate complex prompt failures (context-window overflow, instruction drift in long chains, RAG retrieval poisoning, output/format instability).
* Design prompt/model evaluation frameworks measuring accuracy plus consistency, robustness, latency, cost-per-call, and hallucination rate.
* Operationalize prompt lifecycle management as production code: versioning, CI/CD prompt tests, A/B experiments, rollback, and audited change history.
* Guide model selection and optimization (prompting vs fine-tuning vs custom training) balancing accuracy, latency, cost, and data sensitivity.
* Design RAG architectures for financial documents: chunking, embeddings, vector store design, re-ranking, and context injection.
* Oversee fine-tuning/training workflows: dataset curation, annotation quality, training configurations, and generalization across document variants.
* Build and maintain evaluation infrastructure: benchmark/golden datasets, regression suites, and automated scoring to catch regressions pre-production.
* Define confidence calibration and escalation logic so systems estimate uncertainty and route low-confidence outputs to human reviewers with the right context.
* Partner with governance/model risk and data engineering: produce validator-ready documentation (explainability/auditability) and ensure robust, refreshed data/annotation/eval pipelines; drive AI-native development practices to improve velocity.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**

* 10+ years in NLP/AI/ML or computational linguistics, including 3+ years leading technical teams with direct reports.
* Hands-on LLM internals expertise: tokenization impacts, attention limits, context window management, and temperature/sampling trade-offs.
* Proven prompt architecture design/debugging: multi-turn chains, few-/many-shot, chain-of-thought, self-consistency, and constitutional AI.
* Strong RAG system design experience: embeddings trade-offs (e.g., ada/BGE/Cohere), chunking for semi-structured docs, hybrid retrieval (dense+sparse), and re-ranking.
* Fine-tuning experience: LoRA/QLoRA, instruction tuning, RLHF/DPO, dataset curation, and evaluating tuned vs prompted performance.
* Python + ML engineering proficiency: PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangChain/LlamaIndex (or equivalents), vector DBs (Pinecone/Weaviate/pgvector), and API development.
* AI evaluation systems experience beyond F1: faithfulness, answer relevance, RAG context precision/recall, automated eval pipelines, and LLM-as-judge.
* Deep understanding of LLM failure modes: hallucinations, sycophancy, long-context instruction degradation, prompt-format sensitivity, and catastrophic forgetting.

title: Research Scientist(Speech/Voice AI)_Hyderabad
description:
Research Scientist-Speech AI

(Looking for Phd/MS)

I. Job Details

Job Type – Full Time

Location – Hyderabad

Experience – 4+years in AI/ML, with strong hands-on experience in speech/Audio/Voice

AI

II. About Us

Company Profile -It is a leader in Audio AI, Noise Cancellation, Speaker ID

and other Audio Analytics technologies. It has over 75+ patents

granted and pending in this Audio AI & analytics technologies. , a

pioneer with over 20+ years of experience in Audio solutions, is a spin-off

of the former media processing and real-time communications group of

Imagination Technologies, is the recognized leader in IP Communications

and Voice IoT technology platforms for voice, video and messaging

applications. To see how is helping top-tier OEM, IC, Call Centers

and carrier customers, with embedded software, mobile apps and end-to-

end communications solutions

Who we’re looking for

We’re looking for Research Scientists with strong hands-on experience in Voice AI. Depending on

your strengths, this might mean independently building, evaluating, optimizing, and deploying

production-grade speech/audio models – or formulating research problems, designing rigorous

experiments, developing novel approaches, and driving projects toward state-of-the-art results and

publications/patents where appropriate. Most Research Scientists here do a mix of both.

Candidates may apply against any one (or more) of the following problem tracks, based on their

interest and prior experience.

2

Across every track, you will

• Drive AI research and innovation in Speech/Audio AI

• Translate research questions into measurable hypotheses; design rigorous experiments and

ablations; analyze model behavior and failure modes; reproduce and build on relevant papers

• Take research from prototype to production-grade, deployable systems

• Define appropriate objective and subjective evaluation metrics, and run benchmarking, error

analysis, and statistical comparisons to know when a model is actually better – not just different

• Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, product, and DSP/embedded teams

• Bring strong problem-solving ability – debug, iterate, and optimize models under real-world

constraints

• Stay current with SOTA literature and bring new techniques into the team; publish or patent

where appropriate

Track 1: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR)

• Work on end-to-end ASR architectures (Transformer, Conformer, RNN-T) for streaming speech

recognition

• Work with speech foundation models (Whisper-style architectures) and self-supervised models

(HuBERT, wav2vec 2.0, WavLM) for representation learning and fine-tuning

• Own the end-to-end ASR pipeline – preprocessing, feature extraction, acoustic modeling, and

decoding/language modeling

• Research streaming and causal architectures under strict latency constraints

• Improve robustness under noisy, multi-accent, and low-resource conditions – starting with

Indian-English / regional Indian accents, with a roadmap to scale to international accents and

languages

• Research accent-invariant / accent-normalized representations – removing accent information

from learned embeddings to improve generalization across accents and geographies

• Study representation quality and robustness across speakers, accents, recording conditions, and

domains

• Evaluated on: WER, CER, RTF, latency, memory

• Preferred background: prior work on CTC/RNN-T, self-supervised pretraining, or Whisper

finetuning

Track 2: Text-to-Speech (TTS)

3

• Work on flow-matching / diffusion-based TTS systems (in the spirit of CosyVoice, ZipVoice,

VITS, and similar SOTA architectures) for real-time, low-compute synthesis

• Experience with duration-controlled, time-aligned TTS using forced alignment (e.g., MFA) and

Monotonic Alignment Search (MAS) for multi-speaker settings

• Research controllable accent adaptation using speaker, accent, linguistic, prosodic, and/or style

representations – including decoder-side conditioning and representation-level approaches –

starting with Indian-English and US-English accent pairs and scaling to international accents •

Research controllable duration, timing, rhythm, F0, and prosody modeling for natural accent

rendering

• Improve naturalness, prosody, and voice-cloning quality

• Optimize inference for real-time, streaming synthesis on constrained hardware

• Evaluated on: MOS, speaker similarity, intelligibility, prosody, RTF

• Preferred background: prior work with neural vocoders, diffusion/flow-matching TTS, or zeroshot

voice cloning

Track 3: Speech Enhancement / Noise Suppression

• Develop time-domain, spectral-domain, and hybrid speech enhancement models for real-time

applications

• Work across both single-microphone and multi-microphone / multi-channel scenarios,

including beamforming-informed approaches

• Improve performance in low-SNR, reverberant, and non-stationary noise conditions

• Evaluate using objective and perceptual metrics under challenging real-world acoustic

conditions

• Optimize for low latency and low compute for edge / embedded deployment

• Evaluated on: SI-SDR, PESQ, STOI, DNSMOS, latency, compute

• Preferred background: prior work on single- or multi-channel speech enhancement, beamforming,

or DNS Challenge-style benchmarks

Track 4: Model Optimization • Work on quantization (including quantization-aware training),

pruning, and knowledge distillation for speech/audio models

• Optimize inference pipelines (e.g., ONNX / TensorRT-class toolchains) for low-latency,

lowpower edge and embedded deployment

• Profile end-to-end pipelines across CPU/GPU/NPU targets to identify model- and system-level

bottlenecks – the neural network isn’t always the actual latency bottleneck

• Benchmark and profile models across hardware platforms, balancing latency, throughput, and

memory trade-offs

4

• Preferred background: prior work with model compression, quantization-aware training, or on

device inference

Also of interest

We’re also excited about adjacent problems – target speaker extraction, accent conversion, source

separation, bandwidth extension, and packet loss concealment, Speech Translation. If you’ve

worked on any of these, tell us about it.

Core Skills / Qualifications Required:

• Strong programming skills in Python and AI/ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow)

• Strong ML/DL fundamentals, including CNNs, RNNs, LSTMs, and Transformers applied to

speech/audio

• Good understanding of signal processing, linear algebra, optimization techniques, statistics, and

pattern recognition

• Minimum 4 years of hands-on experience in the Audio/Speech/Voice AI domain

• Ability to independently design and run experiments; strong debugging and analytical skills

• Self-motivated to learn, explore new areas, and work independently

• Hands-on experience with Generative AI concepts, including GANs, Flow Matching, and

Diffusion Models.

Nice to have:

• Working knowledge of C/C++ and CUDA (required for Track 4: Model Optimization)

• Experience with ONNX/TensorRT, Kaldi, ESPnet, NeMo, or Hugging Face

• Experience with embedded/edge deployment

• Publications, patents, or open-source contributions in speech/audio

We value strong fundamentals, research thinking, experimental rigor, and problem-solving ability

over familiarity with any specific framework or model architecture.

Qualification: Bachelor’s / Master’s / PhD in AI/ML, CSE, ECE, or related field

The Databricks Architect / Lead Engineer holds day-to-day engineering leadership of the pod on this engagement. This role works daily with the onshore technical lead to review open questions, resolve ambiguity, and ensure the pod team has clear, prioritized work at all times — at the start of each sprint and throughout it. The Architect / Lead Engineer serves as the primary technical liaison between the onshore Core Team and the hybrid internal team, translating backlog items into assignable tasks, tracking progress against sprint goals daily, and escalating blockers promptly.

This role carries technical and delivery accountability beyond task coordination. The Architect / Lead Engineer is expected to ask the clarifying questions that prevent rework, challenge ambiguity rather than work around it, and maintain a consistent pace of delivery across the pod.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Meet daily with the onshore technical lead to review open questions, clarify requirements, and confirm priorities.

* Own technical quality for the pod's output, including code review, data quality validation, and adherence to the platform's security model (RLS/CLS).
* Identify risks, dependencies, and scope gaps early, and escalate them to the onshore lead outside of standing meetings when necessary.
* Lead the pod's knowledge transfer from the onshore Integration & Middleware team on Boomi integration patterns (e.g., JDE-Concur, JDE-UKG), and plan the pod's transition to build, validation, and support responsibility for those integrations.
* Mentor Senior and Data Engineers on the pod, developing their ability to work independently and resolve ambiguity on their own.

  **Certified**

  **SQL and Python**
  skills, with the ability to review and provide feedback on others' code.

  — JD Edwards (JDE) directly preferred, with EcoSys or Microsoft Dynamics also relevant — into a governed lakehouse or warehouse, including general ledger, cost, and project financial data.

title: Director Data Products, Platform Innovation & Adoption
description:
**Summary**
Lead the strategy, governance, innovation, adoption, and operations of Enterprise Data Products, AI-ready Data Foundations, Data Sharing, and Data & Analytics Platforms across Novartis. Drive the delivery of trusted, compliant, reusable, and interoperable data capabilities that accelerate Analytics, GenAI, Agentic AI, and digital transformation while maximizing business value. Partner across business, architecture, governance, engineering, security, and vendor ecosystems to scale enterprise data foundations and industrialize innovative platform capabilities, products, and accelerators.
  
  
**About The Role**
**Major Accountabilities**

* Define and execute enterprise data product, data sharing, and platform strategies aligned with Data Mesh, Lakehouse, AI, and enterprise architecture principles
* Lead platform innovation initiatives across Data, Analytics, Integration, GenAI, Agentic AI, Semantic Layer, Knowledge Graph, and automation technologies, driving incubation and industrialization of reusable capabilities.
* Establish AI-ready data foundations by enabling metadata management, data quality, lineage, observability, semantic context, and machine-readable data contracts.
* Drive enterprise data sharing and interoperability through data marketplaces, zero-copy sharing, federated access models, semantic standards, and governed data exchange architectures.
* Ensure governance, compliance, and risk management across data, analytics, integration, and AI platforms, embedding security, privacy, audit, and regulatory requirements into platform operations.
* Build strategic partnerships with business and technology stakeholders to align priorities, shape demand, guide roadmaps, and translate platform investments into measurable business outcomes.
* Drive adoption, evangelization, and value realization of enterprise data products and platform capabilities through stakeholder engagement, enablement programs, and performance measurement.
* Lead continuous improvement and vendor ecosystem management to enhance platform reliability, scalability, cost efficiency, operational excellence, and innovation outcomes.

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Data Management, or a related discipline; advanced degree preferred.
* 15+ years of experience in Enterprise Data, Analytics, Integration Platforms, Data Products, Data Sharing, or Digital Platform environments.
* Proven experience in enterprise-scale solution architecture, platform transformation, product leadership, and technology innovation
* Strong expertise in Data Mesh, Data Lakes, Lakehouse architectures, Enterprise Data Products, and AI-ready data foundations
* Hands-on knowledge of data sharing frameworks, Data Marketplaces, Data Contracts, Semantic Layers, Knowledge Graphs, and federated governance models
* Demonstrated experience managing data governance, compliance, privacy, security, risk management, and regulatory requirements in complex organizations.
* Strong stakeholder management and leadership experience across business, technology, governance, and executive teams within global matrix organizations
* Experience with modern data and AI ecosystems, including platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, Collibra, Ataccama, Immuta, Reltio, Power BI, and GenAI/AI-ML technologies

title: Gen AI- Applied AI Engineer
description:
Job Description: Generative AI (GenAI) Developer

**Job Title:**
Generative AI Developer / GenAI Engineer

**Experience:**
5+ Years

**Location:**
Hyderabad

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Generative AI Developer with 5+ years of software development experience to design, develop, and deploy production-ready AI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and AI Agent frameworks.

The ideal candidate should have strong Python development skills and hands-on experience in LLM integration, RAG pipelines, vector databases, and cloud deployment.

Knowledge of the Power Transmission domain and substation communication protocols will be an added advantage.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, and deploy GenAI applications using LLMs, RAG, and AI Agent frameworks.
* Build end-to-end RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, indexing, semantic search, and retrieval optimization.
* Integrate commercial and open-source LLMs.
* Implement prompt engineering, structured outputs, function calling, and tool integrations.
* Develop scalable REST APIs and backend services using Python frameworks such as FastAPI or Flask.
* Optimize AI application accuracy, performance, latency, and cost.
* Implement appropriate guardrails and security measures.
* Deploy, monitor, and maintain applications on cloud platforms.
* Follow software engineering best practices, CI/CD, and automated testing.
* Collaborate with stakeholders and engineering teams to translate business requirements into scalable GenAI solutions.

Required Technical Skills

**1. Programming**

* Strong Python development skills
* Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)
* REST API development

**2. Generative AI & LLMs**

* Large Language Models (LLMs)
* Prompt Engineering
* Embeddings
* Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
* LLM Integration

**3. Frameworks**

* LangChain
* LangGraph
* LlamaIndex or equivalent frameworks

**4. LLM Platforms**

* OpenAI
* Azure OpenAI
* AWS Bedrock
* Google Gemini
* Anthropic Claude
* Open-source LLMs

**5. Vector Databases**

* Pinecone
* FAISS
* Chroma
* Milvus or equivalent

**6. Databases**

* SQL / NoSQL
* PostgreSQL
* MongoDB

**7. Cloud & DevOps**

* AWS / Azure / GCP
* Docker
* Git
* CI/CD pipelines

Nice to Have – Power Transmission & Communication Protocols

**Power Transmission Domain Knowledge:**

* Transmission lines and substations
* Transformers, switchgear, and circuit breakers
* Protection relays and substation automation
* SCADA, Energy Management Systems (EMS), and Substation Automation Systems (SAS)
* IEDs, RTUs, grid monitoring, fault analysis, and asset maintenance

**Substation Communication Protocols:**

* IEC 61850 architecture
* Logical Nodes
* MMS, GOOSE, and Sampled Values (SV)
* Substation Configuration Language (SCL)
* ICD, CID, IID, and SCD files

Candidate Profile

* 5+ years of overall software development experience.
* Hands-on experience developing and deploying GenAI/LLM-based applications.
* Strong Python and RAG implementation experience.
* Ability to build scalable, production-ready AI solutions.
* Power Transmission domain knowledge is an added advantage.

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
Role: Senior Network Engineer

Experience: 5+ years

Location: Hyderabad

Education: Minimum 15 years of full-time education

**JOB PURPOSE :**

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Network Engineer to design, implement, and maintain our network

infrastructure. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in network administration and

architecture, with a strong focus on security and performance optimization. This role involves mentoring

Junior Network Engineers and ensuring the reliability and efficiency of our network systems.

**Accountabilities and Responsibilities:**

• Design, deploy and maintain functional networks (LAN, WLAN, WAN, Wi-Fi)

• Design, deploy and maintain the Paragon network infrastructure.

• Support Paragon’s in-house and cloud-based networks, respond to tickets within agreed SLA’s ensuring

all incidents are resolved and documented

• Accountable for Paragon’s network boundary and security systems covering IDS/IPS, Advanced threat

prevention, Web content filtering, DNS protection, and DLP

• Management and Configuration of all network devices in line with industry best practices and regulatory

controls across routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, VPN and Wi-fi.

• Monitor network performance and ensure system availability and reliability.

• Resolve network issues escalated by ticket or direct notification

• Automate tasks and monitor their effectiveness.

• Escalation management, 3rd line support, and development of the Paragon Global network

• Deliver positive leadership, mentoring and development of all team members delivering a collaborative

and cohesive working environment

• Create, oversee, and test security measures (e.g. access authentication and disaster recovery).

• Create, update and maintain complete technical documentation.

• Suggest improvements to network performance, capacity, and scalability.

• Required to perform out of hours work upon agreement and will be part of an on-call rota for Incident

support and resolution

• Perform system maintenance, patching and updates ensuring compliance with Paragon’s security policies

and controls.

• May be required to travel to site (Paragon or Client)

Competencies

• Technical Expertise – Advanced Formal training or equivalent experience in Networking systems design,

configuration and support

• Relationship Management - Able to communicate clearly and concisely to both technical and non

technical personnel. This may include contact with Paragon’s clients.

• Able to deliver a clear message instilling confidence in the Technology team to deliver results. Able to

demonstrate good written and verbal communication, influencing and negotiation skills

• Customer Management - Able to work with internal and external customers to establish/validate

requirements. Understands that colleagues in the business are customers and adopts a Service Excellence

ethos. Able to communicate effectively with non-technical staff

• Quality Management - Understands Paragon’s Quality policy and able to follow standard operating

procedures

• Change Management – Understands and adheres fully to Paragon’s Change Management procedure

• Project Management – Understands the Paragon Technology Project methodology and complies with

standards set. Communicates in a timely manner on any assigned actions, risks, issues and dependencies.

Defines, documents and carries out service improvements within the Paragon network.

• ITIL – Foundation course completed, understands and follows ITIL practices and procedures

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team with excellent organisational and mentoring skills.

**Skills:**

• Expert knowledge of routing protocols, including BGP, OSPF and EIGRP.

• Extensive experience with campus networking technologies (Cisco, Juniper and HP).

• Strong expertise in wireless networking (Meraki and Ruckus).

• In-depth experience with datacentre networking, including Cisco Nexus and NDFC, Arista CloudVision,

EVPN VXLAN, and Juniper/Cisco routing platforms.

• Advanced knowledge of IPsec VPN technologies.

• Extensive experience in designing and configuring Palo Alto firewalls.

• Additional experience with Cisco ASA, Fortinet and Juniper SRX firewalls.

• Strong background in load balancing and WAF technologies (F5, Kemp and Imperva).

• Hands-on experience with network management and monitoring tools such as SolarWinds, NetBox, Cisco

ISE and Zabbix.

• Experience in network automation, particularly with Ansible and Python, would be highly advantageous.

• Public cloud networking experience across Azure, Oracle Cloud, Megaport and AWS.

• Experience with Arista Velocloud SD-WAN (highly desirable).

• Experience supporting PCI-compliant environments.

**Qualifications:**

• Proven experience as a Senior Network Engineer.

• CCNP Certified, CCIE/CCDP is highly desirable.

• Palo Alto, AWS and Azue certifications highly desirable.

• BSc/BA in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

title: Telecommunication Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Worley is a global professional services company specializing in energy, chemicals, and resources, headquartered in Australia and operating across diverse markets worldwide. The company helps customers navigate the transition to more sustainable energy sources while supporting current energy and resource needs. Worley delivers value across the full lifecycle of assets, from consulting and engineering through installation, commissioning, decommissioning, and remediation. Its integrated, data-centric solutions address complex challenges, including renewable energy, energy storage, and carbon capture, utilization and storage (CCUS), offering professionals opportunities to work on impactful, future-focused projects.
  
**Role Description**
The Telecommunication Engineer will design, implement, and maintain telecommunications systems and networks that support project and operational requirements for Worley and its customers. Day-to-day responsibilities include preparing telecom designs and drawings, specifying equipment, supporting installation and commissioning, and troubleshooting network and communication issues. The role involves collaborating with multidisciplinary engineering teams, vendors, and construction personnel to ensure compliance with industry standards, project specifications, and safety requirements. The engineer will also contribute to documentation, testing procedures, and continuous improvement of telecom infrastructure and associated technologies. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Hyderabad.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong foundation in telecommunications engineering, including network architecture, wired and wireless communication systems, and industrial communication protocols.
* Experience with telecom systems design and integration for industrial or energy-sector projects, such as fiber-optic networks, IP-based communication, radio systems, and SCADA interfaces.
* Proficiency in relevant design and documentation tools (e.g., CAD software, network design tools) and ability to produce accurate drawings, schematics, and technical specifications.
* Knowledge of applicable telecom standards, codes, and regulatory requirements, with a focus on safety, reliability, and cybersecurity in engineering solutions.
* Effective collaboration and communication skills for working in multidisciplinary teams, coordinating with vendors and contractors, and preparing clear technical reports.
* Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunication Engineering, Electronics and Communication, or a closely related engineering discipline.
* Prior experience in the energy, resources, or industrial project environment is an advantage, especially in large-scale infrastructure or EPC projects.
* Ability to work on-site in Hyderabad, manage multiple tasks and priorities, and maintain a detail-oriented, quality-focused approach.

description:
**Why Ryan?**

* Flexibility Built for Life: Hybrid and remote work options, depending on the role
* Benefits Starting Day One: Healthcare effective on your first day for you and your eligible dependents
* Support for Growing Families: 14 weeks of 100% paid paternity leave, including adoption, plus access to a fertility assistance program
* Time to Recharge: Generous paid time off and flexible working environment
* Investing in Your Future: Professional certification and tuition reimbursement after one year of service and unlimited access to LinkedIn Learning
* Support Wherever You Work: Monthly reimbursements for eligible commuter expenses when working onsite, as well as phone and home internet costs
* Fitness Reimbursement: Choose a monthly gym membership or eligible home fitness equipment reimbursement
* An Award-Winning Workplace: Join a culture recognized for its team member experience

**Job Description Summary**
The Analyst - QA is responsible for ensuring the quality of software being delivered by the IT Applications Team. This includes the use of both manual and automated testing to ensure that software not only functions as the end user expects but also that software is in compliance with Ryan standards.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Duties and responsibilities, as they align to Ryan’s Key Results**
**People**

* Create a positive team member experience.
* Provides feedback to Business Analysts to ensure that requirements and acceptance criteria are clear and specific enough to convey the needs of the business.

**Client**

* Responds to client inquiries and requests from tax authorities.

**Value**

* Develops, executes and maintains test plans
* Reads and translates requirements into meaningful manual and automated test cases
* Executes test plans and provides meaningful feedback on results
* Works with Application developers to resolve issues and document bugs
* Use Azure DevOps to document issues and enhancements in the appropriate manner
* Maintains a schedule of testing across multiple software applications to ensure prompt feedback to developers
* Develops and maintains documentation for all testing activities
* Assumes responsibility for the quality and compliance with standards and requirements for all Ryan applications
* Alerts the Product team to potential issues in a constant feedback loop
* Performs other duties as needed and assigned
* Regression testing of the applications during the application release.

**Education And Experience**
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science is preferred or equivalent work experience. Four or more years of hands-on administration experience with Software Quality Assurance and issue documentation.Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Azure DevOps is preferred. Exposure to automation testing, ideally Playwright with C#, and AI-enabled applications or AI-assisted testing is a plus.
  
  
**Computer Skills**
To perform this job successfully, an individual must have advanced knowledge of Microsoft® Word, Excel, and PowerPoint; strong analytical skills; strong oral and written communication skills; and excellent customer service skills and attitude. Experience with SQL is a plus. Willingness to develop automation skills is desirable
  
  
**Certificates And Licenses**
Valid driver's license required.
  
  
**Supervisory Responsibilities**
This position has no supervisory responsibilities.
  
  
**Work Environment**

* Standard indoor working environment
* Occasional long periods of sitting while working at computer
* Position requires regular interaction with employees at all levels of the Firm and interface with external vendors as necessary
* Independent travel requirement: less than 10%

*Equal Opportunity Employer: disability/veteran*
**About Ryan**
Build More Than a Career. Create Your Future.
  
  
Ryan is an award-winning global tax services and software provider and the only global-scale specialist in business tax. We combine deep tax expertise with consulting, technology, advocacy, and compliance solutions to solve complex challenges and help clients pay only what they owe, freeing capital to invest, grow, and thrive.
  
  
At Ryan, team members contribute to meaningful work for many of the world’s most respected organizations. From day one, you’ll have opportunities to solve complex problems, build deep expertise, take ownership of your work, and make a measurable impact while growing at the speed of your own ability.
  
  
Our high-performance, people-first culture is supported by the acclaimed
*myRyan*

The AI Platform Engineer supports the Data Mesh program by designing and implementing solutions that automate the creation, execution, and validation of unit test cases for code written by software engineers and AI-assisted development tools. The role establishes scalable frameworks for automated test generation across PySpark, Scala, and .NET codebases, improving engineering quality, consistency, and delivery speed. Working closely with platform, data, engineering, architecture, and governance teams, the role ensures that both AI-generated and developer-authored code meet enterprise quality standards before promotion into production environment.

* Design, build, and enhance platform capabilities that automate unit test generation for code written in PySpark, Scala, and .NET to improve quality and engineering efficiency.

* Build solutions that validate code produced by engineers, AI coding assistants, and code generation tools to ensure code quality prior to production deployment.

* Partner with engineering and architecture teams to standardize testing patterns across distributed data pipelines and platform services to improve enterprise consistency.
* Contribute to governance and best practices for the responsible use of AI in software engineering and test automation to support controlled innovation.
* Work closely with platform, data, engineering, architecture, and governance teams to align automated testing solutions with enterprise requirements and delivery priorities.
* Support internal developer productivity initiatives by enabling scalable, repeatable, and governed testing solutions.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Establish metrics and reporting for unit test coverage, testing effectiveness, adoption, and defect leakage to support continuous improvement and governance.

* This job works closely with platform engineering, data engineering, software engineering, architecture, and governance teams to design and implement automated testing capabilities.
* This job collaborates with CI/CD, DevOps, and developer enablement teams to embed testing and quality controls into delivery pipelines and engineering workflows.
* This job partners with data product and service teams to validate transformation logic, schema compliance, contract adherence, and business rule implementation.
* This job interacts with stakeholders responsible for AI-assisted development and internal accelerators to establish controls for AI-generated code and tests.
* This job supports broader engineering teams through documentation, onboarding materials, templates, and reusable standards to drive enterprise adoption.

**AUTHORITIES/DECISION RIGHTS:**

* As a key contributor to the business unit, this job has the authority to recommend changes to business processes in order to enhance operational efficiency and effectiveness.

* Enterprise platform role supporting automated testing capabilities across multiple engineering teams and Data Mesh-aligned data products and services.

* Supports quality validation for both developer-authored and AI-generated code.

**Must Have Skills:**

* 7+ years of experience in software engineering, platform engineering, or quality engineering. This includes hands-on work in automated testing and in distributed data processing.
* Knowledge of software engineering, platform engineering, quality engineering, and test automation practices.
* Knowledge of automated unit testing framework design and implementation.
* Knowledge of PySpark, Scala, and .NET / C# development practices, with hands-on experience in at least two.
* Knowledge of CI/CD pipeline integration and enterprise software delivery processes.
* Knowledge of distributed data processing and data engineering platforms.

title: Predictive Science -  AI Engineering & Prompt Architecture Lead - Vice President
description:
**Job Description**
Take a lead role in acquiring, managing and retaining meaningful relationships that deliver outstanding experience to our customers. In this role, you will balance your focus on business results by offering options and finding solutions to help our customers with issues.
  
  
As a Vice President – AI Engineering & Prompt Architecture Lead in Predictive Science, you will own the technical vision and delivery for a team of prompt engineers and AI/ML model developers building intelligent document processing and data extraction solutions in the KYC/AML domain.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Architect agentic, multi-step AI workflows chaining classification → extraction → cross-validation → exception routing with human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
* Debug and remediate complex prompt failures (context-window overflow, instruction drift in long chains, RAG retrieval poisoning, output/format instability).
* Design prompt/model evaluation frameworks measuring accuracy plus consistency, robustness, latency, cost-per-call, and hallucination rate.
* Operationalize prompt lifecycle management as production code: versioning, CI/CD prompt tests, A/B experiments, rollback, and audited change history.
* Guide model selection and optimization (prompting vs fine-tuning vs custom training) balancing accuracy, latency, cost, and data sensitivity.
* Design RAG architectures for financial documents: chunking, embeddings, vector store design, re-ranking, and context injection.
* Oversee fine-tuning/training workflows: dataset curation, annotation quality, training configurations, and generalization across document variants.
* Build and maintain evaluation infrastructure: benchmark/golden datasets, regression suites, and automated scoring to catch regressions pre-production.
* Define confidence calibration and escalation logic so systems estimate uncertainty and route low-confidence outputs to human reviewers with the right context.
* Partner with governance/model risk and data engineering: produce validator-ready documentation (explainability/auditability) and ensure robust, refreshed data/annotation/eval pipelines; drive AI-native development practices to improve velocity.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**

* 10+ years in NLP/AI/ML or computational linguistics, including 3+ years leading technical teams with direct reports.
* Hands-on LLM internals expertise: tokenization impacts, attention limits, context window management, and temperature/sampling trade-offs.
* Proven prompt architecture design/debugging: multi-turn chains, few-/many-shot, chain-of-thought, self-consistency, and constitutional AI.
* Strong RAG system design experience: embeddings trade-offs (e.g., ada/BGE/Cohere), chunking for semi-structured docs, hybrid retrieval (dense+sparse), and re-ranking.
* Fine-tuning experience: LoRA/QLoRA, instruction tuning, RLHF/DPO, dataset curation, and evaluating tuned vs prompted performance.
* Python + ML engineering proficiency: PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangChain/LlamaIndex (or equivalents), vector DBs (Pinecone/Weaviate/pgvector), and API development.
* AI evaluation systems experience beyond F1: faithfulness, answer relevance, RAG context precision/recall, automated eval pipelines, and LLM-as-judge.
* Deep understanding of LLM failure modes: hallucinations, sycophancy, long-context instruction degradation, prompt-format sensitivity, and catastrophic forgetting.
* Structured output enforcement in production: JSON mode, function calling, constrained decoding, output parsers, and schema validation.
* Build-vs-buy/model selection track record: benchmarking foundation models (GPT-4/Claude/Llama/Mistral) against task requirements.
* Leadership under ambiguity: pragmatic trade-offs, rapid iteration as practices evolve, and strong communication with compliance, risk, and business stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**

* Domain expertise in KYC/AML or financial document processing: entity extraction from registries, beneficial ownership structures, sanctions screening logic, adverse media classification.
* Experience designing autonomous AI agents: tool-use patterns, planning/reasoning loops, memory architectures, and safety guardrails for regulated environments.
* Knowledge of AI security/adversarial robustness: prompt injection defense, jailbreak detection, data poisoning awareness, and output monitoring for sensitive financial data.
* Experience with model distillation to produce smaller, faster models for cost-effective deployment.
* Familiarity with AI observability/monitoring: tracking prompt/model performance, drift detection, alerting, and health dashboards.
* Experience with multi-modal AI combining OCR, layout understanding, and LLM-based extraction for complex documents.
* Advanced degree (MS/PhD) in CS/NLP/ML or equivalent depth via publications, open-source, or production system design and Passion for talent development: growing engineers from junior prompt writers into senior AI system designers via structured mentorship.

voice cloning

applications

conditions

or DNS Challenge-style benchmarks

pruning, and knowledge distillation for speech/audio models

lowpower edge and embedded deployment

bottlenecks – the neural network isn’t always the actual latency bottleneck

memory trade-offs

4

device inference

description:

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).

**Areas of Expertise**
**Full Stack Application Engineering**




+ End-to-end design and development of modern web and mobile applications using React, Angular, Next.js, Blazor, or equivalent frameworks
+ Strong backend expertise using .NET / Java / Node.js / Python, with clean architecture, domain-driven design, and API-first principles
+ Experience building microservices and distributed systems using REST, gRPC, event-driven patterns, and asynchronous processing
+ Hands-on expertise with relational and NoSQL databases (Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, Cosmos DB) and performance tuning
+ Strong understanding of state management, scalability, resiliency, and application security

**AI Driven Application Development**

* Proven expertise in AI‑driven application development, embedding intelligence directly into modern, cloud‑native applications.
* Extensive hands‑on experience using GitHub Copilot as a core engineering capability to accelerate solution design, coding, refactoring, testing, and documentation across delivery teams.
* Demonstrated ability to foster a Copilot‑assisted engineering culture (“vibe”) - enabling rapid iteration, AI pair‑programming, explain‑as‑you‑build workflows, and high‑velocity delivery without compromising engineering quality.
* Strong experience modernizing application landscapes using GitHub Copilot‑assisted approaches, including rapid codebase comprehension, dependency analysis, large‑scale refactoring, and migration to cloud‑native and AI‑enabled architectures.
* Effective use of GitHub Copilot across the entire SDLC, from solutioning and scaffolding through CI/CD automation, test generation, production readiness, and operational excellence.

* Apply Responsible AI principles across design and delivery, incorporating security, privacy, governance, and compliance controls into production‑grade engineering workflows.

**AI-Enabled Application Development**

* Ability to translate business scenarios into production‑grade AI solutions using Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Services, Azure AI Foundry, and custom ML models, with hands‑on delivery of RAG architectures leveraging Azure AI Search, vector databases, enterprise data grounding, and integration patterns.
* Strong expertise in prompt engineering, context management, grounding strategies, and LLM integration for copilots, conversational interfaces, intelligent workflows, and decision‑support applications.
* Proven experience designing and implementing single‑agent and multi‑agent AI systems, including task boundaries, tool invocation, memory management, collaboration, delegation, and coordination, using frameworks such as Semantic Kernel, LangChain, and LangGraph.
* Deep understanding of agentic workflows, combining LLM reasoning with external tools, APIs, and enterprise data sources, alongside agent lifecycle management - planning, execution, retries, failure handling, and human‑in‑the‑loop patterns.
* Designs enterprise‑ready AI solutions with built‑in observability and operational excellence, including telemetry, prompt tracing, agent behavior logging, model metrics, experimentation, drift monitoring, and cost/performance optimization, while applying Responsible AI principles across security, privacy, governance, and compliance - balancing speed, quality, and enterprise constraints at scale.

**Cloud-Native Architecture (Azure)**




+ Deep experience designing cloud‑native, PaaS‑first solutions on Azure, prioritizing managed services over IaaS to improve scalability, resilience, security, and operational efficiency.
+ Proven expertise in architecting and delivering solutions using Azure App Service, Azure Container Apps, AKS, Azure Functions, and API Management, selecting the right compute model based on workload characteristics and business needs.
+ Strong working knowledge of identity, security, and networking architectures, including Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC, Managed Identity, Key Vault integration, private endpoints, and VNET‑integrated application deployments.
+ Design and implementation of architectures that support high availability, horizontal scalability, disaster recovery, and fault tolerance, including multi‑region deployment patterns and resiliency strategies.
+ Experience in cost‑aware architecture design, applying cost optimization strategies such as right‑sizing, autoscaling, consumption‑based services, and proactive cost governance.
+ Apply Microsoft Well‑Architected Framework principles across reliability, security, performance efficiency, operational excellence, and cost optimization, incorporating architecture reviews and continuous improvement into delivery.
+ Hands‑on experience building cloud‑ready landing patterns, integrating application architectures with enterprise networking, security baselines, and platform standards.

**DevOps, Platform & Developer Productivity**




+ Strong expertise in designing and operating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions, enabling automated build, test, security scanning, and deployment workflows across environments.
+ Proven hands‑on experience with Infrastructure‑as‑Code (IaC) using Bicep, ARM, and Terraform, leveraging GitHub Copilot to scaffold modules, generate templates, and propose secure configurations aligned with enterprise standards.
+ Deep understanding of observability and reliability engineering, including centralized logging, metrics, distributed tracing, SLOs, and proactive alerting for production systems.
+ Demonstrated ability to enhance developer productivity and delivery velocity through inner‑source practices, reusable components, reference implementations, accelerators, and automation.
+ Experience embedding DevSecOps practices into delivery pipelines, including secure coding checks, dependency scanning, secrets management, policy enforcement, and compliance validation.
+ Effective use of GitHub Copilot across the DevOps lifecycle, including authoring pipeline definitions, generating runbooks and release notes, assisting with PR summaries, and accelerating troubleshooting and incident response.
+ Strong grasp of platform engineering principles, building paved‑road solutions and self‑service capabilities that balance speed, governance, and operational excellence.
+ Ability to continuously improve engineering throughput, quality, and system reliability, while maintaining enterprise security and compliance expectations.

**Solutioning, Pre-Sales & Technical Leadership**




+ Lead technical solutioning, estimations, and support architecture design during pre-sales and delivery shaping
+ Translate business outcomes into clear architecture, execution plans, and risk mitigation strategies
+ Influence technical direction across multiple teams and engagements
+ Act as a trusted advisor to clients and internal leadership

**Frontier Engineering & Customer Enablement Skills**




+ Lead rapid prototyping, pilots, and early-stage deployments for enterprise customers
+ Ability to go from whiteboard to production with minimal friction
+ Strong troubleshooting and production support expertise, including performance, reliability, and security issues
+ Side‑by‑side coding with customer engineering teams to unblock deployments and accelerate time to value
+ Outcome‑driven engineering focused on business impact, not activity
+ Building reusable assets, accelerators, and reference implementations
+ Comfortable operating in ambiguous, high-pressure environments with C-Level customer stakeholders

**Personal Attributes**

* Ability to interact confidently with senior leaders and clients.
* Strong decision-making skills and a consultative mindset.

title: IT Head
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a seasoned, strategic **Head of IT** to lead the technology architecture, digital transformation, and operational resilience across our diverse business verticals: **Media Production Studios, Commercial Malls, and Multiplex/Theater Operations**.

The ideal candidate possesses a unique blend of enterprise IT infrastructure management, high-performance media/post-production workflow expertise, and smart-building/retail IT operations (POS, building management integration, high-density public Wi-Fi, and digital cinema/exhibition technologies). You will drive operational excellence, enforce robust cybersecurity frameworks, and align technology investments with organizational growth.

Key Responsibilities**1. Enterprise & Smart Infrastructure Management (Malls & Corporate)**

· Oversee the end-to-end enterprise IT infrastructure, including data centers, server farms, enterprise storage, virtualization (VMware/Hyper-V), and hybrid cloud environments (AWS/Azure).

· Manage mission-critical IT systems for commercial mall operations, ensuring high availability of Building Management Systems (BMS), Public Address (PA) systems, CCTV/surveillance networks, and automated access controls.

· Architect and maintain high-density public Wi-Fi networks, structured cabling, and robust switching/routing backbones (L2/L3) across retail and office spaces.

· Oversee disaster recovery (DR) planning, business continuity drills, and power redundancy systems (UPS/Generators) for 24/7 retail and entertainment environments.

**2. Multiplex, Cinema & Digital Exhibition Technology**

· Oversee IT and networking infrastructure supporting digital cinema projection systems, server ingestion, and Theatre Management Systems (TMS).

· Manage automated scheduling, digital signage, box office ticketing kiosks, and secure content delivery (KDM/DCP management) in coordination with content distributors.

· Ensure ultra-low latency and absolute uptime for live-streaming, event screenings, and concessionaire point-of-sale (POS) networks.

**3. Post-Production & Media Studio Technology**

· Support high-performance media workflows including non-linear editing (Avid, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve), VFX, animation, sound design, and heavy rendering farms.

· Administer high-speed SAN/NAS environments optimized for uncompressed 4K/8K real-time collaboration.

· Manage Media Asset Management (MAM) systems, secure ingest/transcoding pipelines, and long-term digital archiving/retrieval processes.

**4. Retail & Point-of-Sale (POS) Operations**

· Ensure 99.99% uptime for mission-critical retail POS terminals, payment gateway integrations, inventory management databases, and merchant Wi-Fi networks within mall premises.

· Coordinate with tenant IT teams and retail partners to ensure seamless network integration and compliance with centre guidelines.

**5. Cybersecurity, Compliance & Data Privacy**

· Establish enterprise-wide cybersecurity policies, endpoint protection, Next-Gen Firewalls (NGFW), and SIEM tools.

· Protect high-value intellectual property (IP), unreleased media assets, and confidential tenant/customer data in compliance with data privacy regulations (e.g., DPDP Act, PCI-DSS for retail transactions).

· Conduct regular vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, and IT security audits.

**6. Vendor, Project & Budget Management**

· Lead strategic technology implementation projects, digital upgrades, and capital expenditure (CapEx/OpEx) planning.

· Manage relationships with global technology vendors, telecom operators, OEM partners, and service providers.

· Negotiate Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs), software licensing, and hardware procurement to optimize costs without compromising quality.

**7. Leadership & Cross-Functional Team Management**

· Lead, mentor, and upskill a multi-disciplinary team of IT engineers, system administrators, and helpdesk support staff.

· Define and monitor strict Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for incident resolution and system performance.

· Act as a technology advisor to executive leadership, bridging the gap between creative teams, retail management, and technical execution.

**Core Enterprise & Network Infrastructure**

· Advanced administration of Windows Server, Linux, and macOS enterprise environments.

· Enterprise networking: Cisco/Aruba L2/L3 switching, VLAN segmentation, SD-WAN, enterprise firewalls, and QoS configuration.

· Virtualization & Cloud: VMware ESXi, Hyper-V, AWS, Azure, and hybrid cloud integration.

· Active Directory, LDAP, SSO, and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) frameworks.

· Advanced backup frameworks (Veeam, Commvault) and Disaster Recovery architecture.

**Domain-Specific Expertise**

· **Retail & Mall Tech:** POS infrastructure, payment gateway security (PCI-DSS), digital signage networks, and smart building integration (BMS/CCTV).

· **Theater/Exhibition Tech:** Theatre Management Systems (TMS), digital projection networks, and ticketing system integration.

· Media / Post-Production: High-speed SAN/NAS (Avid ISIS/Nexus, Isilon, QNAP), render management (Deadline, OpenCue), and MAM workflows.

**Educational Qualifications & Credentials**

· Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Electronics, or a related technical field. Master’s degree / MBA is a plus.

Pay: ₹2,000,000.00 - ₹25,000,000.00 per year

About Ruvimo

Ruvimo is a world's fastest-growing online 1:1 tutoring company serving K–12 families in the United States.
