title: Head of Growth - D2C
description:
**Location:**
Mumbai (in-office)

**Function:**
D2C Growth & Performance Marketing

**Reports to:**
Founders

Earthful is a plant-based nutrition brand for women's health, backed by Fireside Ventures and V3 Ventures. This is a leadership role: you'll own the D2C (earthful.me) growth number end to end, and build the team behind it as the channel scales — not just run campaigns, but decide where the channel goes next.

**Role Overview**

This role leads Earthful's D2C growth engine — full ownership of the website's revenue number, driven through performance marketing, conversion optimization, and a high-velocity creative pipeline. You'll be directly accountable for hitting D2C growth targets set in the Annual Operating Plan (AOP), decide how budget is allocated across products, and build the team needed to scale that ownership over time. You'll work closely with the organic/content team, the creative team, and the website team — this starts as a hands-on individual role, but is expected to grow into leading a small team as the channel scales.

**What You'll Own**

**D2C Revenue Growth & Ownership**

• Own the D2C (earthful.me) revenue number end-to-end, driven primarily through performance marketing across Meta, Google, and other paid channels

• Be directly accountable for hitting D2C growth targets set in the AOP

• Coordinate with the organic/content team so paid and organic efforts reinforce each other rather than working at cross purposes

**Creative Pipeline for Performance**

• Direct the creative team's output for performance — a steady flow of new hooks, angles, and formats

• Run structured creative testing across campaigns

• Brief the next round of creative based on what the data shows is actually working

**Budget, ROAS & Site Conversion**

• Decide how budget is allocated across products — what to scale up, what to scale down, and the ROAS target for each

• Own website conversion end-to-end — landing page CVR, checkout drop-off, and AOV — directing the website team's roadmap around what actually moves conversion

• Own the full D2C P&L view — revenue, ad spend, and contribution margin — not just a topline growth number

**Team Building & Leadership**

• Build and lead a small performance marketing/growth team as the D2C channel scales — this starts as a hands-on, individual role but is expected to grow into managing others

• Set the growth roadmap and testing cadence for the function, not just execute your own campaigns

**Cross-Functional (Suggested Additions)**

• Track CAC and LTV alongside channel-level ROAS, so budget decisions aren't driven by vanity metrics that look good in a single channel but don't hold up at the business level

• Coordinate with Supply Chain on demand forecasting tied to growth targets — aggressive scaling only works if inventory can back it up

• Maintain a structured testing roadmap/calendar for creative and channel experiments, rather than running tests ad hoc

**What We're Looking For**

• Ideally has been part of a D2C/e-commerce brand's growth or marketing team during a scale-up phase — joining when revenue was roughly ₹0–30 Cr and helping scale it to ₹300 Cr or more

• MBA from a top-tier B-school strongly preferred, with 4–6+ years of post-MBA experience in performance marketing or growth

• At least 2+ years of experience owning a full P&L or AOP-style revenue number

• Direct, hands-on experience running and optimizing paid campaigns on Meta and Google Ads

• Prior experience building or leading a team, or clear readiness to do so as the role grows — this is a leadership-track role, not a purely individual-contributor one

• Comfortable making budget allocation calls across multiple products, trading off scale versus ROAS

• Understanding of website conversion levers (CVR, checkout drop-off, AOV) and experience working with a website/CRO team

• Strong analytical and Excel skills — comfortable building and interpreting performance dashboards

title: Human Resources Consultant
description:
Our client, World's leading health and safety organization is looking for a proactive
**HR Operations Specialist**
who goes beyond execution and brings a strong problem-solving and process improvement mindset. This role will own core HR operations while independently driving enhancements across systems, policies, and employee lifecycle processes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Talent Acquisition**

• Lead the end-to-end recruitment process, from sourcing and screening candidates to

coordinating interviews, selection, and offer rollout.

• Partner with hiring managers and department heads to understand workforce requirements,

define candidate profiles, and deliver high-quality talent aligned with business needs.

• Develop and refine job descriptions, manage job postings across relevant channels, and drive

initiatives to strengthen the organisation’s talent attraction efforts.

agencies and other sourcing channels, assess candidates against the relevant JD, and share

shortlisted profiles with hiring managers based on suitability.

actively refer relevant talent from their professional networks.

with department heads, identifying and engaging relevant campuses, conducting pre-placement

talks, and developing appropriate candidate assessment processes.

professional networking, and other strategic sourcing channels.

• Track and analyse key Talent Acquisition metrics, including time-to-fill, cost-per-hire, offer-to-join ratio, and quality of hire, using insights to identify gaps and drive continuous improvements in recruitment processes.

**HR Operations**

• Manage end-to-end HR operations, including payroll coordination, employee lifecycle -letter

drafting- visa and new joiners, management, HR documentation, and statutory compliance.

support, ensuring adherence to organisational requirements.

• Ensure accuracy, timeliness, and process discipline across all HR operations and employee

lifecycle processes.

HR updates, and statutory notices.

**Labour Code Compliance**

• Support the implementation and adoption of applicable Labour Codes, ensuring full compliance

with statutory requirements and adherence to prescribed timelines, with no deviations.

**Strategic Initiatives (Future role)**

• Identify and onboard new external partners (e.g., banking, HRMS, benefits) to strengthen

employee offerings

• Evaluate current HRMS, build understanding of existing limitations, and drive recommendations

for system upgrade/optimization

**Performance Management Support**

• Support end-to-end PMS cycle including communication, documentation, tracker management,

and releasing letters centrally to all employees (Mid year & Annual PRP)

• Ensure timely execution and process adherence across performance cycles

Skills Required

• 3–5 years of experience in Talent Acquisition and HR Operations, with exposure to payroll,

statutory compliance, and Performance Management Systems (PMS).

• Strong understanding of strategic Talent Acquisition, with the ability to translate business and

workforce requirements into effective sourcing, hiring, and talent pipeline strategies.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills (especially for formal HR documentation)

• Comfort working with HRMS systems and driving improvements

• High attention to detail with structured thinking

title: Global Human Resources Manager
description:
This is a full time role with our global client.

**Role-Global HR Manager**

**Role Purpose**

To manage Business HR, talent acquisition and HR compliance for the organisation’s businesses across North America and Europe, while being based in India. The role will partner with international business leaders to address people-related priorities, support workforce requirements, ensure compliance with local employment regulations, and facilitate effective HR service delivery across multiple countries.

The role will act as a key interface between international business teams, corporate HR in India, and local HR service providers, ensuring that HR practices are aligned with business needs while adhering to country-specific legal and regulatory requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

A. Business HR (BHR)

* Partner with business leaders across North America and Europe to understand business priorities and address HR-related requirements.
* Provide HR guidance on organisation structure, manpower planning, workforce costs and employee-related matters.
* Support business leaders in managing employee relations, grievances, disciplinary matters and workplace concerns in coordination with local legal and HR experts.
* Facilitate employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, internal movements, changes in employment terms and exits.
* Support organisational changes, restructuring and workforce transitions in line with business requirements and local regulations.
* Drive implementation of corporate HR policies and processes, ensuring appropriate adaptation to local country requirements.
* Act as a bridge between international business teams and the India-based corporate HR function.
* Build relationships with employees and leaders across nationalities, cultures and time zones, demonstrating cultural sensitivity in HR interactions.

B. Talent Acquisition and Hiring

* Partner with business leaders and hiring managers to understand manpower requirements and hiring priorities across the assigned regions.
* Manage end-to-end recruitment, including requisition management, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offer management and onboarding.
* Coordinate with recruitment agencies, search firms and other hiring partners to fulfil business requirements.
* Ensure hiring decisions and processes align with approved manpower budgets, organisational requirements and internal policies.
* Coordinate employment offers, compensation discussions and employment documentation with relevant stakeholders.
* Monitor recruitment timelines, hiring costs, vacancy status and other recruitment metrics.
* Ensure recruitment practices comply with applicable equal employment opportunity, non-discrimination and local hiring requirements.

C. HR Compliance and Employment Regulations

* Coordinate HR compliance across the United States, Canada and relevant European countries.
* Ensure employment documentation, contracts, policies and HR processes comply with applicable local employment laws and regulations.
* Work with local legal counsel, HR consultants and compliance partners on employment terms, working hours, statutory leave, employee exits, disciplinary processes and other employment requirements.
* Monitor changes in employment legislation and coordinate implementation of necessary changes to HR policies and practices.
* Maintain appropriate HR documentation, employee records, compliance trackers and audit-ready information.
* Coordinate statutory and regulatory requirements relating to employee administration, in collaboration with local experts and service providers.
* Support internal and external HR audits and ensure timely closure of identified compliance gaps.
* Ensure appropriate handling of employee information in accordance with applicable data privacy and protection requirements, including GDPR where relevant.

D. HR Operations and External Partner Coordination

* Coordinate HR operational processes across assigned countries, including onboarding, employee documentation, changes in employment status and exits.
* Liaise with local HR representatives, payroll providers, Employer of Record (EOR) partners and external consultants, wherever applicable.
* Coordinate with Finance on employee-related costs, manpower budgets, payroll inputs and related reconciliations, as required.
* Monitor service delivery, accuracy and turnaround times for HR processes managed through external partners.
* Identify opportunities to streamline HR processes and strengthen governance across countries.
* Maintain accurate employee data and provide periodic HR reports and dashboards to business and corporate HR leadership.

E. Cross-Cultural and Global Stakeholder Management

* Collaborate with stakeholders across North America, Europe and India, accounting for differences in culture, communication styles and working practices.
* Manage HR matters across different time zones and ensure timely communication and resolution of employee and business requirements.
* Promote consistency in the organisation’s HR approach while recognising country-specific employment practices and cultural nuances.

**Key Stakeholders**

* International business leaders and functional heads
* Corporate HR leadership and Business HR teams in India
* Hiring managers and recruitment partners
* Finance and payroll teams
* Local HR representatives and EOR providers
* External employment lawyers, compliance consultants and statutory service providers

**Qualifications and Experience**

* Postgraduate qualification in Human Resources, Business Administration or a related discipline.
* Typically 7+ years of progressive HR experience, with relevant exposure to international or multi-country HR management.
* Experience in Business HR and talent acquisition within a multinational organisation.
* Working knowledge of employment regulations and HR practices across North America and Europe.

You will work closely with Business Development, technology, design, data and delivery teams to shape differentiated digital solutions that address client needs and create measurable business value.

2. Digital & Technology Understanding: Strong understanding of digital products, platforms, applications, e-commerce ecosystems, customer experience and technology-led solutions. Ability to work closely with design and engineering teams.
3. Product Thinking & Problem Solving: Ability to identify customer and business needs, translate them into product requirements, define features and prioritise solutions based on business impact and user value.
4. Business & Commercial Acumen: Understanding of business models, product-market fit, monetisation opportunities and growth levers. Ability to connect product decisions with commercial outcomes.
5. Communication & Stakeholder Management: Strong presentation and storytelling skills, with the ability to articulate product concepts, build compelling solution propositions and engage with senior client stakeholders.

title: Inside Sales Specialist
description:
**Background**

Praan (Praan, Inc.) is an impact focused deep-tech startup democratizing clean air using breakthrough filterless technology. The company is backed by top tier VCs and CXOs globally and currently operates between the United States and India. Our team puts extreme attention to detail and loves building technology that's aspirational. Praan's team and culture is positioned to empower people to solve large global problems at an accelerated pace.

**Why?**

Everyone worries about the dooms-day in climate change which is expected to occur in the 2050s. However, there's one doom's day which is the reality for millions of people around the world today. Air pollution takes more than 7 Million lives globally every single year. Over 5% of premature children death occur due to air pollution in developing countries. Everyone has relied on governments or experts to solve the problem, but most solutions up until today have either been too expensive or too ineffective. Praan is an attempt at making the future cleaner, healthier, and safer for the generations to come.

**What you'll do**

* Own inbound leads from our website, WhatsApp, Instagram, events, and referrals, and reply within hours, not days.
* Qualify each lead: the space, the air quality problem, budget, timeline, and who makes the decision.
* Run product walkthroughs and video demos, and explain how filterless purification works without the jargon.
* Close home and small business deals end to end, covering the quote, negotiation, payment, and handover to installation.
* Qualify large project leads (developers, architects, corporates) and pass them to the BDM team with full context.
* Follow up on warm leads and bring cold ones back to life.
* Work with our project team on site surveys and installations so the customer is never left guessing.
* Keep the CRM accurate and your pipeline numbers honest.
* Share what you hear on calls with product and marketing: objections, pricing pushback, feature requests.

**What you bring**

* 1 to 5 years in inside sales or customer-facing sales where you owned closures, not just call volumes
* A record of hitting monthly targets, and numbers to back it up
* Experience selling a considered, higher-ticket product to buyers who ask a lot of questions
* Clear, warm communication on phone, video, and WhatsApp.
* Fast follow-up and good CRM discipline
* Enough curiosity to learn the technical basics and explain them simply

**Good to have**

* Experience selling air purifiers, HVAC, water purifiers, smart home products, or premium appliances
* Experience selling to HNI households, interior designers, or architects
* Hands-on experience with HubSpot, Zoho, or Salesforce

**Praan is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, religion, caste, gender, disability or any other criteria. We just care about working with great human beings!**

title: Strategic Pre-Sales & Outreach Specialist - India
description:
**Strategic Pre-Sales & Outreach Specialist India**

Location: Mumbai (Work-from-Office)

Department: Sales

Industry: FinTech / SaaS

Experience: 1-2 years

Compensation: Competitive ·

Market: India (large enterprises)

About Global PayEX

Global PayEX is an AI-driven FinTech platform trusted by JPMorgan, Citi, ITC and Tata Group. We automate the Order-to-Cash (O2C) cycle: cash application, reconciliation, payments and working-capital workflows. As we scale across India, the US and APAC, we are replacing manual sales motion with a tech-first, AI-augmented growth engine.

Role Overview

India is won on the phone majorly. We are hiring a Strategic Pre-Sales & Outreach Specialist to run senior-level conversations with CFOs, Finance Heads, Controllers and Heads of Order-to-Cash at India's large enterprises. This is not a "do you have a requirement?" calling job. You will walk into each call knowing the company, its ERP and its likely receivables pain, help the CFO see the problem in their own numbers, and earn a yes to a demo.

Calling leads, email follows and LinkedIn supports. You will use AI tools to research each account, prepare the call and sequence the follow-up, so every conversation is informed and every touchpoint is relevant. Your North Star: 20+ qualified demos held per month with senior finance leaders at target enterprises. A demo counts only when it actually happens.

Key Responsibilities

**Strategic calling to senior finance leaders:**
Run consultative calls with CFOs, VPs Finance, Controllers and Heads of O2C. Open with a relevant reference, ask one sharp question at a time, and uncover how many people, hours and rupees go into payment matching, reconciliation and collections.

**Pain-point discovery and conversion:**
Handle objections such as "we do it in-house" or "we just implemented an ERP" with domain-led reframes, build the problem in the prospect's own numbers, and secure a committed demo.

**Account research and call prep:**
Before every call, understand the company's business, ERP landscape, payment channels, recent news and finance org. Use AI tools to speed up research and tailor the call.
**Multi-threaded account coverage:**
Work every account across multiple decision makers, never stopping at one conversation. Follow each call with email and LinkedIn, and request warm intros through bank RMs, existing customers and our leadership network.

**AI-assisted outreach:**
Use AI wherever it adds value: account and contact research, call briefs, personalised email and LinkedIn messaging, call-note summaries, and sequencing in AI tools.

**Demo handover:**
Brief the sales team with a clear picture of the prospect's pain, stakeholders and current setup, so the demo starts at depth, not at introductions.

**Pipeline hygiene and reporting:**
Log every attempt, channel, outcome, next step and reason for closure in the CRM (Pipedrive). Report weekly on calls, conversations, demos and objections, and feed what you learn back into the pitch.

**Account discipline:**
Follow our rules on mining, unreachable and closed accounts, and check before contacting group companies of existing customers.

**What We're Looking For**

* 1-2 years in outbound sales, pre-sales or business development in B2B SaaS, FinTech or enterprise finance solutions, with a track record of booking meetings with senior stakeholders.
* Comfort calling CFOs and Finance Heads at large Indian enterprises, and holding your ground when the first answer is "no".
* Working knowledge of O2C and AR: cash application, reconciliation, collections, DSO, bank and virtual-account payments, GST and input-credit implications.
* Familiarity with ERP landscapes common in Indian enterprises (SAP, Oracle, Tally, Microsoft Dynamics) and enough technical fluency to discuss integrations and security without being a developer.
* Strong consultative skills: one question at a time, listen, reframe, and ask for the next step.
* Executive presence and clear spoken and written English; Hindi is a plus.
* A tinkerer's mindset with AI: you already use AI tools for research, prep and automation. Exposure to Smartlead, Lemlist, Apollo, Sales Navigator, Clay, Hubspot or similar is a plus.
* Disciplined CRM habits: every attempt logged, every next step dated.

**Why Join Global PayEX**

**Real senior-level exposure:**
Talk to CFOs of India's leading enterprises from day one.

**Backed and referenceable:**
Sell a product used by marquee enterprises and banks.

**Career growth:**
Fast track into Account Executive, Solution Consulting or Growth Lead roles. Innovation culture: We move fast, test constantly and believe sales is human plus AI.

**How to Apply**

Send your CV or LinkedIn profile to hr@globalpayex.com with the subject line "Strategic Pre-Sales & Outreach Specialist (India) | [Your Name]".

**The Call Challenge (required):**

In your email, include a short opening script (3–4 sentences) for a first call to the CFO of an Indian enterprise of your choice. It must reference a specific finance pain point or recent company news you uncovered, name the AI tool you used, and end with one question, not a pitch.

description:
# Job Description – Business Development Manager (B2G – Government Sales)

\*\*Company:\*\* SecureNova Systems Pvt. Ltd.

\*\*Position:\*\* Business Development Manager – B2G (Government Sales)

\*\*Department:\*\* Sales & Business Development

\*\*Location:\*\* Malad West, Mumbai

\*\*Experience:\*\* 10+ Years

\*\*Employment Type:\*\* Full-Time

\*\*Industry Preference:\*\* IT Solutions / System Integration / Government Projects

### About the Role

We are looking for a highly experienced, result-oriented and strategically driven Business Development Manager with strong exposure to Government Sales (B2G). The candidate will be responsible for developing government business opportunities, establishing relationships with government departments and authorities, driving tenders and institutional sales, and generating sustainable business revenue.

Candidates with strong IT industry knowledge, government procurement experience and an established network across government departments will be highly preferred.

### Key Responsibilities

1. \*\*Government Business Development:\*\* Identify, develop and generate new business opportunities across Central Government, State Government, PSUs, Government Departments, Municipal Corporations and other government institutions.

2. \*\*Government Networking:\*\* Build and maintain strong relationships with government officers, decision-makers, procurement heads, consultants and key stakeholders.

3. \*\*Tender & GeM Management:\*\* Identify relevant opportunities through GeM, CPPP, state e-procurement portals and other government tender platforms.

4. \*\*End-to-End Sales Cycle:\*\* Manage the complete business development cycle, including lead generation, client meetings, requirement gathering, product demonstrations, technical discussions, quotations, proposals, tender participation, negotiations and order closure.

5. \*\*IT Solutions & Product Sales:\*\* Promote IT infrastructure, hardware, software, servers, storage, networking, CCTV surveillance, cybersecurity, AV/VC solutions, command and control systems and other technology-driven solutions.

6. \*\*Strategic Business Planning:\*\* Develop and execute a structured B2G sales strategy with clear revenue targets, account plans, market penetration strategies and business growth objectives.

7. \*\*New Market Development:\*\* Explore new government departments, geographical territories, business verticals and institutional opportunities to expand the company's presence.

8. \*\*OEM & Channel Coordination:\*\* Coordinate with OEMs, distributors, system integrators and technology partners to develop competitive business proposals and deliver end-to-end solutions.

9. \*\*Tender Execution Coordination:\*\* Work closely with the pre-sales, technical, procurement, finance and execution teams to ensure timely tender submissions and successful project delivery.

10. \*\*Revenue & Target Achievement:\*\* Take ownership of assigned sales targets, order booking, gross margins, collections and overall business profitability.

11. \*\*Competitor & Market Analysis:\*\* Monitor government procurement trends, upcoming projects, competitor activities, budget allocations and emerging business opportunities.

12. \*\*CRM & Pipeline Management:\*\* Maintain accurate records of leads, government contacts, tender opportunities, proposals, follow-ups, expected order values and sales forecasts.

13. \*\*Client Relationship Management:\*\* Maintain long-term relationships with existing government clients and identify opportunities for repeat business, AMC renewals and additional requirements.

14. \*\*Business Conversion:\*\* Convert government enquiries and identified opportunities into confirmed purchase orders and profitable business.

### Candidate Requirements

- Minimum \*\*10+ years of experience\*\* in Business Development, Government Sales, Institutional Sales or B2G Sales.

- Strong understanding of Government Sales processes, procurement procedures and tendering mechanisms.

- Proven experience in handling GeM, CPPP and State Government e-tendering portals.

- IT industry knowledge and experience in selling IT products, infrastructure solutions or system integration services will be highly preferred.

- Established relationships and networking capabilities within government departments, PSUs and institutional clients will be an added advantage.

- Strong understanding of government project cycles, technical specifications, commercial negotiations and purchase order processes.

- Demonstrated ability to independently generate leads, develop accounts and close high-value government projects.

- Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and relationship management skills.

- Strong business acumen, strategic thinking and target-oriented approach.

- Ability to work independently and take complete ownership of the B2G business vertical.

### Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

1. Government business revenue and order booking.

2. Number of new government accounts and departments developed.

3. Qualified government leads and sales pipeline generated.

4. Number and value of tenders identified and participated in.

5. Tender conversion ratio and successful order closures.

6. Gross profit and business profitability.

7. Client meetings, government networking and follow-up effectiveness.

8. Collection efficiency and payment follow-ups.

9. Development of new business territories and strategic accounts.

10. Monthly and quarterly target achievement.

### Preferred Candidate Profile

We are looking for a business-driven professional who can independently establish, develop and scale the Government Sales (B2G) vertical. The ideal candidate should bring a combination of government-sector understanding, IT product knowledge, strong professional networking, tender management expertise and a proven ability to convert opportunities into business.

\*\*Interested candidates may share their updated CV at:\*\*

\*\*Email:\*\* hod@securenova.in

\*\*Subject Line:\*\* Application – Business Development Manager (B2G)

\*\*Location:\*\* Malad West, Mumbai

* Design and implement strategies for sales of effective, high-impact technical and business solutions for Red Hat's customers with a focus on core Red Hat technologies including OpenShift, Ansible AAP, OpenShift AI, RHEL, and others
* Accurately and consistently provide booking and revenue forecasts for your territory
* Manage revenue and booking goals across all practices; meet margin and use targets
* Ensure successful delivery of all projects
* Coordinate customer managers who manage consultants, fostering a culture of collaboration within your team
* Taking accountability for sales and pre-sales performance, meeting customer expectations, and driving future demand
* Providing accurate and regular reports to the management on performance of the service delivery
* Leading personnel management, including staff recruitment, performance assessment, training, and mentoring
* Building strong relationships with teams and stakeholders to enable effective dialogue exchange between departments

**Within 12 months, you will be expected to do the following**

* Grow your order booking and revenue base on a quarterly basis
* Build services pipe for 18 months ahead
* Manage escalations without supervision
* Assist with negotiating Red Hat’s master services agreements and statements of work with the customers and the legal team

**What You Will Bring**

* Knowledge of technical or business consulting practices
* Experience managing technical sales and delivery teams, in the IT infrastructure space
* Experience in services sales and processes in customer accounts in India and South Asia
* Experience in project delivery
* Experience with internal matrix team coordination
* Ability to architect complex solutions using multiple offerings and technologies to deliver requested business value
* Experience in and willingness to speak at public conferences and meetups

**About Red Hat**
Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.
  
  
**Inclusion at Red Hat**
Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)**
Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

We are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written contract between Red Hat and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee.

title: Business Development Associate
description:

holidays into reality. You will engage with a highly qualified inbound user base and guide them through

title: Sales Role - Varnishes For Printing & Packaging Industry
description:
**Company Description**
Quality Products India, founded in 1958, is a long-established manufacturer serving the printing and packaging coatings market. Under the leadership of industry veteran Mr. Rajesh K. Mehta, the company helped drive the transition from solvent-based varnishes to eco-friendly water-based coatings in the early 1990s. Today, Quality Products India is a trusted provider to printing ink and coating manufacturers in India and international markets. Its portfolio includes water-based, UV, and solvent-based coatings designed for consistent performance. The company focuses on low-VOC, HAP-free, cost-effective solutions for food and pharmaceutical packaging, folding cartons, labels, flexible laminates, wood, playing cards, and commercial print applications.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Sales role based in Mumbai, focused on varnishes and coatings for the printing and packaging industry. The role involves identifying and developing new business opportunities, managing existing customer relationships, and driving sales growth across assigned regions and market segments. Day-to-day tasks include visiting customers, understanding their technical requirements, promoting suitable coating solutions, preparing proposals, and negotiating sales terms. The position also involves coordinating with production, logistics, and technical teams to ensure timely deliveries, product trials, and customer support. The individual will monitor market trends, competitor activities, and customer feedback to support continuous improvement and strategic planning.

**Qualifications**

* Strong sales and business development skills, including lead generation, customer relationship management, and negotiation.
* Knowledge of the printing, packaging, or graphic arts industry, especially varnishes, coatings, or related chemical products.
* Ability to understand and explain technical product features, application processes, and performance benefits to customers.
* Effective communication and presentation skills, with proficiency in written and spoken English; additional regional languages are an advantage.
* Comfort with on-site customer visits, frequent field work, and travel within assigned territories.
* Proficiency in basic office and CRM tools for reporting, documentation, and sales tracking.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, meet sales targets, and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
* Diploma or degree in Chemistry, Printing Technology, Packaging Technology, Business, or a related field preferred; relevant industry experience can substitute educational requirements.
* Prior experience in B2B industrial sales, especially coatings, inks, adhesives, or packaging materials, is highly beneficial.

title: General Manager, Pre-Sales
description:
**Job Description**
**General Manager – Pre-Sales, Academic & Education Market**
**Reports to**
Sales Head, India & MEA
  
  
**Business**
Schneider Electric
  
  

* Education Equipment and Services

**Location**
India, with 25–50% travel depending on territory
  
  
**Scope**
Leads technical engagement, solution positioning and pre-sales support for universities, technical institutes and government education departments
  
  
**About The Role**
As the Pre-Sales Manager, you will partner with universities, technical academic institutes, and government education departments to understand their technical and business challenges. You will use these insights to articulate a compelling vision of how Schneider Electric can help address their education and training priorities.
  
  
Customer conversations will span energy management, industrial automation, smart buildings, motion control, and Industry 4.0. You will demonstrate the benefits of teaching and learning through industry-relevant content, show how Schneider Electric technologies are used in industry, and communicate the value of the Education portfolio in curriculum adoption, learning journeys, and hands-on experiential learning.
  
  
This role serves as the primary technical point of contact for universities and technical academic institutes across India. You will empower researchers, educators, and institutional leaders to solve technical and business challenges by combining deep engineering knowledge, consultative engagement, and effective solution positioning.
  
  
What You Will Do
  
  
Territory Planning & Strategy
  
  
Collaborate with sales colleagues to conduct data-driven account assessments and determine overall account health. Develop technical engagement plans, including webinars, technical discussions, demonstrations, workshops, and other interventions that help progress opportunities toward closure.
  
  
Execute Technical Engagement Plans
  
  
Travel to universities, institutes, and government education departments to advocate Schneider Electric technologies across the student learning journey, including curriculum and coursework, hands-on practical learning, competitions, projects, and other high-impact student activities. Prepare and deliver presentations, demonstrations, and application examples.
  
  
Create a Vision Beyond the Curriculum
  
  
Identify priority research projects and groups that can benefit from Schneider Electric technologies. Understand their goals and constraints, then apply product knowledge and industry experience to recommend relevant architectures, applications, and solutions.
  
  
Cultivate Champions
  
  
Build trusted relationships with leading faculty members, academicians, researchers, and institutional influencers. Enable them to advocate Schneider Electric technologies on campus and across the broader education community.
  
  
Be Resourceful
  
  
Mobilise operations, application engineering, product specialists, and other internal teams for key activities and specialised product areas, ensuring the successful technical progression of each opportunity.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own and lead the pre-sales function for the Education market, including RFP and RFI response strategy, solution design, technical compliance, demonstrations, and engagement strategies for professors, researchers, and students.
* Present, explain, and defend technical solutions directly to academic and education customers, procurement teams, evaluation committees, government stakeholders, and other decision-makers associated with the opportunity.
* Convert customer needs into technically sound and commercially viable solution architectures, bills of materials, compliance statements, demonstration plans, and value propositions.
* Maintain disciplined technical opportunity management, including discovery records, solution assumptions, risks, dependencies, competitor positioning, and agreed next actions.

Key Competencies
  
  

* Deep knowledge of industrial automation, energy management, and cyber-physical systems.
* Strong understanding of motion control, variable frequency drives, industrial networks, connectivity, control architectures, and system performance.
* Strong customer focus, supported by excellent listening, discovery, and communication skills.
* Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly and persuasively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Understanding of the Academic and Education market, including key influencers, decision-makers, procurement stakeholders, faculty members, researchers, nodal officers, and channel partners.
* Ability to translate academic requirements into application-oriented learning solutions, technical specifications, and demonstrable outcomes.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum 15 years of experience in industrial automation design, engineering problem-solving, application engineering, or pre-sales activities.
* Experience in technical engineering, application design or validation, techno-commercial activities, demonstrations, and technical training.
* BE, BTech, or MTech in Electrical Engineering.
* Strong relationship-building, communication, presentation, facilitation, and negotiation skills.
* Willingness to travel frequently, typically 25–50%, depending on the assigned territory and opportunity portfolio.

Key Metrics for Success
  
  
**Measure**
**Definition**
**Technical opportunity conversion**
Progression of qualified opportunities from discovery and solution design through technical acceptance and commercial closure.
  
  
**Solution quality**
Accuracy, completeness, compliance, competitiveness, and commercial viability of proposed technical solutions.
  
  
**Customer engagement**
Quality and frequency of technical discussions, workshops, demonstrations, webinars, and institutional engagements.
  
  
**Curriculum adoption**
Adoption of Schneider Electric technologies, content, and practical applications within curricula, laboratories, projects, and student activities.
  
  
**RFP/ Prequalification effectiveness**
Quality, timeliness, compliance, and win contribution of technical responses, specifications, and supporting documentation.
  
  
**Academic advocacy**
Number and strength of faculty champions, research engagements, references, demonstrations, and reusable application success stories.

company: SP Transaction Hub Technology Private Limited
description:
We’re Hiring: HR Manager – Recruitment & HR Operations

Company: SP Transaction Hub Technology Pvt. Ltd.

Location: Thane, Maharashtra

Employment: Full-time | Work from Office

Experience: 5-8 years

Monthly Gross Fixed Salary: ₹30,000–50,000, depending on relevant experience and demonstrated capability

**Reporting To: Founder & CEO**

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on HR professional who can independently drive recruitment, manage employee processes and bring consistency to daily HR operations.

Recruitment will be the primary responsibility, supported by ownership of onboarding, attendance and payroll inputs, employee relations, performance-review coordination and exit processes. This role requires someone who follows through, maintains accurate records and resolves issues with sound judgment.

**Key Responsibilities**

Recruitment & Hiring

• Own the recruitment cycle—from requirement discussions and sourcing to screening, interview coordination, offer rollout and joining.

• Recruit across field sales, inside sales, operations, customer service, risk and compliance, technology and leadership roles.

• Source candidates through LinkedIn, job portals, referrals and targeted outreach while managing recruitment costs.

• Screen candidates for relevant skills, communication, role fit, salary expectations and joining availability.

• Maintain a hiring tracker covering pipeline stages, interview feedback, offer status, joining probability and pending actions.

• Reduce candidate drop-offs through timely communication and structured follow-ups.

• Coordinate reference checks and authorised background verification.

HR Operations & Payroll Coordination

• Manage offer documentation, joining formalities, employee files, induction and probation tracking.

• Maintain accurate attendance, leave and payroll inputs, resolving discrepancies before payroll processing.

• Coordinate applicable PF, ESIC and other employment-compliance requirements with payroll and professional advisers.

• Maintain clear HR policies, employee communications and documented processes.

• Coordinate resignations, handovers, clearance and full-and-final inputs with relevant teams.

Employee Management & Performance

• Conduct regular employee check-ins and address concerns professionally and confidentially.

• Coordinate goal-setting, probation reviews, appraisals and documented performance-improvement processes.

• Support managers in handling attendance, conduct and performance concerns fairly and consistently.

• Track early attrition, identify recurring issues and recommend practical retention improvements.

• Coordinate employee training, workplace-conduct awareness and POSH-related processes with the designated committee.

• Support basic office administration and vendor coordination without losing focus on recruitment priorities.

Reporting & Accountability

• Submit a weekly HR dashboard covering open positions, qualified candidates, interviews, offers, joiners and hiring blockers.

• Track time-to-fill, offer acceptance, joining conversion, recruitment cost and early retention.

• Maintain visibility of payroll deadlines, pending employee documentation and unresolved employee matters.

• Escalate sensitive issues promptly and handle employee information with discretion.

Requirements

• 5–8 years of hands-on experience in recruitment and HR operations.

• Demonstrated experience independently closing multiple positions, including sales and operational roles.

• Strong sourcing, candidate assessment, negotiation and follow-up skills.

• Practical knowledge of attendance, payroll coordination, employee documentation and exit processes.

• Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills and familiarity with recruitment portals or HRMS tools.

• Clear English and Hindi communication; Marathi is an advantage.

• Ability to work independently in a growing company and manage competing priorities.

• Graduate qualification required; an MBA/PGDM in HR is preferred.

• Experience in fintech, payments, BFSI or a growing services company is an advantage.

What Success Looks Like

• A dependable hiring pipeline and timely closure of agreed priority positions.

• Better candidate joining conversion and stronger early employee retention.

• Accurate payroll inputs, complete employee records and timely HR follow-ups.

• Consistent employee communication and clear visibility of unresolved issues.

title: Sr. Design Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
KALYANI FURNACES INDIA PVT LTD (formerly Kalyani Enterprises), established in 1994 in Pune, Maharashtra, is a recognized manufacturer and supplier of industrial heating systems and furnaces, including aluminium melting, tempering, rotary hearth, and holding furnaces. The company operates from a modern, large-scale facility organized into specialized departments for procurement, production, quality testing, warehousing, packaging, and sales & marketing. It focuses on upgrading conventional refractory brick-lined furnaces to advanced, energy-efficient insulation systems that improve output and reduce energy consumption. Supported by a skilled team of engineers and technicians working in shifts, the organization also offers fabrication and installation services and is an authorized dealer for Sandvik Asia Ltd., Kanthal Division, and an approved vendor for FIBROTHAL SYSTEMS.
  
**Role Description**
The Sr. Design Engineer is a full-time, on-site position based in Pune City, responsible for leading the design and development of industrial furnaces and heating systems. The role involves creating detailed design concepts, preparing engineering drawings and 3D models, and selecting suitable materials and components in line with thermal performance, safety, and quality standards. The Sr. Design Engineer collaborates closely with production, quality, and installation teams to ensure designs are manufacturable, cost-effective, and meet client specifications, including revamp and retrofitting projects. Daily responsibilities include reviewing customer requirements, conducting design calculations, coordinating with suppliers, providing technical support during fabrication and commissioning, and continuously improving existing product designs. The role also includes mentoring junior engineers, maintaining design documentation, and adhering to relevant industry codes and company procedures.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Design Engineering skills, including concept development, detailed design, and design validation for industrial furnaces and thermal systems.
* Candidates should possess solid Mechanical Engineering knowledge, covering thermodynamics, heat transfer, structural integrity, materials selection, and manufacturing processes.
* Candidates should possess proficiency in Computer-Aided Design (CAD) tools for 2D drafting and 3D modeling, and should be comfortable with engineering documentation and design standards.
* Candidates should possess fundamental Electrical Engineering understanding related to heating elements, control panels, power distribution, and integration with automation and safety systems.
* Candidates should possess Product Design capabilities, including translating customer requirements into practical solutions, optimizing for performance and cost, and supporting product lifecycle improvements.
* Relevant qualifications such as a bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline; a master’s degree or specialization in thermal or furnace engineering is an advantage.
* Experience in industrial furnace/heating system design, retrofitting, or thermal insulation projects, preferably in a manufacturing environment.

title: Senior Ticketing Operations Executive – Attractions & Activities
description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced and results-oriented Senior Ticketing Operations Executive to oversee ticketing operations for various tourist attractions and activities. The role involves managing attraction and activity ticket requests received through the on-request portal, maintaining ticket inventory, coordinating with suppliers and attraction partners, and ensuring timely ticket availability and issuance.

The candidate will be responsible for managing bulk ticket inventory, monitoring stock utilization, maintaining supplier relationships, handling operational escalations, and ensuring smooth coordination between internal departments. The role will also involve inventory reconciliation, supplier invoice verification, and operational reporting.

An educational background in Commerce, along with knowledge of accounts, supplier reconciliation, and inventory management, will be an added advantage.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Attraction & Activity Ticketing Operations**

* Oversee daily ticketing operations for various attractions, theme parks, water parks, sightseeing experiences, cruises, adventure activities, and other tourism products.
* Manage and monitor incoming attraction and activity ticket requests through the on-request portal.
* Ensure timely processing, confirmation, and issuance of tickets within defined turnaround times.
* Coordinate with suppliers and attraction partners for ticket availability and confirmations.
* Monitor pending requests, identify operational bottlenecks, and ensure timely resolution.
* Handle escalations related to ticket availability, supplier delays, and booking discrepancies.
* Coordinate with reservations, operations, and other internal teams for smooth ticket fulfilment.

**2. Ticket Inventory Management & Control**

* Take ownership of attraction and activity ticket inventory across various destinations.
* Monitor bulk ticket purchases, prepaid inventory, supplier stock, and agent-held stock.
* Plan inventory requirements based on sales trends, demand forecasts, and business requirements.
* Ensure optimum stock utilization and minimize unused, expired, or blocked ticket inventory.
* Monitor ticket validity, expiry dates, stock movement, and revalidation requirements.
* Plan replenishment and coordinate with suppliers to ensure uninterrupted ticket availability.
* Conduct regular inventory audits and reconcile internal stock with supplier records.

**3. Supplier Management & Coordination**

* Develop and maintain strong working relationships with attraction suppliers, activity operators, and tourism partners.
* Coordinate with suppliers for ticket availability, allocations, replenishment, and operational support.
* Follow up on pending supplies, revalidations, extensions, cancellations, and credit notes.
* Resolve supplier-related issues and escalate critical matters when required.
* Monitor supplier performance in terms of service quality, response time, and supply efficiency.
* Support commercial negotiations and procurement discussions in coordination with the Purchase & Products team.

**4. Accounts, Reconciliation & Cost Control**

* Monitor supplier invoices, ticket purchase records, credit notes, and debit notes.
* Ensure regular reconciliation of ticket purchases, stock utilization, and supplier statements.
* Track supplier advances, outstanding balances, and unused ticket inventory.
* Identify financial and inventory discrepancies and coordinate with the Accounts team for resolution.
* Monitor inventory costs and identify opportunities to reduce wastage and operational losses.
* Ensure proper documentation and accuracy of supplier-related financial records.

**5. Team Management & Process Improvement**

* Guide and supervise junior team members handling attraction and activity ticketing operations and inventory.
* Allocate daily responsibilities and monitor team productivity.
* Establish standard operating procedures (SOPs) for portal requests, ticket issuance, and inventory management.
* Train team members on supplier portals, inventory systems, and internal processes.
* Identify process gaps and implement improvements to increase productivity and accuracy.

**6. MIS & Management Reporting**

* Prepare and review daily, weekly, and monthly reports on ticketing operations and inventory.
* Monitor pending requests, supplier response times, ticket stock utilisation, and expiry risks.
* Prepare supplier-wise inventory and reconciliation reports.
* Highlight operational challenges, inventory risks, and supply shortages to management.
* Provide regular updates on team performance and operational efficiency.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* MBA or Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Commerce, Operations Management, or a related field.
* 3–5 years of relevant experience in attraction ticketing, activity ticketing, travel and tourism, inventory management, procurement, or supplier coordination.
* Commerce background will be preferred.
* Experience working with theme parks, water parks, sightseeing attractions, adventure activities, cruises, DMCs, or travel companies will be an advantage.
* Strong understanding of supplier management, ticket inventory control, and procurement operations.
* Good knowledge of inventory reconciliation, invoice verification, supplier statements, and cost control.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, MIS reporting, and data analysis.
* Familiarity with ERP systems, inventory management software, and accounting tools such as Tally or Zoho Books.
* Strong leadership, analytical, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, supervise operational activities, and work under tight deadlines.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely fulfilment of attraction and activity ticket requests received through the on-request portal.
* Accuracy of ticket inventory and stock reconciliation.
* Optimum utilization of bulk and prepaid ticket inventory.
* Reduction in expired, unused, and blocked ticket stock.
* Supplier response time and service efficiency.
* Timely resolution of operational and supplier-related escalations.
* Accuracy of supplier reconciliation and inventory reporting.
* Team productivity and adherence to operational SOPs.

* Solid experience writing and executing manual test cases, including positive, negative and boundary scenarios.

**Good to have**

* Exposure to mobile testing
* Experience with Salesforce or e-commerce applications.

**Job Title: Lead Quality Engineer / MDM Test Engineer**

* Design, develop, and execute test strategies and test plans for Reltio MDM implementations, including unit, functional, integration, regression, and performance testing.
* Validate Reltio data models, entity configurations, relationships, attributes, and reference data for accuracy and completeness.

* Develop and maintain test documentation including test cases, test scripts, test data, and test summary reports.

* 3+ years of experience in software or data quality engineering, with at least 1–2 years of exposure to MDM platforms (Reltio preferred, or Informatica MDM, Semarchy, SAP MDG, Stibo STEP, or similar).
* Hands-on understanding of Reltio MDM concepts — entities, relationships, match & merge, survivorship, hierarchies, and workflows — sufficient to design meaningful test cases.
* Strong SQL skills for data validation, reconciliation, and querying across relational/cloud databases.
* Experience testing REST APIs using Postman, REST Assured, or similar API testing tools.
* Experience with test management tools (JIRA, TestRail, Zephyr, or similar).
* Familiarity with ETL/integration testing (validating data pipelines, transformation logic, and data flow accuracy).
* Experience with data quality testing concepts — completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and uniqueness.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to define test scenarios from complex business and data requirements.
* Good understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and experience working within sprint-based delivery teams.

****Preferred Qualifications****

* Experience with test automation frameworks (Selenium, PyTest, or similar) and scripting in Python or Groovy.
* Exposure to performance/load testing tools (JMeter, Gatling, or similar) for MDM and integration pipelines.
* Reltio platform certification or formal training is a plus.
* Experience testing Snowflake, AWS, Azure, or GCP data platforms integrated with Reltio.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, etc.) for automated testing workflows.
* Experience with data migration testing in large-scale MDM implementation projects.
* Knowledge of data privacy/compliance frameworks (GDPR, HIPAA) and their impact on data quality and testing requirements.
* Experience in industries such as Manufacturing, life sciences, healthcare, retail, or financial services.

**Key Competencies**

* Meticulous attention to detail and strong data analytical mindset.
* Ability to understand complex data relationships and identify edge cases in match/merge scenarios.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills to work across data engineering, business, and architecture teams.
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple test deliverables across concurrent project tracks.
* Proactive in identifying risks, raising issues early, and proposing pragmatic testing solutions.

title: Mechatronics & Robotics Lead (New Product/ Prototype Builder)
description:
Our client says:

About Us:

We are an innovative 3D printer manufacturer based in Pune, operating as a lean, fast-paced hardware R&D startup. We specialize in end-to-end design, custom machine fabrication, precision hardware build-outs, and on-site installation. We spend our energy and resources where it counts most – on machine engineering, high-performance components, and rapid prototyping. Having established our core machine platform, we are now scaling up production and custom enterprise deployments.

Role Overview:

We are seeking a hands-on, high-ownership
**New Product Development Lead**
to work directly with the founders and translate conceptual ideas, rough sketches, and prototype mechanisms into robust, production-ready machinery. You will serve as the technical backbone of our hardware development, bridging mechanical architecture, robotics, electronics, and motion firmware.

This role operates in a high-autonomy, garage-style prototyping environment – ideal for engineers who love getting their hands dirty, building real physical machinery from the ground up, and avoiding corporate red tape. We are eager to hire you if you have rock-solid fundamentals in robotics, automation, and mechatronics, and want to be part of building a high-scale enterprise from scratch.

Key Roles and Responsibilities:

* Translate founder ideas, functional sketches, and early proof-of-concept setups into production-grade CAD designs,electrical systems, and working industrial machines.
* Lead the end-to-end mechatronics architecture, integrating kinematics, gantry motion control, closed-loop stepper/servo drives, extruders, heated chambers, and structural enclosures.
* Architect and execute system electronics, including wire harness design, sensor selection/interfacing (limit switches, thermistors/thermocouples, inductive probes), and power management.
* Configure, flash, and tune motion control firmware (Klipper, Marlin, RepRap, or custom controllers) for precise trajectory, acceleration, and G-code execution.
* Implement Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) principles to continuously optimize Bill of Materials (BOM) costs and production turnaround.
* Collaborate closely with regional Pune fabrication vendors, machine shops, and internal technicians for rapid prototyping, CNC machining, and sheet metal fabrication.
* Supervise bench testing, pre-shipment quality control (QC), and support field troubleshooting during complex on-site machine installations.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Concept-to-functional prototype delivery timeline.
* Machine reliability and uptime during stress-testing and initial field deployments.
* First-Time-Right rate during hardware-software integration and on-site commissioning.
* BOM cost reduction percentage across iterations without sacrificing positioning accuracy or build speed.

Requirements & Qualifications

* **Experience:**
  8 to 10 years in robotics, mechatronics, automation systems, special-purpose machinery (SPM).
* **Education:**
  M.E./ M.Tech in Mechatronics, Robotics & Automation.
* **Culture Fit:**
  A true "maker/builder" who thrives in a lean, fast-paced workshop setting; excited about physical bench testing, rapid iterations, and direct collaboration with technical founders.
* **Key Skills:**
* Expert in SolidWorks/ Fusion 360, DFM/ DFA, and sheet metal/ tolerance design.
* Deep understanding of motion kinematics (Cartesian, CoreXY, Delta, or multi-axis), linear guides, and ball screws.
* Hands-on experience with stepper/ servo drivers, microcontroller/ PLC wiring, sensor integration, and firmware configuration/ tuning.

* Provide prompt, reliable, and clear responses to dealer concerns, ensuring a smooth and positive experience.
* Develop strong working relationships with dealers by acting as a trusted advisor for their website performance.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Experience with SEO analytics and web optimization.
* Familiarity with CMS platforms.

* Proactive problem-solving mindset and keen attention to detail.

title: Business Intelligence Engineer
description:
About Us

At Calfus, we are known for delivering cutting-edge AI agents and products that transform businesses in ways previously unimaginable. We empower companies to harness the full potential of AI, unlocking opportunities they never imagined possible before the AI era.

Our software engineering teams are highly valued by customers, whether start-ups or established enterprises, because we consistently deliver solutions that drive revenue growth. Our ERP solution teams have successfully implemented cloud solutions and developed tools that seamlessly integrate with ERP systems, reducing manual work so teams can focus on high-impact tasks.

None of this would be possible without talent like you! Our global teams thrive on collaboration, and we're actively looking for skilled professionals to strengthen our in-house expertise and help us deliver exceptional AI, software engineering, and solutions using enterprise applications.

As one of the fastest-growing companies in our industry, we take pride in fostering a culture of innovation where new ideas are always welcomed, without hesitation. We are driven and expect the same dedication from our team members. Our speed, agility, and dedication set us apart, and we perform best when surrounded by high-energy, driven individuals.

To continue our rapid growth and deliver an even greater impact, we invite you to apply for our open positions and become part of our journey!

About the Role

As a Business Intelligence Engineer, you'll design, build, and deploy BI solutions and reliable, accurate data marts that drive business growth and make operations more efficient. This is a hands-on role: you'll own ETL development, write the SQL behind reports and data models, build dashboards, and support the analytics platforms in production. With 5–7 years of experience, you translate business needs into technical specifications and deliver solutions that internal and external customers rely on.

• Experience: 5–7 years in business intelligence and data engineering

• Location: Pune / Bangalore

• Timings: India-based.

What You'll Do

BI Solutions & Reporting

• Design, build, and deploy BI solutions and data marts for internal and external customers

• Build dashboards and custom reports using tools such as Sisense, Power BI, or Tableau

• Provide ad-hoc reports where self-service isn't available or possible

Data Engineering & ETL

• Develop and enhance ETL/ELT processes using tools such as Fivetran and dbt

• Write database queries, stored procedures, functions, and views in PostgreSQL and BigQuery

• Continuously improve BI systems and data structures for performance, accuracy, integrity, and security

Data Quality & Platform Support

• Spot data trends and fix data quality issues quickly, completely, and permanently

• Support analytics platforms in production: troubleshooting and testing across PostgreSQL, BigQuery, and BI tools

• Follow the software development life cycle across all development work

Collaboration & Documentation

• Work with IT peers and business partners to balance production support, service requests, and roadmap initiatives

• Maintain BI documentation and source system data mapping

• Share domain and technical expertise through mentoring and cross-training

What You'll Need (Must Have)

• 5–7 years in business intelligence, data warehousing, or data engineering

• Advanced SQL: queries, stored procedures, functions, and views

• ETL/ELT: hands-on development and enhancement of ETL packages and processes

• Databases & OLAP: hands-on experience with database management systems and online analytical processing

• BI Tools: you've built dashboards yourself in Sisense, Power BI, Tableau, or similar

• JSON and XML

• Strong analytical skills: able to translate business needs into technical specifications

• Proficiency in MS Office, especially Excel

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related engineering field

Good to Have

• Google BigQuery and PostgreSQL

• Fivetran and dbt

• Experience with Sales, Operations, and Finance data and platforms

• Business systems such as general ledger, HRIS, or CRM

• Industry certifications in data or cloud technologies

Benefits

At Calfus, we value our employees and offer a strong benefits package. This includes medical, group, and parental insurance, coupled with gratuity and provident fund options. Further, we support employee wellness and provide birthday leave as a valued benefit.

Calfus is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We believe diversity drives innovation. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone, regardless of background, identity, or experience, has the opportunity to thrive. We welcome all applicants!

title: Manager, Software Engineering
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Manager, Software Engineering
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
As a Manager, Software Engineering in the Services organization, you will have the opportunity to lead the development of analytics applications that sit atop vast datasets gathered by retail stores, restaurants, banks, and other consumer-focused companies. Innovative product opportunities, modern business questions, and intricate datasets present uniquely challenging problems that we are eager to take on. Mastercard's next-generation platform blends industry-leading analytics, advanced software architecture, and the latest web technologies to face these problems. Our software is required to effectively decipher analytically complex insights from these problems, on which businesses base multi-million-dollar business decisions.
  
  
As a member of the Business Experimentation & Optimization team, you will apply your full-stack development skills to building industry-leading business experimentation software that brings sophisticated analytic techniques to business users around the world. We are rapidly expanding our product offerings and innovating on how we deliver Business Experimentation & Optimization solutions to our clients.
  
  
What is Services organization?
  
  
The Services organization is a key differentiator for Mastercard, providing the cutting-edge services that help our customers grow. Focused on thinking big and scaling fast around the globe, this team is responsible for end-to-end solutions for a diverse global customer base. We combine traditional management consulting with our rich data assets and in-house technology to provide our clients with powerful insights and tools to drive fact-based decision-making. Centered on data-driven technologies and innovation, our services include consulting, loyalty and marketing programs, business experimentation, and data-driven information and risk management. While specializing in the payments industry, Mastercard Services also works closely with major retailers, airlines, and other enterprises, leveraging data and insights garnered from within and beyond its network.
  
  
We are looking for passionate, talented technologists who share our vision of empowering our customers to make better, fact-based decisions to join us and help shape our team's growth.

title: PPC Marketing Specialist (Remote)
description:
**Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.**
That is the whole job.
  
  
Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.
  
  
So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.
  
  
At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.
  
  
You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.
  
  
Here is what "end to end" actually means.
  
  
**You are the account manager. We do not have any.**
You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.
  
  
**You own the whole funnel, not the campaign.**
Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.
  
  
**You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it.**
We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.
  
  
**You can live anywhere.**
We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.
  
  
If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.
  
  
If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.
  
  
**Requirements**
**What the job looks like**

* Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month
* Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working
* Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people
* Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing
* Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target
* Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule
* Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery
* Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why
* Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team
* Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt

**You are a fit if**

* You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search
* You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have
* You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it
* You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list
* You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard
* You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you
* Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too

**You are not a fit if**

* "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed
* You want to be told what to do this week
* You need a ticketing system to know what matters
* You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question

**Benefits**
**Why this role is exciting**
This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.
  
  
You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.
  
  
You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.
  
  
You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.
