title: Marketing Associate
description:
**The Opportunity**

Most financial content online is either dull or untrustworthy. Your job is to help us be neither — building the ideas, words, and formats that make sound financial advice genuinely worth stopping to read or watch.

This is a hands-on brand-building role, not a “post and hope” job. We're a small firm, which means everything you create has to earn attention on its own merit — and is built to compound, whether that's an article that ranks in search six months from now or a founder LinkedIn post that starts a real conversation. You'll be building the machinery, not just feeding it.

**Content Strategy & Creation**

•     Build a bank of hooks and story angles for short-form video and written content, grounded in what's proven to work in financial content elsewhere.

•     Draft scripts, carousels, and posts that turn dense financial ideas into something investors want to engage with.

•     Own and maintain a content calendar where every piece ties back to a purpose, not just a posting slot.

**Audience Intelligence**

•     Build personas that go beyond demographics — how and what type of content our target audience consumes, what stops their scroll, what earns their trust.

•     Map every piece of content to a stage of the funnel — awareness, consideration, decision, conversion, etc.

**Channel & Format Exploration**

•     Research what's resonating in personal-finance communities and conversations online.

•     Pressure-test what a long-form video or podcast series could look like for the brand — from topic list to a scripted pilot episode.

**Brand Presence**

•     Support the founder's personal brand and public voice.

•     Deliver well-researched, ready-to-review post drafts.

**Campaign & Event Support**

•     Build presentation decks, handouts, and recap content for roadshows and outreach events.

•     Turn live audience questions into future content and FAQ material.

**Who We're Looking For**

0–2 years of experience in content, marketing, or brand roles (or a strong internship/personal-project track record) – A portfolio of work you've created matters more than years on a resume.

A strong feel for language, storytelling, or design; no finance background required. You should be someone who creates and consumes content yourself and has real opinions about what makes it good

Bachelor’s degree with specialisation in Marketing.

title: Influencer & Affiliate Marketing Lead
description:
Advertising is being rebuilt around AI, and creators and partners are becoming one of its most powerful channels. Yet most advertisers still run them across scattered tools and manual processes, from partner discovery to payouts.

One of our clients DeltaX,

brings discovery, partner management, tracking and payments into the same universal buying stack as the rest of the media plan, so influencer and affiliate can be planned, measured and scaled like any other channel. Few platforms can do this today.

Imagine finding, contracting, tracking and paying thousands of creators and partners as easily as launching a search campaign. This is what you will be working on.

As Solutions Lead for Influencer & Affiliate, you are the expert on how these programmes should run on our platform. You understand the ecosystem: how partners are found and recruited, the deal types and engagement models, how performance is tracked and how partners get paid. You help advertisers and agencies design programmes that fit their goals and guide teams on setting them up well.

You also build the practice behind it: the standards, playbooks and know-how that let us do this brilliantly at scale. When a question gets complex, you are the expert Client Success turns to.

Experience: 5 to 7+ years | CTC: 12LPA - 20LPA

What Success looks like

North Star: Advertisers run and scale influencer and affiliate as confidently as paid media

In your first 3 months

* You know our influencer and affiliate solution inside out, can demo and solution it independently, and advertisers and agencies leave excited about what it can do
* You have led onboarding for new advertisers and agencies, from programme design to a live setup
* You have set clear standards for programme setup, tracking and partner onboarding

In your first 6 months

* The practice runs on clear, documented processes and playbooks for common programme types and verticals
* You own the influencer and affiliate process end to end and drive it with the Client Success team
* Your client insight is shaping what we build next, with at least one new capability on the roadmap because of you

What Will You Do

Solutioning and guidance

* Help advertisers and agencies design influencer and affiliate programmes, including partner mix, deal types and commission structures
* Guide setup of partner onboarding, tracking, approvals and payouts on our platform
* Advise on recruitment and engagement approaches, and how to structure deals, without running negotiations yourself
* Diagnose tracking, attribution and payout issues

Advertiser and agency engagement

* Run product demos and training sessions for advertisers, agencies and internal teams
* Own client success during onboarding, then act as the expert Client Success can call on
* Join RFPs and pitches once there is a serious opportunity

Process and enablement

* Own and manage the programme setup process, from onboarding to ongoing partner management
* Create and maintain documentation: setup guides, playbooks, FAQs and training material
* Spot patterns across advertisers and agencies, and turn them into new solutions and product ideas
* Work closely with Client Success so they can support advertisers and agencies day to day
* Work with product and engineering when a client need calls for something new

What you Bring

* 5 to 7+ years in influencer or affiliate marketing, with deep experience in at least one and a working understanding of the other
* Must have worked on an influencer or affiliate platform, at a platform company, network, agency or brand
* Strong knowledge of the ecosystem: deal types such as CPA, CPS, flat fee and hybrid, and engagement models
* Prior experience recruiting partners and negotiating deals
* Confidence leading client calls, demos and platform trainings
* Strong process and documentation skills: you write things down so others can run them
* An AI-first mindset: you use AI every day and want to shape how it changes advertising

Good To Have

* Experience with leading influencer and affiliate platforms or networks
* Understanding of affiliate tracking methods, such as postbacks, coupon codes and server-to-server tracking
* Exposure to creator content rights, disclosure and compliance
* Experience building a programme or practice from the ground up

What You Get

* Shape a channel that is still being defined. You shape how advertisers run influencer and affiliate as real performance channels on our platform.
* Work at the cutting edge, with influencer and affiliate inside the same universal buying stack as the rest of the media plan.
* A voice in what we build. You work closely with product and engineering, and your client insight shapes the roadmap.
* Room to grow. Your scope, influence and team grow as the practice scales.

About DeltaX

Founded in 2012, DeltaX is building the future of how media is bought. Advertising is being rebuilt around AI, and we are building the stack it runs on: a universal buying platform that helps advertisers and their agencies plan, create, buy, measure and report across every major platform and channel, with agentic AI and orchestration at the core.

title: Head of Product – Distribution & Revenue Generation
description:
**Overview**

The Head of Product, Distribution & Revenue Generation is a senior product leadership role responsible for the strategy and delivery of Access Hospitality's distribution and revenue-generation capability across the APAC region – spanning Channel Management, Booking Engine, Rate Shopping, Connectivity, Revenue Management Systems, Review Management and Digital Marketing Services. This role succeeds Gavin Jeddo, Founder of STAAH, and carries the responsibility of preserving and extending the credibility STAAH has built with OTA, channel and technology partners across the region while integrating the product into Access's broader Accommodation platform strategy.

Reporting to the MD, India / Hospitality Capability Centre with a dotted line into the Head of Product, Accommodation (UK), this leader owns the regional distribution and revenue product roadmap and is the primary internal and external voice for how independent hotels and hotel chains in APAC drive bookings, optimise rate and channel mix, and reduce dependency on costly OTA distribution. The role sits within Access's Federated Product, Shared Capability operating model – balancing HCC and regional market/partner depth with alignment to the global Accommodation platform and the 2027 AI-native migration priority. The role is based in Pune and will work closely with product engineering leadership based across Pune, UK, US and NZ, with some travel required.

The ideal candidate brings deep, hands-on accommodation-technology domain expertise – built inside an OTA, PMS company, channel manager, revenue management system or adjacent part of the accommodation technology stack – combined with the commercial instincts to connect product decisions directly to distribution cost, direct booking share and revenue outcomes for customers.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Distribution & Revenue Product Strategy**

* Own the regional product vision, strategy and roadmap for Channel Management, Booking Engine, Rate Shopping, Connectivity and Revenue Management Systems, aligned to APAC commercial priorities and the global Accommodation platform direction
* Define a coherent distribution and revenue product architecture that enhances our customers positioning whilst maximising visibility and yield across the channels that matter in APAC markets
* Set prioritisation frameworks that balance direct booking growth, channel partner breadth, rate/revenue optimisation and customer retention
* Lead product investment decisions in partnership with engineering and finance, grounded in commercial impact – distribution cost reduction, RevPAR/ADR uplift and channel yield
* Monitor the competitive OTA, channel management and revenue management landscape across APAC (including region-specific players and metasearch/OTA dynamics) to continuously sharpen product positioning

**AI-Native Distribution & Revenue Capabilities**

* Lead the product strategy for AI-native and agentic capability within the distribution and revenue suite – including automated rate optimisation, dynamic pricing recommendations, AI-assisted channel mix decisioning and automated review response
* Embed AI across the product suite where it demonstrably improves revenue or reduces manual effort – intelligent rate shopping insights, forecasting-driven pricing, and automation of routine channel and connectivity management tasks
* Work with engineering leadership to ensure AI/agentic features sit on a scalable, interoperable data foundation and connect cleanly into the global Accommodation platform migration
* Define packaging, pricing and migration pathways so customers can adopt new distribution and revenue capability with confidence

**Commercial & Customer Outcomes**

* Partner with the GM APAC, the Head of Product UK, Head of Engineering APAC and regional commercial leadership to ensure the roadmap directly supports direct booking mix growth, distribution cost reduction and NRR/GRR performance

* Engage directly with key hotel and hotel-group customers across APAC to validate roadmap direction, and directly with OTA, GDS and channel partners to maintain and extend commercial relationships built under STAAH's founder-led model
* Support pricing and packaging strategy across the distribution and revenue product portfolio, including tiering for digital marketing services and RMS capability

**Product Delivery & Quality**

* Lead a regional product management team, setting clear standards for discovery, prioritisation, delivery and iteration across the distribution and revenue product lines
* Work in close partnership with the STAAH and SHR engineering organisations to ensure delivery velocity, quality and alignment with the broader platform vision
* Establish product governance rhythms consistent with the HCC's Service Catalogue / SLA and Communities of Practice model, including roadmap reviews and launch readiness criteria
* Ensure product releases are accompanied by strong GTM readiness, including partner and sales enablement, documentation and customer communication

**Cross-functional & Regional Leadership**

* Partner with regional Go-to-Market and commercial teams to translate distribution and revenue product capability into propositions that resonate with APAC hoteliers
* Collaborate with the Hospitality CPO and global Accommodation product leadership to align the regional roadmap with the broader platform strategy and 2027 migration
* Work with STAAH's product engineering leadership to ensure technical foundations support the distribution and revenue roadmap, and act as the connective product leader across engineering sites
* Represent Accommodation distribution and revenue product externally with customers, channel/OTA partners and at APAC industry events – stepping into the external credibility role previously held by the Founder

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Direct booking mix growth and reduction in OTA/channel commission cost attributable to product
* GRR/NRR performance for the distribution and revenue product suite
* Connectivity and channel partner coverage against regional distribution targets
* RevPAR/ADR uplift and rate optimisation outcomes attributable to product capability
* Digital marketing services ROAS and adoption across the customer base
* Review score / reputation management improvement attributable to product
* AI/agentic capability adoption and measurable efficiency or revenue gains
* Roadmap delivery cadence and on-time release achievement

**Essential Experience**

**Accommodation technology domain experience is a mandatory requirement for this role – candidates without a genuine background inside the accommodation technology stack will not be considered, regardless of general SaaS product credentials.**

* Proven track record as a senior product leader within accommodation technology – an OTA, a PMS company, a channel manager/connectivity provider, a revenue management system vendor, a GDS, or a booking engine / CRS / IBE product organisation
* Direct, hands-on experience with the mechanics of hotel distribution – channel management, rate parity and rate shopping, connectivity/integrations, and the commercial dynamics between direct and OTA channels
* Experience with revenue management concepts and systems (dynamic pricing, forecasting, RevPAR/ADR optimisation), even if not the primary product owned
* Strong commercial acumen with direct experience connecting product decisions to distribution cost, direct booking share, pricing and packaging outcomes
* Demonstrated ability to lead product teams in high-growth, PE-backed, founder-led or fast-paced scale-up environments
* Experience operating across APAC hospitality markets, with credibility to engage OTA, GDS and channel partners directly
* Track record of managing product through a leadership transition, M&A integration or platform migration programme is highly advantageous, given this role succeeds a company Founder
* Comfortable operating in matrixed, federated organisations, influencing without direct authority across engineering, commercial, and regional and global product leadership

**Required Skills & Attributes**

**Distribution & Commercial Acumen**

* Deep, practical understanding of hotel distribution economics – channel cost, rate parity, OTA/metasearch dynamics and direct booking conversion
* Strong financial fluency – understands unit economics, pricing architecture and the commercial levers that drive distribution and revenue product growth
* Data-driven approach to prioritisation, using channel performance, booking and revenue data to make clear, defensible product decisions

**AI & Technology Fluency**

* AI-native product mindset applied to distribution and revenue use cases – can identify where AI creates real yield or efficiency gains versus where it is superficial
* Able to engage substantively with engineering on connectivity architecture, data modelling and technical feasibility of AI-driven pricing and channel features
* Stays current with distribution, channel management, RMS and OTA/metasearch trends specific to APAC hospitality markets

**Leadership & Communication**

* Inspiring, credible leader who can attract, develop and retain product talent, and who can step confidently into a role vacated by a company Founder
* Exceptional communicator – able to represent the product externally to OTA, GDS and channel partners as well as internally to customers, executives and engineering teams
* High EQ and collaborative style; builds trust across a federated, matrixed regional and global organisation
* Bias for action combined with rigorous thinking – drives pace without sacrificing quality

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree required; degree in technology, business or a related discipline preferred
* Significant experience in product management or product leadership roles specifically within accommodation/hospitality technology – OTA, PMS, channel management, RMS or booking engine businesses
* Demonstrated experience owning commercially accountable product decisions with a clear line of sight to distribution cost and revenue outcomes
* MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification an advantage but not required

**What We're Looking For**

* **Accommodation domain credibility –**
  Has deep, first-hand knowledge of how hotels distribute and generate revenue – built inside the accommodation technology stack, not adjacent to it:
* **Commercial ownership –**
  Treats distribution and revenue product decisions as commercial decisions, with a clear line of sight from roadmap choices to direct booking growth and channel cost reduction:
* **Technical credibility –**
  Can engage substantively with engineering and connectivity architecture, and has delivered AI-powered pricing or channel features that customers actually use:
* **Partner and customer relationships –**
  Builds close relationships with OTA, GDS and channel partners as well as customers, and can step into the external-facing role previously carried by a company Founder:
* **Pace and rigour –**
  Moves quickly, sets high standards, and holds themselves and their team accountable for delivery quality:
* **Collaborative influence –**
  Earns trust across a federated regional and global organisation and aligns diverse stakeholders behind a shared product direction:

If you are an ambitious, accommodation-technology-native product leader with a passion for transforming how APAC hoteliers distribute and generate revenue, and you want to own a mission-critical regional product agenda succeeding the Founder of one of Access's fastest-growing accommodation businesses, this role offers exceptional scope and impact.

**About Access**

At Access, we are committed to creating a welcoming and inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. If you're excited about this role, even if your past experience doesn't align perfectly and you're not ticking every single box, you might just be the perfect fit. We wholeheartedly believe in equality for all and the transformative power of diversity.

Why not join our vibrant team where you can love what you do, love how you live, and most importantly, be authentically you? Let's make a difference together.

***Love Work. Love Life. Be You.***

title: Strategic Account Director (ID # 912)
description:
**About the Company**

Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is developing India’s full-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research, models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV, and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam partners with India’s leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED, IDFC, and LIC.

**About the Role**

The role owns the commercial relationship and ensures each account is getting real value from Sarvam’s products, expanding into new use cases, and renewing with conviction. You are the single point of commercial accountability for your book of business. You will work at the intersection of the client, the delivery team (FDSEs, CSEs, CSMs), and Sarvam’s product and GTM leadership. What you learn in the field shapes how the company prioritises product improvements, structures pricing, and designs its post-sales playbooks. If you are someone who combines commercial sharpness with genuine curiosity about how AI products create value for enterprise clients, this role is for you.

**Responsibilities**

* Own the full commercial relationship across a portfolio of Sarvam’s enterprise accounts: renewals, expansion, cross-sell, and net revenue retention
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with key stakeholders across your accounts, from operational teams running Sarvam products daily to CXO-level sponsors
* Drive account expansion by identifying new use cases, business units, and product lines where Sarvam can deliver incremental value
* Lead renewal negotiations end-to-end, including pricing, scope, and contract structuring, in close coordination with GTM leadership
* Run structured account reviews (QBRs, health checks, success plans) that demonstrate measurable business impact and align both sides on next steps
* Use product usage data, delivery metrics, and client feedback to proactively identify health signals, adoption gaps, and churn risk
* Work closely with FDSEs, CSEs, and CSMs to ensure delivery quality remains high and client expectations are met throughout the engagement lifecycle
* Translate client feedback, feature requests, and competitive intelligence back to product teams with enough context and specificity to be actionable
* Contribute to building Sarvam’s post-sales playbook: account segmentation frameworks, expansion motions, health scoring models, and renewal processes

**Qualifications**

* 8-20 years of experience in enterprise sales ales, account management, customer success, or post-sales roles within B2B SaaS, enterprise technology, or AI/ML products
* Proven track record of owning and exceeding revenue targets, specifically renewal rates and net revenue retention (NRR) metrics

**Required Skills**

* Commercial instinct: you segment your book by expansion potential, keep active expansion conversations going, and build business cases that land with economic buyers
* Ability to hold a technical conversation with an engineering or product team on the client side. You do not need to write code, but you need to understand how APIs, integrations, and AI workflows connect
* Strong communication skills: you can move fluidly between an operational lead, a technical counterpart, and a procurement team within the same account
* Comfort using product data and analytics to drive account decisions rather than relying on gut feel alone
* Experience working in a fast-moving environment where you build process as you go, not inherit it from a mature org

**Preferred Skills**

* Prior experience managing accounts in conversational AI, voice technology, language technology, or document intelligence
* Familiarity with the Indian enterprise buying landscape: procurement cycles, compliance requirements, multi-stakeholder decision-making, and government contracting norms
* Experience working alongside Forward Deployed Engineering, professional services, or delivery teams in a post-sales capacity
* Background in consulting, solutions engineering, or customer success before moving into account management
* Hands-on experience with CRM and customer health tools (Salesforce, HubSpot, Gainsight, or equivalent)

**Pay range and compensation package**

Note: We are looking for people who can own the outcomes described here, not people who match every line of this specification. If this problem excites you and you believe you can do this work, we want to hear from you.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

Sarvam is a fast-moving, high talent-density team building full-stack AI for India, working on problems that push the frontiers of AI with real population-scale impact. Work alongside researchers, engineers, builders, and business leaders who move fast and hold each other to a very high bar. High ownership and high impact, from day one. Everything we do is AI-first, from the way we build and ship to the way we think about problems. You can work on problems that could change how an entire country learns, works, and communicates. If you want to work on problems at the frontier of AI in India, Sarvam is the place to be.

title: IT Security Analyst
description:

Our organization provides software engineering, application development, cloud solutions, Salesforce implementation, mobile application development, and managed IT services to large enterprise customers. The successful candidate will be responsible for supporting day-to-day security operations, monitoring security threats, identifying vulnerabilities, enforcing security policies, and ensuring adherence to established cybersecurity standards.

 Vulnerability Assessment & Remediation

title: GCC | Product Security Engineer
description:
Cordance is dedicated to accelerating the growth of vertically focused business-to-business (B2B) software-as-a-service (SaaS) companies through acquisition and long-term tactical and financial guidance. We’re experienced operators and subject-matter experts with a passion for software and building businesses. We partner with founders to help them scale their businesses and realize their companies’ full potential.
  
  
We look for businesses with strong leadership and high potential for profitable growth, and work together to increase year-over-year revenue, company efficiency, and impact. Cordance envisions that all companies we work with achieve their full potential. We embrace what makes each company great and build on those foundations. We believe in elevating a company as it scales, delivering dignity to the organization and its employees, and sharing a passion for building a legacy.
  
  
What you will do
  
  
*Development and remediation*

* Fix vulnerabilities directly in application code, in whatever language or framework the application uses, and add tests that prove the fix.
* Fix root causes, not single instances: build shared validation, output encoding, parameterized queries, and authorization checks that remove whole classes of vulnerabilities.
* Upgrade vulnerable libraries, frameworks, and third-party components, resolve breaking changes, and keep builds and tests passing.
* Build internal security tooling and automation: scanner integrations, triage and reporting scripts, and checks that catch issues before release.
* Integrate SAST, DAST, and SCA tooling such as Aikido into CI/CD pipelines, and tune the rules to cut noise.
* Fix infrastructure and configuration issues: web server and TLS settings, cloud IAM and network rules, container and Kubernetes configuration, infrastructure-as-code, and CI/CD pipeline hardening.
* Where code or infrastructure is owned by another team, raise the change yourself as a pull request and drive it to merge.

*Security testing*

* Test web applications and APIs for exploitable vulnerabilities.
* Review code and design for flaws in authentication, authorization, session handling, data flows, and secrets management.
* Run and tune vulnerability scans across applications, hosts, or cloud accounts, and prioritize findings by exploitability and business impact alongside CVSS.
* Retest fixes and close findings only when the vulnerability is confirmed resolved.

*Reporting and communication*

* Write clear findings and fix notes with reproduction steps, evidence, risk rating, and the change made.
* Agree on realistic remediation timelines with engineers, and share secure coding patterns so the same issues stop recurring.

What you bring
  
  
**Experience**

* 5+ years total: approx. 3.5 years building and shipping production software as a developer, and approx. 1.5+ years of hands-on security work such as VAPT, application security, or secure code review.
* A track record of fixing security issues in code.

*Development expertise*

* Production-level depth in at least two of: Java, C#/.NET, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, PHP, Go, Swift, or Kotlin. Comfortable reading and changing code in languages you know less well.
* Able to land a correct, tested fix in an unfamiliar codebase without breaking existing behavior.
* Web and API development: REST and GraphQL services; authentication with OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and JWT; session management; databases and ORMs.
* Unit and integration testing, Git-based workflows, pull requests, and code review.
* CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code such as Terraform or CloudFormation.
* Working knowledge of Nginx, Apache, IIS, and TLS configuration.
* Scripting in Python, Bash, or PowerShell to automate testing and remediation.

*Communication*

* Clear written findings and the ability to explain risk and trade-offs to engineers and business stakeholders.

*Nice to have*

* Web and API: manual testing with Burp Suite Professional; OWASP Top 10 and ASVS; injection, authentication and session flaws, access control (IDOR/BOLA), SSRF, and OAuth and JWT weaknesses.
* Secure code review: spotting vulnerable patterns in code and using SAST and SCA results to find and fix real issues.
* Built security tools, Burp extensions, or custom SAST rules (for example, Semgrep or CodeQL).
* Threat modeling and secure design review experience.
* Familiarity with compliance evidence requirements (ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS) as they relate to vulnerability remediation.

*What success looks like*

* Vulnerabilities reach merged, tested fixes within agreed timelines.
* Recurring vulnerability classes decline because fixes address root causes.
* The tooling and automation you build catch issues before release and cut manual triage.
* Development teams see you as a fellow engineer who ships fixes alongside them.
* Cloud misconfiguration and patch exposure windows stay short.

*Please note that we do not accept unsolicited resumes, work on a Corp-to-Corp basis, or engage with non-vetted external agencies.*
Why Join Us?
  
  
**Benefits**
At Cordance, we believe in taking care of our team members. When you join us, you’ll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and work-life balance:
  
  

* Health and Wellness:

+ Comprehensive Health Coverage: Coverage begins on your first day of employment.

* Retirement Savings:

+ 401K Plan (US): We match 1:1 for the first 3% of contributions and 0.5:1 for the next 2%. Contribute 5% of your salary and get a 4% match. Choose from pre-tax and Roth options. You’re eligible the first of the month after 90 days and immediately vested.
+ RRSP (CAN): We match 1:1 for the first 3% of contributions and 0.5:1 for the next 2%. Contribute 5% of your salary and get a 4% match. Choose from pre-tax and Roth options. You’re eligible the first of the month after 90 days and immediately vested.

* Paid Time Off:

+ Flexible PTO: Enjoy uncapped paid time off to balance your work and personal life.

* Parental Leave:

+ 12 weeks paid leave for all employees.

* Remote Work Support:

+ Monthly Stipend: Receive $75 USD / $140 CAD per month for phone and internet if you work remotely.

* Holidays:

+ Generous Holiday Schedule: Benefit from an extensive list of holidays to recharge and spend time with loved ones.

Join us and be part of a company that values your contributions and well-being from day one!

If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact Human Resources.**

title: Data Business Analyst
description:
Hiring: Data Business Analyst – SQL | Data Analytics | Agile | AI

We are looking for an experienced
**Data Business Analyst**
with 6+ years of relevant experience in Business Analysis, Data Analytics, SQL, and Agile methodologies.

The ideal candidate should have a strong combination of technical data expertise and business understanding, with the ability to analyze complex datasets, understand business requirements, identify trends, and translate data into meaningful business insights.

The candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, Product Owners, Project Managers, and technical/data teams to gather requirements, define business objectives, and ensure successful delivery of data-driven solutions.

Job Details

* **Job Title:**
  Data Business Analyst
* **Experience:**
  6+ Years
* **Work Mode:**
  Remote / Pune
* **Location:**
  Pune / Remote
* **Notice Period:**
  Immediate Joiners Preferred
* **Employment Type:**
  [Full-Time / Contract]

Key Responsibilities

**1. Business Analysis & Stakeholder Management**

* Understand business requirements, project objectives, and business challenges.
* Gather, analyze, and document business requirements from stakeholders.
* Translate business requirements into functional specifications and actionable insights.
* Act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical/data teams.
* Identify business gaps, opportunities, and areas for process improvement.
* Conduct stakeholder discussions and provide recommendations based on business needs.

**2. Data Analysis & SQL**

* Write and execute SQL queries to extract, analyze, and validate business data.
* Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and business insights.
* Interpret data from a business perspective and translate findings into meaningful recommendations.
* Perform data validation, reconciliation, and quality checks.
* Prepare analytical reports and support data-driven business decisions.

**3. Agile & Project Management**

* Work in Agile/Scrum environments and participate in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Prepare Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs), and user stories.
* Define acceptance criteria and coordinate with development and technical teams.
* Track project deliverables, dependencies, priorities, and business requirements.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Project Managers, and cross-functional teams.

**4. AI & Data-Driven Business Insights**

* Understand AI/ML concepts and their practical business applications.
* Identify opportunities for AI, automation, and process optimization.
* Analyze AI-driven outputs and translate them into meaningful business recommendations.
* Collaborate with AI/ML and data teams to understand project requirements and expected outcomes.
* Support business teams in leveraging data and AI-driven insights for decision-making.

Mandatory Skills & Experience

* 6+ years of relevant experience in Business Analysis and/or Data Analysis.
* Strong hands-on experience with SQL and data querying.
* Good understanding of Data Analytics, data interpretation, and data validation.
* Experience in business requirement gathering and documentation.
* Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* Ability to translate business requirements into technical and functional specifications.
* Experience preparing BRDs, FRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills.
* Understanding of AI/ML concepts and their business applications.
* Ability to analyze data from both technical and business perspectives.

Good-to-Have Skills

* Experience with Power BI or other data visualization tools.
* Exposure to AI/ML, Generative AI, and automation initiatives.
* Experience working on data-driven business transformation projects.
* Knowledge of JIRA, Confluence, and Agile project management tools.
* Experience preparing dashboards, analytical reports, and business presentations.
* Exposure to AI-powered business analytics and decision-support solutions.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for candidates who combine strong Business Analysis and Data Analysis capabilities.

The ideal candidate should be able to:

* Understand business objectives and stakeholder expectations.
* Analyze underlying datasets using SQL.
* Identify meaningful trends, patterns, and business opportunities.
* Translate business problems into actionable technical requirements.
* Communicate analytical findings and recommendations effectively to stakeholders.
* Collaborate with technical teams to ensure business expectations are met.

**Important:**
Candidates with a combination of Business Analyst + Data Analyst experience will be preferred over purely technical SQL Developers or Data Engineers.

Notice Period

* Immediate joiners are strongly preferred.

title: Project Implementation Engineer - Construction Product
description:
The Project Implementation Engineer - Construction Product trains project teams on NirmaanXD, sets up projects on the platform, and supports them through execution. The role owns the model-to-schedule link on each project: auditing the model, configuring it, building activity templates, and keeping the model current as the project moves.

**About the Visual Planning Product - NirmaanXD**

NirmaanXD is vConstruct's model-based construction planning and production tracking platform. It connects BIM models (Revit, IFC, Navisworks) to the construction schedule: model-based WBS creation, quantity-backed activity durations, 4D visualization, field-ready lookaheads, and progress tracking. Schedules exchange with Primavera P6 and MS Project through XML import/export.

**Key responsibilities**

**Product training and onboarding**

* Deliver NirmaanXD training to project teams: VDC, planners and schedulers, project engineers, superintendents, and trade partners.
* Onboard new users and projects; tailor sessions to each role's workflow.
* Maintain training material and act as first-line product support for assigned projects.

**Project setup**

* Model audit: review incoming models in Navisworks or similar tools and decide whether each model is usable as-is or needs modification. Check element categorization, parameters, levels and zones, naming, completeness, and level of detail against NirmaanXD's requirements.
* Document audit findings and the remediation required, with owner and timeline.
* Model configuration: set up element filtering and exclusion rules, WBS mapping, and location or zone breakdown.
* Activity template configuration: build activity mapping rules, quantity links, and production rates aligned to the project schedule.

**Implementation support**

* Support project teams through execution: model updates and re-imports, schedule alignment, lookaheads, and progress tracking setup.
* Troubleshoot data and configuration issues; escalate product defects to the NirmaanXD product team with clear reproduction steps.
* Capture user feedback and feature requests from projects.

**Model queries**

* Resolve model-related questions from project teams: missing or misclassified elements, quantity discrepancies, mapping gaps.
* Trace issues to source (model, configuration, or schedule) and fix or route them.

**Project meetings**

* Attend and lead weekly project meetings: Project Kick-off, Scope alignment, timeline, project setup and onboarding, open model and configuration issues, lookahead reviews, progress status.
* Track action items to closure.

**Model changes**

* Make model changes needed for NirmaanXD: add or correct parameters, split elements by pour or zone, reclassify elements, and fix naming.
* Coordinate larger changes with the model author.

**Required skills**

* Working understanding of BIM and VDC processes: model coordination, model structure, and how models feed downstream construction workflows.
* Hands-on experience performing model audits in Navisworks or similar tools: search and selection sets, property review, completeness checks.
* Ability to edit model data at least at the property and selection level to support configuration.
* Clear spoken and written English for training delivery and client-facing meetings with US project teams.
* Model authoring experience in Revit, Tekla, or similar tools.

**Good-to-have skills**

* Planning or scheduling experience: CPM scheduling in Primavera P6 or MS Project, WBS development, lookahead planning.
* Exposure to lean planning methods (Last Planner System, pull planning, TAKT) or 4D tools (Synchro, Navisworks TimeLiner).
* Quantity takeoff from models and familiarity with production rates by trade.
* Experience supporting US construction projects or field teams.

**Competency**

* Training delivery: explains a model-based workflow to users with no BIM background, including superintendents and trade foremen.
* Structured problem solving: isolates whether an issue sits in the model, the configuration, or the schedule before acting.
* Meeting ownership: runs a weekly meeting to an agenda, drives decisions, and closes actions.
* Data discipline: documents audit findings, configuration decisions, and model changes so another specialist can pick up the project.
* Product feedback: reports defects and gaps to the product team with evidence, not anecdotes

**About vConstruct**
: vConstruct specializes in providing high-quality Building Information Modeling, Lean Construction, Integrated Project Delivery and Software Solutions for global construction projects. vConstruct is a wholly owned subsidiary of DPR Construction, USA. The Software Unit for vConstruct works on many interesting problems in Construction Technology. It works across different sets of software technologies such as Web Applications, Workflow Management, Analytics, Machine Learning, and IoT. For more information, please visit www.vconstruct.com.

title: Profit And Loss Head
description:
**Company Description**
Magic Stone Spaces LLP is a growing organization focused on delivering high-quality, innovative solutions in its chosen market segment. The company aims to build a strong, sustainable business through disciplined financial management, operational efficiency, and customer-centric services. Magic Stone Spaces LLP values integrity, accountability, and collaborative decision-making at all levels. Team members are encouraged to take ownership of outcomes and contribute ideas that support profitable growth. The work environment is structured yet flexible, offering opportunities for professional development and impact.

**Role Description**
The Profit and Loss Head is responsible for overseeing the overall financial performance of the business, with a focus on revenue growth, cost control, and profitability. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Pune City. Day-to-day responsibilities include monitoring and analyzing P&L statements, setting financial targets, preparing budgets and forecasts, and tracking variances against plan. The role involves partnering with operations, sales, and leadership teams to evaluate business initiatives, optimize pricing, manage expenditures, and improve margins. The Profit and Loss Head will also establish financial processes, ensure compliance with internal controls, prepare regular management reports, and support strategic planning through data-driven insights.

**Qualifications**

* Strong skills in financial analysis, P&L management, budgeting, and forecasting, with the ability to interpret complex financial data and drive decisions.
* Experience in cost control, revenue optimization, and margin improvement within a business or unit-level leadership role.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams (operations, sales, finance) and influence stakeholders through clear, objective communication.
* Sound knowledge of accounting principles, financial controls, and compliance practices; familiarity with financial reporting tools and spreadsheets.
* Proven track record of leading initiatives that enhance profitability, operational efficiency, and business scalability.
* Strong problem-solving, strategic thinking, and decision-making skills, with attention to detail and a focus on measurable outcomes.
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Management, or a related field; advanced qualifications (e.g., MBA, CA, CMA) are an advantage.
* Previous experience in a profit-center or business-head capacity, preferably in a similar industry or project-based environment.
* Ability to work on-site in Pune City, with readiness to engage closely with internal teams and leadership on day-to-day operations.

As part of our global engineering and technology organization, you'll collaborate with talented colleagues across the United States and India to build products used by more than 3,000 brokerages and 400,000 real estate professionals worldwide.

If you're passionate about solving meaningful problems, building high-quality software, and working in a collaborative, growth-oriented environment, we'd love to have you on our team.

* Customer First
* Innovative
* Passionate
* Sense of Urgency
* Accountable & Reliable
* Relentless Execution

Join MoxiWorks in Pune and help shape the future of PropTech while growing your career with a global team committed to innovation, collaboration, and delivering exceptional customer outcomes.

**Your Next Opportunity:**

**About the Role**

**Billing and invoicing (ANZ)**

* Review and issue monthly subscription invoices in the billing platform (Maxio), with correct quantity, unit price, and coding.
* Process user count adjustments and prepare the related user count reports.
* Process customer cancellations and update subscription schedules on the billing platform.
* Cross-check invoicing between the billing platform (Maxio) and NetSuite each cycle and resolve differences before closing.

**Cash application and reconciliation (ANZ)**

* Post customer payment receipts and apply them to the correct invoices.
* Prepare ANZ bank reconciliations and investigate unmatched items.

**Collections (ANZ and US)**

* Follow up on outstanding and overdue invoices and drive the collection process for ANZ customers.
* Manage payment follow-ups, including payment plans, remittance requests, and short payments.
* Support collections for US customers, working alongside the US AR team.
* Prepare consolidated Collections KPI reporting for ANZ and US for the Revenue & Collections Manager.

**Customer and internal support**

* Monitor and respond to the ANZ accounts inbox in a timely manner.
* Answer Customer Success and Sales requests about invoices, contracts, payments and account status.
* Explain invoicing issues clearly to customers and account managers and see each one through to resolution.

**Process improvement**

* Follow and help maintain documented procedures (SOPs and Scribe walkthroughs) for every task you own.
* Suggest and help implement ways to streamline billing and collections, including AR automation such as automated dunning, AI-assisted cash application and customer payment portals
* Check that customer, invoice, and payment records stay in sync across billing, ERP, payment and CRM systems.
* Assist with month-end tasks and special projects as needed.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Commerce (B.Com) or Finance preferred.
* 2–3 years' experience in accounts receivable, billing or collections, with increasing responsibility.
* Experience supporting Australia, New Zealand or US customers, for example in a shared services or offshore accounting team, preferred.
* Experience at a SaaS or subscription business
* Experience with multicurrency transactions (AUD, NZD, USD) and foreign exchange accounting treatment preferred.
* Hands-on experience with NetSuite and Maxio preferred; similar billing platforms (Chargebee, Zuora, Zoho Billing, Recurly) or ERP AR modules (Oracle Fusion / EBS R12, SAP FI-AR) also welcome
* Exposure to AR automation tools (HighRadius, Tesorio, Billtrust, Versapay, Upflow), payment gateways (Stripe, Razorpay, PayPal, GoCardless) and CRM or ticketing tools (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zendesk, Freshdesk) is a plus.
* Advanced Microsoft Office skills, especially Excel (lookups, pivot tables, reconciliations); Power Query, Power BI, Tableau or basic SQL a plus.

**Skills and competencies**

* Strong written and spoken English, with a clear, professional tone in customer emails and calls.
* Hands-on and willing to get into the details to understand customer contracts and company processes.
* Analytical and data-driven, able to solve problems independently, patient, and with a strong work ethic.
* Tech-savvy and quick to learn new finance systems, with interest in automation tools such as Power Automate or RPA
* Comfortable working with a team spread across India, the US and ANZ, using Microsoft teams

**Working hours and other details**

* Core hours must overlap with ANZ business hours with some overlap with the US team; the preferred schedule is 5am-1pm IST
* Training will be provided through SOPs and Scribe walkthroughs, with the Revenue & Collections Manager and US AR team as onboarding backups.

title: SDE Intern (Full Stack & AI)
description:
Aleph Technologies is hiring SDE Interns (Full Stack & AI).

Location: Pune (Hybrid). Remote within India also considered.

Duration: 6 months, starting December (slightly flexible)

Type: Paid internship

**BEFORE YOU APPLY**

Your resume MUST include:

• A link to your GitHub

• At least one project you built, with a link (repo, deployed app or demo video). For group projects, say clearly which parts were yours.

We look at what you've built before anything else. Applications without GitHub and project links will not be reviewed.

**ABOUT ALEPH**

Aleph Technologies builds intelligent systems that solve complex operational challenges in asset-intensive industries, including aviation and logistics. Our product, Aleph Aero, is an AI-powered airport operations platform. It helps large hub airports plan how they run, respond to disruptions in real time, and replace Excel spreadsheets and clunky legacy systems with something planners want to use.

We are a small, fast-moving team. Interns work directly with the founding team on production systems, not side projects.

**THE ROLE**

Most of the work is on the backend. You'll work on a Python codebase that covers API services, optimisation, simulation, analytics and an AI agent layer, and on the screens airport planners use. This is not a "fetch coffee and watch" internship. You will write code that ships, take part in design discussions, and see your work used in real operational settings.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

• Build and extend backend services and APIs in Python, guided by senior engineers

• Build features in our AI agent layer: LLM tool-calling that reads from and acts on the operational model

• Test and evaluate AI behaviour on real scenarios, and find out where it breaks

• Turn real operational data (CSV, Excel, JSON) into models that help planners make decisions

• Work out what the data can and can't tell us, and write down your assumptions and limits

• Build and refine React screens that show your work to planners

• Write tests, debug issues, and improve your work based on feedback

• Work in short build–deploy–learn cycles through Git, pull requests and async communication

**MUST HAVES**

• Solid Python fundamentals

• Some backend experience from internships, coursework or personal projects (APIs, data models, services)

• Comfort with Git and collaborative workflows

• You can debug, not just copy and paste, and you can explain your own code

• Comfort working with data in tables, spreadsheets and files

• Good written communication (we're async-first and distributed)

• Self-starter energy: you don't wait to be told what to do next

**GREAT TO HAVES**

• FastAPI, Flask or a similar framework

• Any of: SQLAlchemy, Postgres, NetworkX, pytest, async Python

• Hands-on work with LLM APIs, function/tool calling or agent frameworks (e.g. LangGraph)

• Basic React and TypeScript

• Interest in simulation, optimisation, queueing or operations research

• Interest in aviation, logistics or operations

• Anything you've built end to end and can show

We care about what you can build and how you think, not where you went to school. Pre-final and final year students and recent graduates are all welcome.

**WHY ALEPH**

• Real impact from day one: your work is used by airport planners at large international hub airports

• Direct access to the founding team, with no layers of middle management

• Ownership of real work in the product, not a corner of someone else's

• Regular mentorship and real feedback

• Hard, meaningful problems: modelling, optimisation, AI agents and real operational data

• A clear path to full-time: strong performers may convert based on performance, impact and business needs

**HOW TO APPLY**

Apply through LinkedIn and answer all the screening questions. We review applications on a rolling basis. Shortlisted candidates will get an email with the next steps.

Aleph Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. We value diverse perspectives and believe the best teams are built from people with different backgrounds and experiences.

About Us: The Source Journey

At Source, we are digitizing the backbone of India's economy by streamlining traditional supply chains through technology and lean operations.

* **2014 | The Spark:**
  Mission to digitize India's fragmented industrial supply chains.
* **2017 | The Pivot to Lean:**

  Raised $1M from India SME Investments, scaling to ₹1,000 Cr+ topline profitably.
* **2025 | The 10x Era:**
  Series A expansion into Recycled Polymers and Paints; moving 0.5M tons of material across India.
* **2026 & Beyond | The Mission Continues:**
  Scaling to 1M tons, defining the future of Indian industrial distribution.

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on engineer to own complex technology initiatives from problem discovery to production-grade deployment and business outcomes.

This is a senior individual contributor (IC) role focused on engineering depth, problem-solving, and architectural ownership—not team management. You will work directly with business stakeholders, design architectures, write production code, and build AI-native systems end-to-end.

Key Responsibilities1. End-to-End Problem Ownership

* Own complex technology initiatives across the full lifecycle: problem discovery, solution design, deployment, and post-launch outcomes.
* Engage directly with business stakeholders to clarify ambiguous requirements, define actual problem statements, and align on scope.
* Remain accountable for total business impact rather than just code delivery.

2. Architecture and Hands-on Engineering

* Design and build scalable, reliable, secure, and maintainable software systems.
* Drive technical choices, evaluate tradeoffs, and write production-grade code across backend services, APIs, and data pipelines.
* Take projects from initial POCs to production deployment and long-term maintenance.

3. AI and LLM Engineering

* Design, train, evaluate, and deploy Large Language Models (LLMs), including training models from scratch.
* Build AI-native solutions that directly address core business workflows.
* Handle the end-to-end model lifecycle: data prep, architecture, fine-tuning/RAG, inference optimization, latency/cost control, and production monitoring.

4. Delivery & Production Ownership

* Deliver high-quality software on clear timelines by breaking complex tasks into milestones and proactively managing risks.
* Own testing, CI/CD, deployment, monitoring, incident response, and continuous evaluation for traditional and AI software.

5. Technical Judgment & Improvement

* Maintain high engineering standards and document key architectural decisions.
* Continuously optimize systems to reduce complexity, lower operational costs, and improve system observability and developer productivity.

Eligibility Criteria

* **Education:**
  Bachelor's degree in CS, Computer Engineering, IT, or related technical field. (Master's in CS/AI/ML preferred; equivalent strong industry experience accepted).
* **Experience:**
  6–10 years of hands-on software engineering experience delivering complex systems to production.

Required Technical Expertise

* **Backend Engineering:**
  Proficiency in Node.js, TypeScript/JavaScript, API design, async processing, and event-driven architecture.
* **System Design:**
  Expertise in distributed systems, scalability, database design, caching, messaging, and system integration.
* **AI/ML & LLM Engineering:**
  Deep understanding of deep learning, transformer architectures, tokenization, attention mechanisms, GPU utilization, and LLM internals.
* **LLM Training:**
  Direct experience training LLMs from scratch, fine-tuning, RAG, and serving models in production.
* **Frameworks & Languages:**
  Python, PyTorch, or TensorFlow.
* **Data Engineering:**
  Vector embeddings, data pipelines, dataset curation, and processing.
* **Infrastructure & Ops:**
  Docker, CI/CD, cloud/on-prem deployment, monitoring, and logging.
* **Databases:**
  SQL/NoSQL schema design, query optimization, and performance tuning.
* **Engineering Best Practices:**
  Automated testing, code reviews, version control, and security best practices.

Profile & Mindset

* **Owner Mindset:**
  Takes full responsibility for outcomes without needing every step defined.
* **Deep Problem Solver:**
  Investigates business root causes and edge cases before designing software.
* **Hands-on Craftsperson:**
  Writes code, debugs complex issues, and builds maintainable systems.
* **Clear Communicator:**
  Explains technical concepts clearly to business stakeholders to drive consensus.
* **Pragmatic:**
  Makes smart trade-offs between speed, cost, maintainability, and scalability.

Role Scope & Boundaries

* **NOT**
  a people-management or admin position.
* **NOT**
  a project coordination or task-tracking role.
* **NOT**
  limited to prompt engineering or AI experimentation—solutions must run reliably in production.

Success Metrics

* Successful end-to-end execution of complex engineering initiatives.
* Measurable business impact and system ROI.
* System quality, stability, scalability, and maintainability.
* Successful deployment and operation of production AI/LLM models.
* On-time delivery with effective risk management.

*The ideal candidate is a builder, problem solver, and owner who can translate complex business problems into production-ready software.*

title: Controller Financial Planning and Accounting
description:
Role Purpose

The Financial Controller will ensure accurate financial reporting, project-wise accounting, timely statutory compliance and audit readiness. The role will oversee month-end closing, budgeting, management reporting (MIS), fund utilisation, financial reconciliations and the implementation of Zoho Books, while ensuring compliance with applicable CSR, FCRA, GST and Income Tax requirements.

Key Responsibilities

1. Financial Reporting & Audit
2. Prepare financial statements, including the Balance Sheet, Income & Expenditure Account and Receipts & Payments Account.
3. Coordinate statutory and funder audits, respond to audit queries and implement audit recommendations.
4. Accounting & Month-End Closing
5. Maintain accurate books of accounts, including accruals, provisions, depreciation and adjustment entries.
6. Prepare monthly trial balances, reconciliations and surplus/deficit reports.
7. Ensure timely month-end closing and review accounting entries and supporting schedules.
8. Budgeting & MIS
9. Coordinate annual budget preparation with programme and project teams.
10. Monitor budgets, cash flows, fund allocation and expenditure variances.
11. Prepare monthly MIS reports covering income, expenses, fund utilisation, advances, receivables and payables.
12. Project Accounting & Fund Utilisation
13. Ensure accurate project-wise accounting in line with approved budgets, funder agreements and organisational policies.
14. Track fund utilisation, unspent CSR funds and budget variances.
15. Prepare and submit Utilisation Certificates (UCs) and donor financial reports on time.
16. Statutory & CSR Compliance
17. Ensure timely filing of GST and TDS returns, applications for lower TDS deduction certificates and donation-related filings.
18. Support Income Tax and FCRA compliance and maintain supporting documentation.
19. Maintain audit-ready records and ensure compliance with applicable CSR regulations and funder requirements.
20. Systems & Process Improvement
21. Support Zoho Books implementation, including data migration, ledger mapping, testing and reconciliation.
22. Manage accounting through Zoho Books/Tally and use Excel for analysis, reconciliations and reporting.
23. Improve accounting processes and share knowledge with the finance team on compliance and reporting.

We help companies collect, measure, validate and report their ESG data.

title: Sales Executive
description:
**Company Description**
Reliable Lifts India Private Limited is a vertical mobility specialist that has been redefining elevator solutions across Western India since 2009. The company operates as an end-to-end mobility consultant, supporting high-rise commercial buildings and customized luxury home lift projects, primarily in and around Pune. Its leadership team brings over 17 years of experience and has supervised more than 4,000 installations, backed by a strict 4-hour emergency response standard for service. Reliable Lifts focuses on advanced Machine Room-Less (MRL) hydraulic systems that improve energy efficiency while meeting IS 14465 safety standards and international quality benchmarks. From hospital stretcher lifts to panoramic glass elevators for premium residences, the company delivers reliable, safe, and modern mobility infrastructure.
  
**Role Description**
The Sales Executive role is a full-time, on-site position based in the Pune Division. The Sales Executive will identify and qualify new business opportunities, build and manage relationships with architects, builders, developers, and end customers, and promote Reliable Lifts’ portfolio of commercial and residential elevator solutions. Daily activities include conducting client meetings and site visits, preparing proposals and quotations, coordinating with engineering and installation teams to ensure accurate solutions, and following up to close deals and achieve sales targets. The role also involves monitoring market trends, participating in local marketing or promotional activities, maintaining accurate sales records in CRM or reporting tools, and providing feedback to management to improve offerings and customer experience.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong consultative sales and negotiation skills, with the ability to understand client needs and recommend suitable mobility solutions.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, including presentation abilities for meetings with architects, builders, and corporate clients.
* Basic technical understanding of elevators or mechanical/electrical systems, and willingness to learn product specifications and safety standards.
* Proficiency in lead generation, pipeline management, and use of CRM or sales tracking tools.
* Ability to work on-site, conduct regular field visits across the Pune Division, and manage time and territory effectively.
* Prior experience in B2B or infrastructure/real estate/elevator industry sales is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Business, Engineering, or a related field preferred.
* Self-motivated, target-oriented, and comfortable working both independently and in collaboration with cross-functional teams.

* **Key Skills:**
  Technical discovery, consultative selling, industrial ROI modelling, pipeline management, post-sales handoffs.

title: Senior Manager - Business Development
description:
**Job Title: Business Development Manager**
**Location: Pune**
**About Siemens Financial Services India**
Siemens Financial Services India is a subsidiary of Siemens AG and has been operating in India for approximately 15 years. As part of Siemens AG’s global financial services division, SFS India provides innovative and tailor-made financing solutions, including leases, loans, and working capital solutions, for SMEs and large corporates.
  
  
Our industry expertise spans healthcare, manufacturing, renewable energy, technology, and other focused sectors. This enables SFS India to understand sector-specific challenges and structure relevant financial solutions. Technology-enabled platforms, digital processing, online account management, and data analytics support a responsive and efficient customer experience.
  
  
**SERVICES OFFERED**
**Equipment Financing:**
SFS India provides financing solutions for the acquisition of Siemens, domestic, and imported OEM equipment and technology. Solutions include Lease that enable asset usage without ownership and loans structured for specific equipment purchases.
  
  
**Project Financing:**
Customized financing solutions are offered for infrastructure projects, industrial expansion, and renewable energy initiatives, aligned with project requirements and implementation timelines.
  
  
**Working Capital Finance:**
Solutions include Extended Payment Terms, Assignment of Receivables, Factoring, and other structures that help businesses manage working capital effectively.
  
  
**ROLE PURPOSE**
The Business Development Manager will grow equipment finance business by building strategic partnerships with domestic, imported, and global OEMs, developing embedded financing propositions, and converting partner-led opportunities into sustainable business volumes across SFS-focused industries.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and manage relationships with domestic, imported, and global OEMs across focused segments such as Healthcare, Packaging, Food & Beverage, Machine Tools, Plastics, and related industries.
* Co-create business opportunities with OEM partners through embedded and customized financial solutions that enable equipment sales and improve customer affordability.
* Build and maintain a qualified opportunity pipeline, from vendor engagement and customer identification through proposal development.
* Partner closely with Credit, Risk, Operations & Product functions, and other internal stakeholders to facilitate timely evaluation and turnaround of OEM-led opportunities.
* Build and drive long-term relationships with Indian equipment manufacturers, channel partners, and relevant ecosystem participants.
* Understand customer business models, cash flows, equipment applications, and industry dynamics to structure appropriate lease, loan, and working capital solutions.
* Deliver agreed business volumes, profitability, portfolio quality, and partner activation objectives in line with SFS priorities and governance standards.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activity, investment cycles, and emerging financing needs, and convert insights into targeted business development actions.
* Maintain disciplined pipeline reporting, including opportunity status, forecasts, partner plans, and key risks or dependencies.
* Represent SFS India in vendor meetings, Exhibition / Trade Fairs, Customer Seminars, and joint go-to-market initiatives.

**Qualifications And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Engineering, Economics, or a related field; MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification preferred.
* Proven experience in business development, relationship management, equipment finance, leasing, lending, vendor finance, or a related B2B financial services role.
* Demonstrated ability to originate opportunities, develop strategic partnerships, and manage a transaction pipeline from concept to closure.
* Experience working with MNC OEMs, domestic equipment manufacturers, distributors, or channel partners is preferred.
* Understanding of financial solutions and the ability to develop customized commercial structures for customers.
* Familiarity with Siemens businesses, components, verticals, or partner ecosystems will be an advantage.

**Skills And Competencies**

* Strong commercial acumen with an understanding of financial statements, cash flows, pricing, risk-return considerations, and solution structuring.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Customer-centric and consultative approach, with the ability to translate business needs into practical financing solutions.
* High ownership, initiative, and ability to work independently in a target-oriented environment.
* Ability to collaborate across functions and navigate internal approval processes effectively.
* Strong planning, analytical, problem-solving, and execution capabilities.
* Integrity, compliance orientation, and disciplined adherence to applicable policies and regulatory requirements.

title: Senior Database Administrator – Database Platform
description:
**About The Role**
We are looking for an experienced
**Senior Database Administrator (DBA)**
to design, build, and manage reliable, scalable, and secure database infrastructure.
  
  
In this role, you will contribute to the evolution of database architecture, standards, automation, and operational best practices. You will work closely with engineering and infrastructure teams to ensure database platforms support high levels of performance, availability, scalability, and reliability.
  
  
The role involves managing database infrastructure across on-premise and cloud environments, with a strong focus on automation, infrastructure-as-code, and reducing manual operational effort.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Database Administration
  
  

* Deploy, configure, maintain, patch, and upgrade SQL Server and PostgreSQL database environments across development, testing, and production.
* Ensure database servers are securely configured and aligned with operational standards.
* Manage backup, restore, and maintenance strategies to ensure data protection and system availability.
* Support and maintain database platforms across multiple environments.

Cloud Database Management
  
  

* Deploy and manage database infrastructure within Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Provision and manage database servers using Compute Engine virtual machines and managed services such as Cloud SQL.
* Configure networking, storage, security, and access controls for cloud-hosted database environments.
* Implement backup, replication, and disaster recovery strategies for cloud-based database systems.

High Availability & Disaster Recovery
  
  

* Design, implement, and maintain high availability and disaster recovery solutions.
* Configure and support database replication technologies, including transactional replication where required.
* Work with technologies such as SQL Server AlwaysOn Availability Groups, Failover Clustering, and PostgreSQL replication.
* Conduct regular testing of backup and recovery procedures.

Monitoring & Operations
  
  

* Implement and maintain database monitoring and alerting using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, SQL Monitor, or similar platforms.
* Proactively monitor database performance, availability, and operational health.
* Provide database platform expertise and operational support to engineering teams.
* Participate in an on-call rotation to support production systems.
* Support out-of-hours deployments, maintenance, and operational activities when required.

Performance Optimization
  
  

* Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve database performance issues.
* Collaborate with development teams to optimize SQL queries, indexing strategies, and database schema design.
* Continuously improve database performance, reliability, and operational efficiency.

Automation & Platform Tooling
  
  

* Develop automation and tooling for database provisioning, patching, backup management, and routine maintenance.
* Reduce manual operational work by implementing repeatable and automated database processes.
* Maintain automation scripts, configurations, and operational tooling in version-controlled repositories.
* Apply engineering practices such as source control, code reviews, and CI/CD to database automation and operational workflows.

Governance & Collaboration
  
  

* Contribute to the development and maintenance of database standards, procedures, and best practices.
* Ensure strong database security, access control, and auditing practices.
* Collaborate with engineering, infrastructure, and application teams to support database performance and reliability.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Strong production administration experience with SQL Server and PostgreSQL.
* Experience deploying and managing database infrastructure in Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Knowledge of GCP services such as Compute Engine, Cloud SQL, persistent storage, networking, and IAM.
* Strong experience designing and supporting High Availability and Disaster Recovery (HA/DR) architectures.
* Hands-on experience with SQL Server AlwaysOn Availability Groups and Failover Clustering.
* Knowledge of database replication technologies, including transactional replication.
* Experience with database installation, configuration, patching, upgrades, backup, and recovery.
* Strong understanding of database security and access control best practices.
* Experience implementing monitoring and alerting using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, SQL Monitor, or similar database observability platforms.
* Experience automating database administration tasks using PowerShell, Python, or similar scripting languages.
* Familiarity with Git, version control, and CI/CD workflows.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, infrastructure, and application development teams.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with additional database technologies such as Couchbase or CockroachDB.
* Experience managing large-scale database platforms supporting multiple engineering teams.
* Strong focus on automation, platform engineering, and reducing manual operational work.

**What We’re Looking For**

* A technically strong DBA with a focus on building reliable and scalable database platforms.
* Someone who takes ownership of database performance, availability, and operational efficiency.
* A professional with a strong automation mindset and experience improving operational processes.
* A collaborative team member who can work effectively with developers, engineers, and infrastructure teams.

**Equal Opportunity**
We are an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an inclusive and respectful workplace. Employment decisions are based on skills, experience, qualifications, and business requirements, in accordance with applicable laws.

title: Business Intelligence Engineer
description:

Our software engineering teams are highly valued by customers, whether start-ups or established enterprises, because we consistently deliver solutions that drive revenue growth.
