We are driven and expect the same dedication from our team members. Our speed, agility, and dedication set us apart, and we perform best when surrounded by high-energy, driven individuals.

To continue our rapid growth and deliver an even greater impact, we invite you to apply for our open positions and become part of our journey!

About the Role

As a Business Intelligence Engineer, you'll design, build, and deploy BI solutions and reliable, accurate data marts that drive business growth and make operations more efficient. This is a hands-on role: you'll own ETL development, write the SQL behind reports and data models, build dashboards, and support the analytics platforms in production. With 5–7 years of experience, you translate business needs into technical specifications and deliver solutions that internal and external customers rely on.

• Experience: 5–7 years in business intelligence and data engineering

• Location: Pune / Bangalore

• Timings: India-based.

What You'll Do

BI Solutions & Reporting

• Design, build, and deploy BI solutions and data marts for internal and external customers

• Build dashboards and custom reports using tools such as Sisense, Power BI, or Tableau

• Provide ad-hoc reports where self-service isn't available or possible

Data Engineering & ETL

• Develop and enhance ETL/ELT processes using tools such as Fivetran and dbt

• Write database queries, stored procedures, functions, and views in PostgreSQL and BigQuery

• Continuously improve BI systems and data structures for performance, accuracy, integrity, and security

Data Quality & Platform Support

• Spot data trends and fix data quality issues quickly, completely, and permanently

• Support analytics platforms in production: troubleshooting and testing across PostgreSQL, BigQuery, and BI tools

• Follow the software development life cycle across all development work

Collaboration & Documentation

• Work with IT peers and business partners to balance production support, service requests, and roadmap initiatives

• Maintain BI documentation and source system data mapping

• Share domain and technical expertise through mentoring and cross-training

What You'll Need (Must Have)

• 5–7 years in business intelligence, data warehousing, or data engineering

• Advanced SQL: queries, stored procedures, functions, and views

• ETL/ELT: hands-on development and enhancement of ETL packages and processes

• Databases & OLAP: hands-on experience with database management systems and online analytical processing

• BI Tools: you've built dashboards yourself in Sisense, Power BI, Tableau, or similar

• JSON and XML

• Strong analytical skills: able to translate business needs into technical specifications

• Proficiency in MS Office, especially Excel

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related engineering field

Good to Have

• Google BigQuery and PostgreSQL

• Fivetran and dbt

• Experience with Sales, Operations, and Finance data and platforms

• Business systems such as general ledger, HRIS, or CRM

• Industry certifications in data or cloud technologies

Benefits

At Calfus, we value our employees and offer a strong benefits package. This includes medical, group, and parental insurance, coupled with gratuity and provident fund options. Further, we support employee wellness and provide birthday leave as a valued benefit.

Calfus is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We believe diversity drives innovation. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone, regardless of background, identity, or experience, has the opportunity to thrive. We welcome all applicants!

title: FIS Quantum/Integrity Treasury Application Specialist
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**Assurance - FAAS Senior – FIS Quantum Treasury Application Specialist**
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking an experienced FIS Quantum Treasury Application Specialist to support global clients in optimizing and managing their treasury operations using the FIS Quantum platform. This role provides an opportunity to work with a leading Treasury Management System that enables organizations to achieve centralized cash visibility, streamlined payment processing, and enhanced control over liquidity and financial operations.
  
  
You will play a critical role in supporting and enhancing FIS Quantum’s capabilities across cash management, payments, bank connectivity, in-house banking, forecasting, and treasury accounting. Working closely with treasury, finance, and IT teams, you will ensure seamless integration across systems, improve operational efficiency, and support compliance with global banking standards.
  
  
This role offers exposure to end-to-end treasury lifecycle activities, including transaction processing, automation, reporting, and process optimization, while driving continuous improvement within a dynamic global environment.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Application Support & Maintenance**

* Monitor and maintain the FIS Quantum application environment to ensure system stability and performance
* Configure and manage components such as static data, Cash Xplorer, Enterprise Workflow Framework (EWF), and interfaces
* Set up and manage Citrix Scheduler jobs for automation and reporting activities
* Support eBAM functionality for bank account management and electronic banking communication
* Troubleshoot system issues including FX deal failures, interface errors, and workflow disruptions
* Support system upgrades, patching, and enhancements
* Develop and maintain process documentation and knowledge repositories

**Payments & Bank Connectivity**

* Support end-to-end payment lifecycle, including payment initiation, validation, approval workflows, and transmission
* Manage bank connectivity channels (SWIFT FIN/FileAct, Host-to-Host, APIs)
* Configure transaction rules (SQL-based logic) to map bank and cash flows to treasury instruments
* Ensure compliance with global payment standards and formats (MT/MX messages)
* Monitor and resolve payment failures, exceptions, and connectivity issues

**Cash & Liquidity Management**

* Support cash positioning, bank balance monitoring, and global cash visibility
* Assist in cash forecasting and liquidity planning
* Enable treasury processes such as in-house banking and intercompany settlements
* Monitor and optimize cash flows and working capital efficiency

**Integration & Reporting**

* Ensure integration of bank statements (MT940, BAI2) and cashflow interfaces with Quantum and ERP systems
* Support reconciliation of bank transactions, cash positions, and accounting entries
* Generate operational reports, dashboards, and performance metrics
* Support data validation and ensure accuracy and completeness of financial data

**Client Interaction & Project Support**

* Act as a primary point of contact for client queries, incidents, and issue resolution
* Participate in FIS Quantum implementation and enhancement projects, including requirement gathering, configuration, and UAT
* Support onboarding of new entities, bank accounts, and treasury processes
* Collaborate in transition projects and continuous service improvement initiatives
* Contribute to process optimization and automation within treasury operations

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Ideally, you’ll also:**

* Hands-on experience with FIS Quantum Treasury Management System, including configuration and administration
* Strong understanding of treasury processes, including in-house banking, cash forecasting, and intercompany settlements
* Experience with Cash Xplorer, Enterprise Workflow Framework (EWF), and system interfaces
* Knowledge of bank connectivity channels (SWIFT, Host-to-Host, APIs) and payment processing workflows
* Familiarity with financial messaging formats (MT and MX) and bank statement formats (MT940, BAI2)
* Experience with SQL-based transaction rules and data mapping logic
* Understanding of eBAM (electronic bank account management) and bank communication processes
* Exposure to treasury accounting, reporting, and reconciliation processes

**What we look for:**

* Strong problem-solving skills to troubleshoot system issues, payment failures, and integration challenges
* Analytical mindset with attention to detail and focus on accuracy, reconciliation, and controls
* Ability to engage with treasury, finance, and IT stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver solutions
* Strong communication skills to translate technical concepts into business context
* Proactive and solution-oriented approach with focus on automation and process improvements
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, global environment supporting critical treasury operations
* High level of integrity, ownership, and accountability when handling financial information
* Team player with a willingness to learn and adapt to evolving treasury technologies
* Demonstrate a good understanding of accounting concepts; stay informed of professional standards and firm policies (e.g., guidelines of the EY GDS FAAS Policy Manual); and effectively apply this knowledge to moderately difficult and/or complex client situations
* Receive direction from the Manager, Senior Managers.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

We champion excellence, embrace emerging technologies, and offer industry-leading video services that feel made for each viewer.

As part of our team, you'll help shape the future of enterprise data platforms, enable advanced analytics and AI innovation, and contribute to business-critical capabilities that impact millions of customers. If you're ready to bring your expertise, leadership, and passion for innovation to a team redefining entertainment technology, we'd love to have you join us on this journey.

From AI-driven personalization to content built around what people actually want to watch, we're shaping what entertainment looks like next, and Pune is a big part of that.

* Validate data migration activities — pre-migration, mid-migration, and post-migration — ensuring data integrity and completeness.

description:
Oracle HCM Functional Consultant

**InfinityBridge | Location: Pune, Maharashtra | Contract: 12 Months (extendable) | On-site/Hybrid | US EST/CST overlap required**

InfinityBridge is hiring an Oracle HCM Functional Consultant for a high-impact engagement with a US-based client. This role needs deep Oracle HCM Cloud expertise and a strong track record in US Payroll and HCM operations.

**What You'll Do**

* Configure and support Oracle HCM Cloud modules end-to-end
* Lead requirement workshops with US HR and Payroll stakeholders
* Manage US Payroll — tax rules, garnishments, W-2, ACA compliance
* Handle US HCM — workforce structures and hire-to-retire lifecycle
* Provide functional inputs for Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC)

* Build OTBI reports, dashboards, and BI Publisher templates

* Redwood UI — page personalization and configuration
* OTBI — custom reports, subject areas, and dashboards
* BI Publisher — RTF templates, data models, and scheduling

* Payroll — US payroll rules, costing, and taxes
* Time & Labor — time rules, schedules, and worker time

**What You Bring**

* 6+ years of Oracle HCM Functional experience
* 3+ years of US Payroll / US HCM experience (mandatory)
* Strong knowledge of US compliance: W-2, ACA, FLSA, multi-state payroll

* Oracle HCM Cloud certification (any module)
* Oracle Fast Formulas experience

**What We're Looking For**

* Excellent communication skills, comfortable in client-facing workshops
* Ability to work independently across India–US time zones
* Detail-oriented with strong documentation practices
* Proactive in identifying risks and managing stakeholder expectations

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer(Data Scientist)
description:
**About The Role**
We are looking for a hands-on
**Machine Learning Engineer**
to design, build, and deliver end-to-end machine learning products at scale.
  
  
In this role, you will work across the complete ML lifecycle—from problem framing and research to production deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. You will balance the development of new AI capabilities with the modernization and optimization of existing machine learning solutions.
  
  
You will collaborate closely with Data Scientists, Software Engineers, Product Managers, and business stakeholders to transform complex business problems into scalable, measurable AI solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end machine learning projects, from scoping and data discovery through deployment, monitoring, and iteration.
* Design and deploy production-grade ML systems, including batch processing jobs, real-time APIs, and data and feature pipelines.
* Develop clean, reliable, fault-tolerant, and well-tested code using Python and SQL.
* Apply modern MLOps practices, including CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, model registries, and feature stores.
* Use AI-assisted development and coding tools to improve engineering productivity, code quality, testing, and development workflows.
* Select and apply appropriate machine learning approaches, including classical ML, deep learning, NLP, LLMs, RAG, and agentic AI systems.
* Work on use cases such as recommendations, search and ranking, forecasting, pricing, fraud detection, personalization, and supply chain optimization.
* Own feature engineering, experimentation, model evaluation, A/B testing, model monitoring, drift detection, and retraining strategies.
* Modernize legacy ML solutions and improve inference latency, cost efficiency, reproducibility, observability, and governance.
* Translate ambiguous business requirements into clearly defined machine learning problems and communicate technical trade-offs to stakeholders.
* Contribute to technical standards, ML platform improvements, and mentor junior engineers and data professionals.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, or a related quantitative discipline; equivalent practical experience will also be considered.
* Proven experience delivering machine learning products into production at scale.
* Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, data modelling, and software architecture.
* Strong knowledge of the end-to-end ML lifecycle, including data discovery, feature engineering, model development, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.
* Advanced Python programming skills with experience in libraries and tools such as Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, and Jupyter.
* Strong SQL skills for data analysis and analytical workflows.
* Hands-on experience using AI-assisted coding tools or coding agents as part of the software development lifecycle.
* Experience with at least one major cloud platform; experience with Google Cloud Platform is preferred.
* Practical knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines for machine learning workflows.
* Strong understanding of applied statistics, including hypothesis testing, sampling, experimentation, A/B testing, anomaly detection, predictive modelling, and regression analysis.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and work effectively across cross-functional teams.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with agent frameworks and AI agent development platforms.
* Hands-on experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow, particularly for computer vision or multimodal AI use cases.
* Experience with distributed data processing technologies such as Spark, Beam, or Dataflow.
* Experience with streaming technologies such as Kafka or Pub/Sub.
* Knowledge of feature stores and experiment-tracking tools such as Feast, MLflow, Weights & Biases, or similar platforms.
* Experience working on machine learning use cases in retail, e-commerce, fintech, or other large-scale digital platforms.
* Contributions to open-source projects, published technical work, Kaggle projects, or a strong public technical portfolio.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to work on modern AI and machine learning technologies.
* Exposure to complex, large-scale business and technology challenges.
* Collaborative environment with experienced engineering and data professionals.
* Opportunities for continuous learning, technical development, and career growth.

**Equal Opportunity**
We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building an inclusive and respectful workplace. Employment decisions are based on skills, qualifications, experience, and business requirements, without discrimination as protected by applicable laws.

description:

This is a hands-on role: you'll own ETL development, write the SQL behind reports and data models, build dashboards, and support the analytics platforms in production. Good to Have

• Fivetran and dbt

title: Product Lifecycle Analyst
description:
Castrol is one of the world’s leading lubricant brands, serving customers and consumers in the automotive, marine, industrial and energy sectors. Castrol brands are recognised globally for their premium quality and high performance, shaped by the company’s commitment to innovation and cutting-edge technology. With products sold in more than 150 countries, Castrol has helped keep things moving on roads and racetracks, air, sea, and space for over 125 years.
  
  
Whether you're just starting out or ready for your next big move, you're in the right place to explore an exciting career with Castrol.
  
  
**Job Description**
**About the team**
Reporting to the Global Product Portfolio Manager, the Product Lifecycle Analyst will work within the Global Product Portfolio team to support the development of best-in class portfolio management and governance practices within Castrol. The Product Lifecycle analyst will work closely with the Global Product Portfolio Manager to support:
  
  
The management and the governance of the entire Lubricants Product Portfolio
  
  
The compliance to and the continuous improvement of the portfolio. management process (OD&I process) and the established standards (Marketing Operating Framework).
  
  
The monitoring, maintenance and continuous improvement of the product lifecycle management tools and KPIs.
  
  
The Lubricants product portfolio is complex and dynamic – consisting of approximately 4,000 products and 18,000 SKUs:
  
  
Automotive (Cars, Bikes & Commercial Vehicles) – approx. 2,000 products
  
  
Industrial, Marine & Energy – approx. 2,000 products
  
  
**Key tasks**

* Perform product post launch analysis to develop insights, presenting clear tangible actionable recommendations & insights to minimize portfolio complexity and improve profitability, gaining buy-in for your recommendation.
* Work with product managers in the Mobility and Industrial/GME teams and the Performance Units to meet complexity targets, profitability thresholds of product variants and proactive life-cycle management at end-of-life.
* Act as first point of contact for portfolio enquiry. Assist with access, data, and tools access.
* Actively ensure standards are followed – Monitoring operational compliance of pipeline, leading correction where deviation is observed working across markets, marketing, function, and businesses.
* Support the Global Product Portfolio Manager in the preparation of the monthly Product Development Forum involving Senior Leaders. This includes preparation of high-quality pre-read and facilitation of meeting etc.
* Lead ad-hoc projects or interventions in the project portfolio, processes, or tools to ensure best usage and deployment of resources aligned with business strategy.
* Champion the digital agenda in the product portfolio governance and management process by developing and leading the continuous improvement of product lifecycle management tools, standards, practices and KPIs.

**Experience Required**

* Degree or equivalent professional qualification(s) is desirable.
* Analytical experience coupled with the ability to use analytics to solve problems & make decision is necessary. Prior experience of handling and analysing large amount of data leveraging Power BI is desirable.
* Excellent attention to details and data rigor.
* Project management or participation in prior projects. Practical experience of Agile methodologies is desirable.
* Ability to development good relationship & form business network globally.
* Fast learner – Able to grasp a complex global product portfolio as well as matrix organisation with numerous stakeholders across functions and businesses.

Privacy
  
  
The Castrol entity recruiting for this role is the data controller for the personal information you provide. We use it to assess your application and to manage the recruitment and onboarding process. We may share it with service providers who support our recruitment, and it may be transferred to other Castrol entities internationally under appropriate safeguards. We keep it only for as long as necessary. For details of how we use your information and your data protection rights, contact privacy.response@castrol.com.
  
  
*We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, socioeconomic status, neurodiversity/neurocognitive functioning, veteran status or disability status. Individuals with an accessibility need may request an adjustment/accommodation related to Castrol recruiting process (e.g., accessing the job application, completing required assessments, participating in telephone screenings or interviews, etc.).*

**Job Title: Senior Consultant** ( PTC Windchill Data Migration Expert )

  
  

**Experience**: 5-8 Years

  
  

**Technology**: PTC Windchill PLM, Data Migration, CAD Integration, SQL, Java

**Deployment Environment**: On-Premises / Microsoft Azure Cloud / AWS

  
  

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced PTC Windchill Migration Expert with 5–8 years of hands-on experience in PLM data migration, Windchill administration, customization and CAD data management. The candidate will be responsible for planning and executing Windchill migration activities, ensuring data integrity, business continuity and successful migration of PLM data across environments and platforms.

  
  

The role involves collaborating with business stakeholders, infrastructure teams and technical teams to deliver migration solutions aligned with business and technical requirements.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

Migration Strategy & Planning: Define migration strategy, scope, approach, timelines and dependencies for Windchill upgrades and PLM platform migrations.

Windchill Data Migration: Execute migration of Parts, Documents, CAD Documents, BOMs, lifecycle states, versions, iterations and change objects.

Source-to-Target Migration: Perform migration from legacy Windchill environments and other PLM platforms such as Siemens Teamcenter or Dassault ENOVIA.

CAD Data Migration: Handle Creo and multi-CAD data, including CAD structures, assemblies, dependencies, associations and representation files.

Migration Tools & Utilities: Develop and execute migration utilities using Windchill APIs, Java, SQL, loaders and supported bulk-loading mechanisms.

Data Mapping & Transformation: Define source-to-target mappings, attribute transformations, numbering rules, classification, lifecycle and organizational mappings.

Data Validation: Perform pre- and post-migration validation, reconciliation, referential integrity checks and completeness verification.

Migration Rehearsals: Execute mock migrations, trial loads, performance testing, error analysis and migration cycle optimization.

Troubleshooting: Resolve migration failures, data inconsistencies, missing references, duplicate objects and CAD association issues.

Documentation & Reporting: Maintain migration plans, mapping documents, reconciliation reports, issue logs and technical documentation.

Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with PLM architects, business users, CAD teams, database administrators and infrastructure teams.

  
  

**Required Technical Skills**

5-8 years of experience in PTC Windchill PLM, with substantial hands-on migration experience.

Strong knowledge of Windchill PDMLink, Part Management, Document Management, CAD Data Management, BOMs and Change Management.

Experience with Windchill version upgrades, environment migrations, or cross-platform PLM migrations.

Hands-on experience with Windchill APIs, Java, SQL, XML and supported bulk-loading or migration utilities.

Knowledge of Windchill object models, versioning, iterations, lifecycle states, workflows and object relationships.

Experience with CAD integrations, particularly Creo; exposure to NX, CATIA, or SolidWorks is an advantage.

Experience with source-to-target data mapping, transformation, reconciliation and migration validation.

Understanding of Windchill database structures, vaults, content storage and migration dependencies.

Familiarity with Linux/Windows environments, application logs and performance troubleshooting.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and documentation skills.

  
  

**Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills**

Experience with Windchill 11, 12, or 13.

Experience with Windchill Bulk Migrator (WBM).

Exposure to AWS, Microsoft Azure infrastructure and cloud-based PLM deployments.

Knowledge of MPMLink, PartsLink, ProjectLink and Supplier Management.

Understanding of migration security, access control, audit history and compliance requirements.

  
  

**Key Deliverables**

Source-system assessment and migration readiness report.

Data migration strategy, scope and execution plan.

Source-to-target mapping and transformation specifications.

Migration utilities, scripts and reusable components.

Trial migration and reconciliation reports.

Data quality and migration issue reports.

  
  

**Education**

Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent relevant experience.

  
  

**Success Criteria**

Accurate and complete migration of in-scope PLM data.

Preservation of CAD structures, BOM relationships, object associations and required metadata.

Successful reconciliation and business validation.

Completion of migration activities within agreed timelines.

title: Server Operations Engineer
description:
**About Medline**

Medline is the largest provider of medical-surgical products and supply chain solutions serving all points of care. Through its broad product portfolio, resilient supply chain and leading clinical solutions, Medline helps healthcare providers improve their clinical, financial and operational outcomes. Headquartered in Northfield, Ill., the company employs more than 45,000 people worldwide and operates in more than 100 countries. To learn more about how Medline makes healthcare run better, visit www.medline.com.

**Medline India**

Medline India was established in 2010 in Pune as Global Capability Center to support Medline, headquartered in Illinois, USA. Over the years, it has grown into a 1,800+ strong team of technology, finance, and business support professionals who contribute to Medline’s global mission: to make healthcare run better. Medline India offers a dynamic and collaborative work environment with ample opportunities to learn, innovate, and grow. With a highly engaged and empowered team, Medline India plays a vital role in driving business excellence and supporting healthcare systems across the globe.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking an experienced Server Operations Engineer with 4+ years of hands-on experience in managing, maintaining, and supporting enterprise server infrastructure across physical and virtual environments. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring high availability, performance, security, patching (Ivanti Patching Tool for large scale environment), monitoring, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management of Windows and VMware environments.
  
The Server Operations Windows System Administrator will be responsible for Infrastructure as a service (IAAS) based operational tasks at Medline. This will include configuring, monitoring, troubleshooting and upgrading systems in our on-premise, private cloud, and Azure public cloud platforms.

**Job Description**

**MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES**
==========================

  

**Server Administration**

* Manage and maintain Windows Server environments (2016, 2019, 2022, 2025).
* Perform server provisioning, decommissioning, and lifecycle management.
* Execute OS upgrades, migrations, and disaster recovery activities.
* Handle Active Directory administration including DNS, DHCP, GPO, and replication issues.
* Manage file servers, print servers, and application servers.
* Participate in an on-call rotation to provide incident management support to ensure system availability.
* Identify monitor, and troubleshooting Windows and system related issues including performance tuning and incident root cause analysis
* Automate preventive maintenance and operational tasks.

**Virtualization Management**

* Administer VMware vSphere infrastructure (ESXi, vCenter).
* Perform VM provisioning, cloning, snapshots, and resource optimization.
* Execute vCenter upgrades and maintenance activities.
* Monitor VMware cluster health and capacity planning.

**Patch & Vulnerability Management**

* Plan and implement monthly OS patching activities.
* Coordinate maintenance windows and server reboot schedules.
* Remediate vulnerabilities identified through security scans.
* Ensure compliance with organizational security standards – knowledge & Troubleshooting of CrowdStrike & Illumio

**Monitoring & Incident Management**

* Monitor server performance, availability, and capacity.
* Troubleshoot critical incidents and perform root cause analysis (RCA).
* Participate in on-call support and major incident management.
* Work with applications, networks, and security teams for issues if any & provide resolution.

**Security & Compliance**

* Manage Windows certificates (SSL/TLS) and certificate renewals.
* Review event logs and security alerts.
* OS related vulnerability fix & mitigation.

**Automation & Scripting (Good to have)**

* Develop PowerShell scripts for operational tasks and reporting.
* Automate certificate monitoring, patch reporting, and server health checks.
Utilize Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform.  

  
  
  

**MINIMUM JOB REQUIREMENTS**
============================

**Education**

Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field, or equivalent work experience

**Work Experience**

At least 4-6 years of experience in system administration

  

**Knowledge / Skills / Abilities**

* Operating System: Windows Server 2016/2019/2022/2025, Basic Windows administration (preferred)

* MS Technologies: Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, Ivanti Patching, IIS, Failover Clustering (MS & SQL – Good to know)

* Virtualization: VMware vSphere, ESXi, vCenter Server, VSAN, VM Migration & Storage VMotion

* Scripting: PowerShell & Basic Power CLI for Azure Environment.

* Cloud (Preferred) – Microsoft Azure (AZ104)

* ITSM Tools: ServiceNow (HEAT) & Jira.

* Knowledge of Microsoft PKI/certificates

* Experience with IIS and related services

* Knowledge of HPE hardware

* Demonstrate the ability to present areas of expertise to team members with guidance from lead/manager

* Excellent troubleshooting and critical thinking skills

* Ability to adopt emerging technologies such as Terraform (IAAS), Gitlab, GitHub.

* Demonstrate the willingness and ability to improve performance and capabilities across all areas of responsibility utilizing formal and informal training to maintain skill sets

* Good to have PowerShell Scripting & Automation knowledge.

* Consistently demonstrate excellent verbal and written communication skills

· This position may require up to 10 % travel, potentially including international travel & WFO as required.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field, or equivalent work experience
* 4+ years of experience in Server Administration and Infrastructure Operations.
* Experience supporting enterprise production environments.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.

**Preferred Certifications**

* Microsoft Certified
* VMware VCP-DCV
* Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104)
* ITIL Foundation

**Key Competencies**

* Strong problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and documentation abilities.
* Incident and change management experience.
* Team collaboration and stakeholder management.

**Typical Daily Activities**

* Server health checks and monitoring.
* Incident and service request & Incident handling Experience.
* OS patching and vulnerability remediation.
* VMware administration and troubleshooting.
* Active Directory support.
* Certificate management and renewal tracking.
* Automation using PowerShell or any other AI tool good to know.
* Change implementation and RCA documentation.

title: Holiday Sales Consultant – Safari & Wildlife Trips
description:
This role is only for people who have sold international holidays directly to travellers. If you haven’t, please don’t apply.

**About us**

Wild Voyager runs private wildlife holidays, with our own guides, vehicles and teams on the ground in Kenya, Tanzania and India, plus a small collection of journeys elsewhere. Ilora Retreats is our fourteen-suite camp inside the Masai Mara National Reserve, rated 4.9 on Tripadvisor. Our trips are high value, and our guests take time to decide.

**The role**

You’ll handle direct enquiries for both Wild Voyager and Ilora, from guests in India and around the world, and turn them into confirmed trips. You’ll work from our Delhi office as part of the direct sales team.

**What you’ll do**

* Respond quickly to new enquiries from our website, WhatsApp, calls and ads
* Understand what each guest really wants: who’s travelling, when, their budget and what matters to them
* Brief our product team and send clear, well-written proposals
* Sell confidently by phone to Indian guests, and by email to guests in the UK, Europe, the US and the Middle East
* Follow up consistently until the guest books or says no
* Keep every conversation and next step up to date in our CRM
* Hand confirmed bookings to operations with complete, accurate details

**You learn before you sell**

Your first four weeks are product training on Kenya, Tanzania, India and Ilora, with tests, before you take live enquiries. If you’d rather start selling on day one, this role isn’t for you.

**What we’re looking for**

* 3+ years selling international holiday packages directly to travellers (B2C)
* A track record you can show in numbers: bookings, conversion rate, trip values
* Confident phone selling in English and Hindi
* Clear, professional written English
* Comfortable with a CRM, and with following up over weeks or months
* Safari, Africa or luxury travel experience is a strong plus

**What we offer**

* Fixed salary plus commission on confirmed bookings
* A familiarisation trip to Kenya within your first six months
* A small team where good work is noticed

**How to apply**

Email info@wildvoyager.com with “Travel Consultant” in the subject, and include:

1. Your CV
2. A short reply (under 200 words) to this enquiry:
   *“We’re a couple from Mumbai planning a Kenya safari next August for our 10th anniversary. What would you suggest?”*

* We read the reply before the CV.

title: Business Development Manager – Nuclear Energy & Radiation Technologies
description:
Business Development Manager – Nuclear Energy & Radiation Technologies

**Company:**
AdvanceTech Controls Pvt. Ltd. (Advancetech Group)

**Locations:**
Mumbai | New Delhi | Kolkata | Chennai

**Employment:**
Full-time | On-site | Travel Required

**Business Unit:**
Nuclear Energy & Radiation Technologies

About Advancetech

Established in 1995, Advancetech Group is an Indian engineering and technology company with over three decades of experience serving the Nuclear Energy, Defence, Aerospace, Industrial Automation and Research sectors.

We specialize in advanced radiation monitoring and detection systems, nuclear instrumentation, control systems, embedded electronics, indigenous product development and integrated engineering solutions.

Working with leading international technology companies, including Mirion Technologies, we support India's nuclear power plants, Department of Atomic Energy establishments, research institutions and other strategic organizations.

With engineering, manufacturing, integration and technical support capabilities in India, Advancetech is expanding its participation in India's nuclear energy growth programme, with a strong focus on
**Make in India, technology localization and indigenous solutions**
.

Role Overview

We are seeking dynamic, technically competent and result-oriented
**Business Development Managers**
to expand our Nuclear Business Unit across India.

The role involves identifying new business opportunities, developing strategic customer relationships, promoting advanced nuclear instrumentation and radiation protection technologies, and converting opportunities into sustainable business.

The successful candidate will work closely with our technical experts, product specialists, international technology partners and senior management to develop new markets and strengthen our position in the nuclear industry.

Key Responsibilities1. Business Development & Market Expansion

* Identify and develop new business opportunities across nuclear power plants, DAE establishments, research institutions and industrial applications.
* Develop relationships with NPCIL, BARC, ECIL, IGCAR, BHAVINI, universities and other relevant organizations.
* Identify upcoming nuclear projects, modernization programmes, equipment requirements and technology opportunities.
* Develop opportunities with EPC contractors, engineering consultants and emerging private-sector participants in the nuclear energy ecosystem.
* Generate qualified leads and convert them into enquiries, tenders and purchase orders.

2. Technical Sales & Solution Development

* Promote radiation monitoring systems, radiation detection instruments, dosimetry solutions, nuclear instrumentation and associated technologies.
* Develop business for indigenous products, including thyroid monitors, whole-body monitoring systems, radiation mapping solutions and specialized nuclear instruments.
* Understand customer technical requirements and coordinate with engineering teams to develop suitable solutions.
* Organize technical presentations, demonstrations, customer workshops and product training sessions.
* Support techno-commercial proposals, tender submissions, negotiations and order closures.

3. Strategic Account Management

* Build and maintain long-term relationships with key customers, scientists, engineers, consultants and decision-makers.
* Develop account-wise business plans, including upcoming projects, procurement budgets and expected order timelines.
* Identify opportunities for repeat business, modernization, upgrades, annual maintenance contracts and service support.
* Maintain a strong understanding of customer requirements, procurement procedures and competitive developments.

4. New Products & Strategic Initiatives

* Identify market opportunities for indigenous nuclear products and technology localization.
* Support the introduction of new technologies through international collaborations and technology transfer.
* Work with the company's Nuclear Excellence Centre and engineering teams to develop customer-specific solutions.
* Support market development for nuclear instrumentation and control systems, radiation protection and specialized research equipment.

5. Sales Planning & Performance

* Take ownership of assigned territory and annual booking, billing and collection targets.
* Maintain an active opportunity pipeline and accurate sales forecasts.
* Prepare structured 30-, 60- and 90-day customer engagement and opportunity conversion plans.
* Maintain regular CRM updates, customer visit reports and management reviews.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely proposal submission, order execution and customer satisfaction.

Qualifications & Experience

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Electrical, Instrumentation, Nuclear Engineering, Physics or a related technical discipline.
* MBA or postgraduate technical qualifications will be an advantage.

**Experience**

* Preferably 5–12 years of experience in technical sales, business development or key account management.
* Experience in nuclear instrumentation, radiation monitoring, industrial instrumentation, process control, defence electronics or scientific equipment will be preferred.
* Prior exposure to NPCIL, BARC, DAE, ECIL, research institutions, power plants or government procurement processes will be a significant advantage.
* Experience with technical tenders, government procurement, GeM and complex B2B project sales is desirable.

Key Skills & Competencies

* Strong business development and customer relationship skills.
* Ability to understand and communicate complex technical solutions.
* Proven track record of generating enquiries and closing orders.
* Good commercial awareness, negotiation and tendering skills.
* Self-motivated, proactive and comfortable working independently.
* Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory.
* Strong reporting discipline, CRM management and sales forecasting capabilities.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work in India's rapidly expanding nuclear energy sector.
* Exposure to advanced international technologies and indigenous product development.
* Direct interaction with leading scientists, engineers and strategic organizations.
* Strong technical backing from experienced nuclear industry specialists and engineering teams.
* Career growth opportunities within a diversified engineering and technology group.
* Performance-linked incentives based on business results.
* **Join Advancetech and contribute to India's next phase of nuclear energy development through advanced technologies, engineering innovation and indigenous solutions.**

description:

We are looking for a dynamic and customer-facing Cyber Security Sales professional with 3+ years of experience in Cyber Security Product, Solution and/or Services Sales.

The candidate must have excellent communication skills, existing working relationships with Enterprise customers, and experience engaging with both Digital Native and Traditional Enterprise customers.

The role requires strong business development and relationship-management skills along with a basic understanding of key cybersecurity technologies and solutions. The candidate must be highly mobile and willing to travel frequently for customer engagements.

title: Sales - AI for Manufacturing
description:
Sales Lead – AI for Manufacturing

*Gurgaon | 2-3 Years Experience | New Customer Acquisition Focus*

Candidate has to be based in Gurgaon

The Opportunity

Join Renata AI as Sales Lead to drive adoption of Vision, Voice and Document AI and IoT solutions among automobile ancillary manufacturers across NCR. You'll be selling cutting-edge AI-powered defect detection, process monitoring, and traceability systems that deliver measurable ROI—helping manufacturers reduce rejection rates by 15-30% and improve operational efficiency.

This role is 80% focused on new customer acquisition in a booming sector where digital transformation is no longer optional. If you enjoy consultative, technical sales with real business impact, this is your opportunity.

About Renata AI

Renata Envirocom (Renata AI) is pioneering Vision AI and Industrial IoT solutions for manufacturing quality and process excellence.

•      
**Domain Expertise:**
Strong presence in automobile ancillary and other manufacturing sectors—we understand their challenges deeply

•      
**Proven Results:**
Customers achieve 15-30% rejection rate reduction, faster throughput, and complete traceability

•      
**Technical Depth:**
End-to-end solutions covering hardware, AI models, and system integration

•      
**Startup Edge:**
Founded by IIT/IIM alumni with 15+ years in manufacturing technology—culture of autonomy, innovation, and ownership

•      
**Strategic Location:**
Gurgaon base provides access to automobile ancillary manufacturers across NCR region

**Website:**
https://RenataIoT.com

What You'll Do

Core Responsibilities

**Customer Acquisition (80% Focus)**

•      Generate and convert pipeline through marketing leads, referrals, and targeted outreach

•      Maintain high activity levels with regular customer meetings (mix of plant visits and online demos)

•      Perform on-site plant walkthroughs to understand production processes and identify AI/IoT opportunities

•      Position Vision AI solutions for defect detection, process monitoring, or traceability based on customer needs

**Solution Selling**

•      Present case studies and ROI demonstrations to Quality Heads, Production Managers, and Plant Directors

•      Coordinate technical discussions with presales team for solution design

•      Design customer-specific proposals covering hardware (cameras, edge devices), software, and integration

•      Manage pilot/POC deployments to demonstrate value before full rollout

**Sales Execution**

•      Prepare detailed proposals with BOMs, development scope, and integration requirements

•      Negotiate pricing within defined discount authority while maintaining healthy project margins

•      Manage complex B2B sales cycles requiring persistence and strategic relationship building

•      Update CRM daily with pipeline movement, meeting notes, and next actions

•      Report weekly to management on pipeline health and deal progress

*You'll manage enterprise-level deals with significant revenue impact and attractive commission structure. Success metrics and targets will be discussed during the interview process.*

What Your Week Looks Like

•      
**Monday:**
Pipeline review meeting, prioritize follow-ups, plan customer visits for the week

•      
**Tue-Fri:**
Regular customer interactions—plant visits in Manesar/Bawal/IMT belt, online demos, technical discussions with production teams. Some customer visits will also happen across India.

•      
**Customer Meetings Involve:**
Understanding quality challenges, presenting relevant case studies (similar parts/processes), coordinating camera trials or AI model demos

•      
**Saturday:**
Proposal preparation, CRM updates, coordination with technical and delivery teams

•      
**Monthly:**
Business review meetings at customer sites post-implementation

What You Bring

Must-Have Qualifications

•      2-3 years of B2B technology/solution sales (manufacturing, industrial automation, or related sectors preferred)

•      Proven new customer acquisition track record with ability to build pipeline from scratch

•      Technical aptitude to understand and articulate computer vision, AI, and IoT concepts to non-technical stakeholders

•      Consultative selling skills – comfortable with complex sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders

•      Strong communication – ability to present to shop floor teams and C-suite executives alike

•      Process discipline – rigorous in CRM updates, follow-ups, and sales methodology

•      Comfort with complexity – selling solutions involving hardware + software + integration across varied customer environments

Strong Plus (Not Required)

•      Experience selling to automobile/auto-ancillary manufacturers

•      Familiarity with Quality/Production departments in manufacturing plants

•      Understanding of Quality 4.0, Industry 4.0, machine vision, or AI concepts

•      Engineering background (Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics/Computer Science)

•      Existing network in NCR manufacturing belt (Manesar/Gurgaon/Faridabad/Bawal)

Education

Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Engineering (Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics/Computer Science) or equivalent technical background

Compensation & Career Growth

•      
**💰 Compensation:**
Competitive fixed salary + attractive performance-based incentives (structure discussed during interview)

•      
**📈 Career Path:**
Sales Lead → Senior Sales Lead → Regional Sales Manager

•      
**🚀 Growth Opportunity:**
Build and lead sales team as company scales; shape sales strategy for new verticals

•      
**🎯 Impact:**
Direct visibility to founders; your wins directly drive company growth

Success Milestones

•      
**Month 3:**
Close your first deal independently; demonstrate mastery of solution positioning

•      
**Month 6:**
Build strong qualified pipeline; establish relationships with key prospects across the region

•      
**Month 12:**
Achieve annual booking targets; add significant new customer base; become subject matter expert in Vision AI for manufacturing

Selection Process

•      
**Round 1:**
Initial screening call (20 minutes) – experience fit and role clarity

•      
**Round 2:**
Solution sales simulation + technical discussion (60 minutes) – assess consultative approach and technical grasp

•      
**Round 3:**
Founder conversation (30 minutes) – culture fit and growth ambitions

•      
**Round 4:**
Reference checks

**Timeline:**
2-3 weeks from application to offer

Ready to Transform Manufacturing with AI?

**We're looking for someone who:**

•      Gets excited about being on the cutting edge of AI in manufacturing

•      Thrives on building relationships and solving real business problems

•      Wants ownership and impact, not just a job

•      Is ready to build something meaningful in a high-growth startup

Apply Now:

📧 Send your resume to
**anil.sagar@renataiot.com**
with:

•      Brief description of your biggest enterprise sale (deal size, sales cycle, your role)

•      Why Vision AI solutions for manufacturing excite you (2-3 sentences)

*Renata AI is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.*

* *Questions? Feel free to reach out—we're happy to discuss the role in detail before you apply.*

title: Assistant Sales Manager
description:

The company serves diverse and growing industry segments, including industrial packaging, lifestyle products, automotive components, healthcare, infrastructure and construction, material handling, and composite cylinders. Since its inception in 1992, Time Tech has emphasized research and development, innovative product design, and strong customer service to support both domestic and global markets. With more than 34 production facilities, 28 manufacturing units, and 8 regional and marketing offices, the group offers significant scale, stability, and growth opportunities. Time Tech is promoted and led by experienced professionals who prioritize long-term value for customers, suppliers, team members, and shareholders.
  
**Role Description**
The Assistant Sales Manager is a full-time, on-site position based in Ghaziabad, responsible for supporting sales growth and customer relationships within assigned markets. This role includes managing key accounts, following up on inquiries, preparing quotations, and coordinating order processing to ensure timely delivery and customer satisfaction. The Assistant Sales Manager will assist in developing and implementing sales plans, tracking sales performance, and preparing regular reports for senior management. Day-to-day activities involve conducting market visits, gathering competitor and market intelligence, and collaborating closely with production, logistics, and finance teams to align sales commitments with operational capabilities. The role also focuses on maintaining strong communication with customers, resolving issues promptly, and contributing to revenue and margin targets.
  
**Qualifications**

* Demonstrated skills in sales, business development, and account management within manufacturing or industrial products sectors.
* Strong abilities in customer relationship management, negotiation, and handling customer queries and complaints professionally.
* Experience with sales planning, forecasting, and reporting, including use of basic analytics to track performance against targets.
* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and familiarity with ERP or CRM systems for managing orders and customer data.
* Solid communication and presentation skills, with the ability to work collaboratively across cross-functional teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Marketing, or a related field; a postgraduate qualification in management is an advantage.
* Prior experience in polymer products, industrial packaging, or related manufacturing industries is highly beneficial.
* Ability to work on-site in Ghaziabad, travel to customer locations as needed, and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
**Designation: Senior Manager/Associate Director, Partnerships, MSM CampusOS, India Business**

**ABOUT THE COMPANY**

MSM CampusOS is a full-service digital marketing agency exclusively serving the education sector — schools, colleges, universities, EdTech platforms, and coaching institutes. We help institutions grow their brand, drive enrolments, and build a strong digital presence through integrated marketing, technology, and creative solutions.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are looking for a driven and strategic Senior Manager/Associate Director, Partnerships who can identify, acquire, and grow client relationships with educational institutions and EdTech brands. This role demands someone who combines a go-getter sales mindset with a solid understanding of digital marketing — enabling them to confidently pitch our services and deliver measurable value to clients.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Business Development & Client Acquisition**

* Identify and target potential clients including schools, colleges, universities, EdTech platforms, and coaching institutes across assigned territories.
* Conduct thorough market research to map the right decision-makers and key contacts within target institutions.
* Execute outreach through cold calls, emails, LinkedIn, and networking events to generate and qualify leads.
* Schedule and conduct client meetings, presentations, and pitches to introduce and position the agency's services.
* Develop compelling proposals and respond to RFPs in collaboration with the internal creative and strategy teams.
* Drive consistent new client acquisition and build a healthy sales pipeline at all times.

**Client Servicing & Retention**

* Develop and maintain strong, long-term relationships with existing clients to ensure high satisfaction and loyalty.
* Act as the primary point of contact for clients — managing expectations, resolving concerns proactively, and ensuring smooth delivery of services.
* Work closely with the technical and client servicing teams to ensure clients receive the best possible experience.
* Drive contract renewals and up-sell/cross-sell additional services to existing accounts to grow revenue.
* Monitor receivables and ensure timely collection of payments from clients.

**Digital Strategy & Client Advisory**

* Leverage a solid understanding of digital marketing to advise clients on strategies best suited to their goals — admissions, brand awareness, enrolment growth, etc.
* Answer client questions on how digital interactions fit into their broader marketing and communication strategy.
* Provide clients with campaign performance reports and actionable insights on a regular basis.
* Stay updated on trends in digital marketing and the education sector to bring fresh, relevant ideas to clients.
* Position the agency as a trusted growth partner — not just a vendor — by connecting digital strategy to the client's larger business objectives.

**AI-Enabled Prospecting & Pipeline Management**

* Use AI and modern prospecting platforms (LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, Clay, HubSpot/CRM, ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, and similar) to research faster, personalise outreach, and build more intelligent pipelines.
* Apply AI for account research, decision-maker mapping, prospect and competitor intelligence, pitch and meeting preparation, and proposal development.
* Maintain CRM discipline and use AI-assisted tools for pipeline prioritisation and follow-up.
* Focus on relevant, intelligent, and highly targeted outreach rather than mass emailing.

**Targets & Reporting**

* Work on a quarterly target basis and ensure revenue goals are met consistently.
* Maintain accurate records of leads, opportunities, and pipeline status in CRM tools.
* Report regularly to the Sales Head on territory performance, deal progress, and market insights.

**SKILLS & REQUIREMENTS**

**Must-Have**

* 7–10 years of experience in B2B sales, preferably in digital marketing, EdTech, or education services.
* Proven track record of meeting and exceeding revenue targets.
* Strong knowledge of digital marketing platforms and services (SEO, Social Media, Performance Marketing, etc.).
* Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to independently manage the end-to-end sales cycle — from lead generation to deal closure.
* Self-motivated, disciplined, and a genuine go-getter attitude.
* Team player who can collaborate effectively with creative, technical, and strategy teams.

**Good-to-Have**

* Prior experience selling to educational institutions (schools, colleges, universities, coaching institutes).
* Familiarity with digital advertising tools (Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager).
* Experience using CRM tools such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or Zoho CRM.
* Understanding of enrolment marketing and student acquisition funnels.
* Existing relationships or network within the education sector is a strong advantage.

**PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES**

* Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for building and growing business relationships.
* Sharp attention to detail and strong problem-solving skills.
* Comfortable working independently as well as part of a collaborative team.
* High levels of integrity, professionalism, and client-first attitude.
* Resilient and persistent — able to handle rejection and bounce back quickly.
* Genuine interest in the education ecosystem and digital innovation.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* A focused and exciting work environment serving exclusively the education sector.
* Opportunity to work with a diverse portfolio of clients — from K-12 schools to large universities and EdTech platforms.
* Competitive fixed salary of ₹17 – 18 LPA with an attractive performance-linked incentive structure.
* Clear growth path into senior sales leadership roles.
* Supportive team with strong creative and technical capabilities to back your sales efforts.
* Continuous learning on digital marketing trends and education sector dynamics.

title: Senior Manager, Services Sales
description:
**About The Job**
The Red Hat Consulting Services team is adding a Senior Services Manager in India. In this role, you will develop, cultivate, and manage relationships within key Enterprise and Commercial customer accounts. You will oversee pipeline building and sales for services, including determining scope details for consulting, training and TAM. Also, monitoring project progress to ensure that it conforms to customer expectations and contractual agreements. You’ll help identify and qualify new business opportunities and work with Red Hat’s sales organization to formulate account strategies that promote revenue growth. You’ll partner with Red Hat’s sales representatives to guide services sales opportunities from qualification to closing while managing additional pre-sales team members. You’ll need to have a good foundation of technical knowledge, as well as project and scope management expertise, as you'll establish the technical and non-technical enablement needs for the Consulting team.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Cover a territory consisting of Enterprise and Commercial companies
* Oversee the work of services sellers to sell Red Hat's services and solutions using the business requirements of your customers to deliver required outcomes
* Grow your territory through the development of internal business partnerships with the field sales team and alliance and partner programs
* Design and implement strategies for sales of effective, high-impact technical and business solutions for Red Hat's customers with a focus on core Red Hat technologies including OpenShift, Ansible AAP, OpenShift AI, RHEL, and others
* Accurately and consistently provide booking and revenue forecasts for your territory
* Manage revenue and booking goals across all practices; meet margin and use targets
* Ensure successful delivery of all projects
* Coordinate customer managers who manage consultants, fostering a culture of collaboration within your team
* Taking accountability for sales and pre-sales performance, meeting customer expectations, and driving future demand
* Providing accurate and regular reports to the management on performance of the service delivery
* Leading personnel management, including staff recruitment, performance assessment, training, and mentoring
* Building strong relationships with teams and stakeholders to enable effective dialogue exchange between departments

**Within 12 months, you will be expected to do the following**

* Grow your order booking and revenue base on a quarterly basis
* Build services pipe for 18 months ahead
* Manage escalations without supervision
* Assist with negotiating Red Hat’s master services agreements and statements of work with the customers and the legal team

**What You Will Bring**

* Knowledge of technical or business consulting practices
* Experience managing technical sales and delivery teams, in the IT infrastructure space
* Experience in services sales and processes in customer accounts in India and South Asia
* Experience in project delivery
* Experience with internal matrix team coordination
* Ability to architect complex solutions using multiple offerings and technologies to deliver requested business value
* Experience in and willingness to speak at public conferences and meetups

**About Red Hat**
Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.
  
  
**Inclusion at Red Hat**
Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)**
Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.
  
  
Red Hat does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. We are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written contract between Red Hat and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee.
  
  
Red Hat supports individuals with disabilities and provides reasonable accommodations to job applicants. If you need assistance completing our online job application, email application-assistance@redhat.com. General inquiries, such as those regarding the status of a job application, will not receive a reply.

title: MBBS Doctor - Diabetologist and Metabolic Health
description:
**About ReDial Clinic:**

ReDial Clinic (Reversing Diabetes with Lifestyle Management) is one of India's pioneering physician-led centres focused on reversing chronic metabolic disease, not merely managing it.

Founded by Dr. Gagandeep Singh, the clinic has helped over 1,000 patients achieve meaningful reversals across Type 2 Diabetes, Hypertension, Obesity, PCOS, and Fatty Liver Disease through structured, evidence-based lifestyle interventions.

Our approach treats root causes, not symptoms. Every patient is enrolled in the Doctor-Led Programme (DLP), a structured reversal protocol in which a Doctor, Nutritionist, and Fitness Coach work together as a dedicated clinical triad.

***The Role:***

This is not a conventional OPD or prescription-only role. You will own the full patient review, assessing medical, dietary, and fitness dimensions together in every consultation. The Nutritionist and Fitness Coach support delivery under your clinical direction, and you will report directly to Dr. Gagandeep Singh.

***Conditions You Will Manage***

* Type 2 Diabetes — glycaemic assessment, medication review, and structured reversal protocols
* Hypertension — blood pressure management, medication tapering, and lifestyle-led normalisation
* Obesity — body composition assessment, metabolic risk stratification, and intervention planning
* PCOS — hormonal and metabolic evaluation, dietary and lifestyle intervention
* Dyslipidaemia, Non-Alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease (NAFLD), and Metabolic Syndrome

The common thread across all these conditions is insulin resistance. Our clinical model is built on understanding and reversing this root cause.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead structured one-on-one patient consultations covering medical status, dietary adherence, and fitness progression as a unified assessment
* Review blood work and metabolic panels at defined intervals, and adjust medication, diet, and fitness plans accordingly
* Direct medication tapering as lifestyle interventions take effect
* Design and own the integrated patient plan covering medical interventions, dietary framework, and fitness protocol
* Brief and lead the clinical triad (Nutritionist and Fitness Coach), and hold weekly internal team reviews to align on patient progress
* Maintain complete and timely patient records on all designated platforms
* Actively participate in training and clinical discussion sessions led by Dr. Gagandeep Singh

***Qualifications***

*Required*

* MBBS from a recognised, accredited medical institution — mandatory
* Valid registration with the NMC (formerly MCI) or the respective State Medical Council
* 4+ years of post-MBBS, patient-facing clinical experience
* Working knowledge of Type 2 Diabetes, Hypertension, Obesity, or PCOS management
* Ability to independently read and interpret lab reports and metabolic panels
* Strong patient communication skills, with the ability to explain clinical reasoning clearly and empathetically
* Fluency in English and Hindi
* Willingness to be trained in a structured, protocol-based clinical approach

*Preferred — Strong Advantage*

* Prior exposure to disease reversal, lifestyle medicine, or preventive medicine
* Familiarity with low-carb nutrition, therapeutic fasting, or metabolic nutrition frameworks
* Experience with medication tapering or de-prescribing under clinical supervision
* Formal certification in nutrition, sports nutrition, personal training, or fitness coaching
* A personal orientation toward fitness and nutrition — doctors who apply these principles in their own lives bring a depth of practical understanding that is difficult to teach

**What We Offer**

* The opportunity to practise root-cause, reversal-focused medicine rather than symptom management
* Structured, ongoing clinical training and mentorship under Dr. Gagandeep Singh
* A collaborative, multidisciplinary team environment
* Competitive compensation with growth opportunities as the clinic expands

**How to Apply**

Send your updated CV along with a copy of your MBBS degree and NMC / State Medical Council registration certificate to:

* Email: hr@redialclinic.com
* **Call / WhatsApp: +91 96679 48320**

Contact: HR & Operations Manager, ReDial Clinic

ReDial Clinic — Green Park Extension, New Delhi-110016

**ROLE TYPE: Full-Time | On-Site**

**WORKING HOURS: Mon–Sat, 10 AM–6 PM**

**EXPERIENCE: 4+ years post-MBBS**

**Salary Bracket - 80k to 1.20k**
