title: Personal Assistant to Founder
description:
Job Description: Executive Assistant & Personal Assistant to the Founder

Company: Prakul Bakshi Events (PBE)

Position: Executive Assistant & Personal Assistant to the Founder (EA & PA)

Location: Delhi NCR

Reporting To: Founder – Prakul Bakshi

Department: Founder’s Office

1. Role Objective

To provide comprehensive executive, administrative, and personal support to the Founder,

ensuring the seamless management of business priorities, communications, meetings,

schedules, travel, and personal commitments.

The role requires a highly organised, proactive, discreet, and tech-savvy individual who can

anticipate the Founder’s needs, manage competing priorities, coordinate with internal and

external stakeholders, and ensure that important tasks and commitments are completed on

time.

The individual will act as the Founder’s trusted support partner, helping maximise productivity

and reduce the day-to-day administrative burden.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

A. Business Support

- Manage the Founder’s calendar, appointments, meetings, and daily schedule.

- Schedule meetings, coordinate with participants, resolve conflicts, and send reminders.

- Prepare meeting agendas, presentations, briefing notes, and relevant documents.

- Attend meetings when required and prepare minutes, decisions, and action items.

- Maintain a central tracker of tasks, deadlines, pending approvals, and commitments.

- Follow up with department heads and team members on deliverables assigned by the

Founder.

- Coordinate with Sales, Artist Management, Operations, HR, Finance, Marketing, clients,

artists, and vendors.

- Prepare daily and weekly briefs highlighting priorities, pending actions, and upcoming

commitments.

- Assist with business correspondence, reports, presentations, and special projects.

- Ensure that important decisions and commitments are documented and followed through.

B. Communication Management

- Manage and organise the Founder’s calls, emails, WhatsApp messages, and other

communications, subject to authorised access.

- Screen incoming calls and identify urgent or business-critical matters.

- Draft routine responses and follow up on pending communications.

- Maintain a list of important contacts, business relationships, and follow-up commitments.

- Coordinate communication between the Founder and relevant stakeholders.

- Escalate sensitive, urgent, or high-priority matters promptly.

- Maintain professionalism and confidentiality in all communications.

C. Personal Assistance – Private and Lifestyle Support

- Manage personal appointments, reservations, and daily commitments.

- Coordinate personal and professional travel, including flights, hotels, ground transportation,

and itineraries.

- Handle restaurant bookings, event registrations, and other personal arrangements.

- Assist with online shopping, Amazon orders, deliveries, returns, and related requirements.

- Coordinate personal errands and service appointments as requested.

- Maintain reminders for important personal dates, appointments, and commitments.

- Organise personal documents, bookings, and records securely.

- Handle additional personal and logistical requirements as reasonably assigned by the

Founder.

D. Travel and Event Coordination

- Plan and coordinate the Founder’s business and personal travel.

- Prepare detailed itineraries and ensure all bookings are confirmed.

- Coordinate schedules around business meetings, events, and personal commitments.

- Assist with event invitations, registrations, hospitality, and logistics.

- Manage last-minute changes and resolve logistical issues proactively.

E. AI, Digital Tools and Productivity

- Use AI tools to prepare meeting summaries, draft messages, organise notes, and maintain

action trackers.

- Maintain digital calendars, task lists, reminders, contact databases, and document systems.

- Explore approved tools that can automate repetitive administrative tasks.

- Use productivity tools to consolidate information and prepare concise daily briefs.

- Ensure appropriate security, permissions, and confidentiality when using AI tools or accessing

personal and business accounts.

**3. Required Skills and Competencies**

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

- Strong planning, organisation, prioritisation, and follow-up abilities.

- High integrity, discretion, and respect for confidentiality.

- Proficiency in email, calendars, spreadsheets, presentations, and digital collaboration tools.

- Comfortable managing WhatsApp, calls, bookings, and multiple communication channels.

- Practical knowledge of AI productivity tools.

- Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to work independently and anticipate requirements.

- Calmness and flexibility in a fast-paced environment.

- Professional conduct when interacting with senior executives, artists, clients, and personal

contacts.

**4. Experience and Qualifications**

- Graduate in any discipline.

- 2–5 years of experience as an EA, PA, Founder’s Office Executive, or similar professional.

- Previous experience supporting a founder, entrepreneur, business owner, or senior executive

is preferred.

- Experience in events, entertainment, media, hospitality, or a service-led business is an

advantage.

- Candidates with strong digital skills and experience using AI tools will be preferred.

**5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be evaluated on:

1. Calendar and scheduling: Accuracy, preparation, and minimal scheduling conflicts.

2. Follow-through: Timely closure of assigned action items and pending commitments.

3. Communication: Prompt handling, accurate drafting, and appropriate escalation.

4. Meeting effectiveness: Timely meeting notes, decision logs, and action trackers.

5. Personal assistance: Accuracy of bookings, errands, travel arrangements, and reminders.

6. Coordination: Effective follow-up with internal teams and external stakeholders.

7. Confidentiality: Secure and responsible handling of business and personal information.

8. Productivity improvement: Effective use of technology and AI to reduce repetitive work.

**6. Working Expectations**

- The role may require flexibility beyond standard working hours depending on the Founder’s

schedule, travel, and business commitments.

- The candidate must be comfortable balancing business priorities with personal assistance

requirements.

- Any after-hours expectations, availability requirements, and weekly working arrangements

should be clearly communicated during recruitment.

- The individual must maintain strict confidentiality and professional boundaries.

- Purchases, bookings, financial transactions, and consequential communications must follow

the Founder’s approval and authorisation rules.

**7. Ideal Candidate Profile**

We are looking for a dependable, mature, proactive, and well-organised professional who can

manage both the Founder’s business and personal requirements with equal efficiency.

The right candidate should be able to anticipate needs, prioritise tasks independently, maintain

discretion, and ensure that nothing important slips through the cracks.

The individual should be comfortable in a dynamic, founder-led organisation where priorities can

change quickly and effective coordination is essential.

Core expectation: One trusted point of contact who helps the Founder stay organised, prepared,

responsive, and focused on high-value business decisions.

Recruitment priority: Hire for trustworthiness, judgement, proactive execution, communication

skills, and digital proficiency—not merely administrative experience.

Company Description

Estrip Solution is a cleaning innovation company with over 25 years of expertise in bio-enzyme manufacturing and cleaning product R&D. The company has developed India's first water-soluble cleaning sheets, offering powerful, compact and convenient cleaning solutions.

Its products are biodegradable, dermatologically tested, cruelty-free and designed to reduce plastic waste while simplifying everyday cleaning. Estrip Solution serves home consumers as well as private-label, bulk sourcing, B2B and export partners, focusing on smart and sustainable cleaning innovations.

The team is driven by the mission to help people and businesses #CleanWithCare.

This is a full-time, on-site E-commerce Growth Manager role based in Gurugram. The candidate will be responsible for managing and growing Estrip's complete online business through performance marketing, search engine optimization (SEO) and Shopify e-commerce management.

The role involves planning, executing and optimizing paid advertising campaigns across Meta, Google and other relevant digital platforms to drive customer acquisition, increase online sales and improve return on ad spend (ROAS).

The candidate will independently manage the Shopify website, optimize product and landing pages, improve website conversion rates and develop strategies to increase organic traffic through SEO. Day-to-day responsibilities will include managing advertising budgets, analyzing campaign performance, conducting keyword research, improving website visibility, optimizing the customer purchase journey and implementing data-driven growth strategies.

The role will also involve collaborating with creative, content and sales teams to develop high-performing marketing campaigns, improve customer engagement and drive sustainable e-commerce revenue growth.

**1. Performance Marketing**

* Plan, execute and optimize Meta (Facebook & Instagram) Ads and Google Ads campaigns.

**2. SEO & Organic Growth**

* Manage Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager and Meta Pixel.
* Monitor website traffic, customer behavior and conversion funnels.
* Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports.
* Analyze campaign data and identify growth opportunities.
* Track revenue, ROAS, CAC, AOV and conversion rates.

**5. Customer Retention & Growth**

* Plan email and WhatsApp marketing campaigns.
* Develop abandoned cart and customer retention strategies.
* Implement remarketing and repeat purchase campaigns.
* Explore new digital channels and growth opportunities.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 2–4 years of hands-on experience in performance marketing and e-commerce.
* Strong expertise in Meta Ads and Google Ads.
* Practical experience managing Shopify stores.
* Good understanding of SEO and keyword research.
* Experience with GA4, Google Search Console and Google Tag Manager.
* Knowledge of conversion rate optimization (CRO).
* Understanding of D2C, FMCG and e-commerce business models.
* Strong analytical, communication and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Experience

* Experience working with D2C brands, FMCG or consumer product companies.
* Experience scaling e-commerce revenue through paid and organic channels.
* Understanding of marketplace advertising and Google Merchant Center.
* Experience managing marketing budgets and achieving revenue targets.

What We Expect

We are looking for someone who can independently manage the complete digital growth ecosystem, take ownership of marketing performance and turn website traffic into measurable business revenue.

* The ideal candidate should be equally comfortable with campaign execution, SEO strategy, Shopify management, data analysis and continuous optimization.

title: Network Security Specialist
description:
**About REVES**

REVES is a growing organization focused on delivering secure and reliable technology solutions. We specialize in robust network infrastructure, data protection and modern security solutions, providing opportunities to work with the latest technologies and industry best practices.

**Key Responsibilities**

﻿
This is a full-time, on-site Network Security Specialist role based in Gurugram.

* Configure and implement routers, switches, firewalls, wireless networks and related infrastructure.
* Manage VLANs, routing, switching, subnetting, ACLs, NAT, DHCP, DNS and VPNs.
* Deploy and configure Palo Alto, Cisco and Fortinet security solutions.
* Manage firewall policies, security rules, objects, NAT rules and VPN configurations.
* Configure Site-to-Site and Remote Access VPNs.
* Support SASE, DNS Security, Email Security and Endpoint Security implementations.
* Configure SSL/TLS inspection and troubleshoot certificate and application compatibility issues.
* Troubleshoot network connectivity and security configuration issues.
* Maintain network diagrams, configuration records and implementation documentation.
* Coordinate with internal teams, customers and service providers during deployments.

**Technical Skills Required**

**1. Core Firewall & Network Features**

* Security Policies & Rulebase Management, NAT (Source NAT, Destination NAT, PAT, Port Forwarding).
* VPN (IPsec, SSL VPN, Remote Access VPN, Cisco AnyConnect, GlobalProtect).
* High Availability (Active/Passive, Active/Active, Failover).
* Routing & Switching (BGP, OSPF, Static Routing, VLANs, SD-WAN).
* Network Segmentation (DMZ, Micro-segmentation, ACLs).

**2. Threat Prevention & Security Inspection**

* IDS/IPS, Deep Packet Inspection (DPI), SSL/TLS Decryption.
* Web/URL Filtering, DNS Security and Application Control (App-ID).
* DDoS Mitigation and Web Application Firewall (WAF).

**3. Cloud, Zero Trust & Monitoring**

* Zero Trust, ZTNA and SASE (Zscaler, Prisma Access).
* Cloud Security (AWS Security Groups, Azure Firewall, NSGs, VPC).
* Authentication (RADIUS, TACACS+, Active Directory, LDAP, MFA, SSO).
* Troubleshooting (Wireshark, Packet Capture, TCP/IP).
* Logging & SIEM (Syslog, Splunk, Security Event Monitoring).

**Required Qualifications**

* 2–4 years of experience in Network and Security Engineering or a related role.
* Strong understanding of TCP/IP, OSI Model, subnetting, VLANs, routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, NAT, ACLs and VPNs.
* Hands-on experience with Palo Alto, Cisco and Fortinet technologies.
* Knowledge of Palo Alto Networks platforms, including Strata, Prisma and Cortex.
* Working knowledge of ZTNA, SASE, DNS Security, Email Security, Endpoint Security and SSL/TLS Inspection.
* Ability to troubleshoot using command-line tools and packet captures.
* Willingness to travel to project locations and work according to project requirements.
* Good communication, documentation and coordination skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certifications such as CCNA, PCNSA, PCNSE or Fortinet NSE/FCP.
* Experience implementing network and security solutions in enterprise environments.

Interested candidates can share their updated CV along with:

Job description (paste into LinkedIn)

About us

Source of Life Technologies is a US-headquartered healthcare technology company with an engineering and product centre in Gurugram. We build connected hardware and digital care platforms that bring patients, caregivers and clinicians closer together. Our products include PaSeva (home healthcare operations and care coordination), Mat of Life (a smart, camera-free fall-prevention ecosystem) and Mannkaa (a mental health and cognitive wellness app).

The role

We are hiring a hands-on Embedded Systems Engineer to own firmware, sensor integration and hardware prototyping for Mat of Life and our upcoming healthcare devices. You will work directly with product leadership and our software teams to take new hardware ideas from breadboard to reliable, production-ready connected devices.

Job details

• Location: Gurugram, Haryana – MG Road (Vipul Agora, near Sahara Mall)

• Work mode: On-site, work from office

• Employment type: Full-time

• Experience: 4-5 years

• Notice period: Immediate joiners preferred; maximum 30 days

• CTC: competitive, based on experience

What you will do

• Firmware: Design, write and optimise embedded C/C++ firmware on ESP32 for low-power, real-time healthcare IoT devices.

• Sensors: Interface and calibrate sensor arrays – FSR/pressure matrices, IR, PIR, LDR and acoustic sensors – to detect movement, bed-exit events and behaviour patterns.

• Connectivity: Build reliable BLE, Wi-Fi and MQTT/HTTPS communication to send real-time alerts and long-term activity data to our cloud and mobile apps.

• R&D and prototyping: Lead rapid prototyping, hardware simplification and PCB/schematic reviews for new products in our pipeline.

• Testing and reliability: Run hardware-in-the-loop debugging, power optimisation and field testing so devices perform reliably in senior-care settings.

What we are looking for

• B.Tech/B.E. or M.Tech/M.E. in Electronics & Communication, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or a related field.

• 2–5 years of hands-on embedded systems and firmware experience in C/C++ (ESP-IDF / FreeRTOS preferred).

• Must have: ESP32 experience in production or advanced prototypes.

• Good working knowledge of I2C, SPI, UART and ADC/DMA, and of interfacing pressure/FSR, IR, PIR, LDR and sound sensors.

• Comfortable reading PCB schematics and using oscilloscopes, logic analysers and multimeters; understanding of low-power wireless design.

• Strong problem-solver with clear communication, able to work with our US product team and the Gurugram engineering team.

• Good to have: exposure to medical device standards (e.g. IEC 60601, ISO 13485) or products built for regulated environments.

Why join us

• Build what's next: Shape the hardware roadmap of Mat of Life and brand-new healthcare devices from the ground up.

• Real impact: Build technology that keeps seniors safe and gives families peace of mind – without cameras.

• High ownership: Work closely with the leadership team in a fast-moving R&D environment, with competitive pay and room to grow.

How to apply

Apply through LinkedIn with your updated CV. Please mention your current CTC, expected CTC and notice period in your application.

Source of Life Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds.

title: Process Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Ohayo Green Energy is a sustainability-focused organization led by scientists, engineers, and finance professionals committed to driving measurable environmental impact. The company helps bridge the gap between India’s significant renewable energy potential and its current deployment by offering deep industry expertise. Ohayo accelerates the transition to a greener economy through data-driven insights and practical implementation support.

The team aligns global best practices with India’s unique opportunities and challenges, creating solutions tailored to local conditions. Professionals joining Ohayo will contribute to meaningful projects that support clean energy growth and long-term climate resilience.

We are seeking chemical or production engineering students and fresh graduates to join two live consulting projects in the biofuels and oleochemicals space. This is a paid contract with a timesheet-based work commitment. Applications are by CV and a short video (details under Application Process).

The Project Landscape:

• Project Area1: Maximising the utilisation of an existing fatty acid methyl ester (FAME/SME) plant by identifying higher-value, non-fuel applications for its products. Work covers plant assessment, product and application screening, and an understanding of fuels and their derivatives.

• Project Area 2: Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) and related ecosystems of ammonia or green hydrogen. Work areas would include technical research for a Detailed Project Report (DPR) review or a Techno-Economic Viability (TEV) assessment for a sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) project or related ecosystem projects.

Key Responsibilities

Consultants will primarily contribute to technical research and analysis, with exposure to plant assessment, product screening, project review and report development. Key tasks include:

I. Plant and Process Analysis :

• Review plant configuration and operating data to assess capacity utilisation and debottlenecking options

• Apply separation, heat and mass transfer fundamentals to assess product grades and purification routes

II. Product and Application Screening:

• Screen niche oleochemical products and non-fuel applications for technical fit, ease of substitution and qualification requirements

• Benchmark product properties against incumbent industrial products and interpret laboratory and quality data

III. Feedstock, Market and Regulatory Research:

• Compare feedstock options on a delivered-cost basis, from vegetable oils and residues to biomass, and map by-product monetisation routes

• Track applicable standards, certifications and traceability requirements for domestic markets, including fuel and SAF specifications

IV. DPR Review and TEV :

• Review the DPR for the consistency of its design basis, mass and energy balances, equipment sizing, CAPEX and OPEX assumptions

• Build the techno-economic model: yields, product slate, utilities, financial metrics and sensitivity cases

V. Data Analysis and Reporting:

• Build economic comparisons, structured screening matrices and comparison tables

• Support the drafting of technical reports, product literature and client presentations

Skills & Qualifications

• Chemical or production engineering fresh graduate, or student who has completed at least 5 semesters, with a grade of B or better in process engineering or heat and mass transfer

• BSc Tech graduates from ICT in any discipline, with a similar experience profile, are also welcome

Technical knowledge (strong in some areas, willing to learn the rest):

• Fuels and their derivatives: biodiesel/FAME and how it is made (transesterification, washing, drying, distillation); glycerol, fatty acids and other oleochemical derivatives; fuel and product properties such as acid value, iodine value, viscosity, flash point, cold-flow behaviour and oxidation stability; familiarity with specifications such as EN 14214, ASTM D6751 and IS 15607

• Biomass to feedstock: types of biomass and residues; characterisation (moisture, ash, volatile matter, calorific value); preparation routes such as drying, size reduction, pelletisation and torrefaction; collection, logistics and delivered cost

• SAF and Fischer-Tropsch: a working picture of the route (biomass to syngas, syngas cleaning, Fischer-Tropsch synthesis, upgrading) and of how it compares with HEFA and other SAF pathways; awareness of ASTM D7566 / D1655

• Process fundamentals: mass and energy balances, separation processes, heat and mass transfer, reading block flow diagrams, PFDs and basic P&IDs, and utilities and yield estimation

• Economics: CAPEX and OPEX estimation, payback, NPV and IRR, sensitivity analysis, and spreadsheet-based cost modelling

• Tools (preferred, not mandatory): advanced Excel; basic exposure to a process simulator (Aspen, DWSIM) or Python; awareness of life cycle assessment and carbon intensity concepts

Aptitude and approach:

• General understanding of process industries and project methodologies : framing an open-ended problem, defining screening criteria, testing options against them and recommending a way forward

• Comfortable reading technical literature, standards and a DPR critically, and questioning assumptions rather than accepting them

• Strong analytical skills and comfort with data handling; excellent written communication; self-motivated and detail-oriented

Project Details

• Time Commitment: 40 hours a week. Primarily remote with ~40 hours a month travel / hybrid work commitments.

• Stipend: 25,000-40,000 before TDS monthly, depending on prior experience, pay and qualifications.

• Start Date: Immediate

Application Process

This is a CV + video application. Please submit the following:

1. CV/Resume (maximum 2 pages), listing your grades in process engineering or heat and mass transfer. A transcript will be requested if you are shortlisted

2. Video response (maximum 3 minutes), shared as an unlisted link (Google Drive or YouTube) with viewing access enabled, answering the prompt below

Video prompt

Briefly introduce yourself and say which of the two project areas interests you more, and why. Then answer both questions in your own words. Slides are not needed; we are interested in how you think and communicate, not in production quality.

• SME Client: A client runs a biodiesel (FAME/SME) plant and wants to earn more from it through non-fuel applications. How would you approach finding and screening options? Which product properties and fuel derivatives would you look at first, and what would you want to know about the plant and the feedstock?

• SAF via Fischer-Tropsch: You are handed a DPR for a biomass-based SAF plant and asked for a TEV. What would you check first in the DPR, and which inputs do you expect to drive the economics most?

**Submit to: Ohayo Green Energy | Email: info@ohayogreenenergy.com | Subject line: Application: Process Engineering Consultant: [Your Name]**

title: AI Solutions Architect
description:

Bloom AI is an applied AI firm building AI-native intelligence systems and workflows for enterprise teams across research, marketing, sales and other knowledge-intensive functions.

We combine enterprise data, external intelligence, AI and software engineering to help organizations turn information into intelligence and action.

Our approach combines reusable AI capabilities with hands-on solution development in real enterprise environments. We work closely with business teams to rethink workflows, design intelligent systems and deploy solutions that deliver measurable outcomes.

Bloom AI is based in the U.S. and India (Delhi/NCR).

**THE ROLE**

We are looking for a
**hands-on AI Solutions Architect**
who can design, build and deploy enterprise-grade AI applications and agentic systems.

This role sits at the intersection of
**AI architecture, data engineering and software development**
.

You may come from a backend engineering, data engineering or data science background, but you should have evolved into building end-to-end AI solutions.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have worked on
**multiple AI/LLM projects**
, solved different types of problems and gained practical experience making architectural decisions across agent orchestration, data, context management, application development and deployment.

You should be equally comfortable designing a solution architecture, evaluating technology choices, writing code, integrating data sources and taking a working solution into production.

This is
**not a traditional software engineering role, a prompt-engineering role or a PowerPoint-only architecture role**
. We need someone who understands how AI systems work end-to-end and can personally build what they design.

You will work across client engagements, reusable Bloom AI capabilities and internal technology development, taking ownership of solutions from architecture through production deployment.

You will be part of the core team, reporting directly to the CEO.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

Leading a small team, you will:

**Architect Bloom AI Capabilities and Client Solutions**

* Design end-to-end AI solutions combining LLMs, agents, enterprise data, APIs and applications.
* Mak architectural decisions around agent orchestration, context, memory, workflows and technology choices.
* Build modular, reusable solutions that work across different cloud and enterprise environments.

**Build agentic applications**

* Develop multi-agent systems, agentic workflows and LLM-powered applications using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain or similar.
* Implement tool calling, RAG, semantic search, agent memory and state management.
* Build evaluation, monitoring and reliability mechanisms for production AI systems.

**Engineer data and context systems**

* Integrate structured and unstructured enterprise data into AI applications.
* Design retrieval and context architectures using relational, vector and graph databases.
* Build knowledge retrieval, entity relationships and persistent context capabilities.

**Develop and deploy end to end systems**

* Build backend services and APIs using Python, FastAPI or similar technologies.
* Develop functional frontend applications and integrate with enterprise systems.
* Deploy secure, scalable applications across cloud platforms using modern engineering practices.

**Solve enterprise client problems**

* Translate business challenges into practical AI architectures and working solutions.
* Work across multiple client projects, from solution design and prototyping through deployment.
* Evaluate technical approaches, collaborate with stakeholders and develop reusable capabilities for Bloom AI.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* **4–7 years of professional experience**
  , with a foundation in
  **backend engineering, data engineering, data science or related technical disciplines**
  .
* **Hands-on experience across multiple AI/LLM application projects**
  , preferably involving different use cases, data environments or architectural approaches.
* Demonstrated ability to take ownership of solution architecture and technical implementation, rather than contributing to only one component of a system.
* Strong proficiency in
  **Python**
  , with solid software engineering and API development skills.
* Practical experience building
  **agentic applications or multi-agent systems**
  , beyond basic chatbots and prompt-based applications.
* Experience with agent orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen or similar.
* Strong understanding of LLM APIs, tool calling, RAG, embeddings, vector databases and context management.
* Strong understanding of data modeling, SQL, databases, data integration and retrieval architectures.
* Working knowledge of full-stack application development, including modern frontend frameworks such as React or Next.js.
* Familiarity with graph data structures, entity relationships and graph-based retrieval concepts.
* Experience taking AI applications from prototype through testing, integration and production deployment.
* Experience with at least one major cloud platform and familiarity with Docker, Git, CI/CD and modern engineering practices.
* Ability to evaluate different technical approaches and make sound architectural trade-offs.
* Strong independent problem-solving skills, curiosity and comfort working with ambiguous requirements.
* Lead R&D efforts for Bloom AI

**Above all, we are looking for someone who has built several AI solutions, understands the architectural decisions behind them and can independently design and implement new ones.**

**GOOD TO HAVE**

* Startup or
  **0-to-1 product development experience**
  .
* Experience working on enterprise AI projects across different business functions or client environments.
* Experience integrating with
  **marketing, sales or commercial systems**
  , such as CRM, marketing automation, campaign platforms, content management systems or sales enablement tools.

* Experience building AI applications for financial services, research or other knowledge-intensive domains.

title: Senior Vice President - Process Excellence
description:
**A Reputed Insurtech MNC is hiring for Senior Vice President - Process Excellence.**

**Location: Noida/ Gurgaon**

**Work Mode: Hybrid**

**Function: Process Excellence (PEX)/ Transformation**

**Experience: 20+ years, including 5+ years leading Process Excellence / Transformation functions (Consulting background preferred; client-facing experience required)**

**Direct Reports: Head(s)/Leads of Process Excellence & Governance, AI Ecosystem, Client Enablement / Practice, and Operational Intelligence teams.**

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a seasoned Process Excellence leader to own the Process Excellence & Governance pillar within the organization. This is a senior leadership role responsible for setting the standards, tools and governance model that every domain pod and PEX consultant across the enterprise operates against.

You will build and lead the Process Excellence & Governance team, own process mapping and operational resilience standards, chair SOP & controls governance, and drive the enterprise Lean / Continuous Improvement agenda. You will sit alongside the leads for AI Ecosystem, Client Enablement / Practice, and Operational Intelligence — aligning their work to a single, coherent process excellence framework — and you will provide oversight on 30/60/90 day plans for every initiative that moves through the operating model.

This role is best suited to a leader who is equally comfortable setting enterprise governance and metrics, mentoring a bench of PEX consultants, and representing process excellence outcomes to the executive team.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Process Excellence Strategy & Governance**

* Own the enterprise Process Excellence & Governance charter, standards and operating rhythm on behalf of the leadership team.
* Set and govern process mapping standards, taxonomies and documentation practices used consistently across all domain pods.
* Chair SOP & Controls governance — approving, versioning and retiring SOPs, and ensuring controls are current, tested and audit-ready.
* Own the enterprise Metrics & Governance framework: define the KPIs, SLAs and reporting cadence used to track process health and improvement impact.
* Provide oversight and sign-off on 30/60/90 day plans for new initiatives, pods and transformation programmes.

**2. Operational Resilience**

* Lead operational resilience assessments across functions, identifying single points of failure, control gaps and continuity risks.
* Define resilience standards and recovery playbooks, and track remediation of identified gaps to closure.
* Partner with domain pods to embed resilience thinking into day-to-day process design, not just periodic audits.

**3. Lean / Continuous Improvement Leadership**

* Deploy Lean and Six Sigma methodologies enterprise-wide, driving a self-sustaining continuous improvement culture.
* Facilitate value stream mapping, root cause analysis and waste elimination for priority processes, and coach domain teams to run these independently.
* Conduct or oversee operational audits to assess process compliance and performance, recommend corrective actions and track implementation to closure.

**4. Team Leadership & Capability Building**

* Build, lead and develop the Process Excellence & Governance team, and manage the broader bench of PEX consultants deployed into domain pods.
* Own the central tool and template library — ensuring process improvement tools are maintained, standardized and accessible enterprise-wide, and that reuse and knowledge-sharing are actively promoted.
* Provide support in process mapping and operational backup to domain pods, and ensure pods have consistent access to PEX expertise.

**5. Automation & AI Opportunity Governance**

* Partner with the AI Ecosystem and Operational Intelligence teams to identify, evaluate and prioritise automation and AI opportunities against impact, feasibility and ROI.
* Ensure automation and AI use cases surfaced by domain pods are routed through a consistent intake, validation and business-case process.
* Track benefits realisation for approved automation/AI initiatives and course-correct where value is not being delivered.

**6. Agentic / AI-Led Process Design**

* Champion agentic and AI-led approaches to process redesign — moving beyond traditional automation to processes where AI agents plan, decide and execute steps with human oversight.
* Partner with the AI Ecosystem team to identify processes suited to agentic redesign, and define the target operating model, guardrails and human-in-the-loop checkpoints for each.
* Set standards for evaluating agentic solutions — accuracy, exception handling, escalation paths and audit trails — before they are scaled into production.
* Build organisational fluency in agentic AI concepts among PEX consultants and domain pods, so agentic opportunities are identified as routinely as manual process gaps.
* Track and report on the shift of enterprise processes from manual / rules-based automation to agentic execution, and the associated efficiency and quality gains.

**7. Cross-Functional Alignment & Executive Reporting**

* Act as the connective layer between Process Excellence & Governance, AI Ecosystem, Client Enablement / Practice, and Operational Intelligence — ensuring a single, coherent process excellence narrative across the organization.
* Represent process excellence performance, risks and opportunities to leadership and executive stakeholders, with clear visibility of decisions required from leadership.
* Build strong interpersonal relationships across cross-functional teams; influence, train and communicate effectively across all levels of the organisation.

**Key Skills**

**Leadership & Governance**

* Proven experience leading a Process Excellence, Transformation or Operational Excellence function at a senior/enterprise level.
* Strong governance discipline — comfortable owning frameworks, metrics and standards that other teams are held to.

**Process Excellence & Methodologies**

* Lean, Six Sigma (Black Belt / Master Black Belt preferred), and structured continuous improvement toolkits.
* Deep experience in process mapping, root cause analysis, operational resilience and performance measurement.

**Automation & Digital Fluency**

* Familiarity with automation platforms (e.g., Power Automate, UiPath, Automation Anywhere) and low-code/no-code enablement models.
* Working understanding of AI/ML concepts and how they apply to process improvement and decision support.
* Exposure to agentic AI concepts and platforms, and a point of view on where agentic execution fits alongside traditional automation.

**Analytical & Problem-Solving**

* Strong skills in data analysis, process diagnostics and decision-making; ability to quantify impact and drive data-backed recommendations.

**Stakeholder & Change Management**

* Experience in project planning, execution and stakeholder management; knowledge of Agile and traditional project management methodologies.
* Executive-level communication and consulting skills — able to influence C-suite, cross-functional leaders and clients.
* Strong client-facing presence, with experience owning client relationships and representing outcomes directly to client leadership.
* Proven ability to prioritise and manage multiple concurrent initiatives, stakeholders and deadlines without losing sight of enterprise priorities.

**Tool & Knowledge Management**

* Experience maintaining repositories, templates and best-practice libraries, and curating toolkits for enterprise-wide use.

**Experience & Qualifications**

* 20+ years of experience in Process Excellence, Transformation or Consulting roles, with at least 5 years in a leadership capacity.
* Consulting background strongly preferred, with demonstrated client-facing experience — leading engagements, presenting recommendations and managing client relationships directly.
* Track record of building and leading Process Excellence or Governance functions at an enterprise level.
* Experience designing and governing metrics, SOP/controls frameworks and operational resilience standards.
* Demonstrated success building and scaling automation-enablement programmes.
* Lean / Six Sigma Black Belt or Master Black Belt, or equivalent structured problem-solving certification.
* Insurance, BPO or professional services domain experience strongly preferred.

title: Research Associate – AI Entrepreneurship Incubator Program
description:
**Company Description**
J-PAL South Asia, a regional office of the Abdul Latif Jameel Poverty Action Lab (J-PAL), is based at the Institute for Financial Management and Research in India and leads J-PAL’s work across the South Asia region. The office conducts randomized evaluations, builds partnerships to promote evidence-informed policymaking, and supports the scale-up of effective development programs. J-PAL South Asia works closely with governments, NGOs, and academic partners in Bangladesh, India, Nepal, Pakistan, and Sri Lanka. Since 2011, it has hosted the South Asia Center for CLEAR, a World Bank-supported initiative that strengthens monitoring and evaluation systems through training, technical assistance, and knowledge sharing. CLEAR South Asia also serves as a core implementing partner of the Global Evaluation Initiative (GEI), providing opportunities to contribute to high-impact policy and research efforts.

**Project Description**

**The Parvaaz AI Jobs and Firm Growth project investigates whether training in artificial intelligence (AI) can help young people build marketable digital services, connect with local businesses, and access entrepreneurship and employment opportunities. The project is currently piloting an applied AI entrepreneurship bootcamp with engineering students in Ludhiana, Punjab, and is developing plans to expand to additional colleges.**

**The training emphasizes practical use of AI coding tools to develop, test, and refine digital products for real businesses, such as websites, inventory systems, and customer communication tools. The research aims to measure skills development, student engagement, product creation and quality, interactions with businesses, and downstream entrepreneurship and employment outcomes. The team is preparing a rigorous evaluation of the program as it scales. The program is a joint initiative of Parvaaz at UC Berkeley, MIT Sloan, and the Poverty Action Lab (J-PAL), founded at MIT.**

**The candidate will work closely with a multidisciplinary research team from MIT Sloan School of Management (Dr. Namrata Kala), University of California, Berkeley (Dr. Supreet Kaur and Dr. Aprajit Mahajan), and University of Chicago (Dr. Grady Killeen). The candidate will contribute to study design and methods and lead data collection in each study site alongside the research team.**

**About the Role**

**We are seeking a detail-oriented, proactive Research Associate to support research design, survey development, research data systems, data quality assurance, and quantitative analysis. The RA will work closely with the Principal Investigators and research team, and coordinate with the implementation team.**

**Key Responsibilities:**

**The responsibilities of a Research Associate typically include, but are not limited to:**

* Supporting researchers in developing and refining study protocols through in-field scoping activities. You will provide contextual and operational insights to help researchers shape experimental protocols that are methodologically rigorous and feasible within the study setting.
* Strengthening measurement validity and reliability by assisting in the development and piloting of survey instruments. You will be responsible for organizing field tests, analyzing pilot data, and integrating structured feedback loops to improve the precision and accuracy of indicators.
* Enable accurate and efficient data capture through the programming of digital surveys and development of end-to-end data workflows. This includes incorporating survey logic, real-time checks, and secure data transmission to ensure clean, analysis-ready datasets.
* Ensuring collection of high-quality primary data—recruiting, training, and managing field teams to collect data that meets rigorous research standards.
* Safeguarding data integrity in consultation with the research team by setting up and maintaining systems for real-time quality monitoring. You will identify issues in incoming data, identify solutions in collaboration with the researchers, and implement corrective measures.
* Preparing analysis-ready datasets by writing reproducible code (in Stata, R, or Python), generating summary statistics, and contributing to the analytical preparation for publications, working closely with researchers.
* Facilitating alignment between research teams and implementation partners to ensure that project implementation aligns with study protocols. You will coordinate timelines, share updates across teams, and help troubleshoot day-to-day challenges while maintaining strong working relationships with external stakeholders.
* Ensuring transparency and reproducibility by developing and maintaining detailed documentation, including codebooks, field protocols, and project logs that align with academic standards and support eventual replication and publication.
* Maintaining strict adherence to J-PAL’s research protocols throughout all stages of the research lifecycle.

**What We’re Looking For:**

* Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to addressing operational and analytical challenges
* Ability to manage day-to-day work with minimal supervision
* Excellent time management and attention to detail
* Ability to navigate fast-evolving settings that require flexibility and initiative
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt messaging for diverse audiences
* Required Knowledge and Skills:
* A Bachelor's/Master’s degree in economics, sociology, social sciences, public policy, public health or related fields. Other technical degrees with focus on computer science, AI, or data science will also be considered.
* Sound understanding of impact evaluation methods, especially randomized controlled trials (RCTs).
* Proficiency in data analysis and statistical tools such as R (preferred) or Stata.
* Experience with digital data collection platforms such as SurveyCTO (preferred) or Qualtrics.
* Fluency in English and Hindi; proficiency in one or more regional languages (Punjabi) is a strong asset.
* Willingness to travel extensively and stay in field locations. This is a multi-site study requiring extensive travel to Ludhiana, Mohali, and across Punjab.
* Experience working with external stakeholders such as government departments or NGOs is a plus.

The company operates on both the demand and supply sides of the rental market by onboarding homeowners, finding quality tenants, and managing properties end-to-end. Nestaway transforms unbranded, unfurnished houses into fully furnished homes and offers them at affordable prices, ensuring higher rental income for homeowners and a hassle-free experience for all parties. For more information, visit http://www.nestaway.com.
  
**Role Description**
The House Acquisition Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Gurugram, focused on expanding Nestaway’s portfolio of rental homes. This role involves identifying and prospecting potential homeowners, pitching Nestaway’s managed rental solutions, and negotiating property onboarding terms. The manager conducts property visits, assesses suitability and market potential, and coordinates with internal teams to ensure smooth onboarding, furnishing, and listing of homes. Daily activities include maintaining a pipeline of leads, tracking acquisition metrics, collaborating with operations and sales teams, and providing regular market feedback to optimize acquisition strategies.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong relationship-building, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills for working with homeowners and internal teams.
* Experience in property sourcing, market research, and basic real estate evaluation to identify and assess rental opportunities.
* Solid communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain managed rental solutions clearly and persuasively.
* Organizational and time-management skills for handling multiple leads, site visits, and documentation efficiently.
* Comfort with using digital tools, CRM systems, and basic data analysis to track performance and support decision-making.
* Prior experience in real estate, housing rentals, or sales/business development is preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Real Estate, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, travel locally within Gurugram, and maintain a customer-centric approach.

description:
Are you passionate about helping customers protect critical data and maintain resilient IT environments?

Do you enjoy troubleshooting complex backup challenges across on-premises and cloud platforms?

At SoftwareOne, we help organizations protect their critical workloads and maintain business continuity through cloud, backup, and managed services. * Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills with the ability to investigate incidents and drive issues through to resolution.

* Strong written and verbal English communication skills with a customer-focused and collaborative approach.

title: Principal Engineer
description:
**About the Role**

We are hiring a Technical Architect to design and scale a mission-critical, ultra-low latency stock broking platform built for massive scale and peak market volatility. The role calls for deep capital markets expertise and the ability to architect high-throughput, deterministic real-time systems in regulated environments.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Architecture & Platform Ownership**

* Own the end-to-end architecture of a high-performance trading platform.
* Design systems for ultra-low latency, high transactions per second (TPS) and predictable performance.
* Architect scalable, fault-tolerant distributed systems with zero-downtime principles.
* Drive active-active, multi-region architecture strategy and disaster recovery readiness.

**Performance, Reliability & Engineering Excellence**

* Lead performance benchmarking, tuning and capacity planning.
* Establish architectural governance and engineering best practices.
* Lead architecture reviews and contribute to large-scale architecture revamps.
* Mentor senior engineers and provide technical direction across teams.

**Capital Markets & Broking Domain**

* Bring a strong understanding of the complete order lifecycle in broking, including validation, risk checks, routing, exchange acknowledgement, trade confirmation and settlement.
* Design ultra-low latency trade routing, deterministic execution flows, order state management, reconciliation and audit trails.
* Understand market feed ingestion, including tick-by-tick data, LTP and market depth, along with high-throughput feed processing, normalization and real-time charting data pipelines.
* Architect real-time portfolio tracking, position management, MTM and P&L computation, pre- and post-trade risk validation, margin and exposure management.
* Design data movement and event propagation across OMS, RMS, portfolio, reporting and notification services, with appropriate consistency and inter-service communication patterns.

**Security, Compliance & Governance**

* Work with an understanding of broking technology compliance requirements.
* Ensure appropriate data encryption in transit and at rest, and secure key management practices.
* Define data retention, archival and backup strategies.
* Build disaster recovery and audit-readiness considerations into platform architecture.

**Cloud, Infrastructure & Technology**

* Design services hosted on AWS and/or GCP, including multi-AZ and multi-region deployment architectures.
* Drive active-active setup, high-throughput regional design and disaster recovery architecture, including RTO/RPO planning.
* Apply strong fundamentals in concurrency, distributed systems and networking.
* Build event-driven systems using Kafka, with asynchronous processing and high-throughput event pipelines.
* Use gRPC for public APIs and inter-service communication.
* Bring exposure to containerization and orchestration.

**Candidate Requirements**

* 15+ years of experience in backend and distributed systems engineering.
* Mandatory 3–5 years of experience in stock broking, trading platforms or capital markets.
* Proven experience building ultra-low latency, high-scale systems and handling mission-critical platforms with strict SLAs.
* Strong proficiency in both Go and Java.
* Deep understanding of concurrency, distributed systems, networking fundamentals, data consistency models and service decomposition.
* Hands-on experience with gRPC and Kafka, including asynchronous processing and high-throughput event pipelines.
* Experience hosting services on AWS and/or GCP, with exposure to multi-AZ, multi-region, active-active and disaster recovery architectures.
* Strong architectural ownership, technical decision-making and leadership experience.

**What Success Looks Like**

* A scalable, high-performance trading platform that delivers predictable performance during peak market volatility.
* Reliable, fault-tolerant architecture with strong availability, active-active capabilities and disaster recovery readiness.
* Efficient order, market data, portfolio and risk workflows supported by robust distributed-system design.
* Strong architectural governance, engineering practices and technical alignment across teams.
* Secure, compliant and audit-ready technology foundations for a mission-critical broking platform.

description:
**Description**

**Header**

* Role: Analytics Consultant / Senior Analytics Consultant (Digital Experience & Behavioural Analytics)

**The role**

This is a client-facing consulting role in Contentsquare's India Center of Excellence. You will own analytics engagements for global enterprise clients: scoping their business problems, analysing user behaviour in Heap, Contentsquare and similar platforms, and presenting recommendations directly to client product, marketing and senior leaders. You will be measured on the decisions your work changes, not only on the reports you produce.

**About Scaletrix.AI**

Scaletrix.AI is a data analytics and AI services provider with 15 years of experience in the sector, led by alumni of McKinsey, BCG, ZS, Genpact, Citi, IIT, ISB, FMS and CMU. We build end-to-end solutions that bring data engineering and data science together.

Scaletrix.AI is a strategic partner of Contentsquare and serves as Contentsquare's India Center of Excellence (CSQ-India CoE), providing platform selling, onboarding, managed services and client management to Contentsquare and Heap customers globally.

**About the platforms**

Contentsquare is the global leader in digital experience analytics, headquartered in Paris with offices across the US, UK and APAC. Trusted by 1,000+ enterprises including L'Oréal, Walmart and Sephora, it delivers heatmaps, session replay, journey analysis and AI-driven recommendations to optimise conversion and customer experience.

Heap, part of the Contentsquare suite, brings product analytics powered by autocapture: it records every user interaction across web and mobile, with retroactive event definition, funnel tracking and behavioural segmentation. Heap is trusted by enterprises including Microsoft, AMD and Twilio.

Websites: https://www.scaletrix.ai/ | https://contentsquare.com/ | https://www.heap.io/

**Key responsibilities**

* Scope client problems, frame hypotheses and agree the analysis plan with client stakeholders.
* Present insights and prioritised recommendations to Directors, VPs and Heads of Product and Marketing, and quantify their business impact.
* Analyse user journeys, funnels, cohorts, retention and behavioural segments to find friction and growth opportunities.
* Design measurement frameworks: KPI trees, north-star metrics and instrumentation strategy.
* Design A/B tests, set guardrail metrics and interpret results.
* Build decision-oriented dashboards, executive readouts and reusable reporting templates.
* Keep metrics consistent and documented across every engagement deliverable.
* Build reusable playbooks for behavioural analytics use cases across industries.

**At the Senior level, you will also:**

* Own several client engagements in parallel and lead executive-level conversations.
* Mentor other consultants and shape frameworks and best practices across the CoE.

**Tools**

Must-have:

* Digital or product analytics: deep hands-on experience with at least one of Heap, Contentsquare, GA4, Adobe Analytics, Amplitude or Mixpanel
* SQL on a data warehouse: BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift or similar
* BI: Tableau, Power BI or Looker
* Excel or Google Sheets, and PowerPoint or Google Slides for client deliverables

Good to have:

* Experimentation: Optimizely, VWO, AB Tasty
* CDP and MarTech: Segment, mParticle, Braze, HubSpot
* Python or R for statistical analysis
* AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot) to scale analysis and standardise deliverables

**Requirements**

* 3+ years in product, digital or web analytics (6+ years for Senior), including client-facing or consulting experience (2+ years for Senior).
* Strong grasp of funnels, cohorts, retention, segmentation and experiment design.
* Able to turn an ambiguous business problem into a structured analysis plan and present it clearly to senior stakeholders.
* Understands client data ecosystems (MarTech stack, CDPs, warehouses, BI tools) and links recommendations to the tools a client already owns.

Good to have: experience with US or European enterprise clients, regression or causal inference methods, managing several engagements in parallel.

**Why join us**

* Own high-impact analytics engagements with global clients across retail, e-commerce, travel, BFSI and hi-tech.
* Shape how leading brands use Heap, Contentsquare and behavioural analytics, as part of Contentsquare's India Center of Excellence.
* Work alongside leaders with experience at McKinsey, BCG, ZS, Genpact and Citi.
* A clear path to practice leadership and senior consulting roles.

Shortlisted candidates will receive one short question to answer in 3 to 4 lines.

title: Advanced Analytics Specialist
description:
**Department:**
Operations Office
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Permanent - Full Time
  
  
**Location:**
India
  
  
**Reporting To:**
Mike Serpetti
  
  
**Description**
As an Advanced Analytics Specialist / Expert, you are responsible for designing, executing and interpreting advanced statistical analysis and marketing science outputs that help clients make better business decisions. The pillar covers methods such as conjoint and choice modelling, MaxDiff, pricing analytics, clustering and segmentation, driver analysis, regression, predictive modelling and other advanced quantitative techniques.
  
  
You support project delivery by translating business questions into fit-for-purpose analytical approaches, preparing or specifying analysis plans, executing robust modelling, validating outputs, and turning statistical results into clear implications, scenarios and recommendations. A core part of the role is sense making: connecting advanced outputs to the wider research story so that findings are understandable, commercially relevant and usable by client teams.
  
  
The role is expected to be confident in core advanced analytics and marketing science tools, including Sawtooth, R, SPSS, Python, Excel and relevant Human8 tools, while acting as a technical sparring partner for Client Service Teams, Project Delivery Managers, Data Processing specialists and senior experts on analytical feasibility, methodological quality and interpretation of results.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Advanced Statistical Analysis & Modelling**

* Translate client and research questions into appropriate advanced analytical approaches, including conjoint/CBC, MaxDiff, pricing analytics, clustering, segmentation, driver analysis, regression and predictive modelling.
* Execute statistical modelling and marketing science analysis using robust, documented and quality-controlled methods.
* Validate model inputs, assumptions, outputs and diagnostics to ensure analytical conclusions are reliable and fit for purpose.
* Develop simulators, analytical outputs, scenario tools, models, reports or other deliverables that help project teams and clients understand choices, trade-offs and drivers of behaviour.

**Sense Making, Interpretation & Client Impact**

* Interpret statistical outputs and translate them into clear, commercially relevant insights, implications and recommendations.
* Connect advanced analytics findings with broader research evidence, stakeholder context and the overall client story.
* Explain complex methods and outputs in accessible language for internal teams and external clients.
* Guide teams on how to use advanced outputs appropriately, including limitations, interpretation boundaries and decision-making implications.
* Provide a clear point of view on what the numbers mean and what actions they suggest.

**Method Management, Guidance & Continuous Improvement**

* Develop and improve analytical frameworks, templates, syntax, simulators, documentation and quality checks for recurring marketing science methods.
* Provide technical guidance to colleagues on method selection, analysis setup, interpretation and troubleshooting.
* Stay current with relevant marketing science, statistical and data science methods, identifying opportunities to apply new thinking responsibly.
* Contribute to knowledge sharing, training and capability building across the Advanced Analytics community.
* Support governance around methodological standards, reproducibility, model quality and appropriate use of advanced outputs.

**Tools & Platforms**

* Use advanced analytics tools such as Sawtooth, R, SPSS, Python and Excel to design, run, validate and interpret statistical and marketing science analyses.
* Use Copilot and other approved productivity tools responsibly to support efficiency, documentation, checking and workflow improvement.
* Use relevant Human8 tools and methods to support analysis preparation, output review, visualization, synthesis and storytelling where applicable.

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise
  
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Statistics, Data Sciences, Economics, Operations Research, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or related field of study is desirable
* 3-4 years of relevant experience
* Preferably based in Delhi or Bangalore

**Success Measures / KPIs**

* Accuracy, robustness and relevance of advanced statistical analysis and marketing science outputs
* Quality of analysis plans, model validation, documentation and reproducibility
* Ability to translate complex outputs into clear insights, implications and recommendations
* Timeliness and usability of deliverables such as models, simulators, analytical reports and scenario outputs
* Effective use of required tools, including Sawtooth, R, SPSS, Python, Excel, Copilot and relevant Human8 tools
* Contribution to method improvement, training, documentation, quality standards and capability building

* **Plan the mix.**
  Decide what to buy by category, size and price point, based on what sells, what clears slowly and what our shows need next.
* **Manage inventory health.**
  Track sell-through and stock age, and decide when slow stock gets re-run, bundled or liquidated in bulk.
* **Control quality and provenance.**
  Set inward QC standards, collect proper invoices and documentation for every lot, and drop suppliers who don't meet them.
* **Manage suppliers.**
  Build repeat relationships, track supplier quality and returns, and avoid depending on a few suppliers for most of our stock.

**Who we're looking for**

* 3–5 years in sourcing or buying for apparel or other lifestyle categories.
* An existing network of brands, manufacturers, exporters or stock traders you can call on day one.
* Strong negotiator who knows landed cost, margin and how to price a lot before buying it.
* Can judge fabric, finish and quality in person, and knows the common defects in surplus stock.
* Comfortable in spreadsheets: tracking buys, sell-through, stock age and supplier performance.
* Willing to travel to factories, warehouses and trading hubs.
* Fluent in Hindi and English.

**Preferred**

* Category or supply experience at a marketplace or commerce company in fashion or value fashion.
* Experience buying or selling liquidation, excess, export surplus or off-price inventory.
* Knows the surplus trade in hubs such as Delhi NCR, Tirupur, Ludhiana, Jaipur, Surat or Mumbai.
* Understands what documentation makes surplus stock safe to sell, including invoice chains and brand authorisations.

**How we'll measure success**

* Buy cost as a share of clearing price, by category and supplier.
* Sell-through at 30, 60 and 90 days, and how much stock ages past 90 days.
* Days of scheduled lives covered by live-ready stock.
* QC rejection, return and quality complaint rates by supplier.
* Number of active, repeat suppliers, and how much of our stock comes from the top three.
* Share of lots with full provenance documentation.

Professional mannerisms with the ability to listen and probe determine root causes and resolve issues quickly when necessary. Shift timings: 12:30 PM to 9:30 PM

**Responsibilities**
**Customer Survey Operations**

* Retrieve or receive survey and transactional data from approved source systems and internal repositories.
* Prepare survey datasets, labelled exports, and supporting reference files for reporting and dashboard requirements.

* Support survey programs covering technical support, purchase, internal and external P&E, services, delivery, and training/customer-enablement activities, as assigned.

**Data Preparation, Mapping, and Reconciliation**

* Clean, structure, and reconcile Excel-based source files to produce reliable reporting datasets.

* Build and validate match keys using defined combinations of fields, such as course number or course code with student email or username.
* Enrich datasets with required classification fields, including course code and product line, while preserving source traceability.
* Check for duplicate records, missing values, inconsistent labels, unmatched records, and conflicting source information.

* Document mapping rules, assumptions, exceptions, and unresolved data-quality issues.

* Maintain consistent report structures, file naming, version references, and reporting-period definitions.
* Provide validated datasets, mapping workbooks, sample records, and label references to reporting and dashboard teams.
* Support ad hoc data requests by clarifying the required fields, reporting scope, output format, and delivery timeline.
* Investigate discrepancies between source data and reporting outputs and coordinate corrections with the relevant owners.
* Maintain clear records of reporting dependencies and escalate delays or incomplete inputs.

title: Customer  Lifecycle Management (CLM) Manager / Senior Specialist
description:
**Location:**

Gurugram

**Company:**

  HiAstro

**Department:**

Growth / Retention / CRM

**Experience:**

3–7 Years

About the Role

HiAstro is looking for a hands-on lifecycle marketing owner who can translate product and business goals into high-impact, measurable customer communication programs. You will own the strategy and execution of campaigns across push, WhatsApp, SMS, RCS and in-app channels—from identifying opportunities in behavioral data to building segments, configuring journeys, launching campaigns and measuring incremental impact. This is an individual-contributor-first role with manager-level ownership, not a coordination-only position.

What You’ll Own

Lifecycle strategy and business impact

Build a lifecycle roadmap aligned to activation, first purchase/trial conversion, engagement, retention, subscription renewal, feature adoption, reactivation and revenue goals.

Identify user drop-offs and high-intent moments across onboarding, astrologer discovery, chat/call initiation, trial purchase, subscription and repeat usage; determine the right audience, message, channel and timing.

Prioritize campaigns based on expected business impact, user relevance, reach, cost and experimentation learnings.

Hands-on campaign creation and orchestration

Independently create, QA, launch, monitor and optimize one-off campaigns, triggered communications, automated journeys and multi-channel sequences in CleverTap or equivalent tools.

Own behavioral and cohort-based segmentation, personalization, frequency caps, suppression logic, delivery windows, deep links and conversion attribution.

Write or direct compelling campaign briefs and copy; work with Design on creatives while remaining accountable for final execution quality.

Design thoughtful cross-channel orchestration across push notifications, WhatsApp, SMS, RCS and in-app messaging (email where relevant).

App events, tracking and data fluency

Understand the complete app event taxonomy and user journey, including frontend events (screen views, CTA clicks, chat/call starts, feature interactions) and backend events (payment attempts/success/failure, subscription and mandate status, renewals, entitlements, refunds where relevant, and service completion).

Translate business use cases into accurate event/property requirements, audience definitions and trigger conditions; distinguish intent signals from confirmed backend outcomes.

Partner with Product, Engineering and Analytics to audit instrumentation, debug missing/duplicate/delayed events, validate event properties and maintain reliable campaign triggers.

Comfortably analyze funnels, cohorts, user properties and event-level data to identify opportunities and verify campaign outcomes.

Experimentation, measurement and optimization

Run structured A/B tests on proposition, copy, creatives, audience, send time, channel and journey logic; use holdouts where appropriate to assess incrementality.

Track delivery, CTR, conversion, trial/subscription purchases, revenue, repeat engagement, retention, unsubscribes and channel cost—not just vanity metrics.

Build clear weekly performance reviews with hypotheses, insights, decisions and next experiments; proactively diagnose underperforming journeys.

Cross-functional ownership

Work closely with Growth, Product, Analytics, Engineering and Design to ship campaigns quickly without compromising event accuracy or user experience.

Maintain a campaign calendar, QA checklists, documentation and communication hygiene; independently drive work from idea to post-launch analysis.

What We’re Looking For

Approximately 3–7 years in CLM, CRM, lifecycle marketing or retention/growth for a B2C app; scope and demonstrated ability matter more than title or exact years.

Strong hands-on experience with CleverTap (preferred), MoEngage, WebEngage or Braze—including journeys, segmentation, triggers and campaign reporting.

Proven ability to both decide which campaigns should run and personally build and execute them.

Solid understanding of frontend versus backend events, event properties, tracking reliability, conversion funnels and subscription/payment lifecycle signals.

Analytical fluency with dashboards and cohort analysis; working SQL knowledge is strongly preferred. Experience with Mixpanel or similar analytics tools is useful.

Strong copy judgment, structured experimentation, attention to detail and ownership of measurable business outcomes.

Experience in consumer subscription, content, gaming, social, fintech or other high-frequency B2C products.

Nice to Have

Experience at an astrology, spiritual wellness or astrology-tech company is a plus.

Familiarity with Indian WhatsApp/SMS/RCS ecosystems, channel economics, deliverability and compliance.

Experience in fast-moving startups, AI consumer products, paywalls, subscription mandates and renewal journeys.

Ability to use AI tools to accelerate ideation, personalization and campaign operations.

Success in This Role

Within the first 30 days, you will understand the app’s core funnels and event architecture, audit existing campaigns and tracking, establish a prioritized lifecycle opportunity map, and independently launch and optimize journeys tied to clear conversion, engagement or revenue goals.

Why HiAstro?

Work on a fast-evolving AI-powered consumer astrology product, own lifecycle growth end-to-end, collaborate directly with product and growth leadership, and see the measurable impact of your decisions on customer experience and business performance.

title: Performance Marketer
description:

**Company:**
Estrip Solution

**Location:**
Gurugram, Haryana

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Work Mode:**
On-site

**Experience:**
2–4 Years

Company Description

Estrip Solution is a cleaning innovation company with over 25 years of expertise in bio-enzyme manufacturing and cleaning product R&D. The company has developed India's first water-soluble cleaning sheets, offering powerful, compact and convenient cleaning solutions.

Its products are biodegradable, dermatologically tested, cruelty-free and designed to reduce plastic waste while simplifying everyday cleaning. Estrip Solution serves home consumers as well as private-label, bulk sourcing, B2B and export partners, focusing on smart and sustainable cleaning innovations.

The team is driven by the mission to help people and businesses #CleanWithCare.

Role Description

This is a full-time, on-site E-commerce Growth Manager role based in Gurugram. The candidate will be responsible for managing and growing Estrip's complete online business through performance marketing, search engine optimization (SEO) and Shopify e-commerce management.

The role involves planning, executing and optimizing paid advertising campaigns across Meta, Google and other relevant digital platforms to drive customer acquisition, increase online sales and improve return on ad spend (ROAS).

The candidate will independently manage the Shopify website, optimize product and landing pages, improve website conversion rates and develop strategies to increase organic traffic through SEO. Day-to-day responsibilities will include managing advertising budgets, analyzing campaign performance, conducting keyword research, improving website visibility, optimizing the customer purchase journey and implementing data-driven growth strategies.

The role will also involve collaborating with creative, content and sales teams to develop high-performing marketing campaigns, improve customer engagement and drive sustainable e-commerce revenue growth.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Performance Marketing**

* Plan, execute and optimize Meta (Facebook & Instagram) Ads and Google Ads campaigns.
* Manage Google Search, Shopping and Performance Max campaigns.
* Drive customer acquisition, online sales and profitable revenue growth.
* Monitor and optimize ROAS, CAC, CPA, CTR and CPC.
* Conduct audience research, retargeting and A/B testing.
* Manage advertising budgets and campaign performance.

**2. SEO & Organic Growth**

* Develop and implement on-page, off-page and technical SEO strategies.
* Conduct keyword research and competitor analysis.
* Optimize product pages, collection pages, blogs and landing pages.
* Manage Google Search Console and improve organic search rankings.
* Improve website indexing, internal linking and technical SEO.
* Develop strategies to increase organic traffic and conversions.

**3. Shopify E-commerce Management**

* Independently manage and optimize the Shopify store.
* Create and optimize product pages, collections and landing pages.
* Improve website UX/UI, mobile experience and conversion rates.
* Manage product listings, discounts, bundles and promotional campaigns.
* Implement CRO strategies to reduce cart abandonment.
* Monitor website performance, speed and checkout experience.

**4. Analytics & Reporting**

* Manage Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager and Meta Pixel.
* Monitor website traffic, customer behavior and conversion funnels.
* Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports.
* Analyze campaign data and identify growth opportunities.
* Track revenue, ROAS, CAC, AOV and conversion rates.

**5. Customer Retention & Growth**

* Plan email and WhatsApp marketing campaigns.
* Develop abandoned cart and customer retention strategies.
* Implement remarketing and repeat purchase campaigns.
* Explore new digital channels and growth opportunities.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 2–4 years of hands-on experience in performance marketing and e-commerce.
* Strong expertise in Meta Ads and Google Ads.
* Practical experience managing Shopify stores.
* Good understanding of SEO and keyword research.
* Experience with GA4, Google Search Console and Google Tag Manager.
* Knowledge of conversion rate optimization (CRO).
* Understanding of D2C, FMCG and e-commerce business models.
* Strong analytical, communication and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Experience

* Experience working with D2C brands, FMCG or consumer product companies.
* Experience scaling e-commerce revenue through paid and organic channels.
* Understanding of marketplace advertising and Google Merchant Center.
* Experience managing marketing budgets and achieving revenue targets.

What We Expect

We are looking for someone who can independently manage the complete digital growth ecosystem, take ownership of marketing performance and turn website traffic into measurable business revenue.

* The ideal candidate should be equally comfortable with campaign execution, SEO strategy, Shopify management, data analysis and continuous optimization.

description:
