description:
**Introduction**
A career in IBM Consulting embraces long-term relationships and close collaboration with clients across the globe. In this role, you will work for IBM BPO, part of Consulting that, accelerates digital transformation using agile methodologies, process mining, and AI-powered workflows.
  
  
You'll work with visionaries across multiple industries to improve the hybrid cloud and AI journey for the most innovative and valuable companies in the world. Your ability to accelerate impact and make meaningful change for your clients is enabled by our strategic partner ecosystem and our robust technology platforms across the IBM portfolio, including IBM Software and Red Hat.
  
  
Curiosity and a constant quest for knowledge serve as the foundation to success in IBM Consulting. In your role, you'll be supported by mentors and coaches who will encourage you to challenge the norm, investigate ideas outside of your role, and come up with creative solutions resulting in groundbreaking impact for a wide network of clients. Our culture of evolution and empathy centers on long-term career growth and learning opportunities in an environment that embraces your unique skills and experience.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
As a detail-oriented and analytical MIS Reporting Analyst , you are responsible to manage, analyze, and present business data through accurate reports and dashboards with strong expertise in Microsoft Excel, reporting tools, data analysis, and stakeholder management to support business decision-making.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities Include**

* Prepare and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports.
* Develop and automate reports, dashboards, and trackers using Excel and reporting tools.
* Analyze large datasets to identify trends, gaps, and business insights.
* Ensure accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of all reports.
* Generate ad hoc reports and management presentations as required.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders to understand reporting requirements.
* Maintain databases and ensure data integrity across systems.
* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and provide actionable recommendations.
* Support monthly reviews, audits, and business forecasting activities.
* Drive process improvement initiatives through automation and reporting enhancements.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, INDEX-MATCH, Power Query, Macros preferred).
* Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or other visualization tools.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Good understanding of data management and reporting concepts.
* Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Outlook.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
* SAP experience is required.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in commerce, Business Administration, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Applications, or related field.
* Experience in MIS Reporting, Business Analytics, Workforce Management, or Operations Reporting.
* Knowledge of SQL will be an added advantage.

**Key Competencies**

* Data Analysis
* Reporting & Dash-boarding
* Attention to Detail
* Business Acumen
* Process Improvement
* Time Management
* Stakeholder Management

title: PPC Marketing Specialist (Remote)
description:
**Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.**
That is the whole job.
  
  
Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.
  
  
So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.
  
  
At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.
  
  
You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.
  
  
Here is what "end to end" actually means.
  
  
**You are the account manager. We do not have any.**
You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.
  
  
**You own the whole funnel, not the campaign.**
Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.
  
  
**You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it.**
We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.
  
  
**You can live anywhere.**
We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.
  
  
If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.
  
  
If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.
  
  
**Requirements**
**What the job looks like**

* Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month
* Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working
* Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people
* Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing
* Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target
* Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule
* Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery
* Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why
* Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team
* Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt

**You are a fit if**

* You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search
* You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have
* You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it
* You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list
* You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard
* You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you
* Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too

**You are not a fit if**

* "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed
* You want to be told what to do this week
* You need a ticketing system to know what matters
* You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question

**Benefits**
**Why this role is exciting**
This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.
  
  
You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.
  
  
You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.
  
  
You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

title: Product Marketing & Ops Lead
description:
**Job Description**

**Title - Product Marketing & Ops Lead**

**Employment Type: Full-time**

**Location –Remote (**
**Delhi NCR)**

**Experience: 4 – 8 Years**

**About us**

Magure is a UAE-based enterprise AI company. Our platform, MagOneAI, is an enterprise agentic AI orchestration platform that helps large organisations build, orchestrate, deploy, monitor and govern AI agents and AI workflows in production.

We sell to enterprise and government decision-makers: CIOs, CTOs, Chief AI Officers, Heads of Data and AI, and digital transformation leaders across the UAE, wider Middle East and global markets. Marketing is a small, senior, fast-moving team tied directly to pipeline.

**Role Overview**

You will work directly with the Head of Marketing as the execution owner for the function. You will run the day-to-day operating rhythm, manage a small team of specialists, keep events and campaigns moving on schedule, and personally own product marketing collateral alongside our content writer.

Strategy, budget ownership and leadership reporting stay with the Head of Marketing. Your job is to take the plan and land it: on time, on brand, and without needing to be chased. That requires someone who is equally comfortable writing a positioning document, unblocking a designer, and chasing an event vendor on a Friday evening.

If you want a purely strategic role, this is not it. If you are the person who has always quietly been the reason marketing actually shipped, read on.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product marketing (core craft)**

•    

Own product marketing collateral for MagOneAI: positioning documents, solution briefs, one-pagers, battlecards, pitch narratives, feature and launch messaging

•    

Translate technical platform capability into enterprise business outcomes: faster AI deployment, reduced operational risk, governance readiness, model flexibility, cost efficiency

•    

Build and maintain industry use-case narratives across banking, government, healthcare, oil and gas, manufacturing and other regulated sectors

•    

Work with the content writer to turn positioning into published content, and quality-check their output against the messaging framework

•    

Track the competitive landscape and keep comparison and objection handling material current

•    

Run product and feature launches end to end once the narrative is agreed

**Team management and delivery**

•    

Manage the designer, HubSpot specialist and content writer day to day: priorities, briefs, quality, turnaround

•    

Brief work clearly, review it properly, and send it back when it is not good enough

•    

Hold the marketing calendar and make sure everything on it actually ships

•    

Unblock the team, escalate early, and give the Head of Marketing a clean view of status without being asked

**Events**

•    

Own end-to-end execution for exhibitions, conferences, booths, roundtables and partner events across UAE, GCC and international markets

•    

Manage logistics, vendors, booth build, collateral, giveaways, shipping and on-ground coordination

•    

Run pre-event promotion, lead capture setup and post-event follow-up with the SDR team

•    

Build and work from a dated countdown plan per event so nothing lands late

**Day-to-day marketing operations**

•    

Keep campaigns, launches and content moving through the pipeline on schedule

•    

Coordinate with sales and SDRs on handoffs, enablement needs and campaign follow-through

•    

Manage agencies, freelancers and vendors day to day

•    

Keep the HubSpot specialist pointed at the right work, and make sure campaigns are set up correctly before they go live

**Required Qualifications**

**Must have**

•    
**4 to 8 years**

in
**B2B marketing**

, with real product marketing experience, ideally in SaaS, enterprise software, AI or deep tech

•    

Experience managing people or managing delivery across a small team, including briefing and reviewing creative and content work

•    

Demonstrated product marketing output you can show and defend:
**messaging**

,
**positioning, sales collateral, launch material**

•    

Strong written English for a senior business audience

•    

Hands-on
**event execution experience**

, including at least a few events owned end to end

•    

Operational discipline: you work from timelines and checklists, you chase without being chased, and things do not fall through

•    

Based in and living in Delhi NCR, and comfortable working remotely with a UAE-based team across time zones

**Good to have**

•    

Exposure to AI, ML or agentic AI knowledge, or experience marketing to CIO/CTO-level buyers

•    

Working knowledge of HubSpot and marketing funnel mechanics, enough to direct a specialist

•    

Experience with Middle East or GCC enterprise and government markets

•    

Agency or vendor management experience

•    

An engineering, computer science or technical degree, or equivalent technical grounding

**First 90 days**

•    
**Month 1:**

Fluent in MagOneAI, our buyers and our positioning. You have taken over the marketing calendar and the team's day-to-day priorities.

•    
**Month 2:**

First product marketing asset shipped under your name. One event or campaign running end to end on your plan, with no slippage.

•    
**Month 3:**

The Head of Marketing no longer tracks delivery day to day, because you do. Sales is pulling your collateral into live deals.

**Why this role**

•    

Direct line to the Head of Marketing, with genuine ownership of how the function runs

•    

Enterprise AI is where the market is moving, and this is a production platform selling to real enterprise and government buyers

•    

Exposure to UAE, GCC and international markets, and to global events

•    

A small team where your work is visible and measured, not buried in process

**Contact Information**

**Magure Tech India Pvt Ltd**

careers@magureinc.com

title: AVP  - Digital Brand Marketing
description:
Job Purpose:

DMI Finance is looking for a dynamic, digitally savvy and results-driven professional to lead its social and digital marketing initiatives. The role will focus on strengthening the brand's digital presence, improving organic discoverability, enhancing customer engagement and optimising digital experiences across the website, mobile app, search engines and social media platforms.

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of
**SEO, Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO), website CMS management, social media marketing, Google Business Profile (GMB), app UI/UX optimisation and performance marketing**
.

The individual will be responsible for driving a consistent and impactful digital presence for DMI Finance, ensuring that digital platforms are customer-friendly, discoverable, engaging and aligned with business objectives.

The role requires a combination of strategic thinking, hands-on execution, analytical capabilities, creative understanding and strong collaboration with internal teams and external agency partners.

Principal Accountabilities:

Social Media Strategy & Management

* Lead DMI Finance's organic social media strategy across platforms such as LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and other relevant channels.
* Develop and manage the monthly social media content calendar aligned with brand priorities, product communication, financial awareness initiatives and business objectives.
* Drive engaging, relevant and platform-specific content to strengthen brand awareness, credibility, engagement and community growth.
* Work with creative, content and agency partners to develop impactful campaigns, videos, reels, static posts and other digital assets.
* Identify opportunities around emerging social media trends, content formats and platform innovations.
* Monitor social media performance, audience behaviour, engagement trends and competitive activity.
* Collaborate with customer service and relevant stakeholders for timely escalation and resolution of customer queries or complaints received through social platforms.
* Ensure all social communication follows brand guidelines, internal approval processes and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Track reach, engagement, follower growth, video views, share of voice and other relevant metrics.

**Search Engine Optimisation (SEO) & Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO)**

* Develop and execute SEO strategies to improve DMI Finance's organic search visibility, keyword rankings, website traffic and relevant customer acquisition.
* Drive on-page, off-page and technical SEO initiatives, including keyword optimisation, metadata, internal linking, structured data, content optimisation and website health.
* Lead GEO initiatives to improve brand visibility and discoverability across AI-powered search and answer platforms, including Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini and other emerging platforms.
* Work towards improving the accuracy, authority and visibility of DMI Finance's products, services and brand information across search and AI-generated responses.
* Identify content opportunities based on customer search behaviour, emerging search trends and relevant financial services keywords.
* Collaborate with content, technology and agency partners to implement SEO/GEO recommendations.
* Monitor performance through Google Search Console, GA4, SEMrush, Ahrefs and other relevant tools.
* Track organic traffic, non-branded search visibility, qualified leads, conversions and AI-search visibility.

Website Management & CMS Operations

* Own the day-to-day management, maintenance and content updates of the DMI Finance website through the Content Management System (CMS - WordPress).
* Ensure timely updates to product pages, landing pages, banners, blogs, FAQs, campaigns and other website content.
* Work closely with business, product, compliance and technology teams to ensure website content is accurate, updated and aligned with brand and regulatory requirements.
* Continuously improve website navigation, content structure, user experience and conversion journeys.
* Coordinate with technology teams and development partners for website enhancements, bug fixes, integrations and new feature requirements.
* Ensure website responsiveness, mobile optimisation, accessibility, page speed and overall user experience.
* Implement tracking, analytics and conversion optimisation initiatives across key website journeys.
* Maintain website content governance, approval workflows and publishing hygiene.
* Coordinate with IT & Infosec team for back-end updates.

**Digital Marketing: Google Business Profile (GMB) & Online Reputation Management**

* Manage and optimise DMI Finance's Google Business Profile.
* Ensure accuracy and consistency of business information, addresses, contact details, operating hours and other relevant information.
* Drive local SEO initiatives to improve visibility across Google Search and Google Maps.
* Coordinate the management of Google reviews, ratings, customer feedback and business responses with relevant internal teams.
* Monitor online brand mentions, review trends and digital reputation across relevant platforms.
* Work towards improving brand credibility, trust and accuracy of publicly available business information.

**Performance Marketing**

* Support planning of digital campaigns across Google, Meta, and other relevant platforms.
* Work with the Growth & business teams and agencies to optimize campaigns for traffic, leads, conversions, and cost efficiency.
* Help improve landing page journeys and campaign messaging for better conversion.

**Influencer and Partnership Marketing**

* Identify relevant creators, fintech voices, and business influencers where required.
* Support influencer outreach, campaign coordination, and content approvals.
* Track outcomes and brand relevance of such collaborations.

Digital Analytics, Reporting & Optimisation

* Own digital marketing dashboards and periodic performance reporting across website, SEO/GEO, social media, Google Business Profiles and app-related marketing initiatives.
* Use GA4, Google Search Console, Looker Studio, social media analytics and other relevant platforms to monitor performance.
* Analyse customer behaviour, traffic sources, engagement, conversion funnels and content effectiveness.
* Translate data into actionable recommendations to improve digital visibility, engagement and customer experience.
* Track competitor activity, digital marketing innovations and emerging BFSI trends.
* Present monthly and quarterly digital performance reports, insights and recommendations to marketing leadership.

Agency Management & Cross-functional Collaboration

* Manage and coordinate with SEO, social media, creative, digital and website development agencies.
* Set clear deliverables, timelines, quality standards and performance expectations for agency partners.
* Work closely with Product, Technology, Business, Customer Service, Compliance and Legal teams.
* Ensure timely execution of digital initiatives and marketing campaigns.
* Maintain brand consistency and ensure adherence to internal policies, applicable RBI requirements, customer data privacy standards and advertising guidelines.

Manage multiple projects simultaneously while ensuring quality, accuracy and timely delivery

Challenges:

* Strong ownership and execution mindset.
* Strategic thinking with attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong project management and stakeholder management abilities.
* Analytical and data-driven decision-making.
* Customer-first approach to digital experiences.
* Ability to manage agencies and work effectively across functions.

Curiosity and willingness to adopt emerging digital marketing technologies, including AI-led tools and platforms.

Decisions:

* Which marketing priorities need immediate focus based on business goals and timelines.
* Decide the content and campaign calendar across social, digital, website, and performance marketing.
* How to allocate budgets across channels, agencies, campaigns, and events for better impact.
* Which campaigns, creatives, and messages are likely to work best for different audiences.
* What changes need to be made on the website and CMS to improve user journey, relevance, and conversion.
* Which SEO, performance, and content opportunities should be prioritised.
* Which influencers, partners, or event opportunities are relevant for the brand.
* How to brief agencies and what quality standards should be accepted before anything goes live.
* How to balance speed, quality, and cost while working with external partners.

Decide what data, reports, and insights should be highlighted to internal stakeholders.

***Qualifications***

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Mass Communication, Advertising, Digital Media, Business Administration, Commerce, Information Technology or a related field.

**Preferred**

* Relevant certifications in Google Analytics (GA4), Google Ads, SEO, digital marketing, social media marketing or UX/UI fundamentals.

**Additional Advantage**

* Certifications or practical training in technical SEO, GEO / AI-search optimisation, Google Tag Manager, web analytics or conversion rate optimisation.
* Familiarity with financial services marketing and digital customer acquisition.

***Work Experience***

* **8–12 years of overall experience**
  in digital marketing, with significant exposure to SEO, website management, social media and digital analytics.
* **Minimum 4–5 years of relevant BFSI experience,**
  preferably in NBFCs, fintech companies, digital lending platforms, banks or other financial services organisations.
* Proven experience in managing brand websites, CMS platforms and organic digital growth initiatives.
* Hands-on experience working with SEO tools, analytics platforms and social media management tools.
* Experience coordinating with product and technology teams on website or mobile app customer experience improvements.
* Demonstrated ability to manage external agencies and multiple digital marketing workstreams.
* Exposure to performance marketing and online reputation management.
* Experience with AI-powered search optimisation, app store optimisation and digital conversion improvement will be an added advantage.

Good communication skills.

Tintessa is a skin-first clean makeup brand: vegan, cruelty-free, non-comedogenic and made for skin that actually wants to breathe. We're a tiny team with a very not-tiny dream: becoming India's favourite makeup brand.

We're looking for an
**Influencer Marketing Executive**
to be our creator whisperer. You'll need about 1 year of experience in influencer marketing, creator partnerships or social. You'll own creator collaborations from the first DM to the final post.

**What your month will look like:**

* **Scout:**
  Dig through social media for creators who feel real, not rehearsed
* **Slide into DM:**
  Pitch Tintessa, sort out deliverables and money, and lock in collabs that work for both sides
* **Build the squad:**
  Keep timelines and posting dates on track and log it all on a tracker
* **Brief, don't script:**
  Send references, a hook or a talking point, then let creators do their thing. Our rule: their best video, not our script
* **Show up on shoot days:**
  Help out when we shoot content for Tintessa's Instagram and socials
* **Live the startup life:**
  Wear a few hats and jump in whenever the team needs a hand

**You're our person if:**

* You follow more beauty creators than friends and can tell in five seconds if a review is genuine or just paid-for vibes
* You spot trends before they're trends
* You can talk money with a creator so both of you walk away happy
* You're a spreadsheet legend even when things get chaotic
* You're comfy on camera, with or without a full face
* You take ownership instead of waiting to be told

**How to apply**
(read this carefully):

No forms, no portals. We only take applications by email at
**tanisha@tintessa.com.**
If you apply anywhere else, we won't see it.

Send us:

* About 200 words about you. Tell us your story: who you are, why Tintessa and how you'd find and work with creators for us. Show us links to campaigns, creators you've worked with and numbers you're proud of.
* Your CV, attached to the same email.

Subject line: Influencer Marketing Executive - [Your Name]

One rule: no AI. We want your voice, your story and your opinions. AI doesn't have a story but you do. Trust us, we can tell and AI-written applications go straight to the skip pile.

Good luck! <3

title: Performance Marketing Executive
description:
**Role: Performance Marketing Executive**
**Company:**
Fairdeal
  
  
**Location:**
Gurugram
  
  
Experience: 1-2 Years
  
  
**About Fairdeal**
Fairdeal is building India's largest B2B quick commerce platform, enabling neighbourhood retailers to source products at the best market rates, delivered within 60 minutes.
  
  
We're on a mission to transform how millions of retailers source inventory, ensuring they never lose a sale because of a stockout.
  
  
**About The Role**
We're looking for a
**Performance Marketing Executive**
who can turn digital campaigns into transacting retailers.
  
  
Your mission is simple:
**Acquire more retailers, convert them into active customers, and continuously reduce Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC).**
You'll own the digital acquisition journey, from app installs and Click-to-WhatsApp (CTWA) campaigns to automated lead nurturing and first-order conversion.
  
  
This isn't just about running ads. It's about building a scalable, efficient acquisition engine across every live Fairdeal Express Store.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Digital Acquisition & Performance Marketing
* Plan, execute, and optimize performance marketing campaigns across Meta, Google, and other relevant digital channels.
* Drive high-intent app installs and qualified retailer leads within Fairdeal's serviceable markets.
* Execute hyperlocal, geo-targeted campaigns aligned with individual Express Store catchments.
* Continuously experiment with audiences, creatives, messaging, and campaign formats to improve acquisition efficiency.
* Allocate and optimize marketing budgets based on activation performance and CAC.
* WhatsApp Marketing & Chatbot Automation
* Independently set up, execute, and optimize Click-to-WhatsApp (CTWA) campaigns.
* Build, deploy, and manage WhatsApp chatbots for retailer qualification, onboarding, app downloads, and conversion.
* Design automated conversational journeys to nurture leads and drive first orders.
* Set up retargeting and follow-up workflows for retailers who haven't completed registration or activation.
* Monitor chatbot engagement, lead quality, drop-offs, and conversion rates to improve effectiveness.
* Retailer Activation & CAC Optimization
* Own the complete digital acquisition funnel, from first interaction to first successful order.
* Build nurturing journeys through WhatsApp, push notifications, and relevant content.
* Identify funnel drop-offs and work with Product, Tech, and CRM teams to improve conversion.
* Continuously improve install-to-first-order and lead-to-first-order conversion rates.
* Optimize campaign spending to reduce CAC while increasing the number of digitally acquired, activated retailers.
* Develop retargeting strategies to convert unactivated retailers into first-time transacting customers.
* Express Store-Level Growth
* Drive digital customer acquisition across all live Fairdeal Express Stores.
* Identify underpenetrated markets and launch hyperlocal acquisition campaigns.
* Track retailer activations and CAC at the individual Express Store level.
* Collaborate with Sales and Operations teams to maximize retailer activation in serviceable markets.
* Scale successful acquisition strategies across existing and newly launched Express Stores.
* Analytics & Experimentation
* Track the complete acquisition funnel: Impressions → Clicks → Leads/Installs → Registrations → First Orders.
* Monitor campaign performance, acquisition costs, conversion rates, and attribution.
* Run structured A/B tests across audiences, creatives, chatbot flows, and nurturing journeys.
* Build weekly performance reports with actionable insights to improve acquisition efficiency.
* Identify opportunities to increase conversions without proportionately increasing marketing expenditure.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
**KPI**
**Weightage**
**Digitally Acquired Retailer Activations**
**50%**
**Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) Optimization**
**50%**
**Total**
**100%**

* Digitally Acquired Retailer Activations (50%)

Increase the number of digitally acquired retailers completing their first successful order across all live Fairdeal Express Stores.
  
  

* Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) Optimization (50%)

Acquire activated retailers within defined CAC targets while continuously reducing acquisition costs and improving marketing efficiency.
  
  
**What We're Looking For**

* 1–3 years of hands-on experience in performance marketing, growth marketing, or digital customer acquisition.
* Proven experience executing and scaling Click-to-WhatsApp (CTWA) campaigns.
* Hands-on experience building, deploying, and optimizing WhatsApp chatbots and automated conversation flows.
* Strong working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads.
* Experience with WhatsApp Business API and chatbot platforms such as Interakt, WATI, AiSensy, Gallabox, or similar tools.
* Understanding of app install campaigns, conversion tracking, campaign attribution, remarketing, and CAC optimization.
* Familiarity with GA4, Firebase, AppsFlyer, or similar analytics platforms.
* Strong analytical mindset with an obsession for experimentation, efficiency, and measurable outcomes.
* Ability to independently manage campaigns, troubleshoot performance issues, and deliver measurable business results.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with aggressive growth targets.

**Preferred:**
Experience in quick commerce, e-commerce, hyperlocal marketplaces, or app-based customer acquisition.
  
  
**What Success Looks Like**
You won't be measured by how many people see our ads or even how many download our app.
  
  
**You'll be measured by how many retailers become transacting customers and how efficiently you acquire them across our Express Stores.**
**At Fairdeal, Performance Marketing Isn't About Spending More.**
**It's about acquiring more customers with every rupee spent.**

title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
**About SuperProfile**

SuperProfile (built by Cosmofeed Technologies) is a creator commerce platform. From one link, creators, coaches and educators sell courses, digital products, webinars, 1:1 sessions and paid Telegram/Discord.communities, and automate their Instagram and Messenger DMs so a viral post turns into sales. It's link-in-bio, DM automation and a creator store in one profile and one checkout. We were built first for India's long-tail creators and now serve creators globally.

* 2M+ creators use SuperProfile worldwide
* Meta-verified Tech Provider
* Creators can now run their SuperProfile store from Claude, ChatGPT and other AI assistants through the SuperProfile MCP. In its first four weeks: 5,800+ creators and 640,000+ API calls
* Backed by growX ventures, Waveform Ventures and 9 Unicorns (about US$2.3M raised)

**The role**

We ship fast: scheduling, AI comment replies, moderation, Brand Collab, Messenger Auto-DM and the SuperProfile MCP have all launched recently. Shipping isn't the hard part. The hard part is getting the right creator to find the right feature at the right moment. You'll own product marketing end to end: how we position SuperProfile and each feature, how we launch, and every message a creator gets from us across every channel, from signup to their first sale and beyond. You'll work closely with the Head of Product & Design, the product managers and the growth team.

**What you'll own**

* Positioning and messaging: who each product and feature is for, the problem it solves, and why SuperProfile beats the alternatives (Linktree, ManyChat, Stan and others). Keep one source of truth the whole company uses
* Launches, end to end: the story, the launch plan, the landing page, in-app moments, email, WhatsApp, social, creator demos, the changelog, and a post-launch readout on adoption
* Feature discovery on the platform: onboarding, empty states, in-app nudges, tooltips and upsell moments, so creators find what they need without hunting for it. Work with product and design to build them
* All channel communications: email, WhatsApp, push, in-app and SMS. Own the calendar, the tone and the frequency
* User journeys and lifecycle campaigns: onboarding, activation, first sale, free-to-paid, retention, win-back. Built by segment (coaches, educators, community builders, Instagram creators; India and global)
* How we talk about features outside the product: website and product pages, comparison pages, release notes, tutorials, case studies and creator stories
* Insight: talk to creators, run win/loss and churn conversations, track competitors, and bring what you learn back to product
* Measurement: run A/B tests on messaging and journeys, and judge your work on activation, adoption, conversion and retention, not opens and impressions

**What we're looking for (must-haves)**

* 3–5 years in product marketing, lifecycle/CRM marketing or growth at a B2C, SaaS or product-led startup
* You've owned launches end to end, from positioning to channel plan to adoption numbers
* Hands-on with lifecycle and CRM tools (MoEngage, CleverTap, WebEngage, Customer.io, HubSpot or similar), including WhatsApp and email automation
* Sharp writing: clear, specific copy that sounds human, for in-app, email, WhatsApp, web and social
* Comfortable with data: funnels and cohorts in Mixpanel, Amplitude, PostHog or GA4; basic SQL or strong spreadsheets
* You understand the product deeply enough to explain it simply, and to argue with a PM about it
* High ownership and comfort with startup pace: you run the whole thing without a big team behind you

**Nice to have**

* Experience marketing to creators, coaches, SMBs or small sellers, in India, globally, or both
* Experience with Instagram-led or creator-led marketing, community programs or ambassador programs
* Uses AI tools daily to research, write, build pages and assets, and analyse data faster
* Can make simple product videos, demos or designs yourself (Figma, Canva, screen recordings)
* Has worked on pricing, packaging or free-to-paid conversion
* Comfortable writing in Hinglish or regional languages for Bharat audiences

**Why join**

* You own the full product-to-creator story, not one channel or one campaign
* A steady flow of real launches to work with, including AI features that change how creators run their business
* Direct line to product: you help shape what gets built and how it shows up, not just how it's
* announced
* Your work reaches creators across India and around the world, and the audiences who buy from them
* A small team where good ideas ship fast

title: Product Marketing Manager – Revenue & Growth
description:
**Role :Product Marketing Manager – Revenue & Growth**
**Company:**
Fairdeal
  
  
**Location:**
Gurugram
  
  
**Experience:**
5–7 Years
  
  
**Preferred Background:**
Quick Commerce, E-commerce, Consumer Internet, Marketplace or Product-led Growth
  
  
**Own the number. Find the gaps. Run the experiments. Unlock the revenue.**
At Fairdeal, we're building a 60-minute B2B commerce platform for neighbourhood retailers. We're reimagining how millions of retailers discover, purchase, and replenish products while helping brands unlock an entirely new distribution and revenue channel.
  
  
We're looking for a
**Product Marketing Manager who is obsessed with revenue.**
Not someone who simply runs campaigns, launches features, or tracks dashboards.
  
  
We want someone who looks at every stage of the customer journey and sees opportunities to grow. Someone who questions why a retailer isn't ordering, why a brand isn't penetrating deeper, why purchase frequency isn't higher, and what it will take to change that.
  
  
Someone who doesn't just identify problems but relentlessly experiments until they find solutions.
  
  
**This isn't a campaign management role. It's a growth ownership role.**
**What You'll Own**

* Revenue Growth & Retailer Consumption
* Own initiatives that drive revenue per retailer, order frequency, average order value, and repeat consumption.
* Identify opportunities to increase wallet share across existing retailers.
* Build strategies to move retailers from purchasing a handful of products to buying across multiple brands and categories.
* Identify high-potential retailer cohorts and unlock incremental revenue through targeted interventions.
* Work closely with Category, Sales, Product, and Operations teams to turn growth opportunities into measurable business outcomes.
* Funnel Obsession & Conversion Optimisation
* Own the customer journey across activation, discovery, add-to-cart, checkout, purchase, and retention.
* Identify friction points, conversion drop-offs, and missed revenue opportunities across the funnel.
* Deep-dive into customer cohorts, behavioural data, and transaction patterns to understand why retailers behave the way they do.
* Design and execute continuous experiments to improve conversion and repeat purchase.
* Build a culture of testing, learning, iterating, and scaling what works.

**We want someone who sees a funnel leak and cannot rest until it's fixed.**

* New Brand Adoption & Revenue Creation
* Make Fairdeal a meaningful revenue channel for new-to-retail and emerging FMCG brands.
* Own the journey from brand discovery to first purchase, repeat purchase, and sustained consumption.
* Identify the right retailer cohorts for every new brand and design interventions that accelerate adoption.
* Experiment with product placements, discovery mechanisms, offers, sampling, and retailer engagement.
* Build repeatable growth playbooks that help emerging brands scale across Fairdeal's retailer network.

**A brand going live isn't success. A brand generating sustainable revenue is.**

* Established Brand Penetration & Growth
* Work towards achieving maximum penetration of established FMCG brands across relevant retailers.
* Identify why retailers aren't purchasing particular brands, SKUs, or categories.
* Build interventions that increase brand visibility, retailer adoption, purchase frequency, and consumption.
* Identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities using retailer purchase behaviour.
* Partner with Category teams to unlock incremental revenue from existing brand relationships.

**If a brand is reaching 30% of its potential retailer base, your question should be: Why not 100%?**

* Product-led Growth & Experimentation
* Collaborate with Product and Technology teams to identify and implement growth-driving product interventions.
* Improve product discovery, recommendations, merchandising, search, cart conversion, and reorder experiences.
* Develop hypotheses, prioritise experiments, measure outcomes, and scale successful interventions.
* Use push notifications, WhatsApp, in-app communication, and other CRM channels to influence retailer behaviour.
* Partner with communication and creative specialists to develop effective messaging while owning audience selection, targeting, timing, experimentation, and business impact.
* Continuously challenge existing customer journeys and identify opportunities to make the product work harder for revenue.

**What Success Looks Like**
Your performance will be measured by business outcomes, not marketing activities.
  
  
**Core KPIs**

* Incremental Revenue: Measurable revenue growth attributable to your initiatives.
* Conversion: Improvement across activation, product discovery, cart, and checkout funnels.
* Retailer Purchase Frequency: Increase in orders per active retailer.
* Brand Penetration: Growth in the percentage of relevant retailers purchasing targeted brands.
* New Brand Adoption: First purchase, repeat purchase, and sustained revenue for emerging brands.
* Category Expansion: Increase in the number of categories and brands purchased per retailer.
* Retention & Reactivation: Improvement in repeat purchase and recovery of dormant retailers.

**Who We're Looking For**

* 5–7 years of experience in Growth Marketing, Product Growth, Lifecycle Marketing, Product Marketing, or Revenue Growth.
* Experience in quick commerce, e-commerce, marketplaces, consumer internet, or other high-frequency transaction businesses.
* Should have worked on tools such as Clevertap, Webengage, Moengage, or similar ones.
* Strong analytical thinking with the ability to independently identify opportunities from data.
* Hands-on experience with funnels, cohorts, retention, experimentation, and conversion optimization.
* Ability to translate business problems into hypotheses, experiments, and measurable outcomes.
* Comfort working with analytics tools, dashboards, spreadsheets, and ideally SQL.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, especially with Product, Technology, Category, and Sales teams.
* Demonstrated experience influencing revenue, conversion, retention, or purchase frequency through growth initiatives.

**Most importantly, you should be able to show us what business metric you personally moved, how you moved it, and what you learned along the way.**
**The Mindset That Matters**
**We're Looking For Someone Who**

* Thinks revenue first. Every initiative should ultimately connect to a measurable business outcome.
* Sees opportunities everywhere. Every drop-off, inactive retailer, underpenetrated brand, and abandoned cart is an opportunity.
* Experiments relentlessly. If the first experiment fails, you're already thinking about the next ten.
* Takes extreme ownership. You don't wait for someone to tell you what needs fixing.
* Is deeply curious. You want to understand why customers behave the way they do.
* Is resourceful. You know how to get things done by bringing the right people together.
* Is uncomfortable with the status quo. Hitting a target doesn't stop you from looking for the next growth curve.

**Why Fairdeal?**
We're building one of India's most ambitious B2B quick commerce platforms, connecting neighbourhood retailers with the brands and products they need through a 60-minute delivery promise.
  
  
You'll work at the intersection of product, commerce, retailer behaviour, and brand growth.
  
  
You'll have the opportunity to influence how thousands of retailers purchase products, how emerging brands build distribution, and how established FMCG brands unlock deeper market penetration.
  
  
Most importantly,
**you'll have the opportunity to build growth engines, not just execute marketing calendars.**
**One Last Thing**
We're not looking for someone who has run 100 campaigns.
  
  
**We're looking for someone who is willing to run 100 experiments to solve one important business problem.**
Someone who doesn't count problems but finds them, owns them, and solves them.
  
  
**If you believe product marketing should be a revenue function, we'd love to meet you.**

title: Manager, Product Management – Resiliency Operations (Stand-In & On-Demand Decisioning)
description:

Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

Manager, Product Management – Resiliency Operations (Stand-In & On-Demand Decisioning)
  
  
Manager, Product Management – Resiliency Operations (Stand-In & On-Demand Decisioning)
  
  
Issuers face a myriad of authorization risks that come in many forms. Crisis events, such as cyberattacks or natural disasters, complex payment rails and systems, and evolving regulatory demands, like DORA all create disruption to the payment experience. The Mastercard Payment Resiliency team manages a suite of solutions to mitigate these risks. It is critical to ensure a frictionless cardholder experience and uphold the integrity of the Mastercard brand by providing on-behalf authorization decisioning, at any time, for any reason.
  
  
As Manager, Product Management - Resiliency Operations, you will help deliver on our strategy of offering industry leading authorization solutions, promoting Stand-In and On-Demand Decisioning as critical Payment Resiliency solutions. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to aid in the creation and enhancement of resiliency products, drive utilization through customer education, and ultimately support the improvement of customer performance and profitability.
  
  
We’re seeking a collaborative and results-oriented product professional who thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. You are passionate about the cardholder experience, driving issuer change, and delivering impactful solutions. The role requires a highly analytical thinker who can connect data, market dynamics, customer needs, and business priorities to influence decisions and outcomes. As a natural leader and team player, you excel in building relationships and driving strategic outcomes with energy, creativity, and accountability.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Function as a Payment Resiliency Solutions SME in AP
* Work closely with regional sales and account management teams to support the growth of Stand-In and On-Demand Decisioning
* Partner with Advisors Consulting Services to drive Stand-In performance improvement and to define On-Demand Decisioning use case opportunities as part of ACS auth engagements
* Collaborate closely with local Customer Success and Service Business Leads by providing SME guidance and recommendations in support of their efforts
* Craft and present clear and compelling business cases to stakeholders to secure buy-in for product utilization
* Transform complex data into compelling insights, shape business narratives, and identify opportunities to create value across a diverse set of stakeholders
* Work with different teams to support Resiliency offerings because of direct customer feedback
* Identify issues, risks, and dependencies to track product development
* Conduct market research to identify industry trends and competitive analysis

**All About You**

* Ability to work in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment. Works to establish priorities and clear milestones and works with urgency to drive the delivery of tangible outcomes.
* A problem-solver mindset with a focus on delivering value to the business and end-users. Experience working directly with partners and customers.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Demonstrated success in both building relationships and working independently.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to structure tasks efficiently while managing multiple projects simultaneously.
* A natural self-starter – analyzing complex issues, identifying opportunities, and developing actionable plans.
* Familiarity with authorization decisioning and related concepts

**Background & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred.
* At least 7+ years of experience in business analytics, strategy, product management, consulting, payments, financial services, or a related field.
* Experience with value realization and performance optimization programs is a plus

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Brand Manager
description:
About Burger Brewery

Burger Brewery was born with a simple belief:
**burgers deserve beer.**
And every pin code in India deserves an original burger-and-beer spot to call its own.

Great burgers, craft beers on tap, good music, and everything that brings people back. We're building a hospitality driven consumer brand in the midst of a market crowded with QSRs.

**DoTogether**
is our brand's slogan and the operating philosophy we live by. Because we believe success, much like a great burger and a perfectly poured craft beer, are better when shared.

We bring that same belief to how we build our business.

**That's what DoTogether means to us.**

We're looking for a Brand Manager who can help us turn that philosophy into a brand people love, talk about, and want to be part of.

What You Own

You'll own and obsess about how Burger Brewery looks, sounds, feels, and shows up in culture.

Content and campaigns to community, collaborations, and experiences, you'll help shape the personality of a growing consumer brand.

What You'll Do

* **Own the brand:**
  Shape and evolve Burger Brewery's voice, design, aesthetic, storytelling, and overall creative direction.
* **Create content worth consuming:**
  Lead social media, content strategy, creative production, and campaigns that make people stop scrolling.
* **Build culture and community:**
  Bring DoTogether to life through people, partnerships, events, collaborations, and experiences.
* **Make our products the heroes:**
  Find interesting, unexpected, and compelling ways to tell the stories behind our burgers, beers, and everything in between.
* **Connect online and offline:**
  Make the brand feel as exciting on Instagram (and other platforms) as it does inside our restaurants.
* **Drive brand growth:**
  Build awareness, engagement, affinity, and ultimately give more people a reason to walk through our doors.
* **Collaborate and execute:**
  Work closely with the founder's office, ops team, creators, designers, and external partners to bring ideas to life.

Who We're Looking For

* A natural storyteller who understands what makes people pay attention.
* Someone with exceptional creative instincts, good taste, and a playful streak.
* A hard core executer.
* Someone who understands consumer culture, especially food, beverages, hospitality, lifestyle, and the way younger audiences discover brands.
* A strong understanding of social media, content, creative direction, and community building.
* Someone who can think big picture while execute the day-to-day independently.

Experience building or working with consumer-facing brands.

**Most importantly, someone who genuinely loves brands, burgers, beers, and bringing people together.**

What You'll Find Here

An opportunity to help shape a young, ambitious consumer business from the inside.

You'll have creative ownership, room to experiment, and the chance to build a brand that lives beyond a screen.

We're serious about what we're building. We also intend to have a lot of fun doing it.

Come Kick It With Us

Apply with your CV, portfolio, or simply something you've created that's worth showing off.

**Burger Brewery. DoTogether.**

title: AVP, Community — Cuemath Tutor Success
description:
**About the role**

Cuemath is a global math learning platform on a mission to make every child MathFit. Thousands of certified coaches teach children across the US, India, the Middle East, APAC and the UK, and the community is growing fast.

This role owns the coach community after certification: the results coaches deliver, the students they retain, the reviews they earn and the families they bring in through referral. It is a business ownership role on the supply side of a marketplace, judged on outcomes, not activity.

If you have run engagement calendars, newsletters and events but have never owned a retention or referral number for a supplier community, this role is not for you. If you have never read a cohort table and decided what to do next from it, this role is not for you.

**What you will own**

* **Referral growth:**
  year-on-year growth in referral leads from the coach community, and the behaviours and programmes that drive it.
* **Student retention:**
  90-day and 180-day student retention by coach cohort, and the interventions behind it.
* **Student allocation:**
  the rules by which new students are released to coaches, including how allocation is earned through proven retention and referral behaviour. You will make this case to Business and Product with data.
* **Class delivery compliance:**
  the consequence framework for non-compliance, recovery programmes for coaches who slip, and repeat-offender handling across the community.
* **Coach quality on the ground:**
  translating the quality measurement system into coach action, so every coach performs to standard in every class.
* **Engagement and communication:**
  town halls with thousands of coaches, WhatsApp and email communication, recognition programmes and coach NPS.
* **A community management system:**
  you will design and run the operating system for a coach community that is scaling several-fold, with the rhythms, segmentation and tooling that make it work without heroics.
* **The team:**
  directors and managers across community operations, plus a field mentor network, report into this role.

**What you bring**

* **10 to 16 years of experience**
  , with at least 4 years owning retention, cohort or LTV/CAC outcomes for a supplier community: teachers, drivers, delivery partners, sellers, hosts, agents or creators. Customer-side success alone does not qualify.
* **A system you built that still runs without you**
  , with a before-and-after result.
* **A team of 20 or more**
  , including field or mentor staff, led for at least two years.
* **Fluency with data without an analyst:**
  you read cohort tables, compare segments, build your own Sheets views, and define baseline, target and measurement for every initiative. You understand unit economics (CAC, LTV, contribution and EBITDA impact) and can tie community programmes to them.
* **Education in your history:**
  you have taught, trained tutors, run a tutor or faculty network, or run a school or centre cluster. You know what a class is and why a parent renews.
* **Excellent communication and presence:**
  you can hold a webinar of a thousand or more coaches and be believed, write crisply, and handle hard conversations with warmth and authority.
* **AI-native working style:**
  you use Claude Code daily for drafting, analysis and planning, and you are curious about what else it can do.

**Backgrounds that tend to fit**

Head or Director of Partner Success, Supply Operations, Partner or Teacher Quality, Educator Community or Faculty Excellence, at marketplaces, ed-tech teacher networks or large coaching and school networks. Title matters less than what you owned.

**How we will select**

1. A 30-minute conversation about the system you built and the result it delivered.
2. A working session on our internal dashboard: diagnose what you see and tell us what you would change first.
3. A short take-home: a one-page diagnosis, a 90-day plan with three metrics and baselines, and how you would shape the existing team to deliver it.
4. A panel with the leadership team.

*Apply with a two-paragraph note: the supplier retention or referral number you owned, and what you did to move it.*

We are looking for an enthusiastic, organized and detail-oriented Travel & Backend Concierge Executive to join our team. The role involves working closely with the travel team to ensure seamless arrangements and personalised experiences for clients travelling domestically and internationally.

Candidates must be willing and prepared to travel domestically and internationally with clients after completing six months of employment.

title: AI Solutions Architect
description:
**ABOUT BLOOM AI**

Bloom AI is an applied AI firm building AI-native intelligence systems and workflows for enterprise teams across research, marketing, sales and other knowledge-intensive functions.

We combine enterprise data, external intelligence, AI and software engineering to help organizations turn information into intelligence and action.

Our approach combines reusable AI capabilities with hands-on solution development in real enterprise environments. We work closely with business teams to rethink workflows, design intelligent systems and deploy solutions that deliver measurable outcomes.

Bloom AI is based in the U.S. and India (Delhi/NCR).

**THE ROLE**

We are looking for a
**hands-on AI Solutions Architect**
who can design, build and deploy enterprise-grade AI applications and agentic systems.

This role sits at the intersection of
**AI architecture, data engineering and software development**
.

You may come from a backend engineering, data engineering or data science background, but you should have evolved into building end-to-end AI solutions.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have worked on
**multiple AI/LLM projects**
, solved different types of problems and gained practical experience making architectural decisions across agent orchestration, data, context management, application development and deployment.

You should be equally comfortable designing a solution architecture, evaluating technology choices, writing code, integrating data sources and taking a working solution into production.

This is
**not a traditional software engineering role, a prompt-engineering role or a PowerPoint-only architecture role**
. We need someone who understands how AI systems work end-to-end and can personally build what they design.

You will work across client engagements, reusable Bloom AI capabilities and internal technology development, taking ownership of solutions from architecture through production deployment.

You will be part of the core team, reporting directly to the CEO.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

Leading a small team, you will:

**Architect Bloom AI Capabilities and Client Solutions**

* Design end-to-end AI solutions combining LLMs, agents, enterprise data, APIs and applications.
* Mak architectural decisions around agent orchestration, context, memory, workflows and technology choices.
* Build modular, reusable solutions that work across different cloud and enterprise environments.

**Build agentic applications**

* Develop multi-agent systems, agentic workflows and LLM-powered applications using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain or similar.
* Implement tool calling, RAG, semantic search, agent memory and state management.
* Build evaluation, monitoring and reliability mechanisms for production AI systems.

**Engineer data and context systems**

* Integrate structured and unstructured enterprise data into AI applications.
* Design retrieval and context architectures using relational, vector and graph databases.
* Build knowledge retrieval, entity relationships and persistent context capabilities.

**Develop and deploy end to end systems**

* Build backend services and APIs using Python, FastAPI or similar technologies.
* Develop functional frontend applications and integrate with enterprise systems.
* Deploy secure, scalable applications across cloud platforms using modern engineering practices.

**Solve enterprise client problems**

* Translate business challenges into practical AI architectures and working solutions.
* Work across multiple client projects, from solution design and prototyping through deployment.
* Evaluate technical approaches, collaborate with stakeholders and develop reusable capabilities for Bloom AI.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* **4–7 years of professional experience**
  , with a foundation in
  **backend engineering, data engineering, data science or related technical disciplines**
  .
* **Hands-on experience across multiple AI/LLM application projects**
  , preferably involving different use cases, data environments or architectural approaches.
* Demonstrated ability to take ownership of solution architecture and technical implementation, rather than contributing to only one component of a system.
* Strong proficiency in
  **Python**
  , with solid software engineering and API development skills.
* Practical experience building
  **agentic applications or multi-agent systems**
  , beyond basic chatbots and prompt-based applications.
* Experience with agent orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen or similar.
* Strong understanding of LLM APIs, tool calling, RAG, embeddings, vector databases and context management.
* Strong understanding of data modeling, SQL, databases, data integration and retrieval architectures.
* Working knowledge of full-stack application development, including modern frontend frameworks such as React or Next.js.
* Familiarity with graph data structures, entity relationships and graph-based retrieval concepts.
* Experience taking AI applications from prototype through testing, integration and production deployment.
* Experience with at least one major cloud platform and familiarity with Docker, Git, CI/CD and modern engineering practices.
* Ability to evaluate different technical approaches and make sound architectural trade-offs.
* Strong independent problem-solving skills, curiosity and comfort working with ambiguous requirements.
* Lead R&D efforts for Bloom AI

**Above all, we are looking for someone who has built several AI solutions, understands the architectural decisions behind them and can independently design and implement new ones.**

**GOOD TO HAVE**

* Startup or
  **0-to-1 product development experience**
  .
* Experience working on enterprise AI projects across different business functions or client environments.
* Experience integrating with
  **marketing, sales or commercial systems**
  , such as CRM, marketing automation, campaign platforms, content management systems or sales enablement tools.
* Experience working directly with enterprise clients and translating business requirements into technical solutions.
* Experience building AI applications for financial services, research or other knowledge-intensive domains.

title: Principal Engineer
description:
**About the Role**

We are hiring a Technical Architect to design and scale a mission-critical, ultra-low latency stock broking platform built for massive scale and peak market volatility. The role calls for deep capital markets expertise and the ability to architect high-throughput, deterministic real-time systems in regulated environments.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Architecture & Platform Ownership**

* Own the end-to-end architecture of a high-performance trading platform.
* Design systems for ultra-low latency, high transactions per second (TPS) and predictable performance.
* Architect scalable, fault-tolerant distributed systems with zero-downtime principles.
* Drive active-active, multi-region architecture strategy and disaster recovery readiness.

**Performance, Reliability & Engineering Excellence**

* Lead performance benchmarking, tuning and capacity planning.
* Establish architectural governance and engineering best practices.
* Lead architecture reviews and contribute to large-scale architecture revamps.
* Mentor senior engineers and provide technical direction across teams.

**Capital Markets & Broking Domain**

* Bring a strong understanding of the complete order lifecycle in broking, including validation, risk checks, routing, exchange acknowledgement, trade confirmation and settlement.
* Design ultra-low latency trade routing, deterministic execution flows, order state management, reconciliation and audit trails.
* Understand market feed ingestion, including tick-by-tick data, LTP and market depth, along with high-throughput feed processing, normalization and real-time charting data pipelines.
* Architect real-time portfolio tracking, position management, MTM and P&L computation, pre- and post-trade risk validation, margin and exposure management.
* Design data movement and event propagation across OMS, RMS, portfolio, reporting and notification services, with appropriate consistency and inter-service communication patterns.

**Security, Compliance & Governance**

* Work with an understanding of broking technology compliance requirements.
* Ensure appropriate data encryption in transit and at rest, and secure key management practices.
* Define data retention, archival and backup strategies.
* Build disaster recovery and audit-readiness considerations into platform architecture.

**Cloud, Infrastructure & Technology**

* Design services hosted on AWS and/or GCP, including multi-AZ and multi-region deployment architectures.
* Drive active-active setup, high-throughput regional design and disaster recovery architecture, including RTO/RPO planning.
* Apply strong fundamentals in concurrency, distributed systems and networking.
* Build event-driven systems using Kafka, with asynchronous processing and high-throughput event pipelines.
* Use gRPC for public APIs and inter-service communication.
* Bring exposure to containerization and orchestration.

**Candidate Requirements**

* 15+ years of experience in backend and distributed systems engineering.
* Mandatory 3–5 years of experience in stock broking, trading platforms or capital markets.
* Proven experience building ultra-low latency, high-scale systems and handling mission-critical platforms with strict SLAs.
* Strong proficiency in both Go and Java.
* Deep understanding of concurrency, distributed systems, networking fundamentals, data consistency models and service decomposition.
* Hands-on experience with gRPC and Kafka, including asynchronous processing and high-throughput event pipelines.
* Experience hosting services on AWS and/or GCP, with exposure to multi-AZ, multi-region, active-active and disaster recovery architectures.
* Strong architectural ownership, technical decision-making and leadership experience.

**What Success Looks Like**

* A scalable, high-performance trading platform that delivers predictable performance during peak market volatility.
* Reliable, fault-tolerant architecture with strong availability, active-active capabilities and disaster recovery readiness.
* Efficient order, market data, portfolio and risk workflows supported by robust distributed-system design.
* Strong architectural governance, engineering practices and technical alignment across teams.
* Secure, compliant and audit-ready technology foundations for a mission-critical broking platform.
