title: Associate Director - Agentic AI Implementation & Process Automation
description:
**About Sirius AI**

Sirius AI is an AI consulting and solutions firm working with financial services clients, including banks, fintechs, payments companies and wealth managers. Our teams design, build and run GenAI, agentic AI and ML solutions inside client environments, working alongside their operations, technology and risk teams.

**About the Role**

We are hiring an Associate Director to lead agentic AI and process automation work for our US financial services clients. The role combines solution architecture and delivery leadership. You will design the solution, stay close to the build, and be accountable for getting it into production and keeping it running there.

Most of our work is in operations-heavy processes such as onboarding, KYC/AML, lending, payments operations, claims and servicing, at large organisations with strict security, audit and model risk requirements. You will lead a team of AI engineers, automation developers and business analysts, several of whom are early in their careers.

This is a hands-on role. We expect you to have built and deployed agentic systems yourself and to be comfortable reviewing code, agent traces and architecture decisions with your team.

**What You Will Do**

* Own the solution architecture for agentic automation engagements: agent design, orchestration, tool and MCP server design, integration with client systems, identity and access, and deployment topology.
* Lead delivery from process discovery through build, testing, go-live and hypercare. Fix the process before automating it, and decide which steps need an agent, which are better handled by rules, APIs or RPA, and which should stay with a person.
* Design multi-agent systems, including how agents delegate and hand off work (for example over A2A), how they reach tools and data (for example through MCP), and how state, memory, retries and failures are handled.
* Build and maintain the harness around each solution: evaluation datasets, regression tests, tracing, guardrails, and cost and latency monitoring, so that changes to prompts, models or tools are tested before they reach production.
* Implement role-based access control for agents and MCP tools. Define what each agent is allowed to call, on whose behalf and with what data scope, and align this with the client’s IAM, secrets management and audit logging.
* Deploy agentic solutions in large enterprise environments, which means working through security reviews, architecture boards, model risk validation, change management and integration with existing platforms.
* Set accuracy expectations with clients early. Agree what acceptable performance looks like for each use case, how errors and hallucinations will be measured, and where human review will stay in place, then report against those numbers openly throughout the engagement.
* Design solutions to be modular and reusable. Build up a shared library of agent templates, MCP servers for common FS systems, evaluation datasets and deployment patterns that shorten delivery on the next engagement.
* Lead and coach the delivery team, run design and code reviews, and help junior engineers build practical skills in agentic development.
* Act as the senior technical lead with client stakeholders and support pre-sales with solution design, estimates and staffing plans.

**What You Need**

* 8+ years in software engineering, automation or AI delivery, including at least 2 years building and running LLM-based agentic solutions.
* Hands-on delivery of at least two agentic process automation solutions that went into production at an enterprise client. You should be able to walk us through the architecture, what went wrong and how you measured results.
* A strong engineering background. You should be comfortable writing Python, reviewing pull requests and debugging agent behaviour from traces and logs.
* Working experience with one or more agent frameworks (such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen/Microsoft Agent Framework, Semantic Kernel, OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK or Claude Agent SDK) and a considered view on their trade-offs.
* Practical understanding of MCP (building and securing MCP servers, tool design, authentication) and A2A (agent discovery and task delegation), and when each is the right fit.
* Experience building evaluation and testing harnesses for LLM and agent systems, including golden datasets, LLM-as-judge with human calibration, regression testing and production monitoring.
* Experience implementing access control for agents and tools, such as OAuth/OIDC, service identities, scoped tokens, least-privilege tool access, user delegation and audit trails.
* Experience deploying on Azure, AWS or GCP using containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD and secrets management, within enterprise network, data residency and security constraints.
* Solution architecture experience across integration patterns, including APIs, event-driven systems and RPA where no API exists.
* The ability to explain agent behaviour, failure modes and residual risk to business, technology and risk audiences without overselling what the technology can do.
* A bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering or a related field.

**Good to Have**

* Delivery experience in banking, payments, lending, insurance or wealth management operations.
* Experience with RPA and BPM platforms such as UiPath, Power Automate, Pega, Camunda or ServiceNow.
* Experience with agent observability tools such as LangSmith, Langfuse or Arize.
* Familiarity with model risk management (for example SR 11-7) and AI regulation such as the EU AI Act.
* Experience with intelligent document processing.
* Cloud or architecture certifications.

title: Application Engineer
description:
**We're not hiring someone to close tickets.**
We're hiring the person who drives the entire Grip app system: its roadmap, architecture, speed and health. You'll also help shape what we build next.

If you build apps in your spare time just because you love it, try new tools the week they come out, and check the crash dashboard before anyone asks, read on.

**The app today**

The Grip app is built in React Native. Most of the product runs as our web app inside a WebView, joined to the app by a native bridge. Your job is to drive the whole app system: take it fully native, keep it fast, safe and reliable, and make it work hand in hand with web and backend.

**What you'll do**

**01 · Drive the entire app system**

* Own the app end to end: architecture, releases, app health, and the roadmap to a fully native app, which you shape with the leadership team.
* Make the calls on architecture, stack and the order in which screens move.
* Help drive the product roadmap too, with ideas from the app side, from user data and from the best apps out there.

**02 · Stay ahead of app health**

* Own the crash-free rate, ANR rate and app-open time, and watch them in Crashlytics, Sentry and New Relic without being asked.
* Catch regressions before users do, and trace any crash or ANR to its root cause.
* Set up the monitoring and telemetry the whole team relies on.

**03 · Experiment, and automate your own workload**

* Try new technologies and AI workflows early, and keep what works.
* Automate the repetitive parts of the job: builds, releases, checks, triage, task breakdown.
* Work out how app development fits into our AI-driven development process (AI SDLC), so app delivery is as fast as web.

**04 · Build one ecosystem with web and backend**

* Work with the web and backend teams to make everything the app shares with them (APIs, auth, data and events) more secure and robust.
* Design the architecture that lets every new feature go live on app and web on the same timeline, without one waiting for the other.
* Use shared API contracts and business logic, shared analytics events, and server-driven pieces where they help.
* Partner with the engineering manager on the process. The architecture is yours.

**05 · Build in the guardrails**

* Define the checks every release passes for security, accessibility, design and A/B experiments.
* Make releases safe and boring: CI, over-the-air updates, staged rollouts and rollback.

**06 · Set the standard**

* Your PRs, code reviews and incident write-ups become the team's benchmark.
* Come to us with "here's what we should improve" before anyone asks.

**What we're looking for**

**Must have**

* **Mobile:**
  React Native (including the New Architecture: Fabric, TurboModules, JSI) or Flutter, in depth, plus enough native Android (Kotlin) and iOS (Swift) to build and debug native modules.
* **Architecture:**
  mobile app architecture, hybrid-to-native migrations, WebView and JS ↔ native bridges, strict TypeScript.
* **App health:**
  performance profiling (Hermes, Android Studio Profiler, Perfetto, Xcode Instruments) and crash, ANR and telemetry tools (Crashlytics, Sentry, New Relic).
* **Delivery:**
  mobile CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Fastlane), over-the-air updates, Play Console and App Store Connect.
* **Quality:**
  mobile and API security, accessibility on iOS and Android, feature flags and A/B experiments, and testing (Jest, React Native Testing Library, Detox or Maestro).
* **AI:**
  daily use of CLI agents such as Claude Code or Codex, and automations you've built for your own work.

**Strong plus**

* You've led a hybrid-to-native migration or a native rewrite.
* You've built and shipped fully native apps (Kotlin with Jetpack Compose, or Swift with SwiftUI), not only cross-platform ones.
* Server-driven UI, UPI intent payments, SMS Retriever OTP or KYC SDKs.
* Fintech or other regulated B2C apps at scale

**Mindset**

* **Builder at heart:**
  builds apps in their spare time, with personal and pet projects, because they love making apps, not just because it's the job.
* **User-obsessed:**
  gets excited about creating new experiences for users.
* **Ahead of the curve:**
  keeps up with frontier technology and AI, and experiments with new tools before they go mainstream.
* **Automates:**
  keeps cutting their own workload by automating processes and routine work.
* **Proactive:**
  spots crashes, ANRs and slowdowns on the dashboards before users report them.
* **Owner:**
  owns outcomes end to end and thinks about the product, not only the code.
* **Partner:**
  brings ideas, not just questions, and communicates clearly.

**Green flags and red flags**

**We'll move fast for you if**

* You build apps for fun: personal and pet projects, released or not. Show us one.
* You've led a hybrid-to-native migration, a major React Native upgrade or a New Architecture move.
* You've traced a native crash or ANR to its root cause and can tell us the story.
* You've automated a real chunk of your own job, and can show us how.
* You've set up mobile monitoring, telemetry or release checks that a team relied on.
* You've worked with web and backend teams to make shared APIs, auth or events more secure.
* You've shipped one feature on app and web on the same day, and know what it took.
* You have a view on React Native versus fully native versus other stacks, backed by numbers.

**Not a fit if**

* You've only worked in JavaScript and avoid Xcode or Android Studio.
* You close crash reports as "can't reproduce".
* You've never shipped to the app stores yourself.
* You wait to be told what to fix next.
* You only build apps when it's for work.
* You've never used AI tools beyond a chat prompt.

**What owning the app looks like**

No fixed timeline. You drive it.

1. **Know the app cold.**
   Map the app, the bridge, the release flow and the monitoring, and ship your first fixes in your first weeks.
2. **Own the roadmap.**
   Shape the native roadmap with leadership, and present the architecture, stack choice and migration order.
3. **Own the numbers.**
   Crash-free rate, ANR rate, app-open time and product telemetry each have a baseline, a dashboard and a target that you set.
4. **Automate the busywork.**
   Builds, releases and checks run themselves, and app work flows through our AI-driven development process as smoothly as web work.
5. **Work as one with web and backend.**
   New features go live on app and web on the same timeline, shared APIs and auth are secure and robust, and every release passes the checks for security, accessibility, design and experiments.
6. **Become the reference point.**
   When the team debates an app or product approach, they ask what you'd do.

**What you get here**

* **Your ideas, brought to life.**
  The interests, experiments and ideas you'd normally save for a side project get to ship here, to real investors.
* **A company that stays ahead of the curve.**
  We experiment early with new technology and AI tools to build things customers love.
* **Real ownership.**
  The app, its roadmap and its architecture are yours to shape.

We're building a team where
**AI-native isn't a buzzword. It's table stakes.**
The person we hire won't just build a native app. They'll give our investors the best experience we can offer, on every screen, and make the whole team better at building for mobile.

*If you're still reading and nodding, we'd like to meet you.*

title: Gujarati Expert with Mathematical Background
description:
In this hourly, remote contractor role, you will work as a Gujarati Language Specialist (SME) to review AI-generated Gujarati content and/or create high-quality Gujarati reference content, evaluating language quality and step-by-step reasoning while providing precise written feedback. You will assess outputs for accuracy, fluency, grammar, spelling, tone, cultural appropriateness, and adherence to the prompt; identify errors in meaning, mistranslation, register (formal vs informal), ambiguity, and logical consistency; fact-check claims when needed; write high-quality rewrites and model answers that demonstrate best practices in Gujarati writing; and rate and compare multiple AI responses based on correctness and overall quality.
  
  
This role is with SME Careers, a fast-growing AI Data Services company and subsidiary of SuperAnnotate, delivering training data for many of the world’s largest AI companies and foundation-model labs. Your Gujarati expertise directly helps improve the world’s premier AI models by making their Gujarati language output more natural, reliable, culturally accurate, and clearly written.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop AI Training Content: Create prompts and gold-standard Gujarati answers across multiple domains (general knowledge, customer support, education, conversational writing).
* Optimize AI Performance: Evaluate and rank AI outputs to improve fluency, correctness, tone match, and cultural appropriateness.
* Ensure Model Integrity: Detect unsafe or misleading content, factual hallucinations, bias, and policy-risk language; validate reliability across use cases.

**Your Profile**

* Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Mathematics
* Native or near-native Gujarati proficiency (reading and writing required).
* Strong professional proficiency in English (minimum C1) to follow guidelines and provide detailed feedback in English.
* 3+ years of professional experience in writing, editing, localization, translation, content QA, journalism, education, or related language-focused work.
* Deep understanding of Gujarati grammar, spelling conventions, punctuation, and style—able to explain why something is wrong and how to fix it.
* Comfortable handling multiple registers (formal/informal), dialect variation, and audience adaptation (e.g., India vs diaspora audiences).
* High attention to detail when spotting subtle meaning shifts, hallucinated claims, or culturally awkward phrasing.
* Reliable, self-directed, and able to deliver consistent quality in an hourly, remote contractor workflow across time zones.
* Prior experience with AI data training/annotation, translation QA, editorial QA, or rubric-based evaluation is strongly preferred.

title: Business Operations Senior Associate
description:
**About The Role**
You are part of the operations team, but you spend about 90% of your time working inside the Growth and Strategy team. You sit in its key meetings, including those with partners and funders, and become its operating backbone. You track every opportunity and program, build the templates and processes the team uses, and keep the information that leadership, funders and partners rely on complete and current.
  
  
You are also the link between Growth and Operations. Every new opportunity should meet our budget, due diligence and approval requirements from day one, without slowing the team down. The aim is that the Growth and implementation teams spend less time on admin, not more.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Pipeline and CRM: Own documentation of every opportunity, from the first conversation with a lead through to active grants. Own mechanisms to keep the CRM complete and current so that it is the single source for pipeline reporting.
* Program budgets and financial tracking: Work with the Finance and Operations teams and each Growth lead to build and maintain a budget for every program and opportunity. Build mechanisms to ensure monthly spend-vs-actual reporting with Finance. Make sure no proposal goes out without a full cost-recovery budget and the required sign-off.
* Project management and reporting: Roll out and maintain our standard program management template. Ensure there is a live tracker of every large program, covering fundraising, spend, plans and implementation. Produce monthly and quarterly progress reports for leadership.
* Due diligence and approvals: Oversee partner due diligence for every new implementing partner. Prepare Go/No-Go papers for the Investment Committee. Keep the documentation trail for each stage of approval.
* Knowledge management: Capture notes, decisions and actions from Growth meetings and partner conversations in one place, and follow up on agreed actions so nothing is lost.
* Templates and process: Design simple templates and fill in the information yourself where you can, so that process works for the team rather than against it.
* Automation: Build and use AI agents and automation tools for data extraction, tracking and routine reporting, so that reporting is fast and repeatable.

**Required Qualifications**

* An undergraduate or master's degree in business administration, economics, public policy or a related field.
* 4 to 6 years of experience in project management, operations, business operations or similar roles.
* Strong organisation and project-management skills: you build trackers, templates and structured documentation, and keep them current.
* Comfort with budgets and spreadsheets: you can build a program budget and track spend against it.
* Hands-on experience with project management tools and CRM software.
* The ability to get busy senior colleagues to adopt new processes, by earning their buy-in rather than relying on authority.
* Strong coordination with internal teams and external partners and funders.
* Reliable and timely, with a consistent record of following through.
* Clear written and spoken English.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in a mission-driven, grant-funded, or international-development organization, or exposure to fundraising, grants, or funder reporting.
* Experience setting up or using AI agents or automation tools for data extraction, tracking, or reporting.
* Experience working as an operations or business-operations partner embedded with a growth, fundraising, or product team.
* Experience building reporting processes or a documentation hub from the ground up in a small or fast-growing organization.
* Familiarity with the grant lifecycle and funder pipeline management.

ZYPACK POLYPACK PRIVATE LIMITED, a proud unit of Raj Plastics, is a leading innovator in cosmetics container manufacturing. The company focuses on delivering high-quality packaging solutions that blend functionality with modern, attractive design.

Zypack is seeking a highly motivated Mechanical, Industrial, or related Engineering Intern to join our team at the Bawan Industrial Area factory site. This is a hands-on, 6-month internship focused on the management of production and the shop floor. Our facility features active raw stock and material areas, injection moulding units, and fitting/assembly areas.

As a Production Management Intern, your primary role will be supervising shop floor operations and analyzing critical production reports to ensure seamless end-to-end manufacturing flow.

Your daily tasks and standard operating procedures will be guided by our internal manual.

Key responsibilities include:

* **Process Supervision:**

* **Quality & WIP Tracking:**
   Supervise Work in Progress (WIP) between the moulding and assembly areas. Ensure correct component consumption against the Bill of Materials (BOM) and review in-process quality control (IPQC) data.
* **KPI Monitoring:**
   Assist in compiling and analyzing daily, weekly, and monthly KPIs, including Production vs. Plan, downtime hours by reason, scrap percentage, and inventory days.
* **Continuous Improvement:**
   Participate in daily review meetings, categorize defects (e.g., short shots, flash, warpage) and downtime reasons, and help maintain accurate stock ledgers and process sheets.

* Currently pursuing or recently graduated with a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
* Available for a full-time, 6-month internship starting in December 2026.

* Excellent organizational and supervisory skills.
* Familiarity with manufacturing workflows, inventory management (FIFO), or injection moulding processes is a strong plus.

title: Lead Infrastructure Architect (Network Design, LAN/WAN, RFP )
description:
**Overview**
***WELCOME TO SITA***
SITA is the leading specialist in air transport communications and information technology. We don’t just connect the global aviation industry, we apply decades of experience and expertise to address almost every core business, operational, baggage, and passenger process in air transport. As an organization, we cover 95% of all international air travel destinations and work with over 2,800 air transport and government customers in every corner of the globe. Immerse yourself in the dynamic world of technology while embracing our collaborative, and inclusive culture.
  
  
**Ready to redefine air travel? The journey starts here, with you at SITA.**
**About The Role & Team**
Architect and design the solution to meet the business requirements of SITA customers predominantly in the pre-sales phase (RFPs or unsolicited opportunities) with focus on propose, design, deploy network infrastructure and Campus LAN and integration with cloud architecture.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Design and lead enterprise networking solutions**
across Campus LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, Wi-Fi, SD-LAN/SD-Access, Internet connectivity, and cloud networking integration.
  
  
**Own the end-to-end technical solution lifecycle**
, from opportunity qualification and requirement discovery through high-level design, solution validation, proposal development, customer presentation, and handover to delivery teams.
  
  
**Drive Intent-Based Networking (IBN) and network automation solutions**
, leveraging technologies such as Cisco Catalyst Center, Cisco SD-Access, Aruba Central, APIs, telemetry, assurance, and policy-based network management.
  
  
**Develop secure network architectures**
incorporating next-generation firewalls, segmentation, NAC, Zero Trust, SASE, SSE, ZTNA, SWG, CASB, and other network-security capabilities.
  
  
**Translate customer business and technical requirements into compelling solution architectures**
, clearly articulating business value, technical benefits, operational improvements, scalability, resiliency, and security.
  
  
**Lead technical discovery workshops and customer presentations**
, engaging effectively with network architects, security teams, IT leadership, procurement teams, and C-level stakeholders.
  
  
**Qualifications**
***EXPERIENCE***

* Degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Information Technology and/or Engineering.
* CCIE or equivalent certifications.
* 7- 10 years of experience in Information Technology, Air Transport, Telecom, or any other relevant industry in a technical Pre-Sales role
* Proven track record in producing communicating and documenting successful technical customer solutions
* Proven track record in managing solution proposals, costing, and customer presentation with great level of details.
* Expert in Network design WAN/Campus LAN, Cisco SDA, WLC, ISE, ACI, Nexus or similar technologies
* Understanding of Cloud Connectivity such as Azure Express Route, AWS Direct Connect, is a great plus
* Understanding of Cloud Security such as Zscaler, Cisco umbrella is a great plus
* Understanding of Systems Monitoring – Network Monitoring, Security Monitoring (SIEM), etc.
* Understanding of Versa (or Cisco) SDWAN architecture, Salesforce and Service Now is a great plus
* Adept at drawing technical diagrams - good knowledge of Visio, competence in Excel and PowerPoint.
* Network design and standard vendor products
* Commercial Acumen

SITA’s workplace is all about diversity, many different countries and cultures are represented in our workforce. We collaborate in our impressive offices, embracing a hybrid work format. As part of our global benefits, we offer:
  
  
🏡
**Flex-week:**
Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your Team's needs).
  
  
⌚

You may wish to flex your arrival time at the office, to beat the rush hours or you may want to leave the office earlier to pick up your kids from school or to go to your favorite game: We support you in being open about your needs and routine with you manager.

Benefit for 30 working days from anywhere around the world each year!
  
  
🙌🏽

according to the local market

title: Senior Application support specialist
description:
Position Summary
  
  
We are seeking a Senior Application Support Specialist to managing applications used for coordinating engineering documentation for customers and vendors throughout the project lifecycle. The role requires the individual to support internal stakeholders, customers and vendors by ensuring timely, accurate, and compliant handling of designated systems and applications and technical documentation.
  
  
The position involves close collaboration with engineering, project management, procurement, customers, and suppliers located primarily in Europe, requiring strong communication skills and flexibility to support global teams.
  
  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Application & User Support
  
  

* Provide first- and second-line support for the digital applications which manage the product and project documentation.
* Provide support for internal and external users in completing system- and documentation-related activities.
* Investigate user-reported issues, document and report bugs, and track support tickets through closure.
* Identify appropriate workarounds in collaboration with Business Analysts, application owners, and IT teams.
* Identify recurring issues and support root-cause analysis together with Business Analysts and application owners.
* Escalate application issues and coordinate their resolution with the relevant technical teams.

Documentation & Process Support
  
  

* Support and maintain customer and vendor documentation within designated digital platforms and support tools.
* Ensure documentation is correctly uploaded, categorized, revised, approved, maintained, and archived throughout its lifecycle.
* Monitor documentation workflows, identify process-related issues, and recommend corrective actions.
* Maintain procedures, work instructions, user documentation, training materials, and knowledge articles.
* Support document reviews, audits, project milestones, and reporting of documentation status and overdue activities.

Continuous Improvement & Requirements
  
  

* Identify recurring problems, improvement opportunities, and user needs and communicate them to Business Analysts and application owners.
* Capture new requirements and enhancement requests from users and support their clarification and prioritization.
* Support the implementation of process improvements and digitalization initiatives.

Testing, Release & Rollout Support
  
  

* Perform root cause analysis, validate bug corrections and application changes through functional testing.
* Perform regression and smoke testing as required.
* Support application releases, upgrades, rollouts, and user-adoption activities.
* Communicate application status, planned maintenance, releases, and service updates to the user community.

Training & Stakeholder Support
  
  

* Plan and conduct training sessions for internal and external users.
* Respond to customer, vendor, and internal-user queries through appropriate support channels.
* Collaborate with engineering, project teams, Business Analysts, application owners, customers, vendors, and IT teams across multiple locations

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor/Diploma in Mechanical/electrical/Information Technology or other comparable engineering degree.
* 4 to 8 years of engineering work experience. Added advantage if experience in project documentation, document control, project support, or engineering support functions.
* An added advantage if there is prior experience in working with customer and vendor documentation in engineering, energy, power generation, manufacturing, EPC, or industrial projects.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with an extrovert personality with a Leadership mindset.
* Good understanding of engineering project execution and documentation workflows.
* Ability to work independently while managing multiple documentation activities and priorities.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
  
Work Schedule & Flexibility Requirements
  
  

* Willingness to work in a global environment supporting international customers, vendors, and project teams.
* Ability to align working hours primarily with Swedish business hours.
* Flexibility to provide support during UK business hours when required by project, customer, or vendor needs.
* Availability to participate in meetings, documentation reviews, and project coordination activities outside standard India working hours as needed.
* Strong adaptability and responsiveness in a multi-location and multicultural work environment.

title: Analyst-CEG
description:
**Job Description**
The Colleague Experience Group (formerly HR) is focused on providing a great colleague experience every day. Our mission is to obsess over understanding the colleague experience at a deeper level to co-create simple and great ways of working that enable everyone to be and deliver their best. Within CEG, the Colleague Services (CS) organization plays a critical role in providing outstanding services, capabilities, data, and insights to enable that great colleague experience. The organization builds and operates products and services to enable CEG and the business
  
  
The Colleague Experience Servicing Strategy refers to the structured approach American Express and Colleague Experience Group is taking to deliver support services to its colleagues, ensuring that interactions are efficient, consistent, and tailored to individual needs. It encompasses the design of tiered support models, integration of technology platforms, and governance of knowledge assets to enable seamless resolution of colleague inquiries.
  
  
The Knowledge Management Analyst supports the development and maintenance of a centralized knowledge ecosystem that enables efficient, personalized, and scalable colleague servicing. This role is responsible for curating and optimizing content, analyzing usage trends, and supporting platform enhancements that align with the broader servicing strategy. Working closely with the Knowledge Manager and cross-functional teams, the analyst will help ensure that knowledge assets are accurate, accessible, and continuously improved to meet evolving colleague needs.
  
  
Through close collaboration with cross-functional partners and continuous improvement efforts, the analyst will help reduce friction in support workflows, enhance colleague experience, and contribute to the broader transformation of service delivery across the enterprise.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Assist in the creation, tagging, and updating of knowledge articles, FAQs, SOPs, and policy guides for content migration and ongoing maintenance.
* Monitor content lifecycle and flag outdated or low-performing assets for review or retirement.
* Ensure content is structured and tagged for seamless integration with advanced AI tools and future automation initiatives.
* Support configuration and testing of knowledge management platforms during rollout and enhancement phases.
* Troubleshoot content display issues and coordinate with tech teams to resolve functionality gaps.
* Support deployment of AI agents and ChatGPT plug-ins for self-service and automation of core processes.
* Track usage metrics, search trends, and feedback to identify content gaps and improvement opportunities.
* Partner with servicing teams, COEs, and product managers to gather content requirements and validate accuracy.
* Partner with process and content owners to maintain documentation of content workflows and contribute to SOP development.

**Qualifications**

* 2-4 years of experience in knowledge management, content operations, or service delivery support.
* Familiarity with knowledge platforms, taxonomy design, and content lifecycle processes.
* Strong analytical skills and experience with reporting tools (e.g., Excel, Tableau).
* Excellent written communication and attention to detail.
* Ability to work collaboratively across global teams and manage multiple priorities.

**About Us**
At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
  
  
As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.
  
  
**About The Team**
We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:
  
  

* Competitive base salaries
* Bonus incentives
* Support for financial-well-being and retirement
* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
* Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
* Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
* Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
* Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
* Career development and training opportunities

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.
  
  
Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

title: Content Writer & Strategist
description:
**Specialist - Research & Thought Leadership Content**

**Location-**

Gurgaon, India (JTG HQ — Udyog Vihar, Phase 5) | Work from Office

**Reports To-**

Senior Specialist – Sales & Strategy

**Employment Type-**

Full-time

**Experience-**

5–7 years in content, research, journalism, or communications in a B2B / tech domain

**About Josh Technology Group (JTG)**

Josh Technology Group is a 16+ year old product engineering company with 300+ engineers across 20+ countries. We de-risk technology for businesses through AI-accelerated, outcome-accountable delivery — not staff augmentation. We have delivered 100+ projects across Healthcare, EdTech/HR-Tech, FinTech, Transport, and Emerging Tech verticals, primarily for North American and European clients, with a client retention rate of over 90%.

As JTG invests in building its brand with PE/VC firms, enterprise buyers, and startup founders in Western markets, we are building an in-house thought leadership engine — grounded in real delivery experience and domain depth, not generic content.

 

**Role Overview**

Think of this role as an embedded journalist inside a technology company — except your stories build pipeline, not just readership.

The Research & Thought Leadership Lead will sit inside JTG’s business, attend leadership discussions, absorb what is happening across client engagements, industries, and the market — and turn those raw signals into published thought leadership that positions JTG and its leadership as credible, insightful voices in Healthcare, EdTech, and product engineering globally.

You will attend the weekly leadership meeting, listen for problem statements, delivery learnings, client challenges, and market observations — and then go away, research deeply, and come back with a crisp article, POV, or whitepaper that can be published in the name of JTG, Pod.AI, or one of its Co-Founders and Advisors. The best content will not read like a sales brochure — it will read like something a smart practitioner would actually want to read.

This role reports into the Senior Specialist – Sales & Strategy, who will direct topics, align content with active commercial priorities, and review output before publication.

 

**Key Responsibilities**

**Embedded Research & Intelligence**

* Attend the weekly JTG leadership meeting as the designated content listener — capturing problem statements, delivery insights, client challenges, market observations, and strategic priorities as raw material for content.
* Conduct deep, independent research on the topics surfaced in leadership discussions — industry trends, regulatory developments, technology shifts, competitive dynamics, and real-world case evidence — to build a well-grounded point of view.
* Research target industries and verticals (Healthcare, EdTech/HR-Tech, FinTech, Tech GCC/IT-ITES) to develop a running knowledge base that informs content quality and relevance.
* Research potential client companies, PE/VC portfolio firms, and technology leaders that JTG targets commercially — understanding their business context to make content resonate with the right readers.
* Monitor the broader ecosystem — competitor content, industry publications, LinkedIn discourse, analyst reports — to ensure JTG’s content is differentiated, not derivative.

**Content Creation & Publishing**

* Write thought papers, articles, points of view, and opinion pieces grounded in JTG’s delivery experience and domain knowledge — to be published on JTG’s website, LinkedIn, and other relevant platforms.
* Draft executive ghostwritten content — LinkedIn posts, long-form articles, op-eds, conference abstracts, and panel talking points — on behalf of JTG’s Co-Founders and Advisors, capturing their authentic voice.
* Maintain a content calendar in coordination with the Senior Specialist – Sales & Strategy, ensuring a steady cadence of publishing (target: at least one substantive piece every 3–4 weeks) aligned to commercial priorities.
* Convert client engagement learnings and anonymised case study insights into externally shareable content without breaching confidentiality.
* Write in multiple formats and lengths as the need arises — a 300-word LinkedIn post, a 1,500-word industry article, or a 4,000-word whitepaper — with equal comfort.
* Ensure all published content passes a simple test: would a PE partner, a startup CTO, or an enterprise technology buyer find this genuinely useful? If not, rewrite.

**Collaboration & Feedback Loop**

* Work closely with the Senior Specialist – Sales & Strategy to align content themes with live deals and target account strategies — the right article at the right time can open a door that a cold email cannot.
* Coordinate with JTG Co-Founders and Advisors to gather quotes, POVs, and authentic leadership perspectives that elevate content quality.
* Track content performance (LinkedIn engagement, website traffic, inbound leads attributed to content) and share insights to continuously improve topic selection and format.
* Maintain a well-organised content repository — drafts, published pieces, research notes — that can be referenced and repurposed across the team.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* 5–7 years of experience in content writing, research, journalism, or communications — with meaningful B2B technology exposure.
* Exceptional command of written English — the ability to write with clarity, precision, and a distinct voice across formats and audiences. This is the single most important skill for this role.
* Strong storytelling instinct: the ability to take a dry technical or business topic and turn it into something genuinely compelling to read.
* Solid research skills — comfortable synthesising information from analyst reports, industry publications, academic papers, and primary conversations into a coherent, well-evidenced point of view.
* Good working knowledge of the technology and product engineering landscape — enough to write credibly about AI adoption, legacy modernisation, cloud engineering, Healthcare tech, or EdTech platforms without needing everything explained.
* Experience producing content for B2B audiences — particularly senior corporate, investor, or founder readership.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where content priorities can shift based on what is happening in the business that week.
* Strong verbal communication and interpersonal skills — able to extract insights from leadership conversations and translate them into publishable content.
* Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in English, Journalism, Communications, or a related field. MBA or postgraduate qualification is a plus.

**Preferred / Good to Have**

* Prior experience in a B2B technology company’s content/communications function, a tech-focused publication, or a management consulting firm’s knowledge/content team.
* A portfolio of published articles, whitepapers, or thought leadership pieces in tech, business, or policy domains.
* Familiarity with LinkedIn as a B2B content platform — understanding of what performs and why.
* Knowledge of Healthcare technology, EdTech, FinTech, or the Indian IT/GCC market.
* Experience writing ghostwritten executive content (LinkedIn posts, op-eds, keynote scripts).
* Familiarity with SEO basics and content optimisation for online publishing.

**What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months)**

* A published cadence of high-quality thought leadership — at least one substantive article or whitepaper every 3–4 weeks — consistently building JTG’s and its leadership’s visibility on LinkedIn and the JTG website.
* Content that is visibly aligned to commercial priorities — at least one piece directly contributes to opening a sales conversation or supporting an active deal.
* The Co-Founders and key Advisors have an active, credible LinkedIn presence powered by content this person creates.
* A well-maintained research and content library that the wider Sales & Strategy team draws on regularly.
* Feedback from the Senior Specialist and Co-Founders that the content reads like a practitioner wrote it— not a marketer.

title: Bid Manager

The ideal candidate shall have a strong background in handling tenders for Central Government & State Government Utilities, Private Utilities, Overseas customers, good understanding of Field Instruments, C&I Systems, Electrical Packages like Excitation Systems, Power Management Systems & Energy Management Systems etc. The candidate shall possess strong communication skills and ability to co-ordinate with multiple teams.**
**How You'll Make An Impact**

* The role reports directly to the Bid Management Lead (Domestic) of Siemens Energy India Limited and is based in Gurgaon.
* Review & understanding customer’s technical specifications, provide compliances and offering best solution suitable to customer’s requirements.
* Preparation of Bill of Material(s) in line with the specifications.
* Review of technical specifications for. Releasing RFQ’s for vendor quotations for bought-out packages.
* Review of vendor’s quotations including commercial terms & conditions.
* Understanding customer’s terms & conditions mentioned in the tender.
* Co-ordination with Procurement & Commercial Counterparts to expedite the bid submission process.
* Preparation of bid documents in line with the tender specifications.
* Submission of bids within suitable timeframe.
* Post-bid discussion with the customers and consultants, as applicable.
* Project handover to execution team after order acquisition.
* Preparing Win / Loss analysis for higher management.

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Controls & Instrumentation / Electrical)
* Minimum of 7-10 years of experience in engineering or bid management of Control Systems (DCS), Excitation, PMS, EMS preferably for Power Plants. Knowledge of Omnivise T3000 DCS shall be an added advantage.
* Demonstrated success in handling Sales & Tendering process, with a track record of meeting ambitious goals.
* Good understanding of boilers, steam turbines, power plant processes, measurement concepts of various parameters.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex ideas clearly and persuasively.
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team environment, fostering a cooperative work environment.
* Willingness to travel, if required, to meet clients and other business requirements.
* Willingness to work in different time zones, as per business requirements.

**About The Team**
**In the large steam and gas turbine domain, we offer services and solutions for gas turbines, large steam turbines, large generators, and associated control technology. Our portfolio serves customers such as power utilities, Independent Power Producers (IPPs), Engineering Procurement and Construction (EPC) firms, and industrial clients. We provide a comprehensive range of offerings including maintenance, operation, digital services, modernization and upgradation, plant flexibilization, as well as control and digitalization solutions (digital control systems, field instruments, and equipment) and professional consulting.**
**Our power generation portfolio also includes industrial steam turbines (ranging from 10 kW to 250 MW), condensers, and service offerings designed to extend the lifespan and efficiency of industrial steam turbines through heat recovery solutions. We cater to a wide range of process industries—including oil and gas, chemicals, petrochemicals, paper & pulp, sugar & ethanol, and marine—helping customers reduce energy consumption and greenhouse gas emissions. A key focus area is delivering integrated industrial decarbonization solutions built on electrification, automation, and digitalization, while supporting sustainability through carbon-optimized energy systems and hydrogen generation.**
**Who is Siemens Energy India?**
**Siemens Energy India Limited (SEIL) has been a strategic partner in India for more than 100 years and is focused on being the most-valued energy technology company. title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Senior Product Designer (App + Website)

DUSQ | New Delhi | Full-time

About DUSQ

DUSQ is a consumer neurotech company building the world's first closed-loop sleep regulation system. It's a 12-gram wearable that sits behind the ear, reads your nervous system through the night and responds in real time when sleep starts to break. Its companion app turns those overnight signals into scores, trends and a nightly routine people actually keep.

We design for one of the hardest user states there is: someone half-asleep, in the dark, who needs to understand their night in seconds.

What we've built so far

• Fastest Indian healthtech company to cross $1M on Kickstarter, closing at $1.2M+ from 4,200+ backers in the US

• Preorders continuing on our own store after the campaign

• 2,000+ users in India

• ₹24 Cr seed round led by Fireside Ventures, with Antler India and Climber Capital

• Three-Shark deal on Shark Tank India

• Our own sleep lab, with 50M+ physiological data points collected and a completed clinical trial with 460+ participants

The role

This is a foundational role. You will work directly with the founders and set the design foundation for the company: the design language, system and patterns everything else will be built on.

You will own UI/UX across two surfaces:

• The DUSQ app: insights, scores, trends, daily check-in, onboarding and the nightly routine

• The DUSQ website: landing pages and the path from first visit to purchase

What you'll do

• Design data-rich app screens: insights, scores, trends and recovery

• Own end-to-end flows, from onboarding to long-term retention

• Design and iterate high-converting landing pages and the path to purchase

• Run A/B tests and funnel analysis with product and growth

• Show uncertainty, missing data and "good vs bad" without causing sleep anxiety

• Work with engineering, data science and firmware on what the signals can honestly support

• Build the design system from the ground up, including data-viz patterns and low-light accessibility

• Run user research and turn findings into decisions

Must have

• 6+ years designing digital products, with end-to-end ownership

• A track record of shipping: apps or websites you designed went live and are used by real customers. You know how to design within engineering, timeline and data constraints, and what changes between the Figma file and production

• Strong data visualisation experience (dashboards, analytics, health, fintech or similar) where you decided how data is encoded, not just how it is styled

• A data-first approach, with metrics your work has moved

• Strong user-flow and information-architecture skills

• Landing page or conversion funnel work with real before-and-after results

• Fluent in Figma (components, variables, prototyping) and comfortable handing off to engineers

• Clear communication: you can back a design decision with evidence

Good to have

• Wearable, health, sleep or quantified-self product experience

• Mobile-first design for iOS and Android, including dark and low-light interfaces

• Comfort reading data yourself (SQL, a BI tool or a notebook) or prototyping in code

• Behaviour-change design, notifications and habit loops

• Motion and microinteraction skills

How to apply

Send your portfolio with 2 to 3 case studies of shipped work that show your process, the data you used and the outcome. At least one should involve data visualisation and at least one should show a conversion or flow improvement. Include live links where possible. A short note on a time a metric surprised you is welcome - mitansh@dusq.com

title: Computational Designer (Remote, Full-Time) [AS354]
description:
**About Smart Working**

  

At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day. This isn’t just another remote opportunity - it’s about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. From day one, you’re welcomed into a genuine community that values your growth and well-being. Our mission is simple: to break down geographic barriers and connect skilled professionals with outstanding global teams and products for full-time, long-term roles. We help you discover meaningful work with teams that invest in your success, where you’re empowered to grow personally and professionally.

  

Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote-first world.

  

**About the Role**

  

As a Senior Computational Designer, you will contribute to the ongoing development of SiteSolve, a generative design tool focused on site viability and masterplanning. The role combines computational design, geometry development and software engineering, with a predominantly back-end focus.

  

You will work directly with a product team member and may collaborate with an AI research and development specialist on initiatives involving AI agents and machine learning-based optimisation. The precise balance of responsibilities will depend on your skills and interests and may evolve as product priorities change.

  

You will contribute to a standalone product that does not depend on third-party computational design tools. The role requires independent ownership of sub-projects, thoughtful problem-solving and an understanding of how individual technical decisions contribute to the wider product.

**Responsibilities**
  

  
* Develop and maintain computational geometry algorithms for a standalone generative design product
  
* Contribute to the ongoing development of SiteSolve, supporting site viability analysis and masterplanning
  
* Design, implement and refine computational optimisation solutions
  
* Build and maintain internal tools supporting product development
  
* Contribute to cloud infrastructure and back-end development
  
* Work across front-end and back-end development, with a predominant focus on back-end functionality
  
* Undertake primarily C# development, which accounts for approximately 99% of the role
  
* Develop code that interacts with the product's 3D engine as its interface transitions from Unity to Unreal, with dedicated Unreal specialists leading the rendering work
  
* Collaborate with product team members on computational design and software development
  
* Potentially contribute to AI-focused research and development, including connecting SiteSolve to AI agents and exploring machine learning-based optimisation approaches
  
* Independently take ownership of assigned sub-projects
  
* Apply a detail-oriented approach while considering the wider context in which the code operates
  
* Demonstrate flexibility, problem-solving ability and thoroughness in technical development
  
  

  
**Requirements**
  

  
* C# – 3+ years: Expert or advanced proficiency in C#, with hands-on experience developing software applications. C# is the primary language used throughout the product, and no substitute programming language is accepted
  
* AEC Computational Design / Geometry – 3+ years: Solid understanding and practical experience in AEC computational design or geometry. Relevant computational or algorithmic design experience from adjacent domains, including manufacturing, robotics, CAD, simulation or games, is also acceptable
  
* Rhino / Grasshopper – 3+ years: Working knowledge of Rhino and Grasshopper or equivalent 3D CAD and parametric design tools
  
* Computational Optimisation – 2–3 years: Applied experience in computational optimisation. A strong applied mathematics or algorithms background with demonstrated optimisation experience is also acceptable
  
* Ability to independently own and deliver assigned sub-projects
  
* Strong problem-solving skills with a thorough and detail-oriented approach to development
  
* Ability to understand the broader product context and use that understanding to inform technical decisions
  
* Flexibility to work across different development areas as product priorities evolve
  
  

  
**Nice to Have**
  

  
* AWS – 2+ years: Working knowledge of AWS. Experience with another major cloud provider, such as Azure or GCP, combined with a willingness to learn AWS, is also acceptable
  
* Unity / Unreal / 3D Game Engines – 1–2 years: Basic familiarity with Unity, Unreal or other 3D game engines. Alternatively, an understanding of 3D vector mathematics, mesh geometry, rendering and shaders is valuable, even without direct game engine experience
  
* AI / Machine Learning – 1+ years: Basic familiarity with AI/ML concepts, including integrating code with large language models (LLMs) or ML-based optimisation. Python experience combined with strong applied mathematics knowledge, or a demonstrated interest in AI through side projects, is also acceptable

The ultimate goal is to move the digital experience function away from a project-delivery mindset and toward a high-performing, revenue-generating ecosystem.

Function: Brand - Digital Marketing

* Pivot UX metrics from vanity engagement signals (clicks and views) to commercial impact indicators (conversion rates, lead-to-booking efficiency, and pipeline revenue).

**Agency Governance & Stakeholder Management:**

* Drive high-level cross-functional alignment between Global Brand, regional marketing leads, Apparel, and IT teams, ensuring user experience priorities are baked into foundational technical and commercial roadmaps.

4 - 5 years in UI/UX/Design/CRO and Good experience of generating analytics

Bachelor’s degree (Full Time) - Advertising, Marketing, Communications

We are a global leader in middleweight motorcycles (250-750cc), operating in 80 countries. Royal Enfield’s unique approach to forging our path has led to consistent growth and profitability. Emphasizing our values and brand essence, we strive to transform into a premium experiential brand. By embracing diversity and new ideas from various industries and regions, we are expanding our team for a broader perspective on global markets.

title: Accountant
description:
Accountant

**E-Vision India Pvt Ltd**

**Location:**
Faridabad, Haryana

**Employment Type:**
Full-time, on-site

About the Company

E-Vision India Pvt Ltd works in electronic security and surveillance, including CCTV hardware, video management software, and AI video analytics. We are looking for an Accountant to maintain accurate financial records, manage day-to-day accounting, and coordinate with internal teams and our tax advisers.

About the Role

You will handle daily accounting entries, invoices, bank reconciliation, payment tracking, and financial documentation. You will also support GST and TDS compliance, payroll accounting, and month-end closing.

We need someone who checks the details, follows up on pending matters, and flags discrepancies early. You should be comfortable working independently while coordinating with sales, purchase, inventory, HR, and the company’s CA.

Key Responsibilities

**Daily Accounting and Bookkeeping**

* Record sales, purchases, receipts, payments, expenses, and journal entries accurately.
* Maintain ledgers and check entries against invoices, approvals, and supporting documents.
* Keep accounting records updated and resolve missing or incorrect entries.
* Maintain organized digital and physical records for easy retrieval.

**Invoicing and Transaction Documentation**

* Prepare sales invoices, credit notes, debit notes, and other accounting documents as required.
* Check customer and vendor details, GST information, pricing, and applicable tax treatment.
* Coordinate e-invoices and e-way bills where applicable.
* Match purchase invoices with purchase orders, delivery records, and relevant approvals.
* Coordinate with sales and inventory teams to resolve billing and stock-related discrepancies.

**Bank Reconciliation and Payments**

* Reconcile bank statements, customer accounts, and vendor accounts regularly.
* Prepare payment schedules and process payments only after the required authorization.
* Track outstanding receivables and coordinate customer payment follow-ups with sales.
* Monitor vendor dues, advances, reimbursements, and pending adjustments.
* Maintain petty cash records and verify supporting bills.

**GST TDS and Compliance Support**

* Prepare and reconcile accounting data needed for GST and TDS returns.
* Review purchase records against available GST statements and flag mismatches.
* Coordinate with the company’s CA or tax adviser on calculations, filings, and queries.
* Track applicable filing and payment deadlines and keep supporting records ready.
* Escalate unclear tax treatment or compliance concerns before processing.

**Payroll and Employee Expenses**

* Coordinate with HR to obtain approved payroll inputs.
* Record salary payments, deductions, reimbursements, and statutory liabilities as applicable.
* Verify employee expense claims against bills, approvals, and company policy.
* Maintain confidentiality of salary and employee financial information.

**Closing Reporting and Audit Support**

* Support monthly and year-end closing, including accruals, adjustments, and ledger reviews.
* Prepare reports on receivables, payables, expenses, cash and bank balances, and other financial information required by management.
* Maintain fixed asset records and coordinate depreciation workings with the CA.
* Support stock reconciliation with the inventory team.
* Provide documents and explanations for audits and financial reviews.
* Highlight unusual transactions, duplicate payments, overdue balances, and unresolved differences promptly.

Qualifications and Experience

* B.Com or a related qualification in accounting or finance.
* Relevant experience in bookkeeping, invoicing, bank reconciliation, and account reconciliation.
* Practical knowledge of GST and TDS accounting and compliance coordination.
* Ability to work confidently with accounting software such as Tally, Odoo, or equivalent systems.
* Good working knowledge of Excel, including formulas, filters, and reconciliation worksheets.
* Experience in trading, distribution, technology, or project-based businesses is an advantage.

Skills and Working Approach

* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Clear communication and consistent follow-through.
* Ability to prioritize daily work and meet closing deadlines.
* Willingness to question discrepancies and seek clarification.
* Professional integrity and careful handling of confidential information.
* Availability to work full-time from the Faridabad office.

Performance Expectations

Performance will be assessed on accurate and timely accounting, completed reconciliations, reliable reporting, organized documentation, and timely preparation of compliance data. All payments, adjustments, and financial commitments must follow the company’s approval process.

title: Software Engineer in Test
description:
**About the role:**

We are seeking a skilled SDET to own test automation end to end: build the framework, build the pipeline that tests and monitors our voice orchestration product, and make the same foundation reusable for every product that follows.

**WFO - Gurgaon, 5 days working**

**Requirements**

* You will design, build and run the automation and monitoring that tells us whether each product is ready to ship and healthy once it is live. Build the automation framework.
* Design a modular, reusable framework (API, UI, load and data layers, shared fixtures, reporting) that any new product can adopt with minimal setup.
* Set the coding standards and structure for how tests are written at sixhats.ai.
* Test the voice orchestration pipeline end to end.
* Automate full call flows with simulated callers.
* Cover call setup and teardown, interruptions and turn-taking, speech recognition accuracy, response latency, speech output quality, conversation flow correctness and telephony edge cases.
* Handle non-deterministic AI output.
* Create evaluation approaches (golden datasets, scoring rubrics, tolerance-based assertions) so that tests stay meaningful when model responses vary. Own performance and reliability testing.
* Run load, stress and soak tests for concurrent calls, and inject failures (network loss, slow or failing upstream services) to confirm the platform degrades gracefully.
* Wire quality into CI/CD. Run suites in parallel on every change, set release gates, keep tests fast and stable, and drive down flaky tests rather than tolerating them. Build monitoring and observability.
* Set up synthetic test calls against production, dashboards and alerts for latency, error rates, call success and audio quality, and work with engineering to define the targets we hold ourselves to. Prepare for the next products. Extend the framework to the CRM (workflows, APIs, data integrity, permissions) and the photo imaging studio (image output quality, visual regression, processing performance).
* Raise the quality bar across the team. Join design and code reviews, push for testable designs, triage defects, assess release readiness and mentor engineers on writing good tests.

**Required Qualifications and Skills:**

* 2 - 3 years in SDET, test automation or quality engineering roles, with at least one framework built from scratch (not only maintained).
* Must be from a Tier 1 college (Top: IIT/IIIT, also NIT/DTU/REC) ONLY, with a Computer Science B.Tech only.
* Strong programming skills in Python (preferred), Golang: clean code, object-oriented design, async programming and sensible design patterns.
* Framework design experience: layered structure, reusable clients and fixtures, configuration and environment management, test data handling and clear reporting.
* API testing depth across REST and streaming protocols such as WebSockets, plus contract testing and mocking of third-party services.
* UI test automation with Playwright, Selenium or Cypress, including strategies to keep UI tests stable.
* CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or Jenkins, and working knowledge of Docker for repeatable test environments.
* Performance testing with k6, Locust, JMeter or similar, and the ability to read results and find bottlenecks.
* Monitoring and observability basics: logs, metrics and traces, dashboards and alerting (Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog or similar).
* Solid SQL and comfort debugging across several services using logs and tracing.
* A sound test strategy mindset: test pyramid, risk-based prioritisation and shift-left practices.
* Clear written and verbal communication, and ownership of quality outcomes without waiting to be told.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
About the Role

We're hiring a Lead Software Engineer to own the technical direction of Astranova's backend platforms

and lead the engineers who build them. You'll set architecture, drive delivery, and stay hands-on in the

code — across leasing and lending operations, IoT and telematics, and the data platform that ties them

together.

Our stack is cloud-native on GCP — Kubernetes, gRPC, InfluxDB, Airflow, Pub/Sub, BigQuery and modern

CI/CD. You'll lead the next phase of its evolution: building micro-services, moving infrastructure to code,

and building in security and compliance from day one. We want a leader who is strong on fundamentals

and who makes AI-assisted engineering a team-wide practice

What You'll Do

• Technical Leadership — Own the architecture and technical roadmap for backend platforms

across leasing, IoT and data. Make and document the key design decisions, and be accountable

for their outcomes in production.

• Team Leadership — Lead a team of SDE-1 to SDE-3 engineers: plan and assign work, run design

reviews, unblock delivery, and give regular, direct feedback.

• Delivery Ownership — Turn business priorities into scoped technical plans with clear milestones.

Own estimates, sprint execution and release quality, and flag risks early.

• Platform Evolution — Lead the decomposition of monolithic services into well-bounded

microservices, move infrastructure to code (Terraform), and drive service mesh adoption and

clean environment isolation on GCP.

• IoT & Data at Scale — Set the design for pipelines and services that ingest, process and serve

high-volume IoT and telemetry data, using time-series databases, Airflow, Pub/Sub, Apache

Beam and BigQuery.

• Security & Compliance by Design — Build security, auditability and data-privacy controls into

systems from the start, in line with the DPDP Act and the requirements of regulated lending.

• Reliability & Operations — Define SLOs, observability and incident-response practices. Lead

post-incident reviews and drive the fixes to closure.

• AI-Native Engineering — Set the team's standards for AI coding assistants and agentic tools, and

lead AI/ML-driven features such as anomaly detection on IoT data and LLM-powered internal

tools.

• Engineering Excellence — Own the team's bar for code review, testing, documentation and

modular design, and stay hands-on in the codebase on critical paths.

• Hiring & Mentorship — Interview and hire engineers, coach SDE-2 and SDE-3 engineers toward

senior and lead roles, and help raise the technical bar across the org.

• Cross-functional Collaboration — Partner with product, business, finance, risk and design

stakeholders across the full SDLC, and represent engineering in planning and prioritisation.

What We're Looking For

• Experience — 5–8 years building complex, large-scale backend or data engineering systems,

including at least 2 years leading a team of engineers or owning a major platform as tech lead.

• Architecture — A track record of designing distributed systems end to end and owning them in

production, including at least one significant migration or re-architecture.

• Core Skills — Expert-level Python (preferred) or Java, with deep command of low-level and

high-level system design.

• Tech Stack — Deep hands-on experience with microservices, RDBMS (e.g., PostgreSQL), NoSQL

(e.g., MongoDB), messaging systems (e.g., Kafka, Pub/Sub) and gRPC/REST API design.

• Infrastructure — Strong practical experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD and a major cloud

platform (GCP preferred). Infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and service mesh experience is a

plus.

• Data — Experience with time-series databases, workflow orchestration (e.g., Airflow) and

analytical warehouses (e.g., BigQuery).

• Leadership — Proven ability to mentor engineers, run design reviews, manage delivery against

deadlines, and communicate trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

• Domain (good to have) — Exposure to fintech, lending or leasing platforms, IoT/telematics, or

regulated environments (RBI/NBFC.

• Education — B.E. / B.Tech or equivalent from a reputed institute.

AI Skills We Value

At the lead level, we expect you to use AI tools well and to shape how the whole team uses them. The

following are a strong plus.

• Agentic coding at team scale — Hands-on use of tools like Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor

or Windsurf, and experience setting team conventions for them: shared context files, review

rules for AI-generated code, and where agents should and shouldn't be used.

• LLM application development — Experience shipping LLM-powered features in backend services

— function/tool calling, structured outputs, streaming, and cost and latency management.

• Prompt & context engineering — Designing prompts, system instructions and context windows

for reliable, production-grade AI behaviour.

• RAG & retrieval systems — Designing retrieval-augmented generation with embeddings and

vector databases including chunking, ranking and freshness trade-offs.

• MCP / tool-use protocols — Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar

standards for connecting LLMs to internal tools and data sources securely.

• AI workflow automation — Using AI agents to automate parts of the SDLC — test generation,

code review, documentation or CI/CD tasks — and measuring whether they actually help.

• Evaluation & guardrails — Defining evaluation suites, guardrails and approval gates so

AI-generated code and AI features meet correctness, security, privacy and reliability bars before

they ship.

What We Offer

• Impact — Shape the architecture and engineering culture of a platform at an early, fast-scaling

stage.

• Growth — A seat on a rocket ship that's just taking off, with a clear path to larger scope in

engineering leadership.

• Ownership — A lean structure with no micromanagement — you own your platform and your

team's outcomes end to end.

• Culture — A team built on passion, excellence, boldness, humility, and a genuine obsession with

people.

• Compensation — Competitive salary plus ESOPs for long-term wealth creation.

• Work-Life Balance — A healthy hybrid work model based out of Gurgaon.

How to Apply

Please send your resume to hiring@astranovamobility.com

title: AI Solutions Architect
description:
**ABOUT BLOOM AI**

Bloom AI is an applied AI firm building AI-native intelligence systems and workflows for enterprise teams across research, marketing, sales and other knowledge-intensive functions.

We combine enterprise data, external intelligence, AI and software engineering to help organizations turn information into intelligence and action.

Our approach combines reusable AI capabilities with hands-on solution development in real enterprise environments. We work closely with business teams to rethink workflows, design intelligent systems and deploy solutions that deliver measurable outcomes.

Bloom AI is based in the U.S. and India (Delhi/NCR).

**THE ROLE**

We are looking for a
**hands-on AI Solutions Architect**
who can design, build and deploy enterprise-grade AI applications and agentic systems.

This role sits at the intersection of
**AI architecture, data engineering and software development**
.

You may come from a backend engineering, data engineering or data science background, but you should have evolved into building end-to-end AI solutions.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have worked on
**multiple AI/LLM projects**
, solved different types of problems and gained practical experience making architectural decisions across agent orchestration, data, context management, application development and deployment.

You should be equally comfortable designing a solution architecture, evaluating technology choices, writing code, integrating data sources and taking a working solution into production.

This is
**not a traditional software engineering role, a prompt-engineering role or a PowerPoint-only architecture role**
. We need someone who understands how AI systems work end-to-end and can personally build what they design.

You will work across client engagements, reusable Bloom AI capabilities and internal technology development, taking ownership of solutions from architecture through production deployment.

You will be part of the core team, reporting directly to the CEO.

* Build modular, reusable solutions that work across different cloud and enterprise environments.

* Implement tool calling, RAG, semantic search, agent memory and state management.
* Build evaluation, monitoring and reliability mechanisms for production AI systems.

**Engineer data and context systems**

* Integrate structured and unstructured enterprise data into AI applications.
* Design retrieval and context architectures using relational, vector and graph databases.
* Build knowledge retrieval, entity relationships and persistent context capabilities.

**Develop and deploy end to end systems**

* Build backend services and APIs using Python, FastAPI or similar technologies.
* Develop functional frontend applications and integrate with enterprise systems.
* Deploy secure, scalable applications across cloud platforms using modern engineering practices.

**Solve enterprise client problems**

* Translate business challenges into practical AI architectures and working solutions.
* Work across multiple client projects, from solution design and prototyping through deployment.
* Evaluate technical approaches, collaborate with stakeholders and develop reusable capabilities for Bloom AI.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* **4–7 years of professional experience**
  , with a foundation in
  **backend engineering, data engineering, data science or related technical disciplines**
  .
* **Hands-on experience across multiple AI/LLM application projects**

* Demonstrated ability to take ownership of solution architecture and technical implementation, rather than contributing to only one component of a system.
* Strong proficiency in
  **Python**
  , with solid software engineering and API development skills.
* Practical experience building
  **agentic applications or multi-agent systems**
  , beyond basic chatbots and prompt-based applications.
* Experience with agent orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen or similar.
* Strong understanding of LLM APIs, tool calling, RAG, embeddings, vector databases and context management.
* Strong understanding of data modeling, SQL, databases, data integration and retrieval architectures.
* Working knowledge of full-stack application development, including modern frontend frameworks such as React or Next.js.
* Familiarity with graph data structures, entity relationships and graph-based retrieval concepts.
* Experience taking AI applications from prototype through testing, integration and production deployment.
* Experience with at least one major cloud platform and familiarity with Docker, Git, CI/CD and modern engineering practices.
* Ability to evaluate different technical approaches and make sound architectural trade-offs.
* Strong independent problem-solving skills, curiosity and comfort working with ambiguous requirements.
* Lead R&D efforts for Bloom AI

**Above all, we are looking for someone who has built several AI solutions, understands the architectural decisions behind them and can independently design and implement new ones.**
