title: Chief Technology Officer and Co-Founder
description:
About Prismatom
  
  
Prismatom is an independent trust layer for enterprise communications, addressing communication authenticity and impersonation-based fraud at the post-delivery human stage.
  
  
We have built a working, patent-pending product with an existing codebase.
  
  
Our technology uses cryptographic message issuance records, deterministic recognition markers, independent verification, and an append-only, tamper-evident ledger (ATSL) to help customers recognise genuine enterprise communications and enable enterprises to establish verifiable issuance evidence.
  
  
Our advisory board includes top industry leaders who bring strategic expertise, industry insights, and guidance to Prismatom.
  
  
We are seeking a hands-on Co-Founder & CTO who can take complete ownership of our existing technology, strengthen its architecture, and lead its future development.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
- Take end-to-end technical ownership of the existing product, codebase, and architecture.
  
- Conduct technical and security assessments, identify vulnerabilities, and implement improvements.
  
- Lead backend engineering, secure API development, database architecture, and cloud infrastructure.
  
- Oversee cryptographic security, authentication, key management, and system integrity.
  
- Ensure scalability, reliability, performance, and production readiness.
  
- Drive technical strategy, architectural decisions, and future product development.
  
- Establish engineering standards, testing, deployment, and monitoring practices.
  
- Build and lead the engineering team as the company grows.
  
  
Core Technical Requirements
  
  
- Strong hands-on experience in backend engineering and software architecture.
  
- Proven experience designing, developing, and scaling production-grade systems.
  
- Expertise in secure API development, authentication, databases, and cloud infrastructure.
  
- Strong understanding of application security, distributed systems, data integrity, and system reliability.
  
- Ability to independently review, understand, and improve an existing codebase.
  
- Experience making architectural decisions and owning end-to-end engineering execution.
  
  
Specialised Expertise (Highly Desirable)
  
  
- Applied cryptography: SHA-256, HMAC, digital signatures, and asymmetric cryptography.
  
- Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), HSM/KMS, and secure key management.
  
- Tamper-evident ledgers, cryptographic audit trails, and verifiable records.
  
- Enterprise security architecture and secure system integrations.
  
- Experience in cybersecurity, fintech infrastructure, identity systems, or enterprise communication technology.
  
  
Ideal Candidate
  
  
We welcome experienced Staff Engineers, Principal Engineers, Software Architects, Founding Engineers, and hands-on CTOs with demonstrated technical ownership of complex production systems.
  
  
We value independent thinking, strong architectural judgment, security-first engineering, entrepreneurial commitment, and the ability to solve difficult technical problems.
  
  
The ideal candidate should be willing to participate not only in technology development but also in strategic decision-making and the long-term growth of Prismatom.
  
  
Equity, Investment & Co-Founder Commitment
  
  
This is an equity-based co-founder opportunity, not a conventional salaried position.
  
  
- Prismatom is currently at the pre-funding stage, and no salary will be provided before funding.
  
- Equity participation will be mutually negotiated based on responsibilities, commitment, experience, and long-term contribution.

We are looking for a long-term technical and business partner who brings engineering excellence, entrepreneurial conviction, shared financial responsibility, and the commitment to help establish Prismatom as a trusted enterprise technology company.

title: Application Engineer
description:
**We're not hiring someone to close tickets.**
We're hiring the person who drives the entire Grip app system: its roadmap, architecture, speed and health. You'll also help shape what we build next.

If you build apps in your spare time just because you love it, try new tools the week they come out, and check the crash dashboard before anyone asks, read on.

**The app today**

The Grip app is built in React Native. Most of the product runs as our web app inside a WebView, joined to the app by a native bridge. Your job is to drive the whole app system: take it fully native, keep it fast, safe and reliable, and make it work hand in hand with web and backend.

**What you'll do**

**01 · Drive the entire app system**

* Own the app end to end: architecture, releases, app health, and the roadmap to a fully native app, which you shape with the leadership team.
* Make the calls on architecture, stack and the order in which screens move.
* Help drive the product roadmap too, with ideas from the app side, from user data and from the best apps out there.

**02 · Stay ahead of app health**

* Own the crash-free rate, ANR rate and app-open time, and watch them in Crashlytics, Sentry and New Relic without being asked.
* Catch regressions before users do, and trace any crash or ANR to its root cause.
* Set up the monitoring and telemetry the whole team relies on.

**03 · Experiment, and automate your own workload**

* Try new technologies and AI workflows early, and keep what works.
* Automate the repetitive parts of the job: builds, releases, checks, triage, task breakdown.
* Work out how app development fits into our AI-driven development process (AI SDLC), so app delivery is as fast as web.

**04 · Build one ecosystem with web and backend**

* Work with the web and backend teams to make everything the app shares with them (APIs, auth, data and events) more secure and robust.
* Design the architecture that lets every new feature go live on app and web on the same timeline, without one waiting for the other.
* Use shared API contracts and business logic, shared analytics events, and server-driven pieces where they help.
* Partner with the engineering manager on the process. The architecture is yours.

**05 · Build in the guardrails**

* Define the checks every release passes for security, accessibility, design and A/B experiments.
* Make releases safe and boring: CI, over-the-air updates, staged rollouts and rollback.

**06 · Set the standard**

* Your PRs, code reviews and incident write-ups become the team's benchmark.
* Come to us with "here's what we should improve" before anyone asks.

**What we're looking for**

**Must have**

* **Mobile:**
  React Native (including the New Architecture: Fabric, TurboModules, JSI) or Flutter, in depth, plus enough native Android (Kotlin) and iOS (Swift) to build and debug native modules.
* **Architecture:**
  mobile app architecture, hybrid-to-native migrations, WebView and JS ↔ native bridges, strict TypeScript.
* **App health:**
  performance profiling (Hermes, Android Studio Profiler, Perfetto, Xcode Instruments) and crash, ANR and telemetry tools (Crashlytics, Sentry, New Relic).
* **Delivery:**
  mobile CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Fastlane), over-the-air updates, Play Console and App Store Connect.
* **Quality:**
  mobile and API security, accessibility on iOS and Android, feature flags and A/B experiments, and testing (Jest, React Native Testing Library, Detox or Maestro).
* **AI:**
  daily use of CLI agents such as Claude Code or Codex, and automations you've built for your own work.

**Strong plus**

* You've led a hybrid-to-native migration or a native rewrite.
* You've built and shipped fully native apps (Kotlin with Jetpack Compose, or Swift with SwiftUI), not only cross-platform ones.
* Server-driven UI, UPI intent payments, SMS Retriever OTP or KYC SDKs.
* Fintech or other regulated B2C apps at scale

**Mindset**

* **Builder at heart:**
  builds apps in their spare time, with personal and pet projects, because they love making apps, not just because it's the job.
* **User-obsessed:**
  gets excited about creating new experiences for users.
* **Ahead of the curve:**
  keeps up with frontier technology and AI, and experiments with new tools before they go mainstream.
* **Automates:**
  keeps cutting their own workload by automating processes and routine work.
* **Proactive:**
  spots crashes, ANRs and slowdowns on the dashboards before users report them.
* **Owner:**
  owns outcomes end to end and thinks about the product, not only the code.
* **Partner:**
  brings ideas, not just questions, and communicates clearly.

**Green flags and red flags**

**We'll move fast for you if**

* You build apps for fun: personal and pet projects, released or not. Show us one.
* You've led a hybrid-to-native migration, a major React Native upgrade or a New Architecture move.
* You've traced a native crash or ANR to its root cause and can tell us the story.
* You've automated a real chunk of your own job, and can show us how.
* You've set up mobile monitoring, telemetry or release checks that a team relied on.
* You've worked with web and backend teams to make shared APIs, auth or events more secure.
* You've shipped one feature on app and web on the same day, and know what it took.
* You have a view on React Native versus fully native versus other stacks, backed by numbers.

**Not a fit if**

* You've only worked in JavaScript and avoid Xcode or Android Studio.
* You close crash reports as "can't reproduce".
* You've never shipped to the app stores yourself.
* You wait to be told what to fix next.
* You only build apps when it's for work.
* You've never used AI tools beyond a chat prompt.

**What owning the app looks like**

No fixed timeline. You drive it.

1. **Know the app cold.**
   Map the app, the bridge, the release flow and the monitoring, and ship your first fixes in your first weeks.
2. **Own the roadmap.**
   Shape the native roadmap with leadership, and present the architecture, stack choice and migration order.
3. **Own the numbers.**
   Crash-free rate, ANR rate, app-open time and product telemetry each have a baseline, a dashboard and a target that you set.
4. **Automate the busywork.**
   Builds, releases and checks run themselves, and app work flows through our AI-driven development process as smoothly as web work.
5. **Work as one with web and backend.**
   New features go live on app and web on the same timeline, shared APIs and auth are secure and robust, and every release passes the checks for security, accessibility, design and experiments.
6. **Become the reference point.**
   When the team debates an app or product approach, they ask what you'd do.

**What you get here**

* **Your ideas, brought to life.**
  The interests, experiments and ideas you'd normally save for a side project get to ship here, to real investors.
* **A company that stays ahead of the curve.**
  We experiment early with new technology and AI tools to build things customers love.
* **Real ownership.**
  The app, its roadmap and its architecture are yours to shape.

We're building a team where
**AI-native isn't a buzzword. It's table stakes.**
The person we hire won't just build a native app. They'll give our investors the best experience we can offer, on every screen, and make the whole team better at building for mobile.

*If you're still reading and nodding, we'd like to meet you.*

**What Success Looks Like**

* Reliable, fault-tolerant architecture with strong availability, active-active capabilities and disaster recovery readiness.

* Build data archival and restore processes.
* Optimize queries, indexes, and views for large client databases.

* Strong hands-on experience with PostgreSQL: PL/pgSQL functions and procedures, triggers, and views.

* Strong data modelling skills: normalisation, keys, constraints, and partitioning.
* Experience designing scalable database schemas for enterprise applications.

* Experience with data migration, conversion, and reconciliation on large datasets.
* Experience with database migration tools such as Flyway or Liquibase.

**Legacy Code**

* Ability to read and understand complex legacy SQL and stored procedures.

**AI-assisted Development**

* Comfortable using AI coding tools in daily development.

**Version Control**

* Experience with Git.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

**Team Responsibilities**

* Review database changes for correctness and performance.
* Document data models and database logic.
* Work with development teams on data access patterns.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience migrating from SQL Server or Oracle to PostgreSQL.
* Experience with multi-tenant (database-per-client) setups.
* Basic C# / .NET knowledge.
* Domain knowledge of retail, ERP, accounting, or inventory systems is highly desirable.

**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.

**What You'll Work On**

* Enterprise Retail ERP Platform
* Data Model Modernization
* Stored Procedure and Trigger Refactoring
* Data Migration and Reconciliation
* Data Archival
* High-volume Transaction Processing
* Performance and Scalability Engineering

**What We Look For**

* Deep hands-on database skills.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Precision with data and numbers.
* Ownership mindset with a focus on delivering business value.
* Good communication with development teams.

**Why Join Us**

* Opportunity to modernize a large-scale enterprise Retail ERP platform.
* Work on cloud-native, event-driven, and distributed systems.
* Solve challenging scalability and performance problems.
* Collaborate with experienced architects and product engineering teams.
* Play a key role in shaping the technical direction of a mission-critical product

**Benefits**
We like to think that talent grows at Ginesys and stays at Ginesys. To ensure this, we provide our employees with the best working environment, the latest technology and continuous support. We go out of our way to retain the small business feeling with which we started and stimulate innovation and collaboration through teamwork and our non-hierarchical approach. We offer competitive salary, and other fantastic perks and benefits, such as:
  
  
Ginesys Academy for holistic training and development Comprehensive health insurance coverage Excellent rewards and recognition policy
  
  
Transparent compensation policy with no unnecessary deduction in CTC Annual company off-site and a variety of events, celebrations throughout the year
  
  
Travelling opportunities between our offices across the country. Annual Ginesys walkathon & related sporting events. Quarterly Coffee with the CEO and more!
  
  
**Here’s our story; now tell us yours**
Ginesys is India’s best omni retail suite backed by Ginesys, the first integrated Retail specific ERP software for online retail, offline retail and distribution. It is the largest Indian company in the retail tech industry catering to both online and offline needs. 1200 + brands including (Manyavar, V-Mart, Skechers) are accelerating their businesses with Ginesys. With a team of 400+ employees, Ginesys One plans to revolutionize retail by being a single-stop cloud-based retail suite. We have a pan India presence with offices in major cities including Gurgaon, Kolkata, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Coimbatore & Goa and are expanding rapidly. We love the challenges of retail and are busy solving them to create a great retail tech suite. Ginesys core mission is to continue to build world-class internal service capabilities, in a bid to deliver outstanding external service value to customers. We are an ISO-certified and SOC compliant company having won myriad awards for our innovation and support. For further information, please visit our website http://ginesys.in

title: Senior Marketing Analyst
description:
The Senior Analyst, Marketing Analytics is a data specialist on Global Digital Marketing Analytics team, responsible for building and maintaining trustworthy, well-structured datasets and dashboards behind the team's marketing reporting. The focus is reliable data — correctly sourced, assembled, and validated — and reports the team can trust.

This is a role for someone who works with data fluently and independently: able to take a reporting goal, determine what data it requires, and shape it into a sound dataset and a clear dashboard. It suits someone who takes ownership of quality — checking for completeness, confirming data is merged correctly, validating against source systems, and catching problems before they reach a report.

It is also a role for someone who wants to work smarter, more efficiently. We expect this person to bring AI into how they work day to day — using it to speed up data preparation, validation, and dashboard development — and to continuously look for opportunities to automate repetitive work, so the team’s reporting runs faster and more reliably.

What you’ll do

Data Sourcing & Preparation

• Determine the data required for reporting purposes, identifying the right sources and the appropriate fields to meet them.

• Build and prototype datasets structured for clean, efficient consumption in the reporting platform, using AI to accelerate preparation and increase automation.

• Combine data across multiple sources, ensuring it is merged and transformed correctly for the intended use.

Quality & Validation

• Validate data for completeness and accuracy throughout the workflow and against source systems, applying AI to speed up checks and surface issues earlier.

• Critically review and validate AI-generated output.

• Own data quality as a standard, building checks into the process and serving as the quality backstop the team relies on.

• Investigate and resolve discrepancies, recognizing when results do not hold up and tracing them to their source.

Reporting & Dashboards

• Build, prototype, and maintain dashboards and BI products in the team's reporting platform.

• Keep BI products accurate, current, and reliable over time, refining outputs as needs evolve.

• Develop and maintain documentation for datasets, dashboards, and data processes, keeping it clear and current.

• Identify and automate repetitive reporting tasks, reducing manual effort and turnaround time.

• Handle ad-hoc data pulls and requests, turning them around with accuracy and appropriate context.

• Coordinate with the broader BI and insights teams so datasets and dashboards support how reporting and interpretation are used.

Ways of working

• Look for opportunities to work smarter — evaluating new AI tools and approaches and adopting them where they raise the quality or efficiency of the team's data and reporting work.

What you’ll need

• 3–5 years of experience working hands-on with data analysis and reporting; experience in marketing analytics or digital analytics a plus.

• Strong data preparation and transformation skills, with the ability to source, combine, and shape data from multiple systems into clean, reliable datasets. Proficiency in SQL for querying, combining, and transforming data; Python a plus.

• Strong, hands-on skills building dashboards and BI products in Power BI; Data Studio (Looker) experience a plus.

• Comfort using and experimenting with AI tools, and an interest in applying them to automate and improve data and reporting work.

• Familiarity with the digital marketing stack a plus (e.g., Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Customer Data Platform).

• Strong attention to detail and a sense of ownership over the accuracy of what the team produces.

• Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative, business, or related field.

title: Finance Manager - Digital Media / Performance Marketing
description:
**Location:**
Delhi

**Department:**
Finance & Accounts

**Reporting To:**
CFO / Finance Head

**Experience:**
8-10 years

**Industry:**
Digital Media / Performance Marketing / Advertising / E-commerce

**1. Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced and commercially oriented
**Finance Manager**
to manage the company's finance and accounting operations and provide accurate, timely financial information to management.

The role will have a strong focus on
**revenue accounting, digital advertising spend, client profitability, cash-flow management, MIS, budgeting, financial controls, taxation and compliance**
.

The Finance Manager will work closely with the
**Media Buying, Ad Operations, Client Servicing, HR and Management teams**
to ensure financial discipline and profitability across campaigns and clients.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Accounting & Financial Operations**

* Manage day-to-day accounting and ensure books are maintained accurately and on a timely basis.
* Review sales, purchase, expense, bank and ledger entries.
* Monitor accounts receivable and accounts payable.
* Ensure timely monthly and year-end closing of accounts.
* Review revenue recognition, accruals, provisions and prepaid expenses.
* Coordinate with auditors and external consultants for statutory audits and tax matters.
* Maintain proper documentation and financial records.

**B. Revenue & Client Accounting**

* Monitor client-wise revenue and billing.
* Reconcile invoices with client contracts, campaign performance and supporting documentation.
* Track unbilled revenue, deferred revenue, credit notes and sales adjustments.
* Review client receivables and ageing.
* Coordinate with the business team for timely collections.
* Prepare client-wise revenue and profitability reports.

**C. Digital Advertising / Media Spend Control**

* Monitor
  **client-wise and campaign-wise advertising spend**
  .
* Reconcile media spend with platforms, agency balances, invoices and accounting records.
* Review campaign budgets versus actual spending.
* Monitor prepaid balances and funds transferred for media buying.
* Identify unusual or excess spending and escalate exceptions.
* Ensure proper reconciliation of platforms such as Google, Meta and other advertising channels.
* Develop controls to ensure media spend is properly authorised, recorded and recovered from clients.

**D. MIS & Management Reporting**

Prepare and present monthly/weekly MIS covering:

* Revenue by client/campaign.
* Advertising spend.
* Gross margin and contribution margin.
* Client-wise profitability.
* EBITDA and EBITDA margin.
* Revenue vs. advertising spend.
* Budget vs. actual performance.
* Receivables and collections.
* Cash-flow position.
* Working capital.
* Major cost movements.
* Employee and departmental costs.
* Variance analysis.

Provide management with clear explanations for significant financial variances and business trends.

**E. Budgeting & Forecasting**

* Prepare annual budgets and periodic forecasts.
* Develop client-wise and department-wise budgets.
* Prepare cash-flow forecasts.
* Monitor actual performance against budgets.
* Support management in pricing and commercial decisions.
* Analyse campaign economics and expected profitability.
* Provide financial inputs for business expansion and new client opportunities.

**F. Financial Controls & Process Improvement**

* Establish and monitor internal financial controls.
* Review approval processes for expenses, media spend and payments.
* Implement proper maker-checker controls.
* Identify financial leakage, duplicate payments and reconciliation differences.
* Improve accounting and reporting processes through automation.
* Develop SOPs for finance and operational processes.
* Ensure proper segregation of duties within the finance function.

**G. Taxation & Statutory Compliance**

* Coordinate GST, TDS, Income Tax and other statutory compliances.
* Review GST implications of domestic and export digital marketing services.
* Monitor TDS deductions and reconciliations.
* Coordinate with tax consultants and statutory auditors.
* Ensure timely filing of returns and payment of statutory dues.
* Support FEMA / foreign remittance and cross-border transaction compliance wherever applicable.

**H. Payroll & Employee Costs**

* Review monthly payroll workings.
* Monitor salary payable, incentives, bonuses and employee reimbursements.
* Reconcile payroll with accounting records.
* Review employee cost against approved budgets.
* Coordinate with HR for payroll-related financial matters.

**I. Banking & Treasury**

* Monitor daily bank balances and cash position.
* Prepare weekly and monthly cash-flow forecasts.
* Manage payment schedules and working capital.
* Review bank reconciliations.
* Coordinate with banks for working capital facilities and other financial requirements.
* Monitor utilisation of credit facilities and financial obligations.

**3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

The Finance Manager will be evaluated based on:

* Timely monthly financial closure.
* Accuracy of financial statements and MIS.
* Timely statutory compliance.
* Reduction in reconciliation and accounting discrepancies.
* Receivables ageing and collection efficiency.
* Accuracy of media-spend reconciliation.
* Client-wise profitability reporting.
* Budget vs. actual variance control.
* Cash-flow forecasting accuracy.
* Reduction of financial leakage.
* Improvement in finance processes and internal controls.

**4. Required Qualifications**

**Mandatory:**

* CA-Inter / CMA / MBA Finance / M.Com / equivalent qualification.
* 5–8 years of relevant finance and accounting experience.
* Strong experience in MIS and financial analysis.
* Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills.
* Experience with accounting ERP/software.

**Preferred:**

* Experience in digital media, advertising, performance marketing, SaaS, e-commerce or technology businesses.
* Experience handling high-volume transactions.
* Knowledge of digital advertising platforms and media-spend reconciliation.
* Experience in client profitability analysis.

**5. Technical Skills**

* Advanced Excel / Google Sheets.
* Financial modelling and MIS.
* Budgeting and forecasting.
* P&L and balance-sheet analysis.
* Cash-flow management.
* GST, TDS and Income Tax.
* ERP/accounting software.
* Bank and ledger reconciliation.
* Dashboard and management reporting.
* Financial controls and process documentation.

**6. Behavioural Competencies**

* Strong analytical and numerical ability.
* Commercial/business-oriented mindset.
* High attention to detail.
* Strong ownership and accountability.
* Ability to work with cross-functional teams.
* Ability to challenge financial irregularities constructively.
* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to work under tight monthly reporting deadlines.
* Problem-solving and process-improvement mindset.

**7. Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate should be
**more than an accounting professional**
. The person should understand how a digital media business makes money and should be capable of connecting:

**Client Revenue → Media Spend → Gross Margin → Operating Costs → EBITDA → Cash Flow**

The Finance Manager should be able to identify profitability issues at the
**client, campaign and business-unit level**
and provide management with actionable financial insights.

**8. Key Deliverables**

**Daily**

* Bank and cash position.
* Media-spend monitoring.
* Critical receivable/payment follow-up.
* Exception reporting.

**Weekly**

* Revenue and collection dashboard.
* Media spend vs. budget.
* Client profitability monitoring.
* Cash-flow forecast.
* Outstanding reconciliation items.

**Monthly**

* Closing of books.
* P&L and balance sheet.
* Client-wise profitability.
* Revenue vs. media spend.
* EBITDA analysis.
* Budget vs. actual MIS.
* Receivables/payables ageing.
* Management dashboard.

**Quarterly**

* Forecast revision.
* Business profitability review.
* Cost optimisation analysis.
* Working-capital review.
* Internal-control review.

Lumapin helps local businesses like clinics, salons, gyms, cafés, restaurants and coaching centres get more calls and customers from Google Maps, Google Search, Instagram and AI answers, and shows them the results every month. Lumapin is a product of Petdos Online Private Limited.

The role

We're hiring our first Inside Sales Specialist. You'll sell Lumapin to business owners and multi-branch franchisees, mostly by phone and video from our Noida office, with field trips across North India. You'll work directly with the founders and help build our sales playbook.

What you'll do

• Call, email, WhatsApp and visit business owners and multi-branch franchisees

• Run a free Lumapin audit and walk owners through it

• Demo the app and close monthly or annual subscriptions

• Help new customers get set up in their first week

• Keep your pipeline up to date in the CRM and hit monthly targets

What we're looking for

• 2-3 years of experience selling software (SaaS) against a sales target - this is a must

• Experience selling to small business owners is a big plus (SMB SaaS, local SEO, digital marketing, Justdial or IndiaMART)

• Fluent Hindi and good English; Punjabi is a bonus

How we sell

We never promise a #1 ranking or guaranteed calls. We show the gap, fix it, and report real results every month.

Pay

Rs 30,000-40,000 per month fixed + uncapped incentive on every customer you close and keep.

Location: Noida (head office), on-site.

To apply, send your CV to hi@getlumapin.com

description:
**Country Sales Director, Delhi NCR / Noida, India. Role Type: Full Time**

**MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS
: 10+ Years of Healthcare Technology Sales Exp**

Cancard Inc is looking for an experienced, engaged, and hands-on healthcare sales leader for the position of Country Sales Director, to help drive development, launch and successful commercialization of an innovative portfolio of healthcare hardware and technology products across India, starting with Delhi / NCR.

Cancard, Inc is a multi-technology company operating in Markham (Toronto) since in 1989. Both Cancard and its sister business Advaa Health are pioneering the transformation of primary healthcare through technological innovation. Our mission is to empower physicians, nurses, caregivers and providers with state-of-the-art digital tools and solutions to improve long term patient outcomes, while reducing readmissions, chronic disease management, administrative burden on nurses and caregivers and over-all cost to serve. In an era where healthcare professionals face increasing paperwork and complex administrative tasks, we stand as a key partner in enabling physicians to focus on what truly matters—patient care.

We are seeking an ambitious, results-oriented, and entrepreneurial Sales Managers to lead business development and sales efforts starting with our AI Scheduling & Queue Management solution across India. This role is ideal for a senior sales professional with a proven track record in healthcare technology sales who is looking to build and scale a business and ultimately grow into a Country Head leadership position.

Successful candidate will be responsible for driving new customer acquisition, developing strategic partnerships, building a high-performing sales organization, and establishing our solution as a leading patient flow, appointment scheduling, and queue management platform within hospitals, healthcare networks, diagnostic chains, clinics, and other customer-facing enterprises. This is a high-impact role requiring both hands-on sales execution and strategic leadership capabilities.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Revenue Growth & Business Development**

·       Drive end-to-end sales activities, from prospect identification and lead generation through contract negotiation and closure to achieve and exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets.

·       Build and manage a robust pipeline of opportunities across healthcare providers, hospital groups, diagnostic centers, clinics, and healthcare ecosystems.

·       Identify and pursue strategic opportunities within government healthcare initiatives, healthcare networks, and enterprise accounts.

·       Develop account penetration strategies for large healthcare organizations and multi-location healthcare groups.

·       Create territory plans and go-to-market strategies to accelerate market adoption.

·       Engage with hospital administrators, CIOs, CEOs, Operations Heads, Patient Experience Leaders, and Digital Transformation teams.

·       Understand customer workflows and recommend tailored solutions addressing appointment scheduling, patient flow optimization, queue management, self-service check-in, and operational efficiency.

·       Stay informed on healthcare technology trends, regulations, and market developments.

**Strategic Account Management**

·       Build long-term relationships with key decision-makers and executive stakeholders.

·       Develop executive-level business cases and ROI-driven value propositions.

·       Lead complex sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders and procurement processes.

·       Negotiate commercial agreements and manage enterprise contract discussions.

·       Ensure smooth handoff and collaboration with implementation and customer success teams.

**Channel & Partnership Development**

·       Identify and develop strategic partnerships with healthcare consultants, technology integrators, channel partners, and healthcare associations.

·       Build referral networks within the healthcare ecosystem.

·       Explore opportunities for alliances with hospital information system providers, EMR vendors, and digital health solution providers.

·       Develop partnership programs that contribute to revenue growth and market expansion.

**Team Building & Leadership**

·       Participate in hiring, mentoring, and developing future sales team members.

·       Establish sales processes, forecasting methodologies, and performance metrics.

·       Create scalable sales playbooks and best practices.

·       Coach and mentor junior sales professionals as the organization grows.

·       Foster a culture of accountability, customer focus, and high performance.

**Market Expansion & Future Leadership**

·       Contribute to overall business strategy and market expansion initiatives.

·       Provide leadership with competitive intelligence and market insights.

·       Participate in pricing, product positioning, and go-to-market planning.

·       Support expansion into new verticals and geographic markets.

·       Demonstrate the leadership capability, commercial acumen, and strategic vision required for progression into a future Country Head role.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

·      MBA from a reputed institution preferred.

·      8–15 years of enterprise B2B sales experience, with at least 5 years in healthcare technology, digital health, hospital IT solutions, healthcare SaaS, patient engagement platforms, healthcare workflow systems, or related technology solutions.

·      Experience working in high-growth technology companies or startups preferred.

·      Existing understanding, and relationship within hospital groups, healthcare chains, and healthcare technology ecosystem in Delhi / NCR, North and other Indian Regions.

·      Demonstrated success selling solutions to hospitals, healthcare groups, diagnostic chains, healthcare providers, or healthcare government agencies.

title: AIOps-Agentic AI  Architect
description:
Role Summary

We are hiring hands-on Developers and Engineers to design, build, and deploy production-grade Agentic AI solutions on Aisera and similar platforms (ServiceNow AI and open agent frameworks) across client engagements. You will develop autonomous and multi-agent systems that reason, plan, and execute — integrating LLMs with enterprise systems to automate ITSM, operations, and business workflows, and remaining hands-on through to delivery.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop, configure, and deploy AI agents using Aisera’s platform and comparable agentic AI toolsets to solve real-world client workflows.
* Build autonomous and multi-agent systems capable of planning, reasoning, tool selection, and task execution.
* Design and implement RAG pipelines, function/tool calling, memory and context management, and agent orchestration.
* Integrate agents with external systems — APIs, webhooks, databases, CRMs, ITSM platforms, and data pipelines — for seamless workflow execution.
* Apply prompt engineering and configuration tuning to optimize agent accuracy, latency, and cost in complex enterprise environments.
* Translate business requirements into functional and technical agent designs; run interactive demos and PoCs and iterate on feedback.
* Build scalable backend services/microservices for AI applications; ensure testing, monitoring, and CI/CD best practices.
* Implement AI governance, security, and compliance controls (auth flows, responsible-AI safeguards, observability of agent behavior).
* Troubleshoot, monitor, and continuously improve deployed agents using data-driven evaluation (A/B testing, performance monitoring).

Required Skills & Experience

* 8–12 years in software development, AI/ML engineering, or systems integration, with recent hands-on Agentic AI / LLM delivery.
* Hands-on experience with Aisera or comparable agentic AI / conversational AIOps platforms (ServiceNow AI Agents, Automation Anywhere, similar).
* Strong programming in Python (primary), plus Java and/or JavaScript; clean, efficient, production-quality code.
* Proven experience building agents with LLM frameworks — LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or PydanticAI.
* Solid understanding of LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, RAG, function calling, and agent evaluation.
* Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and multi-agent architectures (preferred).
* Integration experience: REST APIs, webhooks, data pipelines; OAuth/OIDC/JWT authorization flows.
* Cloud & DevOps: AWS, Azure, or GCP, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), CI/CD, and monitoring.
* Familiarity with AI/LLM observability tooling (Langfuse, ELK) is highly desirable.
* Strong problem-solving, customer-facing communication, and the ability to work independently.

Qualifications

* Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or a related field.
* Relevant cloud/AI certifications are a plus.
* Knowledge of AI governance frameworks (e.g., ISO/IEC 42001) is a nice-to-have.

title: Forward Deployment AI Solutions Engineer
description:
**Position: Forward Deployment AI Solutions Engineer**

**Location: Noida**

**Role Type: Full Time**

Cancard Inc has been a multi-technology company based in Markham (Toronto) since 1989. Both Cancard and its sister company, Advaa Health, are at the forefront of transforming primary healthcare through technological innovation. Our mission is to empower primary care physicians with state-of-the-art digital tools and solutions that streamline their practices and significantly reduce administrative burdens and operational costs. Amidst increasing paperwork and complex administrative tasks faced by healthcare professionals, we serve as a key partner, enabling physicians to focus on patient care.

Our healthcare product portfolio leverages cutting-edge technologies in data analytics, artificial intelligence, and cloud computing to offer seamless, intuitive, and cost-effective solutions. By integrating our systems, primary care practices can enhance patient engagement, optimize appointment scheduling, automate billing and coding processes, and access comprehensive patient health records in real-time. These advancements not only improve the quality of care provided but also contribute to a significant reduction in overhead costs.

This position is a great opportunity for Software Engineers who are passionate about solving critical healthcare challenges, to learn and grow with the company. This position will have direct experience and exposure to customers in US, Canada, and other global markets.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

·        Collaborate with global commercial team to understand unmet needs, market opportunities and translate these insights into actionable product portfolio plan that delivers improvement in patient care, while reducing cost and ease of use for physicians.

·        Develop detailed product development road map and prioritize execution plans delivering differentiated products on time and within budget while meeting the performance and quality expectations from customers.

·        Lead hiring, training and development of in-house software development team based on organization competency goals. Develop and execute in-house core software programming capability plans to support execution of strategic plans.

·        Responsible for developing yearly budgets and resourcing plans for the software development team.

·       Lead customer calls in collaboration with sales and marketing teams to ensure customer needs are well understood and then accurately translated into design requirements. Develop project delivery plans with accurate estimate of delivery times and costs for any customizations.

·       Develop discipline in reporting regular, timely and complete progress reports on product launch plans. Identify and share any high risk and critical paths that may impact delivery times.

·        Develop a network of in-house and external customer support teams to ensure training and successful onboarding of new customers as well as prompt response for all customers.

·       Write well designed, testable, efficient code when needed to support timely development and delivery of products and projects.

·       Support continuous improvement by investigating alternatives and technologies and presenting these for architectural review.

·       Designing and developing high-volume, low-latency applications for mission-critical systems and delivering high-availability and performance.

·       Comply with applicable laws and regulations, including but not limited to those pertaining to the marketing and sale of medical products to healthcare professionals.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

· Degree in Computer Science Engineering with minimum 2 years’ experience with designing, developing, testing, implementing, and supporting large scale cloud solutions.

· Mid-level programming knowledge of Java, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Hibernate, Restful and SOAP API’s, Microservices, and other back-end, deployment technologies.

· Prefer candidates with experience in US healthcare interoperability, HL7 and FHIR standards.

· Working knowledge of front-end technologies, Angular 10, React, and other JavaScript frameworks like Node.js.

· Experience in working on products that meet HITRUST and SOC 2 security standards.

· Strong training entire software development lifecycle while adopting an Agile approach.

· Ability to diagnose issues and respond in a timely fashion to contain major breakdowns is required.

**WHAT WE OFFER:**

• Competitive salary and benefits package.

• Flexible working hours.

• A dynamic and supportive work environment with opportunities for professional growth and development.

• The chance to work on meaningful projects that have a real impact on healthcare.

**HOW TO APPLY:**

Please submit your resume, cover letter, and any relevant work samples or project portfolios to HR@cancard.com. In your cover letter, explain why you're interested in this role and how your background and experience make you a good fit for our team.

We thank all applicants for their interest in joining Cancard, but only those selected for an interview will be contacted. Cancard is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: AI Lead – Agentic AI & Multi-Agent Systems (Immediate Joinee Preferred)
description:
5+ Years Experience, Technical Leadership, Hands-on Role

About Fegmo

Fegmo is building an AI-powered commerce intelligence platform that transforms product catalogues into intelligent, actionable commerce experiences. We are building autonomous AI agents that work together to solve complex commerce problems involving product discovery, enrichment, comparison, recommendations and decision-making.

We are looking for a rockstar AI Lead who can take ownership of our AI architecture, build intelligent agents, and lead the development of a scalable, production-ready multi-agent platform.

What We Are Looking For

Someone who:

* Has 5+ years of experience in AI/ML, Generative AI and applied AI engineering.
* Has hands-on experience building and deploying autonomous AI agents in production.
* Has designed and implemented multi-agent orchestration and coordination architectures (agents collaborating, delegating tasks, sharing context and producing unified outcomes).
* Can independently design AI architecture and make sound technical decisions.
* Is equally comfortable writing Python code, designing systems and leading a small engineering team.
* Can take an idea from concept to production without needing extensive hand-holding.
* Understands the difference between building an AI demo and building a reliable, scalable AI product.

Key Responsibilities

1. Agentic AI Architecture

* Design and build multi-agent systems with specialized agents working together.
* Develop agent orchestration, task delegation, workflow coordination and execution mechanisms.
* Design agent communication protocols, shared context, memory and state management.
* Build reusable agent frameworks that support dynamic registration of agents and tools.

2. AI Agent Development

* Build intelligent agents for product discovery, product intelligence, comparison, recommendations and commerce workflows.
* Develop agents using Python and modern LLM frameworks.
* Implement tool calling, function calling, structured outputs and context management.
* Build agents capable of interacting with APIs, databases, knowledge graphs and external services.

3. LLM Engineering

* Work with leading LLMs such as Gemini, GPT and Claude.
* Design effective prompting strategies, RAG pipelines and context engineering.
* Optimize token consumption, inference latency and model costs.
* Implement model selection, fallback strategies and evaluation mechanisms.

4. System Design & Scalability

* Design scalable, modular and loosely coupled AI services.
* Build tenant-aware AI architectures where each customer can have independently configurable agents, tools and data sources.
* Implement asynchronous agent execution, queues, retries and failure handling.
* Ensure observability, traceability and reliability of AI workflows.

5. Technical Leadership

* Own the AI engineering roadmap and architecture.
* Lead and mentor AI engineers.
* Establish coding standards, testing practices and AI evaluation frameworks.
* Work closely with product and engineering teams to translate business requirements into production-ready AI capabilities.

Required Technical Skills

Area

Expected expertise

Programming

Strong Python, asynchronous programming, FastAPI

Agentic AI

Multi-agent systems, agent orchestration, tool calling

Frameworks

LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, OpenAI Agents SDK or equivalent

LLMs

Gemini, GPT, Claude, open-source LLMs

RAG

Embeddings, vector databases, retrieval pipelines

Data

MySQL, Elasticsearch, Neo4j, Redis

Infrastructure

Docker, Kubernetes, GCP/AWS

Observability

LangSmith, tracing, evaluation and monitoring

Architecture

Microservices, event-driven systems, distributed systems

Good to Have

* Experience building agentic commerce, e-commerce or enterprise AI applications.
* Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Knowledge Graphs and Graph-based reasoning.
* Experience with recommendation engines and product intelligence.
* Experience building production-grade AI platforms for multiple enterprise customers.
* Understanding of AI evaluation, guardrails and human-in-the-loop workflows.

What Success Looks Like

In the first 90 days, the person should be able to:

* Own and establish Fegmo's agentic AI architecture.
* Build a working multi-agent orchestration platform.
* Develop reusable agents and tool integration capabilities.
* Implement end-to-end agent workflows for product discovery, comparison and recommendations.
* Establish tracing, evaluation and observability.
* Lead the AI engineering team and independently drive delivery.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are not looking for someone who has simply integrated OpenAI APIs or built chatbot applications.

We want someone who has built the intelligence layer of an AI product - someone who understands how agents reason, collaborate, use tools, exchange structured information, recover from failures and execute complex workflows.

The candidate should be a strong individual contributor first and a technical leader second.

title: Oracle EPM-EDMCS Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
**About Sopra Steria**
Sopra Steria, a major Tech player in Europe with 51,000 employees in nearly 30 countries, is recognised for its consulting, digital services and solutions. It helps its clients drive their digital transformation and obtain tangible and sustainable benefits. The Group provides end-to-end solutions to make large companies and organisations more competitive by combining in-depth knowledge of a wide range of business sectors and innovative technologies with a collaborative approach. Sopra Steria places people at the heart of everything it does and is committed to putting digital to work for its clients in order to build a positive future for all. In 2025, the Group generated revenues of €5.6 billion.
  
  
**Job Description**
**The world is how we shape it.**
**Job Summary:**
**The Oracle EPM EDMCS Techno-Functional Consultant is responsible for leading the design, implementation, and support of Oracle’s EDMCS solution. This position combines strong technical skills with functional expertise in data governance, ensuring enterprise data management processes are aligned with business goals. The consultant will work closely with stakeholders across finance, IT, and business teams to configure EDMCS solutions and integrate them with broader EPM and ERP systems.**
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Requirements Gathering & Analysis:
* Collaborate with business users and stakeholders to capture functional and technical requirements for enterprise data management.
* Perform gap analysis to understand business needs and how Oracle EDMCS can address them.
* Provide recommendations for improving data governance, consistency, and accuracy.
* Solution Design & Configuration:
* Design EDMCS structures, including applications, views, viewpoints, and nodes, to manage hierarchical and reference data.
* Configure EDMCS solutions to enable data governance, approvals, and workflows for managing enterprise data across financial systems.
* Set up integration points between EDMCS and other Oracle EPM and ERP systems like EPBCS, FCCS, Oracle ERP Cloud, and external systems.
* Data Management & Governance:
* Define and implement data management workflows, validation rules, and governance processes.
* Work on the alignment and synchronization of master data between EDMCS and downstream systems.
* Ensure compliance with organizational policies and regulatory requirements for data governance.
* Technical Configuration & Integration:
* Develop integration solutions between EDMCS and Oracle ERP/EPM systems, utilizing APIs, data management tools, and third-party applications.
* Configure and manage data mappings, validations, and transformations in EDMCS.
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to system performance, integrations, and data discrepancies.
* Testing, Deployment & Documentation:
* Lead system testing efforts, including unit testing, system integration testing (SIT), and user acceptance testing (UAT).
* Manage data migration activities during implementation, ensuring data accuracy and completeness.
* Develop and maintain technical and functional documentation, including design documents, configuration guides, and user manuals.
* Post-Implementation Support:
* Provide post-go-live support for EDMCS, including troubleshooting, system maintenance, and optimization.
* Assist in training end-users on EDMCS functionality, data governance, and system workflows.
* Continuously monitor system performance and implement enhancements as needed.
* Collaboration & Communication:
* Serve as the point of contact between business teams and technical staff for EDMCS-related projects.
* Provide regular updates to project managers, stakeholders, and business leads on project progress.
* Conduct workshops, training sessions, and presentations for stakeholders and users.

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

* Functional Expertise:
* Strong understanding of enterprise data management, master data governance, and data hierarchies.
* Experience with financial and operational planning processes, including budgeting, forecasting, and reporting.
* Hands-on experience implementing Oracle EDMCS in complex, multi-system environments.
* Technical Skills:
* Proficiency in Oracle EDMCS, including configuration of applications, views, properties, and workflows.
* Familiarity with Oracle EPM suite components (EPBCS, FCCS, ARCS) and ERP systems (Oracle ERP Cloud, Oracle Fusion, or others).
* Knowledge of data integration techniques using Oracle Data Management tools, APIs, and file-based integrations.
* Experience with scripting (e.g., SQL, EPM Automate) and integration tools (e.g., FDMEE, ODI).
* Soft Skills:
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to business stakeholders.
* Proven ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

**Education & Certifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Finance, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Oracle EPM Cloud certification, especially EDMCS, is highly preferred.
* 5+ years of experience in Oracle EPM/ERP implementations, with a focus on data management.

**Qualifications**
Any Graduate
  
  
**Additional Information**
Role is Open for Noida & Bengaluru location

* **Job Title: Sales Executive**
* **Company:** STM Journals
* **Department:** Sales and Business Development
* **Industry:** Publishing, Academic and Research Services
* **Location:** A118, 1st Floor, Sector 63, Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India (Work from Office)
* **Job Type:** Full-time, Permanent
* **Experience Required:** 1 to 3 years
* **Key Skills: Sales, Lead Generation, B2B Sales, Inside Sales, Client Acquisition, Cold Calling, Email Outreach, LinkedIn Outreach, Negotiation, CRM, MS Office**

About STM Journals

STM Journals is a scholarly publishing house that publishes peer-reviewed journals in science, technology, engineering, medicine and management. We help researchers, universities, institutions and libraries share and access quality research. Join us to build a sales career in the fast-growing academic publishing industry.

Role Overview

We are hiring a Sales Executive to generate leads, build relationships with academic and research clients, and close sales of our journals, subscriptions and publication services. If you enjoy talking to people, like working toward targets and want a role where your results are rewarded, this is for you.

Key Responsibilities

* Generate new leads through cold calling, email campaigns, LinkedIn outreach and other digital channels.
* Sell journals, subscriptions and publication services to universities, colleges, research institutes, libraries and researchers.
* Understand client needs, present suitable solutions and share quotations and proposals.
* Follow up on leads and move them through the sales pipeline to closure.
* Build and maintain long-term relationships with existing and prospective clients.
* Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets.
* Record leads, calls, follow-ups and conversions in the CRM or tracking sheets.
* Coordinate with the editorial, production and accounts teams for smooth delivery and timely payment collection.
* Track market trends and competitors, and share feedback with management.
* Prepare regular sales and performance reports.

Required Skills and Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline (MBA or PGDM in Marketing or Sales preferred).
* 1 to 3 years of experience in sales, inside sales, business development, lead generation or client acquisition.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in English and Hindi.
* Good negotiation, presentation and follow-up skills.
* Working knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and email.
* Comfortable with cold calling and handling objections.
* Self-motivated, target-driven and able to manage time independently.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in publishing, EdTech, academic services or the education sector.
* Understanding of scholarly publishing, journal indexing and the research ecosystem.
* Experience with CRM tools and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

Why Join STM Journals?

* Salary of ₹18,000 – ₹35,000 per month, based on your experience and interview performance.
* Performance-linked incentives, so your results are rewarded.
* Hands-on exposure to the scholarly publishing industry.
* Learning and mentoring from an experienced team.
* A clear growth path for high performers.
* A supportive, professional work environment in Sector 63, Noida.

Interview Details

**Interview Location:** STM Journals, A118, 1st Floor, Sector 63, Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India

Please bring your updated resume and a valid photo ID.

How to Apply

Ready to grow your sales career? Email your updated resume to hr@celnet.in, call 9218088228, or walk in for an interview at the address above. Mention "Sales Executive" in your email subject line.

Pay: ₹18,000.00 - ₹34,000.00 per month

title: SEO Link Building Specialist
description:
We're Hiring | SEO Link Building Specialist (Off-Page SEO)
  
  
Company: Arobit Business Solutions Pvt. Ltd.
  
Division: Arobit Digital
  
Location: Kolkata, West Bengal, India
  
Experience: 1–2 Years
  
Employment Type: Full-Time
  
  
About Arobit Business Solutions Pvt. Ltd.
  
  
Arobit Business Solutions Pvt. Ltd. provides technology and digital marketing solutions to businesses across multiple industries. Through Arobit Digital, we help brands strengthen their online presence, improve organic search visibility, and achieve sustainable digital growth.
  
  
We are expanding our SEO team and looking for a skilled SEO Link Building Specialist with practical experience in backlink acquisition, off-page SEO, SEO outreach, and publisher relationship management.
  
  
Job Overview
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for managing link-building campaigns for 4–5 client websites simultaneously.
  
  
The primary responsibility will be to identify, research, negotiate, and acquire high-quality backlinks from authoritative and niche-specific websites to strengthen clients' backlink profiles, improve domain authority, and support organic search rankings.
  
  
Candidates should be comfortable both researching new backlink opportunities independently and working on prospect lists provided by our internal SEO team.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
1. Link Building & Backlink Acquisition
  
  
- Plan and execute off-page SEO and link-building strategies for multiple client websites.
  
- Research and identify high-authority, niche-relevant websites for backlink opportunities.
  
- Identify guest posting, contextual backlink, editorial link, resource page, and industry-specific link opportunities.
  
- Analyse competitor backlink profiles to discover potential link-building opportunities.
  
- Build quality referring domains to strengthen clients' backlink profiles.
  
  
2. SEO Outreach & Negotiation
  
  
- Conduct email outreach to website owners, bloggers, publishers, webmasters, and industry-specific portals.
  
- Build relationships with relevant publishers and website owners.
  
- Negotiate backlink placements through different acquisition models, including:
  
- Paid link placements.
  
- Guest posting and content collaborations.
  
- Reciprocal and three-way link exchanges.
  
- Barter-based collaborations.
  
- Referral-based partnerships.
  
- Editorial and organic link acquisition.
  
- Negotiate competitive pricing and manage backlink placement agreements.
  
  
3. Backlink Research & Quality Analysis
  
  
- Evaluate websites based on Domain Authority (DA), Domain Rating (DR), organic traffic, niche relevance, and overall website quality.
  
- Use SEO tools to analyse backlink profiles, referring domains, and competitor link strategies.
  
- Identify spammy websites, link farms, and irrelevant backlink opportunities.
  
- Ensure acquired backlinks are relevant to the client's industry, target audience, and website pages.
  
- Monitor acquired backlinks for live status, link attributes, and anchor text.
  
  
4. Multi-Client Campaign Management
  
  
- Independently manage link-building activities for 4–5 client websites across different industries.
  
- Maintain separate backlink prospect databases and acquisition strategies for each client.
  
- Coordinate with SEO executives and content writers for guest posts, anchor texts, and target landing pages.
  
- Track outreach progress, successful placements, and acquisition costs.
  
  
5. Reporting & Performance Tracking
  
  
- Maintain client-wise backlink acquisition reports.
  
- Track new referring domains, acquired backlinks, DA/DR, organic traffic, and niche relevance.
  
- Maintain publisher databases, outreach records, negotiation details, and placement costs.
  
- Share regular progress updates and monthly performance reports.
  
  
Required Skills & Qualifications
  
  
- 1–2+ years of practical experience in SEO Link Building, Off-Page SEO, Backlink Building, or SEO Outreach.
  
- Strong understanding of backlink acquisition and link-building strategies.
  
- Hands-on experience in guest posting, blogger outreach, contextual link building, and publisher negotiations.
  
- Knowledge of Domain Authority (DA), Domain Rating (DR), referring domains, anchor text, and do-follow/nofollow backlinks.
  
- Familiarity with SEO tools such as Ahrefs, Semrush, Moz, and Google Search Console.
  
- Excellent research, communication, email outreach, and negotiation skills.
  
- Ability to independently manage multiple client projects.
  
- Knowledge of international SEO and link building for US/UK markets will be an added advantage.
  
  
What We Are Looking For
  
  
We are looking for someone who understands that successful link building is not just about generating backlinks but about acquiring relevant, authoritative, and valuable links.
  
  
The ideal candidate should be capable of independently discovering opportunities, approaching publishers, negotiating placements, building long-term relationships, and delivering measurable link-building results.
  
  
Candidates with practical experience in paid and non-paid link acquisition models are encouraged to apply.
  
  
How to Apply
  
  
Interested candidates can share their updated CV at:
  
  
careers@arobit.com
  
  
Alternatively, apply directly through LinkedIn.
  
  
Join Arobit Business Solutions Pvt. Ltd. and be a part of our growing digital marketing team!

title: BTL Assistant Manager -Marketing
description:
Job Description: Assistant Manager / Manager – BTL Marketing
  
  
Business Vertical: Wires & Cables
  
  
Company: Sturlite
  
  
Department: Marketing
  
  
Position: Assistant Manager / Deputy Manager / Manager
  
  
Experience: 4 to 5 years of relevant experience
  
  
Reporting To: Head – BTL Marketing
  
  
Location: Bangalore, India
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a dynamic and execution-oriented BTL Marketing professional to drive below-the-line marketing initiatives for Sturlite’s Wires & Cables business. The role will focus on strengthening brand visibility and market presence, enhancing channel engagement, influencing purchase decisions, and driving business growth through targeted trade marketing initiatives and on-ground activations.
  
  
The incumbent will work closely with sales teams, channel partners, distributors, dealers, retailers, electricians, contractors, and other relevant stakeholders to plan and execute impactful BTL programs across key markets.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* BTL Strategy & Execution
* Plan and execute BTL marketing initiatives aligned with business objectives, brand strategy, and sales priorities.
* Develop and implement market-specific activation plans to improve brand awareness, product visibility, and consumer preference.
* Drive on-ground marketing activities, including market activations, promotional campaigns, product demonstrations, roadshows, and local events.
* Ensure timely and effective execution of campaigns across identified markets and sales territories.
* Channel & Trade Marketing
* Design and execute dealer, distributor, and retailer engagement programs to strengthen channel relationships and improve brand preference.
* Develop trade promotion schemes, retail visibility initiatives, point-of-sale (POS) materials, merchandising programs, and in-shop branding.
* Identify opportunities to improve product visibility and brand recall at electrical retail outlets and channel partner locations.
* Collaborate with sales teams to support market expansion, channel activation, new product launches, and achieve business targets.
* Electrician, Contractor & Influencer Engagement
* Plan and execute engagement programs for electricians, electrical contractors, installers, and other key purchase influencers.
* Organize electrician meets, contractor meets, product awareness sessions, technical demonstrations, loyalty programs, and recognition initiatives.
* Support the development of influencer engagement and advocacy programs to improve brand consideration and product recommendations.
* Build and maintain engagement calendars for key influencer segments across priority markets.
* Market Development & Competitor Intelligence
* Work closely with regional and territory sales teams to identify market opportunities and prioritize BTL investments.
* Conduct market visits to assess brand visibility, channel engagement, competitor activities, and effectiveness of existing programs.
* Track competitor promotions, trade schemes, retailer engagement initiatives, and market activation practices.
* Translate field insights into actionable recommendations for improving marketing effectiveness and market penetration.
* Agency & Vendor Management
* Coordinate with activation agencies, event partners, printers, fabricators, and other vendors for campaign execution.
* Develop campaign briefs, evaluate vendor proposals, and ensure quality, cost efficiency, and adherence to timelines.
* Monitor execution quality through field visits, photographic evidence, campaign reports, and stakeholder feedback.
* Ensure adherence to company brand guidelines, procurement processes, and vendor compliance requirements.
* Budgeting & Performance Measurement
* Assist in developing and managing the annual and monthly BTL marketing budgets.
* Track campaign expenditure, vendor payments, and budget utilization against approved plans.
* Define and monitor KPIs such as outlet coverage, number of activations, influencer participation, campaign reach, visibility compliance, cost per activation, and lead or sales contribution wherever measurable.
* Prepare periodic performance dashboards and post-campaign reports, highlighting outcomes, learnings, and improvement opportunities.
* Evaluate the effectiveness and ROI of BTL activities and recommend optimization measures.
* Cross-functional Coordination
* Collaborate with sales, product management, brand marketing, regional marketing, and supply chain teams to ensure integrated execution.
* Support new product launches, seasonal campaigns, regional promotions, and market specific business initiatives.
* Ensure availability of marketing collateral, promotional materials, and campaign-related product information at the right locations and time.
* Share regular updates on campaign progress, market feedback, and key business opportunities with the BTL Head.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely execution of planned BTL activities and campaigns.
* Dealer, retailer, electrician, contractor engagement and participation.
* Retail outlet coverage and quality of in-store branding and visibility.
* Effectiveness of trade promotions and market activation programs.
* Campaign expenditure versus approved budgets.
* Cost efficiency and measurable return on BTL investments.
* Improvement in brand visibility and preference across target markets.
* Contribution to lead generation, channel productivity, and sales growth, wherever attributable.
* Quality and timeliness of campaign reporting and market intelligence.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Education:

MBA/PGDM in Marketing or a relevant postgraduate qualification; candidates with a strong track record in trade marketing or BTL execution may also be considered.
  
  

* Experience:

Approximately 4 to 5 years of relevant experience in BTL marketing, trade marketing, channel marketing, or field marketing.
  
  

* Experience in electricals, wires and cables, building materials, lighting, paints, adhesives, consumer durables, or a similar channel-driven industry is preferred.
* Hands-on experience in dealer and retailer activation, influencer engagement, trade promotions, vendor management, and on-ground campaign execution.
* Experience working with regional sales teams and managing multiple markets or territories is desirable.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong execution, planning, and project management skills.
* Understanding distributors, dealers, retailers, and influencer ecosystems.
* Good commercial acumen, budgeting, and vendor negotiation skills.
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Ability to analyze campaign performance and derive actionable insights.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint; familiarity with marketing dashboards and reporting tools is an advantage.
* Willingness to travel extensively across assigned markets.
* High ownership, accountability, and ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.

title: Senior Manager- Growth and Impact
description:
**About the role**

We are looking for a
**Senior Manager**
to lead strategic engagements with government and ecosystem stakeholders across
**education, skilling, vocational education and others**
. The role will involve working closely with senior government officials to understand priorities, identify system-level opportunities, design and drive high-impact interventions, and translate evidence into actionable policy and program decisions.

The ideal candidate will bring a strong understanding of government systems, excellent stakeholder management skills, strategic problem-solving capabilities, and a strong bias for execution. They should be comfortable operating at the intersection of
**government, technology, data and social impact**
, and be able to move seamlessly between strategic discussions with senior bureaucrats and ground-level implementation.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Government engagement & strategic partnerships**

* Build and manage trusted relationships with senior government officials across education, skilling, and other adjacent domains.
* Engage with senior bureaucrats and department leadership to understand priorities, decision cycles, institutional constraints and emerging opportunities.
* Represent the organisation in strategic discussions with state and central government departments, Sector Skill Councils, industry bodies, employers and other ecosystem stakeholders.
* Act as a strategic thought partner to government stakeholders, bringing evidence, insights and practical recommendations to support policy and program decisions.
* Identify opportunities to align organisational interventions with government priorities, schemes, budgets and existing institutional structures.

**2. Strategy, policy & program design**

* Lead the design and execution of large-scale education and skilling programs in partnership with government, private sector and philanthropy.
* Analyse government policies, schemes, budgets and implementation frameworks to identify opportunities for convergence, optimisation and system-level innovation.
* Develop strategies and program models that address challenges across education, skilling, employability, placement and workforce outcomes.
* Drive
  **evidence-backed policy advocacy**
  and support government stakeholders in translating insights into actionable reforms.
* Work with leadership to develop proposals, partnership models and new program opportunities across states, central government and thematic areas.

**3. Data, research & evidence**

* Translate large and complex datasets into actionable insights for government decision-makers and organisational leadership.
* Develop analytical frameworks, policy briefs, dashboards, visual reports and presentations that enable real-time decision-making.
* Lead research and ecosystem assessments to understand implementation bottlenecks, user needs and opportunities for reform.
* Build evidence bases around outcomes such as learning, skilling, employability, placement, wages and workforce participation.
* Use data and field evidence to identify course corrections and strengthen program design and implementation.

**4. Program execution & impact**

* Own delivery of complex, multi-stakeholder programs from strategy and design through implementation and scale-up.
* Work closely with internal teams across product, technology, analytics, training and program delivery to ensure timely and integrated execution.
* Monitor program milestones, risks, dependencies and impact indicators, proactively identifying and resolving bottlenecks.
* Lead impact articulation through clear measurement, reporting and documentation frameworks.
* Ensure that learnings from implementation are systematically captured and translated into improvements in program strategy and delivery.

**5. Field engagement & implementation intelligence**

* Conduct regular field visits to understand implementation realities, frontline needs and stakeholder experiences.
* Engage with teachers, trainers, students, administrators, employers and other actors to gather ground-level intelligence.
* Bring field insights into policy discussions, program design and strategic decision-making.
* Identify gaps between policy intent and implementation and develop practical recommendations to address them.

**6. Communication & thought leadership**

* Develop compelling narratives, presentations and communication materials that connect field evidence, policy priorities and program outcomes.
* Communicate complex insights clearly to senior government and internal leadership.
* Publish articles, reports and thought pieces that showcase organisational learning and insights from the education and skilling ecosystem.
* Represent the organisation in relevant forums, conferences and ecosystem discussions.

**7. Growth & ecosystem development**

* Identify and shape new opportunities across state government departments and relevant thematic areas.
* Build relationships with ecosystem organisations to broaden policy recommendations and enable adoption.
* Work with leadership to identify potential partnerships, funding opportunities and pathways for scaling successful models.

Qualifications & Experience

* **8+ years of relevant professional experience**
  in management consulting, public policy, government advisory, program management, education, skilling or other relevant domains.
* **MBA, Master’s in Public Policy, Development Studies, Education or a related field**
  preferred.
* Demonstrated experience working with
  **government stakeholders**
  , with government engagement experience being essential.
* Prior experience managing relationships with senior bureaucrats, ideally at the level of
  **Principal Secretary/Secretary/Director and above in State Government**
  .
* Experience in designing or implementing large-scale, multi-stakeholder programs in partnership with government.
* Strong understanding of government schemes, policies, institutional structures, decision-making processes and budgetary mechanisms.
* Experience leveraging
  **technology, digital platforms, data products or Digital Public Infrastructure**
  for social impact is highly desirable.
* Demonstrated experience in using data and evidence to influence policy or program decisions.
* Experience leading teams and managing complex programs with multiple stakeholders.

What we are looking for

* **Strategic thinker with a strong execution bias**
  — able to move from a high-level problem statement to concrete action.
* **High ownership and initiative**
  — comfortable taking responsibility for ambiguous problems and charting a path forward.
* **Strong government orientation**
  — able to build credibility and trusted relationships with senior public-sector stakeholders.
* **Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills**
  — able to synthesise diverse information into clear recommendations.
* **Strong communication skills**
  — able to communicate effectively with senior bureaucrats, frontline stakeholders and internal teams.
* **Collaborative leader**
  who can work across multidisciplinary teams and bring diverse stakeholders together.
* **Data-driven and impact-oriented**
  , with a demonstrated commitment to improving education, skilling and employment outcomes.
* Comfortable working in
  **fast-paced, ambiguous and evolving environments**
  , with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

title: Junior Research Fellow
description:
🚀 URGENT: We are hiring! Active Recruitment: One (1) Junior Research Fellow (JRF)

Opportunities are open for motivated researchers to join the Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF) funded PM ECRG project: "AI-Native Foundations for Interference, Connectivity, and Mobility Optimization in Next-Generation Networks."

**Executive project summary:**
Next-generation Networks (NGNs) are expected to deliver high data rates, uninterrupted services to underserved and unserved communities, increased end-user density, and enhanced communication reliability. The existing wireless mobile networks' transition from Fifth Generation (5G) mobile networks to NGNs, including Beyond 5G (B5G) and 6G technologies, introduces unprecedented architectural complexity, larger network density, and more heterogeneity, making interference management, resource allocation, and service reliability a critical challenge, where end users located in areas with underserved and unserved locations often experience interruptions while accessing broadband services.

This project will deliver novel theoretical models, AI-native algorithmic frameworks, and simulation prototypes suited for real-world NGN operations. Also, the proposal will design a UAV-assisted last-mile connectivity network, which strongly justifies national priority missions, such as Digital India, BharatNet, and the National Digital Communications Policy 2018. Therefore, the proposal also aligns directly with the goals of national connectivity and digital inclusion.

**Keywords:**
Next-Generation Networks, AI-Native Optimization, Multi-Objective CoMP, Mechanism-Design Models, UAV-Assisted Connectivity, AI-Native Mobility & Hand-off.
