title: Chief Technology Officer
description:
**Chief Technology Officer**

Cue Home Innovation Labs

· Ahmedabad · Full time, on site

**Role**

We are looking for a CTO who will take complete ownership of Cue's technology and hold

it for the next three to five years while we grow.

There are two halves to the job. Run and scale the platform we have built. And take this

company AI native inside the next nine to eighteen months, in the product and in the way

we work.

The cash is modest for the seniority. The equity is meaningful. You will work beside the

founder every day, and you will have the standing of a co-founder in how this company is

run.

**What Cue Home is**

Cue Home is a brand-agnostic smart home operating system, built in India. Our own gateway

hardware, our own cloud platform, apps live in both stores, and a system that keeps the

house running whether or not the internet does. It is deployed in homes, in enterprises

and in large real estate projects, and it is moving now from pilot installations to full

production.

Hardware, firmware, cloud, mobile and protocol engineering, in one product.

And we are building toward something larger. A lifecycle management platform for the smart home: design, planning, installation, integration and control, across more than 45 product categories and over 2,000 brands, for the thirty-year life of an Indian home. The full stack of a smart home.

**What you will own**

- The whole technology function: platform, hardware, firmware, mobile, cloud and release.

- The architecture and the roadmap. You decide where we go technically, and you defend it.

- The AI native transition, end to end.

- The engineering team. You will lead them, grow them, and hire the next set.

- Engineering quality and security as a standing discipline, not a project.

- The technical half of every investor and partner conversation.

Today the founder ( Non-technical ) carries much of this. The point of this role is that he stops.

**Who we are looking for**

- Around six to nine years building software, with real time spent close to hardware or embedded

 systems.

- You have taken a product from working to shipped at scale, and owned what happened

 after it shipped.

- You have led a small engineering team, and people stayed.

- You have built with LLMs and agents in earnest, not a weekend demo. You know where they

 hold and where they fall over.

- You are comfortable being the most senior technical person in the room, and the one who

 is accountable.

- You want to be in Ahmedabad, in the office, with the team.

What matters more than any of the above: you want to own something, and you are willing

to give it three to five years.

**The Payout**

Meaningful equity vesting over four years, with cash that is fair but deliberately modest

for the level. A seat in every company decision, not only the technical ones. A review of

your title and your standing at twelve months.

Three to five years is the minimum commitment we are asking for. On almost everything

else, for the right person, we are flexible. Tell us what you need and we will have that

conversation properly.

**How to apply**

Write to
**harnish@cuehome.in**
. Keep it structured, in this order.

1. Your name and qualifications. (50 words)

2. Why you think you fit this role best. (250 words)

3. The product you were most deeply involved in building. What it was, what you owned, and what happened to it after it shipped. (400 words)

4. Your minimum monthly cash expectation. A number, not a range. We would rather know now than in the third conversation.

Four answers and your CV. Nothing else.

title: Application and Visa Officer
description:
**Application and Visa Officer**

**Location:**
 Ahmedabad, Gujarat

**Employment Type:**
 Full-time, On-site

**About Gradient Dreamz**

Gradient Dreamz is a strategic education consulting firm dedicated to helping students navigate their journey towards international education. We work with students and families from an early stage, providing personalised guidance on academic planning, university selection, applications, and international admissions.

Our approach combines strategic planning, in-depth university knowledge, and personalised student support to help students make informed decisions and achieve their long-term academic and career aspirations.

We believe that international education is more than securing university admission. It is about making the right decisions at every stage of a student's journey.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Application and Visa Officer to join our team in Ahmedabad. The role involves managing and executing university applications and supporting students through the documentation and visa application process for international education.

The ideal candidate will take ownership of assigned student applications, ensure accuracy across all documentation, proactively manage deadlines, and maintain consistent communication with students, families, universities, and internal teams.

This role requires someone who can work independently, anticipate potential challenges, and ensure that every application progresses smoothly and meets the required quality standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. University Application Management**

* Manage the end-to-end university application process for assigned students.
* Complete and submit university applications accurately and within stipulated deadlines.
* Coordinate with universities and admissions offices regarding application requirements, queries, and updates.
* Track application progress and ensure timely completion of all pending requirements.
* Maintain updated records of applications, offers, rejections, and other admission-related outcomes.

**2. Documentation and Quality Control**

* Collect, organise, and verify student documents required for university applications.
* Review application forms, academic records, test scores, personal details, and supporting documents for accuracy.
* Identify discrepancies, missing information, and potential issues before application submission.
* Ensure all applications undergo appropriate quality checks before submission.
* Maintain organised and up-to-date student records in internal systems.

**3. Visa Documentation and Support**

* Guide students through the documentation and procedural requirements of their visa applications.
* Assist with visa application forms, financial documentation, and other supporting paperwork.
* Stay updated on relevant visa procedures, documentation requirements, and regulatory changes.
* Coordinate with students and relevant institutions to ensure timely completion of visa requirements.
* Escalate complex immigration or legal queries to the appropriate qualified professionals.

**4. Student Coordination and Communication**

* Maintain regular communication with assigned students regarding application progress and pending requirements.
* Follow up proactively on documents, decisions, and other time-sensitive requirements.
* Provide clear and timely updates to students and their families.
* Coordinate with student counsellors and other internal team members to ensure a smooth application experience.
* Anticipate upcoming requirements and communicate them well in advance.

**5. Ownership and Accountability**

* Take complete responsibility for the progress and timely execution of assigned applications.
* Maintain visibility over application deadlines, pending tasks, and outstanding requirements.
* Identify potential delays or bottlenecks and take corrective action proactively.
* Ensure that no application or student requirement is overlooked due to a lack of follow-up.
* Maintain high standards of accuracy, professionalism, and accountability in all assigned responsibilities.

**Qualifications and Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in any relevant discipline.
* Prior experience in overseas education consulting, university application processing, or visa documentation will be an advantage.
* Understanding of international university admission processes and student visa procedures.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy when handling student information and application documents.
* Excellent organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple applications and deadlines simultaneously.
* Strong ownership, problem-solving abilities, and a proactive approach to work.
* Comfortable working with spreadsheets, office software, CRM systems, and digital documentation platforms.
* Ability to work collaboratively while independently managing assigned responsibilities.
* Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and handling sensitive student information responsibly.

**What We Value**

At Gradient Dreamz, we value individuals who take ownership of their work, think ahead, and consistently deliver high-quality outcomes.

We are looking for someone who doesn't simply complete assigned tasks but takes responsibility for ensuring that things move forward. Attention to detail, proactive communication, accountability, and a willingness to improve are essential qualities for success in this role.

**If you are organised, detail-oriented, and passionate about helping students pursue international education, we would love to hear from you.**

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Engineer – Production with experience in the automobile or automotive components industry, particularly in rubber moulding and related manufacturing processes.

The ideal candidate should have strong shop-floor exposure, a practical understanding of production processes, and the ability to manage manpower, machines, productivity, quality, and delivery commitments. The candidate must be capable of identifying production bottlenecks, resolving process-related issues, reducing rejection and downtime, and driving continuous improvement.

This is an execution-focused role for someone who can take ownership of daily production performance and deliver measurable improvements in manufacturing efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

1. Production Planning & Shop-Floor Execution

Execute daily and monthly production plans in line with customer requirements and dispatch schedules.

Monitor production output against targets, identify bottlenecks, and take corrective action to achieve planned productivity.

Ensure optimum utilization of manpower, machines, tools, moulds, raw materials, and other production resources.

Coordinate with Planning, Quality, Maintenance, Stores, and Dispatch teams to ensure smooth production flow.

Monitor shift-wise production, work-in-progress, downtime, rejection, and pending orders.

2. Rubber Moulding & Manufacturing Process Control

Manage and monitor rubber moulding operations, where applicable, including process parameters, mould condition, cycle time, and output.

Understand critical moulding parameters such as temperature, pressure, curing time, material preparation, and demoulding.

Identify and troubleshoot process defects such as flash, short moulding, air traps, dimensional variation, and other moulding-related rejections.

Ensure correct machine setup, mould changeover, process settings, and first-piece approval before starting production.

Maintain process consistency and work with Quality and Maintenance teams to minimize mould-related issues and unplanned downtime.

Support process validation, trial runs, new product introduction, and process stabilization.

3. Exposure to Other Manufacturing Processes

Coordinate and control production activities involving relevant processes such as CNC machining, turning, drilling, cutting, fabrication, assembly, or other component-manufacturing operations, depending on product requirements.

Understand process flow, machine capability, tooling requirements, cycle time, and quality checkpoints.

Ensure standard operating procedures and approved process parameters are followed.

Identify opportunities to simplify operations, improve machine utilization, and reduce material wastage.

4. Quality & Rejection Control

Ensure production conforms to approved drawings, specifications, control plans, and customer quality requirements.

Monitor rejection, rework, scrap, and process deviations; initiate root-cause analysis and corrective actions.

Apply problem-solving tools such as 5 Why, Fishbone Analysis, and 8D, in coordination with the Quality team.

Ensure adherence to in-process inspection, first-piece approval, traceability, and process documentation requirements.

Support customer complaint resolution and corrective/preventive action implementation.

5. Productivity & Continuous Improvement

Track and improve key production KPIs, including output, cycle time, rejection percentage, machine downtime, and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE).

Drive initiatives to reduce cycle time, improve yield, minimize changeover time, and eliminate production losses.

Implement 5S, Kaizen, Lean Manufacturing, and other practical shop-floor improvement initiatives.

Analyze recurring production problems and implement sustainable corrective actions.

Support cost reduction through improved process efficiency, manpower utilization, and material consumption.

6. Manpower & Team Management

Allocate operators and workers according to production plans, machine requirements, and skill levels.

Monitor operator performance, attendance, discipline, and adherence to standard work practices.

Train operators on machine operation, process parameters, quality requirements, and safe working practices.

Ensure shift handovers are effective and production issues are communicated clearly.

Build a culture of accountability, productivity, quality ownership, and teamwork.

7. Maintenance, Safety & Documentation

Coordinate with Maintenance for preventive maintenance, breakdown resolution, and reduction of machine downtime.

Ensure proper handling and maintenance of machines, moulds, tools, fixtures, and production equipment.

Enforce shop-floor safety, PPE compliance, housekeeping, and safe operating practices.

Maintain production reports, shift reports, rejection records, downtime logs, and process documentation.

Ensure compliance with applicable work instructions and the company's quality management system.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The candidate will be evaluated on measurable shop-floor performance, including:

Achievement of daily and monthly production targets.

Reduction in rejection, rework, and material wastage.

Improvement in machine utilization and production efficiency.

Reduction in machine breakdowns and unplanned downtime.

Adherence to customer delivery schedules.

Improvement in cycle time and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE).

Compliance with quality, safety, 5S, and production documentation requirements.

Required Skills & Competencies

Practical knowledge of automotive manufacturing and shop-floor production management.

Hands-on exposure to rubber moulding and mould-related production activities is strongly preferred.

Understanding of manufacturing process parameters, cycle time, tooling, and machine utilization.

Strong problem-solving and root-cause analysis skills.

Ability to manage production teams and coordinate across departments.

Knowledge of production planning, rejection control, and continuous improvement techniques.

Working knowledge of Excel and ERP/MRP systems.

Strong ownership, discipline, communication, and execution skills.

Qualification & Experience

Diploma or Degree in Mechanical, Production, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related discipline.

3–7 years of relevant experience in production, preferably in automotive or automotive component manufacturing.

Candidates with direct experience in rubber moulding, polymer/rubber components, or similar process-driven manufacturing environments will be preferred.

Experience in managing shop-floor manpower, production targets, quality issues, and process improvements is essential.

Familiarity with IATF 16949, APQP, PPAP, FMEA, SPC, and MSA will be an added advantage.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a proactive, technically sound, and execution-oriented production professional who is comfortable working on the shop floor and taking ownership of production performance.

The candidate should be able to independently handle day-to-day production challenges, troubleshoot process issues, lead operators, improve productivity, and ensure consistent quality and on-time delivery.

Preference will be given to candidates currently working with automotive OEMs, Tier-1 suppliers, or Tier-2 automotive component manufacturers who have hands-on production experience rather than purely planning or documentation-based experience.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their updated CV mentioning current CTC, expected CTC, notice period, and relevant manufacturing-process experience.

title: Account Head
description:
**ABOUT US**

Resolute Corp Bharat Private Limited is a diversified investment and venture-building group rooted in India, operating across fintech, consumer brands, and sports. This role is on the Resolute Corp payroll, with the incumbent deployed to lead finance for Hair Drama Co. — the Group's premium hair accessories brand, known for bold design and quality across a curated D2C and retail range, including its in-house manufacturing operations. The role reports into Group Finance.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are looking for an Accounts Head — dual-qualified as a Chartered Accountant (CA) and Cost Accountant (ICWA) — to lead the finance function of Hair Drama Company end-to-end: accounting, audit, costing, and financial reporting. This is a hands-on role for someone with genuine manufacturing and costing experience who can bring the same rigour to a fast-growing D2C and e-commerce business, partnering closely with the CEO in shaping and executing the company's long-term financial strategy.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Financial Strategy & Business Planning**

* Own and drive the company's long-term financial strategy; build long-term financial models
* Drive sustainable, profitable growth
* Evaluate new business opportunities and support expansion into new categories and markets
* Partner closely with the CEO on strategic and business decisions

**Financial Reporting & Controllership**

* Overall supervision of financial accounting, including Trial Balance (TB), Profit & Loss (P&L), and Balance Sheet (BS); ensure timely monthly closure of books of accounts
* Own monthly MIS reporting with clear commentary on variances and key drivers
* Lead preparation of the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) and track AOP vs. actual performance
* Track Standard Cost vs. Actual Cost, investigate variances, and recommend corrective action
* Prepare Quarterly and Annual Budgets and report Budget vs. Actuals to leadership, flagging risks early
* Strengthen internal financial controls and documentation

**Manufacturing & Costing**

* Manage Bill of Materials (BOM) costing and track BOM vs. actual variance
* Oversee inventory management, including valuation, control, and reconciliation
* Conduct physical verification of stock at regular intervals and drive corrective actions

**Cash Flow & Working Capital Management**

* Own the company's cash position — cash flow forecasting, liquidity planning, inventory funding, vendor and customer payment cycles, warehouse cash requirements, operating expenses, and capital expenditure
* Liaise with banks for credit lines and other working capital facilities
* Ensure a healthy cash runway and maintain optimal working capital

**FP&A (Financial Planning & Analysis)**

* Develop dashboards tracking revenue, gross margin (COGS), direct costs, contribution margin (channel-wise), EBITDA, net profit, burn rate, CAC, LTV, repeat purchase rate, inventory turns, and cash conversion cycle
* Generate actionable insights for leadership from these metrics

**E-commerce & Revenue Finance**

* Oversee accounting and reconciliation for e-commerce channels, including marketplace fees, returns, and payment gateway settlements
* Review channel receivables against actual receipts; reconcile Sales vs. Actual Receipts across all channels, resolving mismatches with sales, operations, and banking teams
* Monitor financial performance across channels — Shopify, marketplaces, retail, and international
* Analyse product, SKU, collection, and channel profitability

**Pricing & Margin Management**

* Partner with NPD and sales teams to optimise selling price, discount strategy, promotions, gross margins, markdown planning, and product mix

**Inventory Finance**

* Work closely with Supply Chain on inventory investment, inventory ageing, dead stock, stock turns, replenishment planning, open-to-buy planning, and purchase planning

**Statutory & Internal Audit**

* Coordinate and lead Internal Audit planning and execution; track findings through to closure with process owners
* Lead Statutory Audit end-to-end — coordination with auditors, schedule preparation, and query resolution
* Ensure compliance with statutory, tax, and regulatory requirements applicable to the business (India)

**Accounting & Compliance**

* Ensure accurate and timely GST, TDS, Income Tax, and ROC filings and compliance
* Ensure payroll compliance

**Risk Management**

* Identify and mitigate financial, foreign exchange, credit, fraud, and operational risks
* Implement internal controls and governance

**Business Partnering & Team Leadership**

* Partner with business heads and Group Finance leadership on financial planning and decision support
* Build and mentor teams across Finance, Accounts, Treasury, FP&A, Tax, and Payroll

**CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS**

* **Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) and Cost Accountant (ICWA)**
* Minimum 5+ years of post-qualification experience — open to both strong Manager-level and Head-of-Function-level candidates, provided manufacturing, costing, and finance-ownership experience is a strong match to this role
* **Prior experience in the manufacturing industry is mandatory**
* Strong working knowledge of BOM/costing, inventory management, and e-commerce finance
* Preferred: strong e-commerce/D2C accounting experience
* Hands-on experience with statutory audits, internal audits, and MIS reporting
* Working knowledge of standard costing and budget-vs-actual analysis
* Preferred: prior experience with a Big 4 accounting/audit firm (KPMG, Deloitte, EY, PwC)
* Preferred: experience working in a digital-first / digital business environment
* Proficiency in Tally/ERP and MS Excel; Desirable: exposure to Zoho Books or similar platforms

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Chartered Accountant (CA) and Cost Accountant (ICWA)
* Additional certifications in internal audit or costing are a plus

title: Junior Research Fellow
description:
🚀 URGENT: We are hiring! Active Recruitment: One (1) Junior Research Fellow (JRF)

Opportunities are open for motivated researchers to join the Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF) funded PM ECRG project: "AI-Native Foundations for Interference, Connectivity, and Mobility Optimization in Next-Generation Networks."

**Executive project summary:**
Next-generation Networks (NGNs) are expected to deliver high data rates, uninterrupted services to underserved and unserved communities, increased end-user density, and enhanced communication reliability. The existing wireless mobile networks' transition from Fifth Generation (5G) mobile networks to NGNs, including Beyond 5G (B5G) and 6G technologies, introduces unprecedented architectural complexity, larger network density, and more heterogeneity, making interference management, resource allocation, and service reliability a critical challenge, where end users located in areas with underserved and unserved locations often experience interruptions while accessing broadband services.

This project will deliver novel theoretical models, AI-native algorithmic frameworks, and simulation prototypes suited for real-world NGN operations. Also, the proposal will design a UAV-assisted last-mile connectivity network, which strongly justifies national priority missions, such as Digital India, BharatNet, and the National Digital Communications Policy 2018. Therefore, the proposal also aligns directly with the goals of national connectivity and digital inclusion.

**Keywords:**
Next-Generation Networks, AI-Native Optimization, Multi-Objective CoMP, Mechanism-Design Models, UAV-Assisted Connectivity, AI-Native Mobility & Hand-off.

title: Senior Accounts Manager
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**SENIOR ACCOUNTS MANAGER**

**Company**

**Nine Corporation**

**Department**

Accounts & Finance

**Designation**

Senior Accounts Manager

**Experience**

8–12 Years

**Location**

Ahmedabad, Gujarat

**Reporting To**

AGM – Accounts & Finance / Top Management

**Employment Type**

Full-Time

1. Job Purpose

To lead and manage the accounting and finance operations of Group CNJ entities, ensuring accurate financial reporting, statutory compliance, effective financial budget control, cash-flow management, and timely financial decision-making. The role requires strong leadership, multi-entity accounting experience, and practical expertise in Tally Prime and financial planning.

2. Key Roles & ResponsibilitiesA. Accounting & Financial Management

·       Oversee day-to-day accounting operations across group companies.

·       Ensure accurate and timely recording of financial transactions.

·       Manage general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and bank reconciliations.

·       Review and finalize monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.

·       Maintain books of accounts and supporting documentation.

·       Monitor inter-company transactions and reconciliations.

B. Financial Budgeting & Cost Control

·       Prepare and monitor annual budgets, forecasts, and financial plans.

·       Implement effective budgetary controls across departments and group entities.

·       Prepare budget-versus-actual reports and investigate variances.

·       Monitor operating expenses, identify cost-saving opportunities, and recommend corrective actions.

·       Track cash flow, working capital, fund requirements, and utilization.

·       Coordinate with department heads to ensure spending remains within approved budgets.

C. Tally Prime & Accounting Systems

·       Use Tally Prime independently for day-to-day accounting and financial reporting.

·       Manage ledger scrutiny, voucher verification, journal entries, and account reconciliations.

·       Maintain accurate accounting masters, cost centres, and company-wise records.

·       Generate financial statements, GST reports, and other management reports through Tally.

·       Ensure data accuracy, proper backups, and disciplined accounting-system practices.

D. GST, Taxation & Statutory Compliance

·       Supervise GST returns, TDS returns, Income Tax compliance, and other applicable statutory filings.

·       Reconcile GSTR-2B with purchase records and review eligible input tax credit.

·       Monitor TDS deductions, payments, and quarterly returns.

·       Coordinate with statutory auditors, tax consultants, and government authorities.

·       Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and regulatory requirements.

E. MIS & Financial Reporting

·       Prepare and present monthly MIS reports to management.

·       Develop P&L reports, balance sheets, cash-flow statements, and financial summaries.

·       Prepare entity-wise and consolidated financial reports.

·       Analyze financial performance, expenses, profitability, and budget variances.

·       Provide timely financial insights and recommendations to management.

F. Audit, Internal Controls & Team Management

·       Establish and strengthen internal financial controls and approval processes.

·       Review vouchers, invoices, payment requests, and supporting documents.

·       Coordinate internal, statutory, GST, and tax audits and resolve audit observations.

·       Lead, supervise, and guide the accounts team; allocate responsibilities and review output.

·       Coordinate with HR, Procurement, Sales, Stores, and Plant Operations.

3. Qualifications

·       B.Com / M.Com is mandatory.

·       CA Inter / CMA Inter / MBA Finance will be an added advantage.

·       Strong knowledge of Indian accounting practices, GST, TDS, and Income Tax.

4. Mandatory Experience & Technical Skills

·       Overall 8–12 years of relevant experience in Accounts & Finance.

·       Minimum 5–6 years of hands-on experience in financial budgeting, budget control, cost monitoring, and financial planning.

·       Minimum 5–6 years of practical working experience in Tally Prime.

·       Strong experience in budget preparation, budget-versus-actual analysis, expense monitoring, and cost control.

·       Experience managing multiple company accounts or group-level financial operations.

·       Working knowledge of GST, TDS, Income Tax, account finalization, and statutory compliance.

·       Ability to prepare monthly MIS, P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow Statements independently.

·       Strong MS Excel skills, including Pivot Tables and VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP.

·       Manufacturing or industrial accounting experience will be preferred.

5. Key Competencies

·       Strong financial analysis, planning, and budget-control capabilities.

·       Leadership and team-management skills.

·       Accuracy and attention to detail.

·       Problem-solving and decision-making ability.

·       Strong communication, coordination, and time-management skills.

·       Integrity, confidentiality, and professional ethics.

6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

·       Timely monthly closing of books of accounts.

·       Accuracy and timely submission of MIS and financial reports.

·       Timely statutory compliance and avoidance of preventable penalties.

·       Effective budget monitoring and control of expenses.

·       Timely bank and inter-company reconciliations.

·       Reduction in accounting errors and financial discrepancies.

·       Timely completion of audits and closure of audit observations.

·       Effective working-capital and cash-flow management.

·       Accounts team productivity and timely completion of deliverables.

7. Preferred Candidate Profile

We are looking for a result-oriented finance professional who can independently manage accounting and financial operations across multiple group entities. The candidate must have strong practical expertise in financial budget control and Tally Prime, sound knowledge of taxation and compliance, and the ability to lead a team and work closely with senior management.

**Mandatory Shortlisting Criteria:**
Candidates must have at least 5–6 years of hands-on experience in both Financial Budget Control and Tally Prime. Candidates who do not meet these two requirements should not be shortlisted.

Identify high-value AI opportunities across EPC projects, precast manufacturing and corporate functions; prioritize pilots and help move successful solutions into use.

**Job Overview**
We are seeking a dynamic, analytical, and results-driven
**Senior Marketplace Associate**
to manage and grow our presence across leading U.S. and international marketplaces, including Target, Lowe’s, and Tesco.
  
  
The role will play a key part in executing the Annual Operating Plan (AOP), achieving sales targets, optimizing marketplace operations, and improving overall business performance. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in marketplace management, product catalog optimization, sales analysis, order fulfillment, and cross-functional coordination.
  
  
The successful candidate will work closely with internal teams to enhance product visibility, drive revenue growth, maintain operational excellence, and strengthen marketplace partnerships in a fast-paced e-commerce environment.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Marketplace Management
* Manage end-to-end marketplace operations across Target, Lowe’s, Tesco, and other assigned sales channels.
* Oversee product onboarding, catalog management, listing optimization, and ongoing account maintenance.
* Monitor marketplace performance, identify growth opportunities, and implement strategies to achieve sales targets.
* Ensure product listings, pricing, promotions, and inventory information remain accurate and up to date.
* Sales Performance and Business Growth
* Track daily, weekly, and monthly sales performance against business targets and the Annual Operating Plan.
* Analyze key performance indicators (KPIs), identify sales trends, and recommend actions to improve revenue and profitability.
* Monitor product-level performance, pricing competitiveness, and promotional effectiveness.
* Collaborate with relevant teams to expand product assortment, improve conversion rates, and increase marketplace market share.
* Catalog and Inventory Management
* Coordinate product launches, catalog updates, attribute mapping, and listing enhancements.
* Monitor inventory synchronization across marketplaces and internal systems.
* Identify and resolve issues related to product availability, listing errors, content quality, and product variations.
* Maintain accurate product data to support discoverability, customer experience, and conversion.
* Order Management and Operational Excellence
* Monitor order processing, shipment confirmations, tracking updates, and fulfillment performance.
* Ensure compliance with marketplace service-level agreements (SLAs), including shipping deadlines, order accuracy, and cancellation rates.
* Coordinate with logistics, warehouse, and customer service teams to resolve operational issues.
* Identify process gaps and implement improvements to reduce delays, errors, and operational inefficiencies.
* Marketplace Integrations and Technical Coordination
* Work with marketplace integration platforms and order management systems, including Magento and similar tools.
* Coordinate with technical teams to troubleshoot integration issues involving orders, inventory, product feeds, and tracking information.
* Support marketplace integrations and ensure reliable data synchronization between internal systems and external platforms.
* Monitor recurring technical issues and work toward sustainable resolutions.
* Advertising and Performance Reporting
* Support marketplace advertising and retail media activities, including Target Roundel Media.
* Monitor advertising and sales performance to identify opportunities for improved return on ad spend (ROAS) and overall profitability.
* Prepare regular performance reports and dashboards using Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, or other reporting tools.
* Present actionable insights and recommendations to support business decisions.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Work closely with catalog, marketing, logistics, operations, finance, and technology teams to achieve business objectives.
* Communicate marketplace priorities, operational challenges, and performance updates to relevant stakeholders.
* Proactively identify risks, resolve issues, and support continuous improvement initiatives.

**Qualifications And Requirements**

* 1–3+ years of hands-on experience in e-commerce, online marketplace management, or marketplace operations.
* Experience managing marketplaces such as Target, Lowe’s, Amazon, Tesco, Walmart, or similar platforms.
* Strong understanding of product listings, catalog management, inventory synchronization, and order fulfillment workflows.
* Familiarity with Magento, Feedonomics, Mirakl, or similar marketplace integration and order management platforms.
* Understanding of marketplace SLAs, shipping timelines, order accuracy, and fulfillment processes.
* Basic knowledge of digital advertising and retail media platforms; experience with Target Roundel Media is an advantage.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including sales reporting, data analysis, and performance tracking.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable business recommendations.
* Excellent communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple marketplaces, prioritize competing tasks, and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
* High attention to detail, a proactive mindset, and a strong focus on business results.

title: Head of Brand Partnerships & Monetization
description:
**Ahmedabad, Gujarat – Work from Office**
This is an on-site role based out of our Ahmedabad office. The candidate should be comfortable working from Ahmedabad and collaborating closely with the Founder & CEO.
  
  
**About Nudge**
Nudge is building a consumer intelligence platform powered by verified purchase data. Through receipts, invoices, and purchase activity, Nudge helps brands understand what consumers buy, how they shop, and what influences their decisions.
  
  
We’re building for a mass-market Indian consumer audience, and growth is at the heart of what we do.
  
  
**The Role**
This is a
**founding commercial role**
. You will build Nudge’s
**brand-funded monetization engine from near zero**
- owning partnerships, deal structures, pricing, affiliate rails, and the underlying unit economics. You’ll work directly with the CEO.
  
  
What you build will become a
**core revenue line for the company**
.
  
  
**In one line:**
Move reward costs from our balance sheet to the brands whose customers we influence - and prove it with data.
  
  
**Experience**

* 8 to 14 years in partnerships, monetization, or brand revenue at consumer internet companies.
* You have owned a partner revenue number, not a retention or engagement metric.
* You have personally sourced and closed brand deals in the last 12 months, and can name the brands and deal sizes.
* You have sold first-party consumer data, audiences, or rewards inventory to brand and agency teams.
* You have asked a product team to capture a new data point because a brand would pay for it, and it shipped.
* You have led work across Tech, Product, and Legal, and delivered in weeks rather than quarters.

**Backgrounds that fit best**

* Partnership heads at coalition or partner-funded loyalty programmes.
* Monetization and ads leads at quick commerce, marketplace, or retail media businesses.
* Brand partnership and monetization leads at fintech, rewards, or cashback apps.
* Founders or first business hires who ran revenue and product together at an early-stage consumer startup.

**How You Work**

* You think in numbers: cost per action, redemption rates, repeat purchase, revenue per user.
* You move fast with incomplete structure and build the structure as you go.
* You are comfortable pitching a smaller, high-quality audience on data depth rather than reach.
* You have existing relationships with marketing heads at FMCG, D2C, travel, health, or fintech brands.

**Who This Is Not For**

* You need a large team, a fixed operating structure, or two quarters of build time before revenue.
* Your partners have always come to you inbound because of your employer's scale.
* You see data as something Tech owns and hands to you.
* You prefer managing closers to closing.

title: Head of Brand Partnerships & Monetization
description:
**Ahmedabad, Gujarat – Work from Office**
This is an on-site role based out of our Ahmedabad office. The candidate should be comfortable working from Ahmedabad and collaborating closely with the Founder & CEO.
  
  
**About Nudge**
Nudge is building a consumer intelligence platform powered by verified purchase data. Through receipts, invoices, and purchase activity, Nudge helps brands understand what consumers buy, how they shop, and what influences their decisions.
  
  
We’re building for a mass-market Indian consumer audience, and growth is at the heart of what we do.
  
  
**The Role**
This is a
**founding commercial role**
. You will build Nudge’s
**brand-funded monetization engine from near zero**
- owning partnerships, deal structures, pricing, affiliate rails, and the underlying unit economics. You’ll work directly with the CEO.
  
  
What you build will become a
**core revenue line for the company**
.
  
  
**In one line:**
Move reward costs from our balance sheet to the brands whose customers we influence - and prove it with data.
  
  
**Experience**

* 8 to 14 years in partnerships, monetization, or brand revenue at consumer internet companies.
* You have owned a partner revenue number, not a retention or engagement metric.
* You have personally sourced and closed brand deals in the last 12 months, and can name the brands and deal sizes.
* You have sold first-party consumer data, audiences, or rewards inventory to brand and agency teams.
* You have asked a product team to capture a new data point because a brand would pay for it, and it shipped.
* You have led work across Tech, Product, and Legal, and delivered in weeks rather than quarters.

**Backgrounds that fit best**

* Partnership heads at coalition or partner-funded loyalty programmes.
* Monetization and ads leads at quick commerce, marketplace, or retail media businesses.
* Brand partnership and monetization leads at fintech, rewards, or cashback apps.
* Founders or first business hires who ran revenue and product together at an early-stage consumer startup.

**How You Work**

* You think in numbers: cost per action, redemption rates, repeat purchase, revenue per user.
* You move fast with incomplete structure and build the structure as you go.
* You are comfortable pitching a smaller, high-quality audience on data depth rather than reach.
* You have existing relationships with marketing heads at FMCG, D2C, travel, health, or fintech brands.

**Who This Is Not For**

* You need a large team, a fixed operating structure, or two quarters of build time before revenue.
* Your partners have always come to you inbound because of your employer's scale.
* You see data as something Tech owns and hands to you.
* You prefer managing closers to closing.

title: Growth Marketing Associate (on-site)
description:
**About us**

Mission Sustainability is a bootstrapped sustainability company based in Gandhinagar. We are also building Made for Planet (madeforplanet.com), a marketplace for sustainable products that lists about a lakh products from 4,800+ brands. We believe sustainability is an industry as big as any other, and it should be marketed that way.

**The role**

You will be responsible for getting more people to see us on the web and on social media. You will be measured on two numbers:

1. **Website traffic.**

2. **Social media followers.**
   Grow our audience on Instagram and LinkedIn, and make sure those followers actually engage with what we post.

You will own the strategy for growing both numbers and do the work to get there.

**What you’ll do**

* Track traffic, followers and engagement every week and share them openly with the team
* Work with our design, content and product teams

**Who we’re looking for**

* **You believe sustainability is as important as any other industry.**

* **You take ownership.**
  Traffic is your metric. You don’t wait to be told what to do next.
* **You take risks.**
  You’re ready to experiment and break the usual rules of growth.
* **You have a proven record.**
  You have owned a growth strategy before and can show the numbers it moved.

**Nice to have**

* Hands-on experience with Google Analytics, Search Console and Meta/LinkedIn analytics
* Comfort with Canva, CapCut or similar tools
* Experience with D2C, e-commerce or marketplace brands

title: Account Executive SaaS Sales (Saleshandy)
description:
**About Saleshandy**
Saleshandy is built in Ahmedabad and has been helping businesses scale outreach since 2015. More than 25,000 businesses, agencies and sales teams use it to find leads in a B2B database of 852M+ contacts, set up and warm up sending mailboxes, and run multichannel sequences across email, calls, LinkedIn and WhatsApp. Replies and deals are managed in one unified inbox.
  
  
Plans run from $34 to $149 a month, with custom Enterprise plans above that. We're rated 4.6/5 on G2 and are SOC 2, ISO 27001 and GDPR compliant.
  
  
We're moving from marketing-led to sales-led growth, and we're hiring closers who want to own a number and grow with us.
  
  
**About The Role**
close deals, own your number
  
  
You'll own the full sales cycle at Saleshandy. You'll convert inbound trial users into paying customers and build your own pipeline through outbound, selling to founders, agencies and sales teams in the US, UK and EU.
  
  

* You'll work from our Ahmedabad office. If you live outside Ahmedabad, relocating is mandatory for this role
* You'll work US/UK hours, which means a night shift in India
* We're looking for 2 to 5 years in B2B SaaS sales, with at least 2 years of closing deals yourself
* Full-time role, reporting to the Head of Sales
* Your main market is the US and EU, with India as a secondary market
* Pay is 6 to 8 LPA fixed, plus an uncapped monthly incentive

How we work
  
  
We run a Results-Only Work Environment (ROWE). Nobody tracks your hours or how busy you look. You decide how to plan your day, and you're measured only on outcomes: pipeline created, deals closed, revenue and ticket size.
  
  
In return, you own your target completely. If you're behind, you raise it and fix it before your manager has to ask. This role won't suit someone who waits to be chased or leaves results to chance.
  
  
What you'll do
  
  
Inbound sales and trial conversion
  
  

* Own inbound leads (trial sign-ups, demo requests, calendar bookings, chat conversations) from first contact to closed-won or closed-lost
* Respond fast: within the same business hour for demo requests, the same day for trial sign-ups
* Run discovery to understand the buyer's outreach goals, current tools, sending volume, team size and deliverability problems
* Give tailored demos that show only what solves the buyer's problem, instead of a full feature tour
* Handle pricing, competitor and "we're just researching" objections with value, not quick discounts
* Close deals and move customers from monthly to annual plans to grow ticket size

Outbound sales and pipeline building
  
  

* Identify target accounts and decision-makers across the US and EU: lead-gen agencies, SaaS founders, and SMB and mid-market sales teams
* Build and run your own outbound campaigns on Saleshandy across cold email, LinkedIn and calls
* Write personalised sequences and keep improving subject lines, offers and messaging based on results
* Book meetings and build enough pipeline to cover at least 3x your monthly quota
* Track open rate, reply rate, positive reply rate, meetings booked and meeting-to-close conversion

Follow-up and pipeline discipline
  
  

* Follow up on every lead across email, calls, LinkedIn and WhatsApp until you get a clear yes or no. One email followed by silence is not follow-up
* Keep every lead stage, meeting date, close date and lost reason updated in our CRM (Close). We report from the CRM, never from spreadsheets
* Review your own pipeline every week (stalled deals, overdue tasks, deals at risk) and bring a plan to your 1:1
* Forecast honestly every week and deliver the number you commit to

Product and technical understanding
  
  

* Know cold email deliverability well: SPF, DKIM, DMARC, domain and mailbox warm-up, sender rotation, sending limits, bounce rates and inbox placement
* Know the full Saleshandy product: Lead Finder and credits, email infrastructure, unified inbox, multichannel sequences, AI Sequence Copilot, agency and white-label features, API, and CRM integrations (HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, Zoho)
* Explain technical concepts simply to non-technical founders and sales leaders
* Know the basics of cold email compliance in the US (CAN-SPAM) and EU (GDPR)
* Answer product questions yourself using our internal knowledge base instead of waiting on the product team

AI and sales automation
  
  

* Use AI tools for account research, personalisation, call preparation and follow-up drafting
* Build simple AI workflows that cut research and admin time, so more of your day goes to selling
* Use AI to make outreach more personal, not more generic

Working with other teams
  
  

* Hand closed customers over smoothly to onboarding and customer success, including setup expectations. New Pro-plan customers should finish domain and mailbox setup within their first month
* Share objections, lost reasons, competitor mentions and feature requests with product and marketing every week

You'll fit well if you
  
  

* Have 2 to 5 years of B2B SaaS sales, including at least 2 years of hands-on deal closing
* Have a record of hitting quota, with numbers you can share: quota, achievement, deal size and cycle length
* Have done both inbound conversion and self-sourced outbound pipeline
* Have sold to US, UK or EU customers over video calls
* Speak and write excellent English, and are strong at presenting, negotiating and handling objections
* Can write cold emails that get replies
* Have used a CRM (Close, HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive or similar) and at least one sales engagement or data tool (Saleshandy, Apollo, Clay, Lemlist, Instantly or similar)
* Are comfortable working US/UK night shift hours from Ahmedabad
* Keep learning. You read, listen to sales podcasts and review your own call recordings, and you can show how that improved your results

Good to have
  
  

* Experience selling a cold email, sales engagement or martech product
* Experience selling to lead-gen or marketing agencies
* Hindi and Gujarati for Indian accounts

How you're measured
  
  

* Revenue against quota, meaning monthly new revenue closed from inbound and self-sourced deals. We share the quota at offer stage
* Inbound conversion, the share of assigned trial and demo leads you turn into paying customers
* Average ticket size per deal, and the share of deals you close on annual plans
* Open pipeline of at least 3x your monthly quota
* Speed to lead, the time from lead assignment to your first contact
* Follow-up consistency. Every open lead has a next step and a future task in the CRM
* Reply rate, positive reply rate and meetings booked from your own outbound campaigns
* CRM hygiene, with stages, meeting dates, close dates and lost reasons always up to date

Your first 90 days
  
  

* By day 30 you're ready to sell. You know the product and deliverability basics well enough to run demos alone, and you've closed your first deals
* By day 60 you're at 70% or more of quota, your first outbound campaign is live, and your CRM stays clean without reminders
* By day 90 you're fully ramped and hitting 100% of quota consistently, with at least 30% of revenue from annual plans

Why join us
  
  

* A growing B2B SaaS product used by 25,000+ customers worldwide
* Uncapped incentives, so your earnings grow with your results
* Full ownership of the sales cycle, with real freedom over how you work
* You'll sell to US and EU founders, agencies and sales leaders every day
* Modern outbound and AI tools, and a path to senior AE or team lead roles as we scale

How to apply
  
  
Apply with your CV and answer the screening questions in the form. Shortlisted candidates will be asked for a 10 to 15 minute demo recording before the interview.

description:
**About Us**

Virtual Ops LLP (www.virtualops.net) is a product data and eCommerce content company with offices in Ahmedabad, India and New York, USA. We help US online retailers manage product content, product data, digital assets and marketplace listings, including the product and lifestyle images that improves customer experience and leads to increased online sales. We build, operate and manage a virtual back-office organization for our US based clients. We are building our team to meet our growth requirements.

**About the role**

We're looking for an AI Designer with a strong design sense who can turn AI-generated images into finished, product-accurate visuals that sell.

The challenge is creative freedom without product drift. AI tools can produce a beautiful image in seconds. They can also quietly change a product's shape, color, proportions or details. Your job is to get the best from AI and then use your graphic design skills to make sure every final image is attractive
**and**
true to the real product.

You'll work across many product types, each with its own shapes, sizes, materials and specifications. You'll take ownership of the quality of every image you deliver.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. AI image generation**

•        Work from the client's product and reference images. Learn the visual requirements of each product category and client quickly

•        Write, test and refine prompts, using best of class ai tools

•        Create realistic, commercially usable product images in apt use cases: lifestyle scenes, backgrounds, marketing visuals

**2. Graphic design and image editing**

•        Retouch and improve AI outputs in Photoshop: color correction, background changes, clean-up, composition. Adjust proportions, dimensions and sizing so the product matches its real specifications

•        Place real products into AI-generated scenes with natural shadows, lighting, scale and perspective

•        Create dimension and infographic images and resize assets for each website/marketplace's requirements

**3. Product accuracy and quality**

•        Check every final image against the client's reference before delivery: shape, proportions, color, texture, angle and functional details

•        Spot and fix even small inconsistencies that AI introduces

**What you need**

Shreedhar Labels LLP is a labeling and packaging solutions provider committed to delivering consistent quality and reliable service to its clients. The company focuses on precision manufacturing, adherence to industry standards, and timely delivery of products. Shreedhar Labels LLP values operational excellence, continuous improvement, and strong collaboration across departments. Team members are encouraged to contribute ideas that enhance processes, product quality, and customer satisfaction.
  
**Role Description**
The Quality Control Executive is a full-time, on-site role based in Ahmedabad. This role is responsible for inspecting labels and packaging materials at various stages of production to ensure they meet defined quality standards and client specifications. The Quality Control Executive will conduct routine quality checks, record test results, identify non-conformities, and coordinate with production teams to resolve issues. The role involves maintaining quality documentation, assisting in root-cause analysis, and supporting implementation of corrective and preventive actions. The Quality Control Executive will also help in standardizing processes, verifying compliance with safety and regulatory requirements, and preparing reports for management review.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong attention to detail and analytical skills, including the ability to identify defects and deviations in printed labels and packaging materials.
* Candidates should possess basic knowledge of quality control methods, inspection techniques, and familiarity with standard measurement tools and instruments used in manufacturing.
* Candidates should possess effective communication and collaboration skills to work closely with production, maintenance, and management teams.
* Candidates should possess good documentation and reporting abilities, including maintaining records, preparing quality reports, and using basic computer applications.
* Candidates should possess problem-solving skills and a mindset focused on continuous improvement, including participation in root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* A diploma or degree in engineering, printing technology, quality management, or a related field is beneficial, along with prior experience in manufacturing or packaging industries.
* Understanding of workplace safety practices and adherence to company policies and regulatory guidelines is expected.

title: Quality Assurance Rater - English speakers in India
description:
Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.

This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.

**A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater**

In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.

You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.
* Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.
* Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.
* Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.
* Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.
* Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.
* Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.

**TELUS Digital AI Community**

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands.

Qualification path

Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring.

**Basic Requirements**

* **Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in English.**
* **Resident in India for the last 5 consecutive years.**
* Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.
* Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.
* Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools.
* Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer.
* Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification
* Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently.
* High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification.
* Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems.
* Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering.
* Additional language skills may be beneficial depending on project requirements.

**Equal Opportunity**

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

Click here to Apply

description:
**Role Summary**

We are looking for a
**DevOps Engineer**
with

●Understanding of multi-stage Docker builds and image optimization.

●Experience using Docker Compose for multi-container applications.

**Kubernetes**

●Hands-on experience with Pods, Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, Secrets, Namespaces, and Ingress.

●Understanding of resource requests/limits, health checks, scaling, and application configuration.

●Ability to troubleshoot common Kubernetes workload and deployment issues.

**Helm**

●Hands-on experience deploying and upgrading applications using Helm.

●Understanding of Helm charts, values, releases, and environment-specific configurations.

**CI/CD**

●Hands-on experience with GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or an equivalent CI/CD platform.

●Understanding of automated build, test, Docker image creation, deployment, and rollback workflows.

●Experience managing deployments across development, staging, and production environments.

**Terraform**

●Hands-on experience provisioning and managing infrastructure using Terraform.

●Understanding of variables, outputs, modules, state, and remote state management.

**Linux & Scripting**

●Strong Linux fundamentals and hands-on troubleshooting experience.

●Understanding of processes, services, permissions, filesystems, networking, and logs.

●Good Bash/Shell scripting skills for automation and operational tasks.

**Git & GitHub**

●Strong understanding of Git workflows, including branching, pull requests, merging, and rebasing.

●Experience with tags, releases, and basic GitHub repository and branch management.

**Monitoring & Observability**

●Hands-on experience with Prometheus and Grafana is required.

●Ability to create and maintain Grafana dashboards.

●Working knowledge of PromQL and Kubernetes/infrastructure metrics.

●Understanding of alerting, alert rules, metrics, logs, and production troubleshooting.

**Networking**

●Understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, ports, routing, and subnets/CIDR.

●Understanding of load balancers, NAT, firewalls/security groups, and basic connectivity troubleshooting.

●Understanding of IAM and least-privilege access.

**Programming & Automation**

●Working knowledge of at least one programming language such as Python, Go, Java, or JavaScript.

●Production incident management and on-call experience

title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer (Remote, Full-Time) [AS355]
description:
**About Smart Working**

  

At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day. This isn't just another remote opportunity—it's about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. From day one, you're welcomed into a genuine community that values your growth and well-being. Our mission is simple: to break down geographic barriers and connect skilled professionals with outstanding global teams and products for full-time, long-term roles. We help you discover meaningful work with teams that invest in your success, where you're empowered to grow personally and professionally.

  

Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote-first world.

  

**About the Role**

  

We are seeking a Senior DevSecOps Engineer to strengthen the security, reliability, and scalability of an AI-powered patent search and analytics platform used by enterprises, law firms, and universities. In this role, you will drive a secure-by-design engineering approach, ensuring compliance while enabling fast and reliable software delivery. You will work closely with engineering teams to embed security across the development lifecycle and support the growth of a resilient, scalable infrastructure.

  

This position involves hands-on work with modern cloud technologies, infrastructure automation, containerization, observability platforms, and security compliance frameworks within a fast-growing product environment.

**Responsibilities**
  

  
* Maintain and strengthen AWS infrastructure, including ECS and EKS, supporting the company's platform
  
* Own automated tests and validation checks that ensure ongoing compliance with security frameworks, including SOC 2 and ISO 27001
  
* Identify and flag security compliance issues while collaborating with the engineering team rather than directly leading audit remediation
  
* Embed security thinking throughout the software development lifecycle
  
* Improve the security, reliability, and scalability of the platform infrastructure
  
* Deliver infrastructure solutions independently with minimal oversight
  
* Collaborate closely with software engineers to enable secure-by-design and dependable software delivery
  
* Make sound technical and infrastructure design decisions while iterating quickly
  
* Take full ownership of infrastructure initiatives and contribute to long-term platform stability
  
  

  
**Requirements**
  

  
* 5+ years of experience in DevSecOps or a related role
  
* 5+ years of overall DevOps/DevSecOps experience
  
* Strong experience with AWS, including ECS and EKS
  
* Strong experience with Terraform
  
* Strong experience with Kubernetes or container orchestration
  
* Strong experience with Docker
  
* Strong experience with Ansible
  
* Strong experience with Prometheus and Grafana
  
* Strong experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automation
  
* Good understanding of security best practices and compliance frameworks, including SOC 2 and ISO 27001
  
* Ability to work independently, make technical decisions, and deliver with minimal supervision
  
* Strong problem-solving skills and a product-focused mindset
  
* Experience working in a fast-paced environment
  
* Ability to collaborate effectively with software engineering teams
  
  

  
**Nice To Have**
  

  
* Experience with EKS specifically
  
* Experience working within a SaaS or technology product company
  
* Previous experience leading infrastructure projects or taking ownership of major infrastructure initiatives
  
* Broader exposure to security and compliance practices beyond core operational responsibilities

  

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: Lead – Microsoft 365, Copilot & AI Enablement
description:
**HEAD / LEAD – MICROSOFT 365, COPILOT & AI ENABLEMENT**
**Help PSP Projects become a digitally enabled, AI-ready organisation**
**Company**
PSP Projects Limited
  
  
**Location**
Ahmedabad, Gujarat
  
  
**Experience**
10–12 years overall; minimum 8 years relevant M365 experience
  
  
**Function**
IT & Digital Transformation
  
  
**About The Role**
PSP Projects has implemented Microsoft 365, Copilot and associated digital tools as part of its digital transformation journey. We are seeking a hands-on Microsoft 365 and AI specialist who can maximise the value of these investments, improve employee productivity, automate business processes and help prepare the company for responsible, enterprise-wide AI adoption.
  
  
This role is for a solution builder and business enabler—not simply an IT administrator or trainer. The successful candidate will work with Head Office, project teams and our Pre-cast manufacturing operations to turn technology into practical business outcomes.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Microsoft 365 & SharePoint:**
Optimise SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive and other M365 applications. Build a structured document management environment with libraries, metadata, search, version control and appropriate access governance.
  
  
**Copilot & AI Adoption:**
Drive practical Copilot adoption, develop role-based use cases and prompt guidance, and help employees use AI effectively in their daily work.
  
  
**Power Platform & Business Automation:**
Build Power Automate workflows, Power Apps and Power BI dashboards to simplify approvals, reporting and repetitive business processes.
  
  
**AI Agents & Copilot Studio:**
Design, develop and deploy useful AI agents using approved enterprise knowledge sources and business applications. Demonstrate working agents personally developed or implemented.
  
  
**Integration & Governance:**
Support secure integration with SAP S/4HANA, Primavera and Darwinbox. Work with IT teams on identity, access, data protection, security and platform governance.
  
  
**Training & Change Management:**
Conduct hands-on training, develop internal digital champions and measure adoption and productivity improvements.
  
  
**AI Readiness Roadmap:**
Identify high-value AI opportunities across EPC projects, precast manufacturing and corporate functions; prioritize pilots and help move successful solutions into use.
  
  
Candidate Requirements
  
  

* 10–12 years of overall IT experience, including at least 8 years of substantial hands-on Microsoft 365 experience.
* Strong practical knowledge of SharePoint Online, Microsoft 365 and document management.
* Hands-on experience developing Power Automate workflows and Power Apps.
* Experience creating Power BI dashboards and reports.
* Practical experience with Microsoft Copilot and preferably Copilot Studio, including the development of AI agents.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, information security, data governance and enterprise integration.
* Ability to understand business processes, build solutions independently and work with stakeholders across functions.
* Excellent communication, problem-solving and training skills.
* Experience in EPC, construction, infrastructure or manufacturing will be an advantage.

**Education and certifications**
**:**
Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering or related discipline. Relevant Microsoft certifications are desirable; practical capability is more important.
  
  
What We Expect
  
  

* Personally build and demonstrate working solutions—not just manage vendors or deliver presentations.
* Translate business problems into practical M365, automation and AI solutions.
* Help employees adopt technology and show measurable improvements in productivity, process efficiency and access to information.
* Contribute to a secure, well-governed and scalable foundation for enterprise AI.

**PRACTICAL SELECTION REQUIREMENT**
Shortlisted candidates will be asked to demonstrate solutions they have personally developed or implemented, particularly in SharePoint, Power Automate and Copilot Studio / AI agents. Certifications and theoretical knowledge alone will not be sufficient.
  
  
Why Join PSP Projects?
  
  
Lead an important digital transformation initiative, work on real-world AI applications across construction and manufacturing, and help shape how a growing EPC organisation uses technology for the future.
  
  
**Join PSP Projects and help transform the way we work through Microsoft 365, automation and AI.**

title: EHR Implementation Project Manager – EMR / Practice Management
description:
📍 Ahmedabad, Gujarat | UK business hours | Notice periods up to 60 days

**Take UK clinics from their first workflow workshop to a live service you continue to own**

Have you implemented
**eClinicalWorks (eCW)**
, configured an
**ambulatory EMR or Practice Management**
system, or helped a clinic or hospital get more out of its live
**EHR or HMIS**
?

Script Assist is hiring an
**EHR Implementation Project Manager**
to lead UK clinics and pharmacies through discovery, configuration, product demos, training and go-live. Once the customer is live, you’ll stay their main contact: helping them solve problems, improve workflows and get more from the platform.

If you’ve worked as an
**Implementation Project Manager, EMR Project Manager, Post Implementation Project Manager**
, or as a
**Strategic Account Manager with hands-on EHR implementation experience**
, we’d like to hear from you. We also welcome Clinical Application Specialists and Software Training Specialists who have helped design or configure client workflows and are ready to lead the wider rollout.

🏥
**About Script Assist**

Script Assist builds the technology and operating infrastructure behind private healthcare in the UK. Our platform supports
**tens of thousands of prescriptions every month**
, with established scale in medical cannabis and expansion into ADHD, weight management, longevity and specialist medicine.

Our software connects patient registration, appointments, consultations and prescribing with pharmacy dispensing, inventory, payments and the patient app. A change you make to a clinic’s workflow can affect what the clinician sees, what the pharmacy receives and what the patient does next. You’ll work directly with those customers and with the Product and Engineering teams building the platform.

⚙️
**What you’ll own**

* **Discovery and workflow design.**
  Lead workshops with clinicians, practice managers and pharmacy teams. Understand how they work today, recommend a better setup and turn agreed requirements into configuration decisions.

title: Vice President of Manufacturing
description:
**Role Objective:**

The key objective of this role is to provide global strategic and operational leadership for Biotech's manufacturing network of six sites, producing sterile implantable ophthalmic devices, sterile hyaluronic-acid–based products and ophthalmic surgical consumables.

The role is responsible for safe, compliant, right-first-time and cost-competitive manufacturing; delivering the production plan agreed through S&OP; driving sustained COGS and per-unit cost reduction; commissioning new capacity on time, on budget and on specification; and keeping all manufacturing sites inspection-ready at all times for US FDA, EU MDR Notified Bodies, HPRA, ANVISA, CDSCO and MDSAP.

The position is the senior-most manufacturing leader in the organisation, partnering with the CEO, the senior leadership team and cross-functional teams on network strategy, investment and long-term capability building.

**Desired Candidate Profile:**

**Education**

* Master’s in Engineering or Pharmacy with MBA/PGDM preferred

**Experience & Role Requirements:**

* 20+ years of manufacturing experience in medical devices/sterile pharmaceuticals, including 8–10 years in multi-site leadership and management of large-scale, international operations.
* Strong hands-on expertise in sterile/aseptic manufacturing, terminal sterilization, sterile filling, cleanrooms, environmental monitoring, sterile filtration, bioburden control, packaging validation, and sterility assurance.
* Proven experience in greenfield/brownfield plant commissioning, manufacturing transformation, automation, site transfers, capacity planning, and business continuity.
* Strong track record in regulatory inspections, remediation, global QMS/GMP compliance, and applicable medical device, ophthalmic, implantable, sterilization, and sterile packaging standards.
* Demonstrated manufacturing excellence through Lean, Six Sigma, TPM, Kaizen, cost reduction, digital manufacturing systems, shop-floor automation, traceability, inspection, and analytics.
* Experience in global MedTech/sterile manufacturing environments, preferably with exposure to precision manufacturing, IOLs/OVDs, sterile filling, BFS, and management of in-house and contract sterilization operations.

**Role & Responsibilities:**

1. Own the global manufacturing strategy, network footprint and 3–5-year capacity roadmap for all sites.
2. Lead, direct and hold accountable the Site Heads and central manufacturing functions — Engineering & Projects, Manufacturing Excellence, MSAT / Technology Transfer and EHS.
3. Build a high-performing manufacturing leadership team, with succession plans for every Site Head and critical role.
4. Keep every site permanently inspection-ready, working hand-in-hand with the independent Corporate Quality Assurance function; own site-level deviations, CAPA and root-cause analysis to closure.
5. Maintain sterile / aseptic manufacturing to the highest standard — cleanroom classification and monitoring, water and HVAC systems, media fills and a contamination control strategy per EU GMP Annex 1.
6. Ensure effective validation, control, and periodic revalidation of sterilization and sterile barrier packaging processes in line with applicable standards, including oversight of contract sterilization providers.
7. Deliver the monthly S&OP production plan with ≥95% schedule attainment, ensuring OTIF delivery of finished goods in partnership with Supply Chain.
8. Ensure site gross margin as per approved budget and drive a per-unit cost-reduction roadmap through conversion-cost discipline, daily production cost and yield reviews, BOM control, waste elimination, automation and capacity utilisation.
9. Build a Lean / Operational Excellence culture through tiered Kaizen, TPM and Six Sigma projects with measured, audited savings, and lead the manufacturing digitalization roadmap.
10. Deliver capex and expansion projects from conception to commissioning, qualification and regulatory approval — on time, on budget and on specification.
11. Lead technology transfer and new product introduction from R&D to commercial manufacturing, including scale-up, process validation and design-transfer readiness.
12. Own EHS and business continuity for all sites — zero lost-time injuries, environmental compliance and tested contingency plans for critical utilities, equipment, sterilization capacity and single-site products.
13. Govern manufacturing Opex and Capex budgets, support strategic investment and make-vs-buy decisions, and establish and report manufacturing KPIs for management review.

**Functional Skills Required**

* Strong experience in multi-site sterile manufacturing network management, including capacity planning, Capex evaluation, and make-vs-buy decisions; working knowledge of SAP manufacturing and costing modules, with S/4HANA exposure preferred.
* Quality-first leadership with strong strategic thinking and financial acumen.
* Proven ability to execute transformation, develop leaders across sites, and influence senior cross-functional stakeholders.

**Team Size to be Handled**

* Direct reports: Site Heads and Central function heads.

**Important Links**

Website: https://biotechhealthcare.com/

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/biotechhealthcare/

Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Cluster (OSD & Injectable Facilities)

**Position Overview**

Lead the Engineering Function across a cluster of pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities comprising OSD, Sterile Injectables, Utilities and Infrastructure. The role maps close coordination and performance oversight with Site Engineering Heads while ensuring reliability, compliance, operational excellence, sustainability and cost competitiveness.

• Standardize engineering systems, maintenance practices, SOPs and reliability programs.

• Establish a matrix engineering organization and drive engineering excellence across all sites.

• Lead RCA investigations and implement lessons learned to eliminate repeat failures.

• Improve MTBF and reduce MTTR across facilities.
