• Ensure PM compliance above 98%.

• Drive 100% calibration compliance for GMP critical systems.

• Lead utility management for HVAC, Chillers, Boilers, Electrical Systems, WFI, Pure Steam and

Compressed Air.

• Drive energy conservation and sustainability initiatives.

**5. Engineering Financial Management & Cost Control**

• Own Engineering OPEX budgets.

• Monitor engineering revenue budgets and expenditure controls.

• Deliver annual cost reduction targets.

**6. Engineering QMS & Compliance**

• Govern deviations, CAPA, change controls and risk assessments.

• Ensure GMP compliance and audit readiness.

**7. Regulatory Inspection Readiness**

• Lead preparedness for USFDA, MHRA, EU GMP and customer audits.

**8. Risk Management & Operational Excellence**

• Drive TPM, Lean and Business Continuity programs.

* Standardization of Critical Engineering Records
* Coordination with Production/Stakeholders for Harmonization of Validation Documents templates e.g. URS/DQ/IQ/OQ/PQ across Sites
* Scientific Mapping of Inventory Management
* Horizontal Deployment of Inventory Management and Best practices across Sites

• Develop Site Engineering Heads and build organizational capability.

Energy Conservation Initiatives; Breakdown Reduction; Effective RCA & Lessons Learned; PM Compliance ≥98%; Calibration Compliance 100%; Engineering Revenue Budget Monitoring & Control; Cost Reduction Savings; MTBF Improvement; MTTR Reduction; Equipment Availability ≥98%; Zero Critical Engineering QMS Observations;

B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation or equivalent. 20+ years of pharmaceutical engineering experience with exposure to OSD, Sterile Injectable and Utilities operations.

description:
**Founder's Office Intern – Strategy & Growth, Ahmedabad**

**Company:**

Divine Brands Pvt. Ltd. | Parent Company of DosBros Fresh Mexican Grill India

**Location:**

Ahmedabad, Gujarat

**Work Mode:**

Full-time, Work from Office

**Internship Duration:**

6 months

**Stipend:**

₹14,000 per month + performance bonus of up to ₹10,000 per month

**Probation Period:**

First 15 days

**Joining Requirement:**

Immediate joiners only (join within 5 working days), Candidates who are based in ahmedabad, Gujrat or Ready to Relocate.

**About Divine Brands & DosBros**

Divine Brands Pvt. Ltd. is the company behind DosBros India, bringing the bold flavours of a US-origin Mexican QSR brand to the Indian market.

DosBros has 60+ locations globally across the USA, India and Canada, with an expanding presence in India.

We are on an ambitious journey to build DosBros into one of India's leading Mexican QSR brands, with a strong focus on expansion, brand building, innovation, strategic partnerships and business growth.

As we scale across cities and explore new business opportunities, we are looking for an ambitious and entrepreneurial individual to work directly with the Founder and senior management.

**About the Role**

This is a high-ownership, generalist internship for someone who wants to understand how businesses are built, scaled and funded.

You will act as Entrepreneur in Residence and will work across business strategy, growth initiatives, brand management, marketing, fundraising and business development. You will be involved in evaluating new opportunities, coordinating strategic projects, strengthening brand presence, supporting investor outreach and helping convert business plans into execution.

This is not a conventional desk internship. We are looking for someone who can think independently, work with data, communicate effectively, manage multiple priorities and take ownership of outcomes.

**Think like an entrepreneur. Operate like a business owner. Execute with ownership.**

**Key Responsibilities**
**1. Strategy & Business Growth**

* Work directly with the Founder and senior management on strategic initiatives, business planning and growth strategies.
* Conduct market research, competitor analysis and feasibility assessments to evaluate new business opportunities.
* Identify new revenue streams, business models and expansion possibilities.
* Assist in preparing business plans, financial models, management reports and presentations.
* Track business performance, analyse data and convert findings into actionable recommendations.

**2. Brand Management & Marketing**

* Contribute to strengthening DosBros' brand positioning, brand value, market presence and overall awareness across India.
* Work with external marketing consultants and the internal team to strategise, coordinate and follow up on marketing campaigns, promotional activities and brand-building initiatives, tracking timely execution and deliverables.
* Support new product launches, menu innovations, existing product promotions and seasonal campaigns, coordinating with restaurant teams for effective on-ground implementation and customer engagement.

**3. Fundraising & Investor Relations**

* Research and identify suitable investors, including angel investors, HNIs, family offices, strategic investors and funds interested in consumer, food and beverage, retail or brick-and-mortar businesses.
* Build and maintain a structured investor database and outreach pipeline, and support initial investor communication and follow-ups.
* Assist in preparing and refining investor presentations, fundraising proposals, financial models, unit economics and business expansion plans.
* Coordinate investor meetings, maintain communication records and support the fundraising process, including information sharing and due-diligence coordination.

**4. Business Development & Strategic Partnerships**

* Support franchise development, franchise partner coordination and expansion initiatives across India.
* Explore corporate partnerships, catering opportunities, packaged meals and institutional business opportunities.
* Coordinate with food delivery aggregators such as Zomato and Swiggy, POS providers, technology partners, franchise partners and other external stakeholders.
* Identify and evaluate strategic partnerships, new business models and opportunities to generate additional revenue.
* Manage business discussions, follow-ups and execution coordination with external partners.

**5. Project Management & Operational Execution**

* Take ownership of assigned business projects and drive them from planning through execution.
* Coordinate cross-functional initiatives involving marketing, finance, supply chain, technology and business development teams.
* Track project timelines, identify execution bottlenecks and follow up with relevant stakeholders.
* Ensure timely implementation of management decisions and strategic priorities.
* Prepare progress updates, reports and presentations for the Founder and senior management.

**Who Should Apply?**

We are looking for someone who:

* Has an entrepreneurial mindset and a genuine interest in startups, business strategy and company building.
* Is comfortable working in an ambiguous, fast-paced environment.
* Takes ownership and follows through without requiring constant supervision.
* Has strong analytical, research, problem-solving and communication skills.
* Can manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
* Is comfortable with business research, Excel-based analysis, presentations and external stakeholder coordination.
* Is proactive, resourceful, detail-oriented and execution-focused.

Previous exposure to a Founder's Office, CEO's Office, business strategy, business operations, fundraising, investor relations, marketing or management consulting will be an advantage, but is not mandatory.

Freshers and candidates with 0–2 years of experience are welcome to apply if they demonstrate strong initiative, ownership and entrepreneurial thinking.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Management, Engineering or a related field.
* Strong working knowledge of MS Excel, PowerPoint and Google Workspace.
* Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok.
* Strong research, documentation, presentation and analytical abilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to prepare business reports, investor presentations, research documents and analytical summaries.
* Interest in business strategy, fundraising, consumer brands and the food and beverage industry.

**Why Join Us?**

* **Direct Founder Exposure:**

  Work closely with the Founder on strategic business priorities and growth decisions.
* **Business-Building Experience:**

  Understand how a multi-outlet consumer business operates, expands and raises capital.
* **Fundraising Exposure:**

  Participate in investor research, outreach, fundraising preparation and investor coordination.
* **Cross-Functional Learning:**

  Work across strategy, marketing, brand management, business development and finance.
* **High Ownership:**

  Take responsibility for meaningful projects and see your work translate into business outcomes.
* **Career Growth:**

  Opportunity to be considered for a Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) or full-time role based on performance, contribution and business requirements.

**Internship Structure & Compensation**

* **Duration:**

  6 months.
* **Probation:**

  First 15 days of the internship.
* **Stipend:**

  ₹14,000 per month + performance based bonus upto ₹10,000.
* **Working Hours:**

  11:00 AM – 8:00 PM, Full time, work from office
* **Joining:**

  Immediate joiners only.

A PPO or full-time employment opportunity will be offered to high-performing interns, subject to their contribution, performance.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates should email their updated CV along with a short cover letter or introduction explaining:

1. Why they are interested in working in a Founder's Office.
2. Their interest in strategy, business growth, marketing or fundraising.
3. Any relevant projects, internships or experiences demonstrating ownership and execution ability.
4. Why they believe they would be a good fit for this role at Dosbros India.

**Email:**

admin@dosbros.in

**CC:**

pratham.dsbs@gmail.com

**Subject:**

Application – Founder's Office Strategy & Growth Intern – Ahmedabad

**Important:**

Only candidates who are available to join immediately or within a 5 days should apply.

title: Pavement Engineer
description:
**Role Description**
The Pavement Engineer will be responsible for designing, evaluating, and optimizing pavement structures for road and infrastructure projects in the Greater Ahmedabad Area. On a day-to-day basis, this full-time, on-site role includes conducting pavement condition assessments, preparing design reports, analyzing materials and traffic loading, and supporting pavement management decisions. The Pavement Engineer will collaborate with geotechnical specialists, construction teams, and project managers to develop cost-effective solutions and ensure compliance with relevant standards and specifications. The role also involves reviewing drawings, monitoring construction quality related to pavements, and providing technical input on rehabilitation and maintenance strategies. The engineer will document findings, present recommendations to stakeholders, and support continuous improvement of pavement performance and lifecycle planning.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong skills in Pavement Engineering and Pavement Design, including structural analysis and material selection.
* Experience with Pavement Management practices, including condition surveys, performance modeling, and lifecycle cost analysis.
* Knowledge of Geotechnical Engineering principles related to subgrade evaluation, soil characterization, and foundation interaction.
* Practical understanding of Asphalt materials, mix design, and construction quality control for flexible pavements.
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Civil Engineering or a closely related discipline.
* Familiarity with relevant codes, standards, and guidelines for highway and pavement design.
* Proficiency with engineering design and analysis software (e.g., pavement design tools, CAD, and basic modeling applications).
* Ability to work on-site in the Greater Ahmedabad Area, manage multiple projects, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Strong analytical, documentation, and communication skills, with attention to detail and safety-focused decision making.

title: Integration Architect - FHIR
description:
**Job Title:**
FHIR Integration Architect

**Job Type:**
Contractor

**Location:**
Remote

**About the Role**

We're building an independent FHIR R4 interoperability layer that lets our CRM's clinical workflows starting with provider launch directly from inside the EHR, beginning with Oracle Health (Cerner) PowerChart. We need someone who can do both halves of this job well: design and personally validate the technical architecture, and lead the engineers full-stack, AI, and QA who build it. This is not a design-and-handoff role. You'll be in the SMART on FHIR launch flow when it breaks, in the code review when a mapping rule is wrong, and in the room when the team needs a call made.

**What You'll Own**

**Architecture & Solution Design**

•    
**Own**
the end-to-end architecture of the FHIR layer — SMART on FHIR launch and OAuth2, the canonical data model, the EMR adapter framework, tenant isolation, and event-driven orchestration — and keep it extensible to future EMRs (Epic, athenahealth) and formats (HL7v2, X12) beyond the Cerner pilot.

•    
**Make**
build-vs-buy and vendor decisions (self-hosted HAPI FHIR vs. a managed FHIR store; Keycloak vs. a commercial identity provider; build vs. adopt an interface engine) and can defend the reasoning to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.

•    
**Design**
the architecture against HIPAA-grade security and auditability requirements from day one — encryption, least-privilege access, audit trails — not as a pre-launch retrofit.

•    
**Validate**
the architecture against real constraints: Oracle Health/Cerner's actual FHIR R4 conformance, US Core and Da Vinci PAS implementation guides, and the operational realities of a live, EHR-embedded launch — not just a reference diagram.

**Technical Leadership & Delivery**

•    
**Lead**
a cross-functional engineering pod — full-stack engineers, AI/ML engineers, and QA engineers — setting technical direction, running code and design reviews, and removing blockers day to day.

•    
**Translate**
the solution architecture into a sequenced, phased delivery plan (proof of concept → pilot → multi-client scale) and hold the team accountable to it.

•    
**Own**
technical risk — surfacing integration blockers, vendor API gaps, and compliance findings early, and driving them to resolution rather than escalating and waiting.

**Integration, Standards & Compliance**

•    
**Lead**
the Cerner/Oracle Health integration end to end: SMART App Launch (EHR launch, OAuth2/OIDC, fhirUser claims), Ignite APIs registration, and coordination with the client health system's Cerner administrators.

•    
**Define and enforce**
conformance testing (ONC Inferno, US Core / Da Vinci PAS validation) before any integration is called production-ready.

•    
**Partner with**
compliance and security stakeholders on HIPAA Security Risk Assessments, BAAs, and audit-trail requirements.

**Required Qualifications**

•    8+ years in healthcare interoperability or integration engineering, including 3+ years in an architect or technical lead capacity.

•    Deep, hands-on FHIR R4 experience — resource modeling, RESTful FHIR APIs, and at least one implementation guide (US Core at minimum).

•    Direct experience implementing SMART App Launch (EHR and/or standalone launch), OAuth2/OIDC, and at least one major EHR's FHIR API — Cerner/Oracle Health experience specifically preferred given Phase 1 scope.

•    Hands-on experience with HAPI FHIR or an equivalent FHIR server — server customization and multi-tenant partitioning are a strong plus.

•    Cloud architecture experience on AWS or equivalent: containers, managed relational databases, event-driven services (queues/event buses), and core identity/security services.

•    Proven experience leading or managing engineers — running reviews, setting direction, and being accountable for a team's delivery, not only your own.

•    Working knowledge of healthcare data exchange beyond FHIR — HL7v2, X12, CDA — sufficient to plan for future extensibility.

•    Solid understanding of HIPAA technical safeguards and healthcare data compliance requirements.

**Strongly Preferred**

•    Direct, hands-on experience with Oracle Health (Cerner) Millennium / Ignite APIs and PowerChart SMART app registration — or the Epic App Orchard equivalent.

•    Experience with Keycloak or another open-source identity provider, including custom extension/SPI development.

•    Familiarity with Da Vinci implementation guides (PAS, CRD, DTR) and FHIR-based prior authorization workflows.

•    Experience in patient support programs, prior authorization, or healthcare CRM domains.

•    Experience standing up a healthcare integration function from near-zero on a small team, not only operating within an already-mature enterprise integration group.

•    Familiarity with applying AI/ML to healthcare data mapping, document generation, or clinical NLP — relevant given the AI engineers on this team.

**Tech Stack You'll Work With**

**FHIR & integration standards -**
FHIR R4, SMART App Launch v2, US Core, Da Vinci PAS, OAuth2 / OIDC, HL7v2 (future-facing)

**FHIR server -**
HAPI FHIR (JPA server), multi-tenant partitioning

**Identity -**
Keycloak, custom SMART-launch extension (SPI)

**Cloud / infra -**
AWS — Fargate/ECS, Aurora PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, API Gateway, WAF, EventBridge/SQS, Secrets Manager, KMS, CloudWatch/OpenSearch

**IaC / delivery -**
Terraform or AWS CDK, CI/CD (GitHub Actions or CodePipeline), Docker

**Target EHR (Phase 1) -**
Oracle Health / Cerner Millennium (Ignite APIs, PowerChart chart-toolbar launch)

**Conformance testing -**
ONC Inferno test kit (incl. Da Vinci PAS), Synthea synthetic data

title: Voice Specialist - US Patient Insurance
description:
Job Summary
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Medical Billing Supervisor with strong hands-on knowledge of US healthcare medical billing and Revenue Cycle Management (RCM). The ideal candidate will be responsible for independently managing end-to-end medical billing operations while supervising, guiding, and monitoring the existing billing team.
  
  
The candidate should have strong expertise in insurance verification, eligibility checks, claims processing, payment posting, accounts receivable (AR), denial management, and insurance follow-ups. Previous experience in Dermatology medical billing will be highly preferred.
  
  
Key Responsibilities:
  
  
- Manage and oversee the complete end-to-end US medical billing process, from patient registration to final payment collection.
  
- Perform insurance eligibility verification and benefits checks, including coverage, deductibles, copayments, coinsurance, and policy limitations.
  
- Verify insurance information, prior authorization, and referral requirements before patient appointments and procedures.
  
- Review patient demographics, medical records, charges, and billing information for accuracy.
  
- Handle charge entry, CPT and ICD-10 coding validation, and electronic claim submission.
  
- Monitor claim submissions and resolve clearinghouse rejections and billing discrepancies.
  
- Manage payment posting, EOB (Explanation of Benefits), ERA (Electronic Remittance Advice), and insurance adjustments.
  
- Handle insurance follow-ups, outstanding claims, unpaid claims, and accounts receivable (AR) management.
  
- Identify and resolve claim denials, rejections, and underpayments, including corrected claims and appeals.
  
- Monitor AR aging reports and ensure timely follow-up with insurance companies.
  
- Supervise and manage the existing medical billing team, allocate daily tasks, and monitor productivity.
  
- Independently handle complex billing activities while providing operational guidance and support to team members.
  
- Train and mentor billing staff on insurance verification, claims processing, denial management, and billing procedures.
  
- Review team performance, ensure billing accuracy, and maintain quality standards.
  
- Prepare and analyze daily, weekly, and monthly billing reports, including collections, claim status, denial rates, and AR performance.
  
- Coordinate with healthcare providers, internal teams, and other stakeholders to resolve billing-related issues.
  
- Ensure compliance with US healthcare billing regulations, HIPAA guidelines, and established operational procedures.
  
- Identify process improvement opportunities to enhance billing accuracy, efficiency, and revenue collection.
  
  
Required Skills & Qualifications:
  
  
- Strong experience in US healthcare medical billing and Revenue Cycle Management (RCM).
  
- Hands-on experience managing the complete medical billing cycle.
  
- Excellent knowledge of insurance verification, eligibility checks, and benefits investigation.
  
- Experience in claims submission, charge entry, payment posting, EOB/ERA, AR follow-ups, and denial management.
  
- Good understanding of CPT and ICD-10 coding.
  
- Previous experience managing or supervising a medical billing team.
  
- Ability to work independently and manage daily billing operations.
  
- Strong analytical, communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills.
  
- Experience working with EHR/EMR and medical billing software.
  
  
Preferred Qualifications:
  
  
- Previous experience in Dermatology medical billing.
  
- Knowledge of dermatology procedures, specialty-specific billing, and coding.
  
- Experience with eClinicalWorks (eCW) or similar EMR systems.
  
- Experience handling US healthcare clients and insurance providers.

title: Human Resources Executive
description:
**People, Processes & Compliance — HR cum Admin Executive**

**Job Title**

HR cum Admin Executive

**Department**
Human Resources & Administration

**Company**
Kambaa

**Experience**
3–5 years

**Employment Type**
Full-time | Mandatory work from office

**Location**
Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu — on-site only

**Company Overview — Kambaa**

Kambaa is an AI-first digital transformation company helping organizations get more value from their technology through SaaS implementation, integration and managed services. We work across leading business platforms and collaborate with a broad technology partner ecosystem, including Freshworks, HubSpot, Zoho and monday.com. Our teams support organizations in India and international markets.

**AI-First Culture**

At Kambaa, we encourage employees across functions to embrace intelligent tools, automation and data-driven ways of working. In HR and administration, that means continuously improving accuracy, documentation, employee experience and operational efficiency.

**Role Snapshot**

We are looking for a proactive HR cum Admin Executive with 3–5 years of hands-on experience managing HR operations, statutory compliance and office administration. The successful candidate will independently coordinate people processes, maintain reliable records, support employees and leadership, and ensure day-to-day administrative activities run smoothly. Candidates from any industry are welcome, provided they have relevant practical experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle**

* Coordinate recruitment activities, interview scheduling, candidate communication and joining formalities.
* Manage onboarding, induction, employee documentation, confirmations, transfers and exit formalities.
* Maintain accurate employee records, HR files, attendance, leave and other employee lifecycle documentation.
* Support employee queries, internal communication, policy implementation and employee engagement activities.

**2. Statutory Compliance & HR Documentation**

* Coordinate applicable statutory HR and labour-law compliance activities, including PF, ESI, professional tax and other relevant requirements, with internal teams or external consultants as needed.
* Maintain compliance registers, employee documents, renewals, filing calendars and audit-ready records.
* Track deadlines and follow up on statutory submissions, policy documentation and compliance-related actions.
* Support HR audits and assist management in identifying process gaps and corrective actions.

**3. Payroll, Attendance & HR Reporting**

* Compile and validate attendance, leave, payroll inputs, deductions and employee changes for payroll processing.
* Coordinate with finance, payroll partners and employees to resolve payroll-related discrepancies in a timely manner.
* Prepare periodic HR reports, trackers and dashboards covering headcount, joining, exits, leave and compliance status.

**4. Office Administration & Vendor Coordination**

* Oversee daily office administration, housekeeping, office supplies, facilities and general workplace readiness.
* Coordinate with vendors and service providers for office maintenance, utilities, procurement and renewals.
* Maintain asset and inventory records, track administrative expenses and verify vendor invoices for approval.
* Arrange internal meetings, travel, logistics and employee-related administrative support when required.

**5. Process Improvement & Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Create and maintain clear HR and admin SOPs, checklists, trackers and document repositories.
* Work closely with leadership, finance and functional managers to ensure timely completion of employee and administrative processes.
* Identify opportunities to streamline workflows using spreadsheets, HR software and appropriate automation or AI tools.
* Handle sensitive employee information with discretion, accuracy and confidentiality.

**Requirements**

* 3–5 years of relevant hands-on experience in HR operations, compliance and administration; candidates from any industry may apply.
* Working knowledge of applicable Indian HR and statutory compliance processes; ability to coordinate with compliance advisors where required.
* Practical experience with employee documentation, attendance, payroll inputs, onboarding and exit formalities.
* Experience coordinating office operations, vendors, facilities and administrative records.
* Good spoken and written English, interpersonal skills and the confidence to coordinate across teams.
* Strong working knowledge of MS Excel, Word, email and digital recordkeeping; familiarity with HRMS or payroll tools is an advantage.
* A bachelor’s degree in HR, business administration, commerce or a related field is preferred.

**What Makes a Strong Fit**

* Ownership mindset: follows up independently and ensures tasks are completed.
* Compliance discipline: monitors dates, documentation and accuracy without constant reminders.
* Organized and approachable: balances employee support with structured processes.
* Adaptable and improvement-oriented: willing to use technology and AI-enabled tools to simplify routine work.

**Work Location & Employment Requirement**

**This is a full-time, mandatory on-site position at Kambaa’s Coimbatore office.**
Applicants must be available to work from the Coimbatore office. This is not a work-from-home, remote or hybrid opportunity, and the role is not offered at any other location.

**Career Development at Kambaa**

The role offers opportunities to strengthen expertise in HR operations, compliance governance, administrative process ownership and AI-enabled workplace operations, with scope to take on broader people-operations responsibilities as the organization grows.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates can submit their updated resume, highlighting relevant experience in statutory compliance, HR operations and office administration.

title: Solution Engineer
description:
**Introduction**
At IBM Global Sales, we bring together innovation, collaboration, and expertise to help clients solve their most complex business challenges. Working across industries and geographies, you'll partner with colleagues, clients, and partners to co-create solutions that drive digital transformation and lasting impact.Success in Global Sales is built on curiosity, empathy, and collaboration. You'll connect technical understanding with strong people skills, building trusted relationships and shaping solutions that improve business and society. With world-class onboarding, continuous learning, and a supportive culture, IBM offers the tools and opportunities to grow your career. Join us and be part of a global team that's passionate about driving innovation and making a difference.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
Solutions Engineers at Confluent play a critical role across the customer journey. They help customers evaluate the platform, design the right technical approach, prove value quickly, and build confidence in adopting data streaming patterns that solve meaningful business problems. This role sits at the intersection of technical depth, customer discovery, solution design, and business value articulation.
  
  
In this role, you will partner closely with Account Executives and cross-functional teams to uncover stated and unstated customer needs, shape strong technical strategies, and guide customers toward successful adoption of Confluent. You will be expected to lead technical discovery, own the technical win, and build trusted relationships with technical and business stakeholders.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Lead technical discovery with prospects and customers to uncover business drivers, technical requirements, risks, and success criteria.
* Design and present solution architectures that clearly connect Confluent capabilities to customer outcomes, technical constraints, and long-term platform strategy.
* Own and drive technical evaluations, proofs of concept, and proof of value activities from initial scope through technical win.
* Run workshops, white boarding sessions, and architecture discussions with developers, architects, platform teams, and business stakeholders.
* Help customers adopt best practices for data streaming, cloud, hybrid, and event-driven architectures as they move from individual projects toward broader platform adoption.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Support, Professional Services, and Customer Success to remove blockers, shape solutions, and improve customer outcomes.
* Contribute to account strategy with Account Executives by helping qualify opportunities, build champions, and strengthen the technical and business case for change.
* Create reusable assets such as demos, presentations, reference architectures, discovery patterns, or enablement material that scale beyond a single account.
* Mentor other Solutions Engineers by sharing best practices, giving constructive feedback, and helping lift the technical quality of the wider team.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Experience in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Solution Architecture, or a similar customer-facing technical role.
* Experience working with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, streaming or messaging platforms, data integration, and modern data platforms.
* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, networking, containers, Kubernetes, and modern application architectures.
* Ability to run high-quality discovery, map pain points to solution approaches, and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience leading technical evaluations, workshops, and customer presentations in complex enterprise sales cycles.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with confidence engaging developers, architects, and senior customer stakeholders.
* Hands-on experience with one or more of Java, Python, SQL, or similar technologies commonly used to build and integrate data-driven applications.
* A self-starter mindset with strong judgment, curiosity, and the ability to learn quickly, operate independently, and solve ambiguous technical problems.
* Proven ability to collaborate across functions and build trust with colleagues, customers, and partners.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Experience with Kafka, Apache Flink, stream processing, or real-time analytics platforms.
* Familiarity with value-based selling, MEDDPICC or similar qualification frameworks.
* Experience creating repeatable demos, technical content, playbooks, or enablement material for the broader field organization.
* A track record of mentoring peers and influencing team practices beyond your own accounts.
* Comfort engaging senior customer stakeholders and helping shape larger platform or transformation discussions.

•    
**Make**
build-vs-buy and vendor decisions (self-hosted HAPI FHIR vs. a managed FHIR store; Keycloak vs. a commercial identity provider; build vs. adopt an interface engine) and can defend the reasoning to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.

•    
**Design**
the architecture against HIPAA-grade security and auditability requirements from day one — encryption, least-privilege access, audit trails — not as a pre-launch retrofit.

•    
**Validate**
the architecture against real constraints: Oracle Health/Cerner's actual FHIR R4 conformance, US Core and Da Vinci PAS implementation guides, and the operational realities of a live, EHR-embedded launch — not just a reference diagram.

**Technical Leadership & Delivery**

•    
**Lead**
a cross-functional engineering pod — full-stack engineers, AI/ML engineers, and QA engineers — setting technical direction, running code and design reviews, and removing blockers day to day.

•    
**Translate**
the solution architecture into a sequenced, phased delivery plan (proof of concept → pilot → multi-client scale) and hold the team accountable to it.

•    
**Own**
technical risk — surfacing integration blockers, vendor API gaps, and compliance findings early, and driving them to resolution rather than escalating and waiting.

**Integration, Standards & Compliance**

•    
**Lead**
the Cerner/Oracle Health integration end to end: SMART App Launch (EHR launch, OAuth2/OIDC, fhirUser claims), Ignite APIs registration, and coordination with the client health system's Cerner administrators.

•    
**Define and enforce**
conformance testing (ONC Inferno, US Core / Da Vinci PAS validation) before any integration is called production-ready.

•    
**Partner with**
compliance and security stakeholders on HIPAA Security Risk Assessments, BAAs, and audit-trail requirements.

**Required Qualifications**

•    8+ years in healthcare interoperability or integration engineering, including 3+ years in an architect or technical lead capacity.

•    Deep, hands-on FHIR R4 experience — resource modeling, RESTful FHIR APIs, and at least one implementation guide (US Core at minimum).

•    Direct experience implementing SMART App Launch (EHR and/or standalone launch), OAuth2/OIDC, and at least one major EHR's FHIR API — Cerner/Oracle Health experience specifically preferred given Phase 1 scope.

•    Hands-on experience with HAPI FHIR or an equivalent FHIR server — server customization and multi-tenant partitioning are a strong plus.

•    Cloud architecture experience on AWS or equivalent: containers, managed relational databases, event-driven services (queues/event buses), and core identity/security services.

•    Proven experience leading or managing engineers — running reviews, setting direction, and being accountable for a team's delivery, not only your own.

•    Working knowledge of healthcare data exchange beyond FHIR — HL7v2, X12, CDA — sufficient to plan for future extensibility.

•    Solid understanding of HIPAA technical safeguards and healthcare data compliance requirements.

**Strongly Preferred**

•    Direct, hands-on experience with Oracle Health (Cerner) Millennium / Ignite APIs and PowerChart SMART app registration — or the Epic App Orchard equivalent.

•    Experience with Keycloak or another open-source identity provider, including custom extension/SPI development.

•    Familiarity with Da Vinci implementation guides (PAS, CRD, DTR) and FHIR-based prior authorization workflows.

•    Experience in patient support programs, prior authorization, or healthcare CRM domains.

•    Experience standing up a healthcare integration function from near-zero on a small team, not only operating within an already-mature enterprise integration group.

•    Familiarity with applying AI/ML to healthcare data mapping, document generation, or clinical NLP — relevant given the AI engineers on this team.

**Tech Stack You'll Work With**

**FHIR & integration standards -**
FHIR R4, SMART App Launch v2, US Core, Da Vinci PAS, OAuth2 / OIDC, HL7v2 (future-facing)

**FHIR server -**
HAPI FHIR (JPA server), multi-tenant partitioning

**Identity -**
Keycloak, custom SMART-launch extension (SPI)

**Cloud / infra -**
AWS — Fargate/ECS, Aurora PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, API Gateway, WAF, EventBridge/SQS, Secrets Manager, KMS, CloudWatch/OpenSearch

**IaC / delivery -**
Terraform or AWS CDK, CI/CD (GitHub Actions or CodePipeline), Docker

**Target EHR (Phase 1) -**
Oracle Health / Cerner Millennium (Ignite APIs, PowerChart chart-toolbar launch)

**Conformance testing -**
ONC Inferno test kit (incl. Da Vinci PAS), Synthea synthetic data

title: AR Analyst
description:
**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented
**AR Analyst**

to manage and optimize accounts receivable operations within our US healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM) process.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in insurance claim follow-ups, denial management, appeals, payment reconciliation, and AR aging analysis. The individual will be responsible for identifying payment discrepancies, resolving outstanding claims, minimizing revenue leakage, and ensuring timely reimbursement from insurance providers.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage and monitor accounts receivable portfolios, ensuring timely follow-up on outstanding insurance claims.
* Analyze AR aging reports, identify high-value and aging accounts, and prioritize follow-ups to maximize collections.
* Investigate and resolve claim denials, rejections, underpayments, and payment discrepancies by coordinating with insurance companies.
* Handle denial management and prepare, submit, and track appeals with appropriate supporting documentation.
* Conduct detailed reviews of medical records and supporting documentation to identify errors, discrepancies, and missing information affecting claim payments.
* Coordinate with internal clinical, billing, and administrative teams to resolve documentation and billing-related issues.
* Perform payment posting reviews and reconciliation to identify discrepancies between billed and reimbursed amounts.
* Follow up with insurance companies through calls, portals, and other communication channels to obtain claim status and expedite pending payments.
* Identify recurring denial trends and root causes, recommending corrective actions to improve collections and reduce claim rejections.
* Maintain accurate documentation of all insurance follow-ups, claim statuses, appeals, and resolution activities.
* Prepare and share regular AR performance reports, highlighting collection progress, pending claims, and unresolved issues.
* Ensure adherence to established billing guidelines, payer requirements, and internal RCM processes.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline (preferred).
* **Minimum 3 years of relevant experience**

  in Accounts Receivable, Medical Billing, or US Healthcare Revenue Cycle Management.
* Strong working knowledge of US healthcare insurance processes, claim lifecycles, and reimbursement procedures.
* Hands-on experience in denial management, insurance follow-ups, appeals, and AR aging management.
* Experience working with US insurance portals and payer follow-up processes.
* Ability to analyze AR reports, identify collection gaps, and independently work toward claim resolution.
* Knowledge of medical documentation requirements and their impact on claim processing and reimbursement.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other MS Office applications.
* Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities while meeting deadlines.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of assigned AR accounts.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary starting at ₹40,000+ per month, based on experience and expertise.
* Opportunities to work with US healthcare RCM processes and gain deeper industry exposure.
* Professional development and opportunities for career advancement.
* A collaborative and supportive work environment.
* An opportunity to contribute directly to improving revenue cycle efficiency and operational performance.

**Join Proficio Therapy Services and be part of a team that values excellence, accountability, continuous learning, and innovation.**

Oracle Cloud EPM Account Reconciliation (ARCS)
  
Senior Consultant
  
Job Summary:
  
We are seeking an experienced Oracle Cloud EPM Account Reconciliation (ARCS) Senior Consultant with strong hands-on expertise in Reconciliation Compliance, high-volume Transaction Matching, reconciliation governance, reporting, integrations and automation. The role will support solution design and independently deliver application configuration, data loads, matching rules, workflow, testing, deployment, documentation and production support under the guidance of project leadership.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities:**

* Participate in end-to-end Oracle Cloud EPM Account Reconciliation implementations, rollouts, enhancements and support engagements.
* Conduct requirement-gathering and design discussions; document reconciliation, control, compliance and transaction-matching requirements.
* Configure Reconciliation Compliance, including periods, calendars, currencies, organisational units, attributes, formats, profiles, reconciliation methods, risk ratings and workflow.
* Configure preparer and reviewer assignments, tolerances, variance analysis, auto-reconciliation, ageing, alerts, notifications, attachments, comments, electronic sign-offs and audit evidence.
* Design Transaction Matching solutions using multiple data sources, match types, transaction types, one-to-one, one-to-many, many-to-one and many-to-many rules, tolerance logic and date or amount adjustments.
* Configure and tune auto-match rules, suggested matches, manual matching, adjustments, unmatched-item ageing, exception handling and reconciliation integration.
* Develop balance-sheet, intercompany, bank, cash, subledger-to-ledger, system-to-system and operational reconciliation use cases.
* Create and support operational and compliance dashboards, predefined and custom reports, reconciliation-status reporting, ageing analysis, match-rate monitoring and exception reporting.
* Develop and support integrations with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, E-Business Suite, SAP, FCCS, banks, subledgers, data warehouses and external systems using Data Integration, EPM Automate, REST APIs and file-based interfaces.
* Automate profile imports, balance and transaction loads, currency rates, reconciliation creation, auto-match execution, period-status changes, journal exports, reporting and job monitoring.
* Execute CRP, SIT, UAT, data migration, reconciliation-cycle validation, volume and performance testing, cutover, go-live and hypercare; investigate defects and support root-cause resolution.
* Prepare configuration workbooks, functional and technical specifications, match-rule designs, test scripts, training materials, operating procedures and deployment documentation.
* Support security, segregation of duties, reconciliation policies, audit trails, evidence retention, data lineage, controls and production-support procedures.
* Collaborate with finance, controllership, audit and technical teams; guide junior consultants, participate in peer reviews and support demonstrations and estimations.

Requirements
  
  
**Experience:**

* Minimum 5+ years of Oracle EPM, finance transformation or account-reconciliation experience, including strong hands-on Oracle Cloud EPM Account Reconciliation experience.
* At least two full-lifecycle Oracle EPM implementations, including one ARCS implementation covering Reconciliation Compliance and Transaction Matching.
* Strong knowledge of balance-sheet reconciliation, account substantiation, reconciliation governance, risk-based workflow, variance analysis and financial-close controls.
* Hands-on experience with periods, formats, profiles, rules, currencies, organisational units, workflow, auto-reconciliation, ageing and dashboards.
* Hands-on Transaction Matching experience with data sources, match types, matching rules, adjustments, exceptions, auto-match optimisation and high-volume data sets.
* Experience integrating ARCS with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP or other source systems and automating processes through Data Integration, EPM Automate and REST APIs.
* Experience supporting workshops, configuration, testing, migration, reconciliation-cycle validation, cutover, go-live and post-production support.
* Industry experience in government, retail, energy, real estate, oil and gas, financial services, or power and utilities is preferred.

**Competencies / Skills:**

* Oracle Cloud EPM Account Reconciliation configuration, administration and connected financial-close processes
* Reconciliation Compliance, periods, formats, profiles, workflow, risk ratings, ageing, auto-reconciliation and audit evidence
* Transaction Matching data sources, match types, rules, tolerances, adjustments, exceptions and match-performance optimisation
* Balance-sheet, intercompany, bank, cash, subledger-to-ledger, system-to-system and operational reconciliations
* Operational and compliance dashboards, predefined and custom reports, ageing, variance, status and exception analysis
* Data Integration, EPM Automate, REST APIs, Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, FCCS and third-party ERP, bank and subledger integrations
* Security, segregation of duties, controls, audit trails, evidence retention, data lineage and compliance reporting
* Awareness of Predictive AI, Reconciliation Assignment Assistance, Transaction Matching Assistance, confidence scores, anomaly detection and governed human review is desirable
* Strong accounting, analytical, problem-solving, requirement analysis, documentation and stakeholder communication skills
* Strong teamwork, mentoring and delivery capabilities; willingness to travel and work MENA business timings

title: Senior Zabbix Engineer
description:
Nuventure Connect is looking for an experienced Zabbix Architect / Subject Matter Expert (SME) with strong hands-on expertise in enterprise-scale Zabbix environments.

About the Role

We are looking for a Zabbix SME to lead a major monitoring modernization initiative involving
**two enterprise Zabbix environments currently running on versions 4.x and 7.x**
.

The project includes upgrading both environments to
**Zabbix 7.4**
, optimizing approximately
**150 Zabbix templates**
, and consolidating the environments into a unified deployment.

The existing production environment has
**10,000+ active monitoring configurations**
, so this role requires strong hands-on technical expertise in Zabbix architecture, troubleshooting, optimization, migration and enterprise-scale monitoring.

Key Responsibilities

• Assess existing Zabbix architecture, configuration, infrastructure, database and monitoring design.

• Evaluate scalability, performance, availability and operational efficiency.

• Identify architectural bottlenecks and configuration gaps and recommend improvements.

• Plan and execute the upgrade of Zabbix environments to
**Zabbix 7.4**
, including compatibility validation, testing, backups, rollback planning and production deployment.

• Review and optimize approximately
**150 Zabbix templates**
, including items, discovery rules, triggers, macros, preprocessing, dependencies and update intervals.

• Identify redundant monitoring items, inefficient polling, duplicate checks and unnecessary data collection.

• Reduce false positives, alert noise and unnecessary notifications.

• Design and execute the consolidation of two Zabbix environments into a single deployment.

• Handle configuration differences, host identity conflicts, duplicate monitoring entities, dependencies and migration requirements.

• Review history/trend retention, housekeeping, database performance and storage utilization.

• Optimize triggers, thresholds, dependencies, severity levels, event-generation logic and escalation workflows.

• Conduct gap analysis and align the monitoring environment with Zabbix and enterprise monitoring best practices.

• Identify opportunities for automation using Zabbix APIs, automated host registration, LLD, template linkage and configuration management.

• Develop or improve scripts and integrations where required.

• Prepare architecture documents, migration plans, technical documentation and operational runbooks.

• Provide knowledge transfer to internal infrastructure and monitoring teams.

Required Technical Expertise

* Extensive hands-on experience with
  **Zabbix architecture, administration, troubleshooting and performance optimization**
* **Strong experience with Zabbix 4.x and 7.x**
* **Hands-on experience with Zabbix upgrades, migrations and consolidation projects**
* **Strong understanding of Zabbix Server, Proxy, Agent, Templates, Items, Triggers, Actions, Events and Discovery**
* **Experience developing, reviewing, debugging and optimizing complex Zabbix templates**

* **Experience with history/trend storage, retention policies, housekeeping and database optimization**

* **Experience with PostgreSQL or MySQL/MariaDB**
  and database performance troubleshooting
* Strong
  **Linux administration and troubleshooting**
  skills
* Working knowledge of
  **Python, Bash or similar scripting/automation**
* **Experience with REST APIs, integrations and automated configuration management**
* **Understanding of production change management, backup/recovery, rollback planning and implementation validation.**

Preferred Experience

• MSP or multi-tenant monitoring environment experience

• Experience managing multiple customer environments and tenant-specific monitoring requirements

• Experience designing highly available and scalable Zabbix architectures

• Large-scale infrastructure monitoring across data centers, virtualization, network devices and storage

• Experience with historical monitoring data migration and retention/archival strategies

Oracle Cloud EPM Account Reconciliation (ARCS)

Job Summary:
  
We are seeking an experienced Oracle Cloud EPM Account Reconciliation (ARCS) Senior Consultant with strong hands-on expertise in Reconciliation Compliance, high-volume Transaction Matching, reconciliation governance, reporting, integrations and automation. The role will support solution design and independently deliver application configuration, data loads, matching rules, workflow, testing, deployment, documentation and production support under the guidance of project leadership.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities:**

* Configure Reconciliation Compliance, including periods, calendars, currencies, organisational units, attributes, formats, profiles, reconciliation methods, risk ratings and workflow.
* Configure preparer and reviewer assignments, tolerances, variance analysis, auto-reconciliation, ageing, alerts, notifications, attachments, comments, electronic sign-offs and audit evidence.
* Design Transaction Matching solutions using multiple data sources, match types, transaction types, one-to-one, one-to-many, many-to-one and many-to-many rules, tolerance logic and date or amount adjustments.

* Create and support operational and compliance dashboards, predefined and custom reports, reconciliation-status reporting, ageing analysis, match-rate monitoring and exception reporting.
* Develop and support integrations with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, E-Business Suite, SAP, FCCS, banks, subledgers, data warehouses and external systems using Data Integration, EPM Automate, REST APIs and file-based interfaces.
* Automate profile imports, balance and transaction loads, currency rates, reconciliation creation, auto-match execution, period-status changes, journal exports, reporting and job monitoring.
* Execute CRP, SIT, UAT, data migration, reconciliation-cycle validation, volume and performance testing, cutover, go-live and hypercare; investigate defects and support root-cause resolution.
* Prepare configuration workbooks, functional and technical specifications, match-rule designs, test scripts, training materials, operating procedures and deployment documentation.
* Support security, segregation of duties, reconciliation policies, audit trails, evidence retention, data lineage, controls and production-support procedures.
* Collaborate with finance, controllership, audit and technical teams; guide junior consultants, participate in peer reviews and support demonstrations and estimations.

Requirements
  
  
**Experience:**

* Minimum 5+ years of Oracle EPM, finance transformation or account-reconciliation experience, including strong hands-on Oracle Cloud EPM Account Reconciliation experience.
* At least two full-lifecycle Oracle EPM implementations, including one ARCS implementation covering Reconciliation Compliance and Transaction Matching.
* Strong knowledge of balance-sheet reconciliation, account substantiation, reconciliation governance, risk-based workflow, variance analysis and financial-close controls.
* Hands-on experience with periods, formats, profiles, rules, currencies, organisational units, workflow, auto-reconciliation, ageing and dashboards.
* Hands-on Transaction Matching experience with data sources, match types, matching rules, adjustments, exceptions, auto-match optimisation and high-volume data sets.
* Experience integrating ARCS with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP or other source systems and automating processes through Data Integration, EPM Automate and REST APIs.
* Experience supporting workshops, configuration, testing, migration, reconciliation-cycle validation, cutover, go-live and post-production support.
* Industry experience in government, retail, energy, real estate, oil and gas, financial services, or power and utilities is preferred.

**Competencies / Skills:**

* Oracle Cloud EPM Account Reconciliation configuration, administration and connected financial-close processes
* Reconciliation Compliance, periods, formats, profiles, workflow, risk ratings, ageing, auto-reconciliation and audit evidence
* Transaction Matching data sources, match types, rules, tolerances, adjustments, exceptions and match-performance optimisation
* Balance-sheet, intercompany, bank, cash, subledger-to-ledger, system-to-system and operational reconciliations
* Operational and compliance dashboards, predefined and custom reports, ageing, variance, status and exception analysis
* Data Integration, EPM Automate, REST APIs, Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, FCCS and third-party ERP, bank and subledger integrations
* Security, segregation of duties, controls, audit trails, evidence retention, data lineage and compliance reporting

title: Development Manager
description:

The company combines a strong customer-first focus with high operating efficiency and streamlined claim settlement processes, supported by robust ethical standards. SBI Life has a wide presence across India through an extensive network of offices, employees, agents, partners, and branches, and is steadily enhancing digital experiences for customers, distributors, and employees. title: Solution Engineer
description:
**Introduction**
At IBM Global Sales, we bring together innovation, collaboration, and expertise to help clients solve their most complex business challenges. Working across industries and geographies, you'll partner with colleagues, clients, and partners to co-create solutions that drive digital transformation and lasting impact.Success in Global Sales is built on curiosity, empathy, and collaboration. You'll connect technical understanding with strong people skills, building trusted relationships and shaping solutions that improve business and society. With world-class onboarding, continuous learning, and a supportive culture, IBM offers the tools and opportunities to grow your career. Join us and be part of a global team that's passionate about driving innovation and making a difference.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
Solutions Engineers at Confluent play a critical role across the customer journey. They help customers evaluate the platform, design the right technical approach, prove value quickly, and build confidence in adopting data streaming patterns that solve meaningful business problems. This role sits at the intersection of technical depth, customer discovery, solution design, and business value articulation.
  
  
In this role, you will partner closely with Account Executives and cross-functional teams to uncover stated and unstated customer needs, shape strong technical strategies, and guide customers toward successful adoption of Confluent. You will be expected to lead technical discovery, own the technical win, and build trusted relationships with technical and business stakeholders.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Lead technical discovery with prospects and customers to uncover business drivers, technical requirements, risks, and success criteria.
* Design and present solution architectures that clearly connect Confluent capabilities to customer outcomes, technical constraints, and long-term platform strategy.
* Own and drive technical evaluations, proofs of concept, and proof of value activities from initial scope through technical win.
* Run workshops, white boarding sessions, and architecture discussions with developers, architects, platform teams, and business stakeholders.
* Help customers adopt best practices for data streaming, cloud, hybrid, and event-driven architectures as they move from individual projects toward broader platform adoption.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Support, Professional Services, and Customer Success to remove blockers, shape solutions, and improve customer outcomes.
* Contribute to account strategy with Account Executives by helping qualify opportunities, build champions, and strengthen the technical and business case for change.
* Create reusable assets such as demos, presentations, reference architectures, discovery patterns, or enablement material that scale beyond a single account.
* Mentor other Solutions Engineers by sharing best practices, giving constructive feedback, and helping lift the technical quality of the wider team.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Experience in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Solution Architecture, or a similar customer-facing technical role.
* Experience working with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, streaming or messaging platforms, data integration, and modern data platforms.
* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, networking, containers, Kubernetes, and modern application architectures.
* Ability to run high-quality discovery, map pain points to solution approaches, and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience leading technical evaluations, workshops, and customer presentations in complex enterprise sales cycles.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with confidence engaging developers, architects, and senior customer stakeholders.
* Hands-on experience with one or more of Java, Python, SQL, or similar technologies commonly used to build and integrate data-driven applications.
* A self-starter mindset with strong judgment, curiosity, and the ability to learn quickly, operate independently, and solve ambiguous technical problems.
* Proven ability to collaborate across functions and build trust with colleagues, customers, and partners.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Experience with Kafka, Apache Flink, stream processing, or real-time analytics platforms.
* Familiarity with value-based selling, MEDDPICC or similar qualification frameworks.
* Experience creating repeatable demos, technical content, playbooks, or enablement material for the broader field organization.
* A track record of mentoring peers and influencing team practices beyond your own accounts.
* Comfort engaging senior customer stakeholders and helping shape larger platform or transformation discussions.

title: Senior Staff Software Development Engineer
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.
  
  
We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.
  
  
**Role**
We are looking for a Senior Staff Software Development Engineer (Service Platform & Orchestration) to join our team. This is a Hybrid (3 days in office) role, reporting to the Senior Manager, Software Engineering in the Zero Trust Exchange department.
  
  
In this high-ownership position, you will engineer the management plane and reliability systems that govern ZIA’s fleet lifecycle at massive scale. This is a hands-on building role where you will lead the transformation of our infrastructure from legacy automation into a stateful, durable management plane (built on Temporal) to achieve deterministic “one-touch” provisioning and lifecycle operations. You will treat “infrastructure as a distributed system,” developing self-healing capabilities and AI-driven Software Engineering practices for a global fleet of 100k+ instances.
  
  
**What You’ll Do (Role Expectations)**

* Lead the hands-on development and migration to a workflow-as-code platform (Temporal), building replay-safe, idempotent workflows that ensure deterministic operations across a global scale
* Move the organization beyond “scripted automation” toward a robust management plane that treats the entire global fleet as a single, eventually-consistent distributed system
* Design and implement services that leverage LLMs and ML for intelligent signal correlation, automated triage, and “self-correcting” fleet operations
* Develop framework-level services and internal APIs that ensure all new products are delivered “orchestration-ready” with reliability hooks built directly into the code
* Build deep telemetry (metrics, traces, and events) into the management plane so that every fleet-wide action is fully explainable, auditable, and replayable

**Who You Are (Success Profile)**

* You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
* You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
* You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
* You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
* You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

**What We’re Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)**

* Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
* BS/MS in Computer Science or a related technical field with 5 to 8+ years of experience in hyperscale systems, with a deep understanding of the unique failure modes and technical hurdles that only emerge at massive scale
* Mastery of backend systems languages with a strong preference for Go (or deep expertise in Java with a demonstrated ability to rapidly adopt Go), along with a proven track record of setting the bar for code quality and distributed system correctness
* Strong experience designing and operating complex distributed systems, with a focus on solving systemic challenges in concurrency, failure handling, and performance optimization
* Proven track record of developing Platform APIs (REST/gRPC) with strong guarantees for idempotency, verification, and safe rollout patterns

**What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)**

* Hands-on experience leveraging AI code-assistance tools (e.g., Cursor, Windsurf) to accelerate legacy refactoring alongside building LLM/ML-driven signal correlation or automated fleet triage in distributed systems
* Proficiency in PostgreSQL, or other relational stores used for high-scale, stateful management-plane services
* Direct experience building or operating systems with Temporal.io, Cadence, or similar workflow engines

title: Principal Engineer
description:
**Why this role exists**

Our engineering team is young. We have about 30 engineers, six new team leads and one senior

architect. The leads are good builders who have not led before. They need someone to learn from

every day.

AI agents now write a large share of our code. Design, review and judgement have become the

scarce skills. This role brings them.

**About Company**

We build customised holidays for Indian travellers. We have done this for over 12 years

from Chennai.

A traveller plans a trip with us, a seller helps them decide, and our team delivers it on the ground.

Technology runs through all of it: the website and app, the sales funnel, pricing and supply,

booking, and everything after booking.

**How tech is organised**

You report to Chief Architect. The six team leads look to you for every technical

call.

**The roles you will play**

1. Guide to the six leads. You review their designs and code, and you pair with them on the hard

problems. Every lead gets your time every week.

2. Keeper of standards. You set how we design APIs, test, release and code with AI agents.

Then you make sure it is followed.

3. Builder. You stay hands-on. Expect a good part of your week in code.

4. Chief Architect's partner on architecture. You work with him on data unification and on the API layer

that our website, partners and agents all use.

5. Owner of one critical system. In your first months you own one system end to end, most

likely payments.

6. Hiring bar. You interview engineers and decide who is good enough.

**What you will not do:**

• Manage people. Appraisals and staffing stay with the founder.

• Set AI direction. That sits with the AI head. You make sure agents call our systems safely.

Your first 90 days

• By day 30: you know the codebase, the six leads and where each team is stuck. You have

shipped one fix or feature yourself.

• By day 60: design reviews run every week with every lead. Our standards for APIs, tests and

releases are written down and in use.

• By day 90: one critical system is fully yours. Each lead can name one thing they do better

because of you.

**What we look for**

• 8 to 12 years of building software, full stack with most of it in backend.

• Our stack: Java and Spring Boot, MongoDB, React.

• Time spent on systems where a mistake costs money: booking, payments, fintech or

commerce.

• You code with AI agents every day, and you can show us how.

• The role is in Chennai.

The three skills that matter most:

1. Backend system design.

2. API and data modelling.

3. Code review and debugging across the stack.

The one quality: you enjoy making other engineers better. A teacher's patience matters more here

than being the best coder in the room.

The opportunity

• Six leads grow because of you. That is how we will measure this role.

• You shape how a team builds with AI agents. We are early, and the habits you set will stay.

• The problems are real. Live pricing and supply, bookings that cannot fail, voice AI in sales,

and post-booking work that runs without people.

**What is coming up:**

• One unified data layer across our systems.

• A Holidays API that banks and partners sell from.

• A new product for travellers outside India.

• A CTO decision. We have not hired one. We will decide once this structure settles, and

whoever does this role well is part of that conversation

title: Agentic AI Orchestrator
description:
**Job Summary**

The Agentic AI Orchestrator designs, builds, and operates the Investment Division's agentic AI workflows—the automated, multi-step processes through which AI agents read documents, reconcile data, draft analysis, and assemble reporting across the division's clusters. The role converts analyst workflows into orchestrated agent pipelines with human review gates, owns the division's prompt, skill, and agent library, and is accountable for the accuracy, auditability, and cost of every automated output.

The position anchors the division's AI-led operating model from the Chennai office, working alongside the Data Engineer (data pipelines and infrastructure) and the ML Engineer (models and evaluation), and serves as the bridge between the investment analysts and the division's AI tooling

**ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

1. Design, build, and operate agentic AI workflows for the division's recurring processes: document extraction and reconciliation, portfolio and company performance monitoring, report and IC pack assembly, and data-room processing.

2. Translate analyst and reporting workflows into orchestrated multi-agent pipelines with defined human review gates, so that no figure or recommendation is published without analyst sign-off.

3. Own the division's prompt, skill, agent, and plugin library: design, versioning, testing, and documentation, ensuring workflows are reusable across clusters rather than one-off chats.

4. Integrate agents with the division's systems and data sources — document repositories, custodian and administrator reporting, and the division's knowledge base — working with the Data Engineer on pipelines and access.

5. Build and run evaluation harnesses with the ML Engineer: accuracy benchmarks against verified ground truth, regression testing on workflow changes, and periodic audits of automated outputs.

6. Implement AI governance and guardrails: access controls and confidentiality boundaries for family and portfolio data, audit trails for every automated output, and compliance with the Group's AI usage policies.

7. Monitor agent performance, cost, latency, and failure modes; triage incidents, maintain runbooks, and drive continuous improvement of workflow reliability.

8. Train and support the division's analysts in AI-assisted working practices; capture their feedback and convert it into a prioritised automation backlog.

9. Maintain complete documentation of all orchestrated workflows, their data sources, model versions, and review controls, ensuring every automated output is reproducible and auditable.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Minimum Education Required**

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related quantitative field.

• Strong Python engineering skills: API integration, data handling, and production-quality code with testing and version control (Git).

• Hands-on experience building LLM-based and agentic systems in production: workflow orchestration, tool and function calling, and multi-agent patterns — using frameworks such as LangGraph or LangChain, or SDK-native orchestration (e.g. Claude Agent SDK). Framework experience matters less than sound orchestration design.

• Practical RAG experience: document chunking, embeddings, vector databases (e.g. pgvector, Pinecone, Qdrant, or similar), hybrid search, and retrieval evaluation.

• Experience building or integrating MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and tools, or equivalent connector architectures linking AI agents to enterprise systems and data sources.

• Familiarity with LLM evaluation and observability tooling (accuracy benchmarks, regression tests, tracing); disciplined prompt and skill engineering with versioning and documentation.

• Understanding of data privacy, access control, and audit requirements for confidential financial data; exposure to investment or financial reporting workflows preferred.

**Years of experience are required.**

• Minimum of 4 to 7 years of experience in software or AI engineering, of which at least 2 years hands-on with LLM-based or agentic systems in production, at a technology firm, financial institution, or data-driven enterprise.

title: Senior Product Manager - Trading Platform, Backend & Data (India, Chennai)
description:
**About GoCharting**

GoCharting is a web-native charting and trading workflow platform with institutional-grade orderflow and DOM tools — footprint/cluster charts, volume/market profile, cumulative delta, imbalance charts, DOM trading. We are the only platform that delivers these capabilities fully on the web. Comparable to TradingView for general charting, but differentiated as the leader in the professional orderflow niche. PE-acquired and funded in 2025, profitable, 3M+ registered traders globally, with a mandate to scale 10x over 4 years. A US rebrand is underway and multi-asset coverage (US equities and options) is being added — the platform is entering its most important chapter, and the backend is where that growth is won or lost.

**The Role**

This is a senior, hands-on product role at the core of how GoCharting works. The product's moat is technical — real-time market data, orderflow, and the systems that move it — and this role owns the part of the roadmap that makes that moat deeper. You will run backend and platform product work and own our third-party data integrations end-to-end: the exchange feeds, broker connections, and market-data vendors that everything traders see is built on.

You are the
**product counterpart to a backend engineering team we are scaling right now**
— new senior engineers on the payments/billing platform, on market-data and broker connectivity, and on the core platform and SDK. Your job is to sequence and scope that work into a coherent roadmap, write the specs engineers build from, and hold the line on quality and reliability. You report to the Head of Product and partner daily with the CTO and his engineers, with Business Development (who sign the deals), and with QA and Support. This is an individual-contributor role — no direct reports, plenty of ownership.

You move fast, write clearly, and make decisions with engineers, not over them. You are comfortable in the technical detail — APIs, data contracts, latency, schemas — without needing to be told what matters. In year one, success looks like a backend roadmap that ships, faster and more reliable data integrations, and a platform that stops being the thing users complain about.

**What you'll do**

* **Own the backend & platform roadmap**
  — market-data services, real-time pipelines, APIs, the SDK, and the systems behind charts, alerts, and trading — write clear specs and acceptance criteria, and partner with engineering from design through ship
* **Own third-party data integrations end-to-end**
  — exchange feeds, broker connections, and market-data vendors, from evaluation through onboarding to production — and build the playbook so the tenth integration is faster than the first
* **Manage the provider relationship on the product side**
  — scope, data quality, licensing constraints, SLAs, and the day-to-day of keeping feeds healthy (BD owns the commercial deal; you own the technical delivery)
* **Make the trade-offs that matter**
  — latency, reliability, cost, and coverage — and defend them with data
* **Run dependency management**
  — work across Product and Engineering so backend work is well understood, scoped, and scheduled to unblock other teams, sequenced against US expansion and ROI
* **Treat quality and reliability as product features**
  — define what "good" means, measure against it, triage data and platform issues with engineering, and close the loop with Support and power users

**What we're looking for**

**Must-haves:**

* **6–9 years in product management**
  , with real depth on
  **backend, platform, API, or data-heavy products**
  — you've owned infrastructure/data as a product, not just user-facing features
* **Trading, investing, fintech, or financial-data background**
  — you understand market data and the audience
* **You are technical**
  — comfortable with APIs, data models, schemas, and latency/reliability trade-offs, and able to hold your own in an engineering discussion (you read specs and schemas natively; you don't need to write production code)
* **You have shipped third-party or data integrations end-to-end**
  — evaluating providers, onboarding feeds, and owning data quality in production
* **Strong written communication**
  — you write specs and decisions engineers can build from without a meeting
* **Sharp prioritization**
  — you sequence ambiguous, interdependent work and make defensible trade-offs, and you say no
* **Hands-on operator**
  — you work with engineering, not through layers; you get into the detail and ship
* **Comfortable in a lean, fast-scaling team**
  — high ownership, little hand-holding
* **In-person in our Chennai office**

**Nice-to-haves:**

* Worked directly with
  **exchange feeds, broker APIs, or market-data vendors**
  (order book, tick, or OHLC data)
* Familiarity with
  **real-time data infrastructure**
  — streaming, websockets, time-series storage
* **SQL or light scripting**
  to answer your own data questions
* **Payments, billing, or subscription product**
  familiarity — good to have; this surface may come into scope down the line, but it is
  **not a prerequisite**
* **FIX**
  protocol exposure; familiarity with
  **Indian (NSE/MCX/SEBI)**
  and
  **US (CME)**
  market structure
* **AI-native workflow**
  — you use modern tooling to multiply your output
* **Top-tier Indian institution**
  (IIT/NIT/IIM) — nice-to-have, not a gate

Full-Time

**Travel**
