title: Senior Manager- HR
description:
**Role Overview**

The Senior HR Manager owns end-to-end HR for India and coordinates HR operations across locations. Partnering closely with HR professionals based in Pune and directly supporting Chennai, this role ensures effective delivery of HR programs and processes while maintaining hands-on involvement in key people matters.

As a member of the global HR team, you will collaborate with senior leaders and HR colleagues across regions to shape and execute people strategies, lead selected global HR initiatives, and ensure local and global priorities are effectively aligned. Serving as the primary HR partner for India, you will adapt global programs for local needs while bringing India's perspective into workforce, talent, and organizational decisions.

**Role Responsibilities**

**HR operations and HRIS**

* Run the full employee lifecycle after onboarding: confirmations, transfers, promotions, role changes, separations and exit formalities.
* Own employee records, HR letters and the HRIS, keeping data audit-ready and producing headcount and attrition reports.

**Payroll and benefits**

* Run monthly payroll inputs with the payroll vendor and finance, and administer statutory benefits: PF, ESI, gratuity, bonus, professional tax and TDS.
* Manage group health, term life and accident insurance, and benchmark pay against the Chennai tech market for the annual salary review.

**Employee relations and engagement**

* Act as the first point of contact for employee concerns and grievances, and resolve employee relations and disciplinary matters fairly and confidentially.
* Plan engagement activities, recognition programs and pulse surveys, and act on what they show.
* Manage the Internal Committee under the POSH Act, including training, annual reporting and case handling.

**HR business partnering and leadership support**

* Hold regular 1:1s with employees and managers on career goals, team health, performance and retention risks.
* Coach managers on feedback, underperformance and difficult conversations, and guide first-time managers.
* Spot workload, morale or attrition trends, run stay and exit interviews, and recommend retention actions to leadership.
* Represent India in global HR initiatives, and advise India leadership on workforce planning, organization design and retention.
* Partner with the Pune HR team: work with the recruitment and onboarding specialist on hiring plans and a smooth handover of new hires, and with the Pune HR manager to apply consistent HR practices across both locations.

**Performance management**

* Run the India performance review cycle in line with the global process, link outcomes to increments, promotions and variable pay, and coordinate training.

**Compliance and policy**

* Keep the India entity compliant with central and Tamil Nadu labour laws, including the Shops and Establishments Act and the four Labour Codes and their rules.
* Maintain statutory registers, returns and licenses, support audits, own the India handbook and HR policies, and protect employee data under the DPDP Act.

**Required Qualifications**

* 10 or more years of progressive HR experience, with at least 4 years as an HR generalist or manager, including as the lead HR person for an India entity of 50 to 200 employees.
* Global HR experience, adapting global programs to Indian law and practice, and a track record of working effectively as part of a distributed, global team.
* Working knowledge of Indian labour law and statutory compliance, including the Labour Codes, PF, ESI, gratuity, POSH and the Shops and Establishments Act.
* Hands-on experience with payroll inputs, benefits vendors, and employee relations investigations.
* An MBA or postgraduate degree in HR (or equivalent), and excellent written and spoken English.

**Preferred**

* Experience with Paylocity or a similar HRIS, ideally at the India arm of a US or European technology or SaaS company.
* Experience building HR policies and processes in a growing company, and fluency in Tamil.

**Why Join Virtana?**

* Make a direct impact on a global technology company, and shape how HR in India evolves as it grows.
* Work in a flexible, innovative, and collaborative environment.
* Competitive compensation, equity opportunities, and group health, term life and accident insurance.

description:

**Job Summary**
---------------

The Product Owner is the responsible person to ensure that the bank continues to deliver superior service to our clients by building new capabilities and maintaining existing ones along with all other squad members. The Product Owner works with Clients, business users and stakeholders, risk & compliance colleagues, and Domain colleagues to define in detail what’s needed in order to meet the vision. Thereafter, the Product Owner works closely with the squads to deliver the prioritised vision.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Strategy**  
• Maximize the business value of the product or service by ensuring we “deliver the right thing at the right time”
  
• Responsible for the execution of build and maintain activities for their product or services throughout the lifecycle.
  
• Ensure alignment with strategic outcomes and scorecard priorities.
  
• Ensure the delivery of the "right thing at the right time," contributing to the Business plan and scorecard outcomes.
  
• Craft the vision and concept development of a product.
  
• Develop and maintain the roadmap and Squad backlog by liaising with, teams, and key stakeholders or SME's i.e., country / region / product or client and technical specialists.
  
• Build strong acceptance criteria for new deliveries that take into account business processes and variations, data quality, system speed and UX.
  
• Ensure data-driven prioritization in alignment with strategic outcomes and scorecard.
  
• Work with technical counterparts to mitigate technical debt and balance risk, and regulatory items with new features, functionality, or changes to keep the cost of change low.
  
• Work in partnership with technology to ensure a balance of functional and non-functional requirements are represented in the backlog and that there is an approach to mitigate or avoid technical debt.
  
• Ensures the Product Strategy and Roadmap is transparent, visible, understood by the Delivery Squads and is regularly reviewed with the delivery Squad.

* Asist to Develop and maintain the roadmap and backlog of the Squad with PO (Products/Services) and Engineering Lead using relevant data points to determine the appropriate roadmap milestones. Regularly review and refine it based on relevant data.

• Collaborate on technology roadmap and solution with the Engineering Lead, to drive optimum outcomes.
  
• Assist to regularly review the Squad performance metrics (both in sprint delivery and the performance after go-live) on a regular basis and to use these insights to execute continuous improvement with the Squad.
  
• Build a cadence of measuring business outcomes and benefits. Work closely with markets/segments to ensure that the features can provide the intended benefits which are measured and reviewed in key forums.
  
**Business**  
• Engage with clients, stakeholders, and end users and represent their voice on the product backlog.
  
• Work closely with Stakeholders to ensure the Product Backlog is created and maintained according to business value/ROI.
  
• Facilitate prioritization discussions with all relevant stakeholders including local, regional, country representatives.
  
• Optimize value delivery through Continuous Improvement through relevant data and frequent feedback from stakeholders, SMEs, and customers.
  
• Engage in continuous backlog management, by refining user stories with clear narratives and acceptance criteria.
  
• Prioritize and refine backlog items using data points through collaboration with the technical delivery SMEs.
  
• Use lifecycle tools like ADO and Confluence, to plan, track, and manage backlog items.

* Ensure the Product Backlog is transparent, visible, and understood.

• Potentially support multiple teams if their backlog items come from the same Product Backlog.
  
**Processes**  
• Accountable to ensure the backlog is maintained regularly and backlog user stories are clearly articulated through engagement in continuous backlog management, writing user stories., conducting user story walk-throughs with the delivery Squad and writing clear narratives and acceptance criteria.
  
• Accountable to sign off on the delivery of the backlog items (user stories) and ensure the acceptance criteria has been met i.e., through Squad showcases and / or functional walkthroughs of the product / service in use (live).
  
• Accountable to ensure backlog is regularly refined, prioritised and worked on with the Squad members.
  
• Accountable to ensure sign off of all user stories.
  
• Accountable to be present at Squad showcases / demonstrations to support user story sign off and releases.
  
• Must be present at team meetings including but not limited to backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily stand up, showcase, retrospectives.
  
• Adopt and embed the Change Delivery Standards throughout the lifecycle of the product/service.
  
• Adhere to and execute the relevant delivery processes outlined in the Group Enterprise Software Delivery Lifecycle guidelines (eSDLC)
  
• Continuously review and consider ways to reduce / eliminate manual processes.
  
• Awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.
  
• Participate in the quarterly planning for the Hive and provide steer along with Hive Tech Lead.

**People & Talent**  
• Collaborate and ensure availability for all meetings as an active, daily as a core member of the squad.
  
• Champion and act as a role model of the Group's values and culture.
  
• Collaborate daily as a core member of the team.
  
• Cultivate a high-performance culture and true ‘self-organising’ team by empowering the Squad, celebrating wins, learning from reviews, and conducting regular retrospectives for continuous improvement.
  
**Risk Management**  
• Responsible for effective risk management across all initiatives planed for product.
  
• Balance technical debt, risk, and regulatory items with new features, functionality, or changes to keep the cost of change low.
  
**Governance**  
• Follow the specified governance process for agile delivery
  
• Manage releases and reporting in line with ESDLC standards and other bank governance activities/standards.

**Motivations**  
• Motivated by delivering high-quality operational outcomes while ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies.
  
• Energised by identifying opportunities for process improvement, driving operational efficiency, and enhancing customer and stakeholder experiences.
  
• Thrives in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment that requires problem-solving, critical thinking, and effective decision-making.
  
• Driven by collaborating with cross-functional teams to achieve shared business objectives and deliver sustainable business outcomes.
  
• Demonstrates resilience and adaptability when managing complex operational challenges, changing priorities, and continuous business transformation.
  
• Motivated by developing people, fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement, and supporting team success through coaching and leadership.

**Skills and Experience**
-------------------------

**Must-have Skills**  
• Triple A Plus functional knowledge
  
• Wealth Management processes
  
• Wealth Product lifecycle
  
**Other Skills**  
• Process analysis and Requirements design
  
• Communication & Stakeholder management
  
• Portfolio Performance Methodology and computation approach
  
• Agile Delivery
  
• MS office applications – Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, Word etc.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Certifications / Qualifications**  
• Agile Product Owner
  
• Bachelors / Masters from reputed institutions or equivalent
  
**Languages**  
• English; Additional Asian languages are a plus

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
**About Picmatic Media**

Picmatic Media is a performance-driven IT and digital growth company focused on helping businesses build a strong, scalable and profitable digital presence.

We combine technology, creativity, branding and performance marketing to create end-to-end digital growth ecosystems. Our services include website development, SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, social media management, content production, video production and lead generation systems.

We work with healthcare organizations, local businesses, startups and service-based brands, helping them transform their digital presence into measurable business growth.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a creative, strategic and performance-oriented Social Media & Digital Marketing Manager who understands the intersection of branding, content creation, social media, paid advertising and business growth.

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of social media platforms, Google Ads, Meta Ads, content strategy, brand aesthetics and video production workflows.

This role requires someone who can think creatively, understand Gen-Z content trends, maintain premium brand aesthetics and execute data-driven marketing strategies.

You will work closely with the graphic design, videography, video editing and performance marketing teams to develop impactful digital campaigns for Picmatic Media and its clients.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Social Media Management & Strategy**

Develop and execute social media strategies for multiple brands and clients.

Manage Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and other relevant platforms.

Create monthly content calendars, campaign plans and posting schedules.

Develop engaging content ideas, reel concepts, hooks, captions and storytelling formats.

Monitor social media trends, viral formats and platform algorithm updates.

Improve organic reach, engagement, brand visibility and audience growth.

Maintain consistent brand communication across all platforms.

**2. Performance Marketing – Google Ads & Meta Ads**

Plan, execute and optimize advertising campaigns on Google Ads and Meta Ads.

Understand campaign objectives, audience targeting, budget allocation and bidding strategies.

Work on lead generation, website traffic, conversions and remarketing campaigns.

Understand Meta Pixel, Google Analytics 4, conversion tracking and campaign attribution.

Monitor CPC, CPM, CTR, CPL, CPA and ROAS.

Analyze campaign performance and implement optimization strategies.

Coordinate with the sales and lead management teams to improve lead quality and conversions.

**3. Content Production, Videography & Video Editing**

Have a strong understanding of professional video production and shooting processes.

Assist and coordinate with the videography team during shoots.

Understand camera angles, framing, lighting, composition, audio and shot planning.

Participate in pre-production planning, including scripts, storyboards and shot lists.

Understand video editing workflows, transitions, pacing, sound design, colour grading and visual storytelling.

Provide creative inputs and editing references to the video editing team.

Ensure that the final video content aligns with the brand's identity and campaign objectives.

Understand short-form video formats such as Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and promotional videos.

**4. Branding, Creative Direction & Visual Aesthetics**

Develop and maintain consistent brand identities across digital platforms.

Understand brand positioning, typography, colour palettes, layouts and visual communication.

Ensure that social media creatives, videos and campaigns follow brand guidelines.

Maintain premium, modern and visually appealing content aesthetics.

Provide creative direction and references to graphic designers and video editors.

Identify opportunities to improve the overall visual identity of client brands.

**5. Gen-Z Trends & Creative Content**

Stay updated with Gen-Z culture, internet trends, memes, trending audio and digital behaviour.

Understand modern content consumption patterns and viral storytelling techniques.

Develop relatable, engaging and platform-native content without compromising brand positioning.

Experiment with creative formats, storytelling styles and trend-based campaigns.

Bring fresh ideas and innovative approaches to brand communication.

**6. Analytics, Reporting & Performance Optimization**

Track social media performance through Meta Business Suite, Instagram Insights and LinkedIn Analytics.

Prepare monthly performance reports and campaign analysis.

Monitor reach, impressions, engagement, profile visits, website traffic and leads.

Identify content gaps and growth opportunities.

Use data and audience insights to improve content and advertising strategies.

Present campaign performance and recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders.

**7. Team & Client Coordination**

Collaborate with graphic designers, videographers, video editors, developers and performance marketers.

Coordinate end-to-end content production and campaign execution.

Communicate with clients to understand business objectives and marketing requirements.

Manage multiple projects, timelines and deliverables.

Ensure quality control and timely execution of marketing activities.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

Proven experience in Social Media Management and Digital Marketing.

Strong knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads.

Understanding of campaign setup, targeting, optimization and conversion tracking.

Excellent content strategy, copywriting and communication skills.

Strong understanding of branding, aesthetics and creative direction.

Practical knowledge of videography, shooting techniques and production workflows.

Understanding of video editing tools and editing processes.

Knowledge of Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube.

Familiarity with SEO, Google Analytics 4 and lead generation systems.

Ability to understand Gen-Z trends and create engaging digital content.

Strong organizational, project management and problem-solving skills.

Ability to work with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced agency environment.

**Preferred Tools & Platforms**

Meta Ads Manager

Google Ads

Meta Business Suite

Google Analytics 4

Google Search Console

Canva / Adobe Creative Suite

CapCut / Adobe Premiere Pro

Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube

Google Sheets and reporting tools

**What We Are Looking For**

**We are looking for someone who is:**

Creative-minded but equally focused on performance and results. Updated with modern digital trends, Gen-Z culture and social media behaviour. Passionate about branding, visual storytelling and content aesthetics. Confident in understanding professional shoots and video production. Capable of coordinating and guiding creative teams. Comfortable managing multiple brands and marketing campaigns.

Proactive, detail-oriented and willing to experiment with new ideas.

The ideal candidate is not just a social media manager but a complete digital marketing professional who understands how to build brands, create impactful content, run performance campaigns and drive measurable business growth.

This isn’t just another remote opportunity - it’s about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. From day one, you’re welcomed into a genuine community that values your growth and well-being. Our mission is simple: to break down geographic barriers and connect skilled professionals with outstanding global teams and products for full-time, long-term roles. We help you discover meaningful work with teams that invest in your success, where you’re empowered to grow personally and professionally.

  

Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote-first world.

  

**About the Role**

  

As a Senior Computational Designer, you will contribute to the ongoing development of SiteSolve, a generative design tool focused on site viability and masterplanning. The role combines computational design, geometry development and software engineering, with a predominantly back-end focus.

  

You will work directly with a product team member and may collaborate with an AI research and development specialist on initiatives involving AI agents and machine learning-based optimisation. The precise balance of responsibilities will depend on your skills and interests and may evolve as product priorities change.

  

You will contribute to a standalone product that does not depend on third-party computational design tools. The role requires independent ownership of sub-projects, thoughtful problem-solving and an understanding of how individual technical decisions contribute to the wider product.

**Responsibilities**
  

  
* Develop and maintain computational geometry algorithms for a standalone generative design product
  
* Contribute to the ongoing development of SiteSolve, supporting site viability analysis and masterplanning
  
* Design, implement and refine computational optimisation solutions
  
* Build and maintain internal tools supporting product development
  
* Contribute to cloud infrastructure and back-end development
  
* Work across front-end and back-end development, with a predominant focus on back-end functionality
  
* Undertake primarily C# development, which accounts for approximately 99% of the role
  
* Develop code that interacts with the product's 3D engine as its interface transitions from Unity to Unreal, with dedicated Unreal specialists leading the rendering work
  
* Collaborate with product team members on computational design and software development
  
* Potentially contribute to AI-focused research and development, including connecting SiteSolve to AI agents and exploring machine learning-based optimisation approaches
  
* Independently take ownership of assigned sub-projects
  
* Apply a detail-oriented approach while considering the wider context in which the code operates
  
* Demonstrate flexibility, problem-solving ability and thoroughness in technical development
  
  

  
**Requirements**
  

  
* C# – 3+ years: Expert or advanced proficiency in C#, with hands-on experience developing software applications. C# is the primary language used throughout the product, and no substitute programming language is accepted
  
* AEC Computational Design / Geometry – 3+ years: Solid understanding and practical experience in AEC computational design or geometry. Relevant computational or algorithmic design experience from adjacent domains, including manufacturing, robotics, CAD, simulation or games, is also acceptable
  
* Rhino / Grasshopper – 3+ years: Working knowledge of Rhino and Grasshopper or equivalent 3D CAD and parametric design tools
  
* Computational Optimisation – 2–3 years: Applied experience in computational optimisation. A strong applied mathematics or algorithms background with demonstrated optimisation experience is also acceptable
  
* Ability to independently own and deliver assigned sub-projects
  
* Strong problem-solving skills with a thorough and detail-oriented approach to development
  
* Ability to understand the broader product context and use that understanding to inform technical decisions
  
* Flexibility to work across different development areas as product priorities evolve
  
  

  
**Nice to Have**
  

  
* AWS – 2+ years: Working knowledge of AWS. Experience with another major cloud provider, such as Azure or GCP, combined with a willingness to learn AWS, is also acceptable
  
* Unity / Unreal / 3D Game Engines – 1–2 years: Basic familiarity with Unity, Unreal or other 3D game engines. Alternatively, an understanding of 3D vector mathematics, mesh geometry, rendering and shaders is valuable, even without direct game engine experience
  
* AI / Machine Learning – 1+ years: Basic familiarity with AI/ML concepts, including integrating code with large language models (LLMs) or ML-based optimisation. Python experience combined with strong applied mathematics knowledge, or a demonstrated interest in AI through side projects, is also acceptable

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
**About Artha Group**

Artha Group is a performance-first investment house managing ₹2,300 crores across domestic and international investment vehicles, including Category I & II AIFs, LLPs, and Private Limited companies. With active investments in 130+ startups, with 32+ successful exits, and 10+ renewable energy projects. We operate at the convergence of capital precision and operational depth.

**Role Overview**

Artha Group is seeking a UI/UX Designer at the Analyst/Associate level to join its internal Tech team as a full-time, in-house hire. You will design the user experience for our proprietary platforms, starting with our Deal Flow System and extending to the other internal and external-facing products we will build.

This is not a role for someone who only produces polished screens. We need a designer who deeply understands user psychology, information architecture and role-based experience design, and who thinks in user journeys. A founder logging into a platform has a fundamentally different mental model, intent and cognitive load than an investor reviewing the same data, or an admin managing the back end. Designing for these distinct personas at the same time, without cluttering the experience, is the kind of problem you will own.

You will work closely with the engineering team, translating design intent into developer-ready specs and iterating on technical constraints without losing the integrity of the experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

**End-to-End Product Experience Design**

* Own the user experience of the Deal Flow System and the other internal and external-facing products that follow, from understanding the problem to the shipped interface.
* Map user journeys, define the flows, and produce wireframes, prototypes and high-fidelity designs.
* Maintain consistent visual language and reusable components across products.

**Role-Based and Multi-Persona Design**

* Design distinct experiences for founders, investors and admins, each with its own mental model, intent and cognitive load.
* Decide how the same data surfaces differently depending on who is looking at it, and design role-based access interfaces that stay clean and uncluttered.
* Resolve competing needs across personas inside one platform without compromising any of them.

**Information Architecture and Interaction Design**

* Structure complex, data-heavy information so users can find, understand and act on it quickly.
* Design interactions grounded in usability principles and behavioural UX, reducing friction and cognitive load at every step.

**User Research and Iteration**

* Talk to users, observe how they actually use the product, and validate designs through usability testing and feedback.
* Turn findings into prioritised design improvements, and measure whether changes worked.

**Engineering Collaboration and Handoff**

* Work closely with engineers to translate design intent into clear, developer-ready specs.
* Iterate on technical constraints and trade-offs without losing the integrity of the experience.
* Review what is built against what was designed, and close the gaps.

**Required Experience and Skills**

* 3 to 6 years of experience in UI/UX or product design, with a portfolio of real work demonstrating interaction design, wireframing and prototyping.
* A working understanding of usability principles and behavioural UX, with a clear grasp of user psychology and information architecture.
* Ability to design role-based experiences for distinct personas and explain the reasoning behind your decisions.
* Experience designing consumer-facing B2C or B2B2C financial apps or platforms, with a sound instinct for building clarity and trust in how money and data are presented.
* Comfort translating design into developer-ready specs, and working iteratively with engineers.
* Proficiency with modern design and prototyping tools.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to present and defend design decisions to stakeholders.
* Familiarity with fintech, SaaS or enterprise product design is a plus.
* Bonus if you have worked on multi-persona platforms or role-based access interfaces, where the same data surfaces differently depending on who is looking at it.

**Compensation**

* Total Annual Package: ₹12,00,000 (12 LPA)
* Fixed Annual Salary: ₹10,00,000
* Annual Retention Bonus: ₹2,00,000, paid at the end of each year

description: About TestlifyTestlify helps companies hire on skills. Recruiters use our tests to see what candidates can do before the interview.We also run the company with AI. NEC Corporation is a Japanese multinational information technology and electronics company, headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. Their main goal is to help create a safer society with their innovations in technologies.

For more information, visit NEC at https://www.nec.com.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Experience Required: 8+ Years**
Job Description: Instructional Designer (Storyboarding)
  
  
We are seeking a detail-oriented and creative
**Instructional Designer (Storyboarding)**
to develop clear, structured, and engaging storyboards for digital learning courses and
  
  
e-learning modules. The role focuses on organizing learning content, writing
  
  
instructional scripts, defining screen-level layouts, and preparing detailed storyboards
  
  
that serve as development guides for Digital Learning Developers.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop detailed storyboards for e-learning courses, digital training modules, and online learning programs.
* Review source content, training materials, presentations, documents, and reference materials provided by subject matter experts (SMEs).
* Organize content into logical learning sequences with clear objectives, explanations, examples, and knowledge checks.
* Write learner-friendly on-screen text, narration scripts, voice-over scripts, and multimedia instructions.
* Define screen layouts, visual descriptions, interactions, animations, and navigation requirements.
* Develop assessment questions, quizzes, scenario-based activities, and knowledge checks aligned with learning objectives.
* Specify interactions such as click-to-reveal, drag-and-drop, tabs, hotspots, branching scenarios, and other learning activities.
* Prepare slide-by-slide or screen-by-screen storyboards with content, visual directions, audio scripts, and development notes.
* Collaborate with subject matter experts to validate content accuracy and completeness.
* Work closely with Digital Learning Developers, graphic designers, and multimedia teams to ensure accurate implementation of storyboards.
* Review developed courses against approved storyboards and provide consolidated feedback.
* Revise storyboards based on stakeholder feedback and project requirements.
* Ensure consistency in terminology, tone, formatting, and content presentation across learning modules.
* Maintain storyboard templates, documentation, version control, and project records.
* Ensure learning content follows organizational standards and relevant accessibility guidelines.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Instructional Design, Education, English, Communications, Multimedia, or a related field.
* Experience in instructional content development, e-learning storyboarding, technical writing, or training content creation.
* Strong writing, editing, and content organization skills.
* Ability to convert complex information into clear, concise, learner-friendly content.
* Experience creating detailed storyboards for digital learning or online training programs.

**Required Skills**

* Storyboarding: Ability to create detailed, screen-by-screen storyboards using PowerPoint, Word, Excel, or standard storyboard templates.
* Content writing: Strong skills in instructional writing, scripting, editing, and proofreading.
* Learning activities: Ability to develop quizzes, assessments, scenarios, and interactive exercises.
* Visual communication: Ability to describe screen layouts, graphics, animations, and multimedia requirements clearly.
* E-learning knowledge: Familiarity with digital learning formats, course navigation, learner interactions, and LMS delivery requirements.
* Collaboration: Ability to work effectively with subject matter experts, Digital Learning Developers, and project stakeholders.
* Quality review: Strong attention to detail, content accuracy, consistency, and adherence to project specifications.

**Preferred Skills**

* Familiarity with Articulate Storyline 360, Articulate Rise 360, or Adobe Captivate.
* Understanding of adult learning principles and learner engagement techniques.
* Experience developing scenario-based learning, software simulations, and compliance training.
* Knowledge of accessibility requirements and inclusive content practices.
* Familiarity with SCORM and Learning Management Systems (LMS).

Additional Information
  
  

* Has worked with UK clients and team (Preferred)
* Has working experience of the onshore – offshore model
* Has experience of commercial awareness in aspects such as revenue recognition and margin management

description:
Job Title: Head Programme
  
  
He / She is committed to addressing critical social issues and empowering communities through comprehensive programmes. The mission is to tackle barriers to success, promote equality, and foster positive societal change. We are seeking a dedicated individual to lead our Programme, which focuses on addressing access to education, unemployment, poverty, mental health issues, violence, lack of positive role models, the digital divide, and social and cultural pressures.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Head of Programme will be pivotal in designing, implementing, and managing initiatives to tackle various social challenges within our community. The ideal candidate will be passionate about social justice, have a strong program development and management background, and possess excellent leadership skills.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and implement a comprehensive community empowerment strategy to build a conducive environment in the community that helps young people reach their full potential.
* To Collaborate with community stakeholders, including government agencies, non-profit organizations, schools, businesses, and residents, to identify needs and develop targeted interventions.
* Lead a team of program staff, volunteers, employers, and mentors to deliver impactful initiatives, such as job training programs, educational workshops, mental health support services, violence prevention programs, mentorship initiatives, and digital literacy initiatives.
* Ensure that special emphasis is given to parenting and mentoring sessions for the youth persons. description:

title: Finance Consultant
description:
**Finance Intern — Billing & Revenue Operations**

**Finance · Global Billing Team**

Noida · 5 days WFO Consultant : Immediate Joiners

**₹25,000/month stipend** ·

**LET'S SKIP THE PART EVERY OTHER FINANCE JD DOES**

Most finance internships give you a filing cabinet, a half-read manual, and a spreadsheet nobody looks at. We're not going to do that.

Here's what this actually is: for six months, you become part of the team that keeps a global B2B SaaS business billing cleanly across time zones. You'll process invoices for enterprise customers whose names you've seen on magazine covers. You'll learn subscription-revenue mechanics from the finance operators who run them live. You'll leave with the kind of résumé line that makes recruiters stop and read.

**It's the kind of finance craft you can't learn from a textbook. Most people in India wait three years to get this exposure. If you can do it now — read on.**

**THE MISSION**

We aren't automating scripts — we're deprecating the era of manual-heavy testing entirely. TestMu AI is building the world's first AI-native platform where Agentic Intelligence autonomously plans, authors, and self-heals the entire Quality Engineering lifecycle.

The name "TestMu" comes from our community conference — our users and our team are the heartbeat of what we build, not an audience.

Every great engineering product sits on top of a finance engine that bills cleanly, collects reliably, and reports accurately. That engine is where you'll be. Fortune 500 customers, subscription billing at scale, and the live rebrand from LambdaTest to TestMu AI happening around you.

**WHAT YOU'LL WALK AWAY WITH**

*Six months from now, here's what will be true about you.*

* You'll have sent hundreds of real invoices to procurement teams at Fortune 500 companies. Not a case study. Receipts.
* You'll have reconciled hundreds of payments against open AR — the detective work that teaches you how money actually moves in a B2B SaaS business.
* You'll be fluent in the modern billing stack:, Stripe exposure. The kind of tool literacy most people pay a Big Four firm three years to teach them.
* You'll understand subscription revenue, ARR, MRR, deferred revenue, churn, expansion mechanics the way an operator understands them — not the way an MBA textbook sketches them.
* You'll be able to walk into any SaaS company in India and name exactly what a modern billing operations team does, how, and with which tools. That's a hireable skillset.

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

*This is real work. Not shadowing.*

* Your own set of customer accounts — invoicing, payment tracking, and subscription management for a defined segment from week two onwards.
* Payment reconciliation — matching bank entries to open invoices, investigating variances, closing the loop. The puzzle work that makes finance clean.
* Follow-ups with procurement teams in the US — in your own words, on your own cadence. We'll teach you the register; you'll own the voice.
* Weekly reporting: AR ageing, billing variance, open subscription items. What you report shapes what finance leadership decides on next.

**HOW YOU'LL SPEND YOUR WEEK**

*So you know what you're walking into.*

* Start of shift: triage the AR movement from the previous day. Spot the exceptions. Prioritise what needs to go out today.
* Reconciliation blocks: matching bank statements against open invoices, chasing variances, closing the loop with sales and procurement.
* Live communication: emails to US procurement teams, Slack with Sales and Customer Success, async updates to the finance team globally.
* Weekly team sync: AR ageing review, billing variance deep-dive, action items you'll own for the week.
* Learning blocks: shadowing the FP&A team on month-end close, understanding how your work rolls up into ARR / MRR dashboards and finance leadership reporting.

*Honest note on shift: this role runs on US hours (approximately 6 PM – 3 AM IST window, rotational). You'll cover US business hours because that's when our customers' procurement teams are live. We cover cabs, lunch, dinner, 24/7 snacks, in-house mental health coach, and rest rooms. If you want a 9-to-5, this isn't it.*

**HOW WE'LL KNOW YOU'RE GREAT**

**What we're actually looking for.**

* Attention to detail. You catch the mismatched decimal before it becomes a $20K problem. Numbers don't blur in front of you — they resolve.
* Numerical intuition. A reconciliation isn't a chore for you; it's a puzzle. You'd rather figure out why 847 doesn't equal 850 than move on and ignore it.
* Communication clarity. You can email a Fortune 500 procurement lead at 11 PM and sound like a professional — not a student. Writing isn't a soft skill in this role; it's the job.
* **Extreme Ownership: Takes full accountability for outcomes, not just tasks.**

**WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU**

*Real signals, not marketing.*

  

* ₹25,000/month stipend — no unpaid work, no "exposure economy."
* A clear ladder: Intern Billing Associate Senior Billing Associate Finance Analyst FP&A. We hire for the trajectory, not just the role.
* Direct exposure to Fortune 500 finance teams and procurement cycles — rare at the intern level anywhere in India.
* Hands-on fluency in the modern B2B SaaS billing stack: Stripe, exposure. Tools that take Big Four firms years to teach.
* Cabs across Noida & Delhi NCR. Fresh lunch and dinner every day. 24/7 snacks. In-house mental health coach. Rest rooms when you need to reset.
* A team that treats interns as team members — not free labour.

**WHO THIS IS FOR**

* Final-year students or recent graduates — B.Com, M.Com, MBA (Finance), CA Inter, or related commerce background.
* Strong Excel. Not "familiar with." Comfortable with VLOOKUP, INDEX-MATCH, pivot tables, and nested conditionals under time pressure.
* Comfortable with rotational US night shift (6 PM – 3 AM IST window). This isn't negotiable — our customers are in the US.
* Immediate joiners or candidates within 15 days of graduation.
* 5 days from the Noida office. This is not a remote role.
* You see finance operations as a career foundation — not something to try for six months while you figure out what you want to do. We can tell the difference.

**YOUR PATH**

Intern Billing Associate Senior Billing Associate Finance Analyst FP&A.

Your growth at TestMu AI is mapped to what you ship — not how long you've been here. Prove you can own a customer segment cleanly in the internship, convert to a full-time Billing Associate. Prove you can mentor the next intern cohort, move to Senior. Prove you can read the AR aging report and drive finance leadership decisions off it, move to Analyst. This is the ladder, and it's real.

description:
**About The Company**
(www.rentomojo.com)
  
  
Rentomojo is a market leader and tech-enabled company in rental subscription of furniture and consumer appliances. The company provides affordable and flexible rental subscriptions to cater to mobility needs of Gen Z and Millennials.
  
  
RentoMojo, was founded by Geetansh Bamania, an IITM who worked out of almost every major city in India in his first five years of corporate career. Frustrated with the hassles of relocating from one place to the other, and tired of finding that perfect cluster of home essentials that suited their lifestyle. With 4,000+ people operations, the company has a presence in 22 cities across India.
  
  
Rentomojo is a key beneficiary of India’s rapid urbanisation story, job growth and workforce mobility. ~1mn new members join the workforce every month and 1.2mn-1.5mn employees switch jobs every month. Rentomojo offers attractive bundled rental subscriptions with zero cost of relocation and zero repair and maintenance cost at affordable cost that provides utility of EMI but not its rigidity.
  
  
Job Title: Senior DevOps Engineer
  
  
Location: Bangalore (On-site)
  
  
Job Type: Full-time
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are hiring a Senior DevOps Engineer to own the reliability, security, cost and automation of Rentomojo’s cloud infrastructure and delivery pipelines.
  
  
The role designs and runs the platform that engineering ships on – cloud infrastructure, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, observability and on-call – and keeps it audit-ready for ISO-27001, SOC-2, ITGC, CICRA and DPDP. The role works closely with engineering, IT administration and information security, and mentors junior engineers.
  
  
Responsibilities and Ownership
  
  
Cloud Infrastructure
  
  

* Design, build and operate production, staging and development environments on AWS, GCP or Airtel Cloud.
* Own networking: VPCs, subnets, security groups, load balancers, DNS, VPN and firewall rules.
* Plan capacity and scaling for peak loads; run regular right-sizing reviews.
* Manage databases, caches and queues in partnership with engineering (provisioning, replication, upgrades).

Infrastructure as Code and Configuration Management
  
  

* Manage all infrastructure through code (Terraform) and configuration management (Ansible or equivalent).
* Maintain reusable modules, version control and peer review for every infrastructure change.
* Detect and correct configuration drift across environments.

CI/CD and Release Engineering
  
  

* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure deployments.
* Implement safe release practices: automated tests, blue-green or canary deployments, and quick rollback.
* Reduce build and deploy times and improve deployment frequency.
* Secure pipelines: secrets management, artefact signing, dependency and container image scanning.

Containers and Orchestration
  
  

* Run and tune containerised workloads on Kubernetes or an equivalent orchestration platform.
* Manage cluster upgrades, autoscaling, resource limits and Helm charts or manifests.

Observability and Incident Management
  
  

* Own logging, metrics, tracing and alerting for production systems.
* Define SLOs and error budgets with engineering teams and track them.
* Lead on-call rotation and incident response; run blameless post-mortems and track actions to closure.

Reliability, Backup and Disaster Recovery
  
  

* Own backup policies for cloud resources and databases; test restores on a schedule.
* Document and test disaster-recovery plans with defined RTO and RPO.

Security and Compliance
  
  

* Harden servers, containers and cloud accounts; enforce least-privilege IAM and privileged access controls.
* Manage secrets, keys and certificates.
* Run periodic vulnerability scans and patch cycles; fix findings within agreed timelines.
* Provide infrastructure evidence for ISO-27001, SOC-2, ITGC, CICRA and DPDP audits, and close observations with corrective actions.

Cloud Cost Management
  
  

* Track cloud spend by team and service; report monthly against budget.
* Find savings through right-sizing, reserved or committed-use capacity and removal of idle resources.

Automation and Collaboration
  
  

* Automate repetitive operational work with scripts and tooling.
* Support the IT administration team on server, backup and scripting work.
* Maintain runbooks and architecture documentation so no task depends on one person.
* Mentor junior engineers and review their infrastructure and pipeline changes.

**Preferred Qualifications**
Experience and Education
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 5–8 years in DevOps, SRE or infrastructure engineering, with at least 3 years running production workloads on a public cloud.
* Experience supporting an ISO-27001, SOC-2, ITGC, CICRA or DPDP audit.
* Experience mentoring engineers or leading infrastructure projects end to end.

Core Skills (Must-Have)
  
  

* Cloud: hands-on depth in AWS, GCP or Airtel Cloud (compute, networking, IAM, managed databases, storage).
* Infrastructure as code: Terraform; configuration management with Ansible or equivalent.
* CI/CD: Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or equivalent; Git workflows.
* Containers: Docker and Kubernetes in production.
* Linux administration and scripting (Bash and Python).
* Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch or equivalent.

Also Required
  
  

* Networking: VPC design, DNS, load balancing, VPN, firewall rules, TLS.
* Security practices: secrets management, IAM, vulnerability management, hardening benchmarks.
* Cloud cost management and reporting.
* Clear written communication for runbooks, post-mortems and audit evidence.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Certifications: AWS/GCP Professional (DevOps or Solutions Architect), CKA/CKAD.
* Experience with Windows server administration and RDP-hosted applications.
* Experience in a fast-growing startup or e-commerce company.

In this DevOps and SRE automation role, you will build the automation that keeps them running: infrastructure as code, CI/CD pipelines, self-healing workflows, and internal tools that remove manual effort from deployments, maintenance, and incident response, so the team can support more customers with less toil.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
We are seeking a Senior DevOps / SRE Automation Engineer to join our growing team. In this role, you will:
  
  

* Build automation that removes manual effort (toil) for the SRE team running business-critical retail supply chain applications on Azure and Oracle Cloud.
* Build reusable Terraform modules and Ansible roles to provision networks, VMs, containers, VPN, ExpressRoute, and FastConnect consistently.
* Build CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps) for infrastructure, Docker, and TomEE/Java releases, with automated testing, canary or blue-green deployments, and rollback.
* Build self-healing and auto-remediation workflows triggered by monitoring alerts (Prometheus, Grafana, Zabbix), such as service restarts, failover, disk cleanup, and scaling.
* Convert manual runbooks into tested, version-controlled automation and Python tools.
* Automate routine operations: OS patching, certificate renewal, backup checks, and Cloudflare and HAProxy changes.
* Automate on-demand builds of new customer and non-production environments.
* Integrate monitoring, ticketing, and on-call tools (e.g., ServiceNow, PagerDuty, Microsoft Teams) through APIs for automated ticketing, alert enrichment, and ChatOps.
* Embed security into automation: secrets management (Azure Key Vault, OCI Vault, or HashiCorp Vault), policy as code, drift detection, and pipeline scanning.
* Measure toil and automation impact, prioritize work with the SRE team, and support major incidents as a business-hours escalation point.

**Job Description**
**Key criteria**
**Must-have**

* 5-10 years in DevOps, SRE, cloud infrastructure, or platform engineering, including at least 3 years building automation for production workloads on Azure or OCI.
* Good Python and Bash skills, with Python used beyond one-off scripts (reusable tools, API integrations, or cloud SDK/CLI automation).
* Hands-on Terraform (modules, remote state) and Ansible (roles, playbooks) in production environments.
* Hands-on CI/CD pipeline design and maintenance with Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps, using Git branching, code review, and release workflows.
* Solid hands-on experience with Azure or OCI (compute, storage, networking, and IAM); hybrid connectivity such as VPN, ExpressRoute, or FastConnect is a plus.
* Strong Linux administration (RHEL, Ubuntu) and hands-on Docker experience, including building and managing container images.
* Experience with monitoring and observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Zabbix, or ELK), including using alerts to trigger automated actions.
* Understanding of production support and SRE practices (incident management, toil reduction, SLOs); exposure to HAProxy, Java on TomEE/Tomcat, or Oracle Database is an advantage.

**Good-to-have**

* Kubernetes and Helm, or GitOps tools such as Argo CD or Flux.
* Image building with Packer, and infrastructure testing or scanning with tools such as Terratest, Molecule, or Checkov.
* Runbook or event-driven automation platforms (e.g., Azure Automation, OCI Functions, Rundeck, or Ansible Automation Platform).
* Cloudflare automation through its API or Terraform provider (DNS, WAF, CDN, caching rules).
* Go or another compiled language, and exposure to AIOps, ChatOps, or using AI to accelerate automation.
* Certifications (Azure, OCI, AWS, HashiCorp Terraform, or Kubernetes CKA/CKAD) and exposure to GPU-based compute for AI/ML workloads.
* Retail or supply chain domain exposure, and strong written and verbal communication.

**About Us**
**Growth opportunities**

* Opportunity to shape the automation and platform engineering roadmap for a 24/7 multi-cloud production environment.
* Scope to deepen expertise in Oracle Cloud (OCI), Azure, infrastructure as code, and CI/CD at scale.
* Opportunity for cross-skilling (retail products, SRE, Kubernetes, GitOps, AIOps, and company AI trainings) and enhancing skills to stay competitive in the future.

**Our values**
Our values guide how we work with our customers and with each other.
  
  

* Customer focus
* Innovation at speed
* Targeted focus
* Team unity

**Join us**
SymphonyAI is a global leader in Vertical AI platforms. Our Eureka AI platform helps enterprises solve their most complex, high-value challenges across retail and consumer goods, financial services, industrial, and enterprise IT.
  
  
Our retail division helps retailers and CPG manufacturers drive profitable growth with AI-powered solutions for demand forecasting, merchandising, supply chain, and store operations. Learn more at www.symphonyai.com.

description:

title: DevOps Engineer L3
description:
**About Rupeek:**

Rupeek, established in 2015 and headquartered in Bangalore, stands as India's leading asset-backed digital lending fintech platform. Committed to making credit accessible to Indians in a fair and convenient manner, Rupeek pioneers innovative financial products focused on monetizing India's $2 trillion gold market. Leveraging state-of-the-art technology and an automated asset-light supply chain, Rupeek is transforming the gold loan disbursal landscape across 40+ cities in India. With a customer base exceeding 5,00,000+, the company's strategic partnerships with top banks and financial institutions underscore its commitment to building gold-backed assets through low-risk, low-touch, and friction-free processes.

Rupeek's impressive journey is supported by key investors such as Sequoia Capital, Accel Partners,

Bertelsmann, and GGV Capital. In Apr 2024, Rupeek turned profitable and raised $25 in equity capital from Manipal Group and Elevation Capital to fund its next phase of growth. Join us in redefining the future of finance through innovation, technology, and a commitment to financial inclusivity.

**About the Role:**

Rupeek's infrastructure spans RFPL and RCPL — customer-facing apps, lending core, ledger systems, and operations — running on AWS with EKS as the primary compute plane. DevOps is a horizontal function serving all engineering pods, and also owns the interface with Infosec on audits, RBI/DPDP compliance evidence, and incident response.

The DevOps L3 is the senior-most engineer in the team and its technical lead. This person sets standards, mentors the team, and owns infrastructure vision.

**Job Title:**
DevOps Engineer - L3

**Experience:**
3+ years of experience

**Location:**
Bangalore

**Key Responsibilities:**

● Sets vision and direction for Rupeek's infrastructure — cloud architecture, Kubernetes platform,

CI/CD, observability, cost, and reliability.

● Owns infrastructure-as-code standards — Terraform module design, state management, drift

detection, and review process.

● Owns the production readiness bar — every service that ships production traffic clears standards

this person defines.

● Partners with Infosec to pass audits (RBI IT Outsourcing, SOC 2, ISO 27001, DPDP) and due

diligence (lender, investor, partner).

● Leads incident response from the infra side — the person on the call when the blast radius is

large.

● Mentors junior and mid DevOps engineers; runs design and code reviews for the team.

● Represents DevOps in architecture reviews for major product initiatives.

● Sets AI-fluency standards for the DevOps team — tooling, prompt patterns, safe use of AI in

production workflows.

● Peer to senior SDE IIIs across product pods.

**Must have skills:**

Cloud & Kubernetes

● Deep AWS — VPC design, IAM, EKS, RDS/Aurora, S3, KMS, cost architecture, multi-AZ /

multi-region trade-offs.

● EKS operations — node group strategy, cluster upgrades, addons lifecycle, admission controllers,

network policies, PSA.

● Comfortable debugging at layers others can't — kernel/OS, container runtime, CNI, etcd, control

plane.

Infrastructure as Code

● Terraform mastery — module design, remote state, workspaces vs directories, provider version

discipline, testing (terratest, tflint, checkov).

● Has designed and enforced IaC standards across a team — including PR review process,

plan/apply gating, and drift detection.

● Opinion on Terraform vs Pulumi vs CDK, and why they picked what they picked.

CI/CD & SDLC

● Has built and operated production CI/CD pipelines with strong controls — immutable artifact

tagging, signed artifacts (cosign or equivalent), promotion gates, per-environment approvals.

● Familiar with supply chain security — SLSA levels, SBOMs, dependency pinning, supply chain

(npm/PyPI) incident response.

● Comfortable with GitOps patterns

Observability & Reliability

● Deep in Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager, and PagerDuty — from scrape config to SLO-driven

alerting

● Has designed on-call rotations, runbooks, and blameless post-mortem culture.

● Comfortable with distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, or similar) and structured logging.

Security & Compliance

● Has partnered with Infosec through at least one major audit (SOC 2, ISO 27001, RBI, or

equivalent).

● Strong on secrets management (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, KMS), workload identity (IRSA),

and least-privilege IAM

● Understands regulated-industry constraints — data localization, PII handling, audit trails,

evidence collection.

● Has responded to real security incidents — DDoS, credential leaks, supply chain compromise, or

similar.

Scripting & Automation

● Strong in Python or Go — writes production-quality automation, not just glue scripts.

● Bash fluency; comfortable with the standard Linux toolchain.

AI Fluency

● Uses AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) as part of daily workflow.

● Has opinions on where AI helps and where it hurts in the DevOps SDLC.

● Can articulate what "AI-safe" infrastructure change management looks like.

Leadership

● Has mentored junior and mid engineers; visible track record of growing people.

● Writes well — runbooks, RFCs, post-mortems

● Insists on high standards; can hold the line on production readiness without becoming a

bottleneck.

● Comfortable pushing back on product timelines when infra risk is real.

**Persona:**

● Engineering degree in Computer Science or related

● Has held a "senior-most DevOps / SRE / Platform" role at least once before, in a company where

the infra actually mattered.

● Fintech, payments, or regulated-industry background strongly preferred.

● Recent hands-on work — has written Terraform and touched a cluster in the last month.

● Comfortable being the escalation point at 2am.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
We're looking for a DevOps lead to own our AWS based infrastructure end to end and build out

the team around it. Today that means a small team and a clear scope. As we grow, this

becomes the foundation for a larger DevOps group, so we're looking for someone who can run

things hands-on now and help shape what the function becomes.

**What you'll own**

Infrastructure, end to end: Multi-environment architecture, containers and orchestration,

release pipelines, runtime reliability, and cloud cost.

Reliability and SRE practice: SLOs that reflect what users actually experience, observability

that surfaces problems before customers report them, and an on-call rotation that doesn't burn

people out. You'll run an incident command when things break and lead the review afterward.

We'd like our reliability numbers to improve under you — fewer incidents, faster recovery, less

firefighting.

Automation: Identifying automation opportunities where there are repetition patterns:

provisioning, deployments, environment creation, rollbacks, routine ops. The aim is a team that

spends its time building rather than repeating itself.

AI-native operations: We want agents to be part of how the team works day to day, not a side

project. Incident triage and log analysis, IaC generation and review, cost anomaly detection,

runbook execution. You'd decide what agents can do in production, what needs human

approval, and how their actions get logged.

Infrastructure security. You'll work closely with our security engineering team, and the

infrastructure side is yours to execute: IAM and least privilege, secrets management, secure

Terraform defaults, security gates in CI/CD, patching and image lifecycle. You'll also be involved

when something in the infrastructure needs investigating.

Team and direction. Hiring, growing and supporting a small team of DevOps engineers, plus

the infrastructure roadmap — what we build, what we buy, what we retire, and what it costs.

**What we're looking for**

● 6–10 years in DevOps, SRE or platform engineering, including time leading a team

● You've owned a complete infrastructure boundary — horizontal platform or business

vertical, either works. What matters is that it was substantial, consumer-facing, and

carried real traffic

● Infrastructure at consumer scale: high-volume production systems with meaningful traffic

peaks, where downtime is visible to customers and latency is a product problem

● Strong hands-on AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD and observability tooling

● Hands-on security understanding of AWS infrastructure — IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager,

network controls, secure IaC

● You've hired DevOps engineers and helped them grow

● You already use agentic tooling in your daily work and have shipped something with it in

a DevOps context

● You've owned a cloud bill and brought it down without hurting reliability

**Nice to have**

● GPU infrastructure: provisioning, scheduling, utilisation

● LLM gateway operations — routing, rate limits, cost attribution, provider failover

● Experience in a regulated environment (RBI digital lending, DPDP, PCI-DSS)

● You've scaled a DevOps function through a period of fast growth

How you'll work

You'll report to engineering leadership and work closely with product, backend and security. This

is a hands-on role.

. You will lead

* Strong technical leadership, problem-solving, mentoring, and communication skills.
* Flexibility to provide technical support outside regular working hours when required for critical production incidents.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience leading complex Kubernetes/GKE upgrades in production environments.

* Lead Technical Bridges (TBs), SWARMs, war rooms, and major production incidents, driving troubleshooting, mitigation, service restoration, and follow-up actions.
* Act as a technical escalation point for complex issues across applications, Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, databases, and networking.
* Provide technical guidance to the 24/7 Production Operations team, with flexibility to support critical incidents outside regular working hours when required.
* Lead and coordinate production patching and platform lifecycle activities, including Kubernetes, GKE, EKS, and AKS upgrades and security patching.
* Automate repetitive operational activities using Python, Bash, Go, Terraform, CI/CD, and GitOps.
* Leverage AI and Generative AI tools for troubleshooting, log and alert analysis, automation, knowledge retrieval, and proactive issue identification.
* Improve monitoring, observability, and alert quality, including reducing noisy, duplicate, obsolete, and non-actionable alerts.
* Drive improvements in MTTA, MTTR, incident prevention, and production reliability.
* Lead and contribute to Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and turn incident learnings into automation and permanent corrective actions.
* Develop reusable operational tooling and self-service capabilities to reduce manual intervention.
* Mentor ProdOps engineers and collaborate with Engineering, SRE, DevOps, Cloud Platform, Security, and Support teams.

* A technical leadership role helping shape and mature Production Operations.
* Hands-on work across cloud, Kubernetes, automation, AI-assisted operations, and observability.
* Opportunity to drive the shift from reactive support to proactive, automated production engineering.

title: Manager_AI Platform & Agent Ops
description:

Role Overview

  

We are building a next-generation Enterprise AI Platform powering AI Agents, Multi-Agent Systems, AI Workflows, RAG Applications, Knowledge Systems, and Enterprise Integrations. We are looking for a highly capable Platform & AgentOps Engineer to lead the deployment, operations, scalability, security, and reliability of our AI platform across cloud and customer environments.

  

This is a hands-on engineering role for builders who enjoy owning production systems end-to-end. You will be responsible for designing deployment architectures, operating Kubernetes platforms, automating cloud infrastructure, establishing operational excellence, and ensuring that AI applications can be deployed, monitored, governed, and scaled reliably in enterprise environments.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

· Own the deployment and operational architecture for AI Agents, Agent Servers, Workflow Engines, RAG Platforms, Model Gateways, and AI Runtime Services.

  

· Design, build, and operate Kubernetes-based platforms supporting large-scale AI workloads.

  

· Lead cloud infrastructure engineering, environment provisioning, deployment automation, release management, and platform reliability initiatives.

  

· Establish CI/CD, GitOps, Infrastructure-as-Code, observability, security, disaster recovery, and operational standards across the platform.

  

· Drive production readiness reviews, scalability planning, performance optimization, capacity management, and incident response processes.

  

· Work closely with AI and Platform Engineering teams to ensure applications are cloud-native, secure, observable, and enterprise-ready.

  

· Support customer deployments across cloud, hybrid-cloud, and enterprise-managed environments.

  
  

**Mandatory Skills & Experience**

  

Cloud & Platform Engineering

  

· Strong hands-on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) experience is mandatory.

  

· Deep expertise with services such as GKE, Cloud Run, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, IAM, VPC Networking, Cloud Monitoring, Secret Manager, Cloud Functions, and API Gateway.

  

· Strong experience with Azure and/or AWS is highly desirable.

  

· Experience designing and operating secure, scalable, multi-environment cloud architectures.

  

Kubernetes & Container Platforms

  

· Deep production experience with Kubernetes (GKE preferred).

  

· Strong expertise in Docker, Helm, Ingress Controllers, Autoscaling, Stateful Workloads, Service Discovery, Networking, Storage, and Secrets Management.

  

· Experience operating multi-cluster and multi-environment Kubernetes deployments.

  

· Strong troubleshooting capabilities across Kubernetes, networking, infrastructure, and application layers.

  

Infrastructure as Code & Deployment Automation

  

· Strong Terraform expertise is mandatory.

  

· Experience building reusable infrastructure modules and enterprise-scale Infrastructure-as-Code frameworks.

  

· Hands-on experience with GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Azure DevOps, ArgoCD, FluxCD, and GitOps deployment models.

  

· Experience implementing automated provisioning, release automation, environment management, and deployment governance.

  

AgentOps & AI Infrastructure

  

· Experience deploying and operating AI applications in production.

  

· Understanding of Agent Servers, AI Workflow Engines, Model Gateways, RAG Services, Vector Databases, AI Runtime Infrastructure, and LLM-based applications.

  

· Experience supporting OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Ollama, vLLM, TGI, or similar AI serving environments.

  

· Understanding of AI workload scaling, model routing, latency optimization, throughput planning, token consumption monitoring, and operational governance.

  

Observability, Reliability & Operations

  

· Strong experience with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog, Cloud Monitoring, or Application Insights.

  

· Deep understanding of monitoring, distributed tracing, logging, ing, SRE practices, reliability engineering, and operational excellence.

  

· Experience leading incident management, root-cause analysis, disaster recovery planning, backup strategies, and production support.

  

Distributed Systems & Messaging

  

· Strong experience with Redis, Redis Pub/Sub, Redis Streams, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Google Pub/Sub, Azure Service Bus, or AWS SQS/SNS.

  

· Understanding of event-driven architectures, distributed systems, fault tolerance, high availability, and scalability patterns.

  

Security & Enterprise Deployments

  

· Experience implementing RBAC, IAM, SSO, SAML, OIDC, Secret Management, Network Security, Compliance Controls, and Secure Software Delivery practices.

  

· Experience deploying applications into enterprise, regulated, and customer-managed environments.

  
  

**Highly Desirable**

  

· MCP (Model Context Protocol) infrastructure and integrations.

  

· Self-hosted LLM platforms using vLLM, Ray Serve, Ollama, TGI, or Kubernetes-based inference infrastructure.

  

· Vector databases such as Pinecone, Qdrant, Weaviate, Chroma, pgvector, and Vertex AI Search.

  

· Service Mesh technologies including Istio and Linkerd.

  

· Airflow, Temporal, Dagster, Prefect, or workflow orchestration platforms.

  

· Platform Engineering, Internal Developer Platforms (IDP), Developer Experience tooling, and FinOps.

  
  

**Who We Are Looking For**

  

· Engineers who can independently own mission-critical production platforms.

  

· Individuals with strong architectural thinking and exceptional troubleshooting abilities.

  

· Builders who thrive in fast-moving environments and enjoy solving infrastructure, reliability, scalability, and deployment challenges.

  

· Professionals capable of evolving into Platform Leads, Cloud Architects, or Infrastructure Architects.

  

This is not a traditional DevOps role. We are looking for a Platform Engineer who can own the operational backbone of an enterprise AI platform, establish deployment excellence, and build the foundation on which large-scale Agentic AI systems run reliably in production.

title: Cloud Engineer - SRE
description:
Introduction
  
  
**Job title: Cloud Engineer / Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)**
**Location: Bangalore**
**Experience: 4-7 years**
**The opportunity**
You will work on world-class retail supply chain solutions, deploying and running enterprise applications, including GPU-powered AI/ML products, on Azure and Oracle Cloud. These applications run 24/7 and are business-critical: warehouses and stores depend on them for daily operations. In this cloud and SRE role, you will own their reliability: defining and meeting SLOs, responding fast to incidents, troubleshooting end to end, and engineering out recurring problems through automation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
We are seeking a Cloud Engineer / Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to join our growing team. In this role, you will:
  
  

* Own the reliability of business-critical retail supply chain applications on Azure and Oracle Cloud, used 24/7 by warehouses and stores.
* Track SLIs and SLOs and help define them with product and application teams, using error budgets to balance reliability and release speed.
* Build observability (metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and actionable alerts) using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Zabbix.
* Provide 24/7 L2/L3 support, respond to and resolve incidents, support major incident response, and drive root cause analysis and blameless post-incident reviews for issues you handle.
* Troubleshoot end to end across Cloudflare, HAProxy, network, Linux, Docker, Apache TomEE/Java, APIs, and Oracle Database, and quickly isolate the failing layer.
* Diagnose Java application issues using thread dumps, heap dumps, GC logs, and APM traces.
* Perform first-level Oracle Database triage and escalate to the DBA team with clear diagnostics.
* Build and deploy cloud infrastructure (networks, VMs, containers, VPN, ExpressRoute, FastConnect) using Terraform and Ansible.
* Automate away toil, such as deployments, health checks, failover, and routine maintenance, with Python and Bash.
* Support capacity planning and performance tuning, and take part in high availability and disaster recovery testing through regular failover drills.
* Plan and execute production changes with minimal downtime and tested rollback, and maintain runbooks.

**Job Description**
**Key criteria**
**Must-have**

* 4-7 years in SRE, cloud infrastructure, or production operations, including at least 2 years running production workloads on Azure or OCI.
* Solid hands-on experience with Azure or OCI across networking (VNet/VCN, VPN), compute, storage, and IAM.
* Strong Linux administration (RHEL, Ubuntu) and hands-on Docker experience.
* Hands-on Terraform, Ansible, and Python/Bash automation in production environments.
* Working knowledge of SRE practices (SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, toil reduction) and hands-on experience with 24/7 incident management and post-incident reviews.
* Experience with observability and APM tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Zabbix, ELK, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, or New Relic).
* End-to-end troubleshooting across networking (TCP/IP, DNS, SSL/TLS), HAProxy or similar load balancers, Java on TomEE/Tomcat, REST APIs, and Oracle Database at triage level.
* Willingness to work in a 24/7 rotational shift and on-call model.

**Good-to-have**

* Cloud certifications (Azure, OCI, or AWS).
* Experience with dedicated cloud connectivity (Azure ExpressRoute or OCI FastConnect).
* Experience with Cloudflare (DNS, WAF, CDN, caching rules).
* CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps) with canary or blue-green releases.
* Exposure to Kubernetes or other container orchestration platforms.
* Chaos engineering or game-day exercises to test resilience.
* GPU-based compute supporting AI/ML workloads.
* Retail or supply chain domain exposure, ITIL familiarity, and strong written and verbal communication.

**Growth opportunities**

* Learning opportunities with multi-cloud environments.
* Scope to deepen expertise in Oracle Cloud (OCI) and Azure in large production environments.
* Opportunity for cross-skilling (retail products, multi-cloud, DevOps, orchestration tools, scripting, and company AI trainings) and enhancing skills to stay competitive in the future.
* Clear path to grow into a Senior Cloud Engineer / SRE role, with mentoring from senior engineers.

**About Us**
**Our values**
Our values guide how we work with our customers and with each other.
  
  

* Customer focus
* Innovation at speed
* Targeted focus
* Team unity

**Join us**
SymphonyAI is a global leader in Vertical AI platforms. Our Eureka AI platform helps enterprises solve their most complex, high-value challenges across retail and consumer goods, financial services, industrial, and enterprise IT.
  
  
Our retail division helps retailers and CPG manufacturers drive profitable growth with AI-powered solutions for demand forecasting, merchandising, supply chain, and store operations. Learn more at www.symphonyai.com.

title: Senior Staff Software Development Engineer
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.
  
  
We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.
  
  
**Role**
We are looking for a Senior Staff Software Development Engineer (Service Platform & Orchestration) to join our team. This is a Hybrid (3 days in office) role, reporting to the Senior Manager, Software Engineering in the Zero Trust Exchange department.
  
  
In this high-ownership position, you will engineer the management plane and reliability systems that govern ZIA’s fleet lifecycle at massive scale. This is a hands-on building role where you will lead the transformation of our infrastructure from legacy automation into a stateful, durable management plane (built on Temporal) to achieve deterministic “one-touch” provisioning and lifecycle operations. You will treat “infrastructure as a distributed system,” developing self-healing capabilities and AI-driven Software Engineering practices for a global fleet of 100k+ instances.
  
  
**What You’ll Do (Role Expectations)**

* Lead the hands-on development and migration to a workflow-as-code platform (Temporal), building replay-safe, idempotent workflows that ensure deterministic operations across a global scale
* Move the organization beyond “scripted automation” toward a robust management plane that treats the entire global fleet as a single, eventually-consistent distributed system
* Design and implement services that leverage LLMs and ML for intelligent signal correlation, automated triage, and “self-correcting” fleet operations
* Develop framework-level services and internal APIs that ensure all new products are delivered “orchestration-ready” with reliability hooks built directly into the code
* Build deep telemetry (metrics, traces, and events) into the management plane so that every fleet-wide action is fully explainable, auditable, and replayable
