* You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
* You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
* You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

**What We’re Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)**

* Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
* BS/MS in Computer Science or a related technical field with 5 to 8+ years of experience in hyperscale systems, with a deep understanding of the unique failure modes and technical hurdles that only emerge at massive scale
* Mastery of backend systems languages with a strong preference for Go (or deep expertise in Java with a demonstrated ability to rapidly adopt Go), along with a proven track record of setting the bar for code quality and distributed system correctness
* Strong experience designing and operating complex distributed systems, with a focus on solving systemic challenges in concurrency, failure handling, and performance optimization
* Proven track record of developing Platform APIs (REST/gRPC) with strong guarantees for idempotency, verification, and safe rollout patterns

**What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)**

* Hands-on experience leveraging AI code-assistance tools (e.g., Cursor, Windsurf) to accelerate legacy refactoring alongside building LLM/ML-driven signal correlation or automated fleet triage in distributed systems
* Proficiency in PostgreSQL, or other relational stores used for high-scale, stateful management-plane services

title: Lead Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**Overview**
**About Business Unit:**
The Product team forms the crux of our pofwerful platforms and helps connect millions of customers worldwide with the brands that matter most to them. This team of innovative problem solvers develops and builds products that position Epsilon as a differentiator, encouraging an open and balanced marketplace built on respect for individuals, where every brand interaction holds value. Our full-cycle product engineering and data teams chart the future and set new benchmarks for our products, by using industry standard methodologies and sophisticated capabilities in data, machine learning, and artificial intelligence. Driven by a passion for delivering smart end-to-end solutions, this team plays a key role in Epsilon’s success story.
  
  
**What You Will Enjoy In This Role**
The Epsilon Activation Delivery Platform team builds the core frameworks and connectors powering our audience activation business, processing and moving trillions of user events every month to some of the world's largest advertising and Connected TV platforms, including Meta, Google, Amazon, LG, and Samsung.
  
  
As our dedicated Quality & Reliability lead, you will define and drive the quality engineering and platform reliability strategy for the Activation Delivery Platform. You will architect scalable test automation and data-validation frameworks, establish CI/CD quality gates, and strengthen platform reliability through observability, SLOs, and disciplined incident management practices.
  
  
You will play a critical role in establishing and driving engineering quality standards across an engineering team distributed across the US and India. Working closely with engineering leadership, data engineers, product managers, and partner teams, you will ensure that quality, reliability, and operational excellence are embedded throughout the software development lifecycle.
  
  
Your work will directly contribute to delivering accurate, reliable, and resilient activation systems that meet our customers' expectations and support the scale and performance of our global business.
  
  
**Reporting Structure & Day-to-Day Collaboration**
This role reports to the Senior Manager of Engineering and collaborates closely with data engineers, product managers, engineering leadership, and partner teams across the US and India.
  
  
You will participate in architecture and design reviews, code reviews, release planning, and the end-to-end delivery of critical business capabilities. You will also work with broader People Cloud engineering teams to leverage and align with established engineering frameworks, platforms, processes, and reliability standards.
  
  
**Why We Are Looking For You**
**Operate at True Scale:**
Help ensure that pipelines processing and routing trillions of records every month remain accurate, observable, and resilient. The quality standards and reliability practices you establish will directly protect customer experiences and critical business outcomes.
  
  
**Shape Quality on a Modern Data Stack:**
Architect and implement test automation, data-validation, and observability frameworks across a modern big data ecosystem using Spark, Scala, Python, AWS EMR, and Databricks. Work with distributed data systems, testing data outputs, APIs, and integrations at a significant scale.
  
  
**Establish Engineering Quality Standards:**
Take ownership of defining and driving quality engineering practices for the Activation Delivery Platform, using and extending established frameworks, processes, and engineering standards across the broader People Cloud ecosystem.
  
  
**See Your Impact:**
Directly influence the reliability and quality of integrations connecting our business to the world's largest technology, social media, and Connected TV platforms, including Meta, Google, Amazon, LG, and Samsung.
  
  
**Elevate Engineering Excellence:**
Drive consistent adoption of quality engineering standards, automation practices, and reliability principles across a 12-person engineering team distributed across the US and India, enabling predictable releases, faster feedback cycles, and greater engineering confidence.
  
  
**Pioneer AI-Assisted Quality Engineering:**
Leverage AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor to accelerate test creation, debugging, failure analysis, and incident triage. Explore and introduce agentic workflows that improve the efficiency and effectiveness of quality and reliability engineering.
  
  
Click here to view how Epsilon transforms marketing with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own the Test Automation Strategy

+ Design and implement scalable test automation frameworks for Spark-based (Scala/Python) data pipelines and platform connectors.
+ Establish comprehensive testing strategies covering unit, integration, contract, end-to-end, and regression testing.
+ Integrate automated test suites into the development lifecycle to ensure consistent quality validation with every code change.
+ Establish reusable testing patterns, engineering guidelines, and standard processes across the team.

* Validate Data Quality at Scale

+ Design and implement data-validation and data-quality frameworks to ensure schema integrity, completeness, accuracy, consistency, and freshness.
+ Build automated validation and reconciliation mechanisms for large-scale distributed datasets.
+ Establish quality checks across data ingestion, transformation, processing, and outbound activation pipelines.
+ Ensure data integrity and correctness before information is delivered to external partners such as Meta, Google, Amazon, LG, and Samsung.
+ Integrate data-quality checks into both CI/CD workflows and production environments.

* Build Quality Gates into CI/CD

+ Establish automated quality gates and release criteria across CI/CD pipelines.
+ Define and enforce appropriate test coverage, code quality, security, and reliability thresholds.
+ Implement automated regression testing and validation as part of continuous integration and deployment workflows.
+ Promote safe deployment practices, early defect detection, and continuous feedback mechanisms.
+ Align quality engineering practices with established People Cloud engineering standards and delivery processes.

* Drive Platform Reliability and Operational Excellence

+ Define and implement Service Level Objectives (SLOs), Service Level Indicators (SLIs), and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for critical pipelines and platform connectors.
+ Establish comprehensive observability through metrics, structured logging, distributed tracing, alerting, and operational dashboards.
+ Monitor and improve the reliability, availability, performance, and resilience of AWS EMR and Databricks workloads.
+ Drive effective incident management, root cause analysis, and preventive actions to minimize recurring issues.
+ Establish reliability practices that improve Mean Time to Detect (MTTD), Mean Time to Recover (MTTR), and overall platform stability.

* Drive Engineering Standards and Continuous Improvement

+ Establish and champion quality engineering standards, development guidelines, and automation procedures across the engineering team.
+ Collaborate with engineering leadership to integrate quality and reliability practices into architecture, design, development, and release processes.
+ Find opportunities to improve engineering productivity, reduce technical debt, and strengthen platform resilience.
+ Leverage existing People Cloud engineering frameworks, tools, and processes while finding opportunities for platform-specific improvements.

* Champion AI-Assisted Quality Engineering

+ Leverage AI-assisted tools such as Cursor to accelerate test development, debugging, code analysis, and failure investigation.
+ Explore AI driven approaches for automated test generation, defect prediction, and intelligent failure analysis.
+ Evaluate and introduce agentic workflows that can improve test coverage, accelerate incident triage, and reduce manual engineering effort.

**Qualifications**
**What You'll Bring with You**

* 8–10 years of overall software engineering experience, with substantial experience in Quality Engineering, Test Automation, Data Quality, or Platform Reliability.
* Proven experience designing, architecting, and implementing scalable test automation frameworks, covering unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end testing.
* Strong programming skills in Python and/or Scala, along with fluent SQL skills for validating and reconciling large datasets.
* Hands-on experience testing distributed data pipelines, including data-quality and data-validation checks covering schema, completeness, accuracy, consistency, and freshness.
* Experience designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines with automated quality gates, coverage thresholds, and release standards.
* Working knowledge of Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles, including SLOs, SLIs, SLAs, observability, incident management, and root cause analysis.
* Practical experience with AWS cloud environments and exposure to distributed data processing frameworks such as Apache Spark on EMR or Databricks.
* Demonstrated ability to establish engineering standards, influence development practices, and drive adoption of quality and reliability practices across engineering teams.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex distributed systems and data-related issues.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to engage partners, understand business requirements, and translate them into effective technical solutions.

Technical Skills
  
  
**Must-have**

* Strong programming proficiency in Python and/or Scala, with hands-on experience developing automation frameworks and engineering solutions.
* Strong SQL skills for large-scale data validation, reconciliation, and data-quality analysis.
* Hands-on experience with Apache Spark and distributed data processing environments.
* Experience designing and implementing test automation frameworks using PyTest, ScalaTest, JUnit, or equivalent frameworks.
* Strong understanding of unit, integration, contract, regression, and end-to-end testing methodologies.
* Experience building automated data-quality and validation frameworks covering schema integrity, completeness, accuracy, consistency, and freshness.
* Experience integrating automated testing and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, Bamboo, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or equivalent.
* Practical experience with AWS cloud services, particularly EMR, S3, and CloudWatch.
* Exposure to Databricks or equivalent distributed data processing platforms.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test - Database Automation
description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.
  
  
**About Us**
Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.
  
  
Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.
  
  
Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.
  
  
As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.
  
  
During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.
  
  
**About The Role**
Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.
  
  
We’re looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test with extensive industry experience to define and execute the design, development, and maintenance of Fivetran’s test automation tools and framework using reliable and scalable techniques.
  
  
As a Senior SDET, you will focus on solving complex testing difficulties by designing, developing and improving automation and reporting frameworks. You will invest in improving test stability and performance of the framework by developing innovative solutions to boost Fivetran’s testing efficiency. You will also coach Fivetran quality engineers to be the best in class automation engineers, and will continuously work with the team to ensure high standards for automation. The ideal candidate will be highly technical, detail-oriented, creative, motivated, and focused on achieving results.
  
  
In addition, this role emphasizes leveraging AI driven solutions to accelerate testing, enhance developer productivity, and improve operational insights, making Fivetran’s quality practices smarter, faster, and more scalable.
  
  
This is a full-time position based out of our Bangalore office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration, including two days in the office each week to connect and build as a team.
  
  
**Technologies You’ll Use**

* Languages & Frameworks: Java (17+), JUnit, REST Assured, Shell scripting; Python
* Infrastructure & Tooling: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Bazel, Buildkite
* Cloud & Platform: AWS, GCP, Azure
* Observability & Monitoring: Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog
* CI/CD & Automation: Jenkins, CircleCI, GitHub Actions
* Data & Testing:ELT pipelines, test automation utilities, whitebox testing strategies
* Databases: SQL and NoSQL databases (e.g., Postgres, SAP , Oracle, DB2 ertc)

**What You’ll Do**
  
  

* Review requirements, specifications and technical design documents to provide meaningful, risk-focused feedback.
* Design and evolve scalable automation frameworks in Java with a strong emphasis on reliability, performance, and data correctness.
* Write high-signal test strategies for complex features and automate them across multiple environments.
* Improve CI/CD pipelines by building robust validation layers that prevent silent failures and regressions.

+ Build internal tools and proof-of-concepts using AI/LLM technologies to:
+ Accelerate debugging and failure triaging
+ Generate high-quality test scenarios
+ Detect flaky patterns or regression risks
+ Improve log analysis and root-cause identification
+ Enhance developer and QA productivity

* Design AI-assisted workflows that integrate seamlessly into the existing automation and release pipelines.
* Experiment with and implement agent-based systems or LLM-powered tooling that streamline development and testing processes.
* Actively measure and improve engineering impact through reliability metrics, automation efficiency, and defect prevention signals.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to drive a culture of quality ownership and automation-first thinking.
* Collaborate with engineering and product leaders to align testing priorities and business objectives.

**Skills We’re Looking For**

* 6+ years of experience in the software industry with strong passion for quality, automation, and engineering excellence.
* Deep understanding of OOP principles and strong proficiency in Java.
* Expertise in designing scalable automation frameworks and identifying negative, edge, and high-risk scenarios.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems risks such as schema drift, idempotency failures, data inconsistencies, and race conditions.
* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines with tools such as Jenkins, Buildkite.
* Experience working with backend automation frameworks.
* Testing data pipeline or ELT platforms, with hands-on exposure to Change Data Capture (CDC) mechanisms, connector-based data ingestion, and validating data accuracy and consistency across source and destination systems at scale.
* Deep understanding of database internals
* Demonstrated ability to leverage AI/LLM tools to significantly accelerate development, debugging, test design or automation activities.
* Experience building AI-assisted tools, workflows, or agents that integrate into engineering pipelines.

**Bonus Skills**

* Experience testing against cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) or CDC source databases (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL)
* Familiarity with log-based CDC mechanisms (binlog, WAL, ) and handling schema drift or evolution scenarios.
* Exposure to distributed systems testing, large-scale data reconciliation, and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes) on cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure).
* Familiarity with data extraction using API-based polling, batch/file ingestion, and query-based incremental syncs.

**Perks And Benefits**
100% employer-paid medical insurance- Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.

title: Staff Engineer – Enterprise IT Automation
description:
**Netradyne**
harnesses the power of Computer Vision and Edge Computing to revolutionize the modern-day transportation ecosystem. We are a leader in fleet safety solutions. With growth exceeding 4x year over year, our solution is quickly being recognized as a significant disruptive technology. Our team is growing, and we need forward-thinking, uncompromising, competitive team members to continue to facilitate our growth.
  
  
**About Netradyne:**
Netradyne provides AI-powered technologies for fleet management and safer roads. An award-winning industry leader in fleet safety and video telematics solutions, Netradyne empowers thousands of commercial fleet customers across North America, Europe, and Asia to enhance their driver performance, reduce risk, and optimize operations.
  
  
Netradyne sets the standard among transportation technology companies for enhancing and sustaining road safety, with an industry-leading 25+ billion miles vision-analyzed for risk and an industry-first driver scoring system that reinforces safe behaviours. Founded in 2015, Netradyne is headquartered in San Diego with offices in San Francisco, Nashville, the UK and Bangalore.
  
  
For more details visit: www.netradyne.com
  
  
**About the Role:**
Netradyne is seeking a highly skilled and experienced dedicated Enterprise IT Automation Engineer to join our dynamic team in Bangalore. This role is critical and serve as the centralised enabler of generative-AI adoption across the enterprise. As a Enterprise IT Automation Engineer, you will turn fragmented, team-by-team AI experimentation into reusable, secure, and scalable capabilities that every function — Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, HR, Admin, Legal, and Finance.
  
  
This is a hands-on, build-first role for an engineer who can solution Agentic AI workflows and agents, integrate them into day-to-day operations, and partner with business leaders to ideate, prototype, and scale high-impact use cases. You will operate as a horizontal force-multiplier across the organisation initiatives and embedding responsible AI into how Netradyne works.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design, build, and maintain reusable Agentic AI Agents, workflows, MCP connectors, and assistants for business and support functions, prioritising templates that scale beyond a single team.
* Integrate MCP Connectors with Gen AI platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, Open AI, Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, into existing Enterprise IT & business systems.
* Automate business workflows and cross-functional processes, and continuously optimise systems for performance, cost-efficiency, reliability, and scalability.
* Apply solid software-engineering practices (version control, testing, observability) to AI solutions so they are maintainable, monitored, and production-grade.
* Partner with function teams to ideate, prototype, and scale AI use cases from concept to production, embedding into their workflows rather than handing off in isolation.
* Collaborate across Sales, Marketing, CS, Product, Engineering, HR, Admin, Legal, and Finance to identify high-value automation and Gen AI opportunities aligned to organisational goals.
* Ensure ethical and secure AI deployment in line with Netradyne's Responsible AI principles, data-protection obligations (including GDPR), and InfoSec policies.
* Support governance of Gen AI tool budgets and purchases org-wide, including visibility into shadow-AI spend and usage-based billing models.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and enhance the performance of deployed automation tools and AI systems, ensuring scalability and reliability in production.
* Stay current with advances in Gen AI, agentic frameworks, and IT automation, and translate them into actionable recommendations for continuous improvement.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, AI, or a related field.
* 8+ years of experience in an IT engineering with at least 5+ years of experience in IT automation, AI tools solution and implementation
* Hands-on experience designing and shipping Gen AI solutions using tools such as OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot, Claude, Cursor, Github Co-pilot & Others.
* Proficiency in a programming language such as Python, Java, or similar, with the ability to build and integrate APIs and workflows.
* Working knowledge of AI / ML frameworks, prompt engineering, RAG patterns, and agentic / workflow automation (e.g., n8n, Zapier).
* Strong understanding of enterprise IT infrastructure, cybersecurity, and cloud technologies (Azure, AWS, and / or Google Workspace).
* Experience with Microsoft productivity and platform tooling: O365, SharePoint, and the Microsoft 365 / Power Platform ecosystem.
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI solutions with existing IT systems, with a focus on scalability, security, and reliability.
* Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Experience deploying Gen AI in a high-speed, AI-driven organisation, with a focus on innovation and scale.
* Familiarity with IT security frameworks and identity tooling (LDAP, Entra ID, SSO / IdP, VPNs).
* Exposure to SOC automation, AI-driven ITSM, and / or InfoSec response automation.
* Understanding of SaaS / Gen AI cost governance, usage-based billing, and license management.
* Experience mentoring engineers and leading cross-functional technical initiatives.

**Why Join Netradyne?**

* Help define and build a brand-new, high-visibility Agentic AI Solutions at the centre of the company's AI strategy.
* Work at the intersection of cutting-edge AI and real enterprise impact, across every department.
* Collaborate with talented professionals in a collaborative, inclusive, innovation-driven environment.

title: Fashion Designer

3eings (pronounced “beings”) is a fashion brand that treats clothing as an emotional language, creating collections that reflect different states of being and human experiences. Rather than following a fixed aesthetic, the brand evolves with each drop, allowing colors, fonts, textures, and visual energy to shift with the mood being expressed. 3eings operates like a creative studio, exploring psychology, stories, and inner worlds to capture emotion through design. The brand is crafted for individuals who resist being confined to a single identity and embrace transitions in their lives. At 3eings, fashion is designed to evolve alongside the people who wear it.
  
**Role Description**
The Fashion Designer at 3eings will create and develop collections that align with the brand’s evolving emotional themes, translating concepts and moods into garments and accessories. Day-to-day responsibilities include sketching designs, selecting fabrics and materials, overseeing fittings, collaborating with pattern makers and production teams, and refining details such as embroidery and finishes. The role also involves researching trends, textiles, and visual storytelling to ensure each release fits into the broader brand universe. This is a full-time, on-site position based in Hyderabad, requiring close collaboration with the creative team to bring each collection from concept to final product.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong skills in Fashion Design and Fashion concept development, with the ability to translate emotional and psychological themes into cohesive collections.
* Knowledge of Textiles and Fabric selection, including understanding of textures, materials, and their suitability for different designs and moods.
* Experience with Embroidery and decorative techniques to enhance visual storytelling and garment details.
* Proficiency in Fitting, garment construction, and working with pattern makers and production teams to ensure high-quality, wearable designs.
* Relevant education in Fashion Design or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

* Strong sense of creativity, experimentation, and narrative-driven design, with attention to detail and quality.
* Collaborative mindset, good communication skills, and the ability to work on-site in Hyderabad with cross-functional creative and production teams.

title: Computational Designer (Remote, Full-Time) [AS354]
description:
**About Smart Working**

  

At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day. This isn’t just another remote opportunity - it’s about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. From day one, you’re welcomed into a genuine community that values your growth and well-being. Our mission is simple: to break down geographic barriers and connect skilled professionals with outstanding global teams and products for full-time, long-term roles. We help you discover meaningful work with teams that invest in your success, where you’re empowered to grow personally and professionally.

  

Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote-first world.

  

**About the Role**

  

As a Senior Computational Designer, you will contribute to the ongoing development of SiteSolve, a generative design tool focused on site viability and masterplanning. The role combines computational design, geometry development and software engineering, with a predominantly back-end focus.

  

You will work directly with a product team member and may collaborate with an AI research and development specialist on initiatives involving AI agents and machine learning-based optimisation. The precise balance of responsibilities will depend on your skills and interests and may evolve as product priorities change.

  

You will contribute to a standalone product that does not depend on third-party computational design tools. The role requires independent ownership of sub-projects, thoughtful problem-solving and an understanding of how individual technical decisions contribute to the wider product.

**Responsibilities**
  

  
* Develop and maintain computational geometry algorithms for a standalone generative design product
  
* Contribute to the ongoing development of SiteSolve, supporting site viability analysis and masterplanning
  
* Design, implement and refine computational optimisation solutions
  
* Build and maintain internal tools supporting product development
  
* Contribute to cloud infrastructure and back-end development
  
* Work across front-end and back-end development, with a predominant focus on back-end functionality
  
* Undertake primarily C# development, which accounts for approximately 99% of the role
  
* Develop code that interacts with the product's 3D engine as its interface transitions from Unity to Unreal, with dedicated Unreal specialists leading the rendering work
  
* Collaborate with product team members on computational design and software development
  
* Potentially contribute to AI-focused research and development, including connecting SiteSolve to AI agents and exploring machine learning-based optimisation approaches
  
* Independently take ownership of assigned sub-projects
  
* Apply a detail-oriented approach while considering the wider context in which the code operates
  
* Demonstrate flexibility, problem-solving ability and thoroughness in technical development
  
  

  
**Requirements**
  

  
* C# – 3+ years: Expert or advanced proficiency in C#, with hands-on experience developing software applications. C# is the primary language used throughout the product, and no substitute programming language is accepted
  
* AEC Computational Design / Geometry – 3+ years: Solid understanding and practical experience in AEC computational design or geometry. Relevant computational or algorithmic design experience from adjacent domains, including manufacturing, robotics, CAD, simulation or games, is also acceptable
  
* Rhino / Grasshopper – 3+ years: Working knowledge of Rhino and Grasshopper or equivalent 3D CAD and parametric design tools
  
* Computational Optimisation – 2–3 years: Applied experience in computational optimisation. A strong applied mathematics or algorithms background with demonstrated optimisation experience is also acceptable
  
* Ability to independently own and deliver assigned sub-projects
  
* Strong problem-solving skills with a thorough and detail-oriented approach to development
  
* Ability to understand the broader product context and use that understanding to inform technical decisions
  
* Flexibility to work across different development areas as product priorities evolve
  
  

  
**Nice to Have**
  

  
* AWS – 2+ years: Working knowledge of AWS. Experience with another major cloud provider, such as Azure or GCP, combined with a willingness to learn AWS, is also acceptable
  
* Unity / Unreal / 3D Game Engines – 1–2 years: Basic familiarity with Unity, Unreal or other 3D game engines. Alternatively, an understanding of 3D vector mathematics, mesh geometry, rendering and shaders is valuable, even without direct game engine experience

title: Sr Engineer, AI [T500-30757]
description:

With its unique value proposition of best network, best value, and best experiences, T-Mobile is redefining connectivity, fueling competition, and driving the next wave of innovation in wireless and beyond. We foster innovation, agility, transparency, and strong enterprise partnerships to deliver measurable business outcomes.

This role is responsible for designing, building, and scaling the foundational software platform that powers T-Mobile’s agentic AI capabilities across conversational experiences, including text and voice interactions. The engineer develops the core execution, orchestration, and integration frameworks that enable AI systems to reason, plan, act, and interact safely with enterprise services at scale, while providing technical leadership for the architecture, evolution, and scalability of the AI execution platform.

Working closely with AI/ML engineers, platform engineers, product teams, and enterprise application teams, this role focuses on building reusable platform capabilities rather than individual AI applications. Responsibilities include designing agent orchestration frameworks, workflow execution engines, SDKs, tool integration layers, memory and state management systems, and conversational runtime services that support next-generation customer and employee experiences.

Success in this role requires strong software engineering expertise, distributed systems knowledge, and practical understanding of LLM-powered systems, with an emphasis on reliability, extensibility, scalability, and platform adoption. We pride ourselves on encouraging a culture of innovation, agile ways of working, and transparency in all we do. Join us in embodying the spirit of the Un-carrier and making a tangible impact.

**What You'll Do:**

* Design and develop agent orchestration frameworks and execution engines supporting complex AI-driven workflows.
* Design and optimize low-latency services supporting real-time conversational and voice interactions.
* Build reusable platform services, SDKs, APIs, and libraries that accelerate development of conversational AI applications.
* Design and implement Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations and frameworks that enable secure, scalable access to enterprise tools, APIs, data sources, and agent capabilities.
* Develop reusable tool-calling, context-sharing, and interoperability services that support MCP-enabled agent ecosystems.
* Develop runtime services for text- and voice-based agent interactions, including context management, tool execution, memory, and state orchestration.
* Architect microservices and event-driven systems that integrate AI reasoning with enterprise systems such as customer, billing, network, and support platforms.
* Design mechanisms that safely translate model outputs into deterministic business actions and workflows.
* Collaborate with AI/ML engineers to integrate foundation models, retrieval systems, evaluation frameworks, and agent capabilities into production platforms.
* Drive platform reliability, scalability, observability, and performance across high-volume AI workloads.
* Establish software architecture standards, engineering best practices, and reusable design patterns for agentic systems.
* Contribute to technical strategy and platform evolution by evaluating emerging AI, orchestration, and distributed systems technologies.
* Mentor engineers and promote engineering excellence through design reviews, documentation, and knowledge sharing.

**What You'll Bring**
:

* 7+ years of software engineering experience building distributed systems and cloud-native applications.
* Strong proficiency in Python or Java, with working knowledge of both preferred.
* Experience designing APIs, microservices, workflow engines, or platform services.
* Experience building systems that integrate with LLMs, AI services, or conversational platforms.
* Experience designing highly available distributed systems and service-oriented architectures.
* Strong understanding of software architecture, system design, scalability, resiliency, and performance optimization.
* Demonstrated experience leading technical design discussions, driving architectural decisions, and influencing engineering direction across teams.
* Experience with cloud-native technologies, including containers, Kubernetes, and service-based architectures.
* Excellent problem-solving, debugging, and technical communication skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience integrating AI systems with enterprise applications, APIs, tools, or data platforms through standardized integration patterns.

**Must Have Skills:**

* Python or Rust Or GO software engineering
* Distributed systems, APIs, and microservices
* LLM, AI service, and conversational platform integration
* Cloud-native architecture, containers, and Kubernetes
* Software architecture and technical leadership

**Nice-to-Have:**

* Experience building agent orchestration frameworks, workflow platforms, or AI execution systems.
* Experience with conversational AI, voice platforms, speech technologies, or real-time interaction systems.
* Familiarity with retrieval systems, vector databases, memory architectures, and evaluation frameworks.
* Experience designing internal developer platforms, SDKs, or reusable engineering frameworks.
* Knowledge of event-driven architectures, distributed workflows, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent tool-calling frameworks, or similar standards for connecting AI systems with external tools and services.

* Champion secure design: encryption, key management, secrets handling, least-privilege access and audit trails, in line with PCI DSS and internal InfoSec policy.

**People leadership**

* Mentor and grow engineers through pairing, design reviews and regular feedback.
* Take part in hiring: define the bar, interview and onboard new team members.
* Build a culture of ownership, documentation and calm, data-driven decisions.

**Technical environment**

**Backend**
: Java / Spring Boot (primary); Node.js (TypeScript) or Python for APIs, integrations and tooling

**Frontend**
: React (TypeScript)

**Architecture**
: Microservices, event-driven design, REST APIs, saga and outbox patterns

**Data**
: PostgreSQL (primary), Redis; NoSQL where the workload warrants it

**Cloud and DevOps**
: AWS (or Azure/GCP), Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, feature flags

**Observability**
: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, centralised logging

**Security**
: Cloud KMS/HSM, secrets management, WAF, SAST/DAST

**Critical skills**

* These are must-haves; candidates should show real depth in each area during interviews.
* Delivery leadership: turning high-level requirements into scoped work and shipping it predictably with a team of 5 or more engineers.
* Engineering process: code review, test automation, CI/CD, release management and incident management run as a discipline.
* Distributed systems: consistency, idempotency, concurrency, failure handling and high-throughput APIs.
* Java with Spring Boot, plus working proficiency in TypeScript/Node.js or Python and the ability to review React code.
* SQL: schema design, indexing, query tuning, transactions and isolation levels; zero-downtime migrations.
* Cloud and infrastructure: Kubernetes in a public cloud, infrastructure as code and observability.
* Security fundamentals: encryption, key and secrets management, least privilege and audit trails.

**Required qualifications**

* 8+ years building production systems, including 2+ years as a tech lead leading a team of 5 or more engineers.
* Proven track record of turning architecture and product requirements into detailed specifications that teams deliver against.
* Deep experience with distributed systems and high-availability services.
* Strong command of Java and Spring Boot; working knowledge of Node.js (TypeScript) or Python, and React.
* Experience running services on Kubernetes in a public cloud, with CI/CD and infrastructure as code.
* Working knowledge of security and compliance practices such as PCI DSS; exposure to payments or fintech systems is helpful.
* Clear written and verbal communication; able to explain trade-offs to architects, engineers, product leaders and auditors.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred qualifications**

* Experience in payments, fintech or banking technology, such as payment gateways, processor integrations, settlement and reconciliation.
* Built or scaled a ledger, payment switch or settlement engine handling 1M+ transactions a day.
* Led certification with a card network or an acquiring bank.
* Shipped an AI/ML or LLM-powered feature to production.
* Has used AI coding assistants and agentic tools within a governed SDLC.

description:

Omnicom Global Solutions (OGS) is an integral part of Omnicom Group, a leading global marketing and corporate communications company. OGS India serves as a key global capability center for Omnicom, enabling its agencies and group companies with scaled delivery, specialized expertise, and integrated solutions. Our capabilities span Media, Data & Analytics, Technology, MarTech, Commerce, Business Support Solutions, Creative Production, Healthcare, and Strategy & Insights.

With a workforce of over 7,000 professionals in India, OGS continues to expand its capabilities and global impact, supporting the evolving needs of clients and agencies. We are committed to building future-ready talent and delivering high-quality, outcome-driven solutions.

*OGS India continues to expand its scale and capabilities through the integration of additional global operations, further strengthening its position as a strategic solutions engine for Omnicom.*

**About the Role:**

The Databricks Architect / Lead Engineer holds day-to-day engineering leadership of the pod on this engagement. This role works daily with the onshore technical lead to review open questions, resolve ambiguity, and ensure the pod team has clear, prioritized work at all times — at the start of each sprint and throughout it. The Architect / Lead Engineer serves as the primary technical liaison between the onshore Core Team and the hybrid internal team, translating backlog items into assignable tasks, tracking progress against sprint goals daily, and escalating blockers promptly.

This role carries technical and delivery accountability beyond task coordination. The Architect / Lead Engineer is expected to ask the clarifying questions that prevent rework, challenge ambiguity rather than work around it, and maintain a consistent pace of delivery across the pod.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Meet daily with the onshore technical lead to review open questions, clarify requirements, and confirm priorities.
* Translate sprint-level backlog items into clear, appropriately scoped tasks, ensuring assignments are made at the start of each sprint.
* Lead daily check-ins with the pod to track progress against sprint goals, resolve blockers, and adjust task sequencing as priorities change.
* Design and build complex Databricks pipelines (Bronze through Gold) for financial and operational data, setting the technical standard for the pod.
* Own technical quality for the pod's output, including code review, data quality validation, and adherence to the platform's security model (RLS/CLS).
* Identify risks, dependencies, and scope gaps early, and escalate them to the onshore lead outside of standing meetings when necessary.
* Lead the pod's knowledge transfer from the onshore Integration & Middleware team on Boomi integration patterns (e.g., JDE-Concur, JDE-UKG), and plan the pod's transition to build, validation, and support responsibility for those integrations.
* Mentor Senior and Data Engineers on the pod, developing their ability to work independently and resolve ambiguity on their own.
* Communicate the pod's capacity and constraints accurately, including flagging when scope exceeds available bandwidth.arc

**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years of data engineering experience, including substantial hands-on work with
  **Databricks (Spark/PySpark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks Workflows).**
* Databricks
  **Certified**
  Data Engineer Professional required (Associate accepted if Professional certification is in progress).
* Strong
  **SQL and Python**
  skills, with the ability to review and provide feedback on others' code.
* Demonstrated experience building data pipelines from
  **financial or ERP source systems**
  — JD Edwards (JDE) directly preferred, with EcoSys or Microsoft Dynamics also relevant — into a governed lakehouse or warehouse, including general ledger, cost, and project financial data.
* Experience connecting operational and financial data to core business reporting within a construction, EPC, energy, or other asset-heavy industry (e.g., cost-to-complete, earned value management, project P&L).
* Prior experience in a hybrid onshore/offshore delivery model (dedicated onshore lead plus offshore engineering pod), ideally in the offshore lead role.
* Demonstrated experience leading or co-leading agile delivery teams, including sprint planning, backlog grooming, and daily standups.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, including the ability to lead meetings and discussions directly with onshore and client stakeholders.
* Working knowledge of
  **iPaaS/integration**
  middleware platforms, with Boomi strongly preferred; candidates without direct Boomi experience should demonstrate the ability to ramp quickly through structured knowledge transfer.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience implementing row-level or column-level security (RLS/CLS) in Databricks Unity Catalog.
* Familiarity with Databricks Genie (AI/BI) or comparable self-service analytics tooling.
* Experience with CI/CD for data pipelines (Databricks Asset Bundles, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar).
* Familiarity with Power BI or other BI tools consuming governed Gold-layer data.
* Experience with API-based integration (REST/webhook patterns) and file-based integration (EDI, flat file, CSV) with validation controls.

**Ideal Candidate Profile:**

* Operates effectively in ambiguity; asks precise clarifying questions rather than making assumptions.
* Prioritizes early clarity to maintain delivery speed, and acts decisively once requirements are understood.
* Takes ownership of outcomes rather than assigned tasks alone, and raises concerns when something does not align.
* Communicates directly and proactively across time zones and cultures without requiring prompting.
* Has prior experience in a onshore/offshore hybrid delivery model and understands the trust, transparency, and delivery discipline it requires.

Hyderabad / Bangalore / Gurugram / Pune / Mumbai / Chennai

title: Sr. Platform Engineer - Streaming/Messaging Systems
description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.
  
  
At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate, serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations.
  
  
**Your Team's Impact**
The NoSQL team manages the infrastructure, deployment, and lifecycle of enterprise NoSQL and data platforms, including provisioning, updates, patching, and troubleshooting. We collaborate with data stakeholders to configure, monitor, and resolve issues across a diverse portfolio of technologies (Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Weaviate, Dremio, Redis, Valkey, DocumentDB, MSK, Zookeeper, Snowflake, and others). The team owns the operational excellence and reliability of these distributed systems from deployment through production support.
  
  
You'll join an international platform engineering team where hands-on problem-solving is valued over process overhead. We expect you to dig into problems, learn our systems deeply, and take initiative—not wait for detailed specifications.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* We're seeking a Platform Engineer to join our international team and take hands-on ownership of our streaming and messaging infrastructure. You'll architect, deploy, and maintain event-driven systems that power our Kubernetes ecosystem while working collaboratively across USA and India timezones.
* Design & Deploy: Architect and implement streaming/messaging systems and event buses within Kubernetes environments, making trade-off decisions between reliability, performance, and operational complexity
* Infrastructure as Code: Write and maintain Terraform and Ansible configurations to provision, configure, and manage platform infrastructure reproducibly
* Operational Ownership: Manage deployments, monitor system health, troubleshoot incidents, and continuously improve observability and reliability
* Collaboration: Partner with development teams to understand messaging patterns and with cross-functional platform engineers across regions
* Hands-On Implementation: Write scripts, debug issues, and iterate on solutions—not just design from above
* On-Call Support: Participate in on-call rotation to respond to production incidents and system outages

**What We're Looking For**

* 5+ years of experience in architecting or maintaining streaming/messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS/GCP managed services, etc.)
* Solid hands-on experience with Kubernetes (deployments, operators, scaling, networking)
* Proficiency with Ansible and Terraform for infrastructure automation
* Proven experience deploying and managing resources to cloud platforms (AWS preferred, but GCP and Azure experience also valued)
* Comfortable with distributed systems concepts: eventual consistency, fault tolerance, message ordering trade-offs
* Availability for on-call rotation supporting production systems with flexible timezone coverage
* Timezone flexibility: Ability to work across overlapping USA and India business hours with occasional sync meetings outside standard hours

Nice-to-Have
  
  

* Experience with Crossplane for infrastructure composition and multi-cloud management
* Familiarity with Coralogix or similar observability/log management platforms
* Background in Go, Python, or Bash scripting
* Experience with GitOps workflows and deployment automation

description:

**Position Summary**

Join Deloitte’s Enterprise Performance practice as a Manager, 3DX, where you will support digital transformation initiatives across product lifecycle management environments. In this role, you will contribute to the design, customization, deployment, and support of 3DEXPERIENCE solutions for complex client needs. You will work with cross-functional teams to translate functional requirements into technical solutions, deliver quality work products within project timelines, and support implementation activities across the solution lifecycle.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Manager, 3DX on the Enterprise Performance team, you will be responsible for supporting product lifecycle management transformation initiatives across engineering, manufacturing, and enterprise application environments.
  
  

* Lead configuration and customization activities within Dassault 3DEXPERIENCE ENOVIA and DELMIA environments based on documented business and technical requirements.
* Support bill of materials management, computer-aided design data management, document management, project management, change management, and product information management activities within product lifecycle management environments.
* Lead integration activities between 3DEXPERIENCE and enterprise platforms such as enterprise resource planning, manufacturing execution systems, customer relationship management systems, reporting tools, and MCAD or ECAD applications.
* Support requirements documentation, legacy data migration, test planning, functional testing, user acceptance testing, and issue resolution across deployment phases.
* Collaborate with business, technology, onsite, and offshore teams and provide guidance to junior team members to support end-to-end PLM solution delivery.

**The team**
Enterprise Performance
  
  
Our Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise technology, working across finance, supply chain, and IT operations to support the delivery of holistic performance improvement and digital transformation. We support Deloitte client service teams of strategic advisors and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to help collaborate with leading insights providers and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable the heart of business solutions.
  
  
The Enterprise Performance team leverages deep industry knowledge, strong analytical skills, and practical approaches to address clients’ toughest business challenges. We excel at translating strategic objectives into tangible, measurable outcomes at the operational level. By aligning high-level goals with frontline execution, we ensure our clients realize real value and improved performance across every stage of their supply chain and operations.
  
  
**Location:**
Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai
  
  
**Shift Timings:**
11 AM to 8 PM or 2 PM to 11 PM IST, as per business requirements
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required:

* Experience developing integrations between 3DEXPERIENCE and enterprise systems using web services, Simple Object Access Protocol (SOAP), Representational State Transfer (REST) APIs, or third-party connectors

* Experience documenting technical requirements, supporting legacy data migration, and contributing to test planning, functional testing, and user acceptance testing

* Bachelor of Technology, Master of Computer Applications, Master of Technology, Master of Business Administration, or equivalent from an accredited university

Preferred:
  
  

* Experience with Dassault 3DEXPERIENCE ENOVIA in cloud or on-premises environments
* Experience with 3DX client-side development, including CATIA macros
* Experience with 3DX platform installation, setup, and maintenance
* Experience using code change management tools such as TortoiseSVN or GitLab
* Experience supporting build management and deployments, including continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD)
* Experience with infrastructure components such as Windows, Linux, Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, Apache TomEE, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), or Microsoft Azure

We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including competitive fixed pay, performance-based incentive programs, a family-first benefits program, employer contributions for your retirement, attractive time off and leave offerings, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points-based recognition program.

Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients worldwide

We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day, a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.

**What You’ll Be Doing (position summary):**

The AI Platform Engineer supports the Data Mesh program by designing and implementing solutions that automate the creation, execution, and validation of unit test cases for code written by software engineers and AI-assisted development tools. The role establishes scalable frameworks for automated test generation across PySpark, Scala, and .NET codebases, improving engineering quality, consistency, and delivery speed. Working closely with platform, data, engineering, architecture, and governance teams, the role ensures that both AI-generated and developer-authored code meet enterprise quality standards before promotion into production environment.

**How You’ll Succeed (responsibilities):**

**Design and Development:**

* Design, build, and enhance platform capabilities that automate unit test generation for code written in PySpark, Scala, and .NET to improve quality and engineering efficiency.
* Develop reusable frameworks, templates, and standards for automated testing across Data Mesh-aligned data products and services to support consistency and scale.
* Integrate test generation and execution capabilities into CI/CD pipelines, developer workflows, and quality gates to enable earlier defect detection and faster delivery.
* Build solutions that validate code produced by engineers, AI coding assistants, and code generation tools to ensure code quality prior to production deployment.

**Strategic Planning:**

* Partner with engineering and architecture teams to standardize testing patterns across distributed data pipelines and platform services to improve enterprise consistency.
* Contribute to governance and best practices for the responsible use of AI in software engineering and test automation to support controlled innovation.
* Work closely with platform, data, engineering, architecture, and governance teams to align automated testing solutions with enterprise requirements and delivery priorities.
* Support internal developer productivity initiatives by enabling scalable, repeatable, and governed testing solutions.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Establish metrics and reporting for unit test coverage, testing effectiveness, adoption, and defect leakage to support continuous improvement and governance.

**CROSS-FUNCTIONAL RELATIONSHIPS:**

* This job works closely with platform engineering, data engineering, software engineering, architecture, and governance teams to design and implement automated testing capabilities.
* This job collaborates with CI/CD, DevOps, and developer enablement teams to embed testing and quality controls into delivery pipelines and engineering workflows.
* This job partners with data product and service teams to validate transformation logic, schema compliance, contract adherence, and business rule implementation.
* This job interacts with stakeholders responsible for AI-assisted development and internal accelerators to establish controls for AI-generated code and tests.
* This job supports broader engineering teams through documentation, onboarding materials, templates, and reusable standards to drive enterprise adoption.

**COMPLIANCE REQUIREMENTS/RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* As an employee of CIBC, the incumbent must comply with all applicable CIBC and Line of Business policies, standards, guidelines and controls.

**AUTHORITIES/DECISION RIGHTS:**

* As a key contributor to the business unit, this job has the authority to recommend changes to business processes in order to enhance operational efficiency and effectiveness.

**JOB DIMENSIONS:**

* Enterprise platform role supporting automated testing capabilities across multiple engineering teams and Data Mesh-aligned data products and services.
* Scope includes codebases and testing frameworks across PySpark, Scala, and .NET environments.
* Supports quality validation for both developer-authored and AI-generated code.
* Contributes to the standardization of testing patterns across distributed data pipelines and platform services.
* Accountable for establishing metrics related to test coverage, effectiveness, adoption, and defect leakage.
* Provides reusable frameworks, controls, templates, and enablement materials for broader engineering adoption.

**Who You Are (skills/qualifications):**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.

**Must Have Skills:**

* 7+ years of experience in software engineering, platform engineering, or quality engineering. This includes hands-on work in automated testing and in distributed data processing.
* Knowledge of software engineering, platform engineering, quality engineering, and test automation practices.
* Knowledge of automated unit testing framework design and implementation.
* Knowledge of PySpark, Scala, and .NET / C# development practices, with hands-on experience in at least two.
* Knowledge of CI/CD pipeline integration and enterprise software delivery processes.
* Knowledge of distributed data processing and data engineering platforms.
* Knowledge of schema validation, contract testing, transformation testing, and orchestration logic validation.
* Knowledge of AI-assisted development tools, automated code generation, and controls required for responsible use in engineering environments.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to assess test coverage gaps, logic risks, and quality issues.
* Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills to work effectively across multiple technical teams.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to translate technical complexity into practical and scalable solutions.
* Ability to design reusable frameworks, templates, and standards that drive adoption at scale.
* Ability to balance innovation, governance, control, and delivery speed in a complex enterprise environment.
* Strong ownership mindset, attention to quality, and continuous improvement orientation.

**Good to Have:**

title: Principal Engineer
description:
Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.
  
  
At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day - building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with entrepreneurial speed, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset.
  
  
The Principal Engineer, Software – Finance & Supply Chain Platform is responsible for architecting resilient, distributed transaction flows across microservices, cloud ERPs (Oracle Fusion, NetSuite, D365), OMS, WMS, financial systems, and data platforms that underpin Fanatics Commerce's global operations. This role sets engineering standards for event contracts, data consistency, reconciliation frameworks, and financial ledger integrity while leading modernization initiatives including monolith decomposition, async processing, and domain-driven design. The Principal Engineer, Software – Finance & Supply Chain Platform delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights.
  
  
**How Will You Drive Impact**
Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes.
  
  
Team & Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams)
  
  
**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Partner with Finance, Supply Chain, Data, and Security leadership to translate regulatory and operational requirements into actionable architecture decisions and platform roadmaps.
* Influence cloud infrastructure strategy and drive platform alignment across engineering domains, ensuring cohesive standards for event contracts, API design, and data consistency.
* Engage executive and cross-functional stakeholders to shape long-term platform strategy and build organizational confidence in distributed system design choices.

**People Leadership**

* Mentor senior engineers across domains, elevating technical craft and establishing engineering standards that scale with the organization.
* Champion a culture of observability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement — coaching teams on SRE principles, SLOs, and self-service resilience patterns.

Fan & Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans)
  
  

* Architect systems designed for high availability and horizontal scalability, ensuring seamless fan and commerce experiences during peak traffic events such as seasonal spikes and product launches.
* Design and enforce disaster recovery, fault tolerance, and latency standards that protect the integrity of financial and order management systems fans depend on.
* Enable accurate, real-time inventory and order data flows across OMS and WMS, ensuring fans receive reliable fulfillment experiences at every touchpoint.
* Drive the adoption of Agentic AI to reimagine finance workflows — including invoice processing, reconciliation, and supplier communication — freeing teams to focus on higher-value fan and business outcomes.

Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)
  
  

* Lead modernization initiatives including monolith decomposition, asynchronous processing, event streaming, and domain-driven design across Finance and SCM platforms.
* Define and evolve cloud-native architecture using API-first and event-driven patterns, establishing the technical foundation for a scalable, future-ready platform.
* Establish a robust error framework with self-service retry mechanisms, reducing manual intervention and improving system resilience across distributed transaction flows.
* Influence the adoption of streaming platforms (Kafka, Pub/Sub, Event Hubs) and async messaging patterns to unlock real-time processing capabilities across financial and inventory domains.

Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset)
  
  

* Own system-level non-functional requirements — latency, fault tolerance, disaster recovery, and security — holding the bar on platform reliability for critical financial and supply chain systems.
* Drive observability strategy across logging, tracing, metrics, and SLOs for financial and inventory systems, ensuring engineering teams can detect, diagnose, and resolve issues with speed and confidence.
* Establish standards for financial ledger integrity, revenue recognition, and reconciliation frameworks within distributed, eventually consistent system architectures.
* Design for peak readiness — including month-end close cycles and high-transaction retail events — ensuring platform stability and performance under the most demanding operational conditions.

AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY
  
  
We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to:
  
  

* Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes
* Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance
* Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working
* Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

**Required Qualifications**
CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING
  
  

* 12+ years of engineering experience building distributed, cloud-native systems, with demonstrable expertise in microservices architecture, event-driven systems, and API design.
* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and container orchestration (Kubernetes), including serverless and managed service patterns.
* Experience with streaming platforms (Kafka, Pub/Sub, Event Hubs) and asynchronous messaging patterns in high-transaction retail or eCommerce environments.
* Strong understanding of financial domain concepts — ledgering, revenue recognition, inventory costing, and reconciliation — and direct experience with cloud ERPs such as Oracle Fusion, NetSuite, or D365.
* Deep knowledge of data architecture, eventual consistency, and idempotent processing, paired with strong SQL and data modeling skills and proficiency in modern backend stacks (Java, .NET, Go, or similar).
* Experience implementing observability and SRE principles using tools such as OpenTelemetry, with demonstrated ability to define and enforce SLOs for mission-critical systems.
* Proven ability to influence cross-functional and executive stakeholders on platform strategy, with a track record of mentoring senior engineers and elevating engineering standards at scale.

WORK LOCATION
  
  
Hybrid: The primary place of performance of this role is the Company's office located in

**Our Company**
Teradata empowers companies to achieve high-impact business outcomes through analytics. With a powerful combination of industry expertise and leading hybrid cloud technologies for data warehousing and big data analytics, Teradata unleashes the potential of great companies. Partnering with top companies around the world, Teradata helps improve customer experience, mitigate risk, drive product innovation, achieve operational excellence, transform finance, and optimize assets. The Teradata culture isn’t just about one kind of person. So many individuals make up who we are, making us that much more unique. It’s what sets apart the dynamic, diverse and collaborative environment that is Teradata. But even as individuals, there’s one thing that we all share — our united goal of making Teradata and our people, the best we can be.
  
  
**OUR TEAM**
This position is for a Manager, Software Engineering in the Platform Services team within the Vantage Core – Platform Software organization. The team builds core cloud platform services that power provisioning, lifecycle management, and runtime operations of Teradata compute infrastructure across public cloud environments (AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud). These highly reliable, scalable, and automated infrastructure services are used by multiple engineering teams and enterprise customers.
  
  
Key areas of focus include:
  
  

* Cloud-native provisioning and lifecycle automation for distributed compute environments.
* Platform services for orchestration, scaling, and configuration management across public cloud platforms.
* Serverless and event-driven automation frameworks for infrastructure workflows.
* Secure and reliable connectivity enablement for cloud-deployed compute systems.

We are looking for a candidate to join our fast-paced and cutting-edge development organization that is on the forefront of our “Teradata Everywhere” strategy.
  
  
Teradata Labs, the technology research and development (R&D) organization within Teradata Corporation, has been turning innovative decision support technology into business results for over 30 years. Our R&D team of analytic architects, database developers and engineers work to understand and advance emerging technologies to invent the next wave of cutting-edge analytic data solutions.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
The position involves leading one or more software engineering teams responsible for the development, integration, functional and performance testing, and fault analysis of our cloud platform services across public cloud environments. The manager will be responsible for:
  
  

* Providing and communicating the engineering vision for your team, aligned with the long-term cloud platform strategy.
* Ensuring the timely delivery of committed features.
* Liaising with other engineering teams, project management, and product management, as well as networking, security, and cloud infrastructure teams.
* Mentoring, providing career growth opportunities, satisfying administrative requirements, and maintaining accountability for direct reports.
* Providing engineering leadership in support escalations as needed.
* Partnering with architects and senior technical leaders to drive scalability, reliability, operational efficiency, and developer productivity across the platform.

The ideal candidate is a highly motivated, empathetic, and creative engineering leader who is ready to participate in an agile team environment and contribute to the success of Teradata. Given our team’s focus on cloud platform solutions, the ideal candidate should have deep hands-on cloud experience on AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud.
  
  
**Job Functions**

* Manager of an agile development team responsible for Teradata cloud platform services.
* Collaborates with engineering leadership and project management to set the development priorities of the team.
* Holds direct reports accountable for their individual responsibilities, and is accountable to reports for their career growth.
* Performs various administrative functions related to the management of direct reports, including time sheet approvals, leave approvals, promotion applications, etc.
* Identifies areas for improvement and collaborates with leadership on executing plans for positive change within the organization.

**Qualifications**
**Leadership**

* Proven engineering leadership experience, preferably with direct reports.
* Experience working in a fast-paced agile scrum development environment.
* Proven ability to influence technical decisions across teams and drive engineering alignment.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

**Technical**

* Deep hands-on experience building and operating systems on at least one major public cloud platform such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Strong programming expertise in Python or similar languages used for infrastructure and platform engineering.
* Extensive experience designing large-scale cloud-native platforms or distributed infrastructure systems.
* Strong understanding of multi-cloud architecture, cloud networking, IAM, service quotas, and multi-region deployments.
* Experience designing infrastructure automation and provisioning systems using cloud APIs, SDKs, and Infrastructure as Code tools.
* Experience building event-driven or serverless platform architectures.
* Strong experience designing highly scalable distributed systems.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience designing multi-cloud platforms or cross-cloud infrastructure services.
* Experience building internal developer platforms or shared infrastructure used across large organizations.
* Experience working with Kubernetes-based platforms or container orchestration systems.
* Experience building large-scale provisioning or orchestration systems.
* Experience with Teradata Vantage.

**Minimum Education And Residency Requirements**

* Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related discipline with 8+ years of relevant experience.
* Advanced degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related discipline with 6+ years of relevant experience.

**Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata**
We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.
  
  
Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. ​ We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.
