description:
**About Smart Working**

  

At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day. This isn’t just another remote opportunity - it’s about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. From day one, you’re welcomed into a genuine community that values your growth and well-being. Our mission is simple: to break down geographic barriers and connect skilled professionals with outstanding global teams and products for full-time, long-term roles. We help you discover meaningful work with teams that invest in your success, where you’re empowered to grow personally and professionally.

  

Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote-first world.

  

**About the Role**

  

As a Senior Computational Designer, you will contribute to the ongoing development of SiteSolve, a generative design tool focused on site viability and masterplanning. The role combines computational design, geometry development and software engineering, with a predominantly back-end focus.

  

You will work directly with a product team member and may collaborate with an AI research and development specialist on initiatives involving AI agents and machine learning-based optimisation. The precise balance of responsibilities will depend on your skills and interests and may evolve as product priorities change.

  

You will contribute to a standalone product that does not depend on third-party computational design tools. The role requires independent ownership of sub-projects, thoughtful problem-solving and an understanding of how individual technical decisions contribute to the wider product.

**Responsibilities**
  

  
* Develop and maintain computational geometry algorithms for a standalone generative design product
  
* Contribute to the ongoing development of SiteSolve, supporting site viability analysis and masterplanning
  
* Design, implement and refine computational optimisation solutions
  
* Build and maintain internal tools supporting product development
  
* Contribute to cloud infrastructure and back-end development
  
* Work across front-end and back-end development, with a predominant focus on back-end functionality
  
* Undertake primarily C# development, which accounts for approximately 99% of the role
  
* Develop code that interacts with the product's 3D engine as its interface transitions from Unity to Unreal, with dedicated Unreal specialists leading the rendering work
  
* Collaborate with product team members on computational design and software development
  
* Potentially contribute to AI-focused research and development, including connecting SiteSolve to AI agents and exploring machine learning-based optimisation approaches
  
* Independently take ownership of assigned sub-projects
  
* Apply a detail-oriented approach while considering the wider context in which the code operates
  
* Demonstrate flexibility, problem-solving ability and thoroughness in technical development
  
  

  
**Requirements**
  

  
* C# – 3+ years: Expert or advanced proficiency in C#, with hands-on experience developing software applications. C# is the primary language used throughout the product, and no substitute programming language is accepted
  
* AEC Computational Design / Geometry – 3+ years: Solid understanding and practical experience in AEC computational design or geometry. Relevant computational or algorithmic design experience from adjacent domains, including manufacturing, robotics, CAD, simulation or games, is also acceptable
  
* Rhino / Grasshopper – 3+ years: Working knowledge of Rhino and Grasshopper or equivalent 3D CAD and parametric design tools
  
* Computational Optimisation – 2–3 years: Applied experience in computational optimisation. A strong applied mathematics or algorithms background with demonstrated optimisation experience is also acceptable
  
* Ability to independently own and deliver assigned sub-projects
  
* Strong problem-solving skills with a thorough and detail-oriented approach to development
  
* Ability to understand the broader product context and use that understanding to inform technical decisions
  
* Flexibility to work across different development areas as product priorities evolve
  
  

  
**Nice to Have**
  

  
* AWS – 2+ years: Working knowledge of AWS. Experience with another major cloud provider, such as Azure or GCP, combined with a willingness to learn AWS, is also acceptable
  
* Unity / Unreal / 3D Game Engines – 1–2 years: Basic familiarity with Unity, Unreal or other 3D game engines. Alternatively, an understanding of 3D vector mathematics, mesh geometry, rendering and shaders is valuable, even without direct game engine experience
  
* AI / Machine Learning – 1+ years: Basic familiarity with AI/ML concepts, including integrating code with large language models (LLMs) or ML-based optimisation. Python experience combined with strong applied mathematics knowledge, or a demonstrated interest in AI through side projects, is also acceptable

title: Senior Student Counsellor – Overseas Education
description:
**MAIN DUTIES (UK, Europe , Australia and New Zealand )**

Ø **ENQUIRIES**

· Turn Around time of new enquiries (within 24 hours)

· Mapping of new enquiries is correct for intake and country and ensuring clarity of remarks for all prospects (by all student counselors)

· Strong follow ups for generating walk-ins (University Visits/ General / Fairs)

· Ensure that a minimum number of calls in the “Spoken To” Category are made on a daily basis by all Student counselors.

· Make sure the respective enquiries are transferred to internally to country specialists. Also make sure the respective enquiries are transferred ethically and honesty to the geographically closest branch.

Ø **WALK-INS**

· Keeping a tab of every single walk-in student.

· Ensuring clarity of remarks for all prospects

· Create a welcoming environment and maintain a hospitable interaction with all walk-ins.

· Ensure walk-in are aggressively tapped and converted to applicants by various strategies such as University visits, fairs, coaching, general.

· Monitor repeat walk-in’s and identify operational issues as to why prospect is not converting i.e. student counselor performance / training and development / prospect profile.

· Ensure promotion of fee generation activities such as English coaching classes.

· Ensure EACH and EVERY student is provided the tablet / form to complete the Walk-in Questionnaire/Survey.

· Every first time walk-in prospect should be provided GO marketing materials

· Every walk-in should be informed of all upcoming university visits (where applicable)

· Ensure all SC’s are dealt on time

Ø **APPLICATIONS**

· Monitor, guide and check students while filling up the applications forms.

· Monitor response time for applications that are incomplete / pending / more docs to be resolved within 72 hours.

· Closely monitor that all prospects have an offer letter from GO and ensure that each and every applicant should have 2 offers from GO (even for alternate countries if appropriate). GO Policy is that Prospects must not have all offers with rejections/more docs and should have other options.

· Obtain AL for prospects with competitor after converting to “With GO”

· Offer awaited students should be called every week and reassured that pending offers are being chased, rigorously.

· Keep a close tab on students who are on conditional offers and have given a stipulated date to submit documents to convert from conditional to unconditional.

· Rigorously chase up applicants for deposits at the appropriate time.

· Invite prospects to University visits with the aim of having them converted after meeting the delegates.

· Keep abreast of applicant shortfall for the week and ensure they are not accumulated over a period of time.

· To ensure applicants in not applied, save & post later are dealt within 72 hours

· Encourage early applications for future intakes

Ø **DEPOSITS**

· Ensure all Expected Deposit students are correctly mapped on CRM.

· Students are chased on the given date for deposits

· Constantly monitor deposit shortfall so that targets are met.

· Ensure visa updates are correctly updated on CRM.

· Keep a close tab on Visa not applied prospects so that they apply before deadlines.

· Ensure that incomplete documents are provided to generate the CAS/COE.

· University Visits/GO Fairs/general appointments

· Ensure all appointments on CRM are reconfirmed on the day of visit. In case of no show appropriately change status on CRM (re-fix or cancel)

· Post visit/fair activities to ensure all student applications are processed & ensure high conversions.

Ø **VISAS**

· Provide students visa check lists and guide them to prepare the documents.

· Checking the visa files

· Preparing the students for the visa interview.

Ø **GENERAL**

· Strong Customer Service focus ensuring that all visitors to Global Opportunities are treated in a Respectful and courteous manner.

· Ensure that daily follow-ups are completed on time.

· Ensure that students have paid the balance of their charges on time (as specified on the CRM).

· Core responsibility for conversions.

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹70,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Salesforce Administrator - Service & Experience Cloud
description:
**Join Our Team as a** **Salesforce Administrator - Service & Experience Cloud!**

Do you enjoy working with technology, solving problems, and helping others? We'd love to have you on our team!

We're looking for a **Salesforce Administrator** who is enthusiastic about day-to-day administration, configuration, and health of Service Cloud and Experience Cloud.

If you enjoy learning, collaborating, and making a difference, we'd love to hear from you!

**Come join us and grow together!**

**Apply today and start your journey with Direct Travel!**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Maintain the platform security and sharing model for internal and external users, including org-wide defaults, role hierarchy, sharing rules, sharing sets, and Experience Cloud external and guest user access, in line with Direct Travels security and compliance standards.
* Configure and maintain Service Cloud, including case record types, page layouts, Lightning record pages, queues, assignment and escalation rules, auto-response rules, Email-to-Case and Web-to-Case, entitlements and milestones, macros, and quick text.
* Configure and support Omni-Channel routing, presence statuses, Command Center, and the Service Console across email, phone, and chat channels, in partnership with Customer Support leadership.
* Administer Experience Cloud sites, including member and external user management, pages and components, navigation, branding, and publishing, with a focus on customer self-service and case deflection.
* Maintain the Salesforce Knowledge configuration, including article record types, data categories, approval processes, and visibility for agents and site users, so Customer Support can own and publish article content.
* Build and maintain declarative automation, primarily Flow, along with validation rules, and formula fields. Deliver configuration work from the backlog prioritized by the Service Cloud Product Owner, working with Business Analysts on requirements and acceptance criteria and partnering with developers as needed.
* Manage sandboxes, deployments, and releases including testing, supporting UAT, documenting changes, and following DT change management processes.
* Serve as the go-to resource for Salesforce admin requests and issues, triaging and resolving tickets and escalating to developers, integration owners, or Salesforce Support when needed.
* Monitor org health, including Security Health Check, system limits, data and file storage, licenses, installed AppExchange packages, and integration users, and review each Salesforce seasonal release for impacts and new features.
* Maintain admin documentation, including configuration decisions, user guides, and release notes, and support training and adoption for agents and internal users.

**Qualifications & Experience:**

* 3-5 years of hands-on Salesforce administration experience, including direct administration of Service Cloud and Experience Cloud in a production org.
* Bachelors degree in Information Systems, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* Salesforce Certified Administrator, Salesforce Certified Advanced Administrator, Platform App Builder, Service Cloud Consultant, and/or Experience Cloud Consultant.
* Strong command of the Salesforce security and sharing model, including profiles, permission sets, roles, sharing rules, and external user access for Experience Cloud.
* Hands-on experience configuring Service Cloud case management, queues and assignment rules, Email-to-Case, Omni-Channel, and the Service Console.
* Expert level ability to build and troubleshoot automation using Flow, validation rules, and formula fields.
* Experience configuring Salesforce Knowledge, entitlements and milestones, and chat or messaging channels.
* Experience implementing or supporting computer-telephony integration (CTI), Salesforce Voice, Service Cloud Voice, or other telephony platforms integrated with Salesforce, including voice, chat, and messaging channels.
* Familiarity with Einstein or Agentforce for Service features (e.g., reply recommendations, case classification, conversation insights).
* Experience with sandbox management, change sets or similar deployment tools, and disciplined release and change management practices.
* Strong troubleshooting skills, attention to detail, and written and verbal communication, with a service-oriented approach to supporting users and the judgment to know when to escalate.
* Experience with source driven development with GitHub and CI/CI pipelines using Gearset, Copado, or similar tooling.
* Familiarity with Data Cloud or other Salesforce data and AI products.
* Experience with configuring, supporting, and enhancing Sales Cloud capabilities, including lead management, opportunity management, account management, forecasting, and sales process automation.
* Experience working on an Agile team alongside a Product Owner and Business Analyst, using Jira or similar tools.
* Working understanding of Apex, Lightning Web Components, and integrations, enough to partner effectively with developers.
* Experience supporting a customer Salesforce org in a travel, hospitality, or similar service-based industry.

title: Technical Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
**Job Description for TA Lead – International Hiring**

**Company Description (
www.innefu.com
)**

Founded in 2010, Innefu is an AI Driven R&D company providing cutting edge Data Analytics and Information Security solutions. The company was started with a clear focus to carry out high Tech R&D which fuels innovation and leads to products which can capture the global market and be the cornerstone of the economy of the country.

With more than 100+ installations across Indian Subcontinent, Middle East and Southeast Asia, the company is today a de-facto leader in developing and deploying AI for National and cyber-Security.

The company with its own range of products serves a diverse client base including Defense and Intelligence organizations, Law Enforcement Agencies, Financial Intelligence Units, BFSI as well as top Fortune 500 companies.

Having worked with some of the most sensitive organizations, the company has a deep understanding of handling sensitive and critical installations. The company has a clear focus on developing state-of-the-art products oriented towards solving real world problems of our clients with exemplary support to ensure 100% customer satisfaction.

**Job Description:**

The Tech TA Lead will own the complete recruitment lifecycle for niche, international technical hiring — with a sharp focus on Robotics and adjacent deep-tech talent across global markets (US, UK, Germany, Japan, Korea, and other key geographies). This is a hands-on role for someone who understands the global robotics talent landscape and can personally source, engage, and close highly specialized engineering and research talent, while also building scalable sourcing strategy and market intelligence for the function

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own the complete hiring lifecycle for international technical roles — requisition intake, global sourcing strategy, screening, interview coordination, offer negotiation, and closure — with a primary focus on Robotics.
* Personally source and close critical, niche robotics and deep-tech positions, including:
* VLA (Vision-Language-Action) Research Scientist
* Multimodal AI Engineer
* Robotics Control Engineer
* Embedded Engineer / Embedded Architect
* Firmware Engineer
* Mechatronics Engineer
* and other emerging robotics/AI-adjacent specializations as they arise.
* Product Manager
* Engineering Manager
* Solution Architect
* Build and manage sourcing strategies tailored to each target geography (US, UK, Germany, Japan, Korea, etc.), accounting for local talent pools, compensation norms, visa/work-authorization pathways, and market-specific sourcing channels.
* Partner with hiring managers and technical leadership to translate complex, highly specialized role requirements into clear scorecards and search strategies.
* Build and maintain a strong global pipeline/network of passive robotics and deep-tech talent, including through direct headhunting, niche technical communities, conferences, and executive search partners where needed.
* Conduct market mapping and competitor intelligence (compensation benchmarks, talent availability, competitor hiring patterns) across each target country for robotics-specific roles.
* Track and report hiring funnel metrics (TAT, source mix, offer-to-join ratio, cost per hire, drop-off rate) specific to international/robotics requisitions.
* Manage cross-border offer structuring and negotiation, working closely with HR/legal/compliance teams on region-specific employment norms, relocation, and visa sponsorship where applicable.
* Standardize technical evaluation frameworks and interview scorecards for robotics and AI-adjacent roles across all target countries.
* Manage confidential and business-critical international hiring mandates directly with founders/CXO stakeholders.
* Own candidate experience end-to-end for international hires — from engagement through offer, documentation, and a smooth cross-border onboarding handoff.

**Must-Have Requirements**

* Must have 5-10 years of experience in International technical hiring
* Proven, hands-on experience closing international technical roles, with demonstrated success hiring for Robotics positions specifically across markets such as the US, UK, Germany, Japan, and Korea.
* Track record of closing niche and critical robotics/deep-tech mandates such as VLA Research Scientist, Multimodal AI Engineer, Robotics Control Engineer, Embedded Engineer/Architect, Firmware Engineer, and Mechatronics Engineer.
* Strong technical fluency in robotics, embedded systems, and AI/ML domains — able to independently evaluate technical talent and hold credible conversations with candidates and hiring managers.
* Experience navigating cross-border hiring complexities — visa sponsorship, relocation, regional compensation structures, and local labor market nuances.
* Strong global sourcing skills — LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, niche technical communities/forums, and direct headhunting for passive robotics talent.
* Strong stakeholder management, negotiation, and offer-closing skills at senior/specialist technical levels.

title: TAA-M-Assurance
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Assistant Manager - Relationship Manager - Talent Attraction and Acquisition**
We’re looking for an experienced Recruitment professional with 8+ years of experience in managing end to end recruitment- to attract and acquire top talent for all service lines across EY GDS (India), by deploying unique strategies to locate right Talent.
  
  
In EY GDS we value wellbeing, curiosity and agility as an individual. We create teams of inspiring, teaming and belonging. We care for our business, society and client. Our purpose is building a better working world. Does that resonate with you? We look forward to working with you.
  
  
**The opportunity**
You will act as a Recruitment Partner for Business Leaders and have opportunity to derive insights from data and turn ideas into action. You will propose and execute programs(s) in the areas of Employer Branding, Diversity & Inclusion, Tools and Automation to ensure we achieve impactful results. We are committed to drive improvements for our business and our people, supportive of EY culture and as a result enhance customer experience.
  
  
Being a Partner in an Individual Contributor role, need to engage closely with Business Operations’ Managers and Hiring Managers to help hiring as per pre-defined hiring turnaround timelines of quality resources with effective stake-holder management skills by meeting standard compliance and risk guidelines.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Forecasting business requirement, planning for sourcing strategies to enable just-in-time and pro-active hiring.
* Drive informed, data driven decisions.
* Cultivating strong business relationships with frequent connects with stakeholders and potential candidates.
* Drive organisational best practices.
* Deliver projects for large scale hiring for cross-functional audiences.
* Responsible for operational speed to procure offers selection, conduct best in class offer negotiation, offer roll-out and effective post-offer acceptance management.
* Ensure all positions are closed on time and within the budgeted cost.
* Responsible for tracking and measuring hiring metrics.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Manage stakeholders including senior leaders and build strong relationships.
* Strong verbal and written business communication, active listening and interpretation skills
* Strong influencing abilities
* Ability to communicate complex information in an approachable manner.
* Strong business acumen and commercial awareness, ability to develop clear, actionable plans in support of an overall business unit strategy.
* Strong client focus with the ability to build good relationships with multiple stakeholders across the organisation at all levels
* Exposure to professional services hiring and proven skill of large volume hiring.
* Develop strong relationship with other Talent teams.
* Ability to work with ambiguity and build consensus across diverse, often global, groups.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent work experience
* 8+ years of proven recruitment experience, managing large scale and complex hiring
* Should have experience working on various HR applications including Applicant Tracking System
* Experience in developing hiring strategy for competencies based on the forecast and propose achievable plan
* Strong analytical skills, ability in creating and maintaining dashboards needed for stakeholder management.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong industry outlook
* Approach to learn and adapt quickly to global recruiting trends
* A keen sense to identify key business priorities, delivery models, solutioning, driving timely performance

**What You Can Look For**

* Be an enabler of high-performance recruitment team.
* Keen interest to invest time for self-learning, seeking opportunities to work on cross-functional HR projects
* Vision and capability to understand industry trends and build talent landscape to meet the hiring needs

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Coordinate interview schedules between candidates and hiring managers.

Stay updated on current technology trends and the IT talent market.

Strong understanding of technical roles and IT skill sets & proactive client coordination.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Strong sourcing, screening, and candidate engagement abilities.

Good negotiation and relationship management skills.

Ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and recruitment tools/ATS.

Experience working with recruitment agencies or corporate IT hiring teams is preferred.

Immediate joiners will be given preference.

**Eligibility**

Experience: 2 – 4 Years in IT Recruitment.

Must have worked exclusively on technical hiring
& proactive client coordination

Excellent communication skills are mandatory.

Strong sourcing experience using LinkedIn, Naukri, and other recruitment platforms.

description:
**Role Title:**
Assistant Manager - Talent Acquisition (NCR & East)
  
  
**Purpose of Role:**
To own and deliver regional frontline hiring, internal recruitment and onboarding readiness across existing and upcoming stores, ensuring full-time employee availability for business operations. The role builds proactive store role pipelines, enables timely and quality hiring through internal and external channels, and ensures selected colleagues experience structured onboarding, induction and introduction trainings.
  
  
**Reporting to:**
General Manager - Talent Management
  
  
**Key Accountabilities, Responsibilities, And Measures**
**Securing Colleague Availability & Store Hiring Governance**

* Own regional hiring execution to ensure existing and upcoming stores have the right colleagues in roles as per approved budget. Partner with Regional Managers, Store Managers and HRBPs to understand and act on vacancies, attrition trends, new store needs and peak trading requirements.
* Build proactive region/store role pipelines through referrals, walk-ins, local sourcing, campuses, job portals, vendors and social channels.
* Plan hiring ahead of business needs including new store openings, EOSS, festive periods, high-footfall trading periods and seasonal peaks.
* Track open positions, vacancy ageing, FTE gaps, offer status, joining risks and store-wise hiring plans to ensure strong regional visibility and timely action.

**Candidate Sourcing, Assessment & Selection**

* Ensure internal/external candidates have visibility of opportunities and a transparent application experience. Screen candidates and implement simple, fair and timely selection processes for all regional/store roles for external and internal candidates.
* Run hiring drives, campus recruitment, walk-ins and assessment centres with hiring managers and regional stakeholders.
* Partner with Regional People Partners, Regional/Store Managers to identify internal candidates for business-critical vacancies.
* Track internal applications, shortlisting, selection status, movements, declines and feedback to improve internal mobility.
* Manage all offers, negotiations, documentation, appointment letters and joining formalities as per process.

**Onboarding, Induction & Mandatory Learning Governance**

* Own candidate-to-colleague transition through joining communication, store introduction, buddy/coach support and induction training, including mandatory trainings.
* Move onboarding from a checklist-led process to a structured store-readiness experience in partnership with Store Managers, Store Coaches, People Partner and Operations teams.
* Conduct introduction training and plan role-based onboarding for colleagues new to the company and/or role.
* Own tracking and follow-through of mandatory training completion for new and existing colleagues in the region, including escalation of overdue learning and regular reporting to stakeholders.

**Ways of Working, Governance & Effectiveness**

* Maintain pipeline trackers, FTE gap reports, joining trackers, onboarding completion reports and mandatory training dashboards.
* Use data to identify hiring risks, repeated vacancy patterns, offer/joining drop-offs, early attrition risks, onboarding delays and training non-completion.
* Drive regular regional governance reviews with stakeholders to review manpower fulfilment, hiring pipeline, onboarding readiness, mandatory training completion and upcoming store/seasonal requirements.
* Manage recruitment vendors and hiring channels with a focus on quality, responsiveness, process compliance and value-for-money delivery.

**Key Skills**

* Ability to deliver high-volume store hiring and maintain proactive pipelines for CSA and frontline roles.
* Active listening skills to understand requirements, ask follow-up questions and remain objective and factual.
* Analytical skills and detailed planning using tools such as Gantt charts, with strong follow-up capabilities.
* Clear and engaging communication skills.
* Ability to provide factual information, advocate and advise hiring managers to make the right selection decisions.
* Ability to drive onboarding, induction and mandatory learning completion through disciplined follow-up.
* Accuracy in maintaining dashboards for vacancies, pipeline, joining, IJP, induction and mandatory training completion.
* Strong stakeholder partnership with Regional Managers, Store Managers, HRBPs, People Operations, Learning teams and vendors.

**Qualifications And Experience**
**Qualification:**

* Graduation in HR, Business Management or a related discipline; Post Graduation / HR certification will be an advantage.

**Experience:**

* 5-7 years of experience in Talent Acquisition, recruitment operations, HR operations and/or frontline hiring, preferably in retail, hospitality, consumer services or another high-volume, multi-location environment.
* Experience in volume hiring for store/frontline roles, especially customer-facing roles.
* Experience in screening, assessment coordination, offer management, joining formalities and recruitment dashboards.
* Experience in onboarding, induction, joining readiness or mandatory training completion will be an advantage.
* Strong working knowledge of MS Office, Excel trackers, ATS/integrated recruitment systems and HR dashboards.

title: AI Solutions Architect
description:
**ABOUT BLOOM AI**

Bloom AI is an applied AI firm building AI-native intelligence systems and workflows for enterprise teams across research, marketing, sales and other knowledge-intensive functions.

We combine enterprise data, external intelligence, AI and software engineering to help organizations turn information into intelligence and action.

Our approach combines reusable AI capabilities with hands-on solution development in real enterprise environments. We work closely with business teams to rethink workflows, design intelligent systems and deploy solutions that deliver measurable outcomes.

Bloom AI is based in the U.S. and India (Delhi/NCR).

**THE ROLE**

We are looking for a
**hands-on AI Solutions Architect**
who can design, build and deploy enterprise-grade AI applications and agentic systems.

This role sits at the intersection of
**AI architecture, data engineering and software development**
.

You may come from a backend engineering, data engineering or data science background, but you should have evolved into building end-to-end AI solutions.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have worked on
**multiple AI/LLM projects**
, solved different types of problems and gained practical experience making architectural decisions across agent orchestration, data, context management, application development and deployment.

You should be equally comfortable designing a solution architecture, evaluating technology choices, writing code, integrating data sources and taking a working solution into production.

This is
**not a traditional software engineering role, a prompt-engineering role or a PowerPoint-only architecture role**

You will work across client engagements, reusable Bloom AI capabilities and internal technology development, taking ownership of solutions from architecture through production deployment.

**Solve enterprise client problems**

* Evaluate technical approaches, collaborate with stakeholders and develop reusable capabilities for Bloom AI.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* **4–7 years of professional experience**
  , with a foundation in
  **backend engineering, data engineering, data science or related technical disciplines**
  .
* **Hands-on experience across multiple AI/LLM application projects**
  , preferably involving different use cases, data environments or architectural approaches.

* Strong proficiency in
  **Python**
  , with solid software engineering and API development skills.
* Practical experience building
  **agentic applications or multi-agent systems**
  , beyond basic chatbots and prompt-based applications.

* Strong independent problem-solving skills, curiosity and comfort working with ambiguous requirements.

**Above all, we are looking for someone who has built several AI solutions, understands the architectural decisions behind them and can independently design and implement new ones.**

title: Data Modeler
description:
**About the Company**

The postholder will work as part of the CDAO based in Staines or Salford, collaborating with Data Engineers, Developers, and other Data Modellers. The role supports the Snowflake Data Platform and contributes to the delivery of enterprise data products and capabilities under the direction of the Senior Data Warehouse Development Manager (Modelling).

**About the Role**

The postholder will work mainly in one of our offices and not be required to undertake heavy lifting or manual work. Travel can be required to other office or customer/supplier sites should there be sufficient business justification.

**Responsibilities**

* Accountabilities and Activities
* Build and maintain end-to-end ELT pipelines using scalable, metadata-driven frameworks and patterns.
* Develop high-quality Data Vault 2.0 models (Hubs, Links, Satellites), demonstrating strong understanding of modelling principles and standards.
* Design and implement dimensional models (star schemas, marts) to support efficient analytics and reporting use cases.
* Investigate and resolve SQL performance issues.
* Support Circular Data Architecture ensuring reuse and optimisation.
* Build and enhance the Circular Data Architecture product features.
* Create data marts and data products for analytics consumption.
* Resolve data issues through to source for internal customers.
* Maintain documentation and metadata using tools such as Ellie.ai.
* Contribute to quality assurance, testing and reviews.
* Proactively identify and manage risks and issues.

**Required Skills**

* Tools & Technologies
* Snowflake
* Snowflake Cortex
* VS Code
* Azure DevOps (ADO Git)
* Ellie.ai
* Streamlit

* The postholder will be skilled to the following indicative SFIA competencies and levels:
* Data Modelling and Design (DTAN – Level 4): Investigates data requirements and applies appropriate data modelling techniques, including Data Vault 2.0 and dimensional modelling, to design and maintain scalable and reusable data structures. Provides guidance to others on the use and interpretation of models within the Snowflake platform.
* Database Design (DBDS – Level 4): Applies database design principles to develop and maintain efficient, scalable structures within Snowflake. Evaluates design options and implements physical and logical models to support analytics, reporting, and data product consumption.
* Data Engineering (DENG – Level 4): Designs, builds and maintains reliable and scalable ELT pipelines using modern, cloud-native approaches. Applies metadata-driven and automated techniques to support efficient data processing and platform optimisation.
* Testing (TEST – Level 3): Designs and executes test cases for data pipelines and models. Ensures outputs meet defined requirements and quality standards, identifying and reporting defects and risks.
* Release and Deployment (RELM – Level 4): Supports and executes release and deployment activities using structured processes and ADO Git-based CI/CD pipelines. Ensures repeatable, reliable, and controlled promotion of changes across environments.
* Application Support (ASUP – Level 3): Investigates, diagnoses, and resolves data platform issues. Works within agreed processes to maintain service levels and ensure continuity of data services.
* Security Administration (SCAD – Level 3): Supports implementation and maintenance of data security controls within Snowflake, including access management and adherence to data governance policies.
* Emerging Technology Monitoring (EMRG – Level 3/4): Maintains awareness of emerging capabilities such as Snowflake Cortex, AI-assisted development, and Circular Data Architecture, applying them where appropriate to improve data platform capabilities.

**Qualifications**

* Qualifications, Training and Experience
* At least 3/4 years experience in enterprise data modelling and data platform development.
* Proven hands-on experience with Data Vault 2.0, including:
* Designing Hubs, Links, and Satellites
* Applying business keys and hashing approaches

title: Associate Director - Agentic AI Implementation & Process Automation
description:
**About Sirius AI**

Sirius AI is an AI consulting and solutions firm working with financial services clients, including banks, fintechs, payments companies and wealth managers. Our teams design, build and run GenAI, agentic AI and ML solutions inside client environments, working alongside their operations, technology and risk teams.

**About the Role**

We are hiring an Associate Director to lead agentic AI and process automation work for our US financial services clients. The role combines solution architecture and delivery leadership. You will design the solution, stay close to the build, and be accountable for getting it into production and keeping it running there.

Most of our work is in operations-heavy processes such as onboarding, KYC/AML, lending, payments operations, claims and servicing, at large organisations with strict security, audit and model risk requirements. You will lead a team of AI engineers, automation developers and business analysts, several of whom are early in their careers.

This is a hands-on role. We expect you to have built and deployed agentic systems yourself and to be comfortable reviewing code, agent traces and architecture decisions with your team.

**What You Will Do**

* Own the solution architecture for agentic automation engagements: agent design, orchestration, tool and MCP server design, integration with client systems, identity and access, and deployment topology.
* Lead delivery from process discovery through build, testing, go-live and hypercare. Fix the process before automating it, and decide which steps need an agent, which are better handled by rules, APIs or RPA, and which should stay with a person.
* Design multi-agent systems, including how agents delegate and hand off work (for example over A2A), how they reach tools and data (for example through MCP), and how state, memory, retries and failures are handled.
* Build and maintain the harness around each solution: evaluation datasets, regression tests, tracing, guardrails, and cost and latency monitoring, so that changes to prompts, models or tools are tested before they reach production.
* Implement role-based access control for agents and MCP tools. Define what each agent is allowed to call, on whose behalf and with what data scope, and align this with the client’s IAM, secrets management and audit logging.
* Deploy agentic solutions in large enterprise environments, which means working through security reviews, architecture boards, model risk validation, change management and integration with existing platforms.
* Set accuracy expectations with clients early. Agree what acceptable performance looks like for each use case, how errors and hallucinations will be measured, and where human review will stay in place, then report against those numbers openly throughout the engagement.
* Design solutions to be modular and reusable. Build up a shared library of agent templates, MCP servers for common FS systems, evaluation datasets and deployment patterns that shorten delivery on the next engagement.
* Lead and coach the delivery team, run design and code reviews, and help junior engineers build practical skills in agentic development.
* Act as the senior technical lead with client stakeholders and support pre-sales with solution design, estimates and staffing plans.

**What You Need**

* 8+ years in software engineering, automation or AI delivery, including at least 2 years building and running LLM-based agentic solutions.
* Hands-on delivery of at least two agentic process automation solutions that went into production at an enterprise client. You should be able to walk us through the architecture, what went wrong and how you measured results.
* A strong engineering background. You should be comfortable writing Python, reviewing pull requests and debugging agent behaviour from traces and logs.
* Working experience with one or more agent frameworks (such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen/Microsoft Agent Framework, Semantic Kernel, OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK or Claude Agent SDK) and a considered view on their trade-offs.
* Practical understanding of MCP (building and securing MCP servers, tool design, authentication) and A2A (agent discovery and task delegation), and when each is the right fit.
* Experience building evaluation and testing harnesses for LLM and agent systems, including golden datasets, LLM-as-judge with human calibration, regression testing and production monitoring.
* Experience implementing access control for agents and tools, such as OAuth/OIDC, service identities, scoped tokens, least-privilege tool access, user delegation and audit trails.
* Experience deploying on Azure, AWS or GCP using containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD and secrets management, within enterprise network, data residency and security constraints.
* Solution architecture experience across integration patterns, including APIs, event-driven systems and RPA where no API exists.
* The ability to explain agent behaviour, failure modes and residual risk to business, technology and risk audiences without overselling what the technology can do.
* A bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering or a related field.

**Good to Have**

* Delivery experience in banking, payments, lending, insurance or wealth management operations.
* Experience with RPA and BPM platforms such as UiPath, Power Automate, Pega, Camunda or ServiceNow.
* Experience with agent observability tools such as LangSmith, Langfuse or Arize.
* Familiarity with model risk management (for example SR 11-7) and AI regulation such as the EU AI Act.
* Experience with intelligent document processing.
* Cloud or architecture certifications.

title: Associate Director - AI Foundation Model Delivery
description:
**About Sirius AI**

Sirius AI is an AI-first consulting and solutions firm serving financial services clients: banks, fintechs, payments companies and wealth managers. We help enterprises move from AI ideas to production-ready solutions using GenAI, agentic AI, ML platforms and advanced analytics, delivering measurable business impact. Our strength lies in combining FS domain expertise, hands-on AI delivery and enterprise-grade execution.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an
**Associate Director – AI Foundation Model Delivery**
to lead the delivery of foundation-model-based solutions for our financial services clients in the US. You will own how transformers-based models are selected, adapted, evaluated, deployed and governed in production, on time, on budget and to regulated-industry standards.

This role sits at the intersection of applied research and enterprise delivery. You should be equally comfortable reviewing a fine-tuning experiment, debating model choice and inference cost with a client architect, and walking a model risk team through an evaluation pack. You will lead a team of AI and ML engineers, many of them early in their careers, and set the technical bar for how Sirius AI works with foundation models.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end delivery of foundation model programs, from use-case framing and model selection through data preparation, adaptation, evaluation, deployment and ongoing monitoring.
* Lead model selection and build-vs-buy decisions across commercial and open-weight models, balancing accuracy, latency, cost, data residency and regulatory constraints.
* Direct model adaptation work including prompt engineering, RAG, supervised fine-tuning, parameter-efficient methods (LoRA/PEFT), instruction tuning and preference optimisation (e.g. DPO, RLHF).
* Oversee training and fine-tuning data pipelines: sourcing, curation, labelling, synthetic data generation, quality assurance and lineage, with strict handling of sensitive FS data.
* Build rigorous evaluation frameworks that combine automated benchmarks, domain-specific test sets, human review, hallucination and bias testing, safety and red-team evaluations.
* Take models into production with sound AIOps: versioning, reproducibility, deployment pipelines, inference optimisation (quantisation, distillation, batching, caching) and cost controls.
* Ensure every model meets enterprise AI governance, model risk management, security and privacy requirements, with audit-ready model documentation and validation evidence.
* Own delivery economics for foundation model work, including scope, estimates, GPU and compute budgets, staffing plans, utilisation and margin.
* Lead, mentor and grow a team of AI/ML engineers and data scientists; build training paths in foundation model techniques and FS domain knowledge.
* Build reusable assets such as fine-tuning recipes, evaluation harnesses, model cards and reference architectures that speed up delivery across engagements.
* Act as senior technical lead with client stakeholders and support pre-sales with solution design, model strategy, estimation and staffing plans.

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics or a related field; a PhD is a plus.
* 8+ years of experience in AI/ML, data science or ML engineering, including at least 3–4 years working hands-on with LLMs or other foundation models.
* A proven track record of delivering foundation-model-based solutions into production in enterprise environments, with specific examples of fine-tuning, evaluation and deployment.
* Deep technical knowledge of transformer architectures, fine-tuning and alignment methods, RAG, model evaluation and inference optimisation.
* Strong Python skills and hands-on experience with frameworks such as PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, PEFT, vLLM/TGI and distributed training (e.g. CUDF, DASK, DeepSpeed, FSDP).
* Experience with cloud AI and GPU platforms (AWS SageMaker/Bedrock, Azure ML/Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, Databricks) and AIOps tooling.
* Experience leading technical delivery teams in a consulting, AI services or product engineering environment, including developing junior talent.
* Ability to translate model trade-offs, risks and evaluation results into clear business and risk language for senior stakeholders.

**Good to Have**

* Delivery experience with financial services clients in areas such as risk, fraud, compliance, credit, customer servicing or research.
* Familiarity with model risk management, model validation practices and responsible AI frameworks.
* Experience with multimodal models, document understanding, speech or small language models for on-premise deployment.
* Exposure to agentic AI, LLM orchestration and tool-use patterns built on top of foundation models.
* Publications, open-source contributions or conference talks in LLMs, Foundation Model or applied ML.

**Responsibilities**

* Retrieve or receive survey and transactional data from approved source systems and internal repositories.

* Clean, structure, and reconcile Excel-based source files to produce reliable reporting datasets.

* Build and validate match keys using defined combinations of fields, such as course number or course code with student email or username.

* Check for duplicate records, missing values, inconsistent labels, unmatched records, and conflicting source information.

* Document mapping rules, assumptions, exceptions, and unresolved data-quality issues.

* Prepare and distribute weekly metrics reports, periodic monthly outputs, and supporting raw-data files according to the agreed reporting calendar.
* Maintain consistent report structures, file naming, version references, and reporting-period definitions.

* Support ad hoc data requests by clarifying the required fields, reporting scope, output format, and delivery timeline.
* Investigate discrepancies between source data and reporting outputs and coordinate corrections with the relevant owners.
* Maintain clear records of reporting dependencies and escalate delays or incomplete inputs.

* Work closely with the manager, survey/program owners, Voice of Customer (VOC) Quality Team, source-system owners, and reporting/dashboard stakeholders.
* Clarify request requirements before undertaking data preparation or reporting activities.
* Share approved survey specifications, labelled exports, and reference materials through authorized internal channels.
* Coordinate with source owners when historical files, specifications, or required data are unavailable.
* Provide concise status updates covering progress, dependencies, assumptions, exceptions, and open issues.

Escalate access gaps, source conflicts, missing approvals, and unresolved data-quality concerns promptly.

Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. title: AI Solutions Architect
description:
**ABOUT BLOOM AI**

Bloom AI is an applied AI firm building AI-native intelligence systems and workflows for enterprise teams across research, marketing, sales and other knowledge-intensive functions.

We combine enterprise data, external intelligence, AI and software engineering to help organizations turn information into intelligence and action.

Our approach combines reusable AI capabilities with hands-on solution development in real enterprise environments. We work closely with business teams to rethink workflows, design intelligent systems and deploy solutions that deliver measurable outcomes.

Bloom AI is based in the U.S. and India (Delhi/NCR).

**THE ROLE**

We are looking for a
**hands-on AI Solutions Architect**
who can design, build and deploy enterprise-grade AI applications and agentic systems.

This role sits at the intersection of
**AI architecture, data engineering and software development**
.

You may come from a backend engineering, data engineering or data science background, but you should have evolved into building end-to-end AI solutions.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have worked on
**multiple AI/LLM projects**
, solved different types of problems and gained practical experience making architectural decisions across agent orchestration, data, context management, application development and deployment.

You should be equally comfortable designing a solution architecture, evaluating technology choices, writing code, integrating data sources and taking a working solution into production.

This is
**not a traditional software engineering role, a prompt-engineering role or a PowerPoint-only architecture role**
. We need someone who understands how AI systems work end-to-end and can personally build what they design.

You will work across client engagements, reusable Bloom AI capabilities and internal technology development, taking ownership of solutions from architecture through production deployment.

You will be part of the core team, reporting directly to the CEO.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

Leading a small team, you will:

**Architect Bloom AI Capabilities and Client Solutions**

* Design end-to-end AI solutions combining LLMs, agents, enterprise data, APIs and applications.
* Mak architectural decisions around agent orchestration, context, memory, workflows and technology choices.
* Build modular, reusable solutions that work across different cloud and enterprise environments.

**Build agentic applications**

* Develop multi-agent systems, agentic workflows and LLM-powered applications using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain or similar.
* Implement tool calling, RAG, semantic search, agent memory and state management.
* Build evaluation, monitoring and reliability mechanisms for production AI systems.

**Engineer data and context systems**

* Integrate structured and unstructured enterprise data into AI applications.
* Design retrieval and context architectures using relational, vector and graph databases.
* Build knowledge retrieval, entity relationships and persistent context capabilities.

**Develop and deploy end to end systems**

* Build backend services and APIs using Python, FastAPI or similar technologies.
* Develop functional frontend applications and integrate with enterprise systems.
* Deploy secure, scalable applications across cloud platforms using modern engineering practices.

**Solve enterprise client problems**

* Translate business challenges into practical AI architectures and working solutions.
* Work across multiple client projects, from solution design and prototyping through deployment.
* Evaluate technical approaches, collaborate with stakeholders and develop reusable capabilities for Bloom AI.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* **4–7 years of professional experience**
  , with a foundation in
  **backend engineering, data engineering, data science or related technical disciplines**
  .
* **Hands-on experience across multiple AI/LLM application projects**
  , preferably involving different use cases, data environments or architectural approaches.
* Demonstrated ability to take ownership of solution architecture and technical implementation, rather than contributing to only one component of a system.
* Strong proficiency in
  **Python**
  , with solid software engineering and API development skills.
* Practical experience building
  **agentic applications or multi-agent systems**
  , beyond basic chatbots and prompt-based applications.
* Experience with agent orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen or similar.
* Strong understanding of LLM APIs, tool calling, RAG, embeddings, vector databases and context management.
* Strong understanding of data modeling, SQL, databases, data integration and retrieval architectures.
* Working knowledge of full-stack application development, including modern frontend frameworks such as React or Next.js.
* Familiarity with graph data structures, entity relationships and graph-based retrieval concepts.
* Experience taking AI applications from prototype through testing, integration and production deployment.
* Experience with at least one major cloud platform and familiarity with Docker, Git, CI/CD and modern engineering practices.
* Ability to evaluate different technical approaches and make sound architectural trade-offs.
* Strong independent problem-solving skills, curiosity and comfort working with ambiguous requirements.
* Lead R&D efforts for Bloom AI

**Above all, we are looking for someone who has built several AI solutions, understands the architectural decisions behind them and can independently design and implement new ones.**

**GOOD TO HAVE**

* Startup or
  **0-to-1 product development experience**
  .
* Experience working on enterprise AI projects across different business functions or client environments.
* Experience integrating with
  **marketing, sales or commercial systems**
  , such as CRM, marketing automation, campaign platforms, content management systems or sales enablement tools.
* Experience working directly with enterprise clients and translating business requirements into technical solutions.
* Experience building AI applications for financial services, research or other knowledge-intensive domains.

title: Data Modeler
description:

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to communicate modelling approaches clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience of full development lifecycle and modern delivery approaches.
* Ability to manage workload effectively in a dynamic environment.

**Preferred Skills**

* Autonomy: Works under general direction. Uses discretion in identifying and responding to issues and assignments within the Snowflake data platform. Determines when issues should be escalated.
* Influence: Interacts with and influences colleagues within the CDAO and engages with business stakeholders where required. Contributes ideas and supports the adoption of modern data practices including Data Vault and Circular Data Architecture.
* Complexity: Performs a range of work, sometimes complex and non-routine, including data modelling, pipeline development, Streamlit application development, and performance optimisation. Applies a structured and analytical approach to problem solving.
* Business Skills: Selects appropriately from applicable standards, methods, tools and applications from broader team pre-defined standards. Communicates fluently, orally and in writing, and can present information to both technical and non-technical audiences. Rapidly absorbs new information and applies it effectively. Develops awareness of technologies and their application and takes

title: Graphic Designer
description:
**Company Description**

Rajaganapathy Group of Companies is a semi-vertically integrated knitwear manufacturer in Tiruppur, India, established in 1996. The group began in offset printing and grew into full-scale garment manufacturing, fabric and collar knitting, and exports. With an annual capacity of over 2 million garments, we make men’s polos, T-shirts, women’s tops, kidswear, leggings, shorts and sleepwear for buyers in the USA, Canada, South Africa, Europe, Dubai and Australia. Our in-house offset printing division produces hangtags, wash care labels, size labels, stickers and other branding trims for our own garments and for export buyers.

**Role Description**

This is a full-time, on-site Graphic Designer – Offset Printing & Trims role in Tiruppur. You’ll prepare and manage artwork for hangtags, wash care labels, size labels, price tickets, barcode stickers and packaging, and set it up for offset printing.

**Day-to-day work includes:**

* Updating existing designs for each order: sizes, colours, style numbers, barcodes, care symbols, fibre content, country of origin and buyer-specific text.
* Creating new designs for hangtags, labels and packaging, following buyer brand guidelines.
* Preparing print-ready files: correct dimensions, bleed, die lines, Pantone/CMYK colours and fonts outlined.
* Pre-press setup: arranging multiple tags and labels on a sheet (imposition), colour separation, and sending final files to the outside plate maker, then checking plates when they come back.
* Checking proofs against the buyer’s approved artwork and PO details before printing, so there are no wrong sizes, barcodes or care instructions.
* Working closely with merchandisers and the printing team to meet production deadlines.
* Keeping an organised artwork library, by buyer and season, so repeat orders can be updated quickly.

**Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop and CorelDRAW.
* Knowledge of offset printing pre-press: imposition, colour separation, Pantone matching, and preparing files for outside plate makers.
* Experience with hangtags, wash care labels, stickers or packaging artwork.
* Understanding of barcodes (EAN/UPC) and care symbols used by export buyers.
* Strong attention to detail. One wrong size or barcode can hold up a whole shipment.
* Able to handle many small changes quickly and keep files well organised.
* Good communication with merchandising and print teams.
* A diploma or degree in Graphic Design, Printing Technology or a related field is preferred.
* Experience in an apparel export or label printing company is an advantage.

title: Finance Manager
description:
**Company Profile:**

Prevalent AI (PAI) is a Security Data Science Company, founded in the UK, by experts recognized globally, for solving the world’s toughest security problems. We apply the world’s best Security Data Science knowledge and expertise to help companies understand, deploy, and support the most advanced security solutions, by developing a security architecture based on a deep understanding of Data Science, Security Tradecraft and Big Data Technologies.

PAI’s Security Data Science (SDS) platform is a big data security analytics platform that can ingest wide range of security telemetry data and apply advanced analytical approaches to identify and detect control weakness and security risks within enterprises.

PAI team consists of Cyber Security Domain Specialists, Information Security Analysts, Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and Data Analysts focused on developing advanced security analytics solutions (Solution Development) and delivering security insights to our clients.

Prevalent AI India Pvt Ltd., a subsidiary of Prevalent AI, has office in Infopark, Cochin, Kerala.

For more information, please visit https://www.prevalent.ai

**About the role:**

As we continue to grow, we are looking for a Finance Manager to own the numbers for our global entities and run the finance operations underneath them. The role is based in our Kochi office full time, and reports to the Financial Controller in Bangalore within a finance team led by the CFO in London. Your working day needs a consistent overlap with UK hours, particularly through close.

The ideal candidate is a qualified accountant with hands-on experience of bookkeeping, balance sheet reconciliations and statutory compliance. You will deliver a P&L and balance sheet that are reconciled, explained and ready for the Financial Controller to sign off without rework, and keep filings on time, working closely with our external consultants.

The Finance Manager will run the month-end close up to trial balance, support the Financial Controller on consolidation, and own every balance sheet reconciliation for all group entities. You will be central to bringing accounting in house from external providers and to our move from Xero to a new AI-native ERP.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Accounting and Bookkeeping: Manage day-to-day accounting for the multi-entity group, ensuring the completeness and accuracy of the books. You will maintain clean books with strong audit records.
* Month-End Close: Own the close for all group entities up to a reviewed trial balance. Run the close calendar, chase inputs, post the required journals, and deliver to the Financial Controller on time.
* Balance Sheet Reconciliations: Prepare every reconciliation, every month — bank, receivables, payables, accruals, prepayments, deferred and accrued income, payroll control accounts, GST and VAT, fixed assets and intercompany — reconciled to source with reconciling items explained and cleared.
* Customer Billing, Collections and Revenue: Ensure timely and accurate customer billing through our finance systems. Publish a weekly ageing tracker for customer balances, follow up on collections, and resolve discrepancies. Help improve the overall customer billing experience. Maintain revenue schedules for multi-year contracts billed in multiple currencies, tying invoicing, deferred income and recognised revenue together.
* Accounts Payable and Expense Management: Manage end-to-end vendor invoice processing, from obtaining approvals and booking invoices in our finance systems to processing payments on time, and own supplier set-up and the expense-claims process.
* Payroll Processing: Collaborate with the external payroll consultant and the HR team to process payroll. Manage the payroll cycle proactively and adhere strictly to timelines.
* Audit: Build and maintain the audit files for all group entities and act as the auditors' first point of contact on the detail.
* Statutory Compliance: Work with our advisers and input into the preparation and filing of tax and regulatory returns, including GST, TDS, SEZ, VAT and other global requirements
* ERP, Automation and Finance Process Change: Act as a key user on our ERP implementation and use AI tools and agentic workflows to transform how Finance operates. Support the Financial Controller and CFO on finance process changes and ad hoc projects as required.

**Skills and Experience:**

* Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) with a Big 4 experience.
* 2 to 5+ years' post-qualification in-house finance experience, ideally closing the books of an Indian subsidiary for a UK or US parent, in a software, services or startup business.
* Sound understanding of Indian accounting standards (IGAAP) and financial statements, and a strong grounding in IFRS or UK GAAP.
* Experience owning or contributing to a multi-entity month-end close, and preparing a full set of balance sheet reconciliations and supporting schedules.
* Experience preparing audit files and working directly with auditors.
* Working knowledge of Global tax and statutory requirements.
* Strong attention to detail, with discipline around deadlines and follow-ups.
* Comfort with a modern finance technology stack and change, and hands-on use of AI tools in your own work today.
* A strong sense of ownership, urgency and accountability, and a willingness to learn.
* Clear written and spoken English and the confidence to deal directly with senior colleagues in global locations and to bring your own opinion.

title: Principal Engineer
description:
**Why this role exists**

Our engineering team is young. We have about 30 engineers, six new team leads and one senior

architect. The leads are good builders who have not led before. They need someone to learn from

every day.

AI agents now write a large share of our code. Design, review and judgement have become the

scarce skills. This role brings them.

**About Company**

We build customised holidays for Indian travellers. We have done this for over 12 years

from Chennai.

A traveller plans a trip with us, a seller helps them decide, and our team delivers it on the ground.

Technology runs through all of it: the website and app, the sales funnel, pricing and supply,

booking, and everything after booking.

**How tech is organised**

You report to Chief Architect. The six team leads look to you for every technical

call.

**The roles you will play**

1. Guide to the six leads. You review their designs and code, and you pair with them on the hard

problems. Every lead gets your time every week.

2. Keeper of standards. You set how we design APIs, test, release and code with AI agents.

Then you make sure it is followed.

3. Builder. You stay hands-on. Expect a good part of your week in code.

4. Chief Architect's partner on architecture. You work with him on data unification and on the API layer

that our website, partners and agents all use.

5. Owner of one critical system. In your first months you own one system end to end, most

likely payments.

6. Hiring bar. You interview engineers and decide who is good enough.

**What you will not do:**

• Manage people. Appraisals and staffing stay with the founder.

• Set AI direction. That sits with the AI head. You make sure agents call our systems safely.

Your first 90 days

• By day 30: you know the codebase, the six leads and where each team is stuck. You have

shipped one fix or feature yourself.

• By day 60: design reviews run every week with every lead. Our standards for APIs, tests and

releases are written down and in use.

• By day 90: one critical system is fully yours. Each lead can name one thing they do better

because of you.

**What we look for**

• 8 to 12 years of building software, full stack with most of it in backend.

• Our stack: Java and Spring Boot, MongoDB, React.

• Time spent on systems where a mistake costs money: booking, payments, fintech or

commerce.

• You code with AI agents every day, and you can show us how.

• The role is in Chennai.

The three skills that matter most:

1. Backend system design.

2. API and data modelling.

3. Code review and debugging across the stack.

The one quality: you enjoy making other engineers better. A teacher's patience matters more here

than being the best coder in the room.

The opportunity

• Six leads grow because of you. That is how we will measure this role.

• You shape how a team builds with AI agents. We are early, and the habits you set will stay.

• The problems are real. Live pricing and supply, bookings that cannot fail, voice AI in sales,

and post-booking work that runs without people.

**What is coming up:**

• One unified data layer across our systems.

• A Holidays API that banks and partners sell from.

• A new product for travellers outside India.

• A CTO decision. We have not hired one. We will decide once this structure settles, and

whoever does this role well is part of that conversation

title: Agentic AI Orchestrator
description:
**Job Summary**

The Agentic AI Orchestrator designs, builds, and operates the Investment Division's agentic AI workflows—the automated, multi-step processes through which AI agents read documents, reconcile data, draft analysis, and assemble reporting across the division's clusters. The role converts analyst workflows into orchestrated agent pipelines with human review gates, owns the division's prompt, skill, and agent library, and is accountable for the accuracy, auditability, and cost of every automated output.

The position anchors the division's AI-led operating model from the Chennai office, working alongside the Data Engineer (data pipelines and infrastructure) and the ML Engineer (models and evaluation), and serves as the bridge between the investment analysts and the division's AI tooling

**ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

1. Design, build, and operate agentic AI workflows for the division's recurring processes: document extraction and reconciliation, portfolio and company performance monitoring, report and IC pack assembly, and data-room processing.

2. Translate analyst and reporting workflows into orchestrated multi-agent pipelines with defined human review gates, so that no figure or recommendation is published without analyst sign-off.

3. Own the division's prompt, skill, agent, and plugin library: design, versioning, testing, and documentation, ensuring workflows are reusable across clusters rather than one-off chats.

4. Integrate agents with the division's systems and data sources — document repositories, custodian and administrator reporting, and the division's knowledge base — working with the Data Engineer on pipelines and access.

5. Build and run evaluation harnesses with the ML Engineer: accuracy benchmarks against verified ground truth, regression testing on workflow changes, and periodic audits of automated outputs.

6. Implement AI governance and guardrails: access controls and confidentiality boundaries for family and portfolio data, audit trails for every automated output, and compliance with the Group's AI usage policies.

7. Monitor agent performance, cost, latency, and failure modes; triage incidents, maintain runbooks, and drive continuous improvement of workflow reliability.

8. Train and support the division's analysts in AI-assisted working practices; capture their feedback and convert it into a prioritised automation backlog.

9. Maintain complete documentation of all orchestrated workflows, their data sources, model versions, and review controls, ensuring every automated output is reproducible and auditable.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Minimum Education Required**

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related quantitative field.

• Strong Python engineering skills: API integration, data handling, and production-quality code with testing and version control (Git).

• Hands-on experience building LLM-based and agentic systems in production: workflow orchestration, tool and function calling, and multi-agent patterns — using frameworks such as LangGraph or LangChain, or SDK-native orchestration (e.g. Claude Agent SDK). Framework experience matters less than sound orchestration design.

• Practical RAG experience: document chunking, embeddings, vector databases (e.g. pgvector, Pinecone, Qdrant, or similar), hybrid search, and retrieval evaluation.

• Experience building or integrating MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and tools, or equivalent connector architectures linking AI agents to enterprise systems and data sources.

• Familiarity with LLM evaluation and observability tooling (accuracy benchmarks, regression tests, tracing); disciplined prompt and skill engineering with versioning and documentation.

• Understanding of data privacy, access control, and audit requirements for confidential financial data; exposure to investment or financial reporting workflows preferred.

**Years of experience are required.**

• Minimum of 4 to 7 years of experience in software or AI engineering, of which at least 2 years hands-on with LLM-based or agentic systems in production, at a technology firm, financial institution, or data-driven enterprise.

title: Front-End Engineer - Trading Platform (India, Chennai)
description:
**About GoCharting**

GoCharting is a web-native charting and trading platform. Traders use professional orderflow tools — footprint charts, volume and market profile, cumulative delta, DOM trading — to read the market and place orders through their broker, all in the browser. Our users are active traders in India, the US and around the world.

**The Role**

You will build and ship features in GoCharting's web trading terminal, writing the code yourself from ticket to production. The role is full-time and in person in our Chennai office, and it reports to the Engineering Manager for Client Engineering. You will take well-scoped features and fixes raised by active traders and own them through review and release. At 12 months, you should be the engineer the team trusts with a feature area of the terminal, shipping steadily without close supervision.

**What you'll do**

* **Ship terminal features end to end**
  — build the feature in React and TypeScript, get it through code review and QA, and release it to traders
* **Fix defects reported by traders**
  — find the cause, fix it properly and add a test so it stays fixed
* **Keep the terminal fast**
  — profile slow screens, busy charts and long lists, and remove the cause of the slowdown
* **Work with product and design**
  — turn a written spec and a design into working UI, and raise gaps in the spec early
* **Write clear pull requests**
  — say what changed, why, and what could break
* **Learn the trading domain**
  — charts, market data and the trader's workflow, from the people who use them daily

**What we're looking for**

**Must-haves:**

* 3+ years building production web applications with React and TypeScript
* Has shipped features to production in a team codebase, through code review and a release process
* Hands-on experience with a client-side state-management library, such as Redux or an equivalent
* Has built or maintained a UI that updates in real time, for example with WebSockets, live lists or charts
* In person in our Chennai office, 5 days a week

**Nice-to-haves:**

* Charting, trading, market-data or broker-integration work (adds speed in learning our domain)
* Canvas, SVG or WebGL rendering (adds the ability to work on chart internals)
* Browser performance profiling of long-lived sessions (adds the ability to find slowdowns)
* Automated tests with Vitest, Jest or Playwright (adds confidence in every release)
* Work in a large monorepo (adds familiarity with shared packages and build tooling)

**Logistics**

**Location**
Chennai, India - in person, office-based

**Employment type**
Full-time

**Entity**
ProCharting Private Limited

**Reports to**
Engineering Manager, Client Engineering

**Start date**
ASAP

**Travel**
None
