* Estimate, prioritize, plan, and coordinate testing activities across multiple projects and sprints.
* Define and track quality metrics (defect density, test coverage, pass/fail rates) to measure and improve testing effectiveness.

**Manual Testing (Functional & Non-Functional)**

* Execute manual test cases to verify functionality, usability, and user experience across web, mobile, and desktop applications.
* Perform exploratory testing to identify edge cases, unexpected behaviors, and user experience friction points that scripted tests might miss.
* Conduct regression testing to ensure new features don't break existing functionality.
* Perform non-functional testing including usability, accessibility (WCAG), compatibility (cross-browser, cross-device), and security testing (OWASP basics).

**Automation Testing**

* Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts using industry-standard frameworks to increase testing efficiency and coverage.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) to enable continuous testing and rapid feedback.
* Identify and prioritize test cases suitable for automation to maximize ROI and reduce manual regression efforts.
* Maintain and refactor automation frameworks as the application evolves.

**API & Backend Testing**

* Validate RESTful APIs and GraphQL endpoints using tools like Postman, REST Assured, or SoapUI.
* Verify data integrity, error handling, response times, and authentication/authorization mechanisms.
* Test database interactions, including query validation and data consistency across different environments.

**Performance & Load Testing**

* Conduct performance, load, and stress testing to ensure applications can handle expected user traffic and scale under peak loads.
* Use tools like JMeter, LoadRunner, or K6 to simulate user loads and identify bottlenecks.
* Analyze performance metrics and work with developers to optimize response times, throughput, and resource utilization.

**Defect Management & Reporting**

* Identify, document, and track bugs using issue tracking systems (Jira, Bugzilla, Azure DevOps) with clear, reproducible steps and supporting evidence (logs, screenshots, videos).
* Collaborate closely with developers to prioritize, reproduce, and resolve defects in a timely manner.
* Communicate test progress, risks, and quality status to stakeholders through clear, concise test reports and dashboards.

**Collaboration & Agile Workflow**

* Work closely with Developers, Product Managers, and Designers throughout the software development lifecycle to ensure quality is built in from the start.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, daily stand-ups, retrospectives) and contribute to defining acceptance criteria for user stories.
* Act as the voice of the user, advocating for quality, usability, and accessibility in every product decision.
* Coordinate with SEO, Marketing, and UX teams to ensure that tracking codes, analytics, structured data, and UI/UX implementations are tested and validated.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Stay up-to-date with the latest QA tools, testing methodologies, and industry best practices.
* Proactively suggest improvements to testing processes, tools, and frameworks to increase efficiency and coverage.
* Contribute to the team's knowledge base, testing documentation, and onboarding materials for new QA team members.

**Qualifications & Skills**

**Required**

* **Experience:** 3–6 years of professional experience in software quality assurance, testing, or a related role.
* **Manual Testing:** Deep understanding of software testing principles, methodologies, and the complete SDLC/STLC.
* **Automation:** Hands-on experience with at least one automation framework:
* **Web:** Selenium WebDriver, Cypress, Playwright, or Puppeteer.
* **Mobile:** Appium, Detox, or XCUITest/Espresso.
* **API:** Postman (with Newman), REST Assured, or similar.
* **API Testing:** Strong experience testing RESTful APIs and GraphQL endpoints.
* **Defect Tracking:** Proficiency with issue tracking tools like Jira, Bugzilla, or Azure DevOps.
* **Version Control:** Basic understanding of Git for version control and collaboration.
* **SQL:** Ability to write and execute SQL queries for backend data validation.
* **Analytical Mindset:** Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills with meticulous attention to detail.
* **Communication:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills; ability to articulate complex technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred (Great to Haves)**

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* **CI/CD:** Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CircleCI).
* **Performance Testing:** Experience with load and performance testing tools (JMeter, K6, LoadRunner, Gatling).
* **Security Testing:** Understanding of OWASP Top 10 and experience with security testing tools (Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP).
* **SEO Technical Testing:** Experience validating JSON-LD structured data, meta tags, canonical tags, redirects, and ensuring JavaScript-rendered content is crawlable by search engine bots.
* **Accessibility Testing:** Familiarity with WCAG 2.1 AA guidelines and experience using accessibility testing tools (axe, WAVE, Lighthouse).
* **Mobile Testing:** Experience testing native and hybrid mobile applications on both iOS and Android platforms.
* **Programming Languages:** Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, Java, JavaScript, C#, etc.) for writing automation scripts.
* **Test Management:** Experience with test management tools (TestRail, Xray, Zephyr).
* **ISTQB Certification:** ISTQB Foundation Level or equivalent certification is a plus.

title: Application Testing Intern (Frontend and Backend, QA)
description:
**Tikko Desk · Quality · Hyderabad (preferred) · Hybrid**

**Internship for the first 5 months, then full-time · About 2 years’ experience (strong freshers and interns welcome)**

**Role at a glance**

* Position: Application Testing Engineer.
* Type: starts as a 5-month internship, then becomes a full-time role based on performance.
* Experience: about 2 years in software testing or QA. Strong freshers and interns with real testing projects are welcome to apply.
* Location: Hyderabad preferred, hybrid.
* Pay: the internship stipend and the full-time salary are discussed at the interview.

**About Tikko Desk**

Tikko Desk is an early-stage startup in Hyderabad. We build one product for IT and employee operations: Help Desk, Assets, Endpoints, Workforce onboarding and offboarding, and a Password manager, with an AI assistant called Tikky built in. You’ll be one of the first people focused on quality, and you’ll help shape how we test the product.

**What you’ll do**

* Test new features end to end, the way an IT admin or employee would use them: happy paths, edge cases, permissions, empty states and error handling.
* Do exploratory testing to find the bugs nobody wrote a test case for.
* Design test cases and keep a short regression checklist for each release.
* Test our APIs with Postman or similar tools: responses, status codes, validation and access control.
* Write and maintain automated tests for the web app and APIs (Playwright, Selenium or Cypress; pytest or similar).
* Use basic SQL to check that data was saved correctly.
* Write clear bug reports with steps to reproduce, screenshots or recordings, and expected vs actual results, then re-test the fixes.
* Check Tikky’s AI answers for wrong, unclear or unsafe replies.
* Help run tests in CI and sign off releases before they go live.

**What we’re looking for**

* About 2 years of hands-on software testing or QA, or an internship and projects that show the same skills.
* Strong manual and exploratory testing, with a good eye for detail.
* Solid test design: boundary values, negative cases, and turning requirements into test cases.
* A working understanding of web apps: the browser, dev tools, HTTP, REST APIs and JSON.
* Some automation experience with Playwright, Selenium or Cypress, and basic Python or JavaScript/TypeScript.
* SQL basics: SELECT, JOIN and filtering.
* Familiarity with Git and CI pipelines such as GitHub Actions.
* Curiosity, ownership, and clear written and spoken English.

**Nice to have**

* pytest, Postman collections or other API test frameworks.
* Performance, accessibility or basic security testing.
* Testing across browsers, or Windows and macOS desktop apps.
* Testing AI or chatbot features.
* Hands-on use of AI tools in your testing work, and the habit of checking their output yourself.

**What you get**

* Real testing work on a product in early development, with your findings going straight to production.
* Mentoring and review directly from the founder.
* A clear path: a 5-month internship, then a full-time role based on performance.
* A certificate of completion and a letter of recommendation for the internship.

**How to apply**

Apply on the careers page with your CV (PDF, up to 5 MB) and answer a few short questions. Every application is read, and shortlisted applicants get an email to book a 30-minute interview.

**Questions on the apply form:**

* Must-haves:
* Can you work hybrid from Hyderabad?
* Are you OK with a 5-month internship, then full-time?
* Years of QA experience
* Notice period
* A sample bug report
* Test cases for a “Create ticket” form
* Testing tools used (optional)

* Optimize dashboard performance, data visualization efficiency, and overall user experience across different reporting scenarios.
* Troubleshoot reporting issues, validate data accuracy, and ensure consistency between source systems and SAC applications.
* Support testing, user acceptance testing (UAT), technical documentation, deployment, and continuous improvement of reporting solutions.

* Proven experience developing SAC Stories, interactive dashboards, analytical applications, and reporting solutions.
* Solid understanding of SAC visualization capabilities, calculated measures, dimensions, filters, and input controls.
* Experience with SAC application scripting, JavaScript, and advanced interactive reporting functionalities.
* Strong knowledge of UI/UX design principles, dashboard usability, and data visualization best practices.
* Experience integrating SAC with SAP Datasphere, SAP S/4HANA, SAP BW/4HANA, or other enterprise data platforms.
* Understanding of analytical data modeling, reporting structures, KPIs, and business intelligence concepts.
* Experience optimizing SAC dashboard performance, troubleshooting technical issues, and ensuring reporting accuracy.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams and business stakeholders.

**Technology for today and tomorrow**

The Boeing India Engineering & Technology Center (BIETC) is a 5500+ engineering workforce that contributes to global aerospace growth. Our engineers deliver cutting-edge R&D, innovation, and high-quality engineering work in global markets, and leverage new-age technologies such as AI/ML, IIoT, Cloud, Model-Based Engineering, and Additive Manufacturing, shaping the future of aerospace.

**People-driven culture**

At Boeing, we believe creativity and innovation thrives when every employee is trusted, empowered, and has the flexibility to choose, grow, learn, and explore. We offer variable arrangements depending upon business and customer needs, and professional pursuits that offer greater flexibility in the way our people work. We also believe that collaboration, frequent team engagements, and face-to-face meetings bring together different perspectives and thoughts – enabling every voice to be heard and every perspective to be respected. No matter where or how our teammates work, we are committed to positively shaping people’s careers and being thoughtful about employee wellbeing.

With us, you can create and contribute to what matters most in your career, community, country, and world. Join us in powering the progress of global aerospace.

**Digital Services Overview**

At Boeing Digital Services, we focus on practical innovation that drives tangible results for the aerospace industry. Our team leverages advanced technology and data analytics to develop solutions that enhance operational efficiency and meet the needs of our customers. We are dedicated to creating intuitive, scalable, and secure solutions that empower our customers, partners, and team members to succeed. Join us in creating the future of aviation technology, where your contributions will shape impactful solutions for airlines around the globe.

**Position Overview**

We have an immediate opening for a **Software Application Development Manager** to lead multiple teams developing digital solutions in Application Engineering. This role requires deep engineering experience, the ability to guide teams, and the use of the latest AI tools to build cloud-native systems for cutting-edge digital aircraft maintenance products.

The role will work closely with peer managers, developers, engineering and greenfield leadership, data science, and architects to deliver product features and capabilities with AI/ML at the center. In this role, you will serve as a hands-on manager for development teams and ensure the delivery of reliable production software

This position will report to the Engineering leader of the **Boeing Global Services (BGS) Digital Services** group and work closely with stakeholders across the globe.

**Process Skills and Techniques**

* **Team Management:** The ability to foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment, encouraging open communication, knowledge sharing, and teamwork among team members.

•You take ownership of projects from development to release.

•You enjoy solving challenging technical problems.

Apply through Indeed with your updated resume.

description:

across

You will work closely with Tax, Information Technology, Finance and other cross-functional teams to understand business needs, translate them into functional and technical requirements, support system configuration and testing, and help sustain solutions after implementation. While the position requires a practical understanding of indirect tax compliance, its primary focus is technology, automation, data and continuous improvement.
  
  
You will work with a high degree of autonomy within established procedures, solve complex issues, recommend process improvements and may provide subject matter guidance or coordinate work across stakeholders.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and execute test scenarios and scripts, support user acceptance testing, document results and coordinate issue resolution.
* Provide post-go-live and operational support, including monitoring solution performance, troubleshooting issues, maintaining process documentation and supporting users.
* Support tax data management needs, including data quality, interfaces, reporting, warehousing, record retention and disclosure requirements.
* Develop dashboards, analytics and executive-ready reporting to provide visibility to process performance, risks, issues and improvement opportunities.
* Support the operation and enhancement of automated indirect tax compliance solutions while maintaining appropriate controls, data integrity and audit readiness.
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to define project needs, evaluate solution options and deliver sustainable improvements.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Tax, Information Systems, Technology, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* A minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in tax technology, tax process automation, systems implementation, business analysis or technology-enabled tax compliance.
* Experience working with SAP and tax, finance or compliance processes.
* Experience gathering and documenting business and functional requirements and supporting testing, deployment or post-go-live activities.
* Working knowledge of indirect tax concepts, including VAT or GST, with the ability to understand and translate tax requirements into technology solutions.
* Advanced English communication skills, both written and spoken.
* Ability to support stakeholders across EMEA, India and APAC and accommodate a flexible schedule when required for international collaboration, project milestones or compliance deadlines.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Thomson Reuters ONESOURCE solutions, particularly indirect tax determination or VAT compliance tools.
* Experience with Power BI, Power Query, Power Automate, Alteryx, RPA, Python, generative AI applications or similar automation and analytics tools.
* Experience with system configuration, integrations, data migration, tax data management or reporting solutions.
* Exposure to indirect tax compliance processes in EMEA, India or APAC.
* Experience supporting internal controls, SOX requirements, audit activities or controlled technology processes.
* Experience working in a global, cross-functional environment and with third-party technology providers.

**Skills And Capabilities**

* Tax and technology translation: connects compliance and business needs with practical system and automation solutions.
* Analytical problem solving: evaluates complex issues, identifies root causes and recommends sustainable solutions.
* Ownership and bias for action: works independently, manages competing priorities and follows issues through resolution.
* Communication and collaboration: explains technical and tax topics clearly and builds effective relationships across functions, regions and levels.
* Project and change management: organizes requirements, risks, testing, decisions and stakeholder actions to support successful delivery.
* Continuous improvement: challenges inefficient processes and identifies opportunities to simplify, standardize and automate.
* Control mindset: maintains attention to data integrity, documentation, security, internal controls and audit readiness.
* Learning agility: quickly develops knowledge of new tax processes, systems and technologies.

**Additional Notes**

* This role is based in Navi Mumbai, India. Relocation assistance is not available for this position.
* The role primarily focuses on tax technology and automation while requiring sufficient tax knowledge to support indirect tax solutions across EMEA, India and APAC.

title: Automation & Instrumentation Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Esteril Process Solutions is a pioneer in delivering end-to-end project execution for pharmaceutical industries, from conceptual front-end engineering studies to detailed design. The company specializes in fabrication, installation, and commissioning of systems and equipment with integrated automation. Esteril provides comprehensive engineering solutions that support high-quality, compliant, and efficient pharmaceutical production. Team members collaborate across disciplines to deliver reliable, automated systems that meet strict industry standards and client expectations.

* **Role Description**

1. Process Cycle Valve Matrix Preparation: Prepare valve matrices based on process cycles, P&IDs, and approved process requirements.

2. I/O List Preparation: Prepare PLC/DCS I/O lists based on approved P&IDs, including instrument details, valve feedback, control signals, and equipment interfaces.

3. Simulation & Bench Testing: Perform automation logic simulation and bench testing, and demonstrate the complete process sequences to the client for review and approval.

4. HMI/SCADA Verification: Verify all I/O points against the approved P&IDs and I/O lists in the HMI/SCADA system, ensuring correct tag mapping, indication, alarms, feedback, and control functionality.

5. PLC Programming & Logic Development: Develop, review, and troubleshoot PLC logic for process equipment, vessels, CIP, SIP, PHT, and other automation sequences.

6. FDS Documentation: Prepare and review Functional Design Specifications (FDS), control philosophy, valve matrices, and other automation-related documents.

7. FAT & SAT Activities: Conduct Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), including functional checks and process simulation.

8. Instrumentation & Control Verification: Verify instrument configuration, calibration, signal mapping, and communication with PLC/SCADA systems.

9. Client Coordination: Coordinate with clients, project teams, and vendors to resolve technical queries and ensure timely project execution.

10. Troubleshooting & Commissioning: Attend factory and site activities for troubleshooting, testing, commissioning, and qualification support.

11. Documentation & Handover: Prepare test reports, commissioning reports, and automation documentation required for project handover and CSV activities.

12. ⁠Coordinate with automation vendors and clients for technical discussions, specification finalization, and automation requirements.

**Experience Required:**

 Minimum 1 year of relevant industry experience for the respective job positions.

title: Senior Java Developer
description:
Your Team Responsibilities
  
  

* Contribute to the design, development, and modernization of applications within the Private Assets Engineering platform.
* Act as a strong hands-on Java engineer, independently owning application components and complex features.
* Collaborate with architects and senior engineers on technical design and implementation decisions.
* Develop scalable backend services, APIs, data-processing capabilities, integrations, and automation.
* Apply established architecture patterns, engineering standards, security requirements, and development best practices.
* Use Cursor and other AI-assisted engineering tools effectively to improve productivity and software quality.
* Contribute to the adoption of Generative AI and AI-enabled capabilities within applications where appropriate.
* Participate actively in design reviews, code reviews, testing, and technical discussions.
* Mentor and support Associate-level engineers through code reviews, technical guidance, and knowledge sharing.
* Contribute to CI/CD, observability, application reliability, and operational improvements.
* Take ownership of production issues within assigned areas and contribute to root cause analysis and preventative improvements.
* Work closely with product, business, and engineering stakeholders to deliver solutions that meet business requirements.

Your Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain production-grade applications primarily using Java and the Spring ecosystem.
* Independently deliver complex features and application components through the full software development lifecycle.
* Develop scalable REST APIs, backend services, data-processing workflows, integrations, and automation.
* Contribute to solution design and make appropriate technical decisions within established architecture.
* Write clean, maintainable, secure, and well-tested code following SOLID principles and sound design patterns.
* Develop comprehensive unit, integration, and automated tests using JUnit, Mockito, Testcontainers, or equivalent frameworks.
* Use Cursor and other AI-assisted development tools for coding, debugging, testing, refactoring, documentation, and engineering productivity.
* Review and validate AI-generated code to ensure it meets enterprise standards for security, quality, performance, and maintainability.
* Contribute to the development and integration of LLM, Generative AI, RAG, or agentic capabilities where applicable, including integrating AI services into Java-based applications.
* Perform peer code reviews and provide constructive technical feedback.
* Troubleshoot complex application and production issues, including JVM tuning, thread and memory analysis, and participate in root cause analysis.
* Work with relational and non-relational databases, using JPA/Hibernate or JDBC and optimizing application data access where required.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, monitoring, logging, and observability.
* Identify opportunities to reduce technical debt and improve application architecture and engineering practices.
* Produce and maintain appropriate technical documentation.
* Mentor less experienced engineers and contribute to knowledge sharing across the team.
* Contribute to React and/or .NET applications where required, although these technologies are not the primary focus of the role.

**Your Skills And Experience That Will Help You Excel**

* Strong hands-on software engineering experience with Java (Java 17 or later preferred), including building production-grade applications, APIs, backend services, and integrations.
* Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, concurrency, and software design principles.
* Experience with the Spring ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring Cloud) for building enterprise applications.
* Experience designing and developing REST APIs, microservices, distributed applications, or event-driven solutions using technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ.
* Strong knowledge of relational databases and SQL, including data modeling and query optimization.
* Experience with automated testing, build tools (Maven or Gradle), code reviews, source control, and software development best practices.
* Experience with cloud technologies, CI/CD, containers, and modern DevOps practices is highly desirable.
* Experience with or strong interest in Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, AI agents, and AI-enabled application development, including use of Spring AI or LangChain4j.
* Experience using AI-assisted development environments such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent tools is desirable.
* Ability to use AI-assisted engineering effectively while independently reviewing, understanding, and validating generated solutions.
* Good understanding of application security, performance, scalability, reliability, and observability, including JVM profiling and monitoring tools.
* Ability to independently solve complex technical problems and take ownership of engineering deliverables.
* Experience participating in technical design discussions and contributing to architectural decisions.
* Ability to mentor junior engineers and provide effective technical guidance and code-review feedback.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, and business teams.
* Experience with React and/or .NET is beneficial but not mandatory.
* Experience in financial services, investment management, Private Assets, Real Estate, or other complex data-intensive domains is advantageous.

**About MSCI**
**What we offer you**

* Transparent compensation schemes and comprehensive employee benefits, tailored to your location, ensuring your financial security, health, and overall wellbeing.
* Flexible working arrangements, advanced technology, and collaborative workspaces.
* A culture of high performance and innovation where we experiment with new ideas and take responsibility for achieving results.
* A global network of talented colleagues, who inspire, support, and share their expertise to innovate and deliver for our clients.
* Global Orientation program to kickstart your journey, followed by access to our Learning@MSCI platform, AI Learning Center , LinkedIn Learning Pro and tailored learning opportunities for ongoing skills development.
* Multi-directional career paths that offer professional growth and development through new challenges, internal mobility and expanded roles.
* We actively nurture an environment that builds a sense of inclusion belonging and connection, including eight Employee Resource Groups. All Abilities, Asian Support Network, Black Leadership Network, Climate Action Network, Hola! MSCI, Pride & Allies, Women in Tech, and Women’s Leadership Forum.

At MSCI we are passionate about what we do, and we are inspired by our vision – to power better decisions. You’ll be part of an industry-leading network of creative, curious, and entrepreneurial pioneers. This is a space where you can challenge yourself, set new standards and perform beyond expectations for yourself, our clients, and our industry.
  
  
MSCI strengthens global markets by connecting participants across the financial ecosystem with a common language. Our research-based data, analytics and indexes, supported by advanced technology, set standards for global investors and help our clients understand risks and opportunities so they can make better decisions and unlock innovation. We serve asset managers and owners, private-market sponsors and investors, hedge funds, wealth managers, banks, insurers and corporates.

values of safety, security, fairness and efficiency to promote a more sustainable
  
  
world where everyone has the chance to reach their full potential.
  
  
For more information, visit NEC at https://www.nec.com.
  
  
**Job Description**
Job Description: Digital Learning Developer
  
  
A Digital Learning Developer designs, develops, and implements engaging digital
  
  
learning experiences for employees or other learners. The role combines multimedia
  
  
development, learning technology, and content creation to deliver effective and
  
  
interactive learning solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Digital Learning Content Development
* Design and develop e-learning courses, interactive modules, and online training materials.
* Convert existing classroom training materials, presentations, and documents into digital learning content.
* Create videos, animations, simulations, quizzes, assessments, and interactive learning activities.
* E-Learning Tools and Technologies
* Use authoring tools such as Articulate Storyline, Articulate Rise, Adobe Captivate, and other e-learning development platforms.
* Upload, publish, and maintain courses on Learning Management Systems (LMS).
* Ensure compatibility with SCORM, xAPI, and other digital learning standards, where required.
* Multimedia and Interactive Content
* Develop and edit audio, video, graphics, and animations for learning materials.
* Create responsive learning experiences for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
* Incorporate interactive elements to make learning content engaging and accessible.
* Collaboration and Stakeholder Management
* Work with subject matter experts (SMEs), trainers, instructional designers, and business teams to gather learning requirements.
* Review technical information and translate it into clear, learner-friendly content.
* Incorporate feedback and make revisions based on stakeholder and learner requirements.
* Quality Assurance and Testing
* Test courses for functionality, navigation, usability, and technical accuracy.
* Ensure content meets accessibility standards and organizational quality guidelines.
* Identify and resolve issues before publishing learning modules.

**Educational Qualifications**
**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Instructional Design, Education, Educational Technology, Multimedia, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Relevant experience or certifications in e-learning development are an advantage.

**Technical Skills**

* E-learning authoring tools: Articulate Storyline 360, Articulate Rise 360,
* Multimedia tools: Adobe Creative Cloud, Canva, Camtasia, or similar applications.
* Understanding of SCORM, xAPI, responsive design, and accessibility standards.

**Professional Skills**

* Strong written and verbal communication.
* Creativity and attention to detail.
* Analytical thinking and problem-solving.
* Time management and ability to manage multiple projects.
* Collaboration with cross-functional teams.
* Ability to simplify complex information into engaging learning experiences.

Regards,
  
  
Dakshata

YASH Technologies is a leading technology integrator specializing in helping clients reimagine operating models, enhance competitiveness, optimize costs, foster exceptional stakeholder experiences, and drive business transformation.
  
  
At YASH, we’re a cluster of the brightest stars working with cutting-edge technologies. Our purpose is anchored in a single truth – bringing real positive changes in an increasingly virtual world and it drives us beyond generational gaps and disruptions of the future.
  
  
**We are looking forward to hire Dynamics 365 Professionals in the following areas :**
**Job Description**
**Experience required:**
7-10 years
  
  
Summary: Client need a hands-on contractor to design, build and support Dynamics 365 and Power Platform solutions, including apps, workflows, integrations and reporting. You'll work with business and IT teams in different countries.
  
  
Experience: 7+ years, including 5+ years on Dynamics 365 and Power Platform
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Customise and configure Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement and Dataverse: data models, forms, business rules and security roles.
* Build model-driven and canvas Power Apps, and automate processes with Power Automate.
* Write plug-ins in C# and JavaScript or TypeScript, and build custom controls (PCF).
* Connect Dynamics 365 to other systems using the Dataverse Web API and Azure services (Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus).
* Build Power BI reports and dashboards, including data models, DAX formulas and row-level security.
* Manage solution releases and automated deployments through Azure DevOps or GitHub.

At YASH, you are empowered to create a career that will take you to where you want to go while working in an inclusive team environment. We leverage career-oriented skilling models and optimize our collective intelligence aided with technology for continuous learning, unlearning, and relearning at a rapid pace and scale.
  
  
**Our Hyperlearning workplace is grounded upon four principles**

* Flexible work arrangements, Free spirit, and emotional positivity
* Agile self-determination, trust, transparency, and open collaboration
* All Support needed for the realization of business goals,
* Stable employment with a great atmosphere and ethical corporate culture

title: Software Consultant
description:
Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.

Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.

**Your Role**

  

* Lead architecture, design, development and coordination of software development projects and work teams.

* Provides technical leadership to project team members. Strong project/program management experience in the software field. Understanding of the software development life cycle and process improvement.

* Follows disciplined software development practices. Up-to-date on current and best practices and technologies related to software development and project management. Demonstrates expertise in a variety of the field's concepts, practices, and procedures. Relies on extensive technical experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals.

* Responsible for a variety of technical and project management tasks. Provide consultation on complex technical projects. Considers business side of technical decisions.

**Your Impact**

FlexPLM team need a Software Consultant who will work on designing new UIs for FlexPLM and at the same time solve complex customer problems efficiently

**Your Team**

FlexPLM team is a young and dynamic team of software engineers with average exp. Of around 7-9 years and the candidate will be a great fit to this team and overall PTC

**Your Day-to-Day**

* Prepare functional specifications to include detailed description of specific features and/or functionalities for a component within a product for a specific release.
* A User Interface section, outlining specific UI's and user roles
* References use cases and documents task flows for this particular feature
* Schedule, conduct and participate in design reviews
* Prepare design note(s) per group standards based on an approved set of requirements. A design note shall include at minimum: Requirement statement, problem definition, solution description, test scenarios, migration issues
* Prepare work estimates for assigned tasks
* Develop iterative prototypes when appropriate Technical lead on projects Completes all work according to schedule requirements
* Provide ongoing feedback on deliverables
* Write well documented & performing code including source code documentation that meets organizational standards
* Solicit code reviews for your work. Participate in code reviews of others’ work
* Create and run unit tests
* Test on multiple configurations
* Acquire knowledge necessary to perform job assignments (technology, product and process)
* Provide timely and complete information and document reviews to the publications group
* Provide timely and complete information to the QA group to facilitate formal testing.
* Share technical information with the team and to a wider audience when appropriate
Respond to requests for information in a timely manner  

**Must-Have Skills**

· Java

· ODATA, REST

· JSP

· DB – Oracle, SQLServer

· JavaScript

· JQuery

· Angular

· PrimeNG

**Experience Required**

10+ Years

  
  

Life at PTC is about more than working with today’s most cutting-edge technologies to transform the physical world. It’s about showing up as you are and working alongside some of today’s most talented industry leaders to transform the world around you.

If you share our passion for problem-solving through innovation, you’ll likely become just as passionate about the PTC experience as we are. Are you ready to explore your next career move with us?

We respect the privacy rights of individuals and are committed to handling Personal Information responsibly and in accordance with all applicable privacy and data protection laws.

title: Full Stack Developer - 3 years+ Experience
description:
**About Rasta Pay**

Rasta Pay is a growing startup that handles court-level traffic challan settlement for fleet and transport companies. We take a slow, painful legal process and make it simple for our clients. We’re now building the technology that will run and scale the business — and we’re looking for a developer to build it with us from the ground up.

**About the role**

You’ll be our core technical person, working directly with the founders to turn ideas into working products. We’ll bring you the vision, the references, and a deep understanding of what our clients need; you’ll turn that into a website, the internal tools that run our operations, and eventually mobile apps. This is a build-from-scratch role with real ownership — what you build becomes the backbone of the company.

**What you’ll do**

* Build and launch the Rasta Pay website end to end
* Build the internal tools our team uses to manage challans, clients, and day-to-day operations
* Take rough ideas and competitor references from the founders and turn them into clean, working products
* Deploy, maintain, and improve what you build — you own the technology, not just the code
* Suggest better ways to do things; we want someone who thinks, not just executes
* Later, help extend the product to mobile apps as we grow

**What we’re looking for**

* Ability to build a complete web application on your own — front-end, back-end, database, and deployment — without needing a team around you
* Comfort working directly with non-technical founders, and the patience to translate rough ideas into working products
* Self-driven and resourceful; happy to figure things out in an early-stage environment where everything isn’t defined yet
* Writes clean, organized, maintainable code that someone else could pick up later
* Reliable and communicative — tells us when something’s unclear instead of guessing silently

**Good to have**

* Mobile app experience (React Native or Flutter)
* Experience building dashboards, workflow tools, or operations software
* Interest in legal-tech, fintech, or logistics
* An eye for simple, clean design

**What it’s like here**

We’re a small, bootstrapped, fast-moving team. You’ll have direct access to the founders, real ownership of what you build, and the chance to shape the product and the technology from day one. In return, we need someone who’s comfortable wearing many hats and getting things shipped.

**Office Location-**
306, RG Complex, Plot No. 8, Sector 5, Dwarka, New Delhi

**Compensation**

₹30,000–50,000/month, full-time.

**How to apply**

Fill the Google Form Below

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSf4LdUt\_UGZXjOicqsoG-zAezNWGMdzxrFbAXEtGSl00jog2Q/viewform?usp=publish-editor

title: .NET Fullstack Developer
description:
**THE ROLE:**

You will ship prototypes and production features across client work and incubation products. Take a wireframe brief on a Monday and have a working demo by Thursday. Push production releases. Iterate live with client feedback in the room. Own the middle of the stack (application layer) while our platform engineer owns the infrastructure below and our advisors handle the complex data and architecture calls above.

Many of the systems our clients already own run on .NET, so you need to be at home inside them. You will work directly with the CEO and the delivery lead. You will see every conversation, every client, every product. This role is task-driven, not meeting-driven.

**MUST HAVES :**

* **.NET specialist**
  . Deep, production-grade C# and .NET (ASP.NET Core, Web API, Entity Framework Core). Comfortable working inside existing enterprise .NET codebases, not just greenfield.
* 3+years shipping web applications in production.
* **Strong TypeScript, React, and Node.js**
  .
* Comfortable with SQL and Postgres. SQL Server and Supabase experience a plus.
* Deployment discipline on Vercel, Fly.io, Azure, or similar.
* Working knowledge of AI-augmented development (Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf, or equivalent).
* Git hygiene, code review discipline, opinionated but coachable.

**NICE TO HAVES:**

* Direct Anthropic API experience, or orchestration exposure (LangGraph, Vercel AI SDK, Semantic Kernel).
* Design sensibility. Tailwind, shadcn, motion. You can tell when a UI is off.
* Data engineering exposure (dbt, Airbyte, connectors).
* Comfort in enterprise environments where you are the only Paragon person in the room.

title: AI Solutions Architect
description:
**ABOUT BLOOM AI**

Bloom AI is an applied AI firm building AI-native intelligence systems and workflows for enterprise teams across research, marketing, sales and other knowledge-intensive functions.

We combine enterprise data, external intelligence, AI and software engineering to help organizations turn information into intelligence and action.

Our approach combines reusable AI capabilities with hands-on solution development in real enterprise environments. We work closely with business teams to rethink workflows, design intelligent systems and deploy solutions that deliver measurable outcomes.

Bloom AI is based in the U.S. and India (Delhi/NCR).

**THE ROLE**

We are looking for a
**hands-on AI Solutions Architect**
who can design, build and deploy enterprise-grade AI applications and agentic systems.

This role sits at the intersection of
**AI architecture, data engineering and software development**
.

You may come from a backend engineering, data engineering or data science background, but you should have evolved into building end-to-end AI solutions.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have worked on
**multiple AI/LLM projects**
, solved different types of problems and gained practical experience making architectural decisions across agent orchestration, data, context management, application development and deployment.

You should be equally comfortable designing a solution architecture, evaluating technology choices, writing code, integrating data sources and taking a working solution into production.

This is
**not a traditional software engineering role, a prompt-engineering role or a PowerPoint-only architecture role**
. We need someone who understands how AI systems work end-to-end and can personally build what they design.

You will work across client engagements, reusable Bloom AI capabilities and internal technology development, taking ownership of solutions from architecture through production deployment.

You will be part of the core team, reporting directly to the CEO.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

Leading a small team, you will:

**Architect Bloom AI Capabilities and Client Solutions**

* Design end-to-end AI solutions combining LLMs, agents, enterprise data, APIs and applications.
* Mak architectural decisions around agent orchestration, context, memory, workflows and technology choices.
* Build modular, reusable solutions that work across different cloud and enterprise environments.

**Build agentic applications**

* Develop multi-agent systems, agentic workflows and LLM-powered applications using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain or similar.
* Implement tool calling, RAG, semantic search, agent memory and state management.
* Build evaluation, monitoring and reliability mechanisms for production AI systems.

**Engineer data and context systems**

* Integrate structured and unstructured enterprise data into AI applications.
* Design retrieval and context architectures using relational, vector and graph databases.
* Build knowledge retrieval, entity relationships and persistent context capabilities.

**Develop and deploy end to end systems**

* Build backend services and APIs using Python, FastAPI or similar technologies.
* Develop functional frontend applications and integrate with enterprise systems.
* Deploy secure, scalable applications across cloud platforms using modern engineering practices.

**Solve enterprise client problems**

* Translate business challenges into practical AI architectures and working solutions.
* Work across multiple client projects, from solution design and prototyping through deployment.
* Evaluate technical approaches, collaborate with stakeholders and develop reusable capabilities for Bloom AI.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* **4–7 years of professional experience**
  , with a foundation in
  **backend engineering, data engineering, data science or related technical disciplines**
  .
* **Hands-on experience across multiple AI/LLM application projects**
  , preferably involving different use cases, data environments or architectural approaches.
* Demonstrated ability to take ownership of solution architecture and technical implementation, rather than contributing to only one component of a system.
* Strong proficiency in
  **Python**
  , with solid software engineering and API development skills.
* Practical experience building
  **agentic applications or multi-agent systems**
  , beyond basic chatbots and prompt-based applications.
* Experience with agent orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen or similar.
* Strong understanding of LLM APIs, tool calling, RAG, embeddings, vector databases and context management.
* Strong understanding of data modeling, SQL, databases, data integration and retrieval architectures.
* Working knowledge of full-stack application development, including modern frontend frameworks such as React or Next.js.
* Familiarity with graph data structures, entity relationships and graph-based retrieval concepts.
* Experience taking AI applications from prototype through testing, integration and production deployment.
* Experience with at least one major cloud platform and familiarity with Docker, Git, CI/CD and modern engineering practices.
* Ability to evaluate different technical approaches and make sound architectural trade-offs.
* Strong independent problem-solving skills, curiosity and comfort working with ambiguous requirements.
* Lead R&D efforts for Bloom AI

**Above all, we are looking for someone who has built several AI solutions, understands the architectural decisions behind them and can independently design and implement new ones.**

**GOOD TO HAVE**

* Startup or
  **0-to-1 product development experience**
  .
* Experience working on enterprise AI projects across different business functions or client environments.
* Experience integrating with
  **marketing, sales or commercial systems**
  , such as CRM, marketing automation, campaign platforms, content management systems or sales enablement tools.
* Experience working directly with enterprise clients and translating business requirements into technical solutions.
* Experience building AI applications for financial services, research or other knowledge-intensive domains.

title: Oracle Technical Consultant
description:

Oracle Technical Consultant

Gurgaon or Remote

**Job Type:**
Full-time

3–5 years

**Industry:**
Information Technology & Services

**Company:**
Virtuos Solutions

**Website:**

www.virtuos.com

**Position Overview:**

Virtuos is seeking an experienced
**Oracle Technical Consultant**
to join our high-impact consulting team. In this role, you will work on transformative SaaS and PaaS implementations to modernize and optimize customer engagement for global clients. Your deep expertise in
**Oracle CX Sales and B2B Service Cloud**
will be critical in building scalable, intelligent, and highly customized customer experience solutions.

You’ll collaborate with architects, project managers, and client stakeholders to design, configure, and deliver impactful solutions, ensuring adherence to Oracle’s best practices and methodologies.

* Develop innovative solutions for Oracle CX Cloud implementations.
* Analyze business requirements to align Oracle CX applications with client objectives.
* Lead end-to-end design of technical and functional components, including integrations and customizations.

* **Certifications:**

* Oracle CX Sales
* Oracle B2B Service Cloud
* Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC)
* Visual Builder Cloud Services (VBCS) / Studio (VBS)
* BIP and OTBI reports
* Redwood UI implementation.

**Proficient in:**

* Groovy scripting, workflows, triggers, alerts, OTBI analytics
* Web development using HTML, CSS, JavaScript (React is a plus)
* Integration technologies (SOAP, REST, JSON, XML, XSLT, etc.)
* Oracle PaaS components and tools (GIT, JIRA, shell scripting)
* Redwood UI implementation and customizations
* **Strong problem-solving and architectural design skills.**

* Experience with global clients and multi-time-zone project delivery.
* Prior experience with CRM tools like Oracle Siebel, Oracle B2C Service Cloud, Salesforce, or Microsoft Dynamics.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills—verbal and written.
* Demonstrated leadership, adaptability, and ability to work in fast-paced environments.
* Passion for continuous learning and emerging technologies.

vdc.com

Serving enterprises across Retail, Ecommerce, Financial Services, Travel, Manufacturing, and other industries, VDC stands at the intersection of technology, innovation, and experience transformation.

title: Software Development Engineer II
description:
**Role:**
Software Development Engineer II – Mobile (React Native)

**Function:**
Mobile Engineering / Software Development

**Location:**
Delhi (Onsite)

**Type:**
Full-time

**Industry:**
Broadcast Media, Online Media, Media Production

**About Company**

The company is one of India's largest private FM radio networks. It reaches over 40 million listeners weekly across 49 cities, 1,000+ towns, and 50,000 villages.

Active since 2006 and headquartered in Delhi, it is owned by a major Indian media conglomerate. It is the only private FM station broadcasting from Jammu & Kashmir, with an international presence in Singapore and Bhutan.

Its digital platform extends the brand beyond traditional radio with curated music, news, and lifestyle content. With a team of 740, it operates at the intersection of legacy broadcasting and modern digital media.

**Position Overview**

This role is central to the company's flagship consumer app, which serves millions of listeners with music, news, and lifestyle content. The engineer will own feature development and end-to-end release cycles on React Native, ensuring a high-quality experience across iOS and Android. Beyond mobile, the role includes contributing to web surfaces built on modern JavaScript frameworks.

**Role & Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain features on the consumer app using React Native for iOS and Android
* Own end-to-end app release cycles, including build configuration, code signing, and submission to Apple App Store and Google Play Store
* Collaborate with product and design teams to translate requirements into polished, performant mobile experiences
* Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks, crashes, and UX issues across mobile platforms
* Contribute to web development tasks using a modern JavaScript framework (React, Next.js, Vue.js, or similar)
* Write clean, maintainable code with appropriate test coverage and participate in code reviews
* Stay current with React Native ecosystem updates and mobile platform guidelines from Apple and Google

**Must Have Criteria**

* 3–5 years of software development experience with React Native as the primary mobile framework
* Demonstrated track record of shipping production apps to both Apple App Store and Google Play Store
* Hands-on experience with mobile app build pipelines, code signing, and release management
* Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and solid understanding of mobile performance optimization
* Working experience with at least one modern web framework (React, Next.js, Vue.js, or similar)

**Nice to Have**

* Native iOS (Swift/Objective-C) or Android (Kotlin/Java) development experience
* Experience with CI/CD tools that automate mobile app releases (e.g., Fastlane, Bitrise, or similar)
* Prior work on a consumer-facing media, audio, or streaming application

**What We Offer**

* Direct ownership of a consumer app used by millions of listeners across India
* Onsite role in Delhi, embedded in a cross-functional product and engineering team
* Work at the intersection of broadcast media and digital product engineering at meaningful scale

title: Application Engineer
description:
**We're not hiring someone to close tickets.**
We're hiring the person who drives the entire Grip app system: its roadmap, architecture, speed and health. You'll also help shape what we build next.

If you build apps in your spare time just because you love it, try new tools the week they come out, and check the crash dashboard before anyone asks, read on.

**The app today**

The Grip app is built in React Native. Most of the product runs as our web app inside a WebView, joined to the app by a native bridge. Your job is to drive the whole app system: take it fully native, keep it fast, safe and reliable, and make it work hand in hand with web and backend.

**What you'll do**

**01 · Drive the entire app system**

* Own the app end to end: architecture, releases, app health, and the roadmap to a fully native app, which you shape with the leadership team.
* Make the calls on architecture, stack and the order in which screens move.
* Help drive the product roadmap too, with ideas from the app side, from user data and from the best apps out there.

**02 · Stay ahead of app health**

* Own the crash-free rate, ANR rate and app-open time, and watch them in Crashlytics, Sentry and New Relic without being asked.
* Catch regressions before users do, and trace any crash or ANR to its root cause.
* Set up the monitoring and telemetry the whole team relies on.

**03 · Experiment, and automate your own workload**

* Try new technologies and AI workflows early, and keep what works.
* Automate the repetitive parts of the job: builds, releases, checks, triage, task breakdown.
* Work out how app development fits into our AI-driven development process (AI SDLC), so app delivery is as fast as web.

**04 · Build one ecosystem with web and backend**

* Work with the web and backend teams to make everything the app shares with them (APIs, auth, data and events) more secure and robust.
* Design the architecture that lets every new feature go live on app and web on the same timeline, without one waiting for the other.
* Use shared API contracts and business logic, shared analytics events, and server-driven pieces where they help.
* Partner with the engineering manager on the process. The architecture is yours.

**05 · Build in the guardrails**

* Define the checks every release passes for security, accessibility, design and A/B experiments.
* Make releases safe and boring: CI, over-the-air updates, staged rollouts and rollback.

**06 · Set the standard**

* Your PRs, code reviews and incident write-ups become the team's benchmark.
* Come to us with "here's what we should improve" before anyone asks.

**What we're looking for**

**Must have**

* **Mobile:**
  React Native (including the New Architecture: Fabric, TurboModules, JSI) or Flutter, in depth, plus enough native Android (Kotlin) and iOS (Swift) to build and debug native modules.
* **Architecture:**
  mobile app architecture, hybrid-to-native migrations, WebView and JS ↔ native bridges, strict TypeScript.
* **App health:**
  performance profiling (Hermes, Android Studio Profiler, Perfetto, Xcode Instruments) and crash, ANR and telemetry tools (Crashlytics, Sentry, New Relic).
* **Delivery:**
  mobile CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Fastlane), over-the-air updates, Play Console and App Store Connect.
* **Quality:**
  mobile and API security, accessibility on iOS and Android, feature flags and A/B experiments, and testing (Jest, React Native Testing Library, Detox or Maestro).
* **AI:**
  daily use of CLI agents such as Claude Code or Codex, and automations you've built for your own work.

**Strong plus**

* You've led a hybrid-to-native migration or a native rewrite.
* You've built and shipped fully native apps (Kotlin with Jetpack Compose, or Swift with SwiftUI), not only cross-platform ones.
* Server-driven UI, UPI intent payments, SMS Retriever OTP or KYC SDKs.
* Fintech or other regulated B2C apps at scale

**Mindset**

* **Builder at heart:**
  builds apps in their spare time, with personal and pet projects, because they love making apps, not just because it's the job.
* **User-obsessed:**
  gets excited about creating new experiences for users.
* **Ahead of the curve:**
  keeps up with frontier technology and AI, and experiments with new tools before they go mainstream.
* **Automates:**
  keeps cutting their own workload by automating processes and routine work.
* **Proactive:**
  spots crashes, ANRs and slowdowns on the dashboards before users report them.
* **Owner:**
  owns outcomes end to end and thinks about the product, not only the code.
* **Partner:**
  brings ideas, not just questions, and communicates clearly.

**Green flags and red flags**

**We'll move fast for you if**

* You build apps for fun: personal and pet projects, released or not. Show us one.
* You've led a hybrid-to-native migration, a major React Native upgrade or a New Architecture move.
* You've traced a native crash or ANR to its root cause and can tell us the story.
* You've automated a real chunk of your own job, and can show us how.
* You've set up mobile monitoring, telemetry or release checks that a team relied on.
* You've worked with web and backend teams to make shared APIs, auth or events more secure.
* You've shipped one feature on app and web on the same day, and know what it took.
* You have a view on React Native versus fully native versus other stacks, backed by numbers.

**Not a fit if**

* You've only worked in JavaScript and avoid Xcode or Android Studio.
* You close crash reports as "can't reproduce".
* You've never shipped to the app stores yourself.
* You wait to be told what to fix next.
* You only build apps when it's for work.
* You've never used AI tools beyond a chat prompt.

**What owning the app looks like**

No fixed timeline. You drive it.

1. **Know the app cold.**
   Map the app, the bridge, the release flow and the monitoring, and ship your first fixes in your first weeks.
2. **Own the roadmap.**
   Shape the native roadmap with leadership, and present the architecture, stack choice and migration order.
3. **Own the numbers.**
   Crash-free rate, ANR rate, app-open time and product telemetry each have a baseline, a dashboard and a target that you set.
4. **Automate the busywork.**
   Builds, releases and checks run themselves, and app work flows through our AI-driven development process as smoothly as web work.
5. **Work as one with web and backend.**
   New features go live on app and web on the same timeline, shared APIs and auth are secure and robust, and every release passes the checks for security, accessibility, design and experiments.
6. **Become the reference point.**
   When the team debates an app or product approach, they ask what you'd do.

**What you get here**

* **Your ideas, brought to life.**
  The interests, experiments and ideas you'd normally save for a side project get to ship here, to real investors.
* **A company that stays ahead of the curve.**
  We experiment early with new technology and AI tools to build things customers love.
* **Real ownership.**
  The app, its roadmap and its architecture are yours to shape.

We're building a team where
**AI-native isn't a buzzword. It's table stakes.**
The person we hire won't just build a native app. They'll give our investors the best experience we can offer, on every screen, and make the whole team better at building for mobile.

*If you're still reading and nodding, we'd like to meet you.*

title: Senior Implementation Consultant
description:
**Description**

**Header**

* Role: Implementation Consultant / Senior Implementation Consultant (Web & Mobile Analytics)
* Levels: We are hiring at two levels. Implementation Consultant (3 to 5 years) or Senior Implementation Consultant (6+ years). The level offered depends on experience.
* Location: Gurugram, Hybrid. Remote considered for exceptional candidates who cannot relocate.
* Timings: 2 PM to 12 AM IST. This role follows a rotational shift aligned with global clients.
* Employment type: Full-time

**The role**

You will implement and optimise digital analytics for global enterprise clients on Heap and Contentsquare, as part of Contentsquare's India Center of Excellence. You will own tracking design, web and mobile instrumentation and data QA, working directly with client product, marketing and engineering teams so their behavioural data is accurate and ready to use.

**About Scaletrix.AI**

Scaletrix.AI is a data analytics and AI services provider with 15 years of experience in the sector, led by alumni of McKinsey, BCG, ZS, Genpact, Citi, IIT, ISB, FMS and CMU. We build end-to-end solutions that bring data engineering and data science together.

Scaletrix.AI is a strategic partner of Contentsquare and serves as Contentsquare's India Center of Excellence (CSQ-India CoE), providing platform selling, onboarding, managed services and client management to Contentsquare and Heap customers globally.

**About the platforms**

Contentsquare is the global leader in digital experience analytics, headquartered in Paris with offices across the US, UK and APAC. Trusted by 1,000+ enterprises including L'Oréal, Walmart and Sephora, it delivers heatmaps, session replay, journey analysis and AI-driven recommendations to optimise conversion and customer experience.

Heap, part of the Contentsquare suite, brings product analytics powered by autocapture: it records every user interaction across web and mobile, with retroactive event definition, funnel tracking and behavioural segmentation. Heap is trusted by enterprises including Microsoft, AMD and Twilio.

Websites: https://www.scaletrix.ai/ | https://contentsquare.com/ | https://www.heap.io/

**Key responsibilities**

* Deploy and configure Heap and Contentsquare for event tagging, data capture and KPI alignment.
* Define tracking requirements with client technical teams using HTML, CSS selectors and JavaScript.
* Integrate analytics SDKs in mobile apps (iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter) and align them with tools such as Firebase, Adjust or AppsFlyer.
* Build tracking plans, data layers and implementation documentation.
* Run QA audits using browser console and debugging tools to confirm data is accurate and complete.
* Configure PII masking, API integrations and data enrichment workflows.
* Set up UTM frameworks and connect marketing data sources to measure paid vs organic acquisition.
* Connect analytics with the client's MarTech stack: A/B testing, CRM, CDP and tag managers.
* Run onboarding projects, workshops and enablement sessions with client teams.

**At the Senior level, you will also:**

* Own multi-workstream implementations end to end and act as technical lead with client engineering teams.
* Review the work of other consultants and contribute to implementation playbooks.

**Tools**

Must-have (hands-on with at least one in each line):

* Analytics: Heap, Contentsquare, GA4, Amplitude, Mixpanel or Adobe Analytics
* Tag management: Google Tag Manager or similar, and data layers
* Web: able to read HTML and basic JavaScript, and write CSS selectors. You don't need to be a developer, but you must understand how a web page is built.
* Mobile: analytics SDK integration on iOS, Android, React Native or Flutter

Good to have:

* Mobile measurement and attribution: Firebase, Adjust, AppsFlyer
* CDP and engagement: Segment, MoEngage, WebEngage
* Experimentation: Optimizely, VWO, AB Tasty
* Data and BI: SQL, BigQuery, Snowflake, Tableau, Power BI
* AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot) for QA and documentation

**Requirements**

* 3+ years in analytics implementation (6+ years for Senior), including at least 2 years hands-on implementing a product or digital analytics platform.
* Working understanding of HTML, CSS selectors, JavaScript and data layers, enough to read a page's code and map elements for tracking.
* Experience configuring events, conversions, tracking plans and data layers.
* Has instrumented analytics in at least one mobile app.
* Understanding of marketing analytics: UTM parameters, attribution, paid vs organic.
* Clear written and verbal communication with client developers, marketers and product teams.

Good to have: server-side tracking, session replay and heatmap tools, experience with US or European clients.

**Why join us**

* Work with global enterprise clients on Heap and Contentsquare as part of Contentsquare's India Center of Excellence.
* Hands-on work across web, mobile, product and marketing analytics.
* Work alongside leaders with experience at McKinsey, BCG, ZS, Genpact and Citi.
* A clear path to senior and lead roles.

title: Chief Technology Officer and Co-Founder
description:
About Prismatom
  
  
Prismatom is an independent trust layer for enterprise communications, addressing communication authenticity and impersonation-based fraud at the post-delivery human stage.
  
  
We have built a working, patent-pending product with an existing codebase.
  
  
Our technology uses cryptographic message issuance records, deterministic recognition markers, independent verification, and an append-only, tamper-evident ledger (ATSL) to help customers recognise genuine enterprise communications and enable enterprises to establish verifiable issuance evidence.
  
  
Our advisory board includes top industry leaders who bring strategic expertise, industry insights, and guidance to Prismatom.
  
  
We are seeking a hands-on Co-Founder & CTO who can take complete ownership of our existing technology, strengthen its architecture, and lead its future development.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
- Take end-to-end technical ownership of the existing product, codebase, and architecture.
  
- Conduct technical and security assessments, identify vulnerabilities, and implement improvements.
  
- Lead backend engineering, secure API development, database architecture, and cloud infrastructure.
  
- Oversee cryptographic security, authentication, key management, and system integrity.
  
- Ensure scalability, reliability, performance, and production readiness.
  
- Drive technical strategy, architectural decisions, and future product development.
  
- Establish engineering standards, testing, deployment, and monitoring practices.
  
- Build and lead the engineering team as the company grows.
  
  
Core Technical Requirements
  
  
- Strong hands-on experience in backend engineering and software architecture.
  
- Proven experience designing, developing, and scaling production-grade systems.
  
- Expertise in secure API development, authentication, databases, and cloud infrastructure.
  
- Strong understanding of application security, distributed systems, data integrity, and system reliability.
  
- Ability to independently review, understand, and improve an existing codebase.
  
- Experience making architectural decisions and owning end-to-end engineering execution.
  
  
Specialised Expertise (Highly Desirable)
  
  
- Applied cryptography: SHA-256, HMAC, digital signatures, and asymmetric cryptography.
  
- Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), HSM/KMS, and secure key management.
  
- Tamper-evident ledgers, cryptographic audit trails, and verifiable records.
  
- Enterprise security architecture and secure system integrations.
  
- Experience in cybersecurity, fintech infrastructure, identity systems, or enterprise communication technology.
  
  
Ideal Candidate
  
  
We welcome experienced Staff Engineers, Principal Engineers, Software Architects, Founding Engineers, and hands-on CTOs with demonstrated technical ownership of complex production systems.
  
  
We value independent thinking, strong architectural judgment, security-first engineering, entrepreneurial commitment, and the ability to solve difficult technical problems.
  
  
The ideal candidate should be willing to participate not only in technology development but also in strategic decision-making and the long-term growth of Prismatom.
  
  
Equity, Investment & Co-Founder Commitment
  
  
This is an equity-based co-founder opportunity, not a conventional salaried position.
  
  
- Prismatom is currently at the pre-funding stage, and no salary will be provided before funding.
  
- Equity participation will be mutually negotiated based on responsibilities, commitment, experience, and long-term contribution.
  
- All co-founders will equally share the operating expenses required to run the company.
  
- Candidates must be willing and financially prepared to contribute their equal share of company expenses until the company becomes financially self-sustaining or alternative funding arrangements are established.
  
- Full-time commitment is preferred.
  
- Candidates interested in making an additional strategic investment in Prismatom are particularly welcome. Any such investment will be negotiated separately from co-founder equity and shared operating expenses.
  
  
We are looking for a long-term technical and business partner who brings engineering excellence, entrepreneurial conviction, shared financial responsibility, and the commitment to help establish Prismatom as a trusted enterprise technology company.

description:

Mobile Engineering

Full-time

Broadcast Media, Online Media, Media Production

The company is one of India's largest private FM radio networks. It reaches over 40 million listeners weekly across 49 cities, 1,000+ towns, and 50,000 villages.

Active since 2006 and headquartered in Delhi, it is the only private FM station broadcasting from Jammu & Kashmir. The company also has an international presence in Singapore and Bhutan.

* Define and enforce mobile engineering standards: performance budgets, code review norms, testing strategy, and release cadence
* Mentor and upskill junior and mid-level engineers through code reviews, design discussions, and pairing sessions
* Collaborate with product and design to translate requirements into scalable, maintainable mobile features

**Must Have Criteria**

* 5+ years of software engineering experience, with the majority in mobile development
* Deep, hands-on React Native expertise on large-scale, production mobile applications — including complex state management, native modules, and performance optimization
* Proven ownership of App Store and Google Play Store deployment pipelines — build signing, release tracks, review processes, and rollout management
* Demonstrated ability to lead technical direction on a mobile product, not just execute tasks

**Nice to Have**

* Experience mentoring junior or mid-level engineers in a formal or informal capacity
* Solid web development experience with React, Next.js, Vue.js, or a comparable modern framework
* Background as a tech lead, founding engineer, or early mobile hire at a product company
* Experience building or scaling large multi-feature consumer apps (superapps or apps with 5+ major feature domains)

**What We Offer**

* Technical ownership and influence over the mobile roadmap for a platform serving 40M+ listeners
* Onsite role in Delhi with a close-knit, creativity-driven engineering team
* Opportunity to shape mobile engineering culture and mentor the next generation of engineers at a nationally recognised media brand
