title: Application Engineer
description:
**We're not hiring someone to close tickets.**
We're hiring the person who drives the entire Grip app system: its roadmap, architecture, speed and health. You'll also help shape what we build next.

If you build apps in your spare time just because you love it, try new tools the week they come out, and check the crash dashboard before anyone asks, read on.

**The app today**

The Grip app is built in React Native. Most of the product runs as our web app inside a WebView, joined to the app by a native bridge. Your job is to drive the whole app system: take it fully native, keep it fast, safe and reliable, and make it work hand in hand with web and backend.

**What you'll do**

**01 · Drive the entire app system**

* Own the app end to end: architecture, releases, app health, and the roadmap to a fully native app, which you shape with the leadership team.
* Make the calls on architecture, stack and the order in which screens move.
* Help drive the product roadmap too, with ideas from the app side, from user data and from the best apps out there.

**02 · Stay ahead of app health**

* Own the crash-free rate, ANR rate and app-open time, and watch them in Crashlytics, Sentry and New Relic without being asked.
* Catch regressions before users do, and trace any crash or ANR to its root cause.
* Set up the monitoring and telemetry the whole team relies on.

**03 · Experiment, and automate your own workload**

* Try new technologies and AI workflows early, and keep what works.
* Automate the repetitive parts of the job: builds, releases, checks, triage, task breakdown.
* Work out how app development fits into our AI-driven development process (AI SDLC), so app delivery is as fast as web.

**04 · Build one ecosystem with web and backend**

* Work with the web and backend teams to make everything the app shares with them (APIs, auth, data and events) more secure and robust.
* Design the architecture that lets every new feature go live on app and web on the same timeline, without one waiting for the other.
* Use shared API contracts and business logic, shared analytics events, and server-driven pieces where they help.
* Partner with the engineering manager on the process. The architecture is yours.

**05 · Build in the guardrails**

* Define the checks every release passes for security, accessibility, design and A/B experiments.
* Make releases safe and boring: CI, over-the-air updates, staged rollouts and rollback.

**06 · Set the standard**

* Your PRs, code reviews and incident write-ups become the team's benchmark.
* Come to us with "here's what we should improve" before anyone asks.

**What we're looking for**

**Must have**

* **Mobile:**
  React Native (including the New Architecture: Fabric, TurboModules, JSI) or Flutter, in depth, plus enough native Android (Kotlin) and iOS (Swift) to build and debug native modules.
* **Architecture:**
  mobile app architecture, hybrid-to-native migrations, WebView and JS ↔ native bridges, strict TypeScript.
* **App health:**
  performance profiling (Hermes, Android Studio Profiler, Perfetto, Xcode Instruments) and crash, ANR and telemetry tools (Crashlytics, Sentry, New Relic).
* **Delivery:**
  mobile CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Fastlane), over-the-air updates, Play Console and App Store Connect.
* **Quality:**
  mobile and API security, accessibility on iOS and Android, feature flags and A/B experiments, and testing (Jest, React Native Testing Library, Detox or Maestro).
* **AI:**
  daily use of CLI agents such as Claude Code or Codex, and automations you've built for your own work.

**Strong plus**

* You've led a hybrid-to-native migration or a native rewrite.
* You've built and shipped fully native apps (Kotlin with Jetpack Compose, or Swift with SwiftUI), not only cross-platform ones.
* Server-driven UI, UPI intent payments, SMS Retriever OTP or KYC SDKs.
* Fintech or other regulated B2C apps at scale

**Mindset**

* **Builder at heart:**
  builds apps in their spare time, with personal and pet projects, because they love making apps, not just because it's the job.
* **User-obsessed:**
  gets excited about creating new experiences for users.
* **Ahead of the curve:**
  keeps up with frontier technology and AI, and experiments with new tools before they go mainstream.
* **Automates:**
  keeps cutting their own workload by automating processes and routine work.
* **Proactive:**
  spots crashes, ANRs and slowdowns on the dashboards before users report them.
* **Owner:**
  owns outcomes end to end and thinks about the product, not only the code.
* **Partner:**
  brings ideas, not just questions, and communicates clearly.

**Green flags and red flags**

**We'll move fast for you if**

* You build apps for fun: personal and pet projects, released or not. Show us one.
* You've led a hybrid-to-native migration, a major React Native upgrade or a New Architecture move.
* You've traced a native crash or ANR to its root cause and can tell us the story.
* You've automated a real chunk of your own job, and can show us how.
* You've set up mobile monitoring, telemetry or release checks that a team relied on.
* You've worked with web and backend teams to make shared APIs, auth or events more secure.
* You've shipped one feature on app and web on the same day, and know what it took.
* You have a view on React Native versus fully native versus other stacks, backed by numbers.

**Not a fit if**

* You've only worked in JavaScript and avoid Xcode or Android Studio.
* You close crash reports as "can't reproduce".
* You've never shipped to the app stores yourself.
* You wait to be told what to fix next.
* You only build apps when it's for work.
* You've never used AI tools beyond a chat prompt.

**What owning the app looks like**

No fixed timeline. You drive it.

1. **Know the app cold.**
   Map the app, the bridge, the release flow and the monitoring, and ship your first fixes in your first weeks.
2. **Own the roadmap.**
   Shape the native roadmap with leadership, and present the architecture, stack choice and migration order.
3. **Own the numbers.**
   Crash-free rate, ANR rate, app-open time and product telemetry each have a baseline, a dashboard and a target that you set.
4. **Automate the busywork.**
   Builds, releases and checks run themselves, and app work flows through our AI-driven development process as smoothly as web work.
5. **Work as one with web and backend.**
   New features go live on app and web on the same timeline, shared APIs and auth are secure and robust, and every release passes the checks for security, accessibility, design and experiments.
6. **Become the reference point.**
   When the team debates an app or product approach, they ask what you'd do.

**What you get here**

* **Your ideas, brought to life.**
  The interests, experiments and ideas you'd normally save for a side project get to ship here, to real investors.
* **A company that stays ahead of the curve.**
  We experiment early with new technology and AI tools to build things customers love.
* **Real ownership.**
  The app, its roadmap and its architecture are yours to shape.

We're building a team where
**AI-native isn't a buzzword. It's table stakes.**
The person we hire won't just build a native app. They'll give our investors the best experience we can offer, on every screen, and make the whole team better at building for mobile.

*If you're still reading and nodding, we'd like to meet you.*

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Location: Noida

Experience: 8 to 14 years

**Role:**

We are looking for a hands-on
**Principal**
**Full Stack Architect (**
Node.Js) based to own the design and evolution of a cloud-native platform built on NestJS (TypeScript) backend and Next.JS (Frontend), Postgres SQL, Bull MQ, Redis and Microsoft Azure. You will define how our services provision, configure and manage Azure resources through an ARM-based control plane, and set the standards for reliable asynchronous processing – queue-driven workflows, idempotent operations, retries and failure recovery – across multiple engineering teams.

**Key Responsiblilties:**

This is an architecture-and-delivery role: you are responsible to lead the project, face the customer, gather the requirement and lead the development team, you will produce clear designs, review and shape critical code, and mentor engineers, write and review code and while remaining close enough to the code to prototype and validate your decisions.

**Core Architecture & platform design responsibilities:**

• Define the target architecture for NestJS microservices and APIs on Azure (App Service, Container Apps, AKS, Functions), including module boundaries, shared libraries, configuration and deployment topology.

• Establish API design standards (REST/OpenAPI, versioning, pagination, error models, long-running operation contracts) and enforce them through reviews and tooling.

• Drive non-functional design: scalability, availability, multi-region/DR, cost efficiency, observability and security by default.

**Queue, messaging & idempotency patterns Architecture Design Criteria:**

• Architect asynchronous workflows on Azure Service Bus, Storage Queues, Event Grid and Event Hubs; choose the right broker and semantics (at-least-once, ordering via sessions, dead-lettering, TTL, scheduled delivery).

• Define and standardise idempotency: idempotency keys, deduplication windows, idempotent consumers, inbox/outbox, transactional outbox with the database, and exactly-once-effect designs.

• Design retry and failure handling: exponential backoff with jitter, poison-message handling, circuit breakers, compensating actions (saga), and replay tooling.

• Apply durable orchestration patterns (Durable Functions or equivalent) for long-running, multi-step provisioning with correct state, timeouts and cancellation.

**Leadership & delivery**

• Author architecture decision records (ADRs), HLD/LLD documents and reference implementations; lead design reviews.

• Mentor senior engineers, raise engineering standards, and partner with product, security, SRE and FinOps stakeholders.

• Guide CI/CD (Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions), IaC pipelines, testing strategy (unit, contract, integration, chaos) and production readiness reviews.

title: SSE / Tech Lead (Python + React)
description:
**DXFactor**
is looking for
**SSE / Tech Lead (Python + React)**

**DXFactor**
is a US-based tech company working with fortune 500 customers across the globe.

We have our presence in:

* **US**
* **India (Ahmedabad, Bangalore)**

**Web-site:**
www.DXFactor.com

**Location**
: Ahmedabad

**Employment Type**
: Full Time

**Profile summary**

The Senior Software Engineer / Tech Lead is a hands-on engineer who builds across the full stack and ships AI agents into production. The role owns features end to end, spanning backend services, web applications, cloud infrastructure and the AI layer, and sets the technical standard for a small engineering team. The successful candidate writes code daily, reviews the team's work, and treats AI-assisted development as a core part of how software is planned, built and tested.

**Key responsibilities**

* Build across the stack.
* Design and develop backend services in Python and Node.js, and the web applications on top of them, choosing the right tool for each problem rather than defaulting to one stack.
* Design and ship AI agents.
* Build LLM-powered agents that take real actions: define their tools and function-calling logic, orchestrate multi-step workflows, and design how they recover when a step fails.
* Make AI systems production-grade.
* Put guardrails, structured evaluation and monitoring around every agent, tracking quality, latency and cost per run so issues are caught before customers notice.
* Own cloud deployment and operations.
* Deploy and run services on AWS, monitor them in production, lead debugging during incidents, and keep infrastructure secure and cost-efficient.
* Lead technical design.
* Turn ambiguous requirements into clear technical plans, weigh trade offs, flag risks early, and document decisions so the team can build with confidence.
* Set the engineering bar.
* Review pull requests across the team, define coding and security standards, and mentor engineers through design problems and production issues. Build integrations that hold up.
* Connect to third-party APIs, webhooks and messaging providers, and design for their timeouts, retries and failure modes.
* Drive AI-native engineering. Use AI coding assistants daily to plan, write, test and review code, and help the team adopt the same practices with discipline.
* Work across functions. Partner with product and client-facing teams on scoping and delivery, and explain technical constraints clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

**Required qualifications**

Minimum 5 years of professional experience building and shipping production software, including hands-on work on LLM-backed or agentic systems used by real users.

**Strong Python**
: Production APIs with FastAPI or an equivalent framework, async programming, clean service layering, and meaningful test coverage. 
**JavaScript / TypeScript**
: Real experience with Node.js on the backend and/or React or a similar framework on the frontend, and comfortable moving between the two.

**Hands-on AWS**
: Has personally deployed and operated services using ECS or Lambda, S3, IAM and CloudWatch, and can diagnose why deployed behaviour differs from local.

**Agentic AI engineering**
: Has built at least one agent beyond a chat demo: tool and function calling, multi-step orchestration, prompt design under real constraints, and systematic evaluation of output quality.

**Data modelling**
: Solid with PostgreSQL and a document store such as MongoDB, including schema design, indexing and query performance on large tables.

**Engineering discipline**
: Git in a peer-reviewed pull request workflow, CI/CD, Docker, and a consistent standard of maintainable, well-documented code. 
**Ownership:**
A track record of taking problems from an unclear requirement to production and staying accountable after release.

**Strong written English:**
Writes concise plans, updates and reviews, and is comfortable working with US-based stakeholders.

**Preferred qualifications**

* Retrieval-augmented generation: embeddings, vector search, and grounding agents in client supplied documents.
* Voice or messaging agents, including telephony APIs, speech-to-text and text-to-speech.
* Experience leading or mentoring engineers, formally or informally.
* Microfrontends, Angular or NestJS.
* Infrastructure as code, security hardening, or AWS cost optimisation.
* Multi-tenant B2B SaaS experience, including tenant isolation and the handling of customer personal data.

**:**

Shortlisted candidates will be asked to demonstrate solutions they have personally developed or implemented, particularly in SharePoint, Power Automate and Copilot Studio / AI agents. Certifications and theoretical knowledge alone will not be sufficient.

Lead an important digital transformation initiative, work on real-world AI applications across construction and manufacturing, and help shape how a growing EPC organisation uses technology for the future.

title: Senior Workday Integration Developer
description:
**Ready to be a Titan?**

ServiceTitan's G&A Systems & Integrations team is looking for a Senior Workday Integration Engineer to join our growing integration and automation practice. This role is our primary builder on Workday-native tooling, owning the design and delivery of solutions in Workday Studio, Workday Orchestrate, and Workday Extend. You will support People Tech & HCM workflows as well as Finance workflows (Procure-to-Pay, General Ledger, Tax, and Treasury).

We are not looking for an order taker. You will partner with Finance, People Tech, and the US-based BT team to advise on the best way to solve a problem, including when to use Studio, Orchestrate, Extend, or an external automation platform, and why. You'll collaborate daily with US stakeholders and offshore teammates. This is a high-autonomy role for someone who takes ownership end-to-end and wants to keep complex Finance and People operations running reliably.

**What you'll do:**

* **Workday-Native Integration Development:** Design, build, test, and deploy integrations using Workday Studio, EIBs, and Core Connectors. Own the full lifecycle from requirements through production support.
* **Workday Orchestrate:** Build and maintain multi-step orchestrations that automate cross-system and in-platform workflows.
* **Workday Extend:** Design and build custom Extend applications and extensions that close functional gaps and improve the experience for HR, Finance, and employee users.
* **HCM Integration Ownership:** Own integration coverage for People Tech & HCM, including HR data feeds, Benefits carrier integrations, Payroll connectors, and talent/recruiting platform integrations.
* **Finance Integration Coverage:** Support integrations across P2P, GL, Tax (e.g., Avalara, Vertex), and Treasury, including bank and reconciliation feeds and intercompany data flows.
* **Solution Design & Advisory:** Translate business requirements into technical designs, recommend the right tool and pattern for each need, and apply consistent design standards and reusable components.
* **Workato Collaboration:** Work alongside the automation team on Workato recipes where integrations span non-Workday systems.
* **Troubleshooting & Incident Response:** Monitor and triage production integrations (including critical payroll and benefits file feeds), resolve failures and data discrepancies independently, and document root cause and preventive actions.
* **Documentation & Knowledge Transfer:** Create runbooks, integration specs, and technical documentation so the offshore and US teams can support what you build.

**What you'll bring:**
----------------------

  

* 5-8 years of enterprise integration engineering experience with a meaningful focus on Workday (HCM and/or Financials).
* Deep, hands-on expertise with Workday Studio. You have built custom Studio integrations, EIBs, and Core Connectors in production and are strong in XSLT, document transformation, and error handling.
* Hands-on experience with Workday Orchestrate, having built or maintained production orchestrations.
* Hands-on experience with Workday Extend, having designed and built or deployed Extend apps (or strong working depth with a clear ramp path).
* Strong working knowledge of Workday HCM (Core HCM, Benefits, Payroll) and the Workday data model, plus solid understanding of Financials processes (P2P, R2R, Banking & Settlement).
* Experience with REST/SOAP APIs, OAuth 2.0, SFTP, and PGP encryption patterns common in HCM and Finance integrations.
* Proven ability to evaluate options, recommend an approach, and explain tradeoffs to technical and non-technical stakeholders. You push back when it's the right call.
* Ability to independently manage projects from scoping through delivery with minimal direction.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, comfortable working with HR, Finance, Tax, and Treasury partners.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field; equivalent experience accepted.

**NICE TO HAVE**
----------------

* Experience with Workato (production recipes, error handling and retry logic, reusable connector libraries). This is a plus, not a requirement.
* Workday certification in Integrations, Extend, or Financials/HCM modules.
* Familiarity with tax compliance or automation platforms such as Avalara or Vertex.
* Exposure to MuleSoft or comparable iPaaS platforms.
* Familiarity with Snowflake, SQL, or BI tooling for integration validation and data tracing.
* Experience working in an onshore/offshore delivery model.
* Experience in a SaaS or high-growth technology company.

‌

**Be Human With Us:**

Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us.
  
  
**Use of AI Technology:**

We use technology, including automated and AI-assisted tools, to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams.

At ServiceTitan, we celebrate individuality and uniqueness. We believe that the convergence of fresh perspectives and experiences from all walks of life is what makes our product and culture so great. We do not discriminate against employees based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity or expression, age, disability, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

description:

----------------------

description:

JD

Configure and develop the ServiceNow FSO Complaint Management solution supporting M&T's end-to-end complaints lifecycle, from customer complaint intake through investigation, remediation, communication and controlled closure.

Key responsibilities

\* Configure and extend ServiceNow FSO Complaint Management.

\* Develop complaint intake and case-management workflows.

\* Implement omnichannel complaint capture and normalize incoming complaints into a governed taxonomy.

\* Configure customer/product/account context, classification, prioritization and routing.

\* Build SLA and regulatory-clock controls.

\* Implement investigation workflows, evidence capture, approvals and escalations.

\* Develop integrations with banking/payment, CRM, Customer 360, document, fraud and analytics systems.

\* Develop APIs, business rules, flows and reusable ServiceNow components.

\* Support unit, integration, regression and UAT testing.

\* Participate in release management, defect resolution and production readiness.

\* Maintain secure and auditable complaint history.

Mandatory skills

\* Hands-on ServiceNow development

\* ServiceNow FSO

\* Complaint Management / Case Management

\* Flow Designer / workflow development

\* Business Rules, scripting and integration

\* REST APIs / integration patterns

\* ServiceNow security and data controls

\* Testing and release management

\* Banking/payments/dispute-management understanding

The M&T scope specifically brings together ServiceNow platform engineering and banking payment/dispute case management, rather than treating this as a generic ServiceNow developer position.

Target profile: 5-8+ years ServiceNow experience, with direct FSO or financial-services case-management implementation highly preferred.

2. Complaint Management / CLM implementation

3. Banking / regulated financial-services experience

4. Case management and workflow implementation

6. ServiceNow integrations and platform engineering

7. For AI Engineer: GenAI + ServiceNow implementation experience

For the AI Engineer, I'd accept less direct CLM experience only if the candidate has strong ServiceNow + production GenAI engineering experience.

One important point: I would not advertise these as ordinary ServiceNow ITSM roles. The differentiator M&T is testing in the RFI is whether the supplier has experience implementing the Financial Services Operations Complaint Management Module for financial institutions.

You become a member of one of our Agile-based project teams, focusing on product development. It is an exciting opportunity to design and implement solutions for enterprise level systems.
  
We are seeking a highly motivated and technically proficient Development Manager to lead a team of software engineers responsible for the development, maintenance, and support of one or more products or services. The ideal candidate will be a hands-on leader who fosters innovation, drives engineering excellence, and ensures high team productivity through Agile practices and modern technology adoption, including AI.
  
  
What the role offers
  
  

* Lead and manage a team of 5–10 engineers across development, maintenance, and support functions.
* You will work in an inspiring and fast paced environment with awesome colleagues designing systems from ideas to running products.
* Set clear goals, conduct regular performance reviews, and provide coaching and career development support.
* Promote a collaborative and inclusive team culture that encourages innovation and continuous improvement.
* Guide team members within established organizational policies and ensure alignment with business objectives.
* Drive the adoption of modern engineering practices including CI/CD, DevOps, automated testing, and secure coding standards.
* Ensure high-quality deliverables through code reviews, design reviews, and technical mentoring.
* Apply specialized technical knowledge to solve complex problems and implement scalable solutions.

Agile Delivery& Process Management

* Own sprint planning, backlog grooming, and release management in collaboration with Product Owners and stakeholders.

Technology& Innovation
  
  

* Stay abreast of emerging technologies and trends, especially in AI, cloud computing, and software architecture.
* Encourage experimentation and prototyping to evaluate new tools, frameworks, and approaches.
* Identify opportunities to integrate AI/ML into products and processes to enhance functionality and efficiency.

Product Ownership& Stakeholder Engagement
  
  

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Product Management, QA, and Support to ensure end-to-end delivery.
* Translate business requirements into technical execution plans and ensure alignment with strategic goals.
* Provide input into product roadmaps, architecture decisions, and long-term planning.

Operational Excellence
  
  

* Make day-to-day decisions that impact project effectiveness, resource allocation, and delivery outcomes.
* Analyze ambiguous and complex issues using data-driven approaches and business context.
* Ensure adherence to operational policies and compliance standards in all development activities.

Productivity& Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Implement tools and practices that improve team productivity and reduce technical debt.
* Track and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) related to team output, quality, and customer satisfaction.
* Foster a culture of learning through knowledge sharing, training, and retrospectives.

**You are great at:**  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* 10+ years of relevant experience in software development, with 2+ years in a leadership role.
* Proven experience in Agile environments and managing cross-functional teams.
* Strong understanding of software architecture, cloud platforms, and AI technologies.
* Excellent communication, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

**Technologies in use:**  

* Front-End: JavaScript, React/Angular/Vue, HTML/CSS
* Back-End: Java, SpringBoot, REST, Node.js, Python,
* API design (REST/GraphQL)
* Databases: SQL (PostgreSQL/MySQL), NoSQL (MongoDB)
* DevOps: Git, CI/CD (Jenkins/GitHub Actions), Docker, Kubernetes
* Cloud: AWS, Azure, or GCP; Serverless& Infrastructure as Code
* Agile Tools: JIRA, Confluence; Scrum/Kanban practices
* Security: Secure coding, OAuth/JWT, compliance awareness
* AI& Automation: Basic AI/ML concepts, integration of AI APIs
* Architecture: Microservices, system design, scalability
* Collaboration: Code reviews, documentation, mentoring
* Data& Analytics: Understanding of data pipelines, dashboards, and reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau); ability to guide data-driven decision-making and integrate analytics into products.

One last thing
  
  
As a part of opentext engineering team, you will work in an atmosphere which inspires innovation, collaboration and team work. Our innovations are driven by our customers' challenges and opportunities across a variety of businesses. While we have accomplished successful projects across most industries, we provide deep domain expertise for a defined set of core industries. Welcome to the data inspired future!
  
  
OpenText's efforts to build an inclusive work environment go beyond simply complying with applicable laws. Our Employment Equity and Diversity Policy provides direction on maintaining a working environment that is inclusive of everyone, regardless of culture, national origin, race, color, gender, gender identification, sexual orientation, family status, age, veteran status, disability, religion, or other basis protected by applicable laws.
  
If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please contact us athr@opentext.com. Our proactive approach fosters collaboration, innovation, and personal growth, enriching OpenText's vibrant workplace.

title: STIBO STEP Jr Developer
description:
**Company Description**

**Bosch Global Software Technologies Private Limited** is a 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH, one of the world's leading global supplier of technology and services, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT and Business Solutions. With over 27,000+ associates, it’s the largest software development center of Bosch, outside Germany, indicating that it is the Technology Powerhouse of Bosch in India with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe and the Asia Pacific region.

 **Job Description**

**Roles & Responsibilities :**  
  
**Role Overview**

The STIBO STEP Developer designs, configures, develops, tests and supports MDM/PIM capabilities on the STEP platform. The role combines hands-on application development with requirement analysis, integration delivery, troubleshooting, performance analysis and collaboration with global application stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Analyze customer requirements with functional consultants, architects and product owners, and translate them into technical designs.
* Configure and enhance STEP data models, attributes, references, classifications, hierarchies, workflows, Web UIs and search experiences.
* Develop global business rules, business actions and business conditions using JavaScript/Rhino scripting.
* Build and maintain inbound, outbound and gateway integrations using REST, SOAP, IDOC, XML/JSON, SFTP or messaging patterns.
* Configure import/export processes, bulk updates, data transformations, XSLT and STEP XML structures.
* Implement matching, linking, golden-record and data-quality logic according to approved designs.
* Import and process structured or partly structured data while ensuring validation, traceability and error handling.
* Diagnose root causes of application, interface and data-processing errors and implement sustainable corrective actions.
* Perform application and performance analyses to support availability, scalability and reliability.
* Write unit tests, support integration testing and UAT, manage defects and maintain technical documentation.
* Use version-control, packaging and deployment practices to promote changes safely across environments.

 **Qualifications**

**Core STIBO STEP and Technical Skills**

* System setup, user groups, privileges and security configuration.
* STEP data modelling, attributes, attribute groups, data containers, references and complex object interactions.
* Web UI configuration, screens, sub-screens, pop-ups and workflow configuration.
* JavaScript/Rhino scripting, Java fundamentals, REST APIs, SOAP, XML, JSON and XSLT.
* Inbound, outbound and gateway integration endpoints; STEP API and Extension API concepts.
* Packaging hierarchies, change packaging, import/export configuration and bulk data updates.
* Matching and linking, golden records, data cleansing and maintenance.
* Linux fundamentals, Git and common file-transfer or messaging technologies.

**Preferred / Additional Skills**

* Experience with STIBO STEP PIM and integration with media/digital-asset platforms.
* Knowledge of SAP interfaces, IDOC, Solace/JMS, SFTP or ETL tools.
* Experience developing STEP custom components or extensions.
* Understanding of cloud deployment, monitoring, secure coding and automated testing practices.

**Qualifications and Competencies**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.
* Strong problem-solving, debugging and structured-thinking skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating in a distributed agile team.
* Good written and verbal communication, with an affinity for master data and digital content.

 **Additional Information**

Experience Developer: 3-5 years

Platform STIBO STEP

Domain MDM / Product Master(Material Master)

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
**The Company**

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

**Job Summary:**

Meet our team
  
  
Every time a PayPal customer checks out, signs up or moves money, a decision gets made in milliseconds. Enterprise Decision Management (EDM) is the platform that makes those decisions. We build the engine that teams across PayPal use to write, test and ship decision logic. Changes go live in hours, not release cycles, at a scale few companies ever see.
  
  
EDM is growing fast. More teams and use cases move onto the platform every quarter, and we're building out our engineering hub in Bangalore to match. You'll work side by side with colleagues in San Jose and Shanghai on high-throughput, low-latency systems, from the authoring experience to the rule engine running in production across multiple clouds and the insights that show how every decision performs. On this platform a decision is the product, your code sits on PayPal's critical path, and the problems get bigger as we grow. Come help build what's next.

**Job Description:**

**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Acts as a project or system leader, coordinating the activities of other engineers on the project or within the system
* Determines the technical tasks that other engineers will follow
* Actions result in the achievement of customer, operational, program or service objectives
* Proactively improves existing structures & processes
* Exercises judgement in reconciling diverse and competing priorities (time, quality, complexity risk) to identify optimal solutions to problems
* Notices patterns and condenses repetition into densely meaningful generalized solutions
* Collaborates with management to set/improve standards for engineering rigor
* Trusted to represent PayPal, Inc to the outside world via interactions with partners, customers, or industry organizations
  

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications****:**

* **Java Development:** 6+ years of hands-on Java experience architecting and building decision engines, rule execution systems, and DSL runtime environments at scale.
* **Rule DSL Design & Development:** Deep experience designing and building rule-based systems on custom DSLs, using ANTLR or similar parser-generator frameworks, including grammar design, compilation, and runtime execution.
* **Apache Kafka & Stream Processing:** 4+ years of deep, hands-on experience with the Kafka ecosystem, designing high-throughput, low-latency streaming and event-driven architectures.
* **Technical Leadership:** Proven track record of owning architecture direction across teams and leading cross-org initiatives end to end. Experienced in mentoring senior engineers, shaping long-term technical strategy, and building alignment with stakeholders on complex design decisions.
* **Kubernetes & Container Orchestration:** 3+ years designing, deploying, and operating Kubernetes environments, including deployment pipelines, scaling strategies, and cluster operations.
* **GCP & Data Management:** 3+ years building and operating cloud-native applications on GCP (GKE, and Dataproc for scheduled jobs). Strong SQL skills and experience with relational databases, BigQuery, and Bigtable for data extraction, transformation, and analysis.
* **Python Backend Services:** 3+ years designing and implementing Python backend services for collaborative rule authoring, API development, and platform tooling.
* **Agentic Systems:** Working knowledge of agentic architectures, including tool use, MCP, multi-step workflows, and evaluation. Ability to identify where they can be applied to rule authoring and platform automation, and to drive those efforts.
* **AI-Assisted Development:** Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to speed up design, development, testing, and code review, with good judgment about when and how to use them. Able to set practices for using them across the team.
* **Frontend Development (React):** Experience building React applications, ideally control-plane UIs for rule authoring, review, and deployment. Strong understanding of governance workflows such as approvals, versioning, audit trails, and role-based access control.

**Subsidiary:**

PayPal

**Travel Percent:**

0

PayPal does not charge candidates any fees for courses, applications, resume reviews, interviews, background checks, or onboarding. When making an application directly, we will never ask you to share passwords, one-time passcodes (OTP), or verification codes. Any such request is a red flag and likely part of a scam. All communication regarding your application will come from official PayPal email domains. If you suspect fraudulent activity, please report it immediately. To learn more about how to identify and avoid recruitment fraud please visit https://careers.pypl.com/contact-us.

For the majority of employees, PayPal's balanced hybrid work model offers 3 days in the office for effective in-person collaboration and 2 days at your choice of either the PayPal office or your home workspace, ensuring that you equally have the benefits and conveniences of both locations.

**Our Benefits:**

At PayPal, we’re committed to building an equitable and inclusive global economy. And we can’t do this without our most important asset-you. That’s why we offer comprehensive, choice-based programs, to support all aspects of personal wellbeing—physical, emotional, and financial—delivering meaningful value where it matters most. We strive to create a flexible, balanced work culture with a holistic approach to benefits, including generous paid time off, healthcare coverage for you and your family, and resources to create financial security and support your mental health.

**Who We Are:**

  

**Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**

PayPal provides equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. In addition, PayPal will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you are unable to submit an application because of incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at paypalglobaltalentacquisition@paypal.com.

**Belonging at PayPal:**

Our employees are central to advancing our mission, and we strive to create an environment where everyone can do their best work with a sense of purpose and belonging. Belonging at PayPal means creating a workplace with a sense of acceptance and security where all employees feel included and valued. We are proud to have a diverse workforce reflective of the merchants, consumers, and communities that we serve, and we continue to take tangible actions to cultivate inclusivity and belonging at PayPal.

Any general requests for consideration of your skills, please Join our Talent Community.

We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don’t hesitate to apply.

description:

Here, security is an enabler of innovation, not a barrier. We believe in a culture of shared ownership, continuous learning, and psychological safety where diverse perspectives thrive. You will partner side-by-side with talented engineers, architects, and product innovators to pioneer secure-by-default cloud designs, agentic AI workflows, and modern DevSecOps practices on a global scale.
  
  
**Your Impact:**  

* Build cutting-edge AI agent workflows to automate alert triage, threat modeling, evidence collection, and guided incident response with built-in human-in-the-loop guardrails.
* Design and implement robust, secure-by-default AWS cloud foundations—advancing IAM least privilege, data encryption, network segmentation, and automated guardrails.
* Build seamless CI/CD automation with GitHub Actions, Terraform, and container security tooling (SAST/DAST/SCA, SBOMs, artifact signing) to empower developers to ship fast and securely.
* Partner early with engineering teams to conduct pragmatic threat modeling across microservices, APIs, Kubernetes, and AI/LLM applications.
* Streamline audit readiness and operational workflows for frameworks like SOC 2, FedRAMP, and ISO 27001 using Python, APIs, and Infrastructure-as-Code.

**Minimum Qualifications (Must-Have Skills):**  
We are looking for a DevSecOps Engineer with 7+ years of hands-on experience in Cloud Security, Application Security, or Software Engineering. Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience welcome.
  
  

* Proven experience securing AWS multi-account environments, including IAM policies, SCPs, WAF, KMS, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, and Security Hub.
* Solid scripting and automation capability inPython (or Go/Bash) with hands-onTerraform (IaC) andGitHub Actions (CI/CD pipelines).
* Experience performing security architecture reviews, threat modeling, and integrating vulnerability scanning into software delivery lifecycles.
* Daily comfort using AI coding assistants and modern developer tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, LLMs) to accelerate daily workflows.
* Strong communication and teamwork skills, with a track record of partnering empathetically with developers to solve security challenges.

**Preferred Qualifications (Optional Skills):**  

* Securing generative AI apps, prompt guardrails, and agent tool permissions.
* Automating audit evidence for SOC 2, FedRAMP, ISO 27001, or IRAP/ISMAP.
* Hands-on with SBOMs, provenance, and artifact signing (e.g., Sigstore/Cosign).
* Experience with SIEM logging, detection engineering, and incident triage.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. title: AWS Connect Administrator
description:
**AWS Connect Administrator**

We are looking for a skilled AWS Connect Administrator to manage, support, and enhance our Amazon Connect contact center environment. In this role, you will be responsible for day-to-day administration, call routing, contact flows, agent configurations, troubleshooting, and the reliability of customer-facing voice and digital support channels.

You will partner with TSD, IT support teams, business stakeholders, and AWS specialists to translate operational requirements into effective contact center workflows. You will also maintain integrations with supporting business applications and services, including APIs, automation functions, and reporting tools.

The ideal candidate has hands-on Amazon Connect experience, strong diagnostic and scripting skills, and an understanding of how telephony configuration, interactive voice response (IVR), queues, staffing, and downstream applications affect the customer and agent experience.

Responsibilities include configuring and improving inbound and outbound contact handling, developing and maintaining IVR flows, supporting integrations using AWS Lambda and other AWS services, monitoring performance, and documenting operational procedures and system changes.

If you enjoy managing cloud contact center technology, solving complex routing problems, and improving both agent efficiency and customer experience, we encourage you to apply for this opportunity.

**Responsibilities**

· Administer Amazon Connect instances, including users, security profiles, routing profiles, queues, hours of operation, phone numbers, contact flows, and agent settings.

· Design, test, deploy, and maintain IVR and contact routing workflows, including self-service, transfers, callbacks, and exception handling.

· Troubleshoot call quality, failed or misrouted contacts, agent status, connectivity, contact flow errors, and production incidents; coordinate timely restoration and escalation.

· Configure and maintain Amazon Lex conversational experiences and AWS Lambda integrations when needed to support automated caller interactions and business processes.

· Administer and support the existing Amazon Connect integration with Zendesk, including agent workflows, call-to-ticket interactions, contact context, and the integration platform used to connect the systems.

· Troubleshoot cross-platform issues involving Amazon Connect and Zendesk; coordinate configuration changes, vendor escalation, integration testing, and incident resolution with Zendesk and internal support teams.

· Use AWS services such as CloudWatch, S3, IAM, DynamoDB, and SNS, as applicable, to support observability, storage, access controls, and contact center operations.

· Configure and maintain call recording, retention settings, permissions, and other controls in accordance with organizational privacy, security, and compliance requirements.

· Monitor contact center health, routing outcomes, agent experience, and operational reports; recommend improvements based on contact and performance data.

· Partner with business owners and support leaders to gather requirements, evaluate workflow changes, and improve customer self-service and agent efficiency.

· Coordinate change testing, releases, rollback plans, and post-deployment validation for contact flow and integration updates.

· Maintain accurate documentation of architecture, contact flows, integrations, configurations, incident resolutions, and operational runbooks.

· Work with AWS support, vendors, developers, and internal IT teams to investigate platform issues and implement reliable, scalable improvements.

**Requirements**

· Hands-on experience administering or engineering Amazon Connect in a production contact center environment.

· Strong understanding of contact flows, IVR design, queue-based routing, agent configuration, and contact center operations.

· Experience diagnosing Amazon Connect routing, telephony, integration, and performance issues.

· Working knowledge of AWS IAM, Lambda, CloudWatch, S3, and related services commonly used with Amazon Connect.

· Ability to read, troubleshoot, or develop scripts and API integrations using Python or JavaScript/Node.js.

· Familiarity with Amazon Lex, CRM/ticketing integrations, and contact center reporting or analytics.

· Familiarity with Zendesk Support, its agent and ticket workflows, and its integration with Amazon Connect is highly desired; hands-on experience supporting the associated integration platform is a strong plus.

· Understanding of role-based access, customer data protection, change management, and secure cloud operations.

· Strong analytical, documentation, communication, and stakeholder collaboration skills.

· Ability to manage competing operational priorities and respond effectively to production-impacting incidents.

· AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate, Amazon Connect training/certification, or comparable practical experience is a plus.

Potential Interview Questions

· Walk us through an Amazon Connect contact flow you designed or significantly improved. What business problem did it solve?

· How would you diagnose calls entering the correct phone number but reaching the wrong queue or agent?

· What steps would you take if callers suddenly encountered errors in an IVR after a release?

· How have you integrated Amazon Connect with Zendesk or another ticketing platform, and how would you troubleshoot missing customer or ticket context during a call?

· How would you use Amazon Lex to improve self-service while preserving a reliable path to a live agent?

· Which CloudWatch logs, metrics, and Amazon Connect reports would you examine when investigating contact center issues?

· How would you structure security profiles and IAM permissions to protect recordings and sensitive customer information?

· Describe how you would plan, test, deploy, and roll back a high-impact change to contact routing.

· How would you evaluate a request from support leadership to improve wait times or reduce unnecessary transfers?

· What documentation and operational controls would you establish so another administrator could support the contact center?

title: Agentic AI Orchestrator
description:
**Job Summary**

The Agentic AI Orchestrator designs, builds, and operates the Investment Division's agentic AI workflows—the automated, multi-step processes through which AI agents read documents, reconcile data, draft analysis, and assemble reporting across the division's clusters. The role converts analyst workflows into orchestrated agent pipelines with human review gates, owns the division's prompt, skill, and agent library, and is accountable for the accuracy, auditability, and cost of every automated output.

The position anchors the division's AI-led operating model from the Chennai office, working alongside the Data Engineer (data pipelines and infrastructure) and the ML Engineer (models and evaluation), and serves as the bridge between the investment analysts and the division's AI tooling

**ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

1. Design, build, and operate agentic AI workflows for the division's recurring processes: document extraction and reconciliation, portfolio and company performance monitoring, report and IC pack assembly, and data-room processing.

2. Translate analyst and reporting workflows into orchestrated multi-agent pipelines with defined human review gates, so that no figure or recommendation is published without analyst sign-off.

3. Own the division's prompt, skill, agent, and plugin library: design, versioning, testing, and documentation, ensuring workflows are reusable across clusters rather than one-off chats.

4. Integrate agents with the division's systems and data sources — document repositories, custodian and administrator reporting, and the division's knowledge base — working with the Data Engineer on pipelines and access.

5. Build and run evaluation harnesses with the ML Engineer: accuracy benchmarks against verified ground truth, regression testing on workflow changes, and periodic audits of automated outputs.

6. Implement AI governance and guardrails: access controls and confidentiality boundaries for family and portfolio data, audit trails for every automated output, and compliance with the Group's AI usage policies.

7. Monitor agent performance, cost, latency, and failure modes; triage incidents, maintain runbooks, and drive continuous improvement of workflow reliability.

8. Train and support the division's analysts in AI-assisted working practices; capture their feedback and convert it into a prioritised automation backlog.

9. Maintain complete documentation of all orchestrated workflows, their data sources, model versions, and review controls, ensuring every automated output is reproducible and auditable.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Minimum Education Required**

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related quantitative field.

• Strong Python engineering skills: API integration, data handling, and production-quality code with testing and version control (Git).

• Hands-on experience building LLM-based and agentic systems in production: workflow orchestration, tool and function calling, and multi-agent patterns — using frameworks such as LangGraph or LangChain, or SDK-native orchestration (e.g. Claude Agent SDK). Framework experience matters less than sound orchestration design.

• Practical RAG experience: document chunking, embeddings, vector databases (e.g. pgvector, Pinecone, Qdrant, or similar), hybrid search, and retrieval evaluation.

• Experience building or integrating MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and tools, or equivalent connector architectures linking AI agents to enterprise systems and data sources.

• Familiarity with LLM evaluation and observability tooling (accuracy benchmarks, regression tests, tracing); disciplined prompt and skill engineering with versioning and documentation.

• Understanding of data privacy, access control, and audit requirements for confidential financial data; exposure to investment or financial reporting workflows preferred.

**Years of experience are required.**

• Minimum of 4 to 7 years of experience in software or AI engineering, of which at least 2 years hands-on with LLM-based or agentic systems in production, at a technology firm, financial institution, or data-driven enterprise.

title: Principal Engineer
description:
**Why this role exists**

Our engineering team is young. We have about 30 engineers, six new team leads and one senior

architect. The leads are good builders who have not led before. They need someone to learn from

every day.

AI agents now write a large share of our code. Design, review and judgement have become the

scarce skills. This role brings them.

**About Company**

We build customised holidays for Indian travellers. We have done this for over 12 years

from Chennai.

A traveller plans a trip with us, a seller helps them decide, and our team delivers it on the ground.

Technology runs through all of it: the website and app, the sales funnel, pricing and supply,

booking, and everything after booking.

**How tech is organised**

You report to Chief Architect. The six team leads look to you for every technical

call.

**The roles you will play**

1. Guide to the six leads. You review their designs and code, and you pair with them on the hard

problems. Every lead gets your time every week.

2. Keeper of standards. You set how we design APIs, test, release and code with AI agents.

Then you make sure it is followed.

3. Builder. You stay hands-on. Expect a good part of your week in code.

4. Chief Architect's partner on architecture. You work with him on data unification and on the API layer

that our website, partners and agents all use.

5. Owner of one critical system. In your first months you own one system end to end, most

likely payments.

6. Hiring bar. You interview engineers and decide who is good enough.

**What you will not do:**

• Manage people. Appraisals and staffing stay with the founder.

• Set AI direction. That sits with the AI head. You make sure agents call our systems safely.

Your first 90 days

• By day 30: you know the codebase, the six leads and where each team is stuck. You have

shipped one fix or feature yourself.

• By day 60: design reviews run every week with every lead. Our standards for APIs, tests and

releases are written down and in use.

• By day 90: one critical system is fully yours. Each lead can name one thing they do better

because of you.

**What we look for**

• 8 to 12 years of building software, full stack with most of it in backend.

• Our stack: Java and Spring Boot, MongoDB, React.

• Time spent on systems where a mistake costs money: booking, payments, fintech or

commerce.

• You code with AI agents every day, and you can show us how.

• The role is in Chennai.

The three skills that matter most:

1. Backend system design.

2. API and data modelling.

3. Code review and debugging across the stack.

The one quality: you enjoy making other engineers better. A teacher's patience matters more here

than being the best coder in the room.

The opportunity

• Six leads grow because of you. That is how we will measure this role.

• You shape how a team builds with AI agents. We are early, and the habits you set will stay.

• The problems are real. Live pricing and supply, bookings that cannot fail, voice AI in sales,

and post-booking work that runs without people.

**What is coming up:**

• One unified data layer across our systems.

• A Holidays API that banks and partners sell from.

• A new product for travellers outside India.

• A CTO decision. We have not hired one. We will decide once this structure settles, and

whoever does this role well is part of that conversation

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Strategic Process Analysis:**
  Lead diagnostics across end-to-end RCM processes including front-end (patient access), mid-cycle (coding, billing), and back-end (collections, denials). Use deep domain expertise to assess structural inefficiencies, policy-level gaps, and tech adoption maturity. Prioritize transformation levers based on business value, client pain points, and operational feasibility.
* **Enterprise Process Transformation:**
  Drive portfolio-level transformation programs with clearly defined KPIs (e.g., net collections %, denial resolution TAT, AR aging). Obtain sponsor sign off on key strategic initiatives such as predictive denials, automation at scale, or AI-powered quality checks. Co-create transformation roadmaps with leadership, aligning with client goals and compliance mandates like HIPAA, CMS guidelines, etc.
* **Lean Six Sigma Leadership:**
  Mentor and lead Green Belt/Black Belt projects across global delivery teams. Institutionalize a culture of continuous improvement using DMAIC, Kaizen, and value stream mapping. Ensure all improvement efforts tie directly to measurable outcomes in efficiency, cost reduction, quality, or compliance.
* **Advanced Project Management:**
  Lead transformation governance, define success criteria, and ensure delivery through PMO standards. Engage in regular executive reviews, risk mitigation, stakeholder alignment, and benefit realization tracking. Manage multi-region initiatives across diverse provider clients, tech teams, and operational leads.

Drive adoption of data visualization tools and KPI dashboards at the ops and leadership levels. Leverage TMS, root cause analytics, and ML-based insights to drive strategic decision-making.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in science (Preferably in Biology, Microbiology, Biotechnology, Pharma) or a related field.
* 13 to 15 years of experience in Revenue Cycle Management/ US Provider industry with a strong focus on process improvement, digital transformation
* Atleast 10 years of experience in project management, client management

**Certifications**

* Black Belt or atleast Green Belt
* Project Management (Good to have)
* Claude and GenAI certifications (Good to have)

* **Executive Communication:**
  Skilled in presenting to CXO audiences and simplifying complex initiatives.
* **Operational Leadership:**
  Proven track record of driving change in matrixed environments with measurable impact.
* **Innovation Leadership:**
  Ability to drive and manage digital-first process improvement strategies (AI, RPA, ML)
* **GenAI & Agentic AI Transformation**
  – Ability to identify, design, prototype and scale AI-led solutions using platforms such as Claude, while connecting technology innovation to process transformation, adoption and measurable business value

**Skills:**

* **Advanced Process Improvement:**
  Expertise in Lean, Six Sigma (Green Belt/Black Belt preferred), Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping, and root cause analysis (RCA) techniques for systemic improvements.
* **Project & Change Management:**
  Strong command over project management tools and methodologies (e.g., Agile, PMI, JIRA, Smartsheet). Capable of driving change management through stakeholder alignment, training, and adoption tracking.
* **Data Analytics & Decision Support:**
  Proficient in Excel, Power BI/Tableau for analysis, reporting, and dashboarding. Experience using statistical tools like Minitab or R for deeper analytics. Ability to use data to build ROI models, process performance trackers, and improvement hypotheses.
* **Digital Enablement Experience:**
  Familiarity with automation tools (e.g., UIPath, Automation Anywhere), AI/ML-powered insights, and digital quality assurance systems (e.g., conversational analytics, NLP for call audits).
* **Operational Knowledge of RCM**
  : Deep understanding of U.S. provider RCM processes including Patient Access, Coding, Billing, Payment Posting, AR, Denials, and Compliance.
* **Process Documentation & SOP Creation:**
  Skilled in documenting AS-IS/TO-BE workflows/swimlanes using MS Visio, Lucidchart, or similar tools
* **Excellent Communication & Stakeholder Engagement:**
  Strong executive presence with the ability to present transformation outcomes to CXOs and client leadership.
* **Multi-Project Leadership:**
  Experience in leading and overseeing multiple concurrent transformation projects across regions, balancing timelines, scope, and resources effectively.
* **Compliance & Risk Awareness:**
  Knowledge of HIPAA, PHI handling standards, and payer-provider contract obligations in process reengineering.
* **Key GenAI / Claude skills for the Transformation Lead -**
* **GenAI Fundamentals:**
  Experience with LLMs, GenAI, AI/ML, RPA and Agentic AI, including identifying appropriate business use cases.
* **Prompt Engineering:**
  Experience developing structured prompts for analysis, summarization, classification, extraction and content generation.
* **Claude Proficiency:**
  Hands-on experience using Claude for document/business analysis, research, solution design, process redesign and rapid prototyping.
* **AI Use-Case Identification:**
  Experience identifying opportunities to augment or replace human cognitive work through GenAI.
* **Agentic AI Design:**
  Experience designing agentic workflows, including orchestration, decisioning, tool integration, human-in-the-loop and single vs. multi-agent models.
* **AI-led Process Transformation:**
  Experience redesigning processes to determine the right balance of automation, agentic AI and human-led exceptions.

title: Technical Team Lead
description:
About Audit Sense

Audit Sense is an AI-powered SaaS company developing technology solutions for the Finance and Audit industry. We are looking for a hands-on Technical Team Lead to lead technical architecture, full-stack development and deployment delivery across our Subscription Management system, AuditSense application and AskAthena AI analysis product.

About the Role

The selected candidate will lead the technical team, contribute to production development, review architecture and code, and translate business requirements into scalable and maintainable software solutions.

The role involves managing existing cloud deployments and developing deployment capabilities for customer-managed on-premises and private-cloud environments. It also includes designing subscription and licensing controls across different deployment models.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Full-Stack Development & Architecture**

* Lead the development of React frontends and TypeScript APIs using Hono and Express.
* Define application architecture, module boundaries and service integration patterns.
* Design and manage PostgreSQL databases, Prisma schemas, migrations and database performance.
* Implement database connection pooling using PgBouncer or equivalent solutions.
* Manage multi-tenant database architecture and troubleshoot database connection issues.

**2. Identity & Application Security**

* Design enterprise Single Sign-On (SSO) using OpenID Connect, OAuth 2.0 and SAML.
* Manage JWT, session authentication, MFA, RBAC/ABAC and tenant isolation.
* Apply OWASP Top 10 security practices.
* Implement secure API authentication and HMAC-signed webhooks.

**3. Deployment Architecture & DevOps**

* Manage cloud, customer on-premises and private-cloud deployment architectures.
* Provision and maintain Azure infrastructure, including VMs, networking, storage, Key Vault and monitoring.
* Develop secure customer installation packages using Docker, Docker Compose and Kubernetes/Helm where appropriate.
* Build CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Azure Pipelines.
* Implement infrastructure as code using Terraform, Bicep or Pulumi.
* Manage deployment strategies, application upgrades, rollback procedures, monitoring and production reliability.

**4. Subscription & Licensing Management**

* Architect subscription and licence management across cloud, on-premises and private-cloud deployments.
* Design installation registration, activation, renewal, expiry and suspension mechanisms.
* Implement module entitlements, user limits and usage tracking.
* Develop secure communication and synchronization between customer installations and central subscription services.
* Support licensing requirements for restricted-connectivity and offline environments.

**5. Technical Leadership & Code Review**

* Lead technical planning, task allocation, estimation and delivery coordination.
* Review application architecture and production code.
* Establish development standards, testing practices and API documentation.
* Mentor technical team members and provide guidance during implementation and production support.

Required Technical Expertise

* Strong hands-on expertise in TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Node.js, Hono and Express.
* Strong PostgreSQL and Prisma ORM expertise, including database modelling, migrations, transactions, indexing and performance tuning.
* Practical experience with PgBouncer or equivalent database connection pooling solutions.
* DevOps experience with Docker, Docker Compose, Linux, nginx, GitHub Actions and Azure Pipelines.
* Hands-on Azure infrastructure experience, including virtual machines, networking, storage, identity, secrets and monitoring.
* Experience with customer-managed on-premises or private-cloud software deployments.
* Knowledge of SaaS subscription licensing and entitlement management.
* Experience with enterprise SSO, JWT, MFA, RBAC/ABAC and application security.
* Proven technical leadership, architecture decision-making and code review experience.
* Experience in automated testing, monitoring and production troubleshooting.

Preferred Experience

* Kubernetes, Helm and air-gapped customer installations.
* Infrastructure as code using Terraform, Azure Bicep or Pulumi.
* AI application integration, LLM providers, document processing and vector search.
* Redis, DBOS, ChromaDB, Microsoft Graph and enterprise audit workflows.
* Offline licensing and synchronization between central services and customer installations.

Expected Outcomes

Establish a clear technical architecture and delivery roadmap across our products, develop reliable cloud and customer-managed deployment models, implement a consistent subscription-control framework and lead the team towards maintainable software delivery and reliable releases.

* **Company:**
  Audit Sense Pvt. Ltd.

title: Site Reliability Engineer - Market Data (India, Chennai)
description:
**About GoCharting**

GoCharting is a web-native charting and trading platform. Traders use professional orderflow tools — footprint charts, volume and market profile, cumulative delta, DOM trading — to read the market and place orders through their broker, all in the browser. Our users are active traders in India, the US and around the world.

**The Role**

You will make GoCharting's live market-data and trading services reliable, by building the monitoring, alerting and runbooks yourself and by fixing the causes of outages. The role is full-time and in person in our Chennai office, and it reports to the Chief Technology Officer. Traders depend on live prices at the market open, so one engineer needs to own uptime, observability and incident response across the platform. At 12 months, our alerts should catch problems on live feeds and core services, and each incident should end in a written review and a fix.

**What you'll do**

* **Build monitoring and alerting**
  — cover live data feeds, exchange connections and core services, with alerts that name the failing part
* **Respond to incidents**
  — lead the response, restore service, and write a review that names the cause and the fix
* **Define reliability targets**
  — set service-level objectives for data freshness and uptime, and report against them weekly
* **Write runbooks**
  — document how to detect, triage and recover each critical service so any engineer on duty can follow them
* **Harden infrastructure**
  — manage cloud infrastructure as code, and remove single points of failure
* **Cover the market open**
  — join the weekly rotation for the 08:30–09:30 IST market-open window

**What we're looking for**

**Must-haves:**

* 5+ years in site reliability, DevOps or infrastructure operations on production systems
* Hands-on: you personally build monitoring, alerting and runbooks, and do not only advise
* Has run production services on a major cloud provider (AWS, DigitalOcean, Google Cloud or Azure) with Linux and containers
* Has used a metrics and alerting stack, such as Prometheus and Grafana or an equivalent
* Has been on call for a production service and written post-incident reviews
* In person in our Chennai office, 5 days a week, and able to take part in the weekly 08:30–09:30 IST market-open rotation

**Nice-to-haves:**

* Infrastructure as code with Terraform or similar (adds repeatable, reviewable infrastructure changes)
* Real-time or streaming systems, such as WebSocket feeds or Kafka (adds understanding of our main workload)
* Synthetic monitoring of user journeys from several regions (adds detection before users notice)
* Defining and tracking service-level objectives (adds a measured reliability target)
* Trading, fintech or market-data operations (adds speed in learning our domain)

**Logistics**

**Location**
Chennai, India - in person, office-based

**Employment type**
Full-time

**Entity**
ProCharting Private Limited

**Reports to**
Chief Technology Officer

**Start date**
ASAP

**Travel**
None

title: Agentic AI Orchestrator
description:
**Job Summary**

The Agentic AI Orchestrator designs, builds, and operates the Investment Division's agentic AI workflows—the automated, multi-step processes through which AI agents read documents, reconcile data, draft analysis, and assemble reporting across the division's clusters. The role converts analyst workflows into orchestrated agent pipelines with human review gates, owns the division's prompt, skill, and agent library, and is accountable for the accuracy, auditability, and cost of every automated output.

The position anchors the division's AI-led operating model from the Chennai office, working alongside the Data Engineer (data pipelines and infrastructure) and the ML Engineer (models and evaluation), and serves as the bridge between the investment analysts and the division's AI tooling

**ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

1. Design, build, and operate agentic AI workflows for the division's recurring processes: document extraction and reconciliation, portfolio and company performance monitoring, report and IC pack assembly, and data-room processing.

2. Translate analyst and reporting workflows into orchestrated multi-agent pipelines with defined human review gates, so that no figure or recommendation is published without analyst sign-off.

3. Own the division's prompt, skill, agent, and plugin library: design, versioning, testing, and documentation, ensuring workflows are reusable across clusters rather than one-off chats.

4. Integrate agents with the division's systems and data sources — document repositories, custodian and administrator reporting, and the division's knowledge base — working with the Data Engineer on pipelines and access.

5. Build and run evaluation harnesses with the ML Engineer: accuracy benchmarks against verified ground truth, regression testing on workflow changes, and periodic audits of automated outputs.

6. Implement AI governance and guardrails: access controls and confidentiality boundaries for family and portfolio data, audit trails for every automated output, and compliance with the Group's AI usage policies.

7. Monitor agent performance, cost, latency, and failure modes; triage incidents, maintain runbooks, and drive continuous improvement of workflow reliability.

8. Train and support the division's analysts in AI-assisted working practices; capture their feedback and convert it into a prioritised automation backlog.

9. Maintain complete documentation of all orchestrated workflows, their data sources, model versions, and review controls, ensuring every automated output is reproducible and auditable.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Minimum Education Required**

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related quantitative field.

• Strong Python engineering skills: API integration, data handling, and production-quality code with testing and version control (Git).

• Hands-on experience building LLM-based and agentic systems in production: workflow orchestration, tool and function calling, and multi-agent patterns — using frameworks such as LangGraph or LangChain, or SDK-native orchestration (e.g. Claude Agent SDK). Framework experience matters less than sound orchestration design.

• Practical RAG experience: document chunking, embeddings, vector databases (e.g. pgvector, Pinecone, Qdrant, or similar), hybrid search, and retrieval evaluation.

• Experience building or integrating MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and tools, or equivalent connector architectures linking AI agents to enterprise systems and data sources.

• Familiarity with LLM evaluation and observability tooling (accuracy benchmarks, regression tests, tracing); disciplined prompt and skill engineering with versioning and documentation.

• Understanding of data privacy, access control, and audit requirements for confidential financial data; exposure to investment or financial reporting workflows preferred.

**Years of experience are required.**

• Minimum of 4 to 7 years of experience in software or AI engineering, of which at least 2 years hands-on with LLM-based or agentic systems in production, at a technology firm, financial institution, or data-driven enterprise.
