title: Principal Engineer
description:
**Why this role exists**

Our engineering team is young. We have about 30 engineers, six new team leads and one senior

architect. The leads are good builders who have not led before. They need someone to learn from

every day.

AI agents now write a large share of our code. Design, review and judgement have become the

scarce skills. This role brings them.

**About Company**

We build customised holidays for Indian travellers. We have done this for over 12 years

from Chennai.

A traveller plans a trip with us, a seller helps them decide, and our team delivers it on the ground.

Technology runs through all of it: the website and app, the sales funnel, pricing and supply,

booking, and everything after booking.

**How tech is organised**

You report to Chief Architect. The six team leads look to you for every technical

call.

**The roles you will play**

1. Guide to the six leads. You review their designs and code, and you pair with them on the hard

problems. Every lead gets your time every week.

2. Keeper of standards. You set how we design APIs, test, release and code with AI agents.

Then you make sure it is followed.

3. Builder. You stay hands-on. Expect a good part of your week in code.

4. Chief Architect's partner on architecture. You work with him on data unification and on the API layer

that our website, partners and agents all use.

5. Owner of one critical system. In your first months you own one system end to end, most

likely payments.

6. Hiring bar. You interview engineers and decide who is good enough.

**What you will not do:**

• Manage people. Appraisals and staffing stay with the founder.

• Set AI direction. That sits with the AI head. You make sure agents call our systems safely.

Your first 90 days

• By day 30: you know the codebase, the six leads and where each team is stuck. You have

shipped one fix or feature yourself.

• By day 60: design reviews run every week with every lead. Our standards for APIs, tests and

releases are written down and in use.

• By day 90: one critical system is fully yours. Each lead can name one thing they do better

because of you.

**What we look for**

• 8 to 12 years of building software, full stack with most of it in backend.

• Our stack: Java and Spring Boot, MongoDB, React.

• Time spent on systems where a mistake costs money: booking, payments, fintech or

commerce.

• You code with AI agents every day, and you can show us how.

• The role is in Chennai.

The three skills that matter most:

1. Backend system design.

2. API and data modelling.

3. Code review and debugging across the stack.

The one quality: you enjoy making other engineers better. A teacher's patience matters more here

than being the best coder in the room.

The opportunity

• Six leads grow because of you. That is how we will measure this role.

• You shape how a team builds with AI agents. We are early, and the habits you set will stay.

• The problems are real. Live pricing and supply, bookings that cannot fail, voice AI in sales,

and post-booking work that runs without people.

**What is coming up:**

• One unified data layer across our systems.

• A Holidays API that banks and partners sell from.

• A new product for travellers outside India.

• A CTO decision. We have not hired one. We will decide once this structure settles, and

whoever does this role well is part of that conversation

title: Application Security Architect
description:
We are looking for an experienced Application Security Architect with 9–12 years of experience to drive application security architecture, engineering security standards and secure software development practices across Novac's fintech product ecosystem.

The candidate will be responsible for designing and implementing security architecture for enterprise-grade financial software products, ensuring security is embedded throughout the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). The role requires strong expertise in application security, secure coding, API security, cloud security, DevSecOps, threat modelling, vulnerability management, and security architecture reviews.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience securing fintech applications, digital lending platforms, loan management systems, insurance technology platforms, financial APIs, payment integrations, and enterprise software products. The candidate will work closely with Product Engineering, Software Architecture, Cloud, DevOps, and Information Security teams to ensure that Novac's products are scalable, resilient, and secure.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities:**

**Application Security Architecture**

* Establish secure architecture standards for digital banking, lending, insurance, and payment platforms.
* Define enterprise security reference architectures and reusable security patterns.
* Define security controls for AI-enabled applications and APIs.
* Assess risks relating to LLM integration, prompt injection, sensitive data exposure, and model governance.
* Review application architecture, technical designs, and business requirements to identify security risks and recommend appropriate controls.
* Drive security-by-design principles across product development and software engineering.
* Review architecture designs and provide security requirements before development begins.
* Conduct security architecture reviews for web applications, mobile applications, APIs, microservices, and cloud-based platforms.
* Define secure architecture patterns for authentication, authorization, encryption, data protection, and identity management.
* Review NFRs (Non-Functional Requirements) related to security, privacy, resilience, and compliance.
* Ensure security controls are incorporated into product architecture from the design stage.

**Secure SDLC & DevSecOps**

* Integrate security practices across all stages of the Software Development Life Cycle.
* Implement and strengthen DevSecOps practices by embedding automated security testing into CI/CD pipelines.
* Drive implementation of SAST, DAST, SCA, container security, and Infrastructure-as-Code security scanning.
* Establish secure coding guidelines and conduct application code security reviews.
* Work closely with development teams to identify, prioritise, and remediate security vulnerabilities.
* Automate security validation and vulnerability detection within software development and deployment processes.

**API & Fintech Product Security**

* Design and implement security controls for REST APIs, microservices, third-party integrations, and distributed applications.
* Ensure secure API authentication and authorisation using OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, and API gateways.
* Secure financial applications involving digital lending, loan origination, loan management, insurance workflows, and transaction processing.
* Define security controls for sensitive customer information, financial records, and transactional data.
* Ensure secure integration with banking systems, payment gateways, financial institutions, and external service providers.
* Identify and mitigate risks associated with data exposure, unauthorised access, fraud, and application-level attacks.

**Vulnerability Assessment & Threat Modelling**

* Conduct application security assessments, architecture reviews, and threat modelling exercises.
* Establish vulnerability management processes, risk classification, and remediation SLAs.
* Perform security risk assessments for new product features, application enhancements, and third-party integrations.

**Cloud & Infrastructure Application Security**

* Define and implement application security controls across AWS, Azure, or GCP environments.
* Review IAM architectures and enforce least-privilege access controls.
* Establish Zero-Trust application security principles.
* Ensure security across cloud-native applications, Docker, Kubernetes, and microservices environments.
* Implement encryption, secrets management, key management, and secure communication protocols.
* Work with cloud and DevOps teams to strengthen application deployment and runtime security.
* Ensure secure configurations and access controls across application environments.

**Security Governance & Compliance**

* Define application security policies, standards, technical guidelines, and governance frameworks.
* Ensure alignment with relevant security standards such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, and applicable RBI requirements, based on product and regulatory scope.
* Support internal and external security audits, compliance assessments, and risk reviews.
* Drive security awareness and secure coding practices across engineering teams.
* Work closely with technology leadership and product stakeholders to ensure security requirements are met.
* Define application security KPIs and maturity roadmap.
* Track:
* Vulnerability remediation SLA adherence
* Security debt
* Critical vulnerability trends
* Application security coverage
* Secure coding adoption metrics
* Present security posture and risks to senior management and technology leadership.

**Experience & Educational Qualifications**

* 9–12 years of overall experience in Application Security, Product Security, Security Engineering, or Information Security.
* Minimum 5+ years of relevant hands-on experience in application security and secure software development.
* 3+ years of experience in application security architecture, security design reviews, or security engineering leadership preferred.
* Experience securing UPI, payment gateway, and financial transaction workflows.
* Understanding of RBI Cyber Security Framework expectations.
* Knowledge of PCI DSS v4.0 requirements.
* Familiarity with data protection requirements involving customer PII, financial information, and consent management.
* Experience in a FinTech, BFSI technology, Banking Software, or Enterprise software Product Company is strongly preferred.
* Preferred Certifications (CISSP/CSSLP/CCSP).
* Proven experience in securing enterprise-grade applications, APIs, microservices, and cloud-based platforms.
* Strong understanding of modern software architecture, distributed systems, and cloud-native applications.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate should come from a FinTech, Banking Technology, Financial Software Product, or Enterprise SaaS Product Engineering Organisation.

**Candidates should have demonstrated experience in:**

* Designing and implementing application security architecture for complex software products.
* Securing digital lending, banking, payment, insurance, and transaction-based platforms.
* Implementing DevSecOps and integrating security into CI/CD pipelines.
* Conducting threat modelling, security architecture reviews, and secure code assessments.
* Securing APIs, microservices, cloud platforms, and third-party integrations.
* Working directly with software engineering and product development teams to embed security into product design and delivery.
* Certification related to application security will be an added advantage.

This role is responsible for designing, building, and scaling the foundational software platform that powers T-Mobile’s agentic AI capabilities across conversational experiences, including text and voice interactions. The engineer develops the core execution, orchestration, and integration frameworks that enable AI systems to reason, plan, act, and interact safely with enterprise services at scale, while providing technical leadership for the architecture, evolution, and scalability of the AI execution platform.

Working closely with AI/ML engineers, platform engineers, product teams, and enterprise application teams, this role focuses on building reusable platform capabilities rather than individual AI applications. Responsibilities include designing agent orchestration frameworks, workflow execution engines, SDKs, tool integration layers, memory and state management systems, and conversational runtime services that support next-generation customer and employee experiences.

Success in this role requires strong software engineering expertise, distributed systems knowledge, and practical understanding of LLM-powered systems, with an emphasis on reliability, extensibility, scalability, and platform adoption. We pride ourselves on encouraging a culture of innovation, agile ways of working, and transparency in all we do. Join us in embodying the spirit of the Un-carrier and making a tangible impact.

* Design and develop agent orchestration frameworks and execution engines supporting complex AI-driven workflows.
* Design and optimize low-latency services supporting real-time conversational and voice interactions.
* Build reusable platform services, SDKs, APIs, and libraries that accelerate development of conversational AI applications.
* Design and implement Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations and frameworks that enable secure, scalable access to enterprise tools, APIs, data sources, and agent capabilities.
* Develop reusable tool-calling, context-sharing, and interoperability services that support MCP-enabled agent ecosystems.
* Develop runtime services for text- and voice-based agent interactions, including context management, tool execution, memory, and state orchestration.
* Architect microservices and event-driven systems that integrate AI reasoning with enterprise systems such as customer, billing, network, and support platforms.
* Design mechanisms that safely translate model outputs into deterministic business actions and workflows.
* Collaborate with AI/ML engineers to integrate foundation models, retrieval systems, evaluation frameworks, and agent capabilities into production platforms.
* Drive platform reliability, scalability, observability, and performance across high-volume AI workloads.
* Establish software architecture standards, engineering best practices, and reusable design patterns for agentic systems.
* Contribute to technical strategy and platform evolution by evaluating emerging AI, orchestration, and distributed systems technologies.
* Mentor engineers and promote engineering excellence through design reviews, documentation, and knowledge sharing.

**What You'll Bring**
:

* 7+ years of software engineering experience building distributed systems and cloud-native applications.
* Strong proficiency in Python or Java, with working knowledge of both preferred.
* Experience designing APIs, microservices, workflow engines, or platform services.
* Experience building systems that integrate with LLMs, AI services, or conversational platforms.

* Strong understanding of software architecture, system design, scalability, resiliency, and performance optimization.
* Demonstrated experience leading technical design discussions, driving architectural decisions, and influencing engineering direction across teams.
* Experience with cloud-native technologies, including containers, Kubernetes, and service-based architectures.
* Excellent problem-solving, debugging, and technical communication skills.

**Role summary**

Working closely with Architects and Product Management, you will turn the target architecture and product requirements into clear technical specifications, then lead the team that delivers them predictably, with high quality and on schedule. You will spend roughly half your time on technical design, code and reviews, and half on people, planning and cross-team alignment.

* Define and improve the team’s delivery process: branching, code review, CI/CD, testing and definition of done.

**Technical leadership**

* Translate architecture blueprints into low-level designs, API contracts, data models, sequence diagrams and non-functional requirements.
* Keep implementation aligned with the approved architecture; raise deviations and trade-offs early.
* Champion secure design: encryption, key management, secrets handling, least-privilege access and audit trails, in line with PCI DSS and internal InfoSec policy.

**People leadership**

* Mentor and grow engineers through pairing, design reviews and regular feedback.
* Take part in hiring: define the bar, interview and onboard new team members.
* Build a culture of ownership, documentation and calm, data-driven decisions.

**Technical environment**

**Backend**

**Frontend**
: React (TypeScript)

**Architecture**
: Microservices, event-driven design, REST APIs, saga and outbox patterns

**Data**
: PostgreSQL (primary), Redis; NoSQL where the workload warrants it

**Cloud and DevOps**
: AWS (or Azure/GCP), Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, feature flags

**Observability**
: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, centralised logging

**Security**
: Cloud KMS/HSM, secrets management, WAF, SAST/DAST

**Critical skills**

* These are must-haves; candidates should show real depth in each area during interviews.
* Delivery leadership: turning high-level requirements into scoped work and shipping it predictably with a team of 5 or more engineers.
* Engineering process: code review, test automation, CI/CD, release management and incident management run as a discipline.
* Distributed systems: consistency, idempotency, concurrency, failure handling and high-throughput APIs.
* Java with Spring Boot, plus working proficiency in TypeScript/Node.js or Python and the ability to review React code.
* SQL: schema design, indexing, query tuning, transactions and isolation levels; zero-downtime migrations.
* Cloud and infrastructure: Kubernetes in a public cloud, infrastructure as code and observability.
* Security fundamentals: encryption, key and secrets management, least privilege and audit trails.

* 8+ years building production systems, including 2+ years as a tech lead leading a team of 5 or more engineers.

* Deep experience with distributed systems and high-availability services.
* Strong command of Java and Spring Boot; working knowledge of Node.js (TypeScript) or Python, and React.
* Experience running services on Kubernetes in a public cloud, with CI/CD and infrastructure as code.
* Working knowledge of security and compliance practices such as PCI DSS; exposure to payments or fintech systems is helpful.
* Clear written and verbal communication; able to explain trade-offs to architects, engineers, product leaders and auditors.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred qualifications**

* Experience in payments, fintech or banking technology, such as payment gateways, processor integrations, settlement and reconciliation.
* Built or scaled a ledger, payment switch or settlement engine handling 1M+ transactions a day.
* Led certification with a card network or an acquiring bank.

title: Sr. Platform Engineer - Streaming/Messaging Systems
description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.
  
  
At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate, serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations.
  
  
**Your Team's Impact**
The NoSQL team manages the infrastructure, deployment, and lifecycle of enterprise NoSQL and data platforms, including provisioning, updates, patching, and troubleshooting. We collaborate with data stakeholders to configure, monitor, and resolve issues across a diverse portfolio of technologies (Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Weaviate, Dremio, Redis, Valkey, DocumentDB, MSK, Zookeeper, Snowflake, and others). The team owns the operational excellence and reliability of these distributed systems from deployment through production support.
  
  
You'll join an international platform engineering team where hands-on problem-solving is valued over process overhead. We expect you to dig into problems, learn our systems deeply, and take initiative—not wait for detailed specifications.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* We're seeking a Platform Engineer to join our international team and take hands-on ownership of our streaming and messaging infrastructure. You'll architect, deploy, and maintain event-driven systems that power our Kubernetes ecosystem while working collaboratively across USA and India timezones.
* Design & Deploy: Architect and implement streaming/messaging systems and event buses within Kubernetes environments, making trade-off decisions between reliability, performance, and operational complexity
* Infrastructure as Code: Write and maintain Terraform and Ansible configurations to provision, configure, and manage platform infrastructure reproducibly
* Operational Ownership: Manage deployments, monitor system health, troubleshoot incidents, and continuously improve observability and reliability
* Collaboration: Partner with development teams to understand messaging patterns and with cross-functional platform engineers across regions
* Hands-On Implementation: Write scripts, debug issues, and iterate on solutions—not just design from above
* On-Call Support: Participate in on-call rotation to respond to production incidents and system outages

**What We're Looking For**

* 5+ years of experience in architecting or maintaining streaming/messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS/GCP managed services, etc.)
* Solid hands-on experience with Kubernetes (deployments, operators, scaling, networking)
* Proficiency with Ansible and Terraform for infrastructure automation
* Proven experience deploying and managing resources to cloud platforms (AWS preferred, but GCP and Azure experience also valued)
* Comfortable with distributed systems concepts: eventual consistency, fault tolerance, message ordering trade-offs
* Availability for on-call rotation supporting production systems with flexible timezone coverage
* Timezone flexibility: Ability to work across overlapping USA and India business hours with occasional sync meetings outside standard hours

Nice-to-Have
  
  

* Experience with Crossplane for infrastructure composition and multi-cloud management
* Familiarity with Coralogix or similar observability/log management platforms
* Background in Go, Python, or Bash scripting
* Experience with GitOps workflows and deployment automation

**What's In It For You**
At FactSet, our people are our greatest asset, and our culture is our biggest competitive advantage. Being a FactSetter means:
  
  

* The opportunity to join an S&P 500 company with over 45 years of sustainable growth powered by the entrepreneurial spirit of a start-up.
* Support for your total well-being. This includes health, life, and disability insurance, as well as retirement savings plans and a discounted employee stock purchase program, plus paid time off for holidays, family leave, and company-wide wellness days.
* Flexible work accommodations. We value work/life harmony and offer our employees a range of accommodations to help them achieve success both at work and in their personal lives.
* A global community dedicated to volunteerism and sustainability, where collaboration is always encouraged, and individuality drives solutions.
* Career progression planning with dedicated time each month for learning and development.
* Business Resource Groups open to all employees that serve as a catalyst for connection, growth, and belonging.

**Learn More About Our Benefits Here.**
Salary is just one component of our compensation package and is based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, and certifications.
  
  
**Company Overview**
FactSet (NYSE:FDS | NASDAQ:FDS) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8,200 global clients, including over 200,000 individual users. Clients across the buy-side and sell-side, as well as wealth managers, private equity firms, and corporations, achieve more every day with our comprehensive and connected content, flexible next-generation workflow solutions, and client-centric specialized support. As a member of the S&P 500, we are committed to sustainable growth and have been recognized among the Best Places to Work in 2023 by Glassdoor as a Glassdoor Employees’ Choice Award winner. Learn more at www.factset.com and follow us on X and LinkedIn.
  
  
At FactSet, we celebrate difference of thought, experience, and perspective. Qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

title: Principal Engineer
description:
Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.
  
  
At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day - building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with entrepreneurial speed, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset.
  
  
The Principal Engineer, Software – Finance & Supply Chain Platform is responsible for architecting resilient, distributed transaction flows across microservices, cloud ERPs (Oracle Fusion, NetSuite, D365), OMS, WMS, financial systems, and data platforms that underpin Fanatics Commerce's global operations. This role sets engineering standards for event contracts, data consistency, reconciliation frameworks, and financial ledger integrity while leading modernization initiatives including monolith decomposition, async processing, and domain-driven design. The Principal Engineer, Software – Finance & Supply Chain Platform delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights.
  
  
**How Will You Drive Impact**
Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes.
  
  
Team & Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams)
  
  
**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Partner with Finance, Supply Chain, Data, and Security leadership to translate regulatory and operational requirements into actionable architecture decisions and platform roadmaps.
* Influence cloud infrastructure strategy and drive platform alignment across engineering domains, ensuring cohesive standards for event contracts, API design, and data consistency.
* Engage executive and cross-functional stakeholders to shape long-term platform strategy and build organizational confidence in distributed system design choices.

**People Leadership**

* Mentor senior engineers across domains, elevating technical craft and establishing engineering standards that scale with the organization.
* Champion a culture of observability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement — coaching teams on SRE principles, SLOs, and self-service resilience patterns.

Fan & Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans)
  
  

* Architect systems designed for high availability and horizontal scalability, ensuring seamless fan and commerce experiences during peak traffic events such as seasonal spikes and product launches.
* Design and enforce disaster recovery, fault tolerance, and latency standards that protect the integrity of financial and order management systems fans depend on.
* Enable accurate, real-time inventory and order data flows across OMS and WMS, ensuring fans receive reliable fulfillment experiences at every touchpoint.
* Drive the adoption of Agentic AI to reimagine finance workflows — including invoice processing, reconciliation, and supplier communication — freeing teams to focus on higher-value fan and business outcomes.

Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)
  
  

* Lead modernization initiatives including monolith decomposition, asynchronous processing, event streaming, and domain-driven design across Finance and SCM platforms.
* Define and evolve cloud-native architecture using API-first and event-driven patterns, establishing the technical foundation for a scalable, future-ready platform.
* Establish a robust error framework with self-service retry mechanisms, reducing manual intervention and improving system resilience across distributed transaction flows.
* Influence the adoption of streaming platforms (Kafka, Pub/Sub, Event Hubs) and async messaging patterns to unlock real-time processing capabilities across financial and inventory domains.

Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset)
  
  

* Own system-level non-functional requirements — latency, fault tolerance, disaster recovery, and security — holding the bar on platform reliability for critical financial and supply chain systems.
* Drive observability strategy across logging, tracing, metrics, and SLOs for financial and inventory systems, ensuring engineering teams can detect, diagnose, and resolve issues with speed and confidence.
* Establish standards for financial ledger integrity, revenue recognition, and reconciliation frameworks within distributed, eventually consistent system architectures.
* Design for peak readiness — including month-end close cycles and high-transaction retail events — ensuring platform stability and performance under the most demanding operational conditions.

AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY
  
  
We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to:
  
  

* Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes
* Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance
* Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working
* Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

**Required Qualifications**
CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING
  
  

* 12+ years of engineering experience building distributed, cloud-native systems, with demonstrable expertise in microservices architecture, event-driven systems, and API design.
* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and container orchestration (Kubernetes), including serverless and managed service patterns.
* Experience with streaming platforms (Kafka, Pub/Sub, Event Hubs) and asynchronous messaging patterns in high-transaction retail or eCommerce environments.
* Strong understanding of financial domain concepts — ledgering, revenue recognition, inventory costing, and reconciliation — and direct experience with cloud ERPs such as Oracle Fusion, NetSuite, or D365.
* Deep knowledge of data architecture, eventual consistency, and idempotent processing, paired with strong SQL and data modeling skills and proficiency in modern backend stacks (Java, .NET, Go, or similar).
* Experience implementing observability and SRE principles using tools such as OpenTelemetry, with demonstrated ability to define and enforce SLOs for mission-critical systems.
* Proven ability to influence cross-functional and executive stakeholders on platform strategy, with a track record of mentoring senior engineers and elevating engineering standards at scale.

WORK LOCATION
  
  
Hybrid: The primary place of performance of this role is the Company's office located in
**Hyderabad,Telangana,**
subject to the Company's current hybrid work policy. This role currently requires in-office presence 3 days a week i.e, Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday
  
  
*At Fanatics, we operate with a BOLD mindset - We Build Championship Teams, we’re Obsessed with Fans, we embrace a Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit, and we approach every challenge with a Determined and Relentless Mindset. If you’re ready to contribute to a dynamic, fast-paced environment that thrives on collaboration and growth, we want you to be part of our team.*

*Fanatics is a leading global sports platform redefining how fans connect with the teams, players and moments they love. Our businesses — Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, Fanatics Betting & Gaming, Fanatics Events, Fanatics Advertising, Fanatics Markets and Fanatics Studios — maximize the presence and reach for hundreds of partners globally and create a one-stop experience that allows fans to buy, bet, collect, and earn, while engaging with sports in deeper, more immersive ways. title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
**Company Description**

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**

We build the platform that powers ServiceNow AI Workers: autonomous agents that resolve incidents, complete tasks and learn from every interaction. Our engineers work across retrieval, evaluation, agent memory and learning, runtime infrastructure and customer delivery. The goal is simple: give people AI teammates they can trust, so they can spend their time on the work that matters most.

**What you’ll do**

* Design, build and run core services for the AI Worker platform, including agent runtime, orchestration, tool calling and skill management.
* Build retrieval pipelines that ground agents in enterprise knowledge, using hybrid search, embeddings, reranking and the ServiceNow AI Search stack.
* Develop memory and learning capabilities so agents improve from past resolutions, knowledge articles and human feedback.
* Create evaluation frameworks, including offline benchmarks, LLM-as-judge scoring, ablation studies and production quality monitoring, so we can measure whether agents are actually getting better.
* Integrate deeply with the Now Platform through scoped apps, GlideRecord, Flow Designer and platform APIs, and make AI capabilities easy for other teams to consume.
* Partner with product, architecture and customer delivery teams to take features from prototype to production with real customers.
* Own reliability, latency, cost and observability for the services you build.
* Raise the bar through design reviews, code reviews and mentoring.

  
**Qualifications**  

* 2 to 4 years of software engineering experience, with at least 2 years building ML, LLM or AI-powered systems in production.
* Strong programming skills in Java, JavaScript or Python, and solid understanding of distributed systems and API design.
* Hands-on experience with LLM application patterns: prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation, tool or function calling, and agent frameworks.
* Experience with vector search, embeddings and information retrieval concepts.
* A measurement mindset: you’ve designed evals or experiments and used the results to make decisions.
* Clear communication and comfort working with distributed teams across time zones.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Nice to have**

* ServiceNow platform development experience (scoped apps, AI Search, Flow Designer, Now Assist).
* Experience with agent memory, continual learning or feedback-driven improvement loops.
* Background in IT service management or enterprise workflow automation.
* Contributions to open-source AI tooling or published work on agents, retrieval or evaluation.

  
**Additional Information**

**Work Personas**

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.

**Accommodations**

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.

**Export Control Regulations**

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

title: Client System Manager
description:
We are seeking an experienced Edge Software Manager with a strong background in .NET/C# application development and C++ programming to lead our software team in building and managing Level 2 (L2) supervisory control and data systems for pharmaceutical manufacturing operations. This is a hands-on leadership role that combines deep technical expertise with team management skills to deliver high-quality, compliant, and high-performance software solutions.

The role bridges enterprise .NET application development and real-time/embedded C++ systems, ensuring seamless integration between L2 software layers, PLC/hardware interfaces, and manufacturing execution systems (MES). The incumbent will oversee the full development lifecycle - from architecture design and modernization of legacy systems to performance optimization and cross-team collaboration.

**C. Primary Responsibilities**

**1. Team Leadership & Management**

* Lead and manage a cross-functional team of .NET and C++ developers focused on L2 pharma manufacturing systems.
* Mentor junior and mid-level developers, foster a culture of technical excellence and collaboration.
* Conduct code reviews, enforce coding standards, and uphold software quality best practices.
* Plan sprints, assign tasks, and track delivery in agile/scrum workflows.

**2. .NET Application Development**

* Oversee design, development, and modernization of backend modules using .NET Core / .NET 6+.
* Architect and build RESTful APIs using ASP.NET Core Web API following SOLID and clean architecture principles.
* Drive migration of legacy WPF/WCF/.NET Framework systems to scalable, secure REST-based architectures.
* Support Docker-based containerization and cloud/on-premise deployments.
* Ensure implementation of unit testing (xUnit / NUnit / MSTest) and CI/CD pipelines.
* Leverage AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) responsibly.

**3. C++ / CUDA / Embedded Systems**

* Lead development and optimization of C++ components for high-performance and real-time applications.
* Drive CUDA programming for GPU-based parallel computing tasks relevant to manufacturing data processing.
* Oversee software integration with embedded systems, PLCs, and hardware interfaces on Linux-based platforms.
* Ensure performance profiling and optimization of GPU-accelerated and multi-threaded applications.
* Collaborate with PLC/C++ hardware teams for seamless machine communication integration.

**4. L2 Systems Architecture & Integration**

* Design and govern the software architecture for L2 supervisory systems in pharma manufacturing.
* Ensure seamless data exchange between L2 software, MES, SCADA, and L1 device layers.
* Define integration protocols and APIs for device communication and data acquisition.
* Oversee performance, reliability, and security of manufacturing software systems.

**5. Quality, Compliance & Documentation**

* Ensure all software development aligns with pharma industry regulatory requirements (GMP, 21 CFR Part 11, etc.).
* Maintain comprehensive technical documentation for architecture, APIs, and integration interfaces.

title: Tax Technology Specialist
description:

**About You And This Role**
As a Tax Technology Specialist based in Navi Mumbai, you will support
**tax technology solutions and improvement initiatives**
across
**EMEA, India and APAC**

You will work closely with Tax, Information Technology, Finance and other cross-functional teams to understand business needs, translate them into functional and technical requirements, support system configuration and testing, and help sustain solutions after implementation. While the position requires a practical understanding of indirect tax compliance, its primary focus is technology, automation, data and continuous improvement.
  
  
You will work with a high degree of autonomy within established procedures, solve complex issues, recommend process improvements and may provide subject matter guidance or coordinate work across stakeholders.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Support tax technology projects and continuous improvement initiatives across EMEA, India and APAC, with emphasis on tax compliance, efficiency, risk prevention and scalable processes.
* Partner with tax process owners to understand indirect tax requirements, including VAT and GST compliance, reconciliations, reporting, controls and statutory deadlines.
* Gather, analyze and document business requirements, business processes, functional requirements, solution designs and acceptance criteria.

* Design and execute test scenarios and scripts, support user acceptance testing, document results and coordinate issue resolution.
* Provide post-go-live and operational support, including monitoring solution performance, troubleshooting issues, maintaining process documentation and supporting users.
* Support tax data management needs, including data quality, interfaces, reporting, warehousing, record retention and disclosure requirements.
* Develop dashboards, analytics and executive-ready reporting to provide visibility to process performance, risks, issues and improvement opportunities.
* Support the operation and enhancement of automated indirect tax compliance solutions while maintaining appropriate controls, data integrity and audit readiness.
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to define project needs, evaluate solution options and deliver sustainable improvements.
* May perform other related duties as assigned.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Tax, Information Systems, Technology, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* A minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in tax technology, tax process automation, systems implementation, business analysis or technology-enabled tax compliance.
* Experience working with SAP and tax, finance or compliance processes.
* Experience gathering and documenting business and functional requirements and supporting testing, deployment or post-go-live activities.
* Working knowledge of indirect tax concepts, including VAT or GST, with the ability to understand and translate tax requirements into technology solutions.
* Advanced English communication skills, both written and spoken.
* Ability to support stakeholders across EMEA, India and APAC and accommodate a flexible schedule when required for international collaboration, project milestones or compliance deadlines.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Thomson Reuters ONESOURCE solutions, particularly indirect tax determination or VAT compliance tools.
* Experience with Power BI, Power Query, Power Automate, Alteryx, RPA, Python, generative AI applications or similar automation and analytics tools.
* Experience with system configuration, integrations, data migration, tax data management or reporting solutions.
* Exposure to indirect tax compliance processes in EMEA, India or APAC.
* Experience supporting internal controls, SOX requirements, audit activities or controlled technology processes.
* Experience working in a global, cross-functional environment and with third-party technology providers.

**Skills And Capabilities**

* Tax and technology translation: connects compliance and business needs with practical system and automation solutions.
* Analytical problem solving: evaluates complex issues, identifies root causes and recommends sustainable solutions.
* Ownership and bias for action: works independently, manages competing priorities and follows issues through resolution.
* Communication and collaboration: explains technical and tax topics clearly and builds effective relationships across functions, regions and levels.
* Project and change management: organizes requirements, risks, testing, decisions and stakeholder actions to support successful delivery.
* Continuous improvement: challenges inefficient processes and identifies opportunities to simplify, standardize and automate.
* Control mindset: maintains attention to data integrity, documentation, security, internal controls and audit readiness.
* Learning agility: quickly develops knowledge of new tax processes, systems and technologies.

**Additional Notes**

* This role is based in Navi Mumbai, India. Relocation assistance is not available for this position.
* The role primarily focuses on tax technology and automation while requiring sufficient tax knowledge to support indirect tax solutions across EMEA, India and APAC.

title: APMEA Chief Digital & AI Officer
description:
**Position Title:**
APMEA Chief Digital & AI Officer

**Reporting to:**
APMEA Chief Tech Data & Digital Officer

**Location:**
Mumbai

**Purpose:**
Join Sodexo to shape and lead the Digital & AI agenda across APMEA. You will translate our Shift & Grow strategic ambitions into a prioritized roadmap that delivers growth, stronger operational performance and better experiences for clients, consumers and employees. This is an opportunity to connect regional strategy with execution at country and site level, and scale solutions that create measurable value.

**Role and positioning:**
As the regional Digital & AI leader, you will partner with global teams, Country CIOs, business leaders and Shift & Grow pillar and chapter leaders. You will own the regional strategy, investment priorities, delivery and adoption roadmap, working through the Deployment & Adoption Lead and a matrix of product, country and specialist teams.

**Overall accountability:**
You will be accountable for the business relevance and execution of the APMEA Digital & AI portfolio, from solution prioritization through sustained adoption and value realization. You will secure delivery commitments, challenge capacity and investment assumptions, resolve competing priorities and ensure that technology promises made to clients are achievable and fulfilled.

**Main missions:**

**1. Shape the strategy and roadmap.**
Develop an integrated Digital & AI roadmap across business-to-business (B2B), business-to-operations (B2O) and business-to-consumer (B2C) priorities. Align initiatives with Shift & Grow outcomes, country readiness, business cases, funding and delivery capacity.

**2. Evaluate and scale global and local solutions.**
Partner with the Global CDAO, Solutions Architect, product owners and Country CIOs to assess business fit, scalability, integration, data readiness and responsible AI requirements. Promote global reuse, justify local adaptations and reduce platform duplication and complexity.

**3. Lead delivery and adoption.**
Own the regional delivery and adoption roadmap with product owners and country IT Business Partners. Work through the Deployment & Adoption Lead to coordinate execution, remove roadblocks and sustain adoption beyond go-live. Hold contributing teams accountable for agreed commitments.

**4. Strengthen client propositions and innovation.**
Partner with the account teams on technology presales, bids and strategic-account engagement. Prioritize food, facilities management and workplace innovations with operations and Consumer Insights, including AI-enabled services, autonomous retail, smart kitchens and waste reduction. Scale initiatives with demonstrated value.

**5. Govern performance and realize value.**
Establish clear portfolio decisions, risk escalation and platform accountability with global and country teams. Agree business owners, baselines and benefits; review adoption, productivity, revenue, margin, service quality, sustainability and client return on investment. Drive corrective action on delivery, reliability and customer satisfaction.

**6. Build capability and global alignment.**
Represent APMEA needs in global product roadmaps and share successful regional innovations. Build Digital & AI leadership and change capability across countries. Align partners and vendors with architecture, security, privacy and procurement requirements.

**Mission scope**

The remit covers APMEA Digital & AI strategy, portfolio priorities, client propositions, delivery, adoption and value realization. Subject to agreement with the Global Chief Digital & AI Officer, it may extend to leading AI transformation for Global Business Services (GBS) and selected global functions.

**Key working relationships**

The Deployment & Adoption Lead drives rollout and adoption execution. Product and platform owners, architecture, data, security and service teams retain their specialist accountabilities. You will partner with the Tech Transformation Officer on strategic oversight and with the Regional CIO and PMO on delivery assurance, capacity and dependencies, using shared governance and reporting.

**Your profile**

* A seasoned Digital & AI executive with a proven record of shaping strategy and delivering measurable transformation across multiple markets in a complex global organization.
* Experience taking digital products and AI use cases from business case and pilot to scaled deployment, sustained adoption and demonstrable business value.
* Strong commercial and operational judgment, including investment prioritization, portfolio management, vendor engagement and technology presales with senior clients.
* Sufficient technical depth to challenge solution choices and assess architecture, integration, data dependencies, AI risks and scalability in partnership with specialists.
* Executive presence and the ability to influence global, regional and country stakeholders, resolve competing priorities and hold teams accountable across a matrix.
* A record of leading organizational and behavioral change, building capable teams and communicating effectively from executive forums to operational audiences.
* A relevant degree in technology, engineering, business or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. An MBA or relevant advanced qualification is desirable. Experience in food services, facilities management, workplace, hospitality or retail technology would be valuable.

**What success looks like**

An agreed and funded roadmap; predictable delivery against commitments; sustained adoption; measurable business and client value; customer satisfaction; greater reuse of scalable solutions; and a demonstrable technology contribution to new business, retention and account growth.

If you can turn Digital & AI ambition into practical change across markets and bring a strong client and business perspective to technology leadership, we invite you to apply.

**Please note:**
If you do not hear from our recruitment team within two weeks of submitting your application, please consider that your profile has not been shortlisted for this opportunity. We will, however, retain and consider your profile for relevant opportunities in the future.

title: RHEL Systems Administrator (L2)
description:
Experience Required: 4–5 Years
  
  
Work Schedule: 24/7 Rotational Shifts (including weekends and on-call support)
  
  
Mandatory Certification: Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA)
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for an experienced L2 Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) Systems Administrator to manage, troubleshoot, and automate our enterprise Linux infrastructure. You will handle L2 production escalations, perform root cause analysis (RCA), manage large-scale patching, and ensure high availability, security, and performance across RHEL 7, 8, and 9 environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
L2 Production Support & Troubleshooting: Resolve escalated incidents, perform root cause analysis (RCA), and troubleshoot boot failures, OS performance bottlenecks (CPU, memory, disk I/O), network issues, and SELinux/firewall blocks.
  
  
System Administration: Administer and maintain RHEL 7, 8, and 9 servers, including user/group management, permissions, systemd services, scheduled tasks, and OS upgrades/migrations.
  
  
Storage Management: Configure and manage Logical Volume Manager (LVM), XFS/EXT4 filesystems, NFS shares, iSCSI targets/initiators, and SAN LUNs with multipathing.
  
  
Automation & Scripting: Develop and maintain Ansible playbooks and Bash/Shell scripts to automate repetitive administrative tasks, configuration management, health checks, and bulk deployments.
  
  
Enterprise Patching: Plan, schedule, and execute monthly security and errata patching across Linux servers using Red Hat Satellite (managing Content Views, Repositories, and Lifecycle Environments), including pre-patch checks and rollbacks.
  
  
Security & OS Hardening: Implement OS hardening standards (such as CIS benchmarks), manage SSH/firewall policies, and remediate security vulnerabilities.

title: Business Intelligence Engineer
description:
About Us

At Calfus, we are known for delivering cutting-edge AI agents and products that transform businesses in ways previously unimaginable. We empower companies to harness the full potential of AI, unlocking opportunities they never imagined possible before the AI era.

Our software engineering teams are highly valued by customers, whether start-ups or established enterprises, because we consistently deliver solutions that drive revenue growth. Our ERP solution teams have successfully implemented cloud solutions and developed tools that seamlessly integrate with ERP systems, reducing manual work so teams can focus on high-impact tasks.

None of this would be possible without talent like you! Our global teams thrive on collaboration, and we're actively looking for skilled professionals to strengthen our in-house expertise and help us deliver exceptional AI, software engineering, and solutions using enterprise applications.

As one of the fastest-growing companies in our industry, we take pride in fostering a culture of innovation where new ideas are always welcomed, without hesitation. We are driven and expect the same dedication from our team members. Our speed, agility, and dedication set us apart, and we perform best when surrounded by high-energy, driven individuals.

To continue our rapid growth and deliver an even greater impact, we invite you to apply for our open positions and become part of our journey!

As a Business Intelligence Engineer, you'll design, build, and deploy BI solutions and reliable, accurate data marts that drive business growth and make operations more efficient. This is a hands-on role: you'll own ETL development, write the SQL behind reports and data models, build dashboards, and support the analytics platforms in production. With 5–7 years of experience, you translate business needs into technical specifications and deliver solutions that internal and external customers rely on.

• Experience: 5–7 years in business intelligence and data engineering

• Location: Pune / Bangalore

What You'll Do

BI Solutions & Reporting

• Design, build, and deploy BI solutions and data marts for internal and external customers

• Build dashboards and custom reports using tools such as Sisense, Power BI, or Tableau

• Provide ad-hoc reports where self-service isn't available or possible

Data Engineering & ETL

• Develop and enhance ETL/ELT processes using tools such as Fivetran and dbt

• Write database queries, stored procedures, functions, and views in PostgreSQL and BigQuery

• Continuously improve BI systems and data structures for performance, accuracy, integrity, and security

Data Quality & Platform Support

• Spot data trends and fix data quality issues quickly, completely, and permanently

• Support analytics platforms in production: troubleshooting and testing across PostgreSQL, BigQuery, and BI tools

• Follow the software development life cycle across all development work

Collaboration & Documentation

• Work with IT peers and business partners to balance production support, service requests, and roadmap initiatives

• Maintain BI documentation and source system data mapping

• Share domain and technical expertise through mentoring and cross-training

What You'll Need (Must Have)

• 5–7 years in business intelligence, data warehousing, or data engineering

• Advanced SQL: queries, stored procedures, functions, and views

• ETL/ELT: hands-on development and enhancement of ETL packages and processes

• Databases & OLAP: hands-on experience with database management systems and online analytical processing

• BI Tools: you've built dashboards yourself in Sisense, Power BI, Tableau, or similar

• JSON and XML

• Strong analytical skills: able to translate business needs into technical specifications

• Proficiency in MS Office, especially Excel

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related engineering field

Good to Have

• Google BigQuery and PostgreSQL

• Fivetran and dbt

• Experience with Sales, Operations, and Finance data and platforms

• Business systems such as general ledger, HRIS, or CRM

• Industry certifications in data or cloud technologies

Benefits

At Calfus, we value our employees and offer a strong benefits package. This includes medical, group, and parental insurance, coupled with gratuity and provident fund options. Further, we support employee wellness and provide birthday leave as a valued benefit.

Calfus is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We believe diversity drives innovation. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone, regardless of background, identity, or experience, has the opportunity to thrive. We welcome all applicants!

* Develop and maintain test documentation including test cases, test scripts, test data, and test summary reports.

* Strong SQL skills for data validation, reconciliation, and querying across relational/cloud databases.
* Experience testing REST APIs using Postman, REST Assured, or similar API testing tools.
* Experience with test management tools (JIRA, TestRail, Zephyr, or similar).
* Familiarity with ETL/integration testing (validating data pipelines, transformation logic, and data flow accuracy).
* Experience with data quality testing concepts — completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and uniqueness.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to define test scenarios from complex business and data requirements.

* Exposure to performance/load testing tools (JMeter, Gatling, or similar) for MDM and integration pipelines.

* Create architecture blueprints, design documentation, operational models, and implementation roadmaps.

* 12 to 16 years of experience in Data Architecture, Data Engineering, Cloud Data Platforms, or Enterprise Analytics solutions.

* Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake Dynamic Tables and real-time data processing capabilities.

title: Snowflake architect
description:
**About Position:**

We are looking for an experienced Snowflake Architect with 12 to 16 years of experience in designing, modernizing, and optimizing enterprise data platforms. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Snowflake architecture, cloud data engineering, multi-tenant platform design, data security, and AWS services. This role will be responsible for defining end-to-end Snowflake-native architecture, ensuring scalability, regulatory compliance, security, and operational excellence while supporting large-scale multi-tenant data platforms.

* **Role: Snowflake architect**
* **Location: All Persistent Locations**
* **Experience: 12 to 16 Years**
* **Job Type: Full-Time Employment**

**What You'll Do:**

* Own the end-to-end Snowflake architecture design for Proof of Concept (POC) and enterprise-scale implementations using a 100% Snowflake-native architecture approach.
* Design and recommend the optimal multi-tenant data isolation strategy, including schema-based isolation and Row-Level Security (RLS) approaches for 30+ tenant environments.
* Architect and implement multiple ingestion patterns, including MySQL CDC using Openflow, REST API integrations using Snowpark, and file ingestion through External Stages.
* Define and implement Dynamic Table refresh strategies, including near real-time refresh patterns and automated scheduling.
* Design point-in-time snapshot architectures supporting operational and regulatory reporting requirements.
* Establish secure credential and API key management utilizing Snowflake Secrets and governance best practices.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements including PIPEDA, OSFI audit standards, and SOC 2 Type II controls.
* Design secure networking architectures utilizing AWS PrivateLink, encryption frameworks, and secure access controls.
* Lead architecture reviews with internal stakeholders, Snowflake platform teams, and external vendors.
* Evaluate technical feasibility, scalability, performance, and cost optimization strategies across the Snowflake ecosystem.
* Define enterprise data governance, security, auditing, and access management standards.
* Develop a scale-out strategy to expand the platform from initial deployment to support 30+ tenant environments.
* Drive architectural decisions, platform standardization, and cloud modernization initiatives.
* Create architecture blueprints, design documentation, operational models, and implementation roadmaps.

**Expertise You'll Bring:**

* 12 to 16 years of experience in Data Architecture, Data Engineering, Cloud Data Platforms, or Enterprise Analytics solutions.
* Deep expertise in Snowflake architecture, including databases, schemas, warehouses, virtual warehouses, and RBAC.
* Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake Dynamic Tables and real-time data processing capabilities.
* Expertise in Snowflake Tasks, CRON scheduling, Streams, and orchestration patterns.
* Experience implementing Snowflake Openflow, CDC frameworks, and modern data ingestion architectures.
* Strong knowledge of multi-tenant architecture patterns, including schema isolation, Row-Level Security (RLS), and tenant governance frameworks.
* Extensive experience with SQL optimization, query tuning, performance engineering, and data modeling.
* Strong experience with AWS services including S3, Aurora MySQL, PrivateLink, IAM, VPC, and cloud security services.
* Experience designing secure enterprise platforms with encryption, auditability, and compliance controls.
* Understanding of data residency requirements and regulatory frameworks such as PIPEDA, OSFI, and SOC 2 Type II.
* Experience with Snowpark and API integration frameworks for modern cloud-native data workloads.
* Expertise in enterprise-scale data platform modernization and cloud migration initiatives.
* Strong understanding of security architecture, access management, and governance best practices.
* Experience working with Agile delivery teams and enterprise stakeholders.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and architecture governance skills.
* Ability to drive technical strategy, mentor engineering teams, and influence enterprise architecture decisions.

**Benefits:**

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents

**Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment:**

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.

**About Job Role**

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Firmware Design Engineer with 7-10 years of experience to develop, enhance, migrate, sustain, and release embedded firmware for fire and life-safety portfolio. The role supports new product development, product extensions, platform modernisation, value engineering, component obsolescence, compliance, and field or production support. The engineer will own assigned firmware work packages, define maintainable architectures, develop reusable platform software and product features, and ensure deterministic behaviour on target hardware. Assignments may include microcontroller or toolchain migration, protocol development, diagnostics, hardware integration, verification, and issue resolution across multiple product families.

**Key Responsibilities**

Firmware Architecture and Product Development

• Own firmware work packages for new products, product enhancements, redesigns, sustenance, and value-engineering initiatives.

• Analyses system and software requirements, hardware interfaces, existing code, field behavior, regulatory constraints, and manufacturing needs before defining the implementation approach.

• Define and implement modular architectures covering startup, BSP, HAL, drivers, protocols, application logic, diagnostics, configuration, and production-test support.

• Develop production embedded software in C for bare-metal or RTOS-based systems, with appropriate use of interrupts, timers, state machines, memory, and communication peripherals.

• Plan and execute microcontroller, compiler, IDE, or hardware-platform migrations when required, including build, linker, startup, timing, peripheral, and compatibility changes.

• Create reusable software components and controlled product configurations that reduce duplication and simplify maintenance across product families.

**Qualifications**

• 7-10 years of hands-on embedded firmware-development experience, including responsibility for implementation, integration, debugging, verification, and production release.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Telecommunication, Computer Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a related discipline.

• Strong Embedded C skills and practical experience with bare-metal or RTOS-based systems, interrupts, timers, state machines, memory constraints, and deterministic real-time behaviour.

• Demonstrated experience designing or maintaining modular BSP, HAL, driver, protocol, application, diagnostic, or boot and update layers for production embedded products.

• Experience migrating firmware between microcontroller families, compilers, IDEs, or hardware revisions and resolving architecture, linker, startup, timing, and peripheral differences.

• Hands-on debugging with embedded toolchains, JTAG or SWD probes, oscilloscopes, logic analysers, serial tools, and protocol analysers.

• Working knowledge of version control, code review, static analysis, defect tracking, configuration management, unit testing, integration testing, and regression testing.

Preferred Experience

• Prior firmware-development experience in fire alarm, fire and life-safety, emergency communication, building-automation, or another regulated product industry is strongly preferred.

• Hands-on participation in UL and FCC compliance or certification programs is strongly preferred; experience supporting UL 864 or FM Approvals is valuable.

• Experience with Renesas or comparable microcontrollers, IAR or similar toolchains, processor migration, or legacy-code modernisation is preferred.

• Experience with fire-alarm communication loops, notification circuits, RS-485 or proprietary networks, supervised field circuits, annunciation, relay control, or networked power products is advantageous.

Core Competencies

Ownership Mindset | Embedded C | Firmware Architecture | Product Development | Real-Time Systems | Protocol Engineering | Hardware Debugging | Software Quality | Compliance | Technical Guidance

title: Manager, Software Engineering
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Manager, Software Engineering
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
As a Manager, Software Engineering in the Services organization, you will have the opportunity to lead the development of analytics applications that sit atop vast datasets gathered by retail stores, restaurants, banks, and other consumer-focused companies. Innovative product opportunities, modern business questions, and intricate datasets present uniquely challenging problems that we are eager to take on. Mastercard's next-generation platform blends industry-leading analytics, advanced software architecture, and the latest web technologies to face these problems. Our software is required to effectively decipher analytically complex insights from these problems, on which businesses base multi-million-dollar business decisions.
  
  
As a member of the Business Experimentation & Optimization team, you will apply your full-stack development skills to building industry-leading business experimentation software that brings sophisticated analytic techniques to business users around the world. We are rapidly expanding our product offerings and innovating on how we deliver Business Experimentation & Optimization solutions to our clients.
  
  
What is Services organization?
  
  
The Services organization is a key differentiator for Mastercard, providing the cutting-edge services that help our customers grow. Focused on thinking big and scaling fast around the globe, this team is responsible for end-to-end solutions for a diverse global customer base. We combine traditional management consulting with our rich data assets and in-house technology to provide our clients with powerful insights and tools to drive fact-based decision-making. Centered on data-driven technologies and innovation, our services include consulting, loyalty and marketing programs, business experimentation, and data-driven information and risk management. While specializing in the payments industry, Mastercard Services also works closely with major retailers, airlines, and other enterprises, leveraging data and insights garnered from within and beyond its network.
  
  
We are looking for passionate, talented technologists who share our vision of empowering our customers to make better, fact-based decisions to join us and help shape our team's growth.
  
  
Who is Mastercard?
  
  
Mastercard is the global technology company behind the world’s fastest payments processing network. We are a vehicle for commerce, a connection to financial systems for the previously excluded, and a technology innovation lab. We ensure every employee has the opportunity to be a part of something bigger and to change lives. We believe as our company grows, so should you.
  
  
Role
  
  
As a Part Of Business Experimentation & Optimization, You Will Build Revolutionary Products That Advance How Businesses All Over The World Seize The Most Value From Their Data. As a Manager, Software Engineer Within The Business Experimentation & Optimization Team, You Will
  
  

* Formally supervise, coach, and develop a high-performing development team

* Lead large-scale projects from inception to release
* Lead design of major, complex parts of the platform with high-quality development
* Define state-of-the-art service-oriented software architectures
* Spend 50% of your time on active software development tasks
* Lead planning and scoping features for the team
* Build features used by some of the world's largest organizations to make multi-million dollar decisions
* Critically review the code and guide the team with a focus on improving the code quality
* Play a key role in shaping the direction of engineering processes through working on a small team empowered to organize and run the team as they see fit
* Mentor junior engineers and teammates
* Collaborate across teams with exceptional peers who are passionate about what they do

Ideal
  
  
**All About You**

* Experience managing, coaching, and guiding high-performing software development teams
* Experience with full-stack, data, and cloud technologies such as Databricks, AWS (Data Services + Agentic/ML Services including EMR, Agent Core, Bedrock, etc), .NET/C#, Java, Spring Boot, React, Python, Spark, or similar.
* Experience solving and implementing scalable solutions to solve complex problems
* Experience with AI tools like GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, etc., and their effective usage in PDLC is highly preferred.
* Proficiency with advanced object-oriented programming, design principles, refactoring, microservice development, and databases
* Strong understanding of web technologies and server-side technologies for developing microservices
* Strong understanding of microservices development and integration of microservices with UI technology
* Passion for analytical/quantitative problem solving
* Motivation, creativity, self-direction, and desire to thrive on small project teams
* Prior experience leading a team or mentoring other engineers, both technically and professionally preferred
* Superior academic record with a degree in Computer Science or related technical field
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills

Mastercard is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. Applicants will be considered and treated without regard to gender, gender identity, race, color, ethnicity, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disabled status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
