title: Manager, Engineering
description:
**Our Mission**
At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
  
  
****Who We Are****
In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
  
  
We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
  
  
****Job Summary****
We are seeking an Engineering Manager to lead the team that builds and runs our connectors framework. In this role, you will be accountable for the team’s delivery across several concurrent projects, from platform enhancements to large programs that need multiple teams to collaborate. You will lead by example as a hands-on technical manager, grow the engineers on your team, and remove roadblocks so the connector engineers who build on your platform can move fast.
  
  
****What You’ll Do****

* Own Team Delivery: Be accountable for delivering multiple framework projects and features at the same time. Make pragmatic trade-offs to deliver, and personally deliver features when the team needs it.
* Lead Technically: Stay hands-on and lead by example. Guide the team through large, complex projects that need several teams to complete, such as migrating on-premises connectivity to a cloud-managed agent or extracting the integrations code into its own service. Design features in the framework yourself when needed.
* Direct Quality and Reliability: Set the quality processes the team follows. Own framework reliability, including sync health, incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), and resolution of security findings.
* Develop Talent: Run 1:1s, performance reviews, goal setting, and career guidance. Enable ownership on the team, resolve conflict, and grow engineers into their next level.
* Remove Roadblocks Across Teams: Work closely with the connector development team, other product teams, SRE, security, and PM to keep work clear and unblocked.
* Lead AI-First Engineering: Train the team on our tools and processes, including AI-assisted development workflows, and set the discipline for verifying AI-generated code.
* Drive Initiatives: Run initiatives within the team, such as cutting the time it takes to build a new connector or reducing sync failures.
* Keep Customers in Focus: Understand customer use cases and problems, and use them to set priorities with PM.
* Build the Team: Actively recruit, lead interviews, and make hiring decisions.
* Communicate Clearly: Present plans, progress, and risks to engineering and senior leadership.

**Nice to Have**

* Identity & Access Security Domain: Direct experience with IAM, PAM, IGA, or Secrets Management platforms.
* Integration Platforms: Experience leading teams that build integration frameworks, data pipelines, or SDKs used by other engineers.
* Hybrid Connectivity: Experience with products that run agents inside customer networks.
* Multi-Site Teams: Experience leading engineers across more than one office location.
* DevOps & Observability Ecosystems: Practical experience with progressive delivery, CI/CD pipelines, feature flagging tools, and monitoring tools such as Datadog.

**Impact**
As an Engineering Manager on the connectors framework, you will lead the team that every connector in our product depends on. Your impact will be measured by your team’s delivery, the reliability of the framework in production, and the growth of the engineers you lead. Co-workers will look to you for clarity, technical judgment, and a steady path forward.
  
  
****Qualifications****

* People Leadership: Experience managing software engineers, including 1:1s, performance reviews, career development, and hiring.
* Technical Depth: Strong hands-on background with Node.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, and AWS, plus experience with data integration or distributed systems. Able to review designs and code with credibility.
* Delivery Track Record: Proven record of delivering large, complex projects that need collaboration across several teams.
* Operational Ownership: Experience running production services, leading incident response, and driving RCAs to durable fixes.
* AI Tooling Adoption: Experience leading a team’s adoption of AI tools while keeping review rigor high.
* Conflict Resolution & Influence: Able to resolve conflict, remove roadblocks across teams, and build strong working relationships with ICs and managers.
* Communication: Excellent presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to engineering and business audiences.
* Customer Understanding: Good understanding of customer use cases, problems, and considerations.

****Qualifications****
**Our Commitment**
We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
  
  
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.
  
  
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
  
  
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
  
  
Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

title: Associate Technical Architect
description:
**Company:**
ClinRT Global Services

**Location:**
Pune, Maharashtra

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
6–9 Years

**Department:**
Technology / Software Engineering

**Designation:**
Associate Technical Architect

**About ClinRT**

ClinRT is focused on developing technology solutions that support clinical research and clinical trial operations. We build secure, scalable and reliable digital platforms that help streamline clinical trial processes and support global clinical research.

We are looking for a technically strong and motivated
**Associate Technical Architect**
to join our technology team in Pune.

The ideal candidate will have 6+ years of experience in software development, solution design and application architecture, with strong hands-on expertise in .NET Core, Angular and Microsoft SQL Server.

The candidate should be capable of translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions, driving architectural decisions, guiding development teams and ensuring the delivery of secure, maintainable and high-performance applications.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Application Architecture & Solution Design**

* Design and define scalable, secure and maintainable application architectures using .NET Core, Angular and Microsoft SQL Server.
* Translate business requirements into technical specifications, architecture designs and implementation strategies.
* Define application layers, reusable components, design patterns and coding standards.
* Evaluate technical approaches and recommend appropriate technologies and solutions.
* Design applications with scalability, performance, reliability and maintainability in mind.
* Participate in technical feasibility assessments and solution planning.

**2. Backend Development & API Architecture**

* Design, develop and review RESTful APIs using C# and ASP.NET Core Web API.
* Define API standards, versioning, request/response structures and exception-handling strategies.
* Implement authentication, authorization and secure API communication.
* Apply SOLID principles, dependency injection and appropriate software design patterns.
* Design reusable business logic and service-layer components.
* Ensure secure, reliable and efficient communication between application components.

**3. Frontend Architecture**

* Define frontend architecture and development standards using Angular (v10+).
* Guide developers in building reusable components, services and modules.
* Ensure efficient integration between Angular applications and backend REST APIs.
* Review frontend code quality, application performance and maintainability.
* Promote responsive UI development and consistent application design practices.

**4. Database Design & Performance Optimization**

* Design and maintain efficient database schemas using Microsoft SQL Server.
* Develop and optimize complex T-SQL queries, stored procedures, functions and views.
* Analyze SQL execution plans and identify database performance bottlenecks.
* Implement appropriate indexing and query optimization strategies.
* Ensure data consistency, transaction management and database integrity.
* Review database designs and guide developers on SQL development best practices.

**5. Technical Leadership & Code Quality**

* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to developers.
* Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to coding standards and architectural guidelines.
* Identify technical risks and recommend appropriate solutions.
* Encourage reusable, maintainable and well-structured code.
* Collaborate with project managers, business analysts, QA and development teams.
* Participate in technical discussions and support critical development decisions.

**6. Integration & System Architecture**

* Design and implement third-party system integrations using REST APIs and other integration mechanisms.
* Define integration strategies, data mapping, validation and error-handling mechanisms.
* Ensure secure communication between internal and external systems.
* Design reliable integration workflows with appropriate logging, monitoring and reconciliation.
* Handle integration challenges involving multiple applications and external service providers.

**7. DevOps, Cloud & Deployment**

* Support CI/CD pipeline design and implementation using Azure DevOps or Jenkins.
* Participate in application deployment and release management.
* Work with Microsoft Azure services for application hosting and cloud infrastructure.
* Support production troubleshooting, performance monitoring and application reliability.
* Promote deployment automation and environment configuration best practices.

**8. Documentation & Best Practices**

* Prepare and maintain technical architecture documents and solution design documents.
* Create architecture diagrams, API specifications and database design documentation.
* Maintain technical standards and development guidelines.
* Ensure documentation supports application maintenance, future enhancements and knowledge transfer.

**Required Technical Skills**

**Backend Technologies**

* Strong experience in C#, .NET Core / ASP.NET Core.
* ASP.NET Core Web API and RESTful services.
* Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and SOLID principles.
* Design patterns, dependency injection and layered architecture.
* Experience with microservices architecture and distributed systems.

**Frontend Technologies**

* Strong experience in Angular (v10 or above).
* TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5 and CSS3.
* Angular components, services, modules, routing and RxJS.
* REST API integration and frontend performance optimization.

**Database Technologies**

* Microsoft SQL Server.
* Advanced T-SQL programming.
* Stored procedures, functions, views and triggers.
* Database schema design and normalization.
* Indexing, execution plans and query performance tuning.
* Transaction management and data integrity.

**Architecture & Security**

* Application architecture and system design.
* Layered architecture, microservices and design patterns.
* REST API design and integration strategies.
* JWT authentication and role-based authorization.
* OAuth 2.0 and secure API communication.
* Application security and secure coding practices.

**DevOps & Tools**

* Git and source control management.
* Azure DevOps or Jenkins.
* CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes.
* Microsoft Azure cloud services.
* Visual Studio, VS Code and SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS).

**Good to Have**

* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, including App Services, Azure SQL, Storage and related services.
* Experience with cloud-based application architecture and deployment.
* Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* Experience with application monitoring, logging and production troubleshooting.

* Build and maintain declarative automation, primarily Flow, along with validation rules, and formula fields. Deliver configuration work from the backlog prioritized by the Service Cloud Product Owner, working with Business Analysts on requirements and acceptance criteria and partnering with developers as needed.
* Manage sandboxes, deployments, and releases including testing, supporting UAT, documenting changes, and following DT change management processes.
* Serve as the go-to resource for Salesforce admin requests and issues, triaging and resolving tickets and escalating to developers, integration owners, or Salesforce Support when needed.
* Monitor org health, including Security Health Check, system limits, data and file storage, licenses, installed AppExchange packages, and integration users, and review each Salesforce seasonal release for impacts and new features.
* Maintain admin documentation, including configuration decisions, user guides, and release notes, and support training and adoption for agents and internal users.

**Qualifications & Experience:**

* 3-5 years of hands-on Salesforce administration experience, including direct administration of Service Cloud and Experience Cloud in a production org.
* Bachelors degree in Information Systems, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* Salesforce Certified Administrator, Salesforce Certified Advanced Administrator, Platform App Builder, Service Cloud Consultant, and/or Experience Cloud Consultant.
* Strong command of the Salesforce security and sharing model, including profiles, permission sets, roles, sharing rules, and external user access for Experience Cloud.
* Hands-on experience configuring Service Cloud case management, queues and assignment rules, Email-to-Case, Omni-Channel, and the Service Console.
* Expert level ability to build and troubleshoot automation using Flow, validation rules, and formula fields.
* Experience configuring Salesforce Knowledge, entitlements and milestones, and chat or messaging channels.
* Experience implementing or supporting computer-telephony integration (CTI), Salesforce Voice, Service Cloud Voice, or other telephony platforms integrated with Salesforce, including voice, chat, and messaging channels.
* Familiarity with Einstein or Agentforce for Service features (e.g., reply recommendations, case classification, conversation insights).
* Experience with sandbox management, change sets or similar deployment tools, and disciplined release and change management practices.
* Strong troubleshooting skills, attention to detail, and written and verbal communication, with a service-oriented approach to supporting users and the judgment to know when to escalate.
* Experience with source driven development with GitHub and CI/CI pipelines using Gearset, Copado, or similar tooling.
* Familiarity with Data Cloud or other Salesforce data and AI products.
* Experience with configuring, supporting, and enhancing Sales Cloud capabilities, including lead management, opportunity management, account management, forecasting, and sales process automation.

* Ensure content meets accessibility standards and organizational quality guidelines.

* Creativity and attention to detail.
* Analytical thinking and problem-solving.
* Time management and ability to manage multiple projects.
* Collaboration with cross-functional teams.
* Ability to simplify complex information into engaging learning experiences.

Regards,

Dakshata

description:
Job Description – Backend Java Developer (VAS & Billing Systems)

**Job Title:** Backend Java Developer  
**Experience:** 3–6 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Department:** Engineering / Backend Development

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Backend Java Developer with strong expertise in Java development, telecom Value Added Services (VAS), subscription management, and billing systems.

The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, maintaining, and optimizing scalable backend applications handling high-volume subscription transactions, billing operations, payment processing, recurring renewals, retry mechanisms, and third-party integrations.

The ideal candidate should have strong technical knowledge of backend architecture, Java frameworks, database optimization, Redis, Apache Tomcat, Linux server administration, distributed systems, and production infrastructure management.

Experience working with telecom VAS platforms, operator integrations, and recurring billing systems will be a significant advantage.

Key Responsibilities1. Backend Development & Technical Architecture

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend applications using Java.
* Develop RESTful APIs and microservices using Spring Boot and Spring MVC.
* Design robust backend architecture for high-volume transaction processing.
* Write clean, reusable, maintainable, and efficient code.
* Implement multithreading, concurrency, asynchronous processing, and event-driven architecture.
* Participate in system design, technical architecture, and application scalability discussions.
* Identify performance bottlenecks and implement appropriate solutions.
* Follow coding standards, design patterns, and software development best practices.

2. VAS & Subscription Management

* Develop and maintain telecom Value Added Services (VAS) platforms.
* Implement complete subscription lifecycle workflows, including activation, deactivation, renewal, auto-renewal, expiry, and cancellation.
* Develop and manage subscription validity, grace period, and retry mechanisms.
* Integrate with telecom operators, aggregators, payment gateways, and third-party service providers.
* Understand telecom billing workflows, operator charging mechanisms, and subscription transaction flows.
* Handle high-volume subscription requests, charging requests, and operator callbacks.
* Ensure consistency between subscription status, transaction status, and billing records.

3. Billing & Payment Processing

* Develop and maintain billing engines and charging workflows for VAS platforms.
* Implement recurring billing, renewal processing, and automated retry mechanisms.
* Handle payment success, failure, timeout, and pending transaction scenarios.
* Implement idempotency mechanisms to prevent duplicate charging.
* Develop transaction reconciliation and audit mechanisms.
* Handle concurrent billing requests and ensure transaction integrity.
* Implement reliable billing processes with proper database transaction management.
* Troubleshoot discrepancies in charging, payment, and renewal operations.
* Optimize billing processes to ensure accurate and reliable revenue collection.

4. Database Management & SQL Optimization

* Strong knowledge of MySQL and/or PostgreSQL.
* Write complex SQL queries involving joins, subqueries, aggregations, and stored procedures.
* Design and optimize database schemas, indexes, and relationships.
* Analyze and optimize slow-running queries.
* Work with large transactional datasets and high-volume billing tables.
* Understand database transactions, locking, isolation levels, and deadlock handling.
* Knowledge of database partitioning, replication, and performance tuning.

5. Redis & Caching

* Hands-on experience with Redis for caching and high-performance data access.
* Implement caching strategies to reduce database load.
* Understand Redis data structures, TTL, expiration, and eviction policies.
* Use Redis for distributed locking, session management, and temporary transaction states.
* Understand cache invalidation and data consistency challenges.
* Implement rate limiting and other performance optimization mechanisms.

6. Messaging & Asynchronous Processing

* Experience with messaging systems such as Apache Kafka or RabbitMQ.
* Understand asynchronous processing and event-driven architecture.
* Implement reliable background jobs for subscription renewals, retries, and billing operations.
* Handle message acknowledgements, retries, dead-letter queues, and duplicate events.
* Ensure fault-tolerant and reliable message processing.

7. Apache Tomcat & Application Server Management

* Hands-on experience with Apache Tomcat application server.
* Deploy and manage Java applications using WAR files.
* Configure and manage Tomcat server instances.
* Understand Tomcat thread pools, request processing, and connection management.
* Perform JVM memory allocation and garbage collection tuning.
* Troubleshoot application deployment issues, server errors, and performance bottlenecks.
* Analyze application logs, server logs, and thread dumps.
* Optimize Tomcat configurations for high-traffic production applications.

8. Linux Administration & Production Server Management

* Strong hands-on experience working with Linux-based production servers such as Ubuntu, CentOS, or RHEL.
* Independently manage, monitor, and troubleshoot Linux servers through command-line interfaces.
* Manage Java applications, Tomcat, Redis, and other backend services in Linux environments.
* Monitor CPU, RAM, swap, disk utilization, and overall server performance.
* Perform application deployment, service management, and production troubleshooting.
* Analyze system and application logs to identify and resolve technical issues.
* Knowledge of Linux permissions, SSH, process management, networking, and scheduled jobs.
* Experience with Bash scripting and automation.
* Troubleshoot production incidents and perform root cause analysis.

9. Performance, Scalability & Reliability

* Develop applications capable of handling high transaction volumes.
* Optimize API response times and backend processing.
* Understand JVM performance tuning, garbage collection, and memory management.
* Identify and resolve database, Redis, Tomcat, and application-level bottlenecks.
* Implement logging, monitoring, alerting, and exception handling.
* Design fault-tolerant systems with appropriate recovery mechanisms.
* Ensure application availability and reliability in production environments.

10. AWS, Infrastructure & DevOps

* Working knowledge of AWS infrastructure, including EC2, RDS, CloudWatch, S3, and Load Balancers.
* Experience deploying and managing Java applications on cloud-based infrastructure.
* Familiarity with Docker and containerization.
* Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and tools such as Jenkins or GitHub Actions.
* Experience with Git and version control workflows.
* Basic understanding of Nginx, reverse proxy, and load balancing.

Fegmo is building an AI-powered commerce intelligence platform that transforms product catalogues into intelligent, actionable commerce experiences. We are building autonomous AI agents that work together to solve complex commerce problems involving product discovery, enrichment, comparison, recommendations and decision-making.

We are looking for a rockstar AI Lead who can take ownership of our AI architecture, build intelligent agents, and lead the development of a scalable, production-ready multi-agent platform.

title: Sr. Data Engineer
description:
**Broad Function:**

The
**Senior Data Engineer – VARTA SENSE**
will be responsible for designing, developing, and managing scalable and reliable data pipelines that form the core data foundation of the VARTA SENSE platform.

The role will work closely with the
**ML Lead, Solution Architect, Backend Engineering team and other technology stakeholders**
to transform complex banking and transaction data into standardized, reusable and production-ready datasets and features.

The position requires strong hands-on expertise in
**Python, SQL, Spark/PySpark, data pipelines, orchestration, data quality and distributed data processing,**
with particular emphasis on reliability, performance, scalability and secure deployment within restricted banking environments.

**Roles and Responsibilities (not limited to):**

**1. Data Pipeline Development & Engineering**

* Design and develop scalable batch, incremental and production-grade data pipelines for large volumes of transaction and customer data.
* Build standardized and reusable data models and canonical schemas for transactions, customer attributes, offers, exposure and outcome events.
* Develop configurable ingestion and mapping frameworks to integrate data received from different banks and source systems.
* Manage pipeline orchestration including dependencies, checkpointing, retries, partial failures, backfills and safe replay mechanisms.
* Implement deduplication, late-arriving data handling, incremental loads, CDC, watermarking and merge/upsert processing.

**2. Data Quality, Reconciliation & Governance**

* Establish strong data-quality controls, automated testing, source-to-target reconciliation and schema validation.
* Ensure data lineage and schema evolution are properly managed across pipelines.
* Proactively identify and prevent issues such as missing data, duplicate records, incorrect aggregations, silent data loss and double counting.
* Maintain reliable and auditable data-processing standards across production environments.

**3. ML Feature Engineering Support**

* Work closely with the ML Lead to develop and maintain analytical and ML feature pipelines.
* Ensure consistency between training and production/inference datasets.
* Maintain point-in-time correctness and prevent data leakage within feature pipelines.
* Support versioned analytical features and reusable feature definitions.

**4. Performance & Scalability**

* Optimize large-scale data-processing workloads through effective partitioning, query optimization, join strategies, memory management and I/O optimization.
* Benchmark workloads against expected transaction volumes and available infrastructure.
* Identify bottlenecks and continuously improve processing speed, stability and infrastructure utilization.
* Ensure data pipelines remain scalable as transaction volumes and customer deployments increase.

**5. Deployment, Security & Production Reliability**

* Develop and support pipelines for deployment within bank-controlled on-premise and private-cloud environments.
* Ensure pipelines can operate in restricted or offline environments without public-internet dependency at runtime.
* Implement appropriate controls for PII handling, encryption, tokenization, masking, access management and secure connectivity.
* Establish monitoring and alerting for pipeline failures, data-quality issues, infrastructure bottlenecks and processing delays.
* Define and maintain backfill, replay, recovery and disaster-recovery procedures for critical pipelines.

**6. Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with ML, Architecture, Backend Engineering, DevOps and Infrastructure teams to design and deliver reliable data solutions.
* Collaborate with development partners to reproduce, transition and operationalize data pipelines within FCI.
* Support integration between data platforms and downstream application / ML services.
* Participate in technical discussions, architecture reviews and production troubleshooting.

**7. Reusability, Documentation & Knowledge Transfer**

* Build reusable adapters and configuration layers so that onboarding a new bank can be managed through configuration and mapping rather than changes to the core product code.
* Maintain clear technical documentation, runbooks and operational procedures.
* Document architecture decisions, troubleshooting steps and recovery procedures.
* Enable alternate engineering resources to independently operate and troubleshoot critical pipelines.
* Participate in code reviews, Git-based development, CI/CD practices and continuous improvement of engineering standards.

**Desired Qualifications & Experience:**

* 5–9 years of relevant experience in Data Engineering, with hands-on ownership of production-grade data pipelines.
* Strong hands-on expertise in Python and Advanced SQL.
* Strong understanding of SQL concepts including window functions, query optimization and query-plan analysis.
* Practical experience with distributed data-processing platforms such as Apache Spark / PySpark or equivalent technologies.
* Experience building and managing production pipelines using Apache Airflow or an equivalent orchestration framework.
* Strong understanding of data modelling, ETL/ELT, batch processing and incremental data pipelines.
* Experience working with Parquet and other columnar data formats, partitioning, schema evolution and reconciliation.
* Practical experience with CDC / incremental ingestion technologies and concepts.
* Exposure to technologies such as Kafka, Debezium or equivalent event / CDC platforms would be preferred.
* Experience implementing automated Data Quality frameworks using tools such as Great Expectations, dbt tests, Soda or equivalent.
* Understanding of Data Lineage and Metadata Management using OpenLineage, Marquez or similar self-hosted solutions would be an advantage.
* Experience with lakehouse technologies such as Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg or Apache Hudi would be preferred.
* Exposure to Feature Store platforms such as Feast or equivalent would be beneficial.
* Working knowledge of Git, CI/CD, Docker and Linux environments.
* Experience with monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana or equivalent platforms.
* Strong understanding of production support, troubleshooting, performance tuning and failure recovery.
* Ability to clearly explain technical design decisions, performance trade-offs and production engineering challenges.
* Strong collaboration skills with Data Science, ML, Backend Engineering, Architecture and Infrastructure teams.

**The company offers a range of employee benefits including:**

* Accidental insurance coverage
* Life insurance coverage
* Retirement benefits including Provident Fund (PF) and Gratuity
* ESI\*
* Complementary meal coupons

title: Forward Deployment AI Solutions Engineer
description:

Our healthcare product portfolio leverages cutting-edge technologies in data analytics, artificial intelligence, and cloud computing to offer seamless, intuitive, and cost-effective solutions. By integrating our systems, primary care practices can enhance patient engagement, optimize appointment scheduling, automate billing and coding processes, and access comprehensive patient health records in real-time. title: AIOps-Agentic AI  Architect
description:
Role Summary

We are hiring hands-on Developers and Engineers to design, build, and deploy production-grade Agentic AI solutions on Aisera and similar platforms (ServiceNow AI and open agent frameworks) across client engagements. You will develop autonomous and multi-agent systems that reason, plan, and execute — integrating LLMs with enterprise systems to automate ITSM, operations, and business workflows, and remaining hands-on through to delivery.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop, configure, and deploy AI agents using Aisera’s platform and comparable agentic AI toolsets to solve real-world client workflows.
* Build autonomous and multi-agent systems capable of planning, reasoning, tool selection, and task execution.
* Design and implement RAG pipelines, function/tool calling, memory and context management, and agent orchestration.
* Integrate agents with external systems — APIs, webhooks, databases, CRMs, ITSM platforms, and data pipelines — for seamless workflow execution.
* Apply prompt engineering and configuration tuning to optimize agent accuracy, latency, and cost in complex enterprise environments.
* Translate business requirements into functional and technical agent designs; run interactive demos and PoCs and iterate on feedback.
* Build scalable backend services/microservices for AI applications; ensure testing, monitoring, and CI/CD best practices.
* Implement AI governance, security, and compliance controls (auth flows, responsible-AI safeguards, observability of agent behavior).
* Troubleshoot, monitor, and continuously improve deployed agents using data-driven evaluation (A/B testing, performance monitoring).

Required Skills & Experience

* 8–12 years in software development, AI/ML engineering, or systems integration, with recent hands-on Agentic AI / LLM delivery.
* Hands-on experience with Aisera or comparable agentic AI / conversational AIOps platforms (ServiceNow AI Agents, Automation Anywhere, similar).
* Strong programming in Python (primary), plus Java and/or JavaScript; clean, efficient, production-quality code.
* Proven experience building agents with LLM frameworks — LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or PydanticAI.
* Solid understanding of LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, RAG, function calling, and agent evaluation.
* Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and multi-agent architectures (preferred).
* Integration experience: REST APIs, webhooks, data pipelines; OAuth/OIDC/JWT authorization flows.
* Cloud & DevOps: AWS, Azure, or GCP, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), CI/CD, and monitoring.
* Familiarity with AI/LLM observability tooling (Langfuse, ELK) is highly desirable.
* Strong problem-solving, customer-facing communication, and the ability to work independently.

Qualifications

* Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or a related field.
* Relevant cloud/AI certifications are a plus.
* Knowledge of AI governance frameworks (e.g., ISO/IEC 42001) is a nice-to-have.

title: AI Lead – Agentic AI & Multi-Agent Systems (Immediate Joinee Preferred)

description:

We combine enterprise data, external intelligence, AI and software engineering to help organizations turn information into intelligence and action.

Our approach combines reusable AI capabilities with hands-on solution development in real enterprise environments. We work closely with business teams to rethink workflows, design intelligent systems and deploy solutions that deliver measurable outcomes.

Bloom AI is based in the U.S. and India (Delhi/NCR).

We are looking for a
**hands-on AI Solutions Architect**
who can design, build and deploy enterprise-grade AI applications and agentic systems.

**AI architecture, data engineering and software development**
.

You may come from a backend engineering, data engineering or data science background, but you should have evolved into building end-to-end AI solutions.

You should be equally comfortable designing a solution architecture, evaluating technology choices, writing code, integrating data sources and taking a working solution into production.

You will work across client engagements, reusable Bloom AI capabilities and internal technology development, taking ownership of solutions from architecture through production deployment.

title: Chief Technology Officer and Co-Founder
description:
About Prismatom
  
  
Prismatom is an independent trust layer for enterprise communications, addressing communication authenticity and impersonation-based fraud at the post-delivery human stage.
  
  
We have built a working, patent-pending product with an existing codebase.
  
  
Our technology uses cryptographic message issuance records, deterministic recognition markers, independent verification, and an append-only, tamper-evident ledger (ATSL) to help customers recognise genuine enterprise communications and enable enterprises to establish verifiable issuance evidence.
  
  
Our advisory board includes top industry leaders who bring strategic expertise, industry insights, and guidance to Prismatom.
  
  
We are seeking a hands-on Co-Founder & CTO who can take complete ownership of our existing technology, strengthen its architecture, and lead its future development.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
- Take end-to-end technical ownership of the existing product, codebase, and architecture.
  
- Conduct technical and security assessments, identify vulnerabilities, and implement improvements.
  
- Lead backend engineering, secure API development, database architecture, and cloud infrastructure.
  
- Oversee cryptographic security, authentication, key management, and system integrity.
  
- Ensure scalability, reliability, performance, and production readiness.
  
- Drive technical strategy, architectural decisions, and future product development.
  
- Establish engineering standards, testing, deployment, and monitoring practices.
  
- Build and lead the engineering team as the company grows.
  
  
Core Technical Requirements
  
  
- Strong hands-on experience in backend engineering and software architecture.
  
- Proven experience designing, developing, and scaling production-grade systems.
  
- Expertise in secure API development, authentication, databases, and cloud infrastructure.
  
- Strong understanding of application security, distributed systems, data integrity, and system reliability.
  
- Ability to independently review, understand, and improve an existing codebase.
  
- Experience making architectural decisions and owning end-to-end engineering execution.
  
  
Specialised Expertise (Highly Desirable)
  
  
- Applied cryptography: SHA-256, HMAC, digital signatures, and asymmetric cryptography.
  
- Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), HSM/KMS, and secure key management.
  
- Tamper-evident ledgers, cryptographic audit trails, and verifiable records.
  
- Enterprise security architecture and secure system integrations.
  
- Experience in cybersecurity, fintech infrastructure, identity systems, or enterprise communication technology.
  
  
Ideal Candidate
  
  
We welcome experienced Staff Engineers, Principal Engineers, Software Architects, Founding Engineers, and hands-on CTOs with demonstrated technical ownership of complex production systems.
  
  
We value independent thinking, strong architectural judgment, security-first engineering, entrepreneurial commitment, and the ability to solve difficult technical problems.
  
  
The ideal candidate should be willing to participate not only in technology development but also in strategic decision-making and the long-term growth of Prismatom.
  
  
Equity, Investment & Co-Founder Commitment
  
  
This is an equity-based co-founder opportunity, not a conventional salaried position.
  
  
- Prismatom is currently at the pre-funding stage, and no salary will be provided before funding.
  
- Equity participation will be mutually negotiated based on responsibilities, commitment, experience, and long-term contribution.
  
- All co-founders will equally share the operating expenses required to run the company.
  
- Candidates must be willing and financially prepared to contribute their equal share of company expenses until the company becomes financially self-sustaining or alternative funding arrangements are established.
  
- Full-time commitment is preferred.
  
- Candidates interested in making an additional strategic investment in Prismatom are particularly welcome. Any such investment will be negotiated separately from co-founder equity and shared operating expenses.
  
  
We are looking for a long-term technical and business partner who brings engineering excellence, entrepreneurial conviction, shared financial responsibility, and the commitment to help establish Prismatom as a trusted enterprise technology company.

title: Associate Director - Agentic AI Implementation & Process Automation
description:
**About Sirius AI**

Sirius AI is an AI consulting and solutions firm working with financial services clients, including banks, fintechs, payments companies and wealth managers. Our teams design, build and run GenAI, agentic AI and ML solutions inside client environments, working alongside their operations, technology and risk teams.

**About the Role**

We are hiring an Associate Director to lead agentic AI and process automation work for our US financial services clients. The role combines solution architecture and delivery leadership. You will design the solution, stay close to the build, and be accountable for getting it into production and keeping it running there.

Most of our work is in operations-heavy processes such as onboarding, KYC/AML, lending, payments operations, claims and servicing, at large organisations with strict security, audit and model risk requirements. You will lead a team of AI engineers, automation developers and business analysts, several of whom are early in their careers.

This is a hands-on role. We expect you to have built and deployed agentic systems yourself and to be comfortable reviewing code, agent traces and architecture decisions with your team.

**What You Will Do**

* Own the solution architecture for agentic automation engagements: agent design, orchestration, tool and MCP server design, integration with client systems, identity and access, and deployment topology.
* Lead delivery from process discovery through build, testing, go-live and hypercare. Fix the process before automating it, and decide which steps need an agent, which are better handled by rules, APIs or RPA, and which should stay with a person.
* Design multi-agent systems, including how agents delegate and hand off work (for example over A2A), how they reach tools and data (for example through MCP), and how state, memory, retries and failures are handled.
* Build and maintain the harness around each solution: evaluation datasets, regression tests, tracing, guardrails, and cost and latency monitoring, so that changes to prompts, models or tools are tested before they reach production.
* Implement role-based access control for agents and MCP tools. Define what each agent is allowed to call, on whose behalf and with what data scope, and align this with the client’s IAM, secrets management and audit logging.
* Deploy agentic solutions in large enterprise environments, which means working through security reviews, architecture boards, model risk validation, change management and integration with existing platforms.
* Set accuracy expectations with clients early. Agree what acceptable performance looks like for each use case, how errors and hallucinations will be measured, and where human review will stay in place, then report against those numbers openly throughout the engagement.
* Design solutions to be modular and reusable. Build up a shared library of agent templates, MCP servers for common FS systems, evaluation datasets and deployment patterns that shorten delivery on the next engagement.
* Lead and coach the delivery team, run design and code reviews, and help junior engineers build practical skills in agentic development.
* Act as the senior technical lead with client stakeholders and support pre-sales with solution design, estimates and staffing plans.

**What You Need**

* 8+ years in software engineering, automation or AI delivery, including at least 2 years building and running LLM-based agentic solutions.
* Hands-on delivery of at least two agentic process automation solutions that went into production at an enterprise client. You should be able to walk us through the architecture, what went wrong and how you measured results.
* A strong engineering background. You should be comfortable writing Python, reviewing pull requests and debugging agent behaviour from traces and logs.
* Working experience with one or more agent frameworks (such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen/Microsoft Agent Framework, Semantic Kernel, OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK or Claude Agent SDK) and a considered view on their trade-offs.
* Practical understanding of MCP (building and securing MCP servers, tool design, authentication) and A2A (agent discovery and task delegation), and when each is the right fit.
* Experience building evaluation and testing harnesses for LLM and agent systems, including golden datasets, LLM-as-judge with human calibration, regression testing and production monitoring.
* Experience implementing access control for agents and tools, such as OAuth/OIDC, service identities, scoped tokens, least-privilege tool access, user delegation and audit trails.
* Experience deploying on Azure, AWS or GCP using containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD and secrets management, within enterprise network, data residency and security constraints.
* Solution architecture experience across integration patterns, including APIs, event-driven systems and RPA where no API exists.
* The ability to explain agent behaviour, failure modes and residual risk to business, technology and risk audiences without overselling what the technology can do.
* A bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering or a related field.

**Good to Have**

* Delivery experience in banking, payments, lending, insurance or wealth management operations.
* Experience with RPA and BPM platforms such as UiPath, Power Automate, Pega, Camunda or ServiceNow.
* Experience with agent observability tools such as LangSmith, Langfuse or Arize.
* Familiarity with model risk management (for example SR 11-7) and AI regulation such as the EU AI Act.
* Experience with intelligent document processing.
* Cloud or architecture certifications.

title: Associate Director - AI Foundation Model Delivery
description:
**About Sirius AI**

Sirius AI is an AI-first consulting and solutions firm serving financial services clients: banks, fintechs, payments companies and wealth managers. We help enterprises move from AI ideas to production-ready solutions using GenAI, agentic AI, ML platforms and advanced analytics, delivering measurable business impact. Our strength lies in combining FS domain expertise, hands-on AI delivery and enterprise-grade execution.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an
**Associate Director – AI Foundation Model Delivery**
to lead the delivery of foundation-model-based solutions for our financial services clients in the US. You will own how transformers-based models are selected, adapted, evaluated, deployed and governed in production, on time, on budget and to regulated-industry standards.

This role sits at the intersection of applied research and enterprise delivery. You should be equally comfortable reviewing a fine-tuning experiment, debating model choice and inference cost with a client architect, and walking a model risk team through an evaluation pack. You will lead a team of AI and ML engineers, many of them early in their careers, and set the technical bar for how Sirius AI works with foundation models.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end delivery of foundation model programs, from use-case framing and model selection through data preparation, adaptation, evaluation, deployment and ongoing monitoring.
* Lead model selection and build-vs-buy decisions across commercial and open-weight models, balancing accuracy, latency, cost, data residency and regulatory constraints.
* Direct model adaptation work including prompt engineering, RAG, supervised fine-tuning, parameter-efficient methods (LoRA/PEFT), instruction tuning and preference optimisation (e.g. DPO, RLHF).
* Oversee training and fine-tuning data pipelines: sourcing, curation, labelling, synthetic data generation, quality assurance and lineage, with strict handling of sensitive FS data.
* Build rigorous evaluation frameworks that combine automated benchmarks, domain-specific test sets, human review, hallucination and bias testing, safety and red-team evaluations.
* Take models into production with sound AIOps: versioning, reproducibility, deployment pipelines, inference optimisation (quantisation, distillation, batching, caching) and cost controls.
* Ensure every model meets enterprise AI governance, model risk management, security and privacy requirements, with audit-ready model documentation and validation evidence.
* Own delivery economics for foundation model work, including scope, estimates, GPU and compute budgets, staffing plans, utilisation and margin.
* Lead, mentor and grow a team of AI/ML engineers and data scientists; build training paths in foundation model techniques and FS domain knowledge.
* Build reusable assets such as fine-tuning recipes, evaluation harnesses, model cards and reference architectures that speed up delivery across engagements.
* Act as senior technical lead with client stakeholders and support pre-sales with solution design, model strategy, estimation and staffing plans.

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics or a related field; a PhD is a plus.
* 8+ years of experience in AI/ML, data science or ML engineering, including at least 3–4 years working hands-on with LLMs or other foundation models.
* A proven track record of delivering foundation-model-based solutions into production in enterprise environments, with specific examples of fine-tuning, evaluation and deployment.
* Deep technical knowledge of transformer architectures, fine-tuning and alignment methods, RAG, model evaluation and inference optimisation.
* Strong Python skills and hands-on experience with frameworks such as PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, PEFT, vLLM/TGI and distributed training (e.g. CUDF, DASK, DeepSpeed, FSDP).
* Experience with cloud AI and GPU platforms (AWS SageMaker/Bedrock, Azure ML/Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, Databricks) and AIOps tooling.
* Experience leading technical delivery teams in a consulting, AI services or product engineering environment, including developing junior talent.
* Ability to translate model trade-offs, risks and evaluation results into clear business and risk language for senior stakeholders.

**Good to Have**

* Delivery experience with financial services clients in areas such as risk, fraud, compliance, credit, customer servicing or research.
* Familiarity with model risk management, model validation practices and responsible AI frameworks.
* Experience with multimodal models, document understanding, speech or small language models for on-premise deployment.
* Exposure to agentic AI, LLM orchestration and tool-use patterns built on top of foundation models.
* Publications, open-source contributions or conference talks in LLMs, Foundation Model or applied ML.

title: Director of Engineering
description:
**About ArmorCode**
ArmorCode is the agentic control plane for Unified Exposure Management: one platform that unifies, prioritizes, and remediates risk across applications, code, software supply chain, cloud, infrastructure, and AI.
  
  
The ArmorCode Agentic AI Platform ingests findings from 400+ security tools, correlates them with business context in the Context Risk Graph, and puts Anya AI agents to work prioritizing, routing, and verifying fixes.
  
  
The platform is proven at enterprise scale, processing 400B+ findings annually and supporting more than 5,600 security professionals and 300,000 developers. Global enterprises including Visa, PayPal, Volvo Group, and Johnson Controls use ArmorCode to shorten find-to-fix time and reduce risk.
  
  
ArmorCoders believe in five core values:
**Hungry. Humble. Hardworking. Honest. Human.**
Our organization is powered by exceptional professionals who bring fresh ideas and passion to their roles, believing that nothing is beyond reach when our "5H" principles are applied. In their work and professional relationships, ArmorCoders commit to excellence and experiences that leave an impression.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Director of Engineering owns how ArmorCode builds and delivers its product. This role leads Development and also manages Quality Engineering, and is expected to drive synergies between the two so that building and validating software work as one motion. The role is accountable for delivery predictability, release quality, and the people and org structure behind them.
  
  
This is also the role that shapes how ArmorCode builds software in an AI-native world. Several teams already run agentic workflows. The Director sets the direction, standards, and accountability that move engineering from AI-assisted work toward genuine autonomy, and ensures the org, architecture, and talent are ready for what comes next.
  
  
Reporting to the Head of Engineering, this role gives leadership an accurate, ongoing view of delivery, quality, and engineering health. It also carries direct ownership of engineering-level escalations on strategic enterprise accounts.
  
  
**What You'll Own**
**Your Org**

* Lead Development and Quality Engineering, creating the shared practices and priorities that let the two functions reinforce each other
* Actively redesign org structure as the product, headcount, and AI-driven ways of working evolve, including pod structure, reporting lines, and where Dev and QA boundaries should sit
* Hire and develop engineering managers and QA leadership; set the hiring bar and build a bench capable of running each function independently
* Own IDPs for all direct reports and key senior engineers; hold people accountable to growth plans with a clear 3-6 month review cycle
* Own promotions, calibration, and performance processes for the org, including writing promotion narratives, running calibration sessions, and managing attrition directly
* Handle escalations that span functions, such as a release delayed by both Dev and QA, or inter-team friction that blocks delivery

**Development & Delivery**

* Own delivery predictability across releases: planning, sprint health, dependency management, and on-time, high-quality shipping
* Set engineering standards for architecture, code review, branching, and release practices as headcount and product surface area grow
* Partner with Product and other engineering leaders to commit to realistic scope and timelines, and hold the line when they aren’t
* Drive technical direction for a platform that must scale across customers, integrations, and deployment models, and keep tech debt visible and managed
* Own incident response practice for the product, including being available and accountable when production incidents involve strategic customers

**Enterprise Customer Escalations**

* Own engineering-level escalations for strategic enterprise accounts: debugging production issues, reviewing customer logs, coordinating fixes, and representing engineering directly with the customer or account team
* Make the call on when an issue is ArmorCode’s problem vs. a third-party integration, and own the communication when that distinction matters
* Manage the follow-through on enterprise-specific requirements (private instances, dedicated tenants, custom integrations) from engineering’s side

**Quality Engineering**

* Own quality outcomes at the org level, with Dev and QA sharing accountability for what reaches customers
* Drive shift-left practices and bring QA closer to development, so quality is built in rather than checked at the end
* Own org-wide quality metrics, including defect leakage, escaped defects, and regression stability, and report them to leadership
* Hold the line on quality expectations under exec pressure: be the person who can explain what the numbers actually mean and push back where the bar is set unrealistically

**AI & Agentic Work**

* Set the vision for AI-native engineering at ArmorCode: how code is written, reviewed, tested, and released when agents are part of the team
* Define org-wide standards for agentic work: what constitutes genuine autonomy vs. AI-assisted work, required eval harnesses, guardrails, and where human sign-off remains mandatory
* Make model, tooling, and vendor decisions (which LLM for which workflow, build vs. buy) and own the tradeoffs
* Hold managers accountable for agentic adoption through outcome review, not code review
* Report the org’s actual agentic maturity to leadership: what is genuinely autonomous, what is still AI-assisted, and the plan to close the gap
* Build the skills, hiring profile, and ways of working the org will need as AI changes what engineers do

**Strategy, Capacity & OKRs**

* Set multi-quarter engineering strategy aligned with company priorities and where the ASPM market is heading

title: UX Manager – AI-Native Products
description:
INCEDO · JOB DESCRIPTION

UX Manager – AI-Native Products (Conversational & Agentic Interfaces )

LEVEL -Manager (player-coach)

TEAM -Products & Platforms

EXPERIENCE 10–14 years

ABOUT THE ROLE

Incedo’s Products & Platforms team builds AI-native products for enterprise clients. Our users ask questions in natural language, review what the AI finds and recommends, and decide what to act on. You’ll set the design direction for that experience and lead a senior UI/UX designer. This is a player-coach role: most of your time goes into hands-on design. WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Set the interaction model for our AI-native products: when to use conversation, when to use structured UI, and how the two combine across dashboards, workspaces and agent workflows.

• Design trust into every AI output, including sources and provenance, confidence and uncertainty, explanations an expert can check, and approval steps before an agent acts.

• Personally own the hardest flows end to end, from research and concepts through prototypes built on live model outputs to shipped product.

• Build and govern the design system, including AI patterns for streaming and partial results, latency, errors and refusals, multi-turn context, undo and handoff to a human. • Set up a research and quality practice: regular usability testing, feedback loops from real usage, and UX metrics for AI features that guide priorities with product.

• Lead and grow the senior UI/UX designer, set the quality bar and critique practice, partner with product, engineering and data science, and shape the demos we put in front of client executives.

WHAT YOU BRING

• 10–14 years in UI/UX design, including 3+ years leading design for complex B2B or enterprise products, and at least one AI-powered product (assistant, copilot or agent) that you shipped and then improved based on real usage.

• A demonstrated point of view on AI interaction design: when conversation helps and when it gets in the way, how much autonomy an agent should have, and how to show uncertainty without eroding trust.

• Deep conversation design: context across turns, disambiguation, repair when the model misunderstands, and response guidelines for tone, length and structure. • Agentic and trust patterns for high-stakes work: plan previews, approval gates, undo and rollback, audit trails, and explanations experts can verify quickly.

• Experience measuring AI experiences through task success, time to answer, correction and override rates, and qualitative trust signals.

• Design-system leadership: tokens, components and patterns adopted across multiple products or teams, built to WCAG 2.2 AA by default.

• Senior-level hands-on craft in visual and interaction design for data-dense screens, and in prototyping with live model outputs; expert in Figma or equivalent tools.

• A portfolio of case studies showing framing, trade-offs and outcomes, including what didn’t work and what you changed.

description:

title: Chief Technology Officer and Co-Founder
description:
About Prismatom
  
  
Prismatom is an independent trust layer for enterprise communications, addressing communication authenticity and impersonation-based fraud at the post-delivery human stage.
  
  
We have built a working, patent-pending product with an existing codebase.
  
  
Our technology uses cryptographic message issuance records, deterministic recognition markers, independent verification, and an append-only, tamper-evident ledger (ATSL) to help customers recognise genuine enterprise communications and enable enterprises to establish verifiable issuance evidence.
  
  
Our advisory board includes top industry leaders who bring strategic expertise, industry insights, and guidance to Prismatom.
  
  
We are seeking a hands-on Co-Founder & CTO who can take complete ownership of our existing technology, strengthen its architecture, and lead its future development.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
- Take end-to-end technical ownership of the existing product, codebase, and architecture.
  
- Conduct technical and security assessments, identify vulnerabilities, and implement improvements.
  
- Lead backend engineering, secure API development, database architecture, and cloud infrastructure.
  
- Oversee cryptographic security, authentication, key management, and system integrity.
  
- Ensure scalability, reliability, performance, and production readiness.
  
- Drive technical strategy, architectural decisions, and future product development.
  
- Establish engineering standards, testing, deployment, and monitoring practices.
  
- Build and lead the engineering team as the company grows.
  
  
Core Technical Requirements
  
  
- Strong hands-on experience in backend engineering and software architecture.
  
- Proven experience designing, developing, and scaling production-grade systems.
  
- Expertise in secure API development, authentication, databases, and cloud infrastructure.
  
- Strong understanding of application security, distributed systems, data integrity, and system reliability.
  
- Ability to independently review, understand, and improve an existing codebase.
  
- Experience making architectural decisions and owning end-to-end engineering execution.
  
  
Specialised Expertise (Highly Desirable)
  
  
- Applied cryptography: SHA-256, HMAC, digital signatures, and asymmetric cryptography.
  
- Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), HSM/KMS, and secure key management.
  
- Tamper-evident ledgers, cryptographic audit trails, and verifiable records.
  
- Enterprise security architecture and secure system integrations.
  
- Experience in cybersecurity, fintech infrastructure, identity systems, or enterprise communication technology.
  
  
Ideal Candidate
  
  
We welcome experienced Staff Engineers, Principal Engineers, Software Architects, Founding Engineers, and hands-on CTOs with demonstrated technical ownership of complex production systems.
  
  
We value independent thinking, strong architectural judgment, security-first engineering, entrepreneurial commitment, and the ability to solve difficult technical problems.
  
  
The ideal candidate should be willing to participate not only in technology development but also in strategic decision-making and the long-term growth of Prismatom.
  
  
Equity, Investment & Co-Founder Commitment
  
  
This is an equity-based co-founder opportunity, not a conventional salaried position.
  
  
- Prismatom is currently at the pre-funding stage, and no salary will be provided before funding.
  
- Equity participation will be mutually negotiated based on responsibilities, commitment, experience, and long-term contribution.
  
- All co-founders will equally share the operating expenses required to run the company.
  
- Candidates must be willing and financially prepared to contribute their equal share of company expenses until the company becomes financially self-sustaining or alternative funding arrangements are established.
  
- Full-time commitment is preferred.
  
- Candidates interested in making an additional strategic investment in Prismatom are particularly welcome. Any such investment will be negotiated separately from co-founder equity and shared operating expenses.
  
  
We are looking for a long-term technical and business partner who brings engineering excellence, entrepreneurial conviction, shared financial responsibility, and the commitment to help establish Prismatom as a trusted enterprise technology company.

* Drive active-active setup, high-throughput regional design and disaster recovery architecture, including RTO/RPO planning.
* Apply strong fundamentals in concurrency, distributed systems and networking.

title: Associate Director - Agentic AI Implementation & Process Automation
description:
**About Sirius AI**

Sirius AI is an AI consulting and solutions firm working with financial services clients, including banks, fintechs, payments companies and wealth managers. Our teams design, build and run GenAI, agentic AI and ML solutions inside client environments, working alongside their operations, technology and risk teams.

**About the Role**

We are hiring an Associate Director to lead agentic AI and process automation work for our US financial services clients. The role combines solution architecture and delivery leadership. You will design the solution, stay close to the build, and be accountable for getting it into production and keeping it running there.

Most of our work is in operations-heavy processes such as onboarding, KYC/AML, lending, payments operations, claims and servicing, at large organisations with strict security, audit and model risk requirements. You will lead a team of AI engineers, automation developers and business analysts, several of whom are early in their careers.

This is a hands-on role. We expect you to have built and deployed agentic systems yourself and to be comfortable reviewing code, agent traces and architecture decisions with your team.

**What You Will Do**

* Own the solution architecture for agentic automation engagements: agent design, orchestration, tool and MCP server design, integration with client systems, identity and access, and deployment topology.
* Lead delivery from process discovery through build, testing, go-live and hypercare. Fix the process before automating it, and decide which steps need an agent, which are better handled by rules, APIs or RPA, and which should stay with a person.
* Design multi-agent systems, including how agents delegate and hand off work (for example over A2A), how they reach tools and data (for example through MCP), and how state, memory, retries and failures are handled.
* Build and maintain the harness around each solution: evaluation datasets, regression tests, tracing, guardrails, and cost and latency monitoring, so that changes to prompts, models or tools are tested before they reach production.
* Implement role-based access control for agents and MCP tools. Define what each agent is allowed to call, on whose behalf and with what data scope, and align this with the client’s IAM, secrets management and audit logging.
* Deploy agentic solutions in large enterprise environments, which means working through security reviews, architecture boards, model risk validation, change management and integration with existing platforms.
* Set accuracy expectations with clients early. Agree what acceptable performance looks like for each use case, how errors and hallucinations will be measured, and where human review will stay in place, then report against those numbers openly throughout the engagement.
* Design solutions to be modular and reusable. Build up a shared library of agent templates, MCP servers for common FS systems, evaluation datasets and deployment patterns that shorten delivery on the next engagement.
* Lead and coach the delivery team, run design and code reviews, and help junior engineers build practical skills in agentic development.
* Act as the senior technical lead with client stakeholders and support pre-sales with solution design, estimates and staffing plans.

**What You Need**

* 8+ years in software engineering, automation or AI delivery, including at least 2 years building and running LLM-based agentic solutions.
* Hands-on delivery of at least two agentic process automation solutions that went into production at an enterprise client. You should be able to walk us through the architecture, what went wrong and how you measured results.
* A strong engineering background. You should be comfortable writing Python, reviewing pull requests and debugging agent behaviour from traces and logs.
* Working experience with one or more agent frameworks (such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen/Microsoft Agent Framework, Semantic Kernel, OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK or Claude Agent SDK) and a considered view on their trade-offs.
* Practical understanding of MCP (building and securing MCP servers, tool design, authentication) and A2A (agent discovery and task delegation), and when each is the right fit.
* Experience building evaluation and testing harnesses for LLM and agent systems, including golden datasets, LLM-as-judge with human calibration, regression testing and production monitoring.
* Experience implementing access control for agents and tools, such as OAuth/OIDC, service identities, scoped tokens, least-privilege tool access, user delegation and audit trails.
* Experience deploying on Azure, AWS or GCP using containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD and secrets management, within enterprise network, data residency and security constraints.
* Solution architecture experience across integration patterns, including APIs, event-driven systems and RPA where no API exists.
* The ability to explain agent behaviour, failure modes and residual risk to business, technology and risk audiences without overselling what the technology can do.
* A bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering or a related field.

**Good to Have**

* Delivery experience in banking, payments, lending, insurance or wealth management operations.
* Experience with RPA and BPM platforms such as UiPath, Power Automate, Pega, Camunda or ServiceNow.
* Experience with agent observability tools such as LangSmith, Langfuse or Arize.
* Familiarity with model risk management (for example SR 11-7) and AI regulation such as the EU AI Act.
* Experience with intelligent document processing.
* Cloud or architecture certifications.

title: Associate Director - AI Foundation Model Delivery
description:
**About Sirius AI**

Sirius AI is an AI-first consulting and solutions firm serving financial services clients: banks, fintechs, payments companies and wealth managers. We help enterprises move from AI ideas to production-ready solutions using GenAI, agentic AI, ML platforms and advanced analytics, delivering measurable business impact. Our strength lies in combining FS domain expertise, hands-on AI delivery and enterprise-grade execution.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an
**Associate Director – AI Foundation Model Delivery**
to lead the delivery of foundation-model-based solutions for our financial services clients in the US. You will own how transformers-based models are selected, adapted, evaluated, deployed and governed in production, on time, on budget and to regulated-industry standards.

This role sits at the intersection of applied research and enterprise delivery. You should be equally comfortable reviewing a fine-tuning experiment, debating model choice and inference cost with a client architect, and walking a model risk team through an evaluation pack. You will lead a team of AI and ML engineers, many of them early in their careers, and set the technical bar for how Sirius AI works with foundation models.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end delivery of foundation model programs, from use-case framing and model selection through data preparation, adaptation, evaluation, deployment and ongoing monitoring.
* Lead model selection and build-vs-buy decisions across commercial and open-weight models, balancing accuracy, latency, cost, data residency and regulatory constraints.
* Direct model adaptation work including prompt engineering, RAG, supervised fine-tuning, parameter-efficient methods (LoRA/PEFT), instruction tuning and preference optimisation (e.g. DPO, RLHF).
* Oversee training and fine-tuning data pipelines: sourcing, curation, labelling, synthetic data generation, quality assurance and lineage, with strict handling of sensitive FS data.
* Build rigorous evaluation frameworks that combine automated benchmarks, domain-specific test sets, human review, hallucination and bias testing, safety and red-team evaluations.

**Good to Have**

title: AI Data Science Solutions Lead, Aladdin, Vice President
description:
**About This Role**
**Your Team**
The Data Science & Artificial Intelligence (AI) team helps transform how technology, data, and AI drive better outcomes for clients and the business. The team partners closely with client-facing teams, product strategists, engineers, and business leaders to develop and scale AI-powered solutions that enhance productivity, improve decision-making, strengthen client engagement, and unlock commercial value. This is a highly impactful team focused on translating innovation into real-world business outcomes and advancing the future of AI-powered client engagement across the firm.
  
  
**Your Role and Impact**
We are seeking a highly motivated AI Solutions Lead to join the Data Science & AI team. This role combines technical expertise in machine learning, generative AI, and data engineering with the ability to translate business challenges into scalable AI solutions. You will partner with stakeholders across Sales, Product Strategy, Chief Operating Officer (COO) functions, and Technology to identify opportunities, develop AI-driven products, and deploy solutions that drive measurable business outcomes. Success in this role requires intellectual curiosity, analytical thinking, hands-on technical skills, and the ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**
In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and embrace the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies while challenging outcomes. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Develop artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and advanced analytics solutions that drive commercial growth, improve client experiences, and enhance operational efficiency.
* Design, develop, evaluate, and deploy AI and machine learning solutions in partnership with engineering teams.
* Build intelligent AI-powered assistants, agentic workflows, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) applications that deliver measurable business value.
* Establish experimentation, evaluation, monitoring, and performance measurement frameworks to assess business impact and solution effectiveness.
* Leverage modern cloud, data, and directed acyclic graph-based workflow orchestration frameworks for data and batch processing to build scalable AI solutions.
* Champion responsible AI practices, model governance, security, scalability, and reliability standards.
* Partner across product, engineering, business, and AI teams to advance enterprise AI capabilities and communicate insights effectively.

Your Experience
  
  

* Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Economics, or another quantitative discipline; advanced degrees are a plus.
* Demonstrated ability to build and deploy AI and machine learning solutions in production environments.
* Strong technical proficiency in Python, Structured Query Language (SQL), data engineering, and analytical platforms.
* Demonstrated expertise in machine learning, statistics, experimentation, and predictive modeling.
* Experience developing generative AI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, natural language processing (NLP), and related techniques.
* Experience in asset management, financial services, fintech, or modern cloud-based AI ecosystems is preferred.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and responsible AI practices.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.
