title: AI Solutions Architect
description:
**ABOUT BLOOM AI**

Bloom AI is an applied AI firm building AI-native intelligence systems and workflows for enterprise teams across research, marketing, sales and other knowledge-intensive functions.

We combine enterprise data, external intelligence, AI and software engineering to help organizations turn information into intelligence and action.

Our approach combines reusable AI capabilities with hands-on solution development in real enterprise environments. We work closely with business teams to rethink workflows, design intelligent systems and deploy solutions that deliver measurable outcomes.

Bloom AI is based in the U.S. and India (Delhi/NCR).

**THE ROLE**

We are looking for a
**hands-on AI Solutions Architect**
who can design, build and deploy enterprise-grade AI applications and agentic systems.

This role sits at the intersection of
**AI architecture, data engineering and software development**
.

You may come from a backend engineering, data engineering or data science background, but you should have evolved into building end-to-end AI solutions.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have worked on
**multiple AI/LLM projects**
, solved different types of problems and gained practical experience making architectural decisions across agent orchestration, data, context management, application development and deployment.

You should be equally comfortable designing a solution architecture, evaluating technology choices, writing code, integrating data sources and taking a working solution into production.

This is
**not a traditional software engineering role, a prompt-engineering role or a PowerPoint-only architecture role**
. We need someone who understands how AI systems work end-to-end and can personally build what they design.

You will work across client engagements, reusable Bloom AI capabilities and internal technology development, taking ownership of solutions from architecture through production deployment.

You will be part of the core team, reporting directly to the CEO.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

Leading a small team, you will:

**Architect Bloom AI Capabilities and Client Solutions**

* Design end-to-end AI solutions combining LLMs, agents, enterprise data, APIs and applications.
* Mak architectural decisions around agent orchestration, context, memory, workflows and technology choices.
* Build modular, reusable solutions that work across different cloud and enterprise environments.

**Build agentic applications**

* Develop multi-agent systems, agentic workflows and LLM-powered applications using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain or similar.
* Implement tool calling, RAG, semantic search, agent memory and state management.
* Build evaluation, monitoring and reliability mechanisms for production AI systems.

**Engineer data and context systems**

* Integrate structured and unstructured enterprise data into AI applications.
* Design retrieval and context architectures using relational, vector and graph databases.
* Build knowledge retrieval, entity relationships and persistent context capabilities.

**Develop and deploy end to end systems**

* Build backend services and APIs using Python, FastAPI or similar technologies.
* Develop functional frontend applications and integrate with enterprise systems.
* Deploy secure, scalable applications across cloud platforms using modern engineering practices.

**Solve enterprise client problems**

* Translate business challenges into practical AI architectures and working solutions.
* Work across multiple client projects, from solution design and prototyping through deployment.
* Evaluate technical approaches, collaborate with stakeholders and develop reusable capabilities for Bloom AI.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* **4–7 years of professional experience**
  , with a foundation in
  **backend engineering, data engineering, data science or related technical disciplines**
  .
* **Hands-on experience across multiple AI/LLM application projects**
  , preferably involving different use cases, data environments or architectural approaches.
* Demonstrated ability to take ownership of solution architecture and technical implementation, rather than contributing to only one component of a system.
* Strong proficiency in
  **Python**
  , with solid software engineering and API development skills.
* Practical experience building
  **agentic applications or multi-agent systems**
  , beyond basic chatbots and prompt-based applications.
* Experience with agent orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen or similar.
* Strong understanding of LLM APIs, tool calling, RAG, embeddings, vector databases and context management.
* Strong understanding of data modeling, SQL, databases, data integration and retrieval architectures.
* Working knowledge of full-stack application development, including modern frontend frameworks such as React or Next.js.
* Familiarity with graph data structures, entity relationships and graph-based retrieval concepts.
* Experience taking AI applications from prototype through testing, integration and production deployment.
* Experience with at least one major cloud platform and familiarity with Docker, Git, CI/CD and modern engineering practices.
* Ability to evaluate different technical approaches and make sound architectural trade-offs.
* Strong independent problem-solving skills, curiosity and comfort working with ambiguous requirements.
* Lead R&D efforts for Bloom AI

**Above all, we are looking for someone who has built several AI solutions, understands the architectural decisions behind them and can independently design and implement new ones.**

**GOOD TO HAVE**

* Startup or
  **0-to-1 product development experience**
  .
* Experience working on enterprise AI projects across different business functions or client environments.
* Experience integrating with
  **marketing, sales or commercial systems**
  , such as CRM, marketing automation, campaign platforms, content management systems or sales enablement tools.
* Experience working directly with enterprise clients and translating business requirements into technical solutions.
* Experience building AI applications for financial services, research or other knowledge-intensive domains.

title: Data Modeler
description:
**About the Company**

The postholder will work as part of the CDAO based in Staines or Salford, collaborating with Data Engineers, Developers, and other Data Modellers. The role supports the Snowflake Data Platform and contributes to the delivery of enterprise data products and capabilities under the direction of the Senior Data Warehouse Development Manager (Modelling).

**About the Role**

The postholder will work mainly in one of our offices and not be required to undertake heavy lifting or manual work. Travel can be required to other office or customer/supplier sites should there be sufficient business justification.

**Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain end-to-end ELT pipelines using scalable, metadata-driven frameworks and patterns.
* Develop high-quality Data Vault 2.0 models (Hubs, Links, Satellites), demonstrating strong understanding of modelling principles and standards.
* Design and implement dimensional models (star schemas, marts) to support efficient analytics and reporting use cases.
* Investigate and resolve SQL performance issues.
* Support Circular Data Architecture ensuring reuse and optimisation.
* Build and enhance the Circular Data Architecture product features.
* Create data marts and data products for analytics consumption.
* Resolve data issues through to source for internal customers.
* Maintain documentation and metadata using tools such as Ellie.ai.
* Contribute to quality assurance, testing and reviews.
* Proactively identify and manage risks and issues.

**Required Skills**

**Qualifications**

* Qualifications, Training and Experience
* At least 3/4 years experience in enterprise data modelling and data platform development.

* Strong experience in dimensional modelling, including:
* Star schema design
* Fact and dimension modelling
* Performance and usability optimisation for analytics
* Experience applying the right modelling technique for the right use case (e.g., Data Vault vs dimensional vs 3NF).

* Experience building ELT pipelines using SQL and modern data engineering practices.
* Familiarity with metadata-driven development and modelling tools (e.g., Ellie.ai).
* Experience working with version control and CI/CD tooling (ADO Git).
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to communicate modelling approaches clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience of full development lifecycle and modern delivery approaches.
* Ability to manage workload effectively in a dynamic environment.

**Preferred Skills**

* Freedom of Action
* Autonomy: Works under general direction. Uses discretion in identifying and responding to issues and assignments within the Snowflake data platform. Determines when issues should be escalated.
* Influence: Interacts with and influences colleagues within the CDAO and engages with business stakeholders where required. Contributes ideas and supports the adoption of modern data practices including Data Vault and Circular Data Architecture.
* Complexity: Performs a range of work, sometimes complex and non-routine, including data modelling, pipeline development, Streamlit application development, and performance optimisation. Applies a structured and analytical approach to problem solving.
* Business Skills: Selects appropriately from applicable standards, methods, tools and applications from broader team pre-defined standards. Communicates fluently, orally and in writing, and can present information to both technical and non-technical audiences. Facilitates collaboration between stakeholders (with assistance when necessary) who share common objectives. Plans, schedules and monitors own workload to meet time and quality targets. Rapidly absorbs new information and applies it effectively. Develops awareness of technologies and their application and takes

title: Associate Director - AI Foundation Model Delivery
description:
**About Sirius AI**

Sirius AI is an AI-first consulting and solutions firm serving financial services clients: banks, fintechs, payments companies and wealth managers. We help enterprises move from AI ideas to production-ready solutions using GenAI, agentic AI, ML platforms and advanced analytics, delivering measurable business impact. Our strength lies in combining FS domain expertise, hands-on AI delivery and enterprise-grade execution.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an
**Associate Director – AI Foundation Model Delivery**
to lead the delivery of foundation-model-based solutions for our financial services clients in the US. You will own how transformers-based models are selected, adapted, evaluated, deployed and governed in production, on time, on budget and to regulated-industry standards.

This role sits at the intersection of applied research and enterprise delivery. You should be equally comfortable reviewing a fine-tuning experiment, debating model choice and inference cost with a client architect, and walking a model risk team through an evaluation pack. You will lead a team of AI and ML engineers, many of them early in their careers, and set the technical bar for how Sirius AI works with foundation models.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end delivery of foundation model programs, from use-case framing and model selection through data preparation, adaptation, evaluation, deployment and ongoing monitoring.
* Lead model selection and build-vs-buy decisions across commercial and open-weight models, balancing accuracy, latency, cost, data residency and regulatory constraints.
* Direct model adaptation work including prompt engineering, RAG, supervised fine-tuning, parameter-efficient methods (LoRA/PEFT), instruction tuning and preference optimisation (e.g. DPO, RLHF).
* Oversee training and fine-tuning data pipelines: sourcing, curation, labelling, synthetic data generation, quality assurance and lineage, with strict handling of sensitive FS data.
* Build rigorous evaluation frameworks that combine automated benchmarks, domain-specific test sets, human review, hallucination and bias testing, safety and red-team evaluations.
* Take models into production with sound AIOps: versioning, reproducibility, deployment pipelines, inference optimisation (quantisation, distillation, batching, caching) and cost controls.
* Ensure every model meets enterprise AI governance, model risk management, security and privacy requirements, with audit-ready model documentation and validation evidence.
* Own delivery economics for foundation model work, including scope, estimates, GPU and compute budgets, staffing plans, utilisation and margin.
* Lead, mentor and grow a team of AI/ML engineers and data scientists; build training paths in foundation model techniques and FS domain knowledge.
* Build reusable assets such as fine-tuning recipes, evaluation harnesses, model cards and reference architectures that speed up delivery across engagements.
* Act as senior technical lead with client stakeholders and support pre-sales with solution design, model strategy, estimation and staffing plans.

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics or a related field; a PhD is a plus.
* 8+ years of experience in AI/ML, data science or ML engineering, including at least 3–4 years working hands-on with LLMs or other foundation models.
* A proven track record of delivering foundation-model-based solutions into production in enterprise environments, with specific examples of fine-tuning, evaluation and deployment.
* Deep technical knowledge of transformer architectures, fine-tuning and alignment methods, RAG, model evaluation and inference optimisation.
* Strong Python skills and hands-on experience with frameworks such as PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, PEFT, vLLM/TGI and distributed training (e.g. CUDF, DASK, DeepSpeed, FSDP).
* Experience with cloud AI and GPU platforms (AWS SageMaker/Bedrock, Azure ML/Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, Databricks) and AIOps tooling.
* Experience leading technical delivery teams in a consulting, AI services or product engineering environment, including developing junior talent.
* Ability to translate model trade-offs, risks and evaluation results into clear business and risk language for senior stakeholders.

**Good to Have**

* Delivery experience with financial services clients in areas such as risk, fraud, compliance, credit, customer servicing or research.
* Familiarity with model risk management, model validation practices and responsible AI frameworks.
* Experience with multimodal models, document understanding, speech or small language models for on-premise deployment.
* Exposure to agentic AI, LLM orchestration and tool-use patterns built on top of foundation models.
* Publications, open-source contributions or conference talks in LLMs, Foundation Model or applied ML.

Professional mannerisms with the ability to listen and probe determine root causes and resolve issues quickly when necessary. Shift timings: 12:30 PM to 9:30 PM

title: Manager - AI Delivery
description:
**About Sirius AI**

Sirius AI is an AI-first consulting and solutions firm serving financial services clients: banks, fintechs, payments companies and wealth managers. We help enterprises move from AI ideas to production-ready solutions using GenAI, agentic AI, ML platforms and advanced analytics, delivering measurable business impact. Our strength lies in combining FS domain expertise, hands-on AI delivery and enterprise-grade execution.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Manager - AI Delivery to run day-to-day delivery of AI engagements for our financial services clients in the US. You will own the plan, the team and the client relationship for one or more AI projects, making sure GenAI, agentic AI and ML solutions are built, tested and shipped to production on time, on budget and to regulated-industry standards.

This is a hands-on delivery role for someone who understands the AI lifecycle well enough to spot technical risk early, and who enjoys building strong, well-run teams. You will work closely with technical leads and engineers, many of them early in their careers, and report into our AI delivery leadership.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own day-to-day delivery of one or more AI projects, from requirements and design through build, testing, deployment and hypercare.
* Translate client business objectives into clear scope, user stories, acceptance criteria and technical execution plans together with solution architects and technical leads.
* Run the delivery cadence: sprint planning, stand-ups, demos, retrospectives, milestone tracking, status reporting and RAID management.
* Track scope, estimates, effort, budget and utilisation; manage change requests and escalate risks to leadership and clients early.
* Make sure AI-specific work is planned properly, including data readiness, model and prompt evaluation, testing of non-deterministic outputs, and production monitoring.
* Apply delivery standards for code review, testing, documentation, MLOps/AIOps and quality gates before work reaches clients.
* Coordinate across data engineering, ML/AI engineering, application development, QA and client IT, security and risk teams.
* Lead, coach and support a team of engineers and analysts; contribute to onboarding, performance feedback and skills development.
* Be the primary day-to-day contact for client stakeholders, run project reviews and keep expectations aligned on scope, timelines and outcomes.
* Ensure delivery meets AI governance, security, data privacy and FS compliance requirements, with complete project documentation.
* Contribute to reusable templates, playbooks and lessons learned, and support pre-sales with estimates and project plans.

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics or a related field; a master's degree or MBA is a plus.
* 5+ years of experience in technology, data or analytics delivery, including at least 2–3 years managing AI/ML, Agentic AI or advanced analytics projects.
* Experience delivering AI/ML or Agentic AI solutions into production for enterprise clients.
* Working technical understanding of the AI lifecycle, including data pipelines, model development, LLMs and RAG, AIOps/MLOps, deployment, inferencing and monitoring.
* Strong command of Agile and hybrid delivery methods, estimation, project financials and tools such as Jira, Confluence or Azure DevOps.
* Experience managing and developing small to mid-sized delivery teams, including junior and early-career talent.
* Experience in consulting firms, AI services companies or global delivery centres.
* Clear, structured communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain technical progress and risks in business terms.

**Good to Have**

* Delivery experience with financial services clients in banking, fintech, payments, risk, fraud, compliance or wealth management.
* Exposure to agentic AI, LLM orchestration or intelligent automation projects.
* Familiarity with cloud AI platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP, Databricks).
* Experience working in onshore/offshore or distributed delivery models.
* Certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, CSM/SAFe or cloud AI certifications.

title: Performance Marketer
description:
E-commerce Growth Manager – Performance Marketing, SEO & Shopify

**Company:**
Estrip Solution

**Location:**
Gurugram, Haryana

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Work Mode:**
On-site

**Experience:**
2–4 Years

Company Description

Estrip Solution is a cleaning innovation company with over 25 years of expertise in bio-enzyme manufacturing and cleaning product R&D. The company has developed India's first water-soluble cleaning sheets, offering powerful, compact and convenient cleaning solutions.

Its products are biodegradable, dermatologically tested, cruelty-free and designed to reduce plastic waste while simplifying everyday cleaning. Estrip Solution serves home consumers as well as private-label, bulk sourcing, B2B and export partners, focusing on smart and sustainable cleaning innovations.

The team is driven by the mission to help people and businesses #CleanWithCare.

Role Description

This is a full-time, on-site E-commerce Growth Manager role based in Gurugram. The candidate will be responsible for managing and growing Estrip's complete online business through performance marketing, search engine optimization (SEO) and Shopify e-commerce management.

The role involves planning, executing and optimizing paid advertising campaigns across Meta, Google and other relevant digital platforms to drive customer acquisition, increase online sales and improve return on ad spend (ROAS).

The candidate will independently manage the Shopify website, optimize product and landing pages, improve website conversion rates and develop strategies to increase organic traffic through SEO. Day-to-day responsibilities will include managing advertising budgets, analyzing campaign performance, conducting keyword research, improving website visibility, optimizing the customer purchase journey and implementing data-driven growth strategies.

The role will also involve collaborating with creative, content and sales teams to develop high-performing marketing campaigns, improve customer engagement and drive sustainable e-commerce revenue growth.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Performance Marketing**

* Plan, execute and optimize Meta (Facebook & Instagram) Ads and Google Ads campaigns.
* Manage Google Search, Shopping and Performance Max campaigns.
* Drive customer acquisition, online sales and profitable revenue growth.
* Monitor and optimize ROAS, CAC, CPA, CTR and CPC.
* Conduct audience research, retargeting and A/B testing.
* Manage advertising budgets and campaign performance.

**2. SEO & Organic Growth**

* Develop and implement on-page, off-page and technical SEO strategies.
* Conduct keyword research and competitor analysis.
* Optimize product pages, collection pages, blogs and landing pages.
* Manage Google Search Console and improve organic search rankings.
* Improve website indexing, internal linking and technical SEO.
* Develop strategies to increase organic traffic and conversions.

**3. Shopify E-commerce Management**

* Independently manage and optimize the Shopify store.
* Create and optimize product pages, collections and landing pages.
* Improve website UX/UI, mobile experience and conversion rates.
* Manage product listings, discounts, bundles and promotional campaigns.
* Implement CRO strategies to reduce cart abandonment.
* Monitor website performance, speed and checkout experience.

**4. Analytics & Reporting**

* Manage Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager and Meta Pixel.
* Monitor website traffic, customer behavior and conversion funnels.
* Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports.
* Analyze campaign data and identify growth opportunities.
* Track revenue, ROAS, CAC, AOV and conversion rates.

**5. Customer Retention & Growth**

* Plan email and WhatsApp marketing campaigns.
* Develop abandoned cart and customer retention strategies.
* Implement remarketing and repeat purchase campaigns.
* Explore new digital channels and growth opportunities.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 2–4 years of hands-on experience in performance marketing and e-commerce.
* Strong expertise in Meta Ads and Google Ads.
* Practical experience managing Shopify stores.
* Good understanding of SEO and keyword research.
* Experience with GA4, Google Search Console and Google Tag Manager.
* Knowledge of conversion rate optimization (CRO).
* Understanding of D2C, FMCG and e-commerce business models.
* Strong analytical, communication and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Experience

* Experience working with D2C brands, FMCG or consumer product companies.
* Experience scaling e-commerce revenue through paid and organic channels.
* Understanding of marketplace advertising and Google Merchant Center.
* Experience managing marketing budgets and achieving revenue targets.

What We Expect

We are looking for someone who can independently manage the complete digital growth ecosystem, take ownership of marketing performance and turn website traffic into measurable business revenue.

* The ideal candidate should be equally comfortable with campaign execution, SEO strategy, Shopify management, data analysis and continuous optimization.

title: MIS Reporting Analyst
description:
**Introduction**
A career in IBM Consulting embraces long-term relationships and close collaboration with clients across the globe. In this role, you will work for IBM BPO, part of Consulting that, accelerates digital transformation using agile methodologies, process mining, and AI-powered workflows.
  
  
You'll work with visionaries across multiple industries to improve the hybrid cloud and AI journey for the most innovative and valuable companies in the world. Your ability to accelerate impact and make meaningful change for your clients is enabled by our strategic partner ecosystem and our robust technology platforms across the IBM portfolio, including IBM Software and Red Hat.
  
  
Curiosity and a constant quest for knowledge serve as the foundation to success in IBM Consulting. In your role, you'll be supported by mentors and coaches who will encourage you to challenge the norm, investigate ideas outside of your role, and come up with creative solutions resulting in groundbreaking impact for a wide network of clients. Our culture of evolution and empathy centers on long-term career growth and learning opportunities in an environment that embraces your unique skills and experience.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
As a detail-oriented and analytical MIS Reporting Analyst , you are responsible to manage, analyze, and present business data through accurate reports and dashboards with strong expertise in Microsoft Excel, reporting tools, data analysis, and stakeholder management to support business decision-making.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities Include**

* Prepare and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports.
* Develop and automate reports, dashboards, and trackers using Excel and reporting tools.
* Analyze large datasets to identify trends, gaps, and business insights.
* Ensure accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of all reports.
* Generate ad hoc reports and management presentations as required.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders to understand reporting requirements.
* Maintain databases and ensure data integrity across systems.
* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and provide actionable recommendations.
* Support monthly reviews, audits, and business forecasting activities.
* Drive process improvement initiatives through automation and reporting enhancements.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, INDEX-MATCH, Power Query, Macros preferred).
* Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or other visualization tools.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Good understanding of data management and reporting concepts.
* Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Outlook.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
* SAP experience is required.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in commerce, Business Administration, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Applications, or related field.
* Experience in MIS Reporting, Business Analytics, Workforce Management, or Operations Reporting.
* Knowledge of SQL will be an added advantage.

**Key Competencies**

* Data Analysis
* Reporting & Dash-boarding
* Attention to Detail
* Business Acumen
* Process Improvement
* Time Management
* Stakeholder Management

title: Integration Architect - FHIR
description:
**Job Title:**
FHIR Integration Architect

**Job Type:**
Contractor

**Location:**
Remote

**About the Role**

We're building an independent FHIR R4 interoperability layer that lets our CRM's clinical workflows starting with provider launch directly from inside the EHR, beginning with Oracle Health (Cerner) PowerChart. We need someone who can do both halves of this job well: design and personally validate the technical architecture, and lead the engineers full-stack, AI, and QA who build it. This is not a design-and-handoff role. You'll be in the SMART on FHIR launch flow when it breaks, in the code review when a mapping rule is wrong, and in the room when the team needs a call made.

**What You'll Own**

**Architecture & Solution Design**

•    
**Own**
the end-to-end architecture of the FHIR layer — SMART on FHIR launch and OAuth2, the canonical data model, the EMR adapter framework, tenant isolation, and event-driven orchestration — and keep it extensible to future EMRs (Epic, athenahealth) and formats (HL7v2, X12) beyond the Cerner pilot.

•    
**Make**
build-vs-buy and vendor decisions (self-hosted HAPI FHIR vs. a managed FHIR store; Keycloak vs. a commercial identity provider; build vs. adopt an interface engine) and can defend the reasoning to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.

•    
**Design**
the architecture against HIPAA-grade security and auditability requirements from day one — encryption, least-privilege access, audit trails — not as a pre-launch retrofit.

•    
**Validate**
the architecture against real constraints: Oracle Health/Cerner's actual FHIR R4 conformance, US Core and Da Vinci PAS implementation guides, and the operational realities of a live, EHR-embedded launch — not just a reference diagram.

**Technical Leadership & Delivery**

•    
**Lead**
a cross-functional engineering pod — full-stack engineers, AI/ML engineers, and QA engineers — setting technical direction, running code and design reviews, and removing blockers day to day.

•    
**Translate**
the solution architecture into a sequenced, phased delivery plan (proof of concept → pilot → multi-client scale) and hold the team accountable to it.

•    
**Own**
technical risk — surfacing integration blockers, vendor API gaps, and compliance findings early, and driving them to resolution rather than escalating and waiting.

**Integration, Standards & Compliance**

•    
**Lead**
the Cerner/Oracle Health integration end to end: SMART App Launch (EHR launch, OAuth2/OIDC, fhirUser claims), Ignite APIs registration, and coordination with the client health system's Cerner administrators.

•    
**Define and enforce**
conformance testing (ONC Inferno, US Core / Da Vinci PAS validation) before any integration is called production-ready.

•    
**Partner with**
compliance and security stakeholders on HIPAA Security Risk Assessments, BAAs, and audit-trail requirements.

**Required Qualifications**

•    8+ years in healthcare interoperability or integration engineering, including 3+ years in an architect or technical lead capacity.

•    Deep, hands-on FHIR R4 experience — resource modeling, RESTful FHIR APIs, and at least one implementation guide (US Core at minimum).

•    Direct experience implementing SMART App Launch (EHR and/or standalone launch), OAuth2/OIDC, and at least one major EHR's FHIR API — Cerner/Oracle Health experience specifically preferred given Phase 1 scope.

•    Hands-on experience with HAPI FHIR or an equivalent FHIR server — server customization and multi-tenant partitioning are a strong plus.

•    Cloud architecture experience on AWS or equivalent: containers, managed relational databases, event-driven services (queues/event buses), and core identity/security services.

•    Proven experience leading or managing engineers — running reviews, setting direction, and being accountable for a team's delivery, not only your own.

•    Working knowledge of healthcare data exchange beyond FHIR — HL7v2, X12, CDA — sufficient to plan for future extensibility.

•    Solid understanding of HIPAA technical safeguards and healthcare data compliance requirements.

**Strongly Preferred**

•    Direct, hands-on experience with Oracle Health (Cerner) Millennium / Ignite APIs and PowerChart SMART app registration — or the Epic App Orchard equivalent.

•    Experience with Keycloak or another open-source identity provider, including custom extension/SPI development.

•    Familiarity with Da Vinci implementation guides (PAS, CRD, DTR) and FHIR-based prior authorization workflows.

•    Experience in patient support programs, prior authorization, or healthcare CRM domains.

•    Experience standing up a healthcare integration function from near-zero on a small team, not only operating within an already-mature enterprise integration group.

•    Familiarity with applying AI/ML to healthcare data mapping, document generation, or clinical NLP — relevant given the AI engineers on this team.

**Tech Stack You'll Work With**

**FHIR & integration standards -**
FHIR R4, SMART App Launch v2, US Core, Da Vinci PAS, OAuth2 / OIDC, HL7v2 (future-facing)

**FHIR server -**
HAPI FHIR (JPA server), multi-tenant partitioning

**Identity -**
Keycloak, custom SMART-launch extension (SPI)

**Cloud / infra -**
AWS — Fargate/ECS, Aurora PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, API Gateway, WAF, EventBridge/SQS, Secrets Manager, KMS, CloudWatch/OpenSearch

**IaC / delivery -**
Terraform or AWS CDK, CI/CD (GitHub Actions or CodePipeline), Docker

**Target EHR (Phase 1) -**
Oracle Health / Cerner Millennium (Ignite APIs, PowerChart chart-toolbar launch)

**Conformance testing -**
ONC Inferno test kit (incl. Da Vinci PAS), Synthea synthetic data

title: Software Test Engineer
description:
We are seeking a meticulous and detail-oriented **Software Tester (QA Engineer)** to ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of our digital products. You will be responsible for designing and executing comprehensive test plans, identifying bugs, and collaborating with developers to resolve issues before they reach our users. If you have a knack for breaking things (in a constructive way), an obsession with quality, and a passion for delivering flawless user experiences, we want you on our team.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Test Planning & Strategy**

* Review and analyze software requirements, user stories, and design documents to provide early feedback on testability and potential risks.
* Design, document, and maintain detailed, reusable test plans, test cases, and test scripts for various testing levels (unit, integration, system, acceptance).
* Estimate, prioritize, plan, and coordinate testing activities across multiple projects and sprints.
* Define and track quality metrics (defect density, test coverage, pass/fail rates) to measure and improve testing effectiveness.

**Manual Testing (Functional & Non-Functional)**

* Execute manual test cases to verify functionality, usability, and user experience across web, mobile, and desktop applications.
* Perform exploratory testing to identify edge cases, unexpected behaviors, and user experience friction points that scripted tests might miss.
* Conduct regression testing to ensure new features don't break existing functionality.
* Perform non-functional testing including usability, accessibility (WCAG), compatibility (cross-browser, cross-device), and security testing (OWASP basics).

**Automation Testing**

* Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts using industry-standard frameworks to increase testing efficiency and coverage.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) to enable continuous testing and rapid feedback.
* Identify and prioritize test cases suitable for automation to maximize ROI and reduce manual regression efforts.
* Maintain and refactor automation frameworks as the application evolves.

**API & Backend Testing**

* Validate RESTful APIs and GraphQL endpoints using tools like Postman, REST Assured, or SoapUI.
* Verify data integrity, error handling, response times, and authentication/authorization mechanisms.
* Test database interactions, including query validation and data consistency across different environments.

**Performance & Load Testing**

* Conduct performance, load, and stress testing to ensure applications can handle expected user traffic and scale under peak loads.
* Use tools like JMeter, LoadRunner, or K6 to simulate user loads and identify bottlenecks.
* Analyze performance metrics and work with developers to optimize response times, throughput, and resource utilization.

**Defect Management & Reporting**

* Identify, document, and track bugs using issue tracking systems (Jira, Bugzilla, Azure DevOps) with clear, reproducible steps and supporting evidence (logs, screenshots, videos).
* Collaborate closely with developers to prioritize, reproduce, and resolve defects in a timely manner.
* Communicate test progress, risks, and quality status to stakeholders through clear, concise test reports and dashboards.

**Collaboration & Agile Workflow**

* Work closely with Developers, Product Managers, and Designers throughout the software development lifecycle to ensure quality is built in from the start.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, daily stand-ups, retrospectives) and contribute to defining acceptance criteria for user stories.
* Act as the voice of the user, advocating for quality, usability, and accessibility in every product decision.
* Coordinate with SEO, Marketing, and UX teams to ensure that tracking codes, analytics, structured data, and UI/UX implementations are tested and validated.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Stay up-to-date with the latest QA tools, testing methodologies, and industry best practices.
* Proactively suggest improvements to testing processes, tools, and frameworks to increase efficiency and coverage.
* Contribute to the team's knowledge base, testing documentation, and onboarding materials for new QA team members.

**Qualifications & Skills**

**Required**

* **Experience:** 3–6 years of professional experience in software quality assurance, testing, or a related role.
* **Manual Testing:** Deep understanding of software testing principles, methodologies, and the complete SDLC/STLC.
* **Automation:** Hands-on experience with at least one automation framework:
* **Web:** Selenium WebDriver, Cypress, Playwright, or Puppeteer.
* **Mobile:** Appium, Detox, or XCUITest/Espresso.
* **API:** Postman (with Newman), REST Assured, or similar.
* **API Testing:** Strong experience testing RESTful APIs and GraphQL endpoints.
* **Defect Tracking:** Proficiency with issue tracking tools like Jira, Bugzilla, or Azure DevOps.
* **Version Control:** Basic understanding of Git for version control and collaboration.
* **SQL:** Ability to write and execute SQL queries for backend data validation.
* **Analytical Mindset:** Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills with meticulous attention to detail.
* **Communication:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills; ability to articulate complex technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred (Great to Haves)**

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* **CI/CD:** Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CircleCI).
* **Performance Testing:** Experience with load and performance testing tools (JMeter, K6, LoadRunner, Gatling).
* **Security Testing:** Understanding of OWASP Top 10 and experience with security testing tools (Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP).
* **SEO Technical Testing:** Experience validating JSON-LD structured data, meta tags, canonical tags, redirects, and ensuring JavaScript-rendered content is crawlable by search engine bots.
* **Accessibility Testing:** Familiarity with WCAG 2.1 AA guidelines and experience using accessibility testing tools (axe, WAVE, Lighthouse).
* **Mobile Testing:** Experience testing native and hybrid mobile applications on both iOS and Android platforms.
* **Programming Languages:** Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, Java, JavaScript, C#, etc.) for writing automation scripts.
* **Test Management:** Experience with test management tools (TestRail, Xray, Zephyr).
* **ISTQB Certification:** ISTQB Foundation Level or equivalent certification is a plus.

description:

**Overview**

Boeing is the world's largest aerospace company and leading manufacturer of commercial airplanes and defense, space and security systems. We are engineers and technicians. Skilled scientists and thinkers. Bold innovators and dreamers. Join us, and you can build something better for yourself, for our customers and for the world.

As a leading global aerospace company, Boeing develops, manufactures and services commercial airplanes, defense products and space systems for customers in more than 150 countries. As a top U.S. exporter, the company leverages the talents of a global supplier base to advance economic opportunity, sustainability and community impact. Boeing’s team is committed to innovating for the future, leading with sustainability, and cultivating a culture based on the company’s core values of safety, quality and integrity.

**Technology for today and tomorrow**

The Boeing India Engineering & Technology Center (BIETC) is a 5500+ engineering workforce that contributes to global aerospace growth. Our engineers deliver cutting-edge R&D, innovation, and high-quality engineering work in global markets, and leverage new-age technologies such as AI/ML, IIoT, Cloud, Model-Based Engineering, and Additive Manufacturing, shaping the future of aerospace.

**People-driven culture**

At Boeing, we believe creativity and innovation thrives when every employee is trusted, empowered, and has the flexibility to choose, grow, learn, and explore. We offer variable arrangements depending upon business and customer needs, and professional pursuits that offer greater flexibility in the way our people work. We also believe that collaboration, frequent team engagements, and face-to-face meetings bring together different perspectives and thoughts – enabling every voice to be heard and every perspective to be respected. No matter where or how our teammates work, we are committed to positively shaping people’s careers and being thoughtful about employee wellbeing.

With us, you can create and contribute to what matters most in your career, community, country, and world. Join us in powering the progress of global aerospace.

**Position Overview:**

**Boeing Digital Services org** is currently looking for a **Senior Lead Product Owner** to join the team in **Bangalore, IN.** In this role you will drive product ownership excellence across a portfolio of maintenance and flight product suits. You will establish and scale product management practices, processes, standards, and governance across the organization while providing strategic direction and coaching to Product Owners and Development teams. You will serve as a trusted advisor to product, engineering, business, technology, and executive stakeholders. You will influence outcomes across multiple teams and products without direct authority and ensure that product decisions are driven by customer value, business impact, data, risk, and delivery feasibility.

The role combines enterprise-level Product Owner responsibilities with selected Product Manager responsibilities, including portfolio strategy, market analysis, product positioning, investment planning, customer discovery, business case development, and product lifecycle management. You will work closely with Developers, Product Owners, Greenfield Leadership, Data Scientists, and Architects to deliver product features and capabilities that keep AI and ML at the center of our solutions. You will be helping create new product offerings as well as modernizing systems that have been running the business for years, while building new ones designed to run it for years to come.

**Position Responsibilities:**

* Define and communicate portfolio-level product vision, strategy, objectives, outcomes, and roadmaps for aviation / MRO products, platforms, and capabilities.

* Evaluate customer needs, market trends, competitive offerings, emerging technologies, and internal capabilities to identify opportunities for new products, enhancements, modernization, consolidation, or retirement.

* Establish and maintain consistent product management and product ownership practices, processes, standards, governance, templates, and decision-making frameworks across the organization.

* Provide strategic direction, mentoring, and coaching to Product Owners, Product Managers, and Business Analysts in product discovery, prioritization, backlog management, stakeholder engagement, and value delivery.

* Guide teams in translating customer and business needs into well-defined epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, non-functional requirements, and measurable outcomes.

* Lead portfolio-level prioritization and resolve cross-product dependencies, competing demands, sequencing decisions, resource constraints, and delivery trade-offs.

* Partner with customers and stakeholders to validate product concepts, business problems, solution alternatives, priorities, prototypes, and early product definitions.

* Define and monitor product and portfolio success measures, including customer satisfaction, adoption, operational performance, financial value, quality, delivery, and business outcomes.

* Represent the customer and business perspective throughout product development, Agile delivery, Program Increment planning, release planning, system demonstrations, and operational readiness activities.

* Partner with engineering, architecture, security, quality, operations, and support teams to evaluate technical options, integrations, scalability, technical debt, maintainability, resilience, and non-functional requirements.

* Communicate portfolio priorities, roadmap changes, investment recommendations, delivery progress, performance results, risks, and decisions to customers, stakeholders, and senior leadership while driving continuous improvement in product management maturity and value delivery.

**Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience):**

* Bachelor’s degree is required as basic qualification.
* 15+ years relevant experience in software development including full-stack web development, experience with modern software product development, integration, and delivery

* Experience integrating AI, ML, or LLM capabilities into software applications.

* Familiarity with AI-enabled product management tools and responsible use of generative AI for analysis, documentation, research, and decision support.

* Significant experience in Product Ownership, Product Management, business analysis, solution management, or a related discipline, including experience leading across multiple products.

* Extensive experience working in Agile and Scrum environments, including experience with SAFe, Lean Portfolio Management, Program Increment planning, and Product Owner/Product Manager responsibilities.

* Experience developing and implementing product management practices, operating models, governance frameworks, and standard processes across multiple teams or product areas.

* Demonstrated ability to coach and guide Product Owners and Product Managers in product discovery, prioritization, backlog management, stakeholder engagement, and value delivery.

* Familiarity with latest tools & technology frameworks like JavaScript, JQuery, Java/J2EE, Azure App Services / Functions, Microservices etc.

* Experience with DevOps practices, including CI/CD, Configuration management, Automated testing, Monitoring and observability, Metrics and telemetry, and Infrastructure as code

* Experience with Microsoft Azure services and Azure DevOps.

* Experience with APIs, event-driven integrations, data platforms, analytics, and cloud-native architectures.

* Familiarity with Angular, React, React Native, or comparable web and mobile technologies.

* Understanding of mobile user experience principles and platform-specific design guidelines.

* Understanding of architectural styles like microservices, event-driven systems, monoliths, and serverless computing.

**Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience):**

* Experience in Aerospace and/or Aviation and/or MRO domain is preferred

* Product management or Agile certifications such as: Certified Scrum Product Owner, SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager, SAFe Product Management

* Experience leading product management transformation, product operating model implementation, or Agile-at-scale adoption.

* Experience managing enterprise platforms, digital products, software ecosystems, or products involving complex integrations.

* Demonstrated ability to collaborate across Product, Design, Engineering, and Operations to translate ambiguous business needs into clear technical solutions and measurable outcomes.

* Demonstrated ability to coach and uplift other engineers through pairing, code review, technical mentorship, and knowledge sharing.

**Typical Education & Experience:**

* Education/experience typically acquired through advanced education (e.g. Bachelor) and typically 16 + years’ related work experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience (e.g. Master 15+ Years ) related in computer science, aerospace or other closely related field.

This position does offer relocation within INDIA.

  
  

Applications for this position will be accepted until **Nov. 29, 2026**

  
  

**Export Control Requirements:**

This is not an Export Control position.

Bachelor's Degree or Equivalent Required

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (MERN)
description:
**Own what you build, from first commit to long after go-live.**

Anyone can ship a feature. What sets great engineers apart is what happens next: whether the system holds when traffic doubles overnight, how fast it recovers when something breaks, and whether the client’s product is still thriving a year on.

Techdome designs and runs production-grade platforms for clients in FinTech, Healthcare, E-commerce, SaaS, Logistics, and EdTech. The domains change, but the bar doesn’t: secure, reliable, and ready to scale. We’re looking for a Senior MERN Stack Developer to build full-stack products with MongoDB, Express, React, and Node.js (TypeScript), and to stay accountable for them well beyond launch.

### **What your role looks like**

* **Take features from idea to live:** Drive work through design, build, release, and ongoing support, and remain the owner afterward.
* **Build products that hold up under load:** Create polished React interfaces and secure, well-tested Node/Express APIs on top of thoughtfully modeled MongoDB data.
* **Set the standard for quality:** Run constructive code reviews and champion readable, tested, maintainable code.
* **Keep a steady hand when things break:** Lead the response to incidents, restore service fast, and follow through with root-cause analysis so issues stay fixed.
* **Shape how our platforms evolve:** Help make the architecture and design decisions that matter.
* **Grow the people around you:** Mentor junior and mid-level engineers and raise the team’s overall skill.
* **Work as one team with product, design, QA, and DevOps:** Get hands-on with cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, containers, and observability.
* **See the world through the client’s eyes:** Quickly understand each client’s users, goals, and constraints, and turn them into the right technical solutions.

### **Your first 90 days**

* **Days 1–30, Learn and deliver:** Get to know our codebases, tools, and people, and ship your first meaningful contribution.
* **Days 31–60, Own something real:** Take a feature or service end to end, and add your voice to code reviews and design discussions.
* **Days 61–90, Become the go-to person:** Be a dependable engineer on a core client product, handle production issues confidently, and start guiding teammates.

### **What you bring**

* 4+ years building full-stack web applications professionally
* Deep MERN expertise (MongoDB, Express.js, React, Node.js) with strong JavaScript and TypeScript
* Solid grounding in REST API design, MongoDB schema design and indexing, authentication and authorization, testing, and application security
* Experience with React state management and performance tuning (Redux, React Query, code splitting, etc.)
* A history of *running* production systems, not only building them
* Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
* Comfort with Git, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and production monitoring and debugging
* Experience across different industries or product types, and the ability to ramp up fast on new domains
* A natural tendency to step up and take ownership when it’s needed

### **Bonus points**

* Strong system design skills: microservices, distributed systems, event-driven architecture
* Experience with Next.js, GraphQL, or WebSockets/real-time features
* Kubernetes and infrastructure-as-code experience
* Familiarity with compliance standards such as HIPAA, PCI-DSS, GDPR, or SOC 2
* Experience integrating third-party services like payment gateways (Stripe, Braintree, Adyen), CRMs, or analytics tools
* Background in a consultancy or product studio juggling multiple clients and projects
* Experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot

### **Why you’ll like it here**

* **Independent and profitable:** No investor pressure or growth-at-any-cost targets. We play the long game.
* **A truly global team:** Collaborate with 80+ engineers across five hubs worldwide.
* **Variety built in:** Different industries and products keep your skills sharp.
* **A voice that counts:** You’ll influence our technical direction, and your role goes well beyond closing tickets.

title: Techno Functional Project Manager
description:
Avensys is a reputed global IT professional services company headquartered in Singapore. Our service spectrum includes enterprise solution consulting, business intelligence, business process automation and managed services. Given our decade of success, we have evolved to become one of the top trusted providers in Singapore and service a client base across banking and financial services, insurance, information technology, healthcare, retail and supply chain.

**Role Summary**

We are looking for an experienced Technical Project Manager who can own end-to-end project delivery across technical and functional workstreams. The candidate will act as the primary point of coordination between the client, business stakeholders, designers, developers, QA, and other delivery teams. The role requires enough technical depth to understand the solution architecture, application integrations, data flows, security, and delivery risks, alongside strong functional understanding, client communication, relationship management, planning, and execution. The technology stack remains React, Node.js / TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Microsoft Azure, and Microsoft 365 integrations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end project planning, execution, tracking, and delivery against agreed scope, timelines, budget, quality, and acceptance criteria.
* Act as the primary day-to-day client contact; build trusted relationships, manage expectations, communicate progress, and resolve concerns proactively.
* Understand business requirements and translate them into clear functional requirements, workflows, acceptance criteria, and delivery priorities.
* Lead requirement workshops, stakeholder discussions, demos, and delivery status meetings.
* Coordinate designers, frontend and backend developers, QA, infrastructure teams, integration teams, and other stakeholders to keep delivery aligned.
* Maintain project plans, milestones, dependencies, resource plans, RAID logs, action trackers, status reports, and delivery dashboards.
* Provide technical delivery oversight for applications built with React JS, Node.js / TypeScript, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Microsoft Azure, and Microsoft 365 integrations.
* Come up with the solution design, Technical specification, Architecture document and integration points with other applications, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Graph, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, Azure services, and Azure OpenAI GPT.
* Design database, APIs, workflows, authentication and authorization, RBAC, audit trails, logging, asynchronous processing, and enterprise integration considerations.
* Coordinate UI/UX design reviews and ensure designs are feasible, consistent with requirements, and ready for development.
* Manage scope, change requests, assumptions, risks, issues, dependencies, and escalation paths; drive decisions to prevent delivery slippage.
* Track development, code reviews, testing, defect resolution, UAT, release readiness, controlled manual DEV/UAT/Production deployments, and post-release support.
* Ensure delivery practices align with Git-based version control, SonarQube quality gates, security controls, and agreed quality standards.
* Facilitate root-cause analysis for major technical or delivery issues and coordinate corrective and preventive actions.
* Provide clear, concise updates to client leadership and internal management, including progress, risks, decisions needed, and mitigation plans.
* Drive continuous improvement through retrospectives, delivery metrics, stakeholder feedback, and lessons learned.

**Must-Have Skills**

* 8+ years of experience in software delivery, technical project management, project leadership, business analysis, or a closely related role, with demonstrated ownership of application delivery.
* Strong understanding of the full software development lifecycle, testing, release management, and production support.
* Strong technical knowledge of React JS, Node.js / TypeScript, REST APIs, and PostgreSQL sufficient to discuss design choices, dependencies, risks, and delivery estimates with engineering teams.
* Understanding of relational database concepts, data modelling, transactions, indexing, query performance, and data integrity.
* Experience managing requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, functional workflows, prioritization, and scope changes.
* Strong client-facing communication, stakeholder management, expectation setting, conflict resolution, and relationship-building skills.
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate designers, developers, QA, architects, and business stakeholders across parallel workstreams.
* Strong project planning, estimation, milestone tracking, risk and issue management, dependency management, and status reporting skills.
* Understanding of enterprise authentication, authorization, RBAC, secure application practices, audit trails, logging, exception handling, and integration patterns.
* Experience coordinating Git-based development practices, code reviews, SonarQube quality gates, testing, UAT, and controlled releases.
* Strong problem-solving, decision-making, facilitation, negotiation, and escalation management skills.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Experience with Microsoft Azure application services and cloud-based application delivery.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID, OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, Microsoft Graph API, Microsoft 365, SharePoint Online, and Teams / Adaptive Cards integration.
* Exposure to Azure OpenAI / GPT API integration and Azure Blob Storage.
* Exposure to enterprise system / middleware integration and SAP integration.
* Familiarity with SonarQube, Azure Application Insights / Log Analytics, and secure code-quality practices.
* Experience delivering configurable workflow or rule-engine-based enterprise applications.
* Experience working with distributed or cross-functional teams and enterprise clients.

**Expected Seniority**

The candidate should be able to lead delivery from requirement discovery and solution planning through design, development, integration, testing, UAT, controlled deployment, and production stabilization. They are expected to understand technical discussions well enough to challenge assumptions, identify delivery risks, facilitate decisions, and keep the client and delivery team aligned. This is a hands-on delivery leadership role, not a requirement for the candidate to personally write production code.

WHAT’S ON OFFER

You will be remunerated with an excellent base salary and entitled to attractive company benefits. Additionally, you will get the opportunity to enjoy a fun and collaborative work environment, alongside a strong career progression.

To submit your application, please apply online or email your UPDATED CV to Sandeep.kumar@aven-sys.com or WhatsApp at +65 6761 9819

Your interest will be treated with strict confidentiality.

title: Product Manager
description:
**Role - Product Manager - TMS**

**Loc - Gurgaon**

**What is TMS?**

A transportation management system (TMS) is a logistics platform that uses technology to help businesses plan, execute, and optimize the physical movement of goods (inbound and outbound).

It provides visibility into day-to-day transportation operations, ensures regulatory/ trade compliance and associated documentation, and tracks the timely delivery of freight and goods. TMS also streamlines the shipping process and makes it easier for businesses to manage and optimize their transportation operations.

We are seeking an AI First Product Manager to join our team in Gurgaon. The role is an inherent blend of technology, product management, and product marketing. To succeed in this role, you should enjoy getting your hands dirty, and thrive on end-to-end ownership.

* Owns discovery & build of features
* Develops and ships production code via AI-assisted tools (Kiro); submits all changes as PRs
* Conducts customer discovery, starts with high-level specs and translates insights directly — but everything is documented before productionizing
* Thinks in systems, reusable abstractions, APIs, workflows, and operational scalability — not just feature delivery
* Owns product analytics, workflow QA, release notes, GTM, pilot customers, and competitive intelligence
* Owns feature correctness, rollout quality, customer adoption, and feature-level metrics in production
* Escalates architectural questions to dev before building; treats review feedback as blocking

* Undergraduate degree in engineering from a Tier-I institute

* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment, along with the tenacity to develop ideas independently and the conviction to drive them to completion is crucial for this role

title: Senior Data Product Manager
description:
**About Payoneer**
Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.
  
  
By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.
  
  
**About The Role**
Join Payoneer’s Data Product Unit as a hands-on Senior Data Product Manager owning the data product portfolio for the Enterprise domain.
  
  
You’ll turn Enterprise client needs and internal business priorities into reliable, scalable data products for external data sharing and internal analytics. Working closely with Product, R&D, Data Engineering, BI, and business stakeholders, you’ll lead the full lifecycle—from discovery and prioritization through delivery, adoption, and ongoing improvement.
  
  
A key part of the role is translating individual client requirements into reusable capabilities while keeping Enterprise solutions aligned with Payoneer’s core data products.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own the Enterprise data product strategy, roadmap, and backlog, prioritizing business value, client commitments, and delivery dependencies.
* Lead discovery with Product, business teams, and client stakeholders to understand workflows, challenge requirements, and define the right solutions.
* Translate business needs into clear product requirements, business logic, data specifications, and measurable acceptance criteria.
* Define data models and consumption requirements with Data Engineering and BI, supporting both external data sharing and internal analytical use cases.
* Use SQL and hands-on analysis to assess feasibility, investigate data, validate business logic, and guide product decisions.
* Lead delivery across teams, managing dependencies and balancing client-specific needs with scalable, reusable solutions.
* Define and monitor data quality, freshness, and service-level expectations, including contractual commitments where applicable.
* Measure adoption and business impact, using feedback and usage data to improve the product portfolio.

**What You’ll Bring**

* 5+ years in data product management or related hands-on data roles, with demonstrated ownership of complex data products from discovery through delivery and adoption.
* Strong product judgment and business acumen, including the ability to prioritize competing needs and translate business problems into data solutions.
* Strong SQL and analytical skills, with experience independently exploring data, investigating issues, and validating complex business logic.
* Strong understanding of data modeling, warehouse architecture, and data pipelines, with hands-on BigQuery experience.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and engage effectively in technical and architectural discussions.
* Experience defining data quality requirements, acceptance criteria, and service-level expectations.
* Excellent communication skills and strong English proficiency.

**An Advantage**

* Experience with Enterprise clients and externally consumed data products, such as reports, data feeds, or APIs.

title: UX Manager – AI-Native Products
description:
INCEDO · JOB DESCRIPTION

UX Manager – AI-Native Products (Conversational & Agentic Interfaces )

LEVEL -Manager (player-coach)

TEAM -Products & Platforms

EXPERIENCE 10–14 years

ABOUT THE ROLE

Incedo’s Products & Platforms team builds AI-native products for enterprise clients. Our users ask questions in natural language, review what the AI finds and recommends, and decide what to act on. You’ll set the design direction for that experience and lead a senior UI/UX designer. This is a player-coach role: most of your time goes into hands-on design. WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Set the interaction model for our AI-native products: when to use conversation, when to use structured UI, and how the two combine across dashboards, workspaces and agent workflows.

• Design trust into every AI output, including sources and provenance, confidence and uncertainty, explanations an expert can check, and approval steps before an agent acts.

• Personally own the hardest flows end to end, from research and concepts through prototypes built on live model outputs to shipped product.

• Build and govern the design system, including AI patterns for streaming and partial results, latency, errors and refusals, multi-turn context, undo and handoff to a human. • Set up a research and quality practice: regular usability testing, feedback loops from real usage, and UX metrics for AI features that guide priorities with product.

• Lead and grow the senior UI/UX designer, set the quality bar and critique practice, partner with product, engineering and data science, and shape the demos we put in front of client executives.

WHAT YOU BRING

• 10–14 years in UI/UX design, including 3+ years leading design for complex B2B or enterprise products, and at least one AI-powered product (assistant, copilot or agent) that you shipped and then improved based on real usage.

• A demonstrated point of view on AI interaction design: when conversation helps and when it gets in the way, how much autonomy an agent should have, and how to show uncertainty without eroding trust.

• Deep conversation design: context across turns, disambiguation, repair when the model misunderstands, and response guidelines for tone, length and structure. • Agentic and trust patterns for high-stakes work: plan previews, approval gates, undo and rollback, audit trails, and explanations experts can verify quickly.

• Experience measuring AI experiences through task success, time to answer, correction and override rates, and qualitative trust signals.

• Design-system leadership: tokens, components and patterns adopted across multiple products or teams, built to WCAG 2.2 AA by default.

• Senior-level hands-on craft in visual and interaction design for data-dense screens, and in prototyping with live model outputs; expert in Figma or equivalent tools.

• A portfolio of case studies showing framing, trade-offs and outcomes, including what didn’t work and what you changed.

This is a hands-on delivery role for someone who understands the AI lifecycle well enough to spot technical risk early, and who enjoys building strong, well-run teams. * Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics or a related field; a master's degree or MBA is a plus.

title: AI Solutions Architect
description:
**ABOUT BLOOM AI**

Bloom AI is an applied AI firm building AI-native intelligence systems and workflows for enterprise teams across research, marketing, sales and other knowledge-intensive functions.

We combine enterprise data, external intelligence, AI and software engineering to help organizations turn information into intelligence and action.

Our approach combines reusable AI capabilities with hands-on solution development in real enterprise environments. We work closely with business teams to rethink workflows, design intelligent systems and deploy solutions that deliver measurable outcomes.

Bloom AI is based in the U.S. and India (Delhi/NCR).

**THE ROLE**

We are looking for a
**hands-on AI Solutions Architect**
who can design, build and deploy enterprise-grade AI applications and agentic systems.

This role sits at the intersection of
**AI architecture, data engineering and software development**
.

You may come from a backend engineering, data engineering or data science background, but you should have evolved into building end-to-end AI solutions.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have worked on
**multiple AI/LLM projects**
, solved different types of problems and gained practical experience making architectural decisions across agent orchestration, data, context management, application development and deployment.

You should be equally comfortable designing a solution architecture, evaluating technology choices, writing code, integrating data sources and taking a working solution into production.

This is
**not a traditional software engineering role, a prompt-engineering role or a PowerPoint-only architecture role**
. We need someone who understands how AI systems work end-to-end and can personally build what they design.

You will work across client engagements, reusable Bloom AI capabilities and internal technology development, taking ownership of solutions from architecture through production deployment.

You will be part of the core team, reporting directly to the CEO.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

Leading a small team, you will:

**Architect Bloom AI Capabilities and Client Solutions**

* Design end-to-end AI solutions combining LLMs, agents, enterprise data, APIs and applications.
* Mak architectural decisions around agent orchestration, context, memory, workflows and technology choices.
* Build modular, reusable solutions that work across different cloud and enterprise environments.

**Build agentic applications**

* Develop multi-agent systems, agentic workflows and LLM-powered applications using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain or similar.
* Implement tool calling, RAG, semantic search, agent memory and state management.
* Build evaluation, monitoring and reliability mechanisms for production AI systems.

**Engineer data and context systems**

* Integrate structured and unstructured enterprise data into AI applications.
* Design retrieval and context architectures using relational, vector and graph databases.
* Build knowledge retrieval, entity relationships and persistent context capabilities.

**Develop and deploy end to end systems**

* Build backend services and APIs using Python, FastAPI or similar technologies.
* Develop functional frontend applications and integrate with enterprise systems.
* Deploy secure, scalable applications across cloud platforms using modern engineering practices.

**Solve enterprise client problems**

* Translate business challenges into practical AI architectures and working solutions.
* Work across multiple client projects, from solution design and prototyping through deployment.
* Evaluate technical approaches, collaborate with stakeholders and develop reusable capabilities for Bloom AI.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* **4–7 years of professional experience**
  , with a foundation in
  **backend engineering, data engineering, data science or related technical disciplines**
  .
* **Hands-on experience across multiple AI/LLM application projects**
  , preferably involving different use cases, data environments or architectural approaches.
* Demonstrated ability to take ownership of solution architecture and technical implementation, rather than contributing to only one component of a system.
* Strong proficiency in
  **Python**
  , with solid software engineering and API development skills.
* Practical experience building
  **agentic applications or multi-agent systems**
  , beyond basic chatbots and prompt-based applications.
* Experience with agent orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen or similar.
* Strong understanding of LLM APIs, tool calling, RAG, embeddings, vector databases and context management.
* Strong understanding of data modeling, SQL, databases, data integration and retrieval architectures.
* Working knowledge of full-stack application development, including modern frontend frameworks such as React or Next.js.
* Familiarity with graph data structures, entity relationships and graph-based retrieval concepts.
* Experience taking AI applications from prototype through testing, integration and production deployment.
* Experience with at least one major cloud platform and familiarity with Docker, Git, CI/CD and modern engineering practices.
* Ability to evaluate different technical approaches and make sound architectural trade-offs.
* Strong independent problem-solving skills, curiosity and comfort working with ambiguous requirements.
* Lead R&D efforts for Bloom AI

**Above all, we are looking for someone who has built several AI solutions, understands the architectural decisions behind them and can independently design and implement new ones.**

**GOOD TO HAVE**

* Startup or
  **0-to-1 product development experience**
  .
* Experience working on enterprise AI projects across different business functions or client environments.
* Experience integrating with
  **marketing, sales or commercial systems**
  , such as CRM, marketing automation, campaign platforms, content management systems or sales enablement tools.
* Experience working directly with enterprise clients and translating business requirements into technical solutions.
* Experience building AI applications for financial services, research or other knowledge-intensive domains.

title: Merchant Launch Lead
description:
**About Loop:**

Loop is a subscription management platform built for e-commerce brands on Shopify. Our primary market is the US, with growing presence in Europe and ANZ.

We are scaling rapidly, driven by a strong product and exceptional merchant experience. We achieved ~3x growth in 2024, followed by nearly 3x growth again in 2025, followed by 2x growth again in 2026. Looking ahead, we are building the team and foundation to drive another 2x growth in 2027 as we accelerate toward our $100M goal.

**About the role:**

You will own merchant onboarding at Loop from sales handoff to Success handover, across three regions. You will lead a team of Onboarding Specialists, set the operating standard for every onboarding, and be accountable for time to go live, onboarding quality, and early churn. This role is about building a predictable onboarding engine that scales with our growth. It is not about running onboardings yourself.

**What you will own:**

Onboarding Delivery and Governance

* Own end to end onboarding performance: kickoff SLAs, milestone adherence, and go live dates across the full merchant portfolio.
* Set the standards for kickoff, weekly touchpoints, configuration, migration validation and handover, and audit adherence.
* Step in personally on strategic, high value or at risk merchants.

Cross Functional Partnership

* Act as the primary escalation point for Sales, Implementation Engineering, Migration, Product and Success.
* Improve the sales to onboarding handoff so merchants are scoped correctly before kickoff.
* Agree SLAs and escalation paths with Implementation Engineering and Migration, and hold all sides to them.
* Turn recurring merchant feedback into prioritised product inputs and track them to resolution.

Process, Tooling and Reporting

* Own onboarding playbooks, templates and documentation standards.
* Keep Salesforce, Sheets and internal dashboards accurate, and remove manual tracking wherever possible.
* Report weekly and monthly on onboarding health to leadership, with risks and corrective actions.
* Identify bottlenecks using data and redesign the process to remove them.

Merchant Experience and Retention

* Own the merchant experience during onboarding, including handling of delays, product gaps and escalations.
* Drive down churn during onboarding and in the first 30 days post handover.
* Ensure every handover to Success is complete, documented and accepted by the Success team.

Team Leadership and Capacity

* Lead, coach and grow a team of Onboarding Specialists across regions
* Plan capacity and allocate merchants by region, complexity and specialist bandwidth.
* Hire, onboard and ramp new specialists. Set clear performance goals and run regular 1:1s and reviews.

**What we are looking for:**

* 7+ years in customer onboarding, implementation or customer success at a B2B SaaS company, with 3+ years managing teams of 10 or more.
* Experience leading distributed teams across multiple regions and time zones.
* Strong track record of running onboarding at scale with measurable improvement in time to value and early retention.
* Comfort with technical setups: integrations, data migration, configuration. You do not need to code, but you need to hold your own with engineers.
* Hands on with Salesforce and dashboarding; data driven in how you run the team.
* Calm, clear communicator in escalations with merchants and senior internal stakeholders.
