title: Application Engineer
description:
**We're not hiring someone to close tickets.**
We're hiring the person who drives the entire Grip app system: its roadmap, architecture, speed and health. You'll also help shape what we build next.

If you build apps in your spare time just because you love it, try new tools the week they come out, and check the crash dashboard before anyone asks, read on.

**The app today**

The Grip app is built in React Native. Most of the product runs as our web app inside a WebView, joined to the app by a native bridge. Your job is to drive the whole app system: take it fully native, keep it fast, safe and reliable, and make it work hand in hand with web and backend.

**What you'll do**

**01 · Drive the entire app system**

* Own the app end to end: architecture, releases, app health, and the roadmap to a fully native app, which you shape with the leadership team.
* Make the calls on architecture, stack and the order in which screens move.
* Help drive the product roadmap too, with ideas from the app side, from user data and from the best apps out there.

**02 · Stay ahead of app health**

* Own the crash-free rate, ANR rate and app-open time, and watch them in Crashlytics, Sentry and New Relic without being asked.
* Catch regressions before users do, and trace any crash or ANR to its root cause.
* Set up the monitoring and telemetry the whole team relies on.

**03 · Experiment, and automate your own workload**

* Try new technologies and AI workflows early, and keep what works.
* Automate the repetitive parts of the job: builds, releases, checks, triage, task breakdown.
* Work out how app development fits into our AI-driven development process (AI SDLC), so app delivery is as fast as web.

**04 · Build one ecosystem with web and backend**

* Work with the web and backend teams to make everything the app shares with them (APIs, auth, data and events) more secure and robust.
* Design the architecture that lets every new feature go live on app and web on the same timeline, without one waiting for the other.
* Use shared API contracts and business logic, shared analytics events, and server-driven pieces where they help.
* Partner with the engineering manager on the process. The architecture is yours.

**05 · Build in the guardrails**

* Define the checks every release passes for security, accessibility, design and A/B experiments.
* Make releases safe and boring: CI, over-the-air updates, staged rollouts and rollback.

**06 · Set the standard**

* Your PRs, code reviews and incident write-ups become the team's benchmark.
* Come to us with "here's what we should improve" before anyone asks.

**What we're looking for**

**Must have**

* **Mobile:**
  React Native (including the New Architecture: Fabric, TurboModules, JSI) or Flutter, in depth, plus enough native Android (Kotlin) and iOS (Swift) to build and debug native modules.
* **Architecture:**
  mobile app architecture, hybrid-to-native migrations, WebView and JS ↔ native bridges, strict TypeScript.
* **App health:**
  performance profiling (Hermes, Android Studio Profiler, Perfetto, Xcode Instruments) and crash, ANR and telemetry tools (Crashlytics, Sentry, New Relic).
* **Delivery:**
  mobile CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Fastlane), over-the-air updates, Play Console and App Store Connect.
* **Quality:**
  mobile and API security, accessibility on iOS and Android, feature flags and A/B experiments, and testing (Jest, React Native Testing Library, Detox or Maestro).
* **AI:**
  daily use of CLI agents such as Claude Code or Codex, and automations you've built for your own work.

**Strong plus**

* You've led a hybrid-to-native migration or a native rewrite.
* You've built and shipped fully native apps (Kotlin with Jetpack Compose, or Swift with SwiftUI), not only cross-platform ones.
* Server-driven UI, UPI intent payments, SMS Retriever OTP or KYC SDKs.
* Fintech or other regulated B2C apps at scale

**Mindset**

* **Builder at heart:**
  builds apps in their spare time, with personal and pet projects, because they love making apps, not just because it's the job.
* **User-obsessed:**
  gets excited about creating new experiences for users.
* **Ahead of the curve:**
  keeps up with frontier technology and AI, and experiments with new tools before they go mainstream.
* **Automates:**
  keeps cutting their own workload by automating processes and routine work.
* **Proactive:**
  spots crashes, ANRs and slowdowns on the dashboards before users report them.
* **Owner:**
  owns outcomes end to end and thinks about the product, not only the code.
* **Partner:**
  brings ideas, not just questions, and communicates clearly.

**Green flags and red flags**

**We'll move fast for you if**

* You build apps for fun: personal and pet projects, released or not. Show us one.
* You've led a hybrid-to-native migration, a major React Native upgrade or a New Architecture move.
* You've traced a native crash or ANR to its root cause and can tell us the story.
* You've automated a real chunk of your own job, and can show us how.
* You've set up mobile monitoring, telemetry or release checks that a team relied on.
* You've worked with web and backend teams to make shared APIs, auth or events more secure.
* You've shipped one feature on app and web on the same day, and know what it took.
* You have a view on React Native versus fully native versus other stacks, backed by numbers.

**Not a fit if**

* You've only worked in JavaScript and avoid Xcode or Android Studio.
* You close crash reports as "can't reproduce".
* You've never shipped to the app stores yourself.
* You wait to be told what to fix next.
* You only build apps when it's for work.
* You've never used AI tools beyond a chat prompt.

**What owning the app looks like**

No fixed timeline. You drive it.

1. **Know the app cold.**
   Map the app, the bridge, the release flow and the monitoring, and ship your first fixes in your first weeks.
2. **Own the roadmap.**
   Shape the native roadmap with leadership, and present the architecture, stack choice and migration order.
3. **Own the numbers.**
   Crash-free rate, ANR rate, app-open time and product telemetry each have a baseline, a dashboard and a target that you set.
4. **Automate the busywork.**
   Builds, releases and checks run themselves, and app work flows through our AI-driven development process as smoothly as web work.
5. **Work as one with web and backend.**
   New features go live on app and web on the same timeline, shared APIs and auth are secure and robust, and every release passes the checks for security, accessibility, design and experiments.
6. **Become the reference point.**
   When the team debates an app or product approach, they ask what you'd do.

**What you get here**

* **Your ideas, brought to life.**
  The interests, experiments and ideas you'd normally save for a side project get to ship here, to real investors.
* **A company that stays ahead of the curve.**
  We experiment early with new technology and AI tools to build things customers love.
* **Real ownership.**
  The app, its roadmap and its architecture are yours to shape.

We're building a team where
**AI-native isn't a buzzword. It's table stakes.**
The person we hire won't just build a native app. They'll give our investors the best experience we can offer, on every screen, and make the whole team better at building for mobile.

*If you're still reading and nodding, we'd like to meet you.*

description:
**DEVOPS and MLOPS ENGINEER**

Hyperworks Imaging is a cutting-edge technology company based out of Bengaluru, India since 2016. We are seeking a high-ownership DevOps & MLOps Engineer with 2–3 years of hands-on experience to own and manage our hybrid cloud infrastructure across Azure (Primary Preference) and AWS (Secondary). In this role, you will be responsible for multi-environment cloud provisioning (Dev, Staging, Production), automated wildcard subdomain routing, API Gateways, centralized logging stacks, database reliability, cloud cost governance, and text-to-speech (TTS) AI pipelines across multiple internal applications.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

1. Cloud Infrastructure & Automation (IaC)

* Manage secure multi-environment (Dev/Staging/Prod) provisioning on Azure and AWS using Terraform modules.
* Standardize container build workflows and infrastructure state management.

2. Networking, Subdomain Routing & Gateways

* Automate wildcard subdomains, CNAME mappings, and ingress routing.
* Manage API Gateways (Azure APIM, AWS API Gateway, NGINX, Traefik, Kong).
* Handle SSL/TLS lifecycles via Cloudflare, Azure Key Vault, or AWS ACM.

3. AI, Speech & Storage Pipelines

* Maintain low-latency TTS integration pipelines (AWS Polly, Azure Speech Services).
* Optimize AWS S3/Azure Blob Storage lifecycle rules, access controls, and CDN delivery.

4. Database Administration & Performance

* Manage, tune, and scale PostgreSQL and Redis databases.
* Configure PgBouncer, read-replicas, automated snapshots, and point-in-time recovery.

5. Cost Governance & Observability

* Audit/optimize Azure/AWS spending (Savings Plans, Reserved Instances, rightsizing).
* Maintain centralized logging (ELK, Loki, CloudWatch) and metrics dashboards (Prometheus, Grafana).

6. Security, CI/CD & MLOps

* Enforce Zero-Trust IAM, secrets management (Azure Key Vault, AWS Secrets Manager), and OAuth/JWT auth.
* Manage CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps) for Node.js/Python microservices.
* Deploy ML inference endpoints (MLflow, BentoML, SageMaker, Azure ML).

**CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS**

* Experience Level: 2–3 Years
* Educational Requirement: B.Tech / B.E. / B.S. in Computer Science, IT, or related technical field

**Must Have Skills:**

* Experience: 2–3 years of proven hands-on experience in DevOps, Cloud Platform, or Systems Engineering in a fast-paced environment.
* Hybrid Cloud: Direct experience managing workloads on AWS (Primary) and exposure to Azure as well.
* Infrastructure as Code: High proficiency in writing declarative, modular Terraform code.
* Database Management: Practical experience with PostgreSQL and Redis administration, query tuning, and automated backup strategies.
* Networking & Gateways: Hands-on setup of API Gateways, wildcard DNS routing, and SSL certificate management.
* Audio & Cloud Storage: Experience integrating cloud Speech/TTS APIs (AWS Polly / Azure Speech) and handling cloud object storage (S3 / Azure Blob).
* Cost Optimization: Demonstrated track record of auditing and reducing cloud expenditure across AWS or Azure.
* Logging & Monitoring: Setup and management of centralized logging (Loki, ELK, or CloudWatch) and metrics collection (Prometheus + Grafana).
* Containers & CI/CD: Hands-on expertise with Docker and automated pipeline creation via GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS (Nice-To-Have)**

* Certifications: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104), AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate, or HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate.
* MLOps Frameworks: Prior exposure to model deployment frameworks (MLflow, BentoML, TorchServe, Azure ML, or AWS SageMaker).

Please note that we will reach out to **ONLY** those applicants who satisfy the criteria listed above.

title: Business Development Executive (Upwork)
description:
### **The short version**

Every great client relationship at Techdome started with someone reading a message and thinking, “This person actually understands my problem.” We need the person who writes that message.

You’ll run our Upwork pipeline from end to end: finding the right jobs, writing proposals worth replying to, and taking the conversation all the way to a signed contract. Your results will show up directly in our revenue.

### 

### **About Techdome**

We’re a digital agency building websites, mobile apps, brand experiences, and search-led growth for clients around the world. Our developers, designers, and marketers are strong, and we need someone who can bring in work that fits them.

### 

### **What your day-to-day looks like**

**1. Hunt smart, not wide**

* Find and shortlist Upwork jobs where we have a real edge in web and app development, UI/UX and graphic design, and SEO/digital marketing
* Pass on poor-fit jobs without guilt
* Treat Connects as a budget: spend them on high-quality opportunities, not on volume

**2. Write proposals people actually answer**

* Open every proposal with the client’s problem, not our company profile
* No templates and no copy-paste pitches
* Own the whole conversation: first reply, discovery call, scoping, negotiation, and close
* Negotiate scope, pricing, and timelines within company guidelines

**3. Promise only what we can deliver**

* Work with developers, designers, and marketers to build realistic estimates and timelines
* Make sure what we sell matches what the team can build

**4. Keep our Upwork presence sharp**

* Keep our profile, portfolio, and case studies current and persuasive
* Stay on top of Upwork’s algorithm changes and best practices, and adapt quickly

**5. Know your numbers**

* Track bids, views, replies, interviews, conversions, and revenue
* Share regular reports on what’s working, what isn’t, and what you’ll change next

### 

### **What you bring**

**Must have**

* 1+ years of Upwork bidding experience at an IT services company or agency
* A track record of closed deals and repeat clients (be ready to share examples)
* Excellent written English and the ability to write persuasively
* A solid grasp of Upwork’s bidding process, Connects system, and job matching
* Enough working knowledge of web/app development, design, and digital marketing to scope projects credibly
* Confidence in client communication and negotiation
* Experience with a CRM or lead-tracking tool (LinkedIn Sales Navigator is a plus)

**Nice to have**

* Experience on Fiverr, Freelancer, PeoplePerHour, or similar platforms
* Experience working with international clients across time zones
* Basic estimation and technical scoping skills

### 

### **What’s in it for you**

* **Your wins are visible:** your bids and conversions are tracked and recognized
* **Your earnings grow with your results:** performance-based incentives on every deal you close
* **Real expertise behind you:** direct access to our tech and creative teams
* **A clear growth path:** toward senior Business Development roles
* **Flexibility:** hybrid work setup

title: IT Head
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a seasoned, strategic **Head of IT** to lead the technology architecture, digital transformation, and operational resilience across our diverse business verticals: **Media Production Studios, Commercial Malls, and Multiplex/Theater Operations**.

The ideal candidate possesses a unique blend of enterprise IT infrastructure management, high-performance media/post-production workflow expertise, and smart-building/retail IT operations (POS, building management integration, high-density public Wi-Fi, and digital cinema/exhibition technologies). You will drive operational excellence, enforce robust cybersecurity frameworks, and align technology investments with organizational growth.

Key Responsibilities**1. Enterprise & Smart Infrastructure Management (Malls & Corporate)**

· Oversee the end-to-end enterprise IT infrastructure, including data centers, server farms, enterprise storage, virtualization (VMware/Hyper-V), and hybrid cloud environments (AWS/Azure).

· Manage mission-critical IT systems for commercial mall operations, ensuring high availability of Building Management Systems (BMS), Public Address (PA) systems, CCTV/surveillance networks, and automated access controls.

· Architect and maintain high-density public Wi-Fi networks, structured cabling, and robust switching/routing backbones (L2/L3) across retail and office spaces.

· Oversee disaster recovery (DR) planning, business continuity drills, and power redundancy systems (UPS/Generators) for 24/7 retail and entertainment environments.

**2. Multiplex, Cinema & Digital Exhibition Technology**

· Oversee IT and networking infrastructure supporting digital cinema projection systems, server ingestion, and Theatre Management Systems (TMS).

· Manage automated scheduling, digital signage, box office ticketing kiosks, and secure content delivery (KDM/DCP management) in coordination with content distributors.

· Ensure ultra-low latency and absolute uptime for live-streaming, event screenings, and concessionaire point-of-sale (POS) networks.

**3. Post-Production & Media Studio Technology**

· Support high-performance media workflows including non-linear editing (Avid, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve), VFX, animation, sound design, and heavy rendering farms.

· Administer high-speed SAN/NAS environments optimized for uncompressed 4K/8K real-time collaboration.

· Manage Media Asset Management (MAM) systems, secure ingest/transcoding pipelines, and long-term digital archiving/retrieval processes.

**4. Retail & Point-of-Sale (POS) Operations**

· Ensure 99.99% uptime for mission-critical retail POS terminals, payment gateway integrations, inventory management databases, and merchant Wi-Fi networks within mall premises.

· Coordinate with tenant IT teams and retail partners to ensure seamless network integration and compliance with centre guidelines.

**5. Cybersecurity, Compliance & Data Privacy**

· Establish enterprise-wide cybersecurity policies, endpoint protection, Next-Gen Firewalls (NGFW), and SIEM tools.

· Protect high-value intellectual property (IP), unreleased media assets, and confidential tenant/customer data in compliance with data privacy regulations (e.g., DPDP Act, PCI-DSS for retail transactions).

· Conduct regular vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, and IT security audits.

**6. Vendor, Project & Budget Management**

· Lead strategic technology implementation projects, digital upgrades, and capital expenditure (CapEx/OpEx) planning.

· Manage relationships with global technology vendors, telecom operators, OEM partners, and service providers.

title: Director, Pricing — India Pricing Pod
description:
**Our Company:**

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

**What You'll Do:**

The Director of Pricing for India leads Teradata’s India-based pricing pod, bringing together pricing strategy, pricing analysis, and pricing execution in one team. This leader builds and develops a high-performing team, partners closely with global pricing leadership, and ensures pricing decisions are data-driven, commercially sound, and executable by the field.

Your Responsibilities:

* Lead and grow the India pricing pod, including hiring, coaching, and career development for strategy, analytics, and pricing operations talent.

* Own pricing strategy work for assigned portfolios and regions, partnering with global Pricing Strategy leaders and Product Managers across Core Platform and AI Platform.

* Build value-based pricing models aligned with customer outcomes, competitive dynamics, and product roadmap.

* Lead pricing analysis, including competitive benchmarking, win/loss and discount analysis, price realization, and elasticity and scenario modeling.

* Partner with Finance to model revenue impact and ARR implications of pricing decisions.

* Run pricing execution end to end, including deal support, pricing guardrails, discount frameworks, and approval workflows, in partnership with Sales and Deal Desk.

* Drive launch readiness for assigned products and offers, including pricing, PIDs, CPQ requirements, and field enablement.

* Partner with Product Management to influence roadmap and packaging decisions based on monetization opportunity.

* Help establish repeatable processes, tooling, and reporting that bring consistency and speed to pricing decisions across time zones.

* Provide executive-ready recommendations and pricing narratives for leadership decisions.

**What Makes You A Qualified Candidate:**

* 10–15+ years in pricing, product strategy, or monetization roles, including experience leading teams

* Experience with cloud platforms, data and analytics platforms, infrastructure pricing, or enterprise SaaS

* Hands-on experience across pricing strategy, pricing analytics, and deal-level pricing execution

* Strong financial modeling and scenario analysis skills

* Proven track record building value-based pricing models

* Experience with CPQ, deal desk processes, and pricing governance

* Experience partnering with Product, Finance, and Sales leadership

* Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent preferred

**What You'll Bring:**

* Strategic thinker with strong commercial instincts and a bias for execution

* Deep understanding of enterprise data platforms, analytics, and cloud economics

* Strong analytical rigor, comfortable moving between the big-picture model and the details of a deal

* Proven people leader who builds teams, develops talent, and creates clarity of ownership

* Able to simplify complex technical concepts into clear pricing narratives

* Highly collaborative; strong cross-functional influence across geographies

* Executive presence with strong storytelling and framing skills

* Comfortable operating in ambiguity and driving clarity

#LI-PG1

Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are committed to actively working to foster an inclusive environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.

title: Lead Planner-EM
description:
**Company Description**

**Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Ltd.** is a leading multinational pharmaceutical company based across global locations. Each of our 24,000 plus employees comes to work every day for one collective purpose: to accelerate access to affordable and innovative medicines because **Good Health Can’t Wait.**

We started in 1984 with a modest investment, 20 employees and a bold vision. Today, we have research and development centres, manufacturing facilities or a commercial presence in 66 countries.

For nearly four decades, we have stood for access, affordability and innovation based on the bedrock of deep science, progressive people practices and robust corporate governance. As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).

‘The Next and the New’ is how we aim to continue to be the partner of choice – purpose-driven, future-ready and sustainable. Our aim is to reach over 1.5 Bn+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency

Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to employ & nurture all qualified diverse workforce without regard to race, colour religion, nationality, sex, age, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender expression, citizenship or any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable law(s) of the country we operate in. We treasure every talent, and recognize merit and diversity in our organization.

"

 **Job Description**

**Job Summary :**

This role is for a Business unit **Lead FP&A for Emerging Markets** to drive financial planning, performance management and decision support across a diverse portfolio of international markets. This is a high-impact role working closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams with forward-looking FP&A and business partnering. The role will own key planning and forecasting cycles, provide insights into business performance and profitability, strengthen financial governance and drive automation and finance-transformation initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities :**

* Financial Planning & Forecasting: Lead the annual Budget, Latest Estimate/Forecast and long-range Strategic Plan, consolidating country and regional assumptions across revenue, margins, operating expenses, new products and profitability.
* Business Performance & Insights: Drive monthly and quarterly performance reviews, analyzing Actuals vs Budget, Forecast and Prior Year across sales, gross margin, Opex and EBITDA. Translate variances into clear business drivers, risks, opportunities and recommended actions.
* Closing, MIS & Financial Governance: Partner with Country Finance and Controllership teams during monthly/quarterly closing to ensure timely availability and validation of management information and translate financial outcomes into performance insights. Monitor sales and receivables and strengthen reporting controls.
* Profitability & Decision Support: Analyze performance across countries, products, brands and channels, identify margin and cost-improvement opportunities, and support evaluation of new products, investments and business models.
* Leadership Reporting: Prepare high-quality financial analyses, business updates and presentations for CXO and senior-management reviews, converting complex financial and operational information into sharp, decision-oriented insights.
* Business Partnering: Partner with Commercial, Country Finance, Supply Chain, Strategy, Portfolio/R&D and Corporate Finance teams to challenge assumptions, evaluate financial implications of business decisions and drive delivery of financial commitments.
* Risk & Opportunity Management: Maintain a forward-looking view of business performance, proactively identifying financial risks, opportunities and performance gaps and working with stakeholders on mitigation and value-creation actions.
* Automation & Finance Transformation: Act as a key finance SPOC for automation, reporting and analytics initiatives, driving standardization, simplification, digitalization and stronger financial controls across planning and reporting processes.
* Special Projects: Lead strategic and cross-functional finance initiatives covering profitability improvement, cost optimization, process transformation and operational efficiency, from financial evaluation through execution tracking.
* Lead, coach and develop the FP&A team, ensuring high-quality analytical output, effective prioritization and continued capability development

  
**Qualifications**

**Qualifications and Skills:**

* CA with 8–10 years of post-qualification experience.
* Strong experience in FP&A, Business Finance, Financial Planning, Controllership or Commercial Finance, preferably in a large multinational organization.
* Strong understanding of P&L, financial closing, budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, variance analysis and financial controls.
* Demonstrated ability to translate financial data into commercial insights and actionable recommendations.
* Strong analytical and financial-modelling capabilities, with advanced proficiency in Excel and exposure to ERP, planning and BI/visualization tools.
* Ability to operate effectively across multiple markets and manage diverse senior and cross-functional stakeholders.

* Strong executive communication, problem-solving and presentation skills. Skill in collaborating with stakeholders to prepare the annual budget, conducting reviews, and analyzing variances in estimates.
* Expertise in financial reporting, including preparation and review of financial statements for various entities.
* Ability to conduct analyses, understand variances, and prepare data for strategic meetings, demonstrating analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities.

  
**Additional Information**

Benefits Offered

At Dr. Reddy’s we actively help to catalyse your career growth and professional development through personalised learning programs.

The benefits you will enjoy at Dr. Reddy’s are on par with the best industry standards. They include, among other things and other essential equipment, joining & relocation support, family support (Maternity & Paternity benefits), learning and development opportunities, medical coverage for yourself and your family, life coverage for yourself.

" Our Work Culture

Ask any employee at Dr. Reddy’s why they come to work every day and they’ll say, because Good Health Can’t Wait. This is our credo as well as the guiding principle behind all our actions. We see healthcare solutions not only as scientific formulations, but as a means to help patients lead healthier lives, and we’re always attuned to the new and the next to empower people to stay fit. And to do this, we foster a culture of empathy and dynamism. People are at the core of our journey over the last few decades. They have been supported by an enabling environment that buoys individual ability while fostering teamwork and shared success. We believe that when people with diverse skills are bound together by a common purpose and value system, they can make magic.

For more details, please visit our career website at https://careers.drreddys.com/#!/"

title: Intern for VentureS - The Future of AI Driven Enterprises
description:
MBA Internship Opportunity. Build the Future of The AI Driven Enterprise World

**Position:** MBA Intern – Academic Programme Development, Entrepreneurship & University Partnerships  
**Programme:** Confidential  
**Engagement:** Internship  
**Location:** To be specified  
**Open to:** MBA graduates and final-year MBA students

About the initiative

We are developing a new interdisciplinary academic programme that is the future of AI driven Enterprises.

We intend to introduce this as a subject across engineering branches, including Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Computer Science, AI/ML, Chemical, Agricultural, Biomedical and other disciplines. Also introduce it in MBA and BBA Courses

This is not merely an entrepreneurship course. It is an initiative to develop a new academic discipline combining engineering, business management, entrepreneurship, artificial intelligence and enterprise automation, that will help build the next thousand billion dollar enterprises

We are looking for entrepreneurial, ambitious and execution-oriented MBA interns who want to participate in building this programme from the ground up.

What you will work on

**1. Academic Programme Development**

* Work with famous authors who are holding positions of Vice Chancellors, CEO of famous companies, award winning academicians
* Work with engineering professors, MBA faculty, subject experts and academic institutions
* Develop the complete curriculum, syllabus, course structure and learning outcomes.
* Prepare proposals for undergraduate subjects, electives, minors, full academic programmes and interdisciplinary courses.
* Coordinate with institutions for presentation and consideration by Boards of Studies, Academic Councils and other relevant academic bodies.
* Develop full-length programmes, short-term courses, certification programmes and online learning programmes.

**2. Textbook and Learning Resource Development**

* Work with authors, publishers, professors and industry experts to develop textbooks and reference books.
* Coordinate chapter development, editorial reviews and academic validation.
* Develop teaching notes, lecture materials, presentations, case studies and practical exercises.
* Prepare question banks, assignments, assessments, examination papers, sample papers and evaluation rubrics.
* Coordinate the development of digital learning resources and online course content.

**3. University and College Partnerships**

* Identify and establish relationships with engineering colleges, MBA institutions and universities.
* Present the programme to principals, directors, heads of departments, professors and university administrators.
* Coordinate institutional meetings, academic presentations, proposals and follow-ups.
* Develop institutional adoption and implementation plans.
* Build long-term partnerships with educational institutions.

**4. Faculty Development and Training**

* Design faculty orientation and training programmes.
* Work with subject experts to develop Faculty Development Programmes (FDPs).
* Build teams of trainers and academic resource persons.
* Organise workshops, seminars, webinars and faculty certification programmes.
* Help engineering and management faculty confidently teach this new subject.

**5. Classroom Programme Delivery**

* Develop implementation plans for classroom teaching.
* Recruit and coordinate trainers, visiting faculty, mentors and industry practitioners where required.
* Build teams to deliver programmes in colleges and universities.
* Coordinate academic calendars, teaching schedules, learning materials and student assessments.
* Monitor programme quality and institutional feedback.

**6. Entrepreneurship and Programme Expansion**

* Identify opportunities to expand the programme across institutions and disciplines.
* Develop institutional business models, programme pricing and partnership proposals.
* Explore opportunities for online education, executive education, professional certification and industry-sponsored programmes.
* Develop a network of authors, publishers, professors, trainers and industry mentors.
* Take ownership of projects and convert ideas into measurable outcomes.

Who should apply?

We are looking for candidates who:

* Have completed an MBA/BBA preferably in Entrepreneurship.
* Have a strong interest in entrepreneurship, business development, education and technology.
* Possess an entrepreneurial mindset and a willingness to build something new.
* Are comfortable communicating with senior professors, university officials, authors and business leaders.
* Have excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Can research, organise information, prepare presentations and develop structured proposals.
* Are proactive, resourceful, persistent and capable of working independently.
* Are willing to travel to colleges and universities when required.
* Can coordinate multiple teams and manage projects to completion.

Preferred backgrounds

* MBA in Entrepreneurship/Marketing/Strategy/Operations/Business Development
* BBA with Entrepreneurship

Candidates with experience in startups, consulting, institutional sales, academic administration, publishing, edtech or project management will be particularly relevant.

What you will gain

* Experience in creating and launching a new academic discipline.
* Understand how to build a Billion Dollar AI driven Enterprise
* Direct exposure to university-level curriculum development and academic governance.
* Experience working with professors, authors, publishers and institutional leadership.
* Practical experience in entrepreneurship, business development and programme management.
* Opportunities to lead projects and build teams.
* Exposure to AI, enterprise automation and the future of business.
* The opportunity to grow into programme leadership, institutional partnerships or business development roles.

The kind of people we want

We are not looking for interns who simply want to complete an internship certificate.

We want people who enjoy taking responsibility, building relationships, solving problems, creating systems and making things happen.

**You will not just be assisting with a programme. You will be helping build the programme, its academic ecosystem and its institutional presence.**

Pay: ₹5,000.00 - ₹10,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

·       Write well designed, testable, efficient code when needed to support timely development and delivery of products and projects.

·       Support continuous improvement by investigating alternatives and technologies and presenting these for architectural review.

· Prefer candidates with experience in US healthcare interoperability, HL7 and FHIR standards.

title: OTT & Media Architect

* Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to define digital transformation roadmaps.
* Drive innovation through AI-enabled media operations, personalization, recommendation engines, and intelligent content workflows.
* Mentor architects, engineering teams, and solution leaders while establishing architecture governance and best practices.
* Stay current with emerging industry trends across OTT, Connected TV (CTV), AdTech, cloud broadcast, and streaming technologies.



**Your Profile**

* 15+ years of experience in Media, Entertainment, OTT, Streaming, Broadcast, or Digital Video Engineering.
* Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale OTT and streaming platforms.
* Strong expertise in video delivery technologies including HLS, MPEG-DASH, CMAF, WebRTC, and SCTE standards.
* Hands-on experience with CDN architecture, DRM, content distribution, and video player ecosystems.
* Strong knowledge of cloud platforms including AWS, Azure, or GCP, along with Kubernetes, Docker, and Microservices architecture.
* Experience with AdTech ecosystems including SSAI, CSAI, Dynamic Ad Insertion, audience targeting, and programmatic advertising.
* Strong understanding of media analytics, audience measurement, recommendation engines, and personalization platforms.
* Experience in client consulting, stakeholder management, solutioning, and presales engagements.
* Ability to lead large transformation programs and manage executive-level client relationships.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.

**Preferred Domain Expertise**

* OTT & Streaming Platforms
* Broadcast-to-OTT Transformation
* Connected TV (CTV)
* Live Sports Streaming
* FAST Channels
* Media Supply Chain
* Content Operations
* Video QoE/QoS Monitoring
* Cloud Broadcast & Remote Production

**What You'll Love About Working Here**

We value flexibility and support our employees with remote work options and adaptable schedules to maintain a healthy work-life balance. Our inclusive culture brings together diverse professionals committed to growth, innovation, and excellence. You'll have access to continuous learning opportunities and certifications in emerging technologies such as Cloud, AI, Data, and Digital Engineering.

**About Us**

At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world's most innovative companies unleash their potential. From connected experiences to next-generation digital platforms, our technology experts provide unique engineering and transformation services across industries.

**A senior technology leader who architects and drives cloud-native, AI-enabled OTT and digital media platforms across content, streaming, monetization, and customer experience ecosystems.**

title: Principal Engineer, SoC Architect
description:
Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world leading MCUs, SoCs, Analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world’s leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you.

Renesas employs roughly 21,000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what’s next in electronics and the world.

**Job Description**

**About Renesas India (India for India – IFI)**

Renesas continues to significantly expand its presence in India, with headcount approaching 1,000 and strong engagement across government, academia, and the broader semiconductor ecosystem. As India emerges as a strategic semiconductor market and a global talent hub, Renesas’ India for India (IFI) initiative is focused on creating differentiated products that address local market needs, while remaining globally competitive.

This role represents a rare opportunity to shape future silicon platforms from India—directly influencing product architecture, execution methodologies, and portfolio direction for a fast‑growing, strategically important market. The individual will play a pivotal role in defining end‑to‑end SoC solutions that serve India’s unique applications across automotive, industrial, infrastructure, and emerging domains.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product & Portfolio Architecture**

* Work closely with Business, Product Management, Sales, and Customers to define product portfolio strategy and translate market needs into clear SoC/MCU requirements.
* Architect scalable SoC/MCU platforms, including detailed technical specifications and cost–benefit trade‑offs across architecture options, process nodes, IP reuse, and integration strategies.
* Define–Own–Deliver SoC implementations that meet product KPIs, quality, cost, and schedule targets.
* Ensure end‑to‑end specification compliance across verification, validation, characterization, and production test, with rigorous review of outcomes prior to release.
* Drive paradigm shifts in SoC/MCU execution—covering team structures, tools, design methodologies, and processes—to enable high‑quality, first‑pass silicon.
* Lead IP selection strategies, including make/buy decisions, third‑party IP evaluation, and long‑term platform reuse.
* Collaborate deeply with RTL design, Design Verification, Firmware/Software, Pre‑ and Post‑Silicon Validation, Test, and Program Management teams.
* Enable delivery of first‑pass functional silicon on aggressive and aspirational schedules through architectural rigor and execution discipline.
* Engage with external stakeholders, including IP vendors, EDA partners, foundries, and OSATs.
* Represent Renesas at technical conferences, standards bodies, and ecosystem forums, contributing to thought leadership and technology direction.
* Contribute to training program definition and rollout, mentor senior engineers, and drive systematic lessons‑learned and best‑practice sharing across teams and programs.

**Qualifications**

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Strong can‑do attitude, adaptability, and openness to diverse people, cultures, and working environments.
* Educational background in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Computer Science.
* Hands‑on experience across key portions of the SoC development lifecycle, including:
  + Front‑end architecture and RTL design
  + Verification
  + RTL‑to‑GDSII flow
  + Embedded software and system‑level integration
* Broad technical exposure across multiple domains such as Automotive, Multimedia, Networking, Compute, Computer Vision, and Software‑defined systems.
* Proven ability to influence and coordinate across highly experienced, globally distributed cross‑functional teams.
* Excellent communication, problem‑solving, and technical leadership skills with a strong focus on quality and execution.
* M.Tech / B.Tech in Electrical Engineering or Computer Science with 12+ years of experience in SoC/MCU architecture and RTL design, including leadership across the full NPI lifecycle.

**Additional Information**

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose,
**To Make Our Lives Easier**
. With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future.

title: Salesforce Senior Architect Manager
description:
**Description**
The Technical Consulting Senior Manager is a leader of leaders, responsible for successfully designing and managing the successful delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include—but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
  
  
You are both a big picture thinker and in-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won’t fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills from a technology perspective, including a foundational understanding of how to leverage AI development tools to optimize delivery cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long-term and will scale with the customer’s growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API’s as well as a strong development background. You are able to lead and motivate a team of highly capable individuals and help them meet their targets while enabling their growth.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client’s current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Champion an AI-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation across projects
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects, guiding delivery teams on the effective use of AI-assisted tooling to maintain velocity and quality
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed, encouraging the use of AI coding assistants to enforce best practices
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation
* Ability to understand a project and debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to assist in interpreting logs and isolating bottlenecks
* From time-to-time, participate in activities such as technical landscape discovery, Proof-Of-Concept (POC) development with prospects
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Community, Marketing, and Commerce Clouds, with a foundational familiarity with Salesforce’s AI offerings (e.g., Agentforce)
* Understanding of systems architecture
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth)
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.)
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Strong background in design/development of large web-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Lead a technical team and own customer and team engagement
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50-75%
* Maintain a target billable utilisation aligned to the role
* 14-18 years CRM experience with a minimum of 10 years on the Salesforce platform
* Maintain billable utilisation targets for your team
* Technical enablement of team members on the latest Salesforce products and processes, including upskilling on modern AI development tools and practices
* Working with global teams for delivery across geographies. We will need you to be flexible with your work hours
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire
* Leader of Leaders
* Experience building & growing a practice
* Must have managed a team of technical & solution implementors

title: Associate Enterprise Architect
description:
**About WSO2:**

Founded in 2005, WSO2 is the largest independent software vendor providing open-source API management, integration, and identity and access management (IAM) to thousands of enterprises in over 90 countries. WSO2's products and platforms—including our next-gen internal developer platform, Choreo—empower organizations to leverage the full potential of artificial intelligence and APIs for securely delivering the next generation of AI-enabled digital services and applications. Our open-source, AI-driven, API-first approach frees developers and architects from vendor lock-in and enables rapid digital product creation. Recognized as leaders by industry analysts, WSO2 has more than 800 employees worldwide with offices in Australia, Brazil, Germany, India, Sri Lanka, the UAE, the UK, and the US, with over USD100M in annual recurring revenue. Visit
https://wso2.com
to learn more.

**Job Summary:**

Enterprise Architects are highly visible, enterprise-grade technical consultants who engage directly with WSO2 prospects and customers. This role is fundamental to establishing definitive thought leadership by providing high-level consultation and strategic guidance on addressing complex enterprise application challenges using the WSO2 platform.

As an Enterprise Architect, you will be responsible for translating ambitious business goals into technically precise, implementable solutions, directly supporting high-stakes sales and customer success initiatives.

**Responsibilities and Duties:**

* Design custom demos and proof of concepts (POCs) that align with customer business needs. Evaluate RFP technical feasibility. Contribute to RFP responses by outlining technical and business capabilities.
* Map potential technologies to customer business and integration requirements.
* Clearly communicate technical and business benefits in presentations.
* Create high-quality solution designs that meet customer expectations.
* Develop subject matter expertise in WSO2 products, architecture, industry verticals, and competitive offerings. Apply this knowledge to enhance your personal brand, advise customers, and share expertise with the team.
* Provide feedback to teams on customer feature usage and alignment with design, implementation, and integration. Share architect expectations based on industry standards and developer/DevOps best practices. Raise and follow up on critical product issues and features.
* Maintain up-to-date knowledge of technology usage, including but not limited to WSO2 products, evolution, and future predictions within relevant domains and areas of specialization. Actively participate in discussions regarding technology, product features, direction, company vision, and process improvements.
* Lead technical aspects of project deliveries, collaborating closely with the delivery manager/PM. Take technical ownership, manage expectations, and communicate effectively with customers, the product team, service delivery personnel, and the internal team.
* Develop estimates and detailed schedules for complex projects, collaborating with product specialists.
* Communicate schedules clearly to customers and stakeholders, addressing assumptions, dependencies, and responsibilities.
* Conduct paid deployment reviews for customers, reviewing the solution and deployment architecture. Recommend best practices for using WSO2 products, aligning with customer requirements and use cases. Produce architectural review (AR) documents. Follow up on pending/future items with the customer and account manager (AM).
* Conduct technical workshops for customers, partners, and public users. Design workshop content tailored to diverse audiences, including CXOs, architects, developers, and DevOps engineers. Align content (slides, demos) with customer business problems and use cases.
* Assume primary or secondary technical ownership. Lead post-sales expansions, architectural reviews, and customer engagements. Participate in account planning with AMs. Conduct workshops, webinars, and customer events. Follow up on all post-sales activities. Build strong customer relationships and become a trusted advisor. Manage multiple accounts and prospects of varying size and complexity.
* Drive business and technical discussions with strategic accounts.
* Lead customer escalations. Collaborate with the support team to resolve critical production issues and conduct root cause analysis. Ensure issue resolution and customer satisfaction. Identify and address underlying problems, developing and implementing solutions.
* Lead and manage team members. Mentor new team members, ensuring role clarity and supporting their professional development.
* Write high-quality articles, blogs, and content that position you as an expert and drive traffic to WSO2. Focus on enterprise and business architecture content for CXOs and enterprise architects. Propose innovative concepts and patterns.
* Collaborate with marketing to deliver webinars, events, and public workshops. Design and lead sessions, ensuring market relevance.
* Leverage past experience to enhance team processes, individual skills (through knowledge sharing), and company vision. Adapt and implement successful strategies from previous roles within the WSO2 culture.
* Become an SME in a specific area, leveraging past experiences to improve WSO2. If no prior experience, develop expertise in a domain, subject matter, or industry vertical.
* Lead technical discussions within the team, demonstrating strong WSO2 product knowledge and a broad understanding of related technologies. Continuously expand technical breadth and share knowledge with the team, WSO2, and the wider community through talks, blogs, and articles.
* Lead and implement practices to enhance team productivity and quality. Initiate, collaborate, and lead tasks to improve team functions across the team, WSO2, and your specific pod/region. Measure the impact of initiatives and ensure their adoption and implementation into business-as-usual (BAU) operations.
* Continuously learn and share new ideas, concepts, and technologies with WSO2 and the team. Expand learning beyond technology to encompass areas like architecture, leadership, and management.

**Requirements:**

* BSc in Computer Science/Engineering or equivalent.
* At least 8 to 10 years of solid industry experience, with at least 3 years as a Solution Architect or a similar role in Sales Engineering.
* Experience in business, system architecture principles, architecture patterns, processes, and frameworks.
* Exceptional client management and communication skills, ability to mentor team members, and negotiate technical decisions.
* Ability to travel on short notice for short-term assignments.

**In addition, you should:**

* Be willing to learn MSA, SOA, EDA, enterprise middleware, and cloud computing, while actively participating in the entire process, from design to implementation.
* Exhibit natural curiosity, an analytical mind, and a willingness to explore the unknown.
* Have an affinity for new challenges, a self-starting attitude, and a willingness to work with a global team.
* Be able to take ownership of complex technical problems and drive them to resolution individually as well as work effectively through escalations with the engineering team.
* Possess an amicable personality and excellent communication and interpersonal skills, including sensitivity to the local cultures of WSO2’s global customer and employee base.
* Have the ability (e.g., passport) to travel overseas.

**Benefits:**

We want every team member to feel happy, cared for, and energized at WSO2. That's why, in addition to our performance-driven commission structure, we offer benefits and facilities designed to support your life and work.

* Flexible Leave Policy: We trust you to manage your time and performance. Enjoy a flexible vacation policy as long as you continue to demonstrate your commitment to shared goals.
* Comprehensive Healthcare: Your health is a priority. You are entitled to Health Benefits as detailed in the Company Healthcare plan.
* Essential Equipment: Start strong with a laptop provided as per standard company specifications. You can also request additional equipment like a mouse, keyboard, or monitor to build your ideal workspace.

**Diversity Drives Innovation:**

We’ve built our business on a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We believe it’s important to foster an environment that values and respects each individual’s strengths, perspectives, and ideas. Doing so not only drives innovation; it also ensures that we can create superior experiences for our customers, partners and employees worldwide. We value the diversity of our team regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, gender, age, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, or veteran or marital status, and we do not tolerate any form of discrimination.

title: Solution Engineer
description:

Location: Bangalore

We are seeking a seasoned Solution Engineer with deep expertise in building and scaling ecommerce platforms and marketplaces. You will play a pivotal role in architecting and delivering solutions that drive seamless customer experiences, streamline operations, and scale marketplace ecosystems. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with ecommerce platforms, marketplace integrations, and cloudnative architectures, as well as a strong focus on scalability, performance, and innovation.

● Solution Design: Analyze business requirements for ecommerce and marketplace platforms, translating them into scalable, robust technical solutions.

● Development: Design and implement features that support marketplace scalability, including multivendor capabilities, inventory management, and dynamic pricing models.

● Integration Expertise: Build and integrate APIs for third-party services such as payment gateways, logistics providers, marketing tools, and seller management systems.

● Performance Optimization: Ensure high performance and availability of marketplace systems, including optimizing page load times, search functionality, and transaction processes.

● Scalability: Architect solutions to handle growing marketplace traffic, vendor onboarding, and product catalog expansion.

● Data Strategy: Work with large data sets, ensuring effective integration and processing of customer, vendor, and product data.

● Customer Experience: Collaborate with UX/UI teams to optimize customer and vendor journeys, including advanced search, personalization, and checkout flows.

● Cross-functional Collaboration: Work with stakeholders across product, engineering, and business teams to deliver end-to-end solutions.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

● Experience: 5-7 years of experience in solution engineering, with specific expertise in ecommerce and marketplace platforms.

● Ecommerce & Marketplace Systems: Experience building or scaling multi-vendor marketplaces on platforms like Magento, Shopify Plus, BigCommerce, Mirakl, or custom solutions.

● Full-stack Development: Strong proficiency in the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js) or similar frameworks.

● API Design: Advanced knowledge of RESTful and GraphQL APIs, with experience in creating and managing third-party integrations (e.g., payment, shipping, marketing tools).

● Scalable Architectures: Experience designing microservices and headless commerce solutions tailored for marketplace environments.

● Performance Optimization: Expertise in scaling high-traffic ecommerce systems, load balancing, caching, queuing, and database optimization.

● Data Management: Strong knowledge of database technologies (SQL and NoSQL) and analytics integration for actionable insights.

● DevOps Practices: Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and monitoring tools to ensure uptime and system health.

**Preferred Skills**

● Marketplace-Specific Features: Experience with commission models, dispute resolution workflows, and vendor performance tracking, ads management.

● Familiarity with advanced personalization engines and recommendation systems.

● Knowledge of multi-currency and multi-language implementation for global marketplaces.

● Experience integrating with enterprise tools like ERP, CRM, and WMS systems.

● Exposure to analytics and reporting tools like Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, or Power BI

**Soft Skills**

● Strong problem-solving skills and a focus on delivering business value through technical solutions.

● Excellent communication skills to engage with technical and non-technical stakeholders, including vendors and partners.

● Proven ability to manage multiple projects and deliver on tight deadlines.

● Leadership skills, with a track record of mentoring and guiding engineering teams.

● Education Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related fields (or equivalent experience).

title: Sr. Staff Software Development Engineer
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.
  
  
We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.
  
  
**Role**
We are looking for a Sr. Staff Software Development Engineer. This is a hybrid role based in Bangalore, reporting to the Senior Manager, Software Development Engineering. You will join the Central Authority team working on the control plane for the Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) product, which has redefined how security services are delivered in the cloud. You will bring your expertise in security protocols and services to a team that built the world’s largest cloud security platform from the ground up.
  
  
**What You’ll Do (Role Expectations)**

* Lead the technical roadmap to modernize enterprise platforms using API-first design and microservices architecture
* Design, develop, and deploy highly resilient, low-latency, event-driven solutions while maintaining ownership from API tiers to back-end services
* Drive a culture of quality by setting coding standards, performing code reviews, and championing TDD/BDD practices and mentorship
* Partner with Product, DevOps, and System Architects to translate complex business needs into scalable, high-performance technical solutions
* Manage service lifecycles via Docker/Kubernetes and ensure system health using observability tools like Prometheus and Grafana

**Who You Are (Success Profile)**

* You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
* You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
* You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
* You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
* You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

**What We’re Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)**

* Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
* 8+ years in software development (including 4+ years specializing in production-grade microservices), with hands-on experience in modern programming languages such as Java, Go, or Rust
* Expertise in distributed data patterns (CQRS, Event Sourcing) and event-driven communication (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or SQS)
* Extensive hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes within AWS, Azure, or GCP environments
* Proficiency in both SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (Cassandra, MongoDB, or Cosmos DB) database design and scaling

**What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)**

* Experience leveraging AI-assisted developer tools, automated profiling, or AI acceleration libraries to optimize low-latency software architecture
* Experience with Service Mesh technologies (such as Istio or Linkerd), alongside practical knowledge of chaos engineering and advanced performance testing tools
* Active contributions to open-source projects or technical community leadership

title: Lead Software Architect
description:
**Job Description**
At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.
  
  
**Overview**
Boeing is the world's largest aerospace company and leading manufacturer of commercial airplanes and defense, space and security systems. We are engineers and technicians. Skilled scientists and thinkers. Bold innovators and dreamers. Join us, and you can build something better for yourself, for our customers and for the world.
  
  
As a leading global aerospace company, Boeing develops, manufactures and services commercial airplanes, defense products and space systems for customers in more than 150 countries. As a top U.S. exporter, the company leverages the talents of a global supplier base to advance economic opportunity, sustainability and community impact. Boeing’s team is committed to innovating for the future, leading with sustainability, and cultivating a culture based on the company’s core values of safety, quality and integrity.

The Boeing India Engineering & Technology Center (BIETC) is a 5500+ engineering workforce that contributes to global aerospace growth. Our engineers deliver cutting-edge R&D, innovation, and high-quality engineering work in global markets, and leverage new-age technologies such as AI/ML, IIoT, Cloud, Model-Based Engineering, and Additive Manufacturing, shaping the future of aerospace.
  
  
**People-driven culture**
At Boeing, we believe creativity and innovation thrives when every employee is trusted, empowered, and has the flexibility to choose, grow, learn, and explore. We offer variable arrangements depending upon business and customer needs, and professional pursuits that offer greater flexibility in the way our people work. We also believe that collaboration, frequent team engagements, and face-to-face meetings bring together different perspectives and thoughts – enabling every voice to be heard and every perspective to be respected. No matter where or how our teammates work, we are committed to positively shaping people’s careers and being thoughtful about employee wellbeing.
  
  
With us, you can create and contribute to what matters most in your career, community, country, and world. Join us in powering the progress of global aerospace.
  
  
**Position Overview:**

is currently looking for
**Lead Software Architect**
to join their team in Bengaluru, KA. passionate and motivated team who are excited to use the latest in software technologies for modern web and mobile application development. Through our products we deliver innovative solutions to our global customer base at an accelerated pace.

title: Principal Systems Architect
description:
Sandisk understands how people and businesses consume data and we relentlessly innovate to deliver solutions that enable today’s needs and tomorrow’s next big ideas. With a rich history of groundbreaking innovations in Flash and advanced memory technologies, our solutions have become the beating heart of the digital world we’re living in and that we have the power to shape.
  
  
Sandisk meets people and businesses at the intersection of their aspirations and the moment, enabling them to keep moving and pushing possibility forward. We do this through the balance of our powerhouse manufacturing capabilities and our industry-leading portfolio of products that are recognized globally for innovation, performance and quality.
  
  
Sandisk has two facilities recognized by the World Economic Forum as part of the Global Lighthouse Network for advanced 4IR innovations. These facilities were also recognized as Sustainability Lighthouses for breakthroughs in efficient operations. With our global reach, we ensure the global supply chain has access to the Flash memory it needs to keep our world moving forward.
  
  
**Description**
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for a Software Architect (12+ years relevant experience) to lead the application/framework layer and deployment stack for the Next Generation Accelerator AI platform. This role owns how models run on Next Generation Accelerator—from vLLM / PyTorch / TensotFlow/XLA to production deployment—ensuring correctness, performance, and scalability.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Architect integration of vLLM, PyTorch, and TensorFlow, JAX/XLA into Next Generation Accelerator stack
* Define framework → compiler → runtime APIs and contracts
* Own LLM execution behavior (batching, KV cache, streaming inference)
* Design and implement end-to-end deployment workflows (packaging, versioning, reproducibility)
* Drive performance optimization across model → framework → runtime
* Work cross-functionally with compiler, runtime, and low-level SW teams
* Support customer workloads, model onboarding, and debugging Impact
* Own customer-visible AI execution and deployment on Next Generation Accelerator, closing the gap between models and system performance, and enabling enterprise-grade AI solutions

**Required Qualifications**

* 15+ years in AI/ML systems or software architecture Strong experience with PyTorch / Transformers / LLMs
* Hands-on experience with LLM deployment and scalable inference engine

Additional Information
  
  
Sandisk thrives on the power and potential of diversity. As a global company, we believe the most effective way to embrace the diversity of our customers and communities is to mirror it from within. We believe the fusion of various perspectives results in the best outcomes for our employees, our company, our customers, and the world around us. title: Senior Lead Software Architect
description:
**Job Description**
At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.
  
  
**Overview**
Boeing is the world's largest aerospace company and leading manufacturer of commercial airplanes and defense, space and security systems. We are engineers and technicians. Skilled scientists and thinkers. Bold innovators and dreamers. Join us, and you can build something better for yourself, for our customers and for the world.
  
  
As a leading global aerospace company, Boeing develops, manufactures and services commercial airplanes, defense products and space systems for customers in more than 150 countries. As a top U.S. exporter, the company leverages the talents of a global supplier base to advance economic opportunity, sustainability and community impact. Boeing’s team is committed to innovating for the future, leading with sustainability, and cultivating a culture based on the company’s core values of safety, quality and integrity.

The Boeing India Engineering & Technology Center (BIETC) is a 5500+ engineering workforce that contributes to global aerospace growth. Our engineers deliver cutting-edge R&D, innovation, and high-quality engineering work in global markets, and leverage new-age technologies such as AI/ML, IIoT, Cloud, Model-Based Engineering, and Additive Manufacturing, shaping the future of aerospace.
  
  
**People-driven culture**
At Boeing, we believe creativity and innovation thrives when every employee is trusted, empowered, and has the flexibility to choose, grow, learn, and explore. We offer variable arrangements depending upon business and customer needs, and professional pursuits that offer greater flexibility in the way our people work. We also believe that collaboration, frequent team engagements, and face-to-face meetings bring together different perspectives and thoughts – enabling every voice to be heard and every perspective to be respected. No matter where or how our teammates work, we are committed to positively shaping people’s careers and being thoughtful about employee wellbeing.
  
  
With us, you can create and contribute to what matters most in your career, community, country, and world. Join us in powering the progress of global aerospace.
  
  
**Position Overview:**
  
  
**Boeing Digital Services org**
is currently looking for a

**Bangalore, IN.**
This role is expected to will own the end-to-end delivery of a product capability, helping design the solution and leading a small team of developers to build it. You'll own the technical scope for your product capability, shaping the architecture, driving implementation, and planning delivery with your team. That looks like:
  
  
  

* Building full-stack, production-grade, cloud-native applications: frontend interfaces, backend services, APIs, and the integrations that connect them across complex enterprise environments.
* Writing and reviewing code across multiple languages and paradigms.
* Designing event-driven and microservices architectures that can scale, evolve, and be operated by teams beyond the ones that built them.
* Integrating AI, ML or LLM capabilities into your product.
* Implementing CI/CD pipelines and delivery automation that give teams the confidence to ship frequently.

* Experience designing model-serving infrastructure for batch, real-time, and streaming use cases.
* Ability to define scalable end-to-end ML architectures across data, features, models, and downstream applications.
* Experience establishing operational standards for observability, reliability, governance, and performance of models in production.
* Making day-to-day architecture decisions within your product and escalating the right ones to the leadership team when they have broader implications.
* Identifying technical risk early and surfacing it clearly before it becomes a delivery problem.
* Generating ideas, failing fast, and demonstrating with key stakeholders.
* Driving knowledge sharing across teams and the broader technical group.

* Communication: Using a variety of media, clearly conveys information and ideas to individuals or groups in a manner that engages the audience and helps them understand and retain the message.

* Systems Thinking: Ability to understand the big picture and the inter-relationships between components of systems and plans, anticipate future events, and apply the principles of systems thinking to accelerate performance.

* Deep understanding of architectural styles like microservices, event-driven systems, monoliths, and serverless computing.

* Must have experience with Spring Boot Framework, REST based Web Services and SOA
