title: Staff Software Development Engineer - Data Platforms
description:
**Job Summary:**
As a seasoned Staff Software Development Engineer in Data Platform team you will be at the forefront of designing, building, and optimizing the critical data infrastructure that handles hundreds of millions of requests per minute (RPM) for our ingestion services, processes billions of events daily from Kafka, and manages petabytes of data stored in S3. You will leverage your deep expertise to architect and deliver highly scalable, reliable, and performant data solutions that directly impact our global user base and drive our strategic initiatives.
  
  
**About the team:**
Data platforms team at JioHotStar is building the next generation of AI-powered experiences and autonomous agents, leveraging our vast data to create truly innovative products. Beyond traditional data engineering, you'll be instrumental in developing the data foundations for our AI initiatives, including the development of our own MCP server and the infrastructure supporting our cutting-edge AI Agents.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Core Platform Development**

* Architecture & Design: Build POCs, create architecture designs, and evaluate trade-offs for new services and migrations
* Real-time Data Pipeline: Build and maintain highly scalable, accurate, clean and real-time events collection systems
* Data Foundation for AI & MCP: Specifically design and build data pipelines to support the development and training of AI models and autonomous AI Agents.
* This includes creating robust data infrastructure for our MCP, ensuring data quality and availability for personalized learning paths and skill validation.
* Data Quality Assurance: Continuously work towards detecting, alerting, and fixing quality issues to build trust in our data
* System Enhancement: Improve existing systems and services using latest tooling and engineering standards
* Cost Optimization: Improve unit economics across ingestion, storage, and processing components

**Technical Leadership & Ownership**

* Complete Development Lifecycle: Own the entire development process from ideation to deployment
* Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with different teams to achieve common goals through efficient coordination
* Technical Documentation: Maintain up-to-date documentation with architecture diagrams for entire projects
* Service Ownership: Take complete ownership of services within your workstream and drive continuous improvement
* Operational Excellence: Establish and maintain robust monitoring, alerting, and operational procedures for mission-critical data systems.

**Team Leadership & Growth**

* Knowledge Sharing: Write blogs and articles to help team members and the community
* Architecture Breakdown: Break down high-level architecture into manageable services and tasks
* Technology Trends: Learn and share new trends in technology, engineering, and productivity
* Team Productivity: Actively work towards improving team productivity and knowledge
* Mentorship: Guide and mentor junior team members

**Business Impact**

* Data Governance: Govern data assets across the entire company and audit data posture
* Time to Insight: Reduce time to insight for data team stakeholders
* Business Decision Support: Assist and challenge business decisions using data insights
* Stakeholder Service: Make data available to all stakeholders in an efficient, quick, quarriable, and intuitive manner

**Skills and attributes for success:**

* Experience: 8+ years of progressive professional experience in data engineering, with a proven track record of designing, building, and operating large-scale, high-throughput data platforms, ideally in a consumer-facing or streaming industry.
* Extreme Scale Experience: Demonstrated experience working with data systems that handle hundreds of millions of events/requests per minute, billions of daily events, and petabytes of storage (e.g., S3, HDFS).
* Programming: Strong proficiency in at least one major programming language such as Python, Java, Scala, or Go, with a focus on building robust, production-grade data applications.
* Distributed Data Processing: Deep expertise and practical experience with distributed data processing frameworks like Apache Spark, Apache Flink, or equivalent technologies for batch and streaming workloads.
* AI/ML Data Experience: Specific experience in building data pipelines for Machine Learning model training, inference, and feature stores. Familiarity with data needs for AI Agents or similar intelligent systems.
* Messaging & Streaming: Extensive experience with high-throughput messaging queues and stream processing platforms like Apache Kafka, Kinesis, or equivalent.
* Cloud Platforms: Hands-on expertise with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and their data-related services, with a strong preference for AWS (S3, EMR, Kinesis, Glue, Redshift, etc.).
* Data Warehousing/Lakes: Strong understanding and hands-on experience with modern data warehousing concepts and data lake architectures (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Delta Lake, Iceberg, Hudi).
* ETL/Orchestration: Expertise in building, optimizing, and orchestrating complex ETL/ELT pipelines using tools like Apache Airflow, Prefect, or other workflow management systems.
* Databases: Strong SQL skills and experience with both relational (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL databases (e.g., Cassandra, DynamoDB).
* Data Modeling: Advanced data modeling skills (dimensional, Kimball, data vault) for large, complex datasets.
* Problem-Solving: Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a proven track record of debugging and optimizing complex distributed systems.
* Communication: Excellent communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
* Mentorship: Proven ability to mentor, guide, and technically lead senior and junior engineers.

title: Senior Cloud Engineer
description:
**Job Description:**
**Job Title – Senior Cloud Engineer (GCP)**
Join Fidelity Enterprise Infrastructure & Operations (EI&O) as a Senior Cloud Engineer where you will contribute to Cloud Developer Advocacy (CDA) team through innovative solutions using the latest cloud native technologies and leading-edge engineering practices, driving the design, development, and automation of cloud-native security solutions across Fidelity's AWS
  
  
ecosystem.
  
  
**The Purpose of This Role**
Fidelity is currently seeking a Cloud Engineer to join its Cloud Platform Engineering Team and support the build-out of our Google Cloud platform. This role focuses on developing reusable platform capabilities that enable engineering teams to adopt and operate Google Cloud services securely and efficiently.
  
  
You will work with platform, product, and security teams to provision infrastructure, automate deployments, and support services including Google Cloud IAM, Vertex AI, BigQuery, and Google Maps Platform. The ideal candidate brings practical cloud engineering experience, working knowledge of GCP, and a willingness to deepen their expertise. Deep specialization in every listed service is not required.
  
  
**The Value You Deliver**
As a Cloud Engineer, you will work within the DevOps Integration/Full Stack role. We are a diverse, multi-functional team comprised of highly upbeat and motivated technologists who believe in the power of innovation and constant teamwork. The team blends technology & business expertise with a passion for exploring new technologies while working in an open and transparent way. We believe that small, empowered, self-motivated teams can achieve extraordinary things. We are passionate about opensource contribution, sharing our expertise and knowledge with the engineering community while embracing a continuous learning approach supported by a dedicated learning day each week.
  
  
****How Your Work Impacts The Organization****
EI&O domain is the part of Enterprise Technology with the focus on Enterprise Cloud, Infrastructure, & Operations. We enable Fidelity business units to safely and securely adopt cloud at scale. The cross-enterprise collaboration enables the delivery of solutions that meet the emerging digital expectations of Fidelity’s customers and clients.
  
  
****The Skills That Are Key To This Role****
**Technical**

* Help build and maintain core GCP platform capabilities, including project provisioning, service enablement, access management, networking, logging, and monitoring.
* Develop reusable infrastructure-as-code modules and deployment pipelines that make cloud environments consistent, repeatable, and easier to support.
* Configure IAM roles, service accounts, and workload identities using least-privilege principles and established enterprise security standards.
* Support Vertex AI adoption by configuring environments, permissions, service integrations, and connectivity for AI and machine learning workloads.
* Provision and configure BigQuery datasets, access controls, and supporting platform capabilities, including usage monitoring and cost controls.
* Enable Google Maps Platform APIs and services, including API key restrictions, application integration support, quotas, and usage monitoring.
* Partner with application teams to troubleshoot access, connectivity, configuration, and deployment issues.
* Apply platform guardrails for security, reliability, and cost management in partnership with security and governance teams.
* Maintain documentation, operational runbooks, and onboarding guidance; share knowledge and contribute to continuous platform improvement.

**Behavioural Skills that are Good to Have for this role**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to derive actionable insights from complex data and troubleshoot effectively.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, able to translate technical outcomes into business value and work effectively across teams.
* Growth mindset and continuous learning orientation, with curiosity to explore new cloud capabilities, experiment, and improve through hands-on implementation.
* Ability to prioritize and navigate ambiguity, balancing delivery, security, reliability, and maintainability in a fast-paced environment.

****How Your Work Impacts The Organization****
EI&O domain is the part of Enterprise Technology with the focus on Infrastructure, Cloud Engineering & Operations. We, Cloud Provider Enablement (CPE) enable Fidelity business units to safely and securely adopt cloud at scale. The cross-enterprise collaboration enables the delivery of solutions that meet the emerging digital expectations of Fidelity’s customers and clients.
  
  
**The Expertise We’re Looking For**

* A solid 3+ years of working knowledge of GCP fundamentals, including resource hierarchy, projects, billing, API enablement, and organization policies.
* Around 6 – 8 years of experience in cloud infrastructure, software engineering, DevOps, or platform engineering, including hands-on exposure to GCP.
* Practical experience with Google Cloud IAM, including roles, permissions, service accounts, and least-privilege access. Familiarity with Workload Identity Federation is a plus.
* Foundational knowledge of Vertex AI and experience supporting service configuration, access, or integration with other GCP services.
* Working knowledge of BigQuery datasets, tables, access controls, and basic SQL, with an awareness of query costs and data access considerations.
* Familiarity with Google Maps Platform APIs and services, including API credentials, restrictions, quotas, and billing.
* Experience using Terraform to provision and manage cloud infrastructure through version-controlled, repeatable deployments.
* Familiarity with Git and CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure validation and deployment.
* Understanding of cloud networking fundamentals, including VPCs, subnets, DNS, firewalls, and private connectivity.
* Ability to write scripts in Python, Bash, or a similar language to automate routine engineering tasks.

****Company Overview****
Fidelity Investments is one of the world's largest providers of financial services. Headquartered in Boston, US, Fidelity's goal is to make financial expertise broadly accessible and effective in helping people live the lives they want. Privately held for nearly 70 years, Fidelity employs 45,000 associates who are focused on the long-term success of our customers. title: Solution Engineer
description:
**Role: Solution Engineer (5-8 yrs)**

Location: Bangalore

We are seeking a seasoned Solution Engineer with deep expertise in building and scaling ecommerce platforms and marketplaces. You will play a pivotal role in architecting and delivering solutions that drive seamless customer experiences, streamline operations, and scale marketplace ecosystems. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with ecommerce platforms, marketplace integrations, and cloudnative architectures, as well as a strong focus on scalability, performance, and innovation.

**Key Responsibilities**

● Solution Design: Analyze business requirements for ecommerce and marketplace platforms, translating them into scalable, robust technical solutions.

● Development: Design and implement features that support marketplace scalability, including multivendor capabilities, inventory management, and dynamic pricing models.

● Integration Expertise: Build and integrate APIs for third-party services such as payment gateways, logistics providers, marketing tools, and seller management systems.

● Performance Optimization: Ensure high performance and availability of marketplace systems, including optimizing page load times, search functionality, and transaction processes.

● Scalability: Architect solutions to handle growing marketplace traffic, vendor onboarding, and product catalog expansion.

● Data Strategy: Work with large data sets, ensuring effective integration and processing of customer, vendor, and product data.

● Customer Experience: Collaborate with UX/UI teams to optimize customer and vendor journeys, including advanced search, personalization, and checkout flows.

● Compliance and Security: Ensure marketplace compliance with regulations (e.g., GDPR, PCIDSS) and implement fraud prevention and secure payment mechanisms.

● Cloud Deployment: Leverage cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) to deploy, monitor, and maintain scalable ecommerce and marketplace systems.

● Cross-functional Collaboration: Work with stakeholders across product, engineering, and business teams to deliver end-to-end solutions.

● Mentorship and Leadership: Guide junior engineers and contribute to team development by sharing best practices and expertise.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

● Experience: 5-7 years of experience in solution engineering, with specific expertise in ecommerce and marketplace platforms.

● Ecommerce & Marketplace Systems: Experience building or scaling multi-vendor marketplaces on platforms like Magento, Shopify Plus, BigCommerce, Mirakl, or custom solutions.

● Full-stack Development: Strong proficiency in the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js) or similar frameworks.

● API Design: Advanced knowledge of RESTful and GraphQL APIs, with experience in creating and managing third-party integrations (e.g., payment, shipping, marketing tools).

● Scalable Architectures: Experience designing microservices and headless commerce solutions tailored for marketplace environments.

● Performance Optimization: Expertise in scaling high-traffic ecommerce systems, load balancing, caching, queuing, and database optimization.

● Cloud Platforms: Proven experience deploying applications on AWS, Azure, or GCP, with a focus on scalability and reliability.

● Data Management: Strong knowledge of database technologies (SQL and NoSQL) and analytics integration for actionable insights.

● DevOps Practices: Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and monitoring tools to ensure uptime and system health.

**Preferred Skills**

● Marketplace-Specific Features: Experience with commission models, dispute resolution workflows, and vendor performance tracking, ads management.

● Familiarity with advanced personalization engines and recommendation systems.

● Knowledge of multi-currency and multi-language implementation for global marketplaces.

● Experience integrating with enterprise tools like ERP, CRM, and WMS systems.

● Exposure to analytics and reporting tools like Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, or Power BI

**Soft Skills**

● Strong problem-solving skills and a focus on delivering business value through technical solutions.

● Excellent communication skills to engage with technical and non-technical stakeholders, including vendors and partners.

● Proven ability to manage multiple projects and deliver on tight deadlines.

● Leadership skills, with a track record of mentoring and guiding engineering teams.

● Education Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related fields (or equivalent experience).

title: Technical Lead
description:
This is a hands-on senior developer role that is expected to operate like a Chief Technology Officer for our products.

You will write and review code, and you will also own what gets built, why, and in what order. You will work directly with the founders, the compliance and legal teams, and the sales team, and be the technology voice in front of clients.

You are

* The owner of the product and its technology
* Hands-on in architecture, code and releases
* A partner to sales in demos, pilots and pricing
* Building the roadmap with the founders

Key responsibilities

**Product ownership**

Own product end to end: features, quality, uptime and user experience. Convert client and internal feedback into clear product requirements.

**Technology roadmap**

Build and maintain a 12–18 month product and technology roadmap with the founders. Prioritise by revenue impact, client need and effort.

**Architecture and engineering**

Design and build a scalable, secure, multi-tenant SaaS platform. Modernise the existing product in stages without disrupting live clients. Write production code, review code, own releases.

**AI and automation**

Design AI into the product from the start: regulatory update ingestion, compliance mapping, evidence review and reporting, with human approval where needed.

**Go-to-market**

Join client demos, technical discussions, RFPs and pilots. Shape packaging and pricing inputs. Handle integrations and client security questionnaires.

**Security and reliability**

Set up access control, audit trails, monitoring, alerting and backups. Lead readiness for ISO 27001 / SOC 2 expected by regulated clients.

**Team and vendors**

Hire and mentor developers and interns. Manage external technology vendors and consultants, including scope, cost and delivery.

**Reporting**

Report progress, risks and technology costs to the founders in simple, measurable terms.

Must have

**Experience**

7–8 years in software development, with most of it in a SaaS or product-based technology company (not only services or project delivery).

Has taken at least one product or major module from 0 to 1 and run it in production with paying B2B customers.

Has led a small engineering team (3–5 people) or owned a product area end to end.

Has worked directly with founders, product, sales or customers, not only within engineering.

**Technical skills**

**Backend**

Strong in at least one modern stack: Python (Django / FastAPI) or Node.js

**Frontend**

Working knowledge of React or Angular; able to review and guide UI work

**Data**

PostgreSQL / MySQL, data modelling, migrations with zero downtime; Redis or similar

**SaaS architecture**

Multi-tenancy, role-based access control, audit logging, REST APIs, third-party integrations

**Cloud and DevOps**

AWS, GCP or Azure; Docker; CI/CD; monitoring and alerting (e.g. Grafana, Prometheus, Sentry)

**AI**

Practical experience shipping LLM-based features: RAG, document parsing, classification or agents

**Legacy modernization**

Has migrated or re-platformed a live product in stages

**Leadership and business skills**

•        Can build a roadmap and defend the priorities with numbers.

•        Can explain technology to non-technical founders, lawyers and clients in plain language.

•        Comfortable in client meetings, demos and commercial discussions.

•        Ownership mindset: treats product uptime, cost and delivery dates as personal commitments.

Good to have

•        Experience in compliance, legal-tech, regtech, fintech or other regulated-industry products.

•        Founding-engineer or early-engineer experience at a startup.

•        Exposure to ISO 27001 or SOC 2 Type II programmes.

•        Workflow, document-management or reporting/analytics products.

•        ERP or enterprise integrations (e.g. SAP, NetSuite) and SSO.

•        B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science or a related field.

title: Payments - Engineering Manager
description:
**Organization:**
At CommBank, we never lose sight of the role we play in other people’s financial wellbeing. Our focus is to help people and businesses move forward to progress. To make the right financial decisions and achieve their dreams, targets, and aspirations. Regardless of where you work within our organisation, your initiative, talent, ideas, and energy all contribute to the impact that we can make with our work. Together we can achieve great things.
  
  
**Job Title:**
Engineering Manager
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore-Manyata Tech Park
  
  
**Business & Team:**
Enterprise Services (ES) is responsible for the world leading application of technology and operations across every aspect of CommBank, from innovative product platforms for our customers to essential tools within our business. We also use technology to drive efficient and timely processing, an essential component of great customer service. CommBank is recognized as leading the industry in IT and operations with its world-class platforms and processes, agile IT infrastructure, and innovation in everything from payments to internet banking and mobile apps.
  
  
The Payments Technology and Environments team resides in the Payments Service Utility and its purpose is to restore the trust of our customers by transforming the Payments services experiences provided by the Bank to 99.999% availability, greater agility and reliability.Our team is composed of engineers and technology leaders, who bring in the right mix of skills to enable this transformation. We also work very closely with our business and operations colleagues to support these services which are critical to the Australian and Global economy.Our team is also responsible to also drive Engineering Governance, Continuous Delivery and key technological simplification pillars such as Cloud and Payments Event based architecture.
  
  
**Impact & Contribution:**
As an Engineering Manager within Payments Technology – Channel & Reporting, you will be responsible for implementing the designs. You are expected to develop solutions and guide design to drive outcomes across the Core Product Systems within Channel & Reporting applications. You are responsible for design analysis and the estimation process from Business Case, ideation, discovery and inception phases.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities:**
As an Engineering Manager, you will remain hands-on in software delivery while leading engineers to design, build, secure and operate resilient payment solutions. You will contribute production-quality code, establish engineering standards and enable reliable delivery through modern cloud and DevOps practices.
  
  

+ Design, develop, review and maintain production-grade applications, APIs and microservices using .NET/.NET Core, Node.js, NestJS and Next.js.
+ Provide hands-on technical leadership through coding, pair programming, code reviews, troubleshooting and resolution of complex cross-system issues.
+ Translate business outcomes into clear technical requirements, solution options, architecture decisions, delivery estimates and implementation plans.
+ Own end-to-end solution design, including API contracts, event-driven integration, data flows, domain boundaries, resilience, performance and observability.
+ Build and evolve secure, scalable AWS solutions using services such as Lambda, API Gateway, ECS/EKS, Fargate, IAM, VPC, load balancing, storage and managed databases.
+ Implement and improve CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing, containerisation, deployment, monitoring and operational support practices.
+ Embed security throughout the software development lifecycle, including threat modelling, secure coding, secrets management, vulnerability remediation and security controls.
+ Lead technical analysis, proof-of-concepts and design reviews; challenge assumptions and make pragmatic decisions based on risk, value, cost and maintainability.
+ Coach engineers in coding practices, architecture, testing and DevSecOps while maintaining accountability for delivery quality and engineering outcomes.

**Essential Skills:**

* Extensive software engineering experience with recent hands-on contributions to production code.
* Strong proficiency in C#, .NET and .NET Core, including REST APIs, background services, dependency injection, asynchronous programming, testing and performance optimisation.
* Strong JavaScript and TypeScript development experience using Node.js, NestJS and Next.js.
* Experience designing microservices, API-first and event-driven systems, with sound knowledge of distributed-system patterns and integration practices.
* Strong application architecture and object-oriented design capability, including SOLID principles, design patterns, domain modelling and maintainable code structure.
* Hands-on AWS experience across Lambda, API Gateway, ECS/EKS, Fargate, IAM, VPC, load balancers, CloudWatch and related managed services.
* Practical DevOps experience with GitHub, GitHub Actions, Jenkins or TeamCity, Docker, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code and automated release controls.
* Experience with automated testing, code-quality controls and observability using tools such as SonarQube or SonarCloud, Splunk, AppDynamics and CloudWatch.
* Ability to diagnose and resolve complex application, integration, cloud and production issues across multiple components.
* Proven technical analysis and solution-design capability, including requirements decomposition, option assessment, estimation and architecture documentation.
* Working knowledge of secure software development, threat modelling, identity and access management, secrets management, dependency scanning and vulnerability remediation.
* Experience applying reliability, scalability, availability, disaster recovery, performance and cost considerations to cloud-native designs.
* Demonstrated ability to lead engineers while remaining close to the code through design reviews, coding, code reviews, technical mentoring and incident resolution.
* Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions, risks and trade-offs to engineering, product, business, security and operations stakeholders.
* Experience working in agile, cross-functional delivery environments and contributing throughout discovery, build, test, release and production support.
* Risk Mindset – proactively identify, understand, communicate and manage current and emerging technology risks.

**Education:**
A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent industry experience.
  
  
If you're already part of the Commonwealth Bank Group (including Bankwest, x15ventures), you'll need to apply through Sidekick to submit a valid application. We’re keen to support you with the next step in your career.
  
  
We're aware of some accessibility issues on this site, particularly for screen reader users. We want to make finding your dream job as easy as possible, so if you require additional support please contact HR Direct on 1800 989 696.

title: Sr. Staff Software Development Engineer
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.
  
  
We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.
  
  
**Role**
We are looking for a Sr. Staff Software Development Engineer. This is a hybrid role based in Bangalore, reporting to the Senior Manager, Software Development Engineering. You will join the Central Authority team working on the control plane for the Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) product, which has redefined how security services are delivered in the cloud. You will bring your expertise in security protocols and services to a team that built the world’s largest cloud security platform from the ground up.
  
  
**What You’ll Do (Role Expectations)**

* Lead the technical roadmap to modernize enterprise platforms using API-first design and microservices architecture
* Design, develop, and deploy highly resilient, low-latency, event-driven solutions while maintaining ownership from API tiers to back-end services
* Drive a culture of quality by setting coding standards, performing code reviews, and championing TDD/BDD practices and mentorship
* Partner with Product, DevOps, and System Architects to translate complex business needs into scalable, high-performance technical solutions
* Manage service lifecycles via Docker/Kubernetes and ensure system health using observability tools like Prometheus and Grafana

**Who You Are (Success Profile)**

* You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
* You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
* You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
* You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
* You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

**What We’re Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)**

* Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
* 8+ years in software development (including 4+ years specializing in production-grade microservices), with hands-on experience in modern programming languages such as Java, Go, or Rust
* Expertise in distributed data patterns (CQRS, Event Sourcing) and event-driven communication (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or SQS)
* Extensive hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes within AWS, Azure, or GCP environments
* Proficiency in both SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (Cassandra, MongoDB, or Cosmos DB) database design and scaling

**What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)**

* Experience leveraging AI-assisted developer tools, automated profiling, or AI acceleration libraries to optimize low-latency software architecture
* Experience with Service Mesh technologies (such as Istio or Linkerd), alongside practical knowledge of chaos engineering and advanced performance testing tools
* Active contributions to open-source projects or technical community leadership

At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure.
  
  
**Benefits**
Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including:
  
  

* Various health plans
* Time off plans for vacation and sick time

title: M365 Architect
description:
**Do you want your voice heard and your actions to count?**
Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. Across the globe, we’re 150,000 colleagues, striving to make a difference for every client, organization, and community we serve. We stand for our values, building long-term relationships, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world.
  
  
With a vision to be the world’s most trusted financial group, it’s part of our culture to put people first, listen to new and diverse ideas and collaborate toward greater innovation, speed and agility. This means investing in talent, technologies, and tools that empower you to own your career.
  
  
Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.
  
  
Position Title: M365 SME
  
  
Corporate Title: Assistant Vice President
  
  
Reporting to: Vice President
  
  
Location: Bengaluru
  
  
**Position Details**
Role and Responsibilities
  
  

* M365 enterprise architecture: Act as an M365 architect for Microsoft 365 services, including Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, Copilot Studio, Teams, SharePoint Online, Exchange Online, OneDrive, Viva, Loop, Microsoft Graph, Entra ID integrations, Purview, Defender, Intune and enterprise information protection capabilities. The role includes coverage of Power Platform including PowerBI/Fabric
* Target-state design and standards: Define and maintain the target architecture, roadmap, reference architectures, reusable design patterns, technology standards, implementation guardrails and architecture decision records for collaboration, productivity, automation, knowledge management and AI-assisted work.
* Assessment and recommendation: Lead architecture assessment of current and target states, identify capability gaps, evaluate solution options and provide pragmatic recommendations aligned to enterprise architecture principles, technology risk requirements, business priorities and regulatory expectations.
* Copilot and agent solution architecture: Architect Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Studio agent solutions, including declarative versus custom-engine approaches, orchestration, knowledge-source design, Microsoft Graph grounding, SharePoint and Dataverse knowledge sources, Work IQ/Microsoft IQ alignment, connectors, actions, tools, MCP/API integration, prompt and instruction design, access control, observability, evaluation and lifecycle management.
* Agentic AI adoption patterns: Establish enterprise patterns for agentic AI adoption, including autonomous and semi-autonomous workflows, human-in-the-loop approvals, tool/action permissions, fallback handling, auditability, exception handling, risk classification and production support models.
* Service Owner enablement: Partner with business units, Service Owners and delivery teams to shape use cases, translate business outcomes into technical requirements, assess feasibility and guide implementation teams from ideation and pilot through controlled production rollout and measurable adoption.
* Production readiness and control assurance: Provide architecture oversight for AI-enabled M365 solutions to ensure security, privacy, regulatory, cross-border data, data residency, identity, entitlement, retention, audit, eDiscovery and operational resilience considerations are addressed before production use.
* Responsible AI and Copilot governance: Define and operationalize responsible AI and Copilot governance standards using Microsoft Copilot Control System concepts, including security and governance, management controls, measurement and reporting, readiness, adoption, productivity impact and business-value tracking.
* Agent lifecycle governance: Govern the end-to-end agent lifecycle: intake, ownership, risk tiering, knowledge-source approval, connector approval, prompt/instruction change control, testing, release management, monitoring, periodic recertification, retirement and exception management.
* Security and information protection design: Design and review security controls for Copilot, agents and Power Platform solutions, including least privilege, conditional access, privileged access management, sensitivity labels, DLP, connector policies, SharePoint oversharing remediation, restricted access/content discovery, threat protection and audit logging.
* AI testing and evaluation: Define practical evaluation approaches for Copilot and agent solutions, including test question sets, expected-answer validation, groundedness checks, access-control testing, regression testing, prompt-injection testing, consistency checks, citation-quality review, hallucination management and ongoing production monitoring.
* Reusable assets and guidance: Create solution blueprints, control checklists, design review packs, executive recommendations, adoption playbooks and engineering guidance for M365, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Microsoft 365 agent governance, knowledge management and productivity transformation initiatives.
* Architecture governance forums: Manage and contribute to architecture governance forums by preparing review materials, documenting decisions, tracking risks/actions and guiding projects through EA review, security review, risk acceptance and approval processes.
* Technology roadmap vigilance: Evaluate Microsoft roadmap updates and official announcements covering Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365 agents, Microsoft Graph, SharePoint, Purview, Defender, Power Platform, Teams and agent ecosystem capabilities; translate relevant changes into enterprise adoption recommendations.
* Capability uplift: Drive capability uplift through architecture clinics, knowledge-sharing sessions, reusable templates, practical training, coaching of platform/application teams and guidance for business users, Service Owners and citizen developers.
* Vendor and product evaluation: Support vendor and product evaluations related to M365, Copilot Studio, AI agents, automation, content management, semantic/knowledge layers, connectors, security, monitoring, evaluation, governance tooling and managed services.
* Trusted advisory: Be a trusted adviser to senior management and stakeholders by communicating complex technical, governance and AI risk topics clearly, concisely and in a business-outcome-oriented manner.

**Qualifications And Experience**
Must-have
  
  

* Minimum of 8 years of relevant experience in IT, digital workplace, collaboration platforms, enterprise architecture, cloud architecture, Microsoft 365 engineering/architecture Power Platform, Power BI/Fabric, AI solution architecture or platform governance roles.
* Strong hands-on experience with Power Platform and Power BI/Fbric, architecture experience with Microsoft 365 enterprise services and modern workplace platforms, including the ability to define target-state architecture, integration patterns, governance controls and implementation guardrails.
* Practical experience with enterprise architecture governance, technology standards, solution review, risk/control alignment and stakeholder advisory in a medium-to-large enterprise environment.
* Strong understanding of identity, access management, information protection, data governance, compliance, auditability and operational resilience requirements for SaaS and cloud platforms.
* Ability to advise Service Owners and senior stakeholders by translating business outcomes into feasible, controlled and measurable technology options.
* Excellent written, verbal, facilitation and presentation skills; able to explain complex architecture, AI, governance and risk topics clearly to both technical and executive audiences.

Strongly preferred
  
  

* Practical architecture and delivery experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Copilot Chat, Power Platform, connectors, knowledge grounding, workflow automation and AI-enabled business solution delivery.
* Experience in agentic AI solution design, including agent architecture, orchestration, tool/action integration, prompt/instruction management, testing, evaluation, observability, monitoring and operational controls.
* Experience designing secure and governed Microsoft 365 environments covering Entra ID, Purview, Defender, Intune, SharePoint Online, Teams, Exchange Online, OneDrive, Microsoft Graph, Power Platform and service management integrations.
* Experience in banking, financial services or another highly regulated industry.
* TOGAF, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Security, Power Platform, Power BI/Fabric, Azure, cloud architecture, AI governance or equivalent architecture/governance certification.

Nice to have
  
  

* Experience with DevOps, Agile delivery, CI/CD, solution lifecycle management, infrastructure/configuration as code, environment promotion, automated testing and controlled release practices.
* Advanced experience with AI evaluation, adversarial testing, prompt-injection resilience, telemetry, measurement and production monitoring of AI-enabled applications.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline.

Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG) is an equal opportunity employer. We view our employees as our key assets as they are fundamental to our long-term growth and success. MUFG is committed to hiring based on merit and organsational fit, regardless of race, religion or gender.

title: Senior Software Platform Engineer
description:

**Senior Software Platform Engineer**

title: Terraform Engineer
description:
Relevance Lab is a leading technology solutions and services company specializing in comprehensive IP-led services in Cloud, Automation, Product Engineering, and Data & AI. We offer purpose-built solutions and prebuilt platforms, catering to diverse client needs. Our expertise lies in integrating cutting-edge technology for fueling innovation alongside strategic methodologies and a DevOps approach focused on continuous improvement. This combination enables us to effectively address friction points for our clients, enhancing their capabilities to optimize customer experiences, modernize processes, and boost overall performance.

https://www.relevancelab.com/

The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, and managing our cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles with a primary focus on Terraform. This role requires a deep understanding of cloud platforms, automation, and DevOps methodologies to ensure scalable, reliable, and secure infrastructure.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Company Relevance Lab**

**Post**
Terraform Engineer

**Exp- 6+**

**Location- Bangalore(hybrid)**

**NP Immediate joiners only**

**Salary upto 30 LPA**

**Mandate skill- AWS, Azure, Terraform Coding, Ci/CD, Gen AI exp**

Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable, and secure cloud infrastructure using Terraform across various cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP).

Implement and manage continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines for infrastructure code, ensuring automated testing and deployment.

Collaborate closely with development, operations, and security teams to define infrastructure requirements and integrate solutions seamlessly.

Automate operational tasks and processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.

Ensure infrastructure adheres to security best practices, compliance standards, and organizational policies.

Troubleshoot and resolve complex infrastructure issues, identifying root causes and implementing preventative measures.

description:
**Job Summary:**
As a seasoned Staff Software Development Engineer in Data Platform team you will be at the forefront of designing, building, and optimizing the critical data infrastructure that handles hundreds of millions of requests per minute (RPM) for our ingestion services, processes billions of events daily from Kafka, and manages petabytes of data stored in S3. You will leverage your deep expertise to architect and deliver highly scalable, reliable, and performant data solutions that directly impact our global user base and drive our strategic initiatives.
  
  
**About the team:**
Data platforms team at JioHotStar is building the next generation of AI-powered experiences and autonomous agents, leveraging our vast data to create truly innovative products. Beyond traditional data engineering, you'll be instrumental in developing the data foundations for our AI initiatives, including the development of our own MCP server and the infrastructure supporting our cutting-edge AI Agents.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Core Platform Development**

* Architecture & Design: Build POCs, create architecture designs, and evaluate trade-offs for new services and migrations
* Real-time Data Pipeline: Build and maintain highly scalable, accurate, clean and real-time events collection systems
* Data Foundation for AI & MCP: Specifically design and build data pipelines to support the development and training of AI models and autonomous AI Agents.
* This includes creating robust data infrastructure for our MCP, ensuring data quality and availability for personalized learning paths and skill validation.
* Data Quality Assurance: Continuously work towards detecting, alerting, and fixing quality issues to build trust in our data
* System Enhancement: Improve existing systems and services using latest tooling and engineering standards
* Cost Optimization: Improve unit economics across ingestion, storage, and processing components

**Technical Leadership & Ownership**

* Complete Development Lifecycle: Own the entire development process from ideation to deployment
* Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with different teams to achieve common goals through efficient coordination
* Technical Documentation: Maintain up-to-date documentation with architecture diagrams for entire projects
* Service Ownership: Take complete ownership of services within your workstream and drive continuous improvement
* Operational Excellence: Establish and maintain robust monitoring, alerting, and operational procedures for mission-critical data systems.

**Team Leadership & Growth**

* Knowledge Sharing: Write blogs and articles to help team members and the community
* Architecture Breakdown: Break down high-level architecture into manageable services and tasks
* Technology Trends: Learn and share new trends in technology, engineering, and productivity
* Team Productivity: Actively work towards improving team productivity and knowledge
* Mentorship: Guide and mentor junior team members

**Business Impact**

* Data Governance: Govern data assets across the entire company and audit data posture
* Time to Insight: Reduce time to insight for data team stakeholders
* Business Decision Support: Assist and challenge business decisions using data insights
* Stakeholder Service: Make data available to all stakeholders in an efficient, quick, quarriable, and intuitive manner

**Skills and attributes for success:**

* Experience: 8+ years of progressive professional experience in data engineering, with a proven track record of designing, building, and operating large-scale, high-throughput data platforms, ideally in a consumer-facing or streaming industry.
* Extreme Scale Experience: Demonstrated experience working with data systems that handle hundreds of millions of events/requests per minute, billions of daily events, and petabytes of storage (e.g., S3, HDFS).
* Programming: Strong proficiency in at least one major programming language such as Python, Java, Scala, or Go, with a focus on building robust, production-grade data applications.
* Distributed Data Processing: Deep expertise and practical experience with distributed data processing frameworks like Apache Spark, Apache Flink, or equivalent technologies for batch and streaming workloads.
* AI/ML Data Experience: Specific experience in building data pipelines for Machine Learning model training, inference, and feature stores. Familiarity with data needs for AI Agents or similar intelligent systems.
* Messaging & Streaming: Extensive experience with high-throughput messaging queues and stream processing platforms like Apache Kafka, Kinesis, or equivalent.
* Cloud Platforms: Hands-on expertise with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and their data-related services, with a strong preference for AWS (S3, EMR, Kinesis, Glue, Redshift, etc.).
* Data Warehousing/Lakes: Strong understanding and hands-on experience with modern data warehousing concepts and data lake architectures (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Delta Lake, Iceberg, Hudi).
* ETL/Orchestration: Expertise in building, optimizing, and orchestrating complex ETL/ELT pipelines using tools like Apache Airflow, Prefect, or other workflow management systems.
* Databases: Strong SQL skills and experience with both relational (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL databases (e.g., Cassandra, DynamoDB).
* Data Modeling: Advanced data modeling skills (dimensional, Kimball, data vault) for large, complex datasets.
* Problem-Solving: Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a proven track record of debugging and optimizing complex distributed systems.
* Communication: Excellent communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
* Mentorship: Proven ability to mentor, guide, and technically lead senior and junior engineers.

The ideal candidate will collaborate with cross-functional teams — including Data Scientists, Business Intelligence Engineers, Software Development Engineers, and Product Managers — to deliver impactful data solutions that transform complex financial data into actionable insights.  
  
You'll have the opportunity to pioneer GenAI-powered data solutions that improve analytics efficiency and uncover hidden patterns in fee and transaction data.

The Group’s operations in the Middle East are built on strategic acquisitions and a deep understanding of local market conditions. Egis’ long history of providing comprehensive engineering, consulting, and project management services makes it a trusted partner for regional governments, investors, and developers

 **Job Description**

The CFD Engineer will be responsible for undertaking computational fluid dynamics (CFD) modelling for fire, smoke movement and smoke-control systems as part of Fire & Life Safety and performance-based fire engineering projects.

The role will support projects across the Middle East, particularly UAE and KSA, and will involve development of fire scenarios, CFD models, assessment of tenability conditions, interpretation of results, preparation of technical reports, and coordination with Fire & Life Safety engineers and multidisciplinary design teams.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop CFD models for fire and smoke movement using appropriate modelling software such as FDS / PyroSim, with other CFD platforms such as ANSYS Fluent or OpenFOAM considered advantageous.
* Undertake smoke modelling for:
  + Atriums and large-volume spaces
  + High-rise buildings
  + Basements and car parks
  + Metro/rail stations and transportation facilities
  + Malls and assembly buildings
  + Data centres and complex developments
* Assess the performance and effectiveness of mechanical and natural smoke-management systems.
* Develop appropriate fire scenarios, including fire location, design fire size, fire growth rate, heat release rate, smoke production and simulation duration.
* Evaluate tenability criteria, including visibility, temperature, radiant heat and toxic gases/CO concentrations.
* Undertake sensitivity studies and compare alternative smoke-control/design solutions.
* Support performance-based fire engineering assessments and alternative solutions where prescriptive compliance is impractical.
* Coordinate CFD assumptions and boundary conditions with architectural, mechanical, smoke-control and FLS design information.
* Review smoke-control calculations, extract rates, make-up air provisions and system operating philosophies prior to modelling.
* Interpret CFD outputs and translate modelling results into clear engineering conclusions and recommendations.
* Prepare professional CFD methodology reports, modelling reports and technical presentations suitable for client and authority submissions.
* Support integration of CFD results with evacuation modelling / ASET-RSET assessments, where required.
* Participate in technical meetings with clients, architects, MEP consultants and approving authorities.
* Address technical review comments and revise models/reports where necessary.

  
**Qualifications**

Bachelor's degree in Fire Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Building Services Engineering, or a related discipline.

Strong academic understanding of fluid dynamics, heat transfer, combustion, fire dynamics and smoke movement.

title: Pre-Silicon Validation and Design Emulation Engineer - Cadence Pallidum experience
description:
**Job Role:** We are seeking an experienced Pre-Silicon Validation & Emulation Engineer with deep expertise in **Cadence Palladium** platforms to accelerate our SoC verification and hardware/software co-validation. In this role, you will bridge the gap between RTL design, pre-silicon simulation, and early software bring-up by mapping complex IP and full-chip SoC designs onto hardware-accelerated emulation environments, ensuring first-pass silicon success.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Palladium Model Build & Bring-Up:** Own the end-to-end compilation, synthesis, partitioning, and mapping of complex RTL databases onto Cadence Palladium emulation systems. Resolve compilation, timing, clock-domain, and memory-modeling issues.
* **Pre-Silicon System Validation:** Architect and execute system-level and IP-level validation plans on emulation platforms, exercising CPU subsystems, interconnects, power management states, and high-speed interfaces.

* **Hardware/Software Co-Verification:** Enable early firmware, bootloader, and OS (Linux/RTOS) bring-up on Palladium by configuring virtual debuggers (JTAG/SWD), memory spaces, and transactors.

* **Simulation-to-Emulation Debug:** Diagnose, triage, and root-cause complex functional and performance failures across simulation and emulation environments using waveform analysis, signal probing, and assertion-based debug.

* **Testbench & Transactor Development:** Develop and integrate verification infrastructure, bus functional models (BFMs), speed bridges, and test cases using SystemVerilog, UVM, and C/C++.

* **Flow Automation:** Build and maintain automated regression and build scripts (Python, Tcl, Perl, Shell) to streamline Palladium compile turnaround times and manage large-scale regression suites.

* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner closely with RTL design, Design Verification (DV), firmware, and post-silicon validation teams to close verification gaps and prepare validation content for silicon bring-up.

**Required Qualifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
* **Experience:** 5 to 10+ years of hands-on industry experience in pre-silicon verification, hardware emulation, and SoC validation.

**Technical Expertise:**

* Deep, hands-on experience with **Cadence Palladium** enterprise emulation platforms (e.g., Z1/Z2), including full compile flows, ICE (In-Circuit Emulation), and TBA (Transaction-Based Acceleration).
* Strong proficiency in **Verilog, SystemVerilog, UVM, and C/C++**.
* Proven RTL debugging and waveform analysis skills (e.g., Cadence SimVision, Verdi).
* Solid understanding of SoC architecture, ARM/RISC-V processor subsystems, and standard bus protocols (AMBA AXI, AHB, APB).
* Strong scripting skills in **Python, Tcl, or Shell** for flow automation and log parsing.

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills**

* Experience with FPGA prototyping platforms (e.g., Cadence Protium, Xilinx/AMD Virtex) or other emulators (Synopsys ZeBu, Siemens Veloce).
* Familiarity with high-speed protocols such as PCIe, CXL, DDR/LPDDR, USB, or Ethernet.
* Experience with low-power verification flows (UPF/CPF) in emulation environments.
* Knowledge of formal verification, assertion-based testing (SVA), and functional coverage closure

description:

Boeing is the world's largest aerospace company and leading manufacturer of commercial airplanes and defense, space and security systems. We are engineers and technicians. At Boeing, we believe creativity and innovation thrives when every employee is trusted, empowered, and has the flexibility to choose, grow, learn, and explore. We offer variable arrangements depending upon business and customer needs, and professional pursuits that offer greater flexibility in the way our people work. We also believe that collaboration, frequent team engagements, and face-to-face meetings bring together different perspectives and thoughts – enabling every voice to be heard and every perspective to be respected. No matter where or how our teammates work, we are committed to positively shaping people’s careers and being thoughtful about employee wellbeing.

With us, you can create and contribute to what matters most in your career, community, country, and world. Join us in powering the progress of global aerospace.

**Digital Services Overview**

At Boeing Digital Services, we focus on practical innovation that drives tangible results for the aerospace industry. Our team leverages advanced technology and data analytics to develop solutions that enhance operational efficiency and meet the needs of our customers. We are dedicated to creating intuitive, scalable, and secure solutions that empower our customers, partners, and team members to succeed. Join us in creating the future of aviation technology, where your contributions will shape impactful solutions for airlines around the globe.

**Position Overview**

We have an immediate opening for a **Software Application Development Manager** to lead multiple teams developing digital solutions in Application Engineering. This role requires deep engineering experience, the ability to guide teams, and the use of the latest AI tools to build cloud-native systems for cutting-edge digital aircraft maintenance products.

The role will work closely with peer managers, developers, engineering and greenfield leadership, data science, and architects to deliver product features and capabilities with AI/ML at the center. In this role, you will serve as a hands-on manager for development teams and ensure the delivery of reliable production software

This position will report to the Engineering leader of the **Boeing Global Services (BGS) Digital Services** group and work closely with stakeholders across the globe.

**Process Skills and Techniques**

* **Project Management:** Proficiency in managing projects and customer milestones, including planning, resource allocation, risk management, and ensuring timely delivery of products and capabilities.

* **Quality Assurance:** Knowledge of quality assurance processes and methodologies to ensure the delivery of high-quality, bug-free digital products.

* **Problem-Solving Abilities:** Adept at identifying and resolving technical challenges and issues that may arise during the development process.

**Leadership Skills and Responsibilities**

* **Leadership and influence:** The ability to lead and motivate a team of developers, designers, and other technical professionals to achieve project goals and meet deadlines.

* **Team Management:** The ability to foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment, encouraging open communication, knowledge sharing, and teamwork among team members.

* **Stakeholder management:** Proficiency in managing relationships with stakeholders, such as clients, product owners, and other departments, to ensure alignment of goals and effective collaboration throughout the development process.

* **Innovation and Creativity:** The capacity to think creatively and propose innovative solutions to enhance digital products and meet user needs.

* **Communication skills:** Excellent communication skills to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams, stakeholders, and clients, and to translate technical concepts into non-technical terms.

* **Conflict Resolution:** The skill to identify and address conflicts or disagreements within the team or between stakeholders, finding mutually beneficial solutions and maintaining positive working relationships.

* **Remote Collaboration:** The ability to effectively collaborate with remote team members or distributed teams using various collaboration tools and communication platforms.

* **Cultural Sensitivity:** Awareness and respect for cultural differences when collaborating with diverse teams or stakeholders from different backgrounds and locations.

* Demonstrated Software Engineering experience with involvement in all phases of the software development life cycle using various software development platforms

* Experience in Aircraft Health Management, Predictive Maintenance areas, Flight Management Systems and Aircraft performance computation/optimization

* Experience in Machine learning and data analytics

* Experience in leading teams of production applications grade from scratch and modernized legacy systems — comfortable with both greenfield and brownfield and know when approaches like strangler fig or lift-and-refactor are appropriate.

Uber’s Customer Obsession team builds the platforms and AI that power customer support across mobile, web, and voice at global scale. This role offers the opportunity to architect, bring into production, and scale an autonomous support agent that resolves customer issues end to end.  
  
The engineering challenge spans LLM orchestration, agentic planning, retrieval and reasoning, multilingual support, and real-time voice. Success means delivering grounded, policy-aligned conversations while meeting demanding standards for reliability, safety, latency, and cost efficiency.

* **Advance conversational and voice AI:** Guide low-latency voice experiences spanning streaming speech recognition and synthesis, natural turn-taking, interruption handling, and telephony or WebRTC integration.
* **Set the quality bar:** Establish offline evaluations, simulated scenarios, safety tests, and human-calibrated LLM-as-judge evaluations integrated into development and release workflows.
* **Own production excellence:** Design service-level objectives, fallbacks, human handoff, canary releases, and safeguards against prompt injection, jailbreaks, hallucinations, and exposure of personal information.

What We’re Looking For  
  
Minimum qualifications  

* 10+ years building production ML or AI systems, including 4+ years leading complex ML initiatives end to end.
* Deep expertise in LLM-driven systems, including inference optimization, prompt and program design, model adaptation, safety controls, and evaluation.
* Strong software engineering skills in Python and at least one of Go, Java, or C++, with hands-on experience in distributed services and production infrastructure.
* Demonstrated ownership of highly available services, including service-level objectives, incident response, on-call leadership, and post-incident improvements.
* A track record of shipping customer-facing intelligent experiences with measurable impact through A/B testing and rigorous metrics.

Preferred qualifications  

* Experience building production agentic architectures using planning, execution, memory, and multi-step reasoning.

* Experience with hallucination mitigation, safety red-teaming, privacy-conscious system design, and controlled production rollouts.

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

You are an early-career engineer ready to make your mark in semiconductor design. You have spent your academic years drawn to digital design that requires proof, not just simulation. When you see a spec, you think about corner cases and what could break. You have written Verilog or SystemVerilog, debugged logic that did not behave as expected, and you are comfortable in a Unix terminal. Formal verification might be new to you, but the rigor makes sense. You learn by doing, ask questions when stuck, and you do not mind being the person who finds the bug everyone else missed.

  
  

**What You'll Be Doing**

Learn the latest formal verification methodology from experts and

* your learnings to live projects.
* Work with a team of seasoned FV engineers and execute validation as per defined plans.
* Support quality improvements and contribute insights that help enhance verification tool capabilities.
* Write and refine assertions in SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA) to capture design intent and uncover edge-case failures.
* Script verification flows using Python, Perl, or Tcl to automate repetitive tasks and improve team productivity in Unix/Linux environments.
  

  

**The Impact You Will Have**

* Help catch critical design bugs before tapeout that would otherwise cost months and millions to fix in silicon.
* Contribute to the quality and reliability of Synopsys IP and EDA tools that power semiconductor development across the industry.
Accelerate verification closure on complex designs by* ing formal methods that simulation alone cannot cover.
* Strengthen the formal verification methodology at Synopsys by bringing fresh perspectives and identifying gaps in existing flows.
  

  

**What You'll Need**

* **Build Quality Gates into CI/CD**

  + Implement automated regression testing and validation as part of continuous integration and deployment workflows.

* **Drive Platform Reliability and Operational Excellence**
  + Define and implement Service Level Objectives (SLOs), Service Level Indicators (SLIs), and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for critical pipelines and platform connectors.

  + Drive effective incident management, root cause analysis, and preventive actions to minimize recurring issues.

  + Establish and champion quality engineering standards, development guidelines, and automation procedures across the engineering team.
  + Collaborate with engineering leadership to integrate quality and reliability practices into architecture, design, development, and release processes.

  + Evaluate and introduce agentic workflows that can improve test coverage, accelerate incident triage, and reduce manual engineering effort.

  
**Qualifications**  
**What You'll Bring with You**
  

* 8-10 years of overall software engineering experience, with substantial experience in Quality Engineering, Test Automation, Data Quality, or Platform Reliability.
* Proven experience designing, architecting, and implementing scalable test automation frameworks, covering unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end testing.

* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to engage partners, understand business requirements, and translate them into effective technical solutions.

**Technical Skills**  
  
**Must-have**

* Strong SQL skills for large-scale data validation, reconciliation, and data-quality analysis.
* Hands-on experience with Apache Spark and distributed data processing environments.
