title: Senior Product Manager I
description:
**About Us:**
Seismic is the Go-To-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.
  
  
Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.
  
  
**Overview:**
Learning is where that mission gets personal. Our vision is Connected Learning: training, practice, and coaching that are always-on and tailored to each rep, grounded in what's actually happening in their deals. Because learning shares context with a rep's accounts, meetings, approved content, and skills, we can deliver what they need next, in the moment they need it, and show whether it moved the number.
  
  
As a Senior Product Manager, you'll lead key parts of two of our strategic themes: Adaptive Training, which removes the manual work for enablement teams and gives every rep only what they still need, and Continuous Learning, which brings learning into the flow of work so it sticks. You'll partner closely with others PMs on the team.
  
  
At Seismic, PMs operate as the general managers of their areas. You won't be handed a backlog of feature requests. You'll decide where the most valuable, durable opportunities are, place the bets, and own the results: adoption, expansion, retention, and revenue. This is a role for a PM who wants to run a business, not maintain a feature list.
  
  
**Who you are:**

* 5+ years of product management experience building user-facing products (B2B or B2C). You're fluent in discovery, specs, prioritization, and launch, and you don't need training on the fundamentals.
* An AI-forward way of working. You use AI every day to work faster and better, whether that's synthesizing research, prototyping, drafting specs, or analyzing data, and you can share specific recent examples.
* A business owner's mindset. You think in terms of outcomes, unit economics, and durable value, define clear success metrics, read the data, and change course when the evidence says so.
* Technical fluency. You can have credible conversations with engineers about LLMs, agent harness, data, and design tradeoffs.
* A strong point of view, held with humility. You can turn ambiguity into a clear plan and bring engineering, design, marketing, sales, and customer success along with you.
* Comfort working with distributed teams across time zones, including occasional early or late meetings.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

**Bonus points**

* You've shipped AI products, such as agents, copilots, or AI-powered features, and know what it takes to make them reliable.
* You've built learning products, in corporate learning, sales enablement and readiness, edtech, or consumer learning.
* You're curious about how people learn: spaced reinforcement, mastery learning, coaching, and practice.
* A category being rewritten. AI is changing how sellers learn and how enablement teams work, and you'll help define what comes next.
* Ownership that's real. You'll run a meaningful area of the business, with the accountability and the room to match.
* Real scale from day one. Your work will reach enablement teams and sellers at some of the world's best-known brands.
* A team that builds with AI, not just for it. We use agentic tools in our own work and expect you to as well.

**What you’ll be doing:**

* Run your areas like a business. Set the strategy and roadmap, choose the bets that create the most durable value, help shape how they're packaged and priced, and own the adoption, retention, and revenue outcomes that follow.
* Create best-in-class agentic training authoring and training management, so enablement teams turn the content they already trust into training in minutes and agents handle the busywork of assigning, tracking, and following up, whether teams work in Seismic or in the AI tools they already use.
* Make training adapt to every rep, so reps skip what they've already mastered and spend their time on what they still need.
* Bring learning into the flow of work with just-in-time micro-learning, instant answers grounded in training, and peer examples from top performers' real calls.
* Connect learning to performance. Use deal, meeting, and skill signals to decide what each rep needs next, and define how we prove impact beyond course completions.
* Stay close to customers. Talk with enablement leaders, sellers, and managers every week, run discovery with design and research, and bring a sharp point of view back to the team.
* Ship with engineering in fast, measurable increments, including the evals and quality bar that make AI features trustworthy.

**What we have for you:**
At Seismic, we’re committed to providing benefits and perks for the whole self. To explore our benefits available in each country, please visit the Global Benefits page.
  
  
If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation as part of the application or recruiting process, please click here.
  
  
Seismic is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, age, race, religion, or any other classification which is protected by applicable law.
  
  
Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.
  
  
Please be aware we have noticed an increase in hiring scams potentially targeting Seismic candidates. Read our full statement on our Careers page.

title: Senior Product Manager – Skolasti
description:
Senior Product Manager – Skolasti

Location: Hyderabad (on-site / hybrid)

Experience: 7+ years in product, at least 4 owning a B2B SaaS product end-to-end

Reports to: CEO

Type: Full-time

**About Skolasti**

Skolasti is a multi-tenant SaaS platform for running an online academy. Each customer gets their own branded academy, with its own domain, coaches, courses, learners, payments and certificates, all on shared infrastructure that we operate.

The academy is the core unit, and it scales with the customer. A solo coach can launch one in an afternoon. A training business can run it with a team of coaches. An institution can run several programs, cohorts and roles inside it. The product is built for that whole range, and growing customers along it is a big part of this job.

We host live and recorded courses with DRM-protected delivery, assessments, certification, learner engagement, analytics and AI-assisted learning. We have the platform. Now we need someone to turn it into a growing SaaS business.

**The role**

You will own Skolasti as a business, not just its roadmap. You'll be accountable for how many academies sign up, how many become paying, how fast they get value, how long they stay, and how much they grow.

This is a hands-on, senior role. You'll work directly with the CEO, CTO and a small engineering team, with no layers of product management in between. You decide what we build and why, and you prove it worked with numbers.

**The metrics you will own:**

* Acquisition to activation: signup-to-live-academy rate, time to first course published, time to first paid enrolment
* Conversion: Trial-to-paid, plan mix, self-serve vs sales-assisted
* Retention: logo churn, revenue churn, net revenue retention (NRR)
* Expansion: upgrades, add-ons, seat and coach growth, usage-based revenue
* Tenant health: feature adoption, learner activity per academy, early churn signals

**What you'll own**

**Strategy and segments**

* Define who we win with along the academy range: solo creators, multi-coach academies, institutions. Shape the product and pricing so customers can move upthat range without leaving us.
* Know the competition well, including Teachable, Thinkific, Kajabi, Graphy and institutional LMS players, and decide where we differentiate and where we don't.

**Pricing and packaging**

* Own plans, tiers, feature gating, usage limits, add-ons and trials.
* Run pricing experiments and measure their effect on conversion, ARPA and churn.
* Work with engineering on billing and subscription flows (Chargebee) and plan entitlements.

**Self-serve funnel and onboarding**

* Own the path from signup to a live academy, then to first course published, then to first learner paying.
* Remove friction until a new academy owner gets value without talking to us.

**Retention and expansion**

* Build tenant health scoring and act on early churn signals.
* Design the path from solo academy to multi-coach academy to institution: roles, permissions, seats, white-labeling, custom domains, SSO.

**Platform and ecosystem**

* Prioritise admin, APIs, webhooks and integrations (video, payments, CRM, marketing tools) that make Skolasti the system of record for an academy.

**AI features**

* Define AI-assisted learning and creator tools with clear value to the customer.
* Own their unit economics: what each AI feature costs per tenant, what we meter, and which plans include it.

**Discovery, data and delivery**

* Talk to academy owners, coaches and learners every week, not just when collecting requirements.
* Instrument the product, own the dashboards, and make decisions from funnel and cohort data.
* Write crisp problem statements and PRDs, prioritise ruthlessly against business impact, and ship with engineering in short cycles.
* Partner with marketing, sales and customer success on positioning, launches and feedback loops.

**What success looks like**

**First 90 days**

1. Interview at least 20 academy owners across segments, including some who churned.
2. Stand up a metrics baseline: funnel, activation, conversion, churn and NRR, with dashboards the whole team uses.
3. Present a point of view on our primary segment, pricing and the top three product bets, backed by data.
4. Ship at least one measurable improvement to signup-to-live-academy activation.

**First year**

* A repackaged pricing model in market, with its impact on conversion and ARPA measured.
* Activation and trial-to-paid materially up from baseline.
* A clear upgrade path from solo academy to multi-coach academy to institution, with expansion revenue tracked.
* A product rhythm of discovery, prioritisation and delivery that runs without the CEO in every decision.

**Must-haves**

* 4+ years owning a B2B SaaS product end-to-end, with revenue, conversion or retention outcomes you can quote.
* Has shipped pricing, packaging or monetisation changes and measured the result.
* Fluent in SaaS metrics, including MRR/ARR, churn, NRR, CAC/LTV, activation and cohort analysis. Comfortable pulling your own data (SQL or a product analytics tool such as Mix panel / OpenPanel, Amplitude or PostHog).
* Has driven a self-serve or product-led funnel, or a clear path from self-serve to sales-assisted.
* Understands multi-tenant platforms: tenant admin, roles and permissions, configuration vs customisation, and the cost of one-off customer requests.
* Technical enough to have real trade-off conversations with engineers about architecture, scale and cost.
* Has worked as the only PM, or one of very few, in a small team, and is comfortable doing their own discovery, analysis, writing and launch work.

**Nice-to-haves**

* Experience in EdTech, LMS, creator platforms or online course businesses. We valuestrong SaaS fundamentals over domain knowledge.
* Experience with subscription billing platforms (Chargebee, Stripe Billing, Recurly)and payment gateways, including India-specific payments.
* Has shipped AI/LLM-powered features and thought about their cost and margin.
* Has sold to both small businesses and institutions, and understands how their buying differs.
* Has taken a product into international markets.

**This role is not for you if…**

* You see product management mainly as writing requirements and managing a backlog.
* You need a large PM team, dedicated analysts or a research team to be effective.
* You've only worked on internal tools, services projects or custom client builds.

**Why join**

* **Real ownership:**
  You'll set the direction of a live, multi-tenant product and see thebusiness results of your decisions directly.
* **A strong platform to build on:**
  Multi-tenancy, branded academies, DRM delivery, live learning and AI are already in place. Your job is to turn that into growth.
* **Close to the decisions:**
  You'll work directly with the CEO, CTO and engineering. No committees.
* **A large, open market:**
  From solo creators to institutions, the academy model serves a wide range, and there's room to build a clear leader.

The role requires strong product ownership discipline, practical SAP IBP and SAP S/4HANA planning knowledge, and the ability to translate complex Demand to Supply needs into prioritized features, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, release plans, and measurable business outcomes.

SAP Configuration & Delivery

* Configure and support SAP IBP capabilities across Demand Planning, Response & Supply, Inventory Planning, Sales and Operations Planning, and Control Tower.
* Design and support Demand to Supply processes including forecasting, demand sensing concepts, supply planning, inventory projections, days-on-hand targets, constrained planning, deployment planning, and purchase order recommendation logic.
* Support planning-area design, key figure configuration, master data attributes, planning views, copy operators, planning algorithms, scenario simulation, and planner workspaces.
* Configure and enhance IBP Control Tower capabilities, including custom alerts, intelligent visibility, exception monitoring, case management, analytics, and workflows that support daily planning operations and management by exception.
* Own functional design, configuration documentation, WRICEF requirements, test leadership, cutover planning, and release governance for IBP and SAP S/4HANA planning solutions.
* Ensure global template adherence, standardized planning controls, and scalable solution design across products, plants, locations, resources, suppliers, and customers.

**Technical Delivery & Solution Governance**

* Lead technical delivery planning for SAP IBP capabilities, ensuring solution designs are aligned with platform standards, global templates, architectural direction, and scalable planning processes.
* Validate technical feasibility of proposed solutions, challenge assumptions when needed, and ensure product decisions account for data, integration, security, performance, supportability, and release impacts.
* Guide feature decomposition for planning-area design, master data, key figures, planning views, algorithms, workflows, analytics, alerts, and planner experience improvements.
* Coordinate solution governance for Control Tower, Order-Based Planning, Real-Time Integration, and SAP S/4HANA planning dependencies to maintain consistency across end-to-end Demand to Supply processes.
* Support architecture reviews, design decisions, dependency management, release readiness, testing strategy, cutover planning, hypercare, and operational transition for IBP product increments.
* Ensure documentation, process controls, product artifacts, feature intent, acceptance criteria, support procedures, and knowledge-transfer materials remain current and usable.

**Stakeholder Engagement & Agile Leadership**

* Serve as the primary product owner voice for SAP IBP delivery teams, ensuring the team understands product intent, business value, technical constraints, and acceptance expectations.
* Facilitate backlog refinement, sprint planning, story elaboration, demos, user acceptance planning, dependency reviews, and release readiness discussions.
* Engage demand planners, supply planners, inventory planners, business process owners, executives, architects, data owners, integration teams, QA, security, and operations stakeholders to gather feedback and drive alignment.
* Communicate roadmap progress, risks, trade-offs, release scope, business impacts, and adoption needs in a clear and executive-ready manner.
* Partner with Scrum Masters and delivery leaders to remove blockers, manage dependencies, maintain delivery momentum, and ensure agile practices support predictable value delivery.
* Champion planner adoption by supporting training, change impacts, communications, process readiness, and post-release feedback loops.

**SAP IBP Discipline Expertise**

* Provide product ownership leadership across SAP IBP Demand Planning, Response & Supply, Inventory Planning, Sales and Operations Planning, Control Tower, Order-Based Planning, and related SAP S/4HANA planning capabilities.
* Understand planning-area concepts, key figures, master data, planning levels, planning operators, versions, scenarios, alerts, analytics, exception management, and planner workspaces sufficiently to guide technical delivery decisions.
* Support product decisions related to forecasting, demand sensing concepts, constrained supply planning, deployment planning, inventory optimization, days-on-hand visibility, purchase order recommendations, and exception-driven planning.
* Maintain awareness of SAP IBP roadmap items, quarterly releases, emerging capabilities, and leading practices that may improve planning agility, automation, collaboration, and supply chain responsiveness.

**Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement**

* Use production-support trends, planner feedback, defect patterns, adoption data, and business outcomes to shape future backlog priorities.
* Identify and prioritize improvements that reduce manual planning effort, increase forecast and supply-plan accuracy, strengthen inventory visibility, accelerate exception resolution, and improve planner productivity.
* Partner with support, data, integration, and application teams to address root causes, stabilize solutions, reduce technical debt, improve monitoring, and strengthen resilience.
* Measure releases against agreed success criteria and incorporate lessons learned into subsequent roadmap and delivery decisions.
* Promote disciplined product management, process standardization, agile delivery practices, and transparent decision-making across the IBP discipline.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 11 or more years of experience in SAP, supply chain planning, product ownership, business analysis, solution delivery, or a related enterprise technology discipline.
* 5 or more years of hands-on experience with SAP IBP, SAP APO, SAP S/4HANA supply chain planning, or a comparable integrated planning platform.
* Demonstrated experience managing product roadmaps and backlogs, including epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, prioritization, sprint planning, and release-scope decisions.
* Strong understanding of Demand-to-Supply processes, including demand, response, supply, inventory, sales and operations, and procurement planning, as well as planning master data and SAP S/4HANA integration points.

description:
Job title: Messaging Product Expert
  
  
Location: Hyderabad
  
  
Opella is the self-care challenger with the purest and third-largest portfolio in the Over-The-Counter (OTC) & Vitamins, Minerals & Supplements (VMS) market globally.
  
  
Our mission is to bring health in people’s hands by making self-care as simple as it should be. For half a billion consumers worldwide – and counting.
  
  
At the core of this mission is our 100 loved brands, our 11,000-strong global team, our 13 best-in-class manufacturing sites and 4 specialized science and innovation development centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world’s most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan.
  
  
B Corp certified in multiple markets, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet. Find out more about our mission at www.opella.com.
  
  
About the job:
  
  
Our team
  
  
Our team is engaged in designing, delivering and supporting Digital Tech Services for all CHC worldwide.
  
  
We deliver our solutions in a highly competitive market answering FMCH needs and sometimes supporting regulated environments (GxP, SoX and other regional or local regulations).
  
  
Our team operates in an international context, serving all markets in most of the countries around the world.
  
  
Digital Technology & Architecture organization encompasses following capabilities: Integration, Enterprise Architecture, Cloud engineering, Platform Engineering (e.g. DevOps & related framework), Platforms (ServiceNow, Observability, Chatbots, SAP, Commercial, RPA, …), Digital Workplace and more “classical” infrastructures (hosting, servers, …).
  
  
Digital Workplace & Facilities team manages all Digital Workplace capabilities (all devices, collaboration, communication, printing, software management & deployment, …) and makes the bridge between global standards designed by global infrastructure & workplace teams and their implementation on our 60+ sites (incl. 12 plants) across the globe.
  
  
Are you passionate about shaping a seamless Digital Workplace experience and influencing how people collaborate every day? Join us to own and evolve our global Messaging platform within the Digital Workplace & Facilities team.
  
  
This is a high-impact opportunity for a Messaging Product Owner with advanced Exchange Online expertise to shape the future of our enterprise messaging service. You will combine product ownership with senior technical depth to drive service evolution, lead continuous improvement, support critical escalations and help teams across the organization deliver a reliable, modern messaging experience at global scale.
  
  
Own the Exchange Online product vision, roadmap and priorities, balancing business needs, user experience and technical excellence
  
  
Provide advanced Exchange Online administration expertise across mailboxes, shared mailboxes, distribution lists, delegated access, mail flow and complex troubleshooting
  
  
Act as a senior escalation point for complex messaging issues, while coaching and enabling L1 and L2 support teams through guidance, documentation and knowledge sharing
  
  
Own and improve mail flow, including connectors, transport rules, accepted domains and routing dependencies, while supporting Cybersecurity on related implementations
  
  
Partner with Cybersecurity, Identity and Compliance teams on governance, retention, archiving and eDiscovery-related requirements
  
  
Drive automation, standardization and continuous improvement through Exchange Online PowerShell, service metrics and stakeholder feedback
  
  
Lead messaging transformation and migration initiatives with visible business impact, ensuring service continuity, stakeholder alignment and user adoption
  
  
Define and improve the messaging operating model, including service levels, support processes, documentation and continuous improvement practices
  
  
**About You**
Technical background required
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline
  
  
6+ years of experience in enterprise messaging, workplace engineering or service ownership roles, including significant hands-on Exchange Online experience
  
  
Advanced Exchange Online administration expertise, including mailbox lifecycle management, shared mailboxes, distribution groups, connectors, mail routing, transport rules, delegated administration and troubleshooting
  
  
Experience with Exchange Online PowerShell, automation, reporting and operational improvement
  
  
Working knowledge of messaging security, hygiene and compliance topics, with the ability to support Cybersecurity and Compliance teams during implementation
  
  
Experience supporting large global environments, including incident and problem management, change control and vendor coordination
  
  
Experience creating support documentation, runbooks and knowledge articles, and enabling L1/L2 support teams
  
  
Experience in messaging migration or transformation programs and good understanding of the broader Microsoft 365 ecosystem
  
  
Microsoft 365 or Exchange Online certifications are a plus
  
  
**Soft Skills Required**
A strong product ownership mindset, with the ability to prioritize effectively, make sound decisions and deliver measurable outcomes
  
  
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences
  
  
Ability to coach support teams, explain complex topics clearly and work effectively in global virtual teams
  
  
A proactive, analytical and solutions-oriented mindset, with a passion for continuous improvement
  
  
Comfort working in a complex, international environment, with a structured approach and strong sense of ownership.
  
  
Why us?
  
  
At Opella, you will enjoy doing challenging, purposeful work, empowered to develop consumer brands with passion and creativity. This is your chance to grow new skills and be part of a bold, collaborative, and inclusive culture where people can thrive and be at their best every day.
  
  
We Are Challengers.
  
  
We are dedicated to making self-care as simple as it should be. That starts with our culture. We are challengers by nature, and this is how we do things:
  
  
All In Together: We keep each other honest and have each other's backs.
  
  
Courageous: We break boundaries and take thoughtful risks with creativity.
  
  
Outcome-Obsessed: We are personally accountable, driving sustainable impact and results with integrity.
  
  
Radically Simple: We strive to make things simple for us and simple for consumers, as it should be.
  
  
Join us on our mission. Health. In your hands.

title: IT Head
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a seasoned, strategic **Head of IT** to lead the technology architecture, digital transformation, and operational resilience across our diverse business verticals: **Media Production Studios, Commercial Malls, and Multiplex/Theater Operations**.

The ideal candidate possesses a unique blend of enterprise IT infrastructure management, high-performance media/post-production workflow expertise, and smart-building/retail IT operations (POS, building management integration, high-density public Wi-Fi, and digital cinema/exhibition technologies). You will drive operational excellence, enforce robust cybersecurity frameworks, and align technology investments with organizational growth.

Key Responsibilities**1. Enterprise & Smart Infrastructure Management (Malls & Corporate)**

· Oversee the end-to-end enterprise IT infrastructure, including data centers, server farms, enterprise storage, virtualization (VMware/Hyper-V), and hybrid cloud environments (AWS/Azure).

· Manage mission-critical IT systems for commercial mall operations, ensuring high availability of Building Management Systems (BMS), Public Address (PA) systems, CCTV/surveillance networks, and automated access controls.

· Architect and maintain high-density public Wi-Fi networks, structured cabling, and robust switching/routing backbones (L2/L3) across retail and office spaces.

· Oversee disaster recovery (DR) planning, business continuity drills, and power redundancy systems (UPS/Generators) for 24/7 retail and entertainment environments.

**2. Multiplex, Cinema & Digital Exhibition Technology**

· Oversee IT and networking infrastructure supporting digital cinema projection systems, server ingestion, and Theatre Management Systems (TMS).

· Manage automated scheduling, digital signage, box office ticketing kiosks, and secure content delivery (KDM/DCP management) in coordination with content distributors.

· Ensure ultra-low latency and absolute uptime for live-streaming, event screenings, and concessionaire point-of-sale (POS) networks.

**3. Post-Production & Media Studio Technology**

· Support high-performance media workflows including non-linear editing (Avid, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve), VFX, animation, sound design, and heavy rendering farms.

· Administer high-speed SAN/NAS environments optimized for uncompressed 4K/8K real-time collaboration.

· Manage Media Asset Management (MAM) systems, secure ingest/transcoding pipelines, and long-term digital archiving/retrieval processes.

**4. Retail & Point-of-Sale (POS) Operations**

· Ensure 99.99% uptime for mission-critical retail POS terminals, payment gateway integrations, inventory management databases, and merchant Wi-Fi networks within mall premises.

· Coordinate with tenant IT teams and retail partners to ensure seamless network integration and compliance with centre guidelines.

**5. Cybersecurity, Compliance & Data Privacy**

· Establish enterprise-wide cybersecurity policies, endpoint protection, Next-Gen Firewalls (NGFW), and SIEM tools.

· Protect high-value intellectual property (IP), unreleased media assets, and confidential tenant/customer data in compliance with data privacy regulations (e.g., DPDP Act, PCI-DSS for retail transactions).

· Conduct regular vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, and IT security audits.

**6. Vendor, Project & Budget Management**

· Lead strategic technology implementation projects, digital upgrades, and capital expenditure (CapEx/OpEx) planning.

· Manage relationships with global technology vendors, telecom operators, OEM partners, and service providers.

· Negotiate Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs), software licensing, and hardware procurement to optimize costs without compromising quality.

**7. Leadership & Cross-Functional Team Management**

· Lead, mentor, and upskill a multi-disciplinary team of IT engineers, system administrators, and helpdesk support staff.

· Define and monitor strict Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for incident resolution and system performance.

· Act as a technology advisor to executive leadership, bridging the gap between creative teams, retail management, and technical execution.

**Core Enterprise & Network Infrastructure**

· Advanced administration of Windows Server, Linux, and macOS enterprise environments.

· Enterprise networking: Cisco/Aruba L2/L3 switching, VLAN segmentation, SD-WAN, enterprise firewalls, and QoS configuration.

· Virtualization & Cloud: VMware ESXi, Hyper-V, AWS, Azure, and hybrid cloud integration.

· Active Directory, LDAP, SSO, and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) frameworks.

· Advanced backup frameworks (Veeam, Commvault) and Disaster Recovery architecture.

**Domain-Specific Expertise**

· **Retail & Mall Tech:** POS infrastructure, payment gateway security (PCI-DSS), digital signage networks, and smart building integration (BMS/CCTV).

· **Theater/Exhibition Tech:** Theatre Management Systems (TMS), digital projection networks, and ticketing system integration.

· Media / Post-Production: High-speed SAN/NAS (Avid ISIS/Nexus, Isilon, QNAP), render management (Deadline, OpenCue), and MAM workflows.

**Educational Qualifications & Credentials**

description:
**Company Description**

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description**

We are seeking a highly skilled Mechanical Engineer to handle Cleanroom **HVAC and Process Mechanical packages** for **Semiconductor facilities**. The ideal candidate will have design, engineering and qualification experience for semiconductor projects. This role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams, ensuring compliance with industry standards, and driving innovative solutions for process efficiency and cost optimization.

**Responsibilities:**

**Process Design & Optimization:**

**Cleanroom HVAC Package: Lead the team to perform the activities below:**

* Perform Design and selection of HVAC system for Cleanroom, production areas, semiconductor FAB areas and dry rooms.
* Make up air unit selections using Cooling/Heating/Humidification & De-humidification load calculations, Cleanroom sensible cooling with Dry cooling coils, LT/MT Chiller selections, Hot water requirement, Humidifier selections, humidity/ Dew Point control philosophies and control system design with all equipment and systems
* Plan and support other teams in Chilled water generation Plant Design and selection of cooling tower, Pumps, Primary/secondary circuits etc.
* CFD analysis review and optimization to achieve uniform cleanroom conditions.
* Energy saving options selection to optimize the running cost.
* Conceptual design, planning and project engineering of cleanrooms and dry rooms.
* Prepare designs, coordination, planning and execution of engineering projects.
* Preparation of Technical Proposals and Engineering reports.
* Support development of overall facility design, interior layouts and master planning to address
  + Cleanroom Classification/zoning
  + Cleanroom Pressure Zones
  + Temperature & Relative Humidity Zones
  + Classified Equipment Layout
* Preparation of Tender drawings and functional specifications.
* Review and approve contractor Submittals.
* Review of Process package for completeness of process related data.
* Preparation of PFDs, P&IDs for Process Cooling Water systems (PCW) and development of specifications and layouts for Semiconductor facilities with integration of Tools Layout.

**Process Mechanical packages:Lead the team to perform below activities:**

* Understanding the utility requirements for Process Mechanical Packages from TUM.
* Develop the Equipment layout for Process Exhaust, Process Vacuum, Compressor & PCW system.
* Calculate system flow, pressure requirement.
* Develop the piping layout, Ducting layout.
* Prepare and review PFDs (Process Flow Diagrams), P&IDs, system schematics, equipment layouts, and mechanical specifications.
* Perform equipment sizing and selection for pumps, ID FANS, scrubbers, compressors, heat exchangers, pressure vessels, tanks, and piping & Ducting system.
* Conduct the Hydraulic calculation for the different streams.

Coordinate multidisciplinary engineering teams (process, mechanical, electrical, CSA, automation) to ensure alignment across design deliverables

**Equipment & Technology Integration:**

* Knowledge of functions and dimensions of various semiconductor process equipment used in facilities.
* Collaborate with vendors for equipment selection during design phases, gather installation needs, and validation.

**Compliance & Standards:**

* Ensure adherence to industry regulations SEMI, ISO, ASHRAE, ASME, SMACNA, NBC, NFPA etc.
* Ensure adherence to ASME/API/SEMI/CPCB/Other regulatory standards.
* Knowledge of applicable international standards and local country standards.
* Work with regulatory bodies and internal teams to meet safety and environmental requirements.
* Ensure compliance with industry standards, safety regulations, and company procedures.

**Collaboration & Coordination:**

* Coordinate with disciplines to ensure clash free and code compliant designs.
* Coordination with process utilities, base-build utilities, architecture and structural design and participating in IDC process
* Support during Construction for cleanroom protocol, Installation and certification
* Support process/ utilities/ construction interfaces
* Work closely with architects, MEP engineers, and facility planners for efficient utility layout designs.
* Review vendor drawings, datasheets, and technical documents
* Coordinate with clients and stakeholders to align process requirements with project goals.
* Support Business Development and proposal activities
* Hire the team and train as per the need of the business plan

**Project Documentation:**

* Preparing presentation material that helps stake holders in strategic decision making and subsequently engineering concepts
* Prepare and update: Design Basis Report for Classified HVAC systems, process mechanical systems and Coordinate Design & Engineering deliverables as per project engineering deliverables schedule
* Monitor work progress and ensure compliance with the project quality requirements and schedule

**Experience & Qualification:**

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in mechanical engineering.

**Experience:**

* **20+ years** of experience in Cleanroom, HVAC Design and process mechanical systems engineering.
* Semiconductor fab project experience is must.

**Technical Skills:**

* Strong knowledge of utility design for semiconductor OSAT facilities and FABs.
* Experience with CFD, Energy modeling and simulation tools.
* Proficiency in software tools like AutoCAD, Revit, Navisworks BIM and IES-VE.
* Experience with engineering software such as Pipe flow, Pipenet similar tools
* Knowledge of ACC -Audo desk Cloud portal.

**Soft Skills:**

* Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making abilities.
* Strong communication skills for cross-functional teamwork and client interactions.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and work in a fast-paced environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in **greenfield and brownfield Advanced Manufacturing cleanroom facilities, Semiconductor front end and back end FAB**.
* Familiarity with **sustainability practices** in semiconductor manufacturing.

**Why Join AECOM:**

AECOM is a global leader in engineering, design, and construction services, offering exciting career opportunities and a collaborative work environment.

We are committed to fostering the professional growth and development of our employees, providing access to training, mentorship programs, and challenging projects.

At AECOM, you will have the opportunity to work on iconic projects across diverse sectors, including data center, commercial, airport, and industrial, making a positive impact on communities around the world and shaping a sustainable future for generations to come.

If you are passionate about MEP engineering and have extensive experience in leading projects across data center, commercial, airport, and industrial sectors, we encourage you to apply and become part of the AECOM team.

 **Additional Information**

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***

title: Engineering Manager - APAC OKYC
description:
**Company Description**

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.  
**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.  
**For everyone, everywhere.**

More about **our mission** and **what we offer**.

 **Job Description**

We are looking for an Engineering Lead to join our APAC Onboarding and KYC team in the Hyderabad office.

At Wise, Onboarding and KYC is one of our highest-leverage domains. It is the crucial first interaction millions of people and businesses have with us in APAC - one of our largest and fastest-growing markets. But there is an equally vital side that customers never see: trust, safety, and risk. Getting this right means building high-quality controls that accelerate legitimate growth while actively derisking our markets and firmly locking bad actors out of the global financial system.

As the Engineering Lead for APAC Onboarding and KYC, you will lead and grow a dedicated team that holistically owns KYC and Fincrime risk for the region across aspects of customer experience, control effectiveness and operational scalability.

**What you’ll be doing:**

* Lead the engineering team: Lead, coach, and mentor a team of engineers. Own what they ship, their well-being, and foster a culture of collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Own technical excellence: Architect for scale and resilience so we can adapt to regulatory changes quickly. Ensure appropriate on-call rotas, observability, and SLAs for critical services. Join the team's on-call rotation.
* Stay close to the code: Understand the team's systems deeply enough to be hands-on when needed. Review designs and PRs, assist the team in solving hard problems, and lead by example.
* Stakeholder management: Work closely with first, second, and third line teams (Operations, Risk & Compliance, and Internal Audit) to ensure engineering solutions align with the regulations.
* Co-own product roadmap: Partner with Product Managers to decide what's worth building, break down complex projects into incremental milestones, and ensure we balance fast iteration with long-term platform health.

 **Qualifications**

At Wise, Engineering Leads who manage a single team stay close to the implementation details, meaning strong technical expertise, architectural knowledge, and a willingness to remain hands-on are essential to succeed in this role. If you bring a strong mix of these core technical and leadership capabilities, we’d love to hear from you.

* Experience leading and mentoring software engineers (even if you manage a smaller team of 2-3 as a Tech Lead or Senior Engineer) and owning what they deliver.

* You give people context and direction, empower them to own their work, and know how to navigate ongoing product expansion.
* You have solid Java (17+) knowledge and hands-on experience with Spring / Spring Boot, and you're happy to stay hands-on when the team needs it.
* Deep understanding of distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and microservices, with comfort making high-impact architectural decisions
* You have led the design and delivery of complex engineering solutions and understand their broader impact on business outcomes — including trade-offs between short-term product wins and long-term platform health.
* A product engineer’s mindset—you measure your work by customer and business impact and make data-driven decisions to fix customer pain points.

* A clear communicator who can articulate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, across geographies and time zones.
* Bias to action and comfort with ambiguity: you move quickly without dropping quality.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with financial systems, payments, or digital onboarding flows.
* Understanding of the technical challenges of integrating third-party verification providers, managing sensitive identity data, and building modular KYC workflows adapted for different regulatory bodies.

**What you can expect as an Engineering Lead at Wise:**

We don't measure seniority purely by years of experience, but by the impact you create and the complexity of problems you can help solve. As an EL1 at Wise, you will be given the licence to:

* Balance technical domain ownership with people leadership.
* Execute large cross functional projects, either directly or through your team, that have a meaningful impact on Wise products and customers globally.
* Propose ideas to improve and grow your team’s product while acting as a trusted partner to your regional counterparts.
* Embrace long-term ownership of projects while training other engineers to reduce single points of failure.

 **Additional Information**

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.  
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.

Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

This is a hands-on leadership role that combines deep technical expertise with team management skills to deliver high-quality, compliant, and high-performance software solutions.

The role bridges enterprise .NET application development and real-time/embedded C++ systems, ensuring seamless integration between L2 software layers, PLC/hardware interfaces, and manufacturing execution systems (MES). The incumbent will oversee the full development lifecycle - from architecture design and modernization of legacy systems to performance optimization and cross-team collaboration.

**C. Primary Responsibilities**

**1. Team Leadership & Management**

* Lead and manage a cross-functional team of .NET and C++ developers focused on L2 pharma manufacturing systems.
* Mentor junior and mid-level developers, foster a culture of technical excellence and collaboration.
* Conduct code reviews, enforce coding standards, and uphold software quality best practices.
* Plan sprints, assign tasks, and track delivery in agile/scrum workflows.

**2. .NET Application Development**

* Oversee design, development, and modernization of backend modules using .NET Core / .NET 6+.
* Architect and build RESTful APIs using ASP.NET Core Web API following SOLID and clean architecture principles.
* Drive migration of legacy WPF/WCF/.NET Framework systems to scalable, secure REST-based architectures.
* Support Docker-based containerization and cloud/on-premise deployments.
* Ensure implementation of unit testing (xUnit / NUnit / MSTest) and CI/CD pipelines.
* Leverage AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) responsibly.

* Lead development and optimization of C++ components for high-performance and real-time applications.

* Oversee software integration with embedded systems, PLCs, and hardware interfaces on Linux-based platforms.
* Ensure performance profiling and optimization of GPU-accelerated and multi-threaded applications.
* Collaborate with PLC/C++ hardware teams for seamless machine communication integration.

**4. L2 Systems Architecture & Integration**

* Design and govern the software architecture for L2 supervisory systems in pharma manufacturing.
* Ensure seamless data exchange between L2 software, MES, SCADA, and L1 device layers.
* Define integration protocols and APIs for device communication and data acquisition.
* Oversee performance, reliability, and security of manufacturing software systems.

* Ensure all software development aligns with pharma industry regulatory requirements (GMP, 21 CFR Part 11, etc.).

* On-time delivery of L2 software modules and modernized backend services.
* High-quality, unit-tested, and well-documented codebase.
* Smooth integration between .NET applications and C++/hardware layers.
* Improved system performance through CUDA/GPU optimization and profiling.
* Regulatory compliance of all delivered software in pharma manufacturing context.
* Team capability growth through active mentoring and technical leadership.

  **relevant**
  software development experience.
* Strong proficiency in .NET Core / .NET 6+ and C# including modern features, design patterns, and clean architecture.
* Solid experience in C++ (11/14/17/20) including modern C++ features and OOP design principles.
* Hands-on experience with CUDA programming for GPU-based parallel computing.
* Expertise in Linux development environments (Ubuntu, CentOS, etc.).

description:

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**
D&T Analyst II –Data Foundations will play a pivotal role in shaping and advancing our data ecosystem. This role requires a blend of technical expertise, analytical curiosity, and business partnership, working closely with leaders, D&T peers, and global stakeholders to deliver scalable, high-quality AI Ready data solutions.
  
  
You will serve as a technical data subject matter expert, guiding data best practices, mentoring analysts, and ensuring that our data products are governed, reliable impactful and AI ready. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of business insight, data engineering, and analytics and who is eager to contribute to General Mills’ digital transformation journey.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**
**Business Partnership and Collaboration**

* Gather, analyze, and model data requirements, including data lineage, data quality, business rules, and logical data models,. Work closely with Solution Managers and cross-functional teams to translate business questions into actionable data solutions
* Design business specifications documents and data flow diagrams. Partner with data engineers for delivery of data solutions.
* Translate data into insights and recommendations for stakeholders, where applicable.
* Create and own business and technical documentation (e.g., Alation, Confluence).
* Plan, execute, and support various testing phases, including Quality Assurance (QA), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), Business Acceptance Testing (BAT), and production validation, to ensure solutions meet specified requirements specified in User Stories (ADO/JIRA Board) and perform as expected.
* Perform data discovery followed by exploratory data analysis ensuring smooth data flow and thorough data modelling. Communicate with business stakeholders and dependent PODs to maintain transparency on execution of deliverables and status updates.
* Learn and understand AIDEA Cloud technology and how it connects current Data Foundation capabilities while shaping future ones.
* Communicate timelines, progress, and priorities effectively with business stakeholders to ensure alignment, transparency, and timely delivery.

**Technical Data Leadership**

* Serve as a Data analyst and technical oversight to analysts within the Data Foundations team.
* Act as the technical data SME for the foundation team, uncovering critical business questions and enabling data-driven decision-making.
* Partner with data engineers, analytic engineers, and architects to design, build, and maintain scalable, high-quality data pipelines on GCP.
* Maintain and enhance existing data foundations pipelines, ensuring performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.

**Data Quality, Governance, and Best Practices**

* Define, document, and socialize best practices for data analysis, data modeling, and documentation across data foundations and other workstreams.
* Champion data quality, consistency, and reusability, ensuring alignment with enterprise data governance, metadata, and lineage standards.
* Leverage data observability and monitoring tools (e.g., Monte Carlo, Collibra) to ensure data reliability and trustworthiness.
* Ensure adherence to modern coding practices, data security guidelines, and agile delivery principles.

**Innovation and Enablement**

* Identify opportunities to enhance analytical efficiency, scalability, and automation through technology innovation and AI enablement.
* Facilitate knowledge-sharing sessions, peer learning forums, and capability-building initiatives to strengthen analytical maturity.
* Partner with business and D&T leadership to evolve data maturity and support strategic goals like sustainability reporting, digital twins, and predictive analytics.

**Sustainability and Compliance**

* Partner with business teams to design and build data models supporting metrics aligned with General Mills’ public sustainability commitments.
* Support regulatory compliance by maintaining data pipelines for business requirements.
* Advance data maturity and accuracy of sustainability datasets to ensure real-time analytics and integrity across the GCP Data Foundations.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, information systems, software engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.
* Experience: 7-10 years of total information technology or information technology-enabled services experience, including at least 5 years in data analytics or data analysis roles.
* Technical skills: Strong command of SQL at an intermediate to advanced level, with hands-on experience in ETL processes, data modeling, data pipeline, and data transformation tools.
* Business Understanding: Exposure to Commercials and Consumer data , or FMCG data domains preferred.
* Analytical skills: Ability to translate complex data into actionable insights that support business decisions.
* Communication and collaboration: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas and work effectively across global, cross-functional, and multicultural teams.
* Delivery approach: Strong understanding of agile methodologies and collaborative delivery practices.
* Mindset: Positive, proactive, and self-driven, with a strong sense of ownership and commitment to team success.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* FMCG exposure: Broad understanding of commercial marketing, planning, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, and sustainability, and how data enables insights across these domains.
* Agile and product delivery: Experience delivering solutions in an agile or Scrum environment, with a focus on iterative development, stakeholder feedback, and continuous improvement.
* Leadership and mentoring: Ability to coach and mentor junior analysts, facilitate peer reviews, and promote knowledge sharing across global teams.
* Stakeholder management: Strong relationship management and collaboration skills, with proven success working with business and technical leaders across regions.
* Analytical innovation: Interest in exploring AI, GenAI, or automation to enhance data quality, analyst productivity, and insight generation.
* Academic and professional excellence: Strong academic background and continuous-learning mindset, demonstrated through certifications, courses, or hands-on learning in emerging data technologies.

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Purchasing Analyst
description:
Seaspan employees are goal-driven and thrive in a high-performance culture. Our integrated business model, with over 25 years of fleet life-cycle management expertise, provides the world’s major shipping companies with long-term leases on large, modern and technologically advanced vessels, combined with industry-leading ship management services. As owner and operator of the vessels, we provide skilled officers and crews dedicated to the safe, reliable, and economical operation of our fleet. Seaspan's fleet has evolved over time to meet the varying needs of our customer base. We own vessels in a wide range of sizes, from 2,500 TEU to 24,000 TEU. Our main operating offices are located in Singapore, Vancouver, Hong Kong, and Mumbai.
  
  
**Position Summary:**
The Purchasing Analyst drives cost control and performance across the purchasing and logistics function through
  
  
spend analysis, KPI reporting, and process improvement. Working with the purchasing team, category managers,
  
  
fleet and technical teams, finance, and third-party logistics (3PL) suppliers, the role turns purchasing and freight
  
  
data into clear, actionable insight. The analyst tracks spend under management, identifies savings opportunities
  
  
and purchasing behaviours that drive unnecessary cost, and monitors 3PL supplier performance and freight spend
  
  
across the fleet.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Spend Analysis and Compliance**

* Track and report spend under management compliance, measuring the share of spend placed with contracted and approved suppliers by vessel, category, and purchaser.
* Identify off-contract and maverick spend, and work with purchasers and category managers to bring it back under management.
* Analyze purchasing patterns to identify savings opportunities, including order consolidation, planned versus urgent purchasing, price variances, and supplier selection.
* Highlight purchasing behaviours that drive avoidable cost, such as late requisitions, split orders, and repeated urgent purchases, and recommend corrective actions.

**Freight and 3PL Performance**

* Monitor freight spend by vessel, port, mode, and 3PL supplier, and report trends and cost drivers to management.
* Track air versus sea freight mix, consolidation rates, and cost per kg, and monitor compliance with the urgent air freight approval process.
* Monitor 3PL supplier performance against agreed KPIs and service levels, including transit times, delivery reliability, cost, and reporting accuracy, and prepare data for supplier performance reviews.
* Reconcile 3PL invoices and reports against purchasing and shipment data, and flag discrepancies.

**KPIs, Reporting, and Systems**

* Develop and report purchasing KPIs, including requisition-to-order time, PO cycle time, supplier lead times, ontime delivery, and emergency purchase rates.
* Build and maintain Power BI dashboards and monthly management reports covering spend, savings, freight, and supplier performance.
* Extract, clean, and maintain data from the purchasing system (Jibe), and work with system owners to resolve data quality issues and system gaps.
* Automate recurring reports and support process improvements that reduce manual work for the purchasing team.

**Analytical Support**

* Provide analysis for tenders, supplier reviews, budget planning, and audits.
* Support benchmarking of purchasing and logistics cost and performance.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree, preferably in Supply Chain, Engineering, Business, Statistics, Management Information Systems, or a related field.
* 3 to 4 years of experience in purchasing, procurement, or logistics data analysis.
* Experience developing KPIs, dashboards, and management reporting.
* Understanding of the purchase-to-pay (P2P) cycle and of freight and logistics cost drivers.
* Strong analytical skills, with advanced proficiency in Excel (pivot tables, Power Query, lookups, data modelling) and Power BI.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present data clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks.
* Detail-oriented and resourceful, with a solution-driven attitude.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in shipping, ship management, or another asset-heavy industry.
* Experience with purchasing or ERP software (Jibe, SAP, ShipNet, or similar).
* Knowledge of SQL or Python for data extraction and automation.
* Experience working with freight forwarders or 3PL providers.
* Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt or Green Belt certification.

* Design and recommend the optimal multi-tenant data isolation strategy, including schema-based isolation and Row-Level Security (RLS) approaches for 30+ tenant environments.
* Architect and implement multiple ingestion patterns, including MySQL CDC using Openflow, REST API integrations using Snowpark, and file ingestion through External Stages.
* Define and implement Dynamic Table refresh strategies, including near real-time refresh patterns and automated scheduling.
* Design point-in-time snapshot architectures supporting operational and regulatory reporting requirements.
* Establish secure credential and API key management utilizing Snowflake Secrets and governance best practices.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements including PIPEDA, OSFI audit standards, and SOC 2 Type II controls.
* Design secure networking architectures utilizing AWS PrivateLink, encryption frameworks, and secure access controls.
* Lead architecture reviews with internal stakeholders, Snowflake platform teams, and external vendors.
* Evaluate technical feasibility, scalability, performance, and cost optimization strategies across the Snowflake ecosystem.
* Define enterprise data governance, security, auditing, and access management standards.
* Develop a scale-out strategy to expand the platform from initial deployment to support 30+ tenant environments.
* Drive architectural decisions, platform standardization, and cloud modernization initiatives.
* Create architecture blueprints, design documentation, operational models, and implementation roadmaps.

**Expertise You'll Bring:**

* 12 to 16 years of experience in Data Architecture, Data Engineering, Cloud Data Platforms, or Enterprise Analytics solutions.
* Deep expertise in Snowflake architecture, including databases, schemas, warehouses, virtual warehouses, and RBAC.
* Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake Dynamic Tables and real-time data processing capabilities.
* Expertise in Snowflake Tasks, CRON scheduling, Streams, and orchestration patterns.
* Experience implementing Snowflake Openflow, CDC frameworks, and modern data ingestion architectures.
* Strong knowledge of multi-tenant architecture patterns, including schema isolation, Row-Level Security (RLS), and tenant governance frameworks.
* Extensive experience with SQL optimization, query tuning, performance engineering, and data modeling.
* Strong experience with AWS services including S3, Aurora MySQL, PrivateLink, IAM, VPC, and cloud security services.
* Experience designing secure enterprise platforms with encryption, auditability, and compliance controls.
* Understanding of data residency requirements and regulatory frameworks such as PIPEDA, OSFI, and SOC 2 Type II.
* Experience with Snowpark and API integration frameworks for modern cloud-native data workloads.
* Expertise in enterprise-scale data platform modernization and cloud migration initiatives.
* Strong understanding of security architecture, access management, and governance best practices.
* Experience working with Agile delivery teams and enterprise stakeholders.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and architecture governance skills.
* Ability to drive technical strategy, mentor engineering teams, and influence enterprise architecture decisions.

**Benefits:**

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications

title: Business Technology Solutions Manager- Salesforce Delivery
description:
**ZS**
is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by
**bringing together data, science, technology**
and
**human ingenuity**
to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a
**client-first mentality**
to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS.
  
  
We are seeking a seasoned Salesforce professional with a deep understanding of the Salesforce ecosystem, particularly in the field of Salesforce Health Cloud. This individual will play a crucial role in expanding our Salesforce practice, driving digital transformation across various industries, with a special focus on healthcare. Our firm looks to leverage your innovative thinking and leadership to develop cutting-edge business solutions that leverage AI and Analytics to deliver maximum value to our clients.
  
  
The candidate will be part of our Salesforce Expertise practice. As a Salesforce expert, the candidate will draw on their skills and experience to lead defining salesforce related business solutions/sales plays; work with team(s) to develop ZS capabilities (including: selling collateral and assets/accelerators/demos); and take the offerings to ZS’ client to convert to real opportunities, supporting the entire lifecycle of engagements. To do so, you will need to deeply understand customer requirements, understand the salesforce.com ecosystem and work closely with functional specialists to develop innovative, cutting-edge business solutions leveraging AI/Analytics to maximize the value to our clients. You will work closely with functional specialists to develop creative business solutions, solving some of the most exciting problems for our clients.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* End-to-End Delivery Management:

+ Deliver exceptional client service, ensuring projects stay within expected timeframes and budgets.
+ Review application and technical design documents, ensuring they follow Salesforce best practices and integrate effectively into the client's infrastructure.
+ Team and Capability Development:
+ Develop team skills and collaborate to create accelerators and assets that enhance our service offerings to clients.

* Offerings and Business Development:

+ Collaborate with ZS and industry experts to define integrated programs and offerings, taking them to market with the client service teams.
+ Lead large-scale business development and delivery engagements, especially in the Healthcare sector.

* Mentoring and Coaching:

+ Provide on-the-job feedback and coaching to team members and actively participate in the counseling and mentoring of junior consultants within the organization.

* Solution Architecture and Design:

+ Collaborate with healthcare organizations to understand their business needs and design customized Salesforce Health Cloud solutions.
+ Lead the architecture and design of scalable, secure, and high-performance Salesforce Health Cloud implementations.

* Technical Guidance and Quality Assurance:

+ Develop and maintain technical documentation, including solution designs, data models, and integration patterns.
+ Conduct code reviews and ensure best practices are followed for Salesforce Health Cloud implementations.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Bachelor's degree with major in Computers or Electronics.
* 10+ years’ of overall professional experience; with at least 5 years in a leadership role within a professional services firm.
* Proven experience as a Salesforce Health Cloud Architect, designing and implementing solutions for healthcare organizations.
* Strong understanding of the Salesforce platform, including platform configuration, Visual Force, Lightning, Workflows, Apex, and AppExchange.
* In-depth knowledge of healthcare data models and HIPAA regulations.
* Proficiency in shaping, providing consulting, building & implementing solutions using Salesforce cloud offerings.
* Good understanding of DevOps as they apply to Salesforce, including various methodologies and tools such as Salesforce DX.
* Active Salesforce Certifications Architect is strongly preferred.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Willingness to travel to meet client needs.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Salesforce certifications, such as Salesforce Certified Application Architect or Salesforce Certified System Architect.
* Proficiency in using MuleSoft and familiarity with other Salesforce cloud offerings like Sales, Service, Community, and Marketing Cloud.
* Working experience with Salesforce.com organization to leverage the ecosystem.
* The successful candidate will demonstrate a high level of motivation, excellent problem-solving skills, a strong work ethic, and executive-level presence and communication.

**How you’ll grow:**

* Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathways
* Milestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunities
* Internal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions

title: Manager, Engineering
description:
**Our Mission**
At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
  
  
****Who We Are****
In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
  
  
We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
  
  
****Job Summary****
We are seeking an Engineering Manager to lead the team that builds and runs our connectors framework. In this role, you will be accountable for the team’s delivery across several concurrent projects, from platform enhancements to large programs that need multiple teams to collaborate. You will lead by example as a hands-on technical manager, grow the engineers on your team, and remove roadblocks so the connector engineers who build on your platform can move fast.
  
  
****What You’ll Do****

* Own Team Delivery: Be accountable for delivering multiple framework projects and features at the same time. Make pragmatic trade-offs to deliver, and personally deliver features when the team needs it.
* Lead Technically: Stay hands-on and lead by example. Guide the team through large, complex projects that need several teams to complete, such as migrating on-premises connectivity to a cloud-managed agent or extracting the integrations code into its own service. Design features in the framework yourself when needed.
* Direct Quality and Reliability: Set the quality processes the team follows. Own framework reliability, including sync health, incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), and resolution of security findings.
* Develop Talent: Run 1:1s, performance reviews, goal setting, and career guidance. Enable ownership on the team, resolve conflict, and grow engineers into their next level.
* Remove Roadblocks Across Teams: Work closely with the connector development team, other product teams, SRE, security, and PM to keep work clear and unblocked.
* Lead AI-First Engineering: Train the team on our tools and processes, including AI-assisted development workflows, and set the discipline for verifying AI-generated code.
* Drive Initiatives: Run initiatives within the team, such as cutting the time it takes to build a new connector or reducing sync failures.
* Keep Customers in Focus: Understand customer use cases and problems, and use them to set priorities with PM.
* Build the Team: Actively recruit, lead interviews, and make hiring decisions.
* Communicate Clearly: Present plans, progress, and risks to engineering and senior leadership.

**Nice to Have**

* Identity & Access Security Domain: Direct experience with IAM, PAM, IGA, or Secrets Management platforms.
* Integration Platforms: Experience leading teams that build integration frameworks, data pipelines, or SDKs used by other engineers.
* Hybrid Connectivity: Experience with products that run agents inside customer networks.
* Multi-Site Teams: Experience leading engineers across more than one office location.
* DevOps & Observability Ecosystems: Practical experience with progressive delivery, CI/CD pipelines, feature flagging tools, and monitoring tools such as Datadog.

**Impact**
As an Engineering Manager on the connectors framework, you will lead the team that every connector in our product depends on. Your impact will be measured by your team’s delivery, the reliability of the framework in production, and the growth of the engineers you lead. Co-workers will look to you for clarity, technical judgment, and a steady path forward.
  
  
****Qualifications****

* People Leadership: Experience managing software engineers, including 1:1s, performance reviews, career development, and hiring.
* Technical Depth: Strong hands-on background with Node.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, and AWS, plus experience with data integration or distributed systems. Able to review designs and code with credibility.
* Delivery Track Record: Proven record of delivering large, complex projects that need collaboration across several teams.
* Operational Ownership: Experience running production services, leading incident response, and driving RCAs to durable fixes.
* AI Tooling Adoption: Experience leading a team’s adoption of AI tools while keeping review rigor high.
* Conflict Resolution & Influence: Able to resolve conflict, remove roadblocks across teams, and build strong working relationships with ICs and managers.
* Communication: Excellent presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to engineering and business audiences.
* Customer Understanding: Good understanding of customer use cases, problems, and considerations.

****Qualifications****
**Our Commitment**
We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
  
  
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.

We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
  
  
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

description:
**About the Company**

At
**Infotek Software & Systems**
[i-TEK], we specialize in delivering smart, connected embedded solutions for industrial, logistics, and infrastructure applications. Our next-generation product line includes RFID-based IoT devices running on ARM64 and x86\_64 single-board computers (SBCs), and we are looking for a technical leader to help bring these devices to life.

**Senior Embedded Systems Engineer**

Experience-
**10+ years**

Location-
**Pune**

**Job Summary**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Embedded Systems Engineer to lead the architecture, development, and deployment of RFID-enabled IoT devices. The ideal candidate brings strong expertise in Embedded C, Linux system programming, and Python scripting, along with the leadership skills to guide a small team of developers. This role owns low-level firmware, Linux-based system components, and backend integration using MQTT and related IoT protocols. It offers high visibility, technical ownership, and the opportunity to shape product direction.

**Responsibilities**

* Design and develop embedded applications in C and system-level software for Linux-based SBCs (ARM64, x86\_64).
* Build and maintain Python scripts and tools for device configuration, automation, testing, and lightweight services.
* Integrate and support RFID, UART, and other hardware communication protocols.
* Develop and maintain IoT connectivity using MQTT and related protocols.
* Lead a cross-functional team of 5–7 C and Python developers.
* Review code, set technical direction, and ensure high-quality deliverables.
* Collaborate with hardware, software, and cloud teams to deliver integrated solutions.
* Maintain build systems, debugging tools, and deployment pipelines.
* Optimize performance, manage resources, and ensure production robustness.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 10+ years of experience in Embedded C programming and system-level Linux development.
* Strong knowledge of Linux system programming, multithreading, and low-level I/O.
* Proficiency in Python for scripting, automation, or lightweight service development.
* Hands-on experience with UART, RFID module integration, or similar peripherals.
* Familiarity with MQTT and Linux-based IoT solutions.
* Experience with ARM64 and x86\_64 SBCs (e.g., Raspberry Pi, BeagleBone, custom boards).
* Strong debugging and performance analysis skills using tools such as GDB, dmesg, perf, and strace.
* Knowledge of embedded toolchains, cross-compilation, and build systems (Make, CMake, Yocto).
* Experience leading small engineering teams or mentoring junior developers.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with over-the-air (OTA) updates and firmware deployment strategies.
* Familiarity with Docker or containerized embedded applications.
* Knowledge of secure boot, device provisioning, and embedded security.
* Exposure to cloud IoT platforms such as AWS IoT or Azure IoT Hub.
* Contributions to open-source projects or participation in hardware/software communities.

title: Associate Software Analyst
description:

Our people make all the difference in our success. **Role Overview**

The ideal candidate will be passionate about software development, eager to learn new technologies, and excited to work on both front-end and back-end development. * Contribute to the modernization and enhancement of FlexPLM user interfaces and application capabilities.
* Help develop innovative software solutions that improve customer productivity and user experience.

* Learn and apply industry best practices in software design, coding, testing, and Agile delivery.
* Collaborate with experienced engineers to deliver high-quality, scalable, and maintainable software solutions.

**Your Team**

You will be part of a highly collaborative and dynamic FlexPLM engineering organization comprised of experienced software engineers, architects, product managers, and QA professionals.

The team values innovation, continuous learning, technical excellence, and customer success. You'll have opportunities to learn from senior engineers while contributing to meaningful product development initiatives from day one.

**Software Development**

* Design, develop, modify, test, and maintain enterprise software applications.
