title: Associate Director - Agentic AI Implementation & Process Automation
description:
**About Sirius AI**

Sirius AI is an AI consulting and solutions firm working with financial services clients, including banks, fintechs, payments companies and wealth managers. Our teams design, build and run GenAI, agentic AI and ML solutions inside client environments, working alongside their operations, technology and risk teams.

**About the Role**

We are hiring an Associate Director to lead agentic AI and process automation work for our US financial services clients. The role combines solution architecture and delivery leadership. You will design the solution, stay close to the build, and be accountable for getting it into production and keeping it running there.

Most of our work is in operations-heavy processes such as onboarding, KYC/AML, lending, payments operations, claims and servicing, at large organisations with strict security, audit and model risk requirements. You will lead a team of AI engineers, automation developers and business analysts, several of whom are early in their careers.

This is a hands-on role. We expect you to have built and deployed agentic systems yourself and to be comfortable reviewing code, agent traces and architecture decisions with your team.

**What You Will Do**

* Own the solution architecture for agentic automation engagements: agent design, orchestration, tool and MCP server design, integration with client systems, identity and access, and deployment topology.
* Lead delivery from process discovery through build, testing, go-live and hypercare. Fix the process before automating it, and decide which steps need an agent, which are better handled by rules, APIs or RPA, and which should stay with a person.
* Design multi-agent systems, including how agents delegate and hand off work (for example over A2A), how they reach tools and data (for example through MCP), and how state, memory, retries and failures are handled.
* Build and maintain the harness around each solution: evaluation datasets, regression tests, tracing, guardrails, and cost and latency monitoring, so that changes to prompts, models or tools are tested before they reach production.
* Implement role-based access control for agents and MCP tools. Define what each agent is allowed to call, on whose behalf and with what data scope, and align this with the client’s IAM, secrets management and audit logging.
* Deploy agentic solutions in large enterprise environments, which means working through security reviews, architecture boards, model risk validation, change management and integration with existing platforms.
* Set accuracy expectations with clients early. Agree what acceptable performance looks like for each use case, how errors and hallucinations will be measured, and where human review will stay in place, then report against those numbers openly throughout the engagement.
* Design solutions to be modular and reusable. Build up a shared library of agent templates, MCP servers for common FS systems, evaluation datasets and deployment patterns that shorten delivery on the next engagement.
* Lead and coach the delivery team, run design and code reviews, and help junior engineers build practical skills in agentic development.
* Act as the senior technical lead with client stakeholders and support pre-sales with solution design, estimates and staffing plans.

**What You Need**

* 8+ years in software engineering, automation or AI delivery, including at least 2 years building and running LLM-based agentic solutions.
* Hands-on delivery of at least two agentic process automation solutions that went into production at an enterprise client. You should be able to walk us through the architecture, what went wrong and how you measured results.
* A strong engineering background. You should be comfortable writing Python, reviewing pull requests and debugging agent behaviour from traces and logs.
* Working experience with one or more agent frameworks (such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen/Microsoft Agent Framework, Semantic Kernel, OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK or Claude Agent SDK) and a considered view on their trade-offs.
* Practical understanding of MCP (building and securing MCP servers, tool design, authentication) and A2A (agent discovery and task delegation), and when each is the right fit.
* Experience building evaluation and testing harnesses for LLM and agent systems, including golden datasets, LLM-as-judge with human calibration, regression testing and production monitoring.
* Experience implementing access control for agents and tools, such as OAuth/OIDC, service identities, scoped tokens, least-privilege tool access, user delegation and audit trails.
* Experience deploying on Azure, AWS or GCP using containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD and secrets management, within enterprise network, data residency and security constraints.
* Solution architecture experience across integration patterns, including APIs, event-driven systems and RPA where no API exists.
* The ability to explain agent behaviour, failure modes and residual risk to business, technology and risk audiences without overselling what the technology can do.
* A bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering or a related field.

**Good to Have**

* Delivery experience in banking, payments, lending, insurance or wealth management operations.
* Experience with RPA and BPM platforms such as UiPath, Power Automate, Pega, Camunda or ServiceNow.
* Experience with agent observability tools such as LangSmith, Langfuse or Arize.
* Familiarity with model risk management (for example SR 11-7) and AI regulation such as the EU AI Act.
* Experience with intelligent document processing.
* Cloud or architecture certifications.

The role is accountable for delivery predictability, release quality, and the people and org structure behind them.
  
  
This is also the role that shapes how ArmorCode builds software in an AI-native world. Several teams already run agentic workflows. The Director sets the direction, standards, and accountability that move engineering from AI-assisted work toward genuine autonomy, and ensures the org, architecture, and talent are ready for what comes next.
  
  
Reporting to the Head of Engineering, this role gives leadership an accurate, ongoing view of delivery, quality, and engineering health. It also carries direct ownership of engineering-level escalations on strategic enterprise accounts.
  
  
**What You'll Own**
**Your Org**

* Lead Development and Quality Engineering, creating the shared practices and priorities that let the two functions reinforce each other
* Actively redesign org structure as the product, headcount, and AI-driven ways of working evolve, including pod structure, reporting lines, and where Dev and QA boundaries should sit
* Hire and develop engineering managers and QA leadership; set the hiring bar and build a bench capable of running each function independently
* Own IDPs for all direct reports and key senior engineers; hold people accountable to growth plans with a clear 3-6 month review cycle
* Own promotions, calibration, and performance processes for the org, including writing promotion narratives, running calibration sessions, and managing attrition directly
* Handle escalations that span functions, such as a release delayed by both Dev and QA, or inter-team friction that blocks delivery

**Development & Delivery**

* Own delivery predictability across releases: planning, sprint health, dependency management, and on-time, high-quality shipping
* Set engineering standards for architecture, code review, branching, and release practices as headcount and product surface area grow
* Partner with Product and other engineering leaders to commit to realistic scope and timelines, and hold the line when they aren’t
* Drive technical direction for a platform that must scale across customers, integrations, and deployment models, and keep tech debt visible and managed
* Own incident response practice for the product, including being available and accountable when production incidents involve strategic customers

**Enterprise Customer Escalations**

* Own engineering-level escalations for strategic enterprise accounts: debugging production issues, reviewing customer logs, coordinating fixes, and representing engineering directly with the customer or account team
* Make the call on when an issue is ArmorCode’s problem vs. a third-party integration, and own the communication when that distinction matters
* Manage the follow-through on enterprise-specific requirements (private instances, dedicated tenants, custom integrations) from engineering’s side

**Quality Engineering**

* Own quality outcomes at the org level, with Dev and QA sharing accountability for what reaches customers
* Drive shift-left practices and bring QA closer to development, so quality is built in rather than checked at the end
* Own org-wide quality metrics, including defect leakage, escaped defects, and regression stability, and report them to leadership
* Hold the line on quality expectations under exec pressure: be the person who can explain what the numbers actually mean and push back where the bar is set unrealistically

**AI & Agentic Work**

* Set the vision for AI-native engineering at ArmorCode: how code is written, reviewed, tested, and released when agents are part of the team
* Define org-wide standards for agentic work: what constitutes genuine autonomy vs. AI-assisted work, required eval harnesses, guardrails, and where human sign-off remains mandatory
* Make model, tooling, and vendor decisions (which LLM for which workflow, build vs. buy) and own the tradeoffs
* Hold managers accountable for agentic adoption through outcome review, not code review
* Report the org’s actual agentic maturity to leadership: what is genuinely autonomous, what is still AI-assisted, and the plan to close the gap
* Build the skills, hiring profile, and ways of working the org will need as AI changes what engineers do

**Strategy, Capacity & OKRs**

* Set multi-quarter engineering strategy aligned with company priorities and where the ASPM market is heading
* Own the FY capacity model for the org: maintenance load, integration overhead, headcount allocation, and the evidence-based case for budget changes
* Define and track the metrics that indicate organizational health: delivery predictability, defect leakage, regression stability, incident resolution time, agentic workflow adoption
* Own quarterly OKRs and monthly business reviews; report progress to the India Engineering Head, the Head of Engineering, and broader leadership
* Make build vs. buy and vendor decisions for engineering tooling

**Rubric**

* An engineering rubric: criteria a release must meet before shipping and what constitutes an SLO breach
* An agentic maturity rubric: the distinction between AI-assisted work and genuine agent autonomy, and the bar each function is held to
* A people rubric for the management layer: criteria for IDP accountability, promotion readiness, and what “running a function independently” looks like at each level

**Who You Are**
**Must Have**

* 12+ years in software engineering, with a strong development background and a track record of leading large engineering teams
* Has grown a team before, ideally from a handful of people into the 40-50 range, including making hard calls on org structure, not just steady-state management
* Has owned delivery for a product with real release cadence and customer commitments, and can explain predictability in terms of data, not optimism
* Has led AI/agentic adoption across a team or org, including model and vendor decisions, setting eval expectations, and knowing when a workflow is actually autonomous vs. just AI-assisted
* Has managed or worked closely with QA, and knows the difference between a coverage number that means something and one that doesn’t
* Strong architecture judgment and genuinely hands-on comfort with cloud/AWS and scalable system design; comfortable in a war room when something breaks in prod
* Comfortable owning enterprise customer escalations directly: can represent engineering credibly to a strategic customer, knows when to escalate and when to absorb
* Can sit across the table from other engineering and product leadership and hold their own; this role is visible at that level
* Willing to write code, scripts, or tooling themselves when that’s the fastest path to unblocking the team, not just delegating

**Strong Plus**

* Experience running enterprise-grade private or dedicated cloud instances for large customers, not just multi-tenant SaaS
* Exposure to LLM/GenAI tooling beyond general familiarity: decisions about prompt design, model selection, MCP or tool-call architecture, or eval harness design
* Experience setting agentic engineering standards across multiple functions, not just within one team
* Prior experience in a company going through real org restructuring, not just headcount growth, including navigating manager friction, attrition risk, and role ambiguity
* Experience leading QA or a QA-to-engineering career path
* Cybersecurity or SaaS background

**Why You Will Love It**

* Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in promoting from within and provide career progression paths, enabling our employees to advance in their careers
* Work-Life Balance: We understand the importance of a healthy work-life balance, offering flexible hours and remote work options to promote a sustainable lifestyle
* Collaborative Environment: Our company fosters a collaborative and inclusive workplace culture, where employees can collaborate and learn from each other's experiences
* Employee Recognition: We value and recognize the contributions of our team members through awards, employee of the month programs, and other forms of acknowledgment.
* Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salaries and performance-based bonuses, recognizing and rewarding the hard work and dedication of our team
* Comprehensive Benefits: Our benefits package includes health insurance for employees and dependents, to support the overall well-being of our employees. We encourage learning and skilling, and aid our employees to continuously upskill themselves.
* Diversity and Inclusion: We are committed to diversity and inclusion, striving to create an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and empowered

Join ArmorCode and lead the charge in reducing signal fatigue, prioritizing risk and streamlining key cybersecurity workflows. Apply today to be part of a close-knit team, dedicated to democratizing software security and helping build the safest software possible.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or any other legally protected category. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply and will receive consideration for employment regardless of their background or characteristics. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone is treated with respect and dignity.

description:

We are seeking a Software Engineer – Database (PostgreSQL) to join our Product Engineering team and help drive the modernization of our Retail ERP platform. You will move business logic out of stored procedures and triggers, design clean new data models, and write the conversion and reconciliation scripts that move clients to them safely.

This role requires deep hands-on PostgreSQL skills, strong data modelling, and the ability to read complex legacy SQL. You will work closely with Data Architects, Technical Leads, QA, and DevOps.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Design normalised tables and data models for ERP business areas.
* Write and maintain database migration scripts (Flyway).

* Write data conversion scripts and reconciliation queries for financial, stock, and tax data.
* Build data archival and restore processes.
* Optimize queries, indexes, and views for large client databases.
* Use AI tools to write and check SQL, and review and test what they produce.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Experience designing scalable database schemas for enterprise applications.

### **Data Migration**

* Experience with database migration tools such as Flyway or Liquibase.

### **Legacy Code**

* Ability to read and understand complex legacy SQL and stored procedures.

### **AI-assisted Development**

* Comfortable using AI coding tools in daily development.

### **Version Control**

* Experience with Git.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

**Team Responsibilities**
-------------------------

* Document data models and database logic.
* Work with development teams on data access patterns.

**Preferred Skills**

* Basic C# / .NET knowledge.
* Domain knowledge of retail, ERP, accounting, or inventory systems is highly desirable.

**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.

**What You'll Work On**
-----------------------

* Enterprise Retail ERP Platform
* Data Model Modernization
* Stored Procedure and Trigger Refactoring
* Data Migration and Reconciliation
* Data Archival
* High-volume Transaction Processing
* Performance and Scalability Engineering

**What We Look For**

* Deep hands-on database skills.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Precision with data and numbers.
* Ownership mindset with a focus on delivering business value.
* Good communication with development teams.

**Why Join Us**

* Work on cloud-native, event-driven, and distributed systems.
* Solve challenging scalability and performance problems.
* Collaborate with experienced architects and product engineering teams.
* Play a key role in shaping the technical direction of a mission-critical product

title: Founding AI Engineer
description:
01 About PotionLabs

PotionLabs builds AI that evolves with your company. Most software makes a business change to fit it. Ours learns how the business already works, from its emails, spreadsheets, registers and the knowledge in people's heads. Then it keeps changing itself as the business changes.

We sit on top of the system a customer already has. Their books stay in Tally or SAP. Our first product, the AI Intelligence Workforce, runs every day at JD Jones & Co., a manufacturer that is about 100 years old.

We are a small team. What you build goes to a real business in days, not quarters.

Location: Park Street, Kolkata (in person)

Employment: Full-time

Experience: 1–3 years

Start date: Immediate

CTC: ₹6–12 LPA, based on skill, plus ESOPs

Working hours: Mon–Fri 10 AM–6 PM, Sat 10 AM–2 PM

Openings: 2

02 The role

You do two jobs. You build our product, and you deploy it at our customers.

On the product. You build the AI Intelligence Workforce itself: new features, agents and fixes. What you learn at a customer goes back into the product, so the next customer gets it faster.

At customers. You own the deployment at one or more client businesses, from the first visit to the live system. You learn how the business really runs. You set up our software on top of their systems, such as Tally or SAP. You connect their data, build the automations they need, and train their team. After go-live, you watch it every day. You fix what breaks, and you check that people keep using it.

A senior engineer reviews your work. The product you build and each client deployment you run are yours.

03 What you'll do

1. Find the problem yourself

· Sit with a customer's operations, sales and factory teams. Watch how work really gets done.

· Find the slow, manual and repeated steps, including the ones nobody asked you to fix.

· Decide which problem is worth solving first, and say why.

· Do the same for our own product: find what is slow, missing or broken, and raise it.

2. Deploy at the customer

· Set up our software on top of the client's systems, such as Tally or SAP, and take it live.

· Take a company's registers, spreadsheets and paper forms, and turn them into clean, structured data.

· Prove the new system matches the old one, row by row.

· Handle messy real data: blank rows, wrong dates, numbers written as 1,00,000.

· Train the client's team, and own the deployment for one or more clients.

3. Build AI that takes real actions

· Build AI agents that read data, call tools and update records, with a person approving where it matters.

· Make them safe to run every day on live data: retries, jobs that are safe to run twice, clear logs.

· Test every agent with evals: a fixed set of real cases with known right answers. Prove it works before go-live, and keep measuring it after.

4. Build the product

· Build and improve the AI Intelligence Workforce: backend services, APIs, database tables and background jobs.

· Turn what you learn at one client into a product feature, so the next client gets it without custom work.

· Write most of your code with AI coding tools, and check every line before you trust it.

5. Ship and own it

· Put changes live, for the product and for each client.

· Watch what you shipped after it goes live. Fix it when it breaks.

· Check that people keep using it.

6. Explain it

· Explain what you built to a factory manager in plain words.

· Tell us early when something is going wrong.

04 Who we're looking for

We are looking for entrepreneurs. You are someone who picks up meaningful work on your own, without waiting to be told, and sees it through to a result.

**Must have**

· An entrepreneur's drive. You take on a meaningful task on your own. You decide what matters, do it, and own the result. Tell us about one time you did this.

· 1–3 years of real building. A job, or serious work that real people used.

· Two or three meaningful projects that you owned from start to finish. Anyone can build a project in a weekend with AI tools now. A meaningful one solves a real problem for real people, uses real data, and kept working after the first week. You can explain every part of it and change it in front of us.

· Strong, working Python. Code that another person can read and change.

· Good SQL. You design simple tables and write joins and totals on your own.

· Backend basics. APIs, databases and background jobs.

· Daily use of an AI coding tool such as Claude Code, Cursor or Codex, and the habit of checking what it writes.

· Evals and monitoring. You test AI output against a fixed set of cases, and you watch it after it ships. You can show us how you measured that it worked.

· Honesty about your work. You tell us clearly which parts you built, which a teammate built, and which an AI tool wrote.

Mandatory: something you built that nobody asked you to build, and that people still use. No manager, client or course gave it to you. You saw the problem and built the fix yourself. Real people still use it today. It has an AI feature that takes real actions: it calls tools, reads data or changes records. A chat window alone does not count. We do not interview without it.

Nice to have

· Work with ERP or accounting data, such as Tally or SAP.

· Systems driven by rules or config files, not one-off code for one customer.

· Tool calling, RAG, MCP, and prompt and context design for AI agents.

· Some React or TypeScript.

What doesn't matter

· Degree, college or CGPA.

· Certificates.

· Your job title at a past company. What you built and owned matters.

What we're not looking for

· Chatbot-only projects with nothing behind them.

· Tutorial projects presented as products.

· Tools on your CV that are not in your code.

· Numbers on your CV that you can't explain.

05 What you'll get

· Real problems in real businesses from week one.

· Full ownership of what you build, from the first conversation to the live system.

· Freedom to use the newest AI tools.

· Direct work with the founder.

· Equity in PotionLabs through an employee stock option plan (ESOP). You join as a founding team member. We agree the amount and the vesting terms with you before any offer.

· A seat early in a company that is still taking shape. The work you do now sets how we build later.

06 How to apply

1. Send us your two or three best projects: code, a live link, or a short write-up of what you owned.

2. Show us the thing you built that nobody asked you to build, with its AI feature: a link, the code, and who uses it today.

3. Fill in the pre-interview form. We do not interview candidates who skip it.

In the interview, we open your code together and ask you to change it.

Apply at potionlabs.ai/careers/founding-ai-engineer

title: SAP Business AI (Joule and Basic ABAP) - Senior, Tax Technology Services
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**SAP Business AI (Joule and Basic ABAP) - Senior, Tax Technology Services**
Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited (“USI Tax”) commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all the Deloitte Tax LLP (“Deloitte Tax”) U.S. service offerings have obtained support services through the USI Tax teams. USI Tax offers you opportunities to learn and support U.S. and other countries (such as Australia, Belgium, Canada, Germany, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom) taxation practice, a popular career option.
  
  
Deloitte Tax is leading its clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace, offering a broad range of fully integrated tax services by combining technology and technical tax resources to comply with reporting requirements, uncover insights and deploy smarter approaches for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
We are looking for an innovative Technical SAP ABAP on HANA, CDS, OData, RAP Plus Gen AI develop and implement systems architecture that meet business needs, along with ensuring that our clients’ can keep pace with the changing tax and legal landscape.
  
  
Design, build, and support performance SAP S/4HANA extensions and services using ABAP on HANA, RESTful ABAP Programming Model (RAP), Core Data Services (CDS), and OData to enable modern Fiori/UI and integration scenarios.
  
  
To be successful in this role, you should be able to align the global Tax and Legal landscape with the business’ activities and proposed wider business processes. You will be the lynchpin between the Tax Function and IT Function, ensuring that we build the best SAP Tax design for the client. This will require the ability to explain complex terms to a variety of different stakeholders, and in a way that is relevant to each stakeholder group. You will also need to continually assess the SAP product suite and development roadmap to integrate any updated specifications and requirements into SAP system architecture.
  
  
You will also need to integrate with the wider client project team (whether that is delivered by Deloitte Consulting or another Systems Integration partner). This will involve an understanding of how the tax design interacts with other process flows and also the inter-personal skills to build the required relationships.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities -**

* Develop and enhance ABAP solutions on SAP S/4HANA using clean, modular, and testable patterns.
* Build Gen AI applications and AI Agents.
* Code Python is a plus.
* Ability to navigate fragmented landscapes through API-calls and MCP- servers is key.
* Build end-to-end RAP artifacts (behavior definitions/implementations, validations, determinations, actions, draft handling, locking, authorization concepts).
* Create and optimize CDS views (interface/consumption views, associations, annotations) with strong focus on pushdown and performance.
* Design, expose, and support OData services (preferably OData V4 via RAP; maintain OData V4 where required).
* Implement Fiori-enablement via CDS annotations and support UI integration with SAP Fiori elements (as applicable).
* Integrate with SAP and non-SAP systems using SAP-recommended patterns (e.g., APIs, events, messaging where applicable).
* Apply performance tuning (SQL optimization, buffering strategy, ST05/SAT/SQLM analysis, CDS performance best practices).
* Follow SAP extensibility guidelines (in-app/extensibility, key-user vs developer extensibility, released APIs, clean-core approach where applicable).
* Produce technical designs, code documentation, unit tests, and participate in code reviews.
* Support testing cycles, defect triage, hyper care, and production support with strong root-cause analysis

**Qualification And Experience Required -**

* Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience).
* 4+ years of Experience in SAP or SAP4HANA.
* Hands-on experience in building Gen AI applications, AI Agents.
* SAP Business AI certification is a plus.
* SAP certifications (ABAP for S/4HANA, RAP, BTP) are a plus.
* Strong hands-on experience with ABAP in SAP S/4HANA / ABAP on HANA environments.
* Proven delivery experience with:
* RAP (managed/unmanaged as needed, behavior implementation, draft, authorization)
* CDS (views, annotations, associations, table functions if needed)
* OData service exposure and troubleshooting (RAP/OData V4 strongly preferred)
* Strong understanding of HANA-optimized development: SQL/CDS pushdown, avoiding SELECT-in-loops, efficient joins, pagination, etc.
* Familiarity with modern ABAP practices (e.g., ABAP OO, clean code, exception handling, unit testing mindset).
* Experience working in Agile delivery (user stories, estimation, sprint ceremonies).

**Preferred / Nice To Have**

* SAP BTP exposure (e.g., Integration Suite, API Management, Event Mesh, ABAP environment/Steampunk—if relevant).
* BTP, Joule and SAP business AI certification.
* Proven knowledge of Tax touchpoints within SAP.

title: Chief Technology Officer
description:
**Chief Technology Officer**

Cue Home Innovation Labs

· Ahmedabad · Full time, on site

**Role**

We are looking for a CTO who will take complete ownership of Cue's technology and hold

it for the next three to five years while we grow.

There are two halves to the job. Run and scale the platform we have built. And take this

company AI native inside the next nine to eighteen months, in the product and in the way

we work.

The cash is modest for the seniority. The equity is meaningful. You will work beside the

founder every day, and you will have the standing of a co-founder in how this company is

run.

**What Cue Home is**

Cue Home is a brand-agnostic smart home operating system, built in India. Our own gateway

hardware, our own cloud platform, apps live in both stores, and a system that keeps the

house running whether or not the internet does. It is deployed in homes, in enterprises

and in large real estate projects, and it is moving now from pilot installations to full

production.

Hardware, firmware, cloud, mobile and protocol engineering, in one product.

And we are building toward something larger. A lifecycle management platform for the smart home: design, planning, installation, integration and control, across more than 45 product categories and over 2,000 brands, for the thirty-year life of an Indian home. The full stack of a smart home.

**What you will own**

- The whole technology function: platform, hardware, firmware, mobile, cloud and release.

- The architecture and the roadmap. You decide where we go technically, and you defend it.

- The AI native transition, end to end.

- The engineering team. You will lead them, grow them, and hire the next set.

- Engineering quality and security as a standing discipline, not a project.

- The technical half of every investor and partner conversation.

Today the founder ( Non-technical ) carries much of this. The point of this role is that he stops.

**Who we are looking for**

- Around six to nine years building software, with real time spent close to hardware or embedded

 systems.

- You have taken a product from working to shipped at scale, and owned what happened

 after it shipped.

- You have led a small engineering team, and people stayed.

- You have built with LLMs and agents in earnest, not a weekend demo. You know where they

 hold and where they fall over.

- You are comfortable being the most senior technical person in the room, and the one who

 is accountable.

- You want to be in Ahmedabad, in the office, with the team.

What matters more than any of the above: you want to own something, and you are willing

to give it three to five years.

**The Payout**

Meaningful equity vesting over four years, with cash that is fair but deliberately modest

for the level. A seat in every company decision, not only the technical ones. A review of

your title and your standing at twelve months.

Three to five years is the minimum commitment we are asking for. On almost everything

else, for the right person, we are flexible. Tell us what you need and we will have that

conversation properly.

**How to apply**

Write to
**harnish@cuehome.in**
. Keep it structured, in this order.

1. Your name and qualifications. (50 words)

2. Why you think you fit this role best. (250 words)

3. The product you were most deeply involved in building. What it was, what you owned, and what happened to it after it shipped. (400 words)

4. Your minimum monthly cash expectation. A number, not a range. We would rather know now than in the third conversation.

Four answers and your CV. Nothing else.

title: Integration Architect - FHIR
description:
**Job Title:**
FHIR Integration Architect

**Job Type:**
Contractor

**Location:**
Remote

**About the Role**

We're building an independent FHIR R4 interoperability layer that lets our CRM's clinical workflows starting with provider launch directly from inside the EHR, beginning with Oracle Health (Cerner) PowerChart. We need someone who can do both halves of this job well: design and personally validate the technical architecture, and lead the engineers full-stack, AI, and QA who build it. This is not a design-and-handoff role. You'll be in the SMART on FHIR launch flow when it breaks, in the code review when a mapping rule is wrong, and in the room when the team needs a call made.

**What You'll Own**

**Architecture & Solution Design**

•    
**Own**
the end-to-end architecture of the FHIR layer — SMART on FHIR launch and OAuth2, the canonical data model, the EMR adapter framework, tenant isolation, and event-driven orchestration — and keep it extensible to future EMRs (Epic, athenahealth) and formats (HL7v2, X12) beyond the Cerner pilot.

•    
**Make**
build-vs-buy and vendor decisions (self-hosted HAPI FHIR vs. a managed FHIR store; Keycloak vs. a commercial identity provider; build vs. adopt an interface engine) and can defend the reasoning to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.

•    
**Design**
the architecture against HIPAA-grade security and auditability requirements from day one — encryption, least-privilege access, audit trails — not as a pre-launch retrofit.

•    
**Validate**
the architecture against real constraints: Oracle Health/Cerner's actual FHIR R4 conformance, US Core and Da Vinci PAS implementation guides, and the operational realities of a live, EHR-embedded launch — not just a reference diagram.

**Technical Leadership & Delivery**

•    
**Lead**
a cross-functional engineering pod — full-stack engineers, AI/ML engineers, and QA engineers — setting technical direction, running code and design reviews, and removing blockers day to day.

•    
**Translate**
the solution architecture into a sequenced, phased delivery plan (proof of concept → pilot → multi-client scale) and hold the team accountable to it.

•    
**Own**
technical risk — surfacing integration blockers, vendor API gaps, and compliance findings early, and driving them to resolution rather than escalating and waiting.

**Integration, Standards & Compliance**

•    
**Lead**
the Cerner/Oracle Health integration end to end: SMART App Launch (EHR launch, OAuth2/OIDC, fhirUser claims), Ignite APIs registration, and coordination with the client health system's Cerner administrators.

•    
**Define and enforce**
conformance testing (ONC Inferno, US Core / Da Vinci PAS validation) before any integration is called production-ready.

•    
**Partner with**
compliance and security stakeholders on HIPAA Security Risk Assessments, BAAs, and audit-trail requirements.

**Required Qualifications**

•    8+ years in healthcare interoperability or integration engineering, including 3+ years in an architect or technical lead capacity.

•    Deep, hands-on FHIR R4 experience — resource modeling, RESTful FHIR APIs, and at least one implementation guide (US Core at minimum).

•    Direct experience implementing SMART App Launch (EHR and/or standalone launch), OAuth2/OIDC, and at least one major EHR's FHIR API — Cerner/Oracle Health experience specifically preferred given Phase 1 scope.

•    Hands-on experience with HAPI FHIR or an equivalent FHIR server — server customization and multi-tenant partitioning are a strong plus.

•    Cloud architecture experience on AWS or equivalent: containers, managed relational databases, event-driven services (queues/event buses), and core identity/security services.

•    Proven experience leading or managing engineers — running reviews, setting direction, and being accountable for a team's delivery, not only your own.

•    Working knowledge of healthcare data exchange beyond FHIR — HL7v2, X12, CDA — sufficient to plan for future extensibility.

•    Solid understanding of HIPAA technical safeguards and healthcare data compliance requirements.

**Strongly Preferred**

•    Direct, hands-on experience with Oracle Health (Cerner) Millennium / Ignite APIs and PowerChart SMART app registration — or the Epic App Orchard equivalent.

•    Experience with Keycloak or another open-source identity provider, including custom extension/SPI development.

•    Familiarity with Da Vinci implementation guides (PAS, CRD, DTR) and FHIR-based prior authorization workflows.

•    Experience in patient support programs, prior authorization, or healthcare CRM domains.

•    Experience standing up a healthcare integration function from near-zero on a small team, not only operating within an already-mature enterprise integration group.

•    Familiarity with applying AI/ML to healthcare data mapping, document generation, or clinical NLP — relevant given the AI engineers on this team.

**Tech Stack You'll Work With**

**FHIR & integration standards -**
FHIR R4, SMART App Launch v2, US Core, Da Vinci PAS, OAuth2 / OIDC, HL7v2 (future-facing)

**FHIR server -**
HAPI FHIR (JPA server), multi-tenant partitioning

**Identity -**
Keycloak, custom SMART-launch extension (SPI)

**Cloud / infra -**
AWS — Fargate/ECS, Aurora PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, API Gateway, WAF, EventBridge/SQS, Secrets Manager, KMS, CloudWatch/OpenSearch

**IaC / delivery -**
Terraform or AWS CDK, CI/CD (GitHub Actions or CodePipeline), Docker

**Target EHR (Phase 1) -**
Oracle Health / Cerner Millennium (Ignite APIs, PowerChart chart-toolbar launch)

**Conformance testing -**
ONC Inferno test kit (incl. Da Vinci PAS), Synthea synthetic data

title: Site Reliability Engineer - Market Data (India, Chennai)
description:
**About GoCharting**

  

GoCharting is a web-native charting and trading platform. Traders use professional orderflow tools — footprint charts, volume and market profile, cumulative delta, DOM trading — to read the market and place orders through their broker, all in the browser. Our users are active traders in India, the US and around the world.

**The Role**

You will make GoCharting's live market-data and trading services reliable, by building the monitoring, alerting and runbooks yourself and by fixing the causes of outages. The role is full-time and in person in our Chennai office, and it reports to the Chief Technology Officer. Traders depend on live prices at the market open, so one engineer needs to own uptime, observability and incident response across the platform. At 12 months, our alerts should catch problems on live feeds and core services, and each incident should end in a written review and a fix.

**What you'll do**

  

* **Build monitoring and alerting** — cover live data feeds, exchange connections and core services, with alerts that name the failing part
* **Respond to incidents** — lead the response, restore service, and write a review that names the cause and the fix
* **Define reliability targets** — set service-level objectives for data freshness and uptime, and report against them weekly
* **Write runbooks** — document how to detect, triage and recover each critical service so any engineer on duty can follow them
* **Harden infrastructure** — manage cloud infrastructure as code, and remove single points of failure
* **Cover the market open** — join the weekly rotation for the 08:30–09:30 IST market-open window

  

**What we're looking for**

**Must-haves:**

* 5+ years in site reliability, DevOps or infrastructure operations on production systems
* Hands-on: you personally build monitoring, alerting and runbooks, and do not only advise
* Has run production services on a major cloud provider (AWS, DigitalOcean, Google Cloud or Azure) with Linux and containers
* Has used a metrics and alerting stack, such as Prometheus and Grafana or an equivalent
* Has been on call for a production service and written post-incident reviews
* In person in our Chennai office, 5 days a week, and able to take part in the weekly 08:30–09:30 IST market-open rotation

**Nice-to-haves:**

* Infrastructure as code with Terraform or similar (adds repeatable, reviewable infrastructure changes)
* Real-time or streaming systems, such as WebSocket feeds or Kafka (adds understanding of our main workload)
* Synthetic monitoring of user journeys from several regions (adds detection before users notice)
* Defining and tracking service-level objectives (adds a measured reliability target)
* Trading, fintech or market-data operations (adds speed in learning our domain)

  

**Logistics**

  

**Location** Chennai, India - in person, office-based  
**Employment type** Full-time  
**Entity** ProCharting Private Limited  
**Reports to** Chief Technology Officer  
**Start date** ASAP  
**Travel** None

description:

Zycus is a global leader in Source-to-Pay (S2P) procurement software, helping large enterprises drive efficiency, compliance, and measurable value across their procurement and finance operations. At the core of Zycus’ platform is **Merlin AI**, an advanced AI-powered engine that brings intelligence, automation, and predictive insights across the entire procurement lifecycle—from sourcing and contract management to procurement, invoicing, and supplier management. Merlin AI empowers Chief Procurement Officers and finance leaders to make faster, smarter decisions with real-time visibility and actionable insights.

Zycus is consistently recognized by top industry analysts such as **Gartner, Forrester, and IDC** for its innovation, depth of functionality, and strong customer outcomes. Known for its enterprise-grade solutions, global delivery model, and customer-first mindset, Zycus partners closely with organizations to modernize procurement and unlock long-term business value.

With a strong global presence across North America, EMEA, and APAC, Zycus continues to invest aggressively in product innovation, AI-led capabilities, and brand leadership—shaping the future of intelligent procurement.

  
  

**We Are An Equal Opportunity Employer:**

Zycus is committed to providing equal opportunities in employment and creating an inclusive work environment. We do not discriminate against applicants on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or any other legally protected characteristic. All hiring decisions will be based solely on qualifications, skills, and experience relevant to the job requirements.

**Job Description**

Zycus is looking for a ETL Developer who is responsible for managing and maintaining data warehousing processes, ensuring data integration, and supporting data transformation requirements. The role involves developing, testing, and deploying ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes for efficient data flow across systems, aligning data structures to organizational requirements, and maintaining data quality and integrity. ETL Developers work closely with data analysts, data engineers, and database administrators to build robust ETL frameworks and deliver timely, accurate data solutions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Data Extraction, Transformation, and Loading (ETL):**Design, develop, and implement ETL processes to support data extraction, transformation, and loading across various data sources.
    
  Ensure data integrity, accuracy, and consistency during the ETL process.

* **Data Modeling and Warehousing:**Create and maintain data models to support warehousing and reporting requirements.
    
  Develop and optimize database schemas and maintain data dictionaries.

* **Data Integration and Performance Optimization:**Integrate data from multiple sources, including databases, flat files, APIs, and external platforms.
    
  Optimize ETL processes for performance and scalability, minimizing latency and maximizing throughput.

* **Data Quality Assurance:**Implement data quality checks and validation mechanisms to ensure data accuracy and completeness.
    
  Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve data quality issues in ETL pipelines.

* **Collaboration with Cross-Functional Teams:**Collaborate with data engineers, analysts, and stakeholders to understand data requirements and implement ETL solutions accordingly.
    
  Support data reporting and analytics needs through reliable data flow.

* **Documentation and Maintenance:**Document ETL processes, data mappings, and workflows.
    
  Maintain and update ETL scripts, jobs, and processes to meet evolving business needs.

**Job Requirement**

**Skills And Experience Required :**

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related field.

**Experience:**

* Proven experience in ETL development, data warehousing, or data engineering roles.
* Experience with ETL tools like Informatica, Talend, SSIS, or similar.

**Technical Skills:**

* Proficiency in SQL for data querying and manipulation.
* Familiarity with scripting languages (Python, Shell scripting) is a plus.
* Knowledge of data warehousing concepts, data modeling, and data integration techniques.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and big data technologies (Hadoop, Spark) is beneficial.

**Soft Skills:**

* Strong problem-solving abilities, analytical thinking, and attention to detail.
* Effective communication skills to work with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Five Reasons Why You Should Join Zycus**

**• Cloud Product Company:** We are a Cloud SaaS Company and our products are created by using the latest technologies like ML and AI. Our UI is in Angular JS and we are developing our mobile apps using React.

* **A Market Leader:** Zycus is recognized by Gartner (world’s leading market research analyst) as a Leader in Procurement Software Suites.

**• Move between Roles:** We believe that change leads to growth and therefore we allow our employees to shift careers and move to different roles and functions within the organization

**• Get a Global Exposure:** You get to work and deal with our global customers.

* **Create an Impact:** Zycus gives you the environment to create an impact on the product and transform your ideas into reality. Even our junior engineers get the opportunity to work on different product features.

  

**About Us**

Zycus is a pioneer in Cognitive Procurement software and has been a trusted partner of choice for large global enterprises for two decades. Zycus has been consistently recognized by Gartner, Forrester, and other analysts for its Source to Pay integrated suite. Zycus powers its S2P software with the revolutionary Merlin AI Suite. Merlin AI takes over the tactical tasks and empowers procurement and AP officers to focus on strategic projects; offers data-driven actionable insights for quicker and smarter decisions, and its conversational AI offers a B2C type user-experience to the end-users.Zycus helps enterprises drive real savings, reduce risks, and boost compliance, and its seamless, intuitive, and easy-to-use user interface ensures high adoption and value across the organization.

  
  

Start your #CognitiveProcurement journey with us, as you are #MeantforMore

Role Overview

The Lead Data Scientist is a senior technical role combining deep expertise in statistics, mathematics and data preparation with strong capability in machine learning and hands-on programming. The role leads complex analyses, develops scalable solutions and ensures work is rigorous, reproducible and aligned with business needs.

Working across departments, the Lead Data Scientist communicates findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders, influences technical decisions and helps colleagues develop their skills. The role demonstrates ownership, sound business judgement, effective execution and resilience, while promoting innovation, continuous learning and responsible use of data.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead data science projects from problem definition through analysis, modelling, implementation and evaluation.

• Proficiency in Python and relevant machine learning frameworks, with experience writing clear, tested and maintainable code.

• Ability to build domain knowledge quickly, assess relevant research critically and apply appropriate methods to business problems.

• Experience developing scalable data science solutions using GCP or comparable cloud platforms.

• Takes ownership of project quality, delivery and business impact.

• Collaborates effectively across technical and business teams and communicates complex ideas clearly.

• Applies sound business judgement when prioritising work and balancing accuracy, value, cost and delivery time.

• Executes effectively in ambiguous environments and remains resilient when priorities change or experiments do not succeed.

Experience and Qualifications

• Master’s degree or PhD in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related field, or a bachelor’s degree with significant equivalent experience.

• Demonstrated proficiency in Python, machine learning frameworks and statistical analysis.

• Experience communicating recommendations to senior technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Experience mentoring or technically guiding other data scientists

title: Consultant - IBU Incentive Compensation
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
**Purpose**
At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Our >40,000 employees around the world work to discover and bring life-changing medicines to those who need them, improve the understanding and management of disease, and give back to our communities through philanthropy and volunteerism. We give our best effort to our work, and we put people first. We're looking for people who are determined to make life better for people around the world.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**
This job description intends to provide a general overview of the job requirements at the time it was prepared. The job requirements of any position may change over time and may include additional responsibilities not specifically described in the job description. Consult with your supervisor regarding your actual job responsibilities and any related duties that may be required for the position.
  
  
The GOSO IBU Incentives Consultant / Sr. Consultant works closely with the GOSO India team and IBU affiliates to deliver Incentive Compensation (IC) work across an assigned hub/affiliate book of work. The role advises business partners and provides analytical insight that enables sound, data-driven decision-making and improved field and customer outcomes. The person draws on IC domain expertise and cross-functional collaboration — and increasingly on AI-enabled tools and modern data platforms such as Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, and Claude/other GenAI applications — to accelerate delivery, strengthen quality, and surface insights that would otherwise take considerably longer to produce manually. The role reports to the Global / IBU Incentives Capabilities leader and partners closely with other GOSO Leads to embed best practices across the function.
  
  
The IC Portfolio spans Incentive Plan Design & Quota Setting, IC Payout Calculations, Budget Analysis, Eligibility Processing, IC Contests/Award Programs, and IC Reporting & Analytics.
  
  
**Portfolio Delivery**

* Owns delivery of the assigned book of work for a hub/affiliate portfolio, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and quality across the IC portfolio (Plan Design, Payout, Budget, Eligibility, Contests, Reporting).
* Partners with Incentives Leads to build and execute the Demand Plan, sequencing work to meet affiliate priorities.
* Adjusts work plans in response to shifting priorities, applying structured change control.
* Collaborates with internal team members and external/vendor partners to achieve shared delivery goals; as experience grows, takes on informal guidance of colleagues working through complex or ambiguous problems.
* Identifies the root cause of delivery issues and resolves them, escalating where appropriate.
* Proactively identifies opportunities to simplify or automate recurring work — increasingly applying AI/GenAI tools (e.g., Claude) and modern data platforms (Databricks, AWS, Microsoft Fabric) to reduce manual effort, shorten turnaround time, and strengthen quality control.
* Supports change management and system implementation activities for IC tools and platforms.
* Reports progress and results of assigned work to leadership on a regular cadence.

**Operational Excellence**

* Maintains IC BRDs, Design Documents, SOPs, and QC checklists to current standards; increasingly uses AI tools to draft, structure, and quality-check documentation — applying sound judgment to review and validate AI-assisted output before it is finalized.
* Supports the review/approval process for documents and deliverables, reconciling reviewer feedback and resolving open items.
* Builds and manages project plans for assigned work; contributes to, and with growing experience leads, specific workstreams within larger cross-functional projects.
* Applies quality standards when reviewing project documents, designs, and final deliverables.
* Surfaces process improvement and automation opportunities, using data — and, where relevant, AI-assisted analysis — to identify patterns and inefficiencies in current ways of working.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Manages timelines and coordinates with team members and partners across time zones and geographies.
* Develops, implements, and monitors communication plans for assigned work.
* Communicates project and program status clearly and proactively to India Leads and IBU stakeholders, using data visualization and, where useful, AI-assisted summarization to make updates concise and decision-ready.
* Anticipates project/program issues and escalates appropriately with India leadership, bringing forward well-reasoned recommendations alongside any concerns raised.

**Technical & Peer Development**

* Continues to build depth in IC domain knowledge, strategic thinking, project management, and cross-functional collaboration.
* Shares technical knowledge and best practices with peers; more experienced team members take on structured technical coaching and mentoring of newer joiners.
* Builds fluency in the function's evolving technology stack — including SQL/Python-based analysis, data visualization tools, and AI/GenAI applications (e.g., Claude) — using these tools to augment, not replace, sound business judgment.
* Contributes to a team culture aligned with Team Lilly values — inclusion, innovation, acceleration, delivery, integrity, excellence, and respect for people.
* Ensures own work is compliant with company policies, procedures, and regulations, and supports peers in doing the same.

**Minimum Qualification Requirements**

* Bachelor's Degree.
* 2–4 years of relevant experience (Consultant level) or 5–7 years of relevant experience (Sr. Consultant level) in Incentive Compensation and Sales Force Effectiveness (SFE) domains.
* Working knowledge of Incentive Plan Design & Quota Setting, IC Payout Calculations, Budget Analysis, HR Eligibility Processing, IC Contests/Award Programs, and IC Reporting & Analytics — with depth and independence expected to increase with experience.
* Proficiency in a coding/query language (e.g., SQL, Python, VBA) and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI); comfort using AI/GenAI tools (e.g., Claude) to accelerate analysis, coding, and documentation is expected, with hands-on experience building reusable or automated solutions with these tools valued at the more senior level.
* Working familiarity with modern cloud data platforms (e.g., Databricks, AWS, Microsoft Fabric), or a demonstrated ability to ramp up quickly on new data tools as the function's technology stack evolves.
* Ability to analyze upstream and downstream impact of system changes and organizational change management (OCM) activities.
* Detailed knowledge of pharmaceutical data and business rules.
* Ability to generate incentive analytics that are genuinely useful to stakeholders across management levels and that drive continuous improvement in incentive plan effectiveness.
* Ensures compliance with company policies and applicable state and federal laws and regulations.

**Other Information / Additional Preferences**

* Expertise in industry standards, best practices, compliance considerations, and regulatory requirements relevant to IC.
* Strong problem-solving, negotiation/influence, project management, and critical-thinking skills, applied effectively in team, cross-functional, and global settings; at the more senior level, a demonstrated ability to bring others along and shape outcomes beyond one's own workstream.
* High motivation and genuine curiosity for finding creative, efficient solutions — including proactively exploring how AI and automation can improve the way IC work gets done.
* Experience with Javelin/Zaidyn Incentive tools.
* Exposure to, or interest in, enterprise data platforms (Databricks, AWS, Microsoft Fabric) and GenAI tools (e.g., Claude) as Lilly's Incentives technology stack continues to evolve; candidates who have applied these in a prior role, project, or self-directed learning will stand out.

title: AI Intern
description:
AI Intern – Generative AI, AI Agents & AWS

Company: Datadives India Pvt. Ltd.

Location: Remote

**Unpaid Internship**

Role:
**AI Intern**

**Company Description**

Datadives helps businesses transform scattered data, manual processes, and fragile pipelines into reliable systems for analytics, automation, and AI.

The team specializes in connecting diverse data sources, building cloud data platforms, and implementing data quality checks that enable organizations to trust their numbers. DataDives focuses on optimizing cloud workloads and costs while preparing robust datasets that power practical AI applications.

Our expertise spans data engineering, cloud platforms, machine learning, Generative AI, and intelligent AI agents that automate complex business workflows.

Datadives works with startups, enterprises, and technology firms that require strong engineering ownership and hands-on delivery. Based in India, we partner closely with clients to solve real-world data and AI challenges.

Role Description

As an AI Intern at DataDives India, you will work alongside experienced engineers to design, develop, and evaluate practical AI solutions using Python, Generative AI, AI agents, and AWS cloud services.

This full-time, on-site role provides hands-on experience building intelligent applications, experimenting with Large Language Models (LLMs), developing agent-based automation workflows, and integrating AI with enterprise data systems.

You will contribute to proof-of-concept development, internal AI products, and selected client projects, gaining exposure to modern cloud architectures and production-oriented AI engineering practices.

Key Responsibilities

- Assist in designing and developing AI agents capable of reasoning through tasks, interacting with tools and APIs, and automating business workflows.

- Build and experiment with Generative AI applications using LLMs, prompt engineering, and structured outputs.

- Explore AI agent frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, and AWS Bedrock Agents.

- Develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) workflows using document processing, embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search.

- Work with AWS services such as Amazon Bedrock, S3, Lambda, API Gateway, IAM, and CloudWatch.

- Support the development of Python-based APIs, data processing pipelines, and AI-powered automation solutions.

- Experiment with machine learning models, including data preprocessing, feature engineering, model training, and evaluation.

- Test AI agent reliability, response accuracy, tool-calling behavior, latency, and cost efficiency.

- Integrate AI applications with databases, APIs, enterprise documents, and structured or unstructured data sources.

- Maintain code repositories, document experiments, troubleshoot issues, and collaborate with engineers on technical solutions.

Qualifications

Required Skills

- Strong foundation in computer science, programming fundamentals, data structures, and algorithms.

- Good working knowledge of Python, including functions, object-oriented programming, APIs, and common libraries.

- Understanding of machine learning fundamentals, data preprocessing, feature engineering, and model evaluation.

- Basic knowledge of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, and AI application development.

- Familiarity with AI agents, including concepts such as tool calling, task planning, memory, and multi-step workflows.

- Basic understanding of AWS cloud concepts and services such as S3, Lambda, IAM, and Amazon Bedrock.

- Familiarity with SQL, REST APIs, JSON, Git, and collaborative software development.

- Strong analytical thinking, debugging skills, and willingness to experiment with emerging AI technologies.

- Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Good to Have

- Hands-on experience building AI agents using LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or similar frameworks.

- Exposure to Amazon Bedrock, Bedrock Agents, Bedrock Knowledge Bases, or other AWS AI services.

- Experience with RAG pipelines, embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search.

- Familiarity with LLM APIs, function calling, structured outputs, and agent orchestration.

- Understanding of multi-agent systems, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and human-in-the-loop workflows.

- Experience with FastAPI, Docker, Streamlit, or similar application development tools.

- Knowledge of AI evaluation techniques, hallucination reduction, guardrails, and responsible AI practices.

- Familiarity with AWS architecture, serverless applications, and cloud cost optimization.

- Experience with personal projects, hackathons, open-source contributions, or working AI prototypes.

What You'll Gain

- Hands-on experience designing and building real-world AI agents and Generative AI applications.

- Practical exposure to AWS cloud services and enterprise AI architectures.

- Opportunities to work on industry-focused AI proof-of-concepts and automation solutions.

- Experience taking AI ideas from experimentation to functional prototypes.

- Direct mentorship from experienced data engineers and cloud architects.

- Exposure to production engineering practices, code reviews, documentation, and collaborative development.

At Datadives, we are looking for curious builders who want to move beyond AI tutorials and learn how to engineer intelligent systems that solve real business problems.

title: Chief AI/ML Architect
description:
Overview of 66degrees
  
  
66degrees is an end-to-end AI transformation partner that guides enterprises from complex business challenges to clear, quantifiable outcomes. Our company is the culmination of several successful firms, each a leader in its own right in cloud, artificial intelligence, and data. This convergence of talent and expertise is how we help businesses reach their own "inflection point," where chaotic data becomes a strategic asset, complexity becomes clarity, and AI becomes an engine for growth. Our ultimate vision is to be the catalyst for a future where every business operates as an intelligent enterprise, with autonomous systems unlocking human potential.
  
  
At 66degrees, we believe in thriving through challenges and winning together. These values not only guide us in achieving our goals as a company but also for our people. We are dedicated to creating a significant impact for our employees by fostering a culture that sparks innovation and supports professional and personal growth along the way.
  
  
Overview of Role
  
  
An AI/ML Architect at 66degrees designs and ships production AI systems for enterprise clients and leads the engineers who build them. The Architect is the senior technical person on an engagement: the primary technical point of contact for the client, the owner of the architecture, and the person the team takes direction from.
  
  
The role is hands-on and client-facing in equal measure. Architects take a business problem, define the solution and the value it delivers, and then build and deploy it. They write and review code, make the architectural decisions, and stay with the system through production. They also run discovery, present to client executives, and are the face of 66degrees on the engagement.
  
  
This role is based in India and works daily with US-based colleagues and clients. Engagements typically run 12 to 16 weeks and are delivered by a Delivery Manager, one or more Architects, and a team of engineers.
  
  
Why this role
  
  

* 2026 Google Cloud AI Partner of the Year. This team's work won the Artificial Intelligence category this year, one of four Partner of the Year awards 66degrees has earned. You're joining the top of the Google Cloud AI ecosystem
* About 60% of the work is generative and agentic AI, in production, for clients up to the Fortune 10. The rest is classical ML and MLOps, so you build real agents without losing the rest of the craft.
* New problem, new client, every 12 to 16 weeks. You build range fast and never spend three years on one system
* The whole stack. Architects span infrastructure, software, data, ML, AI, and analytics. The role is built to make you a well-rounded technologist, not to keep you in one lane
* Player-coach all the way up. Growth here doesn't mean giving up the craft. Leaders still build, and the management track is open because the team keeps growing, not because someone has to leave
* No up-or-out, no partner-track politics. Nobody is competing to differentiate themselves; everyone is trying to be the best technologist in the room, which is why people share what they know
* The team has grown roughly tenfold in three years and people stay. The few who've left went on to top tech firms and AI startups

**Responsibilities**
Build
  
  

* Design the architecture for each engagement: data pipelines, classical ML, agentic and generative AI, and the production path on Google Cloud, with the trade-offs written down
* Write and review the code that matters: core logic, orchestration, evaluation, the parts an engineer shouldn't be guessing at
* Take systems to production and own them through handoff: deployment, monitoring, drift, retraining, incident response, and a client who can run it after we leave
* Choose the right approach for the problem, and defend it on cost, explainability, and fit rather than on what's fashionable

Lead the team
  
  

* Direct a team of engineers: write the brief with the reasoning, not only the tasks; confirm it landed before code is written; review the work
* Run a team where engineers raise problems early and are heard when they do
* Develop engineers: pairing, giving them the client call, making them present the design review, and telling the Delivery Manager who is ready for more
* Delegate real work and still own the hard parts. Not a solo builder; not a delegator who only checks in

Own the client relationship
  
  

* Run discovery: turn an ambiguous ask into a scoped plan with success criteria the client agrees to
* Hold the solution to what the client actually needs, and when scope and need diverge, raise it early with options and what each costs
* Raise risk the day you see it, up and across, in business terms, with options. Report "on track" only when it is
* Present to client executives: the design, the trade-offs, the status, and the recommendation, answer first
* Spot expansion: where the client's next problem is, and tell sales

**Qualifications**
Technical (required)
  
  

* Has personally designed and shipped production ML or AI systems, more than once, and owned them after launch. This is a hard requirement: an Architect who cannot point to systems they built and ran is not an Architect, whatever else is on the resume
* A data science foundation with range: several technique families (classification, forecasting, NLP, deep learning, recommendation, anomaly detection) each tied to a real business outcome. Depth in a few, breadth across the rest
* Has built a generative or agentic AI system that real users depended on: the architecture end to end, where the tools ran, how cost and latency were handled, and how quality was measured. A serious RAG system or single-agent workflow with real evaluation discipline qualifies; a chatbot demo does not
* Production fluency on a hyperscaler: Google Cloud preferred (Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Run or GKE); deep AWS or Azure experience with a credible translation is acceptable
* Strong software engineering: expert Python and SQL, containers, CI/CD, and the habits that make code someone else can run
* Currently hands-on, with recent, specific examples of code written and architectural decisions made

Leadership and delivery (required)
  
  

* Currently leads a team of engineers or data scientists, delegating real work while owning the architecture and core logic

* Your engineers learn from you. If you raise risks, they will. If you don't, they won't. You set the standard for how the India team works

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

**Job Description:**

**High Performance Computing, AI and Labs** is a critical element of HPE. We are focused on delivering innovative solutions that accelerate our customers’ digital transformation, enabling them to tackle their complex, and data-intensive workloads. Combining deep expertise and the development of the world’s most cutting-edge, high-performance supercomputers, is defining the next era of computing delivering valuable insight & innovation. Join us and redefine what’s next for you.

**What you'll do:**
-------------------

The Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) HPC Business Unit has an exciting opportunity for an experienced engineer dedicated to providing **remote systems administration and proactive technical support for High-Performance Computing (HPC) environments**. These environments involve multiple components such as operating systems (OS), workload managers, high-speed networks, clustered file systems, and HPC cluster managers.

This role is part of our Global Remote Services (GRS) team and focuses on delivering exceptional service while ensuring the **availability, reliability, performance, and smooth operation of customers' HPC environments**.

As part of this role, you will work within a collaborative team environment where teamwork is essential. Engineers are expected to contribute to the successful operation and support of customer environments. This includes **performing proactive system health checks, troubleshooting technical issues, planning and coordinating maintenance activities, sharing knowledge, documenting findings, communicating with customers, and working with other HPE technical teams when specialist or onsite intervention is required**.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

In this role, you will:

* **Provide remote systems administration and proactive technical support for HPC environments**, dedicating a significant portion of the role to system health monitoring, technical assessment, troubleshooting, documentation, planning, and customer communication, alongside hands-on remote administration activities.
* **Perform detailed technical assessments and regular health checks** across HPC environments, including operating systems, workload managers, SlingShot and other high-speed networks, clustered file systems, cluster management components, and related infrastructure.
* **Troubleshoot and resolve technical and integration challenges** across a mix of HPC technologies, providing effective solutions and recommendations to maintain system availability, stability, and performance while minimizing customer impact.
* **Collaborate with global teams**, including Level 3 SMEs, engineering teams, support organizations, and onsite engineering personnel, to investigate and resolve complex technical issues and deliver seamless, customer-focused support.
* **Prepare and maintain comprehensive technical documentation**, including system health-check reports, troubleshooting notes, technical procedures, maintenance plans, configuration information, recommendations, and customer-facing reports.
* **Provide timely and effective communication with customers**, ensuring they have a clear understanding of system health, identified issues, recommended actions, ongoing investigations, maintenance activities, and outcomes.
* **Coordinate planned maintenance and technical activities** with customers and relevant HPE teams, helping ensure appropriate preparation, technical validation, risk identification, and post-maintenance verification.
* **Proactively identify potential risks and technical issues** before they result in service impact, working with customers and internal teams to recommend appropriate corrective or preventive actions.
* **Support incident investigation and problem resolution**, collecting and analyzing relevant system information, logs, alerts, and diagnostic data, and escalating to the appropriate specialist teams when required.
* **Be flexible with working hours** to support critical customer situations, planned maintenance activities, project milestones, and deadlines, including occasional extended hours and weekend work as needed.
* **Act as a technical service advocate for the customer**, ensuring that systems administration activities and technical recommendations align with the customer's operational and business requirements.
* **Contribute to continuous improvement and knowledge sharing** within the Global Remote Services team by documenting solutions, developing reusable procedures, sharing technical knowledge, and helping improve remote support practices.

**What you need to bring:**

***Education and Experience Required:***

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent.
* 4+ years experience preferred

**Key Qualifications:**
-----------------------

* **In-depth Linux knowledge**, with proficiency in Red Hat, CentOS, or similar Linux distributions.
* **Strong scripting experience with Bash and Python**, with the ability to develop scripts for system administration, diagnostics, automation, data collection, and repetitive operational tasks.
* **Expertise in clustered file systems** such as Lustre, CXFS, GPFS, or StorNext.
* **Hands-on experience with high-speed networking** technologies such as SlingShot, InfiniBand, or Omni-Path.
* **Hands-on experience with HPC workload managers** such as Slurm or PBS.
* **Strong experience administering and troubleshooting HPC systems**, including system health monitoring, configuration management, performance investigation, log analysis, maintenance, and incident resolution.
* Experience working with **HPC cluster management and monitoring tools** and diagnosing issues across multiple components of an HPC environment.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to **isolate complex issues across compute, storage, network, workload management, and operating system layers**.
* Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to **manage multiple customer environments, technical activities, incidents, and priorities effectively**.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills in English, with a strong emphasis on **customer-focused communication and the ability to translate complex technical findings into clear actions and recommendations**.
* Ability to work effectively in a **global and collaborative support environment**, coordinating with remote specialists, engineering teams, and onsite personnel when necessary.

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.
