title: Software Application Development Manager
description:
At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.

**Overview**

Boeing is the world's largest aerospace company and leading manufacturer of commercial airplanes and defense, space and security systems. We are engineers and technicians. Skilled scientists and thinkers. Bold innovators and dreamers. Join us, and you can build something better for yourself, for our customers and for the world.

As a leading global aerospace company, Boeing develops, manufactures and services commercial airplanes, defense products and space systems for customers in more than 150 countries. As a top U.S. exporter, the company leverages the talents of a global supplier base to advance economic opportunity, sustainability and community impact. Boeing’s team is committed to innovating for the future, leading with sustainability, and cultivating a culture based on the company’s core values of safety, quality and integrity.

**Technology for today and tomorrow**

The Boeing India Engineering & Technology Center (BIETC) is a 5500+ engineering workforce that contributes to global aerospace growth. Our engineers deliver cutting-edge R&D, innovation, and high-quality engineering work in global markets, and leverage new-age technologies such as AI/ML, IIoT, Cloud, Model-Based Engineering, and Additive Manufacturing, shaping the future of aerospace.

**People-driven culture**

At Boeing, we believe creativity and innovation thrives when every employee is trusted, empowered, and has the flexibility to choose, grow, learn, and explore. We offer variable arrangements depending upon business and customer needs, and professional pursuits that offer greater flexibility in the way our people work. We also believe that collaboration, frequent team engagements, and face-to-face meetings bring together different perspectives and thoughts – enabling every voice to be heard and every perspective to be respected. No matter where or how our teammates work, we are committed to positively shaping people’s careers and being thoughtful about employee wellbeing.

With us, you can create and contribute to what matters most in your career, community, country, and world. Join us in powering the progress of global aerospace.

**Digital Services Overview**

At Boeing Digital Services, we focus on practical innovation that drives tangible results for the aerospace industry. Our team leverages advanced technology and data analytics to develop solutions that enhance operational efficiency and meet the needs of our customers. We are dedicated to creating intuitive, scalable, and secure solutions that empower our customers, partners, and team members to succeed. Join us in creating the future of aviation technology, where your contributions will shape impactful solutions for airlines around the globe.

**Position Overview**

We have an immediate opening for a **Software Application Development Manager** to lead multiple teams developing digital solutions in Application Engineering. This role requires deep engineering experience, the ability to guide teams, and the use of the latest AI tools to build cloud-native systems for cutting-edge digital aircraft maintenance products.

The role will work closely with peer managers, developers, engineering and greenfield leadership, data science, and architects to deliver product features and capabilities with AI/ML at the center. In this role, you will serve as a hands-on manager for development teams and ensure the delivery of reliable production software

This position will report to the Engineering leader of the **Boeing Global Services (BGS) Digital Services** group and work closely with stakeholders across the globe.

**Position Responsibilities:**

**Process Skills and Techniques**

* **Project Management:** Proficiency in managing projects and customer milestones, including planning, resource allocation, risk management, and ensuring timely delivery of products and capabilities.

* **Agile Methodologies:** Familiarity with agile development methodologies, such as Scrum or Kanban, to facilitate iterative and incremental development.

* **Quality Assurance:** Knowledge of quality assurance processes and methodologies to ensure the delivery of high-quality, bug-free digital products.

* **Problem-Solving Abilities:** Adept at identifying and resolving technical challenges and issues that may arise during the development process.

**Leadership Skills and Responsibilities**

* **Leadership and influence:** The ability to lead and motivate a team of developers, designers, and other technical professionals to achieve project goals and meet deadlines.

* **Team Management:** The ability to foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment, encouraging open communication, knowledge sharing, and teamwork among team members.

* **Cross-functional collaboration:** Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including WO managers, engineering, design, marketing, sales, and customer support, to ensure alignment and successful product launches.

* **Stakeholder management:** Proficiency in managing relationships with stakeholders, such as clients, product owners, and other departments, to ensure alignment of goals and effective collaboration throughout the development process.

* **Innovation and Creativity:** The capacity to think creatively and propose innovative solutions to enhance digital products and meet user needs.

* **Communication skills:** Excellent communication skills to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams, stakeholders, and clients, and to translate technical concepts into non-technical terms.

* **Conflict Resolution:** The skill to identify and address conflicts or disagreements within the team or between stakeholders, finding mutually beneficial solutions and maintaining positive working relationships.

* **Active Listening:** The ability to actively listen to the ideas, concerns, and feedback of team members and stakeholders, fostering a culture of open communication and valuing diverse perspectives.

* **Negotiation Skills:** Proficiency in negotiation techniques to manage expectations, resolve conflicts, and reach consensus on project requirements, timelines, and priorities.

* **Remote Collaboration:** The ability to effectively collaborate with remote team members or distributed teams using various collaboration tools and communication platforms.

* **Cultural Sensitivity:** Awareness and respect for cultural differences when collaborating with diverse teams or stakeholders from different backgrounds and locations.
  

  

**Boeing First-Line Leader Assessment:** To be considered for this position, you will be required to complete an assessment as part of the selection process. Failure to complete the assessment will remove you from consideration.

**Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience):**

* Bachelor’s degree is required as basic qualification.
* Candidates must have at least one year of experience in a leadership role (team leader, temp manager, large scale cross functional project/program management, or formal manager experience) OR completion of the Boeing internal course “Exploring Leadership

* Demonstrated Software Engineering experience with involvement in all phases of the software development life cycle using various software development platforms

* Experience in Aircraft Health Management, Predictive Maintenance areas, Flight Management Systems and Aircraft performance computation/optimization

* Experience in Machine learning and data analytics

* Experience in Deep Learning and Neural Network models

* Experience in leading teams of production applications grade from scratch and modernized legacy systems — comfortable with both greenfield and brownfield and know when approaches like strangler fig or lift-and-refactor are appropriate.

* Experience working in large enterprise environments with disparate / distributed systems and multi-cloud setup – You know how to navigate organizational complexity and deliver despite of it.

* Prior experience in leading cloud-native architecture — containerization, microservices, event-driven patterns — and are comfortable with source control branching strategies and CI/CD automation

* Prior Experience in building and Leading integrated AI capabilities into real applications — you know what it takes to get an AI-powered or ML/LLM feature into production and keep it working.

* Familiarity with AI adoption and coding tools like Claude, Cursor, or Windsurf.

* Ability to understand and guide teams in applying AI responsibly and effectively across development workflows and customer-facing product features.

* Experience in evaluating AI feature quality, reliability, and operational readiness in production environments.

* Strategic Thinking, Critical Thinking, Innovative, Aviation SAAS application development, Cloud technologies, Organization Talent Management and Operational management

**Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience)**:

* Prior experience Flight Plan/Optimization, Aircraft Fuel planning and optimization, expertise in Lateral and Vertical flight planning, Air Traffic Management, Aircraft Health Management.

* Assists in the facilitation of team meetings across time zones

* Delivers informative, well-organized presentations

* Excellent verbal and written English, including grammar

* Problem Solving

* Identifies critical issues with ease

* Exhibits confidence and extensive knowledge of emerging industry practices when solving business problems

* Must have experience working with cross-functional teams spread across multiple products

* Must be flexible, with a high tolerance for organizational complexity and ability to work with partners from within Boeing and outside, across different cultures and time-zones

* Pushes creative thinking beyond the boundaries of existing industry practices and client mindset

* Comfortable in making recommendations, setting technical directions

**Typical Education & Experience:**

* Education/experience typically acquired through advanced education (e.g. Bachelor) and typically 12 + years’ related work experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience (e.g. Master 11+ Years ) related in computer science, aerospace or other closely related field.

**Relocation:**

* Relocation assistance is provided for this position based on candidate’s eligibility
  

  

Applications for this position will be accepted until **Nov. 29, 2026**

  
  

**Export Control Requirements:**

This is not an Export Control position.

Bachelor's Degree or Equivalent Required

**Relocation**

This position offers relocation based on candidate eligibility.

Employer will not sponsor applicants for employment visa status.

Not a Shift Worker (India)

We do not accept unlawful discrimination in our recruitment or employment practices on any grounds including but not limited to; race, color, ethnicity, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military and veteran status, or other characteristics covered by applicable law.

We have teams in more than 65 countries, and each person plays a role in helping us become one of the world’s most innovative, diverse and inclusive companies. Accommodations may include but are not limited to: conducting interviews in accessible locations that accommodate mobility needs, encouraging candidates to bring and use any existing assistive technology such as screen readers and offering flexible interview formats such as virtual or phone interviews.

No matter where you are in life, our benefits help prepare you for the present and the future.

title: Sr Staff Engineer - MLE
description:
**About the role and team**  
  
Uber’s Customer Obsession team builds the platforms and AI that power customer support across mobile, web, and voice at global scale. This role offers the opportunity to architect, bring into production, and scale an autonomous support agent that resolves customer issues end to end.  
  
The engineering challenge spans LLM orchestration, agentic planning, retrieval and reasoning, multilingual support, and real-time voice. Success means delivering grounded, policy-aligned conversations while meeting demanding standards for reliability, safety, latency, and cost efficiency.  
  
The work is still at an early stage. You will help shape the architecture and technical roadmap, turn emerging GenAI capabilities into production systems, and guide multiple teams through experimentation and rollout. We value a bias for action and creative use of GenAI tools to accelerate learning and execution.  
  
The Career Proposition  

* **Shape a foundational AI capability:** Define the architecture for autonomous support agents, including planning and execution loops, memory, tool use, knowledge routing, and policy enforcement.
* **Deliver global customer impact:** Build systems designed to handle millions of conversations, improve resolution quality, and reduce cost per contact across languages and markets.
* **Advance conversational and voice AI:** Guide low-latency voice experiences spanning streaming speech recognition and synthesis, natural turn-taking, interruption handling, and telephony or WebRTC integration.
* **Set the quality bar:** Establish offline evaluations, simulated scenarios, safety tests, and human-calibrated LLM-as-judge evaluations integrated into development and release workflows.
* **Own production excellence:** Design service-level objectives, fallbacks, human handoff, canary releases, and safeguards against prompt injection, jailbreaks, hallucinations, and exposure of personal information.
* **Lead through technical influence:** Set strategy across multiple engineering teams, mentor senior engineers, and align Product, Design, and Operations on coverage, localization, and rollout decisions.

  
What We’re Looking For  
  
Minimum qualifications  

* 10+ years building production ML or AI systems, including 4+ years leading complex ML initiatives end to end.
* Deep expertise in LLM-driven systems, including inference optimization, prompt and program design, model adaptation, safety controls, and evaluation.
* Strong software engineering skills in Python and at least one of Go, Java, or C++, with hands-on experience in distributed services and production infrastructure.
* Demonstrated ownership of highly available services, including service-level objectives, incident response, on-call leadership, and post-incident improvements.
* A track record of shipping customer-facing intelligent experiences with measurable impact through A/B testing and rigorous metrics.
* Ability to set technical direction across teams, lead architectural decisions, and mentor experienced engineers.

  
Preferred qualifications  

* Experience building production agentic architectures using planning, execution, memory, and multi-step reasoning.
* Expertise in retrieval-augmented generation over complex, policy-heavy knowledge bases and integrating agents with structured workflows.
* Experience with voice agents, including streaming ASR/TTS, barge-in, endpointing, telephony, WebRTC, and conversational quality evaluation.
* Experience building support automation for large consumer platforms, including routing, policy codification, agent assistance, and automated resolution.
* Experience with multilingual language understanding and generation, code-switching, or low-resource languages.
* Practical experience with fine-tuning, distillation, or parameter-efficient adaptation techniques such as LoRA.
* Experience with hallucination mitigation, safety red-teaming, privacy-conscious system design, and controlled production rollouts.

  
**Ready to Ride?**  
  
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.  
  
Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.  
  
Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
**Company Description**

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**

We build the platform that powers ServiceNow AI Workers: autonomous agents that resolve incidents, complete tasks and learn from every interaction. Our engineers work across retrieval, evaluation, agent memory and learning, runtime infrastructure and customer delivery. The goal is simple: give people AI teammates they can trust, so they can spend their time on the work that matters most.

**What you’ll do**

* Design, build and run core services for the AI Worker platform, including agent runtime, orchestration, tool calling and skill management.
* Build retrieval pipelines that ground agents in enterprise knowledge, using hybrid search, embeddings, reranking and the ServiceNow AI Search stack.
* Develop memory and learning capabilities so agents improve from past resolutions, knowledge articles and human feedback.
* Create evaluation frameworks, including offline benchmarks, LLM-as-judge scoring, ablation studies and production quality monitoring, so we can measure whether agents are actually getting better.
* Integrate deeply with the Now Platform through scoped apps, GlideRecord, Flow Designer and platform APIs, and make AI capabilities easy for other teams to consume.
* Partner with product, architecture and customer delivery teams to take features from prototype to production with real customers.
* Own reliability, latency, cost and observability for the services you build.
* Raise the bar through design reviews, code reviews and mentoring.

  
**Qualifications**  

* 2 to 4 years of software engineering experience, with at least 2 years building ML, LLM or AI-powered systems in production.
* Strong programming skills in Java, JavaScript or Python, and solid understanding of distributed systems and API design.
* Hands-on experience with LLM application patterns: prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation, tool or function calling, and agent frameworks.
* Experience with vector search, embeddings and information retrieval concepts.
* A measurement mindset: you’ve designed evals or experiments and used the results to make decisions.
* Clear communication and comfort working with distributed teams across time zones.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Nice to have**

* ServiceNow platform development experience (scoped apps, AI Search, Flow Designer, Now Assist).
* Experience with agent memory, continual learning or feedback-driven improvement loops.
* Background in IT service management or enterprise workflow automation.
* Contributions to open-source AI tooling or published work on agents, retrieval or evaluation.

  
**Additional Information**

**Work Personas**

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.

**Accommodations**

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.

**Export Control Regulations**

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

description:
**Company Description**

Version 1 has celebrated 30 years in business and continues to be trusted by global brands to deliver technology and transformation solutions that drive customer success. The role focuses on developing production-grade AI applications, integrating AI models into business systems, and supporting the full AI development lifecycle.

The ideal candidate is passionate about modern AI technologies, software engineering best practices, and delivering reliable AI solutions at scale.

**Key Responsibilities**

**AI Application Development**

* Design, build, and maintain AI-powered applications and services.
* Develop and deploy Machine Learning and Generative AI solutions.
* Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems and AI agents.
* Integrate foundation models and APIs into enterprise applications.
* Create reusable AI components and frameworks.

**Machine Learning Engineering**

* Train, fine-tune, evaluate, and deploy ML models.
* Develop feature engineering and model evaluation pipelines.
* Implement model monitoring and performance tracking.
* Optimize model inference performance and cost efficiency.

**Generative AI Engineering**

* Develop LLM-based applications and workflows.
* Build prompt templates, agent frameworks, and orchestration pipelines.
* Implement vector search and knowledge retrieval systems.
* Design evaluation frameworks for AI quality, safety, and reliability.

* Monitor model performance in production, detecting drift and degradation.
* Manage feature stores and ensure data pipeline reliability for ML workloads.
* Implement experiment tracking and reproducibility across the model lifecycle.

**Collaboration**

* Work closely with Solution Architects, Product Managers, and Engineering Teams.
* Participate in code reviews and technical design discussions.
* Support testing, deployment, and ongoing optimisation activities.

  
**Qualifications**

**Programming & Engineering**

* Strong proficiency in:
  + Python
  + SQL

**AI & Machine Learning**

* Experience with:
  + Scikit-learn
  + PyTorch and/or TensorFlow
  + Hugging Face
  + Main AI services from leading cloud service and model providers
  + Supervised and unsupervised learning
  + Model evaluation
  + Feature engineering
  + Statistical concepts

**Generative AI**

* Practical experience building:
  + RAG systems
  + AI agents
  + LLM-powered applications
  + Vector search solutions
* Familiarity with:
  + LangChain
  + LlamaIndex
  + Semantic Kernel
  + LangGraph

**Cloud & Infrastructure**

* Experience with AWS.
* Docker and containerization.
* Kubernetes (preferred).
* CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.

**Professional Experience**

* 3+ years in ML engineering or data science, with demonstrable experience deploying models to production and building Gen AI applications including RAG systems, LLM integration, or agentic workflows
* Demonstrated experience delivering AI solutions into production environments.

  
**Additional Information**

**Why Version 1?**

At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their wellbeing, professional growth, and financial stability.

* Share in our success with our Quarterly Performance-Related Profit Share Scheme, where employees collectively benefit from a share of our company's profits
* Strong Career Progression & mentorship coaching through our Strength in Balance & Leadership schemes with a dedicated quarterly Pathways Career Development programme

* Employee Wellbeing schemes including Gym Discounts, Bike to Work, Fitness classes, Mindfulness Workshops, Employee Assistance Programme and much more. Generous holiday allowance, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, marriage/civil partnership leave and special leave policies
* Educational assistance, incentivised certifications, and accreditations, including AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, and Red Hat
* Reward schemes including Version 1’s Annual Excellence Awards & ‘Call-Out’ platform.

description:
### **Top 3 Reasons To Join Us**

### **About Us**

At CoverGo, our mission is to empower all insurance companies to make insurance 100% digital and accessible to everyone.

* We are a leading global no-code insurance platform for health, life, and P&C
* We’re the winner of the Insurtech of the Year in all of Asia and other awards globally
* We work with insurance enterprise clients such as AXA, Bupa, MSIG, Dai-ichi, Bank of China Group Insurance, and many more
* We're an international, diverse team of over 200 people with 30 nationalities and team members working remotely from all over the world
* We are fully funded and backed by reputable VC funds and strategic institutional investors
* We have a global presence in Asia, EMEA and the Americas
* We’ve grown our annualized revenue by over 30x since January 2021
* We’re constantly working towards making CoverGo a workplace that you love coming to. We deeply believe that bringing together a diversity of thoughts, expressions, and perspectives is key to building the best culture for equally diverse communities all over the world

### **About The Role**

CoverGo is hiring an Application Security Engineer to use AI to find and prevent vulnerabilities before they reach production, and to give engineering teams the tools and guardrails that stop vulnerabilities from being introduced in the first place. The Security team is small and growing, and works AI-first: everyone uses AI to automate their own work and to scale security across a large engineering organisation.

### **What You Will Do**

* Use AI tools such as Claude and OpenAI models to find and triage vulnerabilities in code, dependencies and designs before changes are merged.
* Embed security checks into developer workflows and CI/CD pipelines so issues surface as code is written.
* Select, configure and tune code-security tools such as GitHub Advanced Security, Snyk and Checkmarx, keeping the signal high enough that engineers act on the findings.
* Build self-service tools, guardrails and guidance that help engineering teams prevent common vulnerability classes.
* Partner with engineering leads and security champions across product teams to prioritise and fix findings.
* Review security-relevant designs and changes, ranking risk by what an attacker could realistically reach.
* Track and report on application-security risk and remediation progress.

### **What We Need**

* 3+ years in application security or a closely related security role.
* An AI-native approach to securing software: you already use LLMs to find, detect and explain vulnerabilities.
* Enough fluency in at least one modern programming language to read, understand and fix vulnerable code. A software-engineering background is not required.
* Hands-on experience with code-security tools such as GitHub Advanced Security, Snyk or Checkmarx.
* A solid grasp of common vulnerability classes, such as the OWASP Top 10, and how to prevent them.
* A practical, enabling style of working with engineers.

### **Nice to have**

* Experience building custom security tooling or automations on LLM APIs.
* Experience securing applications on AWS, Azure or GCP.
* Experience in insurance, financial services or another regulated SaaS environment.

### **Why You'll Love Working Here**

* Paid Annual Leaves
* Annual Performance Bonus
* Health Insurance
* Remote Work Allowance
* Anniversary Bonus
* Company activities and events
* Learning and development plan

title: Cyber Security Engineer
description:
**1. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Robotics & Embedded Systems Security**

* Perform security assessments of robotic systems and connected hardware.
* Identify vulnerabilities in robot communication protocols and interfaces.
* Assess ROS/ROS2 communication security, middleware, and exposed services.
* Evaluate authentication, authorization, and access control mechanisms.
* Test security of robot controllers, sensors, actuators, and connected devices.
* Assess risks associated with remote robot access and control interfaces.
* Recommend security improvements for robot-to-server and robot-to-robot communication

**B. Application Security & Testing**

* Perform security testing of Android, web, and desktop applications.
* Conduct vulnerability assessments and penetration testing.
* Identify authentication, authorization, session management, and data protection issues.
* Test for common vulnerabilities, including OWASP Top 10.
* Assess secure storage, API communication, and application permissions.
* Evaluate application resilience against reverse engineering and common attack techniques.

**C. Backend & API Security**

* Perform security assessments of backend services built using Django, FastAPI, Flask, Node.js, or similar frameworks.
* Conduct API penetration testing and vulnerability assessments.
* Identify SQL injection, authentication bypass, privilege escalation, and insecure access control vulnerabilities.
* Assess JWT, OAuth2, API keys, and session management.
* Evaluate database security, encryption, secrets management, and server configurations.
* Review Docker containers, Linux servers, and cloud infrastructure security.

**D. Wi-Fi & Network Security**

* Perform Wi-Fi security assessments and wireless network audits.
* Evaluate WPA2/WPA3 configurations and network access controls.
* Identify insecure wireless configurations and exposed network services.
* Conduct network vulnerability assessments.
* Assess firewall configurations, VLAN segmentation, and network isolation.
* Evaluate security of communication between robots, edge devices, servers, and cloud platforms.
* Recommend secure network architecture for robotics deployments.

**E. Security Auditing & Reporting**

* Conduct regular vulnerability assessments and security audits.
* Prepare detailed vulnerability reports with severity ratings.
* Perform risk assessments and recommend remediation strategies.
* Validate security fixes through retesting.
* Maintain security documentation and testing records.
* Establish security best practices and guidelines for development teams.

**2. Required Technical Skills**

* Strong knowledge of Cybersecurity and Information Security.
* Experience with penetration testing and vulnerability assessment.
* Knowledge of OWASP Top 10 and OWASP API Security Top 10.
* Familiarity with Kali Linux and Linux administration.
* Experience with tools such as Burp Suite, Nmap, Wireshark, Metasploit, and OWASP ZAP.
* Understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, SSH, VPNs, and wireless protocols.
* Knowledge of Python, Bash, or other scripting languages.
* Understanding of REST APIs, databases, and backend architectures.
* Knowledge of Android application security and web application testing.
* Familiarity with Docker and cloud security fundamentals.

**3. Preferred Skills**

* Experience in ROS/ROS2 security.
* Knowledge of IoT and embedded systems security.
* Understanding of robot communication protocols and industrial networks.
* Familiarity with MQTT, DDS, and RTPS security.
* Experience with firmware security assessments.
* Knowledge of secure SDLC and DevSecOps.
* Familiarity with threat modelling and security frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, NIST, and ISO 27001.

**4. Educational Qualifications**

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in:

- Cybersecurity

- Computer Science

- Information Technology

- Information Security

- Electronics and Communication Engineering

**Relevant certifications are an advantage:**

* **CEH**
* **OSCP**
* **CompTIA Security+**
* **eJPT**
* **PNPT**

**5. Expected Deliverables**

* Security assessment reports for robotic systems.
* Mobile and web application penetration testing reports.
* Backend and API security audit reports.
* Wireless and network security assessment reports.
* Vulnerability tracking and remediation documentation.
* Security recommendations and implementation guidelines.
* Periodic security audits and regression testing.

**6. Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate should be a hands-on security professional who can work across hardware, robotics, applications, backend systems, and network infrastructure.

We are particularly interested in someone who can understand the complete technology stack, identify security weaknesses across interconnected systems, and collaborate with AI, robotics, and software engineering teams to build secure products.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. title: Software Application Development Manager
description:
At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.

**Overview**

Boeing is the world's largest aerospace company and leading manufacturer of commercial airplanes and defense, space and security systems. We are engineers and technicians. Skilled scientists and thinkers. Bold innovators and dreamers. Join us, and you can build something better for yourself, for our customers and for the world.

As a leading global aerospace company, Boeing develops, manufactures and services commercial airplanes, defense products and space systems for customers in more than 150 countries. As a top U.S. exporter, the company leverages the talents of a global supplier base to advance economic opportunity, sustainability and community impact. Boeing’s team is committed to innovating for the future, leading with sustainability, and cultivating a culture based on the company’s core values of safety, quality and integrity.

**Technology for today and tomorrow**

The Boeing India Engineering & Technology Center (BIETC) is a 5500+ engineering workforce that contributes to global aerospace growth. Our engineers deliver cutting-edge R&D, innovation, and high-quality engineering work in global markets, and leverage new-age technologies such as AI/ML, IIoT, Cloud, Model-Based Engineering, and Additive Manufacturing, shaping the future of aerospace.

**People-driven culture**

At Boeing, we believe creativity and innovation thrives when every employee is trusted, empowered, and has the flexibility to choose, grow, learn, and explore. We offer variable arrangements depending upon business and customer needs, and professional pursuits that offer greater flexibility in the way our people work. We also believe that collaboration, frequent team engagements, and face-to-face meetings bring together different perspectives and thoughts – enabling every voice to be heard and every perspective to be respected. No matter where or how our teammates work, we are committed to positively shaping people’s careers and being thoughtful about employee wellbeing.

With us, you can create and contribute to what matters most in your career, community, country, and world. Join us in powering the progress of global aerospace.

**Digital Services Overview**

At Boeing Digital Services, we focus on practical innovation that drives tangible results for the aerospace industry. Our team leverages advanced technology and data analytics to develop solutions that enhance operational efficiency and meet the needs of our customers. We are dedicated to creating intuitive, scalable, and secure solutions that empower our customers, partners, and team members to succeed. Join us in creating the future of aviation technology, where your contributions will shape impactful solutions for airlines around the globe.

**Position Overview**

We have an immediate opening for a **Software Application Development Manager** to lead multiple teams developing digital solutions in Application Engineering. This role requires deep engineering experience, the ability to guide teams, and the use of the latest AI tools to build cloud-native systems for cutting-edge digital aircraft maintenance products.

The role will work closely with peer managers, developers, engineering and greenfield leadership, data science, and architects to deliver product features and capabilities with AI/ML at the center. In this role, you will serve as a hands-on manager for development teams and ensure the delivery of reliable production software

This position will report to the Engineering leader of the **Boeing Global Services (BGS) Digital Services** group and work closely with stakeholders across the globe.

**Position Responsibilities:**

**Process Skills and Techniques**

* **Project Management:** Proficiency in managing projects and customer milestones, including planning, resource allocation, risk management, and ensuring timely delivery of products and capabilities.

* **Agile Methodologies:** Familiarity with agile development methodologies, such as Scrum or Kanban, to facilitate iterative and incremental development.

* **Quality Assurance:** Knowledge of quality assurance processes and methodologies to ensure the delivery of high-quality, bug-free digital products.

* **Problem-Solving Abilities:** Adept at identifying and resolving technical challenges and issues that may arise during the development process.

**Leadership Skills and Responsibilities**

* **Leadership and influence:** The ability to lead and motivate a team of developers, designers, and other technical professionals to achieve project goals and meet deadlines.

* **Team Management:** The ability to foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment, encouraging open communication, knowledge sharing, and teamwork among team members.

* **Cross-functional collaboration:** Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including WO managers, engineering, design, marketing, sales, and customer support, to ensure alignment and successful product launches.

* **Stakeholder management:** Proficiency in managing relationships with stakeholders, such as clients, product owners, and other departments, to ensure alignment of goals and effective collaboration throughout the development process.

* **Innovation and Creativity:** The capacity to think creatively and propose innovative solutions to enhance digital products and meet user needs.

* **Communication skills:** Excellent communication skills to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams, stakeholders, and clients, and to translate technical concepts into non-technical terms.

* **Conflict Resolution:** The skill to identify and address conflicts or disagreements within the team or between stakeholders, finding mutually beneficial solutions and maintaining positive working relationships.

* **Active Listening:** The ability to actively listen to the ideas, concerns, and feedback of team members and stakeholders, fostering a culture of open communication and valuing diverse perspectives.

* **Negotiation Skills:** Proficiency in negotiation techniques to manage expectations, resolve conflicts, and reach consensus on project requirements, timelines, and priorities.

* **Remote Collaboration:** The ability to effectively collaborate with remote team members or distributed teams using various collaboration tools and communication platforms.

* **Cultural Sensitivity:** Awareness and respect for cultural differences when collaborating with diverse teams or stakeholders from different backgrounds and locations.
  

  

**Boeing First-Line Leader Assessment:** To be considered for this position, you will be required to complete an assessment as part of the selection process. Failure to complete the assessment will remove you from consideration.

**Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience):**

* Bachelor’s degree is required as basic qualification.
* Candidates must have at least one year of experience in a leadership role (team leader, temp manager, large scale cross functional project/program management, or formal manager experience) OR completion of the Boeing internal course “Exploring Leadership

* Demonstrated Software Engineering experience with involvement in all phases of the software development life cycle using various software development platforms

* Experience in Aircraft Health Management, Predictive Maintenance areas, Flight Management Systems and Aircraft performance computation/optimization

* Experience in Machine learning and data analytics

* Experience in Deep Learning and Neural Network models

* Experience in leading teams of production applications grade from scratch and modernized legacy systems — comfortable with both greenfield and brownfield and know when approaches like strangler fig or lift-and-refactor are appropriate.

* Experience working in large enterprise environments with disparate / distributed systems and multi-cloud setup – You know how to navigate organizational complexity and deliver despite of it.

* Prior experience in leading cloud-native architecture — containerization, microservices, event-driven patterns — and are comfortable with source control branching strategies and CI/CD automation

* Prior Experience in building and Leading integrated AI capabilities into real applications — you know what it takes to get an AI-powered or ML/LLM feature into production and keep it working.

* Familiarity with AI adoption and coding tools like Claude, Cursor, or Windsurf.

* Ability to understand and guide teams in applying AI responsibly and effectively across development workflows and customer-facing product features.

* Experience in evaluating AI feature quality, reliability, and operational readiness in production environments.

* Strategic Thinking, Critical Thinking, Innovative, Aviation SAAS application development, Cloud technologies, Organization Talent Management and Operational management

**Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience)**:

* Prior experience Flight Plan/Optimization, Aircraft Fuel planning and optimization, expertise in Lateral and Vertical flight planning, Air Traffic Management, Aircraft Health Management.

title: Agentic AI Orchestrator
description:
**Job Summary**

The Agentic AI Orchestrator designs, builds, and operates the Investment Division's agentic AI workflows—the automated, multi-step processes through which AI agents read documents, reconcile data, draft analysis, and assemble reporting across the division's clusters. The role converts analyst workflows into orchestrated agent pipelines with human review gates, owns the division's prompt, skill, and agent library, and is accountable for the accuracy, auditability, and cost of every automated output.

The position anchors the division's AI-led operating model from the Chennai office, working alongside the Data Engineer (data pipelines and infrastructure) and the ML Engineer (models and evaluation), and serves as the bridge between the investment analysts and the division's AI tooling

**ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

1. Design, build, and operate agentic AI workflows for the division's recurring processes: document extraction and reconciliation, portfolio and company performance monitoring, report and IC pack assembly, and data-room processing.

2. Translate analyst and reporting workflows into orchestrated multi-agent pipelines with defined human review gates, so that no figure or recommendation is published without analyst sign-off.

3. Own the division's prompt, skill, agent, and plugin library: design, versioning, testing, and documentation, ensuring workflows are reusable across clusters rather than one-off chats.

4. Integrate agents with the division's systems and data sources — document repositories, custodian and administrator reporting, and the division's knowledge base — working with the Data Engineer on pipelines and access.

5. Build and run evaluation harnesses with the ML Engineer: accuracy benchmarks against verified ground truth, regression testing on workflow changes, and periodic audits of automated outputs.

6. Implement AI governance and guardrails: access controls and confidentiality boundaries for family and portfolio data, audit trails for every automated output, and compliance with the Group's AI usage policies.

7. Monitor agent performance, cost, latency, and failure modes; triage incidents, maintain runbooks, and drive continuous improvement of workflow reliability.

8. Train and support the division's analysts in AI-assisted working practices; capture their feedback and convert it into a prioritised automation backlog.

9. Maintain complete documentation of all orchestrated workflows, their data sources, model versions, and review controls, ensuring every automated output is reproducible and auditable.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Minimum Education Required**

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related quantitative field.

• Strong Python engineering skills: API integration, data handling, and production-quality code with testing and version control (Git).

• Hands-on experience building LLM-based and agentic systems in production: workflow orchestration, tool and function calling, and multi-agent patterns — using frameworks such as LangGraph or LangChain, or SDK-native orchestration (e.g. Claude Agent SDK). Framework experience matters less than sound orchestration design.

• Practical RAG experience: document chunking, embeddings, vector databases (e.g. pgvector, Pinecone, Qdrant, or similar), hybrid search, and retrieval evaluation.

• Experience building or integrating MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and tools, or equivalent connector architectures linking AI agents to enterprise systems and data sources.

• Familiarity with LLM evaluation and observability tooling (accuracy benchmarks, regression tests, tracing); disciplined prompt and skill engineering with versioning and documentation.

• Understanding of data privacy, access control, and audit requirements for confidential financial data; exposure to investment or financial reporting workflows preferred.

**Years of experience are required.**

• Minimum of 4 to 7 years of experience in software or AI engineering, of which at least 2 years hands-on with LLM-based or agentic systems in production, at a technology firm, financial institution, or data-driven enterprise.

title: Performance Reporting Analyst
description:
**Job Summary**

The Performance Reporting Analyst is responsible for consolidated performance measurement and reporting across the global portfolio and the Investment Division's other asset clusters, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and timeliness. The role owns the monthly and quarterly reporting cycle: collecting and validating data from custodians, fund administrators, and external managers; computing returns against benchmarks and targets; and producing the performance packs used by the Executive Director, the Investment Committee (IC), and family shareholders.

The position applies AI-enabled workflows to automate recurring extraction, reconciliation, and report production, and serves as the single source of truth for portfolio performance data across the India-based investment team and the Jeddah-based family governance structure.

**ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

1. Produce the monthly and quarterly consolidated performance reports covering the global portfolio and designated clusters, from custody statements, administrator reports, and manager reporting.

2. Maintain the division's performance database: positions, transactions, cash flows, and valuations, reconciled monthly to custodian and administrator records.

3. Calculate time-weighted and money-weighted returns (TWR/IRR) at portfolio, cluster, asset-class, and manager level, with realised and unrealised components separately identified.

4. Maintain the benchmark framework and produce attribution analysis by asset class, manager, and currency, explaining performance versus benchmarks and the IC's targets.

5. Prepare the quarterly IC performance pack and shareholder reporting with the Executive Director, including commentary, exceptions, and data-quality notes.

6. Track management fees, performance fees, and costs against provider agreements, and report fee drag as part of net performance analysis.

7. Build and maintain AI-enabled reporting pipelines for recurring document extraction, data validation, and report assembly, keeping human review over all published figures.

8. Liaise with the finance department to align investment performance records with the SAP accounting entries.

9. Maintain organised digital archives of all performance records, methodologies, and published reports, ensuring auditability of every reported figure.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Minimum Education Required**

• Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, or business administration.

• Strong understanding of performance measurement: TWR and IRR methodologies, benchmarking, attribution, and composite reporting (GIPS awareness preferred).

• Experience with custodian and fund administrator reporting and multi-asset data (public markets, funds, private assets).

• Proficient in Excel and financial systems; experience with Addepar or similar portfolio platforms preferred; working knowledge of Power BI or Python an advantage.

• Demonstrated ability to use AI tools for document processing and reporting automation, with disciplined verification.

• Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills and ability to manage recurring deadlines.

**Professional Certifications Required**

• N\A. (CIPM or CFA progress preferred)

**Years of experience are required.**

• Minimum of 5 to 8 years of experience in performance measurement, investment reporting, or fund operations at a bank, asset manager, fund administrator, or family office.

description:

**About Karbon Sixth (K6):**

Karbon Sixth (K6) is a fund-backed climate venture developing high-integrity carbon projects that translate measurable environmental improvements into commercially viable outcomes.

We specialize as a climate-tech aggregator and project developer operating at the intersection of environmental compliance and carbon finance. We specialize in nature based agricultural carbon projects and Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) credit structuring and compliance management.

**Role Objective:**

The voluntary and compliance carbon markets are driven by shifting supply-demand dynamics and corporate procurement strategies. We are seeking a Market Intelligence Intern to continuously analyze market trends, pricing data, and corporate buying behavior, providing strategic foresight to guide K6’s project development pipeline.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Global & Domestic Market Monitoring:**

  Track pricing, transaction volumes, and demand signals across the Voluntary Carbon Market (VCM) and domestic compliance markets, with a specific focus on nature-based solutions, agroforestry, and regenerative agriculture.
* **Trend & Gap Analysis:**

  Analyze market trajectories (e.g., the upcoming CORSIA demand surge) to identify structural supply shortages, emerging premium credit categories, and new corporate ESG mandates.
* **Methodology Analysis:**

  Analyze diverse monetization frameworks for the carbon and the EPR markets—including the Voluntary Carbon Market (VCM), the Indian Carbon Market (ICM), bilateral structures like the Joint Crediting Mechanism (JCM), voluntary mechanisms like the Gold Standard Plastic Waste Reduction standard—while actively monitoring industry news, policy shifts, and key climate summits to forecast strategic market movements.
* **Market Intelligence Briefings:**

  Prepare and deliver analytical presentations to the leadership team detailing macroeconomic carbon trends, competitor movements, latest developments and actionable market gaps on regular intervals.
* **Corporate Demand Profiling:**

  Monitor corporate sustainability reports and CSR funding allocations to identify potential off-takers and financing partners for K6 projects.

**Qualifications:**

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Economics, Business Administration, Finance, or Environmental Economics.
* Strong quantitative and qualitative analytical skills, with a capability to interpret market reports and financial data.
* An innate commercial acumen to spot business opportunities within raw market trends.

description:

JR116437

**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for** ***all*****.**

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

**ROLE**

Lead first-silicon bring-up, characterization, debug, and validation of advanced 3D NAND products. Establish whether silicon meets design intent and datasheet requirements, correlate simulation with measurements, and resolve issues that could affect product qualification, reliability, yield, or SSD/system integration.

This role provides a unique opportunity to develop end-to-end expertise across advanced NAND products, spanning circuit design concepts, mixed-signal simulations, first-silicon bring-up, silicon debug, product qualification, and manufacturing readiness. Engineers gain broad exposure to analog, mixed-signal, digital, firmware, memory-array, and system-level behavior while working closely with design, verification, firmware, product, and system teams.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Own validation strategies, coverage, and test plans for assigned NAND circuits and functions; define expected behavior, operating corners, and pass/fail criteria from product specifications and design intent. Be able to perform micro probing to validate and char internal signals at Wafer level and hands on experience with ATEs.

* Lead first-silicon bring-up, characterization, debug, and simulation-to-silicon correlation across voltage, temperature, process, timing, and workload conditions.

* Characterize and debug NAND subsystems including reference and bias generation circuits, bandgap references, oscillators, voltage regulators, charge pumps, sensing and page-buffer paths, high-voltage program/erase circuitry, memory-core drivers, control and timing logic, interface circuitry, trim and calibration functions, and firmware-controlled mixed-signal features.

* Investigate silicon failures with Design, Verification, Firmware, Test, Reliability, Product Engineering, and SSD/System teams. Form evidence-based hypotheses, design targeted experiments, identify root causes, and drive issues to verified closure through hardware, firmware, test-flow, trim, or workaround solutions.

* Convert silicon observations into engineering insight and product decisions by explaining deviations from expected behavior, assessing risk, recommending next actions, reviewing validation evidence, mentoring engineers, and improving reusable validation and debug methodologies.

* Mixed-signal verification

* Familiarity with Verilog/System-Verilog-based simulation and debug environments.

* Experience with validation, characterization, data analysis, scripting, or automation using tools such as Python.

* Strong technical communication, problem-solving, and cross-functional leadership skills.

title: Product Manager, GenAI Products (Enterprise)
description:
### **Who We Are**

Techdome is a product engineering company that helps enterprises move from “we should use AI” to AI running reliably in production. Our cross-functional teams of engineers, designers, and AI specialists build LLM applications, RAG systems, conversational assistants, autonomous agents, and workflow automation for clients in FinTech, Healthcare, E-commerce, EdTech, Logistics, and SaaS. Everything we ship comes with the security, integrations, and compliance that enterprise buyers require.

### **The Opportunity**

A GenAI demo is easy to build. A GenAI product that passes a security audit, stays within budget, keeps cost per query under control, and earns the trust of its users is not.

We’re hiring a Product Manager who wants to own that second problem. You’ll take products from the first client conversation through launch and growth, and you’ll be the one who catches the fuzzy requirement, the dropped handoff, or the hidden risk while it’s still cheap to fix.

### **What You’ll Do**

**Define the product**

* Turn a client’s raw idea into a clear product definition with realistic scope, milestones, timelines, and budgets.
* Learn each client’s industry, regulations, and compliance needs, and translate them into requirements engineers can build from without guessing.

**Get GenAI into production**

* Work with ML engineers to turn LLM, RAG, agent, and automation prototypes into reliable, scalable, and safe systems.
* Set and monitor the production metrics that matter: accuracy, latency, evaluation scores, and cost per query.
* Ensure every AI feature integrates with client systems through APIs and meets enterprise standards for security, data privacy, and uptime.

**Align the team**

* Coordinate UI/UX, frontend, backend, mobile, QA, DevOps, and business analysts so every handoff is explicit.
* Plan capacity and hold all parties to their commitments.
* Manage relationships with third-party partners, including LLM and cloud providers.

**Manage risk and communication**

* Run formal change control whenever scope, timeline, or budget moves.
* Raise delivery, technical, and AI-specific risks early, including hallucinations, prompt injection, data leakage, bias, and cost overruns.
* Track delivery in JIRA or Azure DevOps and keep clients and leadership informed with no surprises.
* Use AI tools to speed up documentation, planning, tracking, and reporting.

### **What You Bring**

**Required**

* 2+ years as a Product Manager delivering complex enterprise software on time and within budget.
* Hands-on GenAI experience, ideally having launched an LLM, RAG, or agent-based product, with a working understanding of the AI lifecycle and its risks.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams across design, engineering, QA, and DevOps.
* Working knowledge of Agile (Scrum/Kanban) and Waterfall, and of tools such as JIRA, Azure DevOps, Trello, or Asana.
* Enough technical depth in the SDLC, APIs, microservices, databases, cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), and CI/CD to challenge estimates and earn engineers’ respect.
* Good judgment on risk, change, vendors, and stakeholders.
* Strong written and verbal communication, including with senior client executives.

**Preferred**

* Familiarity with LLM evaluation, guardrails, and cost optimization.
* PMP, PRINCE2, CSM, CSPO, or an AI/cloud certification.
* Domain expertise in FinTech or Healthcare.
* Cross-industry experience and the curiosity to learn a new domain quickly.

### **Your First 90 Days**

* **Days 1–30:** Learn how Techdome delivers, meet the team, and get up to speed on active client projects.
* **Days 31–60:** Independently lead at least one project, owning the plan, risks, and client relationship.
* **Days 61–90:** Land a key milestone, make a visible improvement to how we run projects, and earn the trust of your team and clients.

### **Why Join Us**

* Technically demanding GenAI work across several industries.
* Daily collaboration with experienced designers, engineers, QA specialists, and AI experts.
* A real voice in how projects are planned, run, and delivered.
* The chance to build deep expertise at the frontier of GenAI.

description:

Amazon Business Onsite Buying Experience team owns the end-to-end Amazon Business website and mobile experience, enabling customers to (1) discover products and features via the business homepage, navigation, and search, (2) purchase through search, detail page, cart, and checkout, (3) track, manage, and reconcile purchases post-purchase, and (4) get help through conversational AI via Alexa for Shopping and Amazon Business Assistant.

The product leader also brings strong collaborative skills and ability to engage leaders from technical teams, go-to-market teams (sales, customer support, and professional services), and UX/customer research teams to communicate and/or draw insights on customer needs/pain points and drive consensus on investments.  
  
Key job responsibilities

2. Define three year product vision for the assigned areas that is a complement to the overall AB vision to serve different customer segments - from SMBs to Enterprises - on both desktop and mobile.  
3. Create a roadmap that meets current and future requirements for Amazon Business customer segments, such as enterprise, SMB and Micro segments.  
4. Work with other product managers in Amazon Business to ensure their roadmap and vision are aligned with a focus on cohesive experiences and reusable UX components/patterns. Own Northstar metrics for assigned feature area(s).  
5. Work with engineering teams to build scalable solutions that enable rapid experimentation and incremental optimization on a continuous basis once the initial solutions are delivered.  
6. Partner closely with other AB feature teams, go-to-market teams, UX/customer research teams, and Retail teams to deliver features in the assigned feature areas within the buying journey.  
7. Be the interface and subject matter expert for your assigned feature areas, create and nurture relationships with other AB feature teams and retail teams.  
8. Contribute to tech strategy of your features and provide guidance to tech teams to come up with future-proof designs.  
9. Drive effective teamwork, communication, collaboration and commitment across multiple disparate groups with competing priorities

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product

* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

* Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight

* Define and maintain the AI architecture, roadmap, and standards for the Support organization, aligned with Support, Product, and Security priorities.
* Identify, evaluate, and prioritize AI use cases across case intake, triage and routing, troubleshooting, case summarization, knowledge creation, client communication, quality audits, and major incident support.
* Design, build, and deploy AI-enabled solutions and workflows, including prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, and automation, integrated with ServiceNow and other support tools.
* Architect and curate knowledge sources, including knowledge articles, SOPs, known-error records, and case history, so that AI outputs are accurate, current, and relevant.
* Establish AI governance, including approved tools and models, data-handling rules, PHI and client data protection, output validation, human review, and compliance with applicable policies and regulations.
* Partner with Information Security, IT, Product Development, and Support leadership to assess risk, select platforms, and implement secure integrations.
* Define success metrics and report on AI adoption, accuracy, time savings, SLA and response-time improvements, and client satisfaction. Continuously test, tune, and improve solutions.
* Use AI and data analysis to identify recurring issues, trends, and suspected defects, and share insights with Product Development to support product improvements.
* Train, coach, and enable Support staff and managers on approved AI tools, effective prompting, output verification, and responsible use. Create guides, SOPs, and best practices.
* Stay current with emerging AI technologies, healthcare IT trends, and supported Altera products, and recommend improvements to the Support AI strategy.

**Secondary Responsibilities – Help Desk & After-Hours Support**

* Provide help desk and after-hours support by answering inbound calls and responding to email, chat, and monitoring alerts. Create accurate ServiceNow tickets that capture the issue, business impact, priority, contact information, and troubleshooting performed.
* Guide clients through troubleshooting with clear, professional communication, confirm understanding of the issue, and set expectations for next steps and follow-up.
* Troubleshoot client questions and technical issues involving system configuration, product functionality, SQL Server, and HL7 interfaces. Investigate issues using Windows Event Logs, IIS logs, and SQL queries, including multi-table JOINs.
* Identify root causes where possible, implement approved fixes or workarounds, validate service restoration, and update tickets with complete resolution details.
* Triage complex issues and route or escalate cases to the appropriate support, Development, Hosting, or Professional Services teams, providing complete troubleshooting details and business impact.
* Coordinate with internal teams during critical or major incident calls, follow established after-hours escalation and notification procedures, and support P1/P2 incident triage by gathering logs, analyzing error patterns, and documenting incident timelines.
* Maintain ownership of assigned tickets, communicate progress and blockers, and provide timely client updates in accordance with service-level agreements (SLAs).
* Maintain complete case documentation, troubleshooting guides, SOPs, and known-error articles. Provide clear shift handovers covering open issues, business impact, actions taken, ownership, and next steps.
* Use company-approved AI tools to assist with knowledge searches, case summaries, troubleshooting research, and drafting client updates. Verify outputs before use and protect client, patient, and company information.
* Participate in scheduled evening, overnight, weekend, holiday, and on-call rotations as part of the 24/7 support schedule.

**Qualifications**
**Academic Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Nursing, Pharmacy, Nursing Informatics, or related discipline.
* Equivalent combination of healthcare, clinical, and information technology experience may be considered.

**Experience**

* 2+ years of experience in technical support, healthcare IT, or a related technical field.
* Experience with generative AI tools and solutions, such as Microsoft Copilot or similar platforms, including prompt engineering and workflow automation.
* Working knowledge of ServiceNow or a comparable ticketing system.
* Understanding of responsible AI practices and data privacy, including protection of PHI and other sensitive information.
* Ability to define use cases and success metrics and to communicate results to technical and executive audiences.
* Strong written, verbal, and telephone communication skills with a customer-focused approach.
* Ability to troubleshoot software issues, prioritize multiple cases, and recognize when escalation is needed.
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams and working both independently and as part of a team.
* Basic knowledge of SQL Server and Windows Server (including IIS) is preferred.
* Familiarity with the U.S. healthcare industry, HL7 interfaces, and enterprise healthcare software is preferred.

**Travel / Shift Requirements**

* Some travel may be required for client engagement, collaboration, or onsite support activities.
* Primary work is performed during standard business hours. Availability for assigned evening, overnight, weekend, holiday, and on-call rotations is required to support the secondary help desk and after-hours responsibilities.

title: AI or ML Engineer
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

As an AI/ML Engineer, you will join our innovative technology team at Optum Technology to design, build, and deploy cutting-edge artificial intelligence and machine learning capabilities that transform healthcare operations. In this role, you will develop scalable GenAI models, Large Language Model (LLM) applications, agentic frameworks, and robust Python inference APIs deployed on Kubernetes infrastructure. Working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, you will leverage modern developer tools and semantic search capabilities to deliver highly accessible, impactful AI solutions across enterprise healthcare data.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Design, develop, and validate machine learning models using GenAI (LLMs, agentic frameworks) and traditional ML techniques on cloud platforms
* Write and deploy scalable Python APIs for model inference running on Kubernetes, ensuring efficient containerization and orchestration of agentic flows
* Develop and optimize Python-based analytical and machine learning solutions, leveraging libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, and Databricks to perform data analysis, build predictive models, and generate actionable business insights from large-scale datasets
* Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered solutions to address complex business challenges with an emphasis on responsible use of AI
* Evaluate emerging technology trends and best practices to inform solution design, architecture, and strategic innovation

* Utilize agentic coding and version control tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude) for efficient code creation, repository management, and technical collaboration
* Maintain rigorous coding standards, thorough documentation, and effective performance monitoring across all deployed AI/ML pipelines
* Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered solutions to address complex business challenges with emphasis on responsible use of AI
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Graduate degree or equivalent experience
* 6+ years of experience in software development, machine learning, data science, analytics, or AI/ML engineering
* 4+ years of professional experience in Python using core data science, analytics, and machine learning libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, Databricks)
* 4+ years of advanced SQL experience, including complex query development, data analysis, performance optimization, data validation, and deriving business insights from large-scale datasets
* 3+ years of experience applying machine learning techniques in enterprise environments, including supervised learning, unsupervised learning, statistical modeling, feature engineering, and model evaluation
* 2+ years of experience developing and deploying NLP or Generative AI solutions, including Transformers, GPT models, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, embeddings, and prompt engineering in production environments
* 1+ years of experience building, deploying, and maintaining RESTful APIs for machine learning or Generative AI model inference

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
* Hands-on experience with containerization and container orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes
* Experience with vision and speech models in GenAI (multimodal architectures)

* Demonstrated familiarity with agentic frameworks, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) architectures
* Demonstrated solid analytical, quantitative, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills
* Demonstrated solid written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present detailed technical analyses to diverse technical and business stakeholders

description:

Medline India was established in 2010 in Pune as Global Capability Center to support Medline, headquartered in Illinois, USA. Medline India offers a dynamic and collaborative work environment with ample opportunities to learn, innovate, and grow. We are seeking an experienced Server Operations Engineer with 4+ years of hands-on experience in managing, maintaining, and supporting enterprise server infrastructure across physical and virtual environments. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring high availability, performance, security, patching (Ivanti Patching Tool for large scale environment), monitoring, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management of Windows and VMware environments.
  
The Server Operations Windows System Administrator will be responsible for Infrastructure as a service (IAAS) based operational tasks at Medline. This will include configuring, monitoring, troubleshooting and upgrading systems in our on-premise, private cloud, and Azure public cloud platforms.

**Job Description**

**MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES**
==========================

  

**Server Administration**

* Manage and maintain Windows Server environments (2016, 2019, 2022, 2025).
* Perform server provisioning, decommissioning, and lifecycle management.
* Execute OS upgrades, migrations, and disaster recovery activities.
* Handle Active Directory administration including DNS, DHCP, GPO, and replication issues.
* Manage file servers, print servers, and application servers.
* Participate in an on-call rotation to provide incident management support to ensure system availability.
* Identify monitor, and troubleshooting Windows and system related issues including performance tuning and incident root cause analysis
* Automate preventive maintenance and operational tasks.

* Perform VM provisioning, cloning, snapshots, and resource optimization.
* Execute vCenter upgrades and maintenance activities.
* Monitor VMware cluster health and capacity planning.

**Patch & Vulnerability Management**

* Coordinate maintenance windows and server reboot schedules.
* Remediate vulnerabilities identified through security scans.
* Ensure compliance with organizational security standards – knowledge & Troubleshooting of CrowdStrike & Illumio

* Troubleshoot critical incidents and perform root cause analysis (RCA).
* Participate in on-call support and major incident management.
* Work with applications, networks, and security teams for issues if any & provide resolution.

**Security & Compliance**

* Manage Windows certificates (SSL/TLS) and certificate renewals.
* Review event logs and security alerts.
* OS related vulnerability fix & mitigation.

**Automation & Scripting (Good to have)**

* Develop PowerShell scripts for operational tasks and reporting.
* Automate certificate monitoring, patch reporting, and server health checks.
Utilize Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform.  

  
  
  

**MINIMUM JOB REQUIREMENTS**
============================

**Education**

Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field, or equivalent work experience

**Work Experience**

At least 4-6 years of experience in system administration

  

**Knowledge / Skills / Abilities**

* Operating System: Windows Server 2016/2019/2022/2025, Basic Windows administration (preferred)

* MS Technologies: Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, Ivanti Patching, IIS, Failover Clustering (MS & SQL – Good to know)

* Virtualization: VMware vSphere, ESXi, vCenter Server, VSAN, VM Migration & Storage VMotion

* Cloud (Preferred) – Microsoft Azure (AZ104)

* Knowledge of Microsoft PKI/certificates

* Experience with IIS and related services

* Knowledge of HPE hardware

* Ability to adopt emerging technologies such as Terraform (IAAS), Gitlab, GitHub.

* Demonstrate the willingness and ability to improve performance and capabilities across all areas of responsibility utilizing formal and informal training to maintain skill sets

* Good to have PowerShell Scripting & Automation knowledge.

* Consistently demonstrate excellent verbal and written communication skills

· This position may require up to 10 % travel, potentially including international travel & WFO as required.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field, or equivalent work experience
* 4+ years of experience in Server Administration and Infrastructure Operations.
* Experience supporting enterprise production environments.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.

**Preferred Certifications**

**Key Competencies**

description:
