**Job Summary**

We are seeking an Engineering Manager to lead the team that builds and runs our connectors framework. In this role, you will be accountable for the team’s delivery across several concurrent projects, from platform enhancements to large programs that need multiple teams to collaborate. You will lead by example as a hands-on technical manager, grow the engineers on your team, and remove roadblocks so the connector engineers who build on your platform can move fast.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* **Own Team Delivery:** Be accountable for delivering multiple framework projects and features at the same time. Make pragmatic trade-offs to deliver, and personally deliver features when the team needs it.
* **Lead Technically:** Stay hands-on and lead by example. Guide the team through large, complex projects that need several teams to complete, such as migrating on-premises connectivity to a cloud-managed agent or extracting the integrations code into its own service. Design features in the framework yourself when needed.
* **Direct Quality and Reliability:** Set the quality processes the team follows. Own framework reliability, including sync health, incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), and resolution of security findings.
* **Develop Talent:** Run 1:1s, performance reviews, goal setting, and career guidance. Enable ownership on the team, resolve conflict, and grow engineers into their next level.
* **Remove Roadblocks Across Teams:** Work closely with the connector development team, other product teams, SRE, security, and PM to keep work clear and unblocked.
* **Lead AI-First Engineering:** Train the team on our tools and processes, including AI-assisted development workflows, and set the discipline for verifying AI-generated code.
* **Drive Initiatives:** Run initiatives within the team, such as cutting the time it takes to build a new connector or reducing sync failures.
* **Keep Customers in Focus:** Understand customer use cases and problems, and use them to set priorities with PM.
* **Build the Team:** Actively recruit, lead interviews, and make hiring decisions.
* **Communicate Clearly:** Present plans, progress, and risks to engineering and senior leadership.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* **Identity & Access Security Domain:** Direct experience with IAM, PAM, IGA, or Secrets Management platforms.
* **Integration Platforms:** Experience leading teams that build integration frameworks, data pipelines, or SDKs used by other engineers.
* **Hybrid Connectivity:** Experience with products that run agents inside customer networks.
* **Multi-Site Teams:** Experience leading engineers across more than one office location.
* **DevOps & Observability Ecosystems:** Practical experience with progressive delivery, CI/CD pipelines, feature flagging tools, and monitoring tools such as Datadog.

**Impact**
----------

As an Engineering Manager on the connectors framework, you will lead the team that every connector in our product depends on. Your impact will be measured by your team’s delivery, the reliability of the framework in production, and the growth of the engineers you lead. Co-workers will look to you for clarity, technical judgment, and a steady path forward.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* **People Leadership:** Experience managing software engineers, including 1:1s, performance reviews, career development, and hiring.
* **Technical Depth:** Strong hands-on background with Node.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, and AWS, plus experience with data integration or distributed systems. Able to review designs and code with credibility.
* **Delivery Track Record:** Proven record of delivering large, complex projects that need collaboration across several teams.
* **Operational Ownership:** Experience running production services, leading incident response, and driving RCAs to durable fixes.
* **AI Tooling Adoption:** Experience leading a team’s adoption of AI tools while keeping review rigor high.
* **Conflict Resolution & Influence:** Able to resolve conflict, remove roadblocks across teams, and build strong working relationships with ICs and managers.
* **Communication:** Excellent presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to engineering and business audiences.
* **Customer Understanding:** Good understanding of customer use cases, problems, and considerations.

**Qualifications**

**Our Commitment**

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

title: Placement Coordinator (IT)
description:
Job description:

Role Overview

The Placement Coordinator – STEM is responsible for connecting students or trainees with employment opportunities in science and technology fields. This role focuses on aligning candidate skills with industry requirements in areas such as software development, data science, engineering, research, and emerging technologies.

Key Responsibilities  
1. Industry Engagement & Partnerships

* Build and maintain relationships with IT companies, engineering firms, R&D organizations, and startups
* Identify hiring needs in domains like AI, data science, software engineering, electronics, and mechanical fields
* Coordinate campus recruitment drives and industry interactions

2. Candidate Skill Assessment & Alignment

* Evaluate students’ technical skills, projects, and certifications
* Match candidates with suitable job roles (developer, analyst, engineer, researcher, etc.)
* Identify skill gaps and collaborate with trainers/faculty to address them

3. Pre-Placement Training & Readiness

* Organize technical training sessions (coding, tools, domain-specific skills)
* Conduct mock interviews (technical + HR) and aptitude tests
* Prepare students for assessments on platforms like HackerRank and LeetCode

4. Placement Coordination

* Plan and execute placement drives, hackathons, and recruitment events
* Coordinate interview schedules, technical tests, and hiring processes
* Ensure candidates are interview-ready and meet employer expectations

5. Internship & Research Opportunities

* Facilitate internships with tech companies, startups, and research labs
* Connect students with live projects, fellowships, and innovation programs
* Encourage participation in hackathons and technical competitions

6. Data Management & Reporting

* Maintain databases of student profiles, technical skills, and placement records
* Track KPIs such as placement rate, average salary, and domain-wise hiring
* Generate reports and insights to improve placement strategies

7. Post-Placement Support

* Monitor candidate performance and retention in technical roles
* Collect feedback from employers regarding skill relevance
* Support career progression through upskilling and certifications

8. Academic & Training Collaboration

* Work with faculty to align curriculum with industry standards
* Recommend inclusion of emerging technologies (AI, cloud, cybersecurity, IoT)
* Support development of industry-relevant projects and capstone work

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, or related STEM field
* 1–3 years of experience in placements, recruitment, or training (preferred)

Key Skills & Competencies

* Basic understanding of STEM domains and technical roles
* Strong communication and employer engagement skills
* Knowledge of technical hiring processes and assessments
* Analytical thinking and problem-solving
* Organizational and coordination skills

Preferred Attributes

* Experience in campus placements or EdTech/STEM programs
* Familiarity with coding platforms and technical interview processes
* Passion for technology and career development

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Number of students placed in STEM roles
* Average salary/package and job relevance
* Internship conversion rate (internship → full-time)
* Employer satisfaction and repeat hiring
* Student retention and career progression

Pay: ₹34,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

* IT Placement: 1 year (Preferred)
* Placement: 2 years (Required)
* NGO/CSR: 1 year (Required)

description:
**Join the Legacy of Innovation with FCI-CCM:**

Backed by a legacy of innovation since 1959, FCI has built over six decades of expertise in communications, continuously evolving to meet changing business and technology needs. By combining deep domain knowledge with innovation, FCI has consistently delivered enterprise-grade communication solutions that help organizations adapt to an increasingly digital world.

Today, FCI continues that legacy through its flagship platform, VARTA, an Insights-Led Customer Communications Platform that empowers organizations to unify customer intelligence, communication workflows, behavioural signals, and engagement orchestration to deliver intelligent, personalized, and real-time customer experiences.

**Broad Function:**

FCI is building advanced AI capabilities to help banks convert transactions and behavioral signals into relevant customer engagement and measurable growth.

The initial focus will be on credit cards, with a product designed for reuse across multiple banks and deployment within bank-controlled environments.

The
**Senior Applied Data Scientist / ML Lead**
will act as FCI’s hands-on analytical lead and will work closely with our banking/data-science co-development partner, along with internal Product, Architecture and Engineering teams.

The role will involve building, challenging and improving machine learning models while creating a lasting analytical capability within FCI beyond the initial engagement.

Roles and Responsibilities (not limited to):

**1. Applied Data Science & Model Development:**

Translate banking growth hypotheses into meaningful features, labels, models and measurable experiments in collaboration with the Product team and banking SMEs.

Build and evaluate approaches for:

* Transaction classification
* Behavioural segmentation
* Recommendation and ranking
* Customer propensity and targeting

Select the right approach for each problem, whether simple statistical baselines or specialized machine learning models.

**2. Model Evaluation & Experimentation:**

Own the complete model evaluation framework, including:

* Time-based holdouts
* Leakage prevention
* Class imbalance handling
* Model calibration
* Segment-level error analysis
* Treatment/control evaluation
* Separation of predictive accuracy from incremental business impact

Ensure that model success is measured not only through technical accuracy but also through measurable business outcomes.

**3. Production ML & Engineering**

Write production-quality Python, tests and reproducible training/evaluation pipelines.

Work closely with Data Engineering and MLOps teams on:

* Model deployment
* Monitoring
* Retraining
* Rollback
* Automated validation
* CI/CD for ML workflows

Ensure models are maintainable, reproducible and capable of being operated by other FCI engineers and client teams.

**4. Partner Co-Development & Knowledge Transfer**

Work hands-on with FCI’s banking/data-science co-development partner.

Reproduce partner results independently, challenge assumptions constructively and document:

* Model assumptions
* Feature definitions
* Evaluation logic
* Rejected alternatives
* Model limitations and risks

Mentor FCI colleagues through practical implementation to build internal capability and reduce dependency on external partners.

**5. Reusable Multi-Bank Architecture:**

Maintain a clean separation between:

* Reusable Core
* Model code
* Feature interfaces
* Evaluation logic
* Training workflowsn and Bank-Specific Components
* Data mappings
* Thresholds
* Configurations
* Client-specific artefacts

Support configurable onboarding of the product for subsequent banks without rebuilding the entire solution each time.

**6. On-Premises / Private Cloud Deployment:**

Design ML solutions for bank-controlled environments, including on-premises and private-cloud deployments. Ensure the solution does not rely on continuous public internet access or managed ML platforms.

Build deployment approaches that support:

* Containerized inference
* Offline dependency management
* Secure model execution
* Self-hosted monitoring and feature management

**7. Model Governance, Security & Privacy:**

Work within bank security controls and maintain proper model provenance, documentation and auditability. Support secure handling of sensitive banking and transaction data through:

* PII masking
* Encryption at rest and in transit
* Secrets management
* Access controls
* Secure self-hosted tooling

Support specialist-led assessment of privacy-preserving techniques such as differential privacy and federated learning, wherever required.

**Success in First 6-9 Months:**

**First 90 Days:**

* Reproduce partner baseline models.
* Establish evaluation methodology and feature documentation.
* Deliver at least one independently implemented analytical improvement.

**By Month 6:**

* Operate and improve agreed model workflows.
* Demonstrate reproducibility and segment-level performance.
* Clearly explain model logic and business rationale to Product and Engineering stakeholders.

**By Month 9:**

* Lead a controlled model or use-case enhancement.
* Enable at least one additional FCI colleague to independently execute critical ML workflows.
* Support reuse and deployment of the solution for a second banking client.

title: AI Lead – Agentic AI & Multi-Agent Systems (Immediate Joinee Preferred)
description:
5+ Years Experience, Technical Leadership, Hands-on Role

About Fegmo

Fegmo is building an AI-powered commerce intelligence platform that transforms product catalogues into intelligent, actionable commerce experiences. We are building autonomous AI agents that work together to solve complex commerce problems involving product discovery, enrichment, comparison, recommendations and decision-making.

We are looking for a rockstar AI Lead who can take ownership of our AI architecture, build intelligent agents, and lead the development of a scalable, production-ready multi-agent platform.

What We Are Looking For

Someone who:

* Has 5+ years of experience in AI/ML, Generative AI and applied AI engineering.
* Has hands-on experience building and deploying autonomous AI agents in production.
* Has designed and implemented multi-agent orchestration and coordination architectures (agents collaborating, delegating tasks, sharing context and producing unified outcomes).
* Can independently design AI architecture and make sound technical decisions.
* Is equally comfortable writing Python code, designing systems and leading a small engineering team.
* Can take an idea from concept to production without needing extensive hand-holding.
* Understands the difference between building an AI demo and building a reliable, scalable AI product.

Key Responsibilities

1. Agentic AI Architecture

* Design and build multi-agent systems with specialized agents working together.
* Develop agent orchestration, task delegation, workflow coordination and execution mechanisms.
* Design agent communication protocols, shared context, memory and state management.
* Build reusable agent frameworks that support dynamic registration of agents and tools.

2. AI Agent Development

* Build intelligent agents for product discovery, product intelligence, comparison, recommendations and commerce workflows.
* Develop agents using Python and modern LLM frameworks.
* Implement tool calling, function calling, structured outputs and context management.
* Build agents capable of interacting with APIs, databases, knowledge graphs and external services.

3. LLM Engineering

* Work with leading LLMs such as Gemini, GPT and Claude.
* Design effective prompting strategies, RAG pipelines and context engineering.
* Optimize token consumption, inference latency and model costs.
* Implement model selection, fallback strategies and evaluation mechanisms.

4. System Design & Scalability

* Design scalable, modular and loosely coupled AI services.
* Build tenant-aware AI architectures where each customer can have independently configurable agents, tools and data sources.
* Implement asynchronous agent execution, queues, retries and failure handling.
* Ensure observability, traceability and reliability of AI workflows.

5. Technical Leadership

* Own the AI engineering roadmap and architecture.
* Lead and mentor AI engineers.
* Establish coding standards, testing practices and AI evaluation frameworks.
* Work closely with product and engineering teams to translate business requirements into production-ready AI capabilities.

Required Technical Skills

Area

Expected expertise

Programming

Strong Python, asynchronous programming, FastAPI

Agentic AI

Multi-agent systems, agent orchestration, tool calling

Frameworks

LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, OpenAI Agents SDK or equivalent

LLMs

Gemini, GPT, Claude, open-source LLMs

RAG

Embeddings, vector databases, retrieval pipelines

Data

MySQL, Elasticsearch, Neo4j, Redis

Infrastructure

Docker, Kubernetes, GCP/AWS

Observability

LangSmith, tracing, evaluation and monitoring

Architecture

Microservices, event-driven systems, distributed systems

Good to Have

* Experience building agentic commerce, e-commerce or enterprise AI applications.
* Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Knowledge Graphs and Graph-based reasoning.
* Experience with recommendation engines and product intelligence.
* Experience building production-grade AI platforms for multiple enterprise customers.
* Understanding of AI evaluation, guardrails and human-in-the-loop workflows.

What Success Looks Like

In the first 90 days, the person should be able to:

* Own and establish Fegmo's agentic AI architecture.
* Build a working multi-agent orchestration platform.
* Develop reusable agents and tool integration capabilities.
* Implement end-to-end agent workflows for product discovery, comparison and recommendations.
* Establish tracing, evaluation and observability.
* Lead the AI engineering team and independently drive delivery.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are not looking for someone who has simply integrated OpenAI APIs or built chatbot applications.

We want someone who has built the intelligence layer of an AI product - someone who understands how agents reason, collaborate, use tools, exchange structured information, recover from failures and execute complex workflows.

The candidate should be a strong individual contributor first and a technical leader second.

title: Product Manager
description:
**About the Platform**

The Digital Office Platform is a multi-tenant, configuration-driven government case-management platform that lets many independent government bodies each configure their own case lifecycle

* data model, intakeforms, versioned workflows, roles, SLAs, notifications, audit and reporting
* and run real cases end-to-end withoutcustom code per tenant. It is built as ~20 independent Spring Boot microservices (engines), each owning its own PostgreSQL database, coordinated behind a Next.js web application, and deployed hosting-agnostic on sovereign

/ government cloud using open-source components. Tenant isolationis by tenant\_id; published workflow versions are immutable and live cases pin to their version; security and data boundaries fail closed.

**Role and Responsibilities**

1. Elicit, analyse and documentrequirements for each onboarding government body; prepare the BRD / FRD with unique requirement IDs, acceptance criteria and a requirement traceability matrix linking every requirement to a design element and a test case.
2. Translate each body’s case lifecycle into configuration — business object types and fields, dynamic intake forms (sections, rows, columns, conditional visibility, calculated fields), versioned workflows (stages, tasks, actions,transitions), roles / personas, rules / decision tables, SLAs, notification templates and dashboards

— so a new office is stood up by configuration, not code.

1. Define the workflow-versioning and in-flight case-migration policy: published versions are immutable, live cases pin to the version in force when filed, and any migration between versions is explicit, mapped stage-to-stage and audited.
2. Specify SLA, clarification, escalation and reminder rules, and the notification matrix (EMAIL / SMS / WhatsApp / push / in-app / webhook) per workflow stage and actor class.
3. Specify role-based access needs across the four actor classes — platform admin,tenant staff, citizens / applicants,and second parties / respondents — and the RBAC / ABAC / policy model with the IAM owner.
4. Define reporting and dashboardrequirements as curated,tenant-scoped datasets and named metrics (never ad-hoc cross-tenant SQL), and the KPIs each role needs.
5. Own the product roadmap,MoSCoW prioritisation, releasephasing and scope discipline across the ~20 engines; chair backlog grooming and sprint planning.
6. Coordinate stakeholders across government bodies,DIC and the platform team; plan and drive UAT, capture sign-off, and manage change requests through a controlled process.
7. Author and maintain productdocumentation — user manuals per actor class, configuration playbooks, release notes and onboarding guides.

**Qualifications and Experiences**

Bachelor's degreein any discipline with 5+ years of experience in business analysis/ product management for enterprise or government IT systems; experience with case-management, grievance-redressal or workflow platforms preferred.

**Required Skill Set**

1. Strong requirements engineering and documentation (requirement specifications, manuals, traceability) and stakeholder management across technical and non-technical audiences.
2. Business-process and workflow modelling (BPMN an advantage); ability to express case lifecycles as configuration rather than code.
3. Working understanding of multi-tenant SaaS, metadata / configuration-driven platforms, RBAC / ABAC, SLA design and notification workflows.
4. Knowledge of GIGW, accessibility and DPDP (Act 2023 / Rules 2025) compliance as they affect requirements.
5. Comfortable readingREST API contracts, data models and configuration schemas; proficient with Agile tooling (Jira / Confluence).

title: Senior Engineering Manager
description:
**Company:** Enlog Prime Energy Private Limited  
**Department:** Engineering & Technology  
**Reporting To:** Founder / CTO  
**Experience:** 5–7 years preferred  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

About Enlog

Enlog is an AI-driven energy management technology company building intelligent IoT solutions for monitoring, analysing and optimising electricity consumption across commercial buildings, hospitality, healthcare and industrial facilities.

Our product ecosystem includes Enmate, Enpro and Ensense, supported by our proprietary AI engine, Ensyte-AI, and a connected cloud and IoT infrastructure.

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager who can take ownership of our complete technology ecosystem and build the engineering foundation required for the next stage of growth.

Role Objective

The Senior Engineering Manager will be responsible for designing, managing and scaling Enlog's complete engineering ecosystem, covering embedded systems, firmware, IoT communication, backend services, cloud infrastructure and production deployments.

The objective is to establish robust engineering practices, improve system reliability and create scalable architecture without compromising the speed of product development.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role, not just a team management position.

Key Responsibilities1. Technology Architecture & Engineering

* Own the overall technology architecture across hardware, firmware, IoT, backend and cloud.
* Review existing systems and identify technical bottlenecks, risks and improvement opportunities.
* Design scalable and modular architecture to support increasing device volumes.
* Define engineering standards, technology selection and architectural guidelines.
* Maintain system architecture documentation and technical roadmaps.

2. IoT & Embedded Systems

* Oversee firmware development and hardware-software integration.
* Establish firmware development standards, versioning and release management.
* Manage IoT communication protocols, including MQTT, LoRaWAN and Wi-Fi.
* Implement reliable device communication, reconnection, buffering and offline data handling.
* Establish OTA firmware updates and remote device configuration.
* Improve device diagnostics, monitoring and remote troubleshooting capabilities.

3. Cloud & Backend Infrastructure

* Own cloud architecture, backend services, databases and data pipelines.
* Review MQTT broker infrastructure, message ingestion and data processing systems.
* Ensure data integrity, system availability and performance.
* Implement infrastructure monitoring, logging, backup and disaster recovery.
* Optimise cloud infrastructure and operational costs.
* Establish security standards for devices, APIs and cloud services.

4. Development Processes & Engineering Standards

* Establish a structured development lifecycle from requirement to production release.
* Introduce code reviews, Git workflows and development standards.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines and automated testing.
* Establish development, staging and production environments.
* Define release management, deployment and rollback procedures.
* Introduce lightweight documentation and technical review processes.

**Important:** Processes must be practical and risk-based. The objective is to improve engineering quality and delivery speed, not introduce unnecessary approvals or bureaucracy.

5. Production Reliability & Operations

* Take ownership of the technical health of live production deployments.
* Establish monitoring for device connectivity, telemetry, backend and cloud services.
* Define incident management, escalation and root cause analysis processes.
* Reduce production failures and recurring technical issues.
* Build tools and systems for remote diagnosis and issue resolution.
* Work closely with installation, operations and customer support teams.

6. Team Leadership & Management

* Lead and mentor firmware, backend, cloud and IoT engineers.
* Establish technical ownership and accountability across engineering teams.
* Conduct architecture reviews and engineering performance evaluations.
* Identify skill gaps and future hiring requirements.
* Build a self-sufficient engineering team with reduced dependency on founders.
* Coordinate technical priorities with product, business and operations teams.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated against the following areas:

KPIWeightageSystem reliability and production stability25%Technology architecture and scalability20%Development processes and release management20%Engineering delivery and execution15%Team development and ownership10%Documentation and automation10%

Additional performance indicators:

* Improvement in device connectivity and telemetry availability.
* Reduction in production incidents and recurring technical failures.
* Availability and reliability of critical cloud services.
* Percentage of deployments following defined release processes.
* Percentage of critical issues resolved remotely.
* Reduction in founder dependency for routine technical decisions.

Specific numerical targets will be established after an initial assessment of existing systems.

Required Technical Skills & Experience

* 5–7 years of experience in software engineering, IoT or technology product development preferred.
* Strong understanding of IoT architecture and embedded systems.
* Experience with ESP32, STM32 or similar microcontroller platforms.
* Strong understanding of MQTT, LoRaWAN and device communication protocols.
* Experience with cloud platforms, preferably AWS.
* Strong knowledge of backend architecture, APIs, databases and distributed systems.
* Experience with CI/CD, DevOps, infrastructure monitoring and automated testing.
* Understanding of firmware OTA, device management and production debugging.
* Experience managing and scaling production technology systems.

Leadership Requirements

* Ability to understand the complete technology ecosystem rather than individual components.
* Strong architectural decision-making and problem-solving capabilities.
* Experience managing engineering teams in a product-driven environment.
* Ability to balance technical quality with development speed.
* Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration.
* Ability to introduce processes without slowing down engineering execution.

What We Expect in the First 90 Days

**First 30 Days**

* Audit existing technology architecture and engineering practices.
* Understand hardware, firmware, cloud and live production systems.
* Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and dependencies.
* Assess the engineering team and current development workflows.

**Days 31–60**

* Prepare an architecture improvement roadmap.
* Establish development, code review and release standards.
* Introduce production monitoring and incident management processes.
* Prioritise critical technical improvements.

**Days 61–90**

* Implement initial CI/CD and testing improvements.
* Establish controlled firmware and backend releases.
* Improve production visibility and remote troubleshooting.
* Define engineering ownership and accountability.
* Present a long-term scalability and technology roadmap.

Why Join Enlog?

This is an opportunity to take ownership of the technology foundation of a growing IoT and AI-driven energy management company.

The selected candidate will have the opportunity to build engineering systems, influence product architecture, establish technical standards and create a technology organisation capable of scaling across thousands of connected devices and multiple customer deployments.

title: Lead Engineer System Engineering
description:
Lead Engineer System Engineering is an early-career lead electrical engineering role within GE Vernova’s Generator & Electrical Systems (GES) organization. It is designed for engineers seeking to broaden their expertise from component-level electrical engineering into system-level engineering. The role provides ownership of key engineering deliverables while offering exposure to multidisciplinary technical integration, customer requirements management, power system engineering, and project execution within a global power generation business. It is designed for engineers with a strong foundation in electrical and power systems engineering They are expected to take ownership of defined project deliverables, drive technical execution, and coordinate across multiple engineering disciplines while continuing to develop broader systems engineering expertise. The role focuses primarily on delivering key systems engineering outputs across Gas Power Order to Remittance (OTR) projects, including Power System Analysis, Electrical Load Lists, Customer Electrical Interface Lists, and Consumer Balance of Power. It also encompasses individual electrical design and engineering deliverables, including power system studies(such as Load Flow, Short Circuit, Motor Starting, Arc Flash, Insulation coordination etc), single-line diagrams, LV/MV distribution systems, cable engineering, and design changes, ensuring compliance with customer requirements, project specifications, applicable standards, and contractual commitments. The role requires a strong foundation in electrical and power systems engineering, good analytical and communication skills, and a willingness to learn. The Lead Engineer is expected to own assigned deliverables, support technical problem-solving, coordinate across engineering disciplines, and ensure timely, high-quality execution. The role also contributes to engineering standardization and continuous improvement, with a focus on Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost (SQDC).

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Work with Senior Electrical Engineers, TLs and CTHs to deliver Power system Analysis, Electrical Load List, Customer Electrical interface list, Consumer Balance of Power and other key systems engineering deliverables.

* Perform power system studies and simulations using DIgSILENT, ETAP, PSCAD and PSS®E.

* Prepare electrical drawings and design calculations covering SLDs, , cable sizing, battery sizing per IEEE/IEC standards.

* Support electrical equipment selection, sizing and specification development based on project requirements and applicable industry standards.

* Review vendor drawings, calculations and technical specifications; support ITO engineering, including BOQ preparation, RFQ development and technical evaluations.

* Develop and maintain project engineering documentation, including LV/MV distribution drawings, cable schedules, equipment specifications and design calculations.

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Mechanical, Controls, Sourcing, GEN-PE and PEM, to ensure effective engineering integration and project execution.

* Take ownership of assigned engineering tasks, proactively resolve technical issues and deliver quality outputs within agreed project schedules.

* Support engineering quality reviews, resolve design comments, incorporate lessons learned and ensure compliance with applicable engineering procedures and project requirements.
  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering from an accredited college or university.

* Minimum of 4+ years of hands-on experience in electrical equipment sizing, Load List Preparation, developing ordering specification, integration, power system studies, and technical problem-solving.
  

**Desired Characteristics**

* Advanced degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.

* Working knowledge of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML), with the ability to identify and leverage emerging digital technologies to improve engineering processes, productivity, and problem-solving.

* Experience supporting site erection and commissioning activities, with strong hands-on technical problem-solving skills and the ability to resolve field engineering challenges effectively.

* Commitment to continuous improvement, LEAN methodologies, engineering standardization, quality, and process simplification.

* Demonstrates unwavering diligence, sincerity, and meticulous attention to detail in managing complex design deliverables, taking deep personal ownership of accuracy, safety, and project success.

* Passion for innovation, technical excellence, and the development of reliable, efficient, and cost-effective engineering solutions.

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** Yes

title: Junior Research Fellow
description:
🚀 URGENT: We are hiring! Active Recruitment: One (1) Junior Research Fellow (JRF)

Opportunities are open for motivated researchers to join the Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF) funded PM ECRG project: "AI-Native Foundations for Interference, Connectivity, and Mobility Optimization in Next-Generation Networks."

**Executive project summary:**
Next-generation Networks (NGNs) are expected to deliver high data rates, uninterrupted services to underserved and unserved communities, increased end-user density, and enhanced communication reliability. The existing wireless mobile networks' transition from Fifth Generation (5G) mobile networks to NGNs, including Beyond 5G (B5G) and 6G technologies, introduces unprecedented architectural complexity, larger network density, and more heterogeneity, making interference management, resource allocation, and service reliability a critical challenge, where end users located in areas with underserved and unserved locations often experience interruptions while accessing broadband services.

This project will deliver novel theoretical models, AI-native algorithmic frameworks, and simulation prototypes suited for real-world NGN operations. Also, the proposal will design a UAV-assisted last-mile connectivity network, which strongly justifies national priority missions, such as Digital India, BharatNet, and the National Digital Communications Policy 2018. Therefore, the proposal also aligns directly with the goals of national connectivity and digital inclusion.

**Keywords:**
Next-Generation Networks, AI-Native Optimization, Multi-Objective CoMP, Mechanism-Design Models, UAV-Assisted Connectivity, AI-Native Mobility & Hand-off.

title: Metadata Engineer and Snowflake & CENtree
description:
Job Description: Metadata Engineer – Collate SaaS Implementation (Snowflake & CENtree)

1. Role Summary The Metadata Engineer will lead the implementation and management of Collate SaaS metadata catalog and governance solutions, focusing on integrating Snowflake and CENtree (ontology management) platforms. This role involves configuring metadata ingestion workflows, custom connector development, and mapping business glossaries to controlled vocabularies for enterprise data governance.

2. Must-Have Technical Skills

2.1 Collate / OpenMetadata Platform - Hands-on experience with Collate SaaS (or OpenMetadata OSS) - Configuring ingestion workflows (metadata, lineage, profiler, usage) - Managing connectors and ingestion pipelines - Working with Collate APIs & SDK (Python) - Setting up glossaries, tags, classifications, and policies - Data lineage configuration and troubleshooting - User roles, teams, and RBAC setup

2.2 Snowflake Expertise - Strong SnowSQL and Snowflake architecture knowledge - Configuring Snowflake connector in Collate - Setting up service accounts with least-privilege access - Knowledge of ACCOUNT\_USAGE and INFORMATION\_SCHEMA for metadata extraction - Query history and usage metadata ingestion - Lineage extraction from Snowflake query logs - Tagging, masking policies, and data governance features in Snowflake - Performance tuning and warehouse cost optimization

2.3 CENtree (Ontology Management) - Experience with SciBite CENtree ontology platform - Understanding of ontologies, taxonomies, and controlled vocabularies - Semantic data modeling (RDF, OWL, SKOS) - Integrating CENtree with data catalogs via REST APIs - Mapping ontology terms to Collate glossary terms - Knowledge of life sciences / pharma data (if applicable)

2.4 Integration & Programming - Python (for custom connectors, API integrations, automation) - REST APIs – consuming and building - YAML/JSON for ingestion configurations - SQL (advanced) - Custom connector development for CENtree → Collate sync

3. Data Governance Skills - Building business glossaries aligned with ontologies - Data classification (PII, PHI, confidential) - Stewardship workflows and approval processes - Compliance frameworks (GDPR, HIPAA)

4. Soft Skills - Stakeholder management – work with data stewards, scientists, analysts - Documentation – metadata standards, runbooks - Training – enable business users on Collate - Problem-solving – troubleshoot ingestion and lineage issues

5. Key Responsibilities 1. Implement and configure Collate SaaS for the organization 2. Set up and maintain Snowflake metadata ingestion (schema, lineage, usage, profiling) 3. Build integration between CENtree ontologies and Collate glossaries 4. Develop custom connectors / scripts where out-of-the-box options don't exist 5. Define data governance policies, tags, and classifications 6. Onboard data stewards and consumers to the platform 7. Monitor ingestion pipelines and resolve issues 8. Maintain documentation and best practices.

title: Staff Integration Engineer (Security Platform and Data Pipelines)
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.
  
  
We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.
  
  
**Role**
We are looking for a Staff Integration Engineer (Security Platform and Data Pipelines) to join our team. This is a remote based in India role, reporting to the Director, Software Development Engineering in the Technical Implementation and Integration department. You will be responsible for connecting and onboarding diverse cybersecurity data sources, mapping and normalizing security data to power exposure and threat management use cases, and customizing workflows to deliver measurable outcomes. This role requires technical depth, comfort with complex datasets, and the ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
**What You’ll Do (Role Expectations)**

* Build and update data mappings for exposure management sources from research specs. This covers vulnerability scanners (Qualys, Tenable, Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike), cloud security (Wiz, Prisma Cloud, Orca), application security (Snyk, AI scanners), device management (Microsoft Intune) and CMDB (ServiceNow). Test every change against raw customer data before it ships
* Investigate customer environments where data looks wrong or incomplete: missing fields, duplicate or stale vulnerabilities, one device showing up as several assets, or counts that don't match the vendor's console. Trace each one to its root cause in the raw data and ship the fix
* Compare vendor APIs and endpoints to pick the right source for each use case, and flag gaps and quirks back to the research team
* Support customer onboarding and proofs of value: get the customer's tools connected, check that the data that lands is accurate and complete, and fix what isn't
* Write clear root-cause notes and handoffs for researchers, engineering and customer-facing teams, and turn recurring issues into product fixes

**Who You Are (Success Profile)**

* You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
* You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
* You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
* You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
* You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

**What We’re Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)**

* Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
* 5 to 8 years experience in security engineering with hands-on experience integrating security tools into a data platform such as a SIEM, vulnerability management or exposure management product. You've mapped or normalized data from at least two of these: vulnerability scanners, EDR, cloud security (CNAPP/CSPM), application security scanners and CMDB
* Working knowledge of vulnerability and exposure data: what a scanner reports about assets, vulnerabilities and misconfigurations, how CVEs relate to vendor IDs and plugins, how one machine appears across tools (hostnames, IPs, cloud and agent IDs), and what CVSS and EPSS mean
* Strong Python and SQL. You can read a raw API response, write the transformation, query large datasets to check the result and debug a data issue end to end
* Comfort with vendor APIs: reading their docs, handling authentication, pagination and rate limits, and finding the field a use case needs

**What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)**

* Experience leveraging AI-assisted developer tools, automated profiling, or AI acceleration libraries to speed up mapping, testing or investigation
* API-level experience with any of the vendors above
* Application security knowledge: what SAST, SCA and container scanners find, and how their results tie to code, packages and images

title: Data and Digital Lead
description:
Digital Architecture and ABDM Integration

• Act as the district technical counterpart to the HIS and CCC technology partners. Review configuration, workflows, and integrations against the AECC architecture and interoperability standards.

• Track the ABDM readiness of every facility, including Health Facility Registry (HFR) entries, Healthcare Professionals Registry (HPR) IDs, ABHA linking and progress against ABDM milestones (M1 to M3).

• Lead go-live readiness for each phase, from Padampur CHC to district-wide coverage. This covers hardware and connectivity checks, user acceptance testing and sign-off checklists.

• Keep an issue and change log for each system. Monitor partner response against agreed service levels, and escalate unresolved issues through the Project Lead.

• Provide technical review of any digital procurement or initiative in the district, including kiosks and other DMF-funded investments. The aim is to ensure that each one plugs into AECC and does not create a parallel data stack.

• Coordinate with the State ABDM team, the State PMU and the agencies responsible for Government data hosting on integration and hosting matters.

B. ABHA and Citizen Identity Quality

• Monitor ABHA quality, not only coverage. Track Aadhaar-KYC-verified ABHAs, duplicates and active use at the point of care against cumulative issuance.

• Support validation and clean-up exercises, and the linkage of ABHA with the State family registry where approved.

• Work with facility teams and frontline workers to increase ABHA use at registration and in the scan-and-share workflow.

C. Data Quality, Standards and Governance

• Develop and maintain the AECC data dictionary, indicator reference sheets and master data (facilities, providers, services).

• Set up and run routine data quality checks for completeness, timeliness and consistency across the HIS, the CCC and existing Government reporting systems.

• Support the District Administration in drafting and applying a Data Use Policy. This includes role-based access, consent, data sharing protocols and the requirement that data are hosted only on Government-approved infrastructure.

• Ensure that project practice complies with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and the ABDM Health Data Management Policy.

D. RAG Governance Dashboard and PHWS

• Operationalize the RAG Governance Dashboard. This covers indicator definitions, Red-Amber-Green thresholds, data pipelines and review formats, starting with interim paper-based tracking where digital feeds are not yet live.

• Prepare weekly and monthly RAG reports for the District Collector as well as other senior leaders at the district level such CDMO and DPM. Prepare data packs in the standard reporting format for the fortnightly District AECC Steering Committee.

• Support facility teams in root-cause analysis of Red and Amber alerts, and track corrective actions to closure.

• Support the PHWS methodology and its quarterly measurement cycles, including registry-based sampling, computation, validation and publication at Gram Panchayat and ward level.

E. Analytics, Evidence and Learning

• Analyse care-pathway data on referral completion, follow-up adherence, missed appointments, waiting times and continuity of care. Turn the findings into short, decision-ready briefs.

• Establish baselines and track project indicators against the results framework. Support funder reporting.

• Make data and documentation available for the independent evaluation, and contribute evidence to learning reports, case studies and the State replication model.

F. Capacity Building and Transition

• Train and mentor facility staff, data entry personnel and the District Health Society's monitoring and data staff in using the systems, maintaining data quality and reading the dashboard.

• Prepare SOPs, user guides and data quality playbooks for the district repository of AECC materials.

• Prepare and carry out a phased plan to hand over data and digital functions to Government-designated personnel before the project closes.

G. Coordination and Reporting

• Work closely with the Project Lead, the Health Administrator, the CDMO office and facility in-charges in Keonjhar.

• Submit monthly progress reports on digital rollout, data quality and dashboard performance to the Project Director. Contribute to quarterly and annual reports to Swasti and the donor.

4. Qualifications and Experience

Education

• Master’s degree in health informatics, Public Health, Statistics, Data Science, Computer Applications or a related field; or a B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science or Information Technology with substantial public health experience.

• Certification or training in digital health, ABDM or health data standards is desirable.

Experience

• Minimum 6 to 8 years of relevant experience, including at least 4 years in health information systems or health data within government health programmes.

• Hands-on experience of implementing or integrating digital health systems at district or state level, including work with technology vendors.

• Experience with ABDM integration (ABHA, HFR, HPR, Health Information Exchange and Consent Manager) is strongly preferred.

• Experience of building dashboards or performance review systems used by district administrations is preferred.

• Prior work in Odisha, aspirational districts or tribal-majority districts is desirable.

**Job Summary**
---------------

The Senior CAS Analyst is an individual contributor responsible for strengthening client authentication and identity verification controls across Retail, Private and Business Banking. The role develops, implements and governs Client Authentication Standards; provides clear, risk-based guidance to business, operations, technology, compliance and fraud teams; and supports consistent adoption across markets. The role helps protect clients and the Bank by ensuring authentication requirements remain aligned with emerging fraud risks, regulatory expectations and secure banking practices.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Authentication standards and policy governance:** Develop, maintain and implement authentication-related standards, policies and governance frameworks in line with regulatory requirements, internal policies and the Fraud Risk Management Framework.
  
**Subject matter expertise and stakeholder guidance:** Act as a subject matter expert for client authentication and identity verification controls, including MFA/2FA, biometrics, soft tokens, OTPs, device binding and knowledge-based authentication. Interpret requirements and provide clear, practical guidance to country, business, operations, technology, risk and compliance teams.
  
**Consistent implementation across markets** : Drive consistent adoption of Client Authentication Standards across countries, customer segments and channels. Lead gap assessments, coordinate remediation, maintain implementation evidence and support cross-functional programmes that strengthen customer security while enabling business objectives.
  
**Risk, dispensation and control oversight:** Identify and assess authentication-related risks; review dispensations, risk acceptances and compensating controls; and ensure appropriate safeguards for higher-risk transactions. Maintain accurate documentation, approvals, governance records and audit trails, and support internal audits and regulatory reviews.
  
**Governance, reporting and continuous improvement:** Monitor compliance and control effectiveness, escalate material gaps, and provide transparent reporting to senior stakeholders and governance forums. Update standards in response to emerging fraud threats, regulatory change, industry practice and lessons from control reviews, while influencing outcomes without direct authority.

**Motivations**
---------------

This role suits someone motivated by solving complex fraud-risk and authentication challenges, translating policy into practical controls, and creating consistent outcomes across diverse markets and channels. The role will appeal to a collaborative, curious and action-oriented professional who values strong governance, clear evidence, continuous improvement and the opportunity to influence senior stakeholders while protecting clients and enabling secure banking experiences.

• Fraud Risk Management
  
• Client Authentication and Identity Verification
  
• Policy and Standards Governance
  
• Risk and Control Assessment
  
• Stakeholder Management and Influencing

• **Qualification:** Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience in banking, risk, fraud, technology, cybersecurity, compliance or a related discipline.

title: Senior Associate - Technology Risk Data Analyst
description:
**Senior Associate - Technology Risk Data Analyst**
===================================================

Req ID: 128067

Department: Chief Information Risk Office

Division: Risk

Location: Bengaluru

**About Us**
------------

**Standard**  
At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.

**About the Role**
------------------

As a Senior Associate, Technology Risk Intelligence in our Risk, Group Technology team, you’ll play a key role supporting the Technology Risk Intelligence practice to deliver trusted, repeatable and decision-useful risk insights and AI-powered agents to strengthen the Risk, Group Technology team’s ability to provide clear, data-led risk insight and challenge so the Board, Executive Committee and regulators understand material risk positions against risk appetite, policy, regulatory expectations and critical service requirements.

You will operate as a hands-on Associate, partnering with Senior Managers, Risk Managers and fellow Associates to deliver monitoring and analytics across material Technology and Information Security (Cyber) risk themes, support thematic reviews, events/issue analysis and governance, by collating evidence, analyzing indicators and synthesizing key risk theme insights. This will help to connect risk control and change signals to business impacts, service resilience, value chains and customer outcomes to improve oversight, challenge, risk measurement and quantification, prioritisation and risk decisions.

  

Using approved automation and AI-enabled tooling (where authorised), you will develop and enhance automated insight products (dashboards, repeatable insight analysis, trend synthesis and first-draft packs), while maintaining strong data governance, privacy/security controls, and clear human accountability. Partnering with Risk specialists across the team, you will play a key support role in the evolution of technology and cyber risk appetite, metrics and oversight priorities via constructive challenge, executive-ready risk opinions and escalation of material concerns.  
  
This role may also provide support for International jurisdictions, partnering (as directed) with country risk officers to provide Line 2 technology and information security support as part of a matrixed Line 2 oversight model.

  

Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.

  

**Role Type: Permanent**  
**Role Location: Bengaluru**  
**Work Hours: 7 AM to 4 PM**

**What will your day look like?**
---------------------------------

As a Senior Associate, Technology Risk Intelligence, you are accountable for:

* Supporting the Senior Manager, Technology Risk Insights to deliver the insights plan by contributing to prioritised insight use-cases aligned to risk appetite, Board/ExCo metrics and material risk themes
* Building and maintaining insight assets (datasets, definitions, lineage notes, dashboards and briefing packs) that provide timely, trusted insight on control effectiveness, resilience outcomes, risk-in-change and remediation progress
* Supporting and delivering repeatable insight routines (e.g., indicator analysis, trend synthesis, evidence collation and first-draft packs) using approved automation and AI-enabled tooling (where authorized), with appropriate controls, QA and clear human accountability
* Maintaining audit-ready artefacts and evidence packs (definitions, assumptions, lineage and supporting evidence) to support Line 2 oversight, Internal Audit and regulatory engagement as required
* Providing hands-on Line 2 risk capacity to support independent oversight, review and challenge activities across Technology domains and cross-cutting disciplines (e.g., preparing analysis, summarizing evidence, drafting risk commentary and supporting thematic reviews)
* Partnering with Technology Risk leaders and senior Technology stakeholders to strengthen risk measurement and governance narrative by supporting indicator design, thresholds, trend interpretation and implications
* Producing executive-ready insight packs and dashboard views that link metrics to material risk themes, decisions required and recommended actions, with review by Managers/Senior Managers as appropriate
* Supporting governance forums by providing analysis, drafting insight commentary and evidence summaries; assisting with review of papers to ensure decision-readiness and consistent messaging
* Providing insight-led contributions to thematic reviews, events/issues analysis and emerging risk horizon scanning, synthesizing themes and root causes
* Supporting PACT-aligned NFR uplift through monitoring and analytics that inform Line 2 oversight priorities and escalation
* Operating as a developing specialist within the team, role-modelling analytical discipline, documentation and responsible tool use

**What will you bring?**
------------------------

To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:

* Minimim of 7+ years of experience in technology/cyber risk, operational risk, assurance or risk analytics within a complex regulated environment
* Strong analytical and data skills: shaping datasets, defining metrics/KRIs, and translating analysis into clear risk insights, trends and recommended actions
* Experience building and maintaining repeatable insight products (dashboards, packs, automated reporting) with strong data quality, definitions and lineage
* Practical understanding of technology and cyber controls and resilience concepts to enable credible challenge and interpretation of indicators
* Experience implementing automation and AI-enabled workflows (e.g., Copilot/LLM agents) with appropriate governance, controls and human accountability
* Strong written communication skills to produce concise, governance-ready insight packs and support senior stakeholders with clear messaging
* Ability to operate in a matrixed model with prioritisation, delivery discipline, and partnering capability across geographies
* Demonstrated ability to operate across regions (time zones and cultures), tailoring insights for local governance while maintaining consistent Group standards and comparability

Good to have skills and experience

* Working knowledge of APRA standards relevant to technology and cyber (e.g., CPS 230, CPS 234) and evidence expectations
* Data science or engineering experience (e.g., statistical methods, NLP, MLOps) in a governed enterprise setting
* Exposure to international regulatory expectations for operational resilience/cyber and the ability to contribute to comparable risk insights and metrics (where applicable)

  

You’re not expected to have 100% of these skills. At ANZ a growth mindset is at the heart of our culture, so if you have most of these things in your toolbox, we’d love to hear from you.

**Job Posting End Date**
------------------------

20/11/2026, 11.59pm

description:
**About the role**

MillD is a high-protein atta brand that largely sells online — and we want to take the brand to where people actually live and gather. We’re looking for an Offline Activation Executive to plan and run on-ground activations that drive trial, footfall and first orders: society and apartment pop-ups, sampling drives, kiosks, experiential events, and tie-ups with gyms, corporates, colleges and local communities. You’ll be the person on the ground making activations happen end to end — hands-on, not a desk planner.

**What you’ll own**

* **Activation calendar & execution** — plan and run society/RWA pop-ups, apartment activations (e.g. MyGate / NoBroker societies), sampling, kiosks and experiential events, start to finish.

* **Sampling & trial** — design and run sampling that converts tasters into first-time buyers; own the follow-through (offer, QR/sign-up, order) so trial turns into trackable orders.

* **Partnerships on the ground** — gyms, fitness studios, corporate parks, apartment complexes, dieticians, local events and fitness/sports meets; build and maintain these local relationships.

* **Vendor & logistics** — manage promoters, fabricators, stall/kiosk setup, collateral, stock and on-site logistics within budget.

* **On-ground brand presence** — ensure every touchpoint looks and sounds like MillD, with correct product claims.

* **Reporting** — track activation cost, reach, samples given, sign-ups and orders generated per activation, and feed back what’s working so we scale the right formats.

**What we’re looking for**

* 3–4 years in on-ground / BTL / experiential / field marketing activations — ideally for an FMCG, food, nutrition or D2C brand.

* A doer who has personally run events and activations on the ground — set up, staffed and executed, not just briefed an agency.

* Comfortable owning promoters/vendors and juggling multiple activations at once.

* Willing to be in the field, including some evenings/weekends when activations run.

* Tracks activations on cost and outcomes (trial, sign-ups, orders) — not just footfall.

**Not the right role if** you’re a pure brand/events planner who hands execution to an agency, or a general-trade/modern-trade distribution salesperson — this is marketing activation, not channel sales.

**Nice to have:** experience with society/RWA or apartment-community activations; health, nutrition or fitness category; existing local vendor/promoter network in Bengaluru; comfort using a phone/sheet to log leads and orders.

**How success is measured:** activations executed on time and on budget; trial and sampling volume; sign-ups and first orders driven per activation; cost per acquisition from on-ground vs. the formats we scale. Specific targets set in a 30/60/90 plan on joining.

title: Head, Business and Client Partnerships
description:
**Job Title:** Head, Business and Client Partnerships  
**Location:** South India (Kochi or Bengaluru preferred), with regular travel across the agreed region  
**Employment Type:** Full-time, initially a 12-month consulting engagement with a path to a permanent role

**About Our Client**  
Our client is an international group in the education and wellbeing technology services sector. It combines a technology platform with professional services for schools, educational institutions, institutional networks and public bodies.

The group is building its India business from the ground up, working alongside leading academic institutions. This is a founding role. The person appointed will shape how the business wins, serves and grows its clients in India, and will help build the commercial function the business scales on.

**About the Role**  
We are looking for a seasoned commercial leader who operates at the highest level of professionalism with clients and is always focused on winning business. You will convert opportunities into revenue, earn the trust of senior client leadership and manage those relationships for the long term.

The role is weighted about 60% to winning new business and 40% to managing accounts and partnerships. It covers a single southern state or the wider southern region, agreed at offer according to your experience and networks. You will report directly to the Founder and work with minimal supervision. For the right person, the role can grow into an executive leadership position as the business scales.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Winning new business:** Build and own a qualified pipeline across schools and school groups, higher education institutions, educational trusts and societies, institutional networks, CSR funders and public bodies. Lead the full sales cycle from prospecting and discovery through proposals, pricing and negotiation to contract close.
* **Public sector and funded programmes:** Identify, qualify and lead responses to public tenders and government programmes, working with institutional partners where a joint approach is needed. Secure CSR and grant funding to support client deployments where appropriate.
* **Senior engagement:** Open and hold conversations with trustees, managements, principals, vice chancellors, senior government officials and heads of CSR. Represent the business at sector forums, conferences and institutional networks.
* **Partnership and channel development:** Develop and manage delivery and referral partners, including academic institutions and their networks. Lead partner onboarding: commercial terms, training and certification, and performance reviews. Turn partner networks into contracted adoption across their member institutions.
* **Account and relationship management:** Own the end-to-end relationship with key clients and partners as the main contact for strategic and commercial matters. Lead structured onboarding from contract to service delivery, run regular business reviews, resolve escalations and drive renewals, expansion and referrals.
* **Commercial management:** Own contracts, scope, change requests, billing coordination and renewals. Monitor account revenue, margin and commercial commitments, and keep pricing within approved frameworks.
* **Delivery coordination and governance:** Connect clients with the internal product, technology and delivery teams. Turn client needs into clear internal priorities. With the delivery lead, set and monitor service levels, performance indicators and client reporting.
* **Building the function:** Set up the CRM, pipeline reviews, forecasting, account plans and governance templates. Design a business development and client success model that scales, recruit and lead a team as the business grows, and report regularly to the Founder.

**Who You Will Work With**

* The Founder and the senior leadership team
* Internal product, technology and service delivery teams
* Clients, including school and institutional managements, trustees and leadership teams
* Academic and delivery partners and the networks they lead
* Government departments, public bodies and CSR funders
* Domain specialists and other external stakeholders as the work requires

**Scope of the Role**

* **Commercial ownership, not technical delivery:** You own the client relationship, the pipeline and the commercial outcome. Platform build and day-to-day service delivery sit with the product and delivery teams. You coordinate them on the client’s behalf rather than running them directly.
* **Influence across the organisation:** At first you lead through relationships, clarity and commercial judgement rather than line authority. You will build and lead your own team as the business grows.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* 15 years or more of professional experience, with at least 10 years in enterprise or institutional business development, strategic account management or client partnerships in India
* A proven record of winning new business and carrying revenue targets, not just managing existing accounts
* Experience selling technology enabled services or software to schools, higher education, institutions, healthcare or the public sector
* Experience with government and public procurement, tenders and programme partnerships
* Established senior relationships in the education, institutional or public sector in one or more southern states
* Experience owning contracts, renewals, service levels and account profitability
* Able to explain and demonstrate a technology platform and service model credibly to senior technical and non-technical audiences
* Strong financial acumen in pricing, margins, deal structuring and forecasting
* Fluent professional English. Malayalam is essential for a Kerala focused scope.
* A graduate degree. A postgraduate management qualification or equivalent is preferred.

**Desirable**

* Experience securing CSR or grant funding
* Experience building a business development or client success function at an early stage
* Understanding of student wellbeing, safeguarding or child protection environments
* Tamil, Kannada or Telugu, for a regional scope
* Experience working with academic institutions, educational trusts or religious and community managed institutions

**Personal Attributes**

* Seasoned and self-driven, able to work independently with minimal supervision
* A persistent business winner who is also a patient, long term relationship builder
* The highest standards of professionalism, discretion and integrity in senior settings
* Diplomatic yet assertive, and comfortable leading difficult commercial conversations
* Entrepreneurial and at ease where processes and structures are still forming

**Compliance**  
You will work within the group’s information security, data protection, safeguarding and conduct policies. This includes India’s Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) requirements as they apply to client data and commercial records. Because the client works with educational institutions, the appointment is subject to enhanced background verification from the start of the consulting period.

**What Success Looks Like**

* In the first three months, a market map, account plans and a qualified pipeline in place
* By month six, the first new contracts closed and onboarded, and partner onboarding under way
* By month twelve, the first year revenue and new client targets met
* Early clients established as reference accounts
* Strong renewal rates, healthy account margins and confident client leadership relationships
* Escalations resolved on time and agreed service levels achieved
* A business development and client success model ready to scale to more clients and regions

**Engagement**  
The role begins as a 12-month consulting engagement, intended to become a permanent role subject to performance and mutual agreement. A formal review takes place before the end of the consulting period. The final engagement model, geographic scope, base location and commercial terms are agreed at offer. The client’s identity is shared with shortlisted candidates under a confidentiality undertaking.

We are seeking a highly skilled AI Systems and Solutions Engineer to design, develop, validation and debug of Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions & AI accelerators systems. * Lead system architecture design, validation and Debug for integrated AI solutions.

title: Agentic AI Orchestrator
description:
**Job Summary**

The Agentic AI Orchestrator designs, builds, and operates the Investment Division's agentic AI workflows—the automated, multi-step processes through which AI agents read documents, reconcile data, draft analysis, and assemble reporting across the division's clusters. The role converts analyst workflows into orchestrated agent pipelines with human review gates, owns the division's prompt, skill, and agent library, and is accountable for the accuracy, auditability, and cost of every automated output.

The position anchors the division's AI-led operating model from the Chennai office, working alongside the Data Engineer (data pipelines and infrastructure) and the ML Engineer (models and evaluation), and serves as the bridge between the investment analysts and the division's AI tooling

**ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

1. Design, build, and operate agentic AI workflows for the division's recurring processes: document extraction and reconciliation, portfolio and company performance monitoring, report and IC pack assembly, and data-room processing.

2. Translate analyst and reporting workflows into orchestrated multi-agent pipelines with defined human review gates, so that no figure or recommendation is published without analyst sign-off.

3. Own the division's prompt, skill, agent, and plugin library: design, versioning, testing, and documentation, ensuring workflows are reusable across clusters rather than one-off chats.

4. Integrate agents with the division's systems and data sources — document repositories, custodian and administrator reporting, and the division's knowledge base — working with the Data Engineer on pipelines and access.

5. Build and run evaluation harnesses with the ML Engineer: accuracy benchmarks against verified ground truth, regression testing on workflow changes, and periodic audits of automated outputs.

6. Implement AI governance and guardrails: access controls and confidentiality boundaries for family and portfolio data, audit trails for every automated output, and compliance with the Group's AI usage policies.

7. Monitor agent performance, cost, latency, and failure modes; triage incidents, maintain runbooks, and drive continuous improvement of workflow reliability.

8. Train and support the division's analysts in AI-assisted working practices; capture their feedback and convert it into a prioritised automation backlog.

9. Maintain complete documentation of all orchestrated workflows, their data sources, model versions, and review controls, ensuring every automated output is reproducible and auditable.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Minimum Education Required**

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related quantitative field.

• Strong Python engineering skills: API integration, data handling, and production-quality code with testing and version control (Git).

• Hands-on experience building LLM-based and agentic systems in production: workflow orchestration, tool and function calling, and multi-agent patterns — using frameworks such as LangGraph or LangChain, or SDK-native orchestration (e.g. Claude Agent SDK). Framework experience matters less than sound orchestration design.

• Practical RAG experience: document chunking, embeddings, vector databases (e.g. pgvector, Pinecone, Qdrant, or similar), hybrid search, and retrieval evaluation.

• Experience building or integrating MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and tools, or equivalent connector architectures linking AI agents to enterprise systems and data sources.

• Familiarity with LLM evaluation and observability tooling (accuracy benchmarks, regression tests, tracing); disciplined prompt and skill engineering with versioning and documentation.

• Understanding of data privacy, access control, and audit requirements for confidential financial data; exposure to investment or financial reporting workflows preferred.

**Years of experience are required.**

• Minimum of 4 to 7 years of experience in software or AI engineering, of which at least 2 years hands-on with LLM-based or agentic systems in production, at a technology firm, financial institution, or data-driven enterprise.
