title: Principal Engineer
description:
**Why this role exists**

Our engineering team is young. We have about 30 engineers, six new team leads and one senior

architect. The leads are good builders who have not led before. They need someone to learn from

every day.

AI agents now write a large share of our code. Design, review and judgement have become the

scarce skills. This role brings them.

**About Company**

We build customised holidays for Indian travellers. We have done this for over 12 years

from Chennai.

A traveller plans a trip with us, a seller helps them decide, and our team delivers it on the ground.

Technology runs through all of it: the website and app, the sales funnel, pricing and supply,

booking, and everything after booking.

**How tech is organised**

You report to Chief Architect. The six team leads look to you for every technical

call.

**The roles you will play**

1. Guide to the six leads. You review their designs and code, and you pair with them on the hard

problems. Every lead gets your time every week.

2. Keeper of standards. You set how we design APIs, test, release and code with AI agents.

Then you make sure it is followed.

3. Builder. You stay hands-on. Expect a good part of your week in code.

4. Chief Architect's partner on architecture. You work with him on data unification and on the API layer

that our website, partners and agents all use.

5. Owner of one critical system. In your first months you own one system end to end, most

likely payments.

6. Hiring bar. You interview engineers and decide who is good enough.

**What you will not do:**

• Manage people. Appraisals and staffing stay with the founder.

• Set AI direction. That sits with the AI head. You make sure agents call our systems safely.

Your first 90 days

• By day 30: you know the codebase, the six leads and where each team is stuck. You have

shipped one fix or feature yourself.

• By day 60: design reviews run every week with every lead. Our standards for APIs, tests and

releases are written down and in use.

• By day 90: one critical system is fully yours. Each lead can name one thing they do better

because of you.

**What we look for**

• 8 to 12 years of building software, full stack with most of it in backend.

• Our stack: Java and Spring Boot, MongoDB, React.

• Time spent on systems where a mistake costs money: booking, payments, fintech or

commerce.

• You code with AI agents every day, and you can show us how.

• The role is in Chennai.

The three skills that matter most:

1. Backend system design.

2. API and data modelling.

3. Code review and debugging across the stack.

The one quality: you enjoy making other engineers better. A teacher's patience matters more here

than being the best coder in the room.

The opportunity

• Six leads grow because of you. That is how we will measure this role.

• You shape how a team builds with AI agents. We are early, and the habits you set will stay.

• The problems are real. Live pricing and supply, bookings that cannot fail, voice AI in sales,

and post-booking work that runs without people.

**What is coming up:**

• One unified data layer across our systems.

• A Holidays API that banks and partners sell from.

• A new product for travellers outside India.

• A CTO decision. We have not hired one. We will decide once this structure settles, and

whoever does this role well is part of that conversation

title: Computer Vision QA Specialist
description:
In this hourly, remote contractor role, you will work as a Computer Vision QA Specialist to review image and video annotations for quality, accuracy, and guideline compliance. You will evaluate annotations such as bounding boxes, segmentation masks, polygons, keypoints, object classes, attributes, and video tracks, identifying missing, incorrect, inconsistent, or poorly placed annotations.
  
  
You will also make corrections when required, provide clear feedback on quality issues, and communicate unclear cases to the project team. This role requires strong attention to detail, consistency, and the ability to carefully follow detailed computer vision annotation guidelines.
  
  
This role is with SME Careers, a fast-growing AI Data Services company and subsidiary of SuperAnnotate, delivering training data for many of the world’s largest AI companies and foundation-model labs. Your computer vision QA work directly helps improve the world’s premier AI models by ensuring that visual training data is accurate, complete, consistent, and aligned with project expectations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Review annotation quality: Review image and video annotations for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and adherence to project guidelines.
* Check annotation outputs: Evaluate bounding boxes, classes, attributes, segmentation masks, polygons, keypoints, image labels, and video tracking outputs.
* Identify annotation errors: Spot missing objects, incorrect labels, inaccurate boundaries, poor box placement, inconsistent attributes, duplicate annotations, and unclear edge cases.
* Make corrections when required: Correct annotation issues according to project-specific instructions and quality standards.
* Provide clear feedback: Document quality issues clearly so annotators or project teams can understand what needs to be improved.
* Follow project guidelines: Apply detailed annotation rules consistently across tasks, including rules for occlusion, truncation, blur, small objects, overlapping objects, and ambiguous cases.
* Escalate unclear cases: Communicate questions or uncertain examples to the project team for clarification.
* Maintain consistent work quality: Complete assigned QA work reliably while maintaining accuracy, consistency, and expected productivity.

**Your Profile**

* Previous experience with computer vision annotation, image annotation, video annotation, or annotation QA is preferred.
* Experience reviewing or creating annotations such as bounding boxes, polygons, segmentation masks, keypoints, object classes, attributes, image classification, or video object tracking.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to identify missing, incorrect, inconsistent, overlapping, mislabeled, or poorly placed annotations.
* Comfortable working with detailed annotation guidelines, edge-case rules, quality standards, and project-specific instructions.
* Ability to review image and video data consistently across large batches while maintaining accuracy and speed.
* Comfortable making corrections when required and explaining annotation errors clearly.
* Good professional proficiency in English to understand guidelines, communicate questions, and provide written feedback.
* Able to work independently in an hourly remote workflow and commit consistent working hours based on project needs.
* Prior experience with annotation platforms such as SuperAnnotate, Labelbox, CVAT, Scale, Appen, Remotasks, Toloka, or similar tools is preferred.

**Job Title: Senior Consultant** ( PTC Windchill Data Migration Expert )

  
  

**Experience**: 5-8 Years

  
  

**Technology**: PTC Windchill PLM, Data Migration, CAD Integration, SQL, Java

**Deployment Environment**: On-Premises / Microsoft Azure Cloud / AWS

  
  

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced PTC Windchill Migration Expert with 5–8 years of hands-on experience in PLM data migration, Windchill administration, customization and CAD data management. The candidate will be responsible for planning and executing Windchill migration activities, ensuring data integrity, business continuity and successful migration of PLM data across environments and platforms.

  
  

The role involves collaborating with business stakeholders, infrastructure teams and technical teams to deliver migration solutions aligned with business and technical requirements.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

Migration Strategy & Planning: Define migration strategy, scope, approach, timelines and dependencies for Windchill upgrades and PLM platform migrations.

Windchill Data Migration: Execute migration of Parts, Documents, CAD Documents, BOMs, lifecycle states, versions, iterations and change objects.

Source-to-Target Migration: Perform migration from legacy Windchill environments and other PLM platforms such as Siemens Teamcenter or Dassault ENOVIA.

CAD Data Migration: Handle Creo and multi-CAD data, including CAD structures, assemblies, dependencies, associations and representation files.

Migration Tools & Utilities: Develop and execute migration utilities using Windchill APIs, Java, SQL, loaders and supported bulk-loading mechanisms.

Data Mapping & Transformation: Define source-to-target mappings, attribute transformations, numbering rules, classification, lifecycle and organizational mappings.

Data Validation: Perform pre- and post-migration validation, reconciliation, referential integrity checks and completeness verification.

Migration Rehearsals: Execute mock migrations, trial loads, performance testing, error analysis and migration cycle optimization.

Troubleshooting: Resolve migration failures, data inconsistencies, missing references, duplicate objects and CAD association issues.

Documentation & Reporting: Maintain migration plans, mapping documents, reconciliation reports, issue logs and technical documentation.

Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with PLM architects, business users, CAD teams, database administrators and infrastructure teams.

  
  

**Required Technical Skills**

5-8 years of experience in PTC Windchill PLM, with substantial hands-on migration experience.

Strong knowledge of Windchill PDMLink, Part Management, Document Management, CAD Data Management, BOMs and Change Management.

Experience with Windchill version upgrades, environment migrations, or cross-platform PLM migrations.

Hands-on experience with Windchill APIs, Java, SQL, XML and supported bulk-loading or migration utilities.

Knowledge of Windchill object models, versioning, iterations, lifecycle states, workflows and object relationships.

Experience with CAD integrations, particularly Creo; exposure to NX, CATIA, or SolidWorks is an advantage.

Experience with source-to-target data mapping, transformation, reconciliation and migration validation.

Understanding of Windchill database structures, vaults, content storage and migration dependencies.

Familiarity with Linux/Windows environments, application logs and performance troubleshooting.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and documentation skills.

  
  

**Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills**

Experience with Windchill 11, 12, or 13.

Experience with Windchill Bulk Migrator (WBM).

Exposure to AWS, Microsoft Azure infrastructure and cloud-based PLM deployments.

Knowledge of MPMLink, PartsLink, ProjectLink and Supplier Management.

Understanding of migration security, access control, audit history and compliance requirements.

  
  

**Key Deliverables**

Source-system assessment and migration readiness report.

Data migration strategy, scope and execution plan.

Source-to-target mapping and transformation specifications.

Migration utilities, scripts and reusable components.

Trial migration and reconciliation reports.

Data quality and migration issue reports.

  
  

**Education**

Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent relevant experience.

  
  

**Success Criteria**

Accurate and complete migration of in-scope PLM data.

Preservation of CAD structures, BOM relationships, object associations and required metadata.

Successful reconciliation and business validation.

Completion of migration activities within agreed timelines.

title: PMO Specialist APAC
description:
**Job Title**

PMO Specialist APAC

**Job Description Summary**

**Job Description**

**CUSHMAN & WAKEFIELD**

**Job Description – PMO Specialist, Design Management**

**Business Line: Global Occupier Services (GOS)**  
**Location: Pune, India**  
**Experience: 4–5 years**  
**Function: PMO – Design Management**

**1. Role Overview**

Cushman & Wakefield is seeking a proactive and detail-oriented PMO Specialist – Design Management to support design coordination, governance, planning, monitoring, and reporting for Mastercard India's corporate office development and interior fit-out projects in Pune.

The role will support the C&W Global Occupier Services (GOS) team and work closely with Mastercard's Real Estate, Design, Workplace, IT, Security, and Facilities Management stakeholders, along with appointed architects, design consultants, and other project partners.

The successful candidate will establish and maintain robust design management controls, monitor the timely delivery of design packages, facilitate multidisciplinary coordination, and identify design-related risks that may affect project timelines, costs, quality, and constructability.

The position requires strong coordination, analytical, documentation, and reporting capabilities, with the ability to manage multiple design deliverables and stakeholders in a fast-paced corporate workplace project environment.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Design Management and Coordination**

* Coordinate and monitor design deliverables across concept design, schematic design, detailed design, tender documentation, and construction drawing stages.
* Maintain a comprehensive design deliverables register, design responsibility matrix, submission schedule, and approval tracker.
* Coordinate with architects, interior designers, MEP consultants, specialist consultants, PMCs, and execution teams to ensure timely submission and closure of design deliverables.
* Facilitate multidisciplinary design coordination and track architectural, interior, structural, MEP, IT, security, and other relevant interfaces.
* Identify design discrepancies, missing information, drawing conflicts, and constructability concerns, and coordinate their timely resolution.
* Monitor compliance with Mastercard's approved workplace standards, project brief, functional requirements, and applicable codes and statutory requirements.
* Track design reviews, comments, revisions, approvals, and design-freeze milestones to minimise delays during procurement and construction.
* Ensure design decisions are documented and communicated to all relevant stakeholders.

**B. Project Planning and Design Controls**

* Develop and maintain the design management schedule, integrated design and pre-construction programme, and key milestone trackers.
* Monitor planned versus actual design submissions, review cycles, approvals, and outstanding decisions.
* Identify critical-path design activities and dependencies affecting tendering, procurement, long-lead items, and site execution.
* Maintain the project risk register, design issue tracker, decision log, change management log, and long-lead item tracker.
* Identify design-related risks and recommend mitigation measures to protect project timelines, cost, quality, and delivery objectives.
* Coordinate design freeze and release of approved drawings in line with the project execution programme.
* Support procurement planning and pre-construction activities in coordination with the C&W GOS team and client stakeholders.

**C. Cost Management and Change Control**

* Track design-stage cost implications and coordinate with cost consultants and project managers to assess the impact of proposed design changes.
* Monitor design changes, additional requirements, and scope modifications, including their potential impact on project budgets and schedules.
* Maintain a structured change management register, including change descriptions, reasons, approval status, and anticipated cost and time implications.
* Support value engineering exercises by coordinating design alternatives and documenting their implications for cost, functionality, quality, and maintainability.
* Highlight potential scope gaps, design omissions, and coordination issues that may lead to variations or rework.
* Ensure design changes are documented and routed through the established review and approval process.

**D. PMO Reporting and Management Information**

* Prepare and circulate weekly and monthly design progress reports, dashboards, management presentations, and project status updates.
* Develop reporting formats covering design progress, pending approvals, overdue submissions, critical decisions, risks, and mitigation actions.
* Consolidate inputs from consultants, PMCs, contractors, and internal stakeholders to provide accurate and timely project information.
* Maintain action trackers and follow up with responsible stakeholders to ensure timely closure of outstanding items.
* Escalate critical design issues, approval delays, and unresolved dependencies to the designated C&W GOS lead and client representatives.
* Provide data-driven insights and recommendations to improve design turnaround time, coordination efficiency, and project predictability.

**E. Stakeholder and User Coordination**

* Coordinate with Mastercard's Real Estate, Workplace, IT, Security, Operations, and Facilities Management teams to capture and track design requirements.
* Facilitate stakeholder reviews and maintain records of design decisions, user comments, and approval status.
* Track closure of user requirements, material and finish selections, workplace standards, and other design-related decisions.
* Coordinate with design consultants and execution teams to maintain alignment between approved design intent and project delivery requirements.

**F. Documentation and Project Handover**

* Maintain a centralised and controlled project document repository for drawings, design submissions, technical specifications, approvals, meeting minutes, and related records.
* Ensure appropriate document naming, version control, revision tracking, and distribution of approved information.
* Maintain records of design reviews, consultant comments, design changes, and approval history.
* Coordinate the transition from design to construction by tracking the release of coordinated and approved drawing packages.
* Support project close-out by tracking final design documentation, as-built drawings, and applicable handover deliverables.
* Ensure compliance with C&W and client requirements relating to project documentation, confidentiality, and information management.

**3. Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Architecture or Interior Design is mandatory.
* Approximately 4–5 years of relevant experience in design coordination, design management, or PMO roles.
* Experience in corporate office interiors, commercial fit-outs, workplace projects, or commercial real estate developments is preferred.
* Good understanding of architectural and interior design drawings, MEP coordination, tender documentation, and construction interfaces.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint is essential; working knowledge of AutoCAD is preferred.
* Familiarity with project scheduling tools and document management platforms is an advantage.
* Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, analytical, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple deliverables, prioritise competing requirements, and work effectively within a structured project management environment.

**4. Core Competencies**

* Design coordination and multidisciplinary interface management
* Project planning, monitoring, and reporting
* Risk identification and mitigation
* Analytical thinking and attention to detail
* Documentation management and version control
* Stakeholder engagement and communication
* Ownership, accountability, and timely follow-up
* Client-service orientation and collaborative working
* Continuous improvement and adherence to project governance

**5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

**Performance will be assessed against agreed project requirements and the applicable C&W performance framework.**

* Design deliverables: Timely tracking and reporting of design submissions against the approved schedule.
* Approval management: Effective monitoring and follow-up of design reviews, comments, and pending approvals.
* Issue resolution: Timely identification, tracking, and escalation of design coordination issues.
* Project controls: Accuracy and regular updating of design schedules, risk registers, change logs, and action trackers.
* Reporting quality: Timely submission of accurate weekly and monthly dashboards and management reports.
* Cost and schedule awareness: Early identification and reporting of design-related cost, procurement, and programme risks.

description:
**About Sirius AI**

Sirius AI is an AI consulting and solutions firm working with financial services clients, including banks, fintechs, payments companies and wealth managers. Our teams design, build and run GenAI, agentic AI and ML solutions inside client environments, working alongside their operations, technology and risk teams.

**About the Role**

We are hiring an Associate Director to lead agentic AI and process automation work for our US financial services clients. The role combines solution architecture and delivery leadership. You will design the solution, stay close to the build, and be accountable for getting it into production and keeping it running there.

Most of our work is in operations-heavy processes such as onboarding, KYC/AML, lending, payments operations, claims and servicing, at large organisations with strict security, audit and model risk requirements. You will lead a team of AI engineers, automation developers and business analysts, several of whom are early in their careers.

This is a hands-on role. We expect you to have built and deployed agentic systems yourself and to be comfortable reviewing code, agent traces and architecture decisions with your team.

**What You Will Do**

* Own the solution architecture for agentic automation engagements: agent design, orchestration, tool and MCP server design, integration with client systems, identity and access, and deployment topology.
* Lead delivery from process discovery through build, testing, go-live and hypercare. Fix the process before automating it, and decide which steps need an agent, which are better handled by rules, APIs or RPA, and which should stay with a person.
* Design multi-agent systems, including how agents delegate and hand off work (for example over A2A), how they reach tools and data (for example through MCP), and how state, memory, retries and failures are handled.
* Build and maintain the harness around each solution: evaluation datasets, regression tests, tracing, guardrails, and cost and latency monitoring, so that changes to prompts, models or tools are tested before they reach production.
* Implement role-based access control for agents and MCP tools. Define what each agent is allowed to call, on whose behalf and with what data scope, and align this with the client’s IAM, secrets management and audit logging.
* Deploy agentic solutions in large enterprise environments, which means working through security reviews, architecture boards, model risk validation, change management and integration with existing platforms.
* Set accuracy expectations with clients early. Agree what acceptable performance looks like for each use case, how errors and hallucinations will be measured, and where human review will stay in place, then report against those numbers openly throughout the engagement.
* Design solutions to be modular and reusable. Build up a shared library of agent templates, MCP servers for common FS systems, evaluation datasets and deployment patterns that shorten delivery on the next engagement.
* Lead and coach the delivery team, run design and code reviews, and help junior engineers build practical skills in agentic development.
* Act as the senior technical lead with client stakeholders and support pre-sales with solution design, estimates and staffing plans.

**What You Need**

* 8+ years in software engineering, automation or AI delivery, including at least 2 years building and running LLM-based agentic solutions.
* Hands-on delivery of at least two agentic process automation solutions that went into production at an enterprise client. You should be able to walk us through the architecture, what went wrong and how you measured results.
* A strong engineering background. You should be comfortable writing Python, reviewing pull requests and debugging agent behaviour from traces and logs.
* Working experience with one or more agent frameworks (such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen/Microsoft Agent Framework, Semantic Kernel, OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK or Claude Agent SDK) and a considered view on their trade-offs.
* Practical understanding of MCP (building and securing MCP servers, tool design, authentication) and A2A (agent discovery and task delegation), and when each is the right fit.
* Experience building evaluation and testing harnesses for LLM and agent systems, including golden datasets, LLM-as-judge with human calibration, regression testing and production monitoring.
* Experience implementing access control for agents and tools, such as OAuth/OIDC, service identities, scoped tokens, least-privilege tool access, user delegation and audit trails.
* Experience deploying on Azure, AWS or GCP using containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD and secrets management, within enterprise network, data residency and security constraints.
* Solution architecture experience across integration patterns, including APIs, event-driven systems and RPA where no API exists.
* The ability to explain agent behaviour, failure modes and residual risk to business, technology and risk audiences without overselling what the technology can do.
* A bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering or a related field.

**Good to Have**

* Delivery experience in banking, payments, lending, insurance or wealth management operations.
* Experience with RPA and BPM platforms such as UiPath, Power Automate, Pega, Camunda or ServiceNow.
* Experience with agent observability tools such as LangSmith, Langfuse or Arize.
* Familiarity with model risk management (for example SR 11-7) and AI regulation such as the EU AI Act.
* Experience with intelligent document processing.
* Cloud or architecture certifications.

title: Director of Engineering
description:
**About ArmorCode**
ArmorCode is the agentic control plane for Unified Exposure Management: one platform that unifies, prioritizes, and remediates risk across applications, code, software supply chain, cloud, infrastructure, and AI.
  
  
The ArmorCode Agentic AI Platform ingests findings from 400+ security tools, correlates them with business context in the Context Risk Graph, and puts Anya AI agents to work prioritizing, routing, and verifying fixes.
  
  
The platform is proven at enterprise scale, processing 400B+ findings annually and supporting more than 5,600 security professionals and 300,000 developers. Global enterprises including Visa, PayPal, Volvo Group, and Johnson Controls use ArmorCode to shorten find-to-fix time and reduce risk.
  
  
ArmorCoders believe in five core values:
**Hungry. Humble. Hardworking. Honest. Human.**
Our organization is powered by exceptional professionals who bring fresh ideas and passion to their roles, believing that nothing is beyond reach when our "5H" principles are applied. In their work and professional relationships, ArmorCoders commit to excellence and experiences that leave an impression.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Director of Engineering owns how ArmorCode builds and delivers its product. This role leads Development and also manages Quality Engineering, and is expected to drive synergies between the two so that building and validating software work as one motion. The role is accountable for delivery predictability, release quality, and the people and org structure behind them.
  
  
This is also the role that shapes how ArmorCode builds software in an AI-native world. Several teams already run agentic workflows. The Director sets the direction, standards, and accountability that move engineering from AI-assisted work toward genuine autonomy, and ensures the org, architecture, and talent are ready for what comes next.
  
  
Reporting to the Head of Engineering, this role gives leadership an accurate, ongoing view of delivery, quality, and engineering health. It also carries direct ownership of engineering-level escalations on strategic enterprise accounts.
  
  
**What You'll Own**
**Your Org**

* Lead Development and Quality Engineering, creating the shared practices and priorities that let the two functions reinforce each other
* Actively redesign org structure as the product, headcount, and AI-driven ways of working evolve, including pod structure, reporting lines, and where Dev and QA boundaries should sit
* Hire and develop engineering managers and QA leadership; set the hiring bar and build a bench capable of running each function independently
* Own IDPs for all direct reports and key senior engineers; hold people accountable to growth plans with a clear 3-6 month review cycle
* Own promotions, calibration, and performance processes for the org, including writing promotion narratives, running calibration sessions, and managing attrition directly
* Handle escalations that span functions, such as a release delayed by both Dev and QA, or inter-team friction that blocks delivery

**Development & Delivery**

* Own delivery predictability across releases: planning, sprint health, dependency management, and on-time, high-quality shipping
* Set engineering standards for architecture, code review, branching, and release practices as headcount and product surface area grow
* Partner with Product and other engineering leaders to commit to realistic scope and timelines, and hold the line when they aren’t
* Drive technical direction for a platform that must scale across customers, integrations, and deployment models, and keep tech debt visible and managed
* Own incident response practice for the product, including being available and accountable when production incidents involve strategic customers

**Enterprise Customer Escalations**

* Own engineering-level escalations for strategic enterprise accounts: debugging production issues, reviewing customer logs, coordinating fixes, and representing engineering directly with the customer or account team
* Make the call on when an issue is ArmorCode’s problem vs. a third-party integration, and own the communication when that distinction matters
* Manage the follow-through on enterprise-specific requirements (private instances, dedicated tenants, custom integrations) from engineering’s side

**Quality Engineering**

* Own quality outcomes at the org level, with Dev and QA sharing accountability for what reaches customers
* Drive shift-left practices and bring QA closer to development, so quality is built in rather than checked at the end
* Own org-wide quality metrics, including defect leakage, escaped defects, and regression stability, and report them to leadership
* Hold the line on quality expectations under exec pressure: be the person who can explain what the numbers actually mean and push back where the bar is set unrealistically

**AI & Agentic Work**

* Set the vision for AI-native engineering at ArmorCode: how code is written, reviewed, tested, and released when agents are part of the team
* Define org-wide standards for agentic work: what constitutes genuine autonomy vs. AI-assisted work, required eval harnesses, guardrails, and where human sign-off remains mandatory
* Make model, tooling, and vendor decisions (which LLM for which workflow, build vs. buy) and own the tradeoffs
* Hold managers accountable for agentic adoption through outcome review, not code review
* Report the org’s actual agentic maturity to leadership: what is genuinely autonomous, what is still AI-assisted, and the plan to close the gap
* Build the skills, hiring profile, and ways of working the org will need as AI changes what engineers do

**Strategy, Capacity & OKRs**

* Set multi-quarter engineering strategy aligned with company priorities and where the ASPM market is heading
* Own the FY capacity model for the org: maintenance load, integration overhead, headcount allocation, and the evidence-based case for budget changes
* Define and track the metrics that indicate organizational health: delivery predictability, defect leakage, regression stability, incident resolution time, agentic workflow adoption
* Own quarterly OKRs and monthly business reviews; report progress to the India Engineering Head, the Head of Engineering, and broader leadership
* Make build vs. buy and vendor decisions for engineering tooling

**Rubric**

* An engineering rubric: criteria a release must meet before shipping and what constitutes an SLO breach
* An agentic maturity rubric: the distinction between AI-assisted work and genuine agent autonomy, and the bar each function is held to
* A people rubric for the management layer: criteria for IDP accountability, promotion readiness, and what “running a function independently” looks like at each level

**Who You Are**
**Must Have**

* 12+ years in software engineering, with a strong development background and a track record of leading large engineering teams
* Has grown a team before, ideally from a handful of people into the 40-50 range, including making hard calls on org structure, not just steady-state management
* Has owned delivery for a product with real release cadence and customer commitments, and can explain predictability in terms of data, not optimism
* Has led AI/agentic adoption across a team or org, including model and vendor decisions, setting eval expectations, and knowing when a workflow is actually autonomous vs. just AI-assisted
* Has managed or worked closely with QA, and knows the difference between a coverage number that means something and one that doesn’t
* Strong architecture judgment and genuinely hands-on comfort with cloud/AWS and scalable system design; comfortable in a war room when something breaks in prod
* Comfortable owning enterprise customer escalations directly: can represent engineering credibly to a strategic customer, knows when to escalate and when to absorb
* Can sit across the table from other engineering and product leadership and hold their own; this role is visible at that level

title: Manager - AI Delivery
description:
**About Sirius AI**

Sirius AI is an AI-first consulting and solutions firm serving financial services clients: banks, fintechs, payments companies and wealth managers. We help enterprises move from AI ideas to production-ready solutions using GenAI, agentic AI, ML platforms and advanced analytics, delivering measurable business impact. Our strength lies in combining FS domain expertise, hands-on AI delivery and enterprise-grade execution.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Manager - AI Delivery to run day-to-day delivery of AI engagements for our financial services clients in the US. You will own the plan, the team and the client relationship for one or more AI projects, making sure GenAI, agentic AI and ML solutions are built, tested and shipped to production on time, on budget and to regulated-industry standards.

This is a hands-on delivery role for someone who understands the AI lifecycle well enough to spot technical risk early, and who enjoys building strong, well-run teams. You will work closely with technical leads and engineers, many of them early in their careers, and report into our AI delivery leadership.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own day-to-day delivery of one or more AI projects, from requirements and design through build, testing, deployment and hypercare.
* Translate client business objectives into clear scope, user stories, acceptance criteria and technical execution plans together with solution architects and technical leads.
* Run the delivery cadence: sprint planning, stand-ups, demos, retrospectives, milestone tracking, status reporting and RAID management.
* Track scope, estimates, effort, budget and utilisation; manage change requests and escalate risks to leadership and clients early.
* Make sure AI-specific work is planned properly, including data readiness, model and prompt evaluation, testing of non-deterministic outputs, and production monitoring.
* Apply delivery standards for code review, testing, documentation, MLOps/AIOps and quality gates before work reaches clients.
* Coordinate across data engineering, ML/AI engineering, application development, QA and client IT, security and risk teams.
* Lead, coach and support a team of engineers and analysts; contribute to onboarding, performance feedback and skills development.
* Be the primary day-to-day contact for client stakeholders, run project reviews and keep expectations aligned on scope, timelines and outcomes.
* Ensure delivery meets AI governance, security, data privacy and FS compliance requirements, with complete project documentation.
* Contribute to reusable templates, playbooks and lessons learned, and support pre-sales with estimates and project plans.

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics or a related field; a master's degree or MBA is a plus.
* 5+ years of experience in technology, data or analytics delivery, including at least 2–3 years managing AI/ML, Agentic AI or advanced analytics projects.
* Experience delivering AI/ML or Agentic AI solutions into production for enterprise clients.
* Working technical understanding of the AI lifecycle, including data pipelines, model development, LLMs and RAG, AIOps/MLOps, deployment, inferencing and monitoring.
* Strong command of Agile and hybrid delivery methods, estimation, project financials and tools such as Jira, Confluence or Azure DevOps.
* Experience managing and developing small to mid-sized delivery teams, including junior and early-career talent.
* Experience in consulting firms, AI services companies or global delivery centres.
* Clear, structured communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain technical progress and risks in business terms.

**Good to Have**

* Delivery experience with financial services clients in banking, fintech, payments, risk, fraud, compliance or wealth management.
* Exposure to agentic AI, LLM orchestration or intelligent automation projects.
* Familiarity with cloud AI platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP, Databricks).
* Experience working in onshore/offshore or distributed delivery models.
* Certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, CSM/SAFe or cloud AI certifications.

title: Computer Vision QA Specialist
description:
In this hourly, remote contractor role, you will work as a Computer Vision QA Specialist to review image and video annotations for quality, accuracy, and guideline compliance. You will evaluate annotations such as bounding boxes, segmentation masks, polygons, keypoints, object classes, attributes, and video tracks, identifying missing, incorrect, inconsistent, or poorly placed annotations.
  
  
You will also make corrections when required, provide clear feedback on quality issues, and communicate unclear cases to the project team. This role requires strong attention to detail, consistency, and the ability to carefully follow detailed computer vision annotation guidelines.
  
  
This role is with SME Careers, a fast-growing AI Data Services company and subsidiary of SuperAnnotate, delivering training data for many of the world’s largest AI companies and foundation-model labs. Your computer vision QA work directly helps improve the world’s premier AI models by ensuring that visual training data is accurate, complete, consistent, and aligned with project expectations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Review annotation quality: Review image and video annotations for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and adherence to project guidelines.
* Check annotation outputs: Evaluate bounding boxes, classes, attributes, segmentation masks, polygons, keypoints, image labels, and video tracking outputs.
* Identify annotation errors: Spot missing objects, incorrect labels, inaccurate boundaries, poor box placement, inconsistent attributes, duplicate annotations, and unclear edge cases.
* Make corrections when required: Correct annotation issues according to project-specific instructions and quality standards.
* Provide clear feedback: Document quality issues clearly so annotators or project teams can understand what needs to be improved.
* Follow project guidelines: Apply detailed annotation rules consistently across tasks, including rules for occlusion, truncation, blur, small objects, overlapping objects, and ambiguous cases.
* Escalate unclear cases: Communicate questions or uncertain examples to the project team for clarification.
* Maintain consistent work quality: Complete assigned QA work reliably while maintaining accuracy, consistency, and expected productivity.

**Your Profile**

* Previous experience with computer vision annotation, image annotation, video annotation, or annotation QA is preferred.
* Experience reviewing or creating annotations such as bounding boxes, polygons, segmentation masks, keypoints, object classes, attributes, image classification, or video object tracking.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to identify missing, incorrect, inconsistent, overlapping, mislabeled, or poorly placed annotations.
* Comfortable working with detailed annotation guidelines, edge-case rules, quality standards, and project-specific instructions.
* Ability to review image and video data consistently across large batches while maintaining accuracy and speed.
* Comfortable making corrections when required and explaining annotation errors clearly.
* Good professional proficiency in English to understand guidelines, communicate questions, and provide written feedback.
* Able to work independently in an hourly remote workflow and commit consistent working hours based on project needs.
* Prior experience with annotation platforms such as SuperAnnotate, Labelbox, CVAT, Scale, Appen, Remotasks, Toloka, or similar tools is preferred.

title: Consultant - Digital and AI Safety for Women Entrepreneurs
description:
Result of Service

The consultant shall commit to performing the tasks stated above with high integrity and dedication to delivering the outputs as per plan. He/she shall be professionally accountable to Economic Affairs Officer, SRO-SSWA. Within the overall parameters set out in this agreement, the Consultant will work according to the agreed ToR.

Work Location

Remotely

Expected duration

5.5 months

Duties and Responsibilities

Under the supervision of the Economic Affairs Officer responsible for the women’s entrepreneurship programme at SRO-SSWA, the consultant will develop practical training materials, prepare policy recommendations and deliver training on the safe use of digital technologies and artificial intelligence (AI). The assignment will begin with women entrepreneurs in India. Its core materials will be designed for later adaptation across South Asia. The consultant will undertake the following tasks: 1. Review programme materials and consult women entrepreneurs, trainers and relevant institutions to identify priority safety risks in everyday business use of digital platforms, e-commerce, digital payments and AI tools. 2. Develop and test a plain-language training manual that helps women use these tools to promote their businesses while protecting their money, business information, personal safety and families. 3. Prepare evidence-based policy recommendations for a safer and more inclusive digital and AI environment for women entrepreneurs, drawing on the India pilot and selected South Asian experience. 4. Deliver practical workshop sessions, introduce the manual to participants and trainers, and revise the materials using feedback and learning assessments. 5. Submit all agreed outputs, source files and supporting evidence to the Economic Affairs Officer in charge of the women’s entrepreneurship programme at SRO-SSWA. The following are the activities and engagements for the consultant: All month references are measured from the contract start date. The scope below provides for three training engagements: two workshops in India and one regional session. Workshop dates and formats will be confirmed in the inception plan. Output 1 Inception report By the end of Month 1, submit an inception report of approximately 6–8 pages, excluding annexes, to outline the proposed methodology and analysis. The inception report should include a review of relevant literature available from ESCAP, UN and governments and other institutions in India and South Asia and a list of government institutions and women entrepreneurs in India and representatives of training partners, women’s business networks and relevant digital safety institutions to consult in the needs assessment. Output 2 Needs assessment and Draft training manual and teaching materials Undertake consultations with identified stakeholders to understand the needs of women entrepreneurs and the eco-system of institutions and partners and their potential roles in the support process. The needs assessment report will set out priority learning needs, common business risks, the manual outline, consultation findings, proposed learning assessments and a workplan. It will identify two additional South Asian countries for a focused desk review, selected with ESCAP, and explain which elements require country-specific adaptation. By the end of Month 3, submit a complete draft manual in English, normally 30–40 pages excluding annexes, with a companion slide deck and facilitator notes. Keep modules short, illustrated and suitable for smartphone reading and low-cost printing. Provide step-by-step actions, realistic business examples, checklists, practice exercises and a brief glossary. Avoid technical language and explain essential terms when first used. The manual will cover the following content: • Safe business use of AI: drafting product descriptions, marketing content, translations and customer messages; checking facts and outputs; protecting customer and business information; recognising bias and misleading content; and respecting consent and intellectual property. • Account and device protection: strong passwords or passkeys, multi-factor authentication, recovery options, updates, backups, app permissions and safer use of shared devices. Explain how to separate business and family information where possible. • Safer e-commerce and payments: checking buyers, suppliers and platform messages; recognising fake orders, payment screenshots, refund requests, phishing links, QR-code and UPI fraud; and using official payment and platform support channels. • AI-enabled deception and personal safety: impersonation, cloned voices, deepfake images or videos, fake AI services, harassment and threats involving family members. Teach independent verification and safe reporting rather than relying on visual clues alone. • Responding to an incident: stopping further payments or disclosure, contacting the bank or payment provider promptly, securing accounts, preserving evidence safely and using verified reporting channels. Include a short action card and explain that reporting does not guarantee recovery of funds. Use fictional data and safe demonstrations. Do not request passwords, one-time passcodes, live bank details or sensitive customer records. Include India-specific official reporting guidance in a clearly marked annex, with verification dates. Provide a reusable country annex structure so that Indian procedures are not presented as regional rules. Output 3 Tested manual and finalized training package By the end of Month 4, test the draft with women entrepreneurs with varied levels of digital experience and trainers. Participants may include people consulted for Output 1. Use practical scenarios to check whether participants can recognise risks and follow protective steps. Submit anonymised findings, a summary of changes and a response to ESCAP’s comments. Deliver the revised manual, participant checklists, incident action card, facilitator notes, slides and short pre- and post-session assessments. Include at least one exercise per module and guidance on local-language delivery and accessibility. Translation is outside the proposed scope; editable files must support later translation. ESCAP’s acceptance will depend on accuracy, usability, completeness and incorporation of agreed revisions. Output 4 Policy recommendations for a safer digital and AI environment By the end of Month 5, submit a policy paper of approximately 12–15 pages, excluding references, and a two-page policy brief. Draw on consultations, the India pilot and the focused desk review of two additional South Asian countries. Distinguish findings supported by evidence from issues requiring further investigation. Do not generalise India’s experience to the whole subregion. Assess gaps in prevention, accessible reporting, redress and institutional support. Address data protection, AI-enabled fraud, online harassment, platform and payment-provider responsibilities, digital literacy and support for small and informal women-led businesses. Verify relevant laws and policies against official sources and distinguish measures in force from proposals or measures awaiting implementation. Present a practical action matrix identifying each recommendation, its evidence base, proposed lead institution, partners, priority, indicative resource needs and progress indicator. Separate near-term operational measures from longer-term policy options. Identify opportunities for regional peer learning. Recommendations should support safe participation and avoid unnecessary costs or barriers for women-led enterprises. Incorporate ESCAP’s comments before final submission. Output 5 Training delivery and workshop reports Deliver two workshops in India and one regional session. Plan for at least three hours of facilitated teaching and exercises at each India workshop and a 90-minute regional session. ESCAP will arrange participants, venues, connectivity and local-language support, as required. The regional session will present lessons from India and explain how to adapt the materials. Tailor each session to the participants’ business activities and digital confidence. Introduce and share the manual, demonstrate safe routines and help local trainers reuse the materials. Submit a short report within ten working days of each engagement, including the agenda, materials used, assessment results and recommended changes. Report learning results with their limitations; do not attribute changes in income or fraud losses to a short training session. Output 6 Final package and handover By the end of the consultancy, submit the final manual and teaching materials updated after the workshops, the final policy paper and brief, and a short completion report. Provide an adaptation guide covering language, payment systems, relevant laws, reporting channels and referral services. Include a dated source register and instructions for updating information that may change. Supply editable Word and PowerPoint source files, accessible PDFs and any original illustrations or other assets needed for reuse. All outputs must contain clear references, respect third-party rights and be ready for ESCAP review and subsequent publication clearance. ESCAP will provide consolidated comments. The consultant will submit revisions based on the received comments. The inception plan will allow for these review periods. Changes to deliverables, fees or the contract end date require written agreement under applicable contract procedures. Workshop rescheduling will be addressed promptly through an agreed revised schedule.

Qualifications/special skills

An advanced university degree (Master’s degree or equivalent) in cybersecurity, information technology, computer science, digital policy or a related field is required. A first-level university degree in a relevant field, combined with two additional years of qualifying experience, may be accepted in lieu of the advanced degree. A minimum of ten years of progressively responsible professional experience in cybersecurity, digital safety or closely related work is required.Experience preparing evidence-based policy analysis or recommendations on digital safety, cybersecurity, AI governance or a closely related field. An advanced university degree (Master’s degree or equivalent) in cybersecurity, information technology, computer science, digital policy or a related field is required. A first-level university degree in a relevant field, combined with two additional years of qualifying experience, may be accepted in lieu of the advanced degree. Practical experience addressing online fraud, privacy, account security and risks arising from the use or misuse of AI, including generative AI. Experience designing plain-language training materials and delivering participatory digital safety training for non-technical audiences. Experience supporting women entrepreneurs or women-led micro, small and medium-sized enterprises in the use of e-commerce, social commerce or digital payments. Professional experience in South Asia, including India, and demonstrated knowledge of the region’s digital business environment and gender-related barriers to safe digital participation. Relevant assignments in at least two South Asian countries; work with rural, home-based or informal enterprises; and experience with the UN or other international development organizations.

Languages

Fluency in English, both written and oral, is required. Working knowledge of Hindi or another South Asian language is desirable.

Additional Information

Consultancy fee: USD 20,000 (payable upon acceptance of above-mentioned deliverables) Payment schedule: •10% upon acceptance of Deliverable 1 •25% upon acceptance of Deliverable 2 •20% upon acceptance of Deliverable 3 •15% upon acceptance of Deliverable 4 •15% upon acceptance of Deliverable 5 •15% upon acceptance of final package and completed handover

No Fee

THE UNITED NATIONS DOES NOT CHARGE A FEE AT ANY STAGE OF THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS (APPLICATION, INTERVIEW MEETING, PROCESSING, OR TRAINING). THE UNITED NATIONS DOES NOT CONCERN ITSELF WITH INFORMATION ON APPLICANTS’ BANK ACCOUNTS.

title: AI-Skilled Accountant
description:
Job Vacancy: Part-Time AI-Skilled Accountant

**Location:** Punjabi Bagh, New Delhi

**Salary:** ₹25,000–₹50,000 per month (Negotiable based on experience and skills)

**Job Type:** Part-Time, On-Site

**Office Visits:** Normally 2–3 days per week (Maximum 4 days, depending on workload)

**Working Hours:** Approximately 3–4 hours per office visit

About the Position

We are looking for an experienced, tech-savvy and responsible **Part-Time Accountant** who can independently manage the accounting requirements of multiple business entities, coordinate with our external Chartered Accountants and use modern AI tools to improve accounting efficiency.

**This is not a full-time position.** The selected candidate will be required to visit our office in Punjabi Bagh, New Delhi, normally 2–3 days per week and work for approximately 3–4 hours per visit. Depending on the workload and accounting requirements, office visits may occasionally increase to a maximum of 4 days per week.

Accounting Workload – Important Clarification

Our accounting operations are relatively limited in terms of the number of transactions.

* We currently manage approximately **10–15 companies/business entities**.
* On average, each company has only **1–2 bills/invoices per week**.
* The overall volume of routine billing and bookkeeping entries is relatively low.
* The selected candidate will also be responsible for maintaining existing records, reconciliation, financial reporting, compliance preparation and coordination with our external CA firm.
* The role is suitable for an experienced professional who can efficiently manage multiple companies with a relatively low transaction volume.

**We are looking for someone who can complete the required accounting work accurately and efficiently within a limited number of office hours, rather than someone who needs to work full-time.**

Required Skills

* TallyPrime and complete bookkeeping
* GST and TDS compliance
* ChatGPT and other modern AI tools
* AI-assisted accounting and automation
* Advanced Excel and automated financial reporting
* Business-wise and property-wise accounting
* Financial reporting, MIS and cash flow management
* Coordination with external Chartered Accountants
* Strong ownership, accuracy, documentation and follow-up skills

Key Responsibilities1. Accounting & Bookkeeping

* Independently maintain accurate and updated books of accounts in TallyPrime.
* Record and verify sales, purchases, expenses, receipts and payments.
* Maintain company-wise, business-wise and property-wise accounts.
* Perform bank, ledger, vendor and customer reconciliations.
* Identify and rectify accounting discrepancies.
* Maintain proper supporting documents for accounting transactions.

2. GST, TDS & Statutory Compliance

* Prepare GST working papers, GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B reconciliations and GSTR-2B matching.
* Calculate applicable TDS deductions and prepare challan and return-related data.
* Maintain a compliance calendar for applicable statutory deadlines.
* Coordinate with our external CA for review, filing and statutory requirements.
* Track completion of assigned filings and maintain acknowledgements and challans.
* Promptly highlight any pending compliance issues to management.

3. CA Coordination & Accountability

The accountant will act as the **primary point of contact between management and our external CA firm**.

Responsibilities include:

* Preparing accurate and reconciled accounting records for CA review.
* Providing required documents, ledgers, invoices, statements and supporting schedules.
* Following up on GST, TDS, income tax, financial statements, audits and other applicable matters.
* Tracking pending documents, CA queries and statutory deadlines.
* Implementing CA-recommended accounting corrections.
* Obtaining confirmation and acknowledgements for completed compliance work.
* Reporting unresolved accounting or compliance issues to management.

**Accountability:** The accountant will be responsible for accurate bookkeeping, complete documentation, timely preparation, coordination and follow-up. Work cannot be considered complete merely because documents have been forwarded to the CA.

The external CA will remain responsible for the professional services assigned under its engagement, while management will retain approval authority.

4. AI-Based Accounting Automation

* Use ChatGPT and other AI tools to improve accounting productivity.
* Automate repetitive Excel reporting and reconciliation activities.
* Develop AI-assisted accounting workflows.
* Improve the speed and accuracy of management reporting.
* Suggest practical automation solutions to reduce manual work.
* Maintain confidentiality of financial records and independently verify AI-generated outputs.

5. Financial Reporting & MIS

* Prepare monthly Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet and cash flow reports.
* Generate company-wise, business-wise and property-wise financial statements.
* Prepare expense summaries, receivables and payment schedules.
* Highlight outstanding balances, unusual expenses and discrepancies.
* Prepare clear management reports and financial summaries.

6. Business & Property Accounting

* Maintain property-wise income and expenditure records.
* Track rent collections, security deposits and maintenance expenses.
* Monitor vendor payments and receivables.
* Maintain separate financial records for different companies and properties.
* Ensure proper classification and reconciliation of inter-company transactions where applicable.

Duties During Office Visits

During each office visit, the accountant will be expected to:

* Update pending accounting entries in TallyPrime.
* Check bank transactions and complete necessary reconciliations.
* Verify invoices, vouchers and payment records.
* Review outstanding payments and receivables.
* Update GST/TDS workings and compliance trackers.
* Coordinate with the external CA on pending matters.
* Implement necessary accounting corrections.
* Update business-wise and property-wise accounts.
* Prepare Excel-based financial reports and MIS.
* Improve accounting efficiency through AI and automation.
* Provide management with a brief report of completed work, pending matters, CA dependencies and upcoming deadlines.

These duties are to be prioritised according to the actual workload and applicable deadlines, rather than necessarily completed in full during every visit.

Weekly & Monthly Deliverables

* Updated and reconciled accounting records
* Bank reconciliation statements
* GST/TDS compliance and filing-status trackers
* CA coordination and pending-compliance reports
* Company-wise and property-wise financial reports
* Vendor and customer outstanding statements
* Cash flow and expense reports
* Monthly management MIS dashboard
* Accounting discrepancy and correction reports
* Progress updates on AI-assisted accounting automation

Preferred Candidates

We welcome applications from:

* Experienced part-time accountants
* CA Inter candidates with practical accounting experience
* Professionals currently working with Chartered Accountant firms
* Freelance accountants looking for a regular part-time engagement
* Tech-savvy accounting professionals proficient in TallyPrime, Advanced Excel and AI tools

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented and dependable professional who can independently manage the accounting requirements of approximately 10–15 companies with limited routine transaction volumes.

The candidate should be capable of coordinating with external CAs, maintaining accurate accounting records, monitoring compliance requirements and delivering reliable financial reporting without constant supervision.

Employment Terms

**Location:** Punjabi Bagh, New Delhi

**Job Type:** Part-Time, On-Site

**Office Attendance:** Normally 2–3 days per week, maximum 4 days depending on workload

**Daily Working Hours:** Approximately 3–4 hours per office visit

**Monthly Remuneration:** ₹25,000–₹50,000 (Negotiable depending on experience, expertise and suitability)

**Important:** This position does not require full-day attendance or a five- or six-day working week. The intention is to engage an experienced accountant who can efficiently handle a relatively low-volume accounting workload while maintaining proper financial records, statutory compliance coordination and timely management reporting.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Punjabi Bagh, Delhi, Delhi

title: Senior Engineering Manager
description:
**Company:** Enlog Prime Energy Private Limited  
**Department:** Engineering & Technology  
**Reporting To:** Founder / CTO  
**Experience:** 5–7 years preferred  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

About Enlog

Enlog is an AI-driven energy management technology company building intelligent IoT solutions for monitoring, analysing and optimising electricity consumption across commercial buildings, hospitality, healthcare and industrial facilities.

Our product ecosystem includes Enmate, Enpro and Ensense, supported by our proprietary AI engine, Ensyte-AI, and a connected cloud and IoT infrastructure.

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager who can take ownership of our complete technology ecosystem and build the engineering foundation required for the next stage of growth.

Role Objective

The Senior Engineering Manager will be responsible for designing, managing and scaling Enlog's complete engineering ecosystem, covering embedded systems, firmware, IoT communication, backend services, cloud infrastructure and production deployments.

The objective is to establish robust engineering practices, improve system reliability and create scalable architecture without compromising the speed of product development.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role, not just a team management position.

Key Responsibilities1. Technology Architecture & Engineering

* Own the overall technology architecture across hardware, firmware, IoT, backend and cloud.
* Review existing systems and identify technical bottlenecks, risks and improvement opportunities.
* Design scalable and modular architecture to support increasing device volumes.
* Define engineering standards, technology selection and architectural guidelines.
* Maintain system architecture documentation and technical roadmaps.

2. IoT & Embedded Systems

* Oversee firmware development and hardware-software integration.
* Establish firmware development standards, versioning and release management.
* Manage IoT communication protocols, including MQTT, LoRaWAN and Wi-Fi.
* Implement reliable device communication, reconnection, buffering and offline data handling.
* Establish OTA firmware updates and remote device configuration.
* Improve device diagnostics, monitoring and remote troubleshooting capabilities.

3. Cloud & Backend Infrastructure

* Own cloud architecture, backend services, databases and data pipelines.
* Review MQTT broker infrastructure, message ingestion and data processing systems.
* Ensure data integrity, system availability and performance.
* Implement infrastructure monitoring, logging, backup and disaster recovery.
* Optimise cloud infrastructure and operational costs.
* Establish security standards for devices, APIs and cloud services.

4. Development Processes & Engineering Standards

* Establish a structured development lifecycle from requirement to production release.
* Introduce code reviews, Git workflows and development standards.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines and automated testing.
* Establish development, staging and production environments.
* Define release management, deployment and rollback procedures.
* Introduce lightweight documentation and technical review processes.

**Important:** Processes must be practical and risk-based. The objective is to improve engineering quality and delivery speed, not introduce unnecessary approvals or bureaucracy.

5. Production Reliability & Operations

* Take ownership of the technical health of live production deployments.
* Establish monitoring for device connectivity, telemetry, backend and cloud services.
* Define incident management, escalation and root cause analysis processes.
* Reduce production failures and recurring technical issues.
* Build tools and systems for remote diagnosis and issue resolution.
* Work closely with installation, operations and customer support teams.

6. Team Leadership & Management

* Lead and mentor firmware, backend, cloud and IoT engineers.
* Establish technical ownership and accountability across engineering teams.
* Conduct architecture reviews and engineering performance evaluations.
* Identify skill gaps and future hiring requirements.
* Build a self-sufficient engineering team with reduced dependency on founders.
* Coordinate technical priorities with product, business and operations teams.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated against the following areas:

KPIWeightageSystem reliability and production stability25%Technology architecture and scalability20%Development processes and release management20%Engineering delivery and execution15%Team development and ownership10%Documentation and automation10%

Additional performance indicators:

* Improvement in device connectivity and telemetry availability.
* Reduction in production incidents and recurring technical failures.
* Availability and reliability of critical cloud services.
* Percentage of deployments following defined release processes.
* Percentage of critical issues resolved remotely.
* Reduction in founder dependency for routine technical decisions.

Specific numerical targets will be established after an initial assessment of existing systems.

Required Technical Skills & Experience

* 5–7 years of experience in software engineering, IoT or technology product development preferred.
* Strong understanding of IoT architecture and embedded systems.
* Experience with ESP32, STM32 or similar microcontroller platforms.
* Strong understanding of MQTT, LoRaWAN and device communication protocols.
* Experience with cloud platforms, preferably AWS.
* Strong knowledge of backend architecture, APIs, databases and distributed systems.
* Experience with CI/CD, DevOps, infrastructure monitoring and automated testing.
* Understanding of firmware OTA, device management and production debugging.
* Experience managing and scaling production technology systems.

Leadership Requirements

* Ability to understand the complete technology ecosystem rather than individual components.
* Strong architectural decision-making and problem-solving capabilities.
* Experience managing engineering teams in a product-driven environment.
* Ability to balance technical quality with development speed.
* Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration.
* Ability to introduce processes without slowing down engineering execution.

What We Expect in the First 90 Days

**First 30 Days**

* Audit existing technology architecture and engineering practices.
* Understand hardware, firmware, cloud and live production systems.
* Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and dependencies.
* Assess the engineering team and current development workflows.

**Days 31–60**

* Prepare an architecture improvement roadmap.
* Establish development, code review and release standards.
* Introduce production monitoring and incident management processes.
* Prioritise critical technical improvements.

**Days 61–90**

* Implement initial CI/CD and testing improvements.
* Establish controlled firmware and backend releases.
* Improve production visibility and remote troubleshooting.
* Define engineering ownership and accountability.
* Present a long-term scalability and technology roadmap.

title: Lead Engineer System Engineering
description:
Lead Engineer System Engineering is an early-career lead electrical engineering role within GE Vernova’s Generator & Electrical Systems (GES) organization. It is designed for engineers seeking to broaden their expertise from component-level electrical engineering into system-level engineering. The role provides ownership of key engineering deliverables while offering exposure to multidisciplinary technical integration, customer requirements management, power system engineering, and project execution within a global power generation business. It is designed for engineers with a strong foundation in electrical and power systems engineering They are expected to take ownership of defined project deliverables, drive technical execution, and coordinate across multiple engineering disciplines while continuing to develop broader systems engineering expertise. The role focuses primarily on delivering key systems engineering outputs across Gas Power Order to Remittance (OTR) projects, including Power System Analysis, Electrical Load Lists, Customer Electrical Interface Lists, and Consumer Balance of Power. It also encompasses individual electrical design and engineering deliverables, including power system studies(such as Load Flow, Short Circuit, Motor Starting, Arc Flash, Insulation coordination etc), single-line diagrams, LV/MV distribution systems, cable engineering, and design changes, ensuring compliance with customer requirements, project specifications, applicable standards, and contractual commitments. The role requires a strong foundation in electrical and power systems engineering, good analytical and communication skills, and a willingness to learn. The Lead Engineer is expected to own assigned deliverables, support technical problem-solving, coordinate across engineering disciplines, and ensure timely, high-quality execution. The role also contributes to engineering standardization and continuous improvement, with a focus on Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost (SQDC).

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Work with Senior Electrical Engineers, TLs and CTHs to deliver Power system Analysis, Electrical Load List, Customer Electrical interface list, Consumer Balance of Power and other key systems engineering deliverables.

* Perform power system studies and simulations using DIgSILENT, ETAP, PSCAD and PSS®E.

* Prepare electrical drawings and design calculations covering SLDs, , cable sizing, battery sizing per IEEE/IEC standards.

* Support electrical equipment selection, sizing and specification development based on project requirements and applicable industry standards.

* Review vendor drawings, calculations and technical specifications; support ITO engineering, including BOQ preparation, RFQ development and technical evaluations.

* Develop and maintain project engineering documentation, including LV/MV distribution drawings, cable schedules, equipment specifications and design calculations.

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Mechanical, Controls, Sourcing, GEN-PE and PEM, to ensure effective engineering integration and project execution.

* Take ownership of assigned engineering tasks, proactively resolve technical issues and deliver quality outputs within agreed project schedules.

* Support engineering quality reviews, resolve design comments, incorporate lessons learned and ensure compliance with applicable engineering procedures and project requirements.
  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering from an accredited college or university.

* Minimum of 4+ years of hands-on experience in electrical equipment sizing, Load List Preparation, developing ordering specification, integration, power system studies, and technical problem-solving.
  

**Desired Characteristics**

* Advanced degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.

* Working knowledge of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML), with the ability to identify and leverage emerging digital technologies to improve engineering processes, productivity, and problem-solving.

* Experience supporting site erection and commissioning activities, with strong hands-on technical problem-solving skills and the ability to resolve field engineering challenges effectively.

* Commitment to continuous improvement, LEAN methodologies, engineering standardization, quality, and process simplification.

* Demonstrates unwavering diligence, sincerity, and meticulous attention to detail in managing complex design deliverables, taking deep personal ownership of accuracy, safety, and project success.

* Passion for innovation, technical excellence, and the development of reliable, efficient, and cost-effective engineering solutions.

**Additional Information**
==========================

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** Yes

title: Technical Lead (Support & Operations)
description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

**Job Description – Control-M Administrator / Control-M Support SME**

**Position Title**

**Control-M Administrator / Control-M Support SME**

**Location**

**Offshore**  
  
**Experience**

**5–10 Years** of experience in Control-M Administration, Platform Support, Automation, and Enterprise Scheduling solutions.

**Note:** This role is focused on **Control-M Platform Administration, Automation, Integration Support, and L2/L3 operational support.**

**Job Summary**

We are seeking an experienced **Control-M Administrator / Support SME** responsible for the administration, maintenance, enhancement, and support of the Control-M scheduling platform. The role involves ownership of the Control-M infrastructure, platform health, integrations, automation initiatives, upgrades, and incident resolution. The candidate will work closely with application, infrastructure, and vendor teams to ensure platform stability, availability, and operational excellence.

The role requires participation in a **24x7 support model**, including shift rotations, on-call support, and major incident management activities.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Control-M Platform Administration & Support**

* Administer and maintain Control-M Enterprise Manager, Control-M Servers, Agents.
* Manage Control-M platform configurations, control parameters, security settings, and system administration activities.
* Monitor and maintain server health, agent connectivity, and overall platform availability.
* Configure and maintain calendars, resources, alert thresholds, notification policies, and escalation mechanisms.
* Perform Control-M upgrades, patch installations, hotfix deployments, and platform lifecycle management.
* Execute post-upgrade validation and resolve compatibility or configuration issues.
* Perform platform performance tuning, optimization, and capacity planning.
* Troubleshoot and resolve platform-level incidents impacting scheduling services.
* Manage Control-M High Availability (HA), Disaster Recovery (DR), and failover-related activities.
* Coordinate with BMC Support for product issues, defect analysis, and escalation management.
* Develop and maintain platform documentation, SOPs, architecture diagrams, configuration baselines, and operational procedures.

**Control-M Integration Support**

* Maintain and support existing Control-M integrations with enterprise applications and external systems.
* Monitor integration health and ensure reliable communication between Control-M and connected platforms.
* Troubleshoot and resolve:
* + Connectivity issues
  + API communication failures
  + Authentication and authorization issues
  + Configuration-related issues
  + Integration service failures
* Support integration of Control-M with enterprise monitoring, observability, and ITSM tools.
* Ensure alert and event forwarding mechanisms are functioning as expected.
* Perform validation and testing following integration, upgrade, or configuration changes.
* Collaborate with application, infrastructure, security, and network teams to resolve cross-functional issues.

* Hands-on experience with **Ansible and/or terraform** for infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and automation.
* Strong scripting capabilities using:
* + Python
  + PowerShell
  + Shell Scripting (Linux/Unix)
* Develop automation solutions to streamline operational and administrative activities.
* Create and maintain reusable automation workflows, playbooks, and scripts.
* Design and support Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) implementations to improve consistency and reduce manual effort.
* Experience with source control and automation best practices.
* Knowledge of Control-M Automation API and Job-as-Code (JaaC) is highly desirable.

**Incident, Problem & Change Management**

* Provide L2/L3 support for Control-M platform and integration-related incidents.
* Perform root cause analysis and implement permanent fixes for recurring issues.
* Support change implementation activities, including platform upgrades, configuration changes, and integration enhancements.
* Participate in Problem Management and Continuous Service Improvement initiatives.
* Ensure compliance with organizational change and release management processes.

**24x7 Operational Support**

* Provide 24x7 operational support for the Control-M platform and related services.
* Participate in shift-based support and on-call rotations.
* Support major incident resolution and critical production recovery activities.
* Ensure adherence to SLA and availability targets.
