* Develop large scale, high performance ML and NAWS systems for Trust sensitive content detection and mitigation.
* Work closely with ML scientists and Product to understand the requirements, design and deliver innovative next-gen solutions to remove sensitive content.
* Follow operational best practices to own and maintain software services.
* Innovate based on new ideas and build comprehensive system/features.

You will develop solutions to improve our sensitive contents detection and mitigation capabilities worldwide. This will involve collaboration with partner teams to innovate on solution development. You will work closely with other Alexa+ teams to deliver platform features that often require cross-team leadership.

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

title: AI Fresher
description:
Freshers can enter the artificial intelligence field through several entry-level job titles spanning technical development, data handling, and evaluation.

Common Job Roles for AI Freshers:

**1. AI / ML Engineer / Trainee:** Builds, tests, and maintains data pipelines, machine learning models, and API integrations for AI applications. (Starting salary in India typically ranges from ₹3 to ₹10 LPA

**2. AI Data Analyst / Annotation Engineer:** Cleans, organizes, labels, and annotates text, image, or video datasets to train machine learning models

**3. Generative AI / Prompt Engineer:** Crafts structured prompts, tests large language model (LLM) responses, and evaluates RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) or chatbot workflows.

**4. AI Content / Specialist Associate:** Utilizes AI tools for automated workflows, digital marketing, and content assistance.

**5. AI/ML Computational Science / Software Associate:** Works with software teams to integrate Python-based scripts, cloud services, and emerging AI functions.

**Programming:** Strong foundation in **Python** (and familiarity with C++ or Java).

title: Junior Research Fellow
description:
🚀 URGENT: We are hiring! Active Recruitment: One (1) Junior Research Fellow (JRF)

Opportunities are open for motivated researchers to join the Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF) funded PM ECRG project: "AI-Native Foundations for Interference, Connectivity, and Mobility Optimization in Next-Generation Networks."

**Executive project summary:**
Next-generation Networks (NGNs) are expected to deliver high data rates, uninterrupted services to underserved and unserved communities, increased end-user density, and enhanced communication reliability. The existing wireless mobile networks' transition from Fifth Generation (5G) mobile networks to NGNs, including Beyond 5G (B5G) and 6G technologies, introduces unprecedented architectural complexity, larger network density, and more heterogeneity, making interference management, resource allocation, and service reliability a critical challenge, where end users located in areas with underserved and unserved locations often experience interruptions while accessing broadband services.

This project will deliver novel theoretical models, AI-native algorithmic frameworks, and simulation prototypes suited for real-world NGN operations. Also, the proposal will design a UAV-assisted last-mile connectivity network, which strongly justifies national priority missions, such as Digital India, BharatNet, and the National Digital Communications Policy 2018. Therefore, the proposal also aligns directly with the goals of national connectivity and digital inclusion.

**Keywords:**
Next-Generation Networks, AI-Native Optimization, Multi-Objective CoMP, Mechanism-Design Models, UAV-Assisted Connectivity, AI-Native Mobility & Hand-off.

title: Senior Associate - Technology Risk Data Analyst
description:
**About Us**
**Standard**
At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Senior Associate, Technology Risk Intelligence in our Risk, Group Technology team, you’ll play a key role supporting the Technology Risk Intelligence practice to deliver trusted, repeatable and decision-useful risk insights and AI-powered agents to strengthen the Risk, Group Technology team’s ability to provide clear, data-led risk insight and challenge so the Board, Executive Committee and regulators understand material risk positions against risk appetite, policy, regulatory expectations and critical service requirements.
  
  
You will operate as a hands-on Associate, partnering with Senior Managers, Risk Managers and fellow Associates to deliver monitoring and analytics across material Technology and Information Security (Cyber) risk themes, support thematic reviews, events/issue analysis and governance, by collating evidence, analyzing indicators and synthesizing key risk theme insights. This will help to connect risk control and change signals to business impacts, service resilience, value chains and customer outcomes to improve oversight, challenge, risk measurement and quantification, prioritisation and risk decisions.
  
  
Using approved automation and AI-enabled tooling (where authorised), you will develop and enhance automated insight products (dashboards, repeatable insight analysis, trend synthesis and first-draft packs), while maintaining strong data governance, privacy/security controls, and clear human accountability. Partnering with Risk specialists across the team, you will play a key support role in the evolution of technology and cyber risk appetite, metrics and oversight priorities via constructive challenge, executive-ready risk opinions and escalation of material concerns.
  
  
This role may also provide support for International jurisdictions, partnering (as directed) with country risk officers to provide Line 2 technology and information security support as part of a matrixed Line 2 oversight model.
  
  
Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.
  
  
**Role Type: Permanent
  
  
Role Location: Bengaluru
  
  
Work Hours: 7 AM to 4 PM**
**What will your day look like?**
As a Senior Associate, Technology Risk Intelligence, you are accountable for:
  
  

* Supporting the Senior Manager, Technology Risk Insights to deliver the insights plan by contributing to prioritised insight use-cases aligned to risk appetite, Board/ExCo metrics and material risk themes
* Building and maintaining insight assets (datasets, definitions, lineage notes, dashboards and briefing packs) that provide timely, trusted insight on control effectiveness, resilience outcomes, risk-in-change and remediation progress
* Supporting and delivering repeatable insight routines (e.g., indicator analysis, trend synthesis, evidence collation and first-draft packs) using approved automation and AI-enabled tooling (where authorized), with appropriate controls, QA and clear human accountability
* Maintaining audit-ready artefacts and evidence packs (definitions, assumptions, lineage and supporting evidence) to support Line 2 oversight, Internal Audit and regulatory engagement as required
* Providing hands-on Line 2 risk capacity to support independent oversight, review and challenge activities across Technology domains and cross-cutting disciplines (e.g., preparing analysis, summarizing evidence, drafting risk commentary and supporting thematic reviews)
* Partnering with Technology Risk leaders and senior Technology stakeholders to strengthen risk measurement and governance narrative by supporting indicator design, thresholds, trend interpretation and implications
* Producing executive-ready insight packs and dashboard views that link metrics to material risk themes, decisions required and recommended actions, with review by Managers/Senior Managers as appropriate
* Supporting governance forums by providing analysis, drafting insight commentary and evidence summaries; assisting with review of papers to ensure decision-readiness and consistent messaging
* Providing insight-led contributions to thematic reviews, events/issues analysis and emerging risk horizon scanning, synthesizing themes and root causes
* Supporting PACT-aligned NFR uplift through monitoring and analytics that inform Line 2 oversight priorities and escalation
* Operating as a developing specialist within the team, role-modelling analytical discipline, documentation and responsible tool use

**What will you bring?**
To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:
  
  

* Minimim of 7+ years of experience in technology/cyber risk, operational risk, assurance or risk analytics within a complex regulated environment
* Strong analytical and data skills: shaping datasets, defining metrics/KRIs, and translating analysis into clear risk insights, trends and recommended actions
* Experience building and maintaining repeatable insight products (dashboards, packs, automated reporting) with strong data quality, definitions and lineage
* Practical understanding of technology and cyber controls and resilience concepts to enable credible challenge and interpretation of indicators
* Experience implementing automation and AI-enabled workflows (e.g., Copilot/LLM agents) with appropriate governance, controls and human accountability
* Strong written communication skills to produce concise, governance-ready insight packs and support senior stakeholders with clear messaging
* Ability to operate in a matrixed model with prioritisation, delivery discipline, and partnering capability across geographies
* Demonstrated ability to operate across regions (time zones and cultures), tailoring insights for local governance while maintaining consistent Group standards and comparability

**Good To Have Skills And Experience**

* Working knowledge of APRA standards relevant to technology and cyber (e.g., CPS 230, CPS 234) and evidence expectations
* Data science or engineering experience (e.g., statistical methods, NLP, MLOps) in a governed enterprise setting
* Exposure to international regulatory expectations for operational resilience/cyber and the ability to contribute to comparable risk insights and metrics (where applicable)

You’re not expected to have 100% of these skills. At ANZ a growth mindset is at the heart of our culture, so if you have most of these things in your toolbox, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
**Job Posting End Date**
20/11/2026, 11.59pm

description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
**Purpose**
At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Our >40,000 employees around the world work to discover and bring life-changing medicines to those who need them, improve the understanding and management of disease, and give back to our communities through philanthropy and volunteerism. We give our best effort to our work, and we put people first. We're looking for people who are determined to make life better for people around the world.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**
This job description intends to provide a general overview of the job requirements at the time it was prepared. The job requirements of any position may change over time and may include additional responsibilities not specifically described in the job description. Consult with your supervisor regarding your actual job responsibilities and any related duties that may be required for the position.
  
  
The GOSO IBU Incentives Consultant / Sr. Consultant works closely with the GOSO India team and IBU affiliates to deliver Incentive Compensation (IC) work across an assigned hub/affiliate book of work. The role advises business partners and provides analytical insight that enables sound, data-driven decision-making and improved field and customer outcomes. The person draws on IC domain expertise and cross-functional collaboration — and increasingly on AI-enabled tools and modern data platforms such as Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, and Claude/other GenAI applications — to accelerate delivery, strengthen quality, and surface insights that would otherwise take considerably longer to produce manually. The role reports to the Global / IBU Incentives Capabilities leader and partners closely with other GOSO Leads to embed best practices across the function.
  
  
The IC Portfolio spans Incentive Plan Design & Quota Setting, IC Payout Calculations, Budget Analysis, Eligibility Processing, IC Contests/Award Programs, and IC Reporting & Analytics.
  
  
**Portfolio Delivery**

* Owns delivery of the assigned book of work for a hub/affiliate portfolio, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and quality across the IC portfolio (Plan Design, Payout, Budget, Eligibility, Contests, Reporting).
* Partners with Incentives Leads to build and execute the Demand Plan, sequencing work to meet affiliate priorities.
* Adjusts work plans in response to shifting priorities, applying structured change control.
* Collaborates with internal team members and external/vendor partners to achieve shared delivery goals; as experience grows, takes on informal guidance of colleagues working through complex or ambiguous problems.
* Identifies the root cause of delivery issues and resolves them, escalating where appropriate.
* Proactively identifies opportunities to simplify or automate recurring work — increasingly applying AI/GenAI tools (e.g., Claude) and modern data platforms (Databricks, AWS, Microsoft Fabric) to reduce manual effort, shorten turnaround time, and strengthen quality control.
* Supports change management and system implementation activities for IC tools and platforms.
* Reports progress and results of assigned work to leadership on a regular cadence.

**Operational Excellence**

* Maintains IC BRDs, Design Documents, SOPs, and QC checklists to current standards; increasingly uses AI tools to draft, structure, and quality-check documentation — applying sound judgment to review and validate AI-assisted output before it is finalized.
* Supports the review/approval process for documents and deliverables, reconciling reviewer feedback and resolving open items.
* Builds and manages project plans for assigned work; contributes to, and with growing experience leads, specific workstreams within larger cross-functional projects.
* Applies quality standards when reviewing project documents, designs, and final deliverables.
* Surfaces process improvement and automation opportunities, using data — and, where relevant, AI-assisted analysis — to identify patterns and inefficiencies in current ways of working.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Manages timelines and coordinates with team members and partners across time zones and geographies.
* Develops, implements, and monitors communication plans for assigned work.
* Communicates project and program status clearly and proactively to India Leads and IBU stakeholders, using data visualization and, where useful, AI-assisted summarization to make updates concise and decision-ready.
* Anticipates project/program issues and escalates appropriately with India leadership, bringing forward well-reasoned recommendations alongside any concerns raised.

**Technical & Peer Development**

* Continues to build depth in IC domain knowledge, strategic thinking, project management, and cross-functional collaboration.
* Shares technical knowledge and best practices with peers; more experienced team members take on structured technical coaching and mentoring of newer joiners.
* Builds fluency in the function's evolving technology stack — including SQL/Python-based analysis, data visualization tools, and AI/GenAI applications (e.g., Claude) — using these tools to augment, not replace, sound business judgment.
* Contributes to a team culture aligned with Team Lilly values — inclusion, innovation, acceleration, delivery, integrity, excellence, and respect for people.
* Ensures own work is compliant with company policies, procedures, and regulations, and supports peers in doing the same.

**Minimum Qualification Requirements**

* Bachelor's Degree.
* 2–4 years of relevant experience (Consultant level) or 5–7 years of relevant experience (Sr. Consultant level) in Incentive Compensation and Sales Force Effectiveness (SFE) domains.
* Working knowledge of Incentive Plan Design & Quota Setting, IC Payout Calculations, Budget Analysis, HR Eligibility Processing, IC Contests/Award Programs, and IC Reporting & Analytics — with depth and independence expected to increase with experience.
* Proficiency in a coding/query language (e.g., SQL, Python, VBA) and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI); comfort using AI/GenAI tools (e.g., Claude) to accelerate analysis, coding, and documentation is expected, with hands-on experience building reusable or automated solutions with these tools valued at the more senior level.
* Working familiarity with modern cloud data platforms (e.g., Databricks, AWS, Microsoft Fabric), or a demonstrated ability to ramp up quickly on new data tools as the function's technology stack evolves.
* Ability to analyze upstream and downstream impact of system changes and organizational change management (OCM) activities.
* Detailed knowledge of pharmaceutical data and business rules.
* Ability to generate incentive analytics that are genuinely useful to stakeholders across management levels and that drive continuous improvement in incentive plan effectiveness.
* Ensures compliance with company policies and applicable state and federal laws and regulations.

**Other Information / Additional Preferences**

* Expertise in industry standards, best practices, compliance considerations, and regulatory requirements relevant to IC.
* Strong problem-solving, negotiation/influence, project management, and critical-thinking skills, applied effectively in team, cross-functional, and global settings; at the more senior level, a demonstrated ability to bring others along and shape outcomes beyond one's own workstream.
* High motivation and genuine curiosity for finding creative, efficient solutions — including proactively exploring how AI and automation can improve the way IC work gets done.
* Experience with Javelin/Zaidyn Incentive tools.
* Exposure to, or interest in, enterprise data platforms (Databricks, AWS, Microsoft Fabric) and GenAI tools (e.g., Claude) as Lilly's Incentives technology stack continues to evolve; candidates who have applied these in a prior role, project, or self-directed learning will stand out.

title: Data and Digital Lead
description:
Digital Architecture and ABDM Integration

• Act as the district technical counterpart to the HIS and CCC technology partners. Review configuration, workflows, and integrations against the AECC architecture and interoperability standards.

• Track the ABDM readiness of every facility, including Health Facility Registry (HFR) entries, Healthcare Professionals Registry (HPR) IDs, ABHA linking and progress against ABDM milestones (M1 to M3).

• Lead go-live readiness for each phase, from Padampur CHC to district-wide coverage. This covers hardware and connectivity checks, user acceptance testing and sign-off checklists.

• Keep an issue and change log for each system. Monitor partner response against agreed service levels, and escalate unresolved issues through the Project Lead.

• Provide technical review of any digital procurement or initiative in the district, including kiosks and other DMF-funded investments. The aim is to ensure that each one plugs into AECC and does not create a parallel data stack.

• Coordinate with the State ABDM team, the State PMU and the agencies responsible for Government data hosting on integration and hosting matters.

B. ABHA and Citizen Identity Quality

• Monitor ABHA quality, not only coverage. Track Aadhaar-KYC-verified ABHAs, duplicates and active use at the point of care against cumulative issuance.

• Support validation and clean-up exercises, and the linkage of ABHA with the State family registry where approved.

• Work with facility teams and frontline workers to increase ABHA use at registration and in the scan-and-share workflow.

C. Data Quality, Standards and Governance

• Develop and maintain the AECC data dictionary, indicator reference sheets and master data (facilities, providers, services).

• Set up and run routine data quality checks for completeness, timeliness and consistency across the HIS, the CCC and existing Government reporting systems.

• Support the District Administration in drafting and applying a Data Use Policy. This includes role-based access, consent, data sharing protocols and the requirement that data are hosted only on Government-approved infrastructure.

• Ensure that project practice complies with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and the ABDM Health Data Management Policy.

D. RAG Governance Dashboard and PHWS

• Operationalize the RAG Governance Dashboard. This covers indicator definitions, Red-Amber-Green thresholds, data pipelines and review formats, starting with interim paper-based tracking where digital feeds are not yet live.

• Prepare weekly and monthly RAG reports for the District Collector as well as other senior leaders at the district level such CDMO and DPM. Prepare data packs in the standard reporting format for the fortnightly District AECC Steering Committee.

• Support facility teams in root-cause analysis of Red and Amber alerts, and track corrective actions to closure.

• Support the PHWS methodology and its quarterly measurement cycles, including registry-based sampling, computation, validation and publication at Gram Panchayat and ward level.

E. Analytics, Evidence and Learning

• Analyse care-pathway data on referral completion, follow-up adherence, missed appointments, waiting times and continuity of care. Turn the findings into short, decision-ready briefs.

• Establish baselines and track project indicators against the results framework. Support funder reporting.

• Make data and documentation available for the independent evaluation, and contribute evidence to learning reports, case studies and the State replication model.

F. Capacity Building and Transition

• Train and mentor facility staff, data entry personnel and the District Health Society's monitoring and data staff in using the systems, maintaining data quality and reading the dashboard.

• Prepare SOPs, user guides and data quality playbooks for the district repository of AECC materials.

• Prepare and carry out a phased plan to hand over data and digital functions to Government-designated personnel before the project closes.

G. Coordination and Reporting

• Work closely with the Project Lead, the Health Administrator, the CDMO office and facility in-charges in Keonjhar.

• Submit monthly progress reports on digital rollout, data quality and dashboard performance to the Project Director. Contribute to quarterly and annual reports to Swasti and the donor.

4. Qualifications and Experience

Education

• Master’s degree in health informatics, Public Health, Statistics, Data Science, Computer Applications or a related field; or a B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science or Information Technology with substantial public health experience.

• Certification or training in digital health, ABDM or health data standards is desirable.

Experience

• Minimum 6 to 8 years of relevant experience, including at least 4 years in health information systems or health data within government health programmes.

• Hands-on experience of implementing or integrating digital health systems at district or state level, including work with technology vendors.

• Experience with ABDM integration (ABHA, HFR, HPR, Health Information Exchange and Consent Manager) is strongly preferred.

• Experience of building dashboards or performance review systems used by district administrations is preferred.

• Prior work in Odisha, aspirational districts or tribal-majority districts is desirable.

Monrow is among the fastest-growing D2C fashion brands in India and a PETA award-winning footwear and bags brand. Led by ex-Versace leadership and supported by professionals from Anita Dongre and Myntra, we are building a data-driven fashion business with a strong customer-first approach and ambitious growth plans.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a highly analytical and execution-focused
**E-commerce Marketplace Specialist**
to drive growth across leading marketplaces including Amazon, Myntra, Ajio, Flipkart, Nykaa, Tata Cliq, and emerging channels. The role will own marketplace performance, catalogue excellence, revenue growth, inventory optimisation, campaign execution, and data-driven decision-making.

The ideal candidate should possess strong marketplace expertise, commercial acumen, and the ability to collaborate with internal teams and marketplace account managers to achieve business objectives.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Marketplace Growth & Revenue Management**

* Own sales performance, revenue growth, and profitability across all marketplace channels.
* Drive marketplace strategy to maximise visibility, conversions, and customer acquisition.
* Track and improve GMV, net revenue, ROAS, contribution margins, and channel profitability.
* Identify growth opportunities through assortment expansion, pricing optimisation, and promotional planning.

**Marketplace Operations & Catalogue Management**

* Manage product listings, catalogue health, content accuracy, A+ content, and brand stores.
* Ensure timely launch of new collections and product updates.
* Monitor listing quality, search rankings, buy box performance, ratings, and reviews.

**Pricing, Promotions & Campaign Execution**

* Plan and execute marketplace campaigns, sale events, brand days, and promotional activities.
* Coordinate with account managers for visibility campaigns and platform-led growth initiatives.
* Drive pricing competitiveness while protecting margins.
* Monitor promotional effectiveness and post-campaign performance.

**Inventory Planning & Supply Coordination**

* Ensure accurate stock availability and inventory mapping across channels.
* Partner with supply chain and operations teams to prevent stock-outs and overstock situations.
* Monitor ageing inventory and implement liquidation strategies.
* Forecast demand during sale periods and seasonal campaigns.

**Analytics & Business Intelligence**

* Analyse daily, weekly, and monthly business performance.
* Prepare leadership dashboards and actionable business insights.
* Identify consumer behaviour trends and recommend growth initiatives.

**Stakeholder & Account Management**

* Build strong relationships with marketplace account managers.
* Coordinate with marketing, merchandising, creative, warehouse, and finance teams.
* Escalate and resolve operational, commercial, and catalogue-related issues promptly.
* Lead periodic business reviews with marketplace partners.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 5-6 years of experience in marketplace management and e-commerce operations.
* Strong hands-on experience with Amazon, Myntra, Flipkart, Ajio, Nykaa, Tata Cliq, or similar platforms.
* Excellent understanding of marketplace algorithms, merchandising, pricing, promotions, and catalogue management.
* Strong proficiency in Excel, Google Sheets, and reporting dashboards.
* Experience in sales forecasting, inventory planning, and demand analysis.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to interpret business data and convert insights into actions.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* High attention to detail and execution excellence.

**Preferred Background**

* Experience in D2C, fashion, footwear, bags, lifestyle, apparel, or retail brands.
* Exposure to marketplace advertising platforms such as Amazon Ads, Myntra M-Ads, and Flipkart Ads.
* Understanding of P&L management, unit economics, and contribution margin analysis.
* Familiarity with ERP, OMS, inventory management, and marketplace automation tools.
* To work with Young company mindset – solo player with ownership

**Why Join Us?**

Be part of a fast-growing D2C fashion brand where your decisions directly impact revenue growth, customer experience, and marketplace expansion. Work alongside experienced industry leaders and contribute to building one of India's most exciting footwear and bags brands.

**How to Apply:**

Pls send your answers along with resume - Email: talent@monrow.in

In the email subject line mention your name, the role applied, CTC, ECTC & notice period

**Screening Questions:**

1.     Describe a marketplace growth initiative you led that significantly improved sales, visibility, or profitability. What was the impact?

2.     How do you analyse underperforming products on Amazon, Myntra, or Flipkart, and what actions do you take to improve performance?

3.     Explain how you forecast inventory requirements for major sales events and prevent stock-outs or excess inventory.

4.     Which e-commerce KPIs do you monitor daily, and how do they influence your business decisions?

title: Program Manager, Audit AI Ops
description:
**Company Introduction**

We exist to wow our customers. We know we’re doing the right thing when we hear our customers say, “How did I ever live without Coupang?” Born out of an obsession to make shopping, eating, and living easier than ever, we’re collectively disrupting the multi-billion-dollar e-commerce industry from the ground up. We are one of the fastest-growing e-commerce companies that established an unparalleled reputation for being a dominant and reliable force in South Korean commerce.

We are proud to have the best of both worlds — a startup culture with the resources of a large global public company. This fuels us to continue our growth and launch new services at the speed we have been since our inception. We are all entrepreneurs surrounded by opportunities to drive new initiatives and innovations. At our core, we are bold and ambitious people that like to get our hands dirty and make a hands-on impact. At Coupang, you will see yourself, your colleagues, your team, and the company grow every day.

Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what’s possible to solve problems and break traditional tradeoffs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always-on, high-tech, and hyper-connected world.

**Role Overview**

As an Audit Intelligence Program Manager, you will design and scale repeatable intelligence products that continuously monitor customer trust risks, growth drivers, competitive posture, and operational gaps. Moving beyond isolated ad-hoc analyses, you will build automated detection mechanisms that proactively direct organizational attention to high-leverage opportunities. You will transform strategic business questions into scalable AI-driven discovery workflows, turning raw signals into sustainable operational capabilities.

**Why This Role Matters**

As Coupang scales, the volume of potential opportunities and risks grows exponentially. The challenge is no longer finding data. The challenge is identifying which signals matter. This role builds the intelligence systems that continuously monitor the ecosystem and proactively surface the highest-value customer, commercial, and market opportunities before competitors, customers, or business stakeholders identify them.

**What You Will Do**

**Build Customer Intelligence Programs**

You will create intelligence products that help the organization continuously monitor customer trust, pricing competitiveness, and customer value perception.

Examples include, but are not limited to, Blue Badge Trust intelligence, customer competitiveness scorecards, pricing trust deterioration detection, customer-value monitoring, and price sharpness opportunity identification.

**Build Commercial Intelligence Programs**

You will develop systems that identify where growth, selection quality, and commercial performance can be improved.

Examples include, but are not limited to, Selection opportunity engines, underserved assortment detection, demand decline monitoring, seasonal opportunity discovery, new SKU acceleration frameworks, and tail-of-tail optimization programs.

**Build Market Intelligence Programs**

You will create mechanisms that continuously monitor market dynamics and competitor activity.

Examples include, but are not limited to, competitiveness monitoring, competitor promotion surveillance, market-share risk detection, and category-level competitive position tracking.

**Build Automated Task Generation Systems**

You will develop frameworks capable of automatically generating prioritized task rooms and investigation queues.

Examples include creating workflows that automatically generate audit opportunities when competitiveness deteriorates, assign categories requiring intervention, or create task rooms for demand-spike and competitiveness investigations.

**Create Executive Intelligence Products**

You will build intelligence products that allow leaders to quickly understand where pricing risks and opportunities exist.

Examples include executive dashboards, AI-generated intelligence summaries, weekly competitiveness reviews, customer trust scorecards, and opportunity prioritization reports.

**Scale AI Adoption**

You will identify opportunities to use AI agents and copilots to improve discovery, investigation, reporting, and prioritization activities.

Examples include GPT-generated business insights, Gemini-assisted market research, Devin-supported workflow automation, and Kiro-enabled task orchestration.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 7+ years of relevant experience.
* Experience leading cross-functional programs.
* Strong analytical and business judgment skills.
* Experience building operational mechanisms or analytical frameworks.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Marketplace, pricing, or retail experience.
* AI product, automation, or workflow experience.
* SQL, Python, or advanced analytics skills.
* Product and Engineering partnership experience.

**Details to consider**

* Those eligible for employment protection (recipients of veteran’s benefits, the disabled, etc.) may receive preferential treatment for employment in accordance with applicable laws.



**Privacy Notice**

* Your personal information will be collected and managed by Coupang as stated in the Application Privacy Notice located below. https://privacy.coupang.com/en/land/jobs/

This role ensures that all regulated systems are compliant with global health authority requirements including the U.S. Food and Drug Administration, European Medicines Agency, and other international regulatory bodies.

title: Associate Program Manager
description:
**Job Description**
**Role: Associate Program Manager**
**Location: Bangalore, India / Hybrid**
**Scope: 70% Jira Platform Administration & Architecture / 30% Scrum & Agile Delivery Facilitation**
**Department: PMO**
**What You’ll Do**
We’re MiQ, a global programmatic media partner for marketers and agencies. Our people are at the heart of everything we do, so you will be too. No matter the role or the location, we’re all united in the vision to lead the programmatic industry and make it better.
  
  
As an Associate Program Manager at MiQ, you will own the governance, configuration, and continuous improvement of our Atlassian Cloud environment while helping delivery squads work with greater clarity, consistency, and predictability.
  
  
This is a high-impact role that combines deep technical ownership of Jira Software, Jira Service Management (JSM), and Confluence Cloud with hands-on Scrum facilitation. You will partner with teams across DnA, Engineering, Product, and Operations to build scalable ways of working, improve delivery visibility, and enable effective cross-functional collaboration.
  
  
Jira platform administration and architecture — 70%
  
  
**Configuration, architecture, and platform hygiene**

* Own the end-to-end configuration of Jira Software, Jira Service Management, and Confluence Cloud.
* Design, build, and maintain workflows, transitions, validators, conditions, post-functions, screen schemes, custom fields, and issue types.
* Configure and manage JSM service desks, request catalogs, customer portals, queues, SLA timers and calendars, and knowledge-base integrations.
* Regularly review custom fields, schemes, boards, and configurations to maintain a clean, scalable, and high-performing platform.

**Automation, integrations, and tooling**

* Design, deploy, and maintain Jira Automation rules that reduce manual effort, standardize handoffs, and synchronize ticket states across teams.
* Maintain and enhance integrations across MiQ’s enterprise toolchain, including Okta, Slack, GitHub or Bitbucket, webhooks, and REST API connections.
* Use Atlassian REST APIs and scripting to support bulk updates, compliance audits, reporting, and custom data synchronization.

**License, storage, and security governance**

* Monitor Atlassian Cloud storage, manage attachment lifecycles, archive aged projects and tickets, and run regular cleanup routines.
* Audit users and licenses to optimize tier usage and de-provision inactive accounts.
* Enforce role-based access controls, manage vendor and external-user permissions, and support adherence to ISO and SOC 2 compliance requirements.

**Dashboards and reporting**

* Build advanced JQL filters, shared agile dashboards, and cross-project views that give leadership and team managers clear delivery visibility.

**AI-enabled efficiency at scale**

* Identify and implement practical use cases for Atlassian AI capabilities, including Rovo, to improve knowledge discovery, ticket triage, request routing, summarization, and self-service across teams.
* Establish appropriate data, access, and governance guardrails for AI-enabled workflows, and measure adoption, time saved, and service-quality improvements.

Scrum and agile delivery facilitation — 30%
  
  
**Sprint ceremonies and cadence**

* Facilitate sprint planning, helping squads define sprint goals, estimate stories, and commit to realistic backlogs based on historical capacity.
* Run focused daily stand-ups that surface progress, risks, and dependencies.
* Coordinate sprint reviews and demos with Product Owners and business stakeholders.
* Facilitate retrospectives, translate insights into actionable improvements, and track follow-through across delivery cycles.

**Backlog health and blocker removal**

* Partner with Product Owners and Squad Leads to maintain healthy backlogs and ensure work meets the Definition of Ready, including clear acceptance criteria.
* Identify, track, and remove delivery blockers, process dependencies, and cross-squad bottlenecks.
* Champion agile practices, team accountability, and adherence to the Definition of Done.

**Agile analytics and delivery metrics**

* Track and present delivery metrics such as sprint velocity, burndown and burnup, cumulative flow, cycle time, and lead time.

title: Lead Data Analyst
description:
**About The Role**
**Grade Level (for internal use):**
08
  
  
**Role Scope**
The Data Research Specialist is an individual contributor role that develops deep proficiency in a niche dataset/workflow and owns the end-to-end data lifecycle for one or more datasets —from sourcing and rule design through validation, enrichment, delivery, and handover. The role moves beyond execution into designing how data is treated, with a measurable downstream impact on data quality, efficiency, and usability.
  
  
Specialists maintain and evolve rule books and SOPs, provide UAT inputs, participate in solutioning, and begin direct interactions with vendors and internal partners. The role requires strong domain understanding, disciplined governance, and the ability to balance quality, speed, and risk while contributing to automation- and AI-enabled improvements.
  
  
**What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities)**
**Operational Delivery**

* Collect, analyze, and validate US GAAP–based financial statement data (Balance Sheet, Income Statement, Cash Flow, and disclosures) from regulatory filings, earnings reports, and company publications
* Interpret complex financial disclosures and ensure accurate mapping, classification, and standardization of financial data in line with Compustat methodologies
* Perform detailed financial statement analysis, including cross‑statement checks, trend analysis, and reasonableness validation
* Ensure data integrity, consistency, and timeliness across financial datasets by following established research guidelines and quality standards
* Own the end-to-end data lifecycle for assigned datasets, including source selection, ingestion checks, rule application, validation and enrichment, publishing, and handover.
* Ensure SLAs for timeliness, coverage, and quality are met; track end-to-end KPIs, exception trends, and data drift indicators.
* Maintain and update rule books and SOPs as requirements evolve; communicate changes and readiness criteria to stakeholders.
* Support onboarding new datasets or sources through playbooks, sample evaluations, and readiness assessments.
* Participate in UAT cycles, providing domain test cases, acceptance criteria, and defect reproduction steps.

**Process Excellence**

* Keep documentation, runbooks, controls, and SOPs audit-ready, ensuring strong handovers and traceability.
* Contribute risk assessments for changes in rules, sources, or workflows, including rollback and monitoring plans.
* Partner with Technology and Process Experts to design and optimize automation- and AI-enabled workflows under governance.
* Apply working knowledge of LLM/GenAI tools for extraction, validation, and quality checks.
* Run small pilots and experiments (e.g., rule optimization, automation scripts, sampling) to improve efficiency, quality, and coverage.
* Provide SME inputs for data analysis, lineage documentation, and downstream integrations.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the point of contact for assigned datasets with peers, Data Stewards, cross-domain teams, Data Automation & Transformation, Quality teams, representing rule decisions within defined governance.
* Support seniors and other stakeholders by providing domain inputs to requirements, validating fixes, and refining data workflows.

* Experience with Oracle EPM integration best practices.
* Exposure to production support and incident management processes.
* Knowledge of data reconciliation and control framework design.

title: Reporting Specialist
description:
Workday Reporting – Finance (Manager / Senior Developer / Developer / Support Analyst)

**Experience:**
2–13 years

**Work Location:**
As per business requirement

**Work Mode:**
As per business requirement

Role Summary

We are looking for Workday Reporting professionals across multiple experience levels to support a live Workday Finance environment in a post-go-live Application Management Services (AMS) engagement.

The roles will be responsible for developing, maintaining, enhancing and supporting Workday reports across Finance and Operations. Candidates should have hands-on experience with Workday Report Writer, Advanced Reports, Composite Reports, Matrix Reports, Calculated Fields and report troubleshooting.

Strong knowledge of Workday Finance data and the ability to validate reporting outputs against financial transactions are essential. Depending on experience, responsibilities will range from first-line reporting support and report development to complex reporting solutions, technical governance, team leadership and stakeholder management.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, enhance and maintain Workday standard, advanced, composite and matrix reports using Workday Report Writer.
* Build and maintain calculated fields, custom report data sources, dashboards and reporting solutions to meet business requirements.
* Troubleshoot and resolve production reporting issues, including broken calculated fields, missing data, incorrect filters, security access issues and report failures.
* Develop BIRT reports and pixel-perfect documents for complex reporting requirements.
* Create scheduled reports, report subscriptions, bursting reports and RaaS (Report-as-a-Service) endpoints for downstream consumption.
* Apply Workday Finance domain knowledge to select appropriate data sources and validate report outputs against source transactions and financial records.
* Work with Finance and Operations stakeholders to gather requirements, clarify reporting needs and translate business questions into technical report designs.
* Manage reporting change requests, incident queues and delivery timelines in accordance with agreed SLAs.
* Conduct unit testing, support UAT and perform regression testing following Workday semiannual releases.
* Maintain report inventories, technical documentation, field mappings, filters and reporting standards.
* Collaborate with Finance Functional, Integration and Enterprise BI teams to resolve cross-functional reporting and data issues.
* Support Workday Prism Analytics and Discovery Boards where applicable.

Workday Technical Skills

* Workday Report Writer – Standard and Advanced Reports
* Composite Reports and Matrix Reports
* BIRT Reports
* Calculated Fields and Custom Report Data Sources
* Workday Dashboards and Worklets
* RaaS (Report-as-a-Service)
* Report Scheduling, Subscriptions and Bursting
* Workday Security and Report Sharing
* Workday Prism Analytics and Discovery Boards
* Workday Release Management, Regression Testing and Production Support

Workday Finance Domain Knowledge

Candidates should have working or hands-on knowledge of relevant Workday Finance data domains, such as:

* Accounts Payable (AP)
* General Ledger (GL)
* Supplier Accounts
* Procurement
* Project Accounting and Project Financials
* Customer Accounts and Customer Billing
* Banking and Settlement
* Treasury
* Expenses

The depth of Finance knowledge and the number of domains required will depend on the role level.

Experience Levels and Role Expectations

**1. Workday Reporting Support Analyst – 2–4 Years**

* Provide first-line support for Workday reporting incidents, user queries and change requests.
* Troubleshoot standard reporting issues involving calculated fields, filters, missing data and security access.
* Build ad-hoc standard reports using Workday Report Writer.
* Maintain report inventories and incident documentation.
* Track and deliver reporting requests within agreed SLAs.
* Escalate complex issues to senior reporting developers.

**2. Workday Reporting Developer – 3–5 Years**

* Independently develop standard, advanced, composite and matrix reports.
* Build calculated fields, custom report data sources, dashboards and RaaS endpoints.
* Resolve production reporting issues and validate outputs against financial transactions.
* Manage reporting change requests, unit testing and UAT.
* Support report scheduling, bursting and Workday release impact assessments.

**3. Workday Reporting Senior Developer – 6–9 Years**

* Design and deliver complex reporting solutions using Advanced, Composite, Matrix and BIRT reports.
* Handle complex reporting escalations, calculated-field errors and cross-domain data discrepancies.
* Apply deep Workday Finance data-model knowledge to validate reporting accuracy.
* Establish reporting standards, conduct peer reviews and mentor reporting developers.
* Lead reporting impact assessments and regression testing for Workday semiannual releases.
* Develop and maintain RaaS endpoints for Power BI, Tableau and other enterprise BI platforms.

**4. Workday Reporting Manager – 9–13 Years**

* Lead and manage reporting developers and support analysts, including work allocation, priorities and performance management.
* Own reporting delivery quality, SLAs, backlog management and AMS delivery metrics.
* Serve as the senior escalation point for Finance and Operations reporting requirements.
* Establish reporting governance, security design principles, change management procedures and report lifecycle standards.
* Oversee advanced reporting solutions, BIRT documents, dashboards and executive Finance reporting.
* Manage Workday release impact assessments, regression testing and reporting roadmap decisions.
* Engage with senior Finance and IT stakeholders, enterprise BI teams and Workday Customer Success.
* Build team capability through mentoring, structured development plans and knowledge sharing.

Qualifications and Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Finance, Business, Data Analytics or a related discipline.
* Relevant Workday reporting experience in a live Workday environment, preferably in a post-go-live or AMS engagement.
* Workday Reporting certification is mandatory.
* Hands-on experience with Workday Report Writer, Calculated Fields and relevant reporting tools.
* Demonstrated knowledge of Workday Finance data structures and reporting requirements.
* Experience in report troubleshooting, data validation, production support and stakeholder coordination.

**Experience by level:**

* Support Analyst: 2–4 years
* Reporting Developer: 3–5 years
* Senior Developer: 6–9 years
* Reporting Manager: 9–13 years, including at least 4 years in a reporting lead or management capacity.

Preferred Skills

* Workday Prism Analytics certification or hands-on Prism experience.
* Discovery Boards experience.
* BIRT reporting experience.
* SQL or data modelling knowledge.
* Exposure to enterprise BI platforms such as Power BI, Tableau or SAP Analytics Cloud.
* Experience managing Workday reporting AMS or Centre of Excellence (COE) functions.

General and Professional Skills

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Good communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to translate business requirements into reporting solutions.
* Attention to detail and focus on data accuracy.
* Strong documentation and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced production support environment.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on functional experience in one or more areas of Oracle Cloud SCM along with a strong willingness to build cross-module functional knowledge over time. Core Oracle Cloud SCM Modules

* Procurement
* Inventory Management
* Cost Management
* Product Information Management (PIM)
* Product Hub

Job Requirements

* Proven experience across the Oracle SaaS SCM modules listed above.
* Strong understanding of supply chain business processes including item master, inventory transactions, procurement-to-pay, shipping and cost/integration touchpoints.
* Experience providing post-implementation support for Oracle SaaS SCM environments, including issue diagnosis, root-cause analysis, configuration troubleshooting and functional fixes.

* Identify opportunities for business process automation and innovation, troubleshoot recurring issues and drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance system efficiency and stability.
* Communicate production status, risks and issues clearly to management, business stakeholders and cross-geography (onsite/offshore) teams, ensuring transparency and alignment on priorities.
* Provide Hypercare support ensuring business continuity, timely issue resolution and compliance with project governance and documentation standards.

Essential Skills & Knowledge

* Proven track record supporting and optimizing live (post Go-live) cloud-based supply chain solutions.
* Deep understanding of end-to-end supply chain processes and cross-functional integration (upstream and downstream).
* Practical familiarity with approval workflows, process automation and configuration in Oracle Cloud SCM.
* Experience coordinating with offshore/remote teams for incident resolution, enhancement delivery and escalation management.
* Exposure to Oracle implementation methodologies and Oracle Integration Cloud or related APIs.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills across master data, transaction,and integration issues.
* Knowledge of Oracle reporting tools (OTBI, BI Publisher) for operational and strategic analytics.
* Demonstrated business partnering and stakeholder management skills; ability to translate business needs into system solutions.
* Strong documentation, process mapping and user training experience.
* Adaptability in high-paced, cloud-centric, globally distributed support environments.

Preferred Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Oracle Cloud certifications in SCM modules are a plus but not required.
* Prior experience on at least one Oracle Cloud ERP implementation or support engagement (internship or project experience considered).

Soft Skills & Attributes

* Strong attention to detail and a methodical approach to testing and troubleshooting.
* Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document work clearly for technical and non-technical audiences.
* Eagerness to learn from senior team members and grow technical breadth across the Oracle Cloud stack.
* Ability to manage assigned tasks against deadlines while escalating blockers early.

What We Offer

The Enterprise Operations as a Service Offering addresses our clients' needs for on-going operations of their technology and business process investments through multi-year contracts. We deliver continuous modernization, upgrades and address incremental business changes as part of our engagements.

The Oracle Operations offering helps our clients realize the return on their investment in Oracle and its ecosystem, including next-generation SaaS products such as ERP Cloud and traditional on-premise ERP products such as Oracle EBS, PeopleSoft and JD Edwards. Our integrated and comprehensive approach to application management enables IT modernization through automation, innovation and deployment of digital tools and assets to drive business outcomes.

* Hands-on exposure across Oracle Cloud SCM Functional, working alongside experienced SCM Leads and Architects.
* Structured mentorship and a clear growth path toward Lead roles.

title: Research Scientist(Speech/Voice AI)_Hyderabad
description:
Research Scientist-Speech AI

(Looking for Phd/MS)

I. Job Details

Job Type – Full Time

Location – Hyderabad

Experience – 4+years in AI/ML, with strong hands-on experience in speech/Audio/Voice

AI

II. About Us

Company Profile -It is a leader in Audio AI, Noise Cancellation, Speaker ID

and other Audio Analytics technologies. It has over 75+ patents

granted and pending in this Audio AI & analytics technologies. , a

pioneer with over 20+ years of experience in Audio solutions, is a spin-off

of the former media processing and real-time communications group of

Imagination Technologies, is the recognized leader in IP Communications

and Voice IoT technology platforms for voice, video and messaging

applications. To see how is helping top-tier OEM, IC, Call Centers

and carrier customers, with embedded software, mobile apps and end-to-

end communications solutions

Who we’re looking for

We’re looking for Research Scientists with strong hands-on experience in Voice AI. Depending on

your strengths, this might mean independently building, evaluating, optimizing, and deploying

production-grade speech/audio models – or formulating research problems, designing rigorous

experiments, developing novel approaches, and driving projects toward state-of-the-art results and

publications/patents where appropriate. Most Research Scientists here do a mix of both.

Candidates may apply against any one (or more) of the following problem tracks, based on their

interest and prior experience.

2

Across every track, you will

• Drive AI research and innovation in Speech/Audio AI

• Translate research questions into measurable hypotheses; design rigorous experiments and

ablations; analyze model behavior and failure modes; reproduce and build on relevant papers

• Take research from prototype to production-grade, deployable systems

• Define appropriate objective and subjective evaluation metrics, and run benchmarking, error

analysis, and statistical comparisons to know when a model is actually better – not just different

• Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, product, and DSP/embedded teams

• Bring strong problem-solving ability – debug, iterate, and optimize models under real-world

constraints

• Stay current with SOTA literature and bring new techniques into the team; publish or patent

where appropriate

Track 1: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR)

• Work on end-to-end ASR architectures (Transformer, Conformer, RNN-T) for streaming speech

recognition

• Work with speech foundation models (Whisper-style architectures) and self-supervised models

(HuBERT, wav2vec 2.0, WavLM) for representation learning and fine-tuning

• Own the end-to-end ASR pipeline – preprocessing, feature extraction, acoustic modeling, and

decoding/language modeling

• Research streaming and causal architectures under strict latency constraints

• Improve robustness under noisy, multi-accent, and low-resource conditions – starting with

Indian-English / regional Indian accents, with a roadmap to scale to international accents and

languages

• Research accent-invariant / accent-normalized representations – removing accent information

from learned embeddings to improve generalization across accents and geographies

• Study representation quality and robustness across speakers, accents, recording conditions, and

domains

• Evaluated on: WER, CER, RTF, latency, memory

• Preferred background: prior work on CTC/RNN-T, self-supervised pretraining, or Whisper

finetuning

Track 2: Text-to-Speech (TTS)

3

• Work on flow-matching / diffusion-based TTS systems (in the spirit of CosyVoice, ZipVoice,

VITS, and similar SOTA architectures) for real-time, low-compute synthesis

• Experience with duration-controlled, time-aligned TTS using forced alignment (e.g., MFA) and

Monotonic Alignment Search (MAS) for multi-speaker settings

• Research controllable accent adaptation using speaker, accent, linguistic, prosodic, and/or style

representations – including decoder-side conditioning and representation-level approaches –

starting with Indian-English and US-English accent pairs and scaling to international accents •

Research controllable duration, timing, rhythm, F0, and prosody modeling for natural accent

rendering

• Improve naturalness, prosody, and voice-cloning quality

• Optimize inference for real-time, streaming synthesis on constrained hardware

• Evaluated on: MOS, speaker similarity, intelligibility, prosody, RTF

• Preferred background: prior work with neural vocoders, diffusion/flow-matching TTS, or zeroshot

voice cloning

Track 3: Speech Enhancement / Noise Suppression

• Develop time-domain, spectral-domain, and hybrid speech enhancement models for real-time

applications

• Work across both single-microphone and multi-microphone / multi-channel scenarios,

including beamforming-informed approaches

• Improve performance in low-SNR, reverberant, and non-stationary noise conditions

• Evaluate using objective and perceptual metrics under challenging real-world acoustic

conditions

• Optimize for low latency and low compute for edge / embedded deployment

• Evaluated on: SI-SDR, PESQ, STOI, DNSMOS, latency, compute

• Preferred background: prior work on single- or multi-channel speech enhancement, beamforming,

or DNS Challenge-style benchmarks

Track 4: Model Optimization • Work on quantization (including quantization-aware training),

pruning, and knowledge distillation for speech/audio models

• Optimize inference pipelines (e.g., ONNX / TensorRT-class toolchains) for low-latency,

lowpower edge and embedded deployment

• Profile end-to-end pipelines across CPU/GPU/NPU targets to identify model- and system-level

bottlenecks – the neural network isn’t always the actual latency bottleneck

• Benchmark and profile models across hardware platforms, balancing latency, throughput, and

memory trade-offs

4

• Preferred background: prior work with model compression, quantization-aware training, or on

device inference

Also of interest

We’re also excited about adjacent problems – target speaker extraction, accent conversion, source

separation, bandwidth extension, and packet loss concealment, Speech Translation. If you’ve

worked on any of these, tell us about it.

Core Skills / Qualifications Required:

• Strong programming skills in Python and AI/ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow)

• Strong ML/DL fundamentals, including CNNs, RNNs, LSTMs, and Transformers applied to

speech/audio

• Good understanding of signal processing, linear algebra, optimization techniques, statistics, and

pattern recognition

• Minimum 4 years of hands-on experience in the Audio/Speech/Voice AI domain

• Ability to independently design and run experiments; strong debugging and analytical skills

• Self-motivated to learn, explore new areas, and work independently

• Hands-on experience with Generative AI concepts, including GANs, Flow Matching, and

Diffusion Models.

Nice to have:

• Working knowledge of C/C++ and CUDA (required for Track 4: Model Optimization)

• Experience with ONNX/TensorRT, Kaldi, ESPnet, NeMo, or Hugging Face

• Experience with embedded/edge deployment

• Publications, patents, or open-source contributions in speech/audio

We value strong fundamentals, research thinking, experimental rigor, and problem-solving ability

over familiarity with any specific framework or model architecture.

Qualification: Bachelor’s / Master’s / PhD in AI/ML, CSE, ECE, or related field

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
  
  
Join us to put AI to work for people.
  
  
**Job Description**
We build the platform that powers ServiceNow AI Workers: autonomous agents that resolve incidents, complete tasks and learn from every interaction. Our engineers work across retrieval, evaluation, agent memory and learning, runtime infrastructure and customer delivery. The goal is simple: give people AI teammates they can trust, so they can spend their time on the work that matters most.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Design, build and run core services for the AI Worker platform, including agent runtime, orchestration, tool calling and skill management.
* Build retrieval pipelines that ground agents in enterprise knowledge, using hybrid search, embeddings, reranking and the ServiceNow AI Search stack.
* Develop memory and learning capabilities so agents improve from past resolutions, knowledge articles and human feedback.
* Create evaluation frameworks, including offline benchmarks, LLM-as-judge scoring, ablation studies and production quality monitoring, so we can measure whether agents are actually getting better.
* Integrate deeply with the Now Platform through scoped apps, GlideRecord, Flow Designer and platform APIs, and make AI capabilities easy for other teams to consume.
* Partner with product, architecture and customer delivery teams to take features from prototype to production with real customers.
* Own reliability, latency, cost and observability for the services you build.
* Raise the bar through design reviews, code reviews and mentoring.

**Qualifications**

* 2 to 4 years of software engineering experience, with at least 2 years building ML, LLM or AI-powered systems in production.
* Strong programming skills in Java, JavaScript or Python, and solid understanding of distributed systems and API design.
* Hands-on experience with LLM application patterns: prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation, tool or function calling, and agent frameworks.
* Experience with vector search, embeddings and information retrieval concepts.
* A measurement mindset: you’ve designed evals or experiments and used the results to make decisions.
* Clear communication and comfort working with distributed teams across time zones.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

* ServiceNow platform development experience (scoped apps, AI Search, Flow Designer, Now Assist).

The engineering challenge spans LLM orchestration, agentic planning, retrieval and reasoning, multilingual support, and real-time voice. Success means delivering grounded, policy-aligned conversations while meeting demanding standards for reliability, safety, latency, and cost efficiency.

* Advance conversational and voice AI: Guide low-latency voice experiences spanning streaming speech recognition and synthesis, natural turn-taking, interruption handling, and telephony or WebRTC integration.
* Set the quality bar: Establish offline evaluations, simulated scenarios, safety tests, and human-calibrated LLM-as-judge evaluations integrated into development and release workflows.
* Own production excellence: Design service-level objectives, fallbacks, human handoff, canary releases, and safeguards against prompt injection, jailbreaks, hallucinations, and exposure of personal information.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 10+ years building production ML or AI systems, including 4+ years leading complex ML initiatives end to end.
* Deep expertise in LLM-driven systems, including inference optimization, prompt and program design, model adaptation, safety controls, and evaluation.
* Strong software engineering skills in Python and at least one of Go, Java, or C++, with hands-on experience in distributed services and production infrastructure.
* Demonstrated ownership of highly available services, including service-level objectives, incident response, on-call leadership, and post-incident improvements.

* Experience building production agentic architectures using planning, execution, memory, and multi-step reasoning.

* Practical experience with fine-tuning, distillation, or parameter-efficient adaptation techniques such as LoRA.
* Experience with hallucination mitigation, safety red-teaming, privacy-conscious system design, and controlled production rollouts.

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.

title: Reporting Specialist
description:
Workday Reporting – Finance (Manager / Senior Developer / Developer / Support Analyst)

**Experience:**
2–13 years

**Work Location:**
As per business requirement

**Work Mode:**
As per business requirement

Role Summary

We are looking for Workday Reporting professionals across multiple experience levels to support a live Workday Finance environment in a post-go-live Application Management Services (AMS) engagement.

The roles will be responsible for developing, maintaining, enhancing and supporting Workday reports across Finance and Operations. Candidates should have hands-on experience with Workday Report Writer, Advanced Reports, Composite Reports, Matrix Reports, Calculated Fields and report troubleshooting.

Strong knowledge of Workday Finance data and the ability to validate reporting outputs against financial transactions are essential. Depending on experience, responsibilities will range from first-line reporting support and report development to complex reporting solutions, technical governance, team leadership and stakeholder management.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, enhance and maintain Workday standard, advanced, composite and matrix reports using Workday Report Writer.
* Build and maintain calculated fields, custom report data sources, dashboards and reporting solutions to meet business requirements.
* Troubleshoot and resolve production reporting issues, including broken calculated fields, missing data, incorrect filters, security access issues and report failures.
* Develop BIRT reports and pixel-perfect documents for complex reporting requirements.
* Create scheduled reports, report subscriptions, bursting reports and RaaS (Report-as-a-Service) endpoints for downstream consumption.
* Apply Workday Finance domain knowledge to select appropriate data sources and validate report outputs against source transactions and financial records.
* Work with Finance and Operations stakeholders to gather requirements, clarify reporting needs and translate business questions into technical report designs.
* Manage reporting change requests, incident queues and delivery timelines in accordance with agreed SLAs.
* Conduct unit testing, support UAT and perform regression testing following Workday semiannual releases.
* Maintain report inventories, technical documentation, field mappings, filters and reporting standards.
* Collaborate with Finance Functional, Integration and Enterprise BI teams to resolve cross-functional reporting and data issues.
* Support Workday Prism Analytics and Discovery Boards where applicable.

Workday Technical Skills

* Workday Report Writer – Standard and Advanced Reports
* Composite Reports and Matrix Reports
* BIRT Reports
* Calculated Fields and Custom Report Data Sources
* Workday Dashboards and Worklets
* RaaS (Report-as-a-Service)
* Report Scheduling, Subscriptions and Bursting
* Workday Security and Report Sharing
* Workday Prism Analytics and Discovery Boards
* Workday Release Management, Regression Testing and Production Support

Workday Finance Domain Knowledge

Candidates should have working or hands-on knowledge of relevant Workday Finance data domains, such as:

* Accounts Payable (AP)
* General Ledger (GL)
* Supplier Accounts
* Procurement
* Project Accounting and Project Financials
* Customer Accounts and Customer Billing
* Banking and Settlement
* Treasury
* Expenses

The depth of Finance knowledge and the number of domains required will depend on the role level.

Experience Levels and Role Expectations

**1. Workday Reporting Support Analyst – 2–4 Years**

* Provide first-line support for Workday reporting incidents, user queries and change requests.
* Troubleshoot standard reporting issues involving calculated fields, filters, missing data and security access.
* Build ad-hoc standard reports using Workday Report Writer.
* Maintain report inventories and incident documentation.
* Track and deliver reporting requests within agreed SLAs.
* Escalate complex issues to senior reporting developers.

**2. Workday Reporting Developer – 3–5 Years**

* Independently develop standard, advanced, composite and matrix reports.
* Build calculated fields, custom report data sources, dashboards and RaaS endpoints.
* Resolve production reporting issues and validate outputs against financial transactions.
* Manage reporting change requests, unit testing and UAT.
* Support report scheduling, bursting and Workday release impact assessments.

**3. Workday Reporting Senior Developer – 6–9 Years**

* Design and deliver complex reporting solutions using Advanced, Composite, Matrix and BIRT reports.
* Handle complex reporting escalations, calculated-field errors and cross-domain data discrepancies.
* Apply deep Workday Finance data-model knowledge to validate reporting accuracy.
* Establish reporting standards, conduct peer reviews and mentor reporting developers.
* Lead reporting impact assessments and regression testing for Workday semiannual releases.
* Develop and maintain RaaS endpoints for Power BI, Tableau and other enterprise BI platforms.

**4. Workday Reporting Manager – 9–13 Years**

* Lead and manage reporting developers and support analysts, including work allocation, priorities and performance management.
* Own reporting delivery quality, SLAs, backlog management and AMS delivery metrics.
* Serve as the senior escalation point for Finance and Operations reporting requirements.
* Establish reporting governance, security design principles, change management procedures and report lifecycle standards.
* Oversee advanced reporting solutions, BIRT documents, dashboards and executive Finance reporting.
* Manage Workday release impact assessments, regression testing and reporting roadmap decisions.
* Engage with senior Finance and IT stakeholders, enterprise BI teams and Workday Customer Success.
* Build team capability through mentoring, structured development plans and knowledge sharing.

Qualifications and Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Finance, Business, Data Analytics or a related discipline.
* Relevant Workday reporting experience in a live Workday environment, preferably in a post-go-live or AMS engagement.
* Workday Reporting certification is mandatory.
* Hands-on experience with Workday Report Writer, Calculated Fields and relevant reporting tools.
* Demonstrated knowledge of Workday Finance data structures and reporting requirements.
* Experience in report troubleshooting, data validation, production support and stakeholder coordination.

**Experience by level:**

* Support Analyst: 2–4 years
* Reporting Developer: 3–5 years
* Senior Developer: 6–9 years
* Reporting Manager: 9–13 years, including at least 4 years in a reporting lead or management capacity.

Preferred Skills

* Workday Prism Analytics certification or hands-on Prism experience.
* Discovery Boards experience.
* BIRT reporting experience.
* SQL or data modelling knowledge.
* Exposure to enterprise BI platforms such as Power BI, Tableau or SAP Analytics Cloud.
* Experience managing Workday reporting AMS or Centre of Excellence (COE) functions.

General and Professional Skills

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Good communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to translate business requirements into reporting solutions.
* Attention to detail and focus on data accuracy.
* Strong documentation and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced production support environment.
