title: Purchasing Analyst
description:
Seaspan employees are goal-driven and thrive in a high-performance culture. Our integrated business model, with over 25 years of fleet life-cycle management expertise, provides the world’s major shipping companies with long-term leases on large, modern and technologically advanced vessels, combined with industry-leading ship management services. As owner and operator of the vessels, we provide skilled officers and crews dedicated to the safe, reliable, and economical operation of our fleet. Seaspan's fleet has evolved over time to meet the varying needs of our customer base. We own vessels in a wide range of sizes, from 2,500 TEU to 24,000 TEU. Our main operating offices are located in Singapore, Vancouver, Hong Kong, and Mumbai.
  
  
**Position Summary:**
The Purchasing Analyst drives cost control and performance across the purchasing and logistics function through
  
  
spend analysis, KPI reporting, and process improvement. Working with the purchasing team, category managers,
  
  
fleet and technical teams, finance, and third-party logistics (3PL) suppliers, the role turns purchasing and freight
  
  
data into clear, actionable insight. The analyst tracks spend under management, identifies savings opportunities
  
  
and purchasing behaviours that drive unnecessary cost, and monitors 3PL supplier performance and freight spend
  
  
across the fleet.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Spend Analysis and Compliance**

* Track and report spend under management compliance, measuring the share of spend placed with contracted and approved suppliers by vessel, category, and purchaser.
* Identify off-contract and maverick spend, and work with purchasers and category managers to bring it back under management.
* Analyze purchasing patterns to identify savings opportunities, including order consolidation, planned versus urgent purchasing, price variances, and supplier selection.
* Highlight purchasing behaviours that drive avoidable cost, such as late requisitions, split orders, and repeated urgent purchases, and recommend corrective actions.

**Freight and 3PL Performance**

* Monitor freight spend by vessel, port, mode, and 3PL supplier, and report trends and cost drivers to management.
* Track air versus sea freight mix, consolidation rates, and cost per kg, and monitor compliance with the urgent air freight approval process.
* Monitor 3PL supplier performance against agreed KPIs and service levels, including transit times, delivery reliability, cost, and reporting accuracy, and prepare data for supplier performance reviews.
* Reconcile 3PL invoices and reports against purchasing and shipment data, and flag discrepancies.

**KPIs, Reporting, and Systems**

* Develop and report purchasing KPIs, including requisition-to-order time, PO cycle time, supplier lead times, ontime delivery, and emergency purchase rates.
* Build and maintain Power BI dashboards and monthly management reports covering spend, savings, freight, and supplier performance.
* Extract, clean, and maintain data from the purchasing system (Jibe), and work with system owners to resolve data quality issues and system gaps.
* Automate recurring reports and support process improvements that reduce manual work for the purchasing team.

**Analytical Support**

* Provide analysis for tenders, supplier reviews, budget planning, and audits.
* Support benchmarking of purchasing and logistics cost and performance.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree, preferably in Supply Chain, Engineering, Business, Statistics, Management Information Systems, or a related field.
* 3 to 4 years of experience in purchasing, procurement, or logistics data analysis.
* Experience developing KPIs, dashboards, and management reporting.
* Understanding of the purchase-to-pay (P2P) cycle and of freight and logistics cost drivers.
* Strong analytical skills, with advanced proficiency in Excel (pivot tables, Power Query, lookups, data modelling) and Power BI.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present data clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks.
* Detail-oriented and resourceful, with a solution-driven attitude.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in shipping, ship management, or another asset-heavy industry.
* Experience with purchasing or ERP software (Jibe, SAP, ShipNet, or similar).
* Knowledge of SQL or Python for data extraction and automation.
* Experience working with freight forwarders or 3PL providers.
* Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt or Green Belt certification.

title: Senior Trading Specialist
description:
The Trade Desk is a global technology company and the world’s leading independent platform for digital advertising, with over 3,000 employees across more than 30 offices. Our technology helps advertisers reach the right audiences across the open internet — from streaming TV and podcasts to mobile apps, news, and more.
  
  
Advertising powers the content people love. By making it more transparent, effective, and responsible, we help support trusted journalism, quality entertainment, and creators worldwide. The world’s brands and agencies rely on us to reach their customers and grow their businesses responsibly.
  
  
The scale of our platform brings unique technical challenges — from processing massive datasets in real time to building systems that operate reliably on a global scale. When you work here, your impact is worldwide. We welcome diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and build teams that learn from one another. If you’re driven to solve meaningful challenges, we’d love to meet you.
  
  
The Trade Desk is changing the way global brands and their agencies advertise to audiences around the world. How? With a media buying platform that helps brands deliver a more insightful and relevant ad experience for consumers –– and sets a new standard for global reach, accuracy, and transparency. We are proud of the culture we have built. We value the unique experiences and perspectives that each person brings to The Trade Desk, and we are committed to fostering inclusive spaces where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work every day.
  
  
So, if you are talented, driven, creative, and eager to join a dynamic, globally-connected team, then we want to talk!
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Become an expert on The Trade Desk’s platform and create best practices for campaign management. You will work closely with clients in the West and South markets in India to troubleshoot campaigns, but will also explain industry trends, upcoming product releases, and new partnerships for relevant opportunities.
* Proactively advise clients on optimisation strategies to help improve campaign pacing and performance. Act as a consultant to clients, understanding their performance goals and objectives and helping clients take full advantage of The Trade Desk’s product suite in order to hit/exceed those goals.
* Provide mid- and post-campaign data analytics and present those findings to clients.
* Collaborate with Account Management and Business Development teams to provide support to clients, including onboarding, optimisation trainings, and product updates.
* Be an influencer in new product development cycle and in beta testing new products as well as in giving feedback on beta test results.
* Understand and communicate The Trade Desk’s value proposition, technology, and partnerships to help grow clients’ accounts.
* Clearly identify, communicate, and offer solutions for problems, spend blockers, and future threats or opportunities. Escalating challenges appropriately.
* Develop strong time management skills and be able to prioritize what the client really needs and what will add the most value.
* Be actively involved in helping to develop trading best practices and seek to share this knowledge with the wider team.
* Demonstrate a level of maturity and gravitas in front of clients and internally. Able to present to all levels confidently.
* Senior Trading Specialists are committed to collaboration and sharing best practices with peers both within and outside of the Trading function.
* They will start taking the lead on delivering to clients and need less day to day direction.
* Be able to present a compelling story to our clients. Adapting to what the client needs to see, balancing the right amount of information; right level of abstract and adapting to different levels in the client org.

**Who You Are**

* 7-9 years of digital advertising experience. Experience in ad tech and/or programmatic advertising is preferred.
* 2-4 years of client facing experience
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting abilities, along with an ability to collaborate cross-functionally in a fast-paced environment
* Effective time management skills – ability to prioritize and meet deadlines
* Proficient in Excel and MS Office suite, including pivot tables, chart-making, and manipulation of large datasets
* Strong quantitative skills and the ability to draw insights from large datasets
* Ability to thrive in a small and high growth environment

*The Trade Desk does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firm recruiters. Fees will not be paid in the event a candidate submitted by a recruiter without an agreement in place is hired; such resumes will be deemed the sole property of The Trade Desk. The Trade Desk is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment will be based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.*
In accordance with various US state laws, the range provided is the Trade Desk's reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may differ based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, and location. All employees may be eligible to become The Trade Desk shareholders through eligibility for stock-based compensation grants, which are awarded to employees based on company and individual performance. The Trade Desk also offers other compensation depending on the role such as variable compensation-based incentives and commissions. Plus, expected benefits for this role include comprehensive healthcare (medical, dental, and vision) with premiums paid in full for employees and dependents, retirement benefits such as a 401k plan and company match, short and long-term disability coverage, basic life insurance, well-being benefits, reimbursement for certain tuition expenses, parental leave, sick time of 1 hour per 30 hours worked, vacation time for full-time employees up to 120 hours thru the first year and 160 hours thereafter, and around 13 paid holidays per year. Employees can also purchase The Trade Desk stock at a discount through The Trade Desk’s Employee Stock Purchase Plan.
  
  
The Trade Desk also offers a competitive benefits package. Click here to learn more.

$97,800—$179,400 USD

title: Supply Analyst - FINI & SEMI, Global Planning Hub
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**
Join the GIC Supply Planning team to translate demand into reliable production and inventory plans for finished and semi-finished products. You will support and enhance planning data, systems, and processes that guide capacity, production, and replenishment decisions.The role involves evaluating planning effectiveness against key business KPIs and driving continuous improvement across global supply planning capabilities. You will collaborate closely with supply planners, plant schedulers, regional planning teams, Supply Chain partners, and GPE/Centers of Excellence (COEs) to improve consistency, efficiency, and planning performance.This role requires working in the 1:30 PM–10:30 PM shift.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Manage supply planning data, parameters, and solver settings to support accurate production splits and capacity plans.
* Analyze planning outputs and resolve data by working attribute gaps with supply planners, plant planners, and finite schedulers.
* Coordinate long-range inventory planning and ensure right product at right time at right location.
* Maintain finished-product lifecycle planning inputs and apply supply-chain optimization policies.
* Monitor supply planning performance measures and provide concise reports with actionable insights.
* Validate system-generated activities and outputs; identify improvements and support standard processes, governance, documentation, and knowledge sharing.
* Partner with Supply Chain teams and planning leads on service-level commitments and continuous improvement initiatives.

KEY COMPETENCIES
  
  

* Supply chain planning and operational management.
* Data analysis and problem-solving.
* Cross-functional collaboration.
* Strategic thinking and adaptability.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent graduate qualification.
* 2-3 years of experience in supply planning, production planning, or end-to-end supply chain operations.
* Hands-on experience with an SAP enterprise resource planning module.
* Basic knowledge of planning for finished and semi-finished products.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree or higher in supply chain management or a related field.
* Experience in the fast-moving consumer goods industry.
* Experience supporting global or regional planning teams and working across multiple functions.

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Manager/Specialist - Paid/Affiliate
description:
**WE'RE HIRING**

**Manager / Specialist – Affiliate Growth & Paid Media**

*Own affiliate acquisition end to end: build partnerships, launch offers and drive high-quality users and first transactions.*

**LOCATION**

**[Noida]**

**EXPERIENCE**

**[3–6 years]**

**SALARY**

**[As Per Market Standards]**

Your Impact at EaseMyDeal

**GROWTH, PERFORMANCE & ANALYTICS TEAM**

**Own Affiliate Growth End to End**

Build the affiliate roadmap, source partners and execute campaigns from outreach through first transaction.

**Launch Coupon & Cashback Partnerships**

Place offers and coupon codes across deal sites, cashback apps and rewards publishers on affiliate models.

**Test Referrals & Reward Placements**

Pilot refer-and-earn, post-transaction offers, success-page scratch cards and partner-app placements.

**Work with Our Growth Stack**

Use Trackier, Apptrove, WebEngage, GA4, Firebase Analytics and Google Tag Manager to measure growth.

**Measure Acquisition & Traffic Quality**

Track verified registrations, first transactions, CAC, retention and suspicious or invalid affiliate traffic.

**Hands-On Paid Media Execution**

Run and optimise Google Ads and Meta campaigns; Google App Campaigns (UAC) knowledge is a plus.

**Lead Publisher Negotiations**

Own commercial terms, CPA/CPI/CPL/CPS or revenue-share payouts, onboarding and publisher relationships.

**Test, Optimise and Scale**

Experiment with publishers, placements, offer hooks and funnels, then scale efficient acquisition sources.

About EaseMyDeal

**5M+**

Active users

**₹15,000+ Cr**

Cumulative GMV

**4**

National awards in 2025–26

EaseMyDeal is a fast-growing FinTech company changing how India saves, spends and manages money. Our platform brings a wallet, credit cards, loans, digital gold, travel bookings, bill payments and a rewards store into one place, so everyday transactions are simpler and more rewarding.

We have 5M+ customers, and we want to build India’s leading fintech and deals ecosystem, one that goes beyond payments. We keep trying new things to give our customers more value.

We want EaseMyDeal to be a place where ideas are welcome, people are backed to grow, and anyone can take ownership of a real problem and solve it.

If you like fast-moving teams, want to help build the future of FinTech and enjoy solving real problems alongside people who care, you’ll fit right in.

And yes,
**we try not to be boring.**
No rigid hierarchies and not much red tape. We’ve built a strong foundation, but we’re only getting started.
**That’s where you come in.**

**How We Work:**
No fluff, a lot of autonomy and fast execution. No micro-management, just direct access to leadership and the freedom to do your best work.

**Recognised for building fintech that works**

**Entrepreneur Awards 2025**

Bootstrapped Business of the Year

**ET Business Excellence 2026**

Excellence in Digital Payments

**Forbes India DGEMS 2025**

Select 200 Global Potential

**Outlook Business Spotlight 2026**

NextGen Fintech of the Year

What you’ll do

You will build and execute EaseMyDeal’s affiliate growth engine, while also managing Google and Meta paid acquisition campaigns.

**Build affiliate strategy and publisher partnerships**

•    Own the affiliate growth roadmap, partner pipeline and campaign budgets across agencies, networks, direct publishers and partner apps.

•    Find, pitch, onboard and negotiate performance-based campaigns using CPA, CPI, CPL, CPS, revenue-share and hybrid commercials.

**Launch coupon, referral and rewards campaigns**

•    Get EaseMyDeal offers and exclusive coupon codes live across coupon websites, cashback apps, deal communities and loyalty platforms.

•    Build affiliate-led referral programs, success-page offers, post-transaction scratch cards, vouchers and other partner-app placements.

**Execute campaigns and manage partner quality**

•    Own partner briefs, creatives, offer terms, deep links, coupon mapping, campaign launches, pacing and payout reconciliation.

•    Validate conversions, commission terms, identify duplicate or fraudulent traffic, prevent incentive abuse and optimise partners for genuine transactions.

**Plan and optimise Google and Meta paid media**

•    Launch and manage Google Ads and Meta campaigns for user acquisition, in-app conversions and remarketing; UAC experience preferred.

•    Test audiences, bids, creatives and landing or app funnels while managing CAC, budgets, conversion rates and ROAS.

**Measure, attribute and scale profitable growth**

•    Operate tracking and insights across Trackier (affiliates), Apptrove (app attribution), WebEngage (customer events and lifecycle), GA4, Firebase Analytics and GTM.

•    Report the click-to-first-transaction funnel, partner CAC, cohort quality, retention and LTV; scale publishers based on valid incremental results.

Your first 90 days

**FIRST 30 DAYS**

**Learn**

•    Audit affiliate agencies, publishers, campaign tracking and paid acquisition

•    Build a shortlist of coupon, cashback, referral and rewards partners

•    Propose pilot budgets, payout models and first-transaction KPIs

**BY DAY 60**

**Own**

•    Launch pilot affiliate offers across selected partner formats

•    Set up Trackier/Apptrove tracking and validate conversion events

•    Manage Google/Meta testing and partner performance reporting

**BY DAY 90**

**Lead**

•    Scale publishers delivering valid, cost-efficient first transactions

•    Establish fraud checks, reconciliation and publisher-level CAC reviews

•    Present the next quarter’s partner pipeline and acquisition roadmap

What we’re looking for

**Must-haves**

•    3-6 years in owning affiliate campaigns, including 1-2 years of paid campaigns for a B2C product company or consumer app.

•    Existing relationships with Indian coupon, cashback, affiliate, loyalty, rewards and performance publishers.

•    Advertiser-side experience sourcing, onboarding and scaling agencies, affiliate networks and direct publishers, with payout negotiation.

•    Ability to launch coupon, cashback, deals or referral campaigns and manage them independently from outreach through optimisation.

•    Working knowledge of CPA/CPI/CPL/CPS, revenue share, tracking links, app attribution, postbacks, fraud checks and conversion validation.

•    Hands-on campaign execution in Google Ads and Meta Ads, including targeting, bids, measurement and optimisation.

•    Comfortable with app funnel analytics, CAC, cost per first transaction, ROAS, LTV, Excel or Google Sheets and partner reporting.

**Nice to have**

•    Fintech, payments, lending, credit cards, recharge, wallets or other transaction-led consumer apps.

•    Hands-on exposure to our stack: Trackier, Apptrove, WebEngage, GA4, Firebase Analytics and Google Tag Manager (or comparable tools).

•    Google App Campaigns (UAC), app-event optimisation and mobile retargeting.

•    Success-page / scratch-card reward placements, offerwalls and performance-based referral programs.

•    Data or Looker Studio, cohort analysis, experimentation and incremental acquisition measurement.

*A marketing or related degree is welcome but not required. Your track record matters most.*
***Don’t tick every box? Apply***

**Who You Are**

•    
**Commercially focused**

: You optimize for valid first transactions and customer value, not just clicks or installs.

•    
**A proactive partnership builder:**

You independently find opportunities, negotiate deals and take campaigns live.

•    
**Execution-driven:**

You track every placement, test new formats, detect fraud and scale what performs.

In short: Bring product-company affiliate growth experience, hands-on partnership execution and strong Google/Meta paid media skills.

What you’ll get

•    
**Competitive pay:**

title: Junior Research Fellow
description:
🚀 URGENT: We are hiring! Active Recruitment: One (1) Junior Research Fellow (JRF)

Opportunities are open for motivated researchers to join the Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF) funded PM ECRG project: "AI-Native Foundations for Interference, Connectivity, and Mobility Optimization in Next-Generation Networks."

**Executive project summary:**
Next-generation Networks (NGNs) are expected to deliver high data rates, uninterrupted services to underserved and unserved communities, increased end-user density, and enhanced communication reliability. The existing wireless mobile networks' transition from Fifth Generation (5G) mobile networks to NGNs, including Beyond 5G (B5G) and 6G technologies, introduces unprecedented architectural complexity, larger network density, and more heterogeneity, making interference management, resource allocation, and service reliability a critical challenge, where end users located in areas with underserved and unserved locations often experience interruptions while accessing broadband services.

This project will deliver novel theoretical models, AI-native algorithmic frameworks, and simulation prototypes suited for real-world NGN operations. Also, the proposal will design a UAV-assisted last-mile connectivity network, which strongly justifies national priority missions, such as Digital India, BharatNet, and the National Digital Communications Policy 2018. Therefore, the proposal also aligns directly with the goals of national connectivity and digital inclusion.

**Keywords:**
Next-Generation Networks, AI-Native Optimization, Multi-Objective CoMP, Mechanism-Design Models, UAV-Assisted Connectivity, AI-Native Mobility & Hand-off.

description:

At CoverGo, our mission is to empower all insurance companies to make insurance 100% digital and accessible to everyone.

CoverGo is hiring an ISMS Manager to own our internal and external audit programme and give management independent assurance on the state of our cybersecurity compliance and risk management. The Security team is small and growing, and works AI-first: everyone uses AI to automate their own work and to scale security across a large engineering organisation.

### **What You Will Do**

* Own the internal and external audit programme, including ISO 27001 and SOC 2 certification and surveillance audits.
* Set up and run an internal audit framework: audit plan, scoping, control testing, findings and follow-up.
* Design custom control frameworks that establish clear ownership and accountability in a matrix organisation, where several teams share responsibility for the same systems.
* Define technical controls for the engineering organisation and test that they operate as designed.
* Report to management on compliance status, control effectiveness and risk, with clear findings and named owners.
* Maintain the risk register and drive remediation through to closure.
* Prepare audit evidence for customer security reviews and due diligence.
* Use AI to automate evidence collection, control testing and reporting.

### **What We Need**

* 3+ years in information security governance, risk and compliance, or audit.
* Hands-on experience leading ISO 27001 and SOC 2 certifications through to a successful audit.
* A track record of building internal audit frameworks with custom controls, not just adopting a standard template.
* Experience designing control frameworks that assign accountability across a matrix organisation.
* Enough technical depth to define and test controls for engineering teams, such as access management, change management, secure development and cloud configuration.
* Practical experience using AI to automate compliance and audit workflows.
* Clear writing for both engineers and executives.

### **Nice to have**

* ISO 27001 Lead Auditor or CISA certification.
* Experience in insurance, financial services or another regulated SaaS environment.

title: Operations Engineer
description:
Syniverse is the world’s most connected company. Whether we’re developing the technology that enables intelligent cars to safely react to traffic changes or freeing travelers to explore by keeping their devices online wherever they go, we believe in leading the world forward. Which is why we work with some of the world’s most recognized brands. Eight of the top 10 banks. Four of the top 5 global technology companies. Over 900 communications providers. And how we’re able to provide our incredible talent with an innovative culture and great benefits.

**Who We're Looking For**

The Operations Engineer provides technical solutions to exceptionally difficult problems. This role will address day-to-day customer issues, application issues, problems and concerns that are detailed and complex in nature, requiring analysis and research. This position will install, configure, operate and evolve common infrastructure such as the network, servers, and external services (e.g. the cloud).





**Some of What You'll Do**

**Scope of the Role:**

* **Direct Reports:** This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Provide technical support for business critical applications running on Linux based production environments.
* Monitor, maintain, and troubleshoot production applications, servers, and supporting services to ensure availability and performance.
* Investigate and resolve complex technical issues through log analysis, system health checks, database queries, and structured troubleshooting.
* Perform Linux server health checks, including CPU, memory, disk utilization, processes, services, and network connectivity.
* Analyze application and system logs to identify errors, performance issues, and potential root causes.
* Troubleshoot application failures, processing delays, connectivity issues, and service interruptions.
* Use SQL queries to investigate application issues, validate data, and support incident resolution.
* Participate in production incidents, help identify root cause analysis, and coordinate with internal technical teams and third-party vendors when necessary.
* Monitor application processes, scheduled jobs, file transfers, data processing, and system alerts.
* Participate in production changes, deployments, maintenance activities, and post-implementation validations.
* Identify opportunities for operational improvements, automation, and proactive issue prevention.
* Maintain technical documentation, troubleshooting procedures, and incident records.

**Required Technical Skills**

  

* Linux Administration and Troubleshooting: Strong hands on experience supporting and troubleshooting applications in Linux based production environments, preferably RHEL.
* SQL and Relational Databases: Working knowledge of SQL, including the ability to independently execute queries, analyze records, and investigate application related database issues.
* Application Support and Troubleshooting: Experience investigating application failures, analyzing logs, monitoring processes, and resolving production issues.
* Networking Fundamentals: Understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, ports, connectivity troubleshooting, and common network protocols.
* Analytical and Problem Solving Skills: Strong troubleshooting capabilities, critical thinking, and the ability to independently investigate and resolve complex technical issues.

**Preferred Technical Skills**

  

* Experience with AWS cloud environments and application support.
* Familiarity with Apache Kafka and distributed messaging systems.
* Knowledge of shell scripting, Bash, or Python.
* Experience with monitoring and log analysis tools such as Grafana or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with automation tools such as Ansible.

**Experience, Education, and Certifications**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Telecommunications, or equivalent work experience.
* Minimum 2 years of relevant professional experience, with 3+ years preferred, in Linux-based application operations, production support, or technical troubleshooting.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience with Linux, SQL, and application troubleshooting.
* Experience supporting business critical production environments is highly desirable.
* Linux, AWS, or database certifications are preferred but not mandatory.

**Additional Requirements**

  

* Ability to work independently, take ownership of technical issues, and drive incidents through resolution with minimal supervision.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and decision making skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with technical and non technical stakeholders.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams while maintaining accountability for assigned responsibilities.
* Proactive approach to problem solving, continuous improvement, and learning new technologies.
* Participate in an on-call rotation and support critical production incidents as required.



**Why You Should Join Us**

Join us as we write a new chapter, guided by world-class leadership. Come be a part of an exciting and growing organization where we offer a competitive total compensation, flexible/remote work and with a leadership team committed to fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and transparent organizational culture.

At Syniverse connectedness is at the core of our business. We believe diversity, equity, and inclusion among our employees is crucial to our success as a global company as we seek to recruit, develop, and retain the most talented people who want to help us connect the world.

**Know someone at Syniverse?**

Be sure to have them submit you as a referral prior to applying for this position.

Pay Transparency

In accordance with applicable pay transparency requirements, Syniverse will provide information regarding the salary range or compensation for this position during the recruitment process and prior to any compensation discussions.

Linux System Support/Admin – HPCThis role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

**Who We Are:**

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. **Job Description:**

**High Performance Computing, AI and Labs** is a critical element of HPE. We are focused on delivering innovative solutions that accelerate our customers’ digital transformation, enabling them to tackle their complex, and data-intensive workloads. Combining deep expertise and the development of the world’s most cutting-edge, high-performance supercomputers, is defining the next era of computing delivering valuable insight & innovation. Join us and redefine what’s next for you.

**What you'll do:**
-------------------

The Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) HPC Business Unit has an exciting opportunity for an experienced engineer dedicated to providing **remote systems administration and proactive technical support for High-Performance Computing (HPC) environments**. These environments involve multiple components such as operating systems (OS), workload managers, high-speed networks, clustered file systems, and HPC cluster managers.

This role is part of our Global Remote Services (GRS) team and focuses on delivering exceptional service while ensuring the **availability, reliability, performance, and smooth operation of customers' HPC environments**.

As part of this role, you will work within a collaborative team environment where teamwork is essential. Engineers are expected to contribute to the successful operation and support of customer environments. This includes **performing proactive system health checks, troubleshooting technical issues, planning and coordinating maintenance activities, sharing knowledge, documenting findings, communicating with customers, and working with other HPE technical teams when specialist or onsite intervention is required**.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

In this role, you will:

* **Provide remote systems administration and proactive technical support for HPC environments**, dedicating a significant portion of the role to system health monitoring, technical assessment, troubleshooting, documentation, planning, and customer communication, alongside hands-on remote administration activities.
* **Perform detailed technical assessments and regular health checks** across HPC environments, including operating systems, workload managers, SlingShot and other high-speed networks, clustered file systems, cluster management components, and related infrastructure.
* **Troubleshoot and resolve technical and integration challenges** across a mix of HPC technologies, providing effective solutions and recommendations to maintain system availability, stability, and performance while minimizing customer impact.
* **Collaborate with global teams**, including Level 3 SMEs, engineering teams, support organizations, and onsite engineering personnel, to investigate and resolve complex technical issues and deliver seamless, customer-focused support.
* **Prepare and maintain comprehensive technical documentation**, including system health-check reports, troubleshooting notes, technical procedures, maintenance plans, configuration information, recommendations, and customer-facing reports.
* **Provide timely and effective communication with customers**, ensuring they have a clear understanding of system health, identified issues, recommended actions, ongoing investigations, maintenance activities, and outcomes.
* **Coordinate planned maintenance and technical activities** with customers and relevant HPE teams, helping ensure appropriate preparation, technical validation, risk identification, and post-maintenance verification.
* **Proactively identify potential risks and technical issues** before they result in service impact, working with customers and internal teams to recommend appropriate corrective or preventive actions.
* **Support incident investigation and problem resolution**, collecting and analyzing relevant system information, logs, alerts, and diagnostic data, and escalating to the appropriate specialist teams when required.
* **Be flexible with working hours** to support critical customer situations, planned maintenance activities, project milestones, and deadlines, including occasional extended hours and weekend work as needed.
* **Act as a technical service advocate for the customer**, ensuring that systems administration activities and technical recommendations align with the customer's operational and business requirements.
* **Contribute to continuous improvement and knowledge sharing** within the Global Remote Services team by documenting solutions, developing reusable procedures, sharing technical knowledge, and helping improve remote support practices.

**What you need to bring:**

***Education and Experience Required:***

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent.
* 4+ years experience preferred

**Key Qualifications:**
-----------------------

* **In-depth Linux knowledge**, with proficiency in Red Hat, CentOS, or similar Linux distributions.
* **Strong scripting experience with Bash and Python**, with the ability to develop scripts for system administration, diagnostics, automation, data collection, and repetitive operational tasks.
* **Expertise in clustered file systems** such as Lustre, CXFS, GPFS, or StorNext.
* **Hands-on experience with high-speed networking** technologies such as SlingShot, InfiniBand, or Omni-Path.
* **Hands-on experience with HPC workload managers** such as Slurm or PBS.
* **Strong experience administering and troubleshooting HPC systems**, including system health monitoring, configuration management, performance investigation, log analysis, maintenance, and incident resolution.
* Experience working with **HPC cluster management and monitoring tools** and diagnosing issues across multiple components of an HPC environment.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to **isolate complex issues across compute, storage, network, workload management, and operating system layers**.
* Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to **manage multiple customer environments, technical activities, incidents, and priorities effectively**.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills in English, with a strong emphasis on **customer-focused communication and the ability to translate complex technical findings into clear actions and recommendations**.
* Ability to work effectively in a **global and collaborative support environment**, coordinating with remote specialists, engineering teams, and onsite personnel when necessary.

title: Software Application Development Manager
description:
At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.

**Overview**

Boeing is the world's largest aerospace company and leading manufacturer of commercial airplanes and defense, space and security systems. We are engineers and technicians. Skilled scientists and thinkers. Bold innovators and dreamers. Join us, and you can build something better for yourself, for our customers and for the world.

As a leading global aerospace company, Boeing develops, manufactures and services commercial airplanes, defense products and space systems for customers in more than 150 countries. As a top U.S. exporter, the company leverages the talents of a global supplier base to advance economic opportunity, sustainability and community impact. Boeing’s team is committed to innovating for the future, leading with sustainability, and cultivating a culture based on the company’s core values of safety, quality and integrity.

**Technology for today and tomorrow**

The Boeing India Engineering & Technology Center (BIETC) is a 5500+ engineering workforce that contributes to global aerospace growth. Our engineers deliver cutting-edge R&D, innovation, and high-quality engineering work in global markets, and leverage new-age technologies such as AI/ML, IIoT, Cloud, Model-Based Engineering, and Additive Manufacturing, shaping the future of aerospace.

**People-driven culture**

At Boeing, we believe creativity and innovation thrives when every employee is trusted, empowered, and has the flexibility to choose, grow, learn, and explore. We offer variable arrangements depending upon business and customer needs, and professional pursuits that offer greater flexibility in the way our people work. We also believe that collaboration, frequent team engagements, and face-to-face meetings bring together different perspectives and thoughts – enabling every voice to be heard and every perspective to be respected. No matter where or how our teammates work, we are committed to positively shaping people’s careers and being thoughtful about employee wellbeing.

With us, you can create and contribute to what matters most in your career, community, country, and world. Join us in powering the progress of global aerospace.

**Digital Services Overview**

At Boeing Digital Services, we focus on practical innovation that drives tangible results for the aerospace industry. Our team leverages advanced technology and data analytics to develop solutions that enhance operational efficiency and meet the needs of our customers. We are dedicated to creating intuitive, scalable, and secure solutions that empower our customers, partners, and team members to succeed. Join us in creating the future of aviation technology, where your contributions will shape impactful solutions for airlines around the globe.

**Position Overview**

We have an immediate opening for a **Software Application Development Manager** to lead multiple teams developing digital solutions in Application Engineering. This role requires deep engineering experience, the ability to guide teams, and the use of the latest AI tools to build cloud-native systems for cutting-edge digital aircraft maintenance products.

The role will work closely with peer managers, developers, engineering and greenfield leadership, data science, and architects to deliver product features and capabilities with AI/ML at the center. In this role, you will serve as a hands-on manager for development teams and ensure the delivery of reliable production software

This position will report to the Engineering leader of the **Boeing Global Services (BGS) Digital Services** group and work closely with stakeholders across the globe.

**Position Responsibilities:**

**Process Skills and Techniques**

* **Project Management:** Proficiency in managing projects and customer milestones, including planning, resource allocation, risk management, and ensuring timely delivery of products and capabilities.

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
**Company Description**

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**

We build the platform that powers ServiceNow AI Workers: autonomous agents that resolve incidents, complete tasks and learn from every interaction. Our engineers work across retrieval, evaluation, agent memory and learning, runtime infrastructure and customer delivery. The goal is simple: give people AI teammates they can trust, so they can spend their time on the work that matters most.

**What you’ll do**

* Design, build and run core services for the AI Worker platform, including agent runtime, orchestration, tool calling and skill management.
* Build retrieval pipelines that ground agents in enterprise knowledge, using hybrid search, embeddings, reranking and the ServiceNow AI Search stack.
* Develop memory and learning capabilities so agents improve from past resolutions, knowledge articles and human feedback.
* Create evaluation frameworks, including offline benchmarks, LLM-as-judge scoring, ablation studies and production quality monitoring, so we can measure whether agents are actually getting better.
* Integrate deeply with the Now Platform through scoped apps, GlideRecord, Flow Designer and platform APIs, and make AI capabilities easy for other teams to consume.
* Partner with product, architecture and customer delivery teams to take features from prototype to production with real customers.
* Own reliability, latency, cost and observability for the services you build.
* Raise the bar through design reviews, code reviews and mentoring.

  
**Qualifications**  

* 2 to 4 years of software engineering experience, with at least 2 years building ML, LLM or AI-powered systems in production.
* Strong programming skills in Java, JavaScript or Python, and solid understanding of distributed systems and API design.
* Hands-on experience with LLM application patterns: prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation, tool or function calling, and agent frameworks.
* Experience with vector search, embeddings and information retrieval concepts.
* A measurement mindset: you’ve designed evals or experiments and used the results to make decisions.
* Clear communication and comfort working with distributed teams across time zones.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Nice to have**

* ServiceNow platform development experience (scoped apps, AI Search, Flow Designer, Now Assist).

title: QA Lead - Trading Platform (India, Chennai)
description:
**About GoCharting**

GoCharting is a web-native charting and trading platform. Traders use professional orderflow tools — footprint charts, volume and market profile, cumulative delta, DOM trading — to read the market and place orders through their broker, all in the browser. Our users are active traders in India, the US and around the world.

**The Role**

You will own the quality gate that every release of GoCharting's terminal and apps passes before it reaches traders, and you will test and write automation yourself while you lead a small QA team. The role is full-time and in person in our Chennai office, and it reports to the Engineering Manager for Client Engineering. Every release needs one accountable owner of what "ready to ship" means, and that is you. At 12 months, no release should reach production without your sign-off, and the team should trust the checks behind it.

**What you'll do**

  

* **Own the release gate** — define what must pass before a release ships, run the sign-off, and stop a release that fails it
* **Test and automate yourself** — write and maintain end-to-end and regression automation for the web terminal and for APIs
* **Lead and coach the QA team** — assign work, review test plans and automation, and raise each engineer's standard
* **Run quality checks in CI** — keep automated tests as required checks on merges and releases, fast and reliable
* **Triage defects** — set severity with product and engineering, and track each one to a verified fix
* **Report quality plainly** — publish a weekly view of defects found, escaped and fixed

  

**What we're looking for**

**Must-haves:**

* 6+ years in QA or test automation on production web applications
* Hands-on automation code with Playwright, Cypress or Selenium, written by you
* Has owned a release gate or release sign-off for a production web application
* Has led or mentored other QA engineers
* Has run automated tests as required checks in a CI pipeline, for example GitHub Actions
* In person in our Chennai office, 5 days a week

  

**Nice-to-haves:**

* Testing real-time or data-dense applications, such as WebSocket feeds or live charts (adds the ability to test our core risk)
* API and contract testing for REST and WebSocket services (adds coverage below the UI)
* Performance and load testing with k6, JMeter or similar (adds confidence under market-open load)
* Trading, fintech or market-data testing (adds speed in learning our domain)
* Mobile app testing for iOS and Android (adds coverage of the app release)

  

**Logistics**

**Location** Chennai, India - in person, office-based  
**Employment type** Full-time  
**Entity** ProCharting Private Limited  
**Reports to** Engineering Manager, Client Engineering  
**Start date** ASAP  
**Travel** None

title: Technical Team Lead
description:
About Audit Sense

Audit Sense is an AI-powered SaaS company developing technology solutions for the Finance and Audit industry. We are looking for a hands-on Technical Team Lead to lead technical architecture, full-stack development and deployment delivery across our Subscription Management system, AuditSense application and AskAthena AI analysis product.

About the Role

The selected candidate will lead the technical team, contribute to production development, review architecture and code, and translate business requirements into scalable and maintainable software solutions.

The role involves managing existing cloud deployments and developing deployment capabilities for customer-managed on-premises and private-cloud environments. It also includes designing subscription and licensing controls across different deployment models.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Full-Stack Development & Architecture**

* Lead the development of React frontends and TypeScript APIs using Hono and Express.
* Define application architecture, module boundaries and service integration patterns.
* Design and manage PostgreSQL databases, Prisma schemas, migrations and database performance.
* Implement database connection pooling using PgBouncer or equivalent solutions.
* Manage multi-tenant database architecture and troubleshoot database connection issues.

**2. Identity & Application Security**

* Design enterprise Single Sign-On (SSO) using OpenID Connect, OAuth 2.0 and SAML.
* Manage JWT, session authentication, MFA, RBAC/ABAC and tenant isolation.
* Apply OWASP Top 10 security practices.
* Implement secure API authentication and HMAC-signed webhooks.

**3. Deployment Architecture & DevOps**

* Manage cloud, customer on-premises and private-cloud deployment architectures.
* Provision and maintain Azure infrastructure, including VMs, networking, storage, Key Vault and monitoring.
* Develop secure customer installation packages using Docker, Docker Compose and Kubernetes/Helm where appropriate.
* Build CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Azure Pipelines.
* Implement infrastructure as code using Terraform, Bicep or Pulumi.
* Manage deployment strategies, application upgrades, rollback procedures, monitoring and production reliability.

**4. Subscription & Licensing Management**

* Architect subscription and licence management across cloud, on-premises and private-cloud deployments.
* Design installation registration, activation, renewal, expiry and suspension mechanisms.
* Implement module entitlements, user limits and usage tracking.
* Develop secure communication and synchronization between customer installations and central subscription services.
* Support licensing requirements for restricted-connectivity and offline environments.

**5. Technical Leadership & Code Review**

* Lead technical planning, task allocation, estimation and delivery coordination.
* Review application architecture and production code.
* Establish development standards, testing practices and API documentation.
* Mentor technical team members and provide guidance during implementation and production support.

Required Technical Expertise

* Strong hands-on expertise in TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Node.js, Hono and Express.
* Strong PostgreSQL and Prisma ORM expertise, including database modelling, migrations, transactions, indexing and performance tuning.
* Practical experience with PgBouncer or equivalent database connection pooling solutions.
* DevOps experience with Docker, Docker Compose, Linux, nginx, GitHub Actions and Azure Pipelines.
* Hands-on Azure infrastructure experience, including virtual machines, networking, storage, identity, secrets and monitoring.
* Experience with customer-managed on-premises or private-cloud software deployments.
* Knowledge of SaaS subscription licensing and entitlement management.
* Experience with enterprise SSO, JWT, MFA, RBAC/ABAC and application security.
* Proven technical leadership, architecture decision-making and code review experience.
* Experience in automated testing, monitoring and production troubleshooting.

Preferred Experience

* Kubernetes, Helm and air-gapped customer installations.
* Infrastructure as code using Terraform, Azure Bicep or Pulumi.
* AI application integration, LLM providers, document processing and vector search.
* Redis, DBOS, ChromaDB, Microsoft Graph and enterprise audit workflows.
* Offline licensing and synchronization between central services and customer installations.

Expected Outcomes

Establish a clear technical architecture and delivery roadmap across our products, develop reliable cloud and customer-managed deployment models, implement a consistent subscription-control framework and lead the team towards maintainable software delivery and reliable releases.

  Audit Sense Pvt. Ltd.

title: Software Test Engineer
description:
We are seeking a meticulous and detail-oriented **Software Tester (QA Engineer)** to ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of our digital products. You will be responsible for designing and executing comprehensive test plans, identifying bugs, and collaborating with developers to resolve issues before they reach our users. If you have a knack for breaking things (in a constructive way), an obsession with quality, and a passion for delivering flawless user experiences, we want you on our team.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Test Planning & Strategy**

* Review and analyze software requirements, user stories, and design documents to provide early feedback on testability and potential risks.
* Design, document, and maintain detailed, reusable test plans, test cases, and test scripts for various testing levels (unit, integration, system, acceptance).
* Estimate, prioritize, plan, and coordinate testing activities across multiple projects and sprints.
* Define and track quality metrics (defect density, test coverage, pass/fail rates) to measure and improve testing effectiveness.

**Manual Testing (Functional & Non-Functional)**

* Execute manual test cases to verify functionality, usability, and user experience across web, mobile, and desktop applications.
* Perform exploratory testing to identify edge cases, unexpected behaviors, and user experience friction points that scripted tests might miss.
* Conduct regression testing to ensure new features don't break existing functionality.
* Perform non-functional testing including usability, accessibility (WCAG), compatibility (cross-browser, cross-device), and security testing (OWASP basics).

**Automation Testing**

* Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts using industry-standard frameworks to increase testing efficiency and coverage.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) to enable continuous testing and rapid feedback.
* Identify and prioritize test cases suitable for automation to maximize ROI and reduce manual regression efforts.
* Maintain and refactor automation frameworks as the application evolves.

**API & Backend Testing**

* Validate RESTful APIs and GraphQL endpoints using tools like Postman, REST Assured, or SoapUI.
* Verify data integrity, error handling, response times, and authentication/authorization mechanisms.
* Test database interactions, including query validation and data consistency across different environments.

**Performance & Load Testing**

* Conduct performance, load, and stress testing to ensure applications can handle expected user traffic and scale under peak loads.
* Use tools like JMeter, LoadRunner, or K6 to simulate user loads and identify bottlenecks.
* Analyze performance metrics and work with developers to optimize response times, throughput, and resource utilization.

**Defect Management & Reporting**

* Identify, document, and track bugs using issue tracking systems (Jira, Bugzilla, Azure DevOps) with clear, reproducible steps and supporting evidence (logs, screenshots, videos).
* Collaborate closely with developers to prioritize, reproduce, and resolve defects in a timely manner.
* Communicate test progress, risks, and quality status to stakeholders through clear, concise test reports and dashboards.

**Collaboration & Agile Workflow**

* Work closely with Developers, Product Managers, and Designers throughout the software development lifecycle to ensure quality is built in from the start.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, daily stand-ups, retrospectives) and contribute to defining acceptance criteria for user stories.
* Act as the voice of the user, advocating for quality, usability, and accessibility in every product decision.
* Coordinate with SEO, Marketing, and UX teams to ensure that tracking codes, analytics, structured data, and UI/UX implementations are tested and validated.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Stay up-to-date with the latest QA tools, testing methodologies, and industry best practices.
* Proactively suggest improvements to testing processes, tools, and frameworks to increase efficiency and coverage.
* Contribute to the team's knowledge base, testing documentation, and onboarding materials for new QA team members.

**Qualifications & Skills**

**Required**

* **Experience:** 3–6 years of professional experience in software quality assurance, testing, or a related role.
* **Manual Testing:** Deep understanding of software testing principles, methodologies, and the complete SDLC/STLC.
* **Automation:** Hands-on experience with at least one automation framework:
* **Web:** Selenium WebDriver, Cypress, Playwright, or Puppeteer.
* **Mobile:** Appium, Detox, or XCUITest/Espresso.
* **API:** Postman (with Newman), REST Assured, or similar.
* **API Testing:** Strong experience testing RESTful APIs and GraphQL endpoints.
* **Defect Tracking:** Proficiency with issue tracking tools like Jira, Bugzilla, or Azure DevOps.
* **Version Control:** Basic understanding of Git for version control and collaboration.
* **SQL:** Ability to write and execute SQL queries for backend data validation.
* **Analytical Mindset:** Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills with meticulous attention to detail.
* **Communication:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills; ability to articulate complex technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred (Great to Haves)**

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* **CI/CD:** Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CircleCI).
* **Performance Testing:** Experience with load and performance testing tools (JMeter, K6, LoadRunner, Gatling).
* **Security Testing:** Understanding of OWASP Top 10 and experience with security testing tools (Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP).
* **SEO Technical Testing:** Experience validating JSON-LD structured data, meta tags, canonical tags, redirects, and ensuring JavaScript-rendered content is crawlable by search engine bots.
* **Accessibility Testing:** Familiarity with WCAG 2.1 AA guidelines and experience using accessibility testing tools (axe, WAVE, Lighthouse).
* **Mobile Testing:** Experience testing native and hybrid mobile applications on both iOS and Android platforms.
* **Programming Languages:** Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, Java, JavaScript, C#, etc.) for writing automation scripts.
* **Test Management:** Experience with test management tools (TestRail, Xray, Zephyr).
* **ISTQB Certification:** ISTQB Foundation Level or equivalent certification is a plus.

title: Mobile Engineer - Trading Platform (India, Chennai)
description:
**About GoCharting**

GoCharting is a web-native charting and trading platform. Traders use professional orderflow tools — footprint charts, volume and market profile, cumulative delta, DOM trading — to read the market and place orders through their broker, all in the browser. Our users are active traders in India, the US and around the world.

**The Role**

You will build and release features in GoCharting's iOS and Android app, working in Flutter and writing the code yourself. The role is full-time and in person in our Chennai office, and it reports to the Engineering Manager for Client Engineering. You will work alongside the existing mobile engineer and share the build, test and release work. At 12 months, you should own a part of the app, including charts, watchlists, alerts or broker connections, and ship releases to both stores without help.

**What you'll do**

* **Build app features in Flutter** — charts, watchlists, alerts and broker connections, from spec to store release
* **Release to both stores** — prepare builds, pass App Store and Google Play review, and fix what review or users find
* **Keep the app stable** — use crash reports and user feedback to find and fix the causes of crashes and slow screens
* **Match the web terminal** — bring behavior and data from the web product to mobile, and raise gaps between the two
* **Work with product and design** — turn a written spec and a design into working screens, and raise gaps in the spec early
* **Write clear pull requests and test notes** — say what changed, how to test it, and what could break

  

**What we're looking for**

**Must-haves:**

* 5+ years building mobile apps, with the code written by you
* Has released at least one app to both the App Store and Google Play
* Strong Flutter and Dart in a production app
* Has built or maintained a mobile screen that updates with live data, for example from WebSockets or push
* In person in our Chennai office, 5 days a week

**Nice-to-haves:**

* Native iOS (Swift) or Android (Kotlin) code, for example for platform plugins (adds the ability to go below Flutter when needed)
* Deep links with Universal Links and App Links, and push notifications (adds the ability to own app-to-web flows)
* Mobile crash reporting and performance profiling (adds faster diagnosis)
* Charting, trading, market-data or broker-integration work (adds speed in learning our domain)
* Automated tests for mobile, such as widget and integration tests (adds confidence in every release)

**Logistics**

**Employment type** Full-time  
**Entity** ProCharting Private Limited  
**Reports to** Engineering Manager, Client Engineering  
**Start date** ASAP

* Lead the engineering team: Lead, coach, and mentor a team of engineers. Own what they ship, their well-being, and foster a culture of collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Own technical excellence: Architect for scale and resilience so we can adapt to regulatory changes quickly. Ensure appropriate on-call rotas, observability, and SLAs for critical services. Join the team's on-call rotation.
* Stay close to the code: Understand the team's systems deeply enough to be hands-on when needed. Review designs and PRs, assist the team in solving hard problems, and lead by example.
* Stakeholder management: Work closely with first, second, and third line teams (Operations, Risk & Compliance, and Internal Audit) to ensure engineering solutions align with the regulations.
* Co-own product roadmap: Partner with Product Managers to decide what's worth building, break down complex projects into incremental milestones, and ensure we balance fast iteration with long-term platform health.

 **Qualifications**

At Wise, Engineering Leads who manage a single team stay close to the implementation details, meaning strong technical expertise, architectural knowledge, and a willingness to remain hands-on are essential to succeed in this role. If you bring a strong mix of these core technical and leadership capabilities, we’d love to hear from you.

* Experience leading and mentoring software engineers (even if you manage a smaller team of 2-3 as a Tech Lead or Senior Engineer) and owning what they deliver.

* You give people context and direction, empower them to own their work, and know how to navigate ongoing product expansion.
* You have solid Java (17+) knowledge and hands-on experience with Spring / Spring Boot, and you're happy to stay hands-on when the team needs it.
* Deep understanding of distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and microservices, with comfort making high-impact architectural decisions
* You have led the design and delivery of complex engineering solutions and understand their broader impact on business outcomes — including trade-offs between short-term product wins and long-term platform health.
* A product engineer’s mindset—you measure your work by customer and business impact and make data-driven decisions to fix customer pain points.

* A clear communicator who can articulate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, across geographies and time zones.
* Bias to action and comfort with ambiguity: you move quickly without dropping quality.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with financial systems, payments, or digital onboarding flows.
* Understanding of the technical challenges of integrating third-party verification providers, managing sensitive identity data, and building modular KYC workflows adapted for different regulatory bodies.

**What you can expect as an Engineering Lead at Wise:**

We don't measure seniority purely by years of experience, but by the impact you create and the complexity of problems you can help solve. As an EL1 at Wise, you will be given the licence to:

* Balance technical domain ownership with people leadership.
* Execute large cross functional projects, either directly or through your team, that have a meaningful impact on Wise products and customers globally.
* Propose ideas to improve and grow your team’s product while acting as a trusted partner to your regional counterparts.
* Embrace long-term ownership of projects while training other engineers to reduce single points of failure.

 **Additional Information**

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.  
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.

Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

title: Data Engineer, Amazon Operations Finance Standardisation and Automation
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

As a Data Engineer in Data Infrastructure and Strategy group, you will play a key role in transforming the way Operations Finance teams access and analyse the data. You will work to advance 3 Year Data Infrastructure Modernisation strategy and play a key role in adopting and expanding a unified data access platform and scalable governance and observability frameworks that follow modern data architecture and cloud-first designs.  
  
Your responsibilities will include supporting and migrating data analytics use cases of a targeted customer group and new features implementations within the central platform: component design, implementation using NAWS services that follow best engineering practices, user acceptance testing, launch, adoption and post-launch support. You will work on system design and integrate new components to established architecture. You will be engaged into cross-team collaboration by building reusable design patterns and components and adopting designs adopted by others. You will contribute to “buy” vs “build” decision by evaluating latest product and features releases for NAWS and internal products, perform gap analysis and define feasibility of their adoption and the list of blockers.  
  
The ideal candidate possess a track record of creating efficient AWS-based data solutions; data models for both relational databases and Glue/Athena/EMR stack; developing solution documentation, project plans, user guides and other project documentation. We are looking into individual contributor inspired to become data systems architects. Track of production level deliverables leveraging GenAI is big plus.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Elevate and optimize existing solutions while driving strategic migration. Conduct thorough impact assessments to identify opportunities for transformative re-architecture or migration to central platforms. Your insights will shape the technology roadmap, ensuring we make progress towards deprecation goals while providing best customer service;
* Design, review and implement data solutions that support WW Operations Finance standardisation and automation initiatives using AWS technologies and internally built tools, including Spark/EMR, Redshift, Athena, DynamoDB, Lambda, S3, Glue, Lake Formation, etc;
* Support data solutions adoption by both, finance and technical teams; identify and remove adoption blockers;
* Ensure the speed of delivery and high-quality: iteratively improve development process and adopt mechanisms for optimisation of the development and support;
* Contribute into engineering excellence by reviewing design and code created by others;
* Contribute to delivery execution, planning, operational excellence, retrospectives, problem identification, and solution proposals;
* Collaborate with finance analysts, engineers, product and program managers and external teams to influence and optimize the value of the delivery in data platform;
* Create technical and customer-facing documentation on the products within the platform.

  
A day in the life  
You work with the Engineering, Product, BI and Operations teams to elevate existing data platforms and implement best-of-class data solutions for WW Operations Finance organization. You solve unstructured customer pain points with technical solutions, you are focused on users productivity when working with the data. You participate in discussions with stakeholders to provide updates on project progress, gather feedback, and align on priorities. Utilizing AWS CDK and various AWS services, you design, execute, and deploy solutions. Your broader focus is on system architecture rather than individual pipelines. You regularly review your designs with Principal Engineer, incorporate gathered insights. Conscious of your impact on customers and infrastructure, you establish efficient development and change management processes to guarantee speed, quality and scalability of delivered solution.  
  
About the team  
WW Operations Finance Standardization and Automation improves customer experience and business outcomes across Amazon Operations Finance through innovative technical solutions, standardization and automation of processes and use of modern data analytics technologies.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of data engineering experience
* 4+ years of SQL experience
* Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions
* Experience with non-relational databases / data stores (object storage, document or key-value stores, graph databases, column-family databases)

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: IT Head
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a seasoned, strategic **Head of IT** to lead the technology architecture, digital transformation, and operational resilience across our diverse business verticals: **Media Production Studios, Commercial Malls, and Multiplex/Theater Operations**.

The ideal candidate possesses a unique blend of enterprise IT infrastructure management, high-performance media/post-production workflow expertise, and smart-building/retail IT operations (POS, building management integration, high-density public Wi-Fi, and digital cinema/exhibition technologies). You will drive operational excellence, enforce robust cybersecurity frameworks, and align technology investments with organizational growth.

Key Responsibilities**1. Enterprise & Smart Infrastructure Management (Malls & Corporate)**

· Oversee the end-to-end enterprise IT infrastructure, including data centers, server farms, enterprise storage, virtualization (VMware/Hyper-V), and hybrid cloud environments (AWS/Azure).

· Manage mission-critical IT systems for commercial mall operations, ensuring high availability of Building Management Systems (BMS), Public Address (PA) systems, CCTV/surveillance networks, and automated access controls.

· Architect and maintain high-density public Wi-Fi networks, structured cabling, and robust switching/routing backbones (L2/L3) across retail and office spaces.

· Oversee disaster recovery (DR) planning, business continuity drills, and power redundancy systems (UPS/Generators) for 24/7 retail and entertainment environments.

**2. Multiplex, Cinema & Digital Exhibition Technology**

· Oversee IT and networking infrastructure supporting digital cinema projection systems, server ingestion, and Theatre Management Systems (TMS).

· Manage automated scheduling, digital signage, box office ticketing kiosks, and secure content delivery (KDM/DCP management) in coordination with content distributors.

· Ensure ultra-low latency and absolute uptime for live-streaming, event screenings, and concessionaire point-of-sale (POS) networks.

**3. Post-Production & Media Studio Technology**

· Support high-performance media workflows including non-linear editing (Avid, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve), VFX, animation, sound design, and heavy rendering farms.

· Administer high-speed SAN/NAS environments optimized for uncompressed 4K/8K real-time collaboration.

· Manage Media Asset Management (MAM) systems, secure ingest/transcoding pipelines, and long-term digital archiving/retrieval processes.

**4. Retail & Point-of-Sale (POS) Operations**

· Ensure 99.99% uptime for mission-critical retail POS terminals, payment gateway integrations, inventory management databases, and merchant Wi-Fi networks within mall premises.

· Coordinate with tenant IT teams and retail partners to ensure seamless network integration and compliance with centre guidelines.

**5. Cybersecurity, Compliance & Data Privacy**

· Establish enterprise-wide cybersecurity policies, endpoint protection, Next-Gen Firewalls (NGFW), and SIEM tools.

· Protect high-value intellectual property (IP), unreleased media assets, and confidential tenant/customer data in compliance with data privacy regulations (e.g., DPDP Act, PCI-DSS for retail transactions).

· Conduct regular vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, and IT security audits.

**6. Vendor, Project & Budget Management**

· Lead strategic technology implementation projects, digital upgrades, and capital expenditure (CapEx/OpEx) planning.

· Manage relationships with global technology vendors, telecom operators, OEM partners, and service providers.

· Negotiate Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs), software licensing, and hardware procurement to optimize costs without compromising quality.

**7. Leadership & Cross-Functional Team Management**

· Lead, mentor, and upskill a multi-disciplinary team of IT engineers, system administrators, and helpdesk support staff.

· Define and monitor strict Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for incident resolution and system performance.

· Act as a technology advisor to executive leadership, bridging the gap between creative teams, retail management, and technical execution.

**Core Enterprise & Network Infrastructure**

· Advanced administration of Windows Server, Linux, and macOS enterprise environments.

· Enterprise networking: Cisco/Aruba L2/L3 switching, VLAN segmentation, SD-WAN, enterprise firewalls, and QoS configuration.

· Virtualization & Cloud: VMware ESXi, Hyper-V, AWS, Azure, and hybrid cloud integration.

· Active Directory, LDAP, SSO, and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) frameworks.

· Advanced backup frameworks (Veeam, Commvault) and Disaster Recovery architecture.

**Domain-Specific Expertise**

· **Retail & Mall Tech:** POS infrastructure, payment gateway security (PCI-DSS), digital signage networks, and smart building integration (BMS/CCTV).

· **Theater/Exhibition Tech:** Theatre Management Systems (TMS), digital projection networks, and ticketing system integration.

· Media / Post-Production: High-speed SAN/NAS (Avid ISIS/Nexus, Isilon, QNAP), render management (Deadline, OpenCue), and MAM workflows.

**Educational Qualifications & Credentials**

· Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Electronics, or a related technical field. Master’s degree / MBA is a plus.

Pay: ₹2,000,000.00 - ₹25,000,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
