title: Automation Engineering Manager - UiPath
description:
**Roboyo AI is a category shaper in Applied AI and Agentic Automation.**

We help leading enterprises move from automation projects and AI experiments into governed, production-grade systems that execute real work across workflows, processes, products and services.

 

Our heritage is in scaled enterprise automation; our future is Applied AI and Agentic Automation: autonomous agents, AI engineering squads, process orchestration, data and knowledge foundations, and human-in-the-loop governance embedded deeply into how our clients operate.

 

We are not here to sell AI theatre. We are here to turn AI into working systems, measurable outcomes and repeatable transformation programs.

 

**WHY ROBOYO?**

 

Roboyo operates at the forefront of the global AI & Agentic Automation adoption curve. Our competitive advantage lies in our heritage: we don’t just implement technology; we understand, decompose, and automate complex business processes. Our vision for AI & Agentic services is to be the global partner that helps enterprises industrialize AI & Agentic Automation across core business functions, so AI agents execute work invisibly in workflows and deliver measurable outcomes. 

 

As enterprises look to integrate AI, they turn to us, their trusted partners in process automation, to

identify

the smartest path forward. We cut through the hype to implement the “best fit" technology for measurable impact. Joining us means working with major US clients, guiding them through their AI transformation, and turning potential into performance.

 

 

**About the role**

 

We're

looking for a
**Lead Automation Engineer**


to own the technical delivery of UiPath automation workstreams end-to-end — from design and development through testing and deployment — working with international clients across a distributed, global delivery environment. You will own the technical execution of our broader

automation

strategy and lead and mentor a high-performing team of engineers.


You will be the agentic architecture and delivery authority for your pod, accountable for governance, production

readiness

and measurable outcomes of UiPath agentic solutions.

 

 

**Key Responsibilities**

 

* Set and enforce UiPath development standards, architectural patterns and delivery frameworks across your team's projects, including agentic standards: agent design patterns, reusable prompt and tool libraries, evaluation thresholds and promotion criteria

* Lead, mentor, and supervise a cross-functional pod of automation engineers and business analysts, fostering a culture of technical excellence

* Review and validate solution designs, ensuring they are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with enterprise standards

* Oversee the quality of UiPath deliverables across all project stages — design, build, test, and deployment

* Own discovery, estimation and delivery of Agentic AI programmes: run use-case assessments, decide agent vs. RPA vs. API vs. human, and define the target architecture across Agent Builder, coded agents, Maestro, IXP and Integration Service

* Architect multi-agent orchestration in UiPath Maestro, including process modelling, exception and escalation design, and SLAs across agents, robots and people

* Define agentic governance with client security, risk and compliance teams: AI Trust Layer policies, LLM selection, data residency, PII handling, autonomy levels and human-in-the-loop controls

* Define production readiness and the run model for agents: observability (traces, UiPath Insights), accuracy and drift monitoring, LLM consumption cost tracking and handover to support

* Conduct rigorous code and prompt reviews and enforce robust CI/CD pipelines, establishing coding standards, automated testing frameworks (Unit, Integrated, UAT) and agent evaluation pipelines that guarantee delivery excellence and mitigate deployment risks

* Partner with clients and stakeholders to understand business objectives, identify agentic automation opportunities, and define and track agent KPIs (automation rate, accuracy, cycle time, cost per transaction) to evidence business value and ROI

* Support business development by contributing to proposals, solution and LLM consumption estimates, agentic POCs and demos, client workshops and pre-sales discussions, serving as a trusted agentic automation subject matter expert

* Act as the primary technical authority and trusted advisor, aligning business stakeholders, project managers and development teams on delivery milestones and technical risks

* Delivery expectations: accountable for on-time, on-budget, quality delivery across multiple concurrent agentic workstreams, with clear status, risk and value reporting to client and Roboyo leadership

* Take the lead on diagnosing and resolving complex technical defects, optimising performance bottlenecks, and stabilizing processes before handoff to support teams

* Stay up to date on industry trends and best practices, and continuously improve consulting service offerings

 

**Must Have Qualifications**

 

* 8+ years of hands-on experience in Intelligent Automation software engineering, with deep, demonstrable expertise in developing complex workflows in UiPath (UiPath Studio, Orchestrator, and REFramework)

* Proven track record operating as a Technical Lead, successfully managing, staffing, and mentoring engineering teams

* UiPath Advanced RPA Developer certification and other relevant UiPath certifications (e.g., Automation Developer Professional, Test Automation Engineer Professional, Agentic Automation Professional, or Automation Infrastructure Engineer Professional)

* Proven track record architecting and leading at least 2 production agentic automation deliveries on UiPath (Agent Builder, Maestro, Context Grounding, IXP, Action Center), including coded agents

* Deep understanding of LLM and agent architecture trade-offs: model selection, RAG design, tool calling, MCP, multi-agent patterns, guardrails, evaluation, latency and cost

* Python proficiency sufficient to design and review coded agents (UiPath Python SDK, LangGraph)

* Understanding of Responsible AI and AI governance requirements (e.g., EU AI Act, data privacy regulations) as they apply to autonomous agents

* Solid command of software engineering principles, including SQL databases, API integrations, and version control (Git)
* Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, with the proven ability to conduct technical workshops, elicit granular business requirements, and negotiate complex architectural decisions with non-technical executives

**Nice to have qualifications**

 

* Experience with UiPath Automation Cloud administration, AI Trust Layer configuration and UiPath Autopilot

* Experience in related technologies such as process mining (e.g., Celonis, UiPath Process Mining), low-code platforms (e.g., Appian, Mendix, Power Apps), conversational AI (e.g., Cognigy, Druid), or test automation (UiPath Test Suite)

**What We Offer:**

* **Medical Insurance:**
  Comprehensive medical insurance fully funded by Roboyo for employees, with the option to extend coverage to eligible family members at the employee’s own cost.
* **Meal Voucher Benefit:**
  Enjoy tax-efficient meal benefits through a Pluxee card, helping you save on everyday meal expenses.
* **A truly international environment**
  , working with talented colleagues and clients on global automation and AI projects.
* **Work at the forefront of Agentic AI and automation**
  , innovating with emerging technologies and helping shape next-generation, future-ready intelligent automation solutions.
* **A growth-focused environment**
  where you are empowered to develop, excel, take ownership, and make a meaningful contribution.
* **Real impact from day one**
  , with the opportunity to bring forward ideas, take initiative, and influence how we work and what we build.
* **A culture shaped by strong values**
  , with human-centric leadership, ownership, integrity, collaboration, and continuous growth at the heart of how we work and succeed together.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

**Privacy Notice:**
By applying, you consent to the processing of your personal data for recruitment purposes in line with our Privacy Policy: https://roboyo.global/data-privacy/

title: Manager, Engineering
description:
**Our Mission**
At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
  
  
****Who We Are****
In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
  
  
We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
  
  
****Job Summary****
We are seeking an Engineering Manager to lead the team that builds and runs our connectors framework. In this role, you will be accountable for the team’s delivery across several concurrent projects, from platform enhancements to large programs that need multiple teams to collaborate. You will lead by example as a hands-on technical manager, grow the engineers on your team, and remove roadblocks so the connector engineers who build on your platform can move fast.
  
  
****What You’ll Do****

* Own Team Delivery: Be accountable for delivering multiple framework projects and features at the same time. Make pragmatic trade-offs to deliver, and personally deliver features when the team needs it.
* Lead Technically: Stay hands-on and lead by example. Guide the team through large, complex projects that need several teams to complete, such as migrating on-premises connectivity to a cloud-managed agent or extracting the integrations code into its own service. Design features in the framework yourself when needed.
* Direct Quality and Reliability: Set the quality processes the team follows. Own framework reliability, including sync health, incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), and resolution of security findings.
* Develop Talent: Run 1:1s, performance reviews, goal setting, and career guidance. Enable ownership on the team, resolve conflict, and grow engineers into their next level.
* Remove Roadblocks Across Teams: Work closely with the connector development team, other product teams, SRE, security, and PM to keep work clear and unblocked.
* Lead AI-First Engineering: Train the team on our tools and processes, including AI-assisted development workflows, and set the discipline for verifying AI-generated code.
* Drive Initiatives: Run initiatives within the team, such as cutting the time it takes to build a new connector or reducing sync failures.
* Keep Customers in Focus: Understand customer use cases and problems, and use them to set priorities with PM.
* Build the Team: Actively recruit, lead interviews, and make hiring decisions.
* Communicate Clearly: Present plans, progress, and risks to engineering and senior leadership.

**Nice to Have**

* Identity & Access Security Domain: Direct experience with IAM, PAM, IGA, or Secrets Management platforms.
* Integration Platforms: Experience leading teams that build integration frameworks, data pipelines, or SDKs used by other engineers.
* Hybrid Connectivity: Experience with products that run agents inside customer networks.
* Multi-Site Teams: Experience leading engineers across more than one office location.
* DevOps & Observability Ecosystems: Practical experience with progressive delivery, CI/CD pipelines, feature flagging tools, and monitoring tools such as Datadog.

title: Site Reliability Engineer, Incident Management
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
  
  
The Site Reliability Engineer – Incident management has the responsibility of monitoring, maintaining and managing entire Qualys infrastructure and services installed at different datacenters. When there is any malfunction in Product/Services, the Site Reliability Engineer- Incident Management technician Monitor, troubleshoots, repairs and gets the service/system back up as quickly as possible. Collaboration and Continuous Improvement

* Proactively identifies reliability risks before they impact customers.
* Uses automation to eliminate repetitive operational tasks.
* Responds effectively to incidents and drives meaningful root cause analysis.
* Collaborates effectively across engineering and infrastructure teams.

**DISTINGUISHING EXPECTATION**
The SRE – Incident management is measured by improvements in reliability, automation, operational efficiency, and service availability. Success is demonstrated through proactive monitoring problem prevention, reduced operational burden, and continuous improvement of production systems.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).

**AppDynamics, ELK, or Splunk.**

* Understanding of networking, security, and distributed systems concepts.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience managing large-scale distributed systems.
* Knowledge of reliability engineering principles and automation best practices.
* Cloud certifications.
* Experience with incident management and postmortem culture.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

* Full-time role.
* On-call participation required.
* Hybrid or remote flexibility depending on company policy.
* Cross-functional collaboration with engineering and operations teams.

Qualys, Inc. is a pioneer and leading provider of cloud-based IT, security, and compliance solutions, serving more than 10,000 customers across over 130 countries. Qualys delivers innovative security and compliance solutions that help organizations simplify security operations and reduce risk.

description:
**Company:** Enlog Prime Energy Private Limited  
**Department:** Engineering & Technology  
**Reporting To:** Founder / CTO  
**Experience:** 5–7 years preferred  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

About Enlog

Enlog is an AI-driven energy management technology company building intelligent IoT solutions for monitoring, analysing and optimising electricity consumption across commercial buildings, hospitality, healthcare and industrial facilities.

Our product ecosystem includes Enmate, Enpro and Ensense, supported by our proprietary AI engine, Ensyte-AI, and a connected cloud and IoT infrastructure.

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager who can take ownership of our complete technology ecosystem and build the engineering foundation required for the next stage of growth.

Role Objective

The Senior Engineering Manager will be responsible for designing, managing and scaling Enlog's complete engineering ecosystem, covering embedded systems, firmware, IoT communication, backend services, cloud infrastructure and production deployments.

The objective is to establish robust engineering practices, improve system reliability and create scalable architecture without compromising the speed of product development.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role, not just a team management position.

Key Responsibilities1. Technology Architecture & Engineering

* Own the overall technology architecture across hardware, firmware, IoT, backend and cloud.
* Review existing systems and identify technical bottlenecks, risks and improvement opportunities.
* Design scalable and modular architecture to support increasing device volumes.
* Define engineering standards, technology selection and architectural guidelines.
* Maintain system architecture documentation and technical roadmaps.

2. IoT & Embedded Systems

* Oversee firmware development and hardware-software integration.
* Establish firmware development standards, versioning and release management.
* Manage IoT communication protocols, including MQTT, LoRaWAN and Wi-Fi.
* Implement reliable device communication, reconnection, buffering and offline data handling.
* Establish OTA firmware updates and remote device configuration.
* Improve device diagnostics, monitoring and remote troubleshooting capabilities.

3. Cloud & Backend Infrastructure

* Own cloud architecture, backend services, databases and data pipelines.
* Review MQTT broker infrastructure, message ingestion and data processing systems.
* Ensure data integrity, system availability and performance.
* Implement infrastructure monitoring, logging, backup and disaster recovery.
* Optimise cloud infrastructure and operational costs.
* Establish security standards for devices, APIs and cloud services.

4. Development Processes & Engineering Standards

* Establish a structured development lifecycle from requirement to production release.
* Introduce code reviews, Git workflows and development standards.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines and automated testing.
* Establish development, staging and production environments.
* Define release management, deployment and rollback procedures.
* Introduce lightweight documentation and technical review processes.

**Important:** Processes must be practical and risk-based. The objective is to improve engineering quality and delivery speed, not introduce unnecessary approvals or bureaucracy.

5. Production Reliability & Operations

* Take ownership of the technical health of live production deployments.
* Establish monitoring for device connectivity, telemetry, backend and cloud services.
* Define incident management, escalation and root cause analysis processes.
* Reduce production failures and recurring technical issues.
* Build tools and systems for remote diagnosis and issue resolution.
* Work closely with installation, operations and customer support teams.

6. Team Leadership & Management

* Lead and mentor firmware, backend, cloud and IoT engineers.
* Establish technical ownership and accountability across engineering teams.
* Conduct architecture reviews and engineering performance evaluations.
* Identify skill gaps and future hiring requirements.
* Build a self-sufficient engineering team with reduced dependency on founders.
* Coordinate technical priorities with product, business and operations teams.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated against the following areas:

KPIWeightageSystem reliability and production stability25%Technology architecture and scalability20%Development processes and release management20%Engineering delivery and execution15%Team development and ownership10%Documentation and automation10%

Additional performance indicators:

* Improvement in device connectivity and telemetry availability.
* Reduction in production incidents and recurring technical failures.
* Availability and reliability of critical cloud services.
* Percentage of deployments following defined release processes.

* Test audiences, bids, creatives and landing or app funnels while managing CAC, budgets, conversion rates and ROAS.

* Report the click-to-first-transaction funnel, partner CAC, cohort quality, retention and LTV; scale publishers based on valid incremental results.

* Build a shortlist of coupon, cashback, referral and rewards partners

**Must-haves**

* Advertiser-side experience sourcing, onboarding and scaling agencies, affiliate networks and direct publishers, with payout negotiation.

**Nice to have**

* Google App Campaigns (UAC), app-event optimisation and mobile retargeting.

* Success-page / scratch-card reward placements, offerwalls and performance-based referral programs.

* Data or Looker Studio, cohort analysis, experimentation and incremental acquisition measurement.

*A marketing or related degree is welcome but not required. Your track record matters most.* ***Don’t tick every box? Apply***

**Who You Are**

* **Commercially focused**: You optimize for valid first transactions and customer value, not just clicks or installs.

* **A proactive partnership builder:** You independently find opportunities, negotiate deals and take campaigns live.

* **Execution-driven:** You track every placement, test new formats, detect fraud and scale what performs.

In short: Bring product-company affiliate growth experience, hands-on partnership execution and strong Google/Meta paid media skills.

What you’ll get

**Position Summary**
**SAP Business AI (Joule and Basic ABAP) - Senior, Tax Technology Services**
Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited (“USI Tax”) commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all the Deloitte Tax LLP (“Deloitte Tax”) U.S. service offerings have obtained support services through the USI Tax teams. USI Tax offers you opportunities to learn and support U.S. and other countries (such as Australia, Belgium, Canada, Germany, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom) taxation practice, a popular career option.
  
  
Deloitte Tax is leading its clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace, offering a broad range of fully integrated tax services by combining technology and technical tax resources to comply with reporting requirements, uncover insights and deploy smarter approaches for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
We are looking for an innovative Technical SAP ABAP on HANA, CDS, OData, RAP Plus Gen AI develop and implement systems architecture that meet business needs, along with ensuring that our clients’ can keep pace with the changing tax and legal landscape.
  
  
Design, build, and support performance SAP S/4HANA extensions and services using ABAP on HANA, RESTful ABAP Programming Model (RAP), Core Data Services (CDS), and OData to enable modern Fiori/UI and integration scenarios.
  
  
To be successful in this role, you should be able to align the global Tax and Legal landscape with the business’ activities and proposed wider business processes. You will be the lynchpin between the Tax Function and IT Function, ensuring that we build the best SAP Tax design for the client. This will require the ability to explain complex terms to a variety of different stakeholders, and in a way that is relevant to each stakeholder group. You will also need to continually assess the SAP product suite and development roadmap to integrate any updated specifications and requirements into SAP system architecture.
  
  
You will also need to integrate with the wider client project team (whether that is delivered by Deloitte Consulting or another Systems Integration partner). This will involve an understanding of how the tax design interacts with other process flows and also the inter-personal skills to build the required relationships.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities -**

* Develop and enhance ABAP solutions on SAP S/4HANA using clean, modular, and testable patterns.
* Build Gen AI applications and AI Agents.
* Code Python is a plus.
* Ability to navigate fragmented landscapes through API-calls and MCP- servers is key.
* Build end-to-end RAP artifacts (behavior definitions/implementations, validations, determinations, actions, draft handling, locking, authorization concepts).
* Create and optimize CDS views (interface/consumption views, associations, annotations) with strong focus on pushdown and performance.
* Design, expose, and support OData services (preferably OData V4 via RAP; maintain OData V4 where required).
* Implement Fiori-enablement via CDS annotations and support UI integration with SAP Fiori elements (as applicable).
* Integrate with SAP and non-SAP systems using SAP-recommended patterns (e.g., APIs, events, messaging where applicable).
* Apply performance tuning (SQL optimization, buffering strategy, ST05/SAT/SQLM analysis, CDS performance best practices).
* Follow SAP extensibility guidelines (in-app/extensibility, key-user vs developer extensibility, released APIs, clean-core approach where applicable).
* Produce technical designs, code documentation, unit tests, and participate in code reviews.
* Support testing cycles, defect triage, hyper care, and production support with strong root-cause analysis

**Qualification And Experience Required -**

* Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience).
* 4+ years of Experience in SAP or SAP4HANA.
* Hands-on experience in building Gen AI applications, AI Agents.
* SAP Business AI certification is a plus.
* SAP certifications (ABAP for S/4HANA, RAP, BTP) are a plus.
* Strong hands-on experience with ABAP in SAP S/4HANA / ABAP on HANA environments.
* Proven delivery experience with:
* RAP (managed/unmanaged as needed, behavior implementation, draft, authorization)
* CDS (views, annotations, associations, table functions if needed)
* OData service exposure and troubleshooting (RAP/OData V4 strongly preferred)
* Strong understanding of HANA-optimized development: SQL/CDS pushdown, avoiding SELECT-in-loops, efficient joins, pagination, etc.
* Familiarity with modern ABAP practices (e.g., ABAP OO, clean code, exception handling, unit testing mindset).
* Experience working in Agile delivery (user stories, estimation, sprint ceremonies).

**Preferred / Nice To Have**

* SAP BTP exposure (e.g., Integration Suite, API Management, Event Mesh, ABAP environment/Steampunk—if relevant).
* BTP, Joule and SAP business AI certification.

* Transaction Matching data sources, match types, rules, tolerances, adjustments, exceptions and match-performance optimisation

title: Product Manager
description:
The Product Manager will be responsible for defining product strategy, managing the product roadmap, gathering business requirements, prioritizing product features, and driving successful product delivery from concept through production. The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with engineering, design, QA, business stakeholders, and customers to deliver scalable, high-quality healthcare software solutions.

This role requires a strategic thinker with strong analytical capabilities, excellent stakeholder management skills, and extensive experience building software products for the US healthcare industry.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Product Strategy & Vision**

* Define and communicate the product vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned with business objectives.
* Identify market opportunities through customer research, competitive analysis, and industry trends.
* Translate business goals into product initiatives and measurable outcomes.
* Drive innovation by identifying opportunities to improve healthcare workflows and operational efficiency.

**2. Product Roadmap & Planning**

* Develop and maintain the product roadmap.
* Define release plans, milestones, and feature priorities.
* Balance customer needs, technical feasibility, business value, and delivery timelines.
* Collaborate with leadership to align product investments with organizational goals.

**3. Product Backlog Management**

* Own and manage the product backlog.
* Create, prioritize, and refine backlog items based on business value and customer impact.
* Ensure backlog items are detailed, actionable, and ready for development.
* Manage feature dependencies and coordinate with multiple teams.

**4. Requirement Gathering & Documentation**

* Work closely with business stakeholders, customers, operations teams, and engineering teams to gather requirements.
* Prepare and maintain:
* Business Requirement Documents (BRD)
* Functional Requirement Documents (FRD)
* User Stories
* Acceptance Criteria
* Functional Specifications
* Product Requirement Documents (PRD)
* Create user flows, workflow diagrams, business process maps, and functional documentation.
* Ensure requirements are complete, traceable, and aligned with business objectives.

**5. Agile Product Management**

* Serve as the Product Manager within Agile Scrum teams.
* Lead backlog refinement sessions.
* Participate in Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives.
* Define sprint goals and collaborate with engineering teams to achieve sprint commitments.
* Support estimation, planning, and release management activities.

**6. Cross-functional Leadership**

Collaborate closely with:

* Software Development Teams
* QA Engineers
* Business Analysts
* UI/UX Designers
* DevOps Engineers
* Customer Success Teams
* Operations Teams
* Executive Leadership
* External Customers and Business Stakeholders
* Provide timely clarifications, facilitate decision-making, and remove functional blockers to ensure successful product delivery.

**7. Product Validation & Release Management**

* Define acceptance criteria for all product features.
* Review completed features against business requirements.
* Participate in sprint demonstrations and release reviews.
* Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Validate production readiness prior to release.
* Support production deployments and post-release monitoring.

**8. Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and engineering teams.
* Present product roadmaps, release plans, and product progress to leadership.
* Facilitate discussions to resolve functional and business challenges.
* Ensure stakeholder expectations are managed effectively.

**9. Product Performance & Continuous Improvement**

* Define product success metrics and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
* Analyze customer feedback and product usage data.
* Identify opportunities for product enhancements and process improvements.
* Drive continuous product innovation and optimization.

description:

**JOOLA**
is a globally recognised table tennis and pickleball brand with an expanding

presence across Asia-Pacific. With over 70 years of heritage in racket sports and a

strong commitment to innovation, we create products and experiences for players at

next stage of our growth.

Our global headquarters is based in the United States, and our Asia-Pacific, headquarters is based in Singapore.

**About the Role :**

A hands-on developer who designs, builds and ships the company’s AI applications: dashboards, live boards, internal tools and workflow automations. Most of the role is writing and deploying code that brings data from across the business together and turns it into timely, useful insight for decision-makers.

**Roles and Responsibilities :**

* Design, develop and deploy the company’s AI dashboards and internal web applications, and maintain the code behind them.
* Build and maintain data pipelines and APIs that bring together data from internal systems (such as ERP, sales and inventory) and approved third-party sources.
* Build workflow automations that remove manual, repetitive work across teams, using tools such as n8n and Zapier alongside custom code.
* Develop dashboards and live boards that give business teams a clear, current view of performance.
* Build LLM-based features: automated summaries, alerts and question-and-answer tools on top of the company’s data.
* Use official APIs and licensed data sources, and follow data privacy, security and terms-of-use requirements.
* Follow sound development practice (version control, code review, automated testing, monitoring and documentation) so systems keep running as data and requirements change.

* B.Tech (or higher) in Computer Science (or an equivalent computer science degree).
* 4-5 years of software development, including work on data or AI applications.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; able to work with global stakeholders and explain technical work to non-technical users.

**AI skills :**

We don’t expect you to know everything here on day one. A solid base and a strong interest in learning matter most.

Regular hands-on use of general-purpose LLMs such as Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini in your day-to-day work.

Good prompt-writing skills: getting clear, consistent outputs from an LLM.

Has built at least one working app or automation that uses an LLM (for example, a chatbot, summarizer or Q&A tool).

* Good understanding of:
* Prompt engineering
* Context engineering
* RAG (retrieval-augmented generation)
* Harness engineering
* Loop engineering
* AI agents and tool calling

Comfortable using AI coding assistants and working in Git repositories for AI tools (for example, prompt files, skill files and agent configurations).

Curious and quick to learn: AI tools change fast, and you’ll have room to grow into more advanced agent design here.

**Engineering and platform skills**

* Strong Python and SQL; experience building data pipelines and REST APIs.
* Good Node.js background for back-end services and APIs.
* Front-end experience with Next.js / React for dashboards, live boards and internal web apps.
* Workflow automation with n8n and Zapier, including connecting SaaS tools, APIs and LLMs.
* AWS experience deploying and running applications.
* Experience with a data platform such as Snowflake, Databricks or BigQuery a plus.

title: Senior Engineer - QA [T500-30771]
description:
**About Officeworks:**

Officeworks’ purpose is “
**we bring**
**big ideas to life at low prices”.**
It’s how we create shared value for customers, team members, suppliers, communities and shareholders.

We are Australia’s leading omnichannel retailer of complete technology solutions, stationery, furniture, art supplies, and learning resources. We also offer services including Print & Create, and Geeks2U.

Our products and services provide solutions to our diverse range of customers across Australia from households, students, small to large sized businesses, governments and schools.

Our culture is built on beginning with customer, doing the right thing, executing with accountability, and leading with ambition. We are
**one team who are proud to “wear the blues”**
and
**deliver for our customers.**

We are an inclusive, forward-thinking organization where diverse perspectives enable innovation, continuous improvement and better outcomes for our customers and teams. The work we do plays an important role in helping Australians work, learn, create and connect.

**The role:**

**Title:**
Senior AI Engineer

**Function:**
Technology

**Location:**
Bengaluru

**About the Technology Function:**

By joining the Technology team in the GCC you will play a direct role in Officeworks’ global digital transformation, contributing to world-class capabilities that sit at the heart of how the business operates and grows. The GCC will support Officeworks’ purpose of helping to bring big ideas to life at low prices, ensuring technology remains a true enabler of customer value and operational excellence.

This opportunity to join as a founding member of the new global hub is a chance to be part of the original build-out of our GCC. Early joiners will influence how the hub operates and help shape the future state of some of Officeworks’ core technology ecosystem.

These roles are best suited for people who enjoy:

* exposure to eCommerce and digital platforms, customer facing services enabled online and in retail stores, and an expanding presence into generative and agentic commerce - covering operations, security, development, automation, and solution architecture
* supporting global initiatives and modernising business critical systems
* being the forefront of global innovation and transformation, helping digitize the Officeworks business
* joining a place where your skills matter, your growth is intentional, and your work has visible impact on business outcomes.

**Why this role exists:**

The Senior AI Engineer sits inside a Customer Platforms pod and orchestrates the technical agents that produce code, tests, documentation and design artefacts. The role is a full stack engineering role that takes complete ownership of the quality engineering and testing, holding accountability for everything committed to production.

The role exists to translate product specifications into functional agent tasks, maintain the human-in-the-loop review gate, and ensure system design integrity, non-functional performance and security standards are met. It plays a critical role in enabling continuous delivery across Customer Platforms while mentoring junior engineers and continuously improving agent workflows across pods.

**Where you will make a difference:**

**In this role you will:**

**Agent Orchestration and Execution:**

* Decompose Product Orchestrator specifications into functional tasks for technical agents.
* Run multiple agents in parallel across coding, test generation, documentation and design workflows.
* Sequence workstreams and manage technical dependencies to maintain high pod delivery velocity.
* Apply base context, security policies and platform standards to every agent execution cycle.

**Quality Control and Commit Gate:**

* Hold the human-in-the-loop review and commit gate independently on complex and high-risk change.
* Perform fast, accurate code and test reviews to ensure correctness, specification alignment and standards conformance.
* Owns end-to-end quality assurance accountability by designing agent test coverage and evaluation logic.
* Own defect management for the pod, from identification through root cause and resolution tracking, escalating systemic quality risks.
* Identify when agent workflows are insufficient and apply direct engineering intervention to resolve technical issues.

**System Design and Non-Functional Excellence:**

* Own architectural fit and system design judgement across the features delivered by the pod.
* Ensure non-functional outcomes, including performance, scalability, resilience and security, are met across all releases.
* Lead production incident resolution within the pod across touched platform domains.
* Contribute to domain design decisions as a consulted partner to the Solution Architects.

**Knowledge Governance and Workflow Improvement:**

* Maintain accurate, up-to-date documentation and knowledge artefacts to serve as context layers for future agent runs.
* Feed refined domain context back to central repositories in collaboration with Context Engineers.
* Continuously refine and optimize agent workflows and share best practices across engineering pods.
* Mentor engineers on test design, defect triage and quality engineering practice across the pod.

**Who you will be working with:**

* Pod Leadership and Delivery Teams: Partner with Product Orchestrators and fellow pod engineers to refine requirements, assess technical feasibility and execute workstreams.
* Architecture Teams: Consult with Domain Architects and Solution Architects on domain design, system architecture and escalation pathways.
* Capability and Platform Specialists: Collaborate with Context Engineers, Associate AI Agent Evaluation Engineers and Associate Platform Engineers to align on shared context, security standards and tooling.
* Vendor and Platform Partners: Liaise with external AI tooling providers and vendor technical support to resolve complex platform constraints and adopt new capabilities.

**What success looks like:**

* Commit Gate Integrity: Low commit gate escape rate on complex and high-risk production changes.
* Innovation and Scaling: Agent workflow improvements developed within the pod are successfully adopted across broader engineering teams.
* Operational Resilience: Rapid resolution of production incidents within the pod with minimal downtime or customer impact.
* Delivery Velocity: High throughput of automated coding and testing tasks achieved without compromising technical quality or architectural standards.
* Demonstrates behaviours aligned to Officeworks’ values, contributing to a respectful, inclusive and high-performing culture.

**How you will lead:**

**Individual Contributor:**

* Lives our Officeworks values and behaviours
* Proactively contributes to a safe working environment, escalates appropriately if there are unsafe conditions or inappropriate behaviour
* Operates in line with applicable Officeworks company policies and Code of Conduct
* Demonstrates a strong sense of personal accountability and curiosity to learn and develop
* Contributes to an inclusive and respectful environment where diverse perspectives are valued and everyone feels safe to speak up and belong

**Our Values:**

Our values shape the way we work, our behaviours and how we interact with each other, our customers, suppliers and communities.

**We begin with customer:**

* We start with our customer’ needs in every decision.
* We offer simple, helpful and affordable solutions.
* We listen, learn and continuously improve.

**We do the right thing:**

* We lead with integrity and care for our team communities and planet.
* We work together safely and treat everyone with respect, inclusion, and trust.
* We collaborate across teams and think Officeworks-wide.

**We execute with accountability:**

* We are accountable for our decisions, actions, results, and mistakes.
* We stay across the details and focus on delivering what matters.
* We move with pace and agility to deliver outcomes.

**We lead with ambition:**

* We set bold ambitions that help us to win and transform.
* We are courageous with new ideas.
* We focus on transformation, not incremental steps.

**Qualifications and work experience:**

**Essential:**

* Education: Tertiary degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience: 8-10 years of software engineering experience, primarily full stack with microservices architecture exposure, including senior-level ownership of quality engineering and test strategy.
* AI-Assisted Delivery: Proven experience or strong proficiency in delivering production software using AI coding, test generation and orchestration tooling.
* Quality Ownership: Demonstrated track record of owning end-to-end code quality, test strategy design, defect management and release gates directly, built through hands-on quality engineering experience.
* Stack Breadth: Broad technical exposure across front-end, back-end and integration layers.
* System Design: Strong system design judgement with the capability to evaluate, challenge and refine agent-generated architectural outputs.
* Technical Support: Experience supporting production cloud environments, including logging, alerting, incident response and observability.
* Strong experience in quality engineering, test strategy and test automation across the software delivery lifecycle
* Strong knowledge of functional, integration, regression and non-functional testing, including performance, resilience and security.
* Experience designing automated tests for APIs, distributed services and data-driven applications, with a shift-left approach to defect prevention.
* Hands-on experience testing AI/ML/GenAI applications using LLM evaluation frameworks such as Ragas or TruLens
* Experience with Playwright, Postman, BrowserStack or equivalent tools, including setting up test frameworks.
* Experience owning production release quality, including automated smoke tests, release verification and appropriate use of synthetic test data.

**Preferred:**

* Retail and Commerce Exposure: Experience in retail, e-commerce, or complex omnichannel platform ecosystems.
* Advanced AI Tooling: Familiarity with modern AI agent frameworks, model gateways, and evaluation platforms.

title: Test Architect
description:
**Job Requirements**
Role Purpose
  
  
We are seeking a Test Architect to provide technical leadership for product-level testing, define scalable test architecture and strategy, and ensure functional and non-functional quality across the development lifecycle. The role partners with engineering, product, quality and project stakeholders to manage quality risks, improve test effectiveness, and provide evidence-based input to release decisions.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Define and implement risk-based test strategies, test architecture, coverage targets, acceptance criteria and completion criteria aligned with product and business goals.
* Design, evolve and document reusable test infrastructure, automation frameworks, test suites, simulators and integration with the system under test.
* Lead testability analysis of requirements and architecture; promote early testing, requirements traceability and test-driven practices.
* Guide testing across unit, integration, system and other relevant levels, including functional and non-functional verification.
* Integrate automated testing into build and continuous integration pipelines; maintain test-code quality, configuration management and reliable build processes.
* Define quality metrics and make test progress, coverage, automation effectiveness, defects and residual risks transparent to stakeholders.
* Assess technical product and test-environment risks; provide recommendations for release readiness and support certification activities where applicable.
* Drive defect resolution, change-impact analysis, continuous test process improvement and reduction of non-conformance costs.
* Evaluate and select testing methods, tools and technologies through technical assessments or prototypes; promote reuse and sound make-or-buy decisions.
* Coach test engineers and advise architects and developers on testing practices; collaborate with test managers, product managers, project managers and quality teams.
* Coordinate testing infrastructure integration plans and contribute to supplier acceptance criteria or outsourced test-infrastructure arrangements when required.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics or a related discipline.
* At least 3 years of experience in research, software development or engineering.
* At least 2 years of successful experience as a Test Architect or in a comparable technical testing role on a substantial product-development project.
* ISTQB Foundation Level certification or demonstrably equivalent knowledge and experience.

Technical Expertise
  
  

* Advanced knowledge of testing processes, test design techniques, test automation, test architecture and continuous test improvement.
* Experience with requirements verification and validation, risk-based testing, product risk management and quality gates.
* Strong understanding of software/system architecture, development lifecycles, design patterns and CI practices.
* Ability to define measurable quality objectives, test coverage, traceability and meaningful test KPIs.
* Experience designing and maintaining test environments, simulators or infrastructure for complex systems.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ISTQB Advanced Level certification.
* Experience with outsourced testing or test-infrastructure development, product lifecycle management and regulatory or certification processes.
* Familiarity with quality maturity assessment approaches such as TMMi or TPI Next.

Leadership & Collaboration
  
  

* Strategic thinking, sound technical judgment and the ability to make timely decisions with incomplete information.
* Strong communication, stakeholder influencing, coaching and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Customer focus, business orientation and commitment to long-term engineering quality

+ Build internal tools and proof-of-concepts using AI/LLM technologies to:
+ Accelerate debugging and failure triaging

+ Enhance developer and QA productivity

**Skills We’re Looking For**

* Familiarity with log-based CDC mechanisms (binlog, WAL, ) and handling schema drift or evolution scenarios.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

title: Engineering Lead
description:
**Company Description**
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
  
  
**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
  
  
As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
  
  
**For everyone, everywhere.**
**Job Description**
More about
**our mission**
and
**what we offer**
.
  
  
**The team you will be joining: Personal Onboarding Verification**
**The Personal Onboarding Verification team is part of the Global KYC and Onboarding Squad. The team is responsible for KYC (Know Your Customer) compliance procedures that our customers go through before using our products. The team achieves this by building systems for identity verification in collaboration with data scientists, data analysts and third parties. Together we’re using computer vision, optical character recognition (OCR), biometrics & facial recognition, large-scale data analytics, and machine learning (ML) models.**
**Wise operates at global scale, onboarding millions of new customers each year in addition to supporting the needs of our large existing customer-base. Our products provide coverage across 160+ countries and over 40 currencies. The Personal Onboarding Verification team is at the centre of that, building systems that cut through the operational complexity of working under 70+ financial licenses while providing a frictionless onboarding experience wherever in the world our customers may be.**
Having product-focused and forward-thinking engineers has allowed Wise to cater to the needs of customers unlike any other business. We already have a world-leading platform and product, but there is more to do.
  
  
**Your Mission**
**As an Engineering Lead for Personal Onboarding Verification, you will:**

* Lead, coach, and mentor a cross-functional team of engineers, supporting their growth and empowering them to do their best work.
* Be an active contributor to delivery. Support day-to-day execution, get hands-on when the team needs it, and stay in touch with the technology stack. You’ll lead by example.
* Work closely with the function leads in the team (Product, Design, Analytics, Data Science) and your team members to shape the roadmap, set the technical and product vision and ensure the team delivers on product goals in a robust and scalable way.
* Enable your team to succeed by ensuring they are well-resourced, can plan effectively, and are set up to commit to and deliver on their roadmap.
* Have a deep understanding of the tech and product of your teams - building out a clear tech strategy that follows from our product and marketing goals, setting high standards for quality, leading by example.
* Own the health and productivity of the team, fostering a culture of collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Collaborate with other engineering leads and teams across the Squad and other Wise teams to ensure your team’s work is aligned with the wider technical strategy.

**Qualifications**
**Qualifications**
**A Bit About You**

* You have experience in leading and mentoring software engineers, including managing performance, well-being and growth, and handling difficult situations constructively.
* You have strong system-design skills with real experience of distributed, high-throughput, resilient services, and event-driven architectures.
* You enjoy helping others grow and succeed.
* You have a strong product and customer mindset and experience building customer facing products.
* You have strong, hands-on technical experience in OOP Languages (Java or similar) and modern technology stacks on technologies such as REST APIs, microservices, distributed systems and CI/CD pipelines - you will have to complete technical interviews to showcase your knowledge.
* You have experience working with and building distributed, high scalability systems and microservices architectures
* You're a great communicator who can articulate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* You thrive in a collaborative environment and have experience working effectively with cross-functional peers like designers, product managers, analysts and data scientists.

Additional Information
  
  
For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
  
  
We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
  
  
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
  
  
If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.
  
  
Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

title: HIH- Business Project Senior Analyst
description:
**Position Summary**
**Controls & Security**
Role is accountable for ensuring that system changes, automation solutions, and business processes are aligned with SOX, Internal Audit, Risk, and Security requirements throughout the full project lifecycle, from design and build through CRP, UAT, parallel running, go-live, and post-go-live stabilization.
  
  
In addition to the core C&S mandate, the role requires targeted programme delivery support —
**outlined below**
— making it a hybrid position suited to a candidate who combines strong controls expertise with hands-on programme execution capability.
  
  
**Business PMO**
Business Project Senior Analyst is responsible for the governance processes associated with business project delivery for the Finance and Accounting organizations. Responsibilities include elements of project management, status tracking, communication with workstreams and external stakeholders, content development to support communications, documentation of project artifacts, and facilitation of training and testing events. This individual will work with users, technology partners, other project team members, and workstream teams.
  
  
**Job Description & Responsibilities**
**Controls & Security**
The following responsibilities represent the core of this role and carry direct SOX and audit consequences. Candidates must demonstrate strength in this area above all others.
  
  

* Perform control impact assessments for system changes, technology enhancements, and automation initiatives — evaluating control design and effectiveness across manual, automated, and hybrid environments relative to SOX, ITGC and application control requirements.
* Lead access governance and segregation of duties (SoD) reviews, including sign-off on provisioning requests, SoD ruleset configuration, and identification and escalation of conflicts such as upload-and-approve capability overlaps and dual-access risks during parallel running and cutover.
* Ensure C&S coverage is maintained across all project lifecycle phases — CRP, UAT, parallel running, and go-live — coordinating with workstream leads to confirm scope, design & build and test coverage ahead of go-live.
* Maintain audit-ready documentation including control narratives, RCMs, automation descriptions, and evidence references; lead discussions with control owners to confirm ownership and evidence generation in future-state environments.
* Prepare workstream status updates, risk and issue reporting, and governance materials for the C&S Workstream Lead and program leadership; serve as the primary point of contact for controls, security, and compliance-related queries across multiple workstreams and initiatives.

**Secondary Accountability: Program Delivery Support:**
The following responsibilities are in addition to the core C&S mandate and require solid program coordination capability.
  
  

* Content creation to support Kick off meetings for project initiatives and other communication material
* Management of documentation on SharePoint and other project tools (Jira)
* Collaborate with Project Managers to create, maintain and monitor project plan
* Collaborate with Project Managers to create and maintain cutover and transition planning; support monitoring of cutover activity status.
* Support the administration and monitoring of Hypercare periods and performance relative to KPIs; may include routing issues and inquiries to appropriate subject matter experts
* Assist change and workstream leads to ensure training, end user support coverage is without gaps; support may involve content creation and user support triage
* Loading and management of test scripts in testing tool: Zephyr.
* Monitoring and development of formal testing entrance and exit gate materials
* Support the planning, administration and status reporting of testing cycles inclusive of tester & environmental readiness and defect tracking and remediation efforts.
* Coordination & Management of test triage calls
* Support development of testing scenarios in collaboration with workstream leads and QA teams; align testing scenarios to requirements for traceability.
* Review Scenarios for breadth and depth of coverage and support business stakeholder review process for “day in the life” testing coverage for UAT cycles.
* Support test script development with workstream leads as needed.
* Execute / administer program and governance management process inclusive of progress status reporting, risk and issue tracing and change control management.
* Create governance committee materials.
* Create broad communication materials for extended stakeholder teams

**Competencies / Skills**
**Controls & Security**

* Strong understanding of SOX, business process controls, ITGCs, and regulatory compliance in a finance transformation context.
* Ability to assess and design controls in automated and technology-enabled environments, including Oracle Cloud and automation solutions.
* Experience with access governance tooling (Saviynt preferred) and GRC platforms e.g. (Oracle GRC).
* Strong stakeholder management skills across Finance, IT, Security, Risk, and Audit functions.
* Ability to translate complex control and automation topics into clear, audit-defensible communications — both written and verbal.

**Business PMO**

* Ability to review deliverables for completeness, quality, and compliance with established project standards.
* Ability to resolve conflict (striving for win-win outcomes); ability to execute with limited information and ambiguity
* Ability to deal with organizational politics including ability to navigate a highly matrixed organization effectively.
* Strong Influencing skills (sound business and technical acumen as well as skilled at achieving buy-in for delivery strategies)
* Stakeholder management (setting and managing expectations)
* Strong business acumen including ability to effectively articulate business objectives.
* Analytical skills, Highly Focused, Team player, Versatile, Resourceful
* Ability to learn and apply quickly including ability to effectively impart knowledge to others.
* Effective under pressure
* Precise communication skills, including an ability to project clarity and precision in verbal and written communication and strong presentation skills.
* Strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills
* Project Management
* Requirements gathering
* Reporting and Dashboards

**Experience Desired**

* Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or a related field preferred
* CPA, CIA, CISA, or related certification (or progress toward certification) is a plus.
* Exposure to control automation, controls optimization, or monitoring solutions.
* Familiarity with Internal Audit and SOX PMO interactions.
* Desired Tool Experience & Project Practices: Oracle Cloud Tools (ERP & EDM), Microsoft Suite, Agile, Jira, Zeyphyr, Saviynt, Aveska, Sharepoint, and Confluence
* Demonstrated experience establishing and delivering complex projects/initiatives within agreed upon parameters while achieving the benefits and/or value-added results.
* Experience with Agile delivery methodology.
* Experience supporting ERP implementations or finance transformation programs, ideally Oracle Cloud GL migrations.

**Note:**
Qualified candidates will typically have 4 - 7 years of project experience within finance and accounting spaces inclusive of planning, status tracking, testing, and coordination & communication across multiple workstreams. Successful candidates will be high energy, self-starters with a focus on quality output and project delivery success. Successful candidates will have project experience in Oracle Cloud ERP & EDM technologies.
  
  
**About Evernorth Health Services**
Evernorth Health Services, a division of The Cigna Group, creates pharmacy, care and benefit solutions to improve health and increase vitality. We relentlessly innovate to make the prediction, prevention and treatment of illness and disease more accessible to millions of people. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.

title: PPC Marketing Specialist (Remote)
description:
**Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.**
That is the whole job.
  
  
Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.
  
  
So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.
  
  
At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.
  
  
You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.
  
  
Here is what "end to end" actually means.
  
  
**You are the account manager. We do not have any.**
You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.
  
  
**You own the whole funnel, not the campaign.**
Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.
  
  
**You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it.**
We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.
  
  
**You can live anywhere.**
We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.
  
  
If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.
  
  
If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.
  
  
**Requirements**
**What the job looks like**

* Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month
* Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working
* Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people
* Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing
* Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target
* Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule
* Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery
* Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why
* Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team
* Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt

**You are a fit if**

* You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search
* You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have
* You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it
* You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list
* You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard
* You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you
* Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too

**You are not a fit if**

* "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed
* You want to be told what to do this week
* You need a ticketing system to know what matters
* You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question

**Benefits**
**Why this role is exciting**
This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.
  
  
You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.
  
  
You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.
  
  
You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

title: Digital Marketing Assistant
description:
**About The Role**
We’re hiring a Digital Marketing Assistant to keep our websites, email, social media and digital brochure running smoothly every week, accurate, on-brand and up to date. You’ll work with a portfolio of well-known beauty and skincare brand partners.
  
  
By taking on the hands-on, high-volume work, you’ll free up our marketing lead to focus on strategy, brand partners and growth channels. You’ll work in a GHL (Go High Level) based workflow that we’re building, so you’ll help shape how we work as well as follow it.
  
  
This role combines digital marketing execution with creative production. You’ll be expected to design and edit assets independently, use AI tools in your daily workflow, and take ownership of your creative output from idea to delivery.
  
  
We expect you to be productive on listings and social within your first 30 days and running the weekly work independently by day 90.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**
**Websites and e-commerce**

* Upload and update products on the B2C Shopify site, including copy, images, prices, stock and collections
* Create and maintain product listings and bundles, and fix duplicates and listing errors
* List monthly excess and clearance stock across the B2C site and TikTok Shop
* Keep brand pages on the corporate website current, adding new brands and removing those no longer in the portfolio
* Support website SEO, product feeds and Google Merchant Center
* Prepare Amazon listing content

**Digital brochure (iPaper)**

* Update the iPaper brochure with new launches and promotions, which is the most important part of the role
* Manage the brochure day to day alongside colleagues
* Promote brochure updates through trade mailers

**Creative design and video editing**

* Independently create and edit social media creatives, short-form videos, Reels and other marketing assets, from concept to final delivery
* Design in Canva and Adobe Creative Suite (particularly InDesign), following company and partner-brand guidelines
* Edit short-form video for TikTok and Instagram Reels
* Produce launch and PR content, and retailer-win announcements

**Social media and digital marketing**

* Independently manage social media content, campaigns and other digital marketing activity
* Draft and schedule posts on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook and TikTok using Social Pilot
* Support the B2B LinkedIn presence, which is staff-led with plenty of company personality
* Coordinate samples for creators and affiliates and track the content they post
* Draft the monthly B2B social and digital calendar

**Email, SMS, WhatsApp And CRM**

* Build B2C campaigns and flows in Klaviyo, and B2B trade mailers in Mailchimp, from approved briefs
* Create SMS and WhatsApp Business campaigns in GHL to drive sales
* Design reusable email templates and build forms for trade account sign-ups, enquiries, sample requests, and event and training registrations
* Maintain lists and segments, and keep retailers and staff subscribed to mailers
* Support GHL marketing automations such as trade emails, lead capture and follow-ups as they roll out
* Log marketing tasks, campaigns and results in GHL

**AI-enabled workflows**

* Use AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude for content creation, research, ideation and marketing workflows
* Draft copy and document processes with AI support, reviewing outputs for accuracy and brand tone
* Help identify new ways to apply AI tools to improve speed and quality across the team
* Monitor the AI agents that respond to customer messages, reviews and cancellations

**Brand asset management**

* Keep an organised asset library for each partner brand, covering logos, packshots, lifestyle imagery, video and guidelines
* Request and chase new assets from brand partners for launches and promotions
* Remove discontinued products and brands that have left the portfolio
* Manage usage rights and version control, and share approved assets with the team and retailers

**Retailer support**

* Optimise retail partners’ online stores, including product content, imagery, range gaps and listings
* Create social assets that support our brands on retailers’ own channels
* Supply launch and promotion packs on request

**Training materials**

* Design training brochures on brands and products for shop-floor staff, pharmacy teams and the internal sales team, using InDesign and Canva
* Keep training materials current with new launches and range changes
* Support brand training sessions and webinars with materials and registrations

**Reporting and admin**

* Put together the monthly digital report (GA4, iPaper, Mailchimp, Klaviyo and TikTok Shop) for review
* Prepare brand reports on digital and sell-through performance for brand partner reviews
* Track weekly KPIs and flag out-of-stock or underperforming listings
* Screen-record repeated processes for the company handbook

**Essential**
**What we’re looking for**

* Fluent spoken and written English, with strong attention to detail for product data, pricing and copy
* Proven ability to create and edit social media creatives, short-form videos and Reels independently
* Confident with Canva and short-form video editing (CapCut or similar)
* Familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite, particularly InDesign, plus other relevant design tools
* Ability to independently manage social media content, campaigns and other digital marketing activity
* Working knowledge of Instagram, TikTok and LinkedIn
* Willingness and ability to learn and work with AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude for content creation, research, ideation and marketing workflows
* Adaptable and comfortable learning new tools and technologies, with the initiative to take ownership of creative execution
* Well organised, comfortable working to a weekly checklist and in spreadsheets
* A genuine interest in beauty, skincare and retail trends

**Desirable**

* Shopify or TikTok Shop seller experience
* Experience building campaigns in Klaviyo or Mailchimp
* GA4 basics, and experience with Go High Level or another CRM
* Experience using Claude or other AI tools to draft copy and document processes
* Wider Adobe experience (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro or After Effects)
* A marketing, design or digital media qualification
