title: Manager / Senior Manager – Marketing
description:
**Location:**
Hyderabad

**Reports To:**
MD / CEO

**Designation:**
Manager / Senior Manager – Marketing

**Experience :**
8+ years

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Marketing professional with a strong background in the IT/ITES industry, IT products and AI-driven solutions. The role will focus on strengthening the company's market presence, developing its brand and market positioning, and generating qualified business opportunities for the company's IT services and products.

The ideal candidate should combine strategic marketing capabilities with a sound understanding of technology offerings, customer needs and B2B marketing in domestic and international markets.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Marketing Strategy and Planning**

* Develop and execute marketing strategies aligned with the company's business growth objectives across IT services, software products and AI solutions.
* Identify target industries, customer segments, market opportunities and emerging business trends.
* Develop differentiated value propositions and positioning for the company's services, products and AI capabilities.
* Prepare annual marketing plans, budgets and measurable performance indicators.

**2. Brand Building and Market Positioning**

* Strengthen the company's brand visibility and credibility across relevant business and technology markets.
* Develop and manage marketing collateral, company presentations, service/product brochures, case studies and customer success stories.
* Oversee website content, digital presence, social media and thought-leadership initiatives.
* Promote the company's technology capabilities, including AI, digital transformation, software development and IT services.

**3. Demand Generation and Lead Development**

* Plan and execute integrated marketing campaigns to generate qualified business leads.
* Leverage digital marketing, email campaigns, content marketing, professional networks, industry events, webinars and other relevant channels.
* Develop account-based marketing initiatives for identified target companies and strategic accounts.
* Work closely with the Sales team to ensure effective lead qualification, handover and conversion tracking.

**4. Market Research and Competitive Intelligence**

* Conduct market and competitor research to identify customer requirements, emerging technologies and new business opportunities.
* Track developments in IT services, SaaS/software products, AI and related technology markets.
* Gather market feedback and recommend improvements to service offerings, product positioning and go-to-market strategies.

**5. Partnerships and Industry Engagement**

* Identify marketing alliances, technology partnerships, industry associations and other channels that can enhance market reach.
* Represent the company at relevant industry events, conferences, webinars and business forums.
* Build visibility among prospective customers, technology partners and industry stakeholders.

**6. Performance Measurement and Collaboration**

* Define and monitor marketing KPIs, including qualified leads, campaign performance, cost per lead, marketing contribution to the sales pipeline and brand engagement.
* Maintain appropriate marketing analytics and reporting systems.
* Collaborate with Sales, Delivery, Technology and Product teams to ensure marketing communication accurately reflects the company's capabilities.
* Provide regular updates to management on marketing performance, opportunities and planned initiatives.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* Approximately 8–12 years of relevant experience in B2B marketing within the IT/ITES industry, software products or technology solutions.
* Strong understanding of IT services, software products, AI/ML and emerging technology offerings, with the ability to translate technical capabilities into compelling business value propositions.
* Proven experience in B2B demand generation, digital marketing, brand positioning and integrated marketing campaigns.
* Experience marketing to medium and large Indian companies and multinational organizations.
* Strong understanding of technology-led business models, enterprise customer segments and go-to-market strategies.
* Excellent communication, content development, presentation and stakeholder-management skills.
* Experience with digital marketing platforms, marketing analytics, CRM and marketing automation tools.
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, IT or a related discipline. An MBA or postgraduate qualification in Marketing is desirable.

**Desirable Experience**

* Exposure to US markets and customers.
* Experience engaging with GCC markets, particularly the UAE, or with GCC-based companies operating in India.
* Experience in marketing AI-enabled solutions, SaaS products or enterprise software.
* Exposure to pharma/healthcare or other large enterprise sectors.

**Other Requirements**

* Willingness to travel for customer meetings, industry events and business engagements as required.
* Ability to work independently, collaborate across functions and operate in a results-oriented environment.

title: Senior Salesforce Marketing Cloud Solution Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
We are seeking a hands-on Senior Salesforce Marketing Cloud Solution Specialist to help us maximize the value of our Marketing Cloud investment and accelerate delivery of innovative, scalable marketing capabilities.
  
  
This is not an advisory-only role. We need someone who can take a business problem or opportunity, demonstrate the art of the possible, architect the solution, build it, and productionize it end to end.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines deep Marketing Cloud expertise with a strong
**“go figure it out” mindset**
: curious, resourceful, comfortable with ambiguity, excited to experiment, and equally focused on turning successful ideas into scalable, reusable production capabilities.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Own solutions end to end, from problem statement → solution design → prototype → build → testing → deployment → optimization.
  
  
Design and build solutions across Marketing Cloud Engagement, Marketing Cloud Personalization / Interaction Studio, Journey Builder, Automation Studio, CloudPages, Preference Centers, Email Studio, and Content Builder.
  
  
Design sophisticated preference and consent management solutions across audiences, brands, channels, and geographies.
  
  
Architect and develop Sales Cloud and Marketing Cloud integrations, including Marketing Cloud Connect, CRM data synchronization, APIs, event-driven journeys, and marketing and sales data flows.
  
  
Build hands-on using SQL, AMPscript, SSJS, REST/SOAP APIs, Data Extensions, HTML/CSS, and Salesforce integration capabilities.
  
  
Partner with Marketing, Sales, CRM, Data, and Technology teams to translate business challenges into compelling art-of-the-possible solutions and prototypes.
  
  
Proactively identify underutilized capabilities and new opportunities across personalization, automation, journey orchestration, AI, and intelligent customer engagement.
  
  
Design for scale and reuse, creating reusable journey frameworks, automation patterns, CloudPage components, preference-management capabilities, data models, and integration patterns.
  
  
Rapidly experiment with new capabilities, validate business value, and then productize successful concepts with appropriate governance, security, monitoring, documentation, and support.
  
  
Continuously identify opportunities to reduce manual effort, accelerate campaign delivery, and increase the business value generated from our Marketing Cloud ecosystem.

title: Lead Data Analyst
description:
**About the Role:**
===================

**Grade Level (for internal use):**

08

**Role Scope**

The Data Research Specialist is an individual contributor role that develops deep proficiency in a niche dataset / workflow and owns the end-to-end data lifecycle for one or more datasets —from sourcing and rule design through validation, enrichment, delivery, and handover. The role moves beyond execution into designing how data is treated, with a measurable downstream impact on data quality, efficiency, and usability.

Specialists maintain and evolve rule books and SOPs, provide UAT inputs, participate in solutioning, and begin direct interactions with vendors and internal partners. The role requires strong domain understanding, disciplined governance, and the ability to balance quality, speed, and risk while contributing to automation- and AI-enabled improvements.

**What** **You’ll** **Do (Key Responsibilities)**

**Operational Delivery**

* Collect, analyze, and validate US GAAP–based financial statement data (Balance Sheet, Income Statement, Cash Flow, and disclosures) from regulatory filings, earnings reports, and company publications

* Interpret complex financial disclosures and ensure accurate mapping, classification, and standardization of financial data in line with Compustat methodologies

* Perform detailed financial statement analysis, including cross ‑ statement checks, trend analysis, and reasonableness validation

* Ensure data integrity, consistency, and timeliness across financial datasets by following established research guidelines and quality standards

* Own the end-to-end data lifecycle for assigned datasets, including source selection , ingestion checks, rule application, validation and enrichment, publishing, and handover.

* Ensure SLAs for timeliness, coverage, and quality are met; track end-to-end KPIs, exception trends, and data drift indicators.

* Maintain and update rule books and SOPs as requirements evolve; communicate changes and readiness criteria to stakeholders.

* Support onboarding new datasets or sources through playbooks, sample evaluations, and readiness assessments.

* Participate in UAT cycles, providing domain test cases, acceptance criteria, and defect reproduction steps.

**Process Excellence**

* Keep documentation, runbooks, controls, and SOPs audit-ready, ensuring strong handovers and traceability.

* Contribute risk assessments for changes in rules, sources, or workflows, including rollback and monitoring plans.

* Partner with Technology and Process Experts to design and optimize automation- and AI-enabled workflows under governance.

* Apply working knowledge of LLM/GenAI tools for extraction, validation, and quality checks.

* Run small pilots and experiments (e.g., rule optimization, automation scripts, sampling) to improve efficiency, quality, and coverage.

* Provide SME inputs for data analysis, lineage documentation, and downstream integrations.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the point of contact for assigned datasets with peers, Data Stewards, cross-domain teams, Data Automation & Transformation, Quality teams , representing rule decisions within defined governance.

* Support seniors and other stakeholders by providing domain inputs to requirements, validating fixes, and refining data workflows.

* Begin liaising with vendor partners on clarifications, escalations, and data quality issues, supporting gap resolution actions.

* Support resolution of client queries/escalations with clear, data-backed responses; contribute to knowledge-sharing forums and working groups.

* Provide informal guidance to Intern s through onboarding support a s a buddy or micro-trainings (no formal people management).

**How Impact Will Be Measured (Success Metrics)**

* Dataset quality KPIs (accuracy, completeness, consistency); reduced exceptions and cycle time

* Timely resolution of client/vendor issues; improved satisfaction

* Quality/maintainability of rule books and SOPs (audit outcomes; update cadence)

* Measurable efficiency and quality gains from UAT, automation, and process improvements.

**For This Role You'll Need to Have (Skills & Competencies)**

**Technical Skills**

* Advanced Excel and solid SQL for investigations, reconciliations, and audits.

* Working knowledge of Python or similar scripting for basic automation and data checks (preferred).

* Familiarity with LLM/GenAI tooling and prompt design, including evaluation of metrics and guardrails.

* Understanding vendor data models and ingestion pipelines, with awareness of upstream/downstream impacts.

* Awareness of internal platforms and data ecosystems (e.g., data lakes, workflow engines).

**Functional Skills**

* Strong understanding of US GAAP financial statements (Balance Sheet, Income Statement, Cash Flow Statement) and their interrelationships

* Ability to analyze and interpret financial disclosures, footnotes, and management commentary

* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and ability to work with large and complex financial datasets

* Rule design and maintenance governing data treatment, enrichment, and delivery.

* Ability to resolve complex tickets and client queries independently.

* Support definition and refinement of data KPIs and control checks.

**Behavioral Skills**

* Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking, with comfort navigating ambiguity within defined scope.

* Curiosity to understand downstream use cases and client impact, translating insights into rule or control improvements.

* Clear communication and ability to collaborate and influence within the assigned dataset or domain.

* Ownership mindset with ability to work with limited supervision and maintain disciplined documentation.

* Resilience under pressure, handling escalations with sound judgment on quality, timeliness, and defined risk controls.

* D emonstrate s strong learning agility and digital acumen, with a continuous learning mindset and the ability to adapt to evolving tools and technologies .

**Preferred Education & Experience**

* 2–4 years of experience in data research, data operations, or market/financial data roles.

**Key Interfaces & Stakeholders**

* Associates and Specialists within Data Research & Operations.

* Data Stewards, Data Automation & Transformation, and Data Quality teams.

* Technology team which is responsible for platforms, tools, and pipelines.

* External vendors and, where applicable, clients via support channels

We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. title: Senior Implementation Analyst – Product Delivery (Immediate Joinee)
description:
The Senior Implementation Analyst (SIA) plays a pivotal role in the end-to-end delivery of software products across client engagements. The SIA owns the structured implementation of assigned projects — from initiation and planning through to UAT, Go Live, and formal closure.

Working in close coordination with the Project Manager and cross-functional teams, the SIA brings deep functional expertise, disciplined execution, and strong client engagement to every implementation. The SIA serves as the primary functional point of contact for the client during the implementation lifecycle — ensuring that the product is configured, trained, and adopted in a manner that delivers measurable value to the client's business.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

**1. Project Planning & Execution**

* Develop and own the Implementation Plan for each assigned engagement / project— covering scope, timelines, milestones, dependencies, resource requirements, and deliverable schedules.
* Translate signed contracts, Purchase Orders (POs), and client briefs into structured implementation charters, clearly defining scope of work, acceptance criteria, and success metrics.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date project records on the project management system (Zoho Projects or equivalent) at all times — including implementation plans, milestone trackers, action items, defect trackers, risks, and project documentation.
* Proactively identify implementation risks and escalate them in a timely manner — maintaining a risk register and applying structured mitigation approaches in line with best practices.
* Ensure that every project is tracked not just against timelines and scope, but against the client's actual business objectives — consistently measuring whether the implementation is delivering the value committed at the point of sale.

**2. Functional Delivery & Product Expertise**

* Gain deep functional mastery of all assigned products and serve as the go-to functional expert for clients, internal teams, and project stakeholders throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Collaborate with clients and concerned stakeholder(s) to understand their goals, workflows, and implementation vision — and translate these into a structured, feasible delivery plan.
* Conduct functional training sessions for User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and Go Live — ensuring that end users are fully equipped to adopt the product effectively.
* Provide best practice usage advisory to clients, recommending optimal configurations and usage approaches based on client context and product capabilities.
* Prepare project-specific training documentation, user guides, and functional reference materials tailored to the client's environment and user base.
* Interface with internal teams to resolve functional gaps, technical dependencies, or product-related challenges that arise during implementation.

**3. Client Relationship & Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the primary functional point of contact for the client during the implementation — building trust, managing expectations, and maintaining a high standard of client communication throughout.
* Conduct regular structured check-ins and progress reviews with client stakeholders — proactively communicating status, risks, decisions required, and next steps.
* Manage client concerns, escalations, and change requests in a composed and solutions-oriented manner — coordinating internally to resolve issues without compromising delivery timelines.
* Liaise with the concerned team to ensure a smooth post-implementation handover and sustained client satisfaction after Go Live.
* Represent the company professionally in client interactions at all levels — reinforcing the organization’s commitment to delivery excellence and client delight.

**4. Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with the assigned Project Manager / Reporting Manager to align on project priorities, share status updates, flag dependencies, and escalate risks within agreed protocols.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure smooth and timely delivery of services to the client.
* Serve as liaison between technical and non-technical teams, both within the organization and at client and vendor / subcontractor organizations, to ensure all project targets and requirements are met.
* Contribute structured, data-backed feedback on client observations, recurring implementation challenges, and product gaps to the Project Manager and SBU leadership.

**5. Process, Governance & Administration**

* Adhere to all implementation processes, documentation standards, and governance protocols as defined by the function — including Ideal Implementation Plans (IIPs), Implementation Risks & Pre-Requisites Documentation (IRPD), and Risk Assessment & Risk Treatment Registers (RART).
* Ensure complete, accurate, and timely updation of all project management system entries for every assigned implementation — providing real-time visibility to the Project Manager and leadership.
* Participate actively in implementation retrospectives — sharing learnings, contributing to process improvement discussions, and adopting refined methodologies in subsequent engagements.
* Ensure compliance with all central company policies, including Travel Policy, Information Security (INFOSEC) Policy, and any other applicable guidelines.

**Qualification / Skill-sets**

* B.Sc. (IT) / B.E. / B.Tech. / MCA / MBA or equivalent Technical Graduate / Post-Graduate with a sound understanding of software solutions and their implementation.
* 3 – 5 years of experience in a Software Implementation, or Project Delivery role within a software product or technology environment.
* Demonstrated ability to independently manage end-to-end software implementation projects — from initiation and planning through to UAT, Go Live, and closure.
* Strong command of project management concepts and methodologies — with working knowledge of both Agile (Scrum / Kanban) and Waterfall approaches.
* PMP Certification (preferred): Candidates[AA1] who hold a valid PMP certification from PMI are preferred. Candidates without the certification are expected to demonstrate a clear inclination and intent to pursue PMP as part of their professional development.
* Proficiency in project management tools (Zoho Projects, Jira, MS Project, or equivalent) — with the ability to maintain structured implementation records and generate meaningful reports.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills — with the ability to engage confidently with client stakeholders at all levels, including senior management.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills — ability to identify root causes, structure solutions, and make sound recommendations under pressure and in complex multi-stakeholder environments.
* Sound interpersonal skills — with demonstrated ability to work collaboratively across teams, manage client relationships, and navigate conflict professionally.
* Willingness and enthusiasm to travel *(within the city as well as PAN India)* for client meetings, implementations, training sessions, and Go Live support.

**Added Advantage Qualification / Skill-sets**

* Prior experience in a BFSI-domain software company, with working knowledge of banking regulations, compliance frameworks, or financial technology products.
* Basic to working knowledge of SQL or Oracle databases — ability to independently validate data and query implementation-relevant information without technical support.
* Exposure to ISO, CMM, or Six Sigma quality frameworks — with experience applying structured quality practices in a software delivery context.
* Experience in managing vendor or subcontractor deliverables as part of a structured implementation.
* Familiarity with product development lifecycle concepts — from product requirements and design through to testing, release, and implementation.

title: Purchasing Analyst
description:
Seaspan employees are goal-driven and thrive in a high-performance culture. Our integrated business model, with over 25 years of fleet life-cycle management expertise, provides the world’s major shipping companies with long-term leases on large, modern and technologically advanced vessels, combined with industry-leading ship management services. As owner and operator of the vessels, we provide skilled officers and crews dedicated to the safe, reliable, and economical operation of our fleet. Seaspan's fleet has evolved over time to meet the varying needs of our customer base. We own vessels in a wide range of sizes, from 2,500 TEU to 24,000 TEU. Our main operating offices are located in Singapore, Vancouver, Hong Kong, and Mumbai.

**Position Summary:**

  

The Purchasing Analyst drives cost control and performance across the purchasing and logistics function through
  
spend analysis, KPI reporting, and process improvement. Working with the purchasing team, category managers,
  
fleet and technical teams, finance, and third-party logistics (3PL) suppliers, the role turns purchasing and freight
  
data into clear, actionable insight. The analyst tracks spend under management, identifies savings opportunities
  
and purchasing behaviours that drive unnecessary cost, and monitors 3PL supplier performance and freight spend
  
across the fleet.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

**Spend Analysis and Compliance**

* Track and report spend under management compliance, measuring the share of spend placed with contracted
    
  and approved suppliers by vessel, category, and purchaser.
* Identify off-contract and maverick spend, and work with purchasers and category managers to bring it back
    
  under management.
* Analyze purchasing patterns to identify savings opportunities, including order consolidation, planned versus
    
  urgent purchasing, price variances, and supplier selection.
* Highlight purchasing behaviours that drive avoidable cost, such as late requisitions, split orders, and repeated
    
  urgent purchases, and recommend corrective actions.

**Freight and 3PL Performance**

* Monitor freight spend by vessel, port, mode, and 3PL supplier, and report trends and cost drivers to
    
  management.
* Track air versus sea freight mix, consolidation rates, and cost per kg, and monitor compliance with the urgent
    
  air freight approval process.
* Monitor 3PL supplier performance against agreed KPIs and service levels, including transit times, delivery
    
  reliability, cost, and reporting accuracy, and prepare data for supplier performance reviews.
* Reconcile 3PL invoices and reports against purchasing and shipment data, and flag discrepancies.

**KPIs, Reporting, and Systems**

* Develop and report purchasing KPIs, including requisition-to-order time, PO cycle time, supplier lead times, ontime delivery, and emergency purchase rates.
* Build and maintain Power BI dashboards and monthly management reports covering spend, savings, freight,
    
  and supplier performance.
* Extract, clean, and maintain data from the purchasing system (Jibe), and work with system owners to resolve
    
  data quality issues and system gaps.
* Automate recurring reports and support process improvements that reduce manual work for the purchasing
    
  team.

**Analytical Support**

* Provide analysis for tenders, supplier reviews, budget planning, and audits.
* Support benchmarking of purchasing and logistics cost and performance.

  

**Requirements:**

  

* Bachelor's degree, preferably in Supply Chain, Engineering, Business, Statistics, Management Information
    
  Systems, or a related field.
* 3 to 4 years of experience in purchasing, procurement, or logistics data analysis.
* Experience developing KPIs, dashboards, and management reporting.
* Understanding of the purchase-to-pay (P2P) cycle and of freight and logistics cost drivers.
* Strong analytical skills, with advanced proficiency in Excel (pivot tables, Power Query, lookups, data modelling)
    
  and Power BI.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present data clearly to non-technical
    
  stakeholders.
* Strong organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks.
* Detail-oriented and resourceful, with a solution-driven attitude.

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Experience in shipping, ship management, or another asset-heavy industry.
* Experience with purchasing or ERP software (Jibe, SAP, ShipNet, or similar).
* Knowledge of SQL or Python for data extraction and automation.
* Experience working with freight forwarders or 3PL providers.
* Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt or Green Belt certification.

title: Specialist II, Process Compliance Review and Analysis
description:
**Job Overview**
It is the responsibility of the post holder to provide all clients, both internal and external, with the appropriate quality of service in a safe and cost-effective manner. The individual will be expected to comply with the legal requirements of the Health and Safety at Work Act 1974, the COSHH regulations 1989 and the EC (European Commission) Directives 1992/3 as documented in the Company’s Health and Safety Manual.

* Compile metrics and identify quality trends.
* Assist in addressing periodic client quality reviews and other ad-hoc client quality findings.

**Experience (Minimum Required)**

* Three years of overall work experience in the pharmaceutical industry, biotechnology, or CRO industry primarily in Pharmacovigilance / Safety writing with at least One year of experience in Peer review/Quality review.

title: Research Analyst - Coal
description:
**Company:** INCWORX Intelligence Private Limited |  
**Location:** Gurugram, Haryana Experience: 2–5 Years | Employment: Full-Time | Compensation: Based on current experience and relevant expertise (20% hike from current pay)

**ROLE OVERVIEW**   
We are seeking a commercially oriented analyst with 2–5 years of relevant experience in coal procurement, sales, physical trading, market research, mining operations or supply-chain activities. Coverage includes coking/metallurgical coal, coke, thermal coal and steam coal, with emphasis on India’s domestic market and imported coal flows. Candidates with operational or commercial experience and some familiarity with seaborne trade and vessel fixtures are preferred.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**  
1. Coal Market Research & Price Intelligence

* Track domestic and international developments for coking coal, metallurgical coal, coke, thermal coal and steam coal.

* Monitor prices, supply-demand fundamentals, production and dispatch trends, inventories, imports, exports and changes in buying interest.

* Collect and validate price indications; compare prices by grade, quality, origin, location and delivery terms, distinguishing indicative information from confirmed transactions.

* Prepare regular market updates and explain price movements with reference to availability, demand, logistics, trade flows and relevant policy or operational developments. 2. Domestic Procurement, Sales & Supply Chain

* Build practical understanding of how domestic coal is sourced, purchased, sold, transported and delivered to industrial consumers.

* Track tenders, e-auctions, spot purchases, supplier offers, procurement requirements and relevant contract or delivery conditions.

* Research sourcing needs of steel plants, power producers, cement manufacturers, coke producers and other coal-consuming industries.

* Follow dispatches, stock levels, transport availability, handling and delivery constraints affecting procurement decisions and material availability.

* Support assessment of supplier options, buyer requirements, grade suitability and commercial considerations.

3. Coal Trading & Commercial Coordination

* Support physical coal trading by tracking sourcing opportunities, buyer requirements, supplier offers and relevant market price levels.

* Assist with commercial comparisons for domestic and imported coal, considering quality, origin, quantity, delivery location, timing and associated costs.

* Coordinate information among buyers, sellers and internal stakeholders to support evaluation and follow-through of potential trades.

* Maintain records of offers, market indications, key commercial terms and transaction status, clearly separating preliminary discussions from confirmed deals.

* Build understanding of the physical trading cycle, from sourcing and negotiation through dispatch or shipment, delivery and transaction follow-up.

4. Seaborne Coal Market & Vessel Fixtures

* Develop working knowledge of seaborne coal trade, including origin-destination flows, shipment schedules, cargo requirements and the impact of ocean freight on landed cost.

* Track available ocean-market information such as freight indications, vessel availability, loading and discharge ports, cargo quantity, laycan and other relevant fixture terms.

* Assist in coordinating information for potential vessel fixtures, including cargo readiness, loading/discharge requirements, shipment windows and communication between cargo and shipping stakeholders.

* Learn and help track basic fixture processes and terminology under the guidance of experienced commercial or shipping personnel; the role does not assume independent chartering authority.

* Assess how vessel availability, freight rates, port constraints and shipment timing may affect imported coal economics and procurement decisions.

5. Mining Operations & Domestic Supply

* Monitor coal-mine production, dispatches, inventories, mine auctions, availability and supply disruptions.

* Research developments involving domestic coal producers, captive and commercial mines, and coal-handling or distribution networks.

* Where information is available, relate mine-level and dispatch developments to market availability, prices and buyer procurement options.

* Mining, production, dispatch, coal-quality or mine-logistics experience will be an advantage.

6. Primary Research, Data & Reporting

* Build professional contacts across producers, traders, importers, industrial buyers, procurement teams and relevant logistics or shipping participants.

* Conduct structured market calls and primary research to collect, cross-check and contextualize information.

* Maintain organized datasets for prices, offers, supply-demand indicators, trade flows and operational developments.

* Use Microsoft Excel, including advanced functions, lookups, pivot tables, data cleaning and analytical reporting, to manage and analyze market data.

* Prepare daily/weekly market updates, price assessments, reports and concise analytical briefs, documenting sources, assumptions and limitations.

**EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE**

* B.E./B.Tech. in Mining Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering or a related technical discipline. Mechanical, Chemical, Mineral Engineering or other relevant graduates may be considered with suitable coal-sector experience.

* MBA in Operations, Supply Chain Management, International Business or a related specialization is an advantage.

* 2-5 years of relevant experience in coal procurement, sales, physical trading, commodity research, mining or supply-chain operations.

* Indian domestic coal-market knowledge is preferred. Exposure to imported coal, seaborne trade, ocean freight or vessel fixture coordination is highly desirable; hands-on mining or dispatch experience is a plus.

* Working knowledge of coal quality parameters such as calorific value, ash, moisture and sulphur, and their commercial implications.

**SKILLS & CANDIDATE PROFILE**

* Strong analytical, numerical and research skills, with attention to source reliability and data accuracy.

* Comfortable communicating with suppliers, buyers and industry stakeholders and following up to validate information.

* Able to distinguish indicative prices/offers from confirmed transactions and document key assumptions and unknowns.

* Commercial curiosity about procurement, trading, logistics, seaborne shipments and vessel fixtures. Advanced Excel skills are required.

**PERFORMANCE AREAS**

Quality and timeliness of market updates; reliability of price and transaction information; depth of domestic and imported coal coverage; quality of primary research; usefulness of procurement, trading and landed-cost analysis; and effective support for shipment and fixture coordination.

**COMPENSATION & APPLICATION**

Compensation will be determined based on the candidate’s current experience, relevant expertise and suitability for the role. Interested candidates should submit an updated resume highlighting coal-sector experience, procurement/sales or trading exposure, operational knowledge, and any seaborne-market or fixture experience.

title: Senior Information Security Analyst - IND
description:
**About Kinaxis**
Are you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!
  
  
In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best-in-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.
  
  
Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.
  
  
**Location**
Chennai,India.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Senior Information Security Analyst is a seasoned cybersecurity specialist responsible for advanced threat detection, incident response, requests, and ongoing enhancement of Security Operations across Corporate IT environments and the Kinaxis Maestro SaaS platform.
  
  
As part of Kinaxis’s global follow-the-sun incident response framework, this role serves as the primary first responder or escalation point for their time zone, providing initial investigative leadership for time-sensitive events and ensuring continuity of response across global shifts. The role functions as an escalation point for complex investigations, leads improvements in detection and response capabilities.
  
  
The position requires independent problem solving, strong judgment during security events, and the ability to collaborate effectively across IT, SaaS Operations, Product Development, and Business Systems teams. The role also contributes to strengthening operational processes and provides mentorship to analysts within the Security Operations team.
  
  
What you will do
  
  
Incident Response
  
  

* Serve as the first responder or an escalation point, local time zone, for security incidents in alignment with the global follow-the-sun coverage model, ensuring timely triage, containment actions, and appropriate escalation.
* Lead investigation and response for complex, high-severity, or sensitive incidents that occur during local operating hours.
* Provide escalation support, guidance, and quality review for Security Analysts during active investigations.
* Direct containment, eradication, and recovery efforts, ensuring accurate documentation and effective handoff as required.
* Coordinate communications and incident status updates for Security leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Participate in the global on-call schedule for high-priority events when incidents exceed local time zone coverage.

AI-Enabled Security Operations
  
  

* Identify and implement responsible uses of AI and machine learning to improve alert triage, investigation, threat analysis, correlation, summarization, documentation, and operational decision-making.
* Evaluate AI-enabled capabilities within existing and prospective security technologies and develop practical use cases that improve quality, consistency, or efficiency.
* Validate AI-generated findings and recommendations before operational use, maintaining appropriate human oversight, data protection, access controls, and auditability.
* Define and document AI use-case objectives, limitations, safeguards, validation requirements, and success measures.
* Evaluate implemented AI and automation use cases for operational benefit, including reduced manual effort, improved analytical consistency, faster workflows, or stronger decision support.
* Ability to evaluate AI-generated outputs critically and apply AI-enabled tools responsibly within established security, privacy, data-protection, and governance requirements.
* Experience designing or operationalizing AI-enabled security use cases with human validation, data protection, and governance controls.

Threat Detection and Hunting
  
  

* Develop, tune, and validate detection logic and analytics in SIEM and XDR platforms, aligned to MITRE ATT&CK.
* Conduct structured threat hunting to identify anomalous activity, emerging threats, and monitoring gaps.
* Integrate cyber threat intelligence into detection engineering, investigations, and operational processes.
* Assess and improve telemetry coverage across endpoints, networks, cloud services, and SaaS platforms.

Security Tooling and Engineering
  
  

* Maintain and optimize security tools supporting detection and response, including SIEM, XDR/EDR, SOAR, log management, and cloud-native security services.
* Create and maintain operational playbooks, runbooks, and automation workflows to ensure consistent response across team
* Partner with IT, SaaS Operations, and Engineering to enhance telemetry, logging, and secure configuration controls across the environment.

Security Advisory and Collaboration
  
  

* Provide expert guidance on risk severity, remediation actions, and prioritization of security findings.
* Support cross-functional teams by ensuring proposed changes, deployments, or configurations incorporate the appropriate security controls.
* Communicate technical findings and recommended actions to stakeholders in clear and concise terms.
* Participate in internal and external audit activities and support remediation workstreams.

Operational Excellence and Team Development
  
  

* Monitor new cyber threats, attack techniques, vulnerabilities, and trends, and recommend operational changes.
* Contribute to cyber resilience, disaster recovery, and business continuity exercises.
* Maintain and continuously improve operational documentation, including playbooks, procedures, and knowledge articles.
* Provide coaching and mentorship to analysts, contributing to skill development and knowledge sharing across the global team.

What we are looking for
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent experience.
* 5 to 7 years of experience in Security Operations, Incident Response, IT Security, or related fields in a global or high-tech environment.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking abilities, with the capacity to make informed decisions under pressure.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical information.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, global environment with shifting priorities and cross-functional collaboration requirements.
* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple concurrent responsibilities.
* Adaptable and resilient in high-urgency operational contexts.
* Demonstrated ability to coach or mentor junior team members.

**Certifications**

* Foundational certifications considered assets: CompTIA Security+, CompTIA CySA+, CCNA Security, CCNP Security.
* Advanced certifications preferred: CISSP, CCSP, GIAC (GCIH, GCIA, GCED, GCFA), or equivalent senior-level credentials.

**Role Specific Skills And Experience**

* Experience serving in an operational security role with responsibility for incident triage, investigation, and response.
* Prior experience acting as a first responder or escalation point for security incidents, ideally within a follow-the-sun or global SOC model.
* Strong knowledge of attacker TTPs, threat modeling, IOCs/IOAs, and MITRE ATT&CK.
* Hands-on experience with SIEM and XDR platforms (Microsoft Sentinel, Defender for Endpoint, or similar).
* Experience with cloud security monitoring and controls in Azure, AWS, or GCP environments.
* Understanding of security technologies including firewalls, IDS/IPS, IAM, encryption, and authentication mechanisms.
* Strong understanding of industry-recognized cybersecurity frameworks, including ISO 27001, NIST CSF, and SOC 2.

**Work With Impact:**
Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.
  
  
**Work with Fortune 500 Brands:**
Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more.
  
  
**Social Responsibility at Kinaxis:**
Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to a long-term net-zero operations strategy. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.
  
  
People matter at Kinaxis and here are some of the perks and benefits we offer, which may vary by location and employee:
  
  

* Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company-wide days off)
* Flexible work options
* Physical and mental well-being programs
* Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes
* Mentorship programs, training, and career development
* Recognition programs and referral rewards
* Hackathons

For more information, visit the Kinaxis website at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at http://blog.kinaxis.com .
  
  
Kinaxis welcomes candidates to apply to our inclusive community. We provide accommodations upon request to ensure fairness and accessibility throughout our recruitment process for all candidates, including those with specific needs or disabilities. If you require an accommodation, please reach out to us at recruitmentprograms@kinaxis.com. This contact information is for accessibility requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.
  
  
Kinaxis is committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process. We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools in the initial step of the recruitment process to compare submitted resumes against the job description to identify candidates whose education, experience, and skills most closely match the requirements of the role. After the initial screening, all subsequent decisions regarding your application, including final selection, are made by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.

title: Application Security Architect
description:
We are looking for an experienced Application Security Architect with 9–12 years of experience to drive application security architecture, engineering security standards and secure software development practices across Novac's fintech product ecosystem.

The candidate will be responsible for designing and implementing security architecture for enterprise-grade financial software products, ensuring security is embedded throughout the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). The role requires strong expertise in application security, secure coding, API security, cloud security, DevSecOps, threat modelling, vulnerability management, and security architecture reviews.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience securing fintech applications, digital lending platforms, loan management systems, insurance technology platforms, financial APIs, payment integrations, and enterprise software products. The candidate will work closely with Product Engineering, Software Architecture, Cloud, DevOps, and Information Security teams to ensure that Novac's products are scalable, resilient, and secure.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities:**

**Application Security Architecture**

* Establish secure architecture standards for digital banking, lending, insurance, and payment platforms.
* Define enterprise security reference architectures and reusable security patterns.
* Define security controls for AI-enabled applications and APIs.
* Assess risks relating to LLM integration, prompt injection, sensitive data exposure, and model governance.
* Review application architecture, technical designs, and business requirements to identify security risks and recommend appropriate controls.
* Drive security-by-design principles across product development and software engineering.
* Review architecture designs and provide security requirements before development begins.
* Conduct security architecture reviews for web applications, mobile applications, APIs, microservices, and cloud-based platforms.
* Define secure architecture patterns for authentication, authorization, encryption, data protection, and identity management.
* Review NFRs (Non-Functional Requirements) related to security, privacy, resilience, and compliance.
* Ensure security controls are incorporated into product architecture from the design stage.

**Secure SDLC & DevSecOps**

* Integrate security practices across all stages of the Software Development Life Cycle.
* Implement and strengthen DevSecOps practices by embedding automated security testing into CI/CD pipelines.
* Drive implementation of SAST, DAST, SCA, container security, and Infrastructure-as-Code security scanning.
* Establish secure coding guidelines and conduct application code security reviews.
* Work closely with development teams to identify, prioritise, and remediate security vulnerabilities.
* Automate security validation and vulnerability detection within software development and deployment processes.

**API & Fintech Product Security**

* Design and implement security controls for REST APIs, microservices, third-party integrations, and distributed applications.
* Ensure secure API authentication and authorisation using OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, and API gateways.
* Secure financial applications involving digital lending, loan origination, loan management, insurance workflows, and transaction processing.
* Define security controls for sensitive customer information, financial records, and transactional data.
* Ensure secure integration with banking systems, payment gateways, financial institutions, and external service providers.
* Identify and mitigate risks associated with data exposure, unauthorised access, fraud, and application-level attacks.

**Vulnerability Assessment & Threat Modelling**

* Conduct application security assessments, architecture reviews, and threat modelling exercises.
* Establish vulnerability management processes, risk classification, and remediation SLAs.
* Perform security risk assessments for new product features, application enhancements, and third-party integrations.

**Cloud & Infrastructure Application Security**

* Define and implement application security controls across AWS, Azure, or GCP environments.
* Review IAM architectures and enforce least-privilege access controls.
* Establish Zero-Trust application security principles.
* Ensure security across cloud-native applications, Docker, Kubernetes, and microservices environments.
* Implement encryption, secrets management, key management, and secure communication protocols.
* Work with cloud and DevOps teams to strengthen application deployment and runtime security.
* Ensure secure configurations and access controls across application environments.

**Security Governance & Compliance**

* Define application security policies, standards, technical guidelines, and governance frameworks.
* Ensure alignment with relevant security standards such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, and applicable RBI requirements, based on product and regulatory scope.
* Support internal and external security audits, compliance assessments, and risk reviews.
* Drive security awareness and secure coding practices across engineering teams.
* Work closely with technology leadership and product stakeholders to ensure security requirements are met.
* Define application security KPIs and maturity roadmap.
* Track:
* Vulnerability remediation SLA adherence
* Security debt
* Critical vulnerability trends
* Application security coverage
* Secure coding adoption metrics
* Present security posture and risks to senior management and technology leadership.

**Experience & Educational Qualifications**

* 9–12 years of overall experience in Application Security, Product Security, Security Engineering, or Information Security.
* Minimum 5+ years of relevant hands-on experience in application security and secure software development.
* 3+ years of experience in application security architecture, security design reviews, or security engineering leadership preferred.
* Experience securing UPI, payment gateway, and financial transaction workflows.
* Understanding of RBI Cyber Security Framework expectations.
* Knowledge of PCI DSS v4.0 requirements.
* Familiarity with data protection requirements involving customer PII, financial information, and consent management.
* Experience in a FinTech, BFSI technology, Banking Software, or Enterprise software Product Company is strongly preferred.
* Preferred Certifications (CISSP/CSSLP/CCSP).
* Proven experience in securing enterprise-grade applications, APIs, microservices, and cloud-based platforms.
* Strong understanding of modern software architecture, distributed systems, and cloud-native applications.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate should come from a FinTech, Banking Technology, Financial Software Product, or Enterprise SaaS Product Engineering Organisation.

**Candidates should have demonstrated experience in:**

* Designing and implementing application security architecture for complex software products.
* Securing digital lending, banking, payment, insurance, and transaction-based platforms.
* Implementing DevSecOps and integrating security into CI/CD pipelines.
* Conducting threat modelling, security architecture reviews, and secure code assessments.
* Securing APIs, microservices, cloud platforms, and third-party integrations.
* Working directly with software engineering and product development teams to embed security into product design and delivery.
* Certification related to application security will be an added advantage.

title: Contract Position: Security Engineer
description:
[Skills & Assignment]
  
  
Experience: 6.0 - 25 years
  
  
Max Experience: 25
  
  
We are seeking a Lead Software Security Engineer to lead a team of trainers who will develop high-quality training and evaluation tasks for frontier AI coding models and step in to perform tasks when there is a high volume. You will transform real-world open-source vulnerabilities—including CVEs, security advisories, and bug reports—into Harbor-format audit-and-patch tasks across multiple programming languages.
  
  
This role combines software security research, vulnerability reproduction, benchmark development, automated testing, and technical review. The goal is to create realistic tasks that evaluate whether AI systems can identify, understand, exploit, and securely remediate software vulnerabilities without relying on superficial pattern matching or known patches.
  
  
What does day-to-day look like
  
  

* Plan task deliveries by batch, assign work across pod members, and track daily throughput against phase-specific targets.
* Monitor pod progress, identify bottlenecks, and ensure tasks move through each stage of production on schedule.
* Lead weekly client reporting, communicate delivery status, and raise risks early, including tooling issues, rate limits, safety blocks, and resource constraints.
* Collaborate with the client to clarify requirements and align on scope, task volume, and difficulty changes.
* Conduct final reviews of completed tasks to ensure they meet the required quality, security, reproducibility, and evaluation standards.
* Calibrate Pod Leads and trainers on CWE classification, verifier robustness, task difficulty, and acceptance criteria.
* Use throughput and quality data to forecast staffing needs for each project phase.
* Initiate hiring and onboarding waves approximately three weeks ahead of projected capacity requirements.
* Maintain clear documentation of delivery plans, risks, quality findings, throughput metrics, and staffing forecasts.

**Requirements**

* 6+ years of professional software engineering experience.
* Expert-level proficiency in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, C/C++, C#, Go, Rust, Ruby, PHP, Kotlin, or Swift.
* Strong understanding of software security concepts, including CWE, CVE, and the OWASP Top 10.
* Ability to reproduce vulnerabilities and write proof-of-vulnerability tests.
* Hands-on experience with security tooling, including sanitizers, fuzzers, and static-analysis tools such as CodeQL or Semgrep.
* Strong proficiency with Git, Linux, Bash, and Docker.
* Excellent technical writing and documentation skills.
* Ability to work independently in a fully remote, research-oriented environment.
* Strong judgment on verifier robustness and on scoring AI patches. Clear, supportive communicator with some experience mentoring others.
* Proven track record on this project or equivalent security-dataset work.

description:

**Role Overview**

The Level 1.5–2 Modern Work & Security Engineer is a hands-on technical support role responsible for assisting with the day-to-day support, administration and improvement of secure Microsoft Modern Workplace environments for managed services clients across Australia.

This role provides advanced Level 1 and developing Level 2 support across Microsoft 365, Intune,

Entra ID, Defender, Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, endpoint management and related security controls. The position is customer-facing and requires strong troubleshooting, clear communication, good documentation habits and the ability to work effectively across service desk, project and escalation teams.

The role is aligned to the ANZ IT MSP market, where a Level 1.5–2 engineer is expected to provide

reliable multi-client support, resolve common and moderately complex issues, follow established

processes, contribute to documentation and escalate effectively when deeper technical ownership is required.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1.1 Managed Services Support & Escalation Handling**

 Provide Level 1.5–2 support across Modern Work, Microsoft 365, endpoint, identity and

security services for managed services clients.

 Investigate and resolve common and moderately complex issues across Exchange Online,

SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams, Intune, Windows 10/11, Entra ID, MFA and Conditional

Access.

 Triage incidents, service requests and alerts accurately, applying agreed troubleshooting

steps before escalation.

 Escalate complex or high-risk issues to Level 3 engineers with clear notes, evidence, impact

assessment and actions already taken.

 Maintain timely ticket updates, client communications and internal notes in line with MSP

service management standards.

 Support incident, request and change activities in line with ITIL-aligned MSP processes and

agreed client SLAs.

**1.2 Operational Administration & Project Assistance**

 Administer user accounts, groups, mailboxes, permissions, devices and common Microsoft

365 service settings under approved processes.

 Assist with Intune, Autopilot, device enrolment, application deployment, compliance policy

and endpoint configuration activities.

 Support delivery of standard changes, small project tasks, onboarding activities, endpoint

refresh tasks and Modern Workplace uplift work.

 Complete testing, validation and post-change checks for approved Microsoft 365, endpoint

and security changes.

 Create and maintain knowledge base articles, support notes, standard operating procedures

and handover documentation.

**1.3 Security Support & Continuous Improvement**

 Apply security-first support practices across user access, endpoint, identity, collaboration

and data protection services.

 Assist with Microsoft Defender, MFA, Conditional Access, device compliance, endpoint

protection and baseline security configuration checks.

 Monitor and respond to common security alerts, suspicious sign-in activity, device

compliance issues and endpoint health concerns using approved runbooks.

 Identify repeat issues, documentation gaps and automation opportunities, and raise

improvement recommendations to senior engineers or practice leads.

 Contribute to continual service improvement by improving ticket quality, knowledge sharing

and consistency of operational support.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

**1.4 Ticket Quality, Escalation Hygiene & SLA Performance**

o Resolve assigned Level 1.5–2 incidents and service requests within agreed SLAs and

with accurate client communication.

o Escalate issues with clear impact, troubleshooting notes, screenshots, logs and

recommended next actions.

**1.5 Operational Delivery & Documentation Quality**

o Complete assigned administration, support and project assistance tasks to agreed

quality and timeframes.

o Maintain accurate knowledge base articles, ticket notes, change records and

operational handover information.

**1.6 Client Experience & Capability Growth**

o Provide professional, timely and helpful communication to clients, service delivery

teams and internal stakeholders.

o Demonstrate ongoing technical development through learning, certification

progress, mentoring and increasing ownership of Level 2 work.

**Qualifications and Experience**

**Skills**

 Good working knowledge of Microsoft 365 administration, including Exchange Online,

SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams, user accounts, groups, licensing and mailbox support.

 Developing capability across Intune, Autopilot, device enrolment, compliance policies,

application deployment and Windows 10/11 endpoint support.

 Foundational to intermediate understanding of Entra ID, MFA, Conditional Access, identity

lifecycle, hybrid identity concepts and common authentication issues.

 Practical awareness of Microsoft Defender, endpoint security, device compliance, secure

configuration and common security alert handling.

 Sound troubleshooting skills across desktop, Microsoft 365, networking fundamentals, DNS,

DHCP, Active Directory, Group Policy and cloud-connected endpoints.

 Basic PowerShell skills or willingness to develop scripting capability for repeatable support

and administration tasks.

 Strong customer service, documentation and communication skills, with the ability to

manage multiple clients, priorities and tickets in a busy MSP environment.

**Experience**

 2+ years’ experience in IT support, service desk, desktop support, Microsoft 365

administration or endpoint support, ideally with exposure to Level 2 work.

 Experience supporting multiple client environments in an APAC MSP, MSSP, professional

services or outsourced IT environment is highly desirable.

 Experience with Microsoft 365, Windows endpoints, Intune, Entra ID, MFA, Exchange Online,

Teams, SharePoint and basic security administration.

 Experience working with ticketing systems, SLAs, knowledge base articles and ITIL-aligned

incident, request and change processes.

 Relevant Microsoft certifications or progress towards certification are desirable, such as MS-

900, SC-900, AZ-900, MD-102, MS-102 or equivalent practical experience.

title: Workplace Services Architect – Vulnerability Management
description:
Job Title Workplace Services Architect – Vulnerability Management

Location: Hyderabad, India

Employment Type: Contract Role

Experience: 10–15 Years

Specialization: Workplace Services & Vulnerability Management

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Workplace Services Architect specializing in Vulnerability Management to design, define, and drive vulnerability management strategies across the enterprise workplace environment. The ideal candidate will have strong architectural expertise in workplace infrastructure, endpoint security, vulnerability assessment, risk management, and remediation. The role involves defining security architecture, establishing vulnerability management frameworks, and ensuring the security and compliance of enterprise workplace services.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and own the vulnerability management architecture and strategy for Workplace Services.
* Design and implement enterprise-wide vulnerability management frameworks, policies, standards, and processes.
* Identify, assess, prioritize, and manage vulnerabilities across workplace infrastructure and endpoint environments.
* Establish risk-based vulnerability remediation strategies based on CVSS scores, exploitability, threat intelligence, and business impact.
* Define vulnerability scanning, assessment, remediation, and mitigation processes.
* Drive vulnerability remediation across desktops, laptops, virtual desktops, workplace servers, and other endpoint environments.
* Provide architectural guidance on vulnerability management tools, technologies, and solutions.
* Integrate vulnerability management platforms with endpoint management, ITSM, CMDB, and security operations platforms.
* Define remediation SLAs, risk acceptance procedures, exception management, and governance processes.
* Work closely with Workplace Engineering, Endpoint Management, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, SOC, and IT Operations teams.
* Establish KPIs, dashboards, and reporting mechanisms to monitor vulnerability exposure and remediation progress.
* Conduct architecture reviews and recommend security improvements across workplace services.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise security policies, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.
* Drive automation and continuous improvement of vulnerability management processes.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong experience in Workplace Services architecture and enterprise workplace infrastructure.
* Expertise in Vulnerability Management architecture, implementation, and governance.
* Hands-on or architectural experience with vulnerability management tools such as Tenable/Nessus, Qualys VMDR, Rapid7 InsightVM, and Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management.
* Strong understanding of endpoint security, vulnerability assessment, patch management, and remediation.
* Experience with Microsoft Intune, SCCM/MECM, and endpoint configuration management.
* Good understanding of Windows operating systems, Active Directory, Entra ID, and enterprise endpoint environments.
* Knowledge of vulnerability lifecycle management, CVE, CVSS, CWE, and threat intelligence.
* Experience integrating vulnerability management solutions with ServiceNow or other ITSM platforms.
* Knowledge of security frameworks such as NIST, ISO 27001, and CIS Controls.
* Understanding of endpoint hardening, security baselines, and configuration compliance.

**Architectural & Leadership Skills**

* Ability to define enterprise workplace security architecture and technical roadmaps.
* Experience developing architecture blueprints, solution designs, and technical standards.
* Ability to translate business and security requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Experience providing technical leadership and architectural guidance to implementation teams.
* Ability to communicate security risks, remediation priorities, and architectural recommendations to senior stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, or Microsoft Security certifications.
* Certifications in Tenable, Qualys, or Rapid7 technologies.
* Experience working in large-scale enterprise or global Workplace Services environments.
* Experience in vulnerability management transformation, automation, and security governance.

**careers@i2d.consulting**

description:
**Role purpose**
Give leadership and clients independent assurance that Agivant's delivery meets agreed standards, contractual SLAs and certification requirements. You own the quality and compliance system, quarterly internal audits, SLA compliance assurance, certifications, client audits and a network of project quality champions, and you will move evidence and control testing to AI-driven continuous monitoring.

* Own the quality and information-security management systems: scope, policies, control mapping, Statement of Applicability.
* Lead certification, surveillance and recertification audits; close non-conformities within certifier deadlines; run half-yearly management reviews.
* Define quality standards and audit criteria; advise the process change board on conformance; evaluate new certifications (SEI/CMMI, ISO9001, SOC 2, ISO/IEC 42001).

**Quarterly internal audit**

* Build a risk-based annual plan and audit every account each month/quarter, sampling projects by risk.
* Issue severity-rated findings; require root-cause analysis for major findings and verify corrective actions before closure.
* Run continuous control monitoring between audits using system data.
* Define delivery quality metrics with delivery leads (defect leakage, rework, release quality) and track trends across accounts.
* Bring continuous improvement to the processes

**SLA compliance assurance**

* Verify SLA terms in new SOWs are measurable and captured correctly in the SLA register.
* Audit SLA measurement accuracy quarterly; require root-cause analysis and corrective action for every breach.
* Report SLA breach trends and raise contract risk where SLAs are repeatedly at risk.

**Project quality champions**

* Identify one quality champion per project, nominated by the ED at kickoff.
* Train champions on standards, audit readiness, SLA evidence and corrective actions; run a monthly champion forum.
* Develop selected champions into part-time internal auditors.

* Own responses to client vendor assessments and security questionnaires using a reusable answer library.

* Specify continuous monitoring and automated evidence collection for the AI PMO; cut manual evidence requests each cycle.

* 5–10 years in IT services, with 3+ years leading quality, compliance or process excellence.
* Familiarity with ISO 9001 and/or ISO/IEC 27001 certification cycles and built a recurring internal audit program across multiple accounts.
* Has faced enterprise client audits and worked with SLA frameworks from contract definition to breach management.
* ISO 9001 or ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Auditor required; Lean Six Sigma, CISA, CISM, ISO/IEC 42001 or ITIL 4 preferred.
* Knowledge of statistical quality control, root-cause analysis and corrective action, audit sampling, Agile delivery metrics, and data protection basics (India's DPDP Act 2023, GDPR).
* Independent, pragmatic, able to influence senior delivery leaders and coach champions.

**Controls & Security**

* Content creation to support Kick off meetings for project initiatives and other communication material
* Management of documentation on SharePoint and other project tools (Jira)
* Collaborate with Project Managers to create, maintain and monitor project plan
* Collaborate with Project Managers to create and maintain cutover and transition planning; support monitoring of cutover activity status.
* Support the administration and monitoring of Hypercare periods and performance relative to KPIs; may include routing issues and inquiries to appropriate subject matter experts
* Assist change and workstream leads to ensure training, end user support coverage is without gaps; support may involve content creation and user support triage
* Loading and management of test scripts in testing tool: Zephyr.
* Monitoring and development of formal testing entrance and exit gate materials
* Support the planning, administration and status reporting of testing cycles inclusive of tester & environmental readiness and defect tracking and remediation efforts.
* Coordination & Management of test triage calls
* Support development of testing scenarios in collaboration with workstream leads and QA teams; align testing scenarios to requirements for traceability.
* Review Scenarios for breadth and depth of coverage and support business stakeholder review process for “day in the life” testing coverage for UAT cycles.
* Support test script development with workstream leads as needed.
* Execute / administer program and governance management process inclusive of progress status reporting, risk and issue tracing and change control management.
* Create governance committee materials.
* Create broad communication materials for extended stakeholder teams

**Competencies / Skills**
**Controls & Security**

* Strong understanding of SOX, business process controls, ITGCs, and regulatory compliance in a finance transformation context.
* Ability to assess and design controls in automated and technology-enabled environments, including Oracle Cloud and automation solutions.
* Experience with access governance tooling (Saviynt preferred) and GRC platforms e.g. (Oracle GRC).
* Strong stakeholder management skills across Finance, IT, Security, Risk, and Audit functions.
* Ability to translate complex control and automation topics into clear, audit-defensible communications — both written and verbal.

**Business PMO**

* Ability to review deliverables for completeness, quality, and compliance with established project standards.
* Ability to resolve conflict (striving for win-win outcomes); ability to execute with limited information and ambiguity
* Ability to deal with organizational politics including ability to navigate a highly matrixed organization effectively.
* Strong Influencing skills (sound business and technical acumen as well as skilled at achieving buy-in for delivery strategies)

title: Networking Managed Services Engineer (L2)
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**
As a Networking Managed Services Engineer (L2) at NTT DATA, you'll take on a developing engineering role where your main goal is to ensure our clients' IT infrastructure and systems remain operational. You'll achieve this by proactively monitoring, identifying, investigating, and resolving technical incidents and problems. You'll work closely with our clients and internal teams to ensure that services are restored swiftly, in line with our service level agreements (SLAs).
  
  
Your day will revolve around reviewing client requests and tickets, applying your technical expertise to resolve them efficiently and effectively. You'll be the go-to person for second-line support, handling incidents and requests of medium complexity. In addition to your daily tasks, you'll have opportunities to contribute to exciting project work from time to time.
  
  
You'll proactively monitor work queues, execute operational tasks, and update tickets with the actions you've taken. Identifying, analysing, and logging issues before they escalate will be a key part of your role. You'll communicate with other teams and clients to provide support and ensure that changes are executed with clear risk identification and mitigation plans.
  
  
As part of the shift handover process, you'll highlight key tickets and upcoming critical tasks for the next shift. When needed, you'll escalate tickets to ensure the right focus from our Centres of Excellence (CoE) and other teams. Collaborating with our automation teams, you'll work on optimizing efforts and automating routine tasks, all while coaching our Service desk and L1 teams in both technical and behavioural skills.
  
  
You'll also establish monitoring for client infrastructure, leading and managing initial client escalations for operational issues. Contributing to the change management process, you'll log change requests, execute approved maintenance activities, and audit incident and request tickets for quality. Your insights will drive trend analysis reports, identifying tasks suitable for automation to reduce tickets and optimize efforts. You might also support disaster recovery functions and other related tasks as needed.
  
  
**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**

* Proficiency in technologies such as Pulse Secure SSL VPN, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco Nexus switches/routers/firewalls, and more familiarity with ticketing tools.
* At least one technical certification in the above-mentioned technologies.
* Strong planning skills, with the ability to anticipate and adapt to changing circumstances.
* Adaptability and resilience in a dynamic work environment.
* Ability to communicate and work effectively across different cultures and social groups.
* Proficiency in active listening and client-centric communication.
