You'll serve as a trusted technical advisor, partnering with customers over Zoom and email to improve adoption, unblock implementations, and apply DevSecOps best practices across the software delivery lifecycle. Working closely with Account Executives and Renewals Managers, you'll align technical recommendations to customer goals and help support renewals and expansion by demonstrating outcomes. You'll also contribute back to the broader GitLab team by sharing learnings through documentation and enablement content, while mentoring team members and customers through complex technical challenges. This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys solving complex technical problems, communicates clearly, and thrives in a remote, asynchronous environment. You're eager to grow into customer-facing technical leadership with strong mentorship and support from a collaborative team.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Provide on-demand technical consultancy and solution guidance through Zoom and written channels, helping customers solve day-to-day issues and design and implement GitLab solutions for their DevSecOps workflows.
* Drive product adoption and measurable customer value across APJ accounts to support renewals and expansion.
* Deliver technical and architectural guidance across source code management, CI/CD, DevSecOps, and Agile planning to unblock implementations and improve adoption.
* Partner with Account Executives and Renewals Managers to align technical recommendations to customer objectives and account plans that support retention and growth.
* Plan and lead customer workshops, demos, and enablement sessions that help teams adopt GitLab confidently and drive measurable adoption and value, supporting renewals and expansion across APJ.
* Maintain and grow your specialty competency in GitLab capabilities and relevant DevSecOps tooling, staying current on new product features and patterns.
* Contribute to scalable enablement by improving documentation, sharing knowledge through internal and external channels (for example, tutorials or technical content), and mentoring team members and customers to build technical competency and adoption.
* Manage multiple customer engagements in parallel, prioritizing effectively and communicating status, risks, and next steps to keep implementations on track.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Experience providing technical consultancy and solution guidance through video calls and written channels, helping users or customers adopt technical solutions successfully.
* Familiarity with DevSecOps workflows and related practices across areas such as source code management, CI/CD, security, and Agile planning, with the ability to grow breadth over time.
* Hands-on technical background in software development, systems engineering, or similar technical environments, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to explain complex technical topics clearly and work effectively with customers, account teams, and cross-functional partners.
* Ability to lead or support workshops, demos, and enablement sessions that build confidence and drive adoption.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a remote, asynchronous environment while communicating status, risks, and next steps clearly.
* Interest in supporting customers across APJ and adapting to different cultures, working styles, and technical maturity levels.
* Must be based in India, with full working rights in India

**About The Team**
In this role, you'll support our customers across APJ, delivering workshops, demos, and best-practice guidance while contributing back to our shared documentation and enablement resources. For more on how we work, see Customer Success Engineering team handbook page.
  
  
**How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees**

* Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Team Member Resource Groups
* Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Growth and Development Fund
* Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.
  
  
**Country Hiring Guidelines:**
GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.
  
  
**Privacy Policy:**
Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.
  
  
GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. title: QA Engineer
description:
**About Ginesys**
Ginesys is India's leading retail technology platform, powering 1,200+ customers and 50,000+ users through the unified GinesysOne suite — ERP, Cloud POS (Zwing), Order Management (Browntape), GST Compliance (EaseMyGST), and BI (InsightX). We are evolving from a System of Records to a System of Intelligence through Ginesys.AI.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a QA Engineer (Automation) to join our Product Engineering team and help drive the modernization of our Retail ERP platform. You will build automated tests that prove new services behave exactly like the existing system, down to financial, stock, and tax totals.
  
  
This role requires strong API test automation and SQL skills, and comfort comparing large datasets. You will work inside development teams with Technical Leads, Architects, and DevOps.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and build automated API, integration, and contract tests for new ERP services.
* Compare outputs of the existing and new systems on large datasets and report differences precisely.
* Write SQL reconciliation checks for financial, stock, and tax data.
* Automate checks for release and data migration steps (before/after counts, totals, timings).
* Integrate tests into CI/CD pipelines and keep them fast and reliable.
* Use AI tools to generate and extend test cases, and review what they produce.
* Log defects with clear data and steps to reproduce; verify fixes.
* Participate in sprint planning, estimation, and release readiness reviews.

**Required Technical Skills**
**Test Automation**

* 3+ years of hands-on test automation experience, mainly API testing.
* Automation in C#, Java, Python, or JavaScript using tools such as RestSharp, Postman/Newman, Playwright, or pytest.

**Database**

* Strong SQL skills; comfortable comparing and reconciling large datasets.
* Experience with PostgreSQL or SQL Server.

**CI/CD**

* Experience running automated tests in CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps).

**AI-assisted Testing**

* Comfortable using AI tools in daily testing work.

**Version Control**

* Experience with Git.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

**Team Responsibilities**

* Work as part of the development team, not after it.
* Push for testability in design and code reviews.
* Share test standards and reusable test utilities with the team.

**Preferred Skills**

* Contract testing (e.g. Pact) or OpenAPI-based testing.
* Data migration or reconciliation testing.
* Performance testing tools (JMeter, k6).
* Domain knowledge of retail, ERP, accounting, inventory, or POS systems is highly desirable.

**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.

**What You'll Work On**

* Enterprise Retail ERP Platform
* API-first Integrations
* Data Migration and Reconciliation
* High-volume Transaction Processing
* Release and Deployment Quality
* Cloud-native Modernization Initiatives

**What We Look For**

* Strong attention to detail.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Comfort with data and numbers.
* Ownership mindset with a focus on quality.
* Good communication with development teams.

**Why Join Us**

* Opportunity to modernize a large-scale enterprise Retail ERP platform.
* Work on cloud-native, event-driven, and distributed systems.
* Solve challenging scalability and performance problems.
* Collaborate with experienced architects and product engineering teams.
* Play a key role in shaping the technical direction of a mission-critical product.

**Benefits**
We like to think that talent grows at Ginesys and stays at Ginesys. To ensure this, we provide our employees with the best working environment, the latest technology and continuous support. We go out of our way to retain the small business feeling with which we started and stimulate innovation and collaboration through teamwork and our non-hierarchical approach. We offer competitive salary, and other fantastic perks and benefits, such as:
  
  
Ginesys Academy for holistic training and development Comprehensive health insurance coverage Excellent rewards and recognition policy
  
  
Transparent compensation policy with no unnecessary deduction in CTC Annual company off-site and a variety of events, celebrations throughout the year
  
  
Travelling opportunities between our offices across the country. Annual Ginesys walkathon & related sporting events. Quarterly Coffee with the CEO and more!
  
  
**Here’s our story; now tell us yours**
Ginesys is India’s best omni retail suite backed by Ginesys, the first integrated Retail specific ERP software for online retail, offline retail and distribution. It is the largest Indian company in the retail tech industry catering to both online and offline needs. 1200 + brands including (Manyavar, V-Mart, Skechers) are accelerating their businesses with Ginesys. With a team of 400+ employees, Ginesys One plans to revolutionize retail by being a single-stop cloud-based retail suite. We have a pan India presence with offices in major cities including Gurgaon, Kolkata, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Coimbatore & Goa and are expanding rapidly. We love the challenges of retail and are busy solving them to create a great retail tech suite. Ginesys core mission is to continue to build world-class internal service capabilities, in a bid to deliver outstanding external service value to customers. We are an ISO-certified and SOC compliant company having won myriad awards for our innovation and support. For further information, please visit our website http://ginesys.in

title: Senior Quality Assurance Analyst
description:
**About Tide**
At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.
  
  
Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.
  
  
Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.
  
  
**Tide Facts**

* Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs
* Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
* Over $300 million raised in funding
* 3,000 Tideans globally
* We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

**About The Team**
As a Senior Quality Assurance (QA) Analyst at Tide, you will play an important role in our first line of defense team ensuring both compliance and enhancing the sales performance of our products. Your expertise in risk management and compliance will help ensure that controls and policies are in place to mitigate risks, safeguarding our members and Business. A natural investigator, you will dive into cases to uncover root causes of defects, identify trends, and develop data-driven solutions.
  
  
Your focus will be on reviewing and analyzing customer interactions, escalated cases, and operational processes across the UK, India, and Germany. By leveraging root cause and trend analyses, you will deliver actionable insights and recommendations to management and key stakeholders. These insights will aim to enhance customer outcomes, reduce risks, and ensure adherence to regulatory standards.
  
  
**About The Role**
**Consumer Duty & Compliance:**

* Understand Consumer Duty initiatives by ensuring QA activities promote fairness, transparency, and positive customer outcomes.
* Review and test policies and procedures to confirm their effectiveness in ensuring consistent and fair customer interactions.

**Quality Assurance & Monitoring**

* Conduct quality reviews of customer interactions, escalations, trends, and complaints to ensure alignment with company policies, regulatory standards (including Consumer Duty), and customer satisfaction.
* Use data-driven insights to analyze quality metrics and sales performance.
* Monitor agent interactions to identify recurring issues, ensuring compliance with financial regulations and promoting fair treatment.

**Risk Management & Process Improvement**

* Identify potential risks or breaches and provide actionable solutions to mitigate regulatory or reputational issues.
* Perform root cause analysis to address recurring issues and trends in customer interactions, enhancing quality and improving processes.
* Enhance QA scorecards to drive performance improvements and better outcomes.

**Coaching & Feedback**

* Deliver coaching sessions and actionable feedback to improve agent performance.
* Identify learning gaps and process inefficiencies, providing recommendations to address negative trends.

**Reporting & Stakeholder Communication**

* Create and deliver detailed monthly QA reports for senior stakeholders, highlighting team data, insights, risks, and recommendations for improvements.
* Collaborate with internal teams to implement policy and process changes based on QA evaluations.

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Facilitate new joiner onboarding and oversee QA evaluations during new team members' probation periods.
* Lead calibration sessions and participate in QA meetings with second-line teams to implement actions that mitigate risk.
* Strong communication and writing skills are essential for presenting findings, preparing reports, and creating training materials and sales scripts.

**What We Are Looking For**
**Experience & Knowledge:**

* A minimum of 2+ years of experience in Quality Assurance (QA) or a related role.
* Expertise in QA responsibilities, with a solid understanding of risk, compliance, and sales within financial services.
* Knowledge of Consumer Duty and FCA regulatory frameworks in the UK.
* Familiarity with QA testing tools and methodologies.
* Comprehensive knowledge of financial services sales processes.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong communication skills, with the ability to present insights and recommendations to stakeholders at all levels.
* Exceptional problem-solving and decision-making abilities, with a proactive and detail-oriented mindset.
* Expertise in enhancing QA scorecards to improve overall performance.
* Ability to analyze data and generate insights that drive continuous improvement.
* Excellent presentation skills to clearly communicate findings and recommendations.
* Skilled in providing coaching and feedback to support a high-performing sales team.

**Technical Proficiency**

* Proficiency in Google Sheets, Microsoft Office, and Jira.
* Familiarity with Looker is a plus (but not essential).

**Cultural & Collaborative Fit**

* Strong understanding of risks associated with sales in regulated industries in the UK.
* Ability to evaluate and refine processes for compliance and operational efficiency.
* Experience collaborating with internal teams to implement automation and improve performance.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
* Ability to work across different teams, including Risk and Compliance, ensuring alignment with policies and regulations.

**Additional Attributes**

* Self-motivated, proactive, and a strong analytical thinker.
* Strong time management skills and multitasking abilities.
* Able to understand local regulatory standards and cultural nuances.

**What You’ll Get In Return**

* Competitive salary
* Self & Family Health Insurance
* Term & Life Insurance
* OPD Benefits
* Mental wellbeing through Plumm
* Learning & Development Budget
* WFH Setup allowance
* 24 days Annual leaves
* Family & Friendly Leaves
* WOO policy allows remote work for up to 90 days a year

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING
  
  
At Tide, we champion a
**flexible workplace**
model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.
  
  
While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.
  
  
TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE
  
  
At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.
  
  
We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.
  
  
*At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.*
**Disclaimer**

Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.*

Job description (paste into LinkedIn)

About us

Source of Life Technologies is a US-headquartered healthcare technology company with an engineering and product centre in Gurugram. We build connected hardware and digital care platforms that bring patients, caregivers and clinicians closer together. Our products include PaSeva (home healthcare operations and care coordination), Mat of Life (a smart, camera-free fall-prevention ecosystem) and Mannkaa (a mental health and cognitive wellness app).

The role

We are hiring a hands-on Embedded Systems Engineer to own firmware, sensor integration and hardware prototyping for Mat of Life and our upcoming healthcare devices. You will work directly with product leadership and our software teams to take new hardware ideas from breadboard to reliable, production-ready connected devices.

Job details

• Location: Gurugram, Haryana – MG Road (Vipul Agora, near Sahara Mall)

• Work mode: On-site, work from office

• Employment type: Full-time

• Experience: 4-5 years

• Notice period: Immediate joiners preferred; maximum 30 days

• CTC: competitive, based on experience

What you will do

• Firmware: Design, write and optimise embedded C/C++ firmware on ESP32 for low-power, real-time healthcare IoT devices.

• Sensors: Interface and calibrate sensor arrays – FSR/pressure matrices, IR, PIR, LDR and acoustic sensors – to detect movement, bed-exit events and behaviour patterns.

• Connectivity: Build reliable BLE, Wi-Fi and MQTT/HTTPS communication to send real-time alerts and long-term activity data to our cloud and mobile apps.

• R&D and prototyping: Lead rapid prototyping, hardware simplification and PCB/schematic reviews for new products in our pipeline.

• Testing and reliability: Run hardware-in-the-loop debugging, power optimisation and field testing so devices perform reliably in senior-care settings.

What we are looking for

• B.Tech/B.E. or M.Tech/M.E. in Electronics & Communication, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or a related field.

• 2–5 years of hands-on embedded systems and firmware experience in C/C++ (ESP-IDF / FreeRTOS preferred).

• Must have: ESP32 experience in production or advanced prototypes.

• Good working knowledge of I2C, SPI, UART and ADC/DMA, and of interfacing pressure/FSR, IR, PIR, LDR and sound sensors.

• Comfortable reading PCB schematics and using oscilloscopes, logic analysers and multimeters; understanding of low-power wireless design.

• Strong problem-solver with clear communication, able to work with our US product team and the Gurugram engineering team.

• Good to have: exposure to medical device standards (e.g. IEC 60601, ISO 13485) or products built for regulated environments.

Why join us

• Build what's next: Shape the hardware roadmap of Mat of Life and brand-new healthcare devices from the ground up.

• Real impact: Build technology that keeps seniors safe and gives families peace of mind – without cameras.

• High ownership: Work closely with the leadership team in a fast-moving R&D environment, with competitive pay and room to grow.

How to apply

Apply through LinkedIn with your updated CV. Please mention your current CTC, expected CTC and notice period in your application.

Source of Life Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds.

Available documents such as UOS&Ds, Field Change Notices, back charge notices, NCR & Deviation Report registers, etc. should be utilized during the investigation process

title: Integration Architect - FHIR
description:
**Job Title:**
FHIR Integration Architect

**Job Type:**
Contractor

**Location:**
Remote

**About the Role**

We're building an independent FHIR R4 interoperability layer that lets our CRM's clinical workflows starting with provider launch directly from inside the EHR, beginning with Oracle Health (Cerner) PowerChart. We need someone who can do both halves of this job well: design and personally validate the technical architecture, and lead the engineers full-stack, AI, and QA who build it. This is not a design-and-handoff role. You'll be in the SMART on FHIR launch flow when it breaks, in the code review when a mapping rule is wrong, and in the room when the team needs a call made.

**What You'll Own**

**Architecture & Solution Design**

•    
**Own**
the end-to-end architecture of the FHIR layer — SMART on FHIR launch and OAuth2, the canonical data model, the EMR adapter framework, tenant isolation, and event-driven orchestration — and keep it extensible to future EMRs (Epic, athenahealth) and formats (HL7v2, X12) beyond the Cerner pilot.

•    
**Make**
build-vs-buy and vendor decisions (self-hosted HAPI FHIR vs. a managed FHIR store; Keycloak vs. a commercial identity provider; build vs. adopt an interface engine) and can defend the reasoning to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.

•    
**Design**
the architecture against HIPAA-grade security and auditability requirements from day one — encryption, least-privilege access, audit trails — not as a pre-launch retrofit.

•    
**Validate**
the architecture against real constraints: Oracle Health/Cerner's actual FHIR R4 conformance, US Core and Da Vinci PAS implementation guides, and the operational realities of a live, EHR-embedded launch — not just a reference diagram.

**Technical Leadership & Delivery**

•    
**Lead**
a cross-functional engineering pod — full-stack engineers, AI/ML engineers, and QA engineers — setting technical direction, running code and design reviews, and removing blockers day to day.

•    
**Translate**
the solution architecture into a sequenced, phased delivery plan (proof of concept → pilot → multi-client scale) and hold the team accountable to it.

•    
**Own**
technical risk — surfacing integration blockers, vendor API gaps, and compliance findings early, and driving them to resolution rather than escalating and waiting.

**Integration, Standards & Compliance**

•    
**Lead**
the Cerner/Oracle Health integration end to end: SMART App Launch (EHR launch, OAuth2/OIDC, fhirUser claims), Ignite APIs registration, and coordination with the client health system's Cerner administrators.

•    
**Define and enforce**
conformance testing (ONC Inferno, US Core / Da Vinci PAS validation) before any integration is called production-ready.

•    
**Partner with**
compliance and security stakeholders on HIPAA Security Risk Assessments, BAAs, and audit-trail requirements.

**Required Qualifications**

•    8+ years in healthcare interoperability or integration engineering, including 3+ years in an architect or technical lead capacity.

•    Deep, hands-on FHIR R4 experience — resource modeling, RESTful FHIR APIs, and at least one implementation guide (US Core at minimum).

•    Direct experience implementing SMART App Launch (EHR and/or standalone launch), OAuth2/OIDC, and at least one major EHR's FHIR API — Cerner/Oracle Health experience specifically preferred given Phase 1 scope.

•    Hands-on experience with HAPI FHIR or an equivalent FHIR server — server customization and multi-tenant partitioning are a strong plus.

•    Cloud architecture experience on AWS or equivalent: containers, managed relational databases, event-driven services (queues/event buses), and core identity/security services.

•    Proven experience leading or managing engineers — running reviews, setting direction, and being accountable for a team's delivery, not only your own.

•    Working knowledge of healthcare data exchange beyond FHIR — HL7v2, X12, CDA — sufficient to plan for future extensibility.

•    Solid understanding of HIPAA technical safeguards and healthcare data compliance requirements.

**Strongly Preferred**

•    Direct, hands-on experience with Oracle Health (Cerner) Millennium / Ignite APIs and PowerChart SMART app registration — or the Epic App Orchard equivalent.

•    Experience with Keycloak or another open-source identity provider, including custom extension/SPI development.

•    Familiarity with Da Vinci implementation guides (PAS, CRD, DTR) and FHIR-based prior authorization workflows.

•    Experience in patient support programs, prior authorization, or healthcare CRM domains.

•    Experience standing up a healthcare integration function from near-zero on a small team, not only operating within an already-mature enterprise integration group.

•    Familiarity with applying AI/ML to healthcare data mapping, document generation, or clinical NLP — relevant given the AI engineers on this team.

**Tech Stack You'll Work With**

**FHIR & integration standards -**
FHIR R4, SMART App Launch v2, US Core, Da Vinci PAS, OAuth2 / OIDC, HL7v2 (future-facing)

**FHIR server -**
HAPI FHIR (JPA server), multi-tenant partitioning

**Identity -**
Keycloak, custom SMART-launch extension (SPI)

**Cloud / infra -**
AWS — Fargate/ECS, Aurora PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, API Gateway, WAF, EventBridge/SQS, Secrets Manager, KMS, CloudWatch/OpenSearch

**IaC / delivery -**
Terraform or AWS CDK, CI/CD (GitHub Actions or CodePipeline), Docker

**Target EHR (Phase 1) -**
Oracle Health / Cerner Millennium (Ignite APIs, PowerChart chart-toolbar launch)

**Conformance testing -**
ONC Inferno test kit (incl. Da Vinci PAS), Synthea synthetic data

Position Title: M365 SME

Corporate Title: Assistant Vice President

Reporting to: Vice President

Location: Bengaluru

**Position Details:**

**Role and Responsibilities**
=============================

* **M365 enterprise architecture:** Act as an M365 architect for Microsoft 365 services, including Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, Copilot Studio, Teams, SharePoint Online, Exchange Online, OneDrive, Viva, Loop, Microsoft Graph, Entra ID integrations, Purview, Defender, Intune and enterprise information protection capabilities. The role includes coverage of Power Platform including PowerBI/Fabric

* **Target-state design and standards:** Define and maintain the target architecture, roadmap, reference architectures, reusable design patterns, technology standards, implementation guardrails and architecture decision records for collaboration, productivity, automation, knowledge management and AI-assisted work.

* **Assessment and recommendation:** Lead architecture assessment of current and target states, identify capability gaps, evaluate solution options and provide pragmatic recommendations aligned to enterprise architecture principles, technology risk requirements, business priorities and regulatory expectations.

* **Copilot and agent solution architecture:** Architect Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Studio agent solutions, including declarative versus custom-engine approaches, orchestration, knowledge-source design, Microsoft Graph grounding, SharePoint and Dataverse knowledge sources, Work IQ/Microsoft IQ alignment, connectors, actions, tools, MCP/API integration, prompt and instruction design, access control, observability, evaluation and lifecycle management.

* **Agentic AI adoption patterns:** Establish enterprise patterns for agentic AI adoption, including autonomous and semi-autonomous workflows, human-in-the-loop approvals, tool/action permissions, fallback handling, auditability, exception handling, risk classification and production support models.

* **Service Owner enablement:** Partner with business units, Service Owners and delivery teams to shape use cases, translate business outcomes into technical requirements, assess feasibility and guide implementation teams from ideation and pilot through controlled production rollout and measurable adoption.

* **Production readiness and control assurance:** Provide architecture oversight for AI-enabled M365 solutions to ensure security, privacy, regulatory, cross-border data, data residency, identity, entitlement, retention, audit, eDiscovery and operational resilience considerations are addressed before production use.

* **Responsible AI and Copilot governance:** Define and operationalize responsible AI and Copilot governance standards using Microsoft Copilot Control System concepts, including security and governance, management controls, measurement and reporting, readiness, adoption, productivity impact and business-value tracking.

* **Agent lifecycle governance:** Govern the end-to-end agent lifecycle: intake, ownership, risk tiering, knowledge-source approval, connector approval, prompt/instruction change control, testing, release management, monitoring, periodic recertification, retirement and exception management.

* **Security and information protection design:** Design and review security controls for Copilot, agents and Power Platform solutions, including least privilege, conditional access, privileged access management, sensitivity labels, DLP, connector policies, SharePoint oversharing remediation, restricted access/content discovery, threat protection and audit logging.

* **AI testing and evaluation:** Define practical evaluation approaches for Copilot and agent solutions, including test question sets, expected-answer validation, groundedness checks, access-control testing, regression testing, prompt-injection testing, consistency checks, citation-quality review, hallucination management and ongoing production monitoring.

* **Reusable assets and guidance:** Create solution blueprints, control checklists, design review packs, executive recommendations, adoption playbooks and engineering guidance for M365, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Microsoft 365 agent governance, knowledge management and productivity transformation initiatives.

* **Architecture governance forums:** Manage and contribute to architecture governance forums by preparing review materials, documenting decisions, tracking risks/actions and guiding projects through EA review, security review, risk acceptance and approval processes.

* **Technology roadmap vigilance:** Evaluate Microsoft roadmap updates and official announcements covering Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365 agents, Microsoft Graph, SharePoint, Purview, Defender, Power Platform, Teams and agent ecosystem capabilities; translate relevant changes into enterprise adoption recommendations.

* **Capability uplift:** Drive capability uplift through architecture clinics, knowledge-sharing sessions, reusable templates, practical training, coaching of platform/application teams and guidance for business users, Service Owners and citizen developers.

* **Vendor and product evaluation:** Support vendor and product evaluations related to M365, Copilot Studio, AI agents, automation, content management, semantic/knowledge layers, connectors, security, monitoring, evaluation, governance tooling and managed services.

* **Trusted advisory:** Be a trusted adviser to senior management and stakeholders by communicating complex technical, governance and AI risk topics clearly, concisely and in a business-outcome-oriented manner.

**Qualifications and Experience**
=================================

**Must-have**
-------------

* Minimum of 8 years of relevant experience in IT, digital workplace, collaboration platforms, enterprise architecture, cloud architecture, Microsoft 365 engineering/architecture Power Platform, Power BI/Fabric, AI solution architecture or platform governance roles.

* Strong hands-on experience with Power Platform and Power BI/Fbric, architecture experience with Microsoft 365 enterprise services and modern workplace platforms, including the ability to define target-state architecture, integration patterns, governance controls and implementation guardrails.

* Practical experience with enterprise architecture governance, technology standards, solution review, risk/control alignment and stakeholder advisory in a medium-to-large enterprise environment.

* Strong understanding of identity, access management, information protection, data governance, compliance, auditability and operational resilience requirements for SaaS and cloud platforms.

* Ability to advise Service Owners and senior stakeholders by translating business outcomes into feasible, controlled and measurable technology options.

* Excellent written, verbal, facilitation and presentation skills; able to explain complex architecture, AI, governance and risk topics clearly to both technical and executive audiences.

**Strongly preferred**
----------------------

* Practical architecture and delivery experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Copilot Chat, Power Platform, connectors, knowledge grounding, workflow automation and AI-enabled business solution delivery.

* Experience in agentic AI solution design, including agent architecture, orchestration, tool/action integration, prompt/instruction management, testing, evaluation, observability, monitoring and operational controls.

* Experience designing secure and governed Microsoft 365 environments covering Entra ID, Purview, Defender, Intune, SharePoint Online, Teams, Exchange Online, OneDrive, Microsoft Graph, Power Platform and service management integrations.

* Experience in banking, financial services or another highly regulated industry.

* TOGAF, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Security, Power Platform, Power BI/Fabric, Azure, cloud architecture, AI governance or equivalent architecture/governance certification.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with DevOps, Agile delivery, CI/CD, solution lifecycle management, infrastructure/configuration as code, environment promotion, automated testing and controlled release practices.

* Advanced experience with AI evaluation, adversarial testing, prompt-injection resilience, telemetry, measurement and production monitoring of AI-enabled applications.

title: Mechanical Engineering V
description:
**Company Description**

**Work with Us. Change the World.**

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description**

We are seeking a highly skilled Mechanical Engineer to handle Cleanroom **HVAC and Process Mechanical packages** for **Semiconductor facilities**. The ideal candidate will have design, engineering and qualification experience for semiconductor projects. This role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams, ensuring compliance with industry standards, and driving innovative solutions for process efficiency and cost optimization.

**Responsibilities:**

**Process Design & Optimization:**

**Cleanroom HVAC Package: Lead the team to perform the activities below:**

* Perform Design and selection of HVAC system for Cleanroom, production areas, semiconductor FAB areas and dry rooms.
* Make up air unit selections using Cooling/Heating/Humidification & De-humidification load calculations, Cleanroom sensible cooling with Dry cooling coils, LT/MT Chiller selections, Hot water requirement, Humidifier selections, humidity/ Dew Point control philosophies and control system design with all equipment and systems
* Plan and support other teams in Chilled water generation Plant Design and selection of cooling tower, Pumps, Primary/secondary circuits etc.
* CFD analysis review and optimization to achieve uniform cleanroom conditions.
* Energy saving options selection to optimize the running cost.
* Conceptual design, planning and project engineering of cleanrooms and dry rooms.
* Prepare designs, coordination, planning and execution of engineering projects.
* Preparation of Technical Proposals and Engineering reports.
* Support development of overall facility design, interior layouts and master planning to address
  + Cleanroom Classification/zoning
  + Cleanroom Pressure Zones
  + Temperature & Relative Humidity Zones
  + Classified Equipment Layout
* Preparation of Tender drawings and functional specifications.
* Review and approve contractor Submittals.
* Review of Process package for completeness of process related data.
* Preparation of PFDs, P&IDs for Process Cooling Water systems (PCW) and development of specifications and layouts for Semiconductor facilities with integration of Tools Layout.

**Process Mechanical packages:Lead the team to perform below activities:**

* Understanding the utility requirements for Process Mechanical Packages from TUM.
* Develop the Equipment layout for Process Exhaust, Process Vacuum, Compressor & PCW system.
* Calculate system flow, pressure requirement.
* Develop the piping layout, Ducting layout.
* Prepare and review PFDs (Process Flow Diagrams), P&IDs, system schematics, equipment layouts, and mechanical specifications.
* Perform equipment sizing and selection for pumps, ID FANS, scrubbers, compressors, heat exchangers, pressure vessels, tanks, and piping & Ducting system.
* Conduct the Hydraulic calculation for the different streams.

Coordinate multidisciplinary engineering teams (process, mechanical, electrical, CSA, automation) to ensure alignment across design deliverables

**Equipment & Technology Integration:**

* Knowledge of functions and dimensions of various semiconductor process equipment used in facilities.
* Collaborate with vendors for equipment selection during design phases, gather installation needs, and validation.

**Compliance & Standards:**

* Ensure adherence to industry regulations SEMI, ISO, ASHRAE, ASME, SMACNA, NBC, NFPA etc.
* Ensure adherence to ASME/API/SEMI/CPCB/Other regulatory standards.
* Knowledge of applicable international standards and local country standards.
* Work with regulatory bodies and internal teams to meet safety and environmental requirements.
* Ensure compliance with industry standards, safety regulations, and company procedures.

**Collaboration & Coordination:**

* Coordinate with disciplines to ensure clash free and code compliant designs.
* Coordination with process utilities, base-build utilities, architecture and structural design and participating in IDC process
* Support during Construction for cleanroom protocol, Installation and certification
* Support process/ utilities/ construction interfaces
* Work closely with architects, MEP engineers, and facility planners for efficient utility layout designs.
* Review vendor drawings, datasheets, and technical documents
* Coordinate with clients and stakeholders to align process requirements with project goals.
* Support Business Development and proposal activities
* Hire the team and train as per the need of the business plan

**Project Documentation:**

* Preparing presentation material that helps stake holders in strategic decision making and subsequently engineering concepts
* Prepare and update: Design Basis Report for Classified HVAC systems, process mechanical systems and Coordinate Design & Engineering deliverables as per project engineering deliverables schedule
* Monitor work progress and ensure compliance with the project quality requirements and schedule

**Experience & Qualification:**

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in mechanical engineering.

**Experience:**

* **20+ years** of experience in Cleanroom, HVAC Design and process mechanical systems engineering.
* Semiconductor fab project experience is must.

**Technical Skills:**

* Strong knowledge of utility design for semiconductor OSAT facilities and FABs.
* Experience with CFD, Energy modeling and simulation tools.
* Proficiency in software tools like AutoCAD, Revit, Navisworks BIM and IES-VE.
* Experience with engineering software such as Pipe flow, Pipenet similar tools
* Knowledge of ACC -Audo desk Cloud portal.

**Soft Skills:**

* Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making abilities.
* Strong communication skills for cross-functional teamwork and client interactions.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and work in a fast-paced environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in **greenfield and brownfield Advanced Manufacturing cleanroom facilities, Semiconductor front end and back end FAB**.
* Familiarity with **sustainability practices** in semiconductor manufacturing.

**Why Join AECOM:**

AECOM is a global leader in engineering, design, and construction services, offering exciting career opportunities and a collaborative work environment.

We are committed to fostering the professional growth and development of our employees, providing access to training, mentorship programs, and challenging projects.

At AECOM, you will have the opportunity to work on iconic projects across diverse sectors, including data center, commercial, airport, and industrial, making a positive impact on communities around the world and shaping a sustainable future for generations to come.

If you are passionate about MEP engineering and have extensive experience in leading projects across data center, commercial, airport, and industrial sectors, we encourage you to apply and become part of the AECOM team.

 **Additional Information**

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***

**About AECOM**

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

**What makes AECOM a great place to work**

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community - where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: IT Head
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a seasoned, strategic **Head of IT** to lead the technology architecture, digital transformation, and operational resilience across our diverse business verticals: **Media Production Studios, Commercial Malls, and Multiplex/Theater Operations**.

The ideal candidate possesses a unique blend of enterprise IT infrastructure management, high-performance media/post-production workflow expertise, and smart-building/retail IT operations (POS, building management integration, high-density public Wi-Fi, and digital cinema/exhibition technologies). You will drive operational excellence, enforce robust cybersecurity frameworks, and align technology investments with organizational growth.

Key Responsibilities**1. Enterprise & Smart Infrastructure Management (Malls & Corporate)**

· Oversee the end-to-end enterprise IT infrastructure, including data centers, server farms, enterprise storage, virtualization (VMware/Hyper-V), and hybrid cloud environments (AWS/Azure).

· Manage mission-critical IT systems for commercial mall operations, ensuring high availability of Building Management Systems (BMS), Public Address (PA) systems, CCTV/surveillance networks, and automated access controls.

· Architect and maintain high-density public Wi-Fi networks, structured cabling, and robust switching/routing backbones (L2/L3) across retail and office spaces.

· Oversee disaster recovery (DR) planning, business continuity drills, and power redundancy systems (UPS/Generators) for 24/7 retail and entertainment environments.

**2. Multiplex, Cinema & Digital Exhibition Technology**

· Oversee IT and networking infrastructure supporting digital cinema projection systems, server ingestion, and Theatre Management Systems (TMS).

· Manage automated scheduling, digital signage, box office ticketing kiosks, and secure content delivery (KDM/DCP management) in coordination with content distributors.

· Ensure ultra-low latency and absolute uptime for live-streaming, event screenings, and concessionaire point-of-sale (POS) networks.

**3. Post-Production & Media Studio Technology**

· Support high-performance media workflows including non-linear editing (Avid, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve), VFX, animation, sound design, and heavy rendering farms.

· Administer high-speed SAN/NAS environments optimized for uncompressed 4K/8K real-time collaboration.

· Manage Media Asset Management (MAM) systems, secure ingest/transcoding pipelines, and long-term digital archiving/retrieval processes.

**4. Retail & Point-of-Sale (POS) Operations**

· Ensure 99.99% uptime for mission-critical retail POS terminals, payment gateway integrations, inventory management databases, and merchant Wi-Fi networks within mall premises.

· Coordinate with tenant IT teams and retail partners to ensure seamless network integration and compliance with centre guidelines.

**5. Cybersecurity, Compliance & Data Privacy**

· Establish enterprise-wide cybersecurity policies, endpoint protection, Next-Gen Firewalls (NGFW), and SIEM tools.

· Protect high-value intellectual property (IP), unreleased media assets, and confidential tenant/customer data in compliance with data privacy regulations (e.g., DPDP Act, PCI-DSS for retail transactions).

· Conduct regular vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, and IT security audits.

**6. Vendor, Project & Budget Management**

· Lead strategic technology implementation projects, digital upgrades, and capital expenditure (CapEx/OpEx) planning.

· Manage relationships with global technology vendors, telecom operators, OEM partners, and service providers.

· Negotiate Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs), software licensing, and hardware procurement to optimize costs without compromising quality.

**7. Leadership & Cross-Functional Team Management**

· Lead, mentor, and upskill a multi-disciplinary team of IT engineers, system administrators, and helpdesk support staff.

· Define and monitor strict Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for incident resolution and system performance.

· Act as a technology advisor to executive leadership, bridging the gap between creative teams, retail management, and technical execution.

**Core Enterprise & Network Infrastructure**

· Advanced administration of Windows Server, Linux, and macOS enterprise environments.

· Enterprise networking: Cisco/Aruba L2/L3 switching, VLAN segmentation, SD-WAN, enterprise firewalls, and QoS configuration.

· Virtualization & Cloud: VMware ESXi, Hyper-V, AWS, Azure, and hybrid cloud integration.

· Active Directory, LDAP, SSO, and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) frameworks.

· Advanced backup frameworks (Veeam, Commvault) and Disaster Recovery architecture.

**Domain-Specific Expertise**

· **Retail & Mall Tech:** POS infrastructure, payment gateway security (PCI-DSS), digital signage networks, and smart building integration (BMS/CCTV).

· **Theater/Exhibition Tech:** Theatre Management Systems (TMS), digital projection networks, and ticketing system integration.

· Media / Post-Production: High-speed SAN/NAS (Avid ISIS/Nexus, Isilon, QNAP), render management (Deadline, OpenCue), and MAM workflows.

**Educational Qualifications & Credentials**

· Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Electronics, or a related technical field. Master’s degree / MBA is a plus.

Pay: ₹2,000,000.00 - ₹25,000,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

description:

Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. Join us as we create something extraordinary together.

JOB DESCRIPTION – MW ENGINEER (TUMBLEWEED)

Designation / Level:5 Professional

ROLE SUMMARY

The Professional Middleware Engineer specializing in Tumbleweed serves as the senior technical authority for enterprise Managed File Transfer (MFT) infrastructure. This role leads platform strategy, drives automation and compliance initiatives, and mentors the MFT engineering team.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

* Architect and govern enterprise MFT strategy using Tumbleweed/Axway and complementary platforms
* Lead complex MFT integration projects including B2B onboarding, protocol migrations, and platform upgrades

* Collaborate with security, compliance, and audit teams to ensure MFT platforms meet regulatory requirements
* Evaluate and recommend new MFT capabilities, toolchain improvements, and vendor roadmap alignment
* Manage critical production incidents and lead post-incident reviews and permanent fixes

* 5-9 years of middleware/file transfer experience with deep expertise in Tumbleweed/Axway platforms
* Expert knowledge of Axway Secure Transport, Gateway, and Tumbleweed MFT administration & Connect Direct
* Advanced understanding of B2B protocols: AS2, SFTP, FTPS, HTTPS, EDI (X12, EDIFACT)
* Strong background in security: PKI, PGP, certificate lifecycle management, and access governance
* Experience leading MFT platform migrations, upgrades, and disaster recovery planning
* Excellent stakeholder management and documentation skills
* Proficiency in scripting and automation (Python, Shell, Ansible)

GOOD TO HAVE

* Experience with cloud MFT solutions and hybrid MFT architectures
* Knowledge of API-based file exchange and modern B2B integration patterns
* Exposure to data governance and sensitive data handling policies

EDUCATION & QUALIFICATIONS

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related field

**Job Title: Senior Consultant** ( PTC Windchill Data Migration Expert )

  
  

**Experience**: 5-8 Years

  
  

**Technology**: PTC Windchill PLM, Data Migration, CAD Integration, SQL, Java

**Deployment Environment**: On-Premises / Microsoft Azure Cloud / AWS

  
  

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced PTC Windchill Migration Expert with 5–8 years of hands-on experience in PLM data migration, Windchill administration, customization and CAD data management. The candidate will be responsible for planning and executing Windchill migration activities, ensuring data integrity, business continuity and successful migration of PLM data across environments and platforms.

  
  

The role involves collaborating with business stakeholders, infrastructure teams and technical teams to deliver migration solutions aligned with business and technical requirements.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

Migration Strategy & Planning: Define migration strategy, scope, approach, timelines and dependencies for Windchill upgrades and PLM platform migrations.

Windchill Data Migration: Execute migration of Parts, Documents, CAD Documents, BOMs, lifecycle states, versions, iterations and change objects.

Source-to-Target Migration: Perform migration from legacy Windchill environments and other PLM platforms such as Siemens Teamcenter or Dassault ENOVIA.

CAD Data Migration: Handle Creo and multi-CAD data, including CAD structures, assemblies, dependencies, associations and representation files.

Migration Tools & Utilities: Develop and execute migration utilities using Windchill APIs, Java, SQL, loaders and supported bulk-loading mechanisms.

Data Mapping & Transformation: Define source-to-target mappings, attribute transformations, numbering rules, classification, lifecycle and organizational mappings.

Data Validation: Perform pre- and post-migration validation, reconciliation, referential integrity checks and completeness verification.

Migration Rehearsals: Execute mock migrations, trial loads, performance testing, error analysis and migration cycle optimization.

Troubleshooting: Resolve migration failures, data inconsistencies, missing references, duplicate objects and CAD association issues.

Documentation & Reporting: Maintain migration plans, mapping documents, reconciliation reports, issue logs and technical documentation.

Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with PLM architects, business users, CAD teams, database administrators and infrastructure teams.

  
  

**Required Technical Skills**

5-8 years of experience in PTC Windchill PLM, with substantial hands-on migration experience.

Strong knowledge of Windchill PDMLink, Part Management, Document Management, CAD Data Management, BOMs and Change Management.

Experience with Windchill version upgrades, environment migrations, or cross-platform PLM migrations.

Hands-on experience with Windchill APIs, Java, SQL, XML and supported bulk-loading or migration utilities.

Knowledge of Windchill object models, versioning, iterations, lifecycle states, workflows and object relationships.

Experience with CAD integrations, particularly Creo; exposure to NX, CATIA, or SolidWorks is an advantage.

Experience with source-to-target data mapping, transformation, reconciliation and migration validation.

Understanding of Windchill database structures, vaults, content storage and migration dependencies.

Familiarity with Linux/Windows environments, application logs and performance troubleshooting.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and documentation skills.

  
  

**Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills**

Experience with Windchill 11, 12, or 13.

Experience with Windchill Bulk Migrator (WBM).

Exposure to AWS, Microsoft Azure infrastructure and cloud-based PLM deployments.

Knowledge of MPMLink, PartsLink, ProjectLink and Supplier Management.

Understanding of migration security, access control, audit history and compliance requirements.

  
  

**Key Deliverables**

Source-system assessment and migration readiness report.

Data migration strategy, scope and execution plan.

Source-to-target mapping and transformation specifications.

Migration utilities, scripts and reusable components.

Trial migration and reconciliation reports.

Data quality and migration issue reports.

  
  

**Education**

Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent relevant experience.

  
  

**Success Criteria**

Accurate and complete migration of in-scope PLM data.

Preservation of CAD structures, BOM relationships, object associations and required metadata.

Successful reconciliation and business validation.

Completion of migration activities within agreed timelines.

We received five awards at the ISG (Information Services Group) Provider Lens Awards 2026 and, for the second year in a row, were awarded the Growth Honor of the Year at the Everest Group Elevate 2026.

  

**About Position:**

  

We are looking for an experienced Snowflake Architect with 10 to 15 years of experience in designing, modernizing, and optimizing enterprise data platforms. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Snowflake architecture, cloud data engineering, multi-tenant platform design, data security, and AWS services. This role will be responsible for defining end-to-end Snowflake-native architecture, ensuring scalability, regulatory compliance, security, and operational excellence while supporting large-scale multi-tenant data platforms.

  

* **Role: Snowflake architect**
* **Location: All Persistent Locations**
* **Experience: 10 to 15 Years**
* **Job Type: Full-Time Employment**
  

**What You'll Do:**

  

* Own the end-to-end Snowflake architecture design for Proof of Concept (POC) and enterprise-scale implementations using a 100% Snowflake-native architecture approach.
* Design and recommend the optimal multi-tenant data isolation strategy, including schema-based isolation and Row-Level Security (RLS) approaches for 30+ tenant environments.
* Architect and implement multiple ingestion patterns, including MySQL CDC using Openflow, REST API integrations using Snowpark, and file ingestion through External Stages.
* Define and implement Dynamic Table refresh strategies, including near real-time refresh patterns and automated scheduling.
* Design point-in-time snapshot architectures supporting operational and regulatory reporting requirements.
* Establish secure credential and API key management utilizing Snowflake Secrets and governance best practices.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements including PIPEDA, OSFI audit standards, and SOC 2 Type II controls.
* Design secure networking architectures utilizing AWS PrivateLink, encryption frameworks, and secure access controls.
* Lead architecture reviews with internal stakeholders, Snowflake platform teams, and external vendors.
* Evaluate technical feasibility, scalability, performance, and cost optimization strategies across the Snowflake ecosystem.
* Define enterprise data governance, security, auditing, and access management standards.
* Develop a scale-out strategy to expand the platform from initial deployment to support 30+ tenant environments.
* Drive architectural decisions, platform standardization, and cloud modernization initiatives.
* Create architecture blueprints, design documentation, operational models, and implementation roadmaps.
  

**Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* 10 to 15 years of experience in Data Architecture, Data Engineering, Cloud Data Platforms, or Enterprise Analytics solutions.
* Deep expertise in Snowflake architecture, including databases, schemas, warehouses, virtual warehouses, and RBAC.
* Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake Dynamic Tables and real-time data processing capabilities.
* Expertise in Snowflake Tasks, CRON scheduling, Streams, and orchestration patterns.
* Experience implementing Snowflake Openflow, CDC frameworks, and modern data ingestion architectures.
* Strong knowledge of multi-tenant architecture patterns, including schema isolation, Row-Level Security (RLS), and tenant governance frameworks.
* Extensive experience with SQL optimization, query tuning, performance engineering, and data modeling.
* Strong experience with AWS services including S3, Aurora MySQL, PrivateLink, IAM, VPC, and cloud security services.
* Experience designing secure enterprise platforms with encryption, auditability, and compliance controls.
* Understanding of data residency requirements and regulatory frameworks such as PIPEDA, OSFI, and SOC 2 Type II.
* Experience with Snowpark and API integration frameworks for modern cloud-native data workloads.
* Expertise in enterprise-scale data platform modernization and cloud migration initiatives.
* Strong understanding of security architecture, access management, and governance best practices.
* Experience working with Agile delivery teams and enterprise stakeholders.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and architecture governance skills.
* Ability to drive technical strategy, mentor engineering teams, and influence enterprise architecture decisions.
  

**Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents
  

**Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment:**

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

  

* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.

title: Integration Architect - FHIR
description:
**Job Title:**
FHIR Integration Architect

**Job Type:**
Contractor

**Location:**
Remote

**About the Role**

We're building an independent FHIR R4 interoperability layer that lets our CRM's clinical workflows starting with provider launch directly from inside the EHR, beginning with Oracle Health (Cerner) PowerChart. We need someone who can do both halves of this job well: design and personally validate the technical architecture, and lead the engineers full-stack, AI, and QA who build it. This is not a design-and-handoff role. You'll be in the SMART on FHIR launch flow when it breaks, in the code review when a mapping rule is wrong, and in the room when the team needs a call made.

**What You'll Own**

**Architecture & Solution Design**

•    
**Own**
the end-to-end architecture of the FHIR layer — SMART on FHIR launch and OAuth2, the canonical data model, the EMR adapter framework, tenant isolation, and event-driven orchestration — and keep it extensible to future EMRs (Epic, athenahealth) and formats (HL7v2, X12) beyond the Cerner pilot.

•    
**Make**
build-vs-buy and vendor decisions (self-hosted HAPI FHIR vs. a managed FHIR store; Keycloak vs. a commercial identity provider; build vs. adopt an interface engine) and can defend the reasoning to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.

•    
**Design**
the architecture against HIPAA-grade security and auditability requirements from day one — encryption, least-privilege access, audit trails — not as a pre-launch retrofit.

•    
**Validate**
the architecture against real constraints: Oracle Health/Cerner's actual FHIR R4 conformance, US Core and Da Vinci PAS implementation guides, and the operational realities of a live, EHR-embedded launch — not just a reference diagram.

**Technical Leadership & Delivery**

•    
**Lead**
a cross-functional engineering pod — full-stack engineers, AI/ML engineers, and QA engineers — setting technical direction, running code and design reviews, and removing blockers day to day.

•    
**Translate**
the solution architecture into a sequenced, phased delivery plan (proof of concept → pilot → multi-client scale) and hold the team accountable to it.

•    
**Own**
technical risk — surfacing integration blockers, vendor API gaps, and compliance findings early, and driving them to resolution rather than escalating and waiting.

**Integration, Standards & Compliance**

•    
**Lead**
the Cerner/Oracle Health integration end to end: SMART App Launch (EHR launch, OAuth2/OIDC, fhirUser claims), Ignite APIs registration, and coordination with the client health system's Cerner administrators.

•    
**Define and enforce**
conformance testing (ONC Inferno, US Core / Da Vinci PAS validation) before any integration is called production-ready.

•    
**Partner with**
compliance and security stakeholders on HIPAA Security Risk Assessments, BAAs, and audit-trail requirements.

**Required Qualifications**

•    8+ years in healthcare interoperability or integration engineering, including 3+ years in an architect or technical lead capacity.

•    Deep, hands-on FHIR R4 experience — resource modeling, RESTful FHIR APIs, and at least one implementation guide (US Core at minimum).

•    Direct experience implementing SMART App Launch (EHR and/or standalone launch), OAuth2/OIDC, and at least one major EHR's FHIR API — Cerner/Oracle Health experience specifically preferred given Phase 1 scope.

•    Hands-on experience with HAPI FHIR or an equivalent FHIR server — server customization and multi-tenant partitioning are a strong plus.

•    Cloud architecture experience on AWS or equivalent: containers, managed relational databases, event-driven services (queues/event buses), and core identity/security services.

•    Proven experience leading or managing engineers — running reviews, setting direction, and being accountable for a team's delivery, not only your own.

•    Working knowledge of healthcare data exchange beyond FHIR — HL7v2, X12, CDA — sufficient to plan for future extensibility.

•    Solid understanding of HIPAA technical safeguards and healthcare data compliance requirements.

**Strongly Preferred**

•    Direct, hands-on experience with Oracle Health (Cerner) Millennium / Ignite APIs and PowerChart SMART app registration — or the Epic App Orchard equivalent.

•    Experience with Keycloak or another open-source identity provider, including custom extension/SPI development.

•    Familiarity with Da Vinci implementation guides (PAS, CRD, DTR) and FHIR-based prior authorization workflows.

•    Experience in patient support programs, prior authorization, or healthcare CRM domains.

•    Experience standing up a healthcare integration function from near-zero on a small team, not only operating within an already-mature enterprise integration group.

•    Familiarity with applying AI/ML to healthcare data mapping, document generation, or clinical NLP — relevant given the AI engineers on this team.

**Tech Stack You'll Work With**

**FHIR & integration standards -**
FHIR R4, SMART App Launch v2, US Core, Da Vinci PAS, OAuth2 / OIDC, HL7v2 (future-facing)

**FHIR server -**
HAPI FHIR (JPA server), multi-tenant partitioning

**Identity -**
Keycloak, custom SMART-launch extension (SPI)

**Cloud / infra -**
AWS — Fargate/ECS, Aurora PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, API Gateway, WAF, EventBridge/SQS, Secrets Manager, KMS, CloudWatch/OpenSearch

**IaC / delivery -**
Terraform or AWS CDK, CI/CD (GitHub Actions or CodePipeline), Docker

**Target EHR (Phase 1) -**
Oracle Health / Cerner Millennium (Ignite APIs, PowerChart chart-toolbar launch)

**Conformance testing -**
ONC Inferno test kit (incl. Da Vinci PAS), Synthea synthetic data

title: SAP Basis Administration
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

A. SAP Basis Administration

• Perform day-to-day SAP Basis administration and system monitoring.

• Manage SAP system health, availability, performance, and troubleshooting.

• Perform SAP client administration, system refreshes, and transport management.

• Monitor background jobs, system logs, dumps, and update failures.

• Manage SAP kernel upgrades, support packages, patches, and system maintenance.

• Coordinate SAP system backups, restoration, and Disaster Recovery activities.

• Manage SAP transport movement across DEV, QAS, and PRD environments.

• Coordinate with SAP infrastructure and hosting teams for system-related issues.

• Support SAP S/4HANA and other integrated SAP applications.

B. SAP Role & Access Management

• Manage SAP user creation, modification, locking, and deletion.

• Design, maintain, and troubleshoot SAP roles and authorization profiles.

• Manage single roles, composite roles, and derived roles.

• Perform role assignment based on approved access requests.

• Ensure access provisioning follows the organization's approval matrix.

• Conduct periodic user access reviews and role validation.

• Identify and mitigate excessive or inappropriate user access.

• Manage privileged access and emergency access (Firefighter ID).

• Review and resolve authorization-related issues using SU53, SUIM, PFCG, and related transactions.

• Ensure appropriate segregation of duties (SoD) across SAP business processes.

• Maintain proper documentation of user access and role changes.

C. SAP Audit & Compliance Management

• Handle SAP-related internal audits, external audits, and statutory audit requirements.

• Coordinate with Internal Audit, Information Security, and external auditors.

• Prepare and provide SAP audit evidence, access reports, and supporting documentation.

• Ensure compliance with IT General Controls (ITGC).

• Manage periodic SAP user access reviews and privileged access reviews.

• Monitor Firefighter ID usage and maintain emergency access logs.

• Ensure audit observations and non-compliances are addressed within agreed timelines.

• Track audit findings, corrective actions, and preventive action plans.

• Ensure adherence to SAP change management and transport management controls.

• Maintain evidence for user provisioning, access modification, access revocation, and approval workflows.

• Support ISO 27001 and other applicable information security compliance requirements.

D. SAP Security & Governance

• Implement SAP security best practices.

• Ensure appropriate authorization controls across SAP environments.

• Review critical SAP transactions and sensitive authorization objects.

• Monitor critical access and privileged activities.

• Ensure appropriate DEV, QAS, and PRD access segregation.

• Support SoD risk identification, analysis, and remediation.

• Maintain SAP security policies, procedures, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

• Drive continuous improvements in SAP security and governance processes.

E. Stakeholder & Vendor Management

• Coordinate with SAP Functional and Technical teams for access and authorization requirements.

• Work with SAP infrastructure partners and managed service providers.

• Manage SAP Basis support tickets and ensure adherence to SLA commitments.

• Provide regular operational and compliance status reports to SAP management.

• Support audit walkthroughs and management reviews.

**Desired Experience**

• 5–10 years of experience in SAP Basis Administration.

• Strong hands-on experience in SAP user and role administration.

• Experience managing SAP access governance and authorization controls.

• Experience handling SAP audit and compliance requirements.

• Exposure to SAP S/4HANA environments.

• Experience in managing Firefighter/Emergency Access.

• Good understanding of SAP change management and transport controls.

• Experience coordinating with auditors, infrastructure teams, and SAP support partners.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

• SAP system availability and stability.

• Timely closure of SAP Basis support tickets within SLA.

• Timely completion of user access provisioning and revocation.

• Periodic user access review completion.

• Zero unauthorized access and reduced SoD violations.

• Timely closure of SAP audit observations.

• Compliance with SAP change and transport management procedures.

• Effective monitoring and governance of Firefighter access.

• Maintenance of updated SAP security and audit documentation.

**Educational Qualifications**

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.

• SAP Basis Administration certification is preferred.

• Relevant SAP Security and Authorization training/certification is an advantage.

**Key Competencies**

• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.

• Good understanding of SAP security and governance.

• Ability to independently handle audit requirements.

• Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills.

• Excellent documentation and communication skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
