title: Data and Digital Lead
description:
Digital Architecture and ABDM Integration

• Act as the district technical counterpart to the HIS and CCC technology partners. Review configuration, workflows, and integrations against the AECC architecture and interoperability standards.

• Track the ABDM readiness of every facility, including Health Facility Registry (HFR) entries, Healthcare Professionals Registry (HPR) IDs, ABHA linking and progress against ABDM milestones (M1 to M3).

• Lead go-live readiness for each phase, from Padampur CHC to district-wide coverage. This covers hardware and connectivity checks, user acceptance testing and sign-off checklists.

• Keep an issue and change log for each system. Monitor partner response against agreed service levels, and escalate unresolved issues through the Project Lead.

• Provide technical review of any digital procurement or initiative in the district, including kiosks and other DMF-funded investments. The aim is to ensure that each one plugs into AECC and does not create a parallel data stack.

• Coordinate with the State ABDM team, the State PMU and the agencies responsible for Government data hosting on integration and hosting matters.

B. ABHA and Citizen Identity Quality

• Monitor ABHA quality, not only coverage. Track Aadhaar-KYC-verified ABHAs, duplicates and active use at the point of care against cumulative issuance.

• Support validation and clean-up exercises, and the linkage of ABHA with the State family registry where approved.

• Work with facility teams and frontline workers to increase ABHA use at registration and in the scan-and-share workflow.

C. Data Quality, Standards and Governance

• Develop and maintain the AECC data dictionary, indicator reference sheets and master data (facilities, providers, services).

• Set up and run routine data quality checks for completeness, timeliness and consistency across the HIS, the CCC and existing Government reporting systems.

• Support the District Administration in drafting and applying a Data Use Policy. This includes role-based access, consent, data sharing protocols and the requirement that data are hosted only on Government-approved infrastructure.

• Ensure that project practice complies with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and the ABDM Health Data Management Policy.

D. RAG Governance Dashboard and PHWS

• Operationalize the RAG Governance Dashboard. This covers indicator definitions, Red-Amber-Green thresholds, data pipelines and review formats, starting with interim paper-based tracking where digital feeds are not yet live.

• Prepare weekly and monthly RAG reports for the District Collector as well as other senior leaders at the district level such CDMO and DPM. Prepare data packs in the standard reporting format for the fortnightly District AECC Steering Committee.

• Support facility teams in root-cause analysis of Red and Amber alerts, and track corrective actions to closure.

• Support the PHWS methodology and its quarterly measurement cycles, including registry-based sampling, computation, validation and publication at Gram Panchayat and ward level.

E. Analytics, Evidence and Learning

• Analyse care-pathway data on referral completion, follow-up adherence, missed appointments, waiting times and continuity of care. Turn the findings into short, decision-ready briefs.

• Establish baselines and track project indicators against the results framework. Support funder reporting.

• Make data and documentation available for the independent evaluation, and contribute evidence to learning reports, case studies and the State replication model.

F. Capacity Building and Transition

• Train and mentor facility staff, data entry personnel and the District Health Society's monitoring and data staff in using the systems, maintaining data quality and reading the dashboard.

• Prepare SOPs, user guides and data quality playbooks for the district repository of AECC materials.

• Prepare and carry out a phased plan to hand over data and digital functions to Government-designated personnel before the project closes.

G. Coordination and Reporting

• Work closely with the Project Lead, the Health Administrator, the CDMO office and facility in-charges in Keonjhar.

• Submit monthly progress reports on digital rollout, data quality and dashboard performance to the Project Director. Contribute to quarterly and annual reports to Swasti and the donor.

4. Qualifications and Experience

Education

• Master’s degree in health informatics, Public Health, Statistics, Data Science, Computer Applications or a related field; or a B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science or Information Technology with substantial public health experience.

• Certification or training in digital health, ABDM or health data standards is desirable.

Experience

• Minimum 6 to 8 years of relevant experience, including at least 4 years in health information systems or health data within government health programmes.

• Hands-on experience of implementing or integrating digital health systems at district or state level, including work with technology vendors.

• Experience with ABDM integration (ABHA, HFR, HPR, Health Information Exchange and Consent Manager) is strongly preferred.

• Experience of building dashboards or performance review systems used by district administrations is preferred.

• Prior work in Odisha, aspirational districts or tribal-majority districts is desirable.

2.3 CENtree (Ontology Management) - Experience with SciBite CENtree ontology platform - Understanding of ontologies, taxonomies, and controlled vocabularies - Semantic data modeling (RDF, OWL, SKOS) - Integrating CENtree with data catalogs via REST APIs - Mapping ontology terms to Collate glossary terms - Knowledge of life sciences / pharma data (if applicable)

2.4 Integration & Programming - Python (for custom connectors, API integrations, automation) - REST APIs – consuming and building - YAML/JSON for ingestion configurations - SQL (advanced) - Custom connector development for CENtree → Collate sync

3. Data Governance Skills - Building business glossaries aligned with ontologies - Data classification (PII, PHI, confidential) - Stewardship workflows and approval processes - Compliance frameworks (GDPR, HIPAA)

4. Soft Skills - Stakeholder management – work with data stewards, scientists, analysts - Documentation – metadata standards, runbooks - Training – enable business users on Collate - Problem-solving – troubleshoot ingestion and lineage issues

5. Key Responsibilities 1. Implement and configure Collate SaaS for the organization 2. Set up and maintain Snowflake metadata ingestion (schema, lineage, usage, profiling) 3. Build integration between CENtree ontologies and Collate glossaries 4. Develop custom connectors / scripts where out-of-the-box options don't exist 5. Define data governance policies, tags, and classifications 6. Onboard data stewards and consumers to the platform 7. Monitor ingestion pipelines and resolve issues 8. Maintain documentation and best practices.

description:

The ideal candidate will possess strong technical expertise in Databricks platform architecture, AWS cloud infrastructure and service enablement, platform engineering, automation, performance optimization, and emerging AI technologies. The role requires practical experience in enabling, integrating, and scaling enterprise platform capabilities rather than focusing primarily on data pipeline development.

title: Lead System Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
**Lead Systems Analyst**
**The Role**
The FFIO Technology team is looking for a highly skilled Systems Analyst to support and enhance strategic Pricing technology platforms and business processes. This role will partner closely with business stakeholders, operations teams, product owners, and engineering teams to define requirements, analyze complex workflows, and deliver scalable technology solutions supporting Pricing, Market Data, Fund Accounting, Investment Operations, Reconciliation, Reporting, and Operational Processing.
  
  
The ideal candidate will bring strong domain expertise in Pricing, Mutual Funds, Capital Markets, Fund Accounting, or Investment Operations, proven systems analysis experience, and the ability to bridge business and technology teams to deliver high-quality solutions. This role requires exceptional analytical thinking, stakeholder management, and the ability to work effectively across business and technology teams.
  
  
**The Purpose of This Role**
As a Systems Analyst, you are required to quickly gain understanding of the FFIO Pricing Strategy, specifically the intersection of Pricing, Reference Data, Accounting, Security Master, Market Data, and Trade Data. As a systems analyst in the team, you will be expected to quickly gain understanding of all the components of our applications and will work with the team to deliver outstanding customer experience solutions.
  
  
The ideal candidate should show ease at making personal connections, be confident in leading and constructively challenging with a dedicated approach to solving problems and overcoming obstacles.
  
  
This role requires knowing the Scrum/Kanban principles and being a strong communicator and influencer. The ideal candidate should step up to be a database developer in lean analysis phases.
  
  
**The Skills That Are Key To This Role**

* Minimum 5 years experience as System Analyst within Financial Services, Mutual Funds, Asset Management, or Capital Markets environments.
* Strong understanding of Pricing Operations, market data management, price sourcing, valuation processes, reconciliations, operational controls, Fund Accounting, and Investment Operations.
* Experience supporting Mutual Funds, Equities, Fixed Income, ETFs, Derivatives, and other investment products.
* Proven ability to gather, analyze, document, and validate business and system requirements for complex enterprise applications.
* Experience creating functional specifications, technical specifications, process flows, use cases, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Strong SQL skills with the ability to perform ad hoc analysis, data validation, reconciliation support, and root cause investigations.
* Strong understanding of relational databases, data models, and data lineage concepts.
* Experience working with Pricing, Accounting, Operational, Reference, and Security Master data across multiple upstream and downstream systems.
* Experience in analyzing and supporting integrations involving APIs, file-based interfaces, and enterprise data platforms.
* Familiarity with cloud-native platforms, AWS, and modern application architectures.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments using Jira, Confluence, and related collaboration tools.
* Knowledge of Pricing platforms, Market Data providers, Fund Accounting, and Investment Operations processes is preferred.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both business and technical stakeholders.
* Strong stakeholder management skills and experience working in globally distributed teams.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced and highly collaborative environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, Accounting, or a related discipline.

**The Value You Deliver**

* Drive process improvements, automation opportunities, and operational efficiencies across Pricing platforms and business processes.
* Act as a subject matter expert for Pricing workflows and related Fund Accounting and Investment Operations processes.
* Partner with business stakeholders and product owners to understand operational challenges and define effective technology solutions.
* Translate business requirements into detailed functional & technical specifications and actionable delivery plans.
* Ensure business requirements are clearly understood and implemented accurately by engineering teams.
* Analyze system behavior, pricing exceptions, data quality issues, and reconciliation breaks to identify root causes and drive resolution.
* Facilitate collaboration across business, operations, vendor, and technology teams.
* Support testing activities including requirement validation, user acceptance testing, and production readiness.
* Reduce delivery risk through thorough analysis, proactive issue identification, and effective stakeholder engagement.
* Help ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with strategic platform objectives.

**How Your Work Impacts The Organization**
Fidelity Fund & Investment Operations (FFIO) provides accounting and investment management support services for Fidelity mutual funds and other retail and institutional investment products. These services include calculating and distributing NAVs, distribution rates and yields for a wide variety of investment products, preparing fund financial statements, dividend estimates and tax returns, monitoring delivery of fund trades to custodian banks, processing corporate actions, collecting securities income on behalf of the funds, reconciling, reporting and moving money in support of fund shareholder transactions, and managing fund liquidity.
  
  
**The Expertise We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science Engineering/ Information Technology, Information Systems.
* 5+ years of Financial IT industry experience.
* Strong team player that thrives in a collaborative environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Quick learner and a great team player.
* Experience supporting Pricing, Mutual Funds, Capital Markets, Fund Accounting, Investment Operations, Security Master, or Investment Management platforms.
* Experience in the financial services industry, preferably in Mutual Funds, Asset Management, Capital Markets, Fund Accounting, Investment Operations, or Pricing environments, is a plus.

**The Team**
Fidelity Fund Investment Operations (FFIO) provides accounting and investment management support services for Fidelity mutual funds and other retail and institutional investment products. These services include calculating and distributing NAVs, holdings, distribution rates and yields for a wide variety of investment products; preparing fund financial statements, dividend estimates and tax returns; monitoring delivery of fund trades to custodian banks; processing corporate actions; collecting securities income on behalf of the funds; reconciling, reporting and moving money in support of fund shareholder transactions; and managing fund liquidity.
  
  
**Company Overview**
At Fidelity, we are passionate about making our financial expertise broadly accessible and effective in helping people live the lives they want! We are a privately held company that places a high degree of value in creating and nurturing a work environment that attracts the best talent and reflects our commitment to our associates. We are proud of our diverse and inclusive workplace where we respect and value our associates for their unique perspectives and experiences. For information about working at Fidelity, visit FidelityCareers.com. Fidelity Investments is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Data Center Network Engineer – Hardware Migration
description:
Experience: 6+ years of relevant network engineering experience preferred

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a Data Center Network Engineer with hands-on experience in Cisco Nexus hardware refresh, device replacement, and production network migrations across Cisco ACI and standalone NX-OS environments.

The role includes migrating connectivity from legacy Nexus 2000/5000 platforms and existing Nexus 9000 devices to approved target platforms. The engineer will own technical preparation, configuration validation, cutover execution, troubleshooting, and post-migration support.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Review source and target device inventories, network diagrams, configurations, connectivity, and application dependencies.
* Assess hardware readiness, including rack space, power, airflow, optics, cable types, port capacity, and software compatibility.
* Prepare detailed port mappings covering source and destination interfaces, VLANs, port channels, uplinks, and connected endpoints.
* Translate and validate configurations for target platforms, identifying unsupported features and required design changes.
* Develop Methods of Procedure (MOPs), migration sequences, pre- and post-checks, rollback plans, and acceptance criteria.
* Coordinate device installation, cabling, labeling, and console access with Data Center operations and remote-hands teams.
* Configure and validate target switches, including management access, routing, switching, redundancy, and monitoring.
* For ACI migrations, support fabric discovery, node registration, interface policies, and access-policy validation according to the approved design.
* Execute phased cable moves and traffic cutovers within approved maintenance windows.
* Validate endpoint connectivity, routing adjacencies, interface health, port-channel operation, and application reachability.
* Troubleshoot migration issues and execute rollback when agreed recovery thresholds are reached.
* Update inventory, topology diagrams, port mappings, implementation evidence, and change records.
* Support legacy-device decommissioning after migration acceptance and required approvals.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Hands-on experience with Cisco Nexus 2000 Fabric Extenders, Nexus 5000, and Nexus 9000 platforms.
* Strong knowledge of NX-OS and Cisco ACI fundamentals, including APIC, fabric nodes, tenants, bridge domains, EPGs, and contracts.
* Experience migrating FEX-connected endpoints and assessing differences between existing and target connectivity designs.
* Strong understanding of VLANs, trunking, STP, LACP, port channels, vPC, VRFs, BGP, and OSPF.
* Experience troubleshooting optics, speed settings, breakout interfaces, MTU, cabling, and interface errors.
* Ability to independently prepare migration plans and lead technical cutover activities.
* Experience working within enterprise change-management and incident-management processes.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* CCNP Data Center or equivalent practical expertise.
* Experience supporting large-scale Data Center hardware refresh programs in banking or similarly controlled environments.
* Familiarity with Ansible or Python for configuration comparison, validation, and evidence collection.

**Who We Are**

**Job Description**
**High Performance Computing, AI and Labs**
is a critical element of HPE. We are focused on delivering innovative solutions that accelerate our customers’ digital transformation, enabling them to tackle their complex, and data-intensive workloads. Combining deep expertise and the development of the world’s most cutting-edge, high-performance supercomputers, is defining the next era of computing delivering valuable insight & innovation. Join us and redefine what’s next for you.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
The Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) HPC Business Unit has an exciting opportunity for an experienced engineer dedicated to providing
**remote systems administration and proactive technical support for High-Performance Computing (HPC) environments**
. These environments involve multiple components such as operating systems (OS), workload managers, high-speed networks, clustered file systems, and HPC cluster managers.
  
  
This role is part of our Global Remote Services (GRS) team and focuses on delivering exceptional service while ensuring the
**availability, reliability, performance, and smooth operation of customers' HPC environments**
.
  
  
As part of this role, you will work within a collaborative team environment where teamwork is essential. Engineers are expected to contribute to the successful operation and support of customer environments. This includes
**performing proactive system health checks, troubleshooting technical issues, planning and coordinating maintenance activities, sharing knowledge, documenting findings, communicating with customers, and working with other HPE technical teams when specialist or onsite intervention is required**
.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
In this role, you will:
  
  

* Provide remote systems administration and proactive technical support for HPC environments, dedicating a significant portion of the role to system health monitoring, technical assessment, troubleshooting, documentation, planning, and customer communication, alongside hands-on remote administration activities.
* Perform detailed technical assessments and regular health checks across HPC environments, including operating systems, workload managers, SlingShot and other high-speed networks, clustered file systems, cluster management components, and related infrastructure.
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical and integration challenges across a mix of HPC technologies, providing effective solutions and recommendations to maintain system availability, stability, and performance while minimizing customer impact.
* Collaborate with global teams, including Level 3 SMEs, engineering teams, support organizations, and onsite engineering personnel, to investigate and resolve complex technical issues and deliver seamless, customer-focused support.
* Prepare and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including system health-check reports, troubleshooting notes, technical procedures, maintenance plans, configuration information, recommendations, and customer-facing reports.
* Provide timely and effective communication with customers, ensuring they have a clear understanding of system health, identified issues, recommended actions, ongoing investigations, maintenance activities, and outcomes.
* Coordinate planned maintenance and technical activities with customers and relevant HPE teams, helping ensure appropriate preparation, technical validation, risk identification, and post-maintenance verification.
* Proactively identify potential risks and technical issues before they result in service impact, working with customers and internal teams to recommend appropriate corrective or preventive actions.
* Support incident investigation and problem resolution, collecting and analyzing relevant system information, logs, alerts, and diagnostic data, and escalating to the appropriate specialist teams when required.
* Be flexible with working hours to support critical customer situations, planned maintenance activities, project milestones, and deadlines, including occasional extended hours and weekend work as needed.
* Act as a technical service advocate for the customer, ensuring that systems administration activities and technical recommendations align with the customer's operational and business requirements.
* Contribute to continuous improvement and knowledge sharing within the Global Remote Services team by documenting solutions, developing reusable procedures, sharing technical knowledge, and helping improve remote support practices.

**What You Need To Bring**
***Education and Experience Required:***

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent.
* 4+ years experience preferred

**Key Qualifications**

* In-depth Linux knowledge, with proficiency in Red Hat, CentOS, or similar Linux distributions.
* Strong scripting experience with Bash and Python, with the ability to develop scripts for system administration, diagnostics, automation, data collection, and repetitive operational tasks.
* Expertise in clustered file systems such as Lustre, CXFS, GPFS, or StorNext.
* Hands-on experience with high-speed networking technologies such as SlingShot, InfiniBand, or Omni-Path.
* Hands-on experience with HPC workload managers such as Slurm or PBS.
* Strong experience administering and troubleshooting HPC systems, including system health monitoring, configuration management, performance investigation, log analysis, maintenance, and incident resolution.
* Experience working with HPC cluster management and monitoring tools and diagnosing issues across multiple components of an HPC environment.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to isolate complex issues across compute, storage, network, workload management, and operating system layers.
* Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple customer environments, technical activities, incidents, and priorities effectively.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills in English, with a strong emphasis on customer-focused communication and the ability to translate complex technical findings into clear actions and recommendations.
* Ability to work effectively in a global and collaborative support environment, coordinating with remote specialists, engineering teams, and onsite personnel when necessary.

HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

title: IVR Engineer
description: POSITION DESCRIPTION:The Genesys Cloud Telecom/IVR Engineer is accountable for day-to-day administration, operational reliability, and hands-on engineering of the Genesys Cloud CX, interactive voice response (IVR), and associated telephony services. The position is structured as approximately 50% platform administration and operational support and 50% engineering, automation, and platform enhancements. The incumbent owns assigned L2 production incidents and service requests, supports L1 escalations, performs L3 troubleshooting within their expertise, and coordinates complex escalations with Genesys, telecom carriers, and MSP partners. Responsibilities include platform configuration, call routing, IVR development, SIP connectivity, integrations, proactive health monitoring, and tested changes. This business-facing role requires direct collaboration with U.S. users and partners, including live Microsoft Teams troubleshooting sessions when needed.ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND TASKS: ADMINISTRATION / PLATFORM OPERATIONS: Own day-to-day administration and operational health of Genesys Cloud CX and associated telecom services. Manage users, roles, permissions, licenses, queues, skills, routing, schedules, phone numbers, and authorized platform configurations. Support SIP connectivity, DID provisioning, carrier coordination, and inbound/outbound call routing. Translate business needs into technical solutions, assess dependencies and impacts, and implement changes using established engineering, security, and change-control standards.ENGINEERING / PLATFORM CHANGES: Develop and maintain supported platform integrations and automation, including Genesys Cloud data actions, APIs, JSON-based payloads, and related configuration where applicable. Investigate root causes, deliver sustainable fixes and enhancements, and coordinate with application, telephony, vendor, and business partners on cross-platform changes. Maintain accurate change records, IVR/routing diagrams, technical documentation, and knowledge articles; participate in design reviews, sprint work, and continuous improvement.EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE• 3–5 years of relevant contact center technology experience, including at least 2 years of hands-on Genesys Cloud CX administration, production support, and/or engineering experience.• Experience owning L2 production incidents, supporting L1 escalations, and performing L3 troubleshooting within expertise in a business-critical contact center environment.• Demonstrated hands-on experience building and troubleshooting production Genesys Cloud Architect IVR flows, ACD routing, queues, skills, schedules, and user access; working knowledge of APIs, data actions, web services, and JSON.• Working knowledge of telecom administration, SIP connectivity, DID provisioning, carrier coordination, call-quality troubleshooting, and inbound/outbound routing; familiarity with outbound campaigns, workforce management, quality management, and omnichannel routing.• Ability to diagnose problems, test changes, document root causes, and manage competing support and engineering priorities.• Demonstrated written and verbal communication skills, including direct user troubleshooting, Teams calls, clear ticket updates, and cross-functional collaboration.QUALIFICATIONS• Willingness and ability to perform both platform administration / production support (50%) and hands-on engineering / platform changes (50%); neither category is optional. title: Network Engineer
description:
Network Engineer

Experience: 2-5 Years

Employment Type: Full-time

Location: Chennai

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced L2 Network Engineer to join our Network Operations team. The role involves handling complex network incidents, advanced troubleshooting, network changes, technical escalations, and infrastructure projects across enterprise customer environments.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in Cisco networking, routing & switching, firewalls, VPN, SD-WAN, wireless, network security and advanced troubleshooting.

Key Responsibilities

· Troubleshoot and resolve complex LAN, WAN, WLAN, VPN and Internet connectivity issues.

· Perform advanced troubleshooting across enterprise network infrastructure.

· Configure, troubleshoot and optimize Cisco routers and switches.

· Troubleshoot routing protocols including BGP, OSPF, EIGRP and static routing.

· Troubleshoot switching technologies including VLANs, trunking, STP/RSTP/MST, EtherChannel and LACP.

· Troubleshoot HSRP, VRRP and network redundancy/high-availability configurations.

· Troubleshoot routing loops, asymmetric routing, packet loss, latency and network instability.

· Analyze network traffic and perform packet-level troubleshooting using Wireshark and packet captures.

· Troubleshoot MPLS, SD-WAN, Internet circuits and WAN connectivity.

· Configure and troubleshoot IPsec, SSL VPN, GRE and site-to-site VPNs.

· Troubleshoot enterprise firewalls including Fortinet, Palo Alto and Cisco ASA/Firepower.

· Troubleshoot firewall policies, NAT, security rules, VPN tunnels and connectivity issues.

· Support enterprise wireless infrastructure including Cisco, Aruba and Meraki environments.

· Troubleshoot wireless authentication, roaming, RF, coverage, performance and connectivity issues.

· Monitor network health and performance using PRTG, SolarWinds or equivalent monitoring platforms.

· Analyze network alerts, logs, SNMP data, syslog and performance metrics to identify root causes.

· Take ownership of Major Incidents and coordinate technical resolution within agreed SLAs.

· Participate in RCA and Problem Management activities for recurring and critical network issues.

· Prepare detailed Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and corrective/preventive action reports.

· Perform network configuration changes, upgrades and maintenance activities following the approved Change Management process.

· Participate in network migrations, infrastructure upgrades and technology refresh projects.

· Review existing network configurations and identify opportunities for performance, availability and security improvements.

· Validate network designs and provide technical recommendations for new implementations.

· Coordinate with ISPs, OEMs, vendors and third-party service providers for complex issue resolution.

· Work closely with internal infrastructure, security, service desk and application teams during troubleshooting.

· Participate in customer technical calls and provide regular updates on critical incidents and planned changes.

· Maintain accurate network diagrams, configuration documents, SOPs, troubleshooting guides and knowledge articles.

· Ensure network documentation and CMDB information are updated following infrastructure changes.

· Perform configuration reviews and identify potential network risks or single points of failure.

· Support network capacity planning and identify bandwidth, performance and infrastructure requirements.

· Participate in network audits, compliance activities and security reviews where required.

· Develop and improve network troubleshooting procedures, SOPs and operational runbooks.

· Conduct knowledge-sharing sessions and technical training for junior engineers.

· Identify recurring incidents and recommend permanent solutions to reduce incident volume.

· Ensure all incidents, changes and problem records are properly documented in the ITSM tool.

· Maintain compliance with SLA, ITIL, security and operational processes.

· Participate in 24×7 on-call / rotational support for critical network incidents.

Required Skills

· 2-5 years of experience in Enterprise Networking / Network Operations.

· Strong hands-on experience with Cisco routers and switches.

· Strong knowledge of BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, VLAN, STP, HSRP/VRRP and TCP/IP.

· Experience with firewalls, VPN and network security.

· Experience with SD-WAN, MPLS and WAN technologies.

· Strong knowledge of enterprise network troubleshooting methodologies.

· Hands-on experience with Wireshark and packet analysis.

· Experience with network monitoring tools such as PRTG, SolarWinds or equivalent.

· Good understanding of ITIL, Incident, Problem and Change Management.

· Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

· Excellent communication and customer-handling skills.

· Ability to work independently and handle critical incidents under pressure.

· Willingness to work in a 24×7 / rotational support environment.

Preferred Certifications

· CCNP Enterprise

· CCNA

· Fortinet / Palo Alto certification

· Aruba / Meraki certification

· ITIL Foundation

### **Virtualization & Cloud Support**

* Hyper-V environments.
* Support virtual machine lifecycle management.
* Work with Azure and AWS cloud-hosted Windows workloads.
* Assist in cloud migration and modernization initiatives.

### **Automation & Scripting**

* Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts for operational automation.
* Automate patch deployment, compliance reporting, server health checks, and administrative tasks.
* Improve operational efficiency through automation initiatives.

### **Backup & Disaster Recovery**

* Support enterprise backup and recovery solutions.
* Perform backup validation and recovery testing.
* Participate in disaster recovery drills and business continuity planning.

### **Documentation & Knowledge Management**

* Maintain operational runbooks, SOPs, and infrastructure documentation.
* Prepare technical reports, compliance reports, and management dashboards.
* Share knowledge and mentor junior team members.

### **Team Collaboration**

* Work closely with local and global stakeholders.
* Participate in 24x7 support and rotational shifts if required.

* B.E. / B.Tech (IT, Computer Science, Electronics)

**Key Responsibilities**

Incident, Problem and Escalation Management • Act as the final escalation point (L3) for complex Linux / UNIX incidents escalated from L1/L2 teams. • Troubleshoot and resolve critical (P1/P2) issues related to OS, kernel, boot, file systems, performance, memory, networking and storage. • Lead root cause analysis (RCA) for major incidents and drive permanent fixes through problem management. • Analyze system logs, core dumps and crash dumps (kdump, sosreport, explorer) to identify underlying issues. • Coordinate with OEM vendors (Red Hat, SUSE, Oracle, IBM, HPE, Dell) for case escalation and resolution. • Participate in on-call rotation and lead bridge calls during major incidents. Server Build, Engineering and Administration • Design, build, configure and decommission physical and virtual Linux (RHEL, CentOS, Rocky, Oracle Linux, SUSE, Ubuntu) and UNIX (Solaris, AIX, HP-UX) servers. • Define and maintain standard OS build templates, golden images and hardening baselines. • Manage storage and file systems including LVM, ext4, XFS, ZFS, NFS, CIFS/Samba, multipathing and SAN/NAS integration. • Configure and support high-availability clusters (Pacemaker/Corosync, Veritas Cluster Server, Red Hat HA, PowerHA/HACMP). • Manage virtualization platforms such as VMware vSphere, KVM, Solaris Zones/LDOMs and IBM LPARs. • Administer core services including DNS, DHCP, NTP/Chrony, SSH, Postfix/Sendmail, Apache/Nginx and cron. • Patching, Upgrades and Lifecycle Management\\r\\n• Plan and execute OS patching, kernel upgrades and major version migrations with minimal downtime. • Manage patch repositories and lifecycle tools such as Red Hat Satellite, SUSE Manager, Spacewalk or IBM NIM. • Track end-of-life (EOL) platforms and drive remediation, refresh and migration plans. • Perform firmware and hardware upgrades in coordination with data center and vendor teams. Security, Compliance and Access Management • Implement and maintain OS hardening in line with CIS benchmarks and organizational security policies. • Remediate vulnerabilities identified through scanning tools (Qualys, Tenable/Nessus, Rapid7) within defined timelines. • Manage user and privileged access, sudo policies, PAM, SELinux/AppArmor, firewalld/iptables and SSH key management. • Integrate Linux / UNIX systems with Active Directory / LDAP using SSSD, Centrify or Winbind. • Support internal and external audits (SOX, ISO 27001, GxP, PCI-DSS) and provide evidence as required. Automation, Monitoring and Performance • Automate routine tasks, builds, patching and compliance checks using Shell, Python, Perl and Ansible. • Develop and maintain configuration management with Ansible, Puppet, Chef or SaltStack. • Configure and tune monitoring and alerting using tools such as Nagios, Zabbix, Prometheus/Grafana, Splunk, Dynatrace or SolarWinds. • Conduct capacity planning and performance tuning for CPU, memory, disk I/O, network and kernel parameters. • Identify repetitive incidents and eliminate them through automation and self-healing solutions. Backup, Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity • Ensure backup and restore processes are configured and tested using tools such as Veritas NetBackup, Commvault, Veeam or IBM Spectrum Protect. • Design, document and execute DR plans and participate in periodic DR drills. • Validate recovery procedures and maintain RTO/RPO compliance for critical systems. Process, Documentation and Leadership • Follow ITIL processes for incident, problem, change and request management using ServiceNow, BMC Remedy or similar ITSM tools. • Prepare and present change requests, implementation plans and rollback plans to the Change Advisory Board (CAB). • Create and maintain SOPs, runbooks, knowledge base articles, architecture diagrams and RCA reports. • Mentor and upskill L1/L2 engineers through knowledge transfer sessions and technical reviews. • Ensure SLA, KPI and operational metrics are met and contribute to continuous service improvement initiatives.

title: SAP Basis Administrator
description:
Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced and versatile SAP BASIS Administrator based in Chennai to oversee the stability, performance, and security of our core SAP landscape. In addition to core BASIS responsibilities, this hybrid role covers baseline infrastructure networking and cybersecurity tasks, allowing a senior professional to manage minor security patches and connectivity oversight without requiring dedicated specialists.

The ideal candidate thrives in a hybrid work environment, brings deep technical expertise in SAP environments, and possesses a foundational understanding of network architecture and security governance.

Key Responsibilities

1. Core SAP BASIS Administration (Primary Focus - ~80%)

* System Lifecycle Management: Lead installations, upgrades, Support Package Stacks (SPS), Enhancement Packages (EHP), and kernel updates across SAP landscapes (e.g., S/4HANA, ECC, BW, Solution Manager).
* Performance & Health Monitoring: Proactively monitor system performance, work processes, lock entries, short dumps, database growth, and background job execution using SAP tools (CCMS, Solution Manager, Focused Run).
* Transport & Landscape Management: Manage the Transport Management System (STMS), handle client copies, system refreshes, and maintain synchronization across Development, Quality Assurance, and Production environments.
* Database Administration: Perform database administration tasks, including backups, restores, tablespace management, and performance tuning for HANA, Oracle, or SQL databases.
* High Availability & Disaster Recovery: Ensure business continuity through robust HA/DR setups, clustering, and routine failover testing.

2. Infrastructure & Networking Oversight (Minimal Focus - ~10%)

* Connectivity Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve basic network-level communication issues affecting SAP (e.g., port availability, RFC connections, Web Dispatcher configurations, firewalls, and routing between application servers and databases).
* OS & Storage Administration: Manage underlying operating system operations (Linux/Windows) and storage mounting/file-system sizing relevant to SAP data directories.
* Vendor Coordination: Act as the technical point of contact for external infrastructure, cloud, or ISP vendors regarding network bandwidth and server health.

3. Cybersecurity & Compliance (Minimal Focus - ~10%)

* Security Patching: Regularly evaluate and apply SAP Security Patch Days and relevant OSS notes to mitigate vulnerabilities.
* User Access & Authorization: Handle complex user administration, role maintenance (PFCG), profiles, and support segregation of duties (SoD) audits.
* Compliance & Auditing: Support internal and external audits (SOX, GDPR, ISO) by generating security logs, access tracking reports, and ensuring system compliance with corporate security frameworks.

Required Qualifications & Technical Skills

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience: 5 to 7 years of dedicated professional experience in SAP BASIS administration.
* Core SAP Skills:
* Expertise in SAP NetWeaver, SAP S/4HANA administration, and SAP HANA Database management.
* Proficiency with SLD configuration, Solution Manager setup, and software provisioning manager (SWPM).
* Hands-on experience with OS/DB migrations and high-availability setups.
* Complementary Networking Skills:
* Working knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, Subnets, VPNs, Load Balancers, and SSL/TLS certificates (secure store/pse management).
* Familiarity with SAP Web Dispatcher and reverse proxy configurations.
* Complementary Cybersecurity Skills:
* Solid understanding of SAP authorization concepts, user lifecycle management, and single sign-on (SSO/SAML).
* Experience implementing SAP Security Notes and vulnerability assessment tools.
* Certifications: SAP Certified Technology Associate (SAP S/4HANA or SAP NetWeaver) is strongly preferred.

Pay: Up to ₹2,000,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

We are seeking an experienced and skilled MongoDB Database Administrator (DBA) with a proven track record in setting up and managing databases for large-scale applications.The successful candidate will work closely with stakeholders to understand their business needs, gather requirements, and facilitate solutions that enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of our operations. As a DBA, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing infrastructure to ensure high availability, scalability, and performance of MongoDB databases. You will play a critical role in maintaining data integrity, implementing backup and recovery strategies, and continuously monitoring and tuning the environment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Job Details:**

● Collaborate with development teams to understand application requirements and provide guidance on data modeling and database design.

● Implement and maintain database clusters, including replica sets and sharded clusters, ensuring data distribution and fault tolerance.

● Perform regular database performance tuning and optimization to maximize query efficiency and reduce response time.

● Develop and implement backup and recovery strategies to ensure data integrity and minimize downtime.

● Monitor and troubleshoot database issues, including performance bottlenecks, query optimization, and replication problems.

* Communication and collaboration: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas and work effectively across global, cross-functional, and multicultural teams.

The EDI Support Subject Matter Expert (SME) serves as a key resource supporting the reliability, performance, and continuous improvement and strategic development of Castrol's EDI ecosystem. * Coordinate testing activities and support successful implementation and go-live activities.
* Validate transaction compliance and connectivity requirements.

* Assist with testing, defect analysis, and production readiness activities.

* Creation of Support documentation, training materials, operational procedures, and EDI Specifications.
* Serve as an escalation resource for complex EDI-related issues.

Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Identify opportunities to improve EDI processes, monitoring, and support effectiveness.
* Recommend automation and process enhancements that improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Support digital transformation initiatives involving integration and customer connectivity.

**Experience Required**

* Advanced knowledge of ANSI X12, EDIFACT and cXML transaction standards.
* Expertise troubleshooting EDI transaction delivery, mappings, and document flows.
* Deep understanding of SAP IDOCs used in Order-to-Cash and logistics processes

description:
**Job Title: Senior Consultant** ( PTC Windchill Data Migration Expert )

  
  

**Experience**: 5-8 Years

  
  

**Technology**: PTC Windchill PLM, Data Migration, CAD Integration, SQL, Java

**Deployment Environment**: On-Premises / Microsoft Azure Cloud / AWS

  
  

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced PTC Windchill Migration Expert with 5–8 years of hands-on experience in PLM data migration, Windchill administration, customization and CAD data management. The candidate will be responsible for planning and executing Windchill migration activities, ensuring data integrity, business continuity and successful migration of PLM data across environments and platforms.

  
  

The role involves collaborating with business stakeholders, infrastructure teams and technical teams to deliver migration solutions aligned with business and technical requirements.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

Migration Strategy & Planning: Define migration strategy, scope, approach, timelines and dependencies for Windchill upgrades and PLM platform migrations.

Windchill Data Migration: Execute migration of Parts, Documents, CAD Documents, BOMs, lifecycle states, versions, iterations and change objects.

Source-to-Target Migration: Perform migration from legacy Windchill environments and other PLM platforms such as Siemens Teamcenter or Dassault ENOVIA.

CAD Data Migration: Handle Creo and multi-CAD data, including CAD structures, assemblies, dependencies, associations and representation files.

Migration Tools & Utilities: Develop and execute migration utilities using Windchill APIs, Java, SQL, loaders and supported bulk-loading mechanisms.

Data Mapping & Transformation: Define source-to-target mappings, attribute transformations, numbering rules, classification, lifecycle and organizational mappings.

Data Validation: Perform pre- and post-migration validation, reconciliation, referential integrity checks and completeness verification.

Migration Rehearsals: Execute mock migrations, trial loads, performance testing, error analysis and migration cycle optimization.

Troubleshooting: Resolve migration failures, data inconsistencies, missing references, duplicate objects and CAD association issues.

Documentation & Reporting: Maintain migration plans, mapping documents, reconciliation reports, issue logs and technical documentation.

Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with PLM architects, business users, CAD teams, database administrators and infrastructure teams.

  
  

**Required Technical Skills**

5-8 years of experience in PTC Windchill PLM, with substantial hands-on migration experience.

Strong knowledge of Windchill PDMLink, Part Management, Document Management, CAD Data Management, BOMs and Change Management.

Experience with Windchill version upgrades, environment migrations, or cross-platform PLM migrations.

Hands-on experience with Windchill APIs, Java, SQL, XML and supported bulk-loading or migration utilities.

Knowledge of Windchill object models, versioning, iterations, lifecycle states, workflows and object relationships.

Experience with CAD integrations, particularly Creo; exposure to NX, CATIA, or SolidWorks is an advantage.

Experience with source-to-target data mapping, transformation, reconciliation and migration validation.

Understanding of Windchill database structures, vaults, content storage and migration dependencies.

Familiarity with Linux/Windows environments, application logs and performance troubleshooting.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and documentation skills.

  
  

**Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills**

Experience with Windchill 11, 12, or 13.

Experience with Windchill Bulk Migrator (WBM).

Exposure to AWS, Microsoft Azure infrastructure and cloud-based PLM deployments.

Knowledge of MPMLink, PartsLink, ProjectLink and Supplier Management.

Understanding of migration security, access control, audit history and compliance requirements.

  
  

**Key Deliverables**

Source-system assessment and migration readiness report.

Data migration strategy, scope and execution plan.

Source-to-target mapping and transformation specifications.

Migration utilities, scripts and reusable components.

Trial migration and reconciliation reports.

Data quality and migration issue reports.

  
  

**Education**

Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent relevant experience.

  
  

**Success Criteria**

Accurate and complete migration of in-scope PLM data.

Preservation of CAD structures, BOM relationships, object associations and required metadata.

Successful reconciliation and business validation.

Completion of migration activities within agreed timelines.

title: Business Development Associate (Sports Club Acquisitions)
description:
**1. About the Project**

The MCD Delhi Mini League is a grassroots sports development initiative being implemented in association with the Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD), with SITDS managing the programme and league operations.

Following the successful execution of the Football League, the initiative is expanding its sporting activities with the upcoming Cricket Edition.

The programme aims to develop a network of independently managed grassroots sports clubs across Delhi, providing young athletes with opportunities to participate in organised competitions, training programmes and long-term sporting development.

**2. Role Overview**

We are looking for a proactive, target-oriented and field-driven Sports Club Acquisition & Activation Associate who will be responsible for identifying, approaching and onboarding prospective club owners for the MCD Delhi Mini League.

The individual will approach sports entrepreneurs, former professional players, cricket coaches, cricket academies, sports administrators, local business owners and other interested individuals who may be willing to establish or operate a cricket club.

The primary objective is to generate qualified club ownership enquiries, convert interested prospects into approved club operators and support their onboarding and activation.

**3. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Club Owner Acquisition**

* Identify potential club owners across different zones and districts of Delhi NCR.
* Approach sports entrepreneurs, former athletes, coaches, cricket academy operators and interested individuals.
* Conduct field visits, meetings, networking activities and direct outreach.
* Explain the MCD Delhi Mini League Club Ownership model and its objectives.
* Communicate the club ecosystem, registration process, eligibility requirements and applicable fee structure.
* Generate genuine enquiries from individuals and organisations interested in operating clubs.

**B. Lead Generation & Conversion**

* Build and maintain a database of prospective club owners.
* Conduct regular follow-ups through calls, WhatsApp, emails and physical meetings.
* Arrange meetings between interested applicants and the programme management team wherever required.
* Assist prospects in understanding the registration and application process.
* Convert qualified enquiries into completed club applications.
* Follow up with applicants during the verification and approval stages.

**C. Club Registration & Onboarding**

* Assist interested applicants with online club registration.
* Collect and verify the completeness of basic application information.
* Coordinate collection of relevant details, including:
* - Proposed club name.- Club representative details.- Contact information.- Sport and geographical area of operation.- Affiliated RWA, school, academy or organisation.- Other prescribed supporting documents.
* Coordinate with the internal team for application verification and approval.

* Follow up with approved applicants regarding applicable registration and onboarding requirements.
* Support the final digital activation process after approval and completion of prescribed payments.**D. Club Development & Team Readiness**

* Maintain communication with activated club representatives.
* Explain the digital club management platform and basic onboarding process.
* Encourage clubs to develop their athlete base.
* Support clubs in registering eligible Under-11 Boys and Girls players.
* Follow up on team formation and competition readiness.
* Coordinate with the league operations team for any club-related requirements.

**E. Reporting & Coordination**

* Submit daily activity and lead-generation reports.
* Maintain an updated CRM / Excel database of prospects.
* Track enquiries, meetings, applications, approvals and activated clubs.
* Share weekly conversion reports with the reporting manager.
* Coordinate with the RWA Activation Executive wherever community-level partnerships can support club formation.

**4. Minimum Qualifications**

* Graduate in any discipline, Candidates with a bachelor's degree in Sports Management, Business Administration, Marketing or related fields will be preferred.
* Minimum 1 year of experience in sales, business development, field marketing, sports management or partnership acquisition.
* Freshers with exceptional communication skills and strong field-sales aptitude may also be considered as an intern with an opportunity of full-time employment upon performance evaluation on successful completion of internship.
* Basic knowledge of cricket and the grassroots sports ecosystem will be an advantage.

**5. Preferred Candidate Profile**

We are particularly interested in candidates from the following backgrounds:

* Cricket academy business development executives.
* Sports event and tournament coordinators.
* Former district/state-level cricket players interested in sports administration.
* Sports academy representatives.
* Business development and field sales professionals.
* Individuals with strong networks among coaches, academies and local sports communities.

**6. Required Skills**

* Excellent verbal communication and convincing skills.
* Strong sales, negotiation and lead-conversion abilities.
* Confidence in conducting face-to-face meetings.
* Ability to independently manage field visits.
* Good relationship-building and networking skills.
* Target-oriented approach.
* Basic knowledge of MS Excel, Google Sheets and digital registration platforms.
* Ability to communicate proficiently in Hindi and English.

**7. Additional Benefits**

* Local field travel reimbursement against approved policy and supporting records.
* Opportunity to work on a large-scale grassroots sports development initiative.
* Direct exposure to sports business development, club management and league operations.
* Performance-based growth opportunities within the programme.

**8. Important Expectations**

The candidate must understand that this is primarily a field-based acquisition role and not a desk-based calling position.

The candidate must be comfortable travelling across Delhi NCR, meeting potential club owners and independently managing the entire acquisition pipeline.

No unauthorised fee collection, false commitments regarding club ownership, guaranteed revenue, league participation or municipal infrastructure access will be permitted.

**Success in this role will be measured by the number of genuine, approved and activated clubs onboarded into the MCD Delhi Mini League ecosystem.**

Pay: ₹350,000.00 - ₹500,000.00 per year

* Do you have any Sports Background? If yes, please share a brief about the same.
* What is your current CTC?
* What is your expected CTC?
* What is your notice period?
* Are you comfortable working 6 days a week onsite?

title: SME - Kubernetes, Terraform
description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

We are looking for an experienced Linux / UNIX Engineer (L3) to own the stability, security and performance of our enterprise server environment. As the final technical escalation point, you will resolve complex incidents, perform root cause analysis, design and implement infrastructure improvements, and guide L1/L2 teams. The role requires deep hands-on expertise across Linux and UNIX platforms, strong automation skills, and the ability to work closely with application, database, network, storage and cloud teams to deliver reliable services in line with agreed SLAs.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

Incident, Problem and Escalation Management • Act as the final escalation point (L3) for complex Linux / UNIX incidents escalated from L1/L2 teams. • Troubleshoot and resolve critical (P1/P2) issues related to OS, kernel, boot, file systems, performance, memory, networking and storage. • Lead root cause analysis (RCA) for major incidents and drive permanent fixes through problem management. • Analyze system logs, core dumps and crash dumps (kdump, sosreport, explorer) to identify underlying issues. • Coordinate with OEM vendors (Red Hat, SUSE, Oracle, IBM, HPE, Dell) for case escalation and resolution. • Participate in on-call rotation and lead bridge calls during major incidents. Server Build, Engineering and Administration • Design, build, configure and decommission physical and virtual Linux (RHEL, CentOS, Rocky, Oracle Linux, SUSE, Ubuntu) and UNIX (Solaris, AIX, HP-UX) servers. • Define and maintain standard OS build templates, golden images and hardening baselines. • Manage storage and file systems including LVM, ext4, XFS, ZFS, NFS, CIFS/Samba, multipathing and SAN/NAS integration. • Configure and support high-availability clusters (Pacemaker/Corosync, Veritas Cluster Server, Red Hat HA, PowerHA/HACMP). • Manage virtualization platforms such as VMware vSphere, KVM, Solaris Zones/LDOMs and IBM LPARs. • Administer core services including DNS, DHCP, NTP/Chrony, SSH, Postfix/Sendmail, Apache/Nginx and cron. • Patching, Upgrades and Lifecycle Management\\r\\n• Plan and execute OS patching, kernel upgrades and major version migrations with minimal downtime. • Manage patch repositories and lifecycle tools such as Red Hat Satellite, SUSE Manager, Spacewalk or IBM NIM. • Track end-of-life (EOL) platforms and drive remediation, refresh and migration plans. • Perform firmware and hardware upgrades in coordination with data center and vendor teams. Security, Compliance and Access Management • Implement and maintain OS hardening in line with CIS benchmarks and organizational security policies. • Remediate vulnerabilities identified through scanning tools (Qualys, Tenable/Nessus, Rapid7) within defined timelines. • Manage user and privileged access, sudo policies, PAM, SELinux/AppArmor, firewalld/iptables and SSH key management. • Integrate Linux / UNIX systems with Active Directory / LDAP using SSSD, Centrify or Winbind. • Support internal and external audits (SOX, ISO 27001, GxP, PCI-DSS) and provide evidence as required. Automation, Monitoring and Performance • Automate routine tasks, builds, patching and compliance checks using Shell, Python, Perl and Ansible. • Develop and maintain configuration management with Ansible, Puppet, Chef or SaltStack. • Configure and tune monitoring and alerting using tools such as Nagios, Zabbix, Prometheus/Grafana, Splunk, Dynatrace or SolarWinds. • Conduct capacity planning and performance tuning for CPU, memory, disk I/O, network and kernel parameters. • Identify repetitive incidents and eliminate them through automation and self-healing solutions. Backup, Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity • Ensure backup and restore processes are configured and tested using tools such as Veritas NetBackup, Commvault, Veeam or IBM Spectrum Protect. • Design, document and execute DR plans and participate in periodic DR drills. • Validate recovery procedures and maintain RTO/RPO compliance for critical systems. Process, Documentation and Leadership • Follow ITIL processes for incident, problem, change and request management using ServiceNow, BMC Remedy or similar ITSM tools. • Prepare and present change requests, implementation plans and rollback plans to the Change Advisory Board (CAB). • Create and maintain SOPs, runbooks, knowledge base articles, architecture diagrams and RCA reports. • Mentor and upskill L1/L2 engineers through knowledge transfer sessions and technical reviews. • Ensure SLA, KPI and operational metrics are met and contribute to continuous service improvement initiatives.

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

Operating Systems Expert-level RHEL / CentOS / Rocky / Oracle Linux, SUSE, Ubuntu; working knowledge of Solaris, AIX or HP-UX • Troubleshooting Boot and GRUB issues, kernel panics, hung systems, performance bottlenecks, crash dump analysis, strace, tcpdump, sar, vmstat, iostat • Storage and File Systems LVM, XFS, ext4, ZFS, NFS, Samba, iSCSI, SAN multipathing, RAID • Clustering and HA Pacemaker/Corosync, Veritas Cluster Server, Red Hat HA, PowerHA • Virtualization VMware vSphere, KVM, Solaris Zones / LDOMs, IBM LPAR • Scripting and Automation Bash / Shell, Python, Perl; Ansible (required), Puppet / Chef (preferred) • Networking TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, bonding / teaming, VLANs, firewalls, load balancers • Security CIS hardening, SELinux, sudo, PAM, SSH, vulnerability remediation, AD / LDAP integration • Tools Red Hat Satellite, ServiceNow, monitoring tools (Nagios, Zabbix, Splunk, Prometheus / Grafana), backup tools

**Must Have Skill**
-------------------

Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service,AWS CloudFormation,PaaS - AWS,Terraform,Linux,Kubernetes

**Good to Have Skill**
----------------------

**Other Requirements**
----------------------

Public cloud experience with AWS (EC2, EBS, IAM), Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform. • Containers and orchestration: Docker, Podman, Kubernetes or Red Hat OpenShift. • Infrastructure as Code with Terraform; CI/CD tools such as Git, Jenkins or GitLab. • Support for enterprise applications and databases on Linux / UNIX (Oracle, SAP, WebLogic, Tomcat, JBoss). • Experience in regulated industries such as pharma, healthcare or financial services. Qualifications and Certifications • Bachelor\'s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or equivalent practical experience. • 8–12 years of hands-on experience in Linux / UNIX administration, with at least 3–4 years in an L3 or engineering role. • Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE) or Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) – strongly preferred. • Additional certifications are an advantage: SUSE Certified Engineer, Oracle Solaris, IBM AIX, LPIC-2/3, ITIL v4 Foundation, AWS / Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA). Soft Skills and Competencies • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a structured approach to troubleshooting. • Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical issues to non-technical stakeholders and leadership. • Ability to stay calm and lead effectively during high-pressure, business-critical incidents. • Ownership mindset with a focus on service quality, documentation and continuous improvement. • Team player who mentors others and collaborates well across global, cross-functional teams.

title: ERP Implementation - IT
description:
**Company Description**
The Rungta Group is one of the oldest industrial houses in eastern India and a leading real estate planner and developer in Bengal. With a comprehensive in-house infrastructure team of architects, engineers, consultants, and designers, the Group has significantly shaped Kolkata’s skyline.

**Role Description**

* The ERP Implementation - IT role is a full-time, on-site position based in Kolkata. The role involves managing end-to-end ERP implementation, including requirement gathering, system configuration, testing, and deployment across business functions.
* Implementation planning: Prepare the module-wise rollout plan in phases, with timelines, milestones, dependencies and change-management steps, and drive it to completion.
  Responsibilities include coordinating with internal stakeholders to understand processes, mapping them to ERP modules, and ensuring smooth data migration from legacy systems.
* Vendor coordination: Be the single point of contact with In4velocity – scope, configuration requests, customization, issue tracking, escalation and sign-offs. T
  he role also entails monitoring system performance, troubleshooting technical and functional issues, and working with In4velocity to resolve them.
* Masters & configuration: Set up and validate all masters – projects, payment plans, budgets/BOQ, supplier & contractor masters, COA mapping, approval workflows, roles and access rights.
* Data migration: Plan and execute migration of legacy data (units, customers, receivables, vendors, inventory, opening balances) with reconciliation to source records.
* Daily tasks include preparing documentation, training users, supporting change management, and collaborating with finance, operations, and customer-facing teams to enhance system usability and efficiency.
* To own the end-to-end implementation of In4Suite® ERP across the organisation – from process mapping and configuration through data migration, training, go-live and stabilisation – so that all core business functions run on one integrated, reliable system.
* Training & adoption: Train end users department-wise, prepare simple user guides, and drive actual day-to-day usage of the system.
* Go-live & stabilisation: Manage cutover, run hypercare support, resolve teething issues and stabilise each module after go-live.
* Reporting & MIS: Build the management reports and dashboards the business needs (collections, project costing, budget vs actual, cash flow, ageing).

**Qualifications**

* Graduate (any discipline). 4–8 years of ERP implementation experience in real estate industry. Hands-on experience with ERP implementation or support (e.g., In4velocity, Farvision, Hirise or similar systems.)
* Strong Analytical Skills and Planning abilities to assess business processes and design effective ERP solutions.
* Working knowledge of real estate business processes, engineering, budgets and work orders, purchase, contractor billing.
* Hands-on with configuration, masters, workflows, data migration and user training.
* Comfortable with Excel, reporting tools.
* Strong communication and follow-through; able to work with department heads, site teams.
* Clear and professional Communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams and train end users.
* Fundamental understanding of Finance processes to support ERP modules related to accounting and reporting.
* Customer Service orientation to respond to user queries, handle issues, and ensure a positive ERP experience.

description:

You will work as deputy to the lead architect, set service structure and code standards, and be the second senior reviewer for the riskiest services and database changes.

**What You'll Work On**

* Enterprise Retail ERP Platform

* Order Management Systems
* API-first Integrations
* Event-Driven Architecture
* Multi-tenant Platform Development
* High-volume Transaction Processing
* Cloud-native Modernization Initiatives

* Strong technical leadership with a hands-on approach.
* Sound judgement on design trade-offs.
* Ability to simplify complex technical challenges.
* Ownership mindset with a focus on delivering business value.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Why Join Us**

* Opportunity to modernize a large-scale enterprise Retail ERP platform.
* Work on cloud-native, event-driven, and distributed systems.
* Solve challenging scalability and performance problems.
* Collaborate with experienced architects and product engineering teams.
* Play a key role in shaping the technical direction of a mission-critical product.

**Benefits**
We like to think that talent grows at Ginesys and stays at Ginesys. To ensure this, we provide our employees with the best working environment, the latest technology and continuous support. We go out of our way to retain the small business feeling with which we started and stimulate innovation and collaboration through teamwork and our non-hierarchical approach. Ginesys Academy for holistic training and development Comprehensive health insurance coverage Excellent rewards and recognition policy
  
  
Transparent compensation policy with no unnecessary deduction in CTC Annual company off-site and a variety of events, celebrations throughout the year
  
  
Travelling opportunities between our offices across the country. Annual Ginesys walkathon & related sporting events. Quarterly Coffee with the CEO and more!

Ginesys is India’s best omni retail suite backed by Ginesys, the first integrated Retail specific ERP software for online retail, offline retail and distribution. It is the largest Indian company in the retail tech industry catering to both online and offline needs. 1200 + brands including (Manyavar, V-Mart, Skechers) are accelerating their businesses with Ginesys. title: Oracle - EPM - TRCS - Functional Consultant - Manager
description:
Oracle Cloud EPM Account Reconciliation (ARCS)
  
Senior Consultant
  
Job Summary:
  
We are seeking an experienced Oracle Cloud EPM Account Reconciliation (ARCS) Senior Consultant with strong hands-on expertise in Reconciliation Compliance, high-volume Transaction Matching, reconciliation governance, reporting, integrations and automation. The role will support solution design and independently deliver application configuration, data loads, matching rules, workflow, testing, deployment, documentation and production support under the guidance of project leadership.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities:**

* Participate in end-to-end Oracle Cloud EPM Account Reconciliation implementations, rollouts, enhancements and support engagements.
* Conduct requirement-gathering and design discussions; document reconciliation, control, compliance and transaction-matching requirements.
* Configure Reconciliation Compliance, including periods, calendars, currencies, organisational units, attributes, formats, profiles, reconciliation methods, risk ratings and workflow.
* Configure preparer and reviewer assignments, tolerances, variance analysis, auto-reconciliation, ageing, alerts, notifications, attachments, comments, electronic sign-offs and audit evidence.
* Design Transaction Matching solutions using multiple data sources, match types, transaction types, one-to-one, one-to-many, many-to-one and many-to-many rules, tolerance logic and date or amount adjustments.
* Configure and tune auto-match rules, suggested matches, manual matching, adjustments, unmatched-item ageing, exception handling and reconciliation integration.
* Develop balance-sheet, intercompany, bank, cash, subledger-to-ledger, system-to-system and operational reconciliation use cases.
* Create and support operational and compliance dashboards, predefined and custom reports, reconciliation-status reporting, ageing analysis, match-rate monitoring and exception reporting.
* Develop and support integrations with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, E-Business Suite, SAP, FCCS, banks, subledgers, data warehouses and external systems using Data Integration, EPM Automate, REST APIs and file-based interfaces.
* Automate profile imports, balance and transaction loads, currency rates, reconciliation creation, auto-match execution, period-status changes, journal exports, reporting and job monitoring.
* Execute CRP, SIT, UAT, data migration, reconciliation-cycle validation, volume and performance testing, cutover, go-live and hypercare; investigate defects and support root-cause resolution.
* Prepare configuration workbooks, functional and technical specifications, match-rule designs, test scripts, training materials, operating procedures and deployment documentation.
* Support security, segregation of duties, reconciliation policies, audit trails, evidence retention, data lineage, controls and production-support procedures.
* Collaborate with finance, controllership, audit and technical teams; guide junior consultants, participate in peer reviews and support demonstrations and estimations.

Requirements
  
  
**Experience:**

* Minimum 5+ years of Oracle EPM, finance transformation or account-reconciliation experience, including strong hands-on Oracle Cloud EPM Account Reconciliation experience.
* At least two full-lifecycle Oracle EPM implementations, including one ARCS implementation covering Reconciliation Compliance and Transaction Matching.
* Strong knowledge of balance-sheet reconciliation, account substantiation, reconciliation governance, risk-based workflow, variance analysis and financial-close controls.
* Hands-on experience with periods, formats, profiles, rules, currencies, organisational units, workflow, auto-reconciliation, ageing and dashboards.
* Hands-on Transaction Matching experience with data sources, match types, matching rules, adjustments, exceptions, auto-match optimisation and high-volume data sets.
* Experience integrating ARCS with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP or other source systems and automating processes through Data Integration, EPM Automate and REST APIs.
* Experience supporting workshops, configuration, testing, migration, reconciliation-cycle validation, cutover, go-live and post-production support.
* Industry experience in government, retail, energy, real estate, oil and gas, financial services, or power and utilities is preferred.

**Competencies / Skills:**

* Oracle Cloud EPM Account Reconciliation configuration, administration and connected financial-close processes
* Reconciliation Compliance, periods, formats, profiles, workflow, risk ratings, ageing, auto-reconciliation and audit evidence
* Transaction Matching data sources, match types, rules, tolerances, adjustments, exceptions and match-performance optimisation
* Balance-sheet, intercompany, bank, cash, subledger-to-ledger, system-to-system and operational reconciliations
* Operational and compliance dashboards, predefined and custom reports, ageing, variance, status and exception analysis
* Data Integration, EPM Automate, REST APIs, Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, FCCS and third-party ERP, bank and subledger integrations
* Security, segregation of duties, controls, audit trails, evidence retention, data lineage and compliance reporting
* Awareness of Predictive AI, Reconciliation Assignment Assistance, Transaction Matching Assistance, confidence scores, anomaly detection and governed human review is desirable
* Strong accounting, analytical, problem-solving, requirement analysis, documentation and stakeholder communication skills
* Strong teamwork, mentoring and delivery capabilities; willingness to travel and work MENA business timings

**Education:**

* CA, CMA, ACCA, MBA Finance or an equivalent finance/business qualification is preferred.
* Relevant Oracle Cloud EPM Account Reconciliation certification is preferred; accounting, audit, controls, integration or reporting credentials are advantageous.

title: Support Engineer, Merchant Support, Amazon Supply Chain Services
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon has spent years building one of the world’s most efficient and optimized supply chains. The Amazon Supply Chain Services (ASCS) will build on that foundation and continue to innovate end-to-end supply chain capabilities.  
As a Support Engineer, you will work with our GTM, Operations, Tech and Product Teams to independently resolve customer issues and blockers by providing knowledgeable and responsive technical support.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Our customers are large enterprises, small-medium businesses, and agencies using Amazon supply chain services. You would interact with customers’ technical and business stakeholders to resolve their issues. You will have ownership for issue investigation, identifying root cause and technical and complex non-technical defects, conceive and provide workarounds if acceptable to customers for continuity. You will gather sufficient information that helps reproduce issues and contribute to building long-term tech/product fixes. This is a complex, and fast-paced environment as you will own the most critical part of the customer experience and delivering on our customers’ most basic need. While we obsess over issue resolution, in this role you will also develop tools to scale our support & service quality, and provide critical input for product prioritization to address root causes of why the customer experienced an issue in the first place. * Act as an escalation point for the most complex and in-depth issues that potentially span multiple external and internal organizations.

* Actively seeking solutions to customer needs, communicating trends to leadership, and suggesting innovative solutions on behalf of the customer experience.
* Writing queries, code samples, tutorials, and technical articles for the customer community and internal organizations
* Working with customers to understand how they are using our services, and providing feedback to development teams
* Collaborating with internal stakeholders to drive timely customer communication
* Driving internal projects that improve support-related processes and our customer's user experience

* 3+ years of technical support experience
* 3+ years of network and operating system support experience
* 3+ years of database administration experience
* 3+ years of software development with object oriented language experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent

* + years of relevant experience in a business analyst, data analyst or statistical analysis role Advanced technical or business degree (MS or MBA) Experience in developing requirements and formulating business metrics for reporting, familiarity with data visualization tools.
