**Job Summary**
---------------

The Senior CAS Analyst is an individual contributor responsible for strengthening client authentication and identity verification controls across Retail, Private and Business Banking. The role develops, implements and governs Client Authentication Standards; provides clear, risk-based guidance to business, operations, technology, compliance and fraud teams; and supports consistent adoption across markets. The role helps protect clients and the Bank by ensuring authentication requirements remain aligned with emerging fraud risks, regulatory expectations and secure banking practices.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Authentication standards and policy governance:** Develop, maintain and implement authentication-related standards, policies and governance frameworks in line with regulatory requirements, internal policies and the Fraud Risk Management Framework.
  
**Subject matter expertise and stakeholder guidance:** Act as a subject matter expert for client authentication and identity verification controls, including MFA/2FA, biometrics, soft tokens, OTPs, device binding and knowledge-based authentication. Interpret requirements and provide clear, practical guidance to country, business, operations, technology, risk and compliance teams.
  
**Consistent implementation across markets** : Drive consistent adoption of Client Authentication Standards across countries, customer segments and channels. Lead gap assessments, coordinate remediation, maintain implementation evidence and support cross-functional programmes that strengthen customer security while enabling business objectives.
  
**Risk, dispensation and control oversight:** Identify and assess authentication-related risks; review dispensations, risk acceptances and compensating controls; and ensure appropriate safeguards for higher-risk transactions. Maintain accurate documentation, approvals, governance records and audit trails, and support internal audits and regulatory reviews.
  
**Governance, reporting and continuous improvement:** Monitor compliance and control effectiveness, escalate material gaps, and provide transparent reporting to senior stakeholders and governance forums. Update standards in response to emerging fraud threats, regulatory change, industry practice and lessons from control reviews, while influencing outcomes without direct authority.

**Motivations**
---------------

This role suits someone motivated by solving complex fraud-risk and authentication challenges, translating policy into practical controls, and creating consistent outcomes across diverse markets and channels. The role will appeal to a collaborative, curious and action-oriented professional who values strong governance, clear evidence, continuous improvement and the opportunity to influence senior stakeholders while protecting clients and enabling secure banking experiences.

**Skills and Experience**
-------------------------

**Priority Skills**  
• Fraud Risk Management
  
• Client Authentication and Identity Verification
  
• Policy and Standards Governance
  
• Risk and Control Assessment
  
• Stakeholder Management and Influencing
  
• Business Analysis and Data Analytics
  
• Microsoft Word and Document Management

**Other Skills**  
• Regulatory and Compliance Awareness
  
• Written and Verbal Communication
  
• Programme and Change Delivery
  
• Banking Operations and Processes
  
• Technology and Information Security Awareness

**Qualifications**
------------------

* **Experience** : Substantial experience, typically 8-10 years, in customer authentication, identity verification, fraud prevention, risk management or related controls across digital and assisted banking channels.

• Strong understanding of banking operations and customer journeys across Retail, Private and/or Business Banking, with experience in policy interpretation, control design, gap assessment, dispensation governance, stakeholder management and executive reporting.
  
• **Qualification:** Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience in banking, risk, fraud, technology, cybersecurity, compliance or a related discipline.
  
• **Knowledge and capabilities** : Working knowledge of authentication mechanisms such as OTP, MFA/2FA, biometrics, soft tokens and device-based authentication, together with strong analytical, documentation, planning and problem-solving skills.
  
• **Stakeholder capability:** Demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority, simplify complex requirements, manage competing priorities and collaborate effectively with business, operations, technology, risk, compliance, auditors and regulators.
  
• **Languages:** Strong written and spoken English. Additional market-relevant language capability is advantageous but not mandatory.

**About Standard Chartered**
----------------------------

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

* Nonconformity classification, root cause analysis and corrective action verification.
* Management system documentation development.
* Compliance management and awareness of statutory and regulatory requirements.
* Technical report writing in clear, precise English.
* Communication, presentation and client-handling skills.
* Microsoft Office - Word, Excel and PowerPoint - and standard documentation tools.

Benefits:

title: Cyber Engineering Manager - Security Event Monitoring
description:
Lead a global 24x7 Security Event Monitoring service as an Engineering Manager, guiding Tier 1 and Tier 2 operations across assigned security verticals. You will provide operational leadership during cybersecurity events, improve investigation quality and service continuity, and develop a capable, resilient team. This role combines security operations leadership, stakeholder engagement, and continuous improvement in a global environment. **Work you'll do**

As an Engineering Manager on the Security Operations team, you will be responsible for:

* Act as Shift Lead, managing assigned Event Monitoring verticals, workload, priorities and operational/technical escalations; Ensure appropriate security-event monitoring, investigation, escalation and response coordination throughout the shift.

**The team**

The Security Operations team provides 24x7 security-event monitoring, investigation, escalation, and response coordination across Deloitte's environment. The team works with Incident Response, Foundation, and other security teams to help investigate cybersecurity events, strengthen operational resilience, and improve service quality. This global team supports through coordinated monitoring, incident response, and continuous improvement.

**Location: Hyderabad**

**Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM IST**

**Qualifications**

Required:

* Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering.
* 10-13 years of cybersecurity experience, including experience leading teams in a 24x7 Security Operations Center (SOC), Incident Response, or cyber-defense environment.
* Experience managing Tier 1 and Tier 2 Security Operations, shift delivery, and operational escalations.
* Experience using Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) or Extended Detection and Response (XDR) technologies, including Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk Enterprise Security, or Microsoft Defender XDR.
* Experience conducting incident investigations, coordinating containment activities, performing service-quality reviews, and preparing Security Operations reports.
* Experience with Incident, Change, and Problem Management; Root Cause Analysis; and Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) practices.
* Experience managing staffing, rosters, on-call coverage, onboarding, coaching, performance development, operational metrics, and stakeholder presentations.

Preferred:

* Master's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering.
* Experience with Security Orchestration, Automation and Response (SOAR), threat intelligence, endpoint, identity, email, cloud, and network security technologies.
* Experience with AI-assisted Security Operations and security automation governance.
* One or more of the following certifications: Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH), Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) 4, or Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC-200).

**Our purpose**

  
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

**Our people and culture**

  
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

**Professional development**

  
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.

**Benefits to help you thrive**

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. title: Salesforce Administrator - Service & Experience Cloud
description:

title: Senior Implementation Analyst – Product Delivery (Immediate Joinee)
description:
The Senior Implementation Analyst (SIA) plays a pivotal role in the end-to-end delivery of software products across client engagements. The SIA owns the structured implementation of assigned projects — from initiation and planning through to UAT, Go Live, and formal closure.

Working in close coordination with the Project Manager and cross-functional teams, the SIA brings deep functional expertise, disciplined execution, and strong client engagement to every implementation. The SIA serves as the primary functional point of contact for the client during the implementation lifecycle — ensuring that the product is configured, trained, and adopted in a manner that delivers measurable value to the client's business.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

**1. Project Planning & Execution**

* Develop and own the Implementation Plan for each assigned engagement / project— covering scope, timelines, milestones, dependencies, resource requirements, and deliverable schedules.
* Translate signed contracts, Purchase Orders (POs), and client briefs into structured implementation charters, clearly defining scope of work, acceptance criteria, and success metrics.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date project records on the project management system (Zoho Projects or equivalent) at all times — including implementation plans, milestone trackers, action items, defect trackers, risks, and project documentation.
* Proactively identify implementation risks and escalate them in a timely manner — maintaining a risk register and applying structured mitigation approaches in line with best practices.
* Ensure that every project is tracked not just against timelines and scope, but against the client's actual business objectives — consistently measuring whether the implementation is delivering the value committed at the point of sale.

**2. Functional Delivery & Product Expertise**

* Gain deep functional mastery of all assigned products and serve as the go-to functional expert for clients, internal teams, and project stakeholders throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Collaborate with clients and concerned stakeholder(s) to understand their goals, workflows, and implementation vision — and translate these into a structured, feasible delivery plan.
* Conduct functional training sessions for User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and Go Live — ensuring that end users are fully equipped to adopt the product effectively.
* Provide best practice usage advisory to clients, recommending optimal configurations and usage approaches based on client context and product capabilities.
* Prepare project-specific training documentation, user guides, and functional reference materials tailored to the client's environment and user base.
* Interface with internal teams to resolve functional gaps, technical dependencies, or product-related challenges that arise during implementation.

**3. Client Relationship & Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the primary functional point of contact for the client during the implementation — building trust, managing expectations, and maintaining a high standard of client communication throughout.
* Conduct regular structured check-ins and progress reviews with client stakeholders — proactively communicating status, risks, decisions required, and next steps.
* Manage client concerns, escalations, and change requests in a composed and solutions-oriented manner — coordinating internally to resolve issues without compromising delivery timelines.
* Liaise with the concerned team to ensure a smooth post-implementation handover and sustained client satisfaction after Go Live.
* Represent the company professionally in client interactions at all levels — reinforcing the organization’s commitment to delivery excellence and client delight.

**4. Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with the assigned Project Manager / Reporting Manager to align on project priorities, share status updates, flag dependencies, and escalate risks within agreed protocols.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure smooth and timely delivery of services to the client.
* Serve as liaison between technical and non-technical teams, both within the organization and at client and vendor / subcontractor organizations, to ensure all project targets and requirements are met.
* Contribute structured, data-backed feedback on client observations, recurring implementation challenges, and product gaps to the Project Manager and SBU leadership.

**5. Process, Governance & Administration**

* Adhere to all implementation processes, documentation standards, and governance protocols as defined by the function — including Ideal Implementation Plans (IIPs), Implementation Risks & Pre-Requisites Documentation (IRPD), and Risk Assessment & Risk Treatment Registers (RART).
* Ensure complete, accurate, and timely updation of all project management system entries for every assigned implementation — providing real-time visibility to the Project Manager and leadership.
* Participate actively in implementation retrospectives — sharing learnings, contributing to process improvement discussions, and adopting refined methodologies in subsequent engagements.
* Ensure compliance with all central company policies, including Travel Policy, Information Security (INFOSEC) Policy, and any other applicable guidelines.

**Qualification / Skill-sets**

* B.Sc. (IT) / B.E. / B.Tech. / MCA / MBA or equivalent Technical Graduate / Post-Graduate with a sound understanding of software solutions and their implementation.
* 3 – 5 years of experience in a Software Implementation, or Project Delivery role within a software product or technology environment.
* Demonstrated ability to independently manage end-to-end software implementation projects — from initiation and planning through to UAT, Go Live, and closure.
* Strong command of project management concepts and methodologies — with working knowledge of both Agile (Scrum / Kanban) and Waterfall approaches.
* PMP Certification (preferred): Candidates[AA1] who hold a valid PMP certification from PMI are preferred. Candidates without the certification are expected to demonstrate a clear inclination and intent to pursue PMP as part of their professional development.
* Proficiency in project management tools (Zoho Projects, Jira, MS Project, or equivalent) — with the ability to maintain structured implementation records and generate meaningful reports.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills — with the ability to engage confidently with client stakeholders at all levels, including senior management.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills — ability to identify root causes, structure solutions, and make sound recommendations under pressure and in complex multi-stakeholder environments.
* Sound interpersonal skills — with demonstrated ability to work collaboratively across teams, manage client relationships, and navigate conflict professionally.
* Willingness and enthusiasm to travel *(within the city as well as PAN India)* for client meetings, implementations, training sessions, and Go Live support.

**Added Advantage Qualification / Skill-sets**

* Prior experience in a BFSI-domain software company, with working knowledge of banking regulations, compliance frameworks, or financial technology products.
* Basic to working knowledge of SQL or Oracle databases — ability to independently validate data and query implementation-relevant information without technical support.
* Exposure to ISO, CMM, or Six Sigma quality frameworks — with experience applying structured quality practices in a software delivery context.
* Experience in managing vendor or subcontractor deliverables as part of a structured implementation.
* Familiarity with product development lifecycle concepts — from product requirements and design through to testing, release, and implementation.

title: Senior Zabbix Engineer
description:
Nuventure Connect is looking for an experienced Zabbix Architect / Subject Matter Expert (SME) with strong hands-on expertise in enterprise-scale Zabbix environments.

About the Role

We are looking for a Zabbix SME to lead a major monitoring modernization initiative involving
**two enterprise Zabbix environments currently running on versions 4.x and 7.x**
.

The project includes upgrading both environments to
**Zabbix 7.4**
, optimizing approximately
**150 Zabbix templates**
, and consolidating the environments into a unified deployment.

The existing production environment has
**10,000+ active monitoring configurations**
, so this role requires strong hands-on technical expertise in Zabbix architecture, troubleshooting, optimization, migration and enterprise-scale monitoring.

Key Responsibilities

• Assess existing Zabbix architecture, configuration, infrastructure, database and monitoring design.

• Evaluate scalability, performance, availability and operational efficiency.

• Identify architectural bottlenecks and configuration gaps and recommend improvements.

• Plan and execute the upgrade of Zabbix environments to
**Zabbix 7.4**
, including compatibility validation, testing, backups, rollback planning and production deployment.

• Review and optimize approximately
**150 Zabbix templates**
, including items, discovery rules, triggers, macros, preprocessing, dependencies and update intervals.

• Identify redundant monitoring items, inefficient polling, duplicate checks and unnecessary data collection.

• Reduce false positives, alert noise and unnecessary notifications.

• Design and execute the consolidation of two Zabbix environments into a single deployment.

• Handle configuration differences, host identity conflicts, duplicate monitoring entities, dependencies and migration requirements.

• Review history/trend retention, housekeeping, database performance and storage utilization.

• Optimize triggers, thresholds, dependencies, severity levels, event-generation logic and escalation workflows.

• Conduct gap analysis and align the monitoring environment with Zabbix and enterprise monitoring best practices.

• Identify opportunities for automation using Zabbix APIs, automated host registration, LLD, template linkage and configuration management.

• Develop or improve scripts and integrations where required.

• Prepare architecture documents, migration plans, technical documentation and operational runbooks.

• Provide knowledge transfer to internal infrastructure and monitoring teams.

Required Technical Expertise

* Extensive hands-on experience with
  **Zabbix architecture, administration, troubleshooting and performance optimization**
* **Strong experience with Zabbix 4.x and 7.x**
* **Hands-on experience with Zabbix upgrades, migrations and consolidation projects**
* **Strong understanding of Zabbix Server, Proxy, Agent, Templates, Items, Triggers, Actions, Events and Discovery**
* **Experience developing, reviewing, debugging and optimizing complex Zabbix templates**
* **Strong knowledge of trigger expressions, event correlation, alert dependencies, escalation workflows and notification configuration**
* **Experience with history/trend storage, retention policies, housekeeping and database optimization**
* **Experience managing large-scale Zabbix environments**
* **Knowledge of SNMP, agent-based monitoring, APIs and infrastructure telemetry**
* **Experience with PostgreSQL or MySQL/MariaDB**
  and database performance troubleshooting
* Strong
  **Linux administration and troubleshooting**
  skills
* Working knowledge of
  **Python, Bash or similar scripting/automation**
* **Experience with REST APIs, integrations and automated configuration management**
* **Understanding of production change management, backup/recovery, rollback planning and implementation validation.**

Preferred Experience

• MSP or multi-tenant monitoring environment experience

• Experience managing multiple customer environments and tenant-specific monitoring requirements

• Experience designing highly available and scalable Zabbix architectures

• Large-scale infrastructure monitoring across data centers, virtualization, network devices and storage

• Experience with historical monitoring data migration and retention/archival strategies

title: Application Vulnerability and Compliance SME
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Application Vulnerability & Compliance SME**
**Role Overview**
We are looking for an experienced Application Compliance SME to drive vulnerability, patching, and lifecycle compliance across enterprise application technologies hosted on Windows and Linux environments.
  
  
This is not a hands-on application installation, configuration, or administration role. The SME will focus on identifying compliance risks, coordinating remediation with application and platform owners, driving patch and upgrade programs, improving visibility through automation, and ensuring vulnerabilities and End-of-Life/End-of-Support components are remediated within defined timelines.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and coordinate application vulnerability and patch compliance activities across web, middleware, runtime, and application components.
* Assess environments to identify technologies such as Microsoft IIS, Apache HTTP Server, Apache Tomcat, NGINX, PHP, Node.js, Java/JDK, .NET/ASP.NET, and related application components.
* Review installed versions and inventories to identify:

+ Security vulnerabilities
+ Missing patches or security updates
+ End-of-Life (EOL) and End-of-Support (EOS) components
+ Unsupported or obsolete software versions
+ Components requiring upgrade or modernization

* Analyze vulnerability findings, vendor advisories, CVEs, severity ratings, product applicability, and available remediation options to determine the appropriate compliance action.
* Coordinate remediation with application owners, platform teams, infrastructure teams, and security teams, ensuring clear ownership and tracking through closure.
* Drive application owners to assess application compatibility and dependencies before upgrades to PHP, Node.js, Java/JDK, Tomcat, .NET, web servers, and other application components.
* Define and maintain remediation plans, priorities, target dates, exceptions, dependencies, and risk tracking for outstanding vulnerabilities.
* Coordinate patching and upgrade campaigns for application technologies without directly performing application installation, configuration, or production changes.
* Develop and implement automation for vulnerability identification, inventory validation, compliance tracking, reporting, and remediation coordination using technologies such as PowerShell, Bash/Shell, or other automation platforms.
* Correlate information from vulnerability management, software inventory, patching, CMDB, and application ownership data sources to improve accuracy and identify compliance gaps.
* Track application components against vendor-supported versions and proactively identify technologies approaching EOL/EOS.
* Support risk assessment and exception management where remediation cannot be completed within required timelines.
* Monitor remediation progress and produce compliance dashboards, metrics, ageing reports, risk summaries, and leadership updates.
* Identify recurring compliance gaps and recommend opportunities for automation, standardization, process improvement, and preventive controls.
* Maintain application technology inventories, compliance standards, remediation procedures, and supporting documentation.
* Support Incident, Change, Problem, Risk, and Vulnerability Management processes where application compliance is impacted.
* Act as the SME and coordination point between Security, Infrastructure, Platform, and Application teams for application technology vulnerabilities and lifecycle compliance.

**Core Technical Knowledge**
The candidate should have strong working knowledge of:
  
  

* Web and application platforms

+ Microsoft IIS
+ Apache HTTP Server
+ Apache Tomcat
+ NGINX

* Application runtimes and frameworks

+ PHP
+ Node.js
+ Java/JDK
+ .NET / ASP.NET

* Operating environments

+ Windows Server
+ Linux / RHEL

* Vulnerability and lifecycle management

+ CVE and CVSS interpretation
+ Vendor security advisories
+ Patch and vulnerability assessment
+ EOL/EOS identification
+ Application dependency and compatibility assessment
+ Risk and exception management
+ Remediation tracking and compliance reporting

* Automation and data analysis

+ PowerShell
+ Bash/Shell scripting
+ Automated inventory and compliance validation
+ Data correlation and reporting

Working knowledge of deployment and application delivery technologies such as Octopus Deploy, Azure DevOps, and CI/CD pipelines from a compliance and vulnerability management perspective, rather than as a deployment administrator.
  
  
**Role Boundary**
This is a governance, coordination, compliance, and automation-focused role. The Application Compliance SME will not be responsible for the routine installation, configuration, administration, or direct production implementation of application components. Remediation changes will be executed by the respective Application, Platform, or Infrastructure teams, while the SME will identify risk, define compliance requirements, coordinate remediation, track progress, automate compliance activities, and validate closure.
  
  
**Preferred Profile**
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in
**Application Compliance, Vulnerability Management, Web Services, Middleware, or Application Platforms,**
with sufficient technical depth to understand application technology stacks, versions, dependencies, vulnerabilities, and lifecycle risks.
  
  
The candidate should be capable of analyzing technical findings and translating them into
**clear remediation requirements for application and platform owners**
, while coordinating remediation through completion.
  
  
The individual should be comfortable working across
**Security, Infrastructure, Application, and Platform teams,**
challenging unresolved risks, tracking remediation commitments, and providing clear compliance status to stakeholders and leadership.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:

description:
Sagility is a tech-enabled BPM services provider, a thought partner providing a broad spectrum of transformational services, to enable our clients to provide efficient and hi-quality care across the healthcare system.

To learn more about our recognition please visit our AWARDS SECTION

We have 48,000+ employees in 15 cities across 5 countries – India, Philippines, USA, Jamaica, and Colombia.

The AVP – Application Security will provide global leadership, strategy, security engineering governance and operational accountability for Application Security, Product Security, DevSecOps and AI Security. The role will embed security across the software and AI lifecycle, establish enterprise testing and assurance capabilities, and enable secure delivery of web, mobile, API, cloud-native and AI-enabled solutions. The position requires deep practical leadership experience across Secure code reviews (SAST), dynamic testing (DAST) and Software Composition Analysis (SCA), together with threat modelling, penetration testing, software supply-chain security, secure CI/CD and AI-specific security testing.

Application Security

* Define and execute a multi-year global strategy and roadmap for Application Security, Product Security, DevSecOps and AI Security.
* Establish Secure Software Development Lifecycle policy/standards, security architecture requirements, release gates, reference patterns and risk-based assurance tiers.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Cloud, Privacy, Risk, Compliance, Legal and business teams to embed security by design.
* Establish decision rights, exception governance, measurable control outcomes and executive reporting across the application portfolio.

Security Testing & DevSecOps

* Provide end-to-end ownership of SAST, DAST and SCA capabilities, including tool strategy, onboarding, integration, tuning, triage and governance.
* Integrate security testing, secrets scanning, API testing, container scanning and infrastructure-as-code scanning into CI/CD pipelines.
* Expert knowledge of OWASP (Web/API/Mobile Top 10), SANS Top 25, MITRE ATT&CK framework, and NIST standards.
* Define risk-based quality gates and release-blocking criteria based on exploitability, application criticality, data sensitivity and business impact.
* Improve signal quality through false-positive reduction, deduplication, runtime context, attack-path analysis and developer-focused remediation guidance.
* In depth knowledge of platforms like Burp Suite, Metasploit, Cobalt Strike, Qualys, Nessus and Checkmarx.
* Automation Scripting fluency in Python, PowerShell, Bash, or Go to customize attack payloads and automate security tests.
* Establish software bill of materials, dependency governance, open-source license review and software supply-chain assurance.

Threat Modelling, Product & Cloud-Native Security

* Establish threat-modelling requirements for critical applications, APIs, cloud services and material technology changes using recognized methodologies.
* Lead security architecture reviews across web, mobile, API, microservices, containers, Kubernetes, serverless and multi-cloud environments.
* Define reusable patterns for authentication, authorization, encryption, secrets management, tenant isolation, logging, monitoring and data protection.
* Govern penetration testing, API security evaluations, business-logic testing, remediation validation and independent security sign-off.

AI Security & Responsible AI Assurance

* Define security standards and assessment methods for Generative AI, LLMs, machine-learning models, RAG solutions, AI agents and AI-enabled applications.
* Assess and mitigate prompt injection, insecure output handling, sensitive-data disclosure, data or model poisoning, model extraction, excessive agency, insecure tools/plugins and AI supply-chain risks.
* Establish AI threat modelling, adversarial testing, red teaming, guardrail validation, model/API monitoring, logging and human-oversight requirements.
* Partner with AI governance, data science, privacy and engineering teams to support secure innovation aligned with ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF and OWASP guidance.

Vulnerability, Risk, Compliance & Assurance

* Establish centralized intake, normalization, prioritization, ownership and remediation governance for application and AI security findings.
* Define remediation SLAs and exception processes and drive overdue critical and high-risk vulnerabilities to closure.
* Ensure alignment with HIPAA, HITRUST, PCI DSS, SOC 1, SOC 2, ISO 27001, corporate policies and client contractual requirements.
* Maintain audit-ready evidence including threat models, architecture diagrams, test reports, control matrices, risk acceptances and remediation records.
* Define KPIs and KRIs covering security-testing coverage, vulnerability aging, mean time to remediate, release-gate adoption, recurring defects and AI assurance.

People, Partner & Financial Leadership

* Build and lead a high-performing global team of Application Security engineers, DevSecOps specialists, penetration testers and AI Security professionals.
* Create clear accountabilities, technical career paths, succession plans, security-champion models and developer enablement programs.
* Coordinate with IR and SOC teams during active incident response or post assessment reviews.
* Govern MSSPs, testing partners, tool vendors and specialist AI Security providers against measurable outcomes and contractual commitments.
* Own budget planning, forecasting, licensing, tool rationalization and value realization for the Application Security and AI Security portfolio.
* Communicate material risks, investment needs, security posture and business outcomes to the CISO and senior stakeholders.

**SUCCESS MEASURES**

* Risk-based coverage of critical and high applications through SAST, DAST and SCA.
* Security controls and quality gates embedded into critical CI/CD pipelines.
* Reduction in critical and high-risk vulnerability aging, recurrence and exception backlog.
* Improved pre-production detection, remediation ownership and developer adoption of secure engineering practices.
* Consistent threat modelling, penetration testing and security sign-off for critical applications and AI systems.
* AI applications inventoried, risk-assessed, tested and monitored before and after production deployment.
* Stronger audit readiness, traceable evidence and measurable reduction in software supply-chain and AI security risk.

**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS**

**Education**

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, Cybersecurity or a related discipline. A relevant postgraduate qualification is desirable.

**Experience**

15–20 years of overall technology and cybersecurity experience, including 15+ years in Application Security, Product Security, Security Architecture or DevSecOps and significant senior leadership experience.

**Mandatory AppSec depth**

Demonstrated implementation and operational leadership across SAST, DAST, SCA and IAST, including tool selection, pipeline integration, tuning, triage, governance and remediation.

**Secure engineering**

Strong experience in Secure SDLC, DevSecOps, threat modelling, penetration testing, API security, cloud-native security, secrets management and software supply-chain security.

**AI Security**

Practical experience securing GenAI, LLM, ML or agentic AI solutions, including AI threat modelling, prompt injection testing, adversarial testing, guardrails and monitoring.

**Cloud & platforms**

Working expertise across Azure and AWS application architectures, containers, Kubernetes, microservices and CI/CD platforms.

**Risk & compliance**

Experience supporting regulated environments and frameworks such as HIPAA, HITRUST, PCI DSS, SOC 2 and ISO 27001.

**Leadership**

title: Solution Engineer
description:
**Introduction**
At IBM Global Sales, we bring together innovation, collaboration, and expertise to help clients solve their most complex business challenges. Working across industries and geographies, you'll partner with colleagues, clients, and partners to co-create solutions that drive digital transformation and lasting impact.Success in Global Sales is built on curiosity, empathy, and collaboration. You'll connect technical understanding with strong people skills, building trusted relationships and shaping solutions that improve business and society. With world-class onboarding, continuous learning, and a supportive culture, IBM offers the tools and opportunities to grow your career. Join us and be part of a global team that's passionate about driving innovation and making a difference.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
Solutions Engineers at Confluent play a critical role across the customer journey. They help customers evaluate the platform, design the right technical approach, prove value quickly, and build confidence in adopting data streaming patterns that solve meaningful business problems. This role sits at the intersection of technical depth, customer discovery, solution design, and business value articulation.
  
  
In this role, you will partner closely with Account Executives and cross-functional teams to uncover stated and unstated customer needs, shape strong technical strategies, and guide customers toward successful adoption of Confluent. You will be expected to lead technical discovery, own the technical win, and build trusted relationships with technical and business stakeholders.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Lead technical discovery with prospects and customers to uncover business drivers, technical requirements, risks, and success criteria.
* Design and present solution architectures that clearly connect Confluent capabilities to customer outcomes, technical constraints, and long-term platform strategy.
* Own and drive technical evaluations, proofs of concept, and proof of value activities from initial scope through technical win.
* Run workshops, white boarding sessions, and architecture discussions with developers, architects, platform teams, and business stakeholders.
* Help customers adopt best practices for data streaming, cloud, hybrid, and event-driven architectures as they move from individual projects toward broader platform adoption.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Support, Professional Services, and Customer Success to remove blockers, shape solutions, and improve customer outcomes.
* Contribute to account strategy with Account Executives by helping qualify opportunities, build champions, and strengthen the technical and business case for change.
* Create reusable assets such as demos, presentations, reference architectures, discovery patterns, or enablement material that scale beyond a single account.
* Mentor other Solutions Engineers by sharing best practices, giving constructive feedback, and helping lift the technical quality of the wider team.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Experience in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Solution Architecture, or a similar customer-facing technical role.
* Experience working with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, streaming or messaging platforms, data integration, and modern data platforms.
* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, networking, containers, Kubernetes, and modern application architectures.
* Ability to run high-quality discovery, map pain points to solution approaches, and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience leading technical evaluations, workshops, and customer presentations in complex enterprise sales cycles.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with confidence engaging developers, architects, and senior customer stakeholders.
* Hands-on experience with one or more of Java, Python, SQL, or similar technologies commonly used to build and integrate data-driven applications.
* A self-starter mindset with strong judgment, curiosity, and the ability to learn quickly, operate independently, and solve ambiguous technical problems.
* Proven ability to collaborate across functions and build trust with colleagues, customers, and partners.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Experience with Kafka, Apache Flink, stream processing, or real-time analytics platforms.
* Familiarity with value-based selling, MEDDPICC or similar qualification frameworks.
* Experience creating repeatable demos, technical content, playbooks, or enablement material for the broader field organization.
* A track record of mentoring peers and influencing team practices beyond your own accounts.
* Comfort engaging senior customer stakeholders and helping shape larger platform or transformation discussions.

title: Application Security Architect
description:
We are looking for an experienced Application Security Architect with 9–12 years of experience to drive application security architecture, engineering security standards and secure software development practices across Novac's fintech product ecosystem.

The candidate will be responsible for designing and implementing security architecture for enterprise-grade financial software products, ensuring security is embedded throughout the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). The role requires strong expertise in application security, secure coding, API security, cloud security, DevSecOps, threat modelling, vulnerability management, and security architecture reviews.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience securing fintech applications, digital lending platforms, loan management systems, insurance technology platforms, financial APIs, payment integrations, and enterprise software products. The candidate will work closely with Product Engineering, Software Architecture, Cloud, DevOps, and Information Security teams to ensure that Novac's products are scalable, resilient, and secure.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities:**

**Application Security Architecture**

* Establish secure architecture standards for digital banking, lending, insurance, and payment platforms.
* Define enterprise security reference architectures and reusable security patterns.
* Define security controls for AI-enabled applications and APIs.
* Assess risks relating to LLM integration, prompt injection, sensitive data exposure, and model governance.
* Review application architecture, technical designs, and business requirements to identify security risks and recommend appropriate controls.
* Drive security-by-design principles across product development and software engineering.
* Review architecture designs and provide security requirements before development begins.
* Conduct security architecture reviews for web applications, mobile applications, APIs, microservices, and cloud-based platforms.
* Define secure architecture patterns for authentication, authorization, encryption, data protection, and identity management.
* Review NFRs (Non-Functional Requirements) related to security, privacy, resilience, and compliance.
* Ensure security controls are incorporated into product architecture from the design stage.

**Secure SDLC & DevSecOps**

* Integrate security practices across all stages of the Software Development Life Cycle.
* Implement and strengthen DevSecOps practices by embedding automated security testing into CI/CD pipelines.
* Drive implementation of SAST, DAST, SCA, container security, and Infrastructure-as-Code security scanning.
* Establish secure coding guidelines and conduct application code security reviews.
* Work closely with development teams to identify, prioritise, and remediate security vulnerabilities.
* Automate security validation and vulnerability detection within software development and deployment processes.

**API & Fintech Product Security**

* Design and implement security controls for REST APIs, microservices, third-party integrations, and distributed applications.
* Ensure secure API authentication and authorisation using OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, and API gateways.
* Secure financial applications involving digital lending, loan origination, loan management, insurance workflows, and transaction processing.
* Define security controls for sensitive customer information, financial records, and transactional data.
* Ensure secure integration with banking systems, payment gateways, financial institutions, and external service providers.
* Identify and mitigate risks associated with data exposure, unauthorised access, fraud, and application-level attacks.

**Vulnerability Assessment & Threat Modelling**

* Conduct application security assessments, architecture reviews, and threat modelling exercises.
* Establish vulnerability management processes, risk classification, and remediation SLAs.
* Perform security risk assessments for new product features, application enhancements, and third-party integrations.

**Cloud & Infrastructure Application Security**

* Define and implement application security controls across AWS, Azure, or GCP environments.
* Review IAM architectures and enforce least-privilege access controls.
* Establish Zero-Trust application security principles.
* Ensure security across cloud-native applications, Docker, Kubernetes, and microservices environments.
* Implement encryption, secrets management, key management, and secure communication protocols.
* Work with cloud and DevOps teams to strengthen application deployment and runtime security.
* Ensure secure configurations and access controls across application environments.

**Security Governance & Compliance**

* Define application security policies, standards, technical guidelines, and governance frameworks.
* Ensure alignment with relevant security standards such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, and applicable RBI requirements, based on product and regulatory scope.
* Support internal and external security audits, compliance assessments, and risk reviews.
* Drive security awareness and secure coding practices across engineering teams.
* Work closely with technology leadership and product stakeholders to ensure security requirements are met.
* Define application security KPIs and maturity roadmap.
* Track:
* Vulnerability remediation SLA adherence
* Security debt
* Critical vulnerability trends
* Application security coverage
* Secure coding adoption metrics
* Present security posture and risks to senior management and technology leadership.

**Experience & Educational Qualifications**

* 9–12 years of overall experience in Application Security, Product Security, Security Engineering, or Information Security.
* Minimum 5+ years of relevant hands-on experience in application security and secure software development.
* 3+ years of experience in application security architecture, security design reviews, or security engineering leadership preferred.
* Experience securing UPI, payment gateway, and financial transaction workflows.
* Understanding of RBI Cyber Security Framework expectations.
* Knowledge of PCI DSS v4.0 requirements.
* Familiarity with data protection requirements involving customer PII, financial information, and consent management.
* Experience in a FinTech, BFSI technology, Banking Software, or Enterprise software Product Company is strongly preferred.
* Preferred Certifications (CISSP/CSSLP/CCSP).
* Proven experience in securing enterprise-grade applications, APIs, microservices, and cloud-based platforms.
* Strong understanding of modern software architecture, distributed systems, and cloud-native applications.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate should come from a FinTech, Banking Technology, Financial Software Product, or Enterprise SaaS Product Engineering Organisation.

**Candidates should have demonstrated experience in:**

* Designing and implementing application security architecture for complex software products.
* Securing digital lending, banking, payment, insurance, and transaction-based platforms.
* Implementing DevSecOps and integrating security into CI/CD pipelines.
* Conducting threat modelling, security architecture reviews, and secure code assessments.
* Securing APIs, microservices, cloud platforms, and third-party integrations.
* Working directly with software engineering and product development teams to embed security into product design and delivery.
* Certification related to application security will be an added advantage.

title: Network & Cyber Security Architect

Cyber Security Threat Hunter

We are looking for an experienced SOC Lead / Threat Hunter with strong expertise in Global SOC operations, SIEM management, and advanced threat hunting. • Work with security architecture and engineering teams to improve detection and prevention mechanisms.

title: Manager, Engineering
description:
**Our Mission**
At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
  
  
****Who We Are****
In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
  
  
We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
  
  
****Job Summary****
We are seeking an Engineering Manager to lead the team that builds and runs our connectors framework. In this role, you will be accountable for the team’s delivery across several concurrent projects, from platform enhancements to large programs that need multiple teams to collaborate. You will lead by example as a hands-on technical manager, grow the engineers on your team, and remove roadblocks so the connector engineers who build on your platform can move fast.
  
  
****What You’ll Do****

* Own Team Delivery: Be accountable for delivering multiple framework projects and features at the same time. Make pragmatic trade-offs to deliver, and personally deliver features when the team needs it.
* Lead Technically: Stay hands-on and lead by example. Guide the team through large, complex projects that need several teams to complete, such as migrating on-premises connectivity to a cloud-managed agent or extracting the integrations code into its own service. Design features in the framework yourself when needed.
* Direct Quality and Reliability: Set the quality processes the team follows. Own framework reliability, including sync health, incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), and resolution of security findings.
* Develop Talent: Run 1:1s, performance reviews, goal setting, and career guidance. Enable ownership on the team, resolve conflict, and grow engineers into their next level.
* Remove Roadblocks Across Teams: Work closely with the connector development team, other product teams, SRE, security, and PM to keep work clear and unblocked.
* Lead AI-First Engineering: Train the team on our tools and processes, including AI-assisted development workflows, and set the discipline for verifying AI-generated code.
* Drive Initiatives: Run initiatives within the team, such as cutting the time it takes to build a new connector or reducing sync failures.
* Keep Customers in Focus: Understand customer use cases and problems, and use them to set priorities with PM.
* Build the Team: Actively recruit, lead interviews, and make hiring decisions.
* Communicate Clearly: Present plans, progress, and risks to engineering and senior leadership.

**Nice to Have**

* Identity & Access Security Domain: Direct experience with IAM, PAM, IGA, or Secrets Management platforms.
* Integration Platforms: Experience leading teams that build integration frameworks, data pipelines, or SDKs used by other engineers.
* Hybrid Connectivity: Experience with products that run agents inside customer networks.
* Multi-Site Teams: Experience leading engineers across more than one office location.
* DevOps & Observability Ecosystems: Practical experience with progressive delivery, CI/CD pipelines, feature flagging tools, and monitoring tools such as Datadog.

**Impact**
As an Engineering Manager on the connectors framework, you will lead the team that every connector in our product depends on. Your impact will be measured by your team’s delivery, the reliability of the framework in production, and the growth of the engineers you lead. Co-workers will look to you for clarity, technical judgment, and a steady path forward.
  
  
****Qualifications****

* People Leadership: Experience managing software engineers, including 1:1s, performance reviews, career development, and hiring.
* Technical Depth: Strong hands-on background with Node.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, and AWS, plus experience with data integration or distributed systems. Able to review designs and code with credibility.
* Delivery Track Record: Proven record of delivering large, complex projects that need collaboration across several teams.
* Operational Ownership: Experience running production services, leading incident response, and driving RCAs to durable fixes.
* AI Tooling Adoption: Experience leading a team’s adoption of AI tools while keeping review rigor high.
* Conflict Resolution & Influence: Able to resolve conflict, remove roadblocks across teams, and build strong working relationships with ICs and managers.
* Communication: Excellent presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to engineering and business audiences.
* Customer Understanding: Good understanding of customer use cases, problems, and considerations.

****Qualifications****
**Our Commitment**
We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
  
  
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.
  
  
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
  
  
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
  
  
Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

title: Operations Engineer
description:
Syniverse is the world’s most connected company. Whether we’re developing the technology that enables intelligent cars to safely react to traffic changes or freeing travelers to explore by keeping their devices online wherever they go, we believe in leading the world forward. Which is why we work with some of the world’s most recognized brands. Eight of the top 10 banks. Four of the top 5 global technology companies. Over 900 communications providers. And how we’re able to provide our incredible talent with an innovative culture and great benefits.

**Who We're Looking For**

The Operations Engineer provides technical solutions to exceptionally difficult problems. This role will address day-to-day customer issues, application issues, problems and concerns that are detailed and complex in nature, requiring analysis and research. This position will install, configure, operate and evolve common infrastructure such as the network, servers, and external services (e.g. the cloud).





**Some of What You'll Do**

**Scope of the Role:**

* **Direct Reports:** This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Provide technical support for business critical applications running on Linux based production environments.
* Monitor, maintain, and troubleshoot production applications, servers, and supporting services to ensure availability and performance.
* Investigate and resolve complex technical issues through log analysis, system health checks, database queries, and structured troubleshooting.
* Perform Linux server health checks, including CPU, memory, disk utilization, processes, services, and network connectivity.
* Analyze application and system logs to identify errors, performance issues, and potential root causes.
* Troubleshoot application failures, processing delays, connectivity issues, and service interruptions.
* Use SQL queries to investigate application issues, validate data, and support incident resolution.
* Participate in production incidents, help identify root cause analysis, and coordinate with internal technical teams and third-party vendors when necessary.
* Monitor application processes, scheduled jobs, file transfers, data processing, and system alerts.
* Participate in production changes, deployments, maintenance activities, and post-implementation validations.
* Identify opportunities for operational improvements, automation, and proactive issue prevention.
* Maintain technical documentation, troubleshooting procedures, and incident records.

**Required Technical Skills**

  

* Linux Administration and Troubleshooting: Strong hands on experience supporting and troubleshooting applications in Linux based production environments, preferably RHEL.
* SQL and Relational Databases: Working knowledge of SQL, including the ability to independently execute queries, analyze records, and investigate application related database issues.
* Application Support and Troubleshooting: Experience investigating application failures, analyzing logs, monitoring processes, and resolving production issues.
* Networking Fundamentals: Understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, ports, connectivity troubleshooting, and common network protocols.
* Analytical and Problem Solving Skills: Strong troubleshooting capabilities, critical thinking, and the ability to independently investigate and resolve complex technical issues.

**Preferred Technical Skills**

  

* Experience with AWS cloud environments and application support.
* Familiarity with Apache Kafka and distributed messaging systems.
* Knowledge of shell scripting, Bash, or Python.
* Experience with monitoring and log analysis tools such as Grafana or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with automation tools such as Ansible.

**Experience, Education, and Certifications**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Telecommunications, or equivalent work experience.
* Minimum 2 years of relevant professional experience, with 3+ years preferred, in Linux-based application operations, production support, or technical troubleshooting.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience with Linux, SQL, and application troubleshooting.
* Experience supporting business critical production environments is highly desirable.
* Linux, AWS, or database certifications are preferred but not mandatory.

**Additional Requirements**

  

* Ability to work independently, take ownership of technical issues, and drive incidents through resolution with minimal supervision.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and decision making skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with technical and non technical stakeholders.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams while maintaining accountability for assigned responsibilities.
* Proactive approach to problem solving, continuous improvement, and learning new technologies.
* Participate in an on-call rotation and support critical production incidents as required.



**Why You Should Join Us**

Join us as we write a new chapter, guided by world-class leadership. Come be a part of an exciting and growing organization where we offer a competitive total compensation, flexible/remote work and with a leadership team committed to fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and transparent organizational culture.

At Syniverse connectedness is at the core of our business. We believe diversity, equity, and inclusion among our employees is crucial to our success as a global company as we seek to recruit, develop, and retain the most talented people who want to help us connect the world.

Be sure to have them submit you as a referral prior to applying for this position.

title: Linux System Support/Admin – HPC
description:
Linux System Support/Admin – HPCThis role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

**Who We Are:**

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

**Job Description:**

**High Performance Computing, AI and Labs** is a critical element of HPE. We are focused on delivering innovative solutions that accelerate our customers’ digital transformation, enabling them to tackle their complex, and data-intensive workloads. Combining deep expertise and the development of the world’s most cutting-edge, high-performance supercomputers, is defining the next era of computing delivering valuable insight & innovation. Join us and redefine what’s next for you.

**What you'll do:**
-------------------

The Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) HPC Business Unit has an exciting opportunity for an experienced engineer dedicated to providing **remote systems administration and proactive technical support for High-Performance Computing (HPC) environments**. These environments involve multiple components such as operating systems (OS), workload managers, high-speed networks, clustered file systems, and HPC cluster managers.

This role is part of our Global Remote Services (GRS) team and focuses on delivering exceptional service while ensuring the **availability, reliability, performance, and smooth operation of customers' HPC environments**.

As part of this role, you will work within a collaborative team environment where teamwork is essential. Engineers are expected to contribute to the successful operation and support of customer environments. This includes **performing proactive system health checks, troubleshooting technical issues, planning and coordinating maintenance activities, sharing knowledge, documenting findings, communicating with customers, and working with other HPE technical teams when specialist or onsite intervention is required**.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

In this role, you will:

* **Provide remote systems administration and proactive technical support for HPC environments**, dedicating a significant portion of the role to system health monitoring, technical assessment, troubleshooting, documentation, planning, and customer communication, alongside hands-on remote administration activities.
* **Perform detailed technical assessments and regular health checks** across HPC environments, including operating systems, workload managers, SlingShot and other high-speed networks, clustered file systems, cluster management components, and related infrastructure.
* **Troubleshoot and resolve technical and integration challenges** across a mix of HPC technologies, providing effective solutions and recommendations to maintain system availability, stability, and performance while minimizing customer impact.
* **Collaborate with global teams**, including Level 3 SMEs, engineering teams, support organizations, and onsite engineering personnel, to investigate and resolve complex technical issues and deliver seamless, customer-focused support.
* **Prepare and maintain comprehensive technical documentation**, including system health-check reports, troubleshooting notes, technical procedures, maintenance plans, configuration information, recommendations, and customer-facing reports.
* **Provide timely and effective communication with customers**, ensuring they have a clear understanding of system health, identified issues, recommended actions, ongoing investigations, maintenance activities, and outcomes.
* **Coordinate planned maintenance and technical activities** with customers and relevant HPE teams, helping ensure appropriate preparation, technical validation, risk identification, and post-maintenance verification.
* **Proactively identify potential risks and technical issues** before they result in service impact, working with customers and internal teams to recommend appropriate corrective or preventive actions.
* **Support incident investigation and problem resolution**, collecting and analyzing relevant system information, logs, alerts, and diagnostic data, and escalating to the appropriate specialist teams when required.
* **Be flexible with working hours** to support critical customer situations, planned maintenance activities, project milestones, and deadlines, including occasional extended hours and weekend work as needed.
* **Act as a technical service advocate for the customer**, ensuring that systems administration activities and technical recommendations align with the customer's operational and business requirements.
* **Contribute to continuous improvement and knowledge sharing** within the Global Remote Services team by documenting solutions, developing reusable procedures, sharing technical knowledge, and helping improve remote support practices.

**What you need to bring:**

***Education and Experience Required:***

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent.
* 4+ years experience preferred

**Key Qualifications:**
-----------------------

* **In-depth Linux knowledge**, with proficiency in Red Hat, CentOS, or similar Linux distributions.
* **Strong scripting experience with Bash and Python**, with the ability to develop scripts for system administration, diagnostics, automation, data collection, and repetitive operational tasks.
* **Expertise in clustered file systems** such as Lustre, CXFS, GPFS, or StorNext.
* **Hands-on experience with high-speed networking** technologies such as SlingShot, InfiniBand, or Omni-Path.
* **Hands-on experience with HPC workload managers** such as Slurm or PBS.
* **Strong experience administering and troubleshooting HPC systems**, including system health monitoring, configuration management, performance investigation, log analysis, maintenance, and incident resolution.
* Experience working with **HPC cluster management and monitoring tools** and diagnosing issues across multiple components of an HPC environment.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to **isolate complex issues across compute, storage, network, workload management, and operating system layers**.
* Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to **manage multiple customer environments, technical activities, incidents, and priorities effectively**.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills in English, with a strong emphasis on **customer-focused communication and the ability to translate complex technical findings into clear actions and recommendations**.
* Ability to work effectively in a **global and collaborative support environment**, coordinating with remote specialists, engineering teams, and onsite personnel when necessary.

title: Support Engineer, Merchant Support, Amazon Supply Chain Services
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon has spent years building one of the world’s most efficient and optimized supply chains. The Amazon Supply Chain Services (ASCS) will build on that foundation and continue to innovate end-to-end supply chain capabilities.  
As a Support Engineer, you will work with our GTM, Operations, Tech and Product Teams to independently resolve customer issues and blockers by providing knowledgeable and responsive technical support.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Our customers are large enterprises, small-medium businesses, and agencies using Amazon supply chain services. You would interact with customers’ technical and business stakeholders to resolve their issues. You will have ownership for issue investigation, identifying root cause and technical and complex non-technical defects, conceive and provide workarounds if acceptable to customers for continuity. You will gather sufficient information that helps reproduce issues and contribute to building long-term tech/product fixes. This is a complex, and fast-paced environment as you will own the most critical part of the customer experience and delivering on our customers’ most basic need. While we obsess over issue resolution, in this role you will also develop tools to scale our support & service quality, and provide critical input for product prioritization to address root causes of why the customer experienced an issue in the first place. Our customers are Amazon customers, and we take seriously maintaining the high customer service bar set by Amazon to be the level at which we need to operate.  
A day in the life
  
  

* Track, investigate, and resolve customer questions and issues using appropriate communication channel including phone, email, and live as well as asynchronous at various levels of complexity and customer impact.
* Act as an escalation point for the most complex and in-depth issues that potentially span multiple external and internal organizations.
* Communicate directly with internal organizations to complete root cause analyses, issue investigation, workarounds and defect resolution.
* Develop and implement complex repro cases to identify potential software defects, mis-configurations, or issues in customer environments.
* Use case management tools to manage and prioritize issues based on multiple factors including customer impact.
* Build & Contribute to training material and documentation for both internal and customer-facing users.
* Actively seeking solutions to customer needs, communicating trends to leadership, and suggesting innovative solutions on behalf of the customer experience.
* Writing queries, code samples, tutorials, and technical articles for the customer community and internal organizations
* Working with customers to understand how they are using our services, and providing feedback to development teams
* Collaborating with internal stakeholders to drive timely customer communication
* Driving internal projects that improve support-related processes and our customer's user experience

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of technical support experience
* 3+ years of network and operating system support experience
* 3+ years of database administration experience
* 3+ years of software development with object oriented language experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
* Knowledge of security best practices

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* + years of relevant experience in a business analyst, data analyst or statistical analysis role Advanced technical or business degree (MS or MBA) Experience in developing requirements and formulating business metrics for reporting, familiarity with data visualization tools.

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

description:

The Manufacturing Expert is a senior, hands-on fabrication specialist based in Chennai who serves as TEi’s manufacturing focal point for equipment executed through the global supplier and subcontractor network. The role provides practical manufacturing leadership and technical oversight to support safe, code-compliant, high-quality, cost-effective, and on-schedule fabrication of heat exchangers, pressure vessels, Feed water heater and Condensers and related equipment.

The position works closely with Engineering, Procurement, Quality, Project Management, and fabricators to identify manufacturing risks early, strengthen supplier capability, resolve complex shop issues, and improve manufacturability and execution. The role provides manufacturing recommendations and coordinates resolution while preserving the formal approval authority of Engineering and Quality for design changes, code interpretation, nonconformances, inspection acceptance, and controlled procedures

**Supplier & Shop-Floor Manufacturing Oversight**

**Fabrication Monitoring & Technical Coordination**

**Fabrication & Welding Monitoring**

**Fabrication Issue Resolution & Continuous Improvement**

**Supplier Capability & Knowledge Transfer**

**Manufacturing Coordination & Reporting**

**DECISION RIGHTS AND ROLE BOUNDARIES**

* Monitor fabrication activities and identify and report any deviations from approved drawings, specifications, procedures, ITPs, quality requirements, or applicable codes.
* Raise concerns and recommend corrective action or suspension of the affected activity, where significant safety, quality, material, or code-compliance concerns are observed, in coordination with the appropriate TEi and fabricator functions.
* Proide practical manufacturing observations and recommendations for resolution of fabrication issues, while responsibility for fabrication methods, sequencing, tooling, manpower, and shop execution remains with the fabricator.
* Coordinate identified fabrication issues, deviations, NCRs, and repair requirements with Engineering, Quality, Project Management, Procurement, and the fabricator, as applicable.
* Does not independently modify approved designs, drawings, specifications, procedures, or customer requirements, or approve technical deviations, NCR dispositions, weld repairs, or inspection acceptance.
* Final technical disposition and approval remain with the designated Engineering and Quality functions, in accordance with established project and company procedures.
* The role provides manufacturing oversight, technical input, coordination, follow-up, and escalation and does not replace the authority or responsibility of the fabricator for production and shop-floor execution

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Production / Manufacturing Engineering, Welding Engineering, or a related discipline.

* Strong working knowledge of ASME Section VIII and Section IX, applicable material specifications, welding requirements, NDE, PWHT, inspection, and quality-control practices.
* Good practical knowledge of fabrication activities including welding, fit-up, forming, machining, assembly sequence, dimensional control, distortion control, material traceability, and pressure-boundary fabrication.
* Experience in monitoring fabrication activities at supplier facilities and verifying compliance with approved drawings, specifications, procedures, ITPs, and project quality requirements.
* Experience in identifying fabrication issues, deviations, and recurring quality concerns and coordinating with suppliers, Engineering, Quality, Procurement, and Project Management for resolution.
* Experience in supplier capability assessment, manufacturing progress monitoring, NCR/corrective-action follow-up, and fabrication risk identification.
* Ability to review fabrication schedules and identify manufacturing constraints or potential delays affecting project milestones, without assuming responsibility for the fabricator’s production planning.
* Strong communication, technical reporting, coordination, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively with fabricators, inspectors, engineers, project teams, and supplier management.
* Working proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, with the ability to reviewelectronic drawings, specifications, procedures, inspection documentation, and manufacturing records.
