title: Senior Director – Amgen’s Clinical Vaults
description:
**JOIN AMGEN’S MISSION OF SERVING PATIENTS**
At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission to serve patients living with serious illnesses drives all that we do.
  
  
Since 1980, we've helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world's toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas, Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease, we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you'll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller, happier lives.
  
  
Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you'll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
  
  
**Senior Director – Amgen’s Clinical Vaults**
**What you will do:**
In this vital role as Senior Director, Amgen’s Clinical Vaults, you will be responsible for advancing the modernization and transformation of clinical operations across Amgen’s global development portfolio.
  
  
This leader will drive strategic innovation and implementation through adoption of emerging technologies, AI-enabled capabilities, process digitization and optimization initiatives in our CTMS, EDC and DQS ecosystems that improve quality, speed, efficiency, and scalability of clinical trial execution.
  
  
This role serves as the transformation and business product lead for the GDO’s Strategic Business Plan which includes D2 (Differentiated Delivery), ACT FAST and TWFS transformation initiative. The Senior Director, Amgen X Vault Platform is accountable for defining and executing Amgen's strategy for the Veeva Clinical ecosystem, encompassing CTMS, EDC, and DQS including the transitionary period between legacy EDC.
  
  
This leader will drive the convergence of digital protocols, connected clinical operations, integrated data review, and cross-vault collaboration to accelerate study startup, improve trial quality, and establish an industry-leading, data-driven clinical development platform. Working in close partnership with Veeva, AI&D, DTI, Clinical Development, GDO, RBQM, and Regulatory teams, this role will shape the future operating model of clinical trial execution leading to cycle time reduction.
  
  
**Strategic Leadership**

* Own the cross clinical vaults strategy: Define and execute Amgen's R&D and GDO strategy for clinical vaults, positioning CTMS, EDC and DQS as integrated, standard-driven platforms that enable consistent clinical execution and reusable data assets.
* Lead Strategic Partnership with Veeva: Serve as Amgen's executive relationship owner for the Veeva clinical ecosystem, influencing product direction, co-innovating future capabilities, shaping roadmap priorities, and ensuring Amgen remains at the forefront of platform adoption and innovation.
* Be part in defining the strategy for business functions: Be the embedded part of Study Start-Up, Study Operations and Data Management to be part of defining the functional strategy under Strategic Business Plan of GDO
* Define Seamless Clinical Data Flow: Establish an integrated digital data flow from protocol to study planning and design through study execution, acquisition, data review enabling a seamless analysis and regulatory submission readiness.
* External Technology Landscape Leadership: Continuously assess emerging technology trends, competitive practices, regulatory developments, and innovation opportunities across the CTMS, EDC and DQS technology ecosystem; translate insights into strategic recommendations that position Amgen as a digital leader in clinical development.

**Execution and Delivery of Strategic Business Plan**

* Be accountable for executing on the strategy and plan: Be accountable for delivery of all strategic business plan elements fully integrated with the platform strategy of CTMS, EDC and DQS roadmap
* In close Collaboration with AI&D: Partner with AI&D, IT and business stakeholders to develop and deploy AI-enabled workflow, automation and intelligence capabilities that improve quality, speed, consistency and reuse.
* Continuous Improvements: Champion continuous improvement and transformation initiatives that simplify operations, standardize processes, and strengthen organizational effectiveness.
* Audit Ready Clinical Vaults: Ensure transformation initiatives incorporate appropriate quality, compliance, and regulatory considerations and is always audit ready through cross-functional partnership and governance.

**Functional Management**

* Build and lead a high-performing organization focused on execution and delivery of the GDO Strategic Business Plan and associated enterprise transformation commitments.
* Lead, mentor, and develop a global team while fostering a culture of accountability, agility, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Develop organizational capabilities, operating models, and skillsets required to support evolving business, technology, and portfolio needs.
* Partner closely with GDO leadership and enterprise stakeholders to align transformation priorities, resource needs, and execution plans.

**External Representation and internal stakeholder partnerships**

* Collaborate across the external life sciences landscape, Tech and SaaS providers, AI&D, DTI and GDO functions to ensure strategic initiatives, transformation activities, and operational priorities remain aligned and effectively executed.
* Support evaluation and integration activities related to new technologies, external partnerships, and organizational transformation opportunities, including M&A activities as applicable.
* Maintain external awareness of industry trends, competitive capabilities, and innovation opportunities that may enhance operational quality, efficiency, speed, and scalability.

**What We Expect Of You**
We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The candidate we seek is an experienced leader with the following qualifications.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications:**

* Master’s with 15+ years of clinical data landscape transformation execution experience OR
* Bachelor’s with 18+ years of clinical data landscape transformation execution experience AND
* 5 years of managerial experience directly managing people and/or leadership experience leading teams, projects, programs or directing the allocation of resources

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 15+ years of experience in clinical development, clinical operations, operational excellence, business transformation, program management, or related functions within the biopharmaceutical industry.
* Demonstrated success leading large-scale enterprise transformation initiatives, including tech transformation, process modernization, organizational change management, and business capability development.
* Experience implementing and scaling AI-enabled solutions, automation technologies, advanced analytics, and digital capabilities within clinical development or other regulated environments.
* Proven ability to establish and lead as a business product owner supporting complex, cross-functional strategic initiatives and program execution.
* Should have lead at least 1 major transformation/Migration of CTMS, EDC and CDR/DQS
* Technical Knowledge: Experience with AI, digital health and informatics tools that may advance ways of working within the clinical trial ecosystem.

**Core Competencies:**

* Enterprise cross-functional leadership across clinical data landscape with deep functional process expertise.
* Deep understanding of clinical operations technologies, AI-enabled capabilities, automation, digital platforms, and enterprise data strategy.
* Expertise leading large-scale transformation initiatives, of process and foundational technologies for Global Development Operations
* Experience driving process, data, and technology transformation, digital enablement, and organizational change management within highly matrixed environments.
* Strategic thinking with the ability to advance business performance through innovation, technology transformation and adoption, and modernization of clinical operations capabilities.

They will also embody the Amgen leadership attributes which are:
  
  

* Inspire: Create a connected, inclusive, and inspiring work environment that empowers talent to thrive
* Accelerate: Enable speed that matches the urgency of patient needs by encouraging progress over perfection
* Integrate: Connect the dots to amplify the collective power of Amgen to drive results for patients, staff, and shareholders
* Adapt: Lead through change by adapting to an ever-changing environment and defining a clear course of action to deliver results

**What You Can Expect Of Us**
As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.
  
  
As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of diverse, ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease.

title: Controls Engineer, Controls Deployment and Service
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
The Data Center Capacity Delivery Asia-Pacific Controls Deployment and Service (DCCD APAC CDS) team delivers and services the control systems that ensure the health of AWS data centers. Operating across Australia & New Zealand, India, North Asia, and Southeast Asia, APAC CDS manages 41 leased/owned sites and supports global follow-the-sun operations. APAC CDS covers three core disciplines: deployments (control systems in new data centers), projects (controls capital improvement works at live sites), and service (control systems at live sites), with additional specializations in colocated sites, systems engineering, controls fleet, program management, and coordination.  
  
As Amazonians, we work in a competitive environment. Our customers are always beautifully, wonderfully dissatisfied. Being successful in our roles is not just about doing our jobs well, but also evolving and innovating. Change is the only constant, and applies to our customers, our roles, our team organization, our tools, and our mechanisms.  
  
To be successful in this team, you will also have:
  

* Ability to thrive at the pace and scale of Amazon
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple competing priorities
* Ability and willingness to collaborate with peers around the globe, which may involve some participation in meetings at odd hours
* Ability and willingness to travel domestically or globally as and when needed

  
Controls Deployment & Service (CDS) Engineers deliver and support data center building automation systems, such as Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS). CDS Engineers work to deploy and service building automation systems, to ensure the health of our data centers. As a CDS Engineer, you may oversee deployment of a new BMS or EPMS as part of a new data center build, deliver projects to upgrade an existing data center owned or leased by Amazon, or deliver projects to upgrade colocated data centers with Amazon hardware. As a CDS Engineer, you may also be required to provide local servicing expertise to our fleet or data centers in your region, and occasionally assist with global support. Successfully working as a CDS Engineer will also require you to partner effectively with the many teams at Amazon that make our data center deployments and operations a success, including Construction, Commissioning, Critical Projects, Data Center Operations, Procurement, Program Management, Design, and Engineering teams, as well as maintaining strong relationships with our vendors.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Deployment of data center controls, on time, with effective management of vendors to ensure minimal defects at the point of Power and Facilities Hand-Off (PFHO)  

* Delivery of critical projects to upgrade data center automation
* Service and support provided to partner teams, providing diagnosis and resolution of Loss of Visibility (LOV), Loss of Resilience (LOR), Large Scale Event (LSE), Critical Scale Event (CSE), and other operations impacting events
* Resolution of tasks within predefined Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
* Delivery of further initiatives to improve the efficiency of our data centers or our operations procedures

  
A day in the life  
Join the cloud leader: AWS has the most proven operational and security expertise, and the business is innovating at a faster clip—especially in new areas such as Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence, the Internet of Things, Serverless Computing, and custom-designed processors and chips.  

* Be at the nexus of action: Your involvement in data center delivery will be mission-critical to the successful deployment of our data centers. You won’t just be observing from the sidelines; you’ll be representing Amazon, building relationships across a wide variety of internal and external stakeholders.
* Build at scale: Build and operate infrastructure at an enormous scale, participating in Amazon’s global presence.
* Your unique background will be an asset: At Amazon, our ability to innovate on behalf of our global customers and communities is dependent upon the skills, perspectives, and knowledge of people from all backgrounds.
* Continuous growth and learning: You may not be an expert in AWS when you join our company, but you will have support to become one. Benefit from direct access to industry-leading specialists, latest training materials, and courses to propel your career.

  
About the team  
Inclusive Team Culture  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our department, Data Center Planning and Delivery (DCPD), sponsors a Women's Leadership Program that supports the growth and development of female builders across the organization. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events build stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation draws on the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 2+ years of relevant work experience
* Experience in MS Excel, Word, and Windows Operating Systems

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 4+ years of data center engineering experience
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
* Knowledge of network design and layout as well as low voltage (copper/ fiber) cabling
* Can perform physical tasks all day without becoming overly tired

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: IT Head
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a seasoned, strategic **Head of IT** to lead the technology architecture, digital transformation, and operational resilience across our diverse business verticals: **Media Production Studios, Commercial Malls, and Multiplex/Theater Operations**.

The ideal candidate possesses a unique blend of enterprise IT infrastructure management, high-performance media/post-production workflow expertise, and smart-building/retail IT operations (POS, building management integration, high-density public Wi-Fi, and digital cinema/exhibition technologies). You will drive operational excellence, enforce robust cybersecurity frameworks, and align technology investments with organizational growth.

Key Responsibilities**1. Enterprise & Smart Infrastructure Management (Malls & Corporate)**

· Oversee the end-to-end enterprise IT infrastructure, including data centers, server farms, enterprise storage, virtualization (VMware/Hyper-V), and hybrid cloud environments (AWS/Azure).

· Manage mission-critical IT systems for commercial mall operations, ensuring high availability of Building Management Systems (BMS), Public Address (PA) systems, CCTV/surveillance networks, and automated access controls.

· Architect and maintain high-density public Wi-Fi networks, structured cabling, and robust switching/routing backbones (L2/L3) across retail and office spaces.

· Oversee disaster recovery (DR) planning, business continuity drills, and power redundancy systems (UPS/Generators) for 24/7 retail and entertainment environments.

**2. Multiplex, Cinema & Digital Exhibition Technology**

· Oversee IT and networking infrastructure supporting digital cinema projection systems, server ingestion, and Theatre Management Systems (TMS).

· Manage automated scheduling, digital signage, box office ticketing kiosks, and secure content delivery (KDM/DCP management) in coordination with content distributors.

· Ensure ultra-low latency and absolute uptime for live-streaming, event screenings, and concessionaire point-of-sale (POS) networks.

**3. Post-Production & Media Studio Technology**

· Support high-performance media workflows including non-linear editing (Avid, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve), VFX, animation, sound design, and heavy rendering farms.

· Administer high-speed SAN/NAS environments optimized for uncompressed 4K/8K real-time collaboration.

· Manage Media Asset Management (MAM) systems, secure ingest/transcoding pipelines, and long-term digital archiving/retrieval processes.

**4. Retail & Point-of-Sale (POS) Operations**

· Ensure 99.99% uptime for mission-critical retail POS terminals, payment gateway integrations, inventory management databases, and merchant Wi-Fi networks within mall premises.

· Coordinate with tenant IT teams and retail partners to ensure seamless network integration and compliance with centre guidelines.

**5. Cybersecurity, Compliance & Data Privacy**

**Responsibilities:**

**Cleanroom HVAC Package: Lead the team to perform the activities below:**

* Perform Design and selection of HVAC system for Cleanroom, production areas, semiconductor FAB areas and dry rooms.
* Make up air unit selections using Cooling/Heating/Humidification & De-humidification load calculations, Cleanroom sensible cooling with Dry cooling coils, LT/MT Chiller selections, Hot water requirement, Humidifier selections, humidity/ Dew Point control philosophies and control system design with all equipment and systems
* Plan and support other teams in Chilled water generation Plant Design and selection of cooling tower, Pumps, Primary/secondary circuits etc.
* CFD analysis review and optimization to achieve uniform cleanroom conditions.
* Energy saving options selection to optimize the running cost.
* Conceptual design, planning and project engineering of cleanrooms and dry rooms.
* Prepare designs, coordination, planning and execution of engineering projects.
* Preparation of Technical Proposals and Engineering reports.
* Support development of overall facility design, interior layouts and master planning to address
  + Cleanroom Classification/zoning
  + Cleanroom Pressure Zones
  + Temperature & Relative Humidity Zones
  + Classified Equipment Layout
* Preparation of Tender drawings and functional specifications.
* Review and approve contractor Submittals.
* Review of Process package for completeness of process related data.
* Preparation of PFDs, P&IDs for Process Cooling Water systems (PCW) and development of specifications and layouts for Semiconductor facilities with integration of Tools Layout.

**Process Mechanical packages:Lead the team to perform below activities:**

* Understanding the utility requirements for Process Mechanical Packages from TUM.
* Develop the Equipment layout for Process Exhaust, Process Vacuum, Compressor & PCW system.
* Calculate system flow, pressure requirement.
* Develop the piping layout, Ducting layout.

* Conduct the Hydraulic calculation for the different streams.

Coordinate multidisciplinary engineering teams (process, mechanical, electrical, CSA, automation) to ensure alignment across design deliverables

**Equipment & Technology Integration:**

* Knowledge of functions and dimensions of various semiconductor process equipment used in facilities.
* Collaborate with vendors for equipment selection during design phases, gather installation needs, and validation.

**Compliance & Standards:**

* Ensure adherence to industry regulations SEMI, ISO, ASHRAE, ASME, SMACNA, NBC, NFPA etc.
* Ensure adherence to ASME/API/SEMI/CPCB/Other regulatory standards.
* Knowledge of applicable international standards and local country standards.
* Work with regulatory bodies and internal teams to meet safety and environmental requirements.
* Ensure compliance with industry standards, safety regulations, and company procedures.

**Collaboration & Coordination:**

* Coordinate with disciplines to ensure clash free and code compliant designs.
* Coordination with process utilities, base-build utilities, architecture and structural design and participating in IDC process
* Support during Construction for cleanroom protocol, Installation and certification
* Support process/ utilities/ construction interfaces
* Work closely with architects, MEP engineers, and facility planners for efficient utility layout designs.
* Review vendor drawings, datasheets, and technical documents
* Coordinate with clients and stakeholders to align process requirements with project goals.
* Support Business Development and proposal activities
* Hire the team and train as per the need of the business plan

**Project Documentation:**

* Preparing presentation material that helps stake holders in strategic decision making and subsequently engineering concepts
* Prepare and update: Design Basis Report for Classified HVAC systems, process mechanical systems and Coordinate Design & Engineering deliverables as per project engineering deliverables schedule
* Monitor work progress and ensure compliance with the project quality requirements and schedule

**Experience & Qualification:**

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in mechanical engineering.

**Experience:**

* **20+ years** of experience in Cleanroom, HVAC Design and process mechanical systems engineering.
* Semiconductor fab project experience is must.

**Technical Skills:**

* Strong knowledge of utility design for semiconductor OSAT facilities and FABs.
* Experience with CFD, Energy modeling and simulation tools.
* Proficiency in software tools like AutoCAD, Revit, Navisworks BIM and IES-VE.
* Experience with engineering software such as Pipe flow, Pipenet similar tools
* Knowledge of ACC -Audo desk Cloud portal.

**Soft Skills:**

* Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making abilities.
* Strong communication skills for cross-functional teamwork and client interactions.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and work in a fast-paced environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in **greenfield and brownfield Advanced Manufacturing cleanroom facilities, Semiconductor front end and back end FAB**.
* Familiarity with **sustainability practices** in semiconductor manufacturing.

**Why Join AECOM:**

AECOM is a global leader in engineering, design, and construction services, offering exciting career opportunities and a collaborative work environment.

We are committed to fostering the professional growth and development of our employees, providing access to training, mentorship programs, and challenging projects.

At AECOM, you will have the opportunity to work on iconic projects across diverse sectors, including data center, commercial, airport, and industrial, making a positive impact on communities around the world and shaping a sustainable future for generations to come.

If you are passionate about MEP engineering and have extensive experience in leading projects across data center, commercial, airport, and industrial sectors, we encourage you to apply and become part of the AECOM team.

title: Engineering Manager - APAC OKYC
description:
**Company Description**

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.  
**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.  
**For everyone, everywhere.**

More about **our mission** and **what we offer**.

 **Job Description**

We are looking for an Engineering Lead to join our APAC Onboarding and KYC team in the Hyderabad office.

At Wise, Onboarding and KYC is one of our highest-leverage domains. It is the crucial first interaction millions of people and businesses have with us in APAC - one of our largest and fastest-growing markets. But there is an equally vital side that customers never see: trust, safety, and risk. Getting this right means building high-quality controls that accelerate legitimate growth while actively derisking our markets and firmly locking bad actors out of the global financial system.

As the Engineering Lead for APAC Onboarding and KYC, you will lead and grow a dedicated team that holistically owns KYC and Fincrime risk for the region across aspects of customer experience, control effectiveness and operational scalability.

**What you’ll be doing:**

* Lead the engineering team: Lead, coach, and mentor a team of engineers. Own what they ship, their well-being, and foster a culture of collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Own technical excellence: Architect for scale and resilience so we can adapt to regulatory changes quickly. Ensure appropriate on-call rotas, observability, and SLAs for critical services. Join the team's on-call rotation.
* Stay close to the code: Understand the team's systems deeply enough to be hands-on when needed. Review designs and PRs, assist the team in solving hard problems, and lead by example.
* Stakeholder management: Work closely with first, second, and third line teams (Operations, Risk & Compliance, and Internal Audit) to ensure engineering solutions align with the regulations.
* Co-own product roadmap: Partner with Product Managers to decide what's worth building, break down complex projects into incremental milestones, and ensure we balance fast iteration with long-term platform health.

 **Qualifications**

At Wise, Engineering Leads who manage a single team stay close to the implementation details, meaning strong technical expertise, architectural knowledge, and a willingness to remain hands-on are essential to succeed in this role. If you bring a strong mix of these core technical and leadership capabilities, we’d love to hear from you.

* Experience leading and mentoring software engineers (even if you manage a smaller team of 2-3 as a Tech Lead or Senior Engineer) and owning what they deliver.

* You give people context and direction, empower them to own their work, and know how to navigate ongoing product expansion.
* You have solid Java (17+) knowledge and hands-on experience with Spring / Spring Boot, and you're happy to stay hands-on when the team needs it.
* Deep understanding of distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and microservices, with comfort making high-impact architectural decisions
* You have led the design and delivery of complex engineering solutions and understand their broader impact on business outcomes — including trade-offs between short-term product wins and long-term platform health.
* A product engineer’s mindset—you measure your work by customer and business impact and make data-driven decisions to fix customer pain points.

* A clear communicator who can articulate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, across geographies and time zones.
* Bias to action and comfort with ambiguity: you move quickly without dropping quality.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with financial systems, payments, or digital onboarding flows.
* Understanding of the technical challenges of integrating third-party verification providers, managing sensitive identity data, and building modular KYC workflows adapted for different regulatory bodies.

**What you can expect as an Engineering Lead at Wise:**

We don't measure seniority purely by years of experience, but by the impact you create and the complexity of problems you can help solve. As an EL1 at Wise, you will be given the licence to:

* Balance technical domain ownership with people leadership.
* Execute large cross functional projects, either directly or through your team, that have a meaningful impact on Wise products and customers globally.
* Propose ideas to improve and grow your team’s product while acting as a trusted partner to your regional counterparts.
* Embrace long-term ownership of projects while training other engineers to reduce single points of failure.

 **Additional Information**

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.  
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.

Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

title: RHEL Systems Administrator (L2)
description:
Experience Required: 4–5 Years
  
  
Work Schedule: 24/7 Rotational Shifts (including weekends and on-call support)
  
  
Mandatory Certification: Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA)
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for an experienced L2 Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) Systems Administrator to manage, troubleshoot, and automate our enterprise Linux infrastructure. You will handle L2 production escalations, perform root cause analysis (RCA), manage large-scale patching, and ensure high availability, security, and performance across RHEL 7, 8, and 9 environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
L2 Production Support & Troubleshooting: Resolve escalated incidents, perform root cause analysis (RCA), and troubleshoot boot failures, OS performance bottlenecks (CPU, memory, disk I/O), network issues, and SELinux/firewall blocks.
  
  
System Administration: Administer and maintain RHEL 7, 8, and 9 servers, including user/group management, permissions, systemd services, scheduled tasks, and OS upgrades/migrations.
  
  
Storage Management: Configure and manage Logical Volume Manager (LVM), XFS/EXT4 filesystems, NFS shares, iSCSI targets/initiators, and SAN LUNs with multipathing.
  
  
Automation & Scripting: Develop and maintain Ansible playbooks and Bash/Shell scripts to automate repetitive administrative tasks, configuration management, health checks, and bulk deployments.
  
  
Enterprise Patching: Plan, schedule, and execute monthly security and errata patching across Linux servers using Red Hat Satellite (managing Content Views, Repositories, and Lifecycle Environments), including pre-patch checks and rollbacks.
  
  
Security & OS Hardening: Implement OS hardening standards (such as CIS benchmarks), manage SSH/firewall policies, and remediate security vulnerabilities.
  
  
Cross-Platform & Tooling Support: Provide basic administrative support for Windows Server environments and utilize ManageEngine tools for monitoring, ticketing, and endpoint management.
  
  
**Required Skills & Qualifications**
Experience: 4–5 years of hands-on experience in enterprise Linux administration and L2 production support.
  
  
Operating Systems: Deep working knowledge of Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL 7, 8, and 9).
  
  
Storage: Strong practical experience with LVM, XFS, EXT4, NFS, SAN, and iSCSI.
  
  
Automation: Proven ability to write Bash/Shell scripts and build Ansible playbooks for infrastructure automation.
  
  
Patch Management: Hands-on experience managing and patching enterprise environments using Red Hat Satellite.
  
  
Security: Familiarity with Linux hardening practices, SELinux, and firewalld/iptables.
  
  
Additional Skills: Working knowledge of Windows OS administration and ManageEngine suites.
  
  
Operational Readiness: Willingness and ability to work in a 24/7 rotational shift model, including weekend coverage and on-call rotations.
  
  
**Certifications**
Mandatory: Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA)
  
  
Preferred: Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE)

description:
Vertiv is looking for a Sr. Supplier Quality Engineer (Sheet metal & enclosures / Power Switching / Electronics Manufacturing Services / Transformers / Heat Exchangers, Fans & Coils / Power switching / Compressors / Cables & Wiring / Metal Plumbing and Pipping) to develop, evaluate, and improve the Vertiv product supplier base through quality management system and product process audits. The Sr. Supplier Quality Engineer Expert is responsible to maintain working relationships with suppliers to ensure the highest quality possible of purchased components / materials with a focus on continuous improvement. The Sr. Supplier Quality Engineer Expert is responsible for pursuing quality objectives, ensuring timely delivery of project PPAPs, and driving the development and continuous improvement of our supplier base.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Initiate and lead supplier performance improvement by partnering with supplier to identify, understand and abate issues for New Product Development Introduction (NPDI), Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) as well as Mass Production.
* Assure OEE, production cycle time, capacity utilization, throughput requirements are met in the pre-launch and post-launch phases.
* Implement world class manufacturing industrialization readiness at our suppliers through a robust APQP process
* Monitor and address supplier nonconformance issues by developing robust quality control plans and implementing effective, sustainable corrective actions.
* Drive permanent resolution of supplier issues reported by Vertiv facilities and by Customers.
* Lead and own PPAP requirements associated with new programs or change management.
* Lead problem definition and preventative problem solving through containment, identification of root cause and corrective action with Supplier Corrective Action Report (SCAR).
* Develop Root Cause Analysis and supplier reports on reported issues. Communicate internally and externally on outcomes of investigations. Work with internal teams, including Engineering, Service, Manufacturing / Operations, Sales, Offering Management, and Plants Quality to resolve quality issues impacting Vertiv facilities and customers.
* Ability to simplify complex information and concisely prepare both verbal and written executive summaries for the Leadership Team.
* Perform supplier on-site audits to monitor supplier Quality Management System (QMS) compliance and effectiveness.
* Identify areas for quality improvements.
* Visit Suppliers to proactively see installations and document improvement needs. Visit suppliers to understand the nature of the issue and get definite corrective action initiated in the organization.
* Evaluate potential new suppliers by conducting on-site audits and scoring of Quality Management System
* Monthly reporting and status updates to management on Supplier performance and various quality initiatives to business management.
* Supports the execution and maintenance of an ISO 9001 certified Quality Management System.
Other responsibilities may be assigned from time to time as needed, based on the evolution of the company and the requirements of the department/position.

**Minimum Job Qualifications:**

* At least 5 years of experience in a Supplier Quality Engineer role or related fields.

* Leader of people, mentoring and coaching others to improve the organization technical knowledge
* High technical expert, supporting all proactive, preventive and reactive strategies for supplier quality on a regional and global scope
* Experienced with problem solving tools and techniques (i.e. 8-D, 5 Whys, SCAR, Fishbone, Pareto, Six Sigma, PPAP).
* Can manage multiple tasks based on priority, difficulty and severity.
Background in applying statistical tools for process and product development and control (i.e. Gage R&R, Process Capability, Control Plans, SPC, Process Failure Mode Effects Analysis (PFMEA).  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 5-10 years of experience in a Supplier Quality Engineer role or related fields.

title: Founder's Office Executive
description:
**THE ROLE**

**This role has two core responsibilities that run in parallel:**

**1. Founder’s Office Support**

You work directly with the Founder to ensure her office runs with zero friction. You own her calendar, attend key meetings, document decisions, and make sure every commitment is tracked and followed through on. You’re her first line of filter — things come to you before they reach her.

**2. Client Servicing — Founder’s Portfolio**

The Founder manages a set of high-value clients directly. You will be the operational backbone of that relationship — coordinating with internal teams, ensuring client communication is prompt and polished, tracking deliverables, and making sure these clients always feel looked after, even when the Founder is unavailable.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

**Founder’s Office**

* Own and manage the Founder’s calendar — proactively block team reviews, client meetings, and focus time every month
* Attend key meetings, take precise notes, and send action items with owners and deadlines within 24 hours
* Review EOD updates from assigned teams against defined checklists and give first-level structured feedback
* Build internal presentations, reports, and briefs independently, working from a brief given by the Founder
* Act as a coordination hub between the Founder and internal teams — track what’s promised, chase what’s pending
* Filter escalations — resolve what you can, batch what genuinely needs the Founder’s attention

**Client Servicing**

* Be the primary point of contact for clients in the Founder’s portfolio for day-to-day operational matters
* Manage client communication — emails, follow-ups, status updates — with speed and professionalism
* Coordinate internally with event ops, accounts, sales, and vendor teams to deliver on client commitments
* Prepare client-facing documents — event decks, proposals, status summaries — independently and accurately
* Track all open items across client accounts and ensure nothing slips without a proactive update
* Flag risks early and escalate with context, not just problems

**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

**Non-Negotiables**

✓ Exceptional written and verbal communication in English — precise, professional, no fluff

✓ Comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or similar) as a daily productivity layer — not just aware of them, actively using them

✓ High ownership mindset — you close loops, you don’t leave things open

✓ Ability to manage multiple priorities without dropping quality

✓ Calm under pressure, especially in client-facing situations

✓ Proficiency in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Gmail, Calendar) and task management tools

**Good to Have**

* Prior experience in events, hospitality, or client servicing
* Experience working directly with a founder, CEO, or senior leadership
* Ability to create polished presentations with minimal direction
* Familiarity with CRM or project tracking tools

**HOW YOU’LL BE MEASURED**

This role is not measured by hours. It’s measured by outcomes.

* Are the Founder’s clients receiving responses within SLA, without her having to follow up?
* Are meeting action items tracked and closed before the next meeting?
* Are deliverables going out on time, complete, and right the first time?
* Is the Founder spending less time on operational follow-through — not more?

**WHAT WORKING HERE LOOKS LIKE**

You’ll be operating in a fast-moving, high-accountability environment. The Founder is hands-on and has high standards — she will invest in your growth if you invest in the quality of your work. You’ll get direct exposure to how a scaled founder-led business operates, real client relationships from day one, and a team that takes execution seriously.

We don’t do handholding. We do clarity, feedback, and growth.

description:
**Job Title:**

**Import–Export & Supply Chain Executive / Manager (Nutraceuticals & Pharmaceuticals)**

**Department:**

Supply Chain / Domestic & International Trade

**Reporting To:**

Operation Head

**Position Overview:**

Responsible for **import and export operations** within the **Nutraceutical and Pharmaceutical** sector. The role ensures **regulatory compliance, documentation accuracy, logistics efficiency**, and smooth coordination between domestic and international partners — from supplier to end customer.

The incumbent will manage **imports of raw materials, packaging materials, and finished goods**, as well as **exports of formulations**, ensuring adherence to **Indian Customs, DGFT, CDSCO, and other regulatory authorities**.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Import Operations:**

* Handle **import transactions** for ingredients, finished formulations, raw materials, and packaging items.
* Prepare and verify **import documentation & Handle Compliance** of the same.
* Coordinate with **freight forwarders, CHA, transporters, and suppliers** for shipment clearance and timely delivery.
* Ensure compliance with **Indian Customs, DGFT, FSSAI, and CDSCO** norms for import of nutraceutical and pharmaceutical products.
* Track shipment status, calculate **landed cost**, and manage **duty payments (BCD, IGST, etc.)** and optimize Transport lead time.
* Maintain updated import documentation for audit and regulatory purposes.

**Export Operations:**

* Handle **export documentation** – Shipping Bill, Commercial Invoice, Packing List, COA, COO, MSDS (if applicable), and relevant export declarations.
* Coordinate with **export regulatory authorities** for NOC, product registration, and country-specific compliance (e.g., Free Sale Certificate, COPP).
* Liaise with freight forwarders and transporters for **container booking, shipment scheduling, and delivery confirmation**.
* Manage **export incentives and licensing** under DGFT schemes (MEIS/RoDTEP).
* Ensure compliance with **CDSCO, FSSAI**, and destination-country requirements for nutraceutical/pharma exports.

**Supply Chain & Logistics Coordination:**

* Collaborate with **procurement, production, QA/QC, and warehouse** teams to ensure smooth flow of materials.
* Oversee **inventory control, logistics optimization, and vendor performance**.
* Manage **logistics partners**, ensuring cold chain or controlled-temperature handling (if applicable).
* Optimise **lead times, cost efficiency**, and resolve supply chain bottlenecks.
* Update system with accurate transaction and shipment data.

**Compliance & Reporting:**

* Ensure full compliance with **EXIM Policy, Drugs & Cosmetics Act, and allied regulatory frameworks**.
* Liaise with **DGFT, Customs, CDSCO, and FSSAI** for approvals, documentation, and renewals.
* Maintain and submit **MIS reports** on import/export status, shipment cost, and inventory movement.
* Support **internal and external audits**, ensuring proper documentation and regulatory readiness.

**Qualifications & Experience:**

* Graduation in Science background with post-graduation in logistic & Supply Chain Management.
* **3–5 years of experience** in **import–export and supply chain operations for finished formulations** (Nutraceuticals/Pharmaceuticals).
* Strong understanding of **customs procedures, DGFT/EXIM documentation, FSSAI, and CDSCO regulations**.
* Proficient in MS Word and MS Excel for documentation, reporting, and coordination.
* Experience with **cold chain / temperature-sensitive** logistics preferred will be an added advantage.

**Key Competencies:**

* In-depth knowledge of **domestic &** **international trade and pharma regulatory frameworks**.
* High attention to detail in documentation and compliance.
* Strong coordination, analytical, and negotiation skills.
* Excellent communication with cross-functional and global teams.
* Ability to work under strict timelines and manage multiple shipments concurrently.
* Ability to lead & coordinate across different teams.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: ₹600,000.00 - ₹800,000.00 per year

description:
**Department:** Accounts & Finance  
**Designation:** Accounts Coordinator  
**Reporting To:** Accounts Manager / Finance Head/CA  
**Location:** Ghatkopar / Head Office  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

1. Job Purpose

The Senior Accounts Coordinator will be responsible for coordinating and supporting day-to-day accounting and finance activities, ensuring accurate accounting records, timely reconciliations, statutory compliance, vendor/customer coordination and preparation of financial and MIS reports.

The role requires strong coordination with internal departments, vendors, customers, banks, auditors and external consultants to ensure smooth and timely completion of accounting activities.

2. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Accounting Operations

* Handle day-to-day accounting transactions, including purchase, sales, receipt, payment and journal entries.
* Verify invoices, vouchers and supporting documents before accounting.
* Maintain accurate ledgers and accounting records.
* Monitor Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable.
* Ensure proper accounting of expenses, provisions and accruals.
* Assist in monthly, quarterly and yearly closing of accounts.
* Support preparation and finalisation of financial statements.

B. Reconciliation & Control

* Prepare and review Bank Reconciliation Statements (BRS).
* Perform customer, vendor and general ledger reconciliations.
* Identify and resolve outstanding and unreconciled items.
* Reconcile GST input/output balances with books and available GST data.
* Monitor advances, outstanding receivables and payables.
* Ensure proper documentation and accounting controls.

C. GST & TDS Compliance

* Prepare data and working for GST returns and coordinate with consultants for timely filing.
* Verify GST applicability, input tax credit and tax-related entries.
* Prepare TDS workings and ensure correct deduction as applicable.
* Coordinate for timely TDS payment, returns and reconciliation.
* Maintain records related to GST, TDS and other statutory requirements.
* Assist in responding to statutory notices and queries, wherever required.

D. Vendor & Customer Coordination

* Coordinate with vendors regarding invoices, payments, outstanding balances and account statements.
* Coordinate with customers for outstanding payments and reconciliation.
* Obtain missing invoices, debit/credit notes and supporting documents.
* Resolve accounting discrepancies with respective departments and external parties.
* Maintain proper records of vendor and customer communications.

E. Banking & Payments

* Coordinate with banks for routine banking activities.
* Prepare payment-related documents and supporting schedules.
* Verify bank transactions and ensure timely accounting.
* Assist in NEFT/RTGS/cheque payment processes as per company approval procedures.
* Follow up on pending banking and payment-related matters.

F. MIS & Management Reporting

* Prepare periodic Accounts MIS reports as required by management.
* Prepare ageing reports for receivables and payables.
* Prepare outstanding, collection and payment status reports.
* Provide financial data and analysis to the Accounts Manager / Finance Head.
* Maintain trackers for statutory payments, reconciliations and important accounting deadlines.

G. Audit & Compliance Support

* Coordinate with statutory, internal and tax auditors.
* Provide accounting records, ledgers, reconciliations and supporting documents for audits.
* Assist in preparation of audit schedules and responses to audit queries.
* Ensure proper filing and maintenance of financial and statutory records.

H. Internal Coordination

* Coordinate with Purchase, Sales, Stores, HR, Administration and other departments for accounting-related requirements.
* Ensure timely receipt of documents required for accounting and compliance.
* Follow up with respective departments for pending documents and approvals.
* Support the Accounts Manager / Finance Head in special assignments and process improvements.

3. Required Qualification

* B.Com / M.Com / MBA (Finance) or equivalent qualification.
* CA Inter / CMA Inter will be an added advantage.

4. Experience

* **3–10 years of relevant experience** in Accounts & Finance.
* Experience in a manufacturing / trading / corporate environment will be preferred.
* Candidates with strong hands-on experience in Tally and statutory compliance will be preferred.

5. Required Skills

* Strong knowledge of accounting principles and practices.
* Hands-on knowledge of **Tally ERP / Tally Prime** or similar accounting software.
* Good knowledge of **GST and TDS**.
* Strong knowledge of Bank, Vendor, Customer and Ledger Reconciliation.
* Good command of **MS Excel**, including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, SUMIF/SUMIFS and basic financial reporting.
* Strong analytical and numerical skills.
* Good written and verbal communication.
* Strong follow-up and coordination skills.
* High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.
* Ability to handle confidential financial information responsibly.

6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Accuracy and timely completion of accounting entries.
* Timely completion of bank, vendor and customer reconciliations.
* Timely submission of GST/TDS data and compliance workings.
* Reduction of outstanding unreconciled items.
* Timely preparation of MIS and management reports.
* Timely resolution of vendor/customer accounting discrepancies.
* Audit readiness and timely submission of audit documents.
* Compliance with company accounting policies and internal controls.

7. Behavioural Competencies

* Ownership and accountability
* Strong coordination and follow-up
* Integrity and confidentiality
* Attention to detail
* Problem-solving ability
* Time management
* Teamwork and collaboration
* Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines

To ensure all Production Machinery/Tools are in good working condition through planned Preventive/Predictive maintenance and through adequate breakdown maintenance. Ensure fully functional maintenance dept.

title: L1 NOC Systems Engineer – Linux / RHEL
description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for an enthusiastic and technically competent L1 NOC Systems Engineer to monitor, support, and maintain Linux-based server infrastructure.

The candidate will be responsible for monitoring system availability, identifying infrastructure alerts, performing first-level troubleshooting, handling incidents, and escalating unresolved issues to L2/L3 teams within defined SLA timelines.

The ideal candidate should have practical knowledge of Linux/RHEL administration, basic networking, server monitoring, troubleshooting, and incident management.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Linux Server Monitoring & Support

- Monitor Linux/RHEL servers and infrastructure through monitoring tools.

- Check server availability, CPU, memory, disk utilization, and filesystem status.

- Monitor system services, processes, and resource utilization.

- Identify server alerts, service failures, and infrastructure abnormalities.

- Perform basic health checks and routine operational activities.

2. L1 Linux Administration

- Perform basic Linux commands and filesystem operations.

- Check disk space, mount points, memory, CPU, and system uptime.

- Monitor and check Linux services using systemctl and service commands.

- Check system logs using journalctl, /var/log/messages, and other relevant logs.

- Perform basic user and group management.

- Check file permissions, ownership, and directory access.

- Perform basic process monitoring and troubleshooting.

- Execute approved service restarts and operational procedures.

3. Incident Management & Troubleshooting

- Acknowledge and investigate monitoring alerts.

- Perform initial troubleshooting for server connectivity, service availability, and performance issues.

- Create, update, and track incident tickets.

- Follow incident management and escalation procedures.

- Escalate unresolved or complex issues to L2/L3 teams with proper troubleshooting details.

- Ensure incidents are handled within agreed SLA timelines.

- Maintain shift handover reports and incident updates.

4. Infrastructure & Networking Support

- Basic understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, gateways, and routing.

- Troubleshoot basic connectivity using ping, traceroute, netstat, ss, and nslookup.

- Check SSH connectivity and remote server accessibility.

- Identify basic network-related issues affecting server availability.

- Coordinate with network, database, storage, and application teams when required.

5. Operational Activities

- Perform daily server health checks.

- Monitor backup job status and report failures.

- Monitor filesystem utilization and raise capacity alerts.

- Follow standard operating procedures (SOPs) and checklists.

- Maintain operational documentation and knowledge-base records.

- Participate in planned maintenance activities under supervision.

- Ensure proper shift handover and communication.

**Technical Skills Required**

\*\*Linux / RHEL\*\*

- Basic to intermediate knowledge of Red Hat Enterprise Linux.

- Linux commands: top, ps, df, du, free, uptime, vmstat, iostat, grep, awk, sed, find, tail.

- Filesystem, partitions, mount points, and permissions.

- User and group administration.

- Service and process management.

- Log monitoring and troubleshooting.

- SSH and basic shell scripting knowledge.

**\*\*Networking\*\***

- TCP/IP fundamentals.

- DNS, DHCP, gateway, subnetting, and routing basics.

- SSH and connectivity troubleshooting.

- Basic understanding of firewalls and ports.

**\*\*Monitoring & ITSM\*\***

- Exposure to Nagios, Zabbix, SolarWinds, Prometheus, Grafana, or similar monitoring platforms.

- Familiarity with ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, or other ticketing systems.

- Understanding of incident, problem, and change management.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

- 1–3 years of experience in Linux system administration or NOC operations.

- Hands-on exposure to RHEL/CentOS/Rocky Linux.

- Good troubleshooting and analytical skills.

- Ability to work in a 24×7 rotational shift environment.

- Good communication and incident reporting skills.

- Ability to follow SOPs and escalation matrices.

- Willingness to learn and work in a critical infrastructure support environment.

**L1 Role Expectations**

The L1 NOC Systems Engineer is expected to:

- Monitor infrastructure proactively.

- Identify and acknowledge alerts promptly.

- Perform standard first-level troubleshooting.

- Resolve routine issues using approved SOPs.

- Escalate complex issues to L2/L3 with complete diagnostic information.

- Maintain accurate incident records and shift handover reports.

- Ensure SLA compliance and minimize service downtime.

**\*\*Primary Objective:\*\***

Maintain infrastructure availability through continuous monitoring, prompt first-level troubleshooting, accurate incident management, and timely escalation to higher-level support teams.

title: R&D Head
description:
**About Us**

Twintech Control Systems is a Pune-based, ISO 9001:2015 certified manufacturer of magnetic speed sensors and industrial instrumentation, including Hall-effect sensors, tacho hour meters, RPM indicators and CAN bus displays. Our products are used by leading engine and genset OEMs and sold through a dealer network across India. With in-house electronics design and manufacturing, we are scaling up and building strong department-level systems for our next phase of growth.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced R&D Head to lead electronics hardware and firmware development for our sensors, meters and displays. You will turn the product roadmap into reliable, manufacturable, cost-effective products, and build the design release and documentation system behind them. This is a hands-on role: in a team our size, you will design and debug yourself as well as lead the team.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product design and development**

* Lead development of new products, upgrades and customer-specific variants, working from the product roadmap and customer requirements.

* Translate requirements into technical specifications; design and review circuits personally, including sensor signal conditioning, power supplies, microcontroller boards and communication interfaces (CAN, RS485).

* Oversee PCB design and lead firmware development on microcontroller platforms such as STM32, including hardware–firmware integration.

* Troubleshoot hardware and firmware issues and guide the team in resolving them.

**Project and team management**

* Plan projects with milestones, resources and timelines, and deliver on schedule; keep management informed of progress, delays and resource needs.

* Allocate technical responsibilities, review design outputs, guide design engineers and identify their training needs.

**Design release, documentation and change control**

* Set up a stage-gate process: requirements, design review, prototype, validation and production release.

* Maintain a controlled document pack for every product: BOM, schematic, PCB/Gerber files, firmware version and test procedure, all under version control.

* Run the Engineering Change Note (ECN) process so no change reaches production without approval, and communicate approved changes to all departments.

**Testing, validation and certification**

* Test and validate products against defined requirements; analyse design-related failures and take corrective action.

* Develop test procedures, specifications, test jigs and calibration procedures.

* Plan and manage external EMC, environmental and ingress protection (IP) testing, certification, and maintain test reports for every product.

* Design products to meet relevant automotive and industrial standards.

**Production support, DFM/DFT and cost**

* Design for manufacturing and testing (DFM/DFT) from the start and support design transfer to production, including yield and field issues traced to design.

* Set a target cost for every new product; drive value engineering on high-volume products.

* Build a preferred-parts list with Purchase, and avoid single-source and end-of-life components.

**Customer and cross-department coordination**

* Respond to OEM and dealer technical queries and custom requirements; support customer approvals, sample submissions and technical documentation.

* Analyse field failures and customer complaints and drive corrective action.

* Coordinate with Sales, Quality, Production and Purchase on design, component and product matters.

**What You Bring**

**Must have**

* B.E./B.Tech or M.E./M.Tech in Electronics, E&TC, Electrical or Instrumentation.

* 10–15 years in embedded product design, with at least 2 products taken from concept into volume production.

* Strong analog and mixed-signal design skills, including sensor signal conditioning and filtering in noisy environments.

* Hands-on firmware development in Embedded C on 32-bit microcontrollers (STM32 or similar).

* Experience with CAN, RS485/Modbus and UART.

* PCB design and review experience in tools such as Altium, KiCad or OrCAD.

* Practical experience with EMC design and testing, and with designing for harsh industrial or automotive environments.

* Experience setting up or working within design release, document control and ECN processes.

* Ability to lead a small team while staying hands-on.

**Good to have**

* Experience with speed sensors, magnetic pickups, Hall-effect sensors, or engine and genset instrumentation.

* Exposure to automotive or industrial standards, ISO 9001 design control and OEM approval processes such as PPAP.

* Experience with IP-rated enclosure design and environmental testing.

* Experience with Android or PC configuration tools for embedded products.

Pay: ₹700,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

The candidate will be responsible for ensuring high availability, performance, security, patching (Ivanti Patching Tool for large scale environment), monitoring, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management of Windows and VMware environments.
  
The Server Operations Windows System Administrator will be responsible for Infrastructure as a service (IAAS) based operational tasks at Medline. This will include configuring, monitoring, troubleshooting and upgrading systems in our on-premise, private cloud, and Azure public cloud platforms.

* Perform server provisioning, decommissioning, and lifecycle management.
* Execute OS upgrades, migrations, and disaster recovery activities.
* Handle Active Directory administration including DNS, DHCP, GPO, and replication issues.

Utilize Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform.

Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field, or equivalent work experience

At least 4-6 years of experience in system administration

  

**Knowledge / Skills / Abilities**

* Operating System: Windows Server 2016/2019/2022/2025, Basic Windows administration (preferred)

* MS Technologies: Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, Ivanti Patching, IIS, Failover Clustering (MS & SQL – Good to know)

* Virtualization: VMware vSphere, ESXi, vCenter Server, VSAN, VM Migration & Storage VMotion

title: Manager, Engineering
description:
Pune, Mahārāshtra, India Product Engineering Ref ID: JR-024160

**Our Mission**

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

**Who We Are**

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking an Engineering Manager to lead the team that builds and runs our connectors framework. In this role, you will be accountable for the team’s delivery across several concurrent projects, from platform enhancements to large programs that need multiple teams to collaborate. You will lead by example as a hands-on technical manager, grow the engineers on your team, and remove roadblocks so the connector engineers who build on your platform can move fast.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* **Own Team Delivery:** Be accountable for delivering multiple framework projects and features at the same time. Make pragmatic trade-offs to deliver, and personally deliver features when the team needs it.
* **Lead Technically:** Stay hands-on and lead by example. Guide the team through large, complex projects that need several teams to complete, such as migrating on-premises connectivity to a cloud-managed agent or extracting the integrations code into its own service. Design features in the framework yourself when needed.
* **Direct Quality and Reliability:** Set the quality processes the team follows. Own framework reliability, including sync health, incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), and resolution of security findings.
* **Develop Talent:** Run 1:1s, performance reviews, goal setting, and career guidance. Enable ownership on the team, resolve conflict, and grow engineers into their next level.
* **Remove Roadblocks Across Teams:** Work closely with the connector development team, other product teams, SRE, security, and PM to keep work clear and unblocked.
* **Lead AI-First Engineering:** Train the team on our tools and processes, including AI-assisted development workflows, and set the discipline for verifying AI-generated code.
* **Drive Initiatives:** Run initiatives within the team, such as cutting the time it takes to build a new connector or reducing sync failures.
* **Keep Customers in Focus:** Understand customer use cases and problems, and use them to set priorities with PM.
* **Build the Team:** Actively recruit, lead interviews, and make hiring decisions.
* **Communicate Clearly:** Present plans, progress, and risks to engineering and senior leadership.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* **Identity & Access Security Domain:** Direct experience with IAM, PAM, IGA, or Secrets Management platforms.
* **Integration Platforms:** Experience leading teams that build integration frameworks, data pipelines, or SDKs used by other engineers.
* **Hybrid Connectivity:** Experience with products that run agents inside customer networks.
* **Multi-Site Teams:** Experience leading engineers across more than one office location.
* **DevOps & Observability Ecosystems:** Practical experience with progressive delivery, CI/CD pipelines, feature flagging tools, and monitoring tools such as Datadog.

**Impact**
----------

As an Engineering Manager on the connectors framework, you will lead the team that every connector in our product depends on. Your impact will be measured by your team’s delivery, the reliability of the framework in production, and the growth of the engineers you lead. Co-workers will look to you for clarity, technical judgment, and a steady path forward.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* **People Leadership:** Experience managing software engineers, including 1:1s, performance reviews, career development, and hiring.
* **Technical Depth:** Strong hands-on background with Node.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, and AWS, plus experience with data integration or distributed systems. Able to review designs and code with credibility.
* **Delivery Track Record:** Proven record of delivering large, complex projects that need collaboration across several teams.
* **Operational Ownership:** Experience running production services, leading incident response, and driving RCAs to durable fixes.
* **AI Tooling Adoption:** Experience leading a team’s adoption of AI tools while keeping review rigor high.
* **Conflict Resolution & Influence:** Able to resolve conflict, remove roadblocks across teams, and build strong working relationships with ICs and managers.
* **Communication:** Excellent presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to engineering and business audiences.
* **Customer Understanding:** Good understanding of customer use cases, problems, and considerations.

**Qualifications**

title: SME - Kubernetes, Terraform
description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

We are looking for an experienced Linux / UNIX Engineer (L3) to own the stability, security and performance of our enterprise server environment. As the final technical escalation point, you will resolve complex incidents, perform root cause analysis, design and implement infrastructure improvements, and guide L1/L2 teams. The role requires deep hands-on expertise across Linux and UNIX platforms, strong automation skills, and the ability to work closely with application, database, network, storage and cloud teams to deliver reliable services in line with agreed SLAs.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

Incident, Problem and Escalation Management • Act as the final escalation point (L3) for complex Linux / UNIX incidents escalated from L1/L2 teams. • Troubleshoot and resolve critical (P1/P2) issues related to OS, kernel, boot, file systems, performance, memory, networking and storage. • Lead root cause analysis (RCA) for major incidents and drive permanent fixes through problem management. • Analyze system logs, core dumps and crash dumps (kdump, sosreport, explorer) to identify underlying issues. • Coordinate with OEM vendors (Red Hat, SUSE, Oracle, IBM, HPE, Dell) for case escalation and resolution. • Participate in on-call rotation and lead bridge calls during major incidents. Server Build, Engineering and Administration • Design, build, configure and decommission physical and virtual Linux (RHEL, CentOS, Rocky, Oracle Linux, SUSE, Ubuntu) and UNIX (Solaris, AIX, HP-UX) servers. • Define and maintain standard OS build templates, golden images and hardening baselines. • Manage storage and file systems including LVM, ext4, XFS, ZFS, NFS, CIFS/Samba, multipathing and SAN/NAS integration. • Configure and support high-availability clusters (Pacemaker/Corosync, Veritas Cluster Server, Red Hat HA, PowerHA/HACMP). • Manage virtualization platforms such as VMware vSphere, KVM, Solaris Zones/LDOMs and IBM LPARs. • Administer core services including DNS, DHCP, NTP/Chrony, SSH, Postfix/Sendmail, Apache/Nginx and cron. • Patching, Upgrades and Lifecycle Management\\r\\n• Plan and execute OS patching, kernel upgrades and major version migrations with minimal downtime. • Manage patch repositories and lifecycle tools such as Red Hat Satellite, SUSE Manager, Spacewalk or IBM NIM. • Track end-of-life (EOL) platforms and drive remediation, refresh and migration plans. • Perform firmware and hardware upgrades in coordination with data center and vendor teams. Security, Compliance and Access Management • Implement and maintain OS hardening in line with CIS benchmarks and organizational security policies. • Remediate vulnerabilities identified through scanning tools (Qualys, Tenable/Nessus, Rapid7) within defined timelines. • Manage user and privileged access, sudo policies, PAM, SELinux/AppArmor, firewalld/iptables and SSH key management. • Integrate Linux / UNIX systems with Active Directory / LDAP using SSSD, Centrify or Winbind. • Support internal and external audits (SOX, ISO 27001, GxP, PCI-DSS) and provide evidence as required. Automation, Monitoring and Performance • Automate routine tasks, builds, patching and compliance checks using Shell, Python, Perl and Ansible. • Develop and maintain configuration management with Ansible, Puppet, Chef or SaltStack. • Configure and tune monitoring and alerting using tools such as Nagios, Zabbix, Prometheus/Grafana, Splunk, Dynatrace or SolarWinds. • Conduct capacity planning and performance tuning for CPU, memory, disk I/O, network and kernel parameters. • Identify repetitive incidents and eliminate them through automation and self-healing solutions. Backup, Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity • Ensure backup and restore processes are configured and tested using tools such as Veritas NetBackup, Commvault, Veeam or IBM Spectrum Protect. • Design, document and execute DR plans and participate in periodic DR drills. • Validate recovery procedures and maintain RTO/RPO compliance for critical systems. Process, Documentation and Leadership • Follow ITIL processes for incident, problem, change and request management using ServiceNow, BMC Remedy or similar ITSM tools. • Prepare and present change requests, implementation plans and rollback plans to the Change Advisory Board (CAB). • Create and maintain SOPs, runbooks, knowledge base articles, architecture diagrams and RCA reports. • Mentor and upskill L1/L2 engineers through knowledge transfer sessions and technical reviews. • Ensure SLA, KPI and operational metrics are met and contribute to continuous service improvement initiatives.

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

Operating Systems Expert-level RHEL / CentOS / Rocky / Oracle Linux, SUSE, Ubuntu; working knowledge of Solaris, AIX or HP-UX • Troubleshooting Boot and GRUB issues, kernel panics, hung systems, performance bottlenecks, crash dump analysis, strace, tcpdump, sar, vmstat, iostat • Storage and File Systems LVM, XFS, ext4, ZFS, NFS, Samba, iSCSI, SAN multipathing, RAID • Clustering and HA Pacemaker/Corosync, Veritas Cluster Server, Red Hat HA, PowerHA • Virtualization VMware vSphere, KVM, Solaris Zones / LDOMs, IBM LPAR • Scripting and Automation Bash / Shell, Python, Perl; Ansible (required), Puppet / Chef (preferred) • Networking TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, bonding / teaming, VLANs, firewalls, load balancers • Security CIS hardening, SELinux, sudo, PAM, SSH, vulnerability remediation, AD / LDAP integration • Tools Red Hat Satellite, ServiceNow, monitoring tools (Nagios, Zabbix, Splunk, Prometheus / Grafana), backup tools

**Must Have Skill**
-------------------

Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service,AWS CloudFormation,PaaS - AWS,Terraform,Linux,Kubernetes

**Good to Have Skill**
----------------------

**Other Requirements**
----------------------

Public cloud experience with AWS (EC2, EBS, IAM), Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform. • Containers and orchestration: Docker, Podman, Kubernetes or Red Hat OpenShift. • Infrastructure as Code with Terraform; CI/CD tools such as Git, Jenkins or GitLab. • Support for enterprise applications and databases on Linux / UNIX (Oracle, SAP, WebLogic, Tomcat, JBoss). • Experience in regulated industries such as pharma, healthcare or financial services. Qualifications and Certifications • Bachelor\'s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or equivalent practical experience. • 8–12 years of hands-on experience in Linux / UNIX administration, with at least 3–4 years in an L3 or engineering role. • Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE) or Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) – strongly preferred. • Additional certifications are an advantage: SUSE Certified Engineer, Oracle Solaris, IBM AIX, LPIC-2/3, ITIL v4 Foundation, AWS / Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA). Soft Skills and Competencies • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a structured approach to troubleshooting. • Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical issues to non-technical stakeholders and leadership. • Ability to stay calm and lead effectively during high-pressure, business-critical incidents. • Ownership mindset with a focus on service quality, documentation and continuous improvement. • Team player who mentors others and collaborates well across global, cross-functional teams.

**Your day at NTT DATA**
As a Cross Technology Managed Services Engineer (L1) at NTT DATA, you will be the first point of contact for our clients, ensuring their IT infrastructure and systems remain operational. You will proactively identify, investigate, and resolve technical incidents and problems, focusing on first-line support for standard and low-complexity incidents and service requests. Your aim? To ensure zero missed service level agreement conditions.
  
  
Every day, you will monitor client infrastructure and solutions, identifying problems and errors before or as they occur. You will dive deep into first-line incidents assigned to you, pinpointing the root causes, and providing telephonic, ITSM ticket or chat support to our clients when they need it most. You will work across two or more technology domains, such as Cloud, Security, Networking, Applications, or Collaboration. Your day may include updating existing knowledge articles or creating new ones, seeking opportunities for work optimization, and supporting project work as needed. Additionally, you will contribute to disaster recovery functions and tests, ensuring our clients' DATA is safe and sound.

description:
**Company Description**
Egaa Marketing, based in Coimbatore, is one of India’s leading providers of security systems and CCTV solutions for homes, offices, corporations, and commercial establishments. The company focuses on integrated, seamless, and customized security solutions that go beyond installing cameras and alarms. Egaa Marketing aims to empower customers with holistic systems that provide control over their environment and peace of mind. Its offerings include IP CCTV cameras, biometric access, burglar alarms, home and gate automation, ANPR, video conferencing, perimeter protection, IPBX, Wi-Fi networking, and advanced fire alarm systems. Applicants can expect to work with a wide range of modern security and technology solutions in a growing, service-oriented environment.

This is a full-time, on-site Technician role based in Coimbatore. The Technician will install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot security and technology systems, including CCTV cameras, biometric access controls, burglar alarms, home and gate automation, ANPR, and fire alarm systems. Daily responsibilities include conducting site surveys, running cables, mounting devices, testing system performance, and ensuring proper integration of hardware and software. The role also involves responding to service calls, performing preventive maintenance, documenting work completed, and providing basic user training to clients on system operation. The Technician will collaborate with the sales and support teams to ensure timely project completion and high-quality customer service.
