* Strong technical aptitude in installing and maintaining CCTV, access control, alarm, automation, and networking systems.
* Hands-on experience with IP-based technologies, including IP cameras, Wi-Fi networking, IPBX, and related hardware.
* Ability to read and interpret wiring diagrams, technical manuals, and installation specifications.
* Basic knowledge of electrical safety, low-voltage systems, and tools used for cabling and equipment installation.
* Good troubleshooting and problem-solving skills for diagnosing and resolving system issues on-site.
* Effective communication skills to explain system functions, provide user guidance, and document service activities clearly.
* Ability to work independently in the field, manage time efficiently, and adapt to varying customer environments.
* Prior experience as a technician in security systems, electronics, or IT infrastructure is an advantage.
* Relevant technical diploma or certification in electronics, electrical engineering, networking, or a related field preferred.
* Willingness to travel locally within and around Coimbatore for installations and service visits.

description:
**About the company:**

India's first social distribution AI fintech platform for the underserved aspirational middle-class- delivering Secured & Unsecured loans, Insurance, and Investment products across 5,000+ small cities of India (referred as India-2). Founded in 2019, WeRize is at an annualized-run-rate of $60 Mn (Gross revenues) and $32Mn (Net) and $7Mn+ of net profits before taxes (3x Y-o-Y growth) with ROE > 20%. We are projecting ~2x growth in topline and ~3x growth in profits over the next 12 months.

WeRize operates as a “category creator” three-sided marketplace connecting 17,000+ trained local freelancers with India-2 customers and partner financial institutions, all powered by a full-stack AI operating layer that creates a “flywheel of trust” with self-reinforcing network effects.

* **Distributor trust:**
  Freelancers are empowered through AI-led tools that help them act in the long-term best interests of their customers.
* **Customer trust:**
  End customers rely on WeRize’s assisted distributor, data-driven recommendations across both asset and liability products
* **Manufacturer trust:**
  Financial Institutions rely on WeRize’s data, risk management and distribution intelligence to reach small city customers that they can’t serve on their own.

**Key highlights: What do we do**

1. **Large, underpenetrated market opportunity:**
   India’s 300Mn+ aspirational middle-class captures ~30% of GDP, yet remains financially underserved across credit, insurance, and investments. Pure-digital models lack the required trust, while physical branches are economically unviable.
2. **Differentiated, asset-light social distribution:**
   WeRize leverages 17,000+ financially literate freelancers across 5,000+ small cities. This branchless, zero-sales-team model delivers high-trust human touchpoints, superb unit economics, and strong freelancer retention through a broad product suite.
3. **Proprietary AI driven tech stack:**
   Trained on 20Bn+ data points across 4Mn+ households, WeRize’s AI powers end-to-end operations. For distribution, it optimizes lead gen, selling, and engagement—turning freelancers into professional advisors. For manufacturing, it sharpens risk management, underwriting, and product structuring for high-margin expansion.

To know more about the company, please visit: https://www.werize.com/

**Role Summary**

As a Senior Test Engineer, you will take end-to-end ownership of testing large features across our

fintech lending products. You will balance hands-on manual validation with scalable test

automation across web and mobile platforms, ensuring seamless quality across critical NBFC

workflows—including KYC verification, loan disbursements, repayment schedules, collections, and

partner settlements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Feature Quality Ownership: Translate Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) into comprehensive test plans, test cases, and execution strategies for major product releases.
* Manual & Functional Execution: Design and execute functional, regression, smoke, integration, and end-to-end (E2E) test cases across Web and Mobile (Android) applications.
* Automation Engineering: Identify high-value automation candidates and build, execute, and maintain automated test scripts using Playwright (TypeScript/JavaScript) to reduce manual regression cycles.
* API & Database Validation: Conduct thorough backend API testing using Postman/SoapUI and validate transactional data integrity using SQL queries.
* Defect Management & RCA: Log, track, and drive defects to closure in Jira, conducting root cause analysis (RCA) in collaboration with backend and product teams.
* CI/CD Execution: Run and monitor automated test suites integrated into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins).

**AI-Driven QA Responsibilities**

* AI-Assisted Code Generation: Actively use AI coding tools (such as Cursor IDE or GitHub Copilot) to generate, refactor, and debug test automation scripts.
* Test Synthesis & Workflows: Leverage LLMs (such as Claude, GPT, or DeepSeek) to accelerate test case generation, edge-case discovery, and test data preparation.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Experience: 4–5 years of hands-on experience in software testing (combining strong manual testing fundamentals with practical UI/API automation).
* Automation Stack: Hands-on proficiency in Playwright with TypeScript/JavaScript (or strong experience in Selenium/Java with the ability to transition quickly).
* Core Technical Skills: Solid command of functional testing, API testing (Postman/SoapUI), SQL querying, and Android mobile app testing.
* Domain Knowledge: Experience in Fintech, BFSI, or NBFC domains (understanding of LOS/LMS, KYC, disbursements, repayments, or collections is strongly preferred).
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

**The role:**

**Title:**
AI Engineer

**Function:**
Technology

**Location:**
Bengaluru

**Why this role exists:**

The AI Engineer orchestrates the technical agents that produce code, tests, documentation and design mock-ups within a pod delivery model. The role translates product specifications into functional instructions for AI agents, running multiple agent workstreams in parallel across standard-complexity work while holding the pre-production commit gate for routine changes.

The role evolves how engineering is executed. AI agents carry a significant share of test generation, documentation and code execution, while the AI Engineer remains fully accountable for system design judgement, code review, quality and all commitments to production. The role relies on AI-driven test coverage, agent-supported execution and human-in-the-loop validation to maintain high release standards.

* Improve agent workflows continuously, sharing prompt techniques, context improvements and automation patterns across pods.

**Review, Quality Engineering, and Commit Gate:**

* Hold the pre-production commit gate on routine changes, ensuring no code reaches production without thorough review.
* Perform fast and accurate reviews of generated code, tests and specifications, identifying subtle errors, logical defects or plausible but incorrect outputs.
* Confirm that instructions given to technical agents have been executed to the expected standard before committing code.
* Design and execute test strategy for assigned workstreams, including functional integration and regression testing, building on AI-generated test coverage and agent-supported execution.
* Identify, document, and track defects to resolution, communicating severity and coordinating fixes with technical and functional stakeholders.
* Own non-functional outcomes for assigned workstreams, including performance, resilience, accessibility and security, and confirm architectural fit before commit.
* Escalate complex, high-risk or major architectural changes to the Senior AI Engineer or Principal AI Engineer for higher-level review.

**Context, Documentation and Knowledge Management:**

* Verify that technical documentation exists and is accurate, maintaining documentation as an active input to subsequent agent runs rather than an after-the-fact record.
* Maintain knowledge artefacts for workstreams so future code and agent outputs draw on detailed, reusable domain context over time.
* Contribute domain knowledge back to shared context repositories in line with central standards managed by Context Engineers.
* Maintain clear system provenance to distinguish agent-generated components from human-authored code.

**Production Support and Continuous Improvement:**

* Identify, troubleshoot and resolve reported defects and incidents promptly across the platform domains the pod touches, including participation in on-call rotations.
* Support and maintain existing platforms, integrations and legacy services alongside agent-based delivery flows during technical transition periods.
* Execute production verification testing during post-deployment and hypercare periods, confirming release quality before handover to steady-state support.
* Report observed drift, hallucinations or specification failures in agent tooling to Agent Integrity Engineers.

**Who you will be working with:**

**In this role, you will:**

* Product Orchestration: Clarify specification intent and raise technical feasibility or workstream sequencing considerations with Product Orchestrators.
* Engineering Leadership: Seek higher-level review for complex or high-risk changes from Senior AI Engineers, Principal Domain Engineers, and Associate Engineering Managers.
* Architecture and Context Teams: Apply platform context libraries and feed domain knowledge back to Context Engineers, Solution Architects and Domain Architects.
* Platform and Integrity Specialists: Report agent drift or hallucination to Associate AI Agent Evaluation Engineers and collaborate with Platform Engineers on workflows and permissions.

**What success looks like:**

* Workstream Throughput: High throughput of reviewed and committed work delivered through parallel multi-agent workstreams.
* Commit Gate Quality: High review quality with minimal defects escaping to production, backed by rigorous verification.
* Context Artefact Accuracy: High standard of accurate, reusable documentation and context artefacts that continuously improve subsequent agent runs.
* Platform Stability: High stability, supportability, and swift issue resolution across owned platform domains and legacy components.
* Demonstrates behaviours aligned to Officeworks’ values, contributing to a respectful, inclusive and high-performing culture.

**How will you lead:**

**Individual Contributor:**

* Lives our Officeworks values and behaviours
* Proactively contributes to a safe working environment, escalates appropriately if there are unsafe conditions or inappropriate behaviour
* Operates in line with applicable Officeworks company policies and Code of Conduct
* Demonstrates a strong sense of personal accountability and curiosity to learn and develop
* Contributes to an inclusive and respectful environment where diverse perspectives are valued and everyone feels safe to speak up and belong

**Our Values:**

Our values shape the way we work, our behaviours and how we interact with each other, our customers, suppliers and communities. We begin with customer, We do the right thing, We execute with accountability and We lead with ambition

**Essential:**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience: 6-8 years of software engineering experience, combining full-stack development with hands-on software quality assurance and testing across manual and automated methodologies.
* System Design Judgement: Demonstrated system design judgement to assess whether AI-generated code and technical output are fit for purpose, performant, and secure.

As a Website Management and Quality Check Engineer (Manual) at Taxmann, you will play a crucial role in managing website and ensuring its quality and functionality. description:

title: Oracle - EPM - TRCS - Functional Consultant - Manager
description:
Oracle Cloud EPM Account Reconciliation (ARCS)
  
Senior Consultant
  
Job Summary:
  
We are seeking an experienced Oracle Cloud EPM Account Reconciliation (ARCS) Senior Consultant with strong hands-on expertise in Reconciliation Compliance, high-volume Transaction Matching, reconciliation governance, reporting, integrations and automation. The role will support solution design and independently deliver application configuration, data loads, matching rules, workflow, testing, deployment, documentation and production support under the guidance of project leadership.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities:**

* Participate in end-to-end Oracle Cloud EPM Account Reconciliation implementations, rollouts, enhancements and support engagements.
* Conduct requirement-gathering and design discussions; document reconciliation, control, compliance and transaction-matching requirements.
* Configure Reconciliation Compliance, including periods, calendars, currencies, organisational units, attributes, formats, profiles, reconciliation methods, risk ratings and workflow.
* Configure preparer and reviewer assignments, tolerances, variance analysis, auto-reconciliation, ageing, alerts, notifications, attachments, comments, electronic sign-offs and audit evidence.
* Design Transaction Matching solutions using multiple data sources, match types, transaction types, one-to-one, one-to-many, many-to-one and many-to-many rules, tolerance logic and date or amount adjustments.
* Configure and tune auto-match rules, suggested matches, manual matching, adjustments, unmatched-item ageing, exception handling and reconciliation integration.
* Develop balance-sheet, intercompany, bank, cash, subledger-to-ledger, system-to-system and operational reconciliation use cases.
* Create and support operational and compliance dashboards, predefined and custom reports, reconciliation-status reporting, ageing analysis, match-rate monitoring and exception reporting.
* Develop and support integrations with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, E-Business Suite, SAP, FCCS, banks, subledgers, data warehouses and external systems using Data Integration, EPM Automate, REST APIs and file-based interfaces.
* Automate profile imports, balance and transaction loads, currency rates, reconciliation creation, auto-match execution, period-status changes, journal exports, reporting and job monitoring.
* Execute CRP, SIT, UAT, data migration, reconciliation-cycle validation, volume and performance testing, cutover, go-live and hypercare; investigate defects and support root-cause resolution.
* Prepare configuration workbooks, functional and technical specifications, match-rule designs, test scripts, training materials, operating procedures and deployment documentation.
* Support security, segregation of duties, reconciliation policies, audit trails, evidence retention, data lineage, controls and production-support procedures.
* Collaborate with finance, controllership, audit and technical teams; guide junior consultants, participate in peer reviews and support demonstrations and estimations.

Requirements
  
  
**Experience:**

* Minimum 5+ years of Oracle EPM, finance transformation or account-reconciliation experience, including strong hands-on Oracle Cloud EPM Account Reconciliation experience.
* At least two full-lifecycle Oracle EPM implementations, including one ARCS implementation covering Reconciliation Compliance and Transaction Matching.
* Strong knowledge of balance-sheet reconciliation, account substantiation, reconciliation governance, risk-based workflow, variance analysis and financial-close controls.
* Hands-on experience with periods, formats, profiles, rules, currencies, organisational units, workflow, auto-reconciliation, ageing and dashboards.
* Hands-on Transaction Matching experience with data sources, match types, matching rules, adjustments, exceptions, auto-match optimisation and high-volume data sets.
* Experience integrating ARCS with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP or other source systems and automating processes through Data Integration, EPM Automate and REST APIs.
* Experience supporting workshops, configuration, testing, migration, reconciliation-cycle validation, cutover, go-live and post-production support.
* Industry experience in government, retail, energy, real estate, oil and gas, financial services, or power and utilities is preferred.

**Competencies / Skills:**

* Oracle Cloud EPM Account Reconciliation configuration, administration and connected financial-close processes
* Reconciliation Compliance, periods, formats, profiles, workflow, risk ratings, ageing, auto-reconciliation and audit evidence
* Transaction Matching data sources, match types, rules, tolerances, adjustments, exceptions and match-performance optimisation
* Balance-sheet, intercompany, bank, cash, subledger-to-ledger, system-to-system and operational reconciliations
* Operational and compliance dashboards, predefined and custom reports, ageing, variance, status and exception analysis
* Data Integration, EPM Automate, REST APIs, Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, FCCS and third-party ERP, bank and subledger integrations
* Security, segregation of duties, controls, audit trails, evidence retention, data lineage and compliance reporting
* Awareness of Predictive AI, Reconciliation Assignment Assistance, Transaction Matching Assistance, confidence scores, anomaly detection and governed human review is desirable
* Strong accounting, analytical, problem-solving, requirement analysis, documentation and stakeholder communication skills
* Strong teamwork, mentoring and delivery capabilities; willingness to travel and work MENA business timings

**Education:**

* CA, CMA, ACCA, MBA Finance or an equivalent finance/business qualification is preferred.
* Relevant Oracle Cloud EPM Account Reconciliation certification is preferred; accounting, audit, controls, integration or reporting credentials are advantageous.

description:

title: Agentic AI Orchestrator
description: Job SummaryThe Agentic AI Orchestrator designs, builds, and operates the Investment Division's agentic AI workflows—the automated, multi-step processes through which AI agents read documents, reconcile data, draft analysis, and assemble reporting across the division's clusters. The role converts analyst workflows into orchestrated agent pipelines with human review gates, owns the division's prompt, skill, and agent library, and is accountable for the accuracy, auditability, and cost of every automated output.The position anchors the division's AI-led operating model from the Chennai office, working alongside the Data Engineer (data pipelines and infrastructure) and the ML Engineer (models and evaluation), and serves as the bridge between the investment analysts and the division's AI toolingROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES1. Design, build, and operate agentic AI workflows for the division's recurring processes: document extraction and reconciliation, portfolio and company performance monitoring, report and IC pack assembly, and data-room processing.2. Translate analyst and reporting workflows into orchestrated multi-agent pipelines with defined human review gates, so that no figure or recommendation is published without analyst sign-off.3. Own the division's prompt, skill, agent, and plugin library: design, versioning, testing, and documentation, ensuring workflows are reusable across clusters rather than one-off chats.4. Integrate agents with the division's systems and data sources — document repositories, custodian and administrator reporting, and the division's knowledge base — working with the Data Engineer on pipelines and access.5. Build and run evaluation harnesses with the ML Engineer: accuracy benchmarks against verified ground truth, regression testing on workflow changes, and periodic audits of automated outputs.6. Implement AI governance and guardrails: access controls and confidentiality boundaries for family and portfolio data, audit trails for every automated output, and compliance with the Group's AI usage policies.7. Monitor agent performance, cost, latency, and failure modes; triage incidents, maintain runbooks, and drive continuous improvement of workflow reliability.8. Train and support the division's analysts in AI-assisted working practices; capture their feedback and convert it into a prioritised automation backlog.9. Maintain complete documentation of all orchestrated workflows, their data sources, model versions, and review controls, ensuring every automated output is reproducible and auditable.QUALIFICATIONSMinimum Education Required• Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related quantitative field.• Strong Python engineering skills: API integration, data handling, and production-quality code with testing and version control (Git).• Hands-on experience building LLM-based and agentic systems in production: workflow orchestration, tool and function calling, and multi-agent patterns — using frameworks such as LangGraph or LangChain, or SDK-native orchestration (e.g. Claude Agent SDK). Framework experience matters less than sound orchestration design.• Practical RAG experience: document chunking, embeddings, vector databases (e.g. pgvector, Pinecone, Qdrant, or similar), hybrid search, and retrieval evaluation.• Experience building or integrating MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and tools, or equivalent connector architectures linking AI agents to enterprise systems and data sources.• Familiarity with LLM evaluation and observability tooling (accuracy benchmarks, regression tests, tracing); disciplined prompt and skill engineering with versioning and documentation.• Understanding of data privacy, access control, and audit requirements for confidential financial data; exposure to investment or financial reporting workflows preferred.Years of experience are required.• Minimum of 4 to 7 years of experience in software or AI engineering, of which at least 2 years hands-on with LLM-based or agentic systems in production, at a technology firm, financial institution, or data-driven enterprise.

title: QA Lead - Trading Platform (India, Chennai)
description:
**About GoCharting**

GoCharting is a web-native charting and trading platform. Traders use professional orderflow tools — footprint charts, volume and market profile, cumulative delta, DOM trading — to read the market and place orders through their broker, all in the browser. Our users are active traders in India, the US and around the world.

**The Role**

You will own the quality gate that every release of GoCharting's terminal and apps passes before it reaches traders, and you will test and write automation yourself while you lead a small QA team. The role is full-time and in person in our Chennai office, and it reports to the Engineering Manager for Client Engineering. Every release needs one accountable owner of what "ready to ship" means, and that is you. At 12 months, no release should reach production without your sign-off, and the team should trust the checks behind it.

**What you'll do**

* **Own the release gate**
  — define what must pass before a release ships, run the sign-off, and stop a release that fails it
* **Test and automate yourself**
  — write and maintain end-to-end and regression automation for the web terminal and for APIs
* **Lead and coach the QA team**
  — assign work, review test plans and automation, and raise each engineer's standard
* **Run quality checks in CI**
  — keep automated tests as required checks on merges and releases, fast and reliable
* **Triage defects**
  — set severity with product and engineering, and track each one to a verified fix
* **Report quality plainly**
  — publish a weekly view of defects found, escaped and fixed

**What we're looking for**

**Must-haves:**

* 6+ years in QA or test automation on production web applications
* Hands-on automation code with Playwright, Cypress or Selenium, written by you
* Has owned a release gate or release sign-off for a production web application
* Has led or mentored other QA engineers
* Has run automated tests as required checks in a CI pipeline, for example GitHub Actions
* In person in our Chennai office, 5 days a week

**Nice-to-haves:**

* Testing real-time or data-dense applications, such as WebSocket feeds or live charts (adds the ability to test our core risk)
* API and contract testing for REST and WebSocket services (adds coverage below the UI)
* Performance and load testing with k6, JMeter or similar (adds confidence under market-open load)
* Trading, fintech or market-data testing (adds speed in learning our domain)
* Mobile app testing for iOS and Android (adds coverage of the app release)

**Logistics**

**Location**
Chennai, India - in person, office-based

**Employment type**
Full-time

**Entity**
ProCharting Private Limited

**Reports to**
Engineering Manager, Client Engineering

**Start date**
ASAP

**Travel**
None

This role sits at the core of the company's digital product engineering team, responsible for building and shipping production-grade web experiences on the company's digital platform and related properties. The engineer will own features end-to-end — from architecture decisions to deployment — with web as the primary surface and occasional mobile work as a complement. title: Sr. Product Manager- Tech, Amazon Compliance Safety Services
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Compliance Safety Services is looking for a Sr. Product Manager - Tech to own the compliance intelligence platform that powers how Amazon understands, structures, and applies regulatory requirements across global marketplaces. You will define how compliance requirements are modeled, stored, and made available to downstream systems that protect sellers and customers. This role sits at the intersection of regulatory knowledge, data architecture, and seller experience, working with engineering, science, legal, and program teams across multiple countries. You will own the product roadmap for structuring compliance data at scale and making it machine-readable, reusable, and accurate across product safety, trade, and labeling domains.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Own the product roadmap for the compliance intelligence platform, including how regulatory requirements are ingested, structured, and distributed to enforcement, seller experience, and automation systems  
Define the data model for compliance requirements at specification grain, enabling cross-policy and cross-marketplace deduplication  
Partner with engineering to build scalable infrastructure for storing and serving compliance data across global marketplaces  
Work with regulatory and program teams to translate evolving regulations into structured, machine-readable requirements  
Define success metrics and drive adoption of compliance data across consuming teams and surfaces  
Represent the compliance intelligence charter in planning cycles, leadership reviews, and cross-org alignment forums  
  
A day in the life  
You will spend your time translating regulatory complexity into structured product decisions. In a given week, you might define how a new regulation maps to existing product categories, review a data model proposal with engineering, align with a program team on requirement coverage gaps, and present the roadmap to leadership. Your customers are the internal teams that depend on accurate, structured compliance data to enforce the right requirements, surface the right guidance to sellers, and automate decisions at scale. description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**  
  
Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

**JOB PURPOSE**
---------------

Okta's Silver customers across ASEAN, India, Korea and Hong Kong carry real renewal ARR and our best Silver-to-Gold pipeline, but there are too many of them for 1:1 coverage. As a Digital CSM on the Asia Silver team, you will turn Gainsight, Salesforce and usage signals into prioritised, repeatable motions that protect renewals, get customers to value faster, and surface qualified expansion.

You won't hold a fixed book of relationships. You will own the system that decides which Silver customers get which touch, and you'll measure whether it works.

If you like building scalable motions that change customer outcomes, and you care about results more than send volume, this is your role.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**
------------------

* **Run the signal-to-action loop.** Monitor renewal forecasts, Gainsight risk and CTAs, activation data and account context. Segment the Silver book into worst-case renewals, flat with churn risk, and flat with growth potential, and route each to the right motion.
* **Protect the base.** Prioritise the worst-case renewals [window to validate, e.g. 3 quarters out]. Trigger and track risk playbooks with named owners, and run targeted saves and Path-to-Green plans, escalating to AEs, Renewal Managers, Support or CSM leadership when needed.
* **Improve adoption.** Close post-sale activation gaps by driving the core value features (FastPass, Workflows, LCM, OIG, Device Assurance) through activation CTAs, onboarding programs and digital nudges. Help customers reach first value inside [90] days, and connect each feature to a business outcome the customer can point to.
* **Identify expansion.** Qualify mature, growth-ready accounts through 1:many outreach and partner cohorts. Support AEs in identifying growth opportunities with smaller tactical activities such as Lead Pass or adoption assessments.
* **Build and run programs.** Design multi-channel outreach (email sequences, webinars and cohort sessions, community and partner-enabled campaigns). Test and iterate on messaging, and build and maintain self-service assets. Flag gaps where assets don't exist.
* **Use AI as part of the job.** Use tools like Claude, Gemini and NotebookLM to synthesise account context, generate customer-ready content and automate your own workflows. We expect practical fluency, not familiarity.
* **Measure and report.** Report on revenue protected, churn risk reduced, activation speed, qualified expansion and Silver-to-Gold conversion, so leadership can see which programs move outcomes and which don't.

* **Partner across the field.** Work with AEs, SEs, Renewal Managers, Support and partners to get the best outcome for each account without friction.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**
--------------------------

* 3+ years in customer success, digital or scale CS, lifecycle marketing or customer marketing, ideally in SaaS or security
* A record of running 1:many programs with measured outcomes (activation, renewal, pipeline), not just campaign activity
* Proficiency with Gainsight (or similar) and Salesforce, including building segments, triggers and dashboards.

* Working knowledge of identity and access concepts, or the curiosity to build it quickly. Okta Professional and Administrator certifications are expected within your first 90 days.
* A builder's mindset: you raise your own bar and find the faster path, you're energised by ambiguity, and you want outcomes over activity

title: Product Owner (Packaging industry/domain)
description:
**About ePS Packaging**

At ePS Packaging, we’re shaping the future of packaging through technology. As a global leader in industry-specific business and production software, we help packaging companies streamline operations, boost efficiency, and unlock growth.

With over 30 years of experience, a global footprint, and a deep understanding of the packaging industry, we believe one thing above all: our success grows when our customers thrive.

**Core responsibilities:**

The Product Owner is the execution arm of the product team and is accountable for translating product direction, roadmap initiatives, and customer needs into clearly defined, prioritised, and deliverable work for Agile development teams. The role owns the product backlog and sprint-level execution, ensuring that development teams understand what needs to be built, why it matters, and how successful delivery will be validated.

**Core responsibilities:**

Product Backlog and Prioritization

* Own, maintain, groom, and prioritise the product backlog, ensuring alignment with product goals, customer needs, business value, and delivery dependencies.
* Lead backlog refinement and ensure items are clearly defined, appropriately sized, prioritised, and ready for development.
* Assess feature requests, enhancements, defects, and competing demands; recommend sequencing and trade-offs in collaboration with the Product Manager.

  

Requirements and User Stories

* Translate roadmap initiatives and customer or business needs into epics, user stories, workflows, business rules, and clear acceptance criteria.
* Break down complex initiatives into manageable increments that can be delivered and validated through Agile sprints.
* Clarify functional behaviour, use cases, edge cases, and dependencies for Engineering and QA.
* Review completed work against acceptance criteria and confirm whether the agreed requirements have been met.

  

Agile Delivery and Team Enablement

* Work as the product domain expert and primary point of contact for the development team on backlog scope and requirement clarification.
* Participate actively in sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and other relevant Agile ceremonies; support the team in maintaining sprint-level momentum.
* Monitor sprint goals, backlog readiness, scope changes, and cross-team dependencies, escalating risks through the appropriate channels.
* Partner with Engineering and QA to support feature validation, quality, and delivery against agreed priorities.

Customer and Stakeholder Collaboration

* Work with Product Managers and relevant customer-facing teams to understand customer feedback and translate it into actionable product backlog items.
* Drive early feedback on new features and incorporate validated insights into backlog refinement and prioritization.
* Communicate priorities, scope decisions, requirement changes, and delivery expectations clearly to cross-functional stakeholders.
* Build alignment where stakeholders have competing needs, using product priorities and customer value to guide recommendations.

Continuous Improvement and Senior-Level Contribution

* Identify opportunities to improve story quality, backlog health, team collaboration, and product delivery practices.
* Use delivery and quality feedback to identify recurring requirement gaps, reduce avoidable rework, and improve sprint readiness.
* Share product domain knowledge and provide guidance or mentorship to less experienced Product Owners and team members, where applicable.

Role Focus and Responsibility Boundaries

* Maintain focus on product backlog ownership, requirement clarity, and sprint-level product execution in alignment with the Product Manager/CPO.
* Tier 2 support and technical triage are owned by Support/DevOps teams; project management and Scrum Master responsibilities by Delivery roles; customer demos and training by Enablement/Presales; and code contribution by Development teams.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Required experience and skills:**

* 8+ years of experience in Product Ownership, product delivery, software product development, or a closely related role, with substantial hands-on Product Owner experience.
* Mandatory: Relevant experience in the Packaging industry/domain, with specific exposure to CLF (Cartons, Labels & Flexibles). Understanding of packaging workflows, products, and industry-specific business processes is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience owning and prioritizing product backlogs for software products, ideally within a global SaaS or enterprise software environment.
* Strong capability in writing epics and detailed user stories, defining measurable acceptance criteria, and translating customer needs and roadmap initiatives into development-ready work.
* Proven experience working with Agile/Scrum development teams and contributing effectively to sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Ability to prioritize competing requirements by considering customer impact, business value, product priorities, effort, and dependencies.
* Experience working closely with Product Managers, developers, QA, Support, Implementation, and other cross-functional stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycle, Agile delivery practices, and product quality/acceptance processes.
* Ability to act as a domain expert for delivery teams, resolve requirement ambiguity, facilitate decisions, and communicate scope and priority changes effectively.
* Experience with JIRA and familiarity with Confluence, Agile boards, backlog tools, and customer feedback tools.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, facilitation, organization, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, globally distributed SaaS business.
* Experience mentoring colleagues or improving product ownership practices is an advantage.
* Business-level English proficiency (written and verbal) required.

  

**Why Join ePS**

At ePS, you’ll be part of a global, collaborative, and forward-thinking team that’s redefining what’s possible in the packaging industry. We foster an inclusive workplace where diversity drives innovation and every team member’s voice is valued. You’ll have the opportunity to make a real impact, helping our customers operate smarter and succeed sustainably.

Join us and help build the future of packaging technology.

title: PPC Marketing Specialist (Remote)
description:
**Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.**

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

**You are the account manager. We do not have any.** You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

**You own the whole funnel, not the campaign.** Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

**You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it.** We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

**You can live anywhere.** We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

 **Requirements**

**What the job looks like**

* **Own a set of DTC accounts** as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
* **Own the client relationship.** There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
* **Audit before you touch anything.** Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
* **Run brand and non brand as different businesses.** Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
* **Know what PMax is actually doing.** The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
* **Keep Google's automation on a leash.** Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
* **Own the feed.** Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
* **Own the tracking.** GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
* **Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it.** Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
* **Build the things the account needs.** Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

**You are a fit if**

* **You have done this with real money.** Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
* **You are fluent in the whole stack**, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
* **You are AI native, and you build.** This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
* **You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level.** You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
* **You are skeptical of your own numbers.** You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
* **You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls.** Where you live is up to you.
* Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.

**You are not a fit if**

* "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
* You want to be told what to do this week.
* You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
* You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

  
**Benefits**

**Why this role is exciting**

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

description:
**Job Summary**
The Product Owner is the responsible person to ensure that the bank continues to deliver superior service to our clients by building new capabilities and maintaining existing ones along with all other squad members. The Product Owner works with Clients, business users and stakeholders, risk & compliance colleagues, and Domain colleagues to define in detail what’s needed in order to meet the vision. Thereafter, the Product Owner works closely with the squads to deliver the prioritised vision.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy**

* Maximize the business value of the product or service by ensuring we “deliver the right thing at the right time”
* Responsible for the execution of build and maintain activities for their product or services throughout the lifecycle.
* Ensure alignment with strategic outcomes and scorecard priorities.
* Ensure the delivery of the "right thing at the right time," contributing to the Business plan and scorecard outcomes.
* Craft the vision and concept development of a product.
* Develop and maintain the roadmap and Squad backlog by liaising with, teams, and key stakeholders or SME's i.e., country / region / product or client and technical specialists.
* Build strong acceptance criteria for new deliveries that take into account business processes and variations, data quality, system speed and UX.
* Ensure data-driven prioritization in alignment with strategic outcomes and scorecard.
* Work with technical counterparts to mitigate technical debt and balance risk, and regulatory items with new features, functionality, or changes to keep the cost of change low.
* Work in partnership with technology to ensure a balance of functional and non-functional requirements are represented in the backlog and that there is an approach to mitigate or avoid technical debt.
* Ensures the Product Strategy and Roadmap is transparent, visible, understood by the Delivery Squads and is regularly reviewed with the delivery Squad.
* Asist to Develop and maintain the roadmap and backlog of the Squad with PO (Products/Services) and Engineering Lead using relevant data points to determine the appropriate roadmap milestones. Regularly review and refine it based on relevant data.
* Collaborate on technology roadmap and solution with the Engineering Lead, to drive optimum outcomes.
* Assist to regularly review the Squad performance metrics (both in sprint delivery and the performance after go-live) on a regular basis and to use these insights to execute continuous improvement with the Squad.
* Build a cadence of measuring business outcomes and benefits. Work closely with markets/segments to ensure that the features can provide the intended benefits which are measured and reviewed in key forums.

**Business**

* Engage with clients, stakeholders, and end users and represent their voice on the product backlog.
* Work closely with Stakeholders to ensure the Product Backlog is created and maintained according to business value/ROI.
* Facilitate prioritization discussions with all relevant stakeholders including local, regional, country representatives.
* Optimize value delivery through Continuous Improvement through relevant data and frequent feedback from stakeholders, SMEs, and customers.
* Engage in continuous backlog management, by refining user stories with clear narratives and acceptance criteria.
* Prioritize and refine backlog items using data points through collaboration with the technical delivery SMEs.
* Use lifecycle tools like ADO and Confluence, to plan, track, and manage backlog items.
* Ensure the Product Backlog is transparent, visible, and understood.
* Potentially support multiple teams if their backlog items come from the same Product Backlog.

**Processes**

* Accountable to ensure the backlog is maintained regularly and backlog user stories are clearly articulated through engagement in continuous backlog management, writing user stories., conducting user story walk-throughs with the delivery Squad and writing clear narratives and acceptance criteria.
* Accountable to sign off on the delivery of the backlog items (user stories) and ensure the acceptance criteria has been met i.e., through Squad showcases and / or functional walkthroughs of the product / service in use (live).
* Accountable to ensure backlog is regularly refined, prioritised and worked on with the Squad members.
* Accountable to ensure sign off of all user stories.
* Accountable to be present at Squad showcases / demonstrations to support user story sign off and releases.
* Must be present at team meetings including but not limited to backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily stand up, showcase, retrospectives.
* Adopt and embed the Change Delivery Standards throughout the lifecycle of the product/service.
* Adhere to and execute the relevant delivery processes outlined in the Group Enterprise Software Delivery Lifecycle guidelines (eSDLC)
* Continuously review and consider ways to reduce / eliminate manual processes.
* Awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.
* Participate in the quarterly planning for the Hive and provide steer along with Hive Tech Lead.

**People & Talent**

* Collaborate and ensure availability for all meetings as an active, daily as a core member of the squad.
* Champion and act as a role model of the Group's values and culture.
* Collaborate daily as a core member of the team.
* Cultivate a high-performance culture and true ‘self-organising’ team by empowering the Squad, celebrating wins, learning from reviews, and conducting regular retrospectives for continuous improvement.

**Risk Management**

* Responsible for effective risk management across all initiatives planed for product.
* Balance technical debt, risk, and regulatory items with new features, functionality, or changes to keep the cost of change low.

**Governance**

* Follow the specified governance process for agile delivery
* Manage releases and reporting in line with ESDLC standards and other bank governance activities/standards.

**Motivations**

* Motivated by delivering high-quality operational outcomes while ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies.
* Energised by identifying opportunities for process improvement, driving operational efficiency, and enhancing customer and stakeholder experiences.
* Thrives in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment that requires problem-solving, critical thinking, and effective decision-making.
* Driven by collaborating with cross-functional teams to achieve shared business objectives and deliver sustainable business outcomes.
* Demonstrates resilience and adaptability when managing complex operational challenges, changing priorities, and continuous business transformation.
* Motivated by developing people, fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement, and supporting team success through coaching and leadership.

**Skills And Experience**
**Must-have Skills**

* Triple A Plus functional knowledge
* Wealth Management processes
* Wealth Product lifecycle

**Other Skills**

* Process analysis and Requirements design
* Communication & Stakeholder management
* Portfolio Performance Methodology and computation approach
* Agile Delivery
* MS office applications – Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, Word etc.

**Qualifications**
**Certifications / Qualifications**

* Agile Product Owner
* Bachelors / Masters from reputed institutions or equivalent

**Languages**

* English; Additional Asian languages are a plus

**About Standard Chartered**
We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.
  
  
Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
* In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
* Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
* A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

This position is responsible for driving
**product branding and communication**
for TVS Credit Gold loan and Co-branded credit card portfolio. The role will also focus on strengthening
**brand visibility, recall, and preference**
at dealer and consumer touchpoints through
**integrated ATL and BTL branding initiatives**

* Drive end-to-end branding and marketing initiatives for Gold Loan and Co-branded Credit Card businesses to support customer acquisition, lead generation, conversions, and business growth.
* Plan and execute ATL (within approved budgets) and BTL campaigns aligned with business objectives and revenue targets.

* MBA – Marketing Tier II B- School

* Strong understanding of brand management, BTL/ATL marketing, and retail marketing.
* Creativity
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

title: 3DX – Manager, Technical Transformation
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**3DX – Manager, Technical Transformation**
Join Deloitte’s Enterprise Performance practice as a Manager, 3DX, where you will support digital transformation initiatives across product lifecycle management environments. In this role, you will contribute to the design, customization, deployment, and support of 3DEXPERIENCE solutions for complex client needs. You will work with cross-functional teams to translate functional requirements into technical solutions, deliver quality work products within project timelines, and support implementation activities across the solution lifecycle.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Manager, 3DX on the Enterprise Performance team, you will be responsible for supporting product lifecycle management transformation initiatives across engineering, manufacturing, and enterprise application environments.
  
  

* Lead configuration and customization activities within Dassault 3DEXPERIENCE ENOVIA and DELMIA environments based on documented business and technical requirements.
* Support bill of materials management, computer-aided design data management, document management, project management, change management, and product information management activities within product lifecycle management environments.
* Lead integration activities between 3DEXPERIENCE and enterprise platforms such as enterprise resource planning, manufacturing execution systems, customer relationship management systems, reporting tools, and MCAD or ECAD applications.
* Support requirements documentation, legacy data migration, test planning, functional testing, user acceptance testing, and issue resolution across deployment phases.
* Collaborate with business, technology, onsite, and offshore teams and provide guidance to junior team members to support end-to-end PLM solution delivery.

**The team**
Enterprise Performance
  
  
Our Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise technology, working across finance, supply chain, and IT operations to support the delivery of holistic performance improvement and digital transformation. We support Deloitte client service teams of strategic advisors and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to help collaborate with leading insights providers and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable the heart of business solutions.
  
  
The Enterprise Performance team leverages deep industry knowledge, strong analytical skills, and practical approaches to address clients’ toughest business challenges. title: Product Architect
description:
**Company Description**
**About Ramboll**
Ramboll is a global leader in sustainable architecture, engineering, and consultancy. At Ramboll Tech, we drive digital transformation across Ramboll, setting the pace for how technology transforms the built environment. Our mission is to become the leading tech-enabled partner for sustainable change.
  
  
If you are passionate about shaping high-impact digital products and want to connect product strategy with engineering execution, cloud platforms, data, integration and AI-enabled capabilities, this is your opportunity.
  
  
**Ramboll globally**
Ramboll is a leading engineering, architecture and consultancy company. Working at one of our offices in 35 countries you will join 16,000 fellow bright minds in creating innovative and sustainable solutions within Buildings, Transport, Energy, Environment & Health, Architecture, Landscape & Urbanism, Water and Management Consulting. Combining local experience with global knowledge, we help shape the society of tomorrow.
  
  
**Inviting bright minds**
Do you want to push the boundaries of your profession and develop your excellence in an open, collaborative, and empowering culture? We work to create a sustainable future and our inspiring projects and innovative solutions aim to set the standard among our peers. You will join a global company that has been growing successfully since its founding in 1945. Together, we lead and leave a positive impact on societies, companies, and people around the world.
  
  
**Job Description**
The
**Product Architect**
will define and evolve the architecture of Ramboll Tech’s digital products. The role combines product architecture expertise with hands-on technical leadership to ensure products are scalable, secure, maintainable and aligned with enterprise architecture principles, product strategy and business needs.
  
  
This Product Architect role sits at the intersection of Product Owners, engineering teams, Enterprise Architecture and business stakeholders: translating complex needs into coherent product architectures, clear technical decisions and practical delivery guidance.
  
  
Your new role
  
  
As the
**Product Architect**
, you will shape the architecture, quality, and evolution of one or more digital products. You will:
  
  
  

* Define and maintain the target architecture for digital products, balancing business value, user needs, scalability, security and long-term maintainability.
* Translate product requirements into practical architecture decisions, solution blueprints, technical specifications and delivery guardrails.
* Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Engineering Leads, Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders to align product direction with technical feasibility.
* Guide technology choices, integration patterns, cloud services and build-versus-buy decisions with pragmatism and foresight.
* Act as the central technical authority for the product, helping teams manage design trade-offs, technical risks and engineering quality.

**Areas of responsibility**

* Design end-to-end product architectures covering front end, back end, APIs, data, integrations and infrastructure.
* Establish reference architectures, architecture decision records and reusable technical guardrails for digital product teams.
* Support technical discovery, proof-of-concepts and build-versus-buy assessments to validate product feasibility and technology choices.
* Ensure product architectures align with enterprise standards, security expectations, data governance and long-term maintainability.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, engineering teams, Enterprise Architecture, Security, Data and Platform teams to define architecture guardrails and guide technical-quality decisions.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related field.
* 10+ years of experience in software engineering, including several years in architecture, technical leadership or principal engineering roles.
* Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise-grade digital products in cloud-native environments.
* Strong understanding of software architecture, APIs, integration patterns, data architecture, DevOps, security and non-functional requirements.
* Experience working with agile, cross-functional product teams and collaborating closely with Product Owners and engineering teams.
* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Curiosity about emerging technologies, including AI-enabled engineering, and the ability to apply them pragmatically.

**Additional Information**
**Ramboll Tech**
Ramboll Tech accelerates innovation and digital transformation for the entire Ramboll Group and directs all AI-related initiatives within the company. This includes collaborating with GBA and enabling functions at Ramboll on their AI and digital journey, developing proprietary AI and digital products for Ramboll and our clients, and following our product life cycle. Ramboll Tech also works on larger technology projects within Ramboll, providing world-class technology operations. Ramboll Tech currently has over 450 employees globally, with strongholds across the Nordics, Germany, the USA and India. We are looking to quickly expand in key areas across Europe and the globe.

title: Product Manager - SMN
description:
The Product Management function defines the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for platforms and capabilities that deliver customer value and enable business outcomes. By partnering closely with engineering, design, data, operations, and business teams, the function drives outcome focused product discovery and delivery, balances innovation with platform stability, and ensures disciplined prioritization and governance. The team applies modern product management practices, customer centric thinking, and data informed decision making to deliver scalable, high impact digital products across the enterprise.
  
  
The Product Manager owns end to end product delivery for assigned products, platforms, or workflows, ensuring our mobile, desktop, and app platforms deliver exceptional digital experiences while aligning product strategy, discovery, and execution with defined business outcomes, customer needs, and governance requirements. The role enables predictable, high quality product outcomes by owning product backlogs and priorities, driving day to day execution, coordinating with cross functional partners, and delivering scalable, reliable product capabilities from concept through launch in line with organizational product management standards.
  
  
  

Functional Responsibilities

· Own delivery of assigned product features and capabilities by managing product discovery,

backlog refinement, prioritization, and acceptance, using approved product practices, tools,

templates, and quality checks.

· Maintain audit ready product documentation, including product requirements, user stories,

acceptance criteria, roadmap artifacts, and outcome metrics, in line with product governance and

lifecycle expectations.

· Coordinate closely with engineering, design, data, QA, platform, and business partners to secure

inputs, clarify requirements, manage dependencies, and ensure cohesive and scalable product

delivery.

· Ensure readiness for execution by confirming availability of required inputs, design artifacts,

technical dependencies, environment readiness, and stakeholder approvals; maintain regular

status updates, checkpoints, and delivery tracking to enable on time and reliable product

outcomes.

People Responsibilities

· Support and guide UX designers, junior Product Managers, in day-to-day product activities,

ensuring adherence to defined product practices, prioritization discipline, documentation standards,

and outcome focused execution.

· Build effective working relationships with engineering, design, data, QA, and business partners to

align on product priorities, delivery expectations, dependencies, and timelines, enabling clear

communication and smooth end to end product delivery.

Requirements
  
  
  
Requirements
  
  
  

Professional Experience and Relevant Skills

· 4 - 9 years of experience owning and delivering digital product capabilities within enterprise or

large-scale product environments, including end to end responsibility for product backlogs, feature

delivery, and measurable outcomes across the product lifecycle from conception through launch

and iteration.

· Strong ability to apply defined product management practices, prioritization frameworks, delivery

processes, governance standards, and Agile methodologies to deliver reliable, scalable product

features and enhancements.

· Experience collaborating closely with cross functional teams including engineering, design, data,

QA, operations, and business stakeholders to clarify requirements, manage dependencies, and

align delivery expectations across mobile, desktop, and app platforms.

· Working knowledge of product governance, quality, and documentation practices, including well-

structured product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, roadmap artifacts, and outcome

tracking.

· Familiarity with product and delivery tracking tools, Agile planning and execution systems, sprint or

milestone checkpoints, dependency management, and regular status reporting to support

predictable delivery across small to mid-scale product initiatives.

· Experience working within relevant industry domains (e.g., B2B, supply chain, office supplies, or

adjacent enterprise ecosystems), enabling faster domain understanding and informed product

decision making.

Academic Qualifications and Certifications

· Minimum: Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Engineering, Computer Science,

Information Technology, or a related field.

· Preferred: Foundational or practitioner-level certifications in Agile methodologies (e.g., Certified Scrum Master (CSM), SAFe Agilist, or PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP)) or product management certifications (e.g., AIPMM Certified Product Manager)

Skilled at identifying product, delivery, and portfolio risks, assessing trade-offs, and shaping recommendations that balance customer impact, strategic priorities, platform health, and delivery timelines.

Master’s degree in Business, Management, Engineering, or a related discipline and/or relevant certifications in Product Management, Agile, Scrum, SAFe, Lean, Design Thinking, OKRs

title: Data Product Owner
description:
**Lloyd’s Register**
**Location: Chennai – India, Gdansk - Poland, Athens - Greece**
****About The Role:****
The Data Product Owner owns demand management, delivery governance, stakeholder engagement, service performance and value delivery across LR’s data platforms.
  
  
The role is the main point of contact between business stakeholders, delivery teams, operational support and programme teams. It ensures demand is prioritised, governed and delivered effectively.
  
  
The Data Product Owner works with the Platform Product Owner and Reporting Product Owner, with a clear focus on business outcomes, delivery, service performance and stakeholder management.
  
  
The Platform Product Owner is accountable for platform strategy, technical direction, architecture and engineering standards.
  
  
The Reporting Product Owner owns the Power BI Reporting and Analytics service, which uses the data products delivered through the platform’s data engineering capability.
  
  
****What We Offer You****

* Fixed term contract (2 years) with option to extend
* The opportunity to work for an organization that has a strong sense of purpose, is values-driven and helps colleagues to develop professionally and personally through our range of people development programs

**The Role**
*Business Analysis*
Minimum 8 years as a Senior or Lead Business Analyst
  
  
**Required Experience:**

* Lead requirements work for data, analytics and software initiatives, from initial discovery and scope through to validation and benefits review.
* Plan and run workshops with business, technical and operational teams to clarify needs, resolve gaps and agree the way forward.
* Produce clear user stories, process models, functional and non-functional requirements, and measurable acceptance criteria that delivery teams can use.
* Maintain clear links between business objectives, operational issues, agreed requirements, delivered outcomes and expected benefits.

*Product Ownership*
Minimum 8 years Product Owner experience within software, data or analytics environments
  
  
**Required Experience:**

* Own and maintain the delivery backlog, ensuring priorities are clear and items are ready for refinement and delivery.
* Set priorities and shape the roadmap using business value, customer need, delivery risk, technical dependencies and available capacity.
* Provide clear product direction and timely decisions across multidisciplinary software, data or analytics teams.
* Lead sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews and acceptance, confirming that delivery meets the agreed criteria.

*Project & Delivery Management*
**Required Experience:**
Minimum 8 years delivery or project management experience
  
  

* Lead medium-to-large data programmes or work packages from planning and mobilisation through to implementation, transition and closure.
* Build and maintain realistic delivery plans, managing risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies, milestones and resource constraints, and escalating where decisions or intervention are needed.
* Coordinate delivery across business analysis, data engineering, architecture, reporting, testing, service operations and change, with clear responsibilities and hand-offs.
* Manage suppliers against agreed scope, deliverables, service levels and commercial commitments, addressing performance and delivery issues when they arise.

*Service Management*
**Required Experience:**

* Coordinate incidents and operational escalations affecting data platforms and services, with clear triage, ownership, communication and service restoration.
* Lead problem management for recurring or high-impact issues, agreeing actions, owners and target dates and tracking them through to resolution.
* Run evidence-based root cause analysis with internal teams and suppliers, record the findings and add preventative actions to delivery and operational backlogs.
* Lead regular service reviews using performance, availability, demand, incident, problem and improvement data to agree priorities and improve service outcomes.
* Apply ITIL practices across change, incident, problem, request and continual improvement management for a live data service.

*Data & Governance*
**Required Knowledge And Experience:**

* Use a practical understanding of data warehousing, including ingestion, transformation, storage, history and consumption, to shape requirements and delivery priorities.
* Understand conceptual, logical and physical data modelling well enough to discuss business entities, relationships, definitions and downstream impacts with analysts, architects and engineers.
* Understand medallion architecture and how data moves through raw, curated and consumption-ready layers, including the quality and governance expected at each stage.
* Define and support data quality controls covering business rules, validation, ownership, monitoring and issue resolution, so data is trusted and fit for use.
* Work within data governance frameworks covering ownership, stewardship, metadata, access, lineage, retention and regulatory requirements, and build these into delivery.
* Support data maturity work by assessing current practice, identifying priority improvements and turning strategic goals into practical changes across people, process and technology.

****What You Bring****

* Work European business hours (CET/CEST) and travel occasionally to LR offices and client sites in the UK and Europe.
* Provide occasional out-of-hours support for Priority 1 incidents, coordinating internal teams and suppliers through to resolution.
* Report to the Director of Data Systems, who is accountable for LR’s Data Strategy.
* Work directly with clients to understand their needs and support the adoption and onboarding of LR technical services, particularly data exchange services.
* Maritime industry experience is desirable.
* Experience preparing data for AI and integration use cases, with an understanding of AI governance and security, is desirable.
* Line manage a blended team of up to eight LR and supplier data analysts, providing clear priorities, performance support and professional development.
* Manage strategic supplier relationships, promoting effective collaboration across LR and partner teams and establishing consistent Agile and DevOps delivery practices.

*Note:*
The candidate must be able to discuss and challenge these areas. The role does not carry solution architecture or engineering lead accountability.
