**Job Summary**

We are looking for a customer-focused and organized CRM Executive to manage customer enquiries, maintain customer relationships, coordinate with internal departments and ensure timely responses to customer requirements. The candidate will act as a communication link between customers and the company's sales, service, production and project teams to ensure customer satisfaction and smooth business operations.

* Handle incoming customer enquiries through phone calls, emails and other communication channels.

* Build strong relationships with customers and ensure a positive customer experience.
* Follow up with customers regarding pending requirements and ongoing orders.

**2. Enquiry & Sales Coordination**

* Receive and record customer enquiries in the CRM system.
* Coordinate with the sales team for quotation preparation and submission.
* Follow up on submitted quotations and maintain enquiry status.
* Track enquiries, order confirmations and sales opportunities.

* Coordinate with customers after receipt of purchase orders.
* Share order status and delivery updates with customers.
* Coordinate with production, purchase, design and dispatch departments.
* Monitor order progress and follow up to ensure timely delivery.
* Communicate any delays or changes in delivery schedules to customers.
* Maintain records of ongoing projects and customer commitments.

**4. Customer Complaint & Service Coordination**

* Receive and register customer complaints and service requests.
* Coordinate with the service and technical teams for complaint resolution.
* Follow up on pending service issues and ensure timely closure.
* Maintain records of complaints, corrective actions and customer feedback.
* Collect customer feedback and identify areas for improvement.
* Ensure proper communication with customers until their issues are resolved.

**5. Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain customer information and enquiry records in CRM software or Excel.
* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly enquiry and follow-up reports.
* Maintain records of quotations, purchase orders and customer communications.
* Track pending quotations, orders, payments and service requests.
* Prepare customer visit reports and sales coordination reports.
* Coordinate with the accounts department for payment reminders and outstanding follow-ups.

**6. Internal Department Coordination**

* Coordinate with sales, service, production, purchase and accounts departments.
* Ensure timely sharing of customer requirements with the concerned teams.
* Follow up on internal commitments and pending customer requests.
* Support management with customer-related reports and business updates.

**Required Skills**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Good customer handling and relationship management abilities.
* Knowledge of CRM software and MS Excel.
* Strong follow-up and coordination skills.
* Ability to handle multiple customer enquiries simultaneously.
* Good email drafting and documentation skills.
* Problem-solving and customer complaint-handling abilities.
* Positive attitude and customer-oriented approach.

**Educational Qualification**

* Graduate in B.Com / BBA / B.Sc. / B.E. / Diploma in Engineering or any relevant discipline.
* Additional certification in CRM or customer relationship management will be an advantage.

**Experience**

* 1–3 years of experience in CRM, customer support or sales coordination.
* Experience in manufacturing, industrial equipment, laboratory instruments or engineering companies will be preferred.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely response to customer enquiries.
* Effective quotation and order follow-ups.

title: Head of Content
description:
The Role

You lead the creative direction, planning and quality of content at every place a customer meets our marketing.

The company agrees the business and brand priorities. You decide how they become content & ownership for its quality and its delivery on time.

**Your authority:** Within the agreed brand guidelines, budgets and campaign goals, you approve everyday creatives, choose the creative approach and direct production without sign-off at every step.

What You Will Own1. THE STANDARD

* **Brand content standard:** Write down what good content looks like for our brand. Clearly enough that anyone on the team can judge a piece without you in the room.
* **Quality check:** Nothing goes out until it passes that standard. Check work at the draft stage, so problems are fixed with time to spare and not rescued the night before.
* **Templates and image library:** Keep fixed templates for each product line and one organised library of approved images and videos (to be done your reportees but ownership would rest with the candidate).

2. THE PLAN

* **Monthly calendar:** Lock next month’s calendar by the 25th, and keep a view of the two to three months after it.
* **Planning ahead:** Leave time for shoots, corrections and repeat rounds on creatives. Get inputs early: about a month ahead from store display, 15 days from merchandising and 7 days from sales.
* **Customer-led planning:** Plan each product line by customer type, occasion and price range, so content answers why someone would buy and is not only a product display.

3. THE MAKING

* **Briefs:** Write clear briefs for shoots, designers, creators, agencies and the Growth team.
* **Shoots:** Have products, references, model, styling, hair and makeup ready well before the day. Lead the shoot and make the calls on set.
* **Campaigns into everyday ads:** Carry the look and message of each big agency campaign into everyday ads and posts.
* **Creatives for the Growth team:** Deliver ad creatives on time and in the right sizes.

4. PEOPLE WHO APPEAR FOR THE BRAND

* **Creator programme:** Build a programme of regular creators, so that Manubhai has a human face and our awareness campaigns have real people in them. You find the talent, brief them, direct the shoot and check the output.

5. LEARNING AND THE TEAM

* **Monthly review:** Each month, show what worked, what did not and why. At least three changes in next month’s calendar must come from this review.
* **Team:** Coach & lead content team. Current content team includes - coordinator, senior visualiser, designer, photographer, social media exec.

Who We Are Looking For

* **Experience:** Five years or more in content or brand work for a consumer brand, having led people and managed agencies.
* **Background:** Jewellery, fashion, beauty, lifestyle or any high-value consumer category. Jewellery experience is not needed.
* **Proof of building:** A content process you set up yourself that kept running.
* **Eye and firmness:** A good eye for premium work, and the firmness to reject what is below standard.
* **Gets things done:** Plans early and gets work out of other teams without going through your reporting manager.
* **Business sense:** Curious about why customers buy, and comfortable reading performance numbers.
* **AI-native:** You have completed a proper course in AI in the last two years, not a short workshop, and you use AI tools in your daily work.

Pay: ₹1,500,000.00 - ₹2,000,000.00 per year

Sr Engineering Manager-MR RF Coils

### **Job Description**

**Sr Engineering Manager-MR RF Coils**

  

**The Senior Engineering Manager is part of the Global MR R&D organization** , specific to the MR Coils R&D sub-organization that delivers impact to the MR business. The role leads a multidisciplinary RF Coils engineering team and manages engineering execution across product development, manufacturing transfer, supplier transition, lifecycle engineering and post-market support.

  

The primary function of this role is to build and transform the MR Coils R&D organization to deliver future customer and business needs while ensuring product quality, regulatory compliance, supply continuity, reliability and productivity.

  

**Your role:**

Drive and support end-to-end MR RF Coil development from concept, design and validation through manufacturing transfer and post-market support.

Develop and maintain the technology, product and lifecycle roadmap for MR RF Coils aligned with system requirements, future platforms, installed-base needs and business priorities.

title: Accountant
description:
Position: Account Executive

Industry: Real Estate / Construction

Location: Upper Thane, Maharashtra

Department: Finance & Accounts

Experience: 3–5 Years

Job Overview

We are looking for a detail-oriented Account Executive to manage day-to-day accounting operations for our real estate and construction projects. The candidate will be responsible for maintaining financial records, handling vendor and contractor payments, monitoring project expenses and ensuring timely payment processing.

Key Responsibilities

1. Day-to-Day Accounting

Handle daily accounting transactions, including purchase, sales, receipts and payment entries.

Maintain books of accounts, ledgers, journals and financial records.

Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable.

Perform bank and vendor reconciliations.

Maintain proper documentation of financial transactions.

2. Real Estate & Project Accounting

Maintain project-wise accounting records and expense statements.

Track construction expenses, material purchases and project-related costs.

Verify vendor, contractor and supplier invoices against purchase orders and work orders.

Monitor project budgets and actual expenses.

Maintain records of land purchases, property-related expenses and project transactions, wherever applicable.

Track customer bookings, advances, instalments and outstanding payments.

Maintain records of customer receipts and payment schedules.

Coordinate with project and site teams regarding bills, expenses and payment approvals.

3. Vendor & Payment Management

Ensure timely processing and clearance of vendor, contractor and supplier payments.

Verify invoices and supporting documents before processing payments.

Follow up on outstanding payments and receivables.

Maintain payment schedules and vendor outstanding reports.

4. Taxation & Compliance

Assist with GST calculations, reconciliations and return-related documentation.

Handle TDS calculations, deductions and payment records.

Maintain records required for statutory audits and financial reporting.

Coordinate with external consultants for taxation and compliance matters.

5. Reporting & Coordination

Prepare daily, weekly and monthly expense and payment reports.

Maintain accurate financial data in accounting software and Excel.

Coordinate with internal departments, vendors, contractors and management.

Ensure all accounting records are updated and properly maintained.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Commerce (B.Com) or equivalent qualification.

3–5 years of experience in accounting, preferably in real estate or construction.

Good knowledge of Tally Prime and MS Excel.

Understanding of GST, TDS, bank reconciliation and vendor management.

Knowledge of project-wise accounting and construction-related expenses.

Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

Good communication and coordination skills.

Preferred Candidate Profile

Prior experience handling accounts in a real estate or construction company.

Ability to manage multiple project-related transactions.

Strong follow-up skills to ensure timely payments and collections.

Ability to maintain financial records and meet deadlines.

Pay: ₹8,500.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

* Flexible schedule
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

title: Head of Product – Distribution & Revenue Generation
description:
**Overview**

The Head of Product, Distribution & Revenue Generation is a senior product leadership role responsible for the strategy and delivery of Access Hospitality's distribution and revenue-generation capability across the APAC region – spanning Channel Management, Booking Engine, Rate Shopping, Connectivity, Revenue Management Systems, Review Management and Digital Marketing Services. This role succeeds Gavin Jeddo, Founder of STAAH, and carries the responsibility of preserving and extending the credibility STAAH has built with OTA, channel and technology partners across the region while integrating the product into Access's broader Accommodation platform strategy.

Reporting to the MD, India / Hospitality Capability Centre with a dotted line into the Head of Product, Accommodation (UK), this leader owns the regional distribution and revenue product roadmap and is the primary internal and external voice for how independent hotels and hotel chains in APAC drive bookings, optimise rate and channel mix, and reduce dependency on costly OTA distribution. The role sits within Access's Federated Product, Shared Capability operating model – balancing HCC and regional market/partner depth with alignment to the global Accommodation platform and the 2027 AI-native migration priority. The role is based in Pune and will work closely with product engineering leadership based across Pune, UK, US and NZ, with some travel required.

The ideal candidate brings deep, hands-on accommodation-technology domain expertise – built inside an OTA, PMS company, channel manager, revenue management system or adjacent part of the accommodation technology stack – combined with the commercial instincts to connect product decisions directly to distribution cost, direct booking share and revenue outcomes for customers.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Distribution & Revenue Product Strategy**

* Own the regional product vision, strategy and roadmap for Channel Management, Booking Engine, Rate Shopping, Connectivity and Revenue Management Systems, aligned to APAC commercial priorities and the global Accommodation platform direction
* Define a coherent distribution and revenue product architecture that enhances our customers positioning whilst maximising visibility and yield across the channels that matter in APAC markets
* Set prioritisation frameworks that balance direct booking growth, channel partner breadth, rate/revenue optimisation and customer retention
* Lead product investment decisions in partnership with engineering and finance, grounded in commercial impact – distribution cost reduction, RevPAR/ADR uplift and channel yield
* Monitor the competitive OTA, channel management and revenue management landscape across APAC (including region-specific players and metasearch/OTA dynamics) to continuously sharpen product positioning

**AI-Native Distribution & Revenue Capabilities**

* Lead the product strategy for AI-native and agentic capability within the distribution and revenue suite – including automated rate optimisation, dynamic pricing recommendations, AI-assisted channel mix decisioning and automated review response
* Embed AI across the product suite where it demonstrably improves revenue or reduces manual effort – intelligent rate shopping insights, forecasting-driven pricing, and automation of routine channel and connectivity management tasks
* Work with engineering leadership to ensure AI/agentic features sit on a scalable, interoperable data foundation and connect cleanly into the global Accommodation platform migration
* Define packaging, pricing and migration pathways so customers can adopt new distribution and revenue capability with confidence

**Commercial & Customer Outcomes**

* Partner with the GM APAC, the Head of Product UK, Head of Engineering APAC and regional commercial leadership to ensure the roadmap directly supports direct booking mix growth, distribution cost reduction and NRR/GRR performance
* Own product-led metrics including channel adoption, connectivity partner coverage, feature usage and customer satisfaction, using these to inform roadmap and GTM decisions
* Engage directly with key hotel and hotel-group customers across APAC to validate roadmap direction, and directly with OTA, GDS and channel partners to maintain and extend commercial relationships built under STAAH's founder-led model
* Support pricing and packaging strategy across the distribution and revenue product portfolio, including tiering for digital marketing services and RMS capability

**Product Delivery & Quality**

* Lead a regional product management team, setting clear standards for discovery, prioritisation, delivery and iteration across the distribution and revenue product lines
* Work in close partnership with the STAAH and SHR engineering organisations to ensure delivery velocity, quality and alignment with the broader platform vision
* Establish product governance rhythms consistent with the HCC's Service Catalogue / SLA and Communities of Practice model, including roadmap reviews and launch readiness criteria
* Ensure product releases are accompanied by strong GTM readiness, including partner and sales enablement, documentation and customer communication

**Cross-functional & Regional Leadership**

* Partner with regional Go-to-Market and commercial teams to translate distribution and revenue product capability into propositions that resonate with APAC hoteliers
* Collaborate with the Hospitality CPO and global Accommodation product leadership to align the regional roadmap with the broader platform strategy and 2027 migration
* Work with STAAH's product engineering leadership to ensure technical foundations support the distribution and revenue roadmap, and act as the connective product leader across engineering sites
* Represent Accommodation distribution and revenue product externally with customers, channel/OTA partners and at APAC industry events – stepping into the external credibility role previously held by the Founder

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Direct booking mix growth and reduction in OTA/channel commission cost attributable to product
* GRR/NRR performance for the distribution and revenue product suite

* AI/agentic capability adoption and measurable efficiency or revenue gains
* Roadmap delivery cadence and on-time release achievement

**Essential Experience**

**Accommodation technology domain experience is a mandatory requirement for this role – candidates without a genuine background inside the accommodation technology stack will not be considered, regardless of general SaaS product credentials.**

* Proven track record as a senior product leader within accommodation technology – an OTA, a PMS company, a channel manager/connectivity provider, a revenue management system vendor, a GDS, or a booking engine / CRS / IBE product organisation
* Direct, hands-on experience with the mechanics of hotel distribution – channel management, rate parity and rate shopping, connectivity/integrations, and the commercial dynamics between direct and OTA channels
* Experience with revenue management concepts and systems (dynamic pricing, forecasting, RevPAR/ADR optimisation), even if not the primary product owned
* Strong commercial acumen with direct experience connecting product decisions to distribution cost, direct booking share, pricing and packaging outcomes
* Demonstrated ability to lead product teams in high-growth, PE-backed, founder-led or fast-paced scale-up environments
* Experience operating across APAC hospitality markets, with credibility to engage OTA, GDS and channel partners directly
* Track record of managing product through a leadership transition, M&A integration or platform migration programme is highly advantageous, given this role succeeds a company Founder
* Comfortable operating in matrixed, federated organisations, influencing without direct authority across engineering, commercial, and regional and global product leadership

**Required Skills & Attributes**

**Distribution & Commercial Acumen**

* Deep, practical understanding of hotel distribution economics – channel cost, rate parity, OTA/metasearch dynamics and direct booking conversion
* Strong financial fluency – understands unit economics, pricing architecture and the commercial levers that drive distribution and revenue product growth
* Data-driven approach to prioritisation, using channel performance, booking and revenue data to make clear, defensible product decisions

**AI & Technology Fluency**

* AI-native product mindset applied to distribution and revenue use cases – can identify where AI creates real yield or efficiency gains versus where it is superficial
* Able to engage substantively with engineering on connectivity architecture, data modelling and technical feasibility of AI-driven pricing and channel features
* Stays current with distribution, channel management, RMS and OTA/metasearch trends specific to APAC hospitality markets

**Leadership & Communication**

* Inspiring, credible leader who can attract, develop and retain product talent, and who can step confidently into a role vacated by a company Founder
* Exceptional communicator – able to represent the product externally to OTA, GDS and channel partners as well as internally to customers, executives and engineering teams
* High EQ and collaborative style; builds trust across a federated, matrixed regional and global organisation
* Bias for action combined with rigorous thinking – drives pace without sacrificing quality

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree required; degree in technology, business or a related discipline preferred
* Significant experience in product management or product leadership roles specifically within accommodation/hospitality technology – OTA, PMS, channel management, RMS or booking engine businesses
* Demonstrated experience owning commercially accountable product decisions with a clear line of sight to distribution cost and revenue outcomes
* MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification an advantage but not required

**What We're Looking For**

* **Accommodation domain credibility –**
  Has deep, first-hand knowledge of how hotels distribute and generate revenue – built inside the accommodation technology stack, not adjacent to it:
* **Commercial ownership –**
  Treats distribution and revenue product decisions as commercial decisions, with a clear line of sight from roadmap choices to direct booking growth and channel cost reduction:
* **Technical credibility –**
  Can engage substantively with engineering and connectivity architecture, and has delivered AI-powered pricing or channel features that customers actually use:
* **Partner and customer relationships –**
  Builds close relationships with OTA, GDS and channel partners as well as customers, and can step into the external-facing role previously carried by a company Founder:
* **Pace and rigour –**
  Moves quickly, sets high standards, and holds themselves and their team accountable for delivery quality:
* **Collaborative influence –**
  Earns trust across a federated regional and global organisation and aligns diverse stakeholders behind a shared product direction:

description:
**Job Description – Senior Project Manager (BMS)**

**Location:**
Delhi NCR

**Experience:**
5+ Years

**Department:**
BMS Projects

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced Senior Project Manager – BMS to manage end-to-end execution of Building Management System projects. The candidate will be responsible for project planning, site execution, resource management, client coordination, vendor management, and timely project delivery.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in BMS installation, integration, testing, and commissioning, along with strong project management and stakeholder management skills.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Project Planning and Execution**

* Manage end-to-end execution of BMS projects from project initiation and planning to installation, testing, commissioning, and final handover.
* Prepare project schedules, execution plans, resource plans, and milestone trackers.
* Monitor project progress and ensure timely completion within the approved scope and budget.
* Coordinate BMS installation activities at commercial buildings, offices, data centres, and other infrastructure projects, as applicable.
* Ensure project activities are aligned with approved drawings, specifications, BOQs, and contractual requirements.

**2. BMS Technical Coordination**

* Oversee installation and integration of BMS field devices, controllers, sensors, actuators, and control panels.
* Coordinate integration of HVAC equipment and other building systems with the BMS platform.
* Monitor testing, commissioning, system functionality, and troubleshooting activities.
* Coordinate with design and engineering teams for shop drawings, control schematics, points lists, and technical submittals.
* Ensure proper integration and communication between BMS controllers, field devices, and supervisory software using protocols such as BACnet and Modbus, wherever applicable.
* Ensure completion of testing reports, commissioning documentation, and system handover.

**3. Client and Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the primary point of contact for clients, consultants, MEP contractors, electrical contractors, and other project stakeholders.
* Conduct project review meetings and provide regular progress updates.
* Resolve technical and execution-related issues in coordination with engineering teams.
* Manage client expectations, project escalations, approvals, and changes in scope.
* Ensure customer satisfaction throughout project execution and handover.

**4. Team and Vendor Management**

* Lead and coordinate site engineers, technicians, subcontractors, and installation teams.
* Allocate resources and monitor productivity at project sites.
* Coordinate with OEMs, suppliers, and vendors for equipment procurement, delivery, and technical support.
* Ensure material availability in line with project schedules.
* Monitor subcontractor performance and ensure adherence to project timelines and quality standards.

**5. Budget and Commercial Management**

* Prepare and monitor project budgets, cost estimates, and resource requirements.
* Track project expenses and control cost overruns.
* Review BOQs, material requirements, and project scope variations.
* Coordinate with commercial and finance teams for billing, payment follow-ups, and variation claims.
* Support preparation of project completion reports and final commercial closure.

**6. Quality, Safety and Compliance**

* Ensure BMS installations comply with approved drawings, technical specifications, and applicable quality standards.
* Conduct regular site inspections and review installation quality.
* Ensure compliance with site safety requirements and contractor guidelines.
* Identify project risks, delays, and technical issues and implement corrective actions.
* Maintain proper documentation for inspections, testing, commissioning, and handover.

**7. Reporting and Documentation**

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly project progress reports.
* Maintain project schedules, material trackers, risk registers, and issue logs.
* Track project milestones, pending approvals, and outstanding work.
* Ensure timely submission of technical documents, testing reports, as-built drawings, and operation and maintenance manuals.
* Coordinate final project handover to the client and operations team.

**Educational Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

**Required Experience and Skills**

* 5–8 years of experience in BMS project execution and project management.
* Hands-on experience in BMS installation, integration, testing, and commissioning.
* Strong understanding of HVAC controls, field devices, DDC controllers, control panels, and BMS architecture.
* Working knowledge of communication protocols such as BACnet and Modbus.
* Experience in managing site engineers, subcontractors, vendors, and client stakeholders.
* Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, control schematics, BOQs, and project specifications.
* Experience in project scheduling, cost control, material planning, and progress reporting.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and project tracking tools.
* Strong leadership, communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
* Willingness to travel to project sites as required.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely completion of BMS projects against agreed milestones.
* Adherence to project budgets and cost estimates.
* Quality of installation and commissioning with minimal rework.
* Timely resolution of site and technical issues.
* Effective coordination with clients, consultants, and subcontractors.
* Material planning and availability aligned with project schedules.
* Timely completion of documentation and project handover.
* Client satisfaction and compliance with project specifications.

title: Business Operations Senior Associate
description:
**About The Role**
You are part of the operations team, but you spend about 90% of your time working inside the Growth and Strategy team. You sit in its key meetings, including those with partners and funders, and become its operating backbone. You track every opportunity and program, build the templates and processes the team uses, and keep the information that leadership, funders and partners rely on complete and current.
  
  
You are also the link between Growth and Operations. Every new opportunity should meet our budget, due diligence and approval requirements from day one, without slowing the team down. The aim is that the Growth and implementation teams spend less time on admin, not more.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Pipeline and CRM: Own documentation of every opportunity, from the first conversation with a lead through to active grants. Own mechanisms to keep the CRM complete and current so that it is the single source for pipeline reporting.
* Program budgets and financial tracking: Work with the Finance and Operations teams and each Growth lead to build and maintain a budget for every program and opportunity. Build mechanisms to ensure monthly spend-vs-actual reporting with Finance. Make sure no proposal goes out without a full cost-recovery budget and the required sign-off.
* Project management and reporting: Roll out and maintain our standard program management template. Ensure there is a live tracker of every large program, covering fundraising, spend, plans and implementation. Produce monthly and quarterly progress reports for leadership.
* Due diligence and approvals: Oversee partner due diligence for every new implementing partner. Prepare Go/No-Go papers for the Investment Committee. Keep the documentation trail for each stage of approval.
* Knowledge management: Capture notes, decisions and actions from Growth meetings and partner conversations in one place, and follow up on agreed actions so nothing is lost.
* Templates and process: Design simple templates and fill in the information yourself where you can, so that process works for the team rather than against it.
* Automation: Build and use AI agents and automation tools for data extraction, tracking and routine reporting, so that reporting is fast and repeatable.

**Required Qualifications**

* An undergraduate or master's degree in business administration, economics, public policy or a related field.
* 4 to 6 years of experience in project management, operations, business operations or similar roles.
* Strong organisation and project-management skills: you build trackers, templates and structured documentation, and keep them current.
* Comfort with budgets and spreadsheets: you can build a program budget and track spend against it.
* Hands-on experience with project management tools and CRM software.
* The ability to get busy senior colleagues to adopt new processes, by earning their buy-in rather than relying on authority.
* Strong coordination with internal teams and external partners and funders.
* Reliable and timely, with a consistent record of following through.
* Clear written and spoken English.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in a mission-driven, grant-funded, or international-development organization, or exposure to fundraising, grants, or funder reporting.
* Experience setting up or using AI agents or automation tools for data extraction, tracking, or reporting.
* Experience working as an operations or business-operations partner embedded with a growth, fundraising, or product team.
* Experience building reporting processes or a documentation hub from the ground up in a small or fast-growing organization.
* Familiarity with the grant lifecycle and funder pipeline management.

title: Oracle EPM Cloud Consultant
description:
BlackStone eIT is looking for an experienced Oracle EPM Cloud Consultant to join a multi-phase Oracle Cloud transformation for a public-sector organisation in the UAE. You will implement Oracle EPM Cloud for budgeting, planning, financial consolidation, management reporting and cost analysis, fully connected to Oracle Fusion ERP.
  
  
You will work closely with the client's finance teams and lead the EPM workstream from design through testing and go-live, reporting to the Program Manager.
  
  

* Lead planning and budgeting workshops and solution design with finance stakeholders
* Lead consolidation and close workshops and design
* Configure Oracle EPM Planning (EPBCS), Financial Consolidation and Close (FCCS) and Narrative Reporting
* Set up data integration from Oracle Fusion ERP, including mappings, scheduled loads and reconciliation of actuals
* Support Profitability and Cost Management and Enterprise Data Management (EDM) set-up
* Lead EPM testing and user acceptance testing (UAT), from test planning to defect resolution and sign-off
* Support go-lives and hand over to the client team

**Requirements**
**What you bring (must have)**

* 8+ years of professional experience, including 4+ years of Oracle EPM Cloud
* Hands-on experience implementing Oracle EPM Cloud Planning (EPBCS) and Financial Consolidation and Close (FCCS)
* Experience with Narrative Reporting
* ERP integration experience using Data Integration
* Strong Smart View skills
* Excellent written and spoken English
* Ability to travel to Dubai regularly: a valid passport and flexibility for on-site weeks

**Good to have**

* Profitability and Cost Management (PCM)
* Enterprise Data Management (EDM)
* Account Reconciliation
* Groovy business rules
* Government budgeting experience
* Arabic

**Who will succeed in this role**
You have taken Oracle EPM Cloud projects from design all the way to go-live, not only supported them in production. You are comfortable running workshops with senior finance users, translating their needs into a clear design, and then building and testing it yourself. You work well in a remote-first team and are happy to be on site in Dubai when the project needs it.

title: Onboarding Manager
description:
**About TravelCalls**

TravelCalls helps hotels and travel companies handle booking changes, guest requests and supplier follow-ups across phone and email. We’re in the early stages of our commercial rollout.

**About the role**

**What you’ll do**

* Lead customer kickoffs and agree on the first workflow, launch plan and success criteria.

* Experience with travel operations, hospitality software or booking systems is a plus.

title: Manager - AI Delivery
description:
**About Sirius AI**

Sirius AI is an AI-first consulting and solutions firm serving financial services clients: banks, fintechs, payments companies and wealth managers. We help enterprises move from AI ideas to production-ready solutions using GenAI, agentic AI, ML platforms and advanced analytics, delivering measurable business impact. Our strength lies in combining FS domain expertise, hands-on AI delivery and enterprise-grade execution.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Manager - AI Delivery to run day-to-day delivery of AI engagements for our financial services clients in the US. You will own the plan, the team and the client relationship for one or more AI projects, making sure GenAI, agentic AI and ML solutions are built, tested and shipped to production on time, on budget and to regulated-industry standards.

This is a hands-on delivery role for someone who understands the AI lifecycle well enough to spot technical risk early, and who enjoys building strong, well-run teams. You will work closely with technical leads and engineers, many of them early in their careers, and report into our AI delivery leadership.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own day-to-day delivery of one or more AI projects, from requirements and design through build, testing, deployment and hypercare.
* Translate client business objectives into clear scope, user stories, acceptance criteria and technical execution plans together with solution architects and technical leads.
* Run the delivery cadence: sprint planning, stand-ups, demos, retrospectives, milestone tracking, status reporting and RAID management.
* Track scope, estimates, effort, budget and utilisation; manage change requests and escalate risks to leadership and clients early.
* Make sure AI-specific work is planned properly, including data readiness, model and prompt evaluation, testing of non-deterministic outputs, and production monitoring.
* Apply delivery standards for code review, testing, documentation, MLOps/AIOps and quality gates before work reaches clients.
* Coordinate across data engineering, ML/AI engineering, application development, QA and client IT, security and risk teams.
* Lead, coach and support a team of engineers and analysts; contribute to onboarding, performance feedback and skills development.
* Be the primary day-to-day contact for client stakeholders, run project reviews and keep expectations aligned on scope, timelines and outcomes.
* Ensure delivery meets AI governance, security, data privacy and FS compliance requirements, with complete project documentation.
* Contribute to reusable templates, playbooks and lessons learned, and support pre-sales with estimates and project plans.

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics or a related field; a master's degree or MBA is a plus.
* 5+ years of experience in technology, data or analytics delivery, including at least 2–3 years managing AI/ML, Agentic AI or advanced analytics projects.
* Experience delivering AI/ML or Agentic AI solutions into production for enterprise clients.
* Working technical understanding of the AI lifecycle, including data pipelines, model development, LLMs and RAG, AIOps/MLOps, deployment, inferencing and monitoring.
* Strong command of Agile and hybrid delivery methods, estimation, project financials and tools such as Jira, Confluence or Azure DevOps.
* Experience managing and developing small to mid-sized delivery teams, including junior and early-career talent.
* Experience in consulting firms, AI services companies or global delivery centres.
* Clear, structured communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain technical progress and risks in business terms.

**Good to Have**

* Delivery experience with financial services clients in banking, fintech, payments, risk, fraud, compliance or wealth management.
* Exposure to agentic AI, LLM orchestration or intelligent automation projects.
* Familiarity with cloud AI platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP, Databricks).
* Experience working in onshore/offshore or distributed delivery models.
* Certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, CSM/SAFe or cloud AI certifications.

title: Project Lead- Paonta Sahib
description:
**Who is Turner & Townsend?**

All over the world people are using buildings, infrastructure, and assets we helped to deliver. It could be the hospital they work in, the railway they travel on every day, the fuel that powers their car or the data centre they depend on at work. For more than 75 years we’ve been helping to deliver transformational programmes across the real estate, infrastructure and natural resources sectors, making a difference to people’s lives and ensuring a return on investment for our clients and their investors.

**Our purpose:**

**Transforming performance for a green, inclusive, and productive world.**

The world is changing and we have a responsibility to support that change, helping drive it and be part of it. Through the commitment, capability and care our team brings, we build trust between clients, suppliers, governments and society. Delivering better outcomes that have a positive impact on the world around us. We work smarter to face the challenges of the future; bringing the clarity that helps teams realise their full potential across the real estate, infrastructure and natural resources sectors. It’s how we’ve made the difference for more than 75 years.

**Our values:**

**Love a challenge:**
We love a challenge and we work hard to make change happen and see things through. We don’t stand still, challenging ourselves and others to do better every day. And we are trusted to do the right thing, raising standards all the time.

**Stronger together:**
We’re stronger together by connecting people in diverse teams, so that we can all collaborate to deliver our best work. We focus on what matters and use our influence to build a better world for everyone.

**Bring out the best in everyone:**
We bring out the best in everyone. We help each other to make the most of our potential, always learning from our experience. We treat each other with care and respect and make time to give everyone a voice

title: IT Lead - SAP S/4HANA ( PP, MM, QM, PM, EWM) -Textile & Apparel Industry
description:
**Role Summary**

We are seeking an experienced
**SAP Implementation Lead**
to drive end-to-end SAP programs for our Textile business. You will own the full implementation lifecycle, from requirement gathering and blueprinting through build, testing, cutover, go-live and hypercare. You will be the key interface between Business Leadership, Corporate IT and implementation partners, ensuring that business requirements become scalable SAP solutions that drive operational excellence.

The ideal candidate combines
**hands-on SAP implementation and rollout experience**
with strong textile manufacturing knowledge, and can lead business stakeholders, system integrators and internal IT teams through large-scale transformation.

**Key Responsibilities**

**SAP Implementation & Delivery (Core)**

* Lead end-to-end SAP implementation, rollout, migration, enhancement and optimization initiatives for the Textile business across all project phases: Prepare, Explore/Blueprint, Realize, Deploy and Run.
* Conduct requirement workshops and fit-gap analysis, and translate business needs into functional specifications, solution designs and configuration requirements.
* Work closely with SAP functional, technical, integration and implementation partner teams to ensure quality, on-time solution delivery.
* Own the project plan, milestones, risks, dependencies and stakeholder expectations across multi-location rollouts.
* Coordinate system integration testing, user acceptance testing (UAT), data migration, cutover planning, go-live and post-go-live (hypercare) support.
* Lead user training, change management and adoption initiatives to ensure sustained use of SAP-enabled processes.
* Promote standardization of business processes and adoption of SAP best practices across manufacturing locations through a global/local template approach.

**Business Partnership & Process Transformation**

* Partner with Textile Business Heads to understand priorities, operational challenges and transformation opportunities.
* Act as the primary liaison between the Textile business and the Enterprise Applications team for SAP and related technology initiatives.
* Drive process improvements across procurement, production planning, manufacturing, inventory, warehousing, quality and supply chain.

**Master Data & Governance**

* Ensure effective governance of business processes and master data, including Materials, BOMs, Routings, Vendors and Production Masters, and plan their migration and validation during implementation.

**Innovation & Continuous Improvement**

* Identify opportunities for automation, analytics, AI and Industry 4.0 initiatives that build on the SAP landscape.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives that enhance productivity, quality, traceability and operational efficiency.

**Qualification & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology, Textile Engineering or a related discipline. MBA is an added advantage.
* 14+ years of experience in Textile Manufacturing and SAP-enabled business transformation, with
  **significant hands-on involvement in SAP implementation projects**
  .
* **Proven track record of leading multiple full-lifecycle SAP implementations, rollouts or transformation programs**
  , from blueprint to go-live and stabilization.
* Strong expertise in one or more SAP modules (PP, MM, QM, PM, EWM/WM) with a sound understanding of end-to-end cross-module integration.
* **Experience in SAP S/4HANA implementation or migration**
  (greenfield, brownfield or hybrid) is strongly preferred.
* Experience managing implementation partners/system integrators, including scope, deliverables and quality governance.
* Hands-on experience with fit-gap analysis, functional specifications, UAT, data migration, cutover and hypercare.
* Strong domain knowledge of textile manufacturing: spinning, weaving, knitting, dyeing, finishing, garment manufacturing, planning, procurement, inventory, warehousing and quality management.
* Strong analytical, stakeholder management, communication and problem-solving skills.
* Experience in multi-location or global manufacturing environments.

**Preferred Sills**

* SAP certification (S/4HANA or module-specific) is desirable but not mandatory.
* Knowledge of SAP Fiori, SAP Analytics and manufacturing dashboards.
* Exposure to MES, Industry 4.0, IoT, shop-floor automation, barcode/RFID or warehouse automation integrated with SAP.
* Experience with AI, analytics and digital transformation initiatives in manufacturing.

**Key Competencies**

SAP Implementation Leadership, SAP Solution Design & Enablement, Project & Change Management, Business Partnership, Manufacturing Process Excellence, Process Standardization, Stakeholder Management, Digital Transformation, Collaboration & Influencing, Results Orientation

**Success Measures**

* On-time, on-budget delivery of SAP implementation and rollout milestones with successful go-lives.
* Smooth post-go-live stabilization with minimal business disruption.
* Higher user adoption of SAP-enabled processes across locations.
* Improved manufacturing efficiency and process standardization.
* Clean, governed master data and strong Business–IT partnership.
* Measurable business value delivered through SAP and technology-enabled transformation.

The Highway Design Manager is responsible for leading and managing the design and engineering activities for highway, expressway, road, and transportation infrastructure projects. The role involves planning, coordinating, reviewing, and delivering highway design solutions in compliance with client requirements, national/international standards, and project timelines.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Highway Design & Engineering***

* Lead the geometric design of highways, expressways, urban roads, interchanges, intersection.
* Review and approve alignment studies, horizontal and vertical profiles, cross-sections, and corridor development plans in plan & hilly areas.
* Ensure compliance with IRC, MoRTH, NHAI, AASHTO, and other applicable design standards.

* Prepare and review feasibility studies, DPRs (Detailed Project Reports), and detailed engineering designs.

* Identify project risks and develop mitigation strategies.
* Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams, consultants, contractors, and stakeholders.

* Conduct technical reviews of design deliverables and ensure quality compliance.
* Verify calculations, drawings, reports, and specifications before submission.
* Implement quality management procedures and best engineering practices.
* Ensure adherence to project-specific quality standards and regulatory requirements.

***Client & Stakeholder Coordination***

* Act as the primary technical point of contact for clients.
* Participate in design review meetings, presentations, and technical discussions.
* Liaise with government authorities, approval agencies, and project stakeholders.
* Address client comments and ensure timely incorporation into design deliverables.

***Team Leadership***

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of highway engineers, designers, and CAD/BIM professionals.
* Assign tasks and monitor team performance.
* Support recruitment, training, and competency development initiatives.

***Software & Design Tools***

* Utilize and guide teams in the use of:
  + Civil 3D
  + OpenRoads Designer
  + AutoCAD
  + InfraWorks
  + BIM platforms and other highway design software

**Experience**

* 12–18+ years of experience in highway and road design projects.
* Experience in NHAI, MoRTH, Expressway, Metro Access Roads, State Highway, or International Highway Projects.
* Proven experience in managing multidisciplinary design teams.

**Required Skills**

* Highway Geometric Design
* Detailed Project Report (DPR) Preparation
* Road Safety Audit Coordination
* Pavement Design Coordination
* Traffic & Transportation Planning Knowledge
* Project Management
* Client Handling & Stakeholder Management
* Team Leadership
* Excellent Communication & Presentation Skills
* Strong Knowledge of IRC, MoRTH, and International Design Standards

* Geometric Design Drawings
* Detailed Engineering Reports
* Design Calculations & Technical Documentation
* Client Presentations & Technical Submissions
* Quality-Compliant Design Deliverables
* Timely Project Completion within Budget and Schedule

This role is critical in ensuring the successful delivery of road and highway infrastructure projects from concept through detailed design and implementation.

* **Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering.
* Master's Degree in Transportation Engineering/Highway Engineering preferred.
* Professional certifications in transportation or project management will be an added advantage.

title: Director- Delivery ops
description:
Acuity Analytics
  
  
Acuity Analytics (Acuity) is a leading provider of bespoke research, analytics and technology solutions to the financial services sector, including asset managers, corporate and investment banks, private equity and venture capital firms, hedge funds and consulting firms. Its global network of over 6,800 analysts and industry experts, combined with proprietary technology, supports more than 680 financial institutions and consulting companies to operate more efficiently and unlock their human capital, driving revenue higher and transforming operations. Acuity is headquartered in London and operates from 20 locations worldwide.
  
  
The company fosters a diverse, equitable and inclusive work environment, nurturing talent, regardless of race, gender, ethnicity or sexual orientation.
  
  
Acuity was established as a separate business from Moody’s Corporation in 2019, following its acquisition by Equistone Partners Europe (Equistone). In January 2023, funds advised by global private equity firm Permira acquired a majority stake in the business from Equistone, which remains invested as a minority shareholder.
  
  
For more information, visit https://www.acuityanalytics.com/
  
  
Position Title-Associate Director
  
  
Experience Level-18 to 22 Years
  
  
Department- Delivery Ops
  
  
Location-Gurgaon
  
  
Position Reports to- Senior Director/ Director
  
  
**Job Purpose**
We are seeking a highly analytical, structured, and execution-oriented Associate Director to support the Delivery Operations team in driving operational excellence, governance, strategic initiatives, and technology-enabled reporting across the organization.
  
  
The role involves partnering with teams and functions to coordinate key programs, manage operational processes, and support the development and governance of reporting frameworks, dashboards, and management information systems. The individual will work closely with business and technology stakeholders to gather requirements, translate them into structured reporting and automation solutions, ensure data quality and consistency, and generate actionable insights for leadership decision-making.
  
  
The successful candidate will be responsible for tracking initiatives, monitoring milestones and dependencies, analyzing operational and business data, identifying trends and risks, and preparing concise reports, dashboards, and executive presentations. They will also support the adoption of technology-driven solutions, process automation opportunities, KPI governance, and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance business visibility and operational effectiveness.
  
  
This role is ideal for someone who can combine strong business acumen with data and technology orientation, bring structure to complex problems, work comfortably with both quantitative and qualitative inputs, and communicate insights effectively to senior stakeholders while driving execution and accountability across strategic and operational priorities.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Program & Project Management
  
  

* Support planning, execution, and governance of strategic, operational, and technology-enabled transformation initiatives.
* Translate business requirements into project plans, timelines, milestones, deliverables, and success metrics.
* Track project progress, dependencies, risks, issues, and actions to ensure timely delivery.
* Coordinate through Delivery, Technology, and Business teams to drive execution and stakeholder alignment.

Governance & Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Manage governance forums, review meetings, steering committees, and executive update processes.
* Prepare agendas, status reports, decision logs, and action trackers; drive follow-ups and accountability.
* Identify, escalate, and support resolution of project risks, bottlenecks, and process gaps.
* Facilitate workshops and working sessions, ensuring clear ownership and execution of outcomes.

Reporting, Analytics & Technology Enablement
  
  

* Own the collection, validation, analysis, and reporting of operational, delivery, and business performance data.
* Design and maintain reporting frameworks, dashboards, scorecards, and management information systems (MIS).
* Partner with Technology and Delivery teams to automate reporting, improve data quality, and enhance KPI governance.
* Analyze trends, variances, and performance metrics to generate actionable insights and recommendations for leadership.

Strategic Insights & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Support business reviews, market research, strategic assessments, and operational improvement initiatives.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve efficiency, for the existing tools.
* Develop executive ready presentations, reports, and business cases to support management decisions.

Key Performance Indicators:
  
  

* Timely and accurate completion of assigned programs, reports, and operational activities.
* Effective coordination and follow-up across teams and stakeholders.
* Quality and completeness of data collected and consolidated.
* Reliability of dashboards, trackers, reports, and management information.
* Ability to identify relevant trends, themes, risks, and improvement opportunities.
* Quality and clarity of presentations and insights provided to management.
* Positive working relationships with internal stakeholders.
* Consistent adherence to agreed processes, timelines, and reporting requirements.
* Constructive contribution to process improvements and operational effectiveness.

Key Competencies
  
  

* Approximately 15 to 18 years of experience in delivery operations / project management, program or project coordination, business analysis, consulting, research, strategy, or a related field.
* Experience supporting or coordinating cross-functional projects and initiatives.
* Good understanding of project tracking, process coordination, governance routines, and follow-up mechanisms.
* Ability to collect, consolidate, and analyze information from multiple teams.
* Strong Excel skills and experience working with KPIs, trends, and performance data.
* Ability to interpret qualitative feedback and incorporate it into analysis.
* Structured approach to understanding problem statements and organizing analysis.
* Ability to translate complex findings into clear "so-what" insights and actionable recommendations
* Strong PowerPoint and written communication skills.
* Good stakeholder-management, facilitation, and coordination skills.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple activities and deadlines.
* Ability to work independently on assigned responsibilities while collaborating effectively with the wider team.
* MBA, CFA, CA, or equivalent relevant tech qualification would be preferred.
* Certification in project management and AI solutions will be added advantage

description:

As a Program Manager – Supply Quality, you will own quality operations for Spinny's vehicle inspection process within the Supply function — driving execution discipline across a ground network of 1,200+ inspectors and new technology/ automation projects that improve how the team works. This is primarily an operations leadership role: you will be responsible for inspection quality ops at scale, and for building the systems and people processes that keep a large, distributed field team performing. The person will also drive select technology and automation initiatives that make quality operations more efficient. The ideal candidate is someone who thrives on ground-level execution and problem-solving with large teams, brings genuine automotive/vehicle domain expertise, and can additionally bring a technology/automation mindset to the table.

* Own end-to-end quality operations across a field network of 1,200+ inspectors — driving inspection accuracy & consistency
* Bring good automotive/vehicle knowledge to define and continuously refine inspection standards, defect checklists, and quality benchmarks
* Build and manage the team structure, training, and performance systems needed to run ground operations reliably across locations
* Drive key quality & ops metrics through hands-on field engagement, reviews, and course correction
* Identify process gaps and inefficiencies in day-to-day ground execution and drive structured problem-solving to closure
* Partner with cross-functional teams (Product, Tech, Central Ops) to identify and implement automation opportunities that reduce manual effort for the inspection team
* Ensure adherence to SOPs and compliance standards across all supply quality operations
* Lead complex projects — spanning process, people, or technology — from scoping through on-ground rollout and adoption

REQUIREMENTS

**Education**

🔹 A B.Tech in Automotive/Automobile/Mechanical Engineering +
**5+ years**
of hands-on Program Management experience
**OR**

🔹 An MBA + B.Tech in Automotive/Automobile Engineering +
**3+ years**
of Program Management experience

**Experience & Skills**

* At least 2–3 years in a fast-paced startup or automotive OEM environment
* Strong automotive/vehicle domain knowledge — understanding of vehicle systems, common defects, and inspection/quality standards
* Proven experience managing large, distributed field teams and driving operational discipline at scale
* Working knowledge of using AI/automation to streamline daily workflows
* A history of taking complex, ambiguous projects from concept to completion
* Sharp problem-solving instincts, with a bias for structured, data-driven decision-making

description:

title: Customer Activation Lead (SaaS, US)
description:
**About the role**

You will own merchant onboarding at Loop from sales handoff to Success handover, across three regions. You will lead a team of Onboarding Specialists, set the operating standard for every onboarding, and be accountable for time to go live, onboarding quality, and early churn. This role is about building a predictable onboarding engine that scales with our growth. It is not about running onboardings yourself.

**What you will own**

Onboarding Delivery and Governance

* Own end to end onboarding performance: kickoff SLAs, milestone adherence, and go live dates across the full merchant portfolio.
* Set the standards for kickoff, weekly touchpoints, configuration, migration validation and handover, and audit adherence.
* Step in personally on strategic, high value or at risk merchants.

Cross Functional Partnership

* Act as the primary escalation point for Sales, Implementation Engineering, Migration, Product and Success.
* Improve the sales to onboarding handoff so merchants are scoped correctly before kickoff.
* Agree SLAs and escalation paths with Implementation Engineering and Migration, and hold all sides to them.
* Turn recurring merchant feedback into prioritised product inputs and track them to resolution.

Process, Tooling and Reporting

* Own onboarding playbooks, templates and documentation standards.
* Keep Salesforce, Sheets and internal dashboards accurate, and remove manual tracking wherever possible.
* Report weekly and monthly on onboarding health to leadership, with risks and corrective actions.
* Identify bottlenecks using data and redesign the process to remove them.

Merchant Experience and Retention

* Own the merchant experience during onboarding, including handling of delays, product gaps and escalations.
* Drive down churn during onboarding and in the first 30 days post handover.
* Ensure every handover to Success is complete, documented and accepted by the Success team.

Team Leadership and Capacity

* Lead, coach and grow a team of Onboarding Specialists across regions
* Plan capacity and allocate merchants by region, complexity and specialist bandwidth.
* Hire, onboard and ramp new specialists. Set clear performance goals and run regular 1:1s and reviews.

﻿

What we are looking for

* 7+ years in customer onboarding, implementation or customer success at a B2B SaaS company, with 3+ years managing teams of 10 or more.
* Experience leading distributed teams across multiple regions and time zones.
* Strong track record of running onboarding at scale with measurable improvement in time to value and early retention.
* Comfort with technical setups: integrations, data migration, configuration. You do not need to code, but you need to hold your own with engineers.
* Hands on with Salesforce and dashboarding; data driven in how you run the team.
* Calm, clear communicator in escalations with merchants and senior internal stakeholders.

title: Director / Associate Director - Agentic AI & Tech Delivery
description:
**About Sirius AI**

Sirius AI is an AI-first consulting and solutions firm serving financial services clients: banks, fintechs, payments and wealth management companies. We help enterprises move from AI ideas to production-ready solutions using GenAI, agentic AI, ML platforms and advanced analytics, delivering measurable business impact. Our strength lies in combining FS domain expertise, hands-on AI delivery and enterprise-grade execution.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a
**Director / Associate Director – Delivery AI (Agentic AI & Tech Delivery)**
to lead delivery of agentic AI and the enterprise technology around it for our financial services clients in the US. You will own how agent-based solutions, and the data, platform, integration and application engineering they depend on, get built, secured and run in production, on time, on budget and to regulated-industry standards.

This role is for a delivery leader with genuine engineering depth: someone who can lead the agent design discussion, review a cloud architecture or integration plan, and present delivery status to a client CIO. You will lead multi-disciplinary teams of AI, data, cloud and software engineers, many of them early in their careers. The level (Director or Associate Director) will be aligned to experience and the scale of programs and teams led.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end delivery of agentic AI and technology programs, from discovery and architecture through build, integration, testing, deployment and hypercare.
* Lead delivery of the full solution stack: AI agents and orchestration, RAG and knowledge layers, data pipelines, APIs and integrations, cloud infrastructure and user-facing applications.
* Take agentic solutions into production at scale, with reliability, observability, evaluation, human-in-the-loop controls and clear operational ownership.
* Set and enforce engineering standards across AI and software delivery: architecture review, secure coding, code review, automated testing, CI/CD, DevSecOps and LLMOps.
* Partner with client technology, security and risk teams on platform choices, identity and access, data residency, vendor and model risk, and production readiness.
* Run a consistent delivery model across engagements, covering Agile cadence, milestone tracking, dependency management, status reporting and RAID management.
* Own delivery economics including scope, estimates, staffing mix, budget, utilisation and margin; surface risks early and keep clients and leadership informed.
* Lead large, multi-disciplinary teams through managers, architects and technical leads; build onboarding, training paths and career growth in agentic AI and modern engineering.
* Build reusable agent frameworks, reference architectures, integration accelerators and delivery playbooks that raise speed and quality across clients.
* Act as senior delivery lead for client stakeholders, run steering committees, and support pre-sales with solution architecture, estimation and staffing plans.
* Ensure all delivery meets enterprise AI governance, security, data privacy and other compliance requirements, with audit-ready documentation.

**What We're Looking For**

* 12+ years of experience in technology delivery, including at least 5 years leading data platform programs. Associate Director: 8+ years, including at least 3–4 years leading AI or data platform programs.
* Hands-on delivery experience with GenAI or agentic AI solutions in production, including agent orchestration frameworks, LLM platforms and evaluation practices.
* Strong technical foundation in enterprise engineering: cloud (AWS, Azure or GCP), microservices and APIs, data engineering, DevOps/CI/CD and application security.
* A proven track record of delivering complex, multi-workstream technology programs for enterprise clients, ideally in regulated industries.
* Experience leading/building large delivery teams across AI, data and software disciplines, including developing junior and early-career talent.
* Strong command of Agile and hybrid delivery, estimation, budgeting and commercial management of engagements.
* Experience in consulting firms, AI services companies, global system integrators or global delivery centres.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with senior business and technology leaders.

**Good to Have**

* Delivery experience with financial services clients in banking, payments, lending, wealth management or insurance, including core banking or payments integration.
* Experience modernising legacy platforms or integrating AI with systems of record (e.g. core banking, CRM, ERP, case management).
* Familiarity with responsible AI frameworks and FS technology risk controls
* Experience running onshore/offshore or distributed delivery models.
* Cloud architecture or AI certifications (e.g. AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).

title: PPC Marketing Specialist (Remote)
description:
**Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.**

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

**You are the account manager. We do not have any.** You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

**You own the whole funnel, not the campaign.** Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

**You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it.** We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

**You can live anywhere.** We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

 **Requirements**

**What the job looks like**

* **Own a set of DTC accounts** as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
* **Own the client relationship.** There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
* **Audit before you touch anything.** Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
* **Run brand and non brand as different businesses.** Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
* **Know what PMax is actually doing.** The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
* **Keep Google's automation on a leash.** Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
* **Own the feed.** Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
* **Own the tracking.** GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
* **Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it.** Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
* **Build the things the account needs.** Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

**You are a fit if**

* **You have done this with real money.** Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
* **You are fluent in the whole stack**, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
* **You are AI native, and you build.** This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
* **You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level.** You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
* **You are skeptical of your own numbers.** You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
* **You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls.** Where you live is up to you.
* Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.

**You are not a fit if**

* "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
* You want to be told what to do this week.
* You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
* You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

  
**Benefits**

**Why this role is exciting**

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

Position: Head – Projects, Growth & Marketing

Organisation: Vishwa Jagriti Mission (VJM) group

Portfolio: Anand Vardhan Resort (Manali), Shiv Vardaan Teerth – Anand Dham Ashram (Delhi), Siddhi Dham Ashram (Kanpur), Yugrishi Anushthan, and future projects under the VJM umbrella
