Team leadership: Minimum 2 years leading a team (in-house or agency)

Location: Delhi, with regular travel to Manali, Kanpur and other project sites

Employment: Full-time

CTC: As per experience and market standards

**About the role**

This is a builder role: you will set up and lead one shared growth and marketing function that serves several hospitality, spiritual and institutional projects at once.

You will own revenue-linked marketing for a 43-room wellness resort, brand and community building for spiritual institutions, and project execution for new initiatives as they launch. You start lean, take over work currently handled by external agencies, and hire the team below you as the function grows.

We are looking for someone who has run campaigns with their own hands, read the numbers themselves, and led people to deliver. Strategy alone will not be enough; neither will execution without direction.

**Key responsibilities**

1. Project leadership and execution

* Translate leadership priorities into a project plan for each initiative: scope, deliverables, timeline, budget and success metrics.

* Run a single calendar and review rhythm across all projects; flag conflicts, dependencies and slippage early.

* Coordinate with operations, sales, finance and ashram management so marketing and delivery move together.

* Allocate team time and cost across projects so each project carries its fair share.

2. Performance marketing and revenue (hospitality-led)

* Plan, run and optimise paid campaigns on Google Ads (Search, PMax, Hotel Ads), Meta and YouTube.

* Own the funnel from impression to booking: landing pages, booking engine, call/WhatsApp tracking, lead follow-up handoff to sales.

* Shift spend with demand: scale in shoulder and lean seasons, protect ROAS in peak.

* Work with revenue management on OTA mix, rate parity and direct-booking offers.

* Track CPL, CAC, ROAS and cost per booking against agreed targets.

3. SEO, GEO and local search

* Own technical, on-page and content SEO for all websites.

* Build visibility in AI search and answer engines (GEO).

* Manage Google Business Profiles and local SEO for each property and ashram.

4. Brand, content and communication

* Define the brand positioning and voice of each project, consistent with spiritual values and institutional culture.

* Run the content calendar across Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, WhatsApp and email.

* Oversee creatives, reels, video, live streaming, event coverage and press/PR communication.

* Build B2C brand and YouTube presence, not only performance ads.

5. Online reputation management

* Monitor and respond to reviews on Google, TripAdvisor, OTAs and social platforms within set timelines.

* Grow review volume and rating through structured guest/devotee feedback loops.

* Lead the response plan for negative coverage or a social media crisis.

6. Event and programme marketing

* Own pre-, during- and post-event promotion for festivals, shivirs and spiritual programmes.

* Manage registrations, reminders and attendance tracking through digital tools.

7. Data, analytics and reporting

* Maintain GA4, GTM, ad-platform tracking and the lead register so every rupee is traceable to an outcome.

* Produce a weekly dashboard and a monthly performance review for the CEO.

* Use data to recommend where to cut, scale or test.

8. Team building, agencies and vendors

* Hire, onboard and lead the team below you: digital marketer, content/video, designers, interns and freelancers.

* Manage the transition of work from external agencies to the in-house team without loss of performance.

* Brief, evaluate and hold agencies and vendors to measurable deliverables.

* Build SOPs, templates and a knowledge base so the function does not depend on any one person.

9. Technology and AI

* Use AI tools across research, content, ad creative, analytics and automation; this is a core KRA, not an add-on.

* Own websites, landing pages, CRM, WhatsApp and email tools, forms and integrations together with technical vendors.

* Manage the marketing budget and tool stack for value.

**Who we are looking forMust have**

* 6–7 years of hands-on experience across performance marketing, SEO, analytics, branding and communication.

* Minimum 2 years leading a team, with at least one hire you made yourself.

* Hospitality, travel or B2C experience with a direct link between marketing and bookings or revenue.

* Hands-on with Google Ads, Meta Ads, YouTube, GA4, GTM, Search Console and Google Business Profile.

* Proven online reputation management across Google, TripAdvisor and OTAs.

* Experience working with and managing agencies, with examples of holding them to results.

* Comfortable with data: builds own reports and can explain CPL, CAC, ROAS and conversion rates.

* Practical use of AI tools in marketing work today, with examples.

* Clear written and spoken communication in English and Hindi.

* Experience with spiritual, cultural, non-profit or wellness organisations.

* Event, live-streaming or large-gathering promotion.

* Experience setting up a marketing function from scratch.

**Core competencies**

* Ownership and accountability for results, not only activity.

* Structured planning and execution across several projects at once.

* Builds systems and people, not dependence on self.

* Sensitivity to spiritual values and institutional culture.

* Integrity with budgets and data.

title: Performance Marketing Executive
description:
**Role: Performance Marketing Executive**
=========================================

**Company:** Fairdeal

**Location:** Gurugram

Experience: 1-2 Years

### **About Fairdeal**

Fairdeal is building India's largest B2B quick commerce platform, enabling neighbourhood retailers to source products at the best market rates, delivered within 60 minutes.

We're on a mission to transform how millions of retailers source inventory, ensuring they never lose a sale because of a stockout.

### **About the Role**

We're looking for a **Performance Marketing Executive** who can turn digital campaigns into transacting retailers.

Your mission is simple: **Acquire more retailers, convert them into active customers, and continuously reduce Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC).**

You'll own the digital acquisition journey, from app installs and Click-to-WhatsApp (CTWA) campaigns to automated lead nurturing and first-order conversion.

This isn't just about running ads. It's about building a scalable, efficient acquisition engine across every live Fairdeal Express Store.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**1. Digital Acquisition & Performance Marketing**

* Plan, execute, and optimize performance marketing campaigns across Meta, Google, and other relevant digital channels.
* Drive high-intent app installs and qualified retailer leads within Fairdeal's serviceable markets.
* Execute hyperlocal, geo-targeted campaigns aligned with individual Express Store catchments.
* Continuously experiment with audiences, creatives, messaging, and campaign formats to improve acquisition efficiency.
* Allocate and optimize marketing budgets based on activation performance and CAC.

**2. WhatsApp Marketing & Chatbot Automation**

* Independently set up, execute, and optimize Click-to-WhatsApp (CTWA) campaigns.
* Build, deploy, and manage WhatsApp chatbots for retailer qualification, onboarding, app downloads, and conversion.
* Design automated conversational journeys to nurture leads and drive first orders.
* Set up retargeting and follow-up workflows for retailers who haven't completed registration or activation.
* Monitor chatbot engagement, lead quality, drop-offs, and conversion rates to improve effectiveness.

**3. Retailer Activation & CAC Optimization**

* Own the complete digital acquisition funnel, from first interaction to first successful order.
* Build nurturing journeys through WhatsApp, push notifications, and relevant content.
* Identify funnel drop-offs and work with Product, Tech, and CRM teams to improve conversion.
* Continuously improve install-to-first-order and lead-to-first-order conversion rates.
* Optimize campaign spending to reduce CAC while increasing the number of digitally acquired, activated retailers.
* Develop retargeting strategies to convert unactivated retailers into first-time transacting customers.

**4. Express Store-Level Growth**

* Drive digital customer acquisition across all live Fairdeal Express Stores.
* Identify underpenetrated markets and launch hyperlocal acquisition campaigns.
* Track retailer activations and CAC at the individual Express Store level.
* Collaborate with Sales and Operations teams to maximize retailer activation in serviceable markets.
* Scale successful acquisition strategies across existing and newly launched Express Stores.

**5. Analytics & Experimentation**

* Track the complete acquisition funnel: Impressions Clicks Leads/Installs Registrations First Orders.
* Monitor campaign performance, acquisition costs, conversion rates, and attribution.
* Run structured A/B tests across audiences, creatives, chatbot flows, and nurturing journeys.
* Build weekly performance reports with actionable insights to improve acquisition efficiency.
* Identify opportunities to increase conversions without proportionately increasing marketing expenditure.

### **Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

**KPI**

**Weightage**

  

**Digitally Acquired Retailer Activations**

**50%**

  

**Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) Optimization**

**50%**

  

**Total**

**100%**

**1. Digitally Acquired Retailer Activations (50%)**

Increase the number of digitally acquired retailers completing their first successful order across all live Fairdeal Express Stores.

**2. Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) Optimization (50%)**

Acquire activated retailers within defined CAC targets while continuously reducing acquisition costs and improving marketing efficiency.

### **What We're Looking For**

* 1–3 years of hands-on experience in performance marketing, growth marketing, or digital customer acquisition.
* **Proven experience executing and scaling Click-to-WhatsApp (CTWA) campaigns.**
* **Hands-on experience building, deploying, and optimizing WhatsApp chatbots and automated conversation flows.**
* Strong working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads.
* Experience with WhatsApp Business API and chatbot platforms such as Interakt, WATI, AiSensy, Gallabox, or similar tools.
* Understanding of app install campaigns, conversion tracking, campaign attribution, remarketing, and CAC optimization.
* Familiarity with GA4, Firebase, AppsFlyer, or similar analytics platforms.
* Strong analytical mindset with an obsession for experimentation, efficiency, and measurable outcomes.
* Ability to independently manage campaigns, troubleshoot performance issues, and deliver measurable business results.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with aggressive growth targets.

**Preferred:** Experience in quick commerce, e-commerce, hyperlocal marketplaces, or app-based customer acquisition.

### **What Success Looks Like**

You won't be measured by how many people see our ads or even how many download our app.

**You'll be measured by how many retailers become transacting customers and how efficiently you acquire them across our Express Stores.**

At Fairdeal, performance marketing isn't about spending more.

**It's about acquiring more customers with every rupee spent.**

title: : Business Head – Loan Distribution .
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Position: Business Head – Loan Distribution .

Level: Senior Management

Location: Kolkata, West Bengal

Industry: Banking, NBFCs & Financial Services

Reporting To: Co-Founder / Promoter.

Interested candidates may share their resume at head.hr@tiptopinsure.in or may connect me at 8420363349

About the Opportunity:

Our client, an emerging financial services organization, is looking to appoint a dynamic, entrepreneurial and result-oriented Business Head – Loan Distribution to establish, lead and scale its loan distribution business.

This is a strategic leadership opportunity for an experienced BFSI professional with a strong track record in business development, institutional relationship management, distribution strategy and team leadership.

The incumbent will have end-to-end ownership of building the business from the ground up, including establishing strategic partnerships with Banks, NBFCs and Housing Finance Companies, developing a robust distribution network, building a high-performing team and driving sustainable business growth.

The role offers direct interaction with the Co-Founder / Promoter and an opportunity to play a pivotal role in shaping the organisation’s business strategy, operating model and long-term growth trajectory.

Key Responsibilities

1. Business Strategy & Business Setup

\* Lead the end-to-end establishment and development of the Loan Distribution

\* Develop the business strategy, operating model, revenue framework and long-term growth roadmap.

\* Identify target customer segments, lending products and emerging business opportunities.

\* Establish business processes, internal controls, operating standards and performance benchmarks.

\* Develop a scalable and sustainable business model aligned with the organization's strategic objectives.

2. Institutional Relationships & Strategic Alliances

\* Establish and strengthen strategic relationships with Banks, NBFCs, HFCs and other financial institutions.

\* Develop partnerships with Corporate DSAs, channel partners, aggregators and financial intermediaries.

\* Lead negotiations on commercial terms, commission structures, revenue-sharing arrangements and business partnerships.

\* Ensure effective coordination with lending partners across sourcing, credit processing, disbursement and customer servicing.

\* Expand the institutional network to maximise business opportunities and revenue potential.

3. Team Building & Organisational Leadership

\* Build, recruit and lead a high-performing team of approximately 40–50 employees and business associates.

\* Design the organisational structure, reporting hierarchy and functional responsibilities.

\* Recruit, develop and manage Sales Managers, Relationship Managers, Telecallers and Field Sales Teams.

\* Establish performance-linked incentive structures, productivity benchmarks and accountability mechanisms.

\* Drive a performance-oriented culture through training, coaching, motivation and regular business reviews.

4. Business Development & Revenue Generation

\* Drive sourcing, business conversion, disbursement and revenue generation across multiple lending products, including:

\* Home Loans

\* Loan Against Property (LAP)

\* Loan Against Rent Receivables (LARR)

\* Business Loans / MSME Loans

\* Personal Loans

\* Other secured and unsecured lending products

\* Develop direct sourcing channels, referral networks and strategic distribution partnerships.

\* Achieve monthly, quarterly and annual business sourcing, disbursement and revenue targets.

\* Identify new markets, customer segments and geographical expansion opportunities.

\* Drive business productivity, channel profitability and sustainable revenue growth.

5. Operations, MIS & Business Governance

\* Establish efficient sourcing, documentation, login, processing and disbursement workflows.

\* Monitor business pipelines, team productivity, conversion ratios, disbursement performance and revenue realisation.

\* Implement robust MIS, dashboards, reporting systems and periodic performance reviews.

\* Coordinate with lending institutions to ensure seamless credit processing, documentation and customer servicing.

\* Ensure adherence to institutional guidelines, KYC requirements, internal controls and applicable regulatory processes.

Desired Candidate Profile

\* Graduate / Postgraduate in Business Administration, Finance, Marketing or a related discipline.

\* Approximately 8–15 years of relevant experience in Banking, NBFCs, Loan Distribution, DSA or Financial Services.

\* Demonstrated experience in establishing, scaling or managing a loan distribution / DSA business.

\* Strong institutional relationships with Banks, NBFCs, HFCs and other financial institutions.

\* Proven ability to build, manage and lead large sales and distribution teams.

\* Experience managing teams of 30–50 or more employees and business associates will be preferred.

\* Strong business development, negotiation, strategic planning and execution capabilities.

\* Excellent leadership, stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.

\* Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to independently drive business growth and take complete business ownership.

Key Success Expectations

The successful candidate will be responsible for:

\* Establishing the complete organizational and operational structure of the business.

\* Securing strategic lending partnerships and institutional tie-ups.

\* Recruiting and developing a high-performing team of 40–50 employees and business associates.

\* Creating a robust and sustainable business sourcing and distribution network.

\* Achieving defined business sourcing, disbursement and revenue targets.

\* Building a scalable, professionally managed and commercially viable loan distribution platform.

The Opportunity

This position is ideal for a seasoned BFSI professional with an entrepreneurial mindset who is passionate about building businesses, creating distribution networks and delivering measurable business outcomes.

The incumbent will have the opportunity to work closely with the Co-Founder / Promoter, exercise significant business ownership and contribute directly to the organization's strategic growth and expansion.

The ideal candidate is a business builder who can transform a new business initiative into a scalable, profitable and professionally managed financial services platform.

Pay: ₹700,000.00 - ₹1,000,000.00 per year

title: General Manager (Production)
description:
**1. Job Purpose**

To lead and manage the overall operations of the spices manufacturing and exporting unit, ensuring efficient production, quality assurance, procurement, supply chain management, export operations, profitability, regulatory compliance, and business growth.

The General Manager will be responsible for achieving organizational objectives through effective coordination of all departments, improving operational efficiency, maintaining international quality standards, and developing export markets.

**2. Key Roles & ResponsibilitiesA. Overall Business & Operations Management**

* Manage the overall functioning of the manufacturing and export unit.
* Develop annual business plans, budgets, production targets and operational strategies.
* Ensure achievement of production, sales, export and profitability targets.
* Monitor daily operations and ensure smooth coordination between departments.
* Implement systems, procedures and performance monitoring mechanisms.
* Identify opportunities for cost reduction and operational improvement.

**B. Manufacturing & Production Management**

* Oversee the complete manufacturing process, including cleaning, grading, drying, grinding, blending, sterilization and packing.
* Ensure optimum utilization of machinery, manpower and production capacity.
* Plan production schedules based on sales orders, export commitments and inventory.
* Minimize production wastage, downtime and rejection rates.
* Ensure preventive maintenance of plant and machinery.
* Improve productivity through process optimization and automation.

**C. Quality Control & Food Safety**

* Ensure compliance with FSSAI, HACCP, GMP, ISO 22000, BRCGS and other applicable standards.
* Maintain product quality, consistency, hygiene and food safety.
* Ensure testing of raw materials, in-process products and finished goods.
* Monitor microbial contamination, pesticide residues, aflatoxins, heavy metals and other relevant parameters.
* Ensure proper implementation of quality management systems.
* Coordinate with internal and external laboratories and certification agencies.
* Handle customer complaints, quality deviations and corrective actions.

**D. Procurement & Raw Material Management**

* Develop reliable sourcing networks for whole spices and raw materials.
* Negotiate prices and commercial terms with suppliers.
* Ensure procurement of quality raw materials at competitive prices.
* Monitor market price fluctuations and seasonal availability.
* Establish supplier evaluation and approval systems.
* Maintain optimum inventory levels and avoid unnecessary stock accumulation.

**E. Export & International Business Management**

* Manage end-to-end export operations and documentation.
* Coordinate with international buyers, agents, distributors and importers.
* Develop new export markets and strengthen existing customer relationships.
* Ensure compliance with destination-country food safety and import regulations.
* Oversee export documentation, including:
* Commercial Invoice
* Packing List
* Certificate of Origin
* Phytosanitary Certificate, where applicable
* Health Certificate, where applicable
* Bill of Lading
* Shipping Bill
* Fumigation Certificate, where applicable
* Coordinate with customs brokers, freight forwarders, shipping lines and banks.
* Ensure timely shipment and fulfilment of export commitments.
* Monitor export payment realization and coordinate with finance for documentation and banking compliance.
* Work towards increasing export turnover and expanding the international customer base.

**F. Sales & Marketing**

* Develop domestic and international sales strategies.
* Identify new business opportunities and potential buyers.
* Participate in international food exhibitions and trade fairs.
* Develop private-label, bulk and branded product opportunities.
* Negotiate pricing, contracts and payment terms with customers.
* Monitor competitor activities and international market trends.

**G. Finance & Cost Control**

* Prepare and monitor departmental and operational budgets.
* Control manufacturing, packaging, logistics and administrative costs.
* Monitor product-wise manufacturing costs and profitability.
* Review monthly profit and loss statements.
* Monitor working capital, receivables and payables.
* Ensure proper financial controls and minimize operational losses.

**H. Human Resource & Administration**

* Manage manpower planning and organizational structure.
* Recruit, train and develop departmental heads and employees.
* Establish clear responsibilities and performance targets.
* Maintain discipline, productivity and workplace safety.
* Conduct periodic performance reviews.
* Develop a result-oriented organizational culture.

**I. Statutory & Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with applicable requirements of:
* FSSAI
* Spices Board of India
* DGFT and IEC regulations
* APEDA, wherever applicable
* GST and other applicable tax laws
* Factory, labour and environmental regulations
* Import-country food safety and labelling requirements
* Ensure timely renewals of registrations, licences and certifications.
* Maintain records for audits and regulatory inspections.

**3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance Area

**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor's degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Agriculture, Engineering, Business Administration or related disciplines.
* MBA in Operations, International Business or Supply Chain Management will be an added advantage.

**Experience**

Join us as a Portfolio Manager

Engineering Manager

* Design calculations for equipment sizing, earthing calculation, cable sizing, cable tray sizing, lighting calculation, lightning calculation

  + Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) from 66kV and up to 400 kV
  + Air Insulated Switchgear (AIS) from 66kV and up to 400 kV
  + Power Transformers
  + Shunt Reactors

* Coordinate with substation automation system / SCADA system for interface engineering activities, Coordination with civil, structural, supply chain, commercial, project management, and manufacturing, testing and site execution teams. Estimate effort for engineering, testing and commissioning
* Prepare Engineering Schedule in line with agreed document deliverable list, matching engineering portion of project schedule.
* Travelling to customer and vendor locations to support engineering, manufacturing and FAT activities.

**Qualifications for the role:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical and Electronics Engineering.
* Minimum 10 to 15 years of relevant experience for Project Engineering

* Pre-Bid Engineering, Bid & Proposal exposure is an added advantage.
* Proficiency in using design tools like relay selections, equipment sizing, earthing, lighting calculation tools etc.,
* Basic Knowledge of power system study and network modelling preferred
* Basic knowledge on communication archtecture, IEC 61850, relay selections (ABB/Hitachi/GE/SEL) is preferred.
* Understanding the various International Standard/ statutory requirements like IEEE/IEC/ANSI

ABB a provides a comprehensive range of integrated automation, electrical and digital systems and services for customers in the process, hybrid and maritime industries. Join us in driving the science, technology and expertise that will serve the growing global demand for safe, reliable, clean energy.

The Project Engineer is the engineering team leader managing all technical activities on assigned projects while following company procedures. Work closely with project manager, project planner, sub-contract manager, project design leader, and functional department engineers to ensure a project is engineered to build codes, industry codes & standards, and contract specifications.

* Plan, coordinate, and monitor projects; develop scope of work; partner with departments and sub-contractors; facilitate construction plans and documents with constructors.
* Ensure technical accuracy and on-time completion of project technical documents, RFQ’s for material and equipment, conformed contract purchase documents, commissioning procedures, O&M Manuals, acceptance test procedures, and reports.
* Initiate and monitor the DMS system including the RFI’s, NCR’s, etc.
* Coordinate project’s engineering effort ensuring technical compliance with project specifications and codes.
* Serve as primary company engineering representative to clients on technical issues.
* Conduct and participate in meetings with clients, consulting engineers, sub-contract engineers, and major equipment & fabricator suppliers to provide technical leadership.
* Secure adequate technical resources to execute a project’s engineering requirements.
* Partner with project team and engineering department to develop the project schedule / design plan.
* Work with the project team to execute the contract in accordance with the schedule, budget, scope, engineering design plans, and engineering resources.
* Manage the engineering project hours and scheduled activities, and report progress and problems.
* Manage and coordinate engineering subcontractors, including the development of the project schedule, time receipt of deliverables.
* Prepare reports, correspondence, agreements, graphs, tables, and presentations, as required.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering

**Licenses & Certificates:**

* Professional Engineering (PE) License a plus
* Project Management Professional (PMP) a plus

title: Senior Technical Documentation & Training Manager
description:
The role
  
  
**Title**
Senior Technical Documentation & Training Manager
**Location**
Hyderabad, India
**Reports to**
Chief Product Officer in US
**Type**
Full-time
  
  
Openprise is looking for a hands-on leader to own everything customers and partners use to learn our platform: product documentation, use case guides, the knowledge base, and training courses. You will set the content strategy and leverage AI to produce accurate, high-quality content at a pace a fast-moving SaaS product demand.
  
  
This is a builder role. You will write and design content yourself while creating the standards, workflows, and AI-assisted processes that let the team scale.
  
  
**About Openprise**
Openprise is a data and AI orchestration platform for revenue teams. Our SaaS platform helps RevOps, Marketing Ops, and Sales Ops teams automate the processes that keep GTM data clean, enriched, routed, and ready for AI, with no code required.
  
  
Customers and partners build sophisticated automations on Openprise. Clear documentation and great training are how they get to value quickly, adopt more use cases, and succeed without waiting on Support. That is the work this role leads.
  
  
What you'll do
  
  
**Lead the technical content strategy**

* Own the documentation and training strategy across product docs, use case content, the knowledge base, and customer and partner training
* Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Channel Enablement teams across US and India time zones
* Generate content that can be used by AI technologies to improve user experience in the product

**Product documentation**

* Own end-to-end product documentation: feature guides, configuration references, API docs, and release notes
* Embed documentation in the release cycle so every feature ships with accurate, reviewed content
* Maintain a consistent style guide, information architecture, and terminology across all content

**Use case documentation and knowledge base**

* Build a library of use case guides showing how customers solve real RevOps problems with Openprise, such as data cleansing, enrichment, deduplication, lead routing, and AI-ready data
* Own the Zendesk knowledge base: structure, search optimization, article quality, and lifecycle management
* Work with Support to turn recurring tickets into self-service content, and keep content optimized for AI support agents that answer from it

**Customer and partner training**

* Design and develop role-based learning paths, courses, and certifications for customers, administrators, and implementation partners
* Run the learning management system (SkillJar), including course publishing, enrollment, and reporting
* Create interactive product walkthroughs and demos (Storylane) to accelerate onboarding and adoption
* Keep training current as the product evolves, and gather learner feedback to improve courses

**AI-powered content operations**

* Use generative AI tools to draft, update, translate, and quality-check content at scale, with strong human review for accuracy
* Design repeatable AI workflows and prompt libraries for the team, from release notes to quiz questions to video scripts
* Structure content so it serves both people and AI systems, including in-product assistants and support bots

What you bring
  
  

* 10+ years in technical writing, documentation, or customer education for B2B SaaS products, including 4+ years managing writers or instructional designers
* A track record of building documentation and training programs from the ground up, not only maintaining them
* Excellent written English and the ability to explain complex, technical workflows clearly to both business and technical users
* Instructional design expertise: needs analysis, learning objectives, adult learning principles, assessments, and certification design
* Hands-on, daily use of generative AI tools (such as Claude or ChatGPT) to create content, with clear methods for checking accuracy and quality
* Experience with knowledge base platforms, LMS platforms, and docs-as-code or modern authoring tools
* Comfort learning complex data platforms quickly; familiarity with CRM and marketing automation systems (Salesforce, Marketo, HubSpot) is a strong plus
* Experience working with global, distributed teams and overlapping with US Pacific time hours when needed
* Bachelor's degree in English, Communications, Computer Science, Education, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* Have prior experience building and managing team, be a player-coach

Bonus points
  
  
Experience with the tools we use today will help you hit the ground running:
**Tool**
**How we use it**
SkillJarCustomer and partner learning platform and certificationsZendeskKnowledge base and support contentFinAI support agent that answers customer questions from our contentStorylaneInteractive product demos and guided walkthroughs
  
  
Also a plus: experience with data management, RevOps, or GTM tooling; video production for training; and content localization.
  
  
Why join us
  
  
You will shape how every Openprise customer and partner learns our platform, and help define what AI-first technical content looks like. You will have real ownership, a growing team in Hyderabad, and close collaboration with leaders across the company.
  
  
Openprise is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and are committed to an inclusive workplace.

description:
**Role Summary**

We are looking for a technically strong, commercially astute and result-oriented professional to independently lead Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects for private-sector clients, from conceptualisation and design through procurement, statutory approvals, execution and commissioning.

The candidate will be responsible for complete techno-commercial coordination and act as the single point of contact for clients, consultants, OEMs, vendors, contractors, government authorities and internal stakeholders.

**KRA: Task / Activities**

**1. Design, Engineering & BOQ Preparation**

* Develop BESS project concepts, system configurations and preliminary engineering solutions.
* Prepare detailed BOQs, BOMs, technical specifications, cost estimates and project budgets.
* Coordinate electrical designs, SLDs, equipment sizing, cable schedules, earthing, protection systems and layout drawings.
* Evaluate technical requirements for battery systems, PCS, BMS, EMS, transformers and associated electrical infrastructure.
* Review and validate engineering deliverables prepared by consultants and OEMs.

**2. Statutory Compliance & Government Approvals**

* Identify applicable statutory approvals and regulatory requirements for each project.
* Coordinate with DISCOMs, CEIG/Electrical Inspectorate, Fire Department and other relevant authorities.
* Manage grid connectivity applications, electrical safety approvals, fire safety requirements and applicable permissions.
* Ensure compliance with applicable CEA regulations, BIS/IEC standards and state-specific requirements.

**3. Vendor Development & Techno-Commercial Management**

* Identify, develop and evaluate OEMs, equipment suppliers, engineering consultants and subcontractors.
* Prepare RFQs, evaluate technical offers and develop techno-commercial comparison statements.
* Negotiate with vendors and contractors to achieve competitive pricing and favourable commercial terms.
* Coordinate procurement planning, manufacturing schedules, inspections and material deliveries.
* Optimise project costs without compromising technical quality or performance.

**4. Project Planning & Execution Coordination**

* Prepare project execution plans, schedules, milestones and resource requirements.
* Coordinate with clients, consultants, vendors, contractors and site execution teams.
* Monitor project progress, engineering deliverables, procurement and installation activities.
* Resolve technical and coordination issues to prevent project delays.
* Ensure adherence to approved project budgets, timelines, safety and quality requirements.

**5. Commercial & Contractual Responsibilities**

* Support technical proposals, tender submissions, EPC quotations and commercial negotiations.
* Prepare project costing, subcontractor work packages and procurement budgets.
* Review vendor quotations, contractor bills, variations and additional work claims.
* Monitor project profitability, cost deviations and contractual obligations.
* Coordinate billing milestones and project documentation.

**6. Testing, Commissioning & Handover**

* Coordinate FAT, SAT, pre-commissioning and commissioning activities.
* Ensure proper integration of battery systems, PCS, EMS, BMS and associated electrical equipment.
* Coordinate statutory inspections, energisation approvals and grid synchronisation, where applicable.
* Ensure completion of testing reports, as-built drawings, O&M manuals and handover documentation.

**KPI: Performance Metrics**

* Timely preparation and accuracy of engineering designs, BOQs and project estimates.
* Timely acquisition of statutory approvals and regulatory clearances.
* Cost optimisation through effective vendor selection and procurement.
* Achievement of project milestones within approved budgets and timelines.
* Successful project commissioning, client satisfaction and profitability.

**Required Skills**

* Strong understanding of BESS technology and electrical EPC projects.
* Proficiency in electrical design review, BOQ preparation and project estimation.
* Knowledge of statutory approvals, grid connectivity and electrical safety regulations.
* Experience in vendor development, procurement and techno-commercial negotiations.
* Strong project planning, stakeholder coordination and problem-solving abilities.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD, MS Excel and project management tools.
* Excellent communication, negotiation and leadership skills.

**Preferred skills**

* Hands-on experience with grid-connected BESS projects, preferably for private industrial and commercial clients.
* Experience coordinating with government authorities, utilities, OEMs and EPC contractors.

title: Project Head – Commercial (Luxury Real Estate Development)
description:
**Project Head – Commercial (Luxury Real Estate Development)**
--------------------------------------------------------------

**Location:** Vile Parle, Mumbai  
**Experience:** 20–25+ Years  
**Qualification:** B.E./B.Tech – Civil Engineering

### **About the Role**

We are looking for an accomplished Project Head with extensive experience in executing large-scale commercial real estate developments, preferably premium and luxury commercial projects.

The individual will be responsible for leading the entire project lifecycle, from project planning, design coordination and pre-construction activities to construction execution, project delivery and final handover.

The role requires strong expertise in managing large construction teams, leading reputed Project Management Consultants (PMCs), coordinating with architects and design consultants, managing contractors, and ensuring project delivery within defined timelines, budgets and quality parameters.

The ideal candidate should have a proven track record of delivering high-value commercial developments and the ability to independently drive project execution at an organisational level.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**1. Project Leadership & End-to-End Execution**

* Lead the complete project lifecycle, from pre-construction planning and design development through execution, commissioning and final handover.
* Develop the overall project execution strategy, construction methodology, master schedule and resource deployment plan.
* Take complete ownership of project delivery, ensuring adherence to approved timelines, budgets, quality benchmarks and project specifications.
* Drive execution of large-scale commercial developments, including high-rise structures and premium commercial buildings.
* Establish project governance mechanisms, reporting structures, review systems and execution controls.

**2. PMC & Consultant Management**

* Lead and manage reputed Project Management Consultants (PMCs), ensuring effective execution, monitoring and delivery.
* Drive accountability across PMC teams, architects, structural consultants, MEP consultants, façade consultants and other technical stakeholders.
* Review PMC deliverables, project schedules, progress reports, technical submissions and quality benchmarks.
* Ensure effective coordination between design consultants, contractors, internal teams and project stakeholders.
* Evaluate technical recommendations, identify execution gaps and drive timely resolution of project-level issues.

**3. Construction & Technical Management**

* Oversee civil, structural, RCC, MEP, façade, finishing, waterproofing, fire-fighting, HVAC, electrical and allied construction activities.
* Review and approve construction methodologies, technical specifications, drawings, BOQs and material submissions within delegated authority.
* Ensure construction execution is aligned with approved architectural and structural drawings, specifications and engineering standards.
* Monitor construction progress through regular site inspections and technical reviews.
* Ensure appropriate coordination between civil, structural, MEP, façade and finishing activities.

**4. Project Planning, Cost & Commercial Management**

* Develop and monitor detailed project schedules, critical path activities and milestone-based execution plans.
* Monitor project budgets, cost estimates, cash flows, procurement plans and resource utilisation.
* Oversee contractor appointments, tender evaluations, work orders, contractual obligations and billing certifications.
* Identify cost optimisation opportunities without compromising project quality and specifications.
* Proactively manage project delays, variations, claims, cost escalations and contractual risks.

**5. Quality, Safety & Compliance**

* Establish and monitor project quality assurance and quality control systems.
* Ensure compliance with applicable statutory regulations, sanctioned plans, development permissions and construction safety requirements.
* Monitor testing, commissioning, quality audits and defect rectification.
* Ensure effective implementation of EHS standards across all contractors and project teams.
* Drive project readiness, snagging, documentation and final handover.

**6. Stakeholder & Management Reporting**

* Act as the primary project-level interface between management, PMC, consultants, contractors and internal departments.
* Conduct periodic project review meetings and present progress against approved milestones.
* Identify execution bottlenecks, project risks and critical decisions requiring management intervention.
* Provide management with accurate project dashboards, progress reports, cost updates and recovery plans.
* Lead and mentor project managers, planning engineers, execution teams and other technical professionals.

### **Eligibility & Experience**

* B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering. Postgraduate qualifications in Construction Management or Project Management will be an advantage.
* Minimum 20–25+ years of experience in the real estate and construction industry.
* Must have substantial experience in **large-scale commercial building construction**, preferably premium or Grade-A commercial developments.
* Should have independently managed projects from pre-construction and design coordination through execution, commissioning and final handover.
* Strong experience in managing reputed PMCs, architects, structural consultants, MEP consultants, façade consultants and large contracting organisations.
* Demonstrated expertise in high-rise commercial construction, large floor plates, RCC structures, MEP integration and premium finishing.
* Strong understanding of project planning, cost control, contract management, procurement and construction methodologies.
* Proficiency in Primavera P6 / MS Project, AutoCAD and MS Excel.
* Strong leadership, stakeholder management, negotiation and decision-making capabilities.

### **Target Candidate Profile – Mandatory**

Candidates should preferably have worked with established real estate developers or reputed construction organisations such as:

* Lodha Developers
* Runwal Group
* L&T Construction
* Godrej Properties
* Oberoi Realty
* K Raheja Corp
* Shapoorji Pallonji
* Hiranandani Group
* Other reputed developers or EPC organisations with demonstrable experience in large-scale premium commercial developments.

**Critical Selection Criteria:**

* Candidates must have hands-on experience in commercial project execution. Residential-only experience will not be sufficient.

* Must have handled large-scale commercial projects with significant construction complexity.

* Must have experience managing reputed PMCs and multiple design and technical consultants.

* Must demonstrate end-to-end project ownership rather than experience limited to site execution or a specific construction phase.

* Should have a proven track record of delivering projects within committed timelines, budgets and quality standards.

### **Key Success Expectation**

The selected individual will be accountable for the successful delivery of the Atharv Marine commercial development at Vile Parle, ensuring strong project governance, execution excellence, cost discipline, technical coordination and timely completion.

**This is a leadership position requiring a seasoned construction professional with the ability to independently drive a landmark commercial real estate development.**

title: Project Manager
description:
Role purpose:

The Country Rollout SPOC will serve as the dedicated coordination and execution-support lead between the central Core Team and Country Teams. The role will provide a consistent view of country readiness, milestones, dependencies, risks and sign-offs, enabling multiple country rollouts to progress in parallel with strong control, timely escalation and clear management reporting.

Key responsibilities

* Act as the single point of contact between the central Core Team and each Country Team for all rollout-related matters.
* Maintain country-wise rollout plans covering milestones, dependencies, readiness criteria and open actions, and consolidate these into a management-level programme view.
* Support the IBG Lead in coordinating parallel country rollouts, resolving cross-country timeline conflicts and escalating material risks or blockers promptly.
* Maintain accurate country and programme RAID logs covering risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies, including owners, target dates and escalation status.
* Coordinate data-migration and reconciliation readiness with relevant teams, including tracking data-quality concerns, mapping gaps and related remediation actions.
* Coordinate UAT planning and execution, cutover planning, go-live readiness reviews and the completion and documentation of required sign-offs.
* Ensure the Core Team's design, migration methodology and control standards are consistently understood and applied by Country Teams, while capturing local regulatory and business-continuity considerations.
* Prepare periodic status reports and dashboards for the IBG Lead and management, summarising progress, risks, decisions, dependencies and readiness across all active countries.
* Maintain disciplined action tracking and follow-through across stakeholders, escalating overdue or unresolved items that may affect scope, quality, compliance or go-live dates.
* Support continuity across rollout phases by maintaining organised programme records, decisions, approvals and country-specific documentation.

Key deliverables

* Integrated country rollout plan and consolidated milestone tracker.
* Country-level and programme-level RAID logs with clear ownership and escalation status.
* Readiness dashboard covering data, testing, cutover, sign-offs and open blockers.
* Periodic management status reports with decisions required and priority actions.
* UAT, cutover and go-live readiness trackers, including documented approvals and sign-offs.
* Consistent repository of country rollout actions, dependencies, decisions and evidence.

Candidate profile

The following profile converts the responsibilities in the justification note into practical hiring criteria.

* Bachelor's degree in technology, engineering, business, finance or a related discipline.
* Relevant experience in programme coordination, PMO, implementation management or country rollout delivery within banking or financial services.
* Practical exposure to core banking transformation, technology implementation, data migration, reconciliation, UAT, cutover or go-live readiness.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple workstreams, countries or delivery timelines simultaneously in a structured and controlled manner.
* Working knowledge of RAID management, milestone planning, dependency tracking, governance reporting and readiness sign-offs.
* Strong stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to coordinate central and local teams and escalate issues clearly and constructively.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including preparation of concise dashboards and senior-management updates.
* High attention to detail, ownership and follow-through, with a disciplined approach to documentation and control evidence.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience with enterprise planning, collaboration or reporting tools is an advantage.

Preferred attributes

* Experience supporting multi-country or regional banking programmes.
* Understanding of local regulatory considerations, business-continuity requirements and audit or control expectations in country implementations.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment where rollout timelines overlap and priorities may shift.
* Professional certification in project or programme management is advantageous.

Success measures

* Timely identification, ownership and escalation of country-specific blockers.
* Accurate and consistent rollout status, RAID and readiness reporting across countries.
* Completion and documentation of required UAT, cutover and go-live readiness sign-offs.
* Effective coordination of parallel rollouts without compromising quality, compliance or oversight.
* Improved management visibility and reduced day-to-day coordination burden on the IBG Lead.

title: Project Implementation Engineer - Construction Product
description:
The Project Implementation Engineer - Construction Product trains project teams on NirmaanXD, sets up projects on the platform, and supports them through execution. The role owns the model-to-schedule link on each project: auditing the model, configuring it, building activity templates, and keeping the model current as the project moves.

**About the Visual Planning Product - NirmaanXD**

NirmaanXD is vConstruct's model-based construction planning and production tracking platform. It connects BIM models (Revit, IFC, Navisworks) to the construction schedule: model-based WBS creation, quantity-backed activity durations, 4D visualization, field-ready lookaheads, and progress tracking. Schedules exchange with Primavera P6 and MS Project through XML import/export.

**Key responsibilities**

**Product training and onboarding**

* Deliver NirmaanXD training to project teams: VDC, planners and schedulers, project engineers, superintendents, and trade partners.
* Onboard new users and projects; tailor sessions to each role's workflow.
* Maintain training material and act as first-line product support for assigned projects.

**Project setup**

* Model audit: review incoming models in Navisworks or similar tools and decide whether each model is usable as-is or needs modification. Check element categorization, parameters, levels and zones, naming, completeness, and level of detail against NirmaanXD's requirements.
* Document audit findings and the remediation required, with owner and timeline.
* Model configuration: set up element filtering and exclusion rules, WBS mapping, and location or zone breakdown.
* Activity template configuration: build activity mapping rules, quantity links, and production rates aligned to the project schedule.

**Implementation support**

* Support project teams through execution: model updates and re-imports, schedule alignment, lookaheads, and progress tracking setup.
* Troubleshoot data and configuration issues; escalate product defects to the NirmaanXD product team with clear reproduction steps.
* Capture user feedback and feature requests from projects.

**Model queries**

* Resolve model-related questions from project teams: missing or misclassified elements, quantity discrepancies, mapping gaps.
* Trace issues to source (model, configuration, or schedule) and fix or route them.

**Project meetings**

* Attend and lead weekly project meetings: Project Kick-off, Scope alignment, timeline, project setup and onboarding, open model and configuration issues, lookahead reviews, progress status.
* Track action items to closure.

**Model changes**

* Make model changes needed for NirmaanXD: add or correct parameters, split elements by pour or zone, reclassify elements, and fix naming.
* Coordinate larger changes with the model author.

**Required skills**

* Working understanding of BIM and VDC processes: model coordination, model structure, and how models feed downstream construction workflows.
* Hands-on experience performing model audits in Navisworks or similar tools: search and selection sets, property review, completeness checks.
* Ability to edit model data at least at the property and selection level to support configuration.
* Clear spoken and written English for training delivery and client-facing meetings with US project teams.
* Model authoring experience in Revit, Tekla, or similar tools.

**Good-to-have skills**

* Planning or scheduling experience: CPM scheduling in Primavera P6 or MS Project, WBS development, lookahead planning.
* Exposure to lean planning methods (Last Planner System, pull planning, TAKT) or 4D tools (Synchro, Navisworks TimeLiner).
* Quantity takeoff from models and familiarity with production rates by trade.
* Experience supporting US construction projects or field teams.

**Competency**

* Training delivery: explains a model-based workflow to users with no BIM background, including superintendents and trade foremen.
* Structured problem solving: isolates whether an issue sits in the model, the configuration, or the schedule before acting.
* Meeting ownership: runs a weekly meeting to an agenda, drives decisions, and closes actions.
* Data discipline: documents audit findings, configuration decisions, and model changes so another specialist can pick up the project.
* Product feedback: reports defects and gaps to the product team with evidence, not anecdotes

**About vConstruct**
: vConstruct specializes in providing high-quality Building Information Modeling, Lean Construction, Integrated Project Delivery and Software Solutions for global construction projects. vConstruct is a wholly owned subsidiary of DPR Construction, USA. The Software Unit for vConstruct works on many interesting problems in Construction Technology. It works across different sets of software technologies such as Web Applications, Workflow Management, Analytics, Machine Learning, and IoT. For more information, please visit www.vconstruct.com.

DPR Construction is a commercial general contractor and construction manager in USA specializing in technically challenging and sustainable projects for advanced technology, biopharmaceutical, corporate office, and higher education and healthcare markets. With the purpose of building great things—great teams, great buildings, great relationships—DPR is a truly great company. For more information, please visit www.dpr.com.

title: EDI and Operations SME
description:
Castrol is one of the world’s leading lubricant brands, serving customers and consumers in the automotive, marine, industrial and energy sectors. Castrol brands are recognised globally for their premium quality and high performance, shaped by the company’s commitment to innovation and cutting-edge technology. With products sold in more than 150 countries, Castrol has helped keep things moving on roads and racetracks, air, sea, and space for over 125 years.
  
  
Whether you're just starting out or ready for your next big move, you're in the right place to explore an exciting career with Castrol.
  
  
**Job Description**
About the Role
  
  
The EDI Support Subject Matter Expert (SME) serves as a key resource supporting the reliability, performance, and continuous improvement and strategic development of Castrol's EDI ecosystem. This role provides functional and technical expertise across EDI operations, SAP integrations, trading partner onboarding, issue resolution, and process optimization.
  
  
The position partners closely with business teams, IT&S, external vendors, and trading partners to support seamless electronic transactions and ensure critical customer-facing processes operate efficiently.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Analyze and support resolution of EDI transaction, mapping, and integration issues.
* Verify root cause analysis outcomes for production incidents and recommend or confirm corrective actions.
* Identify exception trends and create action plans to improve performance.
* Support resolution of complex document processing and interface exceptions.
* Manage Key Customer Scorecards and KPI’s to expected levels

Trading Partner Onboarding
  
  

* Manage E2E onboarding of new customers, distributors, and other trading partners.
* Convert customer EDI requirements and specifications into process and technical specifications.
* Create implementation project plans and coordinate with technical teams to ensure scope and on-time delivery
* Coordinate testing activities and support successful implementation and go-live activities.
* Validate transaction compliance and connectivity requirements.

Mapping & Integration Support
  
  

* Support EDI mapping development, enhancement, and validation activities.
* Provide expertise on SAP IDOCs, Order-to-Cash and logistics processes, and EDI transaction standards.
* Partner with business stakeholders, IT&S and integration providers to evaluate and validate proposed solutions.
* Assist with testing, defect analysis, and production readiness activities.

Subject Matter Expertise & Consultation
  
  

* Act as a trusted EDI advisor to business teams, IT&S, and support organizations.
* Provide consultation and knowledge sharing on EDI processes, standards, and best practices.
* Creation of Support documentation, training materials, operational procedures, and EDI Specifications.
* Serve as an escalation resource for complex EDI-related issues.

Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Identify opportunities to improve EDI processes, monitoring, and support effectiveness.
* Recommend automation and process enhancements that improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Support digital transformation initiatives involving integration and customer connectivity.

**Experience Required**

* Expertise in supporting Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) business processes.
* Advanced knowledge of ANSI X12, EDIFACT and cXML transaction standards.
* Expertise troubleshooting EDI transaction delivery, mappings, and document flows.
* Deep understanding of SAP IDOCs used in Order-to-Cash and logistics processes
* Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder collaboration skills.
* Demonstrable capability to work effectively across cross-functional business and technical teams.
* Expertise with OpenText/GXS, SPS Commerce, or similar EDI platforms.
* Expertise supporting customer onboarding and trading partner implementations.
* Expertise developing and validating EDI mappings.
* Advanced Knowledge of operational support models and incident management processes. ITIL Certification a plus
* 10-15 years working on EDI Implementations
* Played a significant role in at least one major ERP Project
* Lead \*significant EDI Implementations

title: Manager, Engineering
description:
**Our Mission**
At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
  
  
****Who We Are****
In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
  
  
We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
  
  
****Job Summary****
We are seeking an Engineering Manager to lead the team that builds and runs our connectors framework. In this role, you will be accountable for the team’s delivery across several concurrent projects, from platform enhancements to large programs that need multiple teams to collaborate. You will lead by example as a hands-on technical manager, grow the engineers on your team, and remove roadblocks so the connector engineers who build on your platform can move fast.
  
  
****What You’ll Do****

* Own Team Delivery: Be accountable for delivering multiple framework projects and features at the same time. Make pragmatic trade-offs to deliver, and personally deliver features when the team needs it.
* Lead Technically: Stay hands-on and lead by example. Guide the team through large, complex projects that need several teams to complete, such as migrating on-premises connectivity to a cloud-managed agent or extracting the integrations code into its own service. Design features in the framework yourself when needed.
* Direct Quality and Reliability: Set the quality processes the team follows. Own framework reliability, including sync health, incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), and resolution of security findings.
* Develop Talent: Run 1:1s, performance reviews, goal setting, and career guidance. Enable ownership on the team, resolve conflict, and grow engineers into their next level.
* Remove Roadblocks Across Teams: Work closely with the connector development team, other product teams, SRE, security, and PM to keep work clear and unblocked.
* Lead AI-First Engineering: Train the team on our tools and processes, including AI-assisted development workflows, and set the discipline for verifying AI-generated code.
* Drive Initiatives: Run initiatives within the team, such as cutting the time it takes to build a new connector or reducing sync failures.
* Keep Customers in Focus: Understand customer use cases and problems, and use them to set priorities with PM.
* Build the Team: Actively recruit, lead interviews, and make hiring decisions.
* Communicate Clearly: Present plans, progress, and risks to engineering and senior leadership.

**Nice to Have**

* Identity & Access Security Domain: Direct experience with IAM, PAM, IGA, or Secrets Management platforms.
* Integration Platforms: Experience leading teams that build integration frameworks, data pipelines, or SDKs used by other engineers.
* Hybrid Connectivity: Experience with products that run agents inside customer networks.
* Multi-Site Teams: Experience leading engineers across more than one office location.
* DevOps & Observability Ecosystems: Practical experience with progressive delivery, CI/CD pipelines, feature flagging tools, and monitoring tools such as Datadog.

**Impact**
As an Engineering Manager on the connectors framework, you will lead the team that every connector in our product depends on. Your impact will be measured by your team’s delivery, the reliability of the framework in production, and the growth of the engineers you lead. Co-workers will look to you for clarity, technical judgment, and a steady path forward.
  
  
****Qualifications****

* People Leadership: Experience managing software engineers, including 1:1s, performance reviews, career development, and hiring.
* Technical Depth: Strong hands-on background with Node.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, and AWS, plus experience with data integration or distributed systems. Able to review designs and code with credibility.
* Delivery Track Record: Proven record of delivering large, complex projects that need collaboration across several teams.
* Operational Ownership: Experience running production services, leading incident response, and driving RCAs to durable fixes.
* AI Tooling Adoption: Experience leading a team’s adoption of AI tools while keeping review rigor high.
* Conflict Resolution & Influence: Able to resolve conflict, remove roadblocks across teams, and build strong working relationships with ICs and managers.
* Communication: Excellent presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to engineering and business audiences.
* Customer Understanding: Good understanding of customer use cases, problems, and considerations.

****Qualifications****
**Our Commitment**
We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
  
  
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.
  
  
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
  
  
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
  
  
Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

title: Data Protection Consultant
description:
**Job Description**
**Join Tsaaro as a Data Protection Consultant**
**Lead with Purpose. Deliver Impact. Shape Privacy.**
**About Tsaaro**
At Tsaaro, privacy and security are not side functions they are our core. Our team includes dedicated data privacy consultants and cybersecurity specialists, all collaborating to empower organizations with tailored, effective, and cost-conscious solutions.
  
  
We bring a practical, risk-based consulting approach, offering clients actionable insights and hands-on support to help them manage privacy risks, demonstrate compliance, and strengthen their data protection posture.
  
  
**Your Role: Data Protection Consultant**
As a Senior Consultant, you will serve as a strategic advisor to our clients, leading engagements across privacy governance, compliance readiness, and risk management.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, implement, and oversee privacy and data protection programs tailored to client needs.
* Evaluate clients’ privacy and security controls, identifying gaps and building actionable roadmaps.
* Lead privacy gap assessments, PIAs, RoPA, DPIAs, and audits across diverse sectors.
* Provide strategic guidance on regulations including GDPR, CCPA, DPDP Act, and emerging global laws.
* Develop and review privacy policies, training materials, and compliance documentation.
* Drive implementation of ISO 27001, ISO 27701, NIST, and other global frameworks.
* Support incident response planning, breach notification, and Data Subject Rights processes.
* Conduct internal audits, risk assessments, and ISMS documentation in alignment with certification requirements.
* Conduct end-to-end third-party risk assessments
* Collaborate with cross-functional client teams to deliver end-to-end privacy solutions.
* Contribute to cybersecurity initiatives including GRC strategy, policy development, and audit readiness.

**Requirements**

* 2+ years of hands-on experience in data privacy, protection, or cybersecurity consulting.
* Hands-on experience with privacy and compliance tools such as OneTrust, Securiti.ai, and similar platforms for data mapping, consent management, and assessments.
* Strong understanding of global privacy laws such as GDPR, CCPA, and others.
* Solid grasp of ISO 27001, 27701, NIST, and related standards.
* ISMS, PIMS, DPDPA, CCPA/CPRA, GDPR, UK DPA, PIPEDA Compliance & Frameworks, Privacy Tools (e.g., Securiti.ai)
* Experience in AI Privacy Assessments, compliance projects, ISMS implementation, and client communication.
* Certifications such as IAPP Certifications CIPP/E, CIPM, CIPT, ISO LA/LI (preferred).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, client-facing confidence, and analytical thinking.
* A mindset that is solution-oriented, collaborative, and growth-driven.

**Benefits**
**Why Join Tsaaro?**

* Work with one of the most specialized and fast-growing privacy consulting firms in India.
* Exposure to multinational clients and global regulations.
* A clear career path with opportunities to lead projects and mentor junior consultants.
* Ownership of high-impact, strategic engagements from day one.
* Flexible work culture – hybrid options available.
* Ongoing support for certifications, professional development, and learning.

**From The Tsaaro Team**
"At Tsaaro, we’re building not just a consulting firm, but a community of privacy professionals who care about making a difference. If you’re ready to move beyond checklists and become a true advisor, we want you on our team."

description:
**Description**

BACKGROUND: Passing Gifts Private Limited (PGPL) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Heifer International USA and it provide services in educating, consulting, training, advising, and providing professional and technical services to individuals, associations, and entities in India and abroad, particularly those who support or are working in the areas of social advancement and sustainable development. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identify, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.
  
  
**Function**
The Senior Program Officer – Agriculture will provide technical and programmatic leadership for agriculture and allied livelihood interventions with a strong focus on regenerative agriculture, climate resilience, sustainable food systems, and farmer livelihoods. The position will support the planning, implementation, monitoring, and scaling of regenerative agriculture practices that improve soil health, biodiversity, water conservation, ecosystem restoration, and livelihood resilience among smallholder farmers. The role requires close coordination with farmers, farmer institutions, government departments, technical agencies, implementing partner NGOs, other civil society organizations, research institutions, and market actors to promote sustainable agriculture transitions and strengthen rural livelihoods.
  
  
**Responsibiliies And Deliverables**
Programme Planning and Implementation (40%)
  
  

* Lead implementation of regenerative agriculture interventions in project geographies. Provide technical guidance to field teams and communities on regenerative and climate-smart agricultural practices.
* Develop annual work plans, implementation strategies, targets, and seasonal crop plans.
* Promote and facilitate adoption of regenerative agricultural practices, including:
* Soil health restoration and improvement
* Natural and organic farming approaches
* Crop diversification and crop rotation
* Cover cropping and mulching
* Integrated nutrient and pest management
* Agroforestry and mixed farming systems
* Water-efficient and climate-resilient farming practices
* Support establishment of demonstration plots, learning farms, and farmer business/field schools for regenerative agriculture. Integrate climate adaptation and ecosystem-based approaches into agriculture programming.
* Mentor and support field staff on agriculture and regenerative practices.
* Conduct regular field visits for technical support and quality assurance. Ensure documentation of field observations and continuous learning across teams.
* Develop training modules, IEC materials, and technical manuals on regenerative agriculture and sustainable food systems.
* Promote farmer-led experimentation and participatory learning approaches. Build capacities of farmers, community institutions, producer groups, and field teams through trainings, exposure visits, and demonstrations.
* Support development of sustainable and resilient agricultural value chains.
* Facilitate market linkages for regenerative and sustainably produced farm products.
* Promote local enterprises, value addition, post-harvest management, and diversified livelihood opportunities.

Stakeholder Coordination and Partnerships (30%)
  
  

* Liaise with government departments including Agriculture, Horticulture, Watershed, Rural Development, Forestry, and allied departments for convergence and scheme linkages.
* Collaborate with technical experts, research institutions, universities, private sector agencies, and knowledge partners on regenerative agriculture innovations.
* Represent the organization in relevant forums, consultations, and multi-stakeholder platforms related to agriculture and climate resilience.

Monitoring, Learning and Documentation (20%)
  
  

* Develop and track indicators related to regenerative agriculture adoption, productivity improvement, soil health, biodiversity enhancement, and farmer resilience.
* Monitor project progress and ensure quality implementation against program outcomes.
* Document case studies, field learnings, success stories, and evidence on regenerative agriculture transitions.
* Prepare technical reports, donor reports, policy briefs, and knowledge products. Ensure that the implementing partner meets Heifer’s monitoring and evaluation requirements and deadlines. Review of project activities (physical and financial) with partner staff monthly and ensure that reports are submitted on schedule. Participate in ongoing partner activities on a regular basis for quality control and improvement.
* Ensure that the activity-based reforecasting is prepared following the participatory method with appropriate stakeholders.
* Ensure documentation and sharing of best practices.

Community Institution Strengthening (10%)
  
  

* Strengthen farmer groups, producer collectives, and Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs) to adopt regenerative and market-oriented farming systems.
* Facilitate community-led planning for sustainable land use, soil restoration, and natural resource management.
* Encourage inclusion of women, youth, and marginal farmers in agriculture initiatives.

**Qualifications And Skills**

* Degree in Agriculture, Agronomy, Agroecology, Agricultural Extension, Horticulture, Natural Resource Management, Rural Development, Environmental Sciences, or related disciplines.
* Minimum 8–10 years of relevant experience in agriculture, regenerative agriculture, agroecology, climate-resilient agriculture, rural livelihoods, or natural resource management.
* Experience working with NGOs, development organizations, donor-funded projects, or government agriculture programmes.
* Demonstrated experience in community-based agriculture programming and farmer institution strengthening.
* Strong understanding of regenerative agriculture, agroecology, climate-resilient agriculture, soil health, biodiversity conservation, and sustainable food systems.
* Experience in programme planning, implementation, monitoring, and stakeholder engagement.
* Knowledge of farmer institutions, FPOs, agriculture value chains, and livelihood promotion.
* Strong facilitation, training, and community mobilization skills.
* Excellent analytical, reporting, and documentation skills.
* Ability to engage with government agencies, technical experts, and development partners.
* Proficiency in MS Office and digital monitoring tools.
* Willingness to travel extensively to field locations.

**Essential Competencies**

* Basic knowledge of financial controls and systems. Knowledge of word processing, spreadsheets, database and electronic mail software (Microsoft preferred).
* Strong Odia and English language skills, both oral and written.
* Demonstrate a high degree of honesty and integrity.
* Willingness to work flexibly outside normal working hours.
* Ability to foster and maintain a spirit of unity, teamwork and cooperation.
* Constant face-to-face, telephone and electronic communication with colleagues, potential donors, and the public.
* Motivated to work responsibly with little supervision.
* Ability to meet and deal with others in a courteous and tactful manner.
* Ability to work with sensitive information and to always maintain confidentiality.
* Sensitivity in working with multiple cultures and beliefs, and to gender equity.
* Constant sitting, standing and walking, with occasional bending and lifting; may work at a computer for extended periods of time
