title: Senior Manager- Growth and Impact
description:
**About the role**

We are looking for a
**Senior Manager**
to lead strategic engagements with government and ecosystem stakeholders across
**education, skilling, vocational education and others**
. The role will involve working closely with senior government officials to understand priorities, identify system-level opportunities, design and drive high-impact interventions, and translate evidence into actionable policy and program decisions.

The ideal candidate will bring a strong understanding of government systems, excellent stakeholder management skills, strategic problem-solving capabilities, and a strong bias for execution. They should be comfortable operating at the intersection of
**government, technology, data and social impact**
, and be able to move seamlessly between strategic discussions with senior bureaucrats and ground-level implementation.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Government engagement & strategic partnerships**

* Build and manage trusted relationships with senior government officials across education, skilling, and other adjacent domains.
* Engage with senior bureaucrats and department leadership to understand priorities, decision cycles, institutional constraints and emerging opportunities.
* Represent the organisation in strategic discussions with state and central government departments, Sector Skill Councils, industry bodies, employers and other ecosystem stakeholders.
* Act as a strategic thought partner to government stakeholders, bringing evidence, insights and practical recommendations to support policy and program decisions.
* Identify opportunities to align organisational interventions with government priorities, schemes, budgets and existing institutional structures.

**2. Strategy, policy & program design**

* Lead the design and execution of large-scale education and skilling programs in partnership with government, private sector and philanthropy.
* Analyse government policies, schemes, budgets and implementation frameworks to identify opportunities for convergence, optimisation and system-level innovation.
* Develop strategies and program models that address challenges across education, skilling, employability, placement and workforce outcomes.
* Drive
  **evidence-backed policy advocacy**
  and support government stakeholders in translating insights into actionable reforms.
* Work with leadership to develop proposals, partnership models and new program opportunities across states, central government and thematic areas.

**3. Data, research & evidence**

* Translate large and complex datasets into actionable insights for government decision-makers and organisational leadership.
* Develop analytical frameworks, policy briefs, dashboards, visual reports and presentations that enable real-time decision-making.
* Lead research and ecosystem assessments to understand implementation bottlenecks, user needs and opportunities for reform.
* Build evidence bases around outcomes such as learning, skilling, employability, placement, wages and workforce participation.
* Use data and field evidence to identify course corrections and strengthen program design and implementation.

**4. Program execution & impact**

* Own delivery of complex, multi-stakeholder programs from strategy and design through implementation and scale-up.
* Work closely with internal teams across product, technology, analytics, training and program delivery to ensure timely and integrated execution.
* Monitor program milestones, risks, dependencies and impact indicators, proactively identifying and resolving bottlenecks.
* Lead impact articulation through clear measurement, reporting and documentation frameworks.
* Ensure that learnings from implementation are systematically captured and translated into improvements in program strategy and delivery.

**5. Field engagement & implementation intelligence**

* Conduct regular field visits to understand implementation realities, frontline needs and stakeholder experiences.
* Engage with teachers, trainers, students, administrators, employers and other actors to gather ground-level intelligence.
* Bring field insights into policy discussions, program design and strategic decision-making.
* Identify gaps between policy intent and implementation and develop practical recommendations to address them.

**6. Communication & thought leadership**

* Develop compelling narratives, presentations and communication materials that connect field evidence, policy priorities and program outcomes.
* Communicate complex insights clearly to senior government and internal leadership.
* Publish articles, reports and thought pieces that showcase organisational learning and insights from the education and skilling ecosystem.
* Represent the organisation in relevant forums, conferences and ecosystem discussions.

**7. Growth & ecosystem development**

* Identify and shape new opportunities across state government departments and relevant thematic areas.
* Build relationships with ecosystem organisations to broaden policy recommendations and enable adoption.
* Work with leadership to identify potential partnerships, funding opportunities and pathways for scaling successful models.

Qualifications & Experience

* **8+ years of relevant professional experience**
  in management consulting, public policy, government advisory, program management, education, skilling or other relevant domains.
* **MBA, Master’s in Public Policy, Development Studies, Education or a related field**
  preferred.
* Demonstrated experience working with
  **government stakeholders**
  , with government engagement experience being essential.
* Prior experience managing relationships with senior bureaucrats, ideally at the level of
  **Principal Secretary/Secretary/Director and above in State Government**
  .
* Experience in designing or implementing large-scale, multi-stakeholder programs in partnership with government.
* Strong understanding of government schemes, policies, institutional structures, decision-making processes and budgetary mechanisms.
* Experience leveraging
  **technology, digital platforms, data products or Digital Public Infrastructure**
  for social impact is highly desirable.
* Demonstrated experience in using data and evidence to influence policy or program decisions.
* Experience leading teams and managing complex programs with multiple stakeholders.

What we are looking for

* **Strategic thinker with a strong execution bias**
  — able to move from a high-level problem statement to concrete action.
* **High ownership and initiative**
  — comfortable taking responsibility for ambiguous problems and charting a path forward.
* **Strong government orientation**
  — able to build credibility and trusted relationships with senior public-sector stakeholders.
* **Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills**
  — able to synthesise diverse information into clear recommendations.
* **Strong communication skills**
  — able to communicate effectively with senior bureaucrats, frontline stakeholders and internal teams.
* **Collaborative leader**
  who can work across multidisciplinary teams and bring diverse stakeholders together.
* **Data-driven and impact-oriented**
  , with a demonstrated commitment to improving education, skilling and employment outcomes.
* Comfortable working in
  **fast-paced, ambiguous and evolving environments**
  , with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

**Position Summary**

We are looking for an innovative Technical SAP ABAP on HANA, CDS, OData, RAP Plus Gen AI develop and implement systems architecture that meet business needs, along with ensuring that our clients’ can keep pace with the changing tax and legal landscape.
  
  
Design, build, and support performance SAP S/4HANA extensions and services using ABAP on HANA, RESTful ABAP Programming Model (RAP), Core Data Services (CDS), and OData to enable modern Fiori/UI and integration scenarios.
  
  
To be successful in this role, you should be able to align the global Tax and Legal landscape with the business’ activities and proposed wider business processes. You will be the lynchpin between the Tax Function and IT Function, ensuring that we build the best SAP Tax design for the client. This will require the ability to explain complex terms to a variety of different stakeholders, and in a way that is relevant to each stakeholder group. You will also need to continually assess the SAP product suite and development roadmap to integrate any updated specifications and requirements into SAP system architecture.
  
  
You will also need to integrate with the wider client project team (whether that is delivered by Deloitte Consulting or another Systems Integration partner). This will involve an understanding of how the tax design interacts with other process flows and also the inter-personal skills to build the required relationships.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities -**

* Develop and enhance ABAP solutions on SAP S/4HANA using clean, modular, and testable patterns.
* Build Gen AI applications and AI Agents.
* Code Python is a plus.
* Ability to navigate fragmented landscapes through API-calls and MCP- servers is key.
* Build end-to-end RAP artifacts (behavior definitions/implementations, validations, determinations, actions, draft handling, locking, authorization concepts).
* Create and optimize CDS views (interface/consumption views, associations, annotations) with strong focus on pushdown and performance.
* Design, expose, and support OData services (preferably OData V4 via RAP; maintain OData V4 where required).

* Follow SAP extensibility guidelines (in-app/extensibility, key-user vs developer extensibility, released APIs, clean-core approach where applicable).
* Produce technical designs, code documentation, unit tests, and participate in code reviews.
* Support testing cycles, defect triage, hyper care, and production support with strong root-cause analysis

**Qualification And Experience Required -**

* Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience).
* 4+ years of Experience in SAP or SAP4HANA.
* Hands-on experience in building Gen AI applications, AI Agents.
* SAP Business AI certification is a plus.
* SAP certifications (ABAP for S/4HANA, RAP, BTP) are a plus.
* Strong hands-on experience with ABAP in SAP S/4HANA / ABAP on HANA environments.
* Proven delivery experience with:
* RAP (managed/unmanaged as needed, behavior implementation, draft, authorization)
* CDS (views, annotations, associations, table functions if needed)
* OData service exposure and troubleshooting (RAP/OData V4 strongly preferred)
* Strong understanding of HANA-optimized development: SQL/CDS pushdown, avoiding SELECT-in-loops, efficient joins, pagination, etc.
* Familiarity with modern ABAP practices (e.g., ABAP OO, clean code, exception handling, unit testing mindset).
* Experience working in Agile delivery (user stories, estimation, sprint ceremonies).

**Preferred / Nice To Have**

* SAP BTP exposure (e.g., Integration Suite, API Management, Event Mesh, ABAP environment/Steampunk—if relevant).
* BTP, Joule and SAP business AI certification.
* Proven knowledge of Tax touchpoints within SAP.

title: Integration Architect - FHIR
description:
**Job Title:**
FHIR Integration Architect

**Job Type:**
Contractor

**Location:**
Remote

**About the Role**

We're building an independent FHIR R4 interoperability layer that lets our CRM's clinical workflows starting with provider launch directly from inside the EHR, beginning with Oracle Health (Cerner) PowerChart. We need someone who can do both halves of this job well: design and personally validate the technical architecture, and lead the engineers full-stack, AI, and QA who build it. This is not a design-and-handoff role. You'll be in the SMART on FHIR launch flow when it breaks, in the code review when a mapping rule is wrong, and in the room when the team needs a call made.

**What You'll Own**

**Architecture & Solution Design**

•    
**Own**
the end-to-end architecture of the FHIR layer — SMART on FHIR launch and OAuth2, the canonical data model, the EMR adapter framework, tenant isolation, and event-driven orchestration — and keep it extensible to future EMRs (Epic, athenahealth) and formats (HL7v2, X12) beyond the Cerner pilot.

•    
**Make**
build-vs-buy and vendor decisions (self-hosted HAPI FHIR vs. a managed FHIR store; Keycloak vs. a commercial identity provider; build vs. adopt an interface engine) and can defend the reasoning to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.

•    
**Design**
the architecture against HIPAA-grade security and auditability requirements from day one — encryption, least-privilege access, audit trails — not as a pre-launch retrofit.

•    
**Validate**
the architecture against real constraints: Oracle Health/Cerner's actual FHIR R4 conformance, US Core and Da Vinci PAS implementation guides, and the operational realities of a live, EHR-embedded launch — not just a reference diagram.

**Technical Leadership & Delivery**

•    
**Lead**
a cross-functional engineering pod — full-stack engineers, AI/ML engineers, and QA engineers — setting technical direction, running code and design reviews, and removing blockers day to day.

•    
**Translate**
the solution architecture into a sequenced, phased delivery plan (proof of concept → pilot → multi-client scale) and hold the team accountable to it.

•    
**Own**
technical risk — surfacing integration blockers, vendor API gaps, and compliance findings early, and driving them to resolution rather than escalating and waiting.

**Integration, Standards & Compliance**

•    
**Lead**
the Cerner/Oracle Health integration end to end: SMART App Launch (EHR launch, OAuth2/OIDC, fhirUser claims), Ignite APIs registration, and coordination with the client health system's Cerner administrators.

•    
**Define and enforce**
conformance testing (ONC Inferno, US Core / Da Vinci PAS validation) before any integration is called production-ready.

•    
**Partner with**
compliance and security stakeholders on HIPAA Security Risk Assessments, BAAs, and audit-trail requirements.

**Required Qualifications**

•    8+ years in healthcare interoperability or integration engineering, including 3+ years in an architect or technical lead capacity.

•    Deep, hands-on FHIR R4 experience — resource modeling, RESTful FHIR APIs, and at least one implementation guide (US Core at minimum).

•    Direct experience implementing SMART App Launch (EHR and/or standalone launch), OAuth2/OIDC, and at least one major EHR's FHIR API — Cerner/Oracle Health experience specifically preferred given Phase 1 scope.

•    Hands-on experience with HAPI FHIR or an equivalent FHIR server — server customization and multi-tenant partitioning are a strong plus.

•    Cloud architecture experience on AWS or equivalent: containers, managed relational databases, event-driven services (queues/event buses), and core identity/security services.

•    Proven experience leading or managing engineers — running reviews, setting direction, and being accountable for a team's delivery, not only your own.

•    Working knowledge of healthcare data exchange beyond FHIR — HL7v2, X12, CDA — sufficient to plan for future extensibility.

•    Solid understanding of HIPAA technical safeguards and healthcare data compliance requirements.

**Strongly Preferred**

•    Direct, hands-on experience with Oracle Health (Cerner) Millennium / Ignite APIs and PowerChart SMART app registration — or the Epic App Orchard equivalent.

•    Experience with Keycloak or another open-source identity provider, including custom extension/SPI development.

•    Familiarity with Da Vinci implementation guides (PAS, CRD, DTR) and FHIR-based prior authorization workflows.

•    Experience in patient support programs, prior authorization, or healthcare CRM domains.

•    Experience standing up a healthcare integration function from near-zero on a small team, not only operating within an already-mature enterprise integration group.

•    Familiarity with applying AI/ML to healthcare data mapping, document generation, or clinical NLP — relevant given the AI engineers on this team.

**Tech Stack You'll Work With**

**FHIR & integration standards -**
FHIR R4, SMART App Launch v2, US Core, Da Vinci PAS, OAuth2 / OIDC, HL7v2 (future-facing)

**FHIR server -**
HAPI FHIR (JPA server), multi-tenant partitioning

**Identity -**
Keycloak, custom SMART-launch extension (SPI)

**Cloud / infra -**
AWS — Fargate/ECS, Aurora PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, API Gateway, WAF, EventBridge/SQS, Secrets Manager, KMS, CloudWatch/OpenSearch

**IaC / delivery -**
Terraform or AWS CDK, CI/CD (GitHub Actions or CodePipeline), Docker

**Target EHR (Phase 1) -**
Oracle Health / Cerner Millennium (Ignite APIs, PowerChart chart-toolbar launch)

**Conformance testing -**
ONC Inferno test kit (incl. Da Vinci PAS), Synthea synthetic data

title: Oracle - EPM - TRCS - Functional Consultant - Manager
description:
Oracle Cloud EPM Account Reconciliation (ARCS)
  
Senior Consultant
  
Job Summary:
  
We are seeking an experienced Oracle Cloud EPM Account Reconciliation (ARCS) Senior Consultant with strong hands-on expertise in Reconciliation Compliance, high-volume Transaction Matching, reconciliation governance, reporting, integrations and automation. The role will support solution design and independently deliver application configuration, data loads, matching rules, workflow, testing, deployment, documentation and production support under the guidance of project leadership.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities:**

* Participate in end-to-end Oracle Cloud EPM Account Reconciliation implementations, rollouts, enhancements and support engagements.
* Conduct requirement-gathering and design discussions; document reconciliation, control, compliance and transaction-matching requirements.
* Configure Reconciliation Compliance, including periods, calendars, currencies, organisational units, attributes, formats, profiles, reconciliation methods, risk ratings and workflow.
* Configure preparer and reviewer assignments, tolerances, variance analysis, auto-reconciliation, ageing, alerts, notifications, attachments, comments, electronic sign-offs and audit evidence.
* Design Transaction Matching solutions using multiple data sources, match types, transaction types, one-to-one, one-to-many, many-to-one and many-to-many rules, tolerance logic and date or amount adjustments.
* Configure and tune auto-match rules, suggested matches, manual matching, adjustments, unmatched-item ageing, exception handling and reconciliation integration.
* Develop balance-sheet, intercompany, bank, cash, subledger-to-ledger, system-to-system and operational reconciliation use cases.
* Create and support operational and compliance dashboards, predefined and custom reports, reconciliation-status reporting, ageing analysis, match-rate monitoring and exception reporting.
* Develop and support integrations with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, E-Business Suite, SAP, FCCS, banks, subledgers, data warehouses and external systems using Data Integration, EPM Automate, REST APIs and file-based interfaces.
* Automate profile imports, balance and transaction loads, currency rates, reconciliation creation, auto-match execution, period-status changes, journal exports, reporting and job monitoring.
* Execute CRP, SIT, UAT, data migration, reconciliation-cycle validation, volume and performance testing, cutover, go-live and hypercare; investigate defects and support root-cause resolution.
* Prepare configuration workbooks, functional and technical specifications, match-rule designs, test scripts, training materials, operating procedures and deployment documentation.
* Support security, segregation of duties, reconciliation policies, audit trails, evidence retention, data lineage, controls and production-support procedures.
* Collaborate with finance, controllership, audit and technical teams; guide junior consultants, participate in peer reviews and support demonstrations and estimations.

Requirements
  
  
**Experience:**

* Minimum 5+ years of Oracle EPM, finance transformation or account-reconciliation experience, including strong hands-on Oracle Cloud EPM Account Reconciliation experience.
* At least two full-lifecycle Oracle EPM implementations, including one ARCS implementation covering Reconciliation Compliance and Transaction Matching.
* Strong knowledge of balance-sheet reconciliation, account substantiation, reconciliation governance, risk-based workflow, variance analysis and financial-close controls.
* Hands-on experience with periods, formats, profiles, rules, currencies, organisational units, workflow, auto-reconciliation, ageing and dashboards.
* Hands-on Transaction Matching experience with data sources, match types, matching rules, adjustments, exceptions, auto-match optimisation and high-volume data sets.
* Experience integrating ARCS with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP or other source systems and automating processes through Data Integration, EPM Automate and REST APIs.
* Experience supporting workshops, configuration, testing, migration, reconciliation-cycle validation, cutover, go-live and post-production support.
* Industry experience in government, retail, energy, real estate, oil and gas, financial services, or power and utilities is preferred.

**Competencies / Skills:**

* Oracle Cloud EPM Account Reconciliation configuration, administration and connected financial-close processes
* Reconciliation Compliance, periods, formats, profiles, workflow, risk ratings, ageing, auto-reconciliation and audit evidence
* Transaction Matching data sources, match types, rules, tolerances, adjustments, exceptions and match-performance optimisation
* Balance-sheet, intercompany, bank, cash, subledger-to-ledger, system-to-system and operational reconciliations
* Operational and compliance dashboards, predefined and custom reports, ageing, variance, status and exception analysis
* Data Integration, EPM Automate, REST APIs, Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, FCCS and third-party ERP, bank and subledger integrations
* Security, segregation of duties, controls, audit trails, evidence retention, data lineage and compliance reporting
* Awareness of Predictive AI, Reconciliation Assignment Assistance, Transaction Matching Assistance, confidence scores, anomaly detection and governed human review is desirable
* Strong accounting, analytical, problem-solving, requirement analysis, documentation and stakeholder communication skills
* Strong teamwork, mentoring and delivery capabilities; willingness to travel and work MENA business timings

**Education:**

* CA, CMA, ACCA, MBA Finance or an equivalent finance/business qualification is preferred.
* Relevant Oracle Cloud EPM Account Reconciliation certification is preferred; accounting, audit, controls, integration or reporting credentials are advantageous.

description:
**About the company:**

India's first social distribution AI fintech platform for the underserved aspirational middle-class- delivering Secured & Unsecured loans, Insurance, and Investment products across 5,000+ small cities of India (referred as India-2). Founded in 2019, WeRize is at an annualized-run-rate of $60 Mn (Gross revenues) and $32Mn (Net) and $7Mn+ of net profits before taxes (3x Y-o-Y growth) with ROE > 20%. We are projecting ~2x growth in topline and ~3x growth in profits over the next 12 months.

WeRize operates as a “category creator” three-sided marketplace connecting 17,000+ trained local freelancers with India-2 customers and partner financial institutions, all powered by a full-stack AI operating layer that creates a “flywheel of trust” with self-reinforcing network effects.

* **Distributor trust:**
  Freelancers are empowered through AI-led tools that help them act in the long-term best interests of their customers.
* **Customer trust:**
  End customers rely on WeRize’s assisted distributor, data-driven recommendations across both asset and liability products
* **Manufacturer trust:**
  Financial Institutions rely on WeRize’s data, risk management and distribution intelligence to reach small city customers that they can’t serve on their own.

**Key highlights: What do we do**

1. **Large, underpenetrated market opportunity:**
   India’s 300Mn+ aspirational middle-class captures ~30% of GDP, yet remains financially underserved across credit, insurance, and investments. Pure-digital models lack the required trust, while physical branches are economically unviable.
2. **Differentiated, asset-light social distribution:**
   WeRize leverages 17,000+ financially literate freelancers across 5,000+ small cities. This branchless, zero-sales-team model delivers high-trust human touchpoints, superb unit economics, and strong freelancer retention through a broad product suite.
3. **Proprietary AI driven tech stack:**
   Trained on 20Bn+ data points across 4Mn+ households, WeRize’s AI powers end-to-end operations. For distribution, it optimizes lead gen, selling, and engagement—turning freelancers into professional advisors. For manufacturing, it sharpens risk management, underwriting, and product structuring for high-margin expansion.

To know more about the company, please visit: https://www.werize.com/

**Role Summary**

As a Senior Test Engineer, you will take end-to-end ownership of testing large features across our

fintech lending products. You will balance hands-on manual validation with scalable test

automation across web and mobile platforms, ensuring seamless quality across critical NBFC

workflows—including KYC verification, loan disbursements, repayment schedules, collections, and

partner settlements.

* Feature Quality Ownership: Translate Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) into comprehensive test plans, test cases, and execution strategies for major product releases.

* Automation Engineering: Identify high-value automation candidates and build, execute, and maintain automated test scripts using Playwright (TypeScript/JavaScript) to reduce manual regression cycles.
* API & Database Validation: Conduct thorough backend API testing using Postman/SoapUI and validate transactional data integrity using SQL queries.
* Defect Management & RCA: Log, track, and drive defects to closure in Jira, conducting root cause analysis (RCA) in collaboration with backend and product teams.
* CI/CD Execution: Run and monitor automated test suites integrated into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins).

**AI-Driven QA Responsibilities**

* AI-Assisted Code Generation: Actively use AI coding tools (such as Cursor IDE or GitHub Copilot) to generate, refactor, and debug test automation scripts.
* Test Synthesis & Workflows: Leverage LLMs (such as Claude, GPT, or DeepSeek) to accelerate test case generation, edge-case discovery, and test data preparation.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Experience: 4–5 years of hands-on experience in software testing (combining strong manual testing fundamentals with practical UI/API automation).
* Automation Stack: Hands-on proficiency in Playwright with TypeScript/JavaScript (or strong experience in Selenium/Java with the ability to transition quickly).
* Core Technical Skills: Solid command of functional testing, API testing (Postman/SoapUI), SQL querying, and Android mobile app testing.
* Domain Knowledge: Experience in Fintech, BFSI, or NBFC domains (understanding of LOS/LMS, KYC, disbursements, repayments, or collections is strongly preferred).
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

description:
**About the Role**

We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering pod

at GoComet, building critical platform capabilities that power our logistics

transformation. This is a hands-on leadership position where you balance direct team

management, strategic technical decision-making, and owning the delivery of features

that serve 300+ global enterprises, including Fortune 500 clients.

✅ Strategy & Technical Leadership

● Build and lead a high-performing engineering pod responsible for critical platform

capabilities.

● Define technical strategy, architectural patterns, coding standards, and system

design principles aligned with business OKRs.

● Drive technical roadmapping and break down complex requirements into

well-scoped sprints.

● Ensure systems are designed for reliability, scalability, and performance with

strong observability practices.

✅ Delivery & Execution

● Own quarterly OKRs and feature delivery timelines; maintain visibility into team

velocity, blockers, and progress. Be accountable for customer outcomes,

business capabilities shipped per engineer, system reliability, and operating cost.

trade-offs proactively.

continuous process improvement.

quality gates for releases.

👥 Team Building & People Leadership

● Hire, onboard, and retain a high-performing engineering team; conduct technical

interviews.

● Lead team rituals: sprint planning, code reviews, retrospectives, and design

reviews.

● Coach engineers on technical growth, career development, and leadership

potential.

● Conduct regular 1-on-1s, provide feedback, and foster a culture of ownership and

learning.

🤝 Cross-Functional Collaboration

● Partner with Product, Design, QA, DevOps, and other engineering pods on

priorities and technical constraints.

● Communicate proactively on technical decisions, blockers, and resource needs.

● Advocate for engineering needs while balancing business priorities and delivery

timelines.

💻 Technical Contribution

● Write and review production code as appropriate; maintain technical credibility.

● Unblock engineers on debugging, architecture decisions, and technical

problem-solving.

● Lead by example in code quality and operational excellence.

**Requirements**

Experience & Technical Expertise

● 6+ years of experience in software engineering, with 3+ years in engineering

leadership.

● Proven track record leading engineering teams in high-scale SaaS or enterprise

software environments.

● Strong foundation in backend systems: database design, API architecture,

distributed systems, and scalability.

● Hands-on experience with modern tech stacks (Python, Java, Go, Ruby); ability

to code-review and mentor across languages.

● Deep understanding of testing practices: unit, integration, end-to-end, and

performance testing.

● Experience with CI/CD pipelines, test automation, and production observability.

● Demonstrated experience redesigning engineering workflows using AI agents

and verification controls, with measured productivity gains. Familiarity with AI

tools alone is insufficient.

Leadership & Collaboration

● Proven ability to build, scale, and retain high-performing engineering teams.

● Strong project management skills: breaking down requirements, estimating effort,

managing multiple initiatives.

● Excellent communication across technical and non-technical audiences.

● Experience defining technical strategy and making architectural decisions with

pragmatism and long-term thinking.

● Proven cross-functional collaboration with Product, Design, QA, and DevOps

teams.

● Ownership mindset: Take end-to-end accountability for pod outcomes and

proactively solve problems.

● Customer-centric thinking: Understand how your pod's work impacts customer

experience and business goals.

● Adaptability: Comfortable in fast-growing startup environments; flexible and

iterative approach to processes.

● Systems thinking: Aware of how your pod connects to the broader platform and

cross-team impacts.

● Relentless commitment to quality and technical excellence.

You're a technical leader and builder of teams who understands that great engineering

requires both velocity and reliability. You care deeply about system design and code

quality, and you're relentless in pursuing technical excellence while unblocking your

team to move fast. You thrive in collaborative environments and are equally comfortable

pairing with an engineer on a complex bug or presenting technical trade-offs to

leadership. You mentor with intent, hire with rigor, and build cultures where ownership

and continuous learning are non-negotiable

title: Test Architect
description:
**Job Requirements**
Role Purpose
  
  
We are seeking a Test Architect to provide technical leadership for product-level testing, define scalable test architecture and strategy, and ensure functional and non-functional quality across the development lifecycle. The role partners with engineering, product, quality and project stakeholders to manage quality risks, improve test effectiveness, and provide evidence-based input to release decisions.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Define and implement risk-based test strategies, test architecture, coverage targets, acceptance criteria and completion criteria aligned with product and business goals.
* Design, evolve and document reusable test infrastructure, automation frameworks, test suites, simulators and integration with the system under test.
* Lead testability analysis of requirements and architecture; promote early testing, requirements traceability and test-driven practices.
* Guide testing across unit, integration, system and other relevant levels, including functional and non-functional verification.
* Integrate automated testing into build and continuous integration pipelines; maintain test-code quality, configuration management and reliable build processes.
* Define quality metrics and make test progress, coverage, automation effectiveness, defects and residual risks transparent to stakeholders.
* Assess technical product and test-environment risks; provide recommendations for release readiness and support certification activities where applicable.
* Drive defect resolution, change-impact analysis, continuous test process improvement and reduction of non-conformance costs.
* Evaluate and select testing methods, tools and technologies through technical assessments or prototypes; promote reuse and sound make-or-buy decisions.
* Coach test engineers and advise architects and developers on testing practices; collaborate with test managers, product managers, project managers and quality teams.
* Coordinate testing infrastructure integration plans and contribute to supplier acceptance criteria or outsourced test-infrastructure arrangements when required.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics or a related discipline.
* At least 3 years of experience in research, software development or engineering.
* At least 2 years of successful experience as a Test Architect or in a comparable technical testing role on a substantial product-development project.
* ISTQB Foundation Level certification or demonstrably equivalent knowledge and experience.

Technical Expertise
  
  

* Advanced knowledge of testing processes, test design techniques, test automation, test architecture and continuous test improvement.
* Experience with requirements verification and validation, risk-based testing, product risk management and quality gates.
* Strong understanding of software/system architecture, development lifecycles, design patterns and CI practices.
* Ability to define measurable quality objectives, test coverage, traceability and meaningful test KPIs.
* Experience designing and maintaining test environments, simulators or infrastructure for complex systems.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ISTQB Advanced Level certification.
* Experience with outsourced testing or test-infrastructure development, product lifecycle management and regulatory or certification processes.
* Familiarity with quality maturity assessment approaches such as TMMi or TPI Next.

Leadership & Collaboration
  
  

* Strategic thinking, sound technical judgment and the ability to make timely decisions with incomplete information.
* Strong communication, stakeholder influencing, coaching and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Customer focus, business orientation and commitment to long-term engineering quality

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
**About the company:**

India's first social distribution AI fintech platform for the underserved aspirational middle-class- delivering Secured & Unsecured loans, Insurance, and Investment products across 5,000+ small cities of India (referred as India-2). Founded in 2019, WeRize is at an annualized-run-rate of $60 Mn (Gross revenues) and $32Mn (Net) and $7Mn+ of net profits before taxes (3x Y-o-Y growth) with ROE > 20%. We are projecting ~2x growth in topline and ~3x growth in profits over the next 12 months.

WeRize operates as a “category creator” three-sided marketplace connecting 17,000+ trained local freelancers with India-2 customers and partner financial institutions, all powered by a full-stack AI operating layer that creates a “flywheel of trust” with self-reinforcing network effects.

* **Distributor trust:**
  Freelancers are empowered through AI-led tools that help them act in the long-term best interests of their customers.
* **Customer trust:**
  End customers rely on WeRize’s assisted distributor, data-driven recommendations across both asset and liability products
* **Manufacturer trust:**
  Financial Institutions rely on WeRize’s data, risk management and distribution intelligence to reach small city customers that they can’t serve on their own.

**Key highlights: What do we do**

1. **Large, underpenetrated market opportunity:**
   India’s 300Mn+ aspirational middle-class captures ~30% of GDP, yet remains financially underserved across credit, insurance, and investments. Pure-digital models lack the required trust, while physical branches are economically unviable.
2. **Differentiated, asset-light social distribution:**
   WeRize leverages 17,000+ financially literate freelancers across 5,000+ small cities. This branchless, zero-sales-team model delivers high-trust human touchpoints, superb unit economics, and strong freelancer retention through a broad product suite.
3. **Proprietary AI driven tech stack:**
   Trained on 20Bn+ data points across 4Mn+ households, WeRize’s AI powers end-to-end operations. For distribution, it optimizes lead gen, selling, and engagement—turning freelancers into professional advisors. For manufacturing, it sharpens risk management, underwriting, and product structuring for high-margin expansion.

To know more about the company, please visit: https://www.werize.com/

**About the Role**

We are looking for a
**Senior Product Designer**
to own the end-to-end user experience for core product areas. You will translate complex business problems and user pain points into intuitive, scalable, and visually polished solutions. Working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and Researchers, you will drive design strategy from early discovery and prototyping through to final launch and iteration.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **End-to-End Product Ownership:**
  Lead the design lifecycle for major features and new product initiatives—from initial problem framing, user flows, and wireframes to interactive prototypes and high-fidelity UI.
* **User Research & Validation:**
  Conduct user interviews, usability testing, and data analysis (funnels, drop-offs, session replays) to validate assumptions and measure the business impact of shipped designs.
* **Design Systems & Craft:**
  Contribute to, maintain, and evolve our design system to ensure visual consistency, accessibility (WCAG), and engineering efficiency across web and mobile platforms.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:**
  Partner closely with Product Managers to define roadmaps and with Frontend/Mobile Engineers during design handoff and QA to ensure pixel-accurate execution.
* **Mentorship & Design Culture:**
  Review work from junior and mid-level designers, offer constructive feedback, and help establish best practices across the design team.

**Requirements & Qualifications**

* **Experience:**
  3+ years of hands-on experience designing digital products (B2B SaaS, consumer apps, or high-growth tech platforms).
* **Strong Portfolio:**
  A compelling portfolio demonstrating end-to-end case studies—highlighting your problem-solving process, trade-offs made, and measurable outcomes (not just final UI screens).
* **Tool Mastery:**
  Expert proficiency in
  **Figma**
  (auto-layout, variables, interactive prototyping, component libraries) and familiarity with analytics/research tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, Hotjar, or similar).
* **UX & Visual Fundamentals:**
  Deep understanding of information architecture, interaction design, responsive layouts, typography, and micro-interactions.
* **Communication Skills:**
  Ability to clearly articulate design decisions and trade-offs to both technical teams and senior business stakeholders.

title: QA Lead - Trading Platform (India, Chennai)
description:
**About GoCharting**

GoCharting is a web-native charting and trading platform. Traders use professional orderflow tools — footprint charts, volume and market profile, cumulative delta, DOM trading — to read the market and place orders through their broker, all in the browser. Our users are active traders in India, the US and around the world.

**The Role**

You will own the quality gate that every release of GoCharting's terminal and apps passes before it reaches traders, and you will test and write automation yourself while you lead a small QA team. The role is full-time and in person in our Chennai office, and it reports to the Engineering Manager for Client Engineering. Every release needs one accountable owner of what "ready to ship" means, and that is you. At 12 months, no release should reach production without your sign-off, and the team should trust the checks behind it.

**What you'll do**

* **Own the release gate**
  — define what must pass before a release ships, run the sign-off, and stop a release that fails it
* **Test and automate yourself**
  — write and maintain end-to-end and regression automation for the web terminal and for APIs
* **Lead and coach the QA team**
  — assign work, review test plans and automation, and raise each engineer's standard
* **Run quality checks in CI**
  — keep automated tests as required checks on merges and releases, fast and reliable
* **Triage defects**
  — set severity with product and engineering, and track each one to a verified fix
* **Report quality plainly**
  — publish a weekly view of defects found, escaped and fixed

**What we're looking for**

**Must-haves:**

* 6+ years in QA or test automation on production web applications
* Hands-on automation code with Playwright, Cypress or Selenium, written by you
* Has owned a release gate or release sign-off for a production web application
* Has led or mentored other QA engineers
* Has run automated tests as required checks in a CI pipeline, for example GitHub Actions
* In person in our Chennai office, 5 days a week

**Nice-to-haves:**

* Testing real-time or data-dense applications, such as WebSocket feeds or live charts (adds the ability to test our core risk)
* API and contract testing for REST and WebSocket services (adds coverage below the UI)
* Performance and load testing with k6, JMeter or similar (adds confidence under market-open load)
* Trading, fintech or market-data testing (adds speed in learning our domain)
* Mobile app testing for iOS and Android (adds coverage of the app release)

**Logistics**

**Location**
Chennai, India - in person, office-based

**Employment type**
Full-time

**Entity**
ProCharting Private Limited

**Reports to**
Engineering Manager, Client Engineering

**Start date**
ASAP

**Travel**
None

title: Capability Manager
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

We are looking for a Capability Manager / Capability Analyst to join the UHC Data & Analytics Office team. In this role, you will help shape and deliver high-impact capabilities that support the growth of the Commercial business within the Enterprise & Individual segment.

You will partner with business, product, and technology teams to understand customer needs, translate them into clear capabilities and requirements, and guide delivery throughout the software development lifecycle. You will play a key role in managing the capability backlog, prioritizing features, supporting release planning, and ensuring solutions deliver meaningful business value.

This opportunity is well suited for someone who enjoys bringing together business needs, product strategy, data, and technology while working collaboratively across diverse teams.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Own and manage the capability backlog, including defining, refining, and prioritizing capabilities, features, and user stories
* Partner with stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into clear, actionable product requirements and acceptance criteria
* Represent customer and stakeholder perspectives while collaborating with Product Managers, Product Owners, Business Analysts, developers, architects, Release Train Engineers, and Release Managers
* Help define and communicate the capability vision, priorities, and roadmap
* Lead capability and feature-level grooming, sizing, estimation, and prioritization activities
* Develop and manage release plans in partnership with development and delivery teams
* Provide oversight for risks, issues, dependencies, project documentation, and end-to-end testing activities
* Review delivered capabilities, features, and user stories against established acceptance criteria
* Provide clear and timely updates on delivery status, risks, dependencies, issues, and blockers to key stakeholders
* Develop and maintain reporting related to project health, delivery status, resource utilization, and forecasted capacity
* Support Product Owners, Business Analysts, and Subject Matter Experts throughout the delivery lifecycle
* Identify opportunities to continuously improve delivery processes, collaboration, and business outcomes
* Contribute to an inclusive and collaborative environment where different perspectives are valued and teams can effectively deliver shared goals
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Management, Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* Significant experience in Project Management, Agile Product Management, Product Ownership, Business Analysis, or related technology delivery roles
* Experience supporting medium to large-scale initiatives involving software development and deployment
* Experience translating complex business needs into capabilities, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria
* Experience managing or contributing to product/capability backlogs, prioritization, release planning, and delivery
* Experience with relevant product, project, and collaboration tools such as Rally, Aha!, Microsoft Project, SharePoint, Clarity, Visio, Excel, and PowerPoint
* Solis understanding of Agile and Scrum methodologies and experience applying Agile practices within technology initiatives
* Proven solid analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills
* Proven ability to understand complex business and technology scenarios and communicate them clearly to different audiences
* Proven solid written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across business and technology teams
* Proven ability to work across multiple priorities and adapt effectively as business needs evolve

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Product Owner, Scrum Master, or Agile certification such as CSPO, SAFe POPM, or equivalent
* Experience working within the healthcare or health insurance industry
* Experience with Rally or similar Agile delivery management tools
* Experience with Aha! or comparable product strategy and roadmap tools
* Experience working with Data & Analytics teams or data-driven products and capabilities
* Working knowledge of Power BI and SQL

We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. The Salesforce CPQ QA Automation Engineer is responsible for ensuring the quality and reliability of Salesforce applications and integrations. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in testing Salesforce solutions, with a particular focus on
**Salesforce CPQ functionality**
, expertise in QA automation, and a solid understanding of Salesforce Sales Cloud. Exposure to Salesforce Billing is preferred, while experience with Service Cloud and Experience Cloud is desirable.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Prepare and execute test strategies, test plans, test cases, and test scripts for Salesforce applications, with a primary focus on Salesforce CPQ and Sales Cloud.
* Design, execute, and maintain functional, regression, integration, sanity, and user acceptance testing (UAT) for Salesforce implementations.
* Define test environment and test data requirements, and collaborate with development teams to ensure test readiness.
* Validate Salesforce CPQ business processes, including product configuration, pricing and product rules, quoting, approvals, amendments, renewals, and order management.
* Perform integration testing to ensure data accuracy and integrity across Salesforce objects and integrated systems.
* Prepare, automate, and execute regression test suites to maximize test coverage and improve release quality.
* Collaborate with developers, business analysts, product owners, and business stakeholders to clarify requirements and identify defects early in the development lifecycle.
* Conduct sanity testing to ensure applications are production-ready before deployment.
* Track, prioritize, and report defects using Jira or similar tools, ensuring timely resolution.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement of QA processes and automation practices.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in functional and automation testing of Salesforce applications.
* At least 2 years of hands-on experience in Salesforce CPQ functionality testing.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce Sales Cloud business processes and functionality.
* Expertise in at least one QA automation tool, such as Playwright, Provar, Selenium, or an equivalent automation framework.
* Experience in preparing test strategies, test plans, test scenarios, and detailed test cases.
* Hands-on experience with API testing (REST/SOAP) and integration validation.
* Strong understanding of the Salesforce data model, security model, and platform customizations.
* Experience with regression test automation and test execution.
* Proficiency in Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* Hands-on experience using Jira or similar defect management tools.
* Experience working in client-facing roles with strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Exposure to Salesforce Billing.
* Experience conducting load and performance testing.
* Knowledge of Revenue Cloud processes.
* Experience validating Salesforce integrations with external applications.
* Knowledge of Salesforce automation frameworks such as TestNG.

title: Senior Scrum Master
description:
Job Description

**About Persistent**

  

We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what's next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 18 of the Fortune 50 companies, 7 of the 10 top US banks, 9 of the 10 technology companies, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

  

Our disruptor's mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We have delivered 26 sequential quarters of growth with $487.6M in Q2 FY27 revenue, up 7.8% Q-o-Q and 20.0% Y-o-Y. Our 29,500+ global team members, located in 21 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We received five awards at the ISG (Information Services Group) Provider Lens Awards 2026 and, for the second year in a row, were awarded the Growth Honor of the Year at the Everest Group Elevate 2026.

  

**About Position:**

  

We are looking for an experienced Senior Scrum Master / Agile Delivery Manager to lead Agile delivery across complex enterprise programs. The ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in Scrum, Kanban, Lean, and SAFe, with hands-on experience facilitating Program Increment Planning and Agile Release Train events. In this role, you will coach multiple cross-functional teams, manage dependencies and risks, strengthen delivery predictability, and partner with product, technology, and business stakeholders to drive continuous improvement and delivery excellence.

  

* **Role: Senior Scrum Master**
* **Location: Pune**
* **Experience: 8 to 12 Years**
* **Job Type: Full-Time Employment**
  

**What You'll Do:**

  

* Facilitate Agile ceremonies including Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Planning, Sprint Reviews, Backlog Refinement, and Retrospectives.
* Lead and support Program Increment (PI) Planning activities within SAFe delivery environments.
* Coordinate Agile Release Train (ART) events and ensure alignment across multiple teams and workstreams.
* Partner with Product Owners to manage, refine, and prioritize product backlogs based on business priorities.
* Facilitate estimation sessions and support teams in planning and delivering work efficiently.
* Identify, track, and manage project dependencies, blockers, risks, and impediments.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives by implementing Agile best practices and process enhancements.
* Coach Agile teams on Scrum, Kanban, Lean-Agile principles, and SAFe frameworks.
* Ensure transparency through effective use of Agile metrics, dashboards, and reporting tools.
* Monitor sprint progress, velocity, burn-down charts, and delivery commitments.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, product managers, architects, and development teams to ensure alignment with project goals.
* Facilitate communication between cross-functional teams and support effective decision-making.
* Ensure proper documentation and knowledge sharing using JIRA and Confluence.
* Support release planning, sprint forecasting, capacity planning, and resource alignment activities.
* Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, ownership, and delivery excellence.
* Assist leadership teams in Agile transformation and maturity improvement initiatives.
  

**Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* 8 to 12 years of experience in Agile project delivery, Scrum Master, Agile Coach, or Delivery Management roles.
* Strong expertise in Agile methodologies including Scrum, Kanban, Lean, and SAFe frameworks.
* Hands-on experience facilitating Program Increment (PI) Planning and Agile Release Train (ART) events.
* Proven experience managing Agile teams in complex enterprise environments.
* Strong expertise in backlog grooming, estimation techniques, sprint planning, and prioritization methodologies.
* Experience managing dependencies, risks, impediments, and escalation processes.
* Strong understanding of Agile metrics including velocity, burn-down charts, burn-up charts, cycle time, lead time, and throughput.
* Expertise in stakeholder management and effective communication across business and technology teams.
* Hands-on experience with JIRA, Confluence, Azure DevOps, and Agile project management tools.
* Strong facilitation, coaching, mentoring, and conflict-resolution skills.
* Experience driving continuous improvement initiatives and Agile maturity programs.
* Ability to support multiple teams and coordinate cross-functional delivery activities.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical capabilities.
* Experience working with large-scale enterprise delivery programs.
* Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills.
* Ability to influence and guide teams without direct authority.
  

**Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents
  

**Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment:**

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

  

* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
* Our office is accessibility-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
* If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment
  

**Let's unleash your full potential at Persistent -** **persistent.com/careers**

  

***"Persistent is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind.*****"**

title: Software QA Specialist
description:
Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.

Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced **CRT QA Engineer (Level 3 R&D)** to join our engineering organization. This role is responsible for driving quality assurance initiatives for critical customer escalations, complex product issues, performance bottlenecks, and system reliability challenges that cannot be resolved through standard QA processes.

The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in test automation, performance testing, root cause analysis, and quality engineering practices. They will work closely with Product Management, Development, Support, and Customer teams to ensure the delivery of high-quality, scalable, and reliable enterprise software solutions while helping prevent recurrence of critical issues.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Work within an Agile/Scrum environment to define, design, and deliver high-quality software products.
* Participate in product vision, requirements analysis, backlog grooming, and quality planning activities.
* Bridge the gap between Product Management and Engineering by translating high-level requirements into actionable quality validation and test strategies.
* Investigate and resolve complex customer-reported defects, escalations, and production issues.
* Perform detailed **Root Cause Analysis (RCA)** on critical defects, performance issues, and test failures, and recommend long-term corrective and preventive actions.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to provide quality assessments, risk analysis, and delivery estimates for new features and product enhancements.
* Work closely with Technical Product Managers and cross-functional R&D teams to manage dependencies and testing requirements.
* Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks and testing infrastructure.
* Create and maintain automated test suites covering functional, integration, regression, and performance testing scenarios.
* Develop and execute automated tests using modern automation technologies including **Playwright** and related testing frameworks.
* Design and implement performance, load, stress, and scalability testing solutions using **Apache JMeter** and other performance testing tools.
* Gather performance testing requirements and validate system reliability, scalability, throughput, and capacity under varying workloads.
* Develop automated performance test environments and test data strategies.
* Continuously improve product quality through enhanced automation coverage, performance testing, and process improvements.
* Leverage AI-assisted engineering tools such as **GitHub Copilot, Claude, and other AI platforms** to accelerate automation development, test creation, defect analysis, and productivity.
* Analyze application logs, performance metrics, infrastructure telemetry, and monitoring data to identify quality risks and bottlenecks.
* Mentor junior QA engineers and contribute to quality engineering best practices across the organization.
* Document test strategies, RCA findings, performance benchmarks, quality metrics, and knowledge articles.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or related field.
* 5+ years of experience in Software QA, Test Automation, or Quality Engineering roles.
* Strong understanding of Agile and Scrum development methodologies.
* Hands-on experience in developing and maintaining test automation frameworks.
* Experience with:
  + Playwright
  + Automated Functional Testing
  + Regression Testing
  + Integration Testing
  + API Testing
  + Performance and Load Testing
  + Apache JMeter
  + CI/CD pipelines
  + Test management and defect tracking tools
* Strong knowledge of software testing methodologies, test design techniques, and quality assurance processes.
* Proven experience conducting Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and driving quality improvements.
* Experience working on customer escalations, production issues, and critical release validation activities.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with scripting and automation using **Python** .
* Experience testing enterprise-scale SaaS and cloud-based applications.
* Knowledge of:
  + REST APIs
  + HTTP protocols
  + TypeScript
  + Java
  + SOAP services
  + Enterprise application integrations
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as:
  + Microsoft Azure
  + Amazon Web Services (AWS EC2)
* Experience with observability, monitoring, and application performance analysis tools.
* Understanding of networking concepts and distributed systems architecture.
* Experience utilizing AI-assisted testing and automation tools for test generation and productivity improvements.

**Key Competencies**

* Advanced troubleshooting and problem-solving
* Test automation expertise
* Performance engineering mindset
* Customer-focused quality ownership
* Strong analytical thinking
* Technical leadership and mentoring
* Cross-functional collaboration
* Effective communication and stakeholder management
* Continuous improvement mindset
* Ability to perform effectively during critical customer escalations

**Success Measures**

* Resolution of critical quality and performance issues
* Reduction in escaped defects and customer-reported issues
* Improvement in automation and regression coverage
* Increased performance testing effectiveness and system reliability
* High-quality RCA reports and preventive actions
* Improved release readiness and product stability
* Knowledge sharing and mentorship contributions across the QA organization

This role is ideal for a senior quality engineering professional who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, driving quality improvements, leading test automation and performance initiatives, and working directly with engineering teams and customers to ensure exceptional product reliability and customer satisfaction.

  
  

Life at PTC is about more than working with today’s most cutting-edge technologies to transform the physical world. It’s about showing up as you are and working alongside some of today’s most talented industry leaders to transform the world around you.

If you share our passion for problem-solving through innovation, you’ll likely become just as passionate about the PTC experience as we are. Are you ready to explore your next career move with us?

We respect the privacy rights of individuals and are committed to handling Personal Information responsibly and in accordance with all applicable privacy and data protection laws.

title: Manager - AI Delivery
description:
**About Sirius AI**

Sirius AI is an AI-first consulting and solutions firm serving financial services clients: banks, fintechs, payments companies and wealth managers. We help enterprises move from AI ideas to production-ready solutions using GenAI, agentic AI, ML platforms and advanced analytics, delivering measurable business impact. Our strength lies in combining FS domain expertise, hands-on AI delivery and enterprise-grade execution.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Manager - AI Delivery to run day-to-day delivery of AI engagements for our financial services clients in the US. You will own the plan, the team and the client relationship for one or more AI projects, making sure GenAI, agentic AI and ML solutions are built, tested and shipped to production on time, on budget and to regulated-industry standards.

This is a hands-on delivery role for someone who understands the AI lifecycle well enough to spot technical risk early, and who enjoys building strong, well-run teams. You will work closely with technical leads and engineers, many of them early in their careers, and report into our AI delivery leadership.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own day-to-day delivery of one or more AI projects, from requirements and design through build, testing, deployment and hypercare.
* Translate client business objectives into clear scope, user stories, acceptance criteria and technical execution plans together with solution architects and technical leads.
* Run the delivery cadence: sprint planning, stand-ups, demos, retrospectives, milestone tracking, status reporting and RAID management.
* Track scope, estimates, effort, budget and utilisation; manage change requests and escalate risks to leadership and clients early.
* Make sure AI-specific work is planned properly, including data readiness, model and prompt evaluation, testing of non-deterministic outputs, and production monitoring.
* Apply delivery standards for code review, testing, documentation, MLOps/AIOps and quality gates before work reaches clients.
* Coordinate across data engineering, ML/AI engineering, application development, QA and client IT, security and risk teams.
* Lead, coach and support a team of engineers and analysts; contribute to onboarding, performance feedback and skills development.
* Be the primary day-to-day contact for client stakeholders, run project reviews and keep expectations aligned on scope, timelines and outcomes.
* Ensure delivery meets AI governance, security, data privacy and FS compliance requirements, with complete project documentation.
* Contribute to reusable templates, playbooks and lessons learned, and support pre-sales with estimates and project plans.

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics or a related field; a master's degree or MBA is a plus.
* 5+ years of experience in technology, data or analytics delivery, including at least 2–3 years managing AI/ML, Agentic AI or advanced analytics projects.
* Experience delivering AI/ML or Agentic AI solutions into production for enterprise clients.
* Working technical understanding of the AI lifecycle, including data pipelines, model development, LLMs and RAG, AIOps/MLOps, deployment, inferencing and monitoring.
* Strong command of Agile and hybrid delivery methods, estimation, project financials and tools such as Jira, Confluence or Azure DevOps.
* Experience managing and developing small to mid-sized delivery teams, including junior and early-career talent.
* Experience in consulting firms, AI services companies or global delivery centres.
* Clear, structured communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain technical progress and risks in business terms.

**Good to Have**

* Delivery experience with financial services clients in banking, fintech, payments, risk, fraud, compliance or wealth management.
* Exposure to agentic AI, LLM orchestration or intelligent automation projects.
* Familiarity with cloud AI platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP, Databricks).
* Experience working in onshore/offshore or distributed delivery models.
* Certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, CSM/SAFe or cloud AI certifications.

title: UX Manager – AI-Native Products
description:
INCEDO · JOB DESCRIPTION

UX Manager – AI-Native Products (Conversational & Agentic Interfaces )

LEVEL -Manager (player-coach)

TEAM -Products & Platforms

EXPERIENCE 10–14 years

ABOUT THE ROLE

Incedo’s Products & Platforms team builds AI-native products for enterprise clients. Our users ask questions in natural language, review what the AI finds and recommends, and decide what to act on. You’ll set the design direction for that experience and lead a senior UI/UX designer. This is a player-coach role: most of your time goes into hands-on design. WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Set the interaction model for our AI-native products: when to use conversation, when to use structured UI, and how the two combine across dashboards, workspaces and agent workflows.

• Design trust into every AI output, including sources and provenance, confidence and uncertainty, explanations an expert can check, and approval steps before an agent acts.

• Personally own the hardest flows end to end, from research and concepts through prototypes built on live model outputs to shipped product.

• Build and govern the design system, including AI patterns for streaming and partial results, latency, errors and refusals, multi-turn context, undo and handoff to a human. • Set up a research and quality practice: regular usability testing, feedback loops from real usage, and UX metrics for AI features that guide priorities with product.

• Lead and grow the senior UI/UX designer, set the quality bar and critique practice, partner with product, engineering and data science, and shape the demos we put in front of client executives.

WHAT YOU BRING

• 10–14 years in UI/UX design, including 3+ years leading design for complex B2B or enterprise products, and at least one AI-powered product (assistant, copilot or agent) that you shipped and then improved based on real usage.

• A demonstrated point of view on AI interaction design: when conversation helps and when it gets in the way, how much autonomy an agent should have, and how to show uncertainty without eroding trust.

• Deep conversation design: context across turns, disambiguation, repair when the model misunderstands, and response guidelines for tone, length and structure. • Agentic and trust patterns for high-stakes work: plan previews, approval gates, undo and rollback, audit trails, and explanations experts can verify quickly.

• Experience measuring AI experiences through task success, time to answer, correction and override rates, and qualitative trust signals.

• Design-system leadership: tokens, components and patterns adopted across multiple products or teams, built to WCAG 2.2 AA by default.

• Senior-level hands-on craft in visual and interaction design for data-dense screens, and in prototyping with live model outputs; expert in Figma or equivalent tools.

• A portfolio of case studies showing framing, trade-offs and outcomes, including what didn’t work and what you changed.

Cancard Inc has been a multi-technology company based in Markham (Toronto) since 1989. **1.     End-to-End Project Ownership:**

Oversee the complete software development lifecycle (SDLC) from requirement gathering to deployment and post-launch support, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery.

Proactively identify delivery risks, technical constraints, or resource bottlenecks and work with stakeholders to develop mitigation strategies.

**9.     Resource Planning:**

Assess project workload and align resources accordingly. Handle onboarding of new team members and coordinate with HR/Recruitment for staffing needs.

**10. DevOps and Release Management:**

Work closely with DevOps teams to ensure smooth CI/CD pipeline execution, environment management, version control, and secure release processes.

**11. Process Optimization:**

Drive continuous improvement initiatives across delivery workflows. Analyze retrospectives to identify process inefficiencies and implement corrective actions.

**12. Documentation & Knowledge Management:**

Ensure proper documentation of technical specifications, user stories, and deployment guidelines. Promote knowledge sharing and reusability of components.

Stay up to date with industry trends, evaluate new tools and frameworks, and contribute to the technical roadmap and architecture decisions.

You should be comfortable interpreting creative briefs, developing visual concepts and transforming ideas into compelling designs across digital and corporate communication platforms.

title: Tax Technology Specialist
description:
