**About You And This Role**
As a Tax Technology Specialist based in Navi Mumbai, you will support
**tax technology solutions and improvement initiatives**
across
**EMEA, India and APAC**
. The role is designed for a professional who can connect tax requirements with technology, data and process design.
  
  
You will work closely with Tax, Information Technology, Finance and other cross-functional teams to understand business needs, translate them into functional and technical requirements, support system configuration and testing, and help sustain solutions after implementation. While the position requires a practical understanding of indirect tax compliance, its primary focus is technology, automation, data and continuous improvement.
  
  
You will work with a high degree of autonomy within established procedures, solve complex issues, recommend process improvements and may provide subject matter guidance or coordinate work across stakeholders.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Support tax technology projects and continuous improvement initiatives across EMEA, India and APAC, with emphasis on tax compliance, efficiency, risk prevention and scalable processes.
* Partner with tax process owners to understand indirect tax requirements, including VAT and GST compliance, reconciliations, reporting, controls and statutory deadlines.
* Gather, analyze and document business requirements, business processes, functional requirements, solution designs and acceptance criteria.
* Translate tax and business requirements into system setup, configuration or automation solutions using tools such as SAP, Thomson Reuters ONESOURCE, Power Platform, Alteryx, RPA, Python or similar technologies.
* Serve as a liaison between Tax, Information Technology, Accounting, Source to Pay, Invoice to Cash, Financial Consolidations and external solution providers.
* Identify and manage system defects, change requests, enhancements and new functionality; coordinate prioritization, testing, remediation and deployment with relevant teams.
* Design and execute test scenarios and scripts, support user acceptance testing, document results and coordinate issue resolution.
* Provide post-go-live and operational support, including monitoring solution performance, troubleshooting issues, maintaining process documentation and supporting users.
* Support tax data management needs, including data quality, interfaces, reporting, warehousing, record retention and disclosure requirements.
* Develop dashboards, analytics and executive-ready reporting to provide visibility to process performance, risks, issues and improvement opportunities.
* Support the operation and enhancement of automated indirect tax compliance solutions while maintaining appropriate controls, data integrity and audit readiness.
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to define project needs, evaluate solution options and deliver sustainable improvements.
* May perform other related duties as assigned.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Tax, Information Systems, Technology, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* A minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in tax technology, tax process automation, systems implementation, business analysis or technology-enabled tax compliance.
* Experience working with SAP and tax, finance or compliance processes.
* Experience gathering and documenting business and functional requirements and supporting testing, deployment or post-go-live activities.
* Working knowledge of indirect tax concepts, including VAT or GST, with the ability to understand and translate tax requirements into technology solutions.
* Advanced English communication skills, both written and spoken.
* Ability to support stakeholders across EMEA, India and APAC and accommodate a flexible schedule when required for international collaboration, project milestones or compliance deadlines.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Thomson Reuters ONESOURCE solutions, particularly indirect tax determination or VAT compliance tools.
* Experience with Power BI, Power Query, Power Automate, Alteryx, RPA, Python, generative AI applications or similar automation and analytics tools.
* Experience with system configuration, integrations, data migration, tax data management or reporting solutions.
* Exposure to indirect tax compliance processes in EMEA, India or APAC.
* Experience supporting internal controls, SOX requirements, audit activities or controlled technology processes.
* Experience working in a global, cross-functional environment and with third-party technology providers.

**Skills And Capabilities**

* Tax and technology translation: connects compliance and business needs with practical system and automation solutions.
* Analytical problem solving: evaluates complex issues, identifies root causes and recommends sustainable solutions.
* Ownership and bias for action: works independently, manages competing priorities and follows issues through resolution.

title: Project Implementation Engineer - Construction Product
description:
The Project Implementation Engineer - Construction Product trains project teams on NirmaanXD, sets up projects on the platform, and supports them through execution. The role owns the model-to-schedule link on each project: auditing the model, configuring it, building activity templates, and keeping the model current as the project moves.

**About the Visual Planning Product - NirmaanXD**

NirmaanXD is vConstruct's model-based construction planning and production tracking platform. It connects BIM models (Revit, IFC, Navisworks) to the construction schedule: model-based WBS creation, quantity-backed activity durations, 4D visualization, field-ready lookaheads, and progress tracking. Schedules exchange with Primavera P6 and MS Project through XML import/export.

**Key responsibilities**

**Product training and onboarding**

* Deliver NirmaanXD training to project teams: VDC, planners and schedulers, project engineers, superintendents, and trade partners.
* Onboard new users and projects; tailor sessions to each role's workflow.
* Maintain training material and act as first-line product support for assigned projects.

**Project setup**

* Model audit: review incoming models in Navisworks or similar tools and decide whether each model is usable as-is or needs modification. Check element categorization, parameters, levels and zones, naming, completeness, and level of detail against NirmaanXD's requirements.
* Document audit findings and the remediation required, with owner and timeline.
* Model configuration: set up element filtering and exclusion rules, WBS mapping, and location or zone breakdown.
* Activity template configuration: build activity mapping rules, quantity links, and production rates aligned to the project schedule.

**Implementation support**

* Support project teams through execution: model updates and re-imports, schedule alignment, lookaheads, and progress tracking setup.
* Troubleshoot data and configuration issues; escalate product defects to the NirmaanXD product team with clear reproduction steps.
* Capture user feedback and feature requests from projects.

**Model queries**

* Resolve model-related questions from project teams: missing or misclassified elements, quantity discrepancies, mapping gaps.
* Trace issues to source (model, configuration, or schedule) and fix or route them.

**Project meetings**

* Attend and lead weekly project meetings: Project Kick-off, Scope alignment, timeline, project setup and onboarding, open model and configuration issues, lookahead reviews, progress status.
* Track action items to closure.

**Model changes**

* Make model changes needed for NirmaanXD: add or correct parameters, split elements by pour or zone, reclassify elements, and fix naming.
* Coordinate larger changes with the model author.

**Required skills**

* Working understanding of BIM and VDC processes: model coordination, model structure, and how models feed downstream construction workflows.
* Hands-on experience performing model audits in Navisworks or similar tools: search and selection sets, property review, completeness checks.
* Ability to edit model data at least at the property and selection level to support configuration.
* Clear spoken and written English for training delivery and client-facing meetings with US project teams.
* Model authoring experience in Revit, Tekla, or similar tools.

**Good-to-have skills**

* Planning or scheduling experience: CPM scheduling in Primavera P6 or MS Project, WBS development, lookahead planning.
* Exposure to lean planning methods (Last Planner System, pull planning, TAKT) or 4D tools (Synchro, Navisworks TimeLiner).
* Quantity takeoff from models and familiarity with production rates by trade.
* Experience supporting US construction projects or field teams.

**Competency**

* Training delivery: explains a model-based workflow to users with no BIM background, including superintendents and trade foremen.
* Structured problem solving: isolates whether an issue sits in the model, the configuration, or the schedule before acting.
* Meeting ownership: runs a weekly meeting to an agenda, drives decisions, and closes actions.
* Data discipline: documents audit findings, configuration decisions, and model changes so another specialist can pick up the project.
* Product feedback: reports defects and gaps to the product team with evidence, not anecdotes

**About vConstruct**
: vConstruct specializes in providing high-quality Building Information Modeling, Lean Construction, Integrated Project Delivery and Software Solutions for global construction projects. vConstruct is a wholly owned subsidiary of DPR Construction, USA. The Software Unit for vConstruct works on many interesting problems in Construction Technology. It works across different sets of software technologies such as Web Applications, Workflow Management, Analytics, Machine Learning, and IoT. For more information, please visit www.vconstruct.com.

title: Technical Support Architect (AI)
description:
**Overview**
Serve as the AI Architect for the Support organization. Define the AI strategy, architecture, and governance that improve how Support resolves cases, communicates with clients, and shares knowledge. Design, build, integrate, and optimize AI-enabled solutions across ServiceNow, knowledge management, case triage, and incident response. As a secondary responsibility, provide help desk and after-hours technical support to clients, including call, ticket, email, and chat support, and coordinate timely escalation to the appropriate teams.
  
  
Primary Objective: Architect and deliver secure, reliable, and measurable AI solutions that improve Support efficiency, resolution quality, and client experience, while ensuring responsible use of AI and protection of client, patient, and company information. Secondary Objective: Provide responsive, professional help desk and after-hours support, maintain clear client communication, and work with internal teams to resolve critical and escalated issues with minimal business disruption.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities – AI Architecture**

* Define and maintain the AI architecture, roadmap, and standards for the Support organization, aligned with Support, Product, and Security priorities.
* Identify, evaluate, and prioritize AI use cases across case intake, triage and routing, troubleshooting, case summarization, knowledge creation, client communication, quality audits, and major incident support.
* Design, build, and deploy AI-enabled solutions and workflows, including prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, and automation, integrated with ServiceNow and other support tools.
* Architect and curate knowledge sources, including knowledge articles, SOPs, known-error records, and case history, so that AI outputs are accurate, current, and relevant.
* Establish AI governance, including approved tools and models, data-handling rules, PHI and client data protection, output validation, human review, and compliance with applicable policies and regulations.
* Partner with Information Security, IT, Product Development, and Support leadership to assess risk, select platforms, and implement secure integrations.
* Define success metrics and report on AI adoption, accuracy, time savings, SLA and response-time improvements, and client satisfaction. Continuously test, tune, and improve solutions.
* Use AI and data analysis to identify recurring issues, trends, and suspected defects, and share insights with Product Development to support product improvements.
* Train, coach, and enable Support staff and managers on approved AI tools, effective prompting, output verification, and responsible use. Create guides, SOPs, and best practices.
* Stay current with emerging AI technologies, healthcare IT trends, and supported Altera products, and recommend improvements to the Support AI strategy.

**Secondary Responsibilities – Help Desk & After-Hours Support**

* Provide help desk and after-hours support by answering inbound calls and responding to email, chat, and monitoring alerts. Create accurate ServiceNow tickets that capture the issue, business impact, priority, contact information, and troubleshooting performed.
* Guide clients through troubleshooting with clear, professional communication, confirm understanding of the issue, and set expectations for next steps and follow-up.
* Troubleshoot client questions and technical issues involving system configuration, product functionality, SQL Server, and HL7 interfaces. Investigate issues using Windows Event Logs, IIS logs, and SQL queries, including multi-table JOINs.
* Identify root causes where possible, implement approved fixes or workarounds, validate service restoration, and update tickets with complete resolution details.
* Triage complex issues and route or escalate cases to the appropriate support, Development, Hosting, or Professional Services teams, providing complete troubleshooting details and business impact.
* Coordinate with internal teams during critical or major incident calls, follow established after-hours escalation and notification procedures, and support P1/P2 incident triage by gathering logs, analyzing error patterns, and documenting incident timelines.
* Maintain ownership of assigned tickets, communicate progress and blockers, and provide timely client updates in accordance with service-level agreements (SLAs).
* Maintain complete case documentation, troubleshooting guides, SOPs, and known-error articles. Provide clear shift handovers covering open issues, business impact, actions taken, ownership, and next steps.
* Use company-approved AI tools to assist with knowledge searches, case summaries, troubleshooting research, and drafting client updates. Verify outputs before use and protect client, patient, and company information.
* Participate in scheduled evening, overnight, weekend, holiday, and on-call rotations as part of the 24/7 support schedule.

**Qualifications**
**Academic Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Nursing, Pharmacy, Nursing Informatics, or related discipline.
* Equivalent combination of healthcare, clinical, and information technology experience may be considered.

**Experience**

* 2+ years of experience in technical support, healthcare IT, or a related technical field.
* Experience with generative AI tools and solutions, such as Microsoft Copilot or similar platforms, including prompt engineering and workflow automation.
* Working knowledge of ServiceNow or a comparable ticketing system.
* Understanding of responsible AI practices and data privacy, including protection of PHI and other sensitive information.
* Ability to define use cases and success metrics and to communicate results to technical and executive audiences.
* Strong written, verbal, and telephone communication skills with a customer-focused approach.
* Ability to troubleshoot software issues, prioritize multiple cases, and recognize when escalation is needed.
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams and working both independently and as part of a team.
* Basic knowledge of SQL Server and Windows Server (including IIS) is preferred.
* Familiarity with the U.S. healthcare industry, HL7 interfaces, and enterprise healthcare software is preferred.

**Travel / Shift Requirements**

* Some travel may be required for client engagement, collaboration, or onsite support activities.
* Primary work is performed during standard business hours. Availability for assigned evening, overnight, weekend, holiday, and on-call rotations is required to support the secondary help desk and after-hours responsibilities.

Altera’s policy is to provide equal employment opportunity and affirmative action in all of its employment practices without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, marital status, protected veteran status, age, individuals with disabilities, sexual orientation or gender identity or expression or any other legally protected category.

title: AICTE-IFP: Industry Fellow for Faculty members
description:
**Company Description**
KPIT Technologies is a global technology company specializing in product engineering and digital solutions, with a strong focus on automotive and mobility sectors. The organization partners with industry and academia to drive innovation in software, embedded systems, and next-generation mobility platforms. KPIT offers collaborative environments where faculty members and professionals can work together on real-world industry challenges and cutting-edge research. The company emphasizes continuous learning, applied research, and knowledge sharing to strengthen the link between industry needs and academic outcomes.

**Role Description**

This fellowship aims to bridge the gap between industry expectations and academic training in Hardware-Software Integration (HSI). By working alongside KPIT mentors, faculty fellows will develop and implement practical, industry-aligned lab setups and learning materials. Here’s a breakdown of the program: What is HSI and Why is it Important? Hardware-Software Integration is crucial for creating efficient, reliable embedded systems. It’s in high demand across industries like Automotive, Industrial IoT, Robotics, Healthcare, and more. Strong HSI skills lead to faster innovation and quicker time-to-market. Training Focus Areas: The fellowship will center around developing expertise in: • Core Embedded Skills: Embedded C Programming, Coding Standards, Bare Metal Programming, GPIO, Timers, Analog to Digital Converters, Interrupts, PLLs • Communication Protocols: I2C, SPI, CAN, Ethernet, LIN, Flexray • Operating Systems: Real Time Operating Systems, Embedded Linux with Yocto • Debugging & Tools: JTAG, GDB • Advanced Topics: Device Driver Development, Cross-Compilation, System Communication, FOTA, Memory & Power Management, E/E Architecture.

Key Responsibilities

You will collaborate with KPIT experts to: 1. Standardize HSI Setups: Document and standardize HSI setups used in key automotive areas like: • Autonomous Driving • Vehicular Networks & Middleware • Connected Vehicles • Body Electronics • Infotainment and Digital Cockpit 2. Develop Lab Setups: Design and build lab-scale training setups that mirror real-world HSI technologies. 3. Create Learning Materials: Develop comprehensive training content – guides, experiments, demos, and assessments – to ensure consistent and effective learning.

**Qualifications**

* Proven academic experience as a faculty member in engineering, computer science, or related technical disciplines.
* Strong foundation in industry-relevant domains such as software engineering, automotive systems, embedded technologies, data analytics, or similar areas.
* Demonstrated ability to apply theoretical knowledge to practical, real-world industry projects and challenges.
* Experience in research, publishing, or collaborative industry–academia initiatives is highly beneficial.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare technical documentation and deliver knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Capacity to work on-site in Pune, manage full-time responsibilities, and collaborate effectively within cross-functional project teams.
* Commitment to continuous learning, openness to new technologies, and interest in advancing industry–academia partnerships.
* Doctoral or master’s degree in a relevant field is preferred; candidates with significant teaching and project experience will also be considered.

https://ifp.aicte.gov.in/ for more details

Job Summary -

The eDFM Engineer is a change agent, a quick learner and has a passion for excellence. The

eDFM Engineer is responsible for managing development of complex circuit board assemblies and electro -mechanical assemblies design to manufacturing stage . This includes responsibility for defining component mounting, selection of adhesives, potting and coatings, mechanical design and qualification of electrical systems for harsh shock, vibration, and thermal environments. The eDFM Engineer is also responsi ble for ensuring a manufacturable design consistent with contract manufacturer (CM) equipment and processes while adhering to SLB design guidelines . This includes responsibility for manufacturing process fixtures, instructions and profiles to

optimize production yield and ultimately the reliability of the electrical system. The eDFM Engineer has oversight of electronic design readiness. The eDFM Engineer takes an active role in solving complex manufacturing problems and troubleshooting quality and production yield related issues within manufacturing.

* Participate in high level design activities and physical implementation of the functional design

* Responsible for DFA (Design for Assembly) and design for cost.
* Facilitate the design of jigs and tools needed for manufacturing of electrical system (PWA, harness, validation fixture, etc)
* Inspect electronics for quality and reliability standards such as IPC - 610 class 3, etc.
* Analyze manufacturing processes of electronic assemblies for potential risks and implements mitigation measures (pFMEA) .
* Develop DFMEA, PFMEA and process qualification documentations.
* Investigate manufacturing process related failures of electronic assemblies and leads corrective and preventive activities .
* Optimize manufacturing yield during development phase - focal point to drive manufacturing to target levels, interfacing with engineering, eCAD, and Test to implement corrective actions.
* Review documentation for compliance with eDFM specifications
* Coordinate the prototype building process and ensure proper feedback (Prototype Build Report,
* Procurability Analysis) are given to the design team
* Interact with Contract manufacturer and supply chain to address their concerns and make timely decisions.
* Coordinate prototype building process, providing necessary instructions to ensure adherence to quality standards.
* Successfully complete required safety training, wear PPE as appropriate, observe health, safety and environmental policies

Education

Bachelor or master’s degree in electrical, Electronics, Process, Industrial/Manufacturing Eng. or Material Science.

Work Experience

4-7 years of relevant experience

Skills Required

* Strong knowledge of electrical system packaging design (component mounting, thermal principles) .
* Strong knowledge and experience in electronics and electromechanical manufacturing processes and practices .
* Knowledge and experience in technical documentation of engineering and manufacturing product files
* Excellent knowledge of design for manufacturability principles
* Strong decision making skills.
* Strong leadership skills and able to effect change through influence.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.

**This is an office-based position, with the expectation to come in four days a week.**

title: Sr. Project Officer - Agriculture
description:
**Description**
Passing Gifts is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with some form of specially abled.
  
  
BACKGROUND: Passing Gifts Private Limited (PGPL) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Heifer International USA and it provide services in educating, consulting, training, advising, and providing professional and technical services to individuals, associations, and entities in India and abroad, particularly those who support or are working in the areas of social advancement and sustainable development. This position may also require service agreements, secondment agreements, between entities, etc.
  
  
PGPL is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identify, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.
  
  
**Function**
The Senior Program Officer – Agriculture will provide technical and programmatic leadership for agriculture and allied livelihood interventions with a strong focus on regenerative agriculture, climate resilience, sustainable food systems, and farmer livelihoods. The position will support the planning, implementation, monitoring, and scaling of regenerative agriculture practices that improve soil health, biodiversity, water conservation, ecosystem restoration, and livelihood resilience among smallholder farmers. The role requires close coordination with farmers, farmer institutions, government departments, technical agencies, implementing partner NGOs, other civil society organizations, research institutions, and market actors to promote sustainable agriculture transitions and strengthen rural livelihoods.
  
  
**Responsibiliies And Deliverables**
Programme Planning and Implementation (40%)
  
  

* Lead implementation of regenerative agriculture interventions in project geographies. Provide technical guidance to field teams and communities on regenerative and climate-smart agricultural practices.
* Develop annual work plans, implementation strategies, targets, and seasonal crop plans.
* Promote and facilitate adoption of regenerative agricultural practices, including:
* Soil health restoration and improvement
* Natural and organic farming approaches
* Crop diversification and crop rotation
* Cover cropping and mulching
* Integrated nutrient and pest management
* Agroforestry and mixed farming systems
* Water-efficient and climate-resilient farming practices
* Support establishment of demonstration plots, learning farms, and farmer business/field schools for regenerative agriculture. Integrate climate adaptation and ecosystem-based approaches into agriculture programming.
* Mentor and support field staff on agriculture and regenerative practices.
* Conduct regular field visits for technical support and quality assurance. Ensure documentation of field observations and continuous learning across teams.
* Develop training modules, IEC materials, and technical manuals on regenerative agriculture and sustainable food systems.
* Promote farmer-led experimentation and participatory learning approaches. Build capacities of farmers, community institutions, producer groups, and field teams through trainings, exposure visits, and demonstrations.
* Support development of sustainable and resilient agricultural value chains.
* Facilitate market linkages for regenerative and sustainably produced farm products.
* Promote local enterprises, value addition, post-harvest management, and diversified livelihood opportunities.

Stakeholder Coordination and Partnerships (30%)
  
  

* Liaise with government departments including Agriculture, Horticulture, Watershed, Rural Development, Forestry, and allied departments for convergence and scheme linkages.
* Collaborate with technical experts, research institutions, universities, private sector agencies, and knowledge partners on regenerative agriculture innovations.
* Represent the organization in relevant forums, consultations, and multi-stakeholder platforms related to agriculture and climate resilience.

Monitoring, Learning and Documentation (20%)
  
  

* Develop and track indicators related to regenerative agriculture adoption, productivity improvement, soil health, biodiversity enhancement, and farmer resilience.
* Monitor project progress and ensure quality implementation against program outcomes.
* Document case studies, field learnings, success stories, and evidence on regenerative agriculture transitions.
* Prepare technical reports, donor reports, policy briefs, and knowledge products. Ensure that the implementing partner meets Heifer’s monitoring and evaluation requirements and deadlines. Review of project activities (physical and financial) with partner staff monthly and ensure that reports are submitted on schedule. Participate in ongoing partner activities on a regular basis for quality control and improvement.
* Ensure that the activity-based reforecasting is prepared following the participatory method with appropriate stakeholders.
* Ensure documentation and sharing of best practices.

Community Institution Strengthening (10%)
  
  

* Strengthen farmer groups, producer collectives, and Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs) to adopt regenerative and market-oriented farming systems.
* Facilitate community-led planning for sustainable land use, soil restoration, and natural resource management.
* Encourage inclusion of women, youth, and marginal farmers in agriculture initiatives.

**Qualifications And Skills**

* Degree in Agriculture, Agronomy, Agroecology, Agricultural Extension, Horticulture, Natural Resource Management, Rural Development, Environmental Sciences, or related disciplines.
* Minimum 8–10 years of relevant experience in agriculture, regenerative agriculture, agroecology, climate-resilient agriculture, rural livelihoods, or natural resource management.
* Experience working with NGOs, development organizations, donor-funded projects, or government agriculture programmes.
* Demonstrated experience in community-based agriculture programming and farmer institution strengthening.
* Strong understanding of regenerative agriculture, agroecology, climate-resilient agriculture, soil health, biodiversity conservation, and sustainable food systems.
* Experience in programme planning, implementation, monitoring, and stakeholder engagement.
* Knowledge of farmer institutions, FPOs, agriculture value chains, and livelihood promotion.
* Strong facilitation, training, and community mobilization skills.
* Excellent analytical, reporting, and documentation skills.
* Ability to engage with government agencies, technical experts, and development partners.
* Proficiency in MS Office and digital monitoring tools.
* Willingness to travel extensively to field locations.

**Essential Competencies**

* Basic knowledge of financial controls and systems. Knowledge of word processing, spreadsheets, database and electronic mail software (Microsoft preferred).
* Strong Odia and English language skills, both oral and written.
* Demonstrate a high degree of honesty and integrity.
* Willingness to work flexibly outside normal working hours.
* Ability to foster and maintain a spirit of unity, teamwork and cooperation.
* Constant face-to-face, telephone and electronic communication with colleagues, potential donors, and the public.
* Motivated to work responsibly with little supervision.
* Ability to meet and deal with others in a courteous and tactful manner.
* Ability to work with sensitive information and to always maintain confidentiality.
* Sensitivity in working with multiple cultures and beliefs, and to gender equity.
* Constant sitting, standing and walking, with occasional bending and lifting; may work at a computer for extended periods of time

terms.

title: Project Development Specialist
description:
**About Silver Touch Green RE**

Silver Touch Green RE designs and delivers renewable energy solutions for industrial, commercial and government facilities. We help organisations generate cleaner power and manage their electricity costs.

We focus on commercial and industrial (C&I) solar EPC projects and on renewable energy systems for public infrastructure and government sites. Our services cover the full project: feasibility studies, energy assessments, engineering, procurement, installation, grid connection and commissioning, all through a single point of accountability.

Every project is tailored to the facility’s layout, electricity demand, operating needs and long-term sustainability goals. We also offer monitoring and maintenance. As energy needs evolve, we are expanding into battery energy storage (BESS), hybrid solar-wind systems and floating solar.

* Track project milestones and flag risks early
* Share regular project status reports with management

*Skills*

* A working knowledge of Gujarat’s solar and open access policies and approval processes
* Strong coordination and follow-up skills with clients, contractors and government offices
* Planning, documentation and project tracking
* Clear communication and stakeholder management
* Comfortable with Excel, PowerPoint and project tracking tools

*Education and other requirements*

* A B.E./B.Tech in Electrical, Mechanical or a related field is preferred
* Willingness to travel to client sites and government offices as needed

**What we offer**

* Competitive salary
* Ownership of projects from start to finish
* Room to grow into a leadership role as the company grows
* A workplace where your work is recognised
* A real part in India’s clean energy future

Send your CV to hr@silvertouchgreen.com

DosBros has 60+ locations globally across the USA, India and Canada, with an expanding presence in India.

As we scale across cities and explore new business opportunities, we are looking for an ambitious and entrepreneurial individual to work directly with the Founder and senior management.

This is a high-ownership, generalist internship for someone who wants to understand how businesses are built, scaled and funded.

You will act as Entrepreneur in Residence and will work across business strategy, growth initiatives, brand management, marketing, fundraising and business development. You will be involved in evaluating new opportunities, coordinating strategic projects, strengthening brand presence, supporting investor outreach and helping convert business plans into execution.

This is not a conventional desk internship. We are looking for someone who can think independently, work with data, communicate effectively, manage multiple priorities and take ownership of outcomes.

**Think like an entrepreneur. Operate like a business owner. Execute with ownership.**

**Key Responsibilities**
**1. Strategy & Business Growth**

* Work directly with the Founder and senior management on strategic initiatives, business planning and growth strategies.
* Conduct market research, competitor analysis and feasibility assessments to evaluate new business opportunities.
* Identify new revenue streams, business models and expansion possibilities.
* Assist in preparing business plans, financial models, management reports and presentations.
* Track business performance, analyse data and convert findings into actionable recommendations.

* Contribute to strengthening DosBros' brand positioning, brand value, market presence and overall awareness across India.

**3. Fundraising & Investor Relations**

* Build and maintain a structured investor database and outreach pipeline, and support initial investor communication and follow-ups.
* Assist in preparing and refining investor presentations, fundraising proposals, financial models, unit economics and business expansion plans.
* Coordinate investor meetings, maintain communication records and support the fundraising process, including information sharing and due-diligence coordination.

**4. Business Development & Strategic Partnerships**

* Support franchise development, franchise partner coordination and expansion initiatives across India.
* Explore corporate partnerships, catering opportunities, packaged meals and institutional business opportunities.
* Coordinate with food delivery aggregators such as Zomato and Swiggy, POS providers, technology partners, franchise partners and other external stakeholders.
* Identify and evaluate strategic partnerships, new business models and opportunities to generate additional revenue.
* Manage business discussions, follow-ups and execution coordination with external partners.

**5. Project Management & Operational Execution**

* Take ownership of assigned business projects and drive them from planning through execution.
* Coordinate cross-functional initiatives involving marketing, finance, supply chain, technology and business development teams.
* Track project timelines, identify execution bottlenecks and follow up with relevant stakeholders.
* Ensure timely implementation of management decisions and strategic priorities.
* Prepare progress updates, reports and presentations for the Founder and senior management.

We are looking for someone who:

* Has an entrepreneurial mindset and a genuine interest in startups, business strategy and company building.
* Is comfortable working in an ambiguous, fast-paced environment.
* Takes ownership and follows through without requiring constant supervision.
* Has strong analytical, research, problem-solving and communication skills.
* Can manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
* Is comfortable with business research, Excel-based analysis, presentations and external stakeholder coordination.
* Is proactive, resourceful, detail-oriented and execution-focused.

Previous exposure to a Founder's Office, CEO's Office, business strategy, business operations, fundraising, investor relations, marketing or management consulting will be an advantage, but is not mandatory.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to prepare business reports, investor presentations, research documents and analytical summaries.
* Interest in business strategy, fundraising, consumer brands and the food and beverage industry.

* **Fundraising Exposure:**

**AI Agents & Copilot Studio:**
Design, develop and deploy useful AI agents using approved enterprise knowledge sources and business applications. Demonstrate working agents personally developed or implemented.
  
  
**Integration & Governance:**
Support secure integration with SAP S/4HANA, Primavera and Darwinbox. Work with IT teams on identity, access, data protection, security and platform governance.
  
  
**Training & Change Management:**
Conduct hands-on training, develop internal digital champions and measure adoption and productivity improvements.
  
  
**AI Readiness Roadmap:**
Identify high-value AI opportunities across EPC projects, precast manufacturing and corporate functions; prioritize pilots and help move successful solutions into use.

* 10–12 years of overall IT experience, including at least 8 years of substantial hands-on Microsoft 365 experience.

* Hands-on experience developing Power Automate workflows and Power Apps.
* Experience creating Power BI dashboards and reports.
* Practical experience with Microsoft Copilot and preferably Copilot Studio, including the development of AI agents.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, information security, data governance and enterprise integration.
* Ability to understand business processes, build solutions independently and work with stakeholders across functions.
* Excellent communication, problem-solving and training skills.
* Experience in EPC, construction, infrastructure or manufacturing will be an advantage.

**Education and certifications**
**:**

* Personally build and demonstrate working solutions—not just manage vendors or deliver presentations.

* Help employees adopt technology and show measurable improvements in productivity, process efficiency and access to information.

Shortlisted candidates will be asked to demonstrate solutions they have personally developed or implemented, particularly in SharePoint, Power Automate and Copilot Studio / AI agents. Certifications and theoretical knowledge alone will not be sufficient.

title: Solution Engineer
description:
**Introduction**
At IBM Global Sales, we bring together innovation, collaboration, and expertise to help clients solve their most complex business challenges. Working across industries and geographies, you'll partner with colleagues, clients, and partners to co-create solutions that drive digital transformation and lasting impact.Success in Global Sales is built on curiosity, empathy, and collaboration. You'll connect technical understanding with strong people skills, building trusted relationships and shaping solutions that improve business and society. With world-class onboarding, continuous learning, and a supportive culture, IBM offers the tools and opportunities to grow your career. Join us and be part of a global team that's passionate about driving innovation and making a difference.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
Solutions Engineers at Confluent play a critical role across the customer journey. They help customers evaluate the platform, design the right technical approach, prove value quickly, and build confidence in adopting data streaming patterns that solve meaningful business problems. This role sits at the intersection of technical depth, customer discovery, solution design, and business value articulation.
  
  
In this role, you will partner closely with Account Executives and cross-functional teams to uncover stated and unstated customer needs, shape strong technical strategies, and guide customers toward successful adoption of Confluent. You will be expected to lead technical discovery, own the technical win, and build trusted relationships with technical and business stakeholders.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Lead technical discovery with prospects and customers to uncover business drivers, technical requirements, risks, and success criteria.
* Design and present solution architectures that clearly connect Confluent capabilities to customer outcomes, technical constraints, and long-term platform strategy.
* Own and drive technical evaluations, proofs of concept, and proof of value activities from initial scope through technical win.
* Run workshops, white boarding sessions, and architecture discussions with developers, architects, platform teams, and business stakeholders.
* Help customers adopt best practices for data streaming, cloud, hybrid, and event-driven architectures as they move from individual projects toward broader platform adoption.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Support, Professional Services, and Customer Success to remove blockers, shape solutions, and improve customer outcomes.
* Contribute to account strategy with Account Executives by helping qualify opportunities, build champions, and strengthen the technical and business case for change.
* Create reusable assets such as demos, presentations, reference architectures, discovery patterns, or enablement material that scale beyond a single account.
* Mentor other Solutions Engineers by sharing best practices, giving constructive feedback, and helping lift the technical quality of the wider team.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Experience in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Solution Architecture, or a similar customer-facing technical role.
* Experience working with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, streaming or messaging platforms, data integration, and modern data platforms.
* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, networking, containers, Kubernetes, and modern application architectures.
* Ability to run high-quality discovery, map pain points to solution approaches, and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience leading technical evaluations, workshops, and customer presentations in complex enterprise sales cycles.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with confidence engaging developers, architects, and senior customer stakeholders.
* Hands-on experience with one or more of Java, Python, SQL, or similar technologies commonly used to build and integrate data-driven applications.
* A self-starter mindset with strong judgment, curiosity, and the ability to learn quickly, operate independently, and solve ambiguous technical problems.
* Proven ability to collaborate across functions and build trust with colleagues, customers, and partners.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Experience with Kafka, Apache Flink, stream processing, or real-time analytics platforms.
* Familiarity with value-based selling, MEDDPICC or similar qualification frameworks.
* Experience creating repeatable demos, technical content, playbooks, or enablement material for the broader field organization.
* A track record of mentoring peers and influencing team practices beyond your own accounts.
* Comfort engaging senior customer stakeholders and helping shape larger platform or transformation discussions.

title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Leva Home Lifts Pvt Ltd makes India’s first maintenance-free, wall-mounted hydraulic home lift, which needs no pit, no shaft and no machine room. Our lifts are designed for existing Indian homes, with low power consumption and minimal maintenance. We design and build in Thrissur, Kerala, and install lifts in homes across the state.

**Role Description**
We are looking for a Mechanical Design Engineer to design and develop home lift components and systems. This is a full-time, on-site role in Thrissur. You will work closely with our production, purchase and installation teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Create 3D models and assemblies of lift components in
  **SolidWorks**
* Prepare detailed 2D manufacturing and fabrication drawings in
  **AutoCAD**
* Prepare and update BOQs and part lists for production and purchase
* Coordinate with the workshop and outsourced vendors (sheet metal, fabrication) to turn designs into finished parts
* Make site-specific design changes for customer installations
* Do design calculations and evaluate materials and mechanisms for safety and durability
* Support prototype building, testing and new model development, including our upcoming G+3 lift
* Keep design documentation and drawing revisions organised

**Qualifications**

* B.Tech/BE or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering
* At least 2 years of hands-on experience in
  **SolidWorks**
  (3D modelling and assemblies) and
  **AutoCAD**
  (2D manufacturing drawings)
* Good understanding of sheet metal design, fabrication and machine design
* Experience with hydraulics, lifts or elevators, or electromechanical products is an advantage
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
* Good communication in Malayalam and English

**Why Join Leva**

* Work on an innovative, made-in-India product from design to installation
* See your designs built and installed in real homes
* A small, fast-moving team where your work makes a direct impact

**How to Apply**

* **Click Easy Apply**
  and attach your CV. Including samples of your SolidWorks or AutoCAD work is a plus.

description:
About the job

Company Description Energy24by7 is a smart solar energy company in Perumbavoor, Kerala. We design and make solar off-gird inverters, charge controllers and energy storage products, including iCON, iCUBE, iSUN and iSUN+, built on our patented BCI (Battery Charging Inhibition) Technology.

Role Description We are hiring Customer Engagement Interns responsible for identifying and engaging prospective customers, presenting Energy24by7's renewable energy and storage solutions, and managing the entire sales cycle from initial contact to closing deals. Day-to-day activities include visiting client locations, conducting product demonstrations, preparing proposals, negotiating commercial terms, and maintaining ongoing relationships with existing customers. • Respond to every lead assigned to you within the same day.

• Handle basic price and escalate discount requests through the approval process.•

 Build relationships with local electricians and installers.

What we look for

• Diploma or degree in electrical or electronics engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

• Fluent Malayalam and working English, spoken and written.

• Have a valid driving licence and your own two-wheeler.

• Comfortable with long travel days, covering the above mentioned locations.

• Able to read an electricity bill and size a basic system, or willing to learn quickly.

• Comfortable with WhatsApp, Excel and a CRM, and disciplined about keeping records.

Helpful to have: Basic knowledge of Solar PV systems.

Job Company: AI CERTs ,  https://www.sarder.ai/ , https://www.nplus.global/ ,

About Us:

AI CERTs™ is a fast-growing global certification body providing vendor-neutral, role-based certifications in AI, Blockchain, Cloud, and emerging tech. We partner with individuals, institutions, and enterprises to bridge the global skills gap through cutting-edge certifications and training.

About the Role

We are looking for a dynamic and result-oriented Sales Talent Acquisition Specialist with 4 years of experience in end-to-end recruitment, preferably within the EdTech industry. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of sales hiring, excellent stakeholder management skills, and the ability to attract and onboard high-performing sales professionals in a fast-paced business environment.

The candidate will be responsible for managing the complete recruitment lifecycle for various sales positions, ensuring timely closures while maintaining quality of hire.

Key Responsibilities

1. End-to-End Sales Recruitment

* Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle for sales positions, from sourcing to offer rollout and onboarding.
* Hire for multiple sales profiles, including:
* Business Development Executives (BDEs)
* Business Development Managers (BDMs)
* Academic Counselors
* Inside Sales Executives
* Team Leaders – Sales
* Sales Managers and Regional Sales Managers.
* Understand business requirements and translate them into effective recruitment strategies.
* Ensure timely closure of positions as per business hiring targets.

2. Sourcing & Talent Pipeline Management

* Source candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, employee referrals, social media, and other recruitment channels.
* Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline for current and future sales hiring requirements.
* Identify candidates with strong communication, negotiation, persuasion, and target-oriented skills.
* Explore competitor organizations and relevant talent pools within the EdTech, education, and related industries.

3. Stakeholder Management

* Work closely with sales managers, business heads, and department leaders to understand hiring needs.
* Coordinate interview schedules and ensure timely feedback from hiring managers.
* Conduct regular hiring reviews and provide recruitment updates to stakeholders.
* Manage candidate expectations and ensure a positive candidate experience.

4. Recruitment Metrics & Reporting

* Track and maintain recruitment KPIs, including:
* Time to Hire
* Cost per Hire
* Offer-to-Joining Ratio
* Interview-to-Selection Ratio
* Source Effectiveness
* Joining Ratio and Attrition Trends.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly recruitment reports.
* Drive recruitment efficiency while maintaining quality of hire.

5. Offer Management & Onboarding

* Manage salary negotiations and offer discussions.
* Ensure smooth offer rollout and follow-ups until joining.
* Minimize offer dropouts through consistent candidate engagement.
* Coordinate with HR operations for documentation and onboarding formalities.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Graduate/Postgraduate in HR, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Minimum 4 years of experience in Talent Acquisition, preferably in the EdTech industry.
* Strong experience in high-volume sales recruitment.
* Good understanding of the EdTech sales ecosystem and competitor hiring landscape.
* Hands-on experience with Naukri, LinkedIn Recruiter, and other sourcing platforms.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong ability to work with hiring targets, deadlines, and recruitment metrics.
* Ability to manage multiple positions simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

Key Competencies

* Sales hiring expertise
* Strategic sourcing and headhunting
* Stakeholder management
* Candidate relationship management
* Negotiation and offer management
* Data-driven recruitment
* Target-oriented approach
* Problem-solving and decision-making

Pay: ₹40,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Life insurance
* Paid sick time

About Us

Grown Diamond Corporation is one of the pioneers of the Lab Grown Diamond (LGD) industry, manufacturing and exporting lab-grown diamonds and fine jewellery, with group offices in Dubai and New York.

Role Overview

A hands-on role owning day-to-day accounting, statutory compliance, export-import documentation and audit readiness for our India operations, working closely with our external CA firm, tax advisors and international offices.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Accounting & Reporting**

* Own books of accounts end-to-end; monthly closing with accurate, timely MIS
* Manage payables, vendor payments and overseas receivables ageing and follow-up
* Inventory accounting by lot/carat; rough-to-polished yield and loss reconciliation; metal (gold) accounting for jewellery
* Job-work accounting – issue/receipt challans, stock and yield/loss reconciliation with job workers, verification of job-work bills
* Memo/consignment stock tracking and reconciliation, including stock with overseas offices
* Cash flow forecasting, fund planning and working-capital reporting
* Budget vs actual tracking and cost analysis for management

**Taxation & Statutory Compliance**

* GST returns and reconciliations (GSTR-1/3B/2B/9), e-invoicing and e-way bills (including job-work movements), ITC-04, LUT filing and refund of unutilised ITC on zero-rated exports
* TDS/TCS returns and compliance under the Income-tax Act, 2025; advance tax computation
* Coordinate direct tax filings (company and promoter/director) with the CA firm
* Coordinate payroll statutory compliance (PF, ESIC, PT) under the Labour Codes, and ROC/MCA filings
* Stay current on regulatory changes and implement them in processes

**Export, Import & FEMA**

* Export documentation, ICEGATE and Export Declaration Form (EDF) compliance under the FEMA (Export and Import of Goods and Services) Regulations, 2026
* Export realisation tracking within the prescribed 9-month period; EDPMS/IDPMS reconciliation with AD banks
* Import accounting – Bill of Entry, customs duty and import payments
* FEMA compliance for remittances and transactions with group entities
* Bank reconciliations and forex exposure tracking

**Group Reporting, Transfer Pricing & Audit**

* Prepare monthly data packs and intercompany reconciliations for consolidation with Dubai and New York entities
* Provide data and support to tax advisors for transfer pricing documentation
* Coordinate statutory, tax, internal, customs and stock audits (including stock at job workers); close audit points on time

**Controls & Team**

* Build and maintain internal controls, SOPs and approval workflows for the accounts function
* Supervise and train a team of 2–3 accounts executives
* Work with production, sales and logistics teams to ensure clean documentation at source

**Requirements**

* Qualification: **CA Inter or Qualified CA (mandatory)**

– CA Inter: 6 – 10 years of experience (not pursuing further exams)

– Qualified CA: 2 – 5 years of post-qualification experience

* Minimum 3 years of gem & jewellery / diamond manufacturing or export experience (Articleship with gem & jewellery clients counts)
* Hands-on experience with job-work accounting, memo/consignment goods and inventory-heavy accounting (lot/carat/metal)
* Working knowledge of GST, TDS, export-import documentation and FEMA, including recent changes (Income-tax Act 2025, FEMA 2026 regulations)
* Proficiency in Tally Prime; experience with Gati and/or DiamTrade preferred; advanced Excel
* Detail-oriented, deadline-driven, comfortable working directly with promoters and auditors

**Why Join Us**

* Work with a pioneer in a fast-growing global industry
* Direct exposure to international operations (Dubai, New York)
* Competitive pay and growth into a senior finance role as the company scales

description:
Tender Executive – Roles & Responsibilities

A **Tender Executive** is responsible for managing the complete tendering lifecycle, from identifying business opportunities to submitting compliant bids and supporting post-award activities. The role requires strong coordination, documentation, and analytical skills to maximize contract-winning opportunities.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Tender Search & Identification**

* Monitor procurement portals such as GeM, CPPP, and other e-tendering platforms for relevant opportunities.
* Review tender notifications to assess eligibility, scope of work, submission requirements, and deadlines.
* Evaluate tender feasibility based on company capabilities and business objectives.

**2. Proposal Preparation & Documentation**

* Coordinate with Engineering, Sales, Finance, Legal, and other departments to collect technical and commercial information.
* Prepare technical proposals, commercial bids, cost estimates, BOQs, and pricing documents.
* Ensure all bid documents, certifications, declarations, and compliance requirements meet client and regulatory standards.
* Verify accuracy and completeness of all supporting documentation before submission.

**3. Tender Submission & Process Management**

* Manage the end-to-end tender submission process while ensuring adherence to deadlines.
* Submit bids through online e-procurement portals as well as physical submissions where required.
* Participate in pre-bid meetings, clarify tender requirements, and maintain communication with procurement authorities.
* Track amendments, corrigenda, and addenda issued during the bidding process.

**4. Post-Submission & Relationship Management**

* Maintain records of submitted tenders, vendor registrations, contracts, and bid history.
* Monitor bid status, follow up on results, and analyze successful and unsuccessful bids to improve future proposals.
* Support contract finalization, negotiations, and client communications after bid submission.
* Build and maintain professional relationships with clients, government departments, and procurement agencies.

Key Skills

* Tender Management & Bid Coordination
* GeM & CPPP Portal Operations
* E-Tendering & Procurement Processes
* Proposal Writing & Documentation
* Compliance & Regulatory Knowledge
* Cost Estimation & Commercial Bid Preparation
* Cross-functional Coordination
* Time Management & Deadline Adherence
* Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
* Strong Communication & Negotiation Skills

title: Procurement Executive – CGD Materials
description:
**About PipedGas (an Enamun business)** PipedGas (pipedgas.in) is an online procurement and planning platform run by Enamun Pvt. Ltd.,built for City Gas Distribution (CGD) contractors working on PNG, MDPE and GC projects. Contractors describe their work requirement, the platform turns it into a checked bill of quantities (BOQ), and Enamun returns a priced quotation, typically within one working day. We supply materials for domestic PNG connections (LMC and conversion), MDPE network installation and gas station maintenance: MDPE pipes and PE fittings, GI pipes and fittings, copper tube and fittings, brass and MLC fittings, valves and regulators, meter adaptors and disconnectors, clamps and fasteners, consumables, tools and machines, and safety/PPE. Material is delivered across India from Enamun's own regional stores at Gurugram, Bhubaneswar and Sangli, with Ambikapur, Sambhajinagar, Sehore and Erode coming soon. **Role Summary** The Procurement Executive is the supply side of the PipedGas platform. Every contractor enquiry that Sales quotes depends on the right material, from a make approved by that CGD operator, at a competitive buy price, available in the right store. You will source and develop manufacturers, keep approved make and pricing data current, back Sales with fast vendor quotes, keep the regional stores stocked, and make sure every dispatch carries the required QAP, MTC or inspection report.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Sourcing of CGD materials** •Source the full PipedGas catalogue: MDPE pipes and PE (electrofusion / spigot) fittings, GI pipes and GI fittings, copper tube (Cu-DHP to BS EN 1057) and copper fittings, brass and MLC fittings, GI appliance and isolation valves, regulators, brass meter adaptors and disconnectors, clamps, supports, fasteners, consumables and markers. •Source tools and machines used by CGD crews (spanners, wrenches, pliers, NPT dies, electrofusion and pipe-cutting equipment) and safety / PPE items. •Source pressure regulation and metering items for gas station work as the range expands. •Replace "make to be confirmed" lines in the catalogue with firm, approved makes and current buy prices.

**2. Approved makes and CGD operator compliance**

•Build and maintain the approved-make matrix for each CGD operator and geographical area we serve; track changes to operators' approved vendor lists and update the catalogue accordingly. •Get vendors registered / approved with CGD operators where needed, and keep their documents (BIS licences, type-test reports, ISO certificates, QAPs) on file. •Ensure compliance with PNGRB technical standards (T4S) and applicable BIS / international standards for each item.

**3. Quotation support to Sales** •Get vendor prices, lead times and stock for enquiry lines quickly so Sales can meet the one-working-day quotation target. •Flag lines that are unavailable or need more detail (size, make, rating) so Sales can mark them in the revised list. •Maintain a live rate database and price trends for high-volume items (MDPE pipe, PE fittings, GI, copper, brass). **4. Vendor development and Enamun-brand items** •Identify, evaluate and empanel manufacturers and distributors across key CGD markets; develop at least two sources for critical items. •Develop and manage contract manufacturers for Enamun-brand products: specifications, samples, QAP, pricing and capacity. •Run vendor performance reviews on quality, delivery, price and documentation. **5. Purchasing and commercial** •Float RFQs, prepare comparative statements, negotiate and issue POs; finalise rate contracts for fast-moving items. •Manage payment terms, GST, freight and landed cost; reconcile invoices with Accounts. •Place back-to-back purchases against confirmed customer orders and buy for stock against approved plans.

**6. MIS and cost optimization** •Maintain procurement MIS: spend, savings, price trends, vendor performance, open POs and stock cover by store. •Reduce costs through volume consolidation, rate contracts, alternate sources and Enamun-brand substitution.

**Candidate Requirements Education** •B.E. / B.Tech or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering preferred; any graduate with strong relevant experience will be considered. •MBA / PGDM in Materials or Supply Chain Management is a plus.

**Experience** •

3–6 years of purchase / procurement experience with a CGD company, a CGD EPC / LMC contractor, or a supplier of CGD materials.

•Hands-on buying of MDPE pipe, PE fittings, GI, copper and brass fittings, regulators and valves for PNG and steel/MDPE network work.

•Practical knowledge of approved-make lists and vendor approval processes at major CGD operators.

**Knowledge and skills** •Working knowledge of PNGRB T4S and the product standards for these items (e.g. IS 14885 for PE gas pipes, IS 1239 for GI pipes, BS EN 1057 for copper tube). •Strong existing network of CGD material manufacturers and distributors, ideally across North, East and West India. •Comfortable reading BOQs, drawings and item specifications; able to spot wrong size, rating or make. •Strong negotiation, costing and GST knowledge; ERP / Zoho proficiency and advanced Excel. •Responsive and organized: able to turn around vendor quotes the same day. English and Hindi; one more regional language is a plus.

**Good to have**

•Experience in B2B e-commerce, distribution or a trading company serving contractors.

•Exposure to private label / contract manufacturing and to gas station (DRS / metering skid) items.

**Key Performance Indicators** •Turnaround time on vendor quotes for Sales enquiries •Share of enquiry lines quotable with an approved make •Buy-price savings versus last purchase price / market •Vendor on-time, in-full (OTIF) delivery and stock-outs per store •Rejection / return rate and documentation completeness (MTC, QAP, inspection report) •New approved vendors and Enamun-brand items added per quarter

title: Account Executive SaaS Sales (Saleshandy)
description:
**About Saleshandy**
--------------------

Saleshandy is built in Ahmedabad and has been helping businesses scale outreach since 2015. More than 25,000 businesses, agencies and sales teams use it to find leads in a B2B database of 852M+ contacts, set up and warm up sending mailboxes, and run multichannel sequences across email, calls, LinkedIn and WhatsApp. Replies and deals are managed in one unified inbox.

Plans run from $34 to $149 a month, with custom Enterprise plans above that. We're rated 4.6/5 on G2 and are SOC 2, ISO 27001 and GDPR compliant.

We're moving from marketing-led to sales-led growth, and we're hiring closers who want to own a number and grow with us.

#### **About the role** **close deals, own your number**

You'll own the full sales cycle at Saleshandy. You'll convert inbound trial users into paying customers and build your own pipeline through outbound, selling to founders, agencies and sales teams in the US, UK and EU.

* You'll work from our Ahmedabad office. If you live outside Ahmedabad, relocating is mandatory for this role
* You'll work US/UK hours, which means a night shift in India
* We're looking for 2 to 5 years in B2B SaaS sales, with at least 2 years of closing deals yourself
* Full-time role, reporting to the Head of Sales
* Your main market is the US and EU, with India as a secondary market
* Pay is 6 to 8 LPA fixed, plus an uncapped monthly incentive

**How we work**
---------------

We run a Results-Only Work Environment (ROWE). Nobody tracks your hours or how busy you look. You decide how to plan your day, and you're measured only on outcomes: pipeline created, deals closed, revenue and ticket size.

In return, you own your target completely. If you're behind, you raise it and fix it before your manager has to ask. This role won't suit someone who waits to be chased or leaves results to chance.

**What you'll do**
------------------

### **Inbound sales and trial conversion**

* Own inbound leads (trial sign-ups, demo requests, calendar bookings, chat conversations) from first contact to closed-won or closed-lost
* Respond fast: within the same business hour for demo requests, the same day for trial sign-ups
* Run discovery to understand the buyer's outreach goals, current tools, sending volume, team size and deliverability problems
* Give tailored demos that show only what solves the buyer's problem, instead of a full feature tour
* Handle pricing, competitor and "we're just researching" objections with value, not quick discounts
* Close deals and move customers from monthly to annual plans to grow ticket size

### **Outbound sales and pipeline building**

* Identify target accounts and decision-makers across the US and EU: lead-gen agencies, SaaS founders, and SMB and mid-market sales teams
* Build and run your own outbound campaigns on Saleshandy across cold email, LinkedIn and calls
* Write personalised sequences and keep improving subject lines, offers and messaging based on results
* Book meetings and build enough pipeline to cover at least 3x your monthly quota
* Track open rate, reply rate, positive reply rate, meetings booked and meeting-to-close conversion

### **Follow-up and pipeline discipline**

* Follow up on every lead across email, calls, LinkedIn and WhatsApp until you get a clear yes or no. One email followed by silence is not follow-up
* Keep every lead stage, meeting date, close date and lost reason updated in our CRM (Close). We report from the CRM, never from spreadsheets
* Review your own pipeline every week (stalled deals, overdue tasks, deals at risk) and bring a plan to your 1:1
* Forecast honestly every week and deliver the number you commit to

### **Product and technical understanding**

* Know cold email deliverability well: SPF, DKIM, DMARC, domain and mailbox warm-up, sender rotation, sending limits, bounce rates and inbox placement
* Know the full Saleshandy product: Lead Finder and credits, email infrastructure, unified inbox, multichannel sequences, AI Sequence Copilot, agency and white-label features, API, and CRM integrations (HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, Zoho)
* Explain technical concepts simply to non-technical founders and sales leaders
* Know the basics of cold email compliance in the US (CAN-SPAM) and EU (GDPR)
* Answer product questions yourself using our internal knowledge base instead of waiting on the product team

### **AI and sales automation**

* Use AI tools for account research, personalisation, call preparation and follow-up drafting
* Build simple AI workflows that cut research and admin time, so more of your day goes to selling
* Use AI to make outreach more personal, not more generic

### **Working with other teams**

* Hand closed customers over smoothly to onboarding and customer success, including setup expectations. New Pro-plan customers should finish domain and mailbox setup within their first month
* Share objections, lost reasons, competitor mentions and feature requests with product and marketing every week

**You'll fit well if you**
--------------------------

* Have 2 to 5 years of B2B SaaS sales, including at least 2 years of hands-on deal closing
* Have a record of hitting quota, with numbers you can share: quota, achievement, deal size and cycle length
* Have done both inbound conversion and self-sourced outbound pipeline
* Have sold to US, UK or EU customers over video calls
* Speak and write excellent English, and are strong at presenting, negotiating and handling objections
* Can write cold emails that get replies
* Have used a CRM (Close, HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive or similar) and at least one sales engagement or data tool (Saleshandy, Apollo, Clay, Lemlist, Instantly or similar)
* Are comfortable working US/UK night shift hours from Ahmedabad
* Keep learning. You read, listen to sales podcasts and review your own call recordings, and you can show how that improved your results

### **Good to have**

* Experience selling a cold email, sales engagement or martech product
* Experience selling to lead-gen or marketing agencies
* Hindi and Gujarati for Indian accounts

**How you're measured**
-----------------------

* Revenue against quota, meaning monthly new revenue closed from inbound and self-sourced deals. We share the quota at offer stage
* Inbound conversion, the share of assigned trial and demo leads you turn into paying customers
* Average ticket size per deal, and the share of deals you close on annual plans
* Open pipeline of at least 3x your monthly quota
* Speed to lead, the time from lead assignment to your first contact
* Follow-up consistency. Every open lead has a next step and a future task in the CRM
* Reply rate, positive reply rate and meetings booked from your own outbound campaigns
* CRM hygiene, with stages, meeting dates, close dates and lost reasons always up to date

**Your first 90 days**
----------------------

* By day 30 you're ready to sell. You know the product and deliverability basics well enough to run demos alone, and you've closed your first deals
* By day 60 you're at 70% or more of quota, your first outbound campaign is live, and your CRM stays clean without reminders
* By day 90 you're fully ramped and hitting 100% of quota consistently, with at least 30% of revenue from annual plans

**Why join us**
---------------

* A growing B2B SaaS product used by 25,000+ customers worldwide
* Uncapped incentives, so your earnings grow with your results
* Full ownership of the sales cycle, with real freedom over how you work
* You'll sell to US and EU founders, agencies and sales leaders every day
* Modern outbound and AI tools, and a path to senior AE or team lead roles as we scale

**How to apply**
----------------

Apply with your CV and answer the screening questions in the form. Shortlisted candidates will be asked for a 10 to 15 minute demo recording before the interview.

At IBM Global Sales, we bring together innovation, collaboration, and expertise to help clients solve their most complex business challenges. * Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, networking, containers, Kubernetes, and modern application architectures.

description:
**Job Description: Solution Architect - Agentic AI Platform**

This role will be responsible for partnering with client stakeholders at the board and executive levels to translate complex business challenges into production-ready autonomous agentic architectures. You will own the technical relationship during the discovery phase, blueprint the core reference architectures, and guide our internal engineering pods through successful implementation.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Solution Architecture & Technical Blueprinting

* Design and document standardized, enterprise-grade Reference Architectures for multi-agent orchestration and advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems using the Claude Code or Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform.
* Blueprint end-to-end "Agentic Workflows," mapping out how multi-turn reasoning, persistent memory, and state management will behave in live environments.
* Build reusable architecture scaffolds and integration patterns that allow developers to connect agents to core enterprise systems (e.g., Splunk, Elastic, ServiceNow, Salesforce and custom telemetry stacks).
* Transition seamlessly from abstract whiteboard designs to concrete implementation by writing core foundational code, configuration scripts, or orchestration loops alongside the engineering team.
* Act as the technical bridge between Softility’s delivery teams and Google Cloud's partner engineering group to unblock platform-level execution barriers.

2. Tactical Pre-Sales & Consultative Engagement

* Act as the primary technical authority during high-touch, pre-sales discovery workshops to discover, define, and scope client use cases.
* Conduct highly technical product demonstrations and deliver deep-dive sessions to client engineering teams, effectively neutralizing competitive technologies (e.g., OpenAI Assistants, AWS Bedrock).

3. Model Optimization & Workload Selection

* Evaluate enterprise tasks to select the optimal model configuration, balancing computational efficiency and accuracy.
* Define token budget management strategies and performance caching layers to ensure client systems scale effectively.
* Design benchmarking metrics to continually evaluate agent precision, grounding scores, and execution latency.

4. Security, Compliance & Semantic Governance

* Oversee absolute security compliance for all agent deployments, ensuring architectures adhere to Zero-Trust standards and strict data residency mandates.
* Design and implement Semantic Governance Layers to enforce safety guidelines, prevent hallucinations, and automate PII masking before data reaches foundational model layers.

**Required Technical Experience & Qualifications**

* Cloud Expertise (preferably GCP): Deep architectural knowledge of Google Cloud Vertex AI (Agent Platform), BigQuery, VPC Service Controls, and IAM security frameworks. Holding a
  *Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect*
  or
  *Professional Machine Learning Engineer*
  certification is highly preferred.
* Agentic Frameworks & AI Tooling: Proven experience building production-level autonomous systems utilizing the Gemini ADK, LangChain, or comparable agentic libraries.
* Backend Mastery: Exceptional proficiency in Python or Node.js, combined with deep familiarity with API design, enterprise webhooks, and asynchronous message queues.
* Modern Integration Standards: Direct experience working with enterprise application API architectures (REST, gRPC) for platforms like Salesforce, ServiceNow, or large-scale Observability stacks.
* System Observability: Familiarity with OpenTelemetry (OTel), logging fabrics, and monitoring frameworks to track agent behavior in production environments.
* Enterprise Software Delivery: Strong experience in modern DevOps methodologies, including infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and automated CI/CD pipeline structures.
