title: Solutions Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Solutions Engineer to join our business and provide presales support to our customers. A Solutions consultant plays a key role in building customer confidence, addressing technical concerns, and winning sales opportunities.

Solutions Specialists support the sales team by providing technical expertise, demonstrations, and solution presentations to potential customers. Their ability to understand customer requirements and propose tailored solutions drives successful presales engagements. You will also work closely with other employees to ensure customer questions and concerns are addressed in a timely manner.

**Responsibilities**

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Being a champion on Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Large Language Models, Conversational AI, and Omni-channel Automation solutions

• Being the first point of contact and advisor to the customer on all matters related to Conversational AI, Agent Assist & Analytics

• Developing solutions for AI & ML based Omni-Channel Automation

• Responsible for organizing, planning, creating & delivering compelling proof of concept demonstrations

• Ensuring solutions stated in the Statement of Work are best practice and in line with client requirements

• Managing the sales bid process by responding to RFIs & RFPs

• Working closely with Sales, Engineering, Delivery, and Project teams to ensure the successful closure of the sales process

• Liaising with Product Managers to provide feedback from clients about product requirements, roadmaps, etc.

• Keeping abreast of market trends, product, and competitor landscapes

**Requirements and Skills**

• Proven work experience as a Solutions Engineer, Pre-Sales Engineer, or in a similar role, for a minimum of three years

• Experience working in a SaaS organization is a must

• Experience dealing with large and mid-size enterprise customers in India

• A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field

• Strong problem-solving and prioritization skills

• Strong presentation skills

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work across multiple stakeholders

• Technical grasp of LLMs, AI, ML, SaaS, and contact centre technology, with a clear understanding of digital technology stacks — APIs, middleware, ecosystems — and the ability to envision solutions

• Experience working with a diverse group: Developers, Program Managers, Sales, and Pre-Sales teams

• This role requires a fair amount of travel to meet clients, alongside time working from the office location

**About Gnani.ai**

Gnani.ai is a Gen AI-based startup working on voice and chat based solutions for large businesses. Gen AI is the biggest innovation disrupting the market, and we are at the heart of this disruption. We are funded by one of the largest global conglomerates in the world, and backed by a number of market leaders in the tech industry.

We work with top companies across banking, insurance, e-commerce, and financial services, delivering scalable AI solutions that elevate customer experience and operational efficiency. With strong growth momentum, Gnani.ai is rapidly expanding its global footprint.

We are proud to be selected by the Government of India as one of the key contributors to the prestigious
**India AI Mission**
. As part of this initiative, we are developing
**India's first Voice-to-Voice Foundation Model**
, strengthening the nation's Sovereign AI capabilities.

If you're passionate about GenAI and want to build cutting-edge technologies in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, join us. We're looking for driven individuals ready to take on big challenges and shape the future of AI.

title: Solution Engineer
description:
**Introduction**
At IBM Global Sales, we bring together innovation, collaboration, and expertise to help clients solve their most complex business challenges. Working across industries and geographies, you'll partner with colleagues, clients, and partners to co-create solutions that drive digital transformation and lasting impact.Success in Global Sales is built on curiosity, empathy, and collaboration. You'll connect technical understanding with strong people skills, building trusted relationships and shaping solutions that improve business and society. With world-class onboarding, continuous learning, and a supportive culture, IBM offers the tools and opportunities to grow your career. Join us and be part of a global team that's passionate about driving innovation and making a difference.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
Solutions Engineers at Confluent play a critical role across the customer journey. They help customers evaluate the platform, design the right technical approach, prove value quickly, and build confidence in adopting data streaming patterns that solve meaningful business problems. This role sits at the intersection of technical depth, customer discovery, solution design, and business value articulation.
  
  
In this role, you will partner closely with Account Executives and cross-functional teams to uncover stated and unstated customer needs, shape strong technical strategies, and guide customers toward successful adoption of Confluent. You will be expected to lead technical discovery, own the technical win, and build trusted relationships with technical and business stakeholders.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Lead technical discovery with prospects and customers to uncover business drivers, technical requirements, risks, and success criteria.
* Design and present solution architectures that clearly connect Confluent capabilities to customer outcomes, technical constraints, and long-term platform strategy.
* Own and drive technical evaluations, proofs of concept, and proof of value activities from initial scope through technical win.
* Run workshops, white boarding sessions, and architecture discussions with developers, architects, platform teams, and business stakeholders.
* Help customers adopt best practices for data streaming, cloud, hybrid, and event-driven architectures as they move from individual projects toward broader platform adoption.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Support, Professional Services, and Customer Success to remove blockers, shape solutions, and improve customer outcomes.
* Contribute to account strategy with Account Executives by helping qualify opportunities, build champions, and strengthen the technical and business case for change.
* Create reusable assets such as demos, presentations, reference architectures, discovery patterns, or enablement material that scale beyond a single account.
* Mentor other Solutions Engineers by sharing best practices, giving constructive feedback, and helping lift the technical quality of the wider team.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Experience in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Solution Architecture, or a similar customer-facing technical role.
* Experience working with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, streaming or messaging platforms, data integration, and modern data platforms.
* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, networking, containers, Kubernetes, and modern application architectures.
* Ability to run high-quality discovery, map pain points to solution approaches, and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience leading technical evaluations, workshops, and customer presentations in complex enterprise sales cycles.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with confidence engaging developers, architects, and senior customer stakeholders.
* Hands-on experience with one or more of Java, Python, SQL, or similar technologies commonly used to build and integrate data-driven applications.
* A self-starter mindset with strong judgment, curiosity, and the ability to learn quickly, operate independently, and solve ambiguous technical problems.
* Proven ability to collaborate across functions and build trust with colleagues, customers, and partners.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Experience with Kafka, Apache Flink, stream processing, or real-time analytics platforms.
* Familiarity with value-based selling, MEDDPICC or similar qualification frameworks.
* Experience creating repeatable demos, technical content, playbooks, or enablement material for the broader field organization.
* A track record of mentoring peers and influencing team practices beyond your own accounts.

title: Client Development Executive
description:
**About the Company:**

Emeritus is committed to teaching the skills of the future by making high-quality education accessible and affordable to individuals, companies, and governments around the world. It does this by collaborating with more than 65 top-tier universities across the United States, Europe, Latin America, Southeast Asia, India and China. Emeritus’ short courses, degree programs, professional certificates, and senior executive programs help individuals learn new skills and transform their lives, companies and organizations. Its unique model of state-of-the-art technology, curriculum innovation, and hands-on instruction from senior faculty, mentors and coaches has educated more than 250,000 individuals across 80+ countries.

Founded in 2015, Emeritus, part of Eruditus Group, has more than 2,000 employees globally and offices in Mumbai, New Delhi, Shanghai, Singapore, Palo Alto, Mexico City, New York, Boston, London, and Dubai. Following its $650 million Series E funding round in August 2021, the Company is valued at $3.2 billion, and is backed by Accel, SoftBank Vision Fund 2, the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, Leeds Illuminate, Prosus Ventures, Sequoia Capital India, and Bertelsmann.

**About the role**

Become the commercial right hand to a senior leader in Emeritus’s Enterprise business. You’ll help open new executive relationships, prepare for high-stakes client conversations, and make sure every important follow-up happens. The role combines business development, executive client engagement and strategic support. You’ll work closely with senior leaders from some of the world’s largest organizations.

**What you’ll do**

* **Drive targeted business development:**
  research prospective Enterprise clients and senior stakeholders, and write personalized outreach across email and LinkedIn. Follow up persistently until relationships turn into conversations with the leader and the wider team. This is about quality and relevance, not volume.
* **Support senior client conversations:**
  brief yourself on each client’s context, join selected meetings, and capture priorities, challenges, opportunities, decisions and next steps.
* **Turn conversations into action:**
  convert meeting notes, voice notes or quick debriefs into clear action plans with owners, deadlines, introductions and the next best step.
* **Build client agendas for travel:**
  when the leader visits a city, identify the right companies and executives, secure meetings, and manage the agenda and logistics, including client lunches and dinners.
* **Learn the domain:**
  build a strong understanding of executive education, leadership development, AI and digital transformation, and how large organizations invest in capability building.

**What success looks like in 6 months**

You anticipate the leader’s needs, prepare them sharply for client meetings, and identify the right people to approach. You write outreach that gets responses and never let an important follow-up slip.

**What we’re looking for**

*Must-haves*

* 3–6 years of experience in a client-facing, commercial or advisory role
* A track record of engaging senior stakeholders (Director, VP or CXO level) with confidence
* Excellent written English, including concise emails, personalized outreach and clear meeting summaries
* Strong research skills: you can quickly build a sharp profile of a company, industry or executive
* Genuine commercial curiosity: you follow business news and want to know what a company’s moves mean for its people and leadership
* Proven ability to manage multiple relationships, follow-ups and deadlines at once
* Comfort with CRM tools, LinkedIn (Sales Navigator a plus), and Excel or Google Sheets
* Willingness to travel for client meetings when needed
* A graduate degree; an MBA or equivalent is a plus

*Good to have*

* Exposure to B2B sales, enterprise learning, L&D, HR or consulting
* Experience supporting a CXO or senior leader directly
* Experience organizing executive events, client dinners or roadshows
* Familiarity with AI tools for research, note-taking and drafting

**Backgrounds that fit well:**

Business development (SDR/BDR), management consulting, client success or account management, executive search, luxury or hospitality client services, Chief of Staff or strategy roles, or a strong graduate program with client-facing experience.

*Emeritus provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.*

title: Solution Engineer
description:
**Introduction**
At IBM Global Sales, we bring together innovation, collaboration, and expertise to help clients solve their most complex business challenges. Working across industries and geographies, you'll partner with colleagues, clients, and partners to co-create solutions that drive digital transformation and lasting impact.Success in Global Sales is built on curiosity, empathy, and collaboration. You'll connect technical understanding with strong people skills, building trusted relationships and shaping solutions that improve business and society. With world-class onboarding, continuous learning, and a supportive culture, IBM offers the tools and opportunities to grow your career. Join us and be part of a global team that's passionate about driving innovation and making a difference.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
Solutions Engineers at Confluent play a critical role across the customer journey. They help customers evaluate the platform, design the right technical approach, prove value quickly, and build confidence in adopting data streaming patterns that solve meaningful business problems. This role sits at the intersection of technical depth, customer discovery, solution design, and business value articulation.
  
  
In this role, you will partner closely with Account Executives and cross-functional teams to uncover stated and unstated customer needs, shape strong technical strategies, and guide customers toward successful adoption of Confluent. You will be expected to lead technical discovery, own the technical win, and build trusted relationships with technical and business stakeholders.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Lead technical discovery with prospects and customers to uncover business drivers, technical requirements, risks, and success criteria.
* Design and present solution architectures that clearly connect Confluent capabilities to customer outcomes, technical constraints, and long-term platform strategy.
* Own and drive technical evaluations, proofs of concept, and proof of value activities from initial scope through technical win.
* Run workshops, white boarding sessions, and architecture discussions with developers, architects, platform teams, and business stakeholders.
* Help customers adopt best practices for data streaming, cloud, hybrid, and event-driven architectures as they move from individual projects toward broader platform adoption.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Support, Professional Services, and Customer Success to remove blockers, shape solutions, and improve customer outcomes.
* Contribute to account strategy with Account Executives by helping qualify opportunities, build champions, and strengthen the technical and business case for change.
* Create reusable assets such as demos, presentations, reference architectures, discovery patterns, or enablement material that scale beyond a single account.
* Mentor other Solutions Engineers by sharing best practices, giving constructive feedback, and helping lift the technical quality of the wider team.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Experience in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Solution Architecture, or a similar customer-facing technical role.
* Experience working with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, streaming or messaging platforms, data integration, and modern data platforms.
* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, networking, containers, Kubernetes, and modern application architectures.
* Ability to run high-quality discovery, map pain points to solution approaches, and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience leading technical evaluations, workshops, and customer presentations in complex enterprise sales cycles.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with confidence engaging developers, architects, and senior customer stakeholders.
* Hands-on experience with one or more of Java, Python, SQL, or similar technologies commonly used to build and integrate data-driven applications.
* A self-starter mindset with strong judgment, curiosity, and the ability to learn quickly, operate independently, and solve ambiguous technical problems.
* Proven ability to collaborate across functions and build trust with colleagues, customers, and partners.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Experience with Kafka, Apache Flink, stream processing, or real-time analytics platforms.
* Familiarity with value-based selling, MEDDPICC or similar qualification frameworks.
* Experience creating repeatable demos, technical content, playbooks, or enablement material for the broader field organization.
* A track record of mentoring peers and influencing team practices beyond your own accounts.
* Comfort engaging senior customer stakeholders and helping shape larger platform or transformation discussions.

Industry Relations, Strategic Partnerships, Entrepreneurship & Alumni Relations

Assistant Manager / Manager

**Function:**
Corporate Relations & Partnerships

**About the Role**

We are looking for a smart, energetic and highly organised professional to strengthen our Industry

Relations & Strategic Partnerships.

The role will focus on building and managing relationships with corporates, industry professionals,

organisations, startups, founders and other external stakeholders, while ensuring that partnerships are

effectively converted into meaningful opportunities and executed smoothly.

The position requires a balance of business development, relationship management and internal

operations. The ideal candidate should be equally comfortable initiating a conversation with a senior

industry stakeholder and managing the internal follow-through required to deliver a successful

engagement.

The role will also support the Entrepreneurship Cell (E-Cell) by developing relevant industry and

entrepreneurial connections and facilitating programmes, interactions and opportunities for students.

institutional objectives.

• Build a strong pipeline of prospective partners through research, networking, outreach,

referrals and existing industry relationships.

• Initiate conversations, prepare proposals, coordinate meetings and drive partnerships towards

closure.

• Develop partnerships that create tangible opportunities such as industry interactions,

workshops, masterclasses, internships, live projects, mentorships and other relevant student

engagements.

• Manage the complete partnership lifecycle — lead generation, outreach, proposal, internal

alignment, and relationship management.

• Support the functioning of the E-Cell by connecting with founders, entrepreneurs, mentors,

investors, incubators and relevant industry networks.

• Coordinate industry and entrepreneurship-led activities, ensuring stakeholder coordination,

timelines, participation and execution.

• Coordinate with the Department Head for senior-level meetings, including scheduling,

briefing, agenda preparation, stakeholder coordination and follow-up.• Maintain structured partnership databases, trackers, proposals, meeting records, follow-ups

and engagement reports.

• Ensure timely follow-ups and closure of commitments with both internal and external

stakeholders.

• Identify new opportunities, networks and industry trends that can strengthen AAFT's

corporate connect, student exposure and institutional partnerships.

• Provide regular updates to Head of the Deptt. on the partnership pipeline, active engagements,

opportunities and outcomes.

The ideal candidate should be:

• Relationship-oriented but strongly execution-focused.

• Comfortable speaking with external stakeholders and conduct meetings.

• Confident and professional communicator; fluency in English will be preferred.

• Good at initiating conversations and building professional relationships.

• Good negotiation and stakeholder management skills, with a practical understanding of

industry relations.

• Strong in follow-ups — someone who does not allow opportunities to remain stuck at the

conversation stage.

• Organised and capable of handling multiple partnerships and departmental activities

simultaneously.

• Curious and research-oriented, with the ability to explore organisations, industries, people and

new opportunities independently.

• Should be open to travel, external meetings and field visits for business development,

partnership closures and relationship management.

• Quick learner with the ability to understand new industries, business requirements and

opportunities quickly.

will be an advantage.

or a relevant discipline.

Business Communication | Stakeholder Management | Business Development | Event & Programme

Execution | Proposal Development | Networking | Negotiation | Project Coordination | Follow-up &

Reporting | Basic AI literacy

title: Senior Business Development Manager
description:

E-Fill Electric is a technology-driven company building an integrated ecosystem for electric vehicles, including AC and DC chargers. The organization designs and manufactures a wide range of EV chargers (AC001, Type 2, CCS2, CCS1, NACS) supported by an in-house CMS and mobile app for EV drivers. The Business Development Manager will collaborate closely with marketing, product, and operations teams to align offerings with customer needs, track market trends and competitor activity, and provide feedback for product and service improvements. DosBros has 60+ locations globally across the USA, India and Canada, with an expanding presence in India.

We are on an ambitious journey to build DosBros into one of India's leading Mexican QSR brands, with a strong focus on expansion, brand building, innovation, strategic partnerships and business growth.

As we scale across cities and explore new business opportunities, we are looking for an ambitious and entrepreneurial individual to work directly with the Founder and senior management.

**About the Role**

This is a high-ownership, generalist internship for someone who wants to understand how businesses are built, scaled and funded.

You will act as Entrepreneur in Residence and will work across business strategy, growth initiatives, brand management, marketing, fundraising and business development. You will be involved in evaluating new opportunities, coordinating strategic projects, strengthening brand presence, supporting investor outreach and helping convert business plans into execution.

This is not a conventional desk internship. We are looking for someone who can think independently, work with data, communicate effectively, manage multiple priorities and take ownership of outcomes.

**Think like an entrepreneur. Operate like a business owner. Execute with ownership.**

**Key Responsibilities**
**1. Strategy & Business Growth**

* Work directly with the Founder and senior management on strategic initiatives, business planning and growth strategies.
* Conduct market research, competitor analysis and feasibility assessments to evaluate new business opportunities.
* Identify new revenue streams, business models and expansion possibilities.
* Assist in preparing business plans, financial models, management reports and presentations.
* Track business performance, analyse data and convert findings into actionable recommendations.

**2. Brand Management & Marketing**

* Contribute to strengthening DosBros' brand positioning, brand value, market presence and overall awareness across India.
* Work with external marketing consultants and the internal team to strategise, coordinate and follow up on marketing campaigns, promotional activities and brand-building initiatives, tracking timely execution and deliverables.
* Support new product launches, menu innovations, existing product promotions and seasonal campaigns, coordinating with restaurant teams for effective on-ground implementation and customer engagement.

**3. Fundraising & Investor Relations**

* Research and identify suitable investors, including angel investors, HNIs, family offices, strategic investors and funds interested in consumer, food and beverage, retail or brick-and-mortar businesses.
* Build and maintain a structured investor database and outreach pipeline, and support initial investor communication and follow-ups.
* Assist in preparing and refining investor presentations, fundraising proposals, financial models, unit economics and business expansion plans.
* Coordinate investor meetings, maintain communication records and support the fundraising process, including information sharing and due-diligence coordination.

**4. Business Development & Strategic Partnerships**

* Support franchise development, franchise partner coordination and expansion initiatives across India.
* Explore corporate partnerships, catering opportunities, packaged meals and institutional business opportunities.
* Coordinate with food delivery aggregators such as Zomato and Swiggy, POS providers, technology partners, franchise partners and other external stakeholders.
* Identify and evaluate strategic partnerships, new business models and opportunities to generate additional revenue.
* Manage business discussions, follow-ups and execution coordination with external partners.

**5. Project Management & Operational Execution**

* Take ownership of assigned business projects and drive them from planning through execution.
* Coordinate cross-functional initiatives involving marketing, finance, supply chain, technology and business development teams.
* Track project timelines, identify execution bottlenecks and follow up with relevant stakeholders.
* Ensure timely implementation of management decisions and strategic priorities.
* Prepare progress updates, reports and presentations for the Founder and senior management.

**Who Should Apply?**

We are looking for someone who:

* Has an entrepreneurial mindset and a genuine interest in startups, business strategy and company building.
* Is comfortable working in an ambiguous, fast-paced environment.
* Takes ownership and follows through without requiring constant supervision.
* Has strong analytical, research, problem-solving and communication skills.
* Can manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
* Is comfortable with business research, Excel-based analysis, presentations and external stakeholder coordination.
* Is proactive, resourceful, detail-oriented and execution-focused.

Previous exposure to a Founder's Office, CEO's Office, business strategy, business operations, fundraising, investor relations, marketing or management consulting will be an advantage, but is not mandatory.

Freshers and candidates with 0–2 years of experience are welcome to apply if they demonstrate strong initiative, ownership and entrepreneurial thinking.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Management, Engineering or a related field.
* Strong working knowledge of MS Excel, PowerPoint and Google Workspace.
* Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok.
* Strong research, documentation, presentation and analytical abilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to prepare business reports, investor presentations, research documents and analytical summaries.
* Interest in business strategy, fundraising, consumer brands and the food and beverage industry.

**Why Join Us?**

* **Direct Founder Exposure:**

  Work closely with the Founder on strategic business priorities and growth decisions.
* **Business-Building Experience:**

  Understand how a multi-outlet consumer business operates, expands and raises capital.
* **Fundraising Exposure:**

  Participate in investor research, outreach, fundraising preparation and investor coordination.
* **Cross-Functional Learning:**

  Work across strategy, marketing, brand management, business development and finance.
* **High Ownership:**

  Take responsibility for meaningful projects and see your work translate into business outcomes.
* **Career Growth:**

  Opportunity to be considered for a Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) or full-time role based on performance, contribution and business requirements.

**Internship Structure & Compensation**

* **Duration:**

  6 months.
* **Probation:**

  First 15 days of the internship.
* **Stipend:**

  ₹14,000 per month + performance based bonus upto ₹10,000.
* **Working Hours:**

  11:00 AM – 8:00 PM, Full time, work from office
* **Joining:**

  Immediate joiners only.

A PPO or full-time employment opportunity will be offered to high-performing interns, subject to their contribution, performance.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates should email their updated CV along with a short cover letter or introduction explaining:

1. Why they are interested in working in a Founder's Office.
2. Their interest in strategy, business growth, marketing or fundraising.
3. Any relevant projects, internships or experiences demonstrating ownership and execution ability.
4. Why they believe they would be a good fit for this role at Dosbros India.

**Email:**

admin@dosbros.in

pratham.dsbs@gmail.com

Application – Founder's Office Strategy & Growth Intern – Ahmedabad

**Important:**

Only candidates who are available to join immediately or within a 5 days should apply.

description:
**About Silver Touch Green RE**

Silver Touch Green RE designs and delivers renewable energy solutions for industrial, commercial and government facilities. We help organisations generate cleaner power and manage their electricity costs.

We focus on commercial and industrial (C&I) solar EPC projects and on renewable energy systems for public infrastructure and government sites. Our services cover the full project: feasibility studies, energy assessments, engineering, procurement, installation, grid connection and commissioning, all through a single point of accountability.

Every project is tailored to the facility’s layout, electricity demand, operating needs and long-term sustainability goals. We also offer monitoring and maintenance. As energy needs evolve, we are expanding into battery energy storage (BESS), hybrid solar-wind systems and floating solar.

**About the role**

We’re looking for a Project Development Manager to take C&I solar and BESS projects from feasibility and approvals through to commissioning. You’ll be the link between clients, our EPC team and the authorities.

* Prepare and track approval documents, applications and timelines
* Coordinate clients, EPC teams, consultants and authorities through to commissioning
* Support the sales team with technical inputs during proposals
* Track project milestones and flag risks early

* Hands-on experience with DISCOM, GEDA, net metering and open access approvals

*Skills*

* A working knowledge of Gujarat’s solar and open access policies and approval processes
* Strong coordination and follow-up skills with clients, contractors and government offices
* Planning, documentation and project tracking
* Clear communication and stakeholder management
* Comfortable with Excel, PowerPoint and project tracking tools

*Education and other requirements*

* A B.E./B.Tech in Electrical, Mechanical or a related field is preferred
* Willingness to travel to client sites and government offices as needed

**What we offer**

* Competitive salary
* Ownership of projects from start to finish
* Room to grow into a leadership role as the company grows
* A workplace where your work is recognised
* A real part in India’s clean energy future

Send your CV to hr@silvertouchgreen.com

**A Snapshot of Your Day**
As a Service Excellence Professional, you will support the global service organization by driving process improvement, KPI transparency, dashboard development, and data-driven decision-making across regions and functions. Your work will help standardize how we measure performance, identify process gaps, improve operational discipline, and enable stronger execution across the service business.
  
  
You will collaborate closely with global and regional stakeholders across Sales, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, Manufacturing, and Business Development to improve key performance areas such as On-Time Delivery (OTD), Quality Response Time (QRT), Order Entry, Revenue, Lead Time, and customer experience. You will also support digitalization and automation efforts by improving reporting structures, strengthening data quality, and helping convert manual processes into scalable tools and dashboards.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Support global Service Excellence initiatives by analyzing operational and commercial performance data, identifying gaps, and recommending improvement actions.
* Develop, maintain, and improve dashboards and reports that provide clear visibility into key business metrics such as OTD, QRT, Revenue, Order Entry, Lead Time, Hit Rate, and customer feedback.
* Partner with regional and global teams to standardize reporting, improve process discipline, and create one consistent version of truth across business units and regions.
* Support continuous improvement projects, process mapping, root cause analysis, and corrective action tracking to improve service performance and execution reliability.
* Help improve Salesforce (SFDC), CRM, and other business data quality by identifying inconsistencies, defining reporting requirements, and supporting user adoption.
* Prepare leadership updates, performance reviews, project summaries, and data-based insights that help stakeholders make faster and better business decisions.
* Support digital transformation, automation, and AI-enabled improvement opportunities by identifying repetitive manual work and helping translate business needs into scalable solutions.

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Supply Chain, Operations Management, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent years of experience.

* Strong analytical skills with the ability to work with large data sets, identify trends, simplify complex information, and convert findings into actionable business recommendations.
* Working knowledge of Power BI, Excel, Tableau, Salesforce, CRM systems, or similar reporting and analytics tools.
* Ability to create dashboards, management reports, process documentation, training materials, and executive-level presentations.
* Strong project coordination skills with demonstrated experience working across global, cross-functional, and matrix organizations.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills with the ability to clearly communicate insights, risks, and improvement opportunities.

Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. They help customers evaluate the platform, design the right technical approach, prove value quickly, and build confidence in adopting data streaming patterns that solve meaningful business problems. This role sits at the intersection of technical depth, customer discovery, solution design, and business value articulation.
  
  
In this role, you will partner closely with Account Executives and cross-functional teams to uncover stated and unstated customer needs, shape strong technical strategies, and guide customers toward successful adoption of Confluent. You will be expected to lead technical discovery, own the technical win, and build trusted relationships with technical and business stakeholders.
  
  
What you will do

Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Experience in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Solution Architecture, or a similar customer-facing technical role.
* Experience working with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, streaming or messaging platforms, data integration, and modern data platforms.
* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, networking, containers, Kubernetes, and modern application architectures.
* Ability to run high-quality discovery, map pain points to solution approaches, and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience leading technical evaluations, workshops, and customer presentations in complex enterprise sales cycles.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with confidence engaging developers, architects, and senior customer stakeholders.
* Hands-on experience with one or more of Java, Python, SQL, or similar technologies commonly used to build and integrate data-driven applications.
* A self-starter mindset with strong judgment, curiosity, and the ability to learn quickly, operate independently, and solve ambiguous technical problems.
* Proven ability to collaborate across functions and build trust with colleagues, customers, and partners.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Experience with Kafka, Apache Flink, stream processing, or real-time analytics platforms.
* Familiarity with value-based selling, MEDDPICC or similar qualification frameworks.
* Experience creating repeatable demos, technical content, playbooks, or enablement material for the broader field organization.

* Comfort engaging senior customer stakeholders and helping shape larger platform or transformation discussions.

description:
**Manager / Specialist – Affiliate Growth & Paid Media**

*Own affiliate acquisition end to end: build partnerships, launch offers and drive high-quality users and first transactions.*

**LOCATION**

**[Noida]**

**EXPERIENCE**

**[3–6 years]**

**GROWTH, PERFORMANCE & ANALYTICS TEAM**

**Own Affiliate Growth End to End**

Build the affiliate roadmap, source partners and execute campaigns from outreach through first transaction.

**Launch Coupon & Cashback Partnerships**

Place offers and coupon codes across deal sites, cashback apps and rewards publishers on affiliate models.

**Test Referrals & Reward Placements**

Pilot refer-and-earn, post-transaction offers, success-page scratch cards and partner-app placements.

**Work with Our Growth Stack**

Use Trackier, Apptrove, WebEngage, GA4, Firebase Analytics and Google Tag Manager to measure growth.

**Measure Acquisition & Traffic Quality**

Track verified registrations, first transactions, CAC, retention and suspicious or invalid affiliate traffic.

**Hands-On Paid Media Execution**

Run and optimise Google Ads and Meta campaigns; Google App Campaigns (UAC) knowledge is a plus.

**Lead Publisher Negotiations**

Own commercial terms, CPA/CPI/CPL/CPS or revenue-share payouts, onboarding and publisher relationships.

**Test, Optimise and Scale**

Experiment with publishers, placements, offer hooks and funnels, then scale efficient acquisition sources.

**About EaseMyDeal**

EaseMyDeal is a fast-growing FinTech company changing how India saves, spends and manages money. Our platform brings a wallet, credit cards, loans, digital gold, travel bookings, bill payments and a rewards store into one place, so everyday transactions are simpler and more rewarding.

We have 5M+ customers, and we want to build India’s leading fintech and deals ecosystem, one that goes beyond payments. We keep trying new things to give our customers more value.

We want EaseMyDeal to be a place where ideas are welcome, people are backed to grow, and anyone can take ownership of a real problem and solve it.

If you like fast-moving teams, want to help build the future of FinTech and enjoy solving real problems alongside people who care, you’ll fit right in.

And yes, **we try not to be boring.** No rigid hierarchies and not much red tape. We’ve built a strong foundation, but we’re only getting started. **That’s where you come in.**

**How We Work:** No fluff, a lot of autonomy and fast execution. No micro-management, just direct access to leadership and the freedom to do your best work.

**Recognised for building fintech that works**

**What you’ll do**

You will build and execute EaseMyDeal’s affiliate growth engine, while also managing Google and Meta paid acquisition campaigns.

**Build affiliate strategy and publisher partnerships**

* Own the affiliate growth roadmap, partner pipeline and campaign budgets across agencies, networks, direct publishers and partner apps.

* Find, pitch, onboard and negotiate performance-based campaigns using CPA, CPI, CPL, CPS, revenue-share and hybrid commercials.

**Launch coupon, referral and rewards campaigns**

* Get EaseMyDeal offers and exclusive coupon codes live across coupon websites, cashback apps, deal communities and loyalty platforms.

* Build affiliate-led referral programs, success-page offers, post-transaction scratch cards, vouchers and other partner-app placements.

**Execute campaigns and manage partner quality**

* Own partner briefs, creatives, offer terms, deep links, coupon mapping, campaign launches, pacing and payout reconciliation.

* Validate conversions, commission terms, identify duplicate or fraudulent traffic, prevent incentive abuse and optimise partners for genuine transactions.

**Plan and optimise Google and Meta paid media**

* Launch and manage Google Ads and Meta campaigns for user acquisition, in-app conversions and remarketing; UAC experience preferred.

* Test audiences, bids, creatives and landing or app funnels while managing CAC, budgets, conversion rates and ROAS.

**Measure, attribute and scale profitable growth**

* Operate tracking and insights across Trackier (affiliates), Apptrove (app attribution), WebEngage (customer events and lifecycle), GA4, Firebase Analytics and GTM.

title: HR Manager – Talent Acquisition & People Operations
description:
**Company Description** Nabhya Ayurveda is dedicated to promoting health from within, rooted in classical Ayurvedic principles. The brand centers its philosophy around the Nabhi (belly button), considered in Ayurveda as the body’s core, closely linked to digestion, metabolism, immunity, and overall balance. In a modern world where traditional wisdom is often overlooked, Nabhya Ayurveda focuses on reviving and applying these age-old insights in a contemporary, accessible way. Team members work in an environment that blends holistic wellness, scientific understanding, and customer-centered product innovation. Applicants can expect a mission-driven culture that values authenticity, learning, and a deep respect for Ayurveda.

**About the role**

About **70% of the role is recruiting**: finding, attracting and closing strong performance marketers, creative strategists, video editors, marketplace and retention specialists. The other 30% is running the floor: people operations, HRMS, attendance, onboarding, and keeping the team engaged and accountable.

You’ll report directly to the founder.

**What you’ll do**

***Recruitment (your main focus)***

* Own hiring end to end: work out what each role needs with the founder, write sharp job descriptions, source, screen, coordinate interviews, close offers and make sure people actually join
* Know where good talent is for each role, beyond job portals: LinkedIn, D2C and marketing communities, Instagram and Behance for creative roles, referrals, colleges and freelancer networks
* Build a pipeline of candidates before roles open, not after
* Run structured screening with role-specific questions, practical tasks and scorecards, so we hire on proof of work rather than résumés
* Negotiate offers, manage notice periods, and keep candidates engaged until they join
* Manage recruitment agencies and job portals (Naukri, LinkedIn, Instahyre, etc.) and track how much each source costs and what it delivers
* Build our employer brand: careers page, LinkedIn presence, and making candidates want to work here

***People operations & floor management***

* Run day-to-day floor management: attendance, discipline, leave, and making sure the office runs smoothly
* Own our HRMS (Keka, Zoho People, GreytHR or similar): employee records, attendance, leave and payroll inputs
* Coordinate monthly payroll with finance/CA and handle PF, ESIC and statutory compliance
* Run onboarding so every new hire is productive in their first week, and run exit processes properly
* Set up basic HR policies, an employee handbook and appraisal cycles as we grow
* Be the first point of contact for employee concerns, resolve conflicts early, and keep morale and retention high

**Who you are**

* **3–6 years in HR**, with most of it in recruitment
* **You’ve scaled a team before**, ideally helping a startup or D2C brand grow from a small team to 50–100+ people
* You’ve hired for **marketing, creative or e-commerce roles** and know what good looks like in them
* You know where to find talent for each kind of role, and you have a network to start with
* Hands-on with at least one HRMS, and comfortable with payroll inputs and Indian statutory compliance (PF, ESIC, PT)
* Firm but approachable on the floor. People respect you and come to you
* Fast and organised: you can run 6+ open roles at once without dropping any
* Strong communication in English and Hindi

**Bonus**

* Experience at a D2C, FMCG, e-commerce or consumer brand
* Experience setting up HR systems from scratch (policies, appraisals, handbook)
* A strong LinkedIn presence and recruiter network

**What we offer**

* **Competitive pay based on your experience and track record**
* Direct reporting to the founder: real authority, fast decisions, no layers
* The chance to build a company’s team from the ground up
* A clear path to Head of People as we scale

Pay: ₹900,000.00 - ₹1,000,000.00 per year

title: Senior Manager – Total Rewards | HR COE
description:
We are Licious, a Bengaluru-based meat and seafood company founded in 2015 by Abhay Hanjura and Vivek Gupta, our Founders, Foodies and Friends.

Today, we are proud to be one of India's most successful D2C food-tech brands, operating across 20 cities and serving over 5 million customers with fresh, high-quality products and a best-in-class de-licious consumer experience.

As we enter our next phase of growth, we are building the foundations of a future-ready, institution-grade company with strong governance, robust systems, and the ambition to operate at public-market standards.

If you have what it takes to be the magic ingredient in the recipe that is Licious, Read on....

**Role Overview**

At Licious, we’re shaping a people-first organization where thoughtful processes, meaningful programs and a strong, authentic culture help our teams do their best work. To strengthen this vision, we’re looking for a People Experience Partner who is curious, eager to learn and excited to contribute across multiple people focus areas.

In this role, you’ll work at the sweet spot where data, people programs and business priorities meet. You’ll collaborate with People Experience leaders, HRBPs, Finance and business teams to bring clarity to data, structure to systems and consistency to how our programs show up for employees Licians. Your work will influence how teams set and understand goals, how performance is recognized, how engagement is built and how our culture translates into meaningful everyday experiences for every Lician.

If you enjoy connecting details to the bigger picture, have a strong learning mindset and want to build real depth across the backbone of people experience, this role will give you the exposure, ownership and runway you need to truly grow your craft.

**What makes the role meaty?**

* You’ll get to explore every corner of People Experience - including but not limited to Total Rewards, benefits - so if you love learning fast, this is your playground.
* Work closely with other HRBPs, Talent Acquisition, the Founder’s Office, and people leaders, broadening your understanding of how people and business priorities connect.
* You’ll understand the “why” behind people decisions and build both your analytical and strategic muscles (trust us, you’ll use them everywhere)
* You’ll own projects end-to-end, experiment with ideas, and see your work come alive—no “let’s shelve this for later” energy here.
* And yes, you’ll work in a culture that values action, learning, and a good laugh—because people work is serious, but it doesn’t have to feel serious all the time.

What you'll do

* Collaborate closely with leaders/people managers to shape people projects that strengthen our culture, boost performance, and make the way we work smoother and smarter.
* Bring fresh ideas to the table, question the old way of doing things, and help improve our people systems with curiosity and intention.
* Support the creation and execution of recognition programs that make work feel more meaningful and more human.
* Keep our org structures sharp and updated, and use org design insights to help leaders make smart workforce decisions.
* Build clean, insightful dashboards and people analytics reports that turn data into clear, actionable decisions for teams across the organization.
* Spot inefficiencies quickly and help simplify processes because good People Experience is all about making things easier, not harder.

* Have at least
  **6 years of experience in total rewards**

* Be a savant in Excel/Google Sheets.
* Have a proactive approach to work, with an interest in solving problems and figuring things out independently.
* Have clear communication skills and the ability to work well with different teams.
* Have interest in people programs and the processes that help organizations run smoothly and grow.
* Have a sense of ownership, flexibility, and readiness to take on new tasks in a dynamic environment.

title: People Operations Specialist
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a hands-on People Operations Specialist to independently manage and continuously improve HR operations, working closely with our global People and Operations teams. You’ll own the day-to-day: payroll inputs, benefits, onboarding and exits, HR systems, recruitment operations and employee support. You’ll also make that work better. When you see a manual process, you’ll simplify it, automate it, or turn it into self-service, using AI and automation where they help, with care for employee data. You’ll build and improve these workflows yourself, not just identify them.

**AI-Native Operations**

We believe modern People Operations should be increasingly intelligent, automated, and employee-centric. You will actively explore how AI, automation, and better system integration can improve the quality and efficiency of HR operations.

* Identify repetitive, manual processes and implement practical automation.
* Improve employee self-service through digital workflows, knowledge resources, and intelligent assistance.
* Leverage AI tools for appropriate administrative, analytical, reporting, and recruitment-support activities.
* Measure improvements in turnaround time, data accuracy, employee experience, and manual effort.
* Apply human oversight, privacy safeguards, and sound judgment, particularly when handling confidential employee information or supporting people-related decisions.
* We value practical improvements that deliver measurable results, not technology adoption for its own sake.

**Responsibilities**

**Payroll and statutory compliance**

* Independently manage monthly payroll inputs, validation, reconciliations, and coordination with Finance and payroll partners.
* Administer full and final settlements, including applicable notice-period adjustments, leave encashment, gratuity, and recoveries.
* Manage employee tax declarations, investment proofs, Form 16, and payroll-related queries.
* Implement approved changes to compensation structures, payroll policies, and statutory requirements.
* Maintain accurate employee, compensation, attendance, and leave records.

**Benefits and vendor management**

* Administer employee benefits, including health insurance, life insurance and wellness programmes.
* Coordinate enrolments, changes, claims support and benefits queries.
* Prepare annual benefits reviews and renewals using data analysis, vendor comparisons and recommendations.
* Manage relationships with insurers, brokers and other partners, monitor service quality, and coordinate the related admin and invoicing.

**Onboarding and Offboarding**

* Manage onboarding from pre-joining documents through orientation and HR systems setup, so every new hire has a consistent, welcoming start.
* Coordinate lifecycle changes, including transfers, promotions, compensation updates and documentation.
* Manage offboarding: exit documents, clearances, F&F coordination and benefits transitions.

**HR systems and data**

* Administer our HRIS and applicant tracking system: records, workflows, reporting and data integrity.
* Configure, build and improve HR workflows, approvals and self-service, and fix them when they break.
* Build and maintain operational reports and dashboards that support decisions.
* Respond to employee queries on policies, benefits, documents and HR processes, and prepare employment letters and verifications.

**Hiring operations**

* Manage end-to-end recruitment operations: job postings, sourcing, initial screening, interview coordination, offers and background verification.
* Coordinate interviews and candidate communication across distributed teams.
* Keep the applicant tracking system and hiring reports accurate, and improve the candidate experience.

**Compliance, audits and calendars**

* Coordinate HR compliance activities, statutory reporting, POSH-related administration, and required employee training.
* Maintain appropriate records and documentation to support internal and external audits.
* Maintain key People Operations calendars, compliance deadlines, and recurring administrative processes.

**Performance, engagement and recognition**

* Support performance review cycles, compensation administration, and employee recognition programmes.
* Coordinate employee engagement initiatives, feedback surveys, and related activities.

**Qualifications**

**Essential**

* A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT or a related technical field (B.Tech, BE, BCA, BSc CS or similar).
* 5–7 years in HR operations, ideally at a startup or scale-up.
* 3+ years preparing accurate monthly payroll inputs (joiners, exits, LOP, variable pay), with a working knowledge of India statutory benefits (PF, ESI, PT, gratuity) to answer employee queries and check F&F inputs.
* Proof that you build things and don’t just use them: workflows, reports, trackers or automations you set up yourself in an HRIS, Google Sheets, Apps Script, Zapier or similar.
* You use AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT every day to create real work, and you check what they give you before you rely on it.
* You’re comfortable reading, testing, and fixing formulas, workflow rules, and simple scripts. You don’t wait for someone else to do it.
* Hands-on setup of a modern HRIS and ATS: fields, workflows, permissions and reports.
* You can run onboarding, exits, benefits, employee queries and recruitment operations on your own from start to finish.
* You’re careful with data and treat confidential information that way.
* You write and speak clearly with teams in India and the US

**Nice to have**

* An MBA or Master’s in HR alongside your technical degree.
* Experience with Rippling or a similar all-in-one HRIS.
* Basic SQL, scripting or working with APIs.
* Experience with benefits renewals, audits or performance review admin.
* Experience at a global B2B SaaS company.

You’ll enjoy this role if you see a manual process and want to fix it rather than repeat it, and you’d like HR to be an area where operations and technology meet.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Payroll, Attendance & Leave Management**

- Manage monthly attendance, leave records, LOP, overtime, incentives and payroll inputs.

- Prepare and verify monthly payroll, coordinate with Finance for salary disbursement and ensure timely payslip releases.

- Coordinate statutory payroll inputs such as PF, ESI and Professional Tax.

- Ensure payroll accuracy, confidentiality and adherence to monthly deadlines.

**2. Recruitment & Hiring**

- Manage end-to-end recruitment for approved positions, from sourcing and screening to interview coordination and onboarding.

- Publish job openings across relevant hiring platforms and maintain an active candidate pipeline.

- Coordinate interviews, assessments, reference checks and offer releases.

- Track vacancy status, hiring timelines, offer-to-joining conversion and candidate drop-offs.

**3. Employee Lifecycle & HR Documentation**

- Manage employee documentation, including offer letters, appointment letters, NDAs, KYC and personnel records.

- Coordinate employee onboarding, induction, probation, confirmation, increments, transfers and exit formalities.

- Track employee performance review milestones, including 30-60-90 day reviews.

- Ensure employee records and lifecycle changes are updated accurately and on time.

**4. Office Administration & Facilities**

- Oversee day-to-day office administration, housekeeping, pantry, maintenance and facility requirements.

- Coordinate with vendors for office maintenance, supplies and equipment-related requirements.

- Maintain office assets, administrative records and expense trackers.

- Organise employee birthdays, festivals, town halls and other internal events within approved budgets.

**5. Employee Support & HR Operations**

- Act as the first point of contact for routine employee queries related to payroll, leave, policies and documentation.

- Manage HR communications, employee announcements, holiday calendars and certificates.

- Handle employee information with confidentiality and escalate sensitive matters appropriately.

**6. HR MIS & Reporting**

- Prepare weekly recruitment MIS and monthly reports covering headcount, attrition, attendance, payroll exceptions and administration.

- Maintain HR trackers, review calendars and pending-action logs.

- Follow up with reporting managers and stakeholders to ensure timely closure of employee reviews and HR deliverables.

- Proactively identify delays, discrepancies and operational risks and escalate them.

### Desired Candidate Profile

- 3–5 years of relevant experience in HR Generalist / HR Operations / HR & Administration roles.

- Strong understanding of payroll processing, attendance management and recruitment coordination.

- Hands-on experience with employee documentation, onboarding and exit management.

- Working knowledge of PF, ESI, Professional Tax and statutory payroll processes.

- Proficiency in MS Excel / Google Sheets and HR reporting.

- Strong coordination, communication and stakeholder management skills.

- High attention to detail, confidentiality and ownership of deliverables.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities and independently drive closure.

**What We Are Looking For**

Someone who is organised, accountable and execution-driven, with the ability to manage HR operations end-to-end rather than simply coordinate activities.

**Interested?**
Share your profile with us and become a part of the Bene Kleed team.

Bene Kleed | Not for Everyone.

title: Senior Analyst- HRCS- Apprentice & Intern Administration
description:
**Do you want your voice heard and your actions to count?**
Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. Across the globe, we’re 150,000 colleagues, striving to make a difference for every client, organization, and community we serve. We stand for our values, building long-term relationships, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world.
  
  
With a vision to be the world’s most trusted financial group, it’s part of our culture to put people first, listen to new and diverse ideas and collaborate toward greater innovation, speed and agility. This means investing in talent, technologies, and tools that empower you to own your career.
  
  
Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.
  
  
**About The Role**
Position Title -Senior Analyst - Apprenticeship & Internship Administration
  
  
Corporate Title - Analyst
  
  
Reporting To - Vice President - HR Service Center
  
  
Location - Bengaluru
  
  
Function -Human Resources Central Services (HRCS)
  
  
Experience - 5 to 8 years
  
  
**Purpose of Role**
The Senior Analyst - Apprenticeship & Internship Administration will be responsible for the end-to-end administration, governance,
  
  
compliance, reporting, and operational delivery of apprenticeship and internship programs across MGS.
  
  
The role will coordinate with Business Units, HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, Finance, Payroll, Procurement,
  
  
compliance partners, and apprenticeship service providers to support workforce planning, , onboarding, statutory compliance,
  
  
stipend administration, reporting, conversions, and exits.
  
  
The incumbent will maintain appropriate controls, documentation, and audit evidence to ensure that apprenticeship and internship
  
  
programs are administered in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements and approved organizational processes.
  
  
**Main Responsibilities**

* Apprenticeship and Internship Program Administration
* Manage the end-to-end administration of apprenticeship and internship programs.
* Coordinate apprenticeship and internship activities from workforce planning through onboarding, engagement, conversion,

and separation.
  
  

* Maintain accurate records of apprentices and interns across locations and Business Units.
* Track apprenticeship agreements, engagement periods, extensions, conversions, and exits.
* Serve as the central point of contact for apprenticeship and internship administration.
* Ensure operational activities are completed within established timelines.
* Maintain appropriate supporting documents, approvals, and audit evidence.
* Workforce Planning and Hiring Projections
* Coordinate with Business Units to understand apprenticeship and internship hiring requirements.
* Consolidate annual and periodic hiring plans received from Business Units.
* Prepare hiring forecasts and projections based on approved workforce requirements.
* Track approved positions, open requirements, hiring pipelines, and fulfilment status.
* Monitor actual hiring against approved workforce plans and highlight material variances.
* Provide regular updates to HR and business stakeholders on hiring progress.
* Support planning discussions relating to apprentice and intern deployment across functions and locations.
* Campus Program Support
* Support the planning and execution of campus programs for internships, apprenticeships, and graduate/MBA intake in

partnership with Talent Acquisition and Business Units.
  
  

* Maintain the annual campus calendar, including college slots, pre-placement talks, assessments, interview days, offer

timelines, and joining dates.
  
  

* Act as the operational point of contact for partner colleges and placement offices for schedules, student data, documentation,

and follow-ups.
  
  

* Coordinate logistics for campus visits and on-site/virtual events, including travel, venue, panel availability, presentation

materials, and branding collateral.
  
  

* Support assessment and interview logistics, including scheduling, panel coordination, feedback-form collation, and

consolidation of results for decision-makers.
  
  

* Coordinate offer letters, internship letters, and joining documentation for campus selects, and track acceptances, reneges,

and pending documents.
  
  

* Support campus-to-corporate and induction programs for interns and graduate joiners, including onboarding schedules and

engagement activities.
  
  

* Track intern performance evaluations and Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) recommendations, and coordinate approvals and

documentation for conversions.
  
  

* Maintain campus trackers and MIS covering colleges engaged, demand versus fulfilment, offers, joiners, conversions, and

campus-related costs.
  
  

* Support campus budget tracking, including event, travel, and vendor costs, in coordination with Finance and Procurement.
* Capture post-season feedback from colleges, students, and Business Units, and recommend improvements for subsequent

campus cycles.
  
  

* Onboarding and Joining Formalities
* Coordinate pre-joining and onboarding activities for apprentices and interns.
* Ensure timely completion and verification of joining documents.
* Coordinate with Business Units, Talent Acquisition, IT, Facilities, Security, and service providers.
* Support apprentice and intern induction and orientation activities.
* Ensure apprentices and interns are appropriately mapped to the relevant Business Unit, manager, location, and training

program.
  
  

* Track pending documentation, system access, workplace readiness, and other onboarding requirements.
* Address onboarding-related queries and coordinate timely resolution.
* Apprenticeship Compliance
* Coordinate apprenticeship compliance activities in line with applicable regulatory requirements and approved organizational

processes.
  
  

* Work with the appointed compliance partner or apprenticeship service provider for registration, documentation, and statutory

administration.
  
  

* Track the completion of apprenticeship agreements and other mandatory documentation.
* Maintain a compliance calendar covering applicable activities, submissions, reviews, and renewals.
* Monitor compliance requirements throughout the apprenticeship lifecycle.
* Review compliance reports and follow up on exceptions, gaps, and pending actions.
* Coordinate timely closure of identified compliance issues.
* Escalate material compliance risks to the appropriate stakeholders.
* Vendor and Compliance Partner Coordination
* Act as the primary operational contact for apprenticeship service providers and compliance partners.
* Coordinate hiring, registration, onboarding, documentation, stipend support, compliance reporting, and separation activities

with vendors.
  
  

* Monitor service delivery against agreed timelines and requirements.
* Conduct periodic operational and governance reviews with service providers.
* Maintain issue trackers and follow up on open actions through closure.
* Review vendor reports and validate information against internal records.
* Support vendor contract reviews, renewals, scope discussions, and service-performance assessments.
* Escalate recurring service issues, compliance gaps, and delivery risks.
* Apprentice and Intern Lifecycle Management
* Maintain accurate lifecycle records for apprentices and interns.
* Coordinate changes relating to reporting managers, Business Units, locations, training assignments, and engagement

periods.
  
  

* Track attendance, leave, training completion, and other required information in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
* Coordinate apprentice extensions, early exits, completion of training, and conversion to full-time employment.
* Ensure lifecycle changes are supported by appropriate approvals and documentation.
* Coordinate with Business Units and HR stakeholders on apprentice performance and learning-related matters.
* Monitor upcoming completion dates and initiate required actions within defined timelines.
* Stipend, Payroll and Benefits Coordination
* Coordinate apprentice and intern inputs required for stipend or payroll processing.
* Validate joining, attendance, leave, exit, and other relevant inputs before the applicable cut-off.
* Coordinate with Payroll, Finance, service providers, and Business Units to resolve discrepancies.
* Track stipend-processing issues and ensure timely follow-up and closure.
* Support administration of approved benefits applicable to apprentices and interns.
* Maintain supporting documents and approval evidence for stipend-related inputs and changes.
* Escalate unresolved payment issues and recurring exceptions to the appropriate process owner.
* Budgeting, Forecasting and Provisioning
* Support annual and periodic budgeting for apprenticeship and internship programs.
* Prepare hiring projections and estimated costs based on approved workforce requirements.
* Maintain cost trackers for apprentice and intern hiring, stipends, vendor charges, and other program costs.
* Coordinate with Finance on budgeting, forecasting, accruals, and provisioning requirements.
* Monitor actual expenditure and hiring against approved budgets and forecasts.
* Provide periodic updates on projected costs, utilization, variances, and financial commitments.
* Maintain supporting calculations and documentation for provisioning and management reporting.
* Reporting and Analytics
* Prepare weekly, monthly, quarterly, annual, and ad hoc reports relating to apprentices and interns.
* Report on approved positions, hiring status, headcount, onboarding, attendance, attrition, extensions, conversions, exits, and

compliance.
  
  

* Develop dashboards and management information reports for HR and business leadership.
* Reconcile internal data with information received from vendors and compliance partners.
* Analyse trends, exceptions, and recurring operational or compliance issues.
* Provide accurate data for workforce planning, budgeting, governance meetings, and management reviews.
* Ensure reports are validated and shared within agreed timelines.
* Business Unit and Stakeholder Coordination
* Partner with Business Units to understand hiring requirements and program expectations.
* Provide Business Units with regular updates on hiring, onboarding, compliance, and apprentice lifecycle activities.
* Coordinate with managers on training plans, apprentice performance, learning objectives, extensions, conversions, and exits.
* Work with HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Compliance, and HR Operations.
* Communicate process requirements, timelines, responsibilities, and changes to relevant stakeholders.
* Track stakeholder actions and ensure timely follow-up and closure.
* Escalate delays, exceptions, and material risks through the appropriate governance channels.
* Governance, Risk and Audit
* Maintain SOPs, process maps, checklists, compliance trackers, approval records, and evidence repositories.
* Ensure apprenticeship and internship records remain complete and audit-ready.
* Support internal, external, statutory, and regulatory audits.
* Coordinate responses to audit queries and provide supporting documentation.
* Identify process gaps, compliance risks, and control weaknesses.
* Track audit observations and ensure timely closure of agreed corrective actions.
* Maintain confidentiality and appropriate access controls for apprentice and intern information.
* Ensure personal information is handled in accordance with applicable data-privacy and information-security requirements.
* Process Improvement
* Identify opportunities to simplify and standardize apprenticeship and internship administration.
* Improve hiring, onboarding, compliance, reporting, vendor governance, and lifecycle-management processes.
* Support automation of trackers, reports, reminders, and reconciliation activities.
* Develop and maintain SOPs, templates, checklists, and knowledge articles.
* Participate in system enhancements, user acceptance testing, and implementation activities.

**Candidate Profile**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Commerce, Finance, or a related discipline.
* 5-8 years of relevant experience in HR Operations, apprenticeship administration, internship administration, workforce

management, compliance administration, or HR Shared Services.
  
  

* Experience supporting apprenticeship, internship, contingent workforce, or early-career programs is preferred.
* Working knowledge of apprenticeship-related administration and compliance requirements.
* Experience coordinating with Business Units, external vendors, and compliance service providers.
* Experience in workforce planning, hiring projections, budgeting, cost tracking, accruals, or provisioning.
* Strong experience in management reporting, data reconciliation, and preparation of operational dashboards.
* Working knowledge of Workday or a comparable HR management system is preferred.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook.
* Good understanding of governance, documentation, audit evidence, data privacy, and control requirements.
* Strong stakeholder-management, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and follow up with stakeholders for timely closure.
* Experience in a Global Capability Centre, shared-services environment, banking captive, or large organization is preferred.
* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with integrity and discretion.
