title: Manager - People Experience & Culture
description:
**What are we looking for**

*real solver?*

**Solver? Absolutely. But not the usual kind.**
We're searching for the architects of the audacious & the pioneers of the possible. If you're the type to dismantle assumptions, re-engineer ‘best practices,’ and build solutions that make the future possible NOW, then you're speaking our language.

* **Improver. Solver. Futurist.**
* **Great sense of humor.**
* **‘Possible. It is.’ Mindset.**
* **Compassionate collaborator. Bold experimenter. Tireless iterator.**
* **Natural creativity that doesn’t just challenge the norm, but solves to design what’s better.**
* **Thinks in systems. Solves at scale.**

This Isn’t for Everyone. But if you’re the kind who questions why things are done a certain way—and then identifies 3 better ways to do it — we’d love to chat with you.

**Your Mission: The Role**

solving for better.

You are the Directly Responsible Individual (DRI) for building an AI-assisted, high-touch People Operations and Experience engine in Pune.

This is a dual-impact mission. On one side, you are the chief architect of the employee lifecycle—using smart engagement models, continuous listening tools, and AI-enabled insights to nurture a high-trust, vibrant culture where Searcians thrive. On the other side, you are the operational and compliance backbone—leveraging automation to maintain 100% legal precision, seamless HR governance, and frictionless People Operations at scale.

You aren't here to manage manual, administrative HR loops; you are a People Intelligence Engineer here to turn traditional HR processes into a modern, data-smart, and AI-augmented "People OS."

**Your Responsibilities**

*what you will wake up to solve.*

**1. Employee Experience, AI-Driven Engagement & Culture Architecture**

* **Culture Stewardship:**
  Champion Searce’s core values and ‘evlos’ mindset, embedding culture into daily habits and team rhythms rather than static decks.
* **AI-Augmented Lifecycle UX:**
  Treat the employee lifecycle as an evolving product. Integrate smart onboarding workflows, automated sentiment checks, and personalized touchpoints from Day 1 through alumni transitions.
* **Intelligent Engagement & Sentiment Data:**
  Drive continuous feedback loops and AI-assisted pulse analytics to detect attrition risk, morale shifts, and team friction before they escalate.
* **Rewards & Recognition:**
  Build and run real-time, outcome-focused recognition programs that celebrate solvers, innovators, and quiet achievers across teams.
* **Employee Relations & Advocacy:**
  Act as a trusted advisor, using human empathy paired with clear data insights to resolve grievances, mediate disputes, and maintain open organizational channels.

**2. Smart Compliance, Governance & People Operations**

* **Statutory Compliance & Legal Guardrails:**
  Own 100% adherence to central, Maharashtra state, and regional labor laws (Shops & Establishments, POSH, PF, ESI, LWF, Gratuity, Minimum Wages, Contract Labor, etc.).
* **AI-Powered Governance & Audits:**
  Maintain audit-ready employee data repositories, using automated checks to eliminate manual recordkeeping errors and ensure data hygiene.
* **POSH & Grievance Governance:**
  Serve as the functional and operational lead for the Internal Committee (IC) under POSH frameworks, guaranteeing total confidentiality, speed, and strict legal compliance.
* **Policy Design & Modernization:**
  Continuously update and digitize HR policies, using GenAI tools to synthesize policy queries, update documentation, and simplify compliance guidelines for employees.
* **Operational Telemetry:**
  Oversee regional payroll inputs, leave/attendance tracking, benefits administration, offboarding clearances, and vendor management through streamlined, tech-led workflows.

**Welcome to Searce**

*The ‘process-first’, AI-native modern tech consultancy that's rewriting the rules.*

**We don’t do traditional.**

As an engineering-led consultancy, we are dedicated to relentlessly improving real business outcomes. Our solvers co-innovate with clients to futurify operations and make processes smarter, faster & better. We build alongside our clients. Not for the vanity metrics. But for the transformation to embed lasting competitive advantage for our clients.

The result? Modern business reinvention, built on math, tech, and clarity of purpose.

**Functional Skills**

* **Process-First HR Engineering:**
  Capability to break down complex HR workflows into clean, automated, zero-latency processes before layering on software.
* **Statutory & Legal Mastery:**
  Deep, practical knowledge of Indian labor compliance frameworks, state-specific regulations (Maharashtra), and HR audit readiness.
* **Data Science Translation:**
  Experience converting qualitative feedback and survey responses into structured data and actionable interventions.
* **Culture & Engagement Design:**
  Designing engagement initiatives as scalable, high-adoption features rather than one-off, check-the-box events.
* **Crisis Management & Fair Resolution:**
  High emotional intelligence, objectivity, and operational calmness when managing complex legal escalations or employee grievances.

**Tech Superpowers**

* **AI & HR-Tech Orchestration:**
  Hands-on experience with modern HRMS platforms, workflow automation, and integrating AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, custom GPTs) to speed up HR communications and policy retrieval.
* **Predictive Sentiment & Telemetry:**
  Ability to build and read live HR dashboards, replacing static presentations with real-time data loops on attrition, performance, and satisfaction.
* **Process Automation:**
  Familiarity with low-code/no-code automation tools (Zapier, Google Workspace AppSheet, Looker Studio, or native HRMS integrations) to eliminate repetitive admin tasks.

**Experience & Relevance**

* **Experience:**
  12+ years in cloud, data or platform engineering, including 7+ years leading delivery across multiple client engagements and crafts.
* **Education:**
  Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Computer Science, or equivalent.
* **Track Record:**
  Has taken enterprise platforms that run AI or agent workloads into production for multiple clients.
* **Still Builds:**
  Has personally shipped something with a large language model in the recent past, not only overseen a team that did.
* **Team Scale:**
  Has led a delivery organisation of engineers and architects across more than one craft.

**Bonus Points (you will thrive if you have...)**

* **Disruptive HR Thinker:**
  A track record of challenging administrative HR norms in favor of faster, data-backed ways of working.
* **AI Early Adopter:**
  You actively experiment with LLMs, AI agents, or automated workflows in your personal or professional productivity stack to solve HR problems faster.

**Join the ‘real solvers’**

ready to futurify?

If you are excited by the possibilities of what an AI-native engineering-led, modern tech consultancy can do to futurify businesses, apply here and experience the ‘
*Art of the possible*
’.

**Don’t Just Send a Resume. Send a Statement.**

title: People Operations Specialist (US focused)
description:
**People Operations Specialist**

Remote, US/ Pune, India

**About HG**

HG Insights is the pioneer of Revenue Growth Intelligence. For more than a decade, we have delivered comprehensive, AI- driven datasets on B2B buyers, technology adoption, IT spend, and buyer intent, sourced from billions of data points.

Today, we are a trusted partner to Fortune 500 technology companies, hyperscalers, and innovative B2B vendors seeking precise go-to-market analytics and decision-making. Through an evolving suite of AI agents that incorporate first-party data and buyer signals, HG Insights enables AI-powered GTM automation across sales, marketing, RevOps, and data analytics teams, modernizing GTM execution from strategy through activation.

**About the Role**

At HG Insights, our people are everything and this role exists to make sure they feel that every single day. We are looking for a People Operations Specialist who is not just experienced, but genuinely passionate about building people functions that work, This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who has been in the trenches of building HR from the ground up ideally in a fast-moving, high-growth technology environment and who knows what it takes to create structure, clarity and consistency without losing the human touch along the way. You will be reporting to the Senior Director, People and will be the engine behind our People team across the region executing with precision, consistency and care while our People leaders set the strategy and roadmap.

This role was created because our US people's needs have grown significantly and the complexity that comes with that growth deserves dedicated, expert attention. From contracts and benefits administration to immigration law and policy writing, you will own the pieces of our US people function that require real depth, real expertise and real commitment to getting things right. If you are a high-agency builder who thrives on taking ownership and turning ambiguity into structure, this role is for you. We need someone who isn't afraid to roll up their sleeves and do the heavy lifting, but who also wants the autonomy to design, iterate, and scale the processes that define our People Experience.

**What you’ll do**

* Own the drafting, review and management of all AMER employment contracts, offer letters, amendments and separation agreements
* Ensure all employment documentation is legally compliant, up to date and aligned with US federal and state requirements
* Partner with legal counsel where required on complex or non-standard employment arrangements
* Own end-to-end US benefits administration health, dental, vision, 401(k), wellness reimbursements and all ancillary benefits
* Manage open enrolment processes, vendor relationships and employee benefits queries with accuracy and care
* Ensure benefits programmes are competitive, compliant and clearly communicated to all US employees
* Design, write and maintain US people policies that are legally compliant, clearly written and genuinely employee-friendly
* Proactively track changes in AMER federal and state employment law and update policies and practices before they become a problem
* Ensure our US Employee Handbook is current, consistent and reflects who we are as a company
* Manage all US immigration processes including H-1B, OPT, STEM OPT, green card sponsorship and I-9 compliance
* Partner with external immigration counsel to ensure timely and accurate processing of all visa and work authorisation cases
* Serve as the internal point of expertise on immigration matters advising employees and managers with clarity and confidence
* Support the full US employee lifecycle from onboarding to offboarding ensuring every touchpoint is smooth, consistent and handled with care
* Be the trusted, go-to person for US employees on all people-related queries and processes
* Partner with the broader global People team to ensure US processes are aligned with global standards and frameworks
* Support HRIS data integrity, reporting accuracy and system adoption across all people platforms
* Partner with senior People leaders to evaluate, select and implement the HR systems and tools that will power our people function
* Drive employee engagement initiatives, pulse surveys and action planning globally.
* Collaborate closely with Finance, IT, Talent Acquisition and cross-functional teams to identify opportunities for process improvement, streamline operations and elevate the overall employee experience end to end.

**What we are looking for**

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 7+ years of progressive HR / People experience with strong US specific expertise
* Proven experience in a SMB SaaS or technology company you understand the pace, the constraints and the opportunity
* Hands-on experience with US benefits administration you have managed open enrolment, vendor relationships and employee queries
* Hands-on experience with one or more HRIS platforms such as Workday, Namely, BambooHR, SAP SuccessFactors, Rippling or Lattice with proven ability to implement, optimise and manage these systems at scale.
* Strong knowledge of US employment law across federal and multiple state jurisdictions
* Demonstrable experience managing US immigration processes H-1B, OPT, green card and I-9 compliance
* Excellent policy writing skills you can translate complex legal requirements into clear, readable language
* Experience drafting and reviewing employment contracts and separation agreements
* A self-starter who takes ownership, operates with high integrity and thrives in a lean, fast-moving environment

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting a global People team across multiple regions
* Exposure to compensation benchmarking and total rewards in a US tech environment
* Experience leveraging AI tools to improve HR processes and efficiency

**What we offer/Benefits**

We take care of our people fully and genuinely. Every HG Insights employee receives comprehensive healthcare coverage for themselves and their families, a monthly wellness reimbursement and access to Able To professional mental health coaching for stress, anxiety and depression support as per the regions. For your financial future, US employees benefit from a 401(k) with up to 5% company matching and UK and India employees are enrolled in a pension scheme. Every employee also receives stock options because the people who build this company should share in its success.

A remote first role within the United States/India, complemented by periodic travel to HG Insights hub locations for key business and team engagements.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

HG Insights is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the event of a recruiter or agency submitting a resume or candidate without a signed agreement being in place, we explicitly reserve the right to pursue and hire such candidates without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of HG Insights.

title: Workday Compensation & Benefits Analyst
description:
L2 Support Operations: Application Support & Maintenance
  
  

* Ticket & Case Management: Acknowledge, troubleshoot, and resolve daily employee and manager inquiries concerning core benefits elections, total rewards statements, and compensation visibility within defined SLAs.
* Data Administration & EIBs: Prepare, validate, and execute bulk data uploads via Enterprise Interface Builders (EIBs) for compensation grid adjustments, allowance variations, and benefit enrollment data.
* Routine Audits & Payroll Alignment: Perform regular data integrity checks on employee benefit deductions, compensation grades/profiles, and alignment rules to maintain cross-system payroll precision.
* Lifecycle Event Execution: Process standard benefits life events (e.g., qualifying status changes such as marriage, birth, or location updates) alongside off-cycle and ad-hoc compensation changes.
* Business Process Support: Monitor in-flight transactions, unblock stalled approval workflows, and support standard business process (BP) routing.

L3 Support Operations: Core Configuration & Cycle Execution
  
  

* Advanced Comp Cycle Architecture: Lead end-to-end design, tenant staging, configuration, and testing for the Annual Merit Review Process—including guideline grids, pool allocations, target calculations, proration rules, and compensation matrices.
* Benefits Plan Configuration: Build and maintain medical, dental, vision, life, disability, and retirement plans, configuring benefit groups, eligibility rules, and custom coverage/cost formulas.
* Open Enrollment (OE) Leadership: Direct functional staging, tenant setup, and execution for the annual Open Enrollment window, validating passive enrollment rules and election event flows.
* Complex Troubleshooting & Root-Cause Analysis: Diagnose and remediate matrix calculation discrepancies, multi-plan eligibility conflicts, and upstream/downstream security domain restrictions.
* Reporting & Analytics: Develop complex Advanced Custom Reports, Matrix Reports, calculated fields, and BIRT (Business Intelligence and Reporting Tools) templates to generate customized Compensation Review Statements.
* Security & Governance: Maintain and audit Domain Security Policies (DSP) and Business Process Security Policies (BPSP) to safeguard sensitive compensation and benefits data access.
* Release Management: Evaluate, test, and adopt bi-annual Workday release updates across Compensation and Benefits modules.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* Experience: 3–6+ years of hands-on experience supporting and configuring Workday Human Capital Management (HCM), specifically across Advanced Compensation and Benefits modules.
* Technical Skills: Proven track record configuring Merit, Bonus, and Stock cycles from scratch. Deep understanding of Workday security models (role-based, user-based, and intersection security groups).
* Process Knowledge: Strong functional grounding in total rewards, global benefits administration, open enrollment workflows, and payroll integration dependencies.
* Problem-Solving & Communication: Solid analytical skills for root-cause diagnosis paired with clear communication for executive stakeholders, cross-functional HR teams, and end users.
* Certifications: Workday adv compensation or benefit certification is preferred.

title: Lead Enablement Solutions
description:
**About Data Axle:**

Data Axle Inc. has been an industry leader in data, marketing solutions, sales and research for over 50 years in the USA. Data Axle now as an established strategic global centre of excellence in Pune. This centre delivers mission critical data services to its global customers powered by its proprietary cloud-based technology platform and by leveraging proprietary business & consumer databases.

Data Axle Pune is pleased to have achieved certification as a Great Place to Work!

**General Summary:**

The Enablement Solutions Lead owns the revenue enablement platform end to end and serves as Data Axle's single point of accountability for it. This position leads the migration and consolidation of content, learning, and coaching capability from existing systems into the platform, then owns the platform on an ongoing basis — configuration, governance, program build, reporting, support, and adoption. Acting as a trusted partner to Sales, Marketing, Product, and Enablement stakeholders, this role identifies and leads the conversations required to drive real adoption, surfaces barriers early, and translates platform data into insight leadership can act on. This position also owns the working relationship with the platform vendor team.

**Essential Job Functions:**

* Own the enablement platform end to end, including configuration, administration, governance, user and permission management, integrations, content taxonomy, and evaluation and rollout of new platform releases and capabilities.

* Lead the migration and consolidation of content, learning assets, and programs from existing platforms into the current platform — including content audit and mapping, taxonomy and metadata design, data validation, cutover planning, and decommissioning of legacy systems.

* Design and build programs in the platform across core modules, including content management, modern learning and onboarding, AI role play and coaching, conversation intelligence, and digital sales rooms; structure learning journeys, assignments, certifications, and completion workflows that deliver a consistent and scalable ramp experience.

* Develop learning assets outside the platform for delivery within it, including eLearning modules, video and microlearning, job aids, and quick reference guides; package and import content to platform and corporate standards, including SCORM or xAPI compliance, video formatting, captioning, and accessibility requirements.

* Partner with subject matter experts across Sales, Product, and Marketing to extract and structure their expertise into learning assets, and curate or adapt existing and third-party content where building from scratch is not warranted.

* Own reporting and analytics on usage, adoption, content performance, learning completion, and readiness, using native platform reporting and enterprise business intelligence tools such as Power BI; provide visibility to sales leadership, HR partners, and enablement leadership, and turn platform data into recommended action rather than dashboards alone.

* Drive adoption across the organization: identify the stakeholder conversations, training, and change management required to move each audience from awareness to habit; proactively surface resistance, gaps, and barriers and bring solutions.

* Drive continuous improvement of platform programs through KPI tracking, learner and end-user feedback, root cause analysis, and platform enhancements.

* Maintain governance, documentation, and service standards across all enablement platform operations, including intake, request turnaround, content review and refresh cycles, source file and asset version control, and administrative runbooks.

* Own the vendor relationship as primary point of contact for support escalation, roadmap review, business reviews, release planning, managed service engagements, and input to renewal and contract decisions.

* Provide ongoing platform support and enablement for end users and administrators, including documentation, admin training, office hours, and troubleshooting.

* Essential functions are the basic job duties that an employee must be able to perform, with or without reasonable accommodation. The function is considered essential if the reason the position exists is to perform that function.

**Supportive Job Functions: \***

* Contribute to evaluation of adjacent enablement technologies, integration opportunities, and overall enablement tech stack strategy.

* Support broader initiatives as necessary including go-to-market activity, training programs, corporate marketing programs and content development.

* Perform additional sales enablement tasks as required by leadership.

* These tasks do not meet the Americans with Disabilities Act definition of essential job functions and usually equal 5% or less of time spent. However, these tasks still constitute important performance aspects of the job.

Requirements:

**Knowledge, Skill, and Abilities:**

* Hands-on administration experience with a revenue or sales enablement platform, including configuration, permissions, content taxonomy, reporting, and integrations.

* Platform migration experience: content audit and mapping, taxonomy design, data validation, cutover, and legacy system decommissioning.

* Strong analytical skills, including hands-on reporting and dashboard development in Power BI or a comparable business intelligence tool, and the ability to translate usage data into a clear narrative and a recommended action.

* Change management and adoption capability, including the ability to identify the right stakeholder conversations and lead them without direct authority over the audience.

* Expert project management skills across multiple, concurrent workstreams; deadline-driven with flawless attention to detail.

* Comfort working with technical integrations such as CRM, single sign-on, and HRIS, and partnering effectively with IT and Information Security.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document clearly and train non-technical users at all levels.

* Applied knowledge of adult learning and instructional design, with the ability to design learning solutions and journeys rather than only configure the system that delivers them.

* Hands-on proficiency with eLearning authoring and video production tools such as Articulate 360 (Storyline and Rise), Camtasia, or Adobe Captivate, including SCORM and xAPI packaging, video editing, and captioning.

* Ability to work effectively with subject matter experts who are not instructional designers, translating unstructured expertise into usable learning content on a deadline.

**Education, Experience, and Certification: \***

* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience preferred.

* 5-7+ years in revenue or sales enablement, enablement operations, learning operations, or enablement platform ownership; enterprise B2B experience preferred.

* Demonstrated end-to-end ownership of at least one enablement, LMS, or content management platform implementation or migration.

* Allego administration experience or certification strongly preferred; equivalent hands-on experience with a comparable enablement platform will be considered.

* Experience with Salesforce, Power BI, and adjacent sales enablement, learning, and content tools.

* Experience designing and delivering onboarding or ramp programs, including the first 90 days, preferred.

* Portfolio or work samples of learning assets authored outside a delivery platform and deployed through it.

* Experience working with enterprise sales teams in the marketing technology or data services industry preferred.

* Experience innovating with AI to improve processes, adoption, and content quality.

* Minimum requirements needed to perform the job.

**Scope of Job:**

* No direct or indirect reports. Will work across multiple teams to ensure platform success.

* No supervisory responsibility: Exercises independent judgment on platform configuration, governance, and adoption approach.

* Working conditions are good, with some travel for sales meetings, vendor meetings, or industry events, and a consistent workweek.

* Errors are not always detectible and may be serious and costly, including impacts to content accuracy, platform availability, and data integrity.

* Contact with others inside and outside the Company is regular and frequent, including direct ownership of a vendor relationship.

* Access to confidential company and client data, including sales performance data and employee training and certification records.

description:

We are looking for a Payroll & HR Operations professional with strong hands-on experience in end-to-end payroll processing, statutory compliance, and HR operations.
  
  
The role will primarily focus on monthly payroll, PF/ESI, attendance, leave, Full & Final Settlement, payroll reconciliation, and employee lifecycle management, with hands-on experience in Zoho People/Zoho Payroll preferred.

* Ensure accurate and timely salary processing and payroll closure.
* Handle PF, ESI, TDS, and other statutory compliance requirements.
* Manage Full & Final Settlements for exiting employees.
* Reconcile payroll with attendance, employee master data, bank records, and statutory deductions.
* Manage attendance and leave data and resolve discrepancies before payroll closure.
* Handle payroll-related employee queries and salary discrepancies.
* Manage employee payroll data and changes in HRMS/payroll systems.
* Support onboarding, employee movements, exits, and other HR lifecycle activities.

* Strong hands-on experience in independently managing monthly payroll.
* Practical knowledge of PF, ESI, TDS, and statutory compliance.
* Strong experience in Full & Final Settlement.
* Good knowledge of attendance, leave, LOP, deductions, arrears, and reimbursements.
* Hands-on experience with HRMS/payroll systems; Zoho People/Zoho Payroll preferred.
* Strong MS Excel and payroll reconciliation skills.
* Strong numerical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* High attention to detail and confidentiality.
* Good stakeholder management and communication skills.

**Preferred Experience**

* Payroll management for a mid-sized or large employee base.
* Experience with Zoho People/Zoho Payroll implementation or process management.
* Experience handling payroll audits and reconciliations.
* Experience with attendance/biometric and leave management systems.

title: Human Resources Specialist
description:
**About The Corelation**

The Corelation is a boutique talent search firm specialising in mid-to-senior management and senior leadership hiring across industries and functional domains. Our approach is built on tri-axial fitment - a deep alignment between the candidate's profile, the role, and the hiring team. By weighing technical capability and cultural fit with equal rigour, we find professionals who don't just fit in, but outperform.

**About the Opportunity**

We are hiring on behalf of our client, a well-established organisation in the events and conference management space (client name confidential at this stage), for a Human Resources Specialist based in Delhi NCR. This is a broad, hands-on generalist mandate covering the full employee lifecycle - recruitment, employee relations, performance management, benefits and statutory compliance - with direct visibility to management.

Location: Delhi NCR

Employment Type: Full-time, On-site

Experience: 2-5 years

Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Human Resources Management, Business Administration or a related field

**About the Role**

The Human Resources Specialist plays a critical role in ensuring the effective functioning of the organisation's human capital. The role is responsible for a range of HR activities, including recruitment, employee relations, performance management, benefits administration and compliance with labour laws and regulations.

The HR Specialist acts as a liaison between management and employees, fostering a positive work environment and supporting the organisation's strategic objectives. The role contributes to the overall success and effectiveness of the organisation by attracting, retaining and developing top talent.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Recruitment and Selection**

• Collaborate with hiring managers to identify staffing needs and develop job descriptions.

• Source and screen candidates through various channels, including job boards, social media and networking.

• Conduct interviews and coordinate the selection process, including reference checks and background screenings.

• Facilitate the onboarding process for new hires, ensuring a smooth transition into the organisation.

**Employee Relations**

• Serve as a point of contact for employees regarding HR-related inquiries, concerns and grievances.

• Mediate conflicts and facilitate resolution between employees and management.

• Implement employee engagement initiatives to foster a positive work culture and enhance morale.

**Performance Management**

• Administer performance appraisal processes, including goal setting, performance evaluation and feedback sessions.

• Provide guidance and support to managers and employees on performance-related issues.

• Identify training and development needs and coordinate relevant programmes to enhance employee skills and competencies.

**Benefits Administration**

• Administer employee benefits programmes, including health insurance, retirement plans and other perks.

• Assist employees with benefit enrolment, changes and inquiries.

• Collaborate with benefits providers to ensure compliance and resolve issues effectively.

**Compliance and HR Administration**

• Stay up to date with labour laws, regulations and HR best practices.

• Ensure compliance with applicable central and state labour laws and statutory requirements, including PF, ESI, gratuity and Shops & Establishments.

• Maintain accurate HR records and documentation to support compliance efforts.

• Prepare HR reports and analytics to support decision-making and strategic planning.

• Assist in developing and updating HR policies, procedures and the employee handbook.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

• Bachelor's degree in Human Resources Management, Business Administration or a related field.

• 2-5 years of experience in HR roles, preferably in a similar industry.

• Knowledge of HR principles, practices and regulations.

• Strong communication, interpersonal and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information with discretion.

• Proficiency in the Microsoft Office Suite.

**Preferred Qualifications**

• HR certification such as PHR or SHRM-CP.

• Experience supporting a people-facing, project-driven business.

**How to Apply**

Apply through LinkedIn with your updated CV, along with your current CTC and expected CTC. Applications without these details may not be processed. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted by The Corelation for an initial conversation.

title: Senior Lead, Implementation
description:
***World Change Starts with Educated Children®***
=================================================

**IMPORTANT: All applicants must be legally eligible to work in the country where the position is located. Room to Read is not able to provide sponsorship.**
=============================================================================================================================================================

**Position Overview:**
----------------------

The Senior Lead, Implementation, is a member of the Operations team and reports directly to the Program Operations Director (POD). The position is responsible for overseeing and coordinating program implementation and operational activities across 2 - 3 states, to ensure timely delivery of approved program plans and operational priorities. The role will work closely with Country Office teams to address operational issues, facilitate cross-functional coordination, and support effective program implementation. The position requires regular travel to field locations and engagement with government officials, partners, school leaders, and teachers. The role will facilitate coordination between state teams, program functions, government stakeholders, donors, and implementation partners, ensuring that state operations remain aligned with approved program priorities, compliance requirements, and annual business plans.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

### **Multi-State Strategic and Operational Leadership: Program Quality – Delivery – Reporting:**

  

* Oversee the implementation of Literacy, Girls’ Education (GEP), Library, FLN and other relevant programs across assigned states, ensuring alignment with approved program designs, implementation calendars and quality standards.
* Monitor program implementation against approved plans, milestones and KPIs, identify deviations and coordinate timely corrective actions with State Heads and relevant teams.
* Work closely with technical/program teams (IDTS) to ensure program quality and fidelity to approved designs and organizational standards.
* Conduct monthly field visits across assigned states to review program implementation, identify operational challenges and follow up on agreed actions.
* Coordinate with RM&E teams to review program data, assess implementation progress, identify gaps and recommend improvements.
* Conduct monthly Operations calls and periodic performance reviews to monitor progress, address implementation challenges and ensure timely completion of agreed actions.
* Facilitate cross-state learning, sharing of effective practices and improvements in operational processes.
* Coordinate with HR and State Heads to identify staffing requirements, capacity gaps and operational support needs to ensure timely program delivery.
* Review state performance against annual plans, resource requirements and operational priorities, and highlight significant concerns to the Program Operations Director (POD).
* Coordinate with relevant Country Office departments to facilitate effective implementation and resolution of operational issues.
* Consolidate and review monthly and quarterly program reports from assigned states, coordinating with RM&E teams to ensure timely submission to the Country Office and Global Office.

### **Government & External Stakeholder Management:**

  

* Maintain effective working relationships with State Governments, Education Departments, SCERTs, Samagra Shiksha, district administrations and other relevant government institutions.
* Support State Heads in government engagement, stakeholder coordination and resolution of operational issues affecting program implementation.
* Participate in government meetings, consultations, program reviews and relevant forums as required.
* Coordinate follow-up on MoUs, partnership agreements, government approvals and renewals, ensuring timely documentation and compliance with agreed requirements.
* Monitor developments in government priorities and policies affecting program implementation and highlight relevant risks and required actions to the POD.

### **Financial Management, Tracking Financial Utilization Across States:**

  

* Monitor financial utilization across assigned states against approved budgets, implementation plans and expenditure projections.
* Review monthly financial trackers and cash forecasts from state teams, ensuring timely and accurate submission to the Finance team.
* Identify significant budget variances, expenditure trends and financial risks, and coordinate corrective actions in consultation with Finance and the POD.
* Support State Heads in reviewing budget requirements, resource utilization and financial planning for effective program implementation.
* Coordinate timely responses to financial queries from the Country Office and Global Office and ensure adherence to financial policies and reporting timelines.

### **Central Operations Role:**

  

* Coordinate with Country Office and Global Office counterparts on operational matters, facilitate resolution of issues and ensure timely responses to program and budget-related queries.
* Coordinate the Annual Planning & Budgeting (AP&B) process across assigned states, including review, consolidation and timely submission of state plans, budgets and required documentation.
* Support the POD in monitoring operational priorities, coordinating cross-functional activities and following up on agreed actions across assigned states.
* Promote accountability, collaboration, effective communication and continuous improvement across assigned state operations.
* Monitor operational risks relating to government relationships, MoUs, staffing, finances, safeguarding, program continuity, compliance and external developments, ensuring timely escalation of significant concerns to the POD.
* Use program and operational data to monitor performance, identify implementation gaps and recommend process improvements.

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

### **Required:**

  

* Master’s degree in Management, Education or a related field.
* Minimum 8–10 years of relevant experience in program or project management, preferably in the education or development sector, including experience overseeing implementation across multiple locations or states.
* Possess strong data analysis skills for both programs.
* Possess strong financial management expertise, including annual planning, budgeting, budget outlook, cash forecasting, and the ability to analyze and track budgets for various programs.
* Excellent managerial and interpersonal skills, including skills in managing and mentoring people.
* Demonstrates excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.
* Should be willing to travel to various states for a minimum of 8-10 days per month.

**Compensation:**

Room to Read offers a competitive salary with excellent benefits. Benefits include a thirteenth month bonus, health insurance and a retirement plan. The non-monetary compensation includes a unique opportunity to be part of an innovative, meaningful, and rapidly growing organization that is changing and transforming the lives of millions of children in developing countries through literacy and gender equality in education.

**Room to Read is a child-safe organization.**

**Read is a child-safe organization; all personnel must adhere to Room to Read’s Child Protection Policy, Child Protection Code of Conduct and Prevention of Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (PSEA) Policy.**
===========================================================================================================================================================================================================

**Room to Read is an equal opportunity employer committed to identifying and developing the skills and leadership of people from diverse backgrounds.**
=======================================================================================================================================================

  

**Child Protection Principles**
===============================

* Room to Read is committed to the education and welfare of children and protecting them from abuse and exploitation
* Room to Read has zero tolerance for child abuse and exploitation.
* All children have the right to be free from abuse and exploitation, including neglect, maltreatment, and physical, mental or sexual violence, injury or abuse.
* All children should be treated with respect and dignity.
* The well-being of the child is Room to Read’s first priority when dealing with all identified or suspected cases of child abuse.
* Room to Read shall integrate child protection into all its organizational strategies, structures and work practices.

**Protection from Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (PSEA) Principles**
===================================================================

* Room to Read Representatives must create and maintain an environment that prevents sexual exploitation and sexual abuse.
* Room to Read has zero tolerance for adult sexual exploitation and abuse.
* Sexual exploitation and abuse are serious violations of fundamental human rights and will not be accepted or tolerated.
* All adults should be treated with respect and dignity.
* Room to Read implements a survivor-centered approach, putting the survivor’s rights and dignity at the forefront.
* Survivors referred to available professional assistance (e.g. mental health counselling), upon consent.

***About Room to Read:***

Founded in 2000 on the belief that World Change Starts with Educated Children®, *Room to Read envisions a world free from illiteracy and gender inequality, where all children have room to read, learn and grow – creating lasting change*. Through our Literacy Portfolio, we train and coach teachers of the early grades in literacy instruction; create and publish quality books and curricular materials in local languages; and establish children’s libraries filled with diverse children’s books that can be enjoyed at school and home. Our Gender Equality Portfolio supports adolescents, particularly girls, in developing life skills that promote gender equality, helping them to pursue lifelong learning and make informed decisions.

We support young people of all genders to overcome gender biases and build the knowledge and skills to create a gender-equal world. Room to Read collaborates with local communities, partner organizations, publishers, and governments to test and implement innovative models that can be integrated into the education system to deliver positive outcomes for children at scale. To date, Room to Read has benefited more than 50 million children in 28 countries.

Learn more at www.roomtoread.org.

**Job Title: HR Operations Lead (Payroll, Compliance & People Analytics)**

**Location: Noida**

**About the Role**

We are seeking a sharp, analytical, and process-driven **HR Operations Lead** to take full ownership of our payroll administration, statutory compliance, and people data analytics. You will serve as the operational anchor of our HR team, ensuring 100% accuracy in employee compensation, airtight adherence to labor laws, and data-backed decision-making across the organization.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Payroll & Benefits Administration**

* Own end-to-end monthly payroll processing for 1000 employees, ensuring accurate inputs for attendance, leaves, overtime, variable pay, reimbursements, and full-and-final (F&F) settlements.

* Administer employee benefits programs—including group health insurance, term life, and wellness perks—ensuring smooth onboarding, renewals, and claims support.
* Resolve complex employee payroll and tax queries within defined SLAs while maintaining strict confidentiality.

**2. Statutory & Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure 100% timely compliance with all applicable labor laws and statutory filings, including **PF, ESI, Professional Tax (PT), Labour Welfare Fund (LWF), Gratuity, Maternity Benefit, and the Shops & Establishments Act**.
* Manage statutory registers, returns, and documentation required for government inspections, internal audits, and external due diligence.
* Stay ahead of changes in Indian labor laws and wage codes, proactively updating internal policies, salary structures, and HR handbooks to mitigate legal and financial risks.
* Oversee workplace compliance mandates, including POSH documentation, background verifications (BGV), and employee data privacy standards.

**3. People Data Analytics & HRIS Management**

* Design, build, and maintain automated HR dashboards tracking core metrics such as headcount, attrition trends, compensation benchmarks, payroll variance, and overtime costs.
* Conduct deep-dive data analysis to identify workforce trends, forecast hiring/attrition budgets, and present actionable insights to senior leadership.
* Manage the HRIS and payroll software ([Insert Tools, e.g.,PeopleStrong, Darwinbox, Keka, GreytHR, Workday]), ensuring data hygiene, regular system audits, and workflow automation.
* Reconcile HRIS records with Finance and Payroll ledgers every month to eliminate discrepancies.

**4. Core HR Operations**

* Oversee seamless onboarding and offboarding workflows, ensuring accurate documentation, contract generation, and exit clearances.
* Standardize HR SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) to make operations scalable as headcount grows.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* **Experience:** 8+ years of progressive experience in HR Operations, with at least 2–3 years leading payroll, statutory compliance, and HR analytics.
* **Domain Expertise:** Deep, hands-on knowledge of Indian payroll processing, income tax rules, and statutory labor compliances.
* **Analytical & Tech Skills:** Advanced proficiency in **MS Excel / Google Sheets** (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, Macros, complex formulas) and experience with BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) is a strong plus.
* **System Proficiency:** Hands-on experience administering modern HRIS and payroll platforms (e.g., Keka, Darwinbox, GreytHR, SAP SuccessFactors, or Workday).
* **Attributes:** High attention to detail, strong numerical aptitude, absolute integrity with sensitive data, and the ability to collaborate effectively with Finance, Legal, and Leadership teams.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Commerce, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.

title: Human Resource Executive
description:
HR MANAGER – HEROMOTOCORP DEALERSHIP

Company: SMSG Automobiles

Location: Baguihati, Kolkata

Department: Human Resources & Administration

Position: HR Manager

Industry: Automobile / Two-Wheeler Dealership

Employment Type: Full-Time

Reporting To: Dealer Principal / Management

1.⁠ ⁠Job Purpose

To independently manage and oversee all Human Resource and administrative functions of the dealership, ensuring effective manpower planning, recruitment, employee development, performance management, employee engagement and statutory compliance.

The HR Manager will be responsible for building a disciplined, productive and performance-driven workforce across Sales, Service, Spares, Insurance, Accounts and Administration departments.

2.⁠ ⁠Key Roles & Responsibilities

A. Manpower Planning & Recruitment

**⁠ ⁠Identify manpower requirements in coordination with respective department heads.**

**⁠ ⁠Plan and execute recruitment drives for Sales Executives, Service Technicians, Service Advisors, Parts Executives, Telecallers, Back Office and managerial positions.**

**⁠ ⁠Manage end-to-end recruitment, including job postings, screening, interviews, selection and onboarding.**

**⁠ ⁠Maintain a database of prospective candidates for critical positions.**

**⁠ ⁠Ensure timely fulfilment of manpower requirements across all departments.**

B. HR Operations & Employee Management

**⁠ ⁠Maintain employee records, personal files, appointment letters and employment documentation.**

**⁠ ⁠Manage employee attendance, leave records, shift schedules and punctuality.**

**⁠ ⁠Ensure proper joining formalities, induction and exit procedures.**

**⁠ ⁠Monitor employee discipline and workplace conduct.**

**⁠ ⁠Handle employee grievances and resolve workplace issues professionally.**

**⁠ ⁠Maintain updated organisational charts and employee master data.**

C. Payroll & Compensation Management

**⁠ ⁠Coordinate monthly payroll processing, salary calculations and incentive payouts.**

**⁠ ⁠Monitor attendance, overtime, leave adjustments and salary deductions.**

**⁠ ⁠Ensure timely salary disbursement.**

**⁠ ⁠Manage employee incentives, performance-linked payouts and statutory deductions.**

**⁠ ⁠Coordinate with the Accounts Department for payroll reconciliation.**

D. Statutory Compliance & Labour Laws

**⁠ ⁠Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and employment regulations.**

**⁠ ⁠Manage PF, ESIC, Professional Tax, Labour Welfare Fund and other applicable statutory requirements.**

**⁠ ⁠Maintain statutory registers, employee records and compliance documentation.**

**⁠ ⁠Coordinate statutory audits, inspections and renewals wherever applicable.**

**⁠ ⁠Ensure timely filing of applicable statutory returns and payments.**

**⁠ ⁠Liaise with consultants and government authorities whenever required.**

E. Performance Management & Employee Development

**⁠ ⁠Develop and implement employee performance evaluation systems.**

**⁠ ⁠Coordinate monthly performance reviews with department heads.**

**⁠ ⁠Track individual and departmental productivity.**

**⁠ ⁠Identify training requirements and organise employee development programmes.**

**⁠ ⁠Monitor employee performance against assigned targets.**

**⁠ ⁠Recommend performance improvement plans wherever required.**

F. Employee Engagement & Retention

**⁠ ⁠Develop initiatives to improve employee motivation and retention.**

**⁠ ⁠Organise employee engagement activities, recognition programmes and celebrations.**

**⁠ ⁠Conduct employee satisfaction discussions and exit interviews.**

**⁠ ⁠Identify reasons for employee attrition and suggest corrective actions.**

**⁠ ⁠Promote a professional, positive and disciplined work culture.**

G. Administration & General Management

**⁠ ⁠Oversee general administrative activities related to employees and workplace facilities.**

**⁠ ⁠Ensure proper maintenance of employee attendance systems and HR software.**

**⁠ ⁠Maintain confidentiality of employee information and salary records.**

**⁠ ⁠Prepare HR MIS reports for management review.**

**⁠ ⁠Coordinate with all department managers to ensure smooth dealership operations.**

3.⁠ ⁠Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The HR Manager will be evaluated on the following parameters:

1.⁠ ⁠Timely fulfilment of approved manpower requirements.

2.⁠ ⁠Employee retention and reduction in attrition.

3.⁠ ⁠Attendance, punctuality and employee discipline.

4.⁠ ⁠Accuracy and timely completion of payroll.

5.⁠ ⁠Statutory compliance and zero avoidable compliance penalties.

6.⁠ ⁠Completion of employee performance appraisals.

7.⁠ ⁠Training and employee development initiatives.

8.⁠ ⁠Employee grievance resolution.

9.⁠ ⁠Maintenance of updated HR records and MIS.

10.⁠ ⁠Overall workforce productivity and organisational effectiveness.

4.⁠ ⁠Qualification & Experience

**⁠ ⁠Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM in Human Resources preferred.**

**⁠ ⁠Minimum 3–5 years of relevant HR experience.**

**⁠ ⁠Experience in automobile dealerships, retail, automobile workshops or multi-location operations will be preferred.**

**⁠ ⁠Strong knowledge of payroll processing, recruitment and labour law compliance.**

**⁠ ⁠Practical experience in PF, ESIC, Professional Tax and other applicable statutory compliances.**

**⁠ ⁠Good knowledge of MS Excel, HRMS and attendance management systems.**

5.⁠ ⁠Required Competencies

**⁠ ⁠Strong leadership and people management skills.**

**⁠ ⁠Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.**

**⁠ ⁠Problem-solving and conflict-resolution skills.**

**⁠ ⁠Strong organisational and coordination capabilities.**

**⁠ ⁠Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.**

**⁠ ⁠High level of integrity and confidentiality.**

**⁠ ⁠Result-oriented approach with strong execution capabilities.**

6.⁠ ⁠Expected Deliverables

**⁠ ⁠Maintain 100% updated employee documentation.**

**⁠ ⁠Ensure timely recruitment against approved manpower requirements.**

**⁠ ⁠Ensure payroll is processed accurately and on schedule.**

**⁠ ⁠Maintain statutory compliance within prescribed timelines.**

**⁠ ⁠Implement a structured employee performance appraisal system.**

**⁠ ⁠Submit monthly HR MIS to management.**

**⁠ ⁠Build a stable, motivated and performance-oriented workforce.**

Overall Expectation: The HR Manager is expected to function as an independent HR business partner to the management, taking complete ownership of the dealership’s manpower, employee relations, HR processes and statutory compliance.

Pay: ₹13,500.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

**People, Processes & Compliance — HR cum Admin Executive**

**Job Title**

HR cum Admin Executive

**Department**
Human Resources & Administration

**Company**
Kambaa

**Experience**
3–5 years

**Employment Type**
Full-time | Mandatory work from office

**Location**
Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu — on-site only

**Company Overview — Kambaa**

Kambaa is an AI-first digital transformation company helping organizations get more value from their technology through SaaS implementation, integration and managed services. We work across leading business platforms and collaborate with a broad technology partner ecosystem, including Freshworks, HubSpot, Zoho and monday.com. Our teams support organizations in India and international markets.

**AI-First Culture**

At Kambaa, we encourage employees across functions to embrace intelligent tools, automation and data-driven ways of working. In HR and administration, that means continuously improving accuracy, documentation, employee experience and operational efficiency.

**Role Snapshot**

We are looking for a proactive HR cum Admin Executive with 3–5 years of hands-on experience managing HR operations, statutory compliance and office administration. The successful candidate will independently coordinate people processes, maintain reliable records, support employees and leadership, and ensure day-to-day administrative activities run smoothly. Candidates from any industry are welcome, provided they have relevant practical experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle**

* Coordinate recruitment activities, interview scheduling, candidate communication and joining formalities.
* Manage onboarding, induction, employee documentation, confirmations, transfers and exit formalities.
* Maintain accurate employee records, HR files, attendance, leave and other employee lifecycle documentation.
* Support employee queries, internal communication, policy implementation and employee engagement activities.

**2. Statutory Compliance & HR Documentation**

* Coordinate applicable statutory HR and labour-law compliance activities, including PF, ESI, professional tax and other relevant requirements, with internal teams or external consultants as needed.
* Maintain compliance registers, employee documents, renewals, filing calendars and audit-ready records.
* Track deadlines and follow up on statutory submissions, policy documentation and compliance-related actions.
* Support HR audits and assist management in identifying process gaps and corrective actions.

**3. Payroll, Attendance & HR Reporting**

* Compile and validate attendance, leave, payroll inputs, deductions and employee changes for payroll processing.
* Coordinate with finance, payroll partners and employees to resolve payroll-related discrepancies in a timely manner.
* Prepare periodic HR reports, trackers and dashboards covering headcount, joining, exits, leave and compliance status.

**4. Office Administration & Vendor Coordination**

* Oversee daily office administration, housekeeping, office supplies, facilities and general workplace readiness.
* Coordinate with vendors and service providers for office maintenance, utilities, procurement and renewals.
* Maintain asset and inventory records, track administrative expenses and verify vendor invoices for approval.
* Arrange internal meetings, travel, logistics and employee-related administrative support when required.

**5. Process Improvement & Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Create and maintain clear HR and admin SOPs, checklists, trackers and document repositories.
* Work closely with leadership, finance and functional managers to ensure timely completion of employee and administrative processes.
* Identify opportunities to streamline workflows using spreadsheets, HR software and appropriate automation or AI tools.
* Handle sensitive employee information with discretion, accuracy and confidentiality.

**Requirements**

* 3–5 years of relevant hands-on experience in HR operations, compliance and administration; candidates from any industry may apply.
* Working knowledge of applicable Indian HR and statutory compliance processes; ability to coordinate with compliance advisors where required.
* Practical experience with employee documentation, attendance, payroll inputs, onboarding and exit formalities.
* Experience coordinating office operations, vendors, facilities and administrative records.
* Good spoken and written English, interpersonal skills and the confidence to coordinate across teams.
* Strong working knowledge of MS Excel, Word, email and digital recordkeeping; familiarity with HRMS or payroll tools is an advantage.
* A bachelor’s degree in HR, business administration, commerce or a related field is preferred.

**What Makes a Strong Fit**

* Ownership mindset: follows up independently and ensures tasks are completed.
* Compliance discipline: monitors dates, documentation and accuracy without constant reminders.
* Organized and approachable: balances employee support with structured processes.
* Adaptable and improvement-oriented: willing to use technology and AI-enabled tools to simplify routine work.

**Work Location & Employment Requirement**

**This is a full-time, mandatory on-site position at Kambaa’s Coimbatore office.**
Applicants must be available to work from the Coimbatore office. This is not a work-from-home, remote or hybrid opportunity, and the role is not offered at any other location.

**Career Development at Kambaa**

The role offers opportunities to strengthen expertise in HR operations, compliance governance, administrative process ownership and AI-enabled workplace operations, with scope to take on broader people-operations responsibilities as the organization grows.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates can submit their updated resume, highlighting relevant experience in statutory compliance, HR operations and office administration.

We're not just building a brand; we're creating a household name in transportation. Join us and be part of the revolution – where every day is an opportunity to redefine what's possible.

If you are ready to make a significant impact and shape the future of Porter, apply now and be part of our exciting journey!

**Company URL: https://porter.in/**

**Role Overview**

We are hiring a Key Account Manager — Porter for Enterprise (PFE) to own, retain, and scale relationships with some of India’s largest enterprise companies. Porter for Enterprise runs managed logistics at scale, and this role requires an individual who will own a portfolio of enterprise accounts like a business owner—ensuring account health, unlocking multi-dimensional revenue growth, and establishing institutionalized operating systems.

**Key responsibilities**

1. Own the client relationship

Be the face of Porter to your accounts — the partner they trust and call first.

● Serve as the single relationship owner for a portfolio of enterprise accounts.

● Engage proactively across every channel the client uses — calls, WhatsApp, email, and in person — rather than waiting for inbound.

● Run a disciplined cadence of reviews and Quarterly Business Reviews that keeps every account close.

● Day-to-day trip and order issues are handled by a dedicated support team. Your focus is the relationship, not the ticket queue.

2. Grow the book

Turn accounts into bigger accounts, and carry the number for it.

● Own upsell and cross-sell across your portfolio against a clear revenue target.

● Expand each account into new cities, new categories, new use cases, and new Departments.

● Map and deepen relationships beyond a single point of contact so growth never depends on one person.

● Build and run a data-backed growth plan for each key account.

3. Drive adoption and self-service

Make your accounts self-sufficient so your time compounds into growth.

● Drive product adoption and enable clients to book, track, and manage their operations themselves.

● Reduce dependence on hand-holding so your effort shifts from servicing to scaling.

4. Own commercial health

Keep the book financially healthy — pricing is dynamic and out of scope.

● Own credit, collections, and payment discipline across your accounts.

● Partner with Finance on credit decisions, exposure, and recovery.

● Handle credit-linked conversations firmly, protecting both the relationship and Porter.

5. Build the system

Make the book run on a system, not on you.

● Decide off data — read your accounts clearly and let the numbers drive the call.

● Develop playbooks for managing large enterprise clients, so the standard lives in the system.

● Document accounts — plans, contacts, cadences — so any account can be run independent of any single person.

**Skills & Competencies**

● Strong enterprise account management, retention, and relationship-building capabilities.

● Proven track record in carrying and hitting revenue growth targets (upsell/cross-sell).

● Commercial and financial acumen—ability to hold firm conversations around credit, terms, and collections without damaging client partnerships.

● Data fluency—ability to parse metrics, identify operational/revenue trends, and tell actionable stories with data.

● High ownership, proactive outreach habits, and executive communication skills (both in-person presentation and written briefs).

● Playbook and systems-first mindset: preference for designing sustainable operating mechanisms over ad-hoc manual interventions.

**Experience & Eligibility**

● 2–4 years of relevant experience owning client outcomes, targets, and relationships in Key Account Management, B2B/Enterprise Servicing, Logistics, SaaS, or related tech-enabled services.

● Demonstrated track record of consistent growth in account size/revenue book (not just status-quo maintenance).

● Prior experience managing multi-stakeholder relationships and credit/commercial terms in structured B2B environments.

● Willingness and availability to work full-time in-office at the Bangalore Head Office.

**Great People | Great Food | Great Experience | Greater Good**

These values inspire collaboration, innovation, humility, and a relentless pursuit of excellence.

**https://www.linkedin.com/company/smartq-bottlelabs/life/cdc290f8-ff81-4e7f-9c96-37d842f936c4/?viewA…**

**Are you excited to join our team as Senior Implementation Manager?**

As our
**Senior Implementation Manager**
, you will lead end-to-end digital implementations for SmartQ's marquee and complex enterprise accounts. You will drive implementation strategy, oversee large-scale rollouts, build strong stakeholder relationships, and ensure seamless project execution. As the key escalation point for implementation risks, timelines, and client satisfaction, you will also mentor Implementation Engineers and champion delivery excellence across your portfolio.

**1. Implementation & Mobilization Leadership**

* Own end-to-end planning and execution of SmartQ platform implementations and mobilizations for large / multi-location or strategic client accounts, remotely and on-site.
* Define the implementation roadmap, milestones, and rollout sequencing for new sites/launches, and track delivery against them.
* Lead app configuration, menu detailing, and UX verification standards across the portfolio, and sign off on readiness before go-live.
* Anticipate and mitigate implementation risks (technical, operational, or stakeholder-related) before they impact go-live timelines.

**2. Client & Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the senior point of contact for decisionmakers, site managers, and ground-level operations staff across assigned accounts.
* Manage client expectations proactively on deliverables, timelines, and scope — including difficult or escalated conversations.
* Maintain ownership of customer issues through to resolution, escalating internally only where necessary and driving closure.
* Represent SmartQ in senior client reviews, governance calls, and mobilization planning discussions.

**3. Team Enablement & Quality Oversight**

* Guide, review, and mentor Implementation Engineers on solution design, documentation quality, and client communication.
* Train client users and internal teams on SmartQ platform usage, ensuring consistent adoption standards across sites.
* Create and maintain user manuals, process documents, and solutioning templates that can be reused across implementations.
* Establish and monitor quality benchmarks for configuration, testing, and issue resolution across the implementation team.

**4. Documentation, Reporting & Process**

* Own structured documentation for client communications, solution design, and reporting to internal and client leadership.
* Provide inputs into pre-sales solutioning and post-sales service design based on field experience and client feedback.
* Maintain and continuously improve knowledge of SmartQ products, services, policies, and procedures, and cascade updates to the team.
* Ensure all customer queries are investigated and resolved within SLA, escalating appropriately and tracking resolution ownership.

**Experience & Skills Required**

* Bachelor's degree with
  **5+ years of experience**
  in enterprise implementation, project delivery, or account management.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience leading client implementations and mentoring delivery teams.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, improve processes, and work with technology platforms.
* Willingness to travel across India; experience in SaaS, FoodTech, or enterprise technology is a plus.

**Message from CEO:**

Food is an everyday necessity, but the experience around it can influence how we feel, connect, and go about our day. At SmartQ, we see an opportunity to make these everyday moments better, one meal at a time. Our aggregation model, powered by technology and operational excellence, brings together food partners, processes, and people to transform dining experience. By combining these capabilities, we continuously seek better ways to solve problems, improve efficiency, and create experiences that are simpler, smarter, and more human. As we continue to redefine this space, we believe the next breakthrough can come from anyone who questions convention, sees possibilities where others see routine, and brings a fresh perspective to a familiar challenge.

We look forward to welcoming minds who will challenge our thinking and help shape what SmartQ becomes next. We invite you to be that person. Together, let’s make everyday experiences extraordinary.

title: Manager, Software Development

OpenText is the market leader in Enterprise Information Management platforms and applications. You become a member of one of our Agile-based project teams, focusing on product development. It is an exciting opportunity to design and implement solutions for enterprise level systems.
  
We are seeking a highly motivated and technically proficient Development Manager to lead a team of software engineers responsible for the development, maintenance, and support of one or more products or services. The ideal candidate will be a hands-on leader who fosters innovation, drives engineering excellence, and ensures high team productivity through Agile practices and modern technology adoption, including AI.
  
  
What the role offers
  
  

* Lead and manage a team of 5–10 engineers across development, maintenance, and support functions.

* Set clear goals, conduct regular performance reviews, and provide coaching and career development support.

* Drive the adoption of modern engineering practices including CI/CD, DevOps, automated testing, and secure coding standards.

* Own sprint planning, backlog grooming, and release management in collaboration with Product Owners and stakeholders.
* Monitor team velocity, quality metrics, and delivery timelines to ensure project success.

Technology& Innovation
  
  

* Stay abreast of emerging technologies and trends, especially in AI, cloud computing, and software architecture.
* Encourage experimentation and prototyping to evaluate new tools, frameworks, and approaches.
* Identify opportunities to integrate AI/ML into products and processes to enhance functionality and efficiency.

Product Ownership& Stakeholder Engagement
  
  

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Product Management, QA, and Support to ensure end-to-end delivery.
* Translate business requirements into technical execution plans and ensure alignment with strategic goals.
* Provide input into product roadmaps, architecture decisions, and long-term planning.

Operational Excellence
  
  

* Make day-to-day decisions that impact project effectiveness, resource allocation, and delivery outcomes.
* Analyze ambiguous and complex issues using data-driven approaches and business context.
* Ensure adherence to operational policies and compliance standards in all development activities.

Productivity& Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Implement tools and practices that improve team productivity and reduce technical debt.
* Track and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) related to team output, quality, and customer satisfaction.
* Foster a culture of learning through knowledge sharing, training, and retrospectives.

**You are great at:**  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* 10+ years of relevant experience in software development, with 2+ years in a leadership role.
* Proven experience in Agile environments and managing cross-functional teams.
* Strong understanding of software architecture, cloud platforms, and AI technologies.
* Excellent communication, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

**Technologies in use:**  

* Front-End: JavaScript, React/Angular/Vue, HTML/CSS
* Back-End: Java, SpringBoot, REST, Node.js, Python,
* API design (REST/GraphQL)
* Databases: SQL (PostgreSQL/MySQL), NoSQL (MongoDB)
* DevOps: Git, CI/CD (Jenkins/GitHub Actions), Docker, Kubernetes
* Cloud: AWS, Azure, or GCP; Serverless& Infrastructure as Code
* Agile Tools: JIRA, Confluence; Scrum/Kanban practices
* Security: Secure coding, OAuth/JWT, compliance awareness
* AI& Automation: Basic AI/ML concepts, integration of AI APIs
* Architecture: Microservices, system design, scalability
* Collaboration: Code reviews, documentation, mentoring
* Data& Analytics: Understanding of data pipelines, dashboards, and reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau); ability to guide data-driven decision-making and integrate analytics into products.

One last thing
  
  
As a part of opentext engineering team, you will work in an atmosphere which inspires innovation, collaboration and team work. Our innovations are driven by our customers' challenges and opportunities across a variety of businesses. While we have accomplished successful projects across most industries, we provide deep domain expertise for a defined set of core industries. Welcome to the data inspired future!
  
  
OpenText's efforts to build an inclusive work environment go beyond simply complying with applicable laws. Our Employment Equity and Diversity Policy provides direction on maintaining a working environment that is inclusive of everyone, regardless of culture, national origin, race, color, gender, gender identification, sexual orientation, family status, age, veteran status, disability, religion, or other basis protected by applicable laws.
  
If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please contact us athr@opentext.com. Our proactive approach fosters collaboration, innovation, and personal growth, enriching OpenText's vibrant workplace.

description:

ConceptNXT Technologies LLP seeks a commercially astute, entrepreneurial leader to own company-wide sales and business growth. The role spans our established IT Infrastructure, Cybersecurity and Enterprise Technology Solutions business, alongside emerging Cloud & Managed Services, Data Analytics & AI, Zoho & Business Applications, and Application Engineering & Integration offerings.

***Gross Profit & Commerc*****i\*\_**al Sustainability\*\_

* Own commercial gross profit outcomes alongside revenue; maintain pricing, discount and deal-margin discipline.
* Evaluate material deals for profitability, payment terms, funding needs and commercial risk—not revenue alone.
* Partner with Finance, presales and delivery teams to build commercially viable proposals and reliable revenue/gross-profit forecasts.

* Drive sales-related collection follow-up, payment dispute resolution and timely customer payment commitments with Finance.
* Negotiate suitable advances, milestones and credit terms; understand supplier payment cycles and working-capital impact.
* Assess the commercial implications of OD-funded deals and escalate cash-conversion risks early.
* Coordinate billing readiness and collection forecasts. Finance and the CEO retain authority for treasury, OD drawdowns, payroll and final financial approvals.

***Sales Leadership & Organisation Building***

* Lead regional sales leaders, BDMs, inside sales and specialist commercial resources; establish clear accountability and performance reviews.
* Build recruitment, onboarding, coaching, productivity and leadership-development plans.
* Create a high-trust, ethical, customer-focused culture with disciplined execution and prudent resource use.

***New Services & Future Business Growth***

* Build go-to-market plans and qualified opportunities across cloud, managed services, data/AI, business applications and application engineering.
* Collaborate with specialist sellers and technical teams to shape consultative propositions, cross-sell and recurring services.
* Develop future markets, partnerships and commercial capabilities without compromising current-business performance.

***End-to-End Sales Operations***

* Own sales process discipline from lead qualification through quotation, negotiation, order closure, billing coordination and sales-related collections.
* Implement CRM hygiene, forecasting, opportunity reviews and reporting on pipeline, orders, revenue, gross profit and receivables.
* Coordinate customer commitments and handovers with Technology & Solutions, Delivery, Procurement and Finance.

***Required Expertise & Experience***

* Strongly preferred: leadership experience in an IT systems integrator, enterprise IT infrastructure/cybersecurity solutions provider, managed services provider or closely comparable technology solutions business.
* Practical familiarity with OEM/distributor ecosystems, solution-led selling, enterprise procurement and implementation/support services.
* Demonstrated ownership of revenue and gross profit, plus working knowledge of pricing, customer credit, receivables, supplier terms and working capital.
* Proven success leading multi-location B2B sales teams, building managers, growing enterprise accounts and closing complex opportunities.
* Ability to run CRM-based forecasting, sales governance and performance management; strong negotiation and stakeholder skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, IT or related discipline; MBA advantageous, not mandatory.

***Preferred Additional Experience***

* Experience scaling a growing technology solutions or SI business; regional business-head or commercial P&L exposure.
* Exposure to cloud, managed services, SaaS, data/AI, business applications or engineering services; experience building services or recurring revenue.

***Leadership Profile***

A business builder with founder-like ownership—not unrestricted founder authority. Demonstrates initiative, financial judgement, integrity, resource stewardship, customer trust, team development and long-term thinking. Understands that revenue, margin, cash conversion and employee well-being are interconnected.

***Key Result Areas (KRAs)***

* Revenue growth and predictable business generation.
* Commercial gross profit, margin discipline and sustainable deal economics.
* Sales-related collections, payment discipline and commercial cash conversion.
* New customers, strategic accounts, new services and future revenue opportunities.
* Sales-team capability, leadership development and productivity.
