title: Product Innovation Manager – Airline Solutions
description:
**Company Description**

Infiniti Software Solutions is a Chennai-based airline technology company serving over 30 airlines globally. Our products span airline group revenue management, distribution, modern airline retailing, AI-powered intelligence and operational automation.

With over 350 professionals and a growing international airline customer base, we are focused on building technology that solves real business problems and creates measurable value for our customers.

**Role Description**

We are looking for a Product Innovation Manager who combines strong airline-domain knowledge with commercial thinking, customer engagement and a passion for solving business problems.

This is not a conventional product management or project coordination role.

You will engage directly with airline stakeholders, understand their commercial and operational challenges, identify opportunities for innovation, and work with our teams to develop solutions that customers are willing to adopt and pay for.

The role requires someone who can move confidently from customer discovery and solution conceptualization to demonstrations, business cases and commercial progression.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Engage airline commercial, revenue management, distribution and technology stakeholders to understand business challenges.
* Lead customer discovery workshops and identify opportunities for innovation and commercial improvement.
* Translate customer problems into compelling product concepts, solutions and value propositions.
* Present solutions to airline executives, handle objections and build customer confidence.
* Work with engineering and product teams to develop prototypes, validate concepts and bring solutions to market.
* Develop business cases, pricing inputs and go-to-market propositions.
* Collaborate with Sales to progress qualified opportunities through pilots, commercial proposals and customer commitments.
* Identify opportunities to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve airline revenue, efficiency and customer experience.
* Take ownership of initiatives from idea and customer validation through product readiness and commercialization.



**Qualifications**

* 7–12 years of professional experience, preferably including significant exposure to airline technology or airline commercial operations.
* Experience in airline technology pre-sales, solution consulting, product management, business development or commercial transformation.
* Strong understanding of one or more airline domains such as revenue management, group sales, airline distribution, NDC, Offer/Order or ancillary retailing.
* Proven ability to engage customers, identify business problems and communicate technology solutions effectively.
* Experience presenting to senior customer stakeholders and contributing to commercial opportunity progression.
* Strong analytical thinking, communication, influencing and stakeholder-management skills.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with a genuine passion for solving customer problems.
* Familiarity with AI-enabled products and modern software development practices is an advantage.



**What We Value**

We are looking for someone who is curious, commercially minded and comfortable taking ownership.

We value people who listen to customers, challenge assumptions, communicate clearly and focus on outcomes rather than activities.

You do not need to be a hands-on programmer. You must be able to understand technology well enough to work effectively with engineering and confidently present its business value.

**Location:**
Chennai, Tamil Nadu — On-site

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

If you understand airline business challenges and enjoy turning ideas into solutions that customers value, we would like to hear from you.

description:
Account Growth and Delivery

Chennai | Delivery and Operations | 15–20 years of experience

Reports to the Managing Director, India

Role Overview

Own the performance and growth of assigned client accounts. Lead senior client relationships, oversee IT services delivery through Project Managers and Delivery Managers, and own account P&L. Meet agreed revenue and billable headcount targets while maintaining delivery quality and client satisfaction.

Key ResponsibilitiesAnnual Account Planning

·      Own the annual account plan and growth strategy. Set revenue, margin and billable headcount targets, identify priority business units and solution opportunities, and align the plan with senior leadership. Review progress quarterly and update the plan as client priorities and pipeline change.

Client Relationships and Service Reviews

·      Act as the primary point of contact for the account. Build relationships with senior business, technology, delivery and procurement stakeholders, align expectations and manage escalations.

·      Lead regular service reviews with senior client stakeholders. Present delivery performance, risks and improvement plans, agree owners and deadlines, and follow actions through to closure.

Delivery and Team Leadership

·      Oversee delivery across engagements through Project Managers and Delivery Managers. Set clear accountability for scope, milestones, quality, service levels and client commitments.

·      Establish consistent delivery practices and dashboards. Review milestones, service levels, quality indicators, risks and dependencies, and follow up on corrective actions.

·      Coach Project Managers and Delivery Managers, resolve cross-team issues, and support workforce planning, team development and retention.

·      Own the account headcount forecast and work with Practice Leads and Delivery Managers to match demand to available skills, deploy suitable bench consultants and plan redeployment as assignments end.

·      Partner with Talent Acquisition and delivery leads to define new hiring requirements, prioritise demand, track hiring and onboarding, and mobilise teams by agreed start dates.

Key Responsibilities ContinuedAccount Mining and Expansion

·      Map client business units and teams beyond existing engagements. Identify budget holders, decision-makers and sponsors, and build relationships to understand their priorities, budgets and buying cycles.

·      Assess expansion opportunities by looking at business needs, technology gaps, client team capacity and funding. Prioritise target teams by business value, likelihood of conversion and potential revenue and billable headcount.

·      Work with technology and delivery teams to shape targeted solutions and business cases. Present proposals to budget holders and own the pipeline through to signed work.

Commercial and Contract Management

·      Own account P&L. Forecast revenue, costs and margins with Finance, review actuals against plan, and act on variances. Track progress against agreed revenue and billable headcount targets.

·      Manage relationships with client procurement, supply chain and vendor management teams. Oversee Master Services Agreement (MSA) obligations, renewals and commercial discussions with internal Legal and Finance teams.

·      Manage all Statements of Work (SOWs) with Project Managers, covering scope, milestones, commercial terms, changes and renewals.

·      Own billing readiness and timely invoicing for the account. Work with the Project Management Office (PMO) to validate timesheets, milestone sign-offs and billing inputs against SOW terms. Coordinate with Finance on invoice issuance and follow up on disputes and overdue payments.

Senior Leadership Reporting

·      Report account performance to the Senior Leadership Team, covering financials, growth pipeline, staffing, delivery health, client escalations and decisions required.

Experience and Qualifications

·      15–20 years of professional experience in IT services, with a track record of owning client accounts, overseeing delivery and growing existing business.

·      Experience leading Project Managers and Delivery Managers, using delivery dashboards and running service reviews with senior client stakeholders.

·      Demonstrated ownership of account P&L and performance against revenue and staffing targets. Experience managing MSAs, SOWs and client procurement relationships.

·      Track record of winning work in new business areas within existing accounts by engaging budget holders and developing proposals with technology teams. Strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills.

·      Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Operations Management or a related field.

title: Customer Growth & Success Executive
description:
About KAN Innovations

KAN Innovations Pvt. Ltd. is a Mumbai-based medical technology company focused on diabetic foot care, with diagnostic, biomechanics, footwear and software solutions used by hospitals, clinics, physiotherapists and podiatrists.

Role: Customer Growth & Success Executive

Department: Customer Success | Reports to: Manager - Customer Success

Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra

Salary: Rs. 3.6 to 4.2 LPA

About the Role

This is a hybrid customer success and account growth role. You will be the single point of contact for existing and newly onboarded customers - ensuring smooth onboarding, training, product adoption and relationship management - and you will grow revenue from these accounts through consumables, footwear and custom footwear, insoles and orthotic solutions, software and product upgrades, cross-selling, additional equipment, and expansion into other departments, centres and branches.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage a portfolio of high-value existing customer accounts and build long-term relationships with doctors, physiotherapists, podiatrists, hospital administrators, centre heads, owners and purchase teams
* Identify, qualify and convert opportunities for footwear, insoles, orthotics and other consumables
* Drive upselling of software upgrades, product upgrades, additional modules and equipment, and cross-sell complementary products
* Own the customer journey after order confirmation: deployment, training, adoption and value realisation
* Conduct product demonstrations and software walkthroughs, and explain clinical and commercial value
* Monitor product usage and work with internal teams to improve adoption
* Collect customer feedback, feature requests and pain points, and share them with internal teams
* Maintain accurate customer, opportunity and revenue data in the CRM and build account growth plans

Qualifications

* Graduation in any discipline (BBA, B.Com, B.Sc., B.A., B.Pharm, Healthcare or Business Management preferred)
* 1 to 3 years of experience preferred in Customer Success, Account Management, Business Development, Inside/Field Sales, Healthcare, Medical Devices, Physiotherapy, Podiatry, Rehabilitation, SaaS/Software or B2B customer management
* Freshers with strong communication, confidence, learning ability and commercial aptitude may be considered

What We Look For

* A customer-centric mindset and genuine enjoyment of solving customer problems
* Excellent verbal and written communication with clinicians, management and purchase teams
* Commercial acumen to spot upselling, cross-selling and recurring revenue opportunities
* Ability to build long-term professional relationships

Benefits: Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

Pay: ₹360,000.00 - ₹420,000.00 per year

description:

We are looking for a proactive and responsible Manager – Society Operations & Client Success to manage day-to-day operations of assigned housing societies, coordinate financial activities, maintain strong client relationships, and support business development initiatives.

title: Service Cloud Administrator
description:
**Service Cloud Administrator**

**Department:** Business Applications

**Reports to:** SeniorManager, Business Applications (Salesforce)

**Location:** [Remote / Hybrid / Office]

**About the Role**
==================

Sovos is a global tax compliance software company, and our customers depend on fast, accurate support. As a Service Cloud Administrator, you will configure, operate, and continuously improve our Salesforce Service Cloud platform, which supports case management, entitlements and SLAs, knowledge, and omni-channel routing. You will work closely with Support, Customer Success, and Revenue Operations to turn how the business works into reliable, well-governed configuration, and you will partner with our Service Cloud developers on solutions that go beyond declarative tools. This is a hands-on, technical admin role: you are comfortable in Flow, data, and security, and technical enough to troubleshoot alongside developers.

**What You'll Do**
==================

**Configure and administer**
----------------------------

* Configure and maintain Service Cloud: case management, queues, assignment and escalation rules, entitlements, milestones, SLAs, Email-to-Case, Web-to-Case, Omni-Channel, Knowledge, and Service Console

* Build and maintain automation with Flow, validation rules, and other declarative tools, and escalate to developers when logic requires code or approaches platform limits

* Manage users, roles, permission sets, sharing, and field-level security, applying least-privilege access

* Build reports and dashboards that track SLA adherence, case backlog, agent productivity, and customer satisfaction

* Protect data quality through duplicate management, imports and exports, and governance of fields and picklists

**Partner and deliver**
-----------------------

* Gather requirements from Support, Customer Success, and Revenue Operations, write clear user stories, and work with developers on technical design where code is needed

* Build and test changes in sandbox, support UAT, and deploy through the team's release process in compliance with change management, SOX, and ITGC requirements, including documented testing and approvals

* Triage and resolve user issues such as case routing, permissions, and automation errors, and escalate platform or code issues with clear detail

* Manage the three Salesforce releases each year: review release notes, test affected features, and communicate changes to users

* Train agents and managers and maintain clear documentation of configuration and processes

**AI and innovation**
---------------------

* Configure and administer Einstein and Agentforce capabilities for service (such as case summaries, reply recommendations, and knowledge generation) in line with our data governance and AI connector usage standards

* Use AI assistants to speed up admin work, including drafting Flow logic, writing SOQL, analyzing metadata, summarizing release notes, and producing documentation, and verify the output before it reaches production

* Never place credentials or customer data in prompts, and follow approved tools and access controls for connecting AI to Salesforce

* Identify automation and AI opportunities that improve case deflection, resolution time, and agent productivity

**What You'll Bring**
=====================

**Required**
------------

* 4+ years of Salesforce administration experience, including 2+ years on Service Cloud

* Strong hands-on skills in Flow (record-triggered, screen, and scheduled), validation rules, and formulas

* Solid knowledge of Service Cloud features: Cases, Entitlements, Milestones, Omni-Channel, Knowledge, Email-to-Case, and Service Console

* Strong understanding of Salesforce security: sharing model, permission sets, and field-level security

* Working knowledge of SOQL and the ability to read basic Apex and debug logs to troubleshoot with developers

* Experience with sandboxes, change sets or similar deployment tooling, and release management in a controlled environment

* Strong reporting and dashboard skills

* Working fluency with AI tools: you already use AI assistants to speed up admin work, review their output critically, and understand data privacy risks

* Strong communication skills, with the ability to gather requirements and explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders

**Preferred**
-------------

* Salesforce certifications: Administrator, Advanced Administrator, Service Cloud Consultant, Platform App Builder, and/or Agentforce Specialist

* Experience with Agentforce or Einstein for Service

* Familiarity with the Salesforce CLI, Git, or DevOps Center

* Experience with Jira, Gainsight or similar customer success platforms, or telephony/CTI integrations

* Experience supporting SOX or audit requirements, and a background in SaaS, tax, or compliance software

**How We'll Measure Success**
=============================

* A stable platform: accurate case routing, fast resolution of user issues, and few production incidents from configuration changes

* Measurable improvements in SLA adherence, case backlog, and agent efficiency from the configuration and automation you deliver

* Clean releases and audit outcomes, with every change tested, documented, and approved

* Effective, responsible use of AI in your own work, and Einstein or Agentforce features adopted by agents with measurable results

* Strong partnership: clear requirements, smooth handoffs to developers, and satisfied business stakeholders

* No security, data quality, or AI-related compliance incidents in the work you own

**Why Join Us**
===============

You'll work on a mission-critical platform at the center of customer support for a global compliance leader, with real ownership of how Support works day to day and a clear path toward senior administrator, business analyst, or developer roles.

title: Senior Service Cloud Developer
description:

**About the Role**
==================

Sovos is a global tax compliance software company, and our customers depend on fast, accurate support. As a Senior Service Cloud Developer, you will own the technical design, build, and quality of our Salesforce Service Cloud platform, covering case management, entitlements and SLAs, knowledge, and omni-channel routing. ==================

---------------------------

* Architect and develop Service Cloud solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow, and declarative tools, choosing the right approach for each problem

* Build case lifecycle automation (assignment, escalation, entitlements, milestones, SLAs) and extend Omni-Channel, Email-to-Case, Web-to-Case, Knowledge, and Service Console

* Design integrations with Jira, customer success platforms, telephony, NetSuite, and Snowflake using REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, and middleware

* Monitor platform health, governor limits, and performance, resolve technical debt, and drive root cause analysis on complex production issues

**AI and innovation**
---------------------

* Design, build, and test Agentforce agents (topics, actions, guardrails) and other Einstein capabilities, in line with our data governance and AI connector usage standards

* Use AI coding assistants (such as Claude Code) with the Salesforce CLI (sf) and DX tooling to scaffold Apex and LWC, generate tests, analyze metadata, and script deployments and validations

* Connect AI tools to Salesforce orgs only through approved MCP servers, with least-privilege and read-only access, in sandboxes and scratch orgs rather than production

* Apply AI across the delivery lifecycle (code review, impact analysis, documentation, test evidence), holding AI-generated code to the same review, testing, and change management standards as any other change, and never placing credentials or customer data in prompts

* Share effective AI-assisted practices with the team and find opportunities to improve case deflection and resolution time

**What You'll Bring**
=====================

**Required**
------------

* 6+ years of Salesforce development experience, including 3+ years on Service Cloud

* Expert-level Apex (triggers, batch, queueable, asynchronous patterns), SOQL/SOSL, and Lightning Web Components

* Deep knowledge of the Service Cloud data model and features: Cases, Entitlements, Milestones, Omni-Channel, Knowledge, and Service Console

* Strong experience building integrations with REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, and external systems

* Proficiency with Salesforce DX, the Salesforce CLI, Git-based source control, and CI/CD tooling

* Solid understanding of Salesforce security: sharing model, permission sets, field-level security, and data protection

* Experience in a regulated or controlled environment with change management and audit documentation

* Working fluency with AI-assisted development: you already use AI coding assistants with the CLI and DX workflows and critically review their output for correctness, security, and maintainability

* Sound judgment on responsible AI use, including data privacy, least-privilege access, and verifying AI output before it reaches production

* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders

**Preferred**
-------------

* Salesforce certifications: Platform Developer I and II, Service Cloud Consultant, and/or Application Architect

* Experience with Agentforce, Einstein for Service, or MCP-based integrations between AI tools and Salesforce orgs

* Experience with Jira, Gainsight or similar customer success platforms, or telephony/CTI integrations

* Familiarity with Snowflake or other analytics platforms, and multi-org or post-acquisition Salesforce consolidation

* Background in SaaS, tax, or compliance software

**How We'll Measure Success**
=============================

* Reliable, well-tested releases with low defect escape rates and clean audit outcomes for the changes you own

* Measurable improvements in case handling efficiency, SLA adherence, and agent experience

* Responsible, visible use of AI in your delivery workflow, with gains in speed, test coverage, or documentation quality and no increase in defects or audit findings

* Agentforce or other AI capabilities in production that measurably improve case deflection, resolution time, or agent productivity

* Higher engineering standards across the team, including AI practices you introduce being adopted more widely

* No AI-related security, data privacy, or compliance incidents in the work you own

**Why Join Us**
===============

You'll work on a mission-critical platform at the center of customer support for a global compliance leader, with real influence over architecture and standards and a clear path toward architect or technical lead roles.

title: Strategic Account Director (ID # 912)
description:
**About the Company**

Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is developing India’s full-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research, models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV, and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam partners with India’s leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED, IDFC, and LIC.

**About the Role**

The role owns the commercial relationship and ensures each account is getting real value from Sarvam’s products, expanding into new use cases, and renewing with conviction. You are the single point of commercial accountability for your book of business. You will work at the intersection of the client, the delivery team (FDSEs, CSEs, CSMs), and Sarvam’s product and GTM leadership. What you learn in the field shapes how the company prioritises product improvements, structures pricing, and designs its post-sales playbooks. If you are someone who combines commercial sharpness with genuine curiosity about how AI products create value for enterprise clients, this role is for you.

**Responsibilities**

* Own the full commercial relationship across a portfolio of Sarvam’s enterprise accounts: renewals, expansion, cross-sell, and net revenue retention
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with key stakeholders across your accounts, from operational teams running Sarvam products daily to CXO-level sponsors
* Drive account expansion by identifying new use cases, business units, and product lines where Sarvam can deliver incremental value
* Lead renewal negotiations end-to-end, including pricing, scope, and contract structuring, in close coordination with GTM leadership
* Run structured account reviews (QBRs, health checks, success plans) that demonstrate measurable business impact and align both sides on next steps
* Use product usage data, delivery metrics, and client feedback to proactively identify health signals, adoption gaps, and churn risk
* Work closely with FDSEs, CSEs, and CSMs to ensure delivery quality remains high and client expectations are met throughout the engagement lifecycle
* Translate client feedback, feature requests, and competitive intelligence back to product teams with enough context and specificity to be actionable
* Contribute to building Sarvam’s post-sales playbook: account segmentation frameworks, expansion motions, health scoring models, and renewal processes

**Qualifications**

* 8-20 years of experience in enterprise sales ales, account management, customer success, or post-sales roles within B2B SaaS, enterprise technology, or AI/ML products
* Proven track record of owning and exceeding revenue targets, specifically renewal rates and net revenue retention (NRR) metrics

**Required Skills**

* Commercial instinct: you segment your book by expansion potential, keep active expansion conversations going, and build business cases that land with economic buyers
* Ability to hold a technical conversation with an engineering or product team on the client side. You do not need to write code, but you need to understand how APIs, integrations, and AI workflows connect
* Strong communication skills: you can move fluidly between an operational lead, a technical counterpart, and a procurement team within the same account
* Comfort using product data and analytics to drive account decisions rather than relying on gut feel alone
* Experience working in a fast-moving environment where you build process as you go, not inherit it from a mature org

**Preferred Skills**

* Prior experience managing accounts in conversational AI, voice technology, language technology, or document intelligence
* Familiarity with the Indian enterprise buying landscape: procurement cycles, compliance requirements, multi-stakeholder decision-making, and government contracting norms
* Experience working alongside Forward Deployed Engineering, professional services, or delivery teams in a post-sales capacity
* Background in consulting, solutions engineering, or customer success before moving into account management
* Hands-on experience with CRM and customer health tools (Salesforce, HubSpot, Gainsight, or equivalent)

**Pay range and compensation package**

Note: We are looking for people who can own the outcomes described here, not people who match every line of this specification. If this problem excites you and you believe you can do this work, we want to hear from you.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

Sarvam is a fast-moving, high talent-density team building full-stack AI for India, working on problems that push the frontiers of AI with real population-scale impact. Work alongside researchers, engineers, builders, and business leaders who move fast and hold each other to a very high bar. High ownership and high impact, from day one. Everything we do is AI-first, from the way we build and ship to the way we think about problems. You can work on problems that could change how an entire country learns, works, and communicates. If you want to work on problems at the frontier of AI in India, Sarvam is the place to be.

We are looking for a Delivery Lead to own end-to-end offshore delivery of managed services for our insurance clients. You will run application support, maintenance and enhancement engagements against SLAs, lead a multi-vendor blended team, and act as the senior offshore point of contact for client stakeholders. You will bring deep insurance domain knowledge, strong service delivery discipline, and an AI-driven, product-minded approach that moves the service from reactive support to proactive, automated operations.

Key responsibilities

Managed service delivery

•

Own offshore AMS delivery (L2/L3 support, maintenance and enhancements) for insurance platforms against contractual SLAs, KPIs and XLAs.

•

Apply ITIL processes pragmatically across incident, problem, change and release, and lead major incident management and root cause analysis.

•

Plan and execute transitions of new scope into steady state.

Clients and suppliers

•

Act as the senior offshore point of contact for client delivery and IT leadership, and run governance from weekly service reviews to QBRs.

•

Operate within a multi-supplier ecosystem: coordinate handoffs, OLAs and shared incidents, and keep accountability clear across suppliers.

•

Manage escalations transparently and maintain high client satisfaction.

Insurance domain

•

Apply knowledge of the insurance value chain (underwriting, policy administration, billing, claims) to set delivery priorities.

•

Guide teams supporting platforms such as Guidewire, Duck Creek, Majesco or Sapiens, and ensure regulatory and data privacy requirements are met.

AI, automation and innovation

•

Champion an AI-first delivery model, using GenAI for ticket triage, resolution recommendations, knowledge generation and self-service.

•

Deliver automation through shift-left, self-healing, AIOps and agentic AI, with measurable gains in productivity and resolution time.

•

Apply AI-assisted engineering, and take GenAI pilots into secure, governed production with responsible AI controls.

•

Bring a regular pipeline of innovation proposals to clients, backed by business cases.

Product mindset

•

Run the service as a product: define outcomes, measure business value beyond ticket SLAs, and evolve it through a roadmap.

•

Build reusable assets and accelerators that scale across clients.

People and commercials

•

Lead and grow a 30–40 person multi-vendor blended team of client, in-house and partner staff under one delivery model.

•

Own resource planning, rosters, performance management and attrition.

•

Own account metrics (utilisation, pyramid, margin) and support growth through scope expansion and proposals.

Required qualifications

•

8–10 years in IT services, including 3+ years as a delivery lead or manager and at least 4 years in insurance (P&C, Life & Annuities, or Health).

•

Must have: directly managed a team of 30–40 people in an onshore–offshore model.

•

Must have: led multi-vendor blended teams of client, in-house and third-party staff.

•

Must have: delivered in a multi-supplier ecosystem with shared SLAs, OLAs and integrated service management.

•

Proven record running AMS engagements under SLA- or outcome-based contracts, using ITIL and ITSM tools such as ServiceNow.

•

Working understanding of the AI and GenAI stack (LLMs, RAG, vector databases, agents; platforms such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Vertex AI or Anthropic Claude) and AI-era delivery practices (AI-assisted coding, LLMOps, CI/CD, cloud deployment).

•

Demonstrated passion for automation and innovation, with examples of initiatives driven and value delivered.

•

Ownership of delivery financials, and confident communication with senior stakeholders.

•

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related field.

Preferred qualifications

•

Experience managing sizable, multi-year AMS programmes.

•

A pragmatic, lightweight approach to process that favours outcomes over ceremony.

•

Certifications in ITIL v4, PMP or SAFe, cloud or AI (Azure, AWS, Google), or insurance (AINS, CPCU, LOMA).

•

Hands-on exposure to AIOps tools and GenAI use cases in insurance, such as claims summarisation or document intelligence.

•

Product management exposure, and experience with clients in North America, the UK or Europe.

Key competencies

•

Client-first, with strong stakeholder and escalation management across suppliers.

•

Passion for AI and innovation, with a product mindset focused on outcomes rather than tickets.

•

Data-driven, with a bias for action over process for its own sake.

•

* Leadership presence, commercial awareness and calm under pressure.

title: Service Operations Manager
description:
### **Description**

**Overview of the Role**:  
This is a unique opportunity for an experienced leader to shape and mature Gentrack's global support organisation. We are seeking a proven Service Operations leader with strong IT Service Management (ITSM) expertise to standardise, optimise and scale our Service Operations and Service Transition functions across our APAC operations.

Gentrack is committed to leveraging AI, automation and digital agents to transform how services are delivered and operated. We are looking for a leader who will challenge traditional approaches to service management, establish consistent global practices, strengthen governance and improve customer outcomes. The successful candidate will play a key role in building a modern operating model that enables growth through automation, innovation and continual improvement, without adding operational overhead.

  

### **Your Key Responsibilities**

The Service Operations Manager is responsible for establishing and governing Gentrack's global Service Operations framework, ensuring services are transitioned, changed and improved in a consistent, controlled and scalable manner across all regions.

The role will focus on maturing Change Enablement, Problem Management, Service Transition, Continual Service Improvement and Operational Compliance. Through the adoption of modern service management practices, automation and AI-enabled ways of working, the Service Operations Manager will improve operational effectiveness, reduce risk and enhance customer outcomes.

Primary responsibilities are:  
**AI, Automation & Innovation**

* Lead the modernisation of Service Operations through AI, automation and digital agents.
* Redesign operational processes using modern technologies, intelligent workflows and automated controls.
* Evaluate emerging capabilities and industry practices to improve efficiency, governance and service outcomes.
* Champion AI-enabled service management across the organisation.

  

**Change Enablement & Governance**

* Establish and maintain the APAC Change Enablement framework that balances risk, agility and delivery velocity.
* Standardise change processes, governance and reporting across regions and customer-facing teams.
* Ensure changes are appropriately assessed, authorised, implemented and reviewed.
* Leverage automation and AI-assisted controls to maintain governance whilst reducing administrative effort.
* Monitor change performance and drive continuous improvement.

  

**Problem Management**

* Establish a proactive APAC Problem Management practice focused on identifying and eliminating recurring causes of service disruption.
* Drive root cause analysis standards and ensure corrective actions are implemented and tracked to completion.
* Use operational data and trend analysis to identify systemic issues before they impact customers.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, and Service Delivery Management teams to improve service stability and resilience.

  

**Service Transition**

* Define and govern the framework through which new services, customers, releases and major changes transition into operational support.
* Ensure operational readiness requirements are consistently applied and met.
* Develop standardised transition criteria, checklists and acceptance controls.
* Partner with Delivery, Product and Service Delivery Management teams to improve readiness and reduce transition-related risk.
* Drive continual improvement of transition processes and outcomes.

  

**Operational Risk, Compliance & Governance**

* Ensure Service Operations processes support organisational compliance obligations, including SOC2, ISO standards and customer contractual requirements.
* Maintain auditable operational controls and supporting evidence.
* Identify and mitigate operational risks across the service lifecycle.
* Partner with audit, compliance and security teams to strengthen governance and operational maturity.

### **What We’re Looking For:**

  

**Essential Skills & Experience**

* A pragmatic, outcomes-focused leader who can balance governance, agility and customer experience.
* Proven experience designing, implementing and governing IT Service Management practices within a SaaS, managed services or enterprise technology environment.
* Demonstrated success maturing service management disciplines at scale, including change, problem, transition and continual improvement practices.
* Strong understanding of governance, risk and compliance frameworks, including support for audit and certification requirements such as SOC2 or ISO 27001.
* Experience applying automation, AI or modern workflow technologies to improve operational efficiency and service outcomes.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate operational insights into measurable improvements.
* Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively across support, product, engineering, delivery and leadership teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* ITIL certification is highly desirable; additional qualifications in service management, risk management or operational excellence are advantageous.
* Experience within utilities, enterprise software, billing or CRM environments is beneficial but not essential.

### **Interested?**

* Personal growth – in leadership, commercial acumen and technical excellence
* To be part of a global, winning high growth organization – with a career path to match
* A vibrant, culture full of people passionate about transformation and making a difference -with a one team, collaborative ethos
* A competitive reward package that truly awards our top talent
* A chance to make a true impact on society and the planet

If this role sounds like a good fit for you, please click on the “Apply” button to submit your application.

To discover more about Gentrack and how we’re transforming energy and water utilities with innovative solutions, please visit our website and LinkedIn.

### **About Gentrack**

**Who We Are**  
  
Gentrack partners with leading energy and water utilities around the world to deliver innovative technology that helps them navigate an increasingly complex and rapidly changing industry. Working with some of the world's largest utilities and challenger brands, we're helping our customers build a more sustainable future by driving innovation, delivering exceptional customer experiences, harnessing the power of AI, and creating lasting business value.

**Our Values and Culture**

Gentrackers are one team of smart thinkers and dedicated doers, working drive efficiency in two of the planet’s most essential resources: energy and water.

As AI reshapes the way our industry works, we're embedding it into how we innovate, collaborate and solve problems, empowering our people to work smarter and create even greater value for our customers.

Everything we do is guided by three core values: respect for the planet, respect for our customers, and respect for each other.

We're a diverse, global team that collaborates across borders, shares knowledge, embraces new ideas, and continually raises the bar. It's an exciting time to join Gentrack, with a clear growth strategy, world-class leadership, and a culture that combines technology, AI and talented people to shape the future of utilities.

title: Digital Product Manager, Advanced Planning 1
description:
**Shape the Future with Us.**

At Lubrizol, we’re bringing to life the chemistry behind clean water, efficient transportation, reliable infrastructure, critical medicines, and the products people rely on every day through science, sustainability, and a culture of inclusion.

As part of our global team, you’ll be empowered to make a real impact - on your career, your community, and the world around you.

**Position Summary**
====================

The **Digital Product Manager, Transportation Management** has enterprise-wide responsibility for shaping and accelerating the logistics digital transformation journey, building on the foundation established through SAP Advanced Transportation Management.

  

In alignment with business stakeholders, the role owns the logistics digital product strategy and end-to-end product delivery, prioritizes the digital roadmap and backlog, recommends investments, leads solution selection, and translates business requirements into scalable digital products.

  

Success is measured through improvements in freight cost, service reliability, planning productivity, shipment visibility, exception resolution, digital product adoption, and value realization against approved business-case commitments.

  

**Key Accountabilities**
========================

**1. Product Strategy & Roadmap**
---------------------------------

* Define and maintain the global transportation digital-product strategy, target-state capabilities, multi-year roadmap, digital product lifecycle, and value-realization plan, aligned with logistics priorities and enterprise architecture.
* Co-develop investment recommendations and business cases, and guide technology and solution options, sourcing approaches, and vendor selection through appropriate governance forums to deliver measurable improvements in transportation cost, end-to-end visibility, workflow automation, and exception-resolution cycle time.

  

**2. Product Delivery & Lifecycle**
-----------------------------------

* **Translate business needs into scalable product requirements**, user stories, process and functional designs, and acceptance criteria, while facilitating cross-functional decisions on process, data, integration, adoption, and benefit ownership.
* **Lead the cross-functional delivery of end-to-end digital product**, from discovery and design through deployment, stabilization, scaling, continuous enhancement, and retirement, with clear outcomes and decision rights.
* **Prioritize capabilities, release planning, backlog trade-offs, risks, dependencies, service performance, and vendor governance**, within approved governance guardrails and in alignment with business stakeholders.

  

**3. Data, AI & Integration**
-----------------------------

* Establish the data, integration, and interoperability capabilities required to connect SAP TM, visibility platforms, control towers, carriers, freight forwarders, 3PLs, and other partners.
* Advance trusted transportation data products, KPI definitions, analytics, and decision-support capabilities with clear data ownership and quality standards.
* Refine, Design and scale fit-for-purpose AI-enabled capabilities, including predictive insights, ETA forecasting, exception management, optimization, and workflow automation, with appropriate controls and monitoring.

  

**4. Adoption & Value Realization**
-----------------------------------

* Enable business readiness, change leadership, adoption of digital products, training, communications, and stakeholder engagement across regions and business groups.
* Define product-level outcome measures and benefit baselines with business and Finance partners; monitor adoption, value realization, and corrective actions after go-live.
* Use user feedback, operational performance, and product telemetry to improve capability, experience, and realized value throughout the product lifecycle.

**Qualifications & Experience**
===============================

**Required**
------------

* 10+ years of experience in logistics operations, logistics consulting, digital product management, or logistics transformation, with strong knowledge of end-to-end transportation processes.
* Experience with SAP TM or control-tower implementations, enhancements, adoption, or transportation optimization initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience owning or leading digital products across strategy, roadmap prioritization, product delivery, lifecycle management, adoption, and value realization.
* Proven delivery of complex, cross-functional transportation or logistics transformations across business, data, and technology teams.
* Strong product-management leadership, including discovery, portfolio and backlog prioritization, business-case development, product governance, and outcome measurement.
* Ability to influence executive and operational stakeholders, facilitate decisions across functions and regions, and lead teams through ambiguity and organizational change.
* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, logistics, engineering, technology, or a related field

  

**Preferred**
-------------

* Experience with logistics analytics, dashboarding, and Power BI or comparable platforms.
* Experience with logistics visibility, carrier-integration, or collaborative-network platforms.
* Exposure to AI-enabled logistics use cases such as predictive ETA, optimization, exception management, and workflow automation.
* Experience scaling digital products across multiple regions, or an enterprise environment.
* Experience governing technology partners and vendors, including solution evaluation, delivery oversight, performance management, and commercial alignment.

description:

Veralto is headquartered in Waltham, Mass. with 13 operating companies and 300+ locations worldwide. Our global team of 16,000 associates is committed to making an enduring positive impact on the world and is united by a powerful purpose: Safeguarding the World’s Most Vital Resources™.

Our Product Quality & Innovation companies—Esko, Linx, Pantone, Videojet, and X-Rite—help package and protect the world’s food, medicine, and essentials, tracing and authenticating billions of goods that travel the global supply chain every day.
  
  
**WHO WE ARE:**
Headquartered in Grand Rapids, Michigan, X-Rite is a global company with locations around the world. Experts in blending the art and science of color, we focus on providing complete end-to-end color management solutions for our clients in every industry where color matters.
  
  
**Job Details:**
**X-Rite’s Global Brand Strategic Accounts team**
helps customers achieve consistent print and color quality across their global packaging supply chains. Our portfolio of products and professional services enables customers to establish color and print-quality specifications, measure performance, and report results across their operations.
  
  
**The Global Brand Color Program Manager**
will lead the operational, technical, and project-management activities for a strategic global Brand account. The role will coordinate program deployment across regions, suppliers, printers, pre-media partners, and internal teams to ensure consistent execution, measurable performance, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**Job Title:**
Assistant Sales Manager - Print & Packaging, North India
  
  
**Department:**
Sales
  
  
**Reporting to:**
Sales Manager
  
  
**Location:**
Candidates ideally can be from Delhi/Gurgaon/Noida.
  
  
**Territory:**
North India (Punjab, UP, Haryana, Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Rajasthan, Delhi, Chandigarh, J&K)
  
  
**Travel:**
Frequent customer and channel travel across the assigned region - Field based role.
  
  
**Role Purpose:**
Drive profitable growth for X-Rite Pantone print and packaging solutions across North India by developing new customers, expanding strategic accounts, strengthening channel partners, and managing the complete sales cycle from opportunity creation through commercial closure, delivery coordination, and post-sale follow-up.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Sales Growth & Territory Development:**

* Develop and execute annual and quarterly territory plans aligned with revenue, bookings, product-mix, margin, and recurring-revenue objectives.
* Develop new business with:

+ Commercial printers
+ Packaging converters
+ Label printers
+ Brand owners
+ Premedia/prepress companies
+ Ink manufacturers

* Build a healthy sales pipeline through structured prospecting, customer visits, referrals, industry networking, seminars, exhibitions, and partner-led demand generation.
* Position appropriate solutions across color measurement, quality control, color workflow, ink formulation, pressroom automation, closed-loop systems, software, services, and subscriptions.

* Negotiate professionally and close orders while protecting price quality, payment terms, and commercial compliance.
* Drive territory revenue, bookings, margins, product mix and recurring revenue.
* Track competitor activity, customer investments, technology trends and pricing.
* Sell technical solutions covering:

+ Color measurement and spectrophotometers
+ Color/quality-control workflows
+ Ink formulation
+ Pressroom automation
+ Closed-loop systems
+ Software, services and subscriptions

**Account & Opportunity Management:**

* Manage the full sales cycle, including lead qualification, discovery, solution recommendation, demonstration, trial or proof of concept, commercial negotiation, order booking, and handover.
* Grow existing accounts through cross-selling, upgrades, service, software, subscription and replacement opportunities.
* Develop account plans for strategic customers and create cross-sell, upgrade, service, software, subscription, and replacement opportunities within the installed base.
* Maintain accurate opportunity stages, next actions, close dates, forecast categories, competitive information, and customer records in CRM.
* Provide regular forecasts and business updates covering pipeline health, order activity, negotiation status, pricing, risks, competition, and support required.

**Channel Management:**

* Manage and develop dealers, resellers, and solution partners across the assigned territory.
* Manage dealers, resellers and solution partners across North India.
* Create joint business plans, opportunity reviews, customer-visit plans, product training, and demand-generation activities with channel partners.
* Monitor partner performance, opportunity ownership, pricing discipline, forecast quality, customer coverage, and follow-up effectiveness.
* Identify potential channel gaps and support onboarding and development of suitable partners where required.

* Coordinate product demonstrations, application discussions, feasibility assessments, samples, and technical workshops with application, service, product, and marketing teams.
* Coordinate internally with applications, service, marketing, finance, customer service, supply chain and logistics.
* Work closely with customer service, finance, supply chain, logistics, service, and technical teams to support approvals, order processing, delivery, installation, training, and payment follow-up.
* Represent the company at exhibitions, conferences, customer seminars, and industry forums through professional presentations and demonstrations.

title: Sales Analyst
description:
**Company Description**
InMode Ltd. is a leading global provider of innovative, award-winning medical technologies focused on enhancing well-being and clinical outcomes. The company develops, manufactures, and markets platforms that use novel radio-frequency (RF) technology to support minimally invasive procedures and improve existing surgical techniques. InMode’s RF-based platforms serve a multi-billion-dollar market across specialties such as plastic surgery, gynecology, dermatology, ENT, and ophthalmology. The company’s solutions are designed to help medical professionals deliver high-quality, efficient care. Product availability and approved indications may vary by country, and applicants should note that regulatory approvals differ by region.

**Role Description**
This full-time Sales Analyst role is a onsite position based in Delhi, India, with some flexibility for work from home. The Sales Analyst will collect, analyze, and interpret sales data to support strategic planning and decision-making, including performance tracking across territories, products, and customer segments. Day-to-day responsibilities include preparing regular sales reports and dashboards, identifying trends and growth opportunities, and supporting forecasting and budgeting activities in collaboration with sales and finance teams. The role will also involve monitoring key performance indicators, evaluating sales initiatives, and providing data-driven recommendations to optimize revenue and customer retention. The Sales Analyst will work closely with sales representatives and customer-facing teams to improve processes, support pricing and promotions, and ensure timely, accurate information for leadership.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills to manage large data sets, perform quantitative analysis, and generate actionable insights.
* Candidates should possess solid Communication skills to present findings clearly, create concise reports, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Candidates should possess a customer-focused mindset and Customer Service orientation to understand client needs and support sales teams in addressing them.
* Candidates should possess basic to advanced Finance knowledge to support forecasting, budgeting, pricing analysis, and revenue performance reviews.
* Candidates should possess Sales acumen to interpret sales pipelines, understand market dynamics, and contribute to sales strategy and execution.
* Proficiency with Excel and business intelligence or CRM tools (e.g., Power BI, QLIK, Salesforce) is highly beneficial.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Marketing, Data Analytics, or a related field; relevant experience in medical devices or healthcare is an advantage.

title: Branch Manager
description:
**Job Summary**
This role exists to lead the overall performance, governance and customer outcomes of the branch. The role is accountable for delivering sustainable business growth, maintaining a strong risk and control environment, and ensuring customers receive consistent, high-quality banking services.
  
  
Supporting the Bank’s strategy, the role drives customer acquisition, retention and relationship deepening by ensuring the branch delivers trusted financial guidance, exceptional service and access to wealth, liability and asset solutions that meet evolving customer needs. Through effective leadership of people, operations and change initiatives, the role strengthens branch competitiveness, customer loyalty and long-term franchise growth.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Business Growth, Profitability & Market Development**

* Achieve branch revenue and business targets by executing branch plans that drive customer acquisition, customer retention, relationship deepening and sustainable portfolio growth.
* Strengthen branch profitability by improving the deposit mix across current and savings accounts, increasing non-funded income, managing fee waivers effectively and maintaining expenditure within approved budgets.
* Increase customer value and product penetration by leading the branch’s growth across current accounts, savings accounts, term deposits, wealth management solutions, and secured and unsecured asset products.
* Improve customer retention and lifetime value by monitoring customer behaviours, identifying attrition risks and directing timely engagement that strengthens long-term banking relationships.
* Grow branch market share and competitiveness by championing product launches, sales initiatives, customer acquisition campaigns and local promotional activities relevant to the branch catchment area.
* Improve productivity and commercial outcomes by monitoring revenue, portfolio, customer, cost and sales performance indicators and taking timely corrective action.

**Customer Experience & Relationship Leadership**

* Build customer trust, satisfaction and loyalty by establishing clear service expectations and embedding customer-focused behaviours across the branch.
* Improve the consistency and quality of customer service by reviewing customer feedback and service measures, observing frontline delivery, role-modelling expected standards and coaching colleagues on improvement priorities.
* Protect customer confidence and the Bank’s reputation by ensuring complex complaints, service failures and escalations are resolved promptly, fairly and within appropriate authority levels.
* Strengthen customer relationships by ensuring branch teams understand customer needs and provide access to relevant banking, wealth and financing capabilities across the Bank.
* Deliver fair and appropriate customer outcomes by reinforcing responsible selling, customer protection and service standards throughout branch activities.

**Branch Operations & Service Delivery**

* Maintain reliable and efficient branch service delivery by overseeing daily operations, transaction authorisation, payment release, operational workflows and customer service capacity within delegated authorities.
* Protect operational accuracy and service quality by monitoring work, reviewing exceptions and ensuring branch processes consistently meet established standards.
* Maintain effective control over branch funds, records and documentation by overseeing relevant account positions, transaction records, archives and document-retention requirements.
* Resolve operational and customer service issues effectively by providing subject-matter guidance, making decisions within delegated authority and escalating material concerns appropriately.
* Ensure branch resources support customer and business demand by managing staffing capacity, facilities, records, systems and other operational requirements.

**Change and Distribution Transformation**

* Deliver successful branch change initiatives by leading the implementation of transaction migration, systems enhancements, process re-engineering, branch-space optimisation and premises reconfiguration.
* Improve branch productivity and customer access by aligning physical, digital and self-service channels with changing customer behaviours and service needs.
* Sustain business and customer outcomes through change by setting clear expectations, engaging colleagues, managing implementation risks and monitoring adoption across the branch.
* Strengthen branch readiness for future WRB priorities by identifying capability, process and resource changes required to support evolving distribution and customer strategies.

**Risk, Governance and Regulatory Leadership**

* Maintain a strong and effective branch control environment by ensuring activities comply with applicable laws, regulations, internal policies, delegated authorities and operational standards.
* Protect customers and the Bank from material risks by ensuring operational, financial crime, conduct, liquidity, market, reputational and other relevant branch risks are identified, monitored, mitigated and escalated.
* Strengthen branch governance and accountability by reviewing relevant management information, maintaining appropriate oversight and participating in applicable governance and risk forums.
* Ensure timely resolution of control weaknesses by addressing audit findings, compliance matters, operational incidents and recurring issues through appropriate corrective action.
* Promote responsible business conduct by setting clear expectations, reinforcing the Bank’s values and ensuring risk and conduct considerations inform branch decisions.

**People and Talent**

* Set direction and drive high performance by translating strategy into clear direction, aligning individual goals to team outcomes and providing regular, constructive feedback.
* Develop talent and capability through coaching and career conversations that build critical skills, stretch potential and prepare individuals for future opportunities.
* Lead by example by role-modelling the Bank’s valued behaviours, upholding strong risk and conduct standards, exercising sound judgment, and creating an inclusive team culture that supports wellbeing, values diverse perspectives, and drives accountability.

**Motivations**

* Energised by creating a branch environment where customers receive trusted, responsive and consistently high-quality service, and where colleagues understand the part they play, in building lasting customer relationships.
* Motivated by leading a branch to achieve sustainable commercial success, balancing revenue growth and customer retention with responsible risk management and positive customer outcomes.
* Thrives on developing people, improving branch capabilities and leading change that strengthens customer experience, operational effectiveness and long-term business performance.

**Skills And Experience**
**Priority Skills**

* Branch Operations
* Retail Banking
* Financial Services
* Risk Management
* Compliance Advisory
* Compliance Monitoring
* Customer Due Diligence
* Customer Experience
* Financial Performance Analysis
* Client Financial Management
* Change Management
* Regulatory & Compliance
* Sales Licenses
* Sales Monitoring
* Team Management

**Other Skills**

* Coaching & Mentoring
* Complaint Management
* Data Analysis

**Qualifications**

* Experience leading a branch, service-delivery unit or customer-facing financial services operation with accountability for customer outcomes, business performance, operational effectiveness and people leadership.
* Experience leading teams to deliver consistent customer-service standards, including coaching colleagues, addressing complex escalations and improving performance through customer feedback and service measures.
* Experience delivering revenue, profitability, customer acquisition and retention outcomes in a target-driven environment, using commercial and customer insights to set priorities and improve performance.
* Experience overseeing regulated banking operations and controls, including transaction authorities, operational risk, governance, compliance and the resolution of audit or control matters.
* Business English

**About Standard Chartered**
We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.
  
  
Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
* In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
* Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
* A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

title: Customer Success Team Lead | SAAS
description:
**Role Overview**

Most Customer Success roles are built to survive churn. This one is built to prevent it — and then grow past it.

As Team Leader, Customer Success at MyOperator, you will directly manage a pod of 5–8 Customer Success Representatives across an SMB and Mid-Market portfolio. Your job is to move the team from reactive firefighting to a structured, proactive commercial motion — with clear playbooks, health score dashboards, and a 30-day onboarding engine that accelerates Time-to-Value for every new customer. You will own your team's Gross Revenue Retention and Net Retention Rate numbers and be accountable for delivering them, quarter after quarter.

This is a people-management role with hard commercial accountability. You are expected to run a tight ship operationally — 1:1s, pipeline reviews, usage monitoring — while also thinking like a revenue owner who can spot expansion opportunities before customers even ask.

**About MyOperator**

MyOperator is a Business AI Operator and category leader that unifies WhatsApp, Calls, and AI-powered chatbots & voice bots into one intelligent business communication platform. Unlike fragmented communication tools, MyOperator combines automation, intelligence, and workflow integration to help businesses run WhatsApp campaigns, manage calls, deploy AI chatbots, and track performance — all from a single no-code platform. Trusted by 12,000+ brands including Amazon, Domino's, Apollo, and Razorpay, MyOperator enables faster responses, higher resolution rates, and scalable customer engagement.

**Key Responsibility Areas**

* **Team Management:**
  Directly manage 5–8 Customer Success Representatives. Conduct weekly 1:1s tracking individual account health and pipeline, run monthly upsell pipeline reviews, and hold each CSR accountable to quarterly renewal and expansion targets.
* **Revenue & Retention Ownership:**
  Own GRR and NRR for your team's portfolio. Build, maintain, and execute account-specific intervention playbooks for at-risk accounts — triggered by usage signals, low call volumes, or stakeholder changes — before accounts reach the point of churn.
* **Onboarding Engine:**
  Design and enforce a structured 30-day onboarding journey combining tech-touch automation and high-touch check-ins. Track Time-to-Value at the cohort level and identify patterns that delay activation.
* **Health Score Infrastructure:**
  Build and maintain customer health score dashboards in the CRM. Configure automated alerts for accounts showing early warning signals — dropping usage, low call volumes, missed check-ins — so your team can intervene before the customer considers churning.
* **Escalation & Cross-Functional Input:**
  Serve as the primary escalation owner for high-risk accounts in your portfolio. Synthesize product friction data across accounts monthly and deliver structured input to the Product and Engineering teams with account evidence.
* **CSR Skill Development:**
  Identify performance gaps across your team by reviewing call recordings, customer emails, and CRM notes. Run structured coaching sessions to develop commercial conversation skills, objection handling, and expansion identification.

**Requirements — Must Have**

* **5+ years**
  of experience in B2B Customer Success or Account Management at a SaaS or technology company, with direct exposure to SMB or Mid-Market segments.
* **2+ years of people management**
  experience, having directly managed a team of 3 or more CSRs or Account Managers — including running performance reviews, handling underperformance, and conducting hiring.
* **Commercial quota ownership:**
  Demonstrable track record of carrying and achieving a revenue-linked quota — Net Retention Rate, Upsell ARR, or Gross Renewal targets — not just customer satisfaction scores.
* **CRM proficiency:**
  Hands-on experience configuring dashboards, running reports, and managing pipeline in enterprise CRMs (Salesforce, HubSpot, or Zoho CRM) and/or CS platforms (Gainsight, ChurnZero, or Totango).
* **Data independence:**
  Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUPs, conditional logic) to independently build and analyze customer usage reports, churn cohort tables, and renewal forecasts without relying on a BI team.

**Requirements — Good to Have**

* Domain experience in Cloud Telephony, UCaaS, CPaaS, or AI-powered customer communication platforms — familiarity with how call volumes, IVR usage, and agent activity signal account health.
* Demonstrated experience leading a CS team through a motion shift — from reactive support to a commercial upsell and expansion model — including documentation of the before/after process change.
* Experience building or operating automated low-touch customer engagement sequences: triggered email cadences based on usage thresholds, lifecycle milestones, or health score drops.
* Familiarity with CS analytics and forecasting: ability to build a 90-day renewal forecast at the team level and present it to senior leadership with variance analysis.

**This Profile Is Not For**

* Candidates whose primary experience is in B2C customer service, retail support, or high-volume inbound call center operations — even at the team lead level.
* Candidates who have never owned a revenue, renewal, or upsell quota — this role carries hard commercial accountability and requires experience with being measured on a number.
* Individual contributors seeking their first people management opportunity — this role requires prior experience managing, developing, and where necessary, exiting direct reports.

title: Director / Associate Director – Client Relationship & AI Delivery
description:
**About Sirius AI**

Sirius AI is an AI consulting and solutions firm working with financial services clients, including banks, fintechs, payments companies and wealth managers. Our teams design, build and run GenAI, agentic AI and ML solutions inside client environments, working alongside their business, technology and risk teams.

**About the Role**

We are hiring a Director / Associate Director to lead client engagement in the UAE. You will be the senior Sirius AI person the client knows and calls. You will own the relationship, the delivery and the commercials, and you will be responsible for growing our business with the client.

This is primarily a client-facing role. You will spend a good part of your time at client offices, meeting CXOs and business heads, building relationships beyond the teams we already work with, and finding new problems we can help solve. Delivery is run by an account team based in India, which you will lead. You are accountable for that team delivering on time and to a high standard.

The level (Director or Associate Director) will be based on experience and the scale of client relationships and teams you have managed.

**What You Will Do**

* Be the primary point of contact for Sirius AI with client stakeholders at every level, from CXOs through to programme and operational leads.
* Build and maintain relationships with CXO and senior business stakeholders. Run regular executive reviews and steering committees, and make sure senior clients have a clear view of progress, value delivered and what comes next.
* Expand our footprint by building relationships beyond our current sponsors, meeting new business units and functions, understanding their priorities, and turning those conversations into new engagements.
* Spend regular time on site at client offices. Be present in their offices, attend their internal forums where invited, and pick up on issues and opportunities before they show up in a status report.
* Own the account P&L, including revenue, margin, utilisation, billing and collections. Work on pricing and commercial terms for new work and change requests, and keep forecasts accurate.
* Lead the India-based account delivery team through delivery managers and technical leads. Set priorities, remove blockers, and make sure the team understands the client’s business and what matters to each stakeholder.
* Be accountable for on-time, high-quality delivery across all engagements you oversee. Track milestones, risks and dependencies, step in early when something is slipping, and be honest with clients when it does.
* Work closely with our GTM and solutions teams to stay current on what Sirius AI is building across the firm, including new offerings, accelerators and case studies. Identify which of these are relevant to which client stakeholders and set up the right conversations.
* Track client sentiment through regular check-ins, feedback from senior stakeholders and formal satisfaction reviews. Flag concerns early and agree recovery plans where needed.
* Lead proposals and orals for new work, working with solution architects on scope, approach, estimates and staffing.
* Make sure delivery meets client and regulatory requirements for AI governance, security, data privacy and model risk management.

**What You Need**

* Director: 15+ years of experience, including at least 5 years managing client accounts or large programmes in consulting or technology services. Associate Director: 12+ years, including at least 3 years in a client-facing account or delivery leadership role.
* A track record of managing senior client relationships, including regular interaction with CXOs and business heads, at large enterprises.
* Evidence of growing accounts. You should be able to show where you opened new stakeholders or business units and turned that into new revenue.
* Direct responsibility for an account or programme P&L, including pricing, margin management and revenue forecasting.
* Experience leading offshore delivery teams, ideally from India, while managing clients onsite.
* Enough understanding of AI, data and analytics delivery to discuss solutions credibly with clients, challenge your own team on scope and quality, and judge when a delivery problem is technical and when it is not.
* Strong executive communication. You should be comfortable presenting to a CXO, handling a difficult conversation about a missed milestone, and pitching a new idea to a business head you have just met.
* Willingness to travel frequently and spend significant time at client locations.
* A bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, business or a related field. An MBA is a plus.

**Good to Have**

* Experience working with financial services clients in banking, payments, lending, insurance or wealth management.
* Existing relationships with financial services organisations in the UAE or wider GCC.
* Background in a consulting firm, Big 4 or global technology services company in an account management or client partner role.
* Experience delivering GenAI, agentic AI or ML programmes into production.
* Familiarity with AI governance and model risk management requirements in regulated industries.
