title: Team Lead - Revenue
description:
**Team Lead - Revenue (Influencer Marketing)**

We're looking for a hands-on Team Lead to own and grow the Affiliate business at Wishlink. You'll lead a team of 5, driving day-to-day execution while directly managing relationships with our top-performing creators - the backbone of our affiliate revenue. This is a role for someone who thrives on data, structure, and getting into the weeds to solve problems.

**About Wishlink**

Wishlink is on a mission to revolutionize the creator economy and redefine how people shop. We're all about providing every user with a highly personalized shopping experience guided by creators, so they can find exactly what they want, in a very short time, while improving their online shopping experience severalfold. We are shaping a new era at the intersection of two of the most prominent aspects of the internet- e-commerce and social media.

**Team and Investors**

Wishlink was founded by 3 friends from college, Chandan, Shaurya, and Divyansh, with a shared passion to solve real-world problems at scale and consume content for hours (XD). We started Wishlink in January 2022 when we discovered products on social media that we wanted to buy but could not (in some cases, actually did)! We are based out of Gurugram. We have recently raised a series A round of $7M, led by Fundamentum & Elevation Capital.

**Why Join Us?**

**Exciting Problem**

The way people shop online is changing. Users are tired of spending hours browsing humongous catalogs on eCommerce marketplaces just to find a single piece of apparel they like. They need curation, and they need trusted reviews - which is what Wishlink is bringing with the help of content creators. Wishlink is at the forefront of this change, enabling users to shop in an easier and more exciting way.

**Immense Scale**

In just 3 years of existence, Wishlink is used by over 900k users daily to discover and shop products online. This number has grown over 3x in the last 4 months.

**Stellar Team**

Wishlink is all about its people. Our team is young and energetic, come from stellar backgrounds, and are dedicated towards a common goal. Also, we have a LOT of fun!

**Growth Opportunity**

We have grown remarkably in the last 3 years and are doing a monthly GMV of over Rs. 150cr. We are working with over 10,000 content creators and 250+ brands and eCommerce marketplaces including Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Nykaa, Ajio, H&M, Savana (Urbanic), Only, Vero Moda, Libas, Aurelia, Mama Earth, and many more.

Wishlink presents an exciting opportunity for you to contribute to and grow within the creator-enabled eCommerce space, have the chance to work at an emerging consumer-tech startup and be an integral part of this dynamic journey.

**What Would You Be Doing?**

* Lead and manage a team of 5, running daily stand-ups to track progress, unblock issues, and keep the team aligned on priorities
* Own relationships with top affiliate creators, ensuring they're engaged, supported, and set up to maximize their earnings on the platform
* Monitor affiliate business performance daily - GMV, clicks, conversions, and creator earnings - and take corrective action where needed
* Identify trends, bottlenecks, and opportunities in creator performance using data, and translate findings into action plans
* Build and refine processes to make the team's day-to-day execution faster and more scalable
* Coach and mentor team members, helping them grow in their roles and improve their output quality
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Product, Analytics, Ops) to resolve creator issues and improve the affiliate experience
* Prepare and present regular performance reports to leadership

**What Are We Looking For?**

* Btech or Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field.
* 3+ years of experience in affiliate marketing, Influencer marketing, account management, operations, or performance marketing.
* Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders and deliver under tight timelines.
* Highly analytical, with strong Excel and data interpretation skills.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and problem-solving abilities.
* Self-motivated, ownership-driven, and comfortable working in dynamic environments.
* Strong understanding of digital ecosystems and content-led brand campaigns..

**Perks and Benefits**

We are committed to providing the best environment for you to thrive in. To help with this, we have the following benefits available for all our employees.

* Competitive Salary, Generous ESOPs, and Relocation Bonus
* Learning & Development Programs with a Dedicated Budget
* Company sponsored newsletters and books
* AI Subscriptions
* Regular Team Outings
* Discounted Health Plans & Gym Memberships
* Industry insights on growing your social media if you are a (aspiring) creator

**Experience Wishlink**

Explore our Creator App: iOS | Android

Explore our Shopping App: iOS | Android

Divyansh Ameta - Founder & COO

Chandan Yadav - Founder & CTO

title: General Manager, Strategic Alliances
description:
**Job Description**
**General Manager - Strategic Alliances, Partnerships & Outreach**
**Reports to**
Sales Head, India & MEA
  
  
**Business**
Schneider Electric
  
  

* Education Equipment and Services

**Location**
India, with travel across assigned markets
  
  
**Scope**
Builds strategic alliances with industrial companies, prime integrators, CSR sponsors and public-private skilling programmes
  
  
**About The Role**
Large industrial companies, prime integrators, and corporate social responsibility programmes increasingly fund and operate skilling centres for India’s technical institutes. As the Strategic Alliances, Partnerships & Outreach lead, you will position Schneider Electric as the named technical partner within these programmes, bringing expertise in electrical systems, energy management, industrial automation, curriculum, training, and certification into centres originated and anchored by partner organisations.
  
  
This is an alliance-led business development role. Success begins well before an opportunity becomes revenue, often when Schneider Electric is incorporated into a partner’s investment plan, consortium strategy, CSR programme, public-private partnership proposal, or bid. You will influence partner priorities, shape the technical proposition, and build sustained relationships across industrial accounts, integrators, employers, foundations, government frameworks, and education ecosystems.
  
  
You will work closely with Schneider Electric industrial account teams, sales, marketing, pre-sales, application engineering, legal, finance, and operations to qualify alliances, develop joint value propositions, support partner bids, and progress partnership-led opportunities into executable programmes and commercial outcomes.
  
  
What You Will Do
  
  
Build Strategic Partner Relationships
  
  
Develop senior relationships with industrial companies anchoring skilling programmes, prime integrators assembling industry consortia, employers funding Centres of Excellence through CSR budgets, foundations, and other programme sponsors.
  
  
Secure Early Technical-Partner Positioning
  
  
Ensure Schneider Electric is named as the preferred technical partner while partners are preparing investment plans, concept notes, consortium structures, CSR proposals, expressions of interest, and bids, rather than waiting for formal procurement to begin.
  
  
Activate Schneider Electric Account Networks
  
  
Work through Schneider Electric’s industrial account teams and existing customer relationships to identify prospective alliance partners, map decision-makers, secure introductions, and build coordinated engagement plans.
  
  
Translate the Value Proposition
  
  
Convert Schneider Electric’s capabilities in electrification, energy management, automation, digitalisation, curriculum, training, and certification into the criteria on which each partner is evaluated, particularly graduate employability, placement outcomes, industry relevance, utilisation, scalability, and programme impact.
  
  
Pursue Public-Private Partnership Frameworks
  
  
Identify and apply to open, transparent, criteria-based state public-private partnership and skilling frameworks where Schneider Electric’s capabilities and partner model are a strong fit.
  
  
Manage a Scalable Alliance Portfolio
  
  
Maintain disciplined engagement across multiple corporate and institutional relationships in parallel. Track stakeholder maps, partner plans, opportunity stages, next actions, risks, dependencies, and periods of inactivity so that no priority relationship goes quiet.
  
  
Shape and Support Consortium Bids
  
  
Contribute technical-partner inputs to partner-led proposals and bids, including scope, responsibilities, solution narratives, outcome frameworks, credentials, implementation assumptions, governance, and supporting documentation.
  
  
Strengthen Ecosystem Outreach
  
  
Represent Schneider Electric in relevant industry, CSR, skilling, and education forums to identify emerging programmes, develop partner visibility, and create pathways for future alliances.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own the strategic-alliance pipeline from partner identification and qualification through joint proposition development, nomination, bid support, agreement, and commercial handover.
* Develop partner account plans covering strategic fit, programme portfolio, decision-makers, funding sources, influence map, Schneider Electric entry points, risks, and next actions.
* Create joint value propositions and partnership models that clearly define partner roles, Schneider Electric’s technical contribution, expected outcomes, governance, commercial principles, and route to market.
* Coordinate internal approvals and cross-functional inputs for memoranda of understanding, consortium arrangements, framework participation, CSR programmes, and partner-led bids.
* Maintain accurate alliance records and provide management visibility on early-stage nominations, partner-originated pipeline, bid inclusion, conversion risks, and expected business value.

What You Bring
  
  

* 15+ years of experience in corporate business development, strategic alliances, partnerships, ecosystem development, or key-account management involving large industrial customers.
* Demonstrated experience selling into or through another organisation’s programme, rather than relying only on direct sales to an end customer.
* Experience navigating multi-party consortia and contributing effectively to another organisation’s investment plan, proposal, or bid.
* Ability to influence without direct control and to align organisations with different objectives, governance models, timelines, and commercial interests.
* Strong capability in senior stakeholder engagement, partner qualification, consultative business development, negotiation, and executive communication.
* Working understanding of CSR-funded programmes, Centres of Excellence, public-private partnerships, institutional skilling initiatives, and partner-led procurement models in India.
* Commercial judgement to distinguish strategically valuable alliances from unfocused relationship activity and to convert early positioning into qualified pipeline.
* High operating discipline, with the ability to manage many relationships and long-cycle opportunities without losing momentum.
* Willingness to travel frequently across India and, where required, within the India and MEA region.

Key Metrics for Success
  
  
**Measure**
**Definition**
**Strategic relationships**
Number, seniority, quality, and activity of anchor-partner, prime-integrator, employer, CSR sponsor, and ecosystem relationships.
  
  
**Early partner nomination**
Investment plans, concept notes, consortium structures, CSR proposals, and bids that explicitly name Schneider Electric as technical partner.
  
  
**Consortium Partner-originated pipeline**
Qualified opportunities and potential revenue influenced or originated through alliances, account teams, consortium partners, and sponsorship programmes.
  
  
**Consortium and bid inclusion**
Partner-led proposals and bids supported, submitted, shortlisted, and converted with Schneider Electric included in the defined technical role.
  
  
**Framework participation**
Relevant criteria-based public-private partnership, CSR, and skilling frameworks identified, pursued, entered, and activated.
  
  
**Relationship momentum**
Consistency of stakeholder engagement, next-action closure, opportunity progression, and prevention of inactivity across the alliance portfolio.
  
  
**Commercial conversion**
Progression of early partner positioning into signed agreements, funded programmes, orders, and sustainable repeat business.
  
  
**What's in it for me?**

* High-impact role where your work directly influences organizational success and customer outcomes
* Opportunity to build relationships with senior leaders and shape strategic direction
* Access to cross-functional resources, expert networks, and cutting-edge solutions
* Supportive culture that invests in your professional growth and development

Join us and lead the way in delivering solutions that matter — apply today!
  
  
Rewards designed for you
  
  
Our Total Rewards is our way of saying: We see you and we value you. It’s more than just pay and benefits—it’s a meaningful investment in you. It is designed to help you perform, grow, feel safe, and elevate your potential. The package helps you care for yourself and your family, plan your future, grow your skills and career, collaborate in an inclusive workplace, and contribute to your community. These technologies include—but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.You are both a big picture thinker and in-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
We are seeking an exceptional Director of Delivery Management of Professional Services to lead our Global Delivery Centre. This is a senior leadership role for someone who is an equal parts delivery leader & growth driver — someone who does not just run a services organisation but actively multiplies its impact. You will combine deep Salesforce delivery expertise with a growth mindset, executive presence, and the relentless persistence to grow the team’s reputation as a centre of excellence.

* Lead through thought leadership, industry visibility, partner engagement, and a reputation for delivery excellence that makes clients want to work with us and talent want to join us.
* Champion GDC capabilities internally and externally; position the centre as a strategic asset and a differentiator in contested sales situations.
* Build and foster stronger collaboration with Regional Salesforce Professional Services teams and broader ecosystem partners.
* Drive the Product & Engineering feedback loop for Customers as OneSalesforce program by fostering stronger relationships and collaboration with Product & Engineering teams.
* Communicate with clarity, concision, and impact — both in writing and in spoken form — across diverse audiences from technical teams to C-suite executives.
* Listen actively and adapt communication style to the audience; project calm and confidence in high-pressure situations and during periods of crisis or uncertainty.
* Build strong, trusted partnerships across a matrixed organisation, influencing without authority and earning credibility through expertise and integrity.
* Collaborate effectively across internal and external teams to garner alignment and achieve outsized impact.

**You’re Our Person If...**

* 18+ years of experience in a consulting firm or professional services division of a software company, delivering software-based business solutions across Sales, Marketing, Service, and Support.
* Demonstrable growth mindset — a track record of not just managing a practice but building it from scratch, expanding it, opening new accounts, and building a pipeline through personal hustle, network, and thought leadership.
* Strong Salesforce experience across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and/or Industry Clouds; knowledge of Data & AI / Agentic Tech Stacks is highly valued.
* Track record of at least 5 successful Salesforce cloud project implementations, including one or more large-scale transformation engagements.
* Demonstrated success in building and scaling practice capability through pre-sales playbooks, architectural design frameworks, and demand planning.

* Deep understanding of enterprise sales cycles and different professional services engagement models.
* Experience building or contributing to brand positioning for a delivery organization — through content, partnerships, events, or industry recognition.
* Demonstrated understanding of integration frameworks and experience delivering performant, scalable, and robust complex Salesforce integrations.
* Strong grasp of business processes and their implementation into enterprise applications; ability to quickly translate technology concepts into business value.
* Degree or equivalent proven experience; experience evaluated on core competencies, including leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, and work experience.

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*

*do your best*

title: Factory Manager
description:
**Company Description**

Opaque Studio
designs and makes handcrafted solid-wood furniture for [domestic retail / export / hospitality] clients. Our team combines traditional joinery with modern machining, and we are committed to sustainable sourcing and production.

As Factory Manager, you will run our Greater Noida plant end to end, from raw timber to packed, export-ready furniture. You will own production planning, quality, safety, people and costs, and you will be the operational face of the factory for clients, buyers and auditors. You will work closely with design, merchandising, procurement and logistics to make sure every order ships on time, to specification and within budget.

Key responsibilities

**Production planning and control**

* Turn confirmed orders into weekly and daily production plans across machining, carpentry, assembly, finishing and packing.
* Plan capacity, manpower and material requirements so every order meets its committed ship date.
* Track work-in-progress and remove bottlenecks across the shop floor.
* Make the best use of timber, panels, hardware, finishes and consumables, and keep wastage and rework low.

**Wood processing and finishing**

* Oversee wood seasoning and enforce moisture-content checks before machining.
* Supervise cutting, CNC and panel processing, joinery, carving, assembly, sanding and polishing or PU/lacquer finishing.
* Standardise processes, jigs and work instructions so quality stays consistent from batch to batch.

**Quality control**

* Own the QC system: incoming material inspection, in-process checks and pre-dispatch inspection.
* Make sure products match approved samples, drawings and client specifications.
* Investigate defects and customer complaints, find root causes and put corrective actions in place.
* Prepare for and host buyer and third-party inspections and audits.

**Merchandising and client coordination**

* Work with merchandising on sampling, costing inputs, order feasibility and timelines.
* Meet and update clients and buyers on order status, samples and quality.
* Coordinate with design on new product development and production-ready drawings.

**Health, safety and compliance**

* Enforce workplace safety: machine guarding, PPE, dust extraction, fire safety and safe handling of chemicals and finishes.
* Keep the factory compliant with labour laws, factory regulations and environmental norms.
* Maintain certifications and documentation required by clients.

**People leadership**

* Lead, supervise and motivate supervisors, artisans and workers.
* Set targets, review performance and handle discipline and conflict resolution fairly.
* Run ongoing skill training for craftspeople and machine operators, and build a pipeline of future supervisors.

**Reporting and documentation**

* Track and report factory KPIs to leadership every week and every month.
* Maintain production records, QC reports, inventory and maintenance logs.
* Work with procurement, stores and logistics on material availability, dispatch planning and export documentation.

Requirements

**Must have**

* 10–15 years in manufacturing, including at least 5 years managing a wooden furniture or wood-products factory.
* Hands-on knowledge of solid wood and panel processing: seasoning, machining, joinery, assembly and finishing.
* A track record of production planning, capacity planning and on-time delivery in a make-to-order setup.
* Experience running a QC system and handling buyer inspections.
* Proven leadership of large shop-floor teams, including skilled artisans and contract labour.
* Working knowledge of factory safety, labour laws and statutory compliance in India.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and organisational skills, with close attention to detail.
* Clear communication in Hindi and English, for both the shop floor and clients.
* Comfort with MS Excel and an ERP or production-tracking system.
* Familiarity with CNC machines and CAD drawings.

title: Quality Care Manager
description:
**Role purpose**

The QCM heads the dealership's quality care team and ensures all sales operations are aligned with ARENA channel values and guidelines. The QCM ensures all enablers are in place for a delightful experience across the customer journey, and takes corrective action to improve Quality of Sales (QoS) standards.

**Key responsibilities**

1. Ensure a delightful experience at every touch point of the customer journey, in line with ARENA experience standards.

2. Ensure all staff follow ARENA guidelines and processes, including showroom, car display, test drive, delivery and facility management norms.

5. Ensure every vehicle is delivered with complete documentation; record any pendency, inform the customer and track it to closure as committed.

6. Track pending bookings and proactively update customers in case of delay.

7. Handle customer feedback, complaints and escalations with empathy; identify the root cause, resolve every grievance and maximise internal complaint capturing.

8. Attend the morning meeting to review previous-day performance; review team performance on quality of sales parameters fortnightly and prepare an action plan with the CEO.

9. Train the sales team regularly on sales quality aspects of dealership processes and update them on NPS improvement areas.

10. Conduct customer engagement activities (including celebrating customer birthdays and anniversaries) and highlight best practices of RMs and company.

1. Handling digital technology at the dealership (DMS, delivery schedule app, other company apps)

2. Professionalism

3. Self-motivation and ensuring implementation of Experience Standards

5. Using DMS reports for MIS reporting

6. Understanding customer expectations and taking corrective action

7. Good listening skills

8. Leadership in engaging other team members

9. Thorough knowledge of ARENA experience standards

10. Adherence to all quality check points

11. Pro-active, customer-centric approach

title: Head of Operations
description: What This Role IsEvery year, hundreds of thousands of students across India decide they want to study abroad. They choose a destination, find a counselor or agent, start an application — and then enter a process that, for most of them, is opaque, slow, and full of friction. Documents go missing. Deadlines are missed. University portals time out. Applications that should take days take weeks. The student is waiting. The university is waiting. And somewhere in the middle, the operational infrastructure either holds or it doesn't.At Manifest Global, the student placements function is the engine that makes this work at scale. Across destinations — UK, US, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, and beyond — thousands of student applications move through a system that has to be fast, accurate, and consistent, every intake cycle, without fail. Application preparation, submission, tagging, tracking, university coordination, invoicing — every step in that chain has to run cleanly for the business to convert at the rate it needs to and realise the revenue it has built.Right now, the infrastructure exists. The volume is growing. What's needed is the person who owns it — not just manages it, but builds it into something that scales without breaking, performs under pressure, and improves measurably cycle over cycle. That's what this role is.The Head of Operations, is the operational authority for the student placements function across Manifest Global. You'll own the full application lifecycle, the team that executes it, the metrics that measure it, and the processes that hold it together when volume is high and timelines are tight. This is a leadership role for someone who has built operations in high-volume environments before and knows exactly what great looks like, and who wants that operational foundation to be the launchpad for something bigger: building the central operating infrastructure for a multi-brand, multi-country group that's still expanding.What Makes This Role DifferentMost operations leadership roles in student placements sit inside a single brand or a single corridor. This one doesn't.The student placements function at Manifest spans multiple brands and multiple destinations. The volume is real, the commercial stakes are direct — application velocity and conversion rates connect immediately to revenue — and the infrastructure is still being actively built. You're not inheriting a finished system and being asked to run it. You're inheriting a function that works and being asked to make it scale.The Manifest ecosystem behind this role is also genuinely differentiated. Cialfo's school network, BridgeU's international school relationships, Kaaiser's counselor and agent network, Explore's university partnerships — these are all feeding into the student placements pipeline. The person in this seat has visibility across all of it and the authority to build operational infrastructure that works across the full group, not just one brand.The broader overseas education industry is contracting. Manifest's student placements business is growing. That's the environment this role sits in, and it's the reason the operational infrastructure matters so much right now.Where This Function Is GoingThe student placements function is not a back-office operation. It is the growth engine of the Manifest group — the layer that converts the group's two biggest assets into revenue: the demand network (2,000+ schools via Cialfo and BridgeU) and the supply network (1,000+ university partnerships via Kaaiser and Explore). Every structural advantage Manifest has built over a decade converges at this function. The person running its operations is running the engine itself.The mandate is expanding on four fronts:Multi-brand operating hub. This function is being built as the central operations backbone for the entire group — serving Cialfo, Kaaiser, and every brand that joins the portfolio. As the group expands, new businesses will plug into the infrastructure this role builds. You're not running one brand's ops; you're designing the operating system that every current and future brand runs on.D2C expansion. Manifest is preparing to enter the direct-to-consumer segment. The operational chassis for that business will be designed and run from this seat. The person in this role will shape how a new business line is stood up, integrated, and scaled from day one.New business integration. As the portfolio grows, the operational playbook for bringing new businesses into the group — their teams, processes, systems, and pipelines — will be owned here. The ability to absorb and scale new business lines cleanly is a core strategic muscle for Manifest, and this role builds it.AI-native operations. The operations unit is being rebuilt as an AI-native function, and this role leads that transformation. You own the agenda — where AI replaces manual work in the application lifecycle, where it augments the team, and where it has no business being — and you set the roadmap Product and Technology build against. This is not a mandate to adopt tools as they arrive. It's a mandate to define what gets built, hold the standard for what ships, and re-architect the function around it. The target is an operation whose cost-to-serve and turnaround times improve as volume grows, instead of one that scales by adding headcount.What You OwnThe full student application lifecycleOwn end-to-end business operations across all major study destinations, for all of the source markets across the globe.Ensure every stage runs with the speed, accuracy, and consistency that high-volume placements require, not just during normal periods but at peak intake when the system is under maximum pressureGroup-level operating infrastructureDesign the central operations hub that serves all Manifest brands — shared workflows, shared systems, shared standards — so that every new brand, corridor, or business line plugs into proven infrastructure rather than rebuilding from scratchOwn the operational readiness and integration of new business lines, including the upcoming D2C business, from process design and systems setup through team structure and steady-state handoverPartner directly with group leadership on capacity planning, prioritisation, and the operational implications of expansion strategy — this role sits close to where growth decisions are made, because it's the function that has to absorb themOperational infrastructure and process designDesign and implement scalable, structured workflows that can absorb increasing application volumes without degrading quality or turnaround timesDefine and enforce clear SLAs, quality benchmarks, and processing standards across all destinations and team membersIdentify bottlenecks before they become crises, build the visibility and the processes to surface problems early and fix them systematicallyLead the AI transformation of the operations unit — own the transformation roadmap, define and prioritise what Product and Tech build for operations, and redesign roles, workflows, and team structure around AI rather than layering tools on top of legacy processMetrics, data, and performanceBuild dashboards and reporting that give the business a real-time view of pipeline movement and operational health — not lagging indicators, but live visibilityUse data to manage capacity, prioritisation, and risk proactively, so the team is never surprised by what's comingTeam leadershipLead and develop the student placement operations team — set clear roles, responsibilities, and performance expectations, and build a culture where accountability is the norm and ownership is realDevelop the team to perform at peak intake without degrading quality — the measure of a well-run operations function is how it performs when it's hardest, not when it's easiestUniversity and partner coordinationWork closely with university partners, counsellors, and partner teams to ensure alignment on submission standards, timelines, and documentation requirementsReduce friction at every handoff point — between the team and universities, between the team and counselors, between destinations — so that the application moves cleanly through the system from start to finishWhat Success Looks LikeThe markers below reflect where the student placements function is today. The business will have moved by the time you join — new volume targets set, new destinations in scope, new priorities surfaced. We'll calibrate the specifics together once you're in the seat. These are directional, not fixed.That said, the shape of success is clear.You'll start by building a complete picture of the current operational infrastructure — what's working, what's breaking, where the bottlenecks are, and what the highest-leverage improvements look like. You'll have a point of view on where to move first and what the function needs to look like to handle the volume that's coming.From there, things will be measurably better. Turnaround times will be faster. Submission accuracy will be higher. The team will have clearer roles and stronger capability. The metrics will show it.Over time, the student placements operation will be a genuine competitive advantage — a function that processes at scale without errors, converts at the rates the business needs, and runs consistently across intake cycles without heroics from individuals. The infrastructure you build will outlast the intake it was built for.And the function will run measurably differently from how it runs today: work that took a person will be done by a system, and the team's time will be spent on judgment and exceptions, not processing.Beyond the placements function itself, success means the operations hub you've built becomes the default answer to "how do we run this?" for every new business Manifest adds. When the D2C business launches, it launches on your infrastructure. When a new brand enters the portfolio, your playbook is what makes it productive in months instead of years. The scope of this role grows with the group, and the group is growing fast.The specifics will be calibrated once you're in the role. The direction won't change.What You BringYou've spent twelve to fifteen years in operations, and a meaningful part of that has been in student placements, international admissions, or study abroad. You understand the application lifecycle end to end, not from a policy document, but from having run it. You know where it breaks, what causes delays, and how to build systems that don't depend on the same person catching the same problem every time.You've led teams in high-volume environments before. You know that operational culture is set by what gets measured, what gets escalated, and what gets ignored, and you've built functions where accountability is real and performance expectations are clear. You don't accept that peak intake has to mean chaos. You've planned for it before and you know how to do it again.You're metrics-driven in the way that actually matters: not because the numbers look good in a report, but because you use them to make decisions. You look at turnaround time data and you know what it's telling you about where the process is breaking. You look at conversion rates and you know which stage of the lifecycle is the constraint. You build the dashboards you need to manage the function, not the ones that make it look managed.You're comfortable with ambiguity and with building. The student placements function at Manifest is growing and the infrastructure is still being actively shaped. There's no finished playbook to inherit. There are real problems to solve, real volume to handle, and real commercial outcomes riding on how well the operation runs.Most importantly, you read the description of what this function is building and your first reaction was "I know exactly what needs to happen here." That's the person this role is for.Why ManifestManifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility, connecting students, schools, universities, and employers across 150+ countries. Our portfolio spans Cialfo (AI-powered college counseling, 2,000+ schools), BridgeU (university guidance for international schools globally), Kaaiser (trusted study abroad counseling since 1997 across India and Southeast Asia), Explore (AI-powered university outreach, 1,000+ university partners), EduGo Abroad (India's only dedicated platform for European education), and Flow AI (AI-native platform for study abroad agents, 1,000+ agent partners, 550+ universities). $700B flows annually in remittances from migrant workers. 85M workers will be missing from developed economies by 2030. We're building the operating system that changes that. $80M raised. Still early.The student placements business sits at the commercial heart of that mission. When a student from India enrols at a university in Australia or the UK, that placement is the moment the entire ecosystem — the school platform, the counselor network, the university partnership, the outreach infrastructure — converts into a real outcome for a real person. The operations function that makes that happen at scale is not a support function. It's the engine. The person who builds and runs that engine from this seat is doing some of the most consequential operational work in the group.Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility, operating across 50+ countries.

title: Head of Operations
description:
The Head – Operations will own and strengthen operational performance across multiple service lines and locations — covering delivery, productivity, quality, capacity, client commitments and contribution to profitability. Working closely with the CEO and Senior Leadership Team, the person will translate business strategy into ground-level execution, deep-dive into processes, solve problems with teams and build scalable systems. expands, the role may also support operations across new geographies, requiring the flexibility to build and manage multi-location and multi-region operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Operations Leadership & Scale**

• Lead performance across service lines, ensuring delivery, productivity, quality, SLA adherence and operational efficiency.

• Build scalable structures, SOPs and accountability mechanisms.

• Strengthen capacity and resource utilization in partnership with HR and Finance.

**2. People Leadership, Talent & Capability**

• Coach and develop Operations Managers and Team Leaders, building strong leadership capability across the organisation.

• Build a strong leadership pipeline and succession plan for critical roles.

• Anticipate and forecast future talent and skill requirements based on customer business outlook, emerging service requirements and industry trends.

• Partner with HR and Training to build the required talent, skills and capability ahead of business needs through hiring, upskilling, reskilling and internal mobility.

• Foster a culture of ownership, continuous learning and performance.

• Lead with humility, respect and an equality mindset.

**3. Client & Business Partnership**

• Build strong client relationships, manage delivery commitments and handle escalations proactively.

• Support client retention and account growth.

• Partner with Business Development on RFPs, bids, solution design, pricing inputs, capacity planning and transition plans.

**4. Quality, MIS & Performance Management**

• Establish meaningful operational dashboards covering productivity, quality, utilization and SLAs.

• Convert Data → Insight → Decision → Action → Follow-up.

• Establish early-warning indicators to address gaps before they impact clients.

• Maintain a strong quality orientation across operations.

**5. Technology, AI & Business Transformation**

• Own the technology and AI-enabled transformation agenda for Operations, identifying where technology, automation, analytics and AI can materially improve productivity, quality, turnaround time, client experience and profitability.

• Develop and drive an AI & Automation roadmap for Operations, aligned with business strategy, service lines and client requirements.

• Identify and prioritize opportunities to automate repetitive/manual work, improve decision-making, strengthen quality controls and create scalable operating models.

• Work closely with IT, Operations, Business Development and external technology partners to evaluate, pilot and implement relevant AI, automation, analytics and digital solutions.

• Ensure that technology investments translate into measurable operational outcomes — productivity improvement, cost efficiency, quality improvement, capacity creation, faster turnaround and/or new client offerings.

• Lead operational change management and adoption, ensuring teams are trained and equipped to work effectively with new technologies and AI-enabled processes.

• Continuously assess emerging AI and technology capabilities and determine where they can create competitive advantage for and its clients.

• Retain clear internal accountability for transformation outcomes, even when implementation involves external technology or transformation partners.

**6. Rural & Growth-Stage Leadership**

• Balance business performance with local realities, employee development and social impact.

• Be comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment where processes and structures are evolving.

• Work comfortably with both senior leadership and frontline teams.

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for someone who has built, transformed and scaled operations — not simply held a senior title.

**Essential**

• 15+ years of professional experience, with substantial Operations leadership experience.

• Proven experience in BPO / ITES / Business Services, preferably managing multiple service lines and clients.

• Deep understanding of operations, productivity, quality, SLAs, client management and commercial outcomes.

• Proven track record in coaching managers, building teams and creating succession pipelines.

• Strong MIS, reporting, analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to support business proposals, pricing inputs, bids and solution design.

• Strong English communication and stakeholder-management skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.

• Demonstrated understanding of technology-enabled operations, including automation, data/analytics and emerging AI

applications, with the ability to identify practical use cases and translate them into operational and business outcomes.

• Experience leading or significantly contributing to technology, automation, AI or digital transformation initiatives within an

operations environment.

**Added Advantage**

• Experience in a large or established MSME.

• Experience in a social enterprise, impact-driven or purpose-driven organization.

• Experience managing rural or semi-urban, multi-location teams.

• Experience in organizational transformation, scaling, or engaging external consulting/technology partners.

• Experience building or implementing an AI, automation or technology roadmap for operations.

• Experience in technology-led transformation within BPO, ITES, shared services or business-process environments.

description:
We’re Hiring:
**Quality & Food Safety Manager**

**Reports to:**
Founder

**Location:**
Noida, Sector - 80

**Shift:**
general (day), plus surprise night audits twice a month ·

**Experience:**
5–8 years

**About The Cinnamon Kitchen**
The Cinnamon Kitchen is a D2C health-snacking and bakery brand built on one promise “So good, you’ll forget it’s good for you!”

**About the role.**
You'll build and own TCK's food-safety and gluten-free assurance system, and take our dedicated gluten-free facility through FSSC 22000 certification. This is a hands-on role: you'll write the documents yourself, train the floor, and lead a two-person QC team across day and night shifts.

**Requirements**

* B.Tech, B.Sc or M.Sc in Food Technology or a related field
* 5–8 years in quality in food manufacturing; bakery, confectionery or snacks preferred
* Hands-on role in at least one FSSC 22000, BRCGS or ISO 22000 implementation or certification audit
* Strong in HACCP, FSSAI regulations, labelling and documentation
* Allergen-management experience strongly preferred
* FoSTaC trained; HACCP or internal-auditor certification preferred

**KRAs**

1. Lead FSSC 22000 certification with the consultant: gap closure, documentation, internal audit, Stage 1 and Stage 2 audits.
2. Own the gluten-free assurance system: supplier approval, raw-material testing, per-batch testing, cleaning checks, hold-and-release.
3. Write and maintain the HACCP plan and all food-safety SOPs.
4. Own FSSAI licence compliance, label checks and claims sign-off.
5. Handle customer complaints, root-cause analysis, recalls, and audits by buyers and platforms.
6. Train production staff and supervisors on hygiene and gluten-free rules.
7. Supervise and upskill the two QC executives; run shift handovers and check records.

**KPIs**

* FSSC 22000 certified by June 2027
* 100% of batches released only after tests pass
* Zero regulatory non-compliances
* Complaint rate falling every quarter
* Two mock recalls a year, each completed in under 4 hours
* Records complete and audit-ready every month

JOB DESCRIPTION

Position: Business Head – Loan Distribution .

Level: Senior Management

Location: Kolkata, West Bengal

Industry: Banking, NBFCs & Financial Services

Reporting To: Co-Founder / Promoter.

Interested candidates may share their resume at head.hr@tiptopinsure.in or may connect me at 8420363349

About the Opportunity:

Our client, an emerging financial services organization, is looking to appoint a dynamic, entrepreneurial and result-oriented Business Head – Loan Distribution to establish, lead and scale its loan distribution business.

This is a strategic leadership opportunity for an experienced BFSI professional with a strong track record in business development, institutional relationship management, distribution strategy and team leadership.

The incumbent will have end-to-end ownership of building the business from the ground up, including establishing strategic partnerships with Banks, NBFCs and Housing Finance Companies, developing a robust distribution network, building a high-performing team and driving sustainable business growth.

The role offers direct interaction with the Co-Founder / Promoter and an opportunity to play a pivotal role in shaping the organisation’s business strategy, operating model and long-term growth trajectory.

Key Responsibilities

1. Business Strategy & Business Setup

\* Lead the end-to-end establishment and development of the Loan Distribution

\* Develop the business strategy, operating model, revenue framework and long-term growth roadmap.

\* Identify target customer segments, lending products and emerging business opportunities.

\* Establish business processes, internal controls, operating standards and performance benchmarks.

\* Develop a scalable and sustainable business model aligned with the organization's strategic objectives.

2. Institutional Relationships & Strategic Alliances

\* Establish and strengthen strategic relationships with Banks, NBFCs, HFCs and other financial institutions.

\* Develop partnerships with Corporate DSAs, channel partners, aggregators and financial intermediaries.

\* Lead negotiations on commercial terms, commission structures, revenue-sharing arrangements and business partnerships.

\* Ensure effective coordination with lending partners across sourcing, credit processing, disbursement and customer servicing.

\* Expand the institutional network to maximise business opportunities and revenue potential.

3. Team Building & Organisational Leadership

\* Build, recruit and lead a high-performing team of approximately 40–50 employees and business associates.

\* Design the organisational structure, reporting hierarchy and functional responsibilities.

\* Recruit, develop and manage Sales Managers, Relationship Managers, Telecallers and Field Sales Teams.

\* Establish performance-linked incentive structures, productivity benchmarks and accountability mechanisms.

\* Drive a performance-oriented culture through training, coaching, motivation and regular business reviews.

4. Business Development & Revenue Generation

\* Drive sourcing, business conversion, disbursement and revenue generation across multiple lending products, including:

\* Home Loans

\* Loan Against Property (LAP)

\* Loan Against Rent Receivables (LARR)

\* Business Loans / MSME Loans

\* Personal Loans

\* Other secured and unsecured lending products

\* Develop direct sourcing channels, referral networks and strategic distribution partnerships.

\* Achieve monthly, quarterly and annual business sourcing, disbursement and revenue targets.

\* Identify new markets, customer segments and geographical expansion opportunities.

\* Drive business productivity, channel profitability and sustainable revenue growth.

5. Operations, MIS & Business Governance

\* Establish efficient sourcing, documentation, login, processing and disbursement workflows.

\* Monitor business pipelines, team productivity, conversion ratios, disbursement performance and revenue realisation.

\* Implement robust MIS, dashboards, reporting systems and periodic performance reviews.

\* Coordinate with lending institutions to ensure seamless credit processing, documentation and customer servicing.

\* Ensure adherence to institutional guidelines, KYC requirements, internal controls and applicable regulatory processes.

Desired Candidate Profile

\* Graduate / Postgraduate in Business Administration, Finance, Marketing or a related discipline.

\* Approximately 8–15 years of relevant experience in Banking, NBFCs, Loan Distribution, DSA or Financial Services.

\* Demonstrated experience in establishing, scaling or managing a loan distribution / DSA business.

\* Strong institutional relationships with Banks, NBFCs, HFCs and other financial institutions.

\* Proven ability to build, manage and lead large sales and distribution teams.

\* Experience managing teams of 30–50 or more employees and business associates will be preferred.

\* Strong business development, negotiation, strategic planning and execution capabilities.

\* Excellent leadership, stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.

\* Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to independently drive business growth and take complete business ownership.

Key Success Expectations

The successful candidate will be responsible for:

\* Establishing the complete organizational and operational structure of the business.

\* Securing strategic lending partnerships and institutional tie-ups.

\* Recruiting and developing a high-performing team of 40–50 employees and business associates.

\* Creating a robust and sustainable business sourcing and distribution network.

\* Achieving defined business sourcing, disbursement and revenue targets.

\* Building a scalable, professionally managed and commercially viable loan distribution platform.

The Opportunity

This position is ideal for a seasoned BFSI professional with an entrepreneurial mindset who is passionate about building businesses, creating distribution networks and delivering measurable business outcomes.

The incumbent will have the opportunity to work closely with the Co-Founder / Promoter, exercise significant business ownership and contribute directly to the organization's strategic growth and expansion.

The ideal candidate is a business builder who can transform a new business initiative into a scalable, profitable and professionally managed financial services platform.

Pay: ₹700,000.00 - ₹1,000,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Growth Manager II
description:
About Swiggy:
  
  
Swiggy is India's leading on-demand delivery platform with a tech-first approach to logistics and a solution-first approach to consumer demands. With a presence in 500 cities across India, partnerships with hundreds of thousands of restaurants, an employee base of over 5000, a 2 lakh strong independent fleet of Delivery Executives, we deliver unparalleled convenience driven by continuous innovation. Built on the back of robust ML technology and fuelled by terabytes of data processed every day, Swiggy offers a fast, seamless and reliable delivery experience for millions of customers across India. From starting out as a hyperlocal food delivery service in 2014, to becoming a logistics hub of excellence today, our capabilities result not only in lightning-fast delivery for customers, but also in a productive and fulfilling experience for our employees.
  
  
**Overview**
**Job Description**
A Grwoth Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants—learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success. You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
* Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
* Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy’s products as solutions, not features
* Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
* Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
* Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
* Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
* Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
* 80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month

**Qualifications**

With a strong understanding of modern dental practice, INDENT offers a comprehensive range of products built on cutting-edge technology and rigorous quality standards. The Territory Manager will plan and execute territory-level business strategies, track sales performance, and identify new business opportunities. Daily responsibilities include visiting customers, coordinating with internal teams for order processing and post-sales support, gathering market intelligence, and participating in local events or trainings to increase brand visibility. find, qualify and convert opportunities, then manage the sales cycle from first meeting to installation

run hands-on demos, clinic visits, workshops and live scanning or printing sessions that turn interest into orders

**Dealer development:**
find, onboard and grow channel partners to widen coverage across your territory

**Market presence:**
represent Indent at dental conferences, trade shows, study clubs and CDE programmes

keep CRM records accurate, forecast every month, and share market insights with the leadership team

What you brings :

•     A graduate degree in any field. A BDS or a science background is an advantage

title: Support Engineer, Merchant Support, Amazon Supply Chain Services
description:
**Description**
Amazon has spent years building one of the world’s most efficient and optimized supply chains. The Amazon Supply Chain Services (ASCS) will build on that foundation and continue to innovate end-to-end supply chain capabilities.
  
  
As a Support Engineer, you will work with our GTM, Operations, Tech and Product Teams to independently resolve customer issues and blockers by providing knowledgeable and responsive technical support.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Our customers are large enterprises, small-medium businesses, and agencies using Amazon supply chain services. You would interact with customers’ technical and business stakeholders to resolve their issues. You will have ownership for issue investigation, identifying root cause and technical and complex non-technical defects, conceive and provide workarounds if acceptable to customers for continuity. You will gather sufficient information that helps reproduce issues and contribute to building long-term tech/product fixes. This is a complex, and fast-paced environment as you will own the most critical part of the customer experience and delivering on our customers’ most basic need. While we obsess over issue resolution, in this role you will also develop tools to scale our support & service quality, and provide critical input for product prioritization to address root causes of why the customer experienced an issue in the first place. Our customers are Amazon customers, and we take seriously maintaining the high customer service bar set by Amazon to be the level at which we need to operate.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  

* Track, investigate, and resolve customer questions and issues using appropriate communication channel including phone, email, and live as well as asynchronous at various levels of complexity and customer impact.
* Act as an escalation point for the most complex and in-depth issues that potentially span multiple external and internal organizations.
* Communicate directly with internal organizations to complete root cause analyses, issue investigation, workarounds and defect resolution.
* Develop and implement complex repro cases to identify potential software defects, mis-configurations, or issues in customer environments.
* Use case management tools to manage and prioritize issues based on multiple factors including customer impact.
* Build & Contribute to training material and documentation for both internal and customer-facing users.
* Actively seeking solutions to customer needs, communicating trends to leadership, and suggesting innovative solutions on behalf of the customer experience.
* Writing queries, code samples, tutorials, and technical articles for the customer community and internal organizations
* Working with customers to understand how they are using our services, and providing feedback to development teams
* Collaborating with internal stakeholders to drive timely customer communication
* Driving internal projects that improve support-related processes and our customer's user experience

**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of technical support experience
* 3+ years of network and operating system support experience
* 3+ years of database administration experience
* 3+ years of software development with object oriented language experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
* Knowledge of security best practices

**Preferred Qualifications**

* + years of relevant experience in a business analyst, data analyst or statistical analysis role Advanced technical or business degree (MS or MBA) Experience in developing requirements and formulating business metrics for reporting, familiarity with data visualization tools.

title: Consultant - IT & Application Support
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
At Technology @ Lilly, we define success by the employee experience, working backward from their needs to our solutions. Our shift to a Lilly-led, digital-first service model is transforming how we deliver support — and it depends on empowered problem solvers, not process followers. As a Consultant for IT and Application Support, you are the primary advocate for our workforce across both IT and application support, using intelligent tools and sound judgment to restore confidence and productivity at first contact.
  
  
This role is designed for the ambitious. We are looking for people who are obsessed with the customer experience and ready to resolve — not just route. You will work across IT/device issues and application support, looking beyond the immediate problem to the root cause, navigating ambiguity, and delivering a memorable, personalized experience that earns trust. As an advanced-L1 contributor, you will also help raise the standard of the desk — coaching peers and helping prove practices that scale across our support model.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
*IT & Application Support — First Contact Resolution*

* Act as the first point of contact for IT and application-related issues via chat, self-service, and phone.
* Diagnose and resolve device, application, and access-related problems — moving beyond catch-and-dispatch to resolve more at first contact and reduce downstream escalations.
* Provide basic application troubleshooting and access-provisioning assistance across supported applications.
* Use remote desktop and endpoint management tools for real-time diagnostics and resolution.

*Automation & Self-Service Enablement*

* Guide users to resolution through AI chatbot, self-heal, and other self-service channels.
* Champion adoption of AI-powered workflows to reduce avoidable contacts and shift routine work left.
* Document troubleshooting steps and identify gaps in knowledge base content.

*Ticketing & Documentation*

* Create and manage tickets in ServiceNow with complete issue context and configuration-item linkage.
* Ensure clean handoffs to escalation and application teams for timely resolution.
* Maintain ticket hygiene and accuracy of support data.

*Experience, Insights & Continuous Improvement*

* Use endpoint tools and chatbot transcripts to spot recurring issues and improvement opportunities.
* Feed insights into automation, knowledge, and process improvements — helping deflect volume to self-heal and self-service.
* As an advanced-L1 contributor, support peer coaching and help codify practices that can be adopted more widely across the desk.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related technical field (preferred).
* 2–4 years in IT support, service desk, or application support in a corporate or global environment.
* Working knowledge of ITSM platforms (e.g., ServiceNow), remote desktop and endpoint tools, and end-user support technologies.
* Exposure to application-support troubleshooting and the ability to pick up new applications quickly.
* Availability to work flexible, non-standard hours across two shifts, including weekends and holidays, with 24×7 support coverage as required. Appropriate benefit adjustments are provided for non-standard hours where applicable.

**Key Competencies & Personal Attributes**

* Customer Obsession — Start with the employee and work backward. You see users as customers to be delighted, not tickets to be closed, and you work to earn and keep their trust.
* High Judgment & Intuition — You operate beyond scripts, adapting instantly to unique situations. You never hide behind “that’s not my job” or rigid protocol when it leads to a poor outcome.
* Resolve, Don’t Route — You push to solve at first contact and get to the root cause, rather than dispatching the problem onward.
* Memorable Service Delivery — You make support feel seamless, personalized, and memorable; users remember how you made them feel, not just that you fixed the issue.
* Earn Trust — You listen, speak candidly, and communicate with clarity — no jargon, no arrogance. You own mistakes, fix them, and make sure the user feels understood.
* Proactive Curiosity — You never settle for the quick fix. You ask “why,” look for ways to prevent the next contact, and champion AI and self-help tools to empower users.

Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response.

title: RHEL Systems Administrator (L2)
description:
Experience Required: 4–5 Years
  
  
Work Schedule: 24/7 Rotational Shifts (including weekends and on-call support)
  
  
Mandatory Certification: Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA)
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for an experienced L2 Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) Systems Administrator to manage, troubleshoot, and automate our enterprise Linux infrastructure. You will handle L2 production escalations, perform root cause analysis (RCA), manage large-scale patching, and ensure high availability, security, and performance across RHEL 7, 8, and 9 environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
L2 Production Support & Troubleshooting: Resolve escalated incidents, perform root cause analysis (RCA), and troubleshoot boot failures, OS performance bottlenecks (CPU, memory, disk I/O), network issues, and SELinux/firewall blocks.
  
  
System Administration: Administer and maintain RHEL 7, 8, and 9 servers, including user/group management, permissions, systemd services, scheduled tasks, and OS upgrades/migrations.
  
  
Storage Management: Configure and manage Logical Volume Manager (LVM), XFS/EXT4 filesystems, NFS shares, iSCSI targets/initiators, and SAN LUNs with multipathing.
  
  
Automation & Scripting: Develop and maintain Ansible playbooks and Bash/Shell scripts to automate repetitive administrative tasks, configuration management, health checks, and bulk deployments.
  
  
Enterprise Patching: Plan, schedule, and execute monthly security and errata patching across Linux servers using Red Hat Satellite (managing Content Views, Repositories, and Lifecycle Environments), including pre-patch checks and rollbacks.
  
  
Security & OS Hardening: Implement OS hardening standards (such as CIS benchmarks), manage SSH/firewall policies, and remediate security vulnerabilities.
  
  
Cross-Platform & Tooling Support: Provide basic administrative support for Windows Server environments and utilize ManageEngine tools for monitoring, ticketing, and endpoint management.
  
  
**Required Skills & Qualifications**
Experience: 4–5 years of hands-on experience in enterprise Linux administration and L2 production support.
  
  
Operating Systems: Deep working knowledge of Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL 7, 8, and 9).
  
  
Storage: Strong practical experience with LVM, XFS, EXT4, NFS, SAN, and iSCSI.
  
  
Automation: Proven ability to write Bash/Shell scripts and build Ansible playbooks for infrastructure automation.
  
  
Patch Management: Hands-on experience managing and patching enterprise environments using Red Hat Satellite.
  
  
Security: Familiarity with Linux hardening practices, SELinux, and firewalld/iptables.
  
  
Additional Skills: Working knowledge of Windows OS administration and ManageEngine suites.
  
  
Operational Readiness: Willingness and ability to work in a 24/7 rotational shift model, including weekend coverage and on-call rotations.
  
  
**Certifications**
Mandatory: Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA)
  
  
Preferred: Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE)

* Proven experience in an L3 production support role, including handling priority incidents and critical business issues.
* Strong expertise in SAP SD configuration, including pricing, order management, delivery processing, billing, and output management.
* Strong expertise in SAP TM configuration and execution, including freight order management, planning, tendering, rate management, charge calculation, and settlement.

* Experience integrating SD/TM with MM, EWM/WM, FI/CO, GTS, and external applications.

* Strong communication and business-partnering skills
* Documentation and test-management discipline

* Reduction in recurring incidents and manual workarounds

description:
**Job Description – System Administrator**

**Company:** Core Ocean Solutions LLP  
**Location:** Thane, Maharashtra  
**Experience:** 2–4 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

About the Role

We are looking for a skilled and responsible **System Administrator** to manage and maintain our company's IT infrastructure, systems, networks, hardware, software, and user support. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring smooth day-to-day IT operations, system security, troubleshooting, and overall infrastructure reliability.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage and maintain **Windows/Linux systems, servers, desktops, laptops, printers, and other IT infrastructure**.
* Install, configure, update, and troubleshoot operating systems and software applications.
* Monitor and maintain **LAN/WAN, Wi-Fi, routers, switches, firewalls, and network connectivity**.
* Create and manage **user accounts, access permissions, email accounts, and system privileges**.
* Provide technical support to employees for hardware, software, network, and system-related issues.
* Maintain regular **data backup, system recovery, and basic disaster recovery procedures**.
* Monitor system performance, storage, network availability, and security.

title: Technical Support Consultant
description:
**Overview**
Provide help desk and technical support to clients through inbound telephone calls, ServiceNow, email, and chat, including after-hours coverage. Assess business impact, document and prioritize requests, troubleshoot application, server, database, and access issues, and resolve problems within established support procedures. Coordinate timely escalation to the appropriate teams when additional expertise is required.
  
  
Primary Objective: Deliver responsive, professional call support and after-hours assistance, maintain clear client communication, and work with internal teams to resolve critical and escalated issues with minimal business disruption.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Answer inbound support calls and respond to email, chat, and monitoring alerts. Create accurate ServiceNow tickets that capture the issue, business impact, priority, contact information, and troubleshooting performed.
* Guide clients through troubleshooting with clear, professional communication, confirm understanding of the issue, and set expectations for next steps and follow-up.
* Troubleshoot client questions and technical issues involving system configuration, product functionality, SQL Server, and HL7 interfaces; document suspected defects and enhancement requests.
* Investigate application, server, database, access, and infrastructure-related issues using Windows Event Logs, IIS logs, and SQL queries.
* Execute SQL queries, including multi-table JOINs, to investigate application errors, validate records, and identify data inconsistencies.
* Identify root causes where possible, implement approved fixes or workarounds, validate service restoration, and update tickets with complete resolution details.
* Triage complex issues and route or escalate cases to the appropriate support, Development, Hosting, or Professional Services teams, providing complete troubleshooting details and business impact.
* Coordinate with internal teams during critical or major incident calls and follow established after-hours escalation and notification procedures.
* Support P1/P2 incident triage by gathering logs, analyzing error patterns, documenting incident timelines, and assisting incident coordinators with technical updates.
* Maintain ownership of assigned tickets, communicate progress and blockers, and provide timely client updates in accordance with service-level agreements (SLAs).
* Maintain complete case documentation, troubleshooting guides, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and known-error articles. Provide clear shift handovers covering open issues, business impact, actions taken, ownership, and next steps.
* Share recurring issues, suspected defects, and client feedback with Product Development to support product improvements.
* Stay current with supported products, releases, technical changes, and support tools, including approved AI-assisted capabilities.
* Use company-approved AI tools to assist with knowledge searches, case summaries, troubleshooting research, and drafting client updates or knowledge articles. Verify outputs before use and protect client, patient, and company information in accordance with applicable policies.
* Work assigned late-evening and overnight shifts to provide consistent after-hours client support.
* Participate in weekend, holiday, and on-call rotations as part of a 24/7 support schedule.

**Qualifications**
**Academic Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Nursing, Pharmacy, Nursing Informatics, or related discipline.
* Equivalent combination of healthcare, clinical, and information technology experience may be considered.

**Experience**

* 2–4 years of relevant experience in help desk support, technical support, healthcare IT, enterprise software support, or a related technical field.
* Working knowledge of ServiceNow or a comparable ticketing system, including case documentation, prioritization, routing, and queue management.
* Experience supporting international clients across multiple regions and time zones.
* Strong telephone, written, and verbal communication skills, with a customer-focused approach and the ability to explain technical information clearly.
* Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative team.
* Ability to prioritize incoming calls and support requests, manage multiple active cases, and meet established response and follow-up expectations.
* Experience with writing SQL and T-SQL queries, including multi-table JOINs, using Microsoft SQL Server.
* Intermediate Windows Server troubleshooting skills, including IIS, and basic knowledge of the U.S. healthcare industry.
* Experience troubleshooting software issues, analyzing technical evidence, and recognizing when additional expertise or escalation is required.
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams and managing complex client situations.
* Foundational knowledge of generative AI and AI-assisted support tools, including writing clear prompts, reviewing outputs for accuracy, recognizing limitations, and handling sensitive information responsibly. Practical experience using AI for support research, documentation, or communication is preferred.
* Basic understanding of HL7 messaging and interfaces is preferred.
* Basic functional and technical knowledge of enterprise healthcare software solutions is preferred.
* Familiarity with healthcare workflows, clinical systems, and healthcare industry practices is preferred.

**Travel / Shift Requirements**

* Some travel may be required for client engagement, collaboration, or onsite support activities.
* Availability for assigned evening, overnight, weekend, holiday, and on-call rotations is required to support 24/7 client needs.

Altera’s policy is to provide equal employment opportunity and affirmative action in all of its employment practices without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, marital status, protected veteran status, age, individuals with disabilities, sexual orientation or gender identity or expression or any other legally protected category.

description:
### **General Information**

Job ID

37504

Full Time

Information Technology
