**About TMF Group**

TMF Group is a leading global provider of high-value business services to clients operating and investing globally. We focus on providing specialized and business-critical financial and administrative services that enable our clients to operate their corporate structures, finance vehicles and investment funds in different geographical locations.

TMF India is a Great Place to Work, ISO & ISAE certified organization.

**Discover the Role**

The Engineer - Global Service Desk serves as the first point of contact for IT support across the organization, providing 24x7 operational support to end users. The role is responsible for incident logging, triage, initial diagnosis, first-call resolution, user communication, escalation management, and ensuring service delivery meets agreed SLAs.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Incident & Request Management**

* Receive, log, categorize, prioritize, and manage incidents and service requests in BMC Helix.
* Perform initial triage and information gathering for reported issues.
* Provide first-line investigation and diagnosis for Level 1 incidents.
* Utilize knowledge articles and standard operating procedures to achieve First Call Resolution (FCR).
* Ensure all tickets are updated with accurate work notes, actions, and customer communications.

  

**User Support & Communication**

* Deliver professional support through phone, chat, email, and self-service channels.
* Communicate ticket status, progress updates, planned outages, and resolutions to users.
* Maintain high customer satisfaction through effective communication and timely follow-up.

  

**Key Requirements**

* IT support for Office 365, On-Premise active directory and On-premise Exchange
* Available and willing for participating in ‘On-Call Support’ beyond normal business/work hours to support Global support model of operations
* Supports UC Leads/ L3, senior Leads in execution and implementation of BAU activities or other activities as tasked time to time or case to case basis.
* Provide upto level 2 BAU support on below service:
* Office365 (Exchange online, AzureAD, Teams, Teams Telephony, Office365 security and compliance)
* Available and willing to work in shifts across the time zones in support of Global Service Model
* Collaborate closely with the Operation Teams
* Assist and collaborate with other Infra-Leads/architects like DC, EUC, Infosec etc. wherever UC related engagement is required
* Participate in Vendor engagement to conduct and drive activities like Problem Management, RCA, SLA compliance, Risks and Issues
* Generate ideas for improvement based on experience
* Assess and work proactively on identifying and mitigating risks to the service delivery
* Understands personal development areas and is driven to 'bridge' gaps.
* Will ask relevant questions and maintain communication to improve business awareness/ knowledge
* Willing to learn and adapt quickly with the technology changes and Infrastructural reforms
* Be aware of client contracts/requirements
* Work under direct supervision and review of Leads/Global UC Head

**What’s in it for you?**

**Pathways for career development**

* Work with colleagues and clients around the world on interesting and challenging work.
* We provide internal career opportunities, so you can take your career further within TMF.
* Continuous development is supported through global learning opportunities from the TMF Business Academy.

**Making an impact**

* You’ll be helping us to make the world a simpler place to do business for our clients.
* Through our corporate social responsibility program, you’ll also be making a difference in the communities where we work.

**A supportive environment**

* Strong feedback culture to help build an engaging workplace.
* Regardless of where you are in your career, TMF Group opens a world of opportunity where you will be part of our team and is supported in your global career journey.
* Our inclusive work environment allows you to work from our offices around the world, as well as from home, helping you find the right work-life balance to perform at your best.
* At TMF Group, it’s our people who make us who we are. Our company thrives on entrepreneurial spirit and is full of proactive people who combine enthusiasm with responsibility and accountability.

**Other Benefits**

* Anniversary & Birthday Leave policy
* Be part of One TMF
* Paternity & Adoption leaves
* Salary advance policy
* Work flexibility – Hybrid work model
* Talk about growth opportunities (we invest in talent)
* Well-being initiatives

**We’re looking forward to getting to know you!**

We are seeking a Senior Application Support Specialist to managing applications used for coordinating engineering documentation for customers and vendors throughout the project lifecycle. The role requires the individual to support internal stakeholders, customers and vendors by ensuring timely, accurate, and compliant handling of designated systems and applications and technical documentation.
  
  
The position involves close collaboration with engineering, project management, procurement, customers, and suppliers located primarily in Europe, requiring strong communication skills and flexibility to support global teams.
  
  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

Application & User Support
  
  

* Provide first- and second-line support for the digital applications which manage the product and project documentation.
* Provide support for internal and external users in completing system- and documentation-related activities.
* Investigate user-reported issues, document and report bugs, and track support tickets through closure.
* Identify appropriate workarounds in collaboration with Business Analysts, application owners, and IT teams.

description:

Do you enjoy troubleshooting complex backup challenges across on-premises and cloud platforms?

Would you like to develop your expertise across Commvault, Metallic, Azure, and AWS while supporting customers around the world?

At SoftwareOne, we help organizations protect their critical workloads and maintain business continuity through cloud, backup, and managed services. We are looking for an Associate Consultant – Backup & Recovery to join our Global Delivery Team, supporting enterprise customers across hybrid environments while delivering a high-quality customer experience.

As an Associate Consultant, you will provide technical support for backup and recovery solutions across on-premises, Microsoft Azure, and AWS environments. Working closely with customers and technical teams, you will troubleshoot incidents, manage backup operations, and help ensure customer environments remain stable, protected, and recoverable.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Providing technical support for enterprise backup and recovery environments, managing incidents and service requests through to resolution.
* Administering and troubleshooting Commvault and Metallic solutions, including backup policies, schedules, retention, recovery, and operational issues.
* Supporting backup solutions across hybrid environments spanning on-premises infrastructure, Microsoft Azure, and AWS.
* Acting as a key customer contact during technical incidents, providing clear communication, progress updates, and resolution guidance.

title: TechOps-SAP-CPI-SENIOR
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**SAP CPI Senior 1,2 TechOps (Application Management) Consultant**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are looking for an SAP CPI Senior to join the EY GDS – SAP TechOps Team. As part of our EY GDS – TechOps team, you will be responsible for the development, maintenance and optimization of our SAP CPI solutions in alignment with our business objectives in a multi-region environment. You will collaborate closely with cross functional teams to address issues, implement enhancements, and optimize applications to deliver seamless global operations support to global clients.
  
  
You will lead the design, development, and implementation of integration solutions within the SAP BTP Integration Suite. You will bridge business requirements with technical specifications, connecting SAP S/4HANA, cloud apps (SuccessFactors/Ariba), and third-party systems. Key responsibilities include designing iFlows, securing APIs, troubleshooting, and mentoring developers
  
  
This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth as you get to work with high quality team to support clients ensuring the stability of global 500 companies through best-in-class solutions, automation and innovation.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Provide day to day Application Management support for SAP Applications across IT Service Management including service requests, incident management, enhancement requests as Level 2 Application Management Specialist
* Provide level 2 support for SAP CPI/PIPO development activities including customizations, enhancements, and bug fixes across multiple SAP environments troubleshooting and resolving issues related to customer CPI developments and SAP System Performance
* Collaborate with functional consultants to gather requirements for incidents, enhancements and problems and translate them into technical solutions
* Perform Debugging and Testing to ensure the quality of CPI/PI/PO developments
* Support system integration testing, user acceptance testing and production deployment of CPI/PI/PO objects
* Document technical specifications, code changes and implementation details for knowledge sharing and future reference
* Keep abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies and SAP best practices to contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
* Participate in on-call rotation and provide off hours support as needed to ensure the availability and reliability of critical SAP systems.
* Available to work on shift hours depending on the requirement of the client
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor’s degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.) or comparable job experiences.
* Minimum of 5-7 years working experience in SAP CPI/PI/PO development with a focus on level 2 support
* Proven experience in designing complex integrations, cloud applications, and security architectures.
* Sound experience in Design and implement complex, end-to-end integration scenarios using SAP BTP Integration Suite (CPI, API Management, Event Mesh).
* Upto 3 years of SAP PI/PO/CPI experience participation as a lead person responsible for integration design and implementation in at least two full-cycle SAP projects or roll-outs
* Strong skills in SAP PI/PO/CPI Design, Configuration, and Administration
* Good hands-on knowledge of Java, XSLT Mapping, Java mapping, Groovy Scripts Support integration projects through various phases from gathering business requirements to go-live and post-implementation support
* Good Understanding of Business processes and Create and maintain end-to-end functional designs for interfaces
* Suggest improvements to current operational procedures within integration environment good knowledge of integration technologies and specific SAP Integration architecture
* Strong Knowledge of using IDOC, RFC, JDBC, File, ABAP Proxy, SOAP, HTTP, REST, SFTP, SuccessFactors, sFTP
* Knowledge of SAP BPM/BRM Design, Build, Monitoring and troubleshooting
* Strong Knowledge of SAP Cloud Platform services like CPI-DS, SDI, Open Connectors, Persistence
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills with good attention to detail
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams effectively in a team environment
* Good understanding of the integration patterns, best practices.
* Strong knowledge in integration of SAP and Non-SAP applications with 3rd party & internal applications
* Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment
* Ability to work in a global setting with multi-regional teams, understanding cultural nuances and time zone differences and across shifts
* Flexibility in managing work hours due to the volatile nature of Application Management support work including ability to do shifts and being on-call for critical business requirements

**Ideally, you’ll also have:**

* Excellent knowledge in SAP CPI/PI/PO and API Development with goof knowledge of HTML/XML/WSDL/XSD, JSON, SOAP, AXIS, ODATA, with hands on experience in debugging interfaces issues and development of small to medium complex enhancements
* Experience with PO PI configuration mapping and development using Message Mapping, XSLT
* Knowledge of complex mapping transformation, resolving technical issues, adapter configurations.
* Experience in EDIFACT and ANSI X12 formats, XML for B2B EDI
* Experience in APIM, Event Mesh
* Expert in using the standard Modules & Development of Custom Adapter modules.
* Expert in Java for developing User Defined Functions (UDF) and NWDS

**What We Look For**

* A team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment.
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 250+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Data practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Customer Service Operations Manager
description:
**About the role & super.money:**

Super.Money is a Flipkart-backed fintech app. Users pay with UPI and cards, recharge and pay bills, buy digital gold, pay education fees, use splitStore (BNPL product), and take personal loans. The support channel is primarily an AI chat bot with an inhouse team handling escalations. We are currently expanding our channel offerings to improve resolution speed and experience.

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a
**CS Operations Manager**
to run day-to-day support operations across leading our in-house L1 and L2 teams and own the operational performance of an outsourced voice partner as we set up that channel. This role reports to the Head of Customer Experience.

What exists today: AI bot, in-house L1 and L2 teams, playbooks

What’s greenfield: Outsourced voice process, vendor SLA and governance framework for the support function, Agent console & knowledge base tool.

As an early-stage startup, we need a hands-on, accountable operator who can manage a small team directly and a vendor partner by the numbers.

This is a people-manager role with direct ownership of operational outcomes. You will define how support operations run, hold partners to SLA, and work closely with the Process Lead, Product and Tech to improve resolution and automation. If you thrive on ownership and want to build operations from the ground up, this role is for you.

**What you’ll do:**

●
**Lead L1 & L2 Operations:**
Manage and coach the in-house L1 and L2 teams. Own queue health, TAT, escalations and daily performance.

●
**Own the Outsourced Partner:**
Take responsibility for the operational performance of the outsourced contact centre partner. Run day-to-day operations so all deliverables are met as per the agreed SLA.

●
**Vendor Governance:**
Run weekly/ monthly performance reviews with the partner. Drive corrective action plans, manage penalties and incentives, and own partner onboarding, ramp-up and quality calibration.

●
**Escalation & Customer Management:**
Own escalation handling, including social, regulatory, legal and leadership escalations. Ensure closure within TAT and convert recurring escalations into process fixes.

●
**Stakeholder Management:**
Manage relationships with allied business units (Product, Tech, Risk, Compliance, lending and payment partners). Represent customer issues and drive resolution across teams.

●
**KPIs:**
Own CSAT, FCR, FRT, TAT, AHT, QA scores, backlog and SLA adherence.

●
**Reporting & Insights:**
Own a robust reporting stack: daily ops dashboards, weekly performance packs and monthly business reviews, with a single source of truth for L1, L2 and vendor metrics. Report performance, trends and risks to leadership.

●
**Automation & Process Improvement:**
Identify repetitive contacts and manual workflows, and work with the Process Lead, Product and Tech to automate them via bot resolution, workflow tooling and self-help. Track contact volume and automation rate.

●
**Compliance & Documentation:**
Ensure operations and the outsourced partner adhere to internal policies, data security norms and regulatory guidelines. Maintain documentation of reviews, audits and escalations.

**Must have:**

● 7–10 years of experience in customer service operations, including 3+ years managing teams and 2+ years managing an outsourced contact centre or BPO partner against SLAs.

● Minimum 3 years in fintech.

● Proven track record improving CSAT, L1 FRT & L2 TAT

● Strong escalation management, with the ability to run RCAs and drive closure across functions.

● Strong data skills: comfortable with dashboards and operational data analysis (SQL is a plus).

**Good to have:**

● Prior experience setting up a new outsourced voice process, including vendor selection, onboarding and ramp-up

● Experience operating in an AI-first support environment (bot plus human handover)

● Hands-on experience in workforce planning, capacity forecasting and operations budgeting.

● Familiarity with lending or BNPL operations and RBI grievance redressal requirements

● Lean Six Sigma or similar process-improvement certification

title: Customer Operations Team Lead
description:
**About Us**
At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Team Leader – Institutional Lending Operations, you will play a critical leadership role within the Institutional Lending Operations function, supporting the delivery of high-quality operational services across the US Institutional, Corporate, Commercial and Private Banking portfolios.
  
  
The role is accountable for leading a team responsible for the execution of lending operations activities, while ensuring exceptional customer outcomes, operational excellence, risk management, and regulatory compliance. You will work closely with regional stakeholders, senior leaders, and partner functions to drive strategic initiatives, improve operational efficiency, manage change, and strengthen the control environment.
  
  
As a people leader, you will be responsible for developing a high-performing team culture, fostering employee engagement, building future leadership capability, and driving continuous improvement across processes and service delivery.
  
  
Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.
  
  
Role Location: Bengaluru
  
  
Role Type: Permanent, Fulltime
  
  
**What will your day look like?**
As a Team Leader, you will lead a high-performing team responsible for delivering operational excellence, exceptional customer outcomes, and sustainable business performance. You will drive a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, risk awareness, and collaboration while ensuring operational activities are executed efficiently, effectively, and in line with organisational policies, regulatory requirements, and customer expectations.
  
  

* Lead the day-to-day operational delivery of the team, ensuring service commitments, performance standards, quality outcomes, and business objectives are consistently achieved.
* Foster a customer-centric culture by driving high-quality service delivery, resolving complex issues, and promoting positive customer and stakeholder outcomes.
* Build and maintain effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders, partnering across functions to deliver business priorities and achieve shared objectives.
* Drive team performance through effective workforce planning, resource management, productivity oversight, and performance monitoring to optimise operational outcomes.
* Identify, recommend, and implement continuous improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency, strengthen controls, reduce complexity, and improve the overall customer experience.
* Lead, coach, and develop team members by providing clear direction, performance feedback, mentoring, and growth opportunities to build a highly engaged and capable workforce.
* Create an inclusive, collaborative, and high-performance culture that promotes accountability, innovation, wellbeing, and continuous learning.
* Ensure operational activities are conducted in accordance with regulatory obligations, risk frameworks, governance requirements, and internal policies and procedures.
* Proactively identify, manage, and escalate risks, control weaknesses, issues, and incidents while supporting audit, compliance, and remediation activities to maintain a strong control environment.
* Lead and support strategic, transformational, and change initiatives, ensuring successful implementation, effective stakeholder engagement, and sustainable business outcomes.

**What will you bring?**
To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:
  
  

* Extensive experience in Institutional / Commercial Lending Operations with strong knowledge of syndicated lending, bilateral lending, loan servicing, documentation, and credit administration processes.
* Advanced knowledge of Loan IQ and Global Lending Platforms (GLP), including expertise in facility setup, maintenance, loan servicing, and interpretation of lending documentation such as Letters of Offer, Limit Approval Advice Letters, One-Way Amendments, Two-Way Amendments, and facility documentation.
* Proven people leadership experience (minimum 3-4 years) managing large operational teams, driving performance, employee engagement, capability development, and succession planning.
* Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills, with a track record of managing senior business partners and challenging conversations.
* Experience managing audits, accreditation reviews, Key Control Testing (KCT), periodic procedure reviews, BAU controls, SOW reviews, and regulatory compliance activities.
* Strong understanding of operational risk management frameworks and experience implementing preventive and detective controls.
* Proven ability to balance strategic priorities while maintaining operational excellence in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with the ability to make sound judgments in complex and time-sensitive situations.

You’re not expected to have 100% of these skills. At ANZ a growth mindset is at the heart of our culture, so if you have most of these things in your toolbox, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
**So why join us?**
ANZ is a place where big things happen as we work together to provide banking and financial services across more than 30 markets. With more than 7,500 people, our Bengaluru team is the bank's largest technology, data and operations centre outside Australia. In operation for over 33 years, the centre is critical in delivering the bank's strategy and making an impact for our millions of customers around the world. title: Supply Chain Manager
description:
**Supply Chain Manager**
, SILT Nutrition, Bengaluru (in office, full-time).

**We hire for four things: ownership, intent, the ability to learn and unlearn, and a generalist attitude.**
At this 0 to 1 stage, relatively empty slates eager to wear many hats are welcome.

Experience: ideally 5 to 8 years, but ownership, intent, learning speed and a generalist attitude matter more than years.

Production, operations, logistics, purchase. End to end, CDMO to doorstep.

**About SILT Nutrition**

SILT makes evidence-based daily wellness rituals for India's busy professionals. Two drink mixes: SILT Mornings (gut + energy + vitamins) and SILT Nights (recovery + calm + sleep). Clinical doses, every mg printed on the pack, no proprietary blends.

We opened the cart on 28 October 2026. Three weeks in: 248 orders, 1,870 pre-bookers, ~90% organic, rated 4.9/5 by verified buyers. Four of us did that. SILT is not short of demand. It is short of hands.

**What you will own**

* Own production planning with our CDMO: forecasts, batches, raw materials and packaging
* Own purchase: vendors, MOQs, costs and lead times
* Own logistics and 3PL: inventory, dispatch, returns and marketplace readiness
* Keep stock, COGS and quality on one sheet: COAs, batch records, FSSAI compliance
* Build the ops playbook as we scale to marketplaces and quick commerce
* Pitch in beyond your role: content, ops, customer calls, whatever ships

**What you bring**

* Supply chain or operations experience at any FMCG or D2C brand. No wellness background needed
* Experience working with contract manufacturers and 3PLs
* Strong with numbers: inventory planning, costing and working capital
* Bonus: exposure to food or beverage manufacturing

**Who we're looking for**

You don't need a wellness background: the best D2C and FMCG operators learn this category fast. Numbers over adjectives, and the habit of reading the label.

**What you get**

* An early seat at the table in a 0 to 1 consumer brand
* Every number in the open
* Direct work with the founders
* Full-time, in office, Bengaluru

**How to apply**

Apply here: https://tinyurl.com/silt-jobs (or write to careers@drinksilt.com with the role in the subject line). The question that matters most: what would you fix about SILT in your first 30 days? That answer matters more than the CV.

title: Logistics Manager
description:
****Career Area:****
Supply Chain and Logistics
  
  
****Job Description:****
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
****Job Summary****
Manager Logistics leads a team of engineers responsible for identifying, designing, and implementing large-scale warehousing automation and optimization initiatives. This role combines deep operational understanding, engineering expertise, and technology leadership to drive improvements in productivity, safety, quality, capacity, and cost efficiency across the distribution network. The position develops long-term storage and automation strategies aligned with business growth and inventory objectives while ensuring operational excellence through continuous system and process optimization.
  
  
****What You Will Do:****

* Lead and develop a team of engineers managing warehouse automation, systems optimization, and network improvement projects.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, automation solutions, robotics, AI, analytics, and warehouse systems to identify opportunities that deliver measurable business value.
* Partner with Operations, procurement, infrastructure, systems, Supply Chain, Finance, Safety, and Technology teams to define and execute strategic automation roadmaps.
* Design future-state warehouse layouts, storage strategies, and material flow concepts aligned with long-term inventory growth and network requirements.
* Assess and implement automation technologies such as ASRS, AMRs, conveyors, sortation systems, goods-to-person solutions, vision systems, and warehouse execution systems.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on productivity enhancement, variable cost optimization, throughput improvement, inventory accuracy, and service performance.
* Analyze warehouse processes and physical movements to eliminate waste, reduce travel time, improve ergonomics, and enhance operational efficiency.
* Develop business cases, ROI analyses, and capital investment proposals for automation and infrastructure projects.
* Ensure all engineering solutions prioritize safety, quality, compliance, and sustainability objectives.
* Monitor project execution, budgets, timelines, vendor performance, and operational outcomes to ensure successful deployment and adoption.
* Establish engineering standards, best practices, and design guidelines across the warehouse network.
* Leverage data analytics and business intelligence tools to identify opportunities and measure project performance.

**Degree Requirement**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in industrial engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Supply Chain Engineering, or related field.
* 10+ years of experience in warehouse or logistics engineering & automation
* Strong knowledge of warehouse automation technologies, WMS, WES, robotics, material handling systems, and industrial engineering, warehousing principles.
* Proven experience leading cross-functional teams and managing large-scale capital projects.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, stakeholder management, and communication skills.

****What You Have:****
Continuous Transformation: Knowledge of evolving the business to remain competitive; ability to understand, adapt oneself to respond to and proactively seek changes and innovation in the business environment to improve the competitive advantage of an organization.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Implements new systems, procedures and tools efficiently when changes occur in the work environment.
* Adjusts current working processes or adopts new approaches in response to changes in the business environment.
* Seeks challenging opportunities or assignments to grow and develop one's own knowledge, skills and abilities.
* Explains lessons or experiences learned from mistakes and failures as well as successes.
* Communicates and analyzes assumptions about a particular issue with colleagues to gain new perspectives or more effective solutions.

Data Gathering & Analysis: Knowledge of data gathering and analysis tools, techniques, and processes; ability to collect and synthesize data from a variety of stakeholders and sources in an objective manner to reach a conclusion, goal, or judgment.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Participates in gathering and analyzing an organization's data based on requirements.
* Follows proper data gathering and analysis processes and policies.
* Utilizes basic data collection and evaluation tools and techniques.
* Reports problems that arise in the data collection process.
* Documents data from various sources and in various formats.

Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Applies an assigned technique for critical thinking in a decision-making process.
* Identifies, obtains, and organizes relevant data and ideas.
* Participates in documenting data, ideas, players, stakeholders, and processes.
* Recognizes, clarifies, and prioritizes concerns.
* Assists in assessing risks, benefits and consideration of alternatives.

Distribution Center Management: Knowledge of distribution center management; ability to design or operate a warehouse or distribution center that handles the flow of goods from supplier to production to customer.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Helps minimize bottlenecks and delays and the resulting impact on operating costs.
* Uses real-time inventory software, with guidance, to move supplies where needed, when needed.
* Maintains item and inventory management records.
* Assists in resolving issues related to physical space management.
* Works with Distribution Requirements Planning (DRP) processes and operations.

Logistics Management: Knowledge of logistics and management; ability to follow proper processes and run operations for effective and efficient movement of materials and finished products.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Assists in the development of process flows to track lead time by activity.
* Uses tools, with guidance, to forecast delivery times, determine costs and assess performance.
* Maintains records of all shipments and invoices using an established system.
* Participates in integrating logistics processes and developing effective networks.
* Works with logistics in a domestic environment.

Planning and Organizing: Knowledge of the process of planning and arranging tasks and resources; ability to plan and organize both time and resources to get things completed while structuring and maintaining work in a systematic and highly methodical way.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Raises awareness of potential bottlenecks and disruptions to the schedule.
* Breaks tasks into manageable steps that can be incorporated into a personal work plan.
* Escalates concerns over competing or conflicting priorities.
* Monitors progress continuously and adjusts tactics for handling situations on a case by case basis.
* Creates action plans that ensure the accomplishment of responsibilities.

Project Management: Knowledge of effective project management strategies and tactics; ability to plan, organize, monitor, and control projects, ensuring efficient utilization of technical and administrative resources to achieve project objectives.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Provides input for Gantt or PERT charts or their equivalent to track project progress and status.
* Under guidance, plans and estimates simple projects.
* Assists in detailed project plans including cost, schedule, and resource requirements.
* Obtains information from stakeholders during the planning stage of a project.
* Produces standard project status reports.

Supply Chain Management - MFG: Knowledge of functions, principles and techniques used in supply chain management; ability to develop and use, strategies, practices and tools for controlling the logistical processes.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Discusses considerations for integrating partner and supplier transactions.
* Recognizes software systems or components used to manage supply chain.
* Summarizes supply chain considerations for different types of products or components.
* Participates in supply chain analysis and uses it to spot trends and improvement opportunities.
* Works with a specific part of supply chain management process.

****What You Will Get:****

title: Manager -Global Supply Chain-APAC
description:
Imagine working at the forefront of innovation in fluid-flow technology, with over 1,400 colleagues across the globe, and contributing to a legacy of excellence that spans eight manufacturing facilities on four continents. Armstrong Fluid Technology is more than just a leader in our industry; we are a community of the brightest and most creative minds, driven by a shared mission to engineer the future and safeguard our planet.

As part of our team, you'll be immersed in an environment that fosters growth, creativity, and collaboration. Here, you'll have the opportunity to push boundaries, tackle exciting challenges, and develop cutting-edge solutions that promote energy efficiency and reduce environmental impact. Every day offers the chance to make a meaningful contribution to a more sustainable future, driving innovations that help lower global carbon footprints. Together, we’re creating a legacy that goes beyond business—one that’s changing the world for the better.

In this role of
**Manager - -Global Supply Chain-APAC,**
you will be responsible for developing, maintaining, and executing supply plans for APAC-sourced materials. You will define and optimize supplier min-max levels, manage consignment stock programs to enable proactive capacity alignment and replenishment. By leveraging advanced planning tools such as Kinaxis RapidResponse you will monitor supply-demand imbalances, run scenario simulations, and implement mitigation actions to prevent shortages and excess inventory. This role requires close collaboration with APAC buyers, suppliers, logistics, and global site planners to achieve service level targets while optimizing cost, working capital, and inventory health. Additionally, you will drive automation of reporting and dashboards to enable exception-based, data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement in global supply planning performance.

**Key Accountabilities**

Supply Planning & Execution

* Execute and maintain supply plans for APAC-sourced materials to ensure continuous support for Armstrong Global Plants demand.
* Collaborate with the Demand Planning team to share rolling forecasts with APAC suppliers, ensuring alignment, capacity planning, and timely replenishment.
* Monitor supply-demand imbalances and recommend corrective actions (expedite, reschedule, reallocation) to maintain service levels.
* Collaborate with Sourcing, Engineering, Logistics, and Site Planners /Managers on shortages for risk mitigation and delivery constraints.
* Lead and manage a team of Buyer/Planners to ensure effective planning, procurement, and timely material availability.

Supplier Min-Max & Inventory Management

* Define, monitor, and continuously optimize APAC supplier min-max levels to ensure uninterrupted replenishment, prevent stockouts, and maintain optimal inventory levels.
* Set up system-driven alerts and automated monitoring in Kinaxis to proactively flag potential breaches of min or max levels.
* Collaborate with Sourcing and suppliers to adjust reorder points, lead times, and MOQ based on consumption trends and forecast changes.
* Monitor inventory health at distribution hub and plants implementing actions to minimize excess and obsolete stock.

Consignment Stock Planning and Hub Management

* Manage and track consignment stock agreements with suppliers to optimize working capital and improve availability.
* Develop automated dashboards and report to track consignment stock usage, inventory levels, and replenishment needs in real time.
* Reconcile consignment stock ageing, ensuring accurate reporting and timely settlements.
* Drive process improvements for visibility, traceability, and cost efficiency in consignment inventory programs.
* Manage Hub operational performance including Logistcis, consolidation, stock planning, ageing, fill rates and utilization

Material Risk Analysis & Mitigation

* Conduct material risk analysis for critical components and suppliers, identifying potential disruptions (capacity issues, geopolitical risks, long lead times).
* Leverage Kinaxis to perform scenario simulations and automated risk tracking, providing early visibility of potential shortages.
* Develop and implement mitigation strategies such as dual sourcing, safety stock builds, or alternate supplier
* Maintain an automated risk dashboard to track open risks, status, and mitigation progress, providing stakeholders with real-time visibility.

Digital Transformation & Process Improvement

* Identify and drive process automation opportunities across supply planning, inventory management, and supplier collaboration.
* Partner with IT and global planning teams to implement system enhancements and digital tools that improve planning accuracy and responsiveness.

title: Manager – Admissions & Enrolment
description:
**Position Summary**
UNSW Bengaluru is establishing a distinctive international campus, with teaching now underway and an interim IT operating model supporting its initial operations. The Head of IT will lead the next stage: shaping and delivering a secure, reliable and scalable technology environment that can support the campus as its academic, research and student activity grows.
  
  
Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, the role provides senior leadership across campus technology operations, service delivery, people, partners and investment. The Head of IT will set the local IT strategy and technology roadmaps, strengthen the operating model, and guide the transition from tactical solutions to sustainable services aligned with UNSW standards and the needs of the Bengaluru campus.
  
  
The role will work closely with campus leadership, academic and professional staff, UNSW IT and delivery partners in Australia and India. It will lead a multidisciplinary local team and champion digital transformation that improves the experience of students and staff and enables high-quality teaching and research.
  
  
**POSITION PURPOSE**
Lead the end-to-end admissions and enrolments function at UNSW Bengaluru, ensuring fair and timely application assessment, accurate offers and acceptances, effective student onboarding and enrolment, and reliable student records. The role translates approved UNSW academic and admissions policies into consistent operational practice while delivering a responsive applicant experience, managing compliance risks and enabling data-informed intake planning.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Admissions assessment and decision control — Lead domestic and eligible international applicant processing; ensure consistent assessment against approved academic prerequisites, qualification equivalencies, English proficiency, citizenship/residency requirements and programme capacity.
* Application-to-offer operations — Manage admissions rounds, workflow queues, conditional/unconditional offers, scholarship-related offer data, outstanding evidence, offer acceptance, deposit reconciliation and timely applicant communications; ensure decisions and exceptions are appropriately authorised.
* Enrolments and student lifecycle — Oversee first-time enrolment, class registration readiness, re-enrolment, course changes, approved withdrawals and records updates; coordinate published dates, census controls and handovers to Student Services and Academic Operations.
* Quality assurance and audit — Maintain assessment checklists, decision logs, evidence verification, maker–checker controls, versioned procedures and audit trails; escalate suspected document fraud, inconsistent decisions, data errors and policy exceptions.
* Compliance and governance — Apply UNSW policies and relevant Indian requirements, including conditions of UGC approval for foreign university campuses, privacy/data protection and records retention; coordinate regulatory returns through authorised University owners.
* Systems and process improvement — Own functional accuracy and improvement of CRM/SMS/ERP admissions workflows, data validation, integrations and user access; partner with IT to automate controls and eliminate repetitive manual work.
* Performance intelligence — Produce admissions funnel and enrolment dashboards covering volume, quality, turnaround times, conversion, yield, capacity, scholarship uptake and enrolment load; provide timely forecasts and exception reports to the Registrar and leadership.
* Service and escalation — Resolve complex applicant, parent and partner enquiries; ensure accurate published information, consistent templates, effective complaints routing and service standards across telephone, email, walk-in and digital channels.
* People leadership — Supervise, coach and develop admissions/enrolment staff; allocate workloads during intake peaks, review quality and productivity, train on policy changes and strengthen cross-functional collaboration.
* Cross-campus coordination — Liaise with UNSW academic programme authorities and relevant Australian and Bengaluru teams on qualification assessment, academic decisions, student systems, quality assurance and approved international student arrangements.

**DECISION-MAKING AND ACCOUNTABILITY**

* Exercise operational authority only within the approved admissions delegation framework; refer exceptions, contested eligibility, non-standard offers, appeals and policy interpretations to the authorised decision-maker.
* Maintain separation of duties for assessment, offer approval, scholarship determination and fee reconciliation; do not independently alter academic criteria, regulatory requirements or approved programme capacities.
* Work closely with the Registrar on risk, compliance, policy interpretation, escalations and strategic enrolment planning; collaborate with the Chief Business Officer on recruitment forecasts and business performance.

**Qualifications And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Education, Business, Management or a related discipline (essential); relevant postgraduate qualification in higher education, administration, business or management (desirable).
* At least five years’ progressively responsible experience in university admissions, enrolments, student administration or related higher education functions, including supervising staff and managing peak-cycle operations.
* Demonstrated understanding of qualification equivalency, admissions selection, English proficiency evidence, conditional offers, student records and enrolment regulations.
* Experience with student information and applicant management systems (e.g., CRM/SMS/ERP; PeopleSoft, Callista, Banner or SITS desirable), data reporting and advanced Excel; dashboard or BI capability desirable.
* Knowledge of Indian higher education compliance and foreign university campus contexts; experience working with international academic requirements and multi-campus stakeholders is advantageous.

**Core Capabilities**

* Sound judgement, procedural fairness, integrity, confidentiality and meticulous attention to student data and documentation.
* Strong service leadership, stakeholder communication, conflict resolution, coaching and cross-functional coordination.
* Ability to analyse admissions conversion and enrolment performance, identify risks, communicate insights and drive measurable process improvements.
* Ability to prioritise under pressure, manage concurrent deadlines and implement change without compromising compliance or student experience.

****KEY RELATIONSHIPS****
**Stakeholder**
**Primary Interaction**
**Registrar**
Reporting, operational oversight, escalations, compliance and policy implementation
  
  
**Chief Business Officer**
Intake forecasts, recruitment conversion, service KPIs and strategic reporting
  
  
**Academic programme authorities**
Eligibility rules, academic decisions, credit matters and programme capacity
  
  
**Recruitment/Marketing**
Applicant campaigns, admissions rounds, communications and conversion
  
  
**Student Services/Finance/IT**
Enrolment handover, deposits, student systems, data quality and service delivery
  
  
**UNSW Australia teams**
Approved policy alignment, equivalency assessments and cross-campus coordination
  
  
**UGC And Other Bodies**
Regulatory evidence and reporting through authorised institutional channels
  
  
****INDICATIVE PERFORMANCE MEASURES****
Application turnaround and backlog; assessment accuracy and audit findings; offer-release timeliness; offer-to-acceptance conversion; deposit-to-enrolment reconciliation; enrolment completeness; applicant service response times; forecast accuracy; data-quality exceptions; and staff training/compliance completion. Targets are established through the University’s approved planning process.
  
  
**Role governance note:**
This position description describes the expected scope of work and does not itself delegate admission, academic, scholarship or regulatory decision-making authority. Duties may evolve in line with institutional requirements.

title: ITIL Service Management Office Manager - Bengaluru
description:
**About Diversified**
Diversified is a global leader in audio visual and media innovation, recognized for designing and building the world’s most experiential environments. Our award-winning team specializes in delivering solutions for the most complex, large-scale and immersive installations. Serving a global clientele that includes major media organizations and retailers, sports and live performance venues, corporate enterprises, and government agencies, Diversified partners with clients to create spaces that bring people together and keep them coming back.
  
  
**What To Expect**
At Diversified, we're on a mission to create a world without boundaries, where technology enables all people to connect and experience the moments that matter, wherever they choose to be. With clients spanning the globe and an exciting pipeline of projects across industries, Diversified offers more than just a job. We offer a career path with the flexibility to grow personally and professionally, wherever your ambitions take you.
  
  
As a Diversified associate, you'll dive headfirst into big, complex, and rewarding projects that push the boundaries of what's possible. Plus, you'll enjoy a flexible work environment, competitive compensation and benefits, and a culture that celebrates diversity and inclusion.
  
  
**IF YOU CAN DREAM IT, YOU CAN DO IT AT DIVERSIFIED.**
**Role Summary**
The Service Management Office (SMO) Manager governs how Diversified runs managed services. The role designs, documents and governs the ITIL processes that every delivery team follows, from incident and change to service levels, configuration and knowledge, so that each client receives the same disciplined, measurable service.
  
  
The SMO Manager is the enforcer of process compliance and the architect of its improvement. The role sets the standards, audits adherence, closes gaps, and turns process maps into automation, using ServiceNow workflow and AI to remove manual effort, shorten cycle times and raise data quality.
  
  
This is a highly collaborative role. The SMO Manager works across Service Desk, Field Services, Engineering, Client Success and Sales operations, and earns adoption by making the right way of working the easiest way of working.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* ITIL Process Design & Ownership. Design, document and own the managed services ITIL 4 practices: incident, major incident, problem, change enablement, service request, service level, service configuration , Asset Management and knowledge management. Define process policy, roles, RACI, inputs, outputs and controls for each.
* Compliance & Governance. Set the process standards and enforce them. Run regular compliance audits of tickets, changes and records; publish compliance scorecards by team; drive corrective action with team leaders; and escalate persistent non-compliance.
* Process Mapping & Automation. Map current-state processes end to end (swimlanes, hand-offs, wait times and failure points), quantify waste, and build the automation backlog. Deliver automation through ServiceNow workflow, integrations and orchestration, and measure the effort removed.
* AI Enablement. Identify and deliver practical AI use cases across the service lifecycle: ticket classification and routing, summarization, knowledge generation, alert correlation and predictive insight. Set guardrails for data quality, accuracy, privacy and human review, and track adoption and benefit.
* Client Onboarding into ITSM. Own onboarding process of new managed services clients into ServiceNow: accounts, contacts, locations, contracts, SLAs, entitlements, routing, portal access and reporting.
* Collaboration & Stakeholder Management. Partner with delivery, Client Success, Solution Architects and Finance to design processes that work for the people who use them. Run process forums, communicate changes clearly, and build process champions in every team.
* Team Leadership. Lead, coach and develop the SMO team. Set priorities, manage workload against onboarding and improvement demand, and build ITIL, ServiceNow and automation skills across the team.

**Operational Responsibilities (Process Owner)**

* Service level management. Define and govern SLA and XLA definitions, measurement and reporting in ServiceNow. Confirm XLA maturity gates (telemetry, survey and baseline) are met before any XLA is offered.
* Change enablement. Run the Operational change advisory board (CAB) and emergency CAB. Maintain change models, standard change catalog, maintenance windows and approval rules per client. Report change success rate and failed-change trends.
* Incident and major incident. Own the incident and major incident process, priority matrix and communication standards. Facilitate post-incident reviews and make sure lessons are captured.
* Problem management. Maintain the problem backlog and known-error register. Drive root cause analysis and permanent fixes for repeat incidents with delivery teams.
* Service request and catalog. Define and maintain the service request catalog, request items, entitlement and approval rules, and fulfilment workflows for each client.
* Service configuration (CMDB) and Asset Management. Set CMDB/Asset data standards, ownership and reconciliation cadence. Measure CMDB completeness and accuracy and drive remediation.
* Knowledge management. Own the knowledge standard and lifecycle. Make sure articles exist for top call drivers and are reviewed on schedule.
* Process documentation and controls. Keep process documents, work instructions and client runbook standards current and version controlled. Maintain an audit trail of process changes and approvals.

**Values and Behaviors**

* Process with purpose. Design processes that serve the client and the people doing the work, not paperwork for its own sake.
* Firm on standards. Hold every team to the agreed process, fairly and consistently, and explain the why.
* Collaborative by default. Build processes with the teams who use them. Earn adoption rather than mandate it.
* Automate the repeatable. Treat every manual hand-off as a candidate for automation, and prove the benefit with data.
* Responsible with AI. Use AI where it improves outcomes, with clear guardrails, human review and measured accuracy.
* Data-driven. Base decisions on measured performance, not anecdote. Publish results openly.
* Continuous improvement. Review, learn and improve every quarter. Share what works across the organization.

**Tools and data**
ServiceNow (ITSM, CMDB/Asset, service catalog, Performance Analytics, workflow and integration), ConnectWise, process-mapping tools (e.g., Visio, Lucidchart or Miro), BI and reporting (e.g., Power BI), and AI and automation tooling.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Required**

* 10+ years in IT service management, with 3+ years leading a service management office, process team or ITSM function in managed services or technology services.
* Deep, hands-on experience designing and running ITIL processes, including incident, problem, change enablement, service request, service level and configuration management.
* ITIL 4 Foundation required.
* Working knowledge of IT governance frameworks such as COBIT, ISO/IEC 38500, ITIL, TOGAF, the NIST Cybersecurity Framework, CMMI, and the FinOps Framework.
* Proven record enforcing process compliance through audits, scorecards and corrective action across multiple teams.
* Strong process-mapping skills (swimlane and value-stream mapping) and a track record of turning maps into automation with measured results.
* Hands-on experience applying AI or machine learning to service management, such as ticket classification, summarization, knowledge generation or alert correlation.
* Advanced ServiceNow ITSM knowledge, including workflow, service catalog, SLAs and CMDB.
* Excellent collaboration, facilitation and change-management skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including executive reporting.

**Preferred**

* ITIL 4 Managing Professional or Strategic Leader, or ITIL Practice Manager certification.
* ServiceNow certification preferred and experience with Now Assist or other generative AI capabilities.
* Lean, Six Sigma (Green Belt or above) or business process management certification.
* Experience with XLAs, experience management and service improvement programs.
* Experience in audio visual, collaboration, networking or broadcast managed services, or with a multi-client managed service provider.
* Experience with automation and integration tools (e.g., ServiceNow Flow Designer and IntegrationHub, Power Automate or RPA).

**What We Offer**
Along with competitive compensation, you will be eligible for the following benefits:
  
  

* Multiple medical plan for self and family
* Company paid Basic Life, AD&D, Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance, and Employee Assistance Plan (EAP)
* Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
* Commuter & Shift Benefits (US / APAC shifts)

To learn more about becoming part of the Diversified team, visit us at https://onediversified.com/careers/careers-at-diversified or email us at careers@onediversified.com.
  
  
Diversified is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. All aspects of employment will be based on job requirements, individual qualifications, merit, performance, and business need.
  
  
We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.
  
  
We believe in fair and equitable hiring practices and strive to create an environment where all individuals feel valued and empowered.

description:
US Tax Service Delivery Manager – US Tax & Bookkeeping, Chennai, India · Full-time · In-office only (no remote or hybrid) · ₹25–36 LPA

About FinAccurate:

FinAccurate is a tech-forward accounting, tax and advisory firm based in Boston, serving small business owners and their families. Our mission: we remove financial worry — for this generation and the next. We combine AI-driven tax preparation with an in-house team in the US, India and El Salvador, so every client return is accurate, on time and explained face to face.

You will lead our entire India team. You own training, quality and delivery, and you are accountable for every US tax return reaching 100% complete before it is handed to our US reviewers. • Hire, onboard and train India tax preparers across Levels 1–4 • QA and sign off every return as 100% complete — deep review on complex returns, checklist sign-off on simpler ones • Own our Instead AI workflow, daily SLAs, capacity and workload balancing across pods • Be the first escalation point for preparers and the single India contact for US reviewers • Bookkeeping (about 25%): oversee monthly close, reconciliations, payroll and catch-up work, and bookkeeping quality • Report weekly on delivery, quality and capacity to firm leadership in Boston

Requirements:

• 10+ years of US tax experience, including 1120-S / 1065 and some international exposure • 3+ years leading a team of 10 or more • EA, CA or CPA required • Hands-on bookkeeping or month-end close experience (QuickBooks Online / Xero) • Strong process, QA and people-leadership skills

The Officer role represents the first formal leadership layer within Transaction Management and is expected to combine deep operational expertise, strong risk awareness, stakeholder management capability, and team leadership while driving operational excellence, client satisfaction, and strategic transformation across the transaction lifecycle.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Officer is responsible for overseeing critical Transaction Management activities across Trade Settlements, Trade Confirmation, and Static Data Maintenance functions. The role requires operational expertise, strong risk and control awareness, effective stakeholder management, and the ability to lead process improvement initiatives.
  
  
The Officer serves as a subject matter expert (SME), providing oversight and guidance to associates and senior associates while ensuring adherence to service level agreements, regulatory requirements, and operational risk standards. * Review and approve critical settlement exceptions and escalation decisions.
* Lead investigations of complex settlement failures and client-impacting issues.
* Coordinate with brokers, custodians, counterparties, and trading desks to resolve settlement breaks.
* Ensure timely processing of market claims, penalties, buy-ins, and interest claims where applicable.
* Monitor settlement MIS and risk indicators to identify emerging issues.
* Support new market openings, account launches, and product implementations.
* Drive reduction of settlement fails through proactive risk mitigation strategies.

* Manage escalations relating to unmatched trades, allocation discrepancies, and affirmation delays.

* Demonstrate strong experience in basic logistics execution with four to seven years of hands on practice in order processing shipment coordination and execution monitoring within complex operations

title: Cyber Engineering Manager - Security Event Monitoring
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
Lead a global 24x7 Security Event Monitoring service as an Engineering Manager, guiding Tier 1 and Tier 2 operations across assigned security verticals. You will provide operational leadership during cybersecurity events, improve investigation quality and service continuity, and develop a capable, resilient team. This role combines security operations leadership, stakeholder engagement, and continuous improvement in a global environment. Because this position supports a global 24x7 operating environment, participation in significant incident escalations outside standard business hours may be required according to the operating model.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As an Engineering Manager on the Security Operations team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Act as Shift Lead, managing assigned Event Monitoring verticals, workload, priorities and operational/technical escalations; Ensure appropriate security-event monitoring, investigation, escalation and response coordination throughout the shift.
* Provide senior operational leadership during significant cybersecurity incidents and ensure appropriate coordination with Tier 3, Incident Response and other security teams; Coordinate with Foundation teams and other security teams during incident investigation and response.
* Manage shift rosters, staffing coverage, weekend schedules and on-call requirements to maintain service continuity; Manage Member Firm security requests and escalations, ensuring effective communication, ownership and follow-through.
* Review investigation tickets and conduct periodic quality checks with other leads, focusing on evidence quality, investigation logic, documentation and escalation decisions; Prepare weekly and monthly Security Operations reports covering incident volumes, escalations, quality observations, operational trends, risks and improvement initiatives; Present service performance, key incidents, risks and recommendations to managers and other leads.
* Track Root Cause Analysis and preventive actions arising from priority incidents and recurring operational issues; Support continuous improvement of SOC procedures, playbooks, knowledge articles and service quality.
* Lead onboarding of new team members, conduct regular 1:1 discussions, provide feedback and identify training and cross-skilling opportunities; Mentor analysts and leads, support succession planning and maintain effective workforce capability across shifts; Ensure responsible use of AI-assisted investigations and automation with appropriate evidence validation, human accountability and operational controls.

**The team**
The Security Operations team provides 24x7 security-event monitoring, investigation, escalation, and response coordination across Deloitte's environment. The team works with Incident Response, Foundation, and other security teams to help investigate cybersecurity events, strengthen operational resilience, and improve service quality. This global team supports through coordinated monitoring, incident response, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**Location: Hyderabad**
**Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM IST**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering.
* 10-13 years of cybersecurity experience, including experience leading teams in a 24x7 Security Operations Center (SOC), Incident Response, or cyber-defense environment.
* Experience managing Tier 1 and Tier 2 Security Operations, shift delivery, and operational escalations.
* Experience using Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) or Extended Detection and Response (XDR) technologies, including Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk Enterprise Security, or Microsoft Defender XDR.
* Experience conducting incident investigations, coordinating containment activities, performing service-quality reviews, and preparing Security Operations reports.
* Experience with Incident, Change, and Problem Management; Root Cause Analysis; and Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) practices.
* Experience managing staffing, rosters, on-call coverage, onboarding, coaching, performance development, operational metrics, and stakeholder presentations.

Preferred:
  
  

* Master's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering.
* Experience with Security Orchestration, Automation and Response (SOAR), threat intelligence, endpoint, identity, email, cloud, and network security technologies.
* Experience with AI-assisted Security Operations and security automation governance.
* One or more of the following certifications: Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH), Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) 4, or Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC-200).

title: Trial Supplies Manager
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Collaborates with internal Global Clinical Supply Chain (GCSC) teams and external Customers and Service Providers, including but not limited to Global Drug Development, Pharmaceutical Development, Product Development Quality (PDQ), External Vendors and Medical to ensure all needs are met.
* Proactively defines, plans, and communicates the clinical supply chain strategy in support of global clinical studies to promote optimal use and alignment with study and corporate goals. Demonstrates strong knowledge of GCSC processes when presenting at cross-functional meetings.
* Responsible for identifying and supporting strategies for continuous improvement, both departmental and/or inter-departmental.
* Influences clinical and development timelines, study design and country selection. Directly responsible for reviewing and providing input to draft clinical protocols, communicating timelines and investigational product strategies to study and cross-functional teams.
* Develops supply forecasts for studies through evaluation of the clinical development plan and protocol analysis. Monitors inventory and analyzes drug utilization versus forecast taking into account country requirements and logistical timelines.
* Issues Manufacturing and Packaging/Labeling requests to Clinical Supply Operations (CSO) in alignment with RDSC Master Planning timelines and based on collaboration with Clinical Development team, Chemistry, Manufacturing & Controls (CMC) team and CSO Packaging and Labeling to ensure package design and clinical label for investigational product meet protocol and regulatory requirements.
* Monitor use date of investigational drug product for assigned protocols. Support use date extension activities, such as generation of Use Date Extension (UDE) memo and provide feedback to Logistics team to support generation of UDE labels for depots and clinical sites.
* Ensures timely delivery of quality clinical supplies for all assigned compounds and protocols by collaborating with internal and external sources while taking into account country Regulatory and QP Release requirements.
* Participates in development, review and approval of Interactive Response Technology (IRT) specifications. Develops investigational product distribution strategies and maintains distribution and supply strategies at depot and site level according to study and IRT requirements.
* Actively participates in internal Trial Supply Management and Clinical Supply Chain meetings, Study Team meetings, Clinical Supply Matrix Team meetings and any other relevant meetings providing all relevant data and documentation prior to each meeting, highlighting any risks and mitigation strategies.
* Collaborates with Clinical Supply Strategic Sourcing team to procure commercial drug in alignment with country and clinical study requirements. Attends meetings with vendors and generates purchase requisitions as needed. Actively supports the budget process by maintaining supply and demand estimates for assigned studies in Budget Tool and by regularly reviewing and updating against revised clinical plans.
* Acts as the main Clinical Supplies contact person for the assigned compound and associated studies, leading communications regarding global supply strategy with study team as appropriate.
* Supports associated actions stemming from change controls.
* In collaboration with Compliance, prepare eTMF, CSR appendices and batch listings to support inspection readiness activities.
* Enters product complaints and deviations in appropriate system and works with PDQ for investigation and resolution.
* Manages conflicts/issues with internal and external partners and customers.
* Writing of departmental procedural documents as applicable.
* Performs other tasks as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum 2 years Pharma industry related experience.
* Minimum 1-year Clinical Supplies / Development with Global experience or equivalent experience.
* An equivalent combination of education and experience may substitute.
* Moderate / Strong knowledge of the global drug development process and global regulatory requirements.
* Proficient and strong analytical skills.
* Strong communication and negotiation skills.
* Proficient and strong Project management skills.
* Strong knowledge of Forecasting and Planning and proficient knowledge of related areas, i.e., Manufacturing, Packaging & Labeling, IVRS, Logistics, Quality, Stability, etc.
* Proficient knowledge of import / export requirements.
* Proficient/Strong knowledge of IVRS and CTMS systems.
* Proficient / Strong knowledge of industry technology.
* Applies and drives Forecasting and Planning activity as it relates to protocol.
* Ability to build/drive internal team consensus.
* Translates broad strategies into specific objectives and action plans.
* Team and individual leadership (leads courageously).
* Oral and written communication (fosters open communication).
* Conflict resolution (manages disagreements).
* Negotiation (Manages Execution, Results Driven, Analysis of Issues, Effective Speaking, Builds Relationships).
* Influencing (manages influencing others).
* Coaching and mentoring (fosters teamwork).

**Education/Experience/ Licenses/Certifications**

* BA/BS in Science, IT or Business, preferably with focus on IT / Digitization / Supply Chain.
* Travel: N/A

description:
**About InvoiceCloud**
InvoiceCloud is a fast-growing fintech leader recognized with 20 major awards in 2025, including USA TODAY and Boston Globe Top Workplaces, multiple SaaS Awards wins for Best Solution for Finance and FinTech, and national customer service honors from Stevie and the Business Intelligence Group.
