It’s an award-winning, purpose-driven environment where top talent thrives. To learn more, visit InvoiceCloud.com.
  
  
**Customer Support Manager**
**Job Summary:**
The Customer Support Manager will oversee and support the Biller Support Tier 1 Product Specialists team. This role involves managing daily operations, addressing service needs, handling escalations, and ensuring high-quality support for both billers and payers. The manager will also be responsible for training new team members, generating reports, and improving support processes. The working hours for this role may vary depending on the team’s needs but will be between the hours of 8AM EST – 6PM EST.
  
  
**Supervisory Responsibilities/Duties**

* Manage and support the daily workflow of the Biller Support Tier 1 Product Specialists team.
* Handle Tier 1 escalations from Billers
* Strong customer support understanding and skillset (deescalation, response time, customer satisfaction)
* Participate in interviewing, hiring, and training of new staff members.
* Perform managerial tasks such as approve time off, assist with workload reassignment and phone queue management / work schedules.
* Analyze call center metrics to meet KPIs and improve processes.
* Assist with escalated cases by requesting necessary resources and aiding in resolution.
* Serve as the point of escalation for complex tickets requiring advanced knowledge.
* Work with the Biller Support team to initiate the Incident Process.
* Find key issues and work with leadership to design resolution paths.
* Conduct performance evaluations and provide regular constructive feedback.
* Help create and send biller and payer communications (calls, emails, and ticket reviews)
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Goals**

* First 30 Days:

+ Gain a complete understanding of the company’s SaaS solutions, payment processing, and internal systems.
+ Attend training, review all provided materials, and complete quizzes.
+ Shadow team members to learn how to handle biller/payer calls and emails.

* First 60 Days:

+ Complete Internal Certification Program
+ Start assisting with and gaining an understanding on solving tickets and emails from billers.
+ Take phone calls on the assigned schedule to gain a complete understanding of support processes.

* First 90 Days:

+ Review and become familiar with support metrics.
+ Start assisting with escalations and incident management.

* Ongoing:

+ Generate weekly and monthly reports.
+ Evaluate and plan for support improvement.
+ Manage all escalations and debrief the manager.
+ Assist team members by removing barriers to case resolution.
+ Keep an ongoing pulse on call queues.

**Competencies**

* Understanding of SaaS technology and basic funding flows e.g. ACH and Credit Card.
* Experience with Customer Support metrics.
* Customer-driven, results-oriented, and focused.
* Outstanding verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Self-starter with a demonstrated ability to achieve results as part of an effective team.
* Excellent time management, organizational, and planning skills.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite or related software.

**Education And Experience**

* A Bachelor’s degree or a minimum of 10 years of relevant work experience.
* At least five years of experience in customer service, preferably in the software/technology industry.
* At least two years of related experience in a supervisory position is preferred.

Process efficiency and alignment with business objectives, as well as driving optimization across regions and business units to achieve operational excellence.

Collaborate with Digital teams, Business stakeholders, scientific communication team members across geographies and business units to ensure accelerated adoption and insight sharing. Regularly report on the Progress and outcomes of AI projects to senior leadership

* Support internal stakeholders with key information, stay up to date on global industry trends and regulations, and incorporate them into the business strategy.
* Actively contribute to finding synergies with all members of the team transversally.
* Share knowledge and best practices with peers and stakeholders, leading transformation initiatives to completion.
* Become a key driver of innovation and agile ways of working. Represent the team internally and externally.
* Promote a culture of collaboration and knowledge-sharing across departments to prevent silos. Facilitate regular cross-functional meetings and workshops to ensure alignment and integration of digital initiatives.

* Soft skills: Leadership and stakeholder management, Excellent communication at all organizational levels, Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, Outstanding interpersonal skills, Ability to influence, collaborate, and negotiate, Innovative mindset, Change management expertise, High attention to detail, Ability to ask insightful questions

Why choose us?
  
  

* Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.
* Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, access robust training, continuous learning, and clear career progression pathways.
* Play an instrumental part in creating best practice within our Medical and Events team.

**Pursue**
Progress.

Extraordinary.
  
  
Progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. **Job Description:**

Role Overview

We are looking for an Import & Export Operations Manager to handle end-to-end international logistics and back-end operations for IT components, computer hardware, and peripherals.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage day-to-day import and export shipments from booking to final delivery.
* Coordinate with overseas suppliers, freight forwarders, shipping lines, airlines and customs brokers.
* Handle import/export documentation, including invoices, packing lists, shipping bills, Bills of Entry and Bills of Lading.
* Manage customs clearance, duty calculations and shipment tracking.
* Ensure compliance with Indian customs regulations, DGFT guidelines and EXIM policies.
* Coordinate with banks for import/export payment documentation and related procedures.
* Monitor shipment schedules, freight costs and delivery timelines.
* Maintain accurate records of shipments, logistics expenses and documentation.
* Resolve shipment delays, customs issues and other operational challenges.
* Coordinate with internal accounts and warehouse teams for smooth movement of goods.

**Requirements**

* 3–5 years of experience in import/export logistics operations.
* Strong knowledge of Indian customs procedures and international shipping documentation.
* Experience working with freight forwarders and customs clearing agents.
* Knowledge of HS codes, Incoterms, ICEGATE and DGFT procedures.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and operational documentation.
* Strong coordination, follow-up and problem-solving skills.
* Experience handling IT components and electronics imports/exports is preferred.

title: Cluster Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Reliance General Insurance is a leading general insurance provider in India, offering a wide range of insurance products for individuals, families, and businesses. The company focuses on customer-centric solutions, digital innovation, and strong service standards to make insurance accessible and reliable. With a robust presence across major cities, including the Mumbai Metropolitan Region, Reliance General Insurance emphasizes professional growth and performance-driven careers. Team members work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment that values integrity, accountability, and long-term customer relationships.
  
**Role Description**
The Cluster Manager role is a full-time, on-site position based in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region. The Cluster Manager will oversee sales and operations for a designated cluster of branches or business units, ensuring achievement of revenue, profitability, and growth targets. Daily responsibilities include managing and mentoring branch teams, driving business development activities, monitoring performance metrics, and implementing sales strategies aligned with company objectives. The role involves regular coordination with corporate functions, reviewing market trends and competitor activity, ensuring adherence to compliance and underwriting guidelines, and maintaining high standards of customer service. The Cluster Manager will also be responsible for forecasting, reporting, and optimizing processes to improve efficiency and effectiveness across the cluster.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong leadership and team management skills, with experience in guiding and developing sales or operations teams.
* Proven experience in sales management, business development, or channel management within insurance or financial services.
* Ability to analyze performance data, prepare reports, and make data-driven decisions to achieve business targets.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills for interacting with internal teams and external partners.
* Solid understanding of general insurance products, regulatory requirements, and compliance practices (or willingness to learn quickly).
* Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to handle multiple branches or business units simultaneously.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, marketing, or a related field; a postgraduate degree or relevant certifications in insurance or management are an advantage.
* Prior experience in a cluster, regional, or branch management role, preferably in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region or similar markets.

title: Asst Manager, Cash Operations
description:
**Job Summary**

* Provide advisory and transactional guidance on current and capital account matters under FEMA

**Processes**

* Interpret FEMA, current account rules, capital account regulations, RBI Master Directions, notifications and circulars, and translate them into clear operational guidance.
* Perform regulatory do-ability assessments and advise on transaction structuring, permitted routes, limits, approvals, documentation, account usage, purpose codes and post-transaction obligations.

* Monitor regulatory developments and ensure prompt impact assessment, process updates, stakeholder communication and implementation.

**Risk and Governance**

* Identify regulatory, conduct, operational and reputational risks and define proportionate controls, escalation triggers and residual-risk treatment.
* Support audits, compliance reviews, regulatory inspections and remediation of identified gaps.
* Maintain policies, operating instructions, checklists, templates, ready reckoners and knowledge repositories aligned to extant regulations.
* Deliver training to Relationship Managers, Product, Operations and clients on FEMA requirements and emerging regulatory changes.

**Risk Management**

* Ensure 100% compliance at all times to the group’s risk management framework as applicable

**Governance**

* Comply with all the group standards, policies, procedures and guidelines as applicable and values of the Bank at all times.
* Adhere to Group Code of Conduct at all times.
* Ensure compliance to the group’s risk management framework as applicable.

**Key Stakeholders**

* Reserve Bank of India, Compliance, Legal, Cross-Border Payments, Trade Operations, Product, Relationship Management, Treasury, Finance, Technology, Data and Regulatory Reporting teams

**Skills And Experience**
**Priority Skills**

* Cross border Payments Processing
* Current and capital account – FEMA
* Regulatory Risk Assessment and Transaction Structuring

**Other Skills**

* Data Analysis, Reconciliation and Control Governance
* Policy, Process and Documentation Management
* Spoken and Written Communication

**Qualifications**

* Minimum 6 year's relevant experience in any Banking operations
* Minimum 3 years’ experience of cross border operations
* Sound understanding of transaction documentation, KYC/AML and sanctions interfaces, purpose-code selection, approval routes and regulatory timelines.
* Good verbal & written English communication
* Proficient in PC skills, particularly MS Office
* Good management and interpersonal skills
* Problem solving / Trouble shooting skills
* Ability to identify, mitigate and eliminate risks in processes.

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. title: General Manager -Supply Chain & Logistics
description: Position: General Manager – Supply Chain & Logistics Office location: Worli, Mumbai, with travel to project sites and operational locations. Reporting to: Directors / Management Compensation: Based on experience and suitability About the company This Private Limited Company focuses on developing and operating businesses across logistics and supply chain services. Its business plans include transportation of excavated material from real estate and construction projects, potential integration into crusher operations, and expansion into additional supply chain activities identified and approved by management. Role objective To establish, execute and manage the company’s logistics and supply chain operations, taking opportunities provided by management from initial assessment through commercial launch and ongoing operations. The candidate must have broad supply chain execution experience, along with relevant experience in quarry, aggregates or excavated-material transportation. The role requires ownership of planning, resources, vendors, teams, systems, customer delivery and profitability across multiple business activities. Key responsibilities 1. Establish and execute new business operations • Translate management-approved opportunities into practical business and implementation plans. • Assess operational feasibility, infrastructure, manpower, equipment, vendor requirements, timelines and financial viability. • Prepare project budgets, capital expenditure proposals, operating costs and working capital requirements.• Establish facilities, vendors, teams, processes and reporting systems. • Lead mobilisation, trial operations, commercial launch and stabilisation.• Identify execution risks and recommend workable solutions to management. 2. Lead logistics and supply chain activities Set up and manage relevant activities as the company enters them, including: • Transportation: Primary and secondary transportation, bulk material movement, dedicated fleets, attached vehicles and contracted transport. • Warehousing and storage: Facility selection, setup, receiving, storage, inventory control, dispatch and stock reconciliation. • Distribution: Distribution planning, delivery scheduling, route planning and customer service performance. • Material handling: Loading, unloading, internal movement, equipment deployment and contractor coordination. • Procurement and vendor management: Sourcing operational services and equipment, vendor selection, negotiation and performance management. • Integrated supply chain services: Coordinating multiple activities into complete operating solutions for clients. The candidate should bring demonstrated execution experience across several of these functions and organise specialist support where required. 3. Manage quarry and excavated-material transportation • Establish and manage transportation of excavated earth, rock, quarry material and aggregates from construction sites to approved destinations. • Assess material characteristics, movement volumes, loading arrangements, routes, receiving locations and vehicle requirements. • Mobilise tippers/Hyvas, attached fleets, contractors and loading support• Manage vehicle placement, dispatch, trip cycles, turnaround time, weighment and delivery reconciliation. • Coordinate with developers, excavation contractors, transporters, receiving sites and crusher operators. • Resolve operational disruptions and maintain agreed service levels.4. Support crusher-related operations • Assess arrangements for supplying suitable material to existing crusher plants. • Evaluate operational and commercial requirements for a company-owned crusher plant, if management decides to proceed. • Coordinate technical feasibility, site requirements, equipment selection, feedstock availability, approvals and implementation with relevant specialists. • Establish transport, material handling, storage and dispatch arrangements supporting plant operations. 5. Own commercial and financial performance • Prepare project costing, quotations, rate proposals and operating budgets. • Negotiate customer and vendor contracts within management-approved limits. • Monitor project profitability, resource utilisation, operating costs and working capital. • Establish controls over fuel, trips, inventory, contractor billing and operational expenditure. • Coordinate invoicing, reconciliation and collections with finance and customers. • Review actual performance against budgets and implement corrective action. 6. Build teams, systems and operating controls • Design the organisation structure and recruit teams appropriate to each business. • Establish standard operating procedures, responsibilities and escalation processes. • Implement suitable transport, warehouse, inventory and management reporting systems. • Develop reliable vendor networks and alternative capacity. • Report regularly to management on execution milestones, service performance, costs, profitability and risks. 7. Ensure safety and compliance • Establish safe operating practices across transport, sites, warehouses and material handling activities. • Coordinate applicable registrations, permissions, documentation and compliance requirements with relevant advisers and authorities. • Verify contractual responsibilities for material movement, receiving arrangements, royalties and permits wherever applicable. • Maintain auditable operational records and ensure vendors meet agreed requirements. Minimum selection criteria • Experience: At least 12 years of relevant experience in logistics and supply chain operations, including at least five years in a managerial or leadership role. • Broad functional exposure: Hands-on experience across transportation and at least two additional areas such as warehousing, distribution, inventory management, material handling or operational procurement. • Quarry/bulk material experience: Direct experience managing quarry, aggregates, construction materials or excavated-material transportation, including tippers/Hyvas and transport contractors.• Business setup experience: Successfully established a new operation, facility, project or business vertical and managed it through launch and stabilisation. • Commercial capability: Experience in budgeting, costing, contract negotiation and responsibility for project or business profitability. • Leadership: Experience building and managing teams, vendors and multiple operational locations. • Execution capability: Ability to independently convert a management mandate into a resourced, budgeted and functioning operation. • Qualifications: A recognised bachelor’s degree. Relevant qualifications in logistics, supply chain, engineering or management are preferred. • Mobility: Willingness to travel, visit sites regularly and manage time-sensitive operational requirements. Preferred additional experience • Crusher plant setup, aggregates processing or related operations. • Execution across more than one industry or supply chain business model. • Implementation of transport, warehouse or inventory management systems. • Established operational networks in Mumbai, MMR and Maharashtra. Key performance measures • Timely launch and stabilisation of management-approved businesses. • Delivery within approved setup budgets and operating plans. • Project profitability and working capital control. • Transport productivity, warehouse accuracy and delivery performance, as applicable. • Customer service, safety and compliance. • Team capability, vendor reliability and operational scalability.

title: Student Success Manager - Edtech Operations
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

**A. Student Query and Grievance Management**

* Oversee student queries received through email, ticketing systems, and other approved communication channels.
* Ensure timely, accurate, and complete resolution of student issues within defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Monitor ticket ageing, pending cases, repeat queries, escalations, and unresolved grievances.
* Coordinate with internal teams, institute representatives, faculty, and other stakeholders to resolve issues.
* Maintain clear communication with students until closure and ensure appropriate documentation of resolutions.

**B. Student Engagement and Retention**

* Proactively engage with students to understand their academic, administrative, and programme-related challenges.
* Identify disengaged, inactive, dissatisfied, and at-risk learners using available student data and engagement indicators.
* Execute structured outreach campaigns through email, calls, and other approved channels to improve participation and programme continuation.
* Follow up with students who have discontinued engagement or are at risk of dropping out.
* Support semester renewals, reactivation, and learner retention initiatives in coordination with relevant teams.

**C. Learner Experience and Satisfaction**

* Monitor recurring student concerns and identify root causes affecting the learner experience.
* Collect, analyse, and report student feedback, satisfaction trends, and grievance patterns.
* Recommend improvements in student-facing processes, communication, and service delivery.
* Ensure professional, empathetic, and consistent communication across all student touchpoints.

**D. Revenue and Business Contribution**

* Support fee recovery and semester renewal initiatives through timely student outreach and follow-ups.
* Identify opportunities for learner referrals, programme recommendations, and positive word-of-mouth advocacy.
* Contribute to reactivation campaigns for students who have discontinued or disengaged from programmes.
* Collaborate with Admissions, Sales, Finance, and Institute Operations teams to improve conversion, continuation, and revenue realisation.
* Track the outcomes of outreach activities and report measurable business contributions.

**E. Student Communication and Online Reputation**

* Support online reputation management (ORM), including monitoring and addressing learner concerns on relevant digital platforms.
* Coordinate responses to student feedback and online grievances in accordance with approved communication guidelines.
* Encourage positive learner advocacy based on genuine student experiences.
* Identify emerging reputational risks and escalate sensitive issues promptly.

**F. Process Management and Continuous Improvement**

* Establish and maintain standard operating procedures for student query management, outreach, escalation, and closure.
* Maintain accurate student interaction records, ticket histories, follow-up actions, and resolution documentation.
* Analyse recurring issues and recommend preventive measures to reduce repeat queries and operational inefficiencies.
* Work with cross-functional teams to improve turnaround time, communication quality, and overall student experience.

**G. MIS, Reporting, and Team Management**

* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) covering query resolution, SLA adherence, student satisfaction, retention, renewals, and outreach effectiveness.
* Prepare periodic dashboards and reports highlighting performance, risks, trends, and corrective actions.
* Lead daily operational reviews and weekly performance discussions with the Student Success team, where applicable.
* Coach team members on communication, problem-solving, ownership, and service quality.
* Ensure accountability for assigned activities, deadlines, and measurable outcomes.

title: Project Manager
description:
About JJ Retail Fixtures Pvt. Ltd.

JJ Retail Fixtures Pvt. Ltd. is a specialised furniture and retail fixture manufacturing company, catering to leading retail brands and commercial establishments. With a well-equipped manufacturing facility and a focus on quality, timely delivery and cost control, we undertake customised furniture and fixture manufacturing projects for reputed brands across India.

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Project Manager to independently manage furniture and retail fixture projects from order confirmation to final dispatch and execution.

The candidate will be responsible for project planning, coordination between design, production, procurement and site teams, monitoring project costs, maintaining quality standards and ensuring timely project completion.

Key Roles & Responsibilities

**1. Project Planning & Execution**

* Plan and execute multiple furniture and retail fixture projects simultaneously.
* Prepare project schedules, production plans and delivery timelines.
* Ensure projects are completed within committed timelines and approved budgets.
* Monitor daily project progress and proactively address delays and bottlenecks.

**2. Production Coordination**

* Coordinate with the Production Head and factory team for smooth execution.
* Ensure production activities are carried out as per approved drawings and specifications.
* Monitor material availability, production schedules and machine utilisation.
* Ensure proper coordination between design, engineering and production teams.

**3. Design & Technical Coordination**

* Coordinate with the design and technical teams for drawings, BOQs and specifications.
* Ensure drawings are approved before production begins.
* Identify technical issues and resolve design or execution-related discrepancies.
* Ensure materials, finishes, hardware and dimensions meet client requirements.

**4. Procurement & Material Management**

* Coordinate with the purchase and stores departments for timely material procurement.
* Monitor material consumption and minimise wastage.
* Ensure materials are available as per the project schedule.
* Follow up on pending materials and vendor deliveries.

**5. Quality Control**

* Ensure quality checks at various stages of production.
* Ensure finished furniture and fixtures meet approved specifications and quality standards.
* Identify and resolve defects, rework and production-related issues.
* Ensure proper finishing, packaging and dispatch quality.

**6. Costing & Project Monitoring**

* Monitor project budgets, actual costs and material consumption.
* Track project-wise profitability and identify cost overruns.
* Maintain project MIS, progress reports and cost records.
* Ensure proper utilisation of manpower, materials and resources.

**7. Dispatch & Site Coordination**

* Coordinate timely packing, dispatch and transportation of finished products.
* Coordinate with site teams for installation and project handover requirements.
* Resolve site-related issues in coordination with the concerned teams.
* Ensure client commitments and delivery schedules are met.

**8. Team Management & Reporting**

* Lead and coordinate project coordinators, supervisors and execution teams.
* Conduct regular project review meetings.
* Provide daily/weekly project status reports to management.
* Take ownership of project deliverables and ensure accountability across teams.

Candidate Requirements

* Diploma / Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Interior Design or a related field.
* Preferably 4–8 years of experience in furniture manufacturing, retail fixtures, modular furniture or interior fit-out project execution.
* Strong understanding of furniture manufacturing processes, materials, hardware, finishes and production drawings.
* Experience in handling multiple projects simultaneously.
* Good knowledge of project planning, costing, budgeting and execution.
* Strong coordination, team management and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Office and project tracking tools.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet strict delivery timelines.
* Willingness to travel to project sites whenever required.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who is:

* Proactive and takes complete ownership of assigned projects.
* Strong in planning, coordination and execution.
* Capable of managing multiple projects independently.
* Solution-oriented and capable of handling unexpected challenges.
* Accountable for timelines, quality and project costs.
* Able to coordinate effectively with factory, office and site teams.
* **The position requires an individual who can take end-to-end ownership of projects and ensure timely delivery without compromising on quality or cost control.**

title: Operations Manager
description:
**Operations Manager**

**Business Verticals:** Theme Parks | Spatial Experience Design | Resort Design | Interior Design.

**Company:** D’Fine Art Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** Mumbai, Maharashtra

**Url -https://www.dfineart.in**

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a dynamic, strategic and execution-driven **Operations** to lead and manage the end-to-end operations of projects across Theme Parks, Spatial Experience Design, Resort Design and Interior Design.

The role will be responsible for translating creative vision and design concepts into well-planned, efficiently managed and successfully executed projects. The individual will work closely with the Creative, Design, Architecture, Engineering, Project Management, Procurement and Execution teams to ensure seamless coordination from concept development through design development, production, implementation and final delivery.

The ideal candidate will bring a strong understanding of design-led businesses, project operations, resource planning, team leadership, commercial management and on-ground execution, with the ability to balance creative aspirations with operational efficiency, quality, timelines and profitability.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Strategic & Operational Leadership**

* Lead overall business operations across all verticals, ensuring alignment with the company's vision, business objectives and growth strategy.
* Develop operational frameworks, processes, systems and standard operating procedures (SOPs) to improve efficiency and accountability.
* Establish clear operational goals, performance metrics and reporting structures.
* Drive cross-functional collaboration between creative, design, technical and execution teams.
* Identify operational challenges and implement solutions to improve productivity and delivery efficiency.

**2. Project Planning & Execution**

* Oversee the complete project lifecycle, from project initiation and planning to execution, installation and handover.
* Ensure projects are delivered within agreed timelines, budgets and quality parameters.
* Establish project schedules, milestones, resource allocation plans and execution strategies.
* Monitor project progress, identify bottlenecks and proactively resolve operational issues.
* Ensure effective coordination between internal teams, consultants, contractors, vendors and clients.
* Oversee multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining delivery standards.

**3. Design & Creative Operations**

* Work closely with the Creative Head and Design Leadership to translate creative concepts into practical and executable project plans.
* Ensure seamless transition from concept design to detailed design, technical development, production and implementation.
* Facilitate coordination between creative, interior, architectural, landscape, lighting, MEP and other technical teams.
* Ensure design intent, quality standards and creative vision are maintained throughout execution.
* Evaluate design feasibility in terms of cost, materials, construction methodologies, timelines and operational requirements.

**4. Resource & Team Management**

* Lead, mentor and manage multidisciplinary teams across design, project management, technical, procurement and execution functions.
* Plan manpower requirements and optimize resource utilization across projects.
* Define roles, responsibilities, performance expectations and accountability structures.
* Build a culture of ownership, collaboration, efficiency and continuous improvement.
* Identify skill gaps and develop training and capability-building initiatives.

**5. Financial & Commercial Management**

* Oversee project budgets, cost planning, cost control and operational expenditure.
* Work closely with finance and commercial teams to monitor project profitability and cash flow.
* Ensure effective budgeting, estimation, procurement planning and financial reporting.
* Identify opportunities for cost optimization without compromising design quality or project outcomes.
* Monitor project variations, additional costs, vendor payments and commercial commitments.

**6. Vendor, Procurement & Production Management**

* Develop and manage a reliable network of contractors, fabricators, suppliers, consultants and specialist vendors.
* Oversee procurement planning, vendor selection, negotiations and performance evaluation.
* Ensure materials, finishes, equipment and technical components meet project specifications and quality standards.
* Monitor production, fabrication, logistics, installation and site execution.
* Establish vendor performance benchmarks and quality-control mechanisms.

**7. Quality, Risk & Compliance**

* Establish quality assurance and quality control systems across all projects.
* Ensure adherence to safety standards, statutory requirements, building codes and relevant industry regulations.
* Identify project risks and develop mitigation strategies.
* Conduct periodic operational reviews, site inspections and project audits.
* Ensure timely resolution of quality, technical and execution-related challenges.

**8. Client & Stakeholder Management**

* Work closely with business development and leadership teams to support project planning and delivery commitments.
* Maintain strong relationships with clients, consultants, contractors and external stakeholders.
* Participate in project reviews, presentations and strategic client meetings whenever required.
* Ensure client expectations are managed effectively, and project deliverables are aligned with agreed commitments.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* 5 years of relevant professional experience, with significant experience in operations, project delivery or leadership roles.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Civil, Interior Design, Product Design, Fine Arts, Industrial Design, Experience Design or a related field.
* Experience in Theme Parks, Entertainment, Experiential Design, Hospitality, Resorts, Architecture, Interior Design, Exhibition Design or Large-scale Design & Build projects.
* Proven experience managing multidisciplinary teams and multiple large-scale projects.
* Strong understanding of the complete design-to-execution lifecycle.
* Experience in project budgeting, costing, procurement, vendor management and commercial control.
* Ability to understand creative and design requirements while ensuring operational and technical feasibility.
* Strong leadership, decision-making, negotiation and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management and organizational skills.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, project-driven environment with multiple priorities.

Pay: ₹22,000.00 - ₹65,000.00 per month

**• Ensure compliance to the group’s risk management framework as applicable.**

**Priority Skills**

**Other Skills**  
**• Data Analysis, Reconciliation and Control Governance**

The Center Head will be responsible for ensuring the highest standards of education, safety, and care for our students, while managing staff, building relationships with parents, and driving the center’s growth and success. The ideal candidate will have strong leadership skills, a passion for early childhood education, and a proven track record in managing educational or childcare facilities.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Enrollment and Marketing**: Drive enrollment growth by developing and implementing marketing strategies, conducting tours, and promoting the center’s programs to prospective families.
* **Operational Management**: Oversee the day-to-day operations of the preschool, ensuring a safe, welcoming, and efficient environment for children, staff, and parents.
* **Staff Leadership**: Recruit, train, mentor, and supervise teachers and support staff, fostering a positive and collaborative work culture.
* Curriculum Oversight: Ensure the implementation of a high-quality, age-appropriate curriculum that aligns with Kidzonia’s educational philosophy and standards.
* **Parent Communication**: Build strong relationships with parents and guardians, addressing concerns, providing regular updates, and organizing parent-teacher meetings and events.
* **Regulatory Compliance**: Ensure the center complies with all local, state, and federal regulations, licensing requirements, and health and safety standards.
* **Financial Management**: Manage the center’s budget, including tuition collection, payroll, and expense tracking, while identifying opportunities for cost efficiency and revenue growth.
* **Quality Assurance**: Regularly evaluate the center’s programs, staff performance, and child outcomes to maintain and improve quality standards.
* **Community Engagement**: Represent Kidzonia in the local community, building partnerships and participating in events to enhance the center’s reputation and visibility.

  

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Early Childhood Education, Business Administration, or a related field (Master’s degree preferred).
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in early childhood education, with at least 2 years in a leadership or managerial role.
* Strong understanding of early childhood development, curriculum design, and best practices in preschool education.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Proven ability to manage budgets, meet financial targets, and drive operational efficiency.
* Proficiency in using technology for administrative tasks and communication.

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with play-based, Montessori, or Reggio Emilia-inspired programs.
* Familiarity with childcare management software.
* Multilingual abilities are a plus.

  

**What We Offer:**

* Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.
* Paid time off and holidays.
* Professional development opportunities.
* A supportive and collaborative work environment.

title: Delivery Lead
description:
Job Description

Delivery Lead – Insurance Managed Services (Offshore)

Role snapshot

Job title

Delivery Lead – Insurance Managed Services

Location

Pune, India (Hybrid)

Experience

8–10 years total, with at least 4 years in Insurance and 3+ years leading managed service delivery

Reports to

Delivery Head / Account Delivery Director

Works with

Onshore client stakeholders, onshore engagement manager, offshore delivery teams

Team size

30–40 resources in a multi-vendor blended team across support, maintenance and enhancement

Shift

US overlap: 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST

Employment type

Full-time, permanent

About the role

We are looking for a Delivery Lead to own end-to-end offshore delivery of managed services for our insurance clients. You will run application support, maintenance and enhancement engagements against SLAs, lead a multi-vendor blended team, and act as the senior offshore point of contact for client stakeholders. You will bring deep insurance domain knowledge, strong service delivery discipline, and an AI-driven, product-minded approach that moves the service from reactive support to proactive, automated operations.

Key responsibilities

Managed service delivery

•

Own offshore AMS delivery (L2/L3 support, maintenance and enhancements) for insurance platforms against contractual SLAs, KPIs and XLAs.

•

Apply ITIL processes pragmatically across incident, problem, change and release, and lead major incident management and root cause analysis.

•

Plan and execute transitions of new scope into steady state.

Clients and suppliers

•

Act as the senior offshore point of contact for client delivery and IT leadership, and run governance from weekly service reviews to QBRs.

•

Operate within a multi-supplier ecosystem: coordinate handoffs, OLAs and shared incidents, and keep accountability clear across suppliers.

•

Manage escalations transparently and maintain high client satisfaction.

Insurance domain

•

Apply knowledge of the insurance value chain (underwriting, policy administration, billing, claims) to set delivery priorities.

•

Guide teams supporting platforms such as Guidewire, Duck Creek, Majesco or Sapiens, and ensure regulatory and data privacy requirements are met.

AI, automation and innovation

•

Champion an AI-first delivery model, using GenAI for ticket triage, resolution recommendations, knowledge generation and self-service.

•

Deliver automation through shift-left, self-healing, AIOps and agentic AI, with measurable gains in productivity and resolution time.

•

Apply AI-assisted engineering, and take GenAI pilots into secure, governed production with responsible AI controls.

•

Bring a regular pipeline of innovation proposals to clients, backed by business cases.

Product mindset

•

Run the service as a product: define outcomes, measure business value beyond ticket SLAs, and evolve it through a roadmap.

•

Build reusable assets and accelerators that scale across clients.

People and commercials

•

Lead and grow a 30–40 person multi-vendor blended team of client, in-house and partner staff under one delivery model.

•

Own resource planning, rosters, performance management and attrition.

•

Own account metrics (utilisation, pyramid, margin) and support growth through scope expansion and proposals.

Required qualifications

•

8–10 years in IT services, including 3+ years as a delivery lead or manager and at least 4 years in insurance (P&C, Life & Annuities, or Health).

•

Must have: directly managed a team of 30–40 people in an onshore–offshore model.

•

Must have: led multi-vendor blended teams of client, in-house and third-party staff.

•

Must have: delivered in a multi-supplier ecosystem with shared SLAs, OLAs and integrated service management.

•

Proven record running AMS engagements under SLA- or outcome-based contracts, using ITIL and ITSM tools such as ServiceNow.

•

Working understanding of the AI and GenAI stack (LLMs, RAG, vector databases, agents; platforms such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Vertex AI or Anthropic Claude) and AI-era delivery practices (AI-assisted coding, LLMOps, CI/CD, cloud deployment).

•

Demonstrated passion for automation and innovation, with examples of initiatives driven and value delivered.

•

Ownership of delivery financials, and confident communication with senior stakeholders.

•

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related field.

Preferred qualifications

•

Experience managing sizable, multi-year AMS programmes.

•

A pragmatic, lightweight approach to process that favours outcomes over ceremony.

•

Certifications in ITIL v4, PMP or SAFe, cloud or AI (Azure, AWS, Google), or insurance (AINS, CPCU, LOMA).

•

Hands-on exposure to AIOps tools and GenAI use cases in insurance, such as claims summarisation or document intelligence.

•

Product management exposure, and experience with clients in North America, the UK or Europe.

Key competencies

•

Client-first, with strong stakeholder and escalation management across suppliers.

•

Passion for AI and innovation, with a product mindset focused on outcomes rather than tickets.

•

Data-driven, with a bias for action over process for its own sake.

•

* Leadership presence, commercial awareness and calm under pressure.

**Job Description:**

We are seeking an experienced Windows Administrator & Patch Management Specialist (L3) to manage, maintain, secure, and optimize enterprise Windows Server environments. The role involves end-to-end ownership of Windows infrastructure, patch management lifecycle, vulnerability remediation, automation, security compliance, and L3 technical support. ### **Windows Server Administration**

* Perform server provisioning, upgrades, migration, and decommissioning activities.
* Administrator Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, GPO, Certificate Services, and File Servers.

### **Security & Compliance**

* Implement OS hardening as per industry best practices and security guidelines.
* Ensure compliance with security standards, audit requirements, and regulatory policies.
* Manage server security baselines and access controls.
* Monitor security events and coordinate incident response activities.
* Review and mitigate vulnerabilities identified through regular security scans.
* Support internal and external security audits.

### **Incident, Problem & Change Management**

* Handle L3 escalations and critical incident management.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring incidents.
* Support change management processes and CAB activities.
* Ensure incident resolution within defined SLAs.
* Collaborate with engineering, application, cloud, and security teams during major incidents.

### **Monitoring & Performance Management**

* Monitor infrastructure using SCOM, SolarWinds, Nagios, or equivalent tools.
* Analyze performance bottlenecks and implement optimization measures.
* Perform capacity planning and infrastructure forecasting.
* Implement proactive monitoring and health checks.

### **Virtualization & Cloud Support**

* Hyper-V environments.
* Support virtual machine lifecycle management.
* Work with Azure and AWS cloud-hosted Windows workloads.
* Assist in cloud migration and modernization initiatives.

### **Automation & Scripting**

* Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts for operational automation.
* Automate patch deployment, compliance reporting, server health checks, and administrative tasks.
* Improve operational efficiency through automation initiatives.

### **Backup & Disaster Recovery**

* Support enterprise backup and recovery solutions.
* Perform backup validation and recovery testing.
* Participate in disaster recovery drills and business continuity planning.

### **Documentation & Knowledge Management**

* Maintain operational runbooks, SOPs, and infrastructure documentation.
* Prepare technical reports, compliance reports, and management dashboards.
* Share knowledge and mentor junior team members.

### **Team Collaboration**

* Work closely with local and global stakeholders.
* Participate in 24x7 support and rotational shifts if required.
* Drive continuous service improvement initiatives.

* B.E. / B.Tech (IT, Computer Science, Electronics)
* BCA / MCA
* B.Sc / M.Sc (IT / Computer Science)
* Any equivalent IT-related degree

title: Team Leader – AML Transaction Monitoring (SM / AVP)
description:
Team Leader – Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Transaction Monitoring

**Designation:**
AVP / DVP

**Department:**
Compliance

**Location:**
Kolkata

**Experience:**
15+ Years

Job Summary

Lead the AML Transaction Monitoring function, ensuring regulatory compliance, effective transaction monitoring, timely suspicious transaction reporting, robust risk management and operational efficiency. The role involves team leadership, stakeholder coordination, regulatory reporting and strengthening AML controls.

Key Roles & Responsibilities

* Oversee regulatory reporting and statutory submissions within stipulated timelines.
* Monitor transaction alerts and ensure timely closure within defined TATs.
* Review, enhance and approve Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs).
* Coordinate with Branch, Cluster, Regional and Zonal Heads for due diligence and AML-related requirements.
* Manage team performance, resource planning, training and attrition.
* Liaise with Internal/External Audit, Compliance, IT and Operations for AML-related activities.
* Analyse bulk transaction data, identify trends and present insights to senior management.
* Ensure timely closure of audit observations and implementation of Action Taken Reports (ATRs).
* Prepare AML reports and presentations for the Board, Audit Committee and Compliance Committee.
* Coordinate the bank-wide Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing (ML-TF) Risk Assessment.
* Drive continuous improvement in AML processes, systems and controls.
* Support recruitment, team development and strategic projects assigned by senior management.

Educational Qualifications

* Postgraduate degree in Finance, Banking, Economics or a related discipline.
* AML, KYC, Risk Management or Regulatory Compliance certifications will be an advantage.

Experience Required

* 15+ years of overall professional experience.
* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in AML, Transaction Monitoring, Risk, Vigilance or Compliance.
* Experience in regulatory audits, transaction monitoring systems and handling regulatory interactions, particularly with RBI.
* Prior experience in centralised functions, project management and decision-making roles.

Key Skills & Competencies

* Strong knowledge of AML regulations, KYC guidelines and regulatory compliance.
* Expertise in transaction monitoring and suspicious transaction reporting.
* Strong analytical, data interpretation and risk assessment skills.
* Excellent drafting, reporting and presentation skills.
* Leadership, team management and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Strong communication, problem-solving and decision-making abilities.

title: Owner
description:
**Company Description**
S.K Agencies is a second-generation customs clearing and forwarding firm that has been serving clients since 1974. The company focuses on providing up-to-date information on Pakistan customs clearing practices and industry-specific trends to support client business decisions. With deep experience in customs assessment and regulatory requirements, S.K Agencies recognizes that business needs and compliance standards are continually evolving. The team is committed to ongoing research and continuous improvement to deliver enhanced services as part of a standard, reliable package. This long-standing expertise positions S.K Agencies as a trusted partner for clients seeking clarity and efficiency in customs and forwarding operations.
  
**Role Description**
The Owner at S.K Agencies will oversee end-to-end operations of the customs clearing and forwarding business, ensuring smooth coordination between clients, customs authorities, and logistics partners. Day-to-day responsibilities include monitoring customs assessments, reviewing documentation, staying current with regulatory changes, and guiding the team in implementing best practices. The role also involves managing client relationships, addressing operational challenges, and driving service improvements based on ongoing research and industry trends. The Owner will be responsible for strategic planning, financial oversight, and setting performance standards for the agency. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Kolkata.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong knowledge of customs clearing, forwarding procedures, and regulatory compliance, with the ability to interpret and apply changing customs rules and assessment criteria.
* Experience in operations management, including workflow optimization, documentation control, and coordination with internal teams and external stakeholders.
* Proven client relationship management skills, including clear communication, problem-solving, and the ability to provide guidance on industry trends and requirements.
* Business and financial acumen, with experience in budgeting, cost control, and making data-driven decisions to enhance service quality and profitability.
* Leadership skills with the ability to mentor staff, set clear goals, and foster a culture of continuous improvement and ethical business practices.
* Strong research and analytical abilities to track market developments, regulatory updates, and competitor practices and translate findings into actionable strategies.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Logistics, Supply Chain, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience in customs clearing and forwarding may be considered.
* Willingness to work on-site in Kolkata and commit to a full-time leadership role within a growing, service-oriented organization.

title: Senior Manager/DGM – Accounts Receivable & Revenue Assurance
description:
Job Description

**Senior Manager / Deputy General Manager – Accounts Receivable & Revenue Assurance**

**Function:**
Finance

**Location:**
Kolkata – Head Office

**Department:**
Finance & Accounts

**Experience:**
8–11 years

**Qualification:**
CA preferred

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced finance professional to lead
**Accounts Receivable (AR), revenue accounting, collections, reconciliations and receivables reporting**
. The role will be responsible for ensuring accurate revenue recognition, timely collections, effective credit control, reconciliation of customer accounts and strong financial governance across sales channels.

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of receivables management, revenue accounting, channel-wise reconciliations and working capital optimization, with the ability to work closely with Sales, Key Accounts, E-commerce, Modern Trade, General Trade and other business teams.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Accounts Receivable & Revenue Management**

* Oversee the end-to-end accounts receivable process, including invoicing, billing, Debit / Credit Notes, collections, customer reconciliations and outstanding balances.
* Ensure accurate and timely revenue accounting in accordance with applicable accounting standards and company policies.
* Monitor customer outstanding balances, credit periods, payment commitments and overdue receivables.
* Drive regular reconciliation of customer ledgers and resolution of short payments, deductions, debit notes and disputed invoices.
* Ensure timely issuance of credit notes, debit notes and customer statements, with appropriate approvals and documentation.
* Establish robust processes to minimize billing errors, revenue leakage and unapplied customer receipts.

**Collections & Credit Control**

* Drive collection efficiency and ensure adherence to agreed customer credit terms.
* Monitor receivables ageing, overdue balances and collection performance, identifying risks and escalation requirements.
* Partner with business teams to resolve collection bottlenecks and improve payment realization.
* Support the development and implementation of customer credit policies, credit limits and escalation mechanisms.
* Assess customer payment behavior and highlight potential bad debts or credit risks.
* Monitor provisions for doubtful debts and recommend appropriate actions based on ageing, recoverability and applicable accounting requirements.

**Channel-wise Reconciliation**

* Oversee receivables and settlement reconciliations across key business channels and customers, including marketplaces, e-commerce, modern trade, general trade and other relevant sales channels.
* Reconcile sales, invoices, collections, deductions, returns, schemes, claims and credit notes with customer statements and settlement reports.
* Identify and resolve discrepancies between internal sales records, customer accounts and platform settlements.
* Coordinate with Key Account Management, Sales, Commercial, Supply Chain and other stakeholders to close pending claims and deductions.
* Establish standardized reconciliation processes and reporting mechanisms for improved visibility and control.

**Financial Reporting& MIS**

* Prepare and review monthly AR reports, receivables ageing, collection dashboards and channel-wise outstanding statements.
* Provide management visibility on debtor days, overdue receivables, collection efficiency, credit exposure and working capital.
* Track key variances in revenue, collections and receivables against budgets, forecasts and previous periods.
* Ensure timely month-end closure of AR accounts, including reconciliations, provisions and balance sheet schedules.
* Present actionable insights to senior finance leadership on collection risks, customer exposure and improvement opportunities.
* Develop standardized dashboards and reporting tools to enable data-driven decision-making.

**Compliance, Audit & Internal Controls**

* Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, GST requirements and internal policies relating to billing, revenue and receivables.
* Lead and drive audits and IFC testing across the areas of Billing, collections, revenue & customer accounting (including DN/CN), reconciliations, etc.
* Ensure adequate internal controls are implemented and operated effectively across Billing, collections, revenue & customer accounting (including DN/CN), reconciliations, etc.
* Ensure appropriate documentation and controls for customer onboarding, credit approvals, invoicing, collections and write-offs.
* Coordinate with internal and external auditors on AR balances, revenue transactions and customer confirmations.
* Strengthen controls around revenue leakage, unauthorized credit notes, deductions and overdue accounts.
* Ensure timely closure of audit observations and maintenance of accurate supporting documentation.

**Process Improvement & Team Leadership**

* Drive automation and standardization of billing, reconciliation, collection tracking and reporting processes.
* Establish SOPs, performance metrics and escalation frameworks for effective AR management.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual work, improve reconciliation turnaround time and strengthen data accuracy.
* Lead, mentor and develop the AR team, fostering accountability and operational excellence.
* Collaborate with senior finance leadership on workingcapital improvement and finance process transformation.
* Lead the smooth transition from the existing Accounting System to an ERP for the areas of Billing, collections, revenue & customer balances, etc.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Reduction in overdue receivables and improvement in collection efficiency. Believe this would be with the SCM team as this happens from Warehouse.
* Improvement in debt or days and working capital cycle.
* Accuracy and timeliness of revenue recognition and customer invoicing.
* Timely closure of customer reconciliations and settlement discrepancies.
* Reduction in outstanding deductions, disputed invoice sand unresolved claims.
* Timely completion of month-end closing and AR reporting.
* Reduction in bad debt exposure and revenue leakage.
* Compliance with internal controls, statutory requirements and audit timelines.
* Drive efficiency through automation and ensure smooth transition of systems in a timely manner.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* 8–11 years of relevant experience in Finance & Accounts, with substantial experience in Accounts Receivable and revenue accounting.
* CA preferred; candidates with strong relevant experience and other suitable finance qualifications may also be considered.
* Experience in FMCG, consumer goods, retail, e-commerce or other multi-channel business environments.
* Strong understanding of revenue recognition, receivables accounting, collections, credit control and working capital management.
* Experience managing customer reconciliations, marketplace settlements, modern trade claims and channel-specific deductions.
* Sound knowledge of GST, accounting standards and relevant statutory compliance.
* Proficiency in ERP systems and advanced MS Excel; experience with Power BI or other reporting tools is an advantage.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to lead teams, strengthen controls and improve processes in a fast-paced business environment.

title: Senior Manager- Growth and Impact
description:
**About the role**

We are looking for a
**Senior Manager**
to lead strategic engagements with government and ecosystem stakeholders across
**education, skilling, vocational education and others**
. The role will involve working closely with senior government officials to understand priorities, identify system-level opportunities, design and drive high-impact interventions, and translate evidence into actionable policy and program decisions.

The ideal candidate will bring a strong understanding of government systems, excellent stakeholder management skills, strategic problem-solving capabilities, and a strong bias for execution. They should be comfortable operating at the intersection of
**government, technology, data and social impact**
, and be able to move seamlessly between strategic discussions with senior bureaucrats and ground-level implementation.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Government engagement & strategic partnerships**

* Build and manage trusted relationships with senior government officials across education, skilling, and other adjacent domains.
* Engage with senior bureaucrats and department leadership to understand priorities, decision cycles, institutional constraints and emerging opportunities.
* Represent the organisation in strategic discussions with state and central government departments, Sector Skill Councils, industry bodies, employers and other ecosystem stakeholders.
* Act as a strategic thought partner to government stakeholders, bringing evidence, insights and practical recommendations to support policy and program decisions.
* Identify opportunities to align organisational interventions with government priorities, schemes, budgets and existing institutional structures.

**2. Strategy, policy & program design**

* Lead the design and execution of large-scale education and skilling programs in partnership with government, private sector and philanthropy.
* Analyse government policies, schemes, budgets and implementation frameworks to identify opportunities for convergence, optimisation and system-level innovation.
* Develop strategies and program models that address challenges across education, skilling, employability, placement and workforce outcomes.
* Drive
  **evidence-backed policy advocacy**
  and support government stakeholders in translating insights into actionable reforms.
* Work with leadership to develop proposals, partnership models and new program opportunities across states, central government and thematic areas.

**3. Data, research & evidence**

* Translate large and complex datasets into actionable insights for government decision-makers and organisational leadership.
* Develop analytical frameworks, policy briefs, dashboards, visual reports and presentations that enable real-time decision-making.
* Lead research and ecosystem assessments to understand implementation bottlenecks, user needs and opportunities for reform.
* Build evidence bases around outcomes such as learning, skilling, employability, placement, wages and workforce participation.
* Use data and field evidence to identify course corrections and strengthen program design and implementation.

**4. Program execution & impact**

* Own delivery of complex, multi-stakeholder programs from strategy and design through implementation and scale-up.
* Work closely with internal teams across product, technology, analytics, training and program delivery to ensure timely and integrated execution.
* Monitor program milestones, risks, dependencies and impact indicators, proactively identifying and resolving bottlenecks.
* Lead impact articulation through clear measurement, reporting and documentation frameworks.
* Ensure that learnings from implementation are systematically captured and translated into improvements in program strategy and delivery.

**5. Field engagement & implementation intelligence**

* Conduct regular field visits to understand implementation realities, frontline needs and stakeholder experiences.
* Engage with teachers, trainers, students, administrators, employers and other actors to gather ground-level intelligence.
* Bring field insights into policy discussions, program design and strategic decision-making.
* Identify gaps between policy intent and implementation and develop practical recommendations to address them.

**6. Communication & thought leadership**

* Develop compelling narratives, presentations and communication materials that connect field evidence, policy priorities and program outcomes.
* Communicate complex insights clearly to senior government and internal leadership.
* Publish articles, reports and thought pieces that showcase organisational learning and insights from the education and skilling ecosystem.
* Represent the organisation in relevant forums, conferences and ecosystem discussions.

**7. Growth & ecosystem development**

* Identify and shape new opportunities across state government departments and relevant thematic areas.
* Build relationships with ecosystem organisations to broaden policy recommendations and enable adoption.
* Work with leadership to identify potential partnerships, funding opportunities and pathways for scaling successful models.

Qualifications & Experience

* **8+ years of relevant professional experience**
  in management consulting, public policy, government advisory, program management, education, skilling or other relevant domains.
* **MBA, Master’s in Public Policy, Development Studies, Education or a related field**
  preferred.
* Demonstrated experience working with
  **government stakeholders**
  , with government engagement experience being essential.
* Prior experience managing relationships with senior bureaucrats, ideally at the level of
  **Principal Secretary/Secretary/Director and above in State Government**
  .
* Experience in designing or implementing large-scale, multi-stakeholder programs in partnership with government.
* Strong understanding of government schemes, policies, institutional structures, decision-making processes and budgetary mechanisms.
* Experience leveraging
  **technology, digital platforms, data products or Digital Public Infrastructure**
  for social impact is highly desirable.
* Demonstrated experience in using data and evidence to influence policy or program decisions.
* Experience leading teams and managing complex programs with multiple stakeholders.

What we are looking for

* **Strategic thinker with a strong execution bias**
  — able to move from a high-level problem statement to concrete action.
* **High ownership and initiative**
  — comfortable taking responsibility for ambiguous problems and charting a path forward.
* **Strong government orientation**
  — able to build credibility and trusted relationships with senior public-sector stakeholders.
* **Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills**
  — able to synthesise diverse information into clear recommendations.
* **Strong communication skills**
  — able to communicate effectively with senior bureaucrats, frontline stakeholders and internal teams.
* **Collaborative leader**
  who can work across multidisciplinary teams and bring diverse stakeholders together.
* **Data-driven and impact-oriented**
  , with a demonstrated commitment to improving education, skilling and employment outcomes.
* Comfortable working in
  **fast-paced, ambiguous and evolving environments**
  , with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

title: Deputy Vice President - Procurement
description:
Key Responsibilities

title: Vice President of Supply Chain
description:
**Role Objective:**

A key objective of this role is to deliver reliable, compliant and cost-efficient end-to-end supply of Biotech's sterile ophthalmic, orthopaedic and aesthetic products to surgeons, hospitals, distributors and partners in more than 110 countries — balancing service, inventory and cost while keeping patient safety and product quality first.

The role owns the global supply chain across Plan, Source and Deliver: demand planning, S&OP / IBP, master production and materials planning, global inventory policy, strategic procurement, logistics, distribution and customer OTIF, supported by supply chain systems and data.

**Desired Candidate Profile:**

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, Engineering, Pharmacy, Science; MBA/Postgraduation and relevant professional certifications (APICS/ASCM/CIPS) preferred.

**Experience Requirement:**

* 15+ years of supply chain experience, including 5+ years in global/multi-regional leadership across planning, procurement, and logistics.
* Experience in regulated medical devices, pharmaceuticals, or life sciences; ophthalmic devices preferred.
* Strong expertise in global demand planning, executive S&OP/IBP, MPS, MRP/DRP, constraint-based planning and inventory optimization.
* Proficiency in procurement, supplier management, contract negotiation and supply risk management.
* Knowledge of logistics, 3PL, import/export, trade compliance, and regulatory standards (ISO 13485, GDP, UDI).
* Demonstrated impact on inventory days/turns, working capital, cost-to-serve, procurement savings and freight cost, supported by measurable results.
* • Hands-on experience with SAP/ERP, advanced planning systems, WMS/TMS and supply chain digital tools; SAP S/4HANA experience preferred.
* Proven track record in improving OTIF, inventory optimization, and leading ERP/supply chain transformation.
* Experience leading senior management teams with accountability for multi-plant and multi-country operations.
* Experience in specialized supply models, including consignment, made-to-order and patient-specific products.
* Expertise in multi-country fulfilment across WOS, direct sales and distributor channels, including intercompany movements, inventory ownership, replenishment and partner governance.
* Experience in distribution network optimization, regional hub development, or M&A integration.
* Proven ability to manage supply chain disruptions and operations across emerging markets.
* Experience with batch/lot traceability, shelf-life management, slow-moving/obsolete inventory and market-specific availability for sterile or implantable products.

**Role & Responsibilities:**

**Supply Chain Strategy & Network Management**

* Develop and execute global supply chain strategies aligned with business growth and expansion.
* Optimize supply chain networks, distribution infrastructure, service levels, costs, and lead times.
* Establish common supply chain governance, decision rights and operating reviews across manufacturing sites, WOS, regional hubs, direct sales and distributor markets.

**Demand Planning & S&OP/IBP**

* Lead demand forecasting and executive integrated business planning across Commercial, Manufacturing, Procurement and Finance, consolidating demand by market, vertical and product family.
* Ensure alignment of demand, supply, production and revenue plans while managing supply constraints and documenting risk, allocation and scenario decisions.

**Production & Inventory Management**

* Own the master supply plan, MPS/MRP/DRP, materials availability and inventory policy in partnership with Manufacturing.
* Optimize global inventory, safety stock, replenishment, distribution planning and working capital, including visibility over WOS, consignment, slow-moving, near-expiry and obsolete inventory.

**Procurement & Supplier Management**

* Lead strategic sourcing, supplier development, contract negotiations, and procurement cost optimization.
* Ensure supplier performance, supply continuity, risk mitigation, and compliance with quality requirements.

**Logistics & Distribution Management**

* Oversee global logistics, warehousing, 3PL operations, and import/export activities.
* Optimize distribution networks, freight costs, delivery timelines, customs/trade compliance and intercompany shipments across relevant markets.

**Customer Service & Supply Fulfilment**

* Drive customer OTIF performance, order management, and timely product availability across markets.
* Manage differentiated fulfilment models for WOS entities, direct sales channels, third-party distributors, consignment and patient-specific products, including channel-specific service and stock governance.

**Quality, Regulatory & Product Launch Readiness**

* Ensure supply chain compliance with applicable quality, regulatory, traceability, and distribution standards.
* Coordinate supply readiness for new product launches, market expansion, and product lifecycle changes.
* Maintain batch/lot traceability and distribution controls.

**Digital Transformation & Risk Management**

* Apply AI-enabled forecasting, supply visibility and exception analytics where validated and appropriate for regulated operations.
* Lead ERP, advanced planning, automation, and supply chain digital transformation initiatives.
* Strengthen supply chain resilience through risk management and business continuity planning.

**Financial & Operational Excellence**

* Manage supply chain budgets, operating costs, cost-to-serve, procurement and freight savings, inventory carrying cost and working capital optimization.
* Drive continuous improvement in service levels, productivity, efficiency, and overall supply chain performance.
* Define Finance-validated savings, inventory and service baselines and report agreed KPIs through regular management reviews.

**Leadership & Sustainability**

* Lead global supply chain teams, develop leadership capabilities, and strengthen succession planning.

**Functional Skills Required:**

* Supply Chain is accountable for demand forecasting, IBP/S&OP leadership, master supply and materials planning, global inventory policies, sourcing, logistics/distribution and customer OTIF.
* Production planning interfaces, plant RM/PM storage, product launch readiness, quality events and OTIF require documented cross-functional RACI and escalation mechanisms.

**Team Size to be Handled:**

* General Managers at Sites and WOS.

**Important Links**

**LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/biotechhealthcare/**

title: General Manager – Finance & Accounts (Taxation, Audit & Compliance)
description:
**Role Objective:**

Key objective of this role is to lead the group's accounting, taxation, audit and compliance function across all Indian and overseas entities of Biotech Healthcare Group, ensuring robust financial processes and strong internal controls.

The role is responsible for delivering a clean, reconciled trial balance every month across all subsidiaries; preparing quarterly consolidated financial statements; owning the annual statutory audit with Big 4 auditors; building a robust internal audit and internal financial controls (IFC) framework, including plant and operational process audits; and ensuring full global regulatory and tax compliance.

The position will lead a team of ~20 across accounts, taxation and internal audit, and will serve as the company's key interface with statutory and internal auditors, tax consultants and government revenue departments (Income Tax, GST, FEMA and Customs), ensuring a clean compliance track record for the group.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

**Education**

**Minimum:**

* Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA).

**Desirable:**

* Additional certification in IFRS (e.g. DipIFR) or Internal Audit / Controls (e.g. CIA, CISA).

**Experience Requirement**

**Minimum:**

* 12–15 years of post-qualification experience in accounts, taxation, audit and compliance.
* Experience of handling Big 4 statutory audits from the company side – audit readiness, schedules, queries and timely sign-off.
* Experience of managing financial processes across subsidiaries – timely accounting, monthly closure with clean trial balance and preparation of quarterly consolidated financial statements (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow).
* Minimum 5 years of hands-on SAP experience.

**Desirable:**

* Big 4 background – trained at a Big 4 firm.
* Experience in a multi-entity manufacturing group, preferably in pharma / healthcare / medical devices.
* Exposure to overseas group entities and global / group-level compliance.

**Role Requirements**

* Strong experience in group accounting, monthly close and consolidation across multiple entities.
