title: Account Head
description:
**ABOUT US**

Resolute Corp Bharat Private Limited is a diversified investment and venture-building group rooted in India, operating across fintech, consumer brands, and sports. This role is on the Resolute Corp payroll, with the incumbent deployed to lead finance for Hair Drama Co. — the Group's premium hair accessories brand, known for bold design and quality across a curated D2C and retail range, including its in-house manufacturing operations. The role reports into Group Finance.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are looking for an Accounts Head — dual-qualified as a Chartered Accountant (CA) and Cost Accountant (ICWA) — to lead the finance function of Hair Drama Company end-to-end: accounting, audit, costing, and financial reporting. This is a hands-on role for someone with genuine manufacturing and costing experience who can bring the same rigour to a fast-growing D2C and e-commerce business, partnering closely with the CEO in shaping and executing the company's long-term financial strategy.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Financial Strategy & Business Planning**

* Own and drive the company's long-term financial strategy; build long-term financial models
* Drive sustainable, profitable growth
* Evaluate new business opportunities and support expansion into new categories and markets
* Partner closely with the CEO on strategic and business decisions

**Financial Reporting & Controllership**

* Overall supervision of financial accounting, including Trial Balance (TB), Profit & Loss (P&L), and Balance Sheet (BS); ensure timely monthly closure of books of accounts
* Own monthly MIS reporting with clear commentary on variances and key drivers
* Lead preparation of the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) and track AOP vs. actual performance
* Track Standard Cost vs. Actual Cost, investigate variances, and recommend corrective action
* Prepare Quarterly and Annual Budgets and report Budget vs. Actuals to leadership, flagging risks early
* Strengthen internal financial controls and documentation

**Manufacturing & Costing**

* Manage Bill of Materials (BOM) costing and track BOM vs. actual variance
* Oversee inventory management, including valuation, control, and reconciliation
* Conduct physical verification of stock at regular intervals and drive corrective actions

**Cash Flow & Working Capital Management**

* Own the company's cash position — cash flow forecasting, liquidity planning, inventory funding, vendor and customer payment cycles, warehouse cash requirements, operating expenses, and capital expenditure
* Liaise with banks for credit lines and other working capital facilities
* Ensure a healthy cash runway and maintain optimal working capital

**FP&A (Financial Planning & Analysis)**

* Develop dashboards tracking revenue, gross margin (COGS), direct costs, contribution margin (channel-wise), EBITDA, net profit, burn rate, CAC, LTV, repeat purchase rate, inventory turns, and cash conversion cycle
* Generate actionable insights for leadership from these metrics

**E-commerce & Revenue Finance**

* Oversee accounting and reconciliation for e-commerce channels, including marketplace fees, returns, and payment gateway settlements
* Review channel receivables against actual receipts; reconcile Sales vs. Actual Receipts across all channels, resolving mismatches with sales, operations, and banking teams
* Monitor financial performance across channels — Shopify, marketplaces, retail, and international
* Analyse product, SKU, collection, and channel profitability

**Pricing & Margin Management**

* Partner with NPD and sales teams to optimise selling price, discount strategy, promotions, gross margins, markdown planning, and product mix

**Inventory Finance**

* Work closely with Supply Chain on inventory investment, inventory ageing, dead stock, stock turns, replenishment planning, open-to-buy planning, and purchase planning

**Statutory & Internal Audit**

* Coordinate and lead Internal Audit planning and execution; track findings through to closure with process owners
* Lead Statutory Audit end-to-end — coordination with auditors, schedule preparation, and query resolution
* Ensure compliance with statutory, tax, and regulatory requirements applicable to the business (India)

**Accounting & Compliance**

* Ensure accurate and timely GST, TDS, Income Tax, and ROC filings and compliance
* Ensure payroll compliance

**Risk Management**

* Identify and mitigate financial, foreign exchange, credit, fraud, and operational risks
* Implement internal controls and governance

**Business Partnering & Team Leadership**

* Partner with business heads and Group Finance leadership on financial planning and decision support
* Build and mentor teams across Finance, Accounts, Treasury, FP&A, Tax, and Payroll

**CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS**

* **Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) and Cost Accountant (ICWA)**
* Minimum 5+ years of post-qualification experience — open to both strong Manager-level and Head-of-Function-level candidates, provided manufacturing, costing, and finance-ownership experience is a strong match to this role
* **Prior experience in the manufacturing industry is mandatory**
* Strong working knowledge of BOM/costing, inventory management, and e-commerce finance
* Preferred: strong e-commerce/D2C accounting experience
* Hands-on experience with statutory audits, internal audits, and MIS reporting
* Working knowledge of standard costing and budget-vs-actual analysis
* Preferred: prior experience with a Big 4 accounting/audit firm (KPMG, Deloitte, EY, PwC)
* Preferred: experience working in a digital-first / digital business environment
* Proficiency in Tally/ERP and MS Excel; Desirable: exposure to Zoho Books or similar platforms

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Chartered Accountant (CA) and Cost Accountant (ICWA)
* Additional certifications in internal audit or costing are a plus

title: Lead Banking & Treasury
description:
**Role Purpose -**

The position is responsible for managing the organization's treasury operations, banking relationships, liquidity planning, working capital optimization, trade finance instruments (LCs/BGs/SBLCs), compliance management, and treasury process automation. The role ensures efficient cash flow management, optimal utilization of banking facilities, regulatory compliance, and technology-driven treasury operations to support business growth.

**Role Overview**

* Manage
  **cash flow forecasting, liquidity planning, and working capital requirements**
  to ensure smooth business operations.
* Oversee utilization and monitoring of
  **fund-based and non-fund-based banking facilities**
  such as Cash Credit (CC), Overdraft (OD), Letters of Credit (LCs), Bank Guarantees (BGs), and SBLCs.
* Handle end-to-end
  **Trade Finance operations**
  , including Import/Export LCs, DA/DP Bills, Buyers' Credit, Suppliers' Credit, and Bill Discounting.
* Manage issuance, amendment, negotiation, renewal, and closure of
  **LCs, BGs, and SBLCs**
  in coordination with banks and business teams.
* Ensure timely settlement of
  **import/export transactions, trade-related payments, bills of exchange, and banking obligations**
  .
* Develop and maintain relationships with
  **banks and financial institutions**
  for credit facilities, pricing negotiations, and treasury support.
* Ensure compliance with
  **RBI, FEMA, banking regulations, and trade finance guidelines**
  , including documentation and statutory reporting.
* Prepare and submit
  **CMA data, stock statements, drawing power calculations, covenant compliance reports, and banking MIS**
  .
* Drive
  **working capital optimization initiatives**
  through factoring, channel financing, supply chain finance, and other liquidity enhancement mechanisms.
* Monitor
  **interest costs, bank charges, treasury reconciliations, shipping bills, bills of entry, and foreign trade transactions**
  to ensure cost efficiency and regulatory compliance.
* Manage
  **foreign exchange (Forex) exposure**
  , hedging strategies, forward contracts, and currency risk mitigation for import/export transactions.
* Coordinate with commercial, procurement, logistics, and finance teams to ensure seamless execution of
  **trade finance and banking transactions**
  .
* Evaluate and implement
  **treasury and banking process improvements**
  , digital banking solutions, and automation initiatives to enhance operational efficiency.
* Support business expansion by arranging
  **project finance, working capital enhancement, structured finance solutions, and additional banking limits**
  as required.
* Prepare and present
  **treasury dashboards, cash position reports, fund utilization reports, and banking performance analytics**
  for management review and strategic decision-making.

**Desired Qualification**

CA / MBA (Finance) from a reputed institute.

**Experience**

7+ years of experience in Treasury, Banking Operations, Working Capital Management, Trade Finance, or Corporate Finance

description:

The Operations Executive is responsible for arranging vehicles as per customer requirements, coordinating with drivers and clients, monitoring vehicle movements, and ensuring smooth and timely transportation operations.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Vehicle Arrangement**

* Arrange vehicles according to customer and operational requirements.

* Coordinate with drivers regarding vehicle reporting time and location.

* Track vehicle reporting, departure and arrival status.
* Ensure proper coordination between drivers, customers and the operations team.
* Handle emergency vehicle breakdowns and replacement arrangements.

* Maintain daily vehicle arrangement and trip records.
* Collect trip sheets, duty slips and other supporting documents.

* Problem-solving and decision-making abilities.

title: Senior Manager/DGM – Accounts Receivable & Revenue Assurance
description:
Job Description

**Senior Manager / Deputy General Manager – Accounts Receivable & Revenue Assurance**

**Function:**
Finance

**Location:**
Kolkata – Head Office

**Department:**
Finance & Accounts

**Experience:**
8–11 years

**Qualification:**
CA preferred

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced finance professional to lead
**Accounts Receivable (AR), revenue accounting, collections, reconciliations and receivables reporting**
. The role will be responsible for ensuring accurate revenue recognition, timely collections, effective credit control, reconciliation of customer accounts and strong financial governance across sales channels.

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of receivables management, revenue accounting, channel-wise reconciliations and working capital optimization, with the ability to work closely with Sales, Key Accounts, E-commerce, Modern Trade, General Trade and other business teams.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Accounts Receivable & Revenue Management**

* Oversee the end-to-end accounts receivable process, including invoicing, billing, Debit / Credit Notes, collections, customer reconciliations and outstanding balances.
* Ensure accurate and timely revenue accounting in accordance with applicable accounting standards and company policies.
* Monitor customer outstanding balances, credit periods, payment commitments and overdue receivables.
* Drive regular reconciliation of customer ledgers and resolution of short payments, deductions, debit notes and disputed invoices.
* Ensure timely issuance of credit notes, debit notes and customer statements, with appropriate approvals and documentation.
* Establish robust processes to minimize billing errors, revenue leakage and unapplied customer receipts.

**Collections & Credit Control**

* Drive collection efficiency and ensure adherence to agreed customer credit terms.
* Monitor receivables ageing, overdue balances and collection performance, identifying risks and escalation requirements.
* Partner with business teams to resolve collection bottlenecks and improve payment realization.
* Support the development and implementation of customer credit policies, credit limits and escalation mechanisms.
* Assess customer payment behavior and highlight potential bad debts or credit risks.
* Monitor provisions for doubtful debts and recommend appropriate actions based on ageing, recoverability and applicable accounting requirements.

**Channel-wise Reconciliation**

* Oversee receivables and settlement reconciliations across key business channels and customers, including marketplaces, e-commerce, modern trade, general trade and other relevant sales channels.
* Reconcile sales, invoices, collections, deductions, returns, schemes, claims and credit notes with customer statements and settlement reports.
* Identify and resolve discrepancies between internal sales records, customer accounts and platform settlements.
* Coordinate with Key Account Management, Sales, Commercial, Supply Chain and other stakeholders to close pending claims and deductions.
* Establish standardized reconciliation processes and reporting mechanisms for improved visibility and control.

**Financial Reporting& MIS**

* Prepare and review monthly AR reports, receivables ageing, collection dashboards and channel-wise outstanding statements.
* Provide management visibility on debtor days, overdue receivables, collection efficiency, credit exposure and working capital.
* Track key variances in revenue, collections and receivables against budgets, forecasts and previous periods.
* Ensure timely month-end closure of AR accounts, including reconciliations, provisions and balance sheet schedules.
* Present actionable insights to senior finance leadership on collection risks, customer exposure and improvement opportunities.
* Develop standardized dashboards and reporting tools to enable data-driven decision-making.

**Compliance, Audit & Internal Controls**

* Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, GST requirements and internal policies relating to billing, revenue and receivables.
* Lead and drive audits and IFC testing across the areas of Billing, collections, revenue & customer accounting (including DN/CN), reconciliations, etc.
* Ensure adequate internal controls are implemented and operated effectively across Billing, collections, revenue & customer accounting (including DN/CN), reconciliations, etc.
* Ensure appropriate documentation and controls for customer onboarding, credit approvals, invoicing, collections and write-offs.
* Coordinate with internal and external auditors on AR balances, revenue transactions and customer confirmations.
* Strengthen controls around revenue leakage, unauthorized credit notes, deductions and overdue accounts.
* Ensure timely closure of audit observations and maintenance of accurate supporting documentation.

**Process Improvement & Team Leadership**

* Drive automation and standardization of billing, reconciliation, collection tracking and reporting processes.
* Establish SOPs, performance metrics and escalation frameworks for effective AR management.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual work, improve reconciliation turnaround time and strengthen data accuracy.
* Lead, mentor and develop the AR team, fostering accountability and operational excellence.
* Collaborate with senior finance leadership on workingcapital improvement and finance process transformation.
* Lead the smooth transition from the existing Accounting System to an ERP for the areas of Billing, collections, revenue & customer balances, etc.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Reduction in overdue receivables and improvement in collection efficiency. Believe this would be with the SCM team as this happens from Warehouse.
* Improvement in debt or days and working capital cycle.
* Accuracy and timeliness of revenue recognition and customer invoicing.
* Timely closure of customer reconciliations and settlement discrepancies.
* Reduction in outstanding deductions, disputed invoice sand unresolved claims.
* Timely completion of month-end closing and AR reporting.
* Reduction in bad debt exposure and revenue leakage.
* Compliance with internal controls, statutory requirements and audit timelines.
* Drive efficiency through automation and ensure smooth transition of systems in a timely manner.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* 8–11 years of relevant experience in Finance & Accounts, with substantial experience in Accounts Receivable and revenue accounting.
* CA preferred; candidates with strong relevant experience and other suitable finance qualifications may also be considered.
* Experience in FMCG, consumer goods, retail, e-commerce or other multi-channel business environments.
* Strong understanding of revenue recognition, receivables accounting, collections, credit control and working capital management.
* Experience managing customer reconciliations, marketplace settlements, modern trade claims and channel-specific deductions.
* Sound knowledge of GST, accounting standards and relevant statutory compliance.
* Proficiency in ERP systems and advanced MS Excel; experience with Power BI or other reporting tools is an advantage.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to lead teams, strengthen controls and improve processes in a fast-paced business environment.

title: Risk Consulting - Actuarial - Prophet - Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Role Name And Description - Life Actuarial (Senior),**
EY GDS Consulting Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high-quality services at a competitive cost to support EY’s client-serving and enablement teams worldwide.
  
  
Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with advanced technology and automation capabilities to develop innovative solutions that deliver greater value to our clients. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team! We are looking for a Senior Consultant in our Business Consulting Practice within the Life Actuarial domain.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for Senior Consultants within the Life Actuarial team delivering actuarial solutions and working closely with Senior Manager or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and risk consulting professionals.
  
  
Our clients are large multinationals insurers, conglomerate groups and domestic life insurers within the Life insurance sector. The team delivers sustainable benefits to our clients by enhancing business decisions using improved and effective applications of core actuarial principles and methodologies within applicable standard practice.
  
  
Our growing team of professionals comes from diverse backgrounds, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients. This role will offer exposure to diverse areas comprising assets and liabilities within life actuarial domain.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
As a Senior Consultant, you will:
  
  

* Responsible for delivering high-quality results and generating effective and impactful solutions
* Provide focused guidance and training to Staff members
* Be responsible for ensuring all engagements are delivered within agreed timelines
* Deliver engagements in line with our values and commitment to quality, consistently driving projects to completion and ensuring that work is of a high standard

We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Good analytical skills
* Ability to investigate issues within actuarial models and reporting processes.
* Hands-on experience in actuarial valuation and projections using FIS Prophet will be an added advantage.
* Strong understanding of Prophet model structure, data flows, checking frameworks, and control processes; ability to enhance and optimize existing Prophet models
* Advanced proficiency in MS Excel; working knowledge of VBA is a strong advantage
* Willingness to learn and apply learning actively in project work
* High level of self-motivation and ownership in driving deliverables
* Willingness to travel to meet and work with clients

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Experienced resource – preferably 3-6 years
* Experience in one or more of the following areas: Actuarial reserving, Assumption setting, US GAAP / STAT, FIS Prophet

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Preferred Actuarial Degree
* A strong academic background with a bachelor’s degree in actuarial science, business, finance, or a related field
* Overseas exposure (especially US market experience)
* Understanding of Life/Annuity products under US GAAP/STAT regulations
* Knowledge of FIS Prophet/ Insurance Risk Suite End-to-End (DCS, PP, PE, PRD, IDR and PP APIs) preferred
* AI Literacy – Good knowledge on GenAI, Agentic AI would be an added advantage

**What We Look For**

* Good communication skills
* Fluency in spoken and written English
* Experience of leading/supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building industry relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Lead financial Planning & Analysis
description:
**FP&A Lead (Financial Planning & Analysis)**

**Location:**
Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu

**Experience:**
8–10 Years

**Qualification:**
ICWA / MBA (Finance)

**Company Turnover:**
Approx. ₹3,500 Crores

**Working Days:**
5.5 Days (Alternate Saturdays Off)

**Job Purpose**

The FP&A Lead will be responsible for driving financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, and management reporting. The role will work closely with business and functional leaders to provide financial insights, improve profitability, monitor business performance, and support strategic decision-making.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Financial Planning & Budgeting**

* Lead the annual budgeting and financial planning process.
* Develop annual operating plans, budgets, and periodic forecasts.
* Coordinate with business heads to prepare departmental budgets.
* Monitor actual performance against budgets and identify variances.
* Drive rolling forecasts and financial projections.

**2. Financial Analysis & MIS**

* Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial performance reports.
* Develop management dashboards, MIS reports, and KPI tracking mechanisms.
* Analyse revenue, gross margins, operating expenses, and profitability.
* Provide actionable insights to management for business improvement.
* Track store-wise, region-wise, and business-segment-wise performance.

**3. Business Finance & Decision Support**

* Partner with business and operational teams to evaluate financial performance.
* Conduct financial modelling and scenario analysis for business decisions.
* Support new store expansion and business growth initiatives.
* Evaluate business opportunities, investments, and cost-benefit analysis.
* Provide financial insights to improve operational efficiency and profitability.

**4. Cost Control & Profitability**

* Identify cost optimization opportunities across business functions.
* Monitor operating costs and recommend corrective actions.
* Analyse gross margins, contribution margins, and store-level profitability.
* Drive initiatives to improve EBITDA and overall business profitability.

**5. Strategic Reporting**

* Prepare financial presentations and reports for senior management.
* Support leadership in strategic planning and business reviews.
* Establish financial KPIs and performance monitoring frameworks.
* Ensure accuracy and timeliness of financial information.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong experience in Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A).
* Excellent knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, and financial modelling.
* Strong understanding of P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow, and financial statements.
* Expertise in MIS reporting and management dashboards.
* Advanced MS Excel skills.
* Experience with Power BI and ERP systems will be an added advantage.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and business partnering skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.

**Candidate Profile**

* 8–10 years of relevant experience in FP&A / Financial Planning / Business Finance.
* ICWA / CMA or MBA in Finance.
* Candidates from large-scale retail, consumer electronics, organised retail, telecom, or other multi-location businesses would be preferred.
* Experience in store-level profitability, revenue analysis, budgeting, and forecasting will be an advantage.

title: Assistant Executive- Finance
description:
**About Cloud Shoes LLP (Walkaroo Group)**

Cloud Shoes LLP, part of the Walkaroo Group, operates a growing footwear business across major e-commerce marketplaces, direct-to-consumer channels, online B2B platforms, retail stores, and large-format retail. We are seeking a capable and detail-oriented professional to take ownership of day-to-day finance and accounting functions and ensure strong financial controls.

* **Location:**
  Malumichampatty, Coimbatore
* **Experience:**
  1–3 Years
* **Qualification:**
  CA/CMA Inter or CMA Final qualified

**Role Overview**

This hands-on position is responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, ensuring timely statutory compliance, coordinating audits, overseeing payments and reconciliations, monitoring working capital, and delivering reliable financial reports to management.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Accounting & Financial Control:**
  Ensure correct transaction recording, oversee ledger scrutiny, reconciliations, journal entries, provisions, month-end book closings, and internal controls.

* **Taxation & Compliance:**
  Independently manage GST compliance (filings, returns, reconciliations), TDS deductions and returns, statutory obligations, and audit coordination.

* **Payables & Receivables:**
  Manage scheduled payment plans, verify vendor invoices and expenses, track customer receivables and supplier payables with ageing analysis, and review financial reconciliations.

* **Cash Flow & Working Capital:**
  Monitor cash/bank balances, prepare short-term cash-flow forecasts, track working capital and inventory values, and flag prospective funding gaps.

* **Financial Reporting & MIS:**
  Deliver actionable weekly reports (cash-flow, working-capital, ageing, issue tracking) and monthly reports (P&L, budget variance, channel profitability, tax/audit status) for leadership.

* **Process Improvement:**
  Standardize accounting processes, utilize Excel and automation to reduce errors, and support e-commerce settlement reconciliations.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* **Essential:**
  CMA Inter or qualified (1–3 years of relevant practical experience preferred); strong knowledge of GST, TDS, and statutory compliance; practical exposure to audit coordination; advanced Microsoft Excel skills and financial MIS reporting capability.

* **Preferred:**
  Experience in maintaining/finalizing books of accounts, bank/vendor/customer reconciliations, cash-flow monitoring, working knowledge of Zoho Books (or similar software), and background in an in-house finance department or CA/audit firm.

* **Attributes:**
  High integrity, attention to detail, proactive problem ownership, effective communication, and a strong interest in a stable, long-term role.

**What We Offer**

* Meaningful ownership of finance operations within a growing business.
* Direct interaction with business leadership.
* Exposure to e-commerce, retail, and B2B financial operations.
* Scope to improve financial processes, reporting systems, and automation.

description:

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of legal concepts and workflows, along with practical experience in using AI tools, prompt engineering, and working closely with technical teams to develop and improve AI-driven legal solutions.

This role will act as a bridge between the legal domain and technology teams, helping developers understand legal requirements, testing AI-generated legal outputs, refining prompts, and ensuring that the AI solutions deliver accurate, relevant, and legally meaningful results.

* Participate in developing AI-driven legal products and features.
* Assist in identifying opportunities to automate repetitive legal processes.
* Suggest improvements in existing legal workflows through AI and automation.

* Contribute towards making AI-powered legal solutions more reliable, practical, and user-friendly.

* Bachelor's degree in Law (LL.B.) is mandatory.
* 1–2 years of relevant professional experience in LegalTech, AI-driven legal solutions, legal automation, or prompt engineering.
* Practical experience working with AI tools and LLM-based platforms.
* Understanding of prompt engineering and the ability to create and optimise prompts for legal applications.
* Strong knowledge of contracts, legal documentation, clauses, and legal workflows.

* Exposure to AI-powered contract review, legal research, document automation, or CLM platforms.

* Basic understanding of APIs, AI workflows, and how LLM-based applications function.

title: Senior Associate - PE Ecosystem & Policy
company: Indian Venture and Alternate Capital Association (IVCA)
description:
**About IVCA**

Established in 1993, the Indian Venture and Alternate Capital Association (IVCA) is the apex industry body for alternative asset investors investing in India. Our 500+ members include leading international and domestic private equity funds, private credit, infrastructure and real estate funds, Limited Partners and family offices, together managing an aggregate AUM of over $350 billion.

IVCA advocates for a stronger investment environment in India through regulatory engagement, research and constructive dialogue with the Government of India, policymakers and regulators.

About the role

We are building out our Private Equity function in Mumbai and are looking for someone who sits at the intersection of member engagement and policy. You will own relationships with some of the largest PE funds in the country, and work hand-in-hand with IVCA's policy and regulatory team to turn what members need into well-argued positions before government and regulators.

This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role. You will be a trusted point of contact for senior fund leadership, represent IVCA in regulatory conversations, and drive the flagship initiatives, councils and research that shape India's PE ecosystem.

**Key responsibilities**

**1. Member relationships and portfolio ownership**

* Own a portfolio of key member firms as their primary point of contact, building trusted relationships with senior fund leadership.
* Run proactive engagement plans for each account, spot cross-engagement opportunities and drive member retention.
* Respond to member queries with timely, accurate information and keep members informed of regulatory and market developments that affect them.

**2. Policy and regulatory engagement**

* Work in tandem with IVCA's policy and regulatory team on issues affecting PE funds, from fund structuring to taxation, AIF regulations, foreign investment rules among others.
* Gather and consolidate member input into policy submissions, representations, briefing notes and position papers.
* Build relationships with government bodies and regulators such as SEBI, RBI, IFSCA, the Ministry of Finance and CBDT, DPIIT, IRDAI, PFRDA and EPFO, and represent IVCA in meetings and working groups.
* Track regulatory consultations and circulars, and translate their impact into clear, practical updates for members.

**3. Councils and special interest groups**

* Manage IVCA's PE-focused councils and special interest groups across buyouts, growth, private credit, infrastructure and real estate.
* Coordinate meetings and calls, gather member input and turn council priorities into action, such as toolkits, policy notes and industry recommendations.

**4. Flagship initiatives and events**

* Own end-to-end planning and execution of PE initiatives, including IVCA flagship conferences, closed-door roundtables, webinars and member meetings.
* Lead agenda design, speaker curation, delegate management, vendor relations and post-event documentation.
* Grow these initiatives into recurring, scalable annual properties.

**5. Research, content and thought leadership**

* Assist with PE research deliverables, owning scope, data collection and coordination with research team and knowledge partners.
* Prepare reports, presentations and strategic briefs for IVCA leadership, councils and members on sector activity, deal and exit trends, and the regulatory outlook.
* Develop content and promotional materials for events and initiatives.

**6. Business development and partnerships**

* Build the membership pipeline and onboard new member firms.
* Develop sponsorship proposals and partnerships with consultants, law firms, knowledge partners and institutions for joint initiatives.

**What we are looking for**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Law, Public Policy or a related field.
* Relevant experience in private equity, investment banking, consulting, financial regulation or policy, a law firm's funds practice, or an industry body.
* Fluent understanding of how PE funds operate across the fund lifecycle, and of the wider PE ecosystem: sector activity, deal and exit trends, LP dynamics.
* Working knowledge of India's regulatory landscape for alternative investment funds, such as SEBI's AIF Regulations, FEMA and foreign investment rules, and fund taxation. Experience drafting policy submissions or regulatory notes is a strong plus.
* Demonstrated experience managing senior stakeholders, whether fund leadership, government officials or institutional partners.
* A true people's person who enjoys building long-term relationships with prominent public and private stakeholders.
* Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to turn complex regulatory issues into crisp, persuasive writing.
* Strong research and analytical skills, and proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and Google Workspace.
* Self-driven and proactive, able to own initiatives end-to-end independently and as part of a team, and to balance multiple projects at once.

**Note**

* This is a non-investment role. IVCA is an industry body representing the alternate capital industry and does not make any direct or indirect investments.
* IVCA is a neutral body focused on policy advocacy, research, market development and member engagement. It does not provide advisory or consulting services, and is not involved in transaction execution, investment decisions, M&A deal making or any form of investment intermediation.
* The role may require occasional travel and flexible working hours to accommodate meetings and events.
* The position is based in BKC, Mumbai, Maharashtra, India.

title: Analyst - Taxation
description:
**Role — Analyst, Tax | Direct Tax & Compliance Specialist**

**Role Tagline:**

Building the foundation of flawless direct tax compliance and sharpening litigation instincts as a ‘forward-deployed executor’ — where every filing is precise, every submission is persuasive, and every deadline is a commitment.

**Role Description:**

You’re not here to be a passive number-cruncher. You’re here to operate as a hands-on, detail-obsessed contributor who anchors Searce’s direct tax function with rigor and reliability.

This role sits at the intersection of compliance execution, litigation support, and tax advisory — and it demands someone who takes genuine ownership of their work. You’ll work closely with senior tax leadership to manage direct tax compliances end-to-end, support ongoing litigations, and research evolving tax positions with precision.

You bring 1–3 years of direct tax experience, a strong grasp of domestic tax law, and a restless curiosity for finding answers that go beyond the surface. A Chartered Accountancy qualification is not mandatory — what matters is your depth of direct tax knowledge, your attention to detail, and your drive to grow into a well-rounded tax professional.

If you’re someone who believes in solving first, escalating second — and treats every notice, filing, and advisory memo as an opportunity to add value — this role is built for you.

**Responsibilities:**

A. Compliance Execution

* Support end-to-end direct tax compliances for the India region — including advance tax computations, TDS compliance, Form 26AS reconciliations, and income tax return filings.
* Ensure all filing deadlines are tracked and met with zero-defect accuracy.
* Maintain and organize all compliance records, documentation, and statutory filings in a structured, audit-ready manner.
* Assist in preparing and reviewing computations of taxable income across business units.

B. Litigation & Assessment Support

* Assist in managing tax assessments, scrutiny proceedings, and notices received from income tax authorities.
* Support the drafting of replies to notices, submissions, and appeals to be filed before the CIT(A) and ITAT.
* Collate supporting documents, coordinate with internal teams, and maintain a tracker for all ongoing litigation matters.
* Research relevant case laws, judicial precedents, and CBDT circulars to strengthen submissions.

C. Tax Advisory & Research

* Conduct focused research on domestic tax issues — including TDS applicability, deductions, exemptions, and withholding tax obligations.
* Assist in preparing advisory memos and internal notes on tax implications of proposed transactions or business decisions.
* Stay updated on changes to the Income Tax Act, Finance Act amendments, CBDT notifications, and relevant judicial developments.
* Support leadership in responding to ad hoc tax queries raised by business and finance teams.

**Functional Skills:**

* Compliance Executor: Tracks every deadline, filing, and document with methodical precision — ensuring nothing slips through the cracks.
* Research-First Thinker: Digs deep into tax law, case precedents, and regulatory updates to build well-substantiated positions.
* Litigation Contributor: Assists in drafting clear, structured submissions and is comfortable working through the procedural mechanics of assessment proceedings.
* Advisory Support: Translates technical tax concepts into clear, business-relevant language for internal stakeholders.
* Process-Conscious Operator: Proactively spots inefficiencies in compliance workflows and contributes to building cleaner, faster processes.

**Skills:**

Direct Tax · Income Tax Compliance · TDS Management · Tax Litigation Support · Tax Research · Assessment & Notice Management · Tax Advisory · Attention to Detail · Analytical Thinking

**Tech Superpowers:**

* Data-Fluent Executor: Comfortable working with tax portals, financial data, and compliance software to extract, reconcile, and validate information accurately.
* Research-Enabled: Proficient in using legal and tax databases (Taxmann, Taxsutra, SCC Online) to find relevant judgments, circulars, and legislative updates.
* Documentation Disciplinarian: Maintains clean, structured records of all filings and litigation documents — audit-ready at all times.

**Experience & Relevance:**

* Tax Foundation: 1–3 years of hands-on direct tax experience in a corporate tax function, CA firm, or consulting environment. CA qualification is not mandatory — candidates with B.Com, M.Com, MBA Finance, or LLB and strong direct tax exposure are encouraged to apply.
* Compliance Track Record: Demonstrated experience managing or supporting direct tax compliances — including ITR filing, advance tax, and TDS.
* Litigation Exposure: Prior involvement in assessment proceedings, drafting replies to notices, or litigation support is a strong advantage.
* Research Orientation: Proven ability to independently research tax issues and articulate positions with reference to law and precedents.

**Bonus Points:**

* Ownership Instinct: Takes full accountability for assigned tasks — follows through without reminders, flags blockers early, delivers on commitments.
* Curiosity-Driven: Doesn’t stop at the first answer — digs deeper, looks for alternative interpretations, proactively highlights risks or opportunities.
* Growth Mindset: Actively seeks to upskill, stays updated on tax law developments, contributes ideas to improve team workflows.

*You default to solve, not wait; deliver, not defer; grow through doing — and you treat every compliance and litigation matter as an opportunity to build expertise that compounds over time.*

**Location:**
Pune

**Experience:**
1–3 years

**Qualification:**
B.Com / M.Com / MBA Finance / LLB / CA (preferred but not mandatory)

You are a proactive, indispensable partner to Searce's leadership, deeply embedded in our financial and operational strategy. This isn't just about filing returns or managing audits; it’s about being a
**'Tax Strategist'**
who preempts risks, optimizes tax structures, and acts as a force multiplier for Searce's financial health and growth.

You'll be a
**Directly Responsible Individual (DRI)**
for orchestrating all direct & indirect tax activities for the India region. You will ensure meticulous compliance, manage complex litigations, and serve as a critical advisor, enabling Searce to navigate the intricate tax landscape with confidence and efficiency.

Let’s be clear: this role demands more than just technical knowledge. It requires a keen business acumen, an analytical mindset to identify opportunities, and the proactive drive to implement value-generating tax strategies. You'll solve challenges before they arise, operate with a "process-first" mindset, and contribute directly to our ability to "solve differently" for our clients and our organization.

If you’re a meticulously organized, analytical professional with a strategic brain, an unwavering commitment to compliance, and the ability to amplify financial impact — you’re exactly who we’re looking for.

You're not just a tax manager; you're a
**'Compliance Architect.'**

* Take accountability for tax outflow, implementing strategies for estimation, forecasting, and optimization to align with business goals.
* Research and recommend tax-efficient structures, including restructuring, and advise on cross-border transactions and overseas operations.
* Identify tax savings and proactively suggest ways to increase profitability while maintaining compliance.

(B) Compliance & Litigation Management:

* Own and oversee all litigations, assessments, and notices, drafting appeals and submissions to be filed before various tax authorities.

* Provide expert advice and strategic guidance to leadership on new and existing tax laws, ensuring all business decisions are tax-efficient and compliant.

**Functional Skills:**

Manages all regulatory filings and deadlines with meticulous attention to detail, ensuring zero-defect execution.

**Direct Tax, Indirect Tax**
, Transfer Pricing, Tax Litigation, Tax Advisory, Tax Planning, FEMA, Companies Act, Financial Management, Team Leadership, Analytical Skills, Attention to Detail.

Proficiently uses financial and tax software to extract, analyze, and synthesize large datasets for strategic tax planning and compliance.

The role owns end-to-end execution and advisory support on Indian labour law compliance, payroll inputs, employee lifecycle management, and system/process improvements, acting as an individual contributor working closely with HRBPs, Global Payroll, Legal, and business stakeholders.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Payroll Input Management: Own end-to-end payroll input accuracy and timeliness (new joiners, exits, salary changes, LOP, arrears, full & final settlements) in coordination with the Global Payroll team ensuring compliance with local laws, and resolving any payroll discrepancies in collaboration with Global Payroll team.

+ Support POSH Act (2013) compliance — Internal Committee (IC) coordination, quarterly/annual reporting, case management support, and mandatory awareness training.

title: Chief Compliance Officer (Stock Broking)
description:
**Role Overview:**

Univest is seeking a highly experienced Chief Compliance Officer (CCO) to lead regulatory governance, statutory compliance, risk controls, and regulatory relations across all its entities: Univest, Univest Broking, and Univest Research.

You're expected to build and scale a robust risk and compliance framework, ensuring our business growth fully aligns with SEBI guidelines, Advisory regulation, Stock Exchange (NSE/BSE) regulations, DP regulations (NSDL/CDSL), RBI, and RBI/Fintech data governance laws.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Enterprise Compliance & Governance:**

- Build, execute, and continuously upgrade the group-wide compliance policy architecture covering stockbroking, research advisory, investment products, and tech platforms.

- Act as the designated compliance lead and primary liaison for SEBI, NSE, BSE, MCX, CDSL/NSDL, AMFI, and other regulatory authorities.

- Oversee statutory filings, periodic audits, regulatory reporting, inspections, and formal responses to regulatory show-cause notices or inquiries.

**2. Entity-Specific Regulatory Management:**

-
**Univest Broking:**

Ensure full compliance with SEBI Broking Regulations, Exchange Business Rules, Authorised Person (AP) norms, client code modifications, KYC/AML norms, edge risk management, margin trading facilities (MTF), and client funds segregation.

-
**UniResearch:**

Establish strict Chinese Walls and supervisory controls around research analyst operations, investment advice, SEBI (RA) regulations, disclosure frameworks, model portfolios, and marketing communications.

-
**Platform:**

Guide product and engineering teams on regulatory-by-design principles, digital onboarding journeys, e-KYC, customer consent frameworks, and data protection laws (DPDP Act).

**3. Operational Control & Internal Audits:**

- Design and execute Annual/ Biannual/ Quarterly internal compliance audit programs across broking, research, and platform operations.

- Monitor sales, product communications, ad copy, partner promotion materials, and social media content to ensure strict compliance with SEBI advertising codes and anti-fraud guidelines.

- Establish internal fraud detection mechanisms, anti-money laundering (AML) / CFT surveillance systems, and insider trading prevention frameworks (PIT Regulations).

**4. Regulatory Strategy & Product Consultation:**

- Partner closely with Product, Tech, Business Development, and Marketing teams to evaluate new product launches, features, algorithms, and revenue models from a regulatory standpoint.

- Proactively track regulatory changes, issue impact assessments to senior leadership, and adapt business workflows to stay ahead of regulatory updates.

**5. Board & Stakeholder Reporting:**

- Present quarterly compliance updates, audit findings, regulatory risk matrices, and remediation roadmaps to the Board of Directors and Audit Committee.

- Instill a company-wide culture of regulatory integrity, customer protection, and legal accountability.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):**

- 100% On-Time Regulatory Filings: Zero default or penalty on SEBI, Exchange, and Depository statutory submissions.

- Audit & Inspection Outcomes: Clean regulatory inspection records with minimal/zero adverse observations or penalties.

- Product Launch Speed & Compliance: Rapid regulatory clearance and legal architecture for new product features.

- Partner & AP Network Oversight: Zero non-compliance breaches across the Authorised Person (AP) and distributor network.

- Issue Resolution: Resolution turnaround time (TAT) for regulatory notices, customer grievances, and audit recommendations.

**Ideal Candidate Profile:**

- Experience: 15 - 20 years of core compliance experience in stockbroking, SEBI registered entities (RA/RIA/DP), wealth management, or fintech.

- Regulatory Expertise: In-depth knowledge of SEBI (Stock Brokers) Regulations, SEBI (Research Analysts) Regulations, Prohibition of Insider Trading (PIT), Prohibition of Fraudulent and Unfair Trade Practices (PFUTP), and Exchange Bye-laws.

- Qualifications: Qualified Company Secretary (CS), LL.B / Master of Laws, or CA/MBA Finance with specialized compliance certifications (e.g., NISM Series III-A, NISM Series VIII).

title: Payroll and Statutory Compliance
description:
**Location:**
Gurugram (Udyog Vihar)

**Experience:**
7–10 Years

**Working Days:**
6 Days a Week

**Work Mode:**
Work From Office

**Reporting To:**
Head – Human Resources

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Payroll & Compliance professional to independently manage end-to-end payroll operations, statutory compliances and labour law requirements. The incumbent will ensure accurate payroll processing, timely statutory filings, regulatory compliance and effective coordination with HR, Finance and external consultants.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. End-to-End Payroll Management**

* Manage monthly payroll, salary calculations, incentives, deductions, arrears and reimbursements.
* Ensure accurate attendance, leave, LOP and payroll inputs.
* Handle full & final settlements, employee tax calculations and payroll reconciliation.
* Coordinate with Finance for timely salary disbursement.

**2. Statutory & Labour Law Compliance**

* Manage PF, ESI, Professional Tax, LWF, TDS, gratuity, bonus and other applicable compliances.
* Ensure timely statutory deposits, returns, filings and reconciliations.
* Maintain statutory registers, records and documentation.
* Ensure compliance with applicable central and state labour laws.

**3. Payroll Systems & Process Management**

* Manage payroll through HRMS/payroll platforms, preferably HR One.
* Ensure accurate employee master data and payroll configurations.
* Establish payroll SOPs, internal controls and approval mechanisms.
* Drive payroll automation and process improvements.

**4. Audit & Stakeholder Management**

* Coordinate internal, statutory and labour law audits.
* Handle statutory notices, inspections and queries.
* Liaise with auditors, consultants and government authorities.
* Resolve employee queries relating to salary, PF, deductions and taxation.

**5. MIS & Reporting**

* Prepare monthly payroll, employee cost and statutory compliance reports.
* Maintain entity-wise payroll records and compliance dashboards.
* Track statutory deadlines and report compliance status to management.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* MBA / PGDM in Finance or HR, M.Com or equivalent qualification.
* 7–10 years of hands-on experience in payroll and statutory compliance.
* Strong knowledge of Indian labour laws and statutory requirements.
* Practical expertise in PF, ESI, PT, LWF, TDS, gratuity and payroll taxation.
* Experience managing large employee populations and multiple entities.
* Proficiency in Excel and HRMS/payroll software, preferably HR One.
* Strong analytical, reconciliation and stakeholder management skills.

title: Managing Associate
description:
**About Us**

We are a professional legal organisation handling assignments across multiple areas of law. We are looking for a seasoned legal professional who can contribute to the firm's legal practice through independent matter management, team leadership and consistent execution.

**Job Overview**

We are seeking a highly experienced, committed and result-oriented Managing Associate to lead legal assignments, manage client engagements and drive team performance.

The candidate must possess substantial legal experience, excellent professional judgment and the ability to independently manage complex matters with minimal supervision. They should be well experienced and able in independent drafting and must possess a higher level of intellect.

This is a hands-on leadership position. We are looking for someone who can lead teams while remaining actively involved in the execution and delivery of legal work.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Legal Management & Independent Execution**

* Independently manage complex legal assignments and client engagements.
* Provide strategic legal advice, opinions and practical solutions.
* Lead legal research, drafting, vetting and review of complex documentation.
* Manage litigation, advisory and transactional matters across multiple practice areas.
* Take complete ownership of assigned matters from inception to completion.
* Ensure quality, accuracy and timely delivery of all assignments.

**Team Leadership & Management**

* Lead, supervise and mentor associates and junior legal professionals.
* Allocate assignments and monitor individual and team performance.
* Review legal work and maintain consistent quality standards.
* Provide guidance, feedback and professional development support.
* Promote accountability, teamwork and a performance-driven work culture.

**Client & Stakeholder Management**

* Independently manage client relationships and professional engagements.
* Participate in client meetings, conferences and strategic discussions.
* Coordinate with partners, clients, counsels and other stakeholders.
* Proactively communicate matter progress, challenges and deliverables.

**Operational Accountability**

* Ensure effective management of deadlines and priorities.
* Identify potential challenges and implement practical solutions.
* Monitor the overall progress and quality of legal assignments.
* Maintain discipline, efficiency and professional standards across the team.

**Eligibility & Skills**

* LL.B. from a reputed / premier law institution.
* Minimum 10 years of relevant post-qualification experience.
* Strong legal expertise and demonstrated independent matter management.
* Excellent drafting, research and analytical capabilities.
* Proven leadership and team management experience.
* Strong client management and communication skills.
* Excellent command of written and spoken English.
* Ability to manage multiple complex assignments simultaneously.
* High levels of ownership, integrity and professional accountability.

**What We Expect**

* A strong work ethic and willingness to work hard to achieve results.
* Independent execution rather than dependence on constant supervision.
* Ability to lead by example and work collaboratively.
* Complete ownership of assignments and team deliverables.
* A proactive, solution-oriented and performance-driven approach.

**Our Ideal Candidate:** An experienced legal professional who combines legal expertise with leadership, independent execution and a strong sense of responsibility.

Pay: ₹125,000.00 - ₹175,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* How many years of post-qualification experience do you have?
* Have you independently managed complex legal matters?
* Have you led and supervised a team of legal professionals?
* Have you independently managed client relationships?
* Which practice areas do you have substantial experience in?
* Are you comfortable with a hands-on role involving both execution and team leadership?

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Manager/AVP - Contract & Litigation, Legal
description:
**Job Title**

Senior Manager/AVP - Contract & Litigation, Legal

**Job Description Summary**

**Job Description**

**ABOUT CUSHMAN & WAKEFIELD:** Cushman & Wakefield (NYSE: CWK) is a leading global real estate services firm that delivers exceptional value for real estate occupiers and owners.

**OUR PURPOSE:** We make an impact. Our work creates meaningful value for our clients, our business, our shareholders, our people, our communities and world.

**Role Overview**

Reporting to the Head of Legal – India, you will serve as a senior individual contributor and embedded legal partner within the India legal function, providing practical, commercially minded legal advice to C&W’s service lines and corporate functions in India. The role covers commercial contracts, litigation and disputes, corporate governance, regulatory compliance, and employment-related matters, working in collaboration with the broader Legal, Risk and Compliance function across APAC.

In the near term, the role will carry a hands-on workload, including day-to-day contract and dispute management. It is also designed with the future in mind: as the India legal function evolves towards a more embedded, business-aligned model supported by centralised teams, standard playbooks and technology, we expect the role to move progressively towards complex, business-critical and judgement-intensive work. The role is suited to an experienced in-house or law firm lawyer who can independently manage a varied workload in a fast-paced, matrixed environment, build credibility with senior business stakeholders, and help shape how legal supports the business over time. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Strategic business partnering:** Act as a trusted legal adviser and primary point of contact for assigned service lines and corporate functions in India. Build working knowledge of the business’s structure, key people, revenue drivers and operating risks; join business leadership discussions where appropriate; and translate business objectives into clear, practical and risk-aware recommendations, so that Legal is consulted early rather than after the fact.
* **Commercial contracts:** Independently draft, review, negotiate and finalise commercial contracts, including project management agreements, design and build agreements, maintenance contracts, property management contracts, consultancy agreements, valuation contracts, legal notices, MOUs / LOIs, NDAs, lease deeds, and other client or vendor agreements, applying approved templates, playbooks and escalation triggers. Provide structured advice to the Head of Legal – India on non-standard, high-value, precedent-setting or high-risk agreements, including deal structure, unusual terms, indemnity and liability positions, and regulatory considerations.
* **Disputes and litigation:** Manage disputes and litigation matters in India on a day-to-day basis, working with external counsel and internal business teams. Act as the business liaison for gathering facts, coordinating witnesses and managing document and data requests; flag new claims and disputes early; and keep the Head of Legal – India informed of key developments, risk exposure and reporting requirements.
* **Risk identification, escalation and governance:** Identify legal and regulatory risk within the supported businesses and escalate it to the Head of Legal – India and, where appropriate, the wider APAC Legal, Risk and Compliance function, with context and a recommended course of action. Advise business leaders on the practical application of company policy, delegation of authority and approval protocols, and support internal audits, investigations and compliance reviews.
* **Regulatory and legal developments:** Research and keep current on laws, regulations and court decisions affecting the real estate industry and real estate service providers in India, and advise on their applicability and impact on C&W.
* **Governance, compliance and employment:** Support corporate governance, regulatory compliance and employment-related legal matters, coordinating with business verticals, support functions, operations and site teams to respond to claims, regulatory queries and other legal requirements.
* **External counsel:** Work with external law firms and counsel, supporting effective management of the quality, timelines and cost of external legal spend on assigned matters.
* **Process and collaboration:** Collaborate with the Head of Legal – India and the broader Legal, Risk and Compliance function across APAC to implement firm policies and processes in India. Contribute to improving contracting processes, templates, playbooks, escalation triggers and matrix working protocols, leveraging technology where appropriate.
* **Corporate support, training and other duties:** Support corporate and transactional matters in India as required, including providing business context, personnel insight and due diligence support on M&A transactions and flagging region- or business-specific risks early (transaction leadership remains with the relevant corporate / M&A team). Share knowledge through targeted training and awareness sessions tailored to the businesses supported, and perform other related legal duties as assigned.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Business stakeholders consult Legal proactively on emerging issues, and value the timeliness, accuracy and practicality of the advice they receive.
* Quality and turnaround of contract drafting, review and negotiation, with appropriate and well-framed escalation of non-standard or high-risk issues.
* Effective management of assigned litigation and disputes, with accurate and up-to-date trackers and timely reporting to the Head of Legal – India.
* Legal and regulatory risks in supported businesses are identified, escalated and mitigated early, before they become claims, losses or regulatory exposure.
* Effective coordination of external counsel, including quality, timelines and cost discipline on assigned matters.
* Adherence to legal policies, processes and compliance requirements, and awareness of regulatory changes affecting the business.
* Contribution to templates, playbooks, process improvement, training and legal knowledge management initiatives.
* Effective working across the Legal, Risk and Compliance matrix, including growing capacity to take on higher-value, judgement-intensive work over time.

**Candidate Profile**

**Experience**

10 plus years’ post-qualification experience in commercial legal practice, gained through an in-house legal role (ideally in real estate, professional services or a similarly complex multinational environment) or with a reputed law firm. Proven experience in commercial contracts and in managing litigation matters, with exposure to real estate services, project and development services, facilities management, or corporate and regulatory work, would be an advantage. Experience of working in a matrixed organisation, balancing the needs of multiple businesses and stakeholders, is also valued.

**Skills**

* Strong contract drafting, review and negotiation skills.
* Fluent in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong analytical, legal research and technical legal skills, with sound working knowledge of Indian corporate, commercial and regulatory law.
* Sound commercial judgement, with the ability to work independently, distinguish routine issues from business-critical ones that need senior attention, and escalate key risks appropriately to the Head of Legal – India.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to understand business requirements and advise senior managers and business leaders in a clear, practical and confident manner.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and time-sensitive deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Good organisational and coordination skills, including working effectively with external advisers.
* Collaborative approach and ability to work with cross-functional teams, operating effectively in a matrixed environment and alongside legal colleagues across APAC.
* A proactive, business-embedded mindset: anticipates issues, builds trusted relationships and is consulted early.
* Adaptable and improvement-minded, comfortable with change and keen to use templates, playbooks and technology to work more efficiently as the function evolves.

**Education**

* Law degree from an accredited university.

**Why Join Us**

As one of the leading global real estate services firms, Cushman & Wakefield offers experienced legal professionals the opportunity to take ownership of meaningful work, collaborate with senior stakeholders across India and APAC, and contribute to a growing business in India.

* Opportunity to broaden in-house legal experience in a leading real estate services business.
* Exposure to commercial contracts, litigation management, compliance support and cross-functional stakeholder engagement.
* Opportunity to help shape the India legal function as it moves towards a more embedded, business-aligned model, with a path to take on more complex, strategic work.
* Opportunity to work closely with the Head of Legal – India and the broader APAC Legal, Risk and Compliance function.
* Role that supports meaningful business and operational outcomes.
* Career development in a culture that encourages internal growth.
* An organisation committed to diversity and inclusion.

title: company secratory
description:
Job Description – Company Secretary (IPO Preparation & Compliance)

**Company:**
SI Surgical Pvt. Ltd.

**Location:**
Kolkata, West Bengal

**Experience:**
2–3 Years

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Department:**
Legal, Compliance & Corporate Affairs

About the Company

SI Surgical Pvt. Ltd., part of the SI Surgical Group based in Kolkata, specializes in modular operation theatre solutions, hospital infrastructure, and advanced medical equipment.

The group has nearly a decade of experience in innovation, technology, manufacturing, and marketing of hospital furniture and medical equipment, serving hospitals and healthcare institutions across India and international markets.

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Company Secretary with 2–3 years of experience to manage corporate compliance, statutory filings, corporate governance, and IPO preparation activities.

The candidate will play an important role in organizing and preparing company records, financial and statutory information, corporate documentation, and due diligence data required for the company's proposed IPO.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Company Secretarial & Statutory Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with the Companies Act, 2013, and applicable corporate laws.
* Handle ROC/MCA filings, including AOC-4, MGT-7/MGT-7A, DIR-12 and other applicable forms.
* Maintain statutory registers, minutes books, and corporate records.
* Organize Board Meetings, Annual General Meetings (AGMs), and other corporate meetings.
* Prepare notices, agendas, resolutions, and minutes of meetings.
* Manage director-related compliances, shareholding records, and corporate documentation.
* Ensure timely completion of statutory and regulatory filings.

**2. IPO Preparation & Documentation**

* Assist management in preparing the company for its proposed IPO.
* Compile, organize, and maintain all data and documents required for IPO preparation.
* Prepare corporate records, statutory information, shareholding details, and capital structure documentation.
* Coordinate with Merchant Bankers, Chartered Accountants, legal advisors, auditors, and other IPO consultants.
* Assist in preparing information and supporting documents for the Draft Red Herring Prospectus (DRHP).
* Coordinate the collection and verification of financial, legal, operational, and corporate information required for due diligence.
* Identify gaps in statutory records and corporate compliance and coordinate their rectification.
* Maintain proper documentation and records for IPO-related due diligence.

**3. Corporate Governance & Legal Compliance**

* Monitor changes in Companies Act, SEBI regulations, and other applicable corporate laws.
* Coordinate with statutory auditors, internal auditors, legal advisors, and regulatory authorities.
* Ensure proper corporate governance practices and documentation.
* Support management in implementing compliance policies and procedures.

Educational Qualifications

* Qualified Company Secretary (CS) from the Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI).
* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Law, or a related field will be preferred.

Experience & Skills Required

* 2–3 years of relevant experience in a Company Secretarial role.
* Strong knowledge of Companies Act, 2013, ROC/MCA filings, and statutory compliance.
* Hands-on experience with the MCA portal.
* Good knowledge of corporate governance and secretarial documentation.
* Strong MS Excel and MS Office skills.
* Excellent documentation, analytical, coordination, and communication skills.

Preferred Experience

* Practical exposure to IPO preparation and IPO readiness activities.
* Experience in compiling and preparing IPO-related data and documentation.
* Knowledge of SME IPO and Main Board IPO processes.
* Familiarity with DRHP preparation and due diligence requirements.
* Experience coordinating with Merchant Bankers, CAs, auditors, and legal consultants.
* Knowledge of SEBI regulations and stock exchange listing requirements.

**Preference will be given to candidates who have hands-on experience in IPO preparation, data compilation, due diligence, and DRHP-related documentation.**

Job Location

Kolkata, West Bengal.

How to Apply

Interested candidates may share their updated CV mentioning their Company Secretary qualification, relevant work experience, and exposure to IPO preparation.

**Job Title for Recruitment Portals:**
Company Secretary – IPO Preparation & Compliance (2–3 Years Experience) | Kolkata

title: Senior Associate
description:
**About Aurtus Consulting LLP**

Aurtus is a full-service tax, transaction and regulatory advisory firm that provides practical, well-researched solutions to complex tax, transaction, and regulatory challenges for Indian and multinational clients. The firm combines deep technical expertise with a commercially focused, risk-balanced approach.

With a team of 75+ professionals across offices in Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Ahmedabad and GIFT City, Aurtus delivers partner-led, hands-on advice along with end-to-end implementation support. Its professionals include Chartered Accountants and law graduates, many with prior large firm experience, enabling the firm to offer specialised and bespoke solutions.

Aurtus serves a diverse client base comprising corporates, multinational companies, private equity and venture capital funds, start-ups, family offices, and high-net-worth individuals. Its core practice areas include corporate and international tax, indirect tax, transaction advisory, transfer pricing, financial services, dispute resolution, and regulatory matters. One of Aurtus’ unique offerings is advising reputed families in succession planning, family arrangements, GIFT city structures, overseas migration, etc.

The firm has been recognised as the
**“Best Newcomer Tax Firm in Asia”**
by
**International Tax Review**
& it’s Founder & CEO, Mr. Vishal Gada, regularly features in the International Tax Review (ITR) list of top tax advisors in India. Reflecting our strong people-centric culture, Aurtus has recently been certified as a
**Great Place To Work®**
.

**Job Title:**
Senior Associate

**Department:**
Indirect Taxes

**Role Overview**

* The Indirect Tax practice at Aurtus advises corporates, MNCs, PE/VC-backed businesses, family offices, and high-net-worth individuals on the full spectrum of GST, Customs, and Foreign Trade Policy matters.
* The Senior Associate will work closely with Partners and Directors on advisory, compliance, litigation, and due diligence engagements across diverse sectors.
* This role offers meaningful client-facing exposure and the opportunity to take ownership of deliverables in a partner-led, entrepreneurial environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Advising clients on GST structuring, ITC optimisation, and various other aspects of indirect taxes across sectors, including manufacturing, services, real estate, infrastructure, and e-commerce
* Drafting opinions, advisory notes, and client-ready deliverables on complex indirect tax matters
* Handling GST compliances, including monthly/quarterly returns, annual returns (GSTR-9/9C), reconciliations, and ITC analysis
* Drafting and assisting in litigation, which includes replies to show cause notices, appeals, written submissions, and personal hearings before GST/Customs authorities and appellate forums
* Assisting in GST/indirect tax due diligence and health checks for M&A transactions
* Research and tracking of legislative changes, rulings, circulars, and judicial precedents relevant to client mandates
* Assisting with refund applications and advance ruling matters
* Representing or assisting in representation before GST/Customs authorities

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Must be a Chartered Accountant
* 0 to 4 years of post-qualification experience in Indirect Taxes (GST/Customs/FTP), preferably in a professional services firm or Big 4

**What We Offer**

* Work on marquee advisory, compliance and litigation mandates across diverse sectors.
* Collaborative, learning-focused environment with mentorship from experienced professionals.
* Strong career progression in a fast-growing advisory platform.
* Competitive compensation and performance-linked growth.

**Ideal Candidate Traits**

* In-depth knowledge of GST law and procedures; familiarity with Customs/FTP is a plus
* Research-driven mindset with strong attention to detail.
* Ability to draft clear, well-structured opinions and client communications
* High sense of ownership, responsiveness, and ability to thrive in fast-paced client engagements.
* Team player with strong communication skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office (especially Excel); familiarity with GST portal, tax research tools, and AI tools preferred

**Job Description**

Role Summary

We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented
**Contract Engineer**
to support contract administration, commercial management, claims evaluation, and contractual compliance for construction and infrastructure projects. The role involves managing contract documentation, reviewing contractual obligations, administering variations, and coordinating with project stakeholders to ensure compliance with contract requirements and successful project delivery.

Key Responsibilities

* Review and administer construction contracts, subcontracts, consultancy agreements, and work orders.
* Monitor compliance with contractual terms, obligations, deliverables, and project milestones.
* Prepare, review, and maintain contractual correspondence, notices, and documentation.
* Support the management of variations, change orders, and contract amendments.
* Assist in the evaluation and preparation of contractor and subcontractor claims.
* Review requests for extensions of time (EOT) and support delay analyses.
* Maintain contract registers, risk logs, variation trackers, and commercial records.
* Coordinate with project, procurement, legal, commercial, and site teams on contractual matters.
* Track key contractual deliverables, payment milestones, and obligations.
* Assist in preparing commercial reports, contract status updates, and management dashboards.
* Support tendering activities, bid evaluations, and contract award documentation.
* Identify contractual risks and propose mitigation measures.
* Participate in negotiations with contractors, vendors, and consultants on contract-related matters.
* Ensure compliance with company procedures, project requirements, and contractual frameworks.
* Support dispute avoidance and resolution activities through documentation and contract administration.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Quantity Surveying, or related discipline.
* Postgraduate qualification in Contracts Management, Commercial Management, or Construction Law will be an added advantage.

  **FIDIC**
